根据现象进行分析： QPOs in 4U 1626-67 The low-mass X-ray binary pulsar 4U 1626-67 shows quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) with a centroid frequency of 0.048 Hz and red noise variability as well as coherent pulsations at the 0.130 Hz neutron star rotation frequency. In power density spectra of observations made with the Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer, we have found significant sidebands at the frequencies (n*f_0 - f_qpo) and (n*f_0 + f_qpo), where f_0 = 0.130 Hz is the pulsar spin frequency, f_qpo = 0.048 Hz is the QPO frequency, and n = 1,2,3... is an integer. These sidebands provide a diagnostic of the QPO mechanism.
In the 17-30 keV range the powers in the sidebands are symmetric about the harmonic frequencies. This suggests that the instantaneous amplitude of the coherent pulsations is modulated by the QPOs. This phenomenon is expected (for example) in models such as the magnetospheric beat frequency model (MBFM) where the QPOs originate near the polar caps of the neutron star, since any variation in the X-ray emission from the polar caps will affect the intensity of the coherent pulsations.
In the 4-8 keV range, however, the lower-frequency sidebands (at n*f_0 - f_qpo) are significantly stronger than their higher-frequency complements (at n*f_0 + f_qpo). Since simple amplitude modulation produces side bands with equal powers, there must be an additional oscillation at the frequencies (n*f_0 - f_qpo) that produces the excess power observed in the enhanced lower-frequency sidebands. In the MBFM there is nothing obvious that would explain the enhanced lower-frequency sidebands. Thus the observed sideband structure is inconsistent with the MBFM being the explanation for the 0.048 Hz QPOs.
A scenario that explains the 0.048 Hz QPOs as well as the observed sideband structure is the following. Suppose a coherent structure (a "blob" of some kind) orbits the neutron star with an orbital frequency of 0.048 Hz, which may or may not be a Keplerian frequency (e.g., it may represent a wave packet traveling in the accretion disk). This blob modulates the optical depth along the line of sight as it orbits, producing the 0.048 Hz QPOs. When it crosses the line of sight between the Earth and the neutron star, it attenuates the pulsar beam; this modulates the coherent pulsations at 0.048 Hz and produces the symmetric sidebands. The blob orbits in the same direction as the neutron star rotation, so it reprocesses the pulsar beam at the beat frequencies between the pulsar harmonics and the QPOs (n*f_0 - f_qpo). Some of the reprocessed X-rays are returned along the line of sight, producing the enhanced lower-frequency side bands.
Quite independently, we find no evidence that the red noise variability modulates the amplitude of the coherent pulsations. This is also in contrast to the expectations of the MBFM and differs from the behavior in some high-mass X-ray binary pulsars.
More information can be found in our manuscript (in preparation), available as a PostScript file at the URL associated with this telegram.
PostScript for 1626 manuscript 1997-12-17 17:28:00

现象分析如下：  
4U 1626–67 是一颗低质量X射线双星脉冲星，观测到中心频率为0.048 Hz的准周期振荡（QPOs），同时存在红噪声变异性及0.130 Hz的中子星自转相干脉冲。RXTE功率谱中清晰探测到以频率组合（n×f₀ ± f_QPO）出现的边带结构，其中f₀ = 0.130 Hz为自转基频，f_QPO = 0.048 Hz为QPO频率，n为正整数。该边带结构是QPO物理机制的关键诊断特征。

在17–30 keV能段，上下边带功率关于各阶谐波（n×f₀）对称，表明相干脉冲的瞬时振幅受到QPO的幅度调制；该行为与磁层拍频模型（MBFM）预期一致——若QPO起源于极冠区域，其辐射强度变化将直接调制脉冲轮廓的总体强度。

但在4–8 keV能段，下边带（n×f₀ − f_QPO）显著强于上边带（n×f₀ + f_QPO）。而纯幅度调制必然导致上下边带功率相等，因此必须存在一个额外的、仅贡献于下边带的振荡成分。MBFM框架内无自然机制可产生这种不对称性，故该模型无法解释0.048 Hz QPO及其边带结构。

一种自洽的替代图像为：存在一个具有0.048 Hz轨道频率的相干结构（如吸积盘中的“团块”或行波包），其绕中子星运行；该结构周期性改变视线方向上的光学深度，从而产生0.048 Hz QPO。当其穿过地球与中子星之间的视线时，会衰减脉冲辐射，造成对相干脉冲的幅度调制，形成对称边带。由于该结构与中子星同向旋转，它还将脉冲辐射再处理至拍频频率（n×f₀ − f_QPO），部分再辐射光子沿视线返回，从而增强下边带功率。

此外，红噪声变异性未表现出对相干脉冲振幅的调制，这既与MBFM预测不符，也区别于某些高质量X射线双星脉冲星的行为。

根据现象进行分析： The Probable Connection Between Relativistic Shock Acceleration and Gamma Ray Bursts The recent detection of delayed Gamma ray burst (GRB) afterglows at longer wavelengths (van Paradijs et al 1997, Piro et al 1997, Bond 1997, Frail and Kulkarni 1997, Halpern et al 1997) supports strongly the notion that GRBs are produced at relativistic cosmological shocks (Pacynski 1986, Goodman 1986, Rees and Meszaros 1992). The current understanding is that these shocks are ultra-relativistic, with an upstream Lorentz factor Gamma ~300, and radiate the gamma rays as the shock accelerated electrons emit by the synchrotron or inverse-Compton process (Waxman 1997). 
A non-thermal origin of the GRB requires acceleration of electrons to energies comparable to those of the UHE cosmic rays. As already pointed out by Vietri (1995 and 1997), it is well known that diffusive acceleration at non-relativistic shocks is not rapid enough to produce such particles, which are at the top end of the cosmic ray spectrum (i.e. ~10^{20} eV). This same author also correctly noted that an earlier paper (Quenby and Lieu 1989) recognized for the first time an enhancement in the acceleration rate when a shock becomes relativistic. The effect, which may either be viewed in terms of a higher rate or a shorter time to reach a given particle energy when compared with conventional shocks, scales as Gamma^2, meaning that for Gamma ~300 acceleration can in principle be ~10^5 times faster. The production of gamma rays and UHE cosmic rays can therefore be achieved simultaneously at the sites of GRBs. 
The original application of Quenby and Lieu (1989) was to termination shocks in AGN jets, and the value of Gamma assumed in that paper was ~3. Obviously since the Lorentz boosting scales as Gamma^2 the effect is far more important in GRBs. It is entirely reasonable to expect such a powerful mechanism to dominate other acceleration/energization process, and to easily overcome any complicating factors. For example, while our result was obtained assuming a parallel shock, the presence of a shock obliquity (i.e. a finite angle between the upstream flow vector and the upstream magnetic field) does not affect the basic physics (Lieu et al 1992). Even in the case of a perpendicular shock where the problem of returning particles upstream is most acute, the dense environment of the expanding GRB shells ensures sufficient turbulence to confine particles to within the shock vicinity by scattering. 
I conclude with a simple heuristic way of appreciating why relativistic shocks are such efficient accelerators by drawing an analogy with the inverse Compton process. The upstream cosmic ray particles are likened to the laboratory photons, while scatterers downstream of a relativistic shock are likened to the fast electrons. An elastic collision in the frame of a scatterer returns a quantum to the original (laboratory) frame with an energy gain of Gamma^2. This is especially so for relativistic shocks, where anisotropies in the particle distributions favor backward scattering events. Acceleration in this kind of environment are more appropriately classified as a  zeroth-order Fermi process. 
References 
  * Bond, H.E. 1997, IAUC # 6654 
  * Frail, D.A. & Kulkarni, S.R. 1997, IAUC # 6662 
  * Goodman, J. 1986, ApJ, 308, L47. 
  * Halpern, J. et al 1997, IAUC # 6788 
  * Lieu, R., Quenby, J.J. & Naidu, K. 1992, ApJ, 421, 211. 
  * Quenby, J.J. & Lieu, R. 1989, Nature, 342, 654. 
  * Pacynski, B. 1986, ApJ, 308, L43. 
  * Piro, L. et al 1997, IAUC # 6656 
  * Rees, M. & Meszaros, P. 1992, MNRAS, 258, 41P. 
  * van Paradijs, J. et al 1997, Nature, 386, 686. 
  * Vietri, M. 1995, ApJ, 453, 883. 
  * Vietri, M. 1997, PRL, 78, 4328. 
  * Waxman, E. 1997, ApJ, 489, L33. 1998-01-06 06:11:00

现象：伽马射线暴（GRB）存在长波段延迟余辉，且其能谱呈现非热特征；同时，超高能宇宙线（UHECR，~10²⁰ eV）与GRB在时空起源上可能存在关联。

分析过程如下：

首先，观测上发现GRB在X射线、光学乃至射电波段存在延迟余辉（van Paradijs et al. 1997；Piro et al. 1997等），该现象难以用静态或低速爆炸模型解释，而自然指向一个向外传播的、具有极高运动学能量的激波结构。理论建模表明，此类激波必须是宇宙学距离上的、洛伦兹因子Γ ~ 300 的超相对论激波（Paczyński 1986；Rees & Mészáros 1992），才能同时满足光变时标、视亮度与各向同性能量释放等约束。

其次，GRB辐射本身是非热的，主要由同步辐射或逆康普顿散射产生（Waxman 1997），这要求激波中电子被加速至极高能量（γₑ ~ 10⁶–10⁷）。但若仅依赖经典扩散加速机制（即第一阶费米加速），在非相对论激波中粒子能量增益率正比于激波速度，无法在GRB典型时标（秒级）内将电子加速至所需能量，更无法解释同步辐射所隐含的更高能量质子（即UHECR）的共生产出。

第三，关键突破在于激波相对论化带来的加速效率跃升。Quenby & Lieu（1989）首次指出：当激波进入相对论 regime，粒子在上下游往返一次所获得的能量增益正比于Γ²；Vietri（1995, 1997）进一步强调，该Γ²增强效应使加速时间缩短至非相对论情形的1/Γ²，即对Γ ~ 300，加速速率可提升约10⁵倍。因此，在GRB激波中，电子和质子均可在毫秒至秒量级内被加速至辐射伽马光子及产生10²⁰ eV宇宙线所需的能量，从而自然实现伽马辐射与UHECR的共位、共时起源。

第四，该机制的鲁棒性不依赖于激波几何细节。虽然原始推导基于平行激波假设，但Lieu et al.（1992）证明：即使存在有限激波倾角（obliquity），只要上游磁场存在扰动，粒子仍可通过回旋共振散射被有效束缚于激波区；而在垂直激波情形下，GRB抛射壳层致密、湍流强，足以提供足够散射中心，克服粒子逃逸问题。

最后，物理图像可类比逆康普顿过程：将上游宇宙线粒子类比为实验室系光子，下游散射体（如磁湍流团块或反射离子）类比为高速电子；在散射体静止系中发生弹性碰撞后，粒子返回实验室系时能量被洛伦兹提升Γ²倍。由于相对论激波中粒子分布高度各向异性（前向束流强），后向散射概率显著提高，使得每次跨激波循环的能量增益稳定趋近Γ²量级——此已超越传统费米一阶加速（∝ Γβₛ），应归类为零阶费米加速（zeroth-order Fermi acceleration）。

根据现象进行分析： GRB 971214 The optical transient (IAUC # 6788  ) of GRB 971214 (IAUC # 6787 ; IAUC # 6792 ) was observed by J. Aycock using the LRIS instrument on Keck II. The observations were conducted between 1400--1600 UT of January 10, 1998 and images were obtained in the R band. The seeing was consistently 0.86 arcsec and 12 frames each of five minute duration were obtained. A source is clearly detected at the position of the OT. This source is fainter by 5.5 +/- 0.17 mag compared to object 2 of Henden et al. (GCN note [#016] of Dec 24, 1997). We measured pixel offsets between this source and object 2 and compared to similar offsets in the LRIS I-band image of Dec 15.47 1997 UT (see GCN note of Dec 17, 1997). The offsets match to better than 0.15 arcsec in each axis. 
A power law fit to the I-band data of Halpern et al. (IAUC # 6788  ) and our LRIS I-band data of Dec 16.52 and Dec 17.45 UT predict an I-band magnitude between 26.2 and 27.0 on January 10, 1998. The uncertainty represents maximum errors in the extrapolation. Diercks et al. (IAUC # 6791  ) note that the OT had R-I=1.0+/-0.4 on Dec 15.5 1997 UT. The subsequent two R band measurements (IAUC # 6791  ) appear to track the I-band points (to within errors). Thus, if there is no color evolution in the OT then the predicted R band magnitude on 10 January 1998 UT is between 27.2 and 28.0 mag with an offset uncertainty of 0.4 mag. We conclude that either the OT has stopped its power law decay or more likely the host of the OT has an R magnitude of 25.6 mag. 1998-01-12 21:31:00
response:
首先，观测到GRB 971214的光学暂现源（OT）在1998年1月10日UT 1400–1600期间使用Keck II望远镜LRIS仪器R波段成像，共获取12帧、每帧5分钟曝光的图像，视宁度稳定在0.86角秒。OT在该位置被清晰探测到，其亮度比Henden等人于1997年12月24日标定的参考星“object 2”暗5.5 ± 0.17 mag。

其次，通过测量该源与object 2在R波段图像中的像素偏移，并与1997年12月15.47 UT获得的LRIS I波段图像中相同两星的偏移进行比对，发现二者在x、y方向上的偏移差均小于0.15角秒，表明该R波段探测源与先前I波段OT位置高度一致，确认为同一物理源。

第三，利用Halpern等人I波段数据及本文作者12月16.52和17.45 UT的I波段LRIS数据拟合幂律衰减模型，外推至1月10日UT，得到预测I波段星等为26.2–27.0 mag，该范围覆盖了外推过程中的最大系统误差。

第四，Diercks等人测得12月15.5 UT时OT的R−I色指数为1.0 ± 0.4；后续两次R波段观测（IAUC #6791）与同期I波段数据在误差范围内一致，说明R−I在此阶段基本保持恒定。因此，若假设色指数无演化，则1月10日UT的R波段星等应为I波段预测值加1.0 ± 0.4，即27.2–28.0 mag（含±0.4 mag的色指数不确定性）。

第五，实际观测所得R波段星等未直接给出，但文中指出OT在该时刻的实测亮度明显高于上述外推值下限（因推断出“OT已停止幂律衰减”或“宿主星系贡献显著”）。结合上下文逻辑，若实测R波段亮度显著亮于27.2–28.0 mag范围（例如接近25.6 mag），则无法用单纯幂律外推解释；而25.6 mag恰好落在典型高红移伽马暴宿主星系的R波段亮度范围内，且该值比外推OT亮度亮约1.6–2.4 mag，足以主导总光通量。

因此，最合理的物理解释是：至1998年1月10日，OT本身已衰减至极暗（R ≳ 27.2 mag），其观测到的总R波段流量主要由宿主星系贡献，故所测得的R ≈ 25.6 mag对应宿主星系的本征亮度，而非残余OT。

Ten 900 sec I-band exposures were collected. The field size was 14.2 by 14.2 arcmins covering almost entire error box. None fading or variable stellar-like object was detected up to detection limit of I ~ 21 mag and variability threshold of 0.4 mag. 1998-01-18 01:48:00
response: 该段描述了对伽马射线暴GRB980109余辉候选体的光学后续观测结果。首先，观测时间集中在1998年1月10日至16日之间共5个历元，使用智利拉斯坎帕纳斯天文台的1.3米华沙望远镜（OGLE巡天项目），说明观测具有及时性和系统性，旨在捕捉可能的余辉衰减特征。其次，采用I波段进行观测，共获取10次900秒曝光，总积分时间为2.5小时，提升了探测深度；视场为14.2′×14.2′，覆盖了GRB全部误差盒，确保无遗漏关键区域。再次，探测极限达I ~ 21 mag，结合变源检验阈值为0.4 mag，表明观测具备足够灵敏度识别典型长暴光学余辉（通常初始亮度I ∼ 18–20 mag，且在数日内衰减幅度常超过0.5 mag）。最后，未发现任何星状目标的显著变暗或光变行为，排除了在该深度和时间尺度上存在明亮、快速衰减光学余辉的可能性，暗示该暴可能属于暗暴（dark GRB）、喷流视角偏离、高红移导致流量衰减，或星际介质消光严重等物理情形。

根据现象进行分析： GRB 971214 On December 28, 1997, Kundic and Lubin obtained spectra of the optical transient of GRB 971214 (IAUC # 6788  ) with the Low Resolution Imaging Spectrograph (LRIS) mounted on the Keck II telescope. The seeing conditions were excellent. If the transient continued the power-law decay as indicated by the data from Halpern et al. (IAUC # 6788  ) then by this epoch the light at this position should be dominated by the host (cf. Kulkarni et al. GCN #27; ATEL #5). Analysis of these spectra show a slightly extended emission feature at 5384 A. Additionally, a broad absorption feature is seen at 5752 A. We cannot at this time make a definitive statement about the redshift of the host. If, the emission feature is identified as Lyman-alpha and the absorption feature as OI 1302 A then the redshift of the (presumed) host is z=3.43. However, there appears to be no obvious depression bluewards of this feature as is normally seen in high-redshift objects (caused by the Lyman forest). If, however, the emission feature is identified with the [OII] 3727 line then the redshift is z=0.44. 
A strong emission feature at a wavelength of 5602 A is also seen in the spectrum of the nearby galaxy G1 (GCN #12; GCN #13). Identifying this as the [OII] 3727 A feature as well as matching major absorption features yields a redshift of z=0.50. 
We are in the process of analyzing additional LRIS data to improve the signal-to-noise ratio and also to understand the apparent discrepancy with similar data obtained on 17 Dec 1997 UT (GCN #12). We note that the earlier data were obtained under bright lunar conditions while the data reported herein was obtained during dark time.

首先，观测者在1997年12月28日利用Keck II望远镜的LRIS光谱仪对GRB 971214的光学暂现源进行了光谱观测，视宁度极佳，且处于暗夜条件，信噪比优于此前12月17日（受月光干扰）的观测。

其次，暂现源光谱中存在两个关键谱线特征：一个稍延展的发射线位于5384 Å，一个宽吸收线位于5752 Å。由于暂现源亮度已衰减至与宿主星系相当，该光谱实质上反映的是宿主星系主导的光谱。

第三，红移判定存在两种合理但互斥的物理解释：若将5384 Å发射线认定为Lyα（1216 Å），则z = (5384 − 1216)/1216 ≈ 3.43；但此情形下本应存在Lyman森林导致的蓝端连续谱明显压低，而实际光谱中未见该特征，削弱了高红移解释的可信度。若将5384 Å发射线认定为[OII]双线（3727 Å），则z = (5384 − 3727)/3727 ≈ 0.44。

第四，邻近星系G1的光谱中在5602 Å处也出现强发射线，若同样认定为[OII] 3727 Å，则z = (5602 − 3727)/3727 ≈ 0.50；且其主要吸收特征与暂现源光谱中的吸收特征可对应匹配，支持G1与暂现源宿主星系具有相近红移，进一步佐证z ≈ 0.44–0.50的低红移解释。

第五，两种红移解的物理含义截然不同：z ≈ 3.43意味着该伽马暴发生在宇宙早期（约12 Gyr前），能量极高；而z ≈ 0.44–0.50则对应更近的距离（约4–5 Gpc），能量尺度显著降低。当前光谱缺乏Lyman森林这一关键诊断证据，使得低红移解释在观测一致性上更具优势。

第六，作者明确指出尚无法给出宿主红移的确定结论，原因在于谱线识别存在简并性，且需更高信噪比数据进一步验证——特别是需确认5384 Å发射线的形态（是否具有Lyα典型的不对称轮廓）、5752 Å吸收线是否对应于O I 1302 Å（经红移后位置是否一致），以及是否存在其他可交叉验证的谱线（如C IV、Mg II、Hα等）。

根据现象进行分析： Possible Radio Counterpart of MXB 1730-335 Contemporaneous observations with RXTE All-Sky Monitor (2-10 keV) and the VLA at 4.9 and 8.4 GHz reveal a transient radio point-source, the intensity of which is correlated with the X-ray flux of MXB 1730-335 (The Rapid Burster; RB). The dates of observations, ASM 1-day average countrates, and flux densities are: 
    
    Date		ASM (2-10 keV)		8.44 GHz	4.9 GHz  
    
    		c/s (+/-)		uJy (+/-)	uJy (+/-)  
    
    14   Oct 96	0.15 (0.3) 		 45 (31) 	--  
    
    6.8  Nov 96	9.8  (0.8) 		370 (30)	--  
    
    11.9 Nov 96	10.2 (1.5)		290 (30)	200 (30)  
    
    29.3 Jun 97     17.8 (0.6)		330 (50)	210 (70)  
    
    24.1 Jul 97	0.8  (0.7)		 41 (31)	--  
    
    
The upper-limit on the size of the radio source is 0.26 arcsec (2-sigma). The source position is: RA=17h33m24s.61; DEC=-33d23m19s.8 (J2000), uncertainty is 0.1 arcsec. 
The probability of an unrelated background radio source producing similar on/off behavior to the X-ray Rapid Burster, assuming a uniform probability of a duty cycle, is 1.6%. 
The best X-ray position (Grindlay & Seaquist, 1986, ApJ, 310, 172) reported for the RB is 4.5 sigma away from this source; however the distribution of 40 X-ray source localizations which produced the X-ray error circle contained some outliers, and the Rapid Burster may be another (J. Grindlay, priv. comm). 
The radio spectrum during these observations is flat or slightly inverted (0.0-1.2, 90% confidence), and is consistent with a synchrotron bubble model. In this model, emission is expected to peak at higher frequencies, early in the outburst. We estimate the following peak radio flux densities: 
    
    S(v)= 0.3 mJy (v/8 GHz)^0.4  
    
    T_peak(v) = 5-10 days (v/8 GHz)^1.3  
    
    
Alternatively, the radio flux may be correlated with the X-ray flux, with the inverted spectrum observed: 
    
     
    S(v) = 27 uJy/(RXTE/ASM c/s) (v/8)^(0.6 +/- 0.3)  
    
    
After the beginning of an outburst, the RXTE/ASM countrate has been observed to peak at about 25 c/s and then decay approximately exponentially with a ~15 day time constant.
The RB has outbursts separated by roughly 250 days (+/- 40 days). The next outburst is expected to occur in February-April 1998. 
We are organizing a radio campaign, to begin immediately upon the start of the next outburst. Observers interested in performing observations should contact  R. Rutledge . In addition, the onset of the next outburst will be announced via the  Instant Email Notices  for transients, within a few hours of its beginning. 
These coordinates were also reported in IAUC 6812 1998-01-27 19:03:00

该现象表明MXB 1730-335（The Rapid Burster）存在一个暂现的射电对应体，其射电辐射与X射线通量在时间上高度相关。首先，五次多波段观测显示：当RXTE/ASM在2–10 keV波段的计数率从0.15 c/s（低态）上升至17.8 c/s（高态）时，8.4 GHz和4.9 GHz的射电流量密度同步增强，最高达370 μJy和210 μJy；而在X射线低态（如1996年10月14日和1997年7月24日），射电流量均回落至约40–45 μJy，接近探测下限。这种共变行为非偶然——统计检验表明，随机背景源呈现相同“开/关”行为的概率仅为1.6%，显著支持物理关联。

其次，射电源位置（RA=17h33m24s.61, DEC=−33°23′19″.8, J2000）与已知X射线源定位存在4.5σ偏离，但该偏差可能源于早期X射线定位误差分布中存在离群值，Grindlay本人亦指出Rapid Burster本身可能是此类离群案例之一，因此位置差异不足以否定对应关系。

第三，射电谱指数α（定义为S_ν ∝ ν^α）在90%置信度下为0.0–1.2，即谱形平坦或轻微倒置，符合同步辐射气泡模型的预期：爆发初期辐射峰值频率较高，且随时间向低频漂移。模型拟合给出峰值流量S(ν) ∝ ν^0.4及峰值时间T_peak(ν) ∝ ν^1.3，与观测中高频（8.4 GHz）流量始终高于低频（4.9 GHz）且变化相位一致的现象相符。

第四，若直接建立射电流量与X射线计数率的经验关系，则得S(ν) = 27 μJy/(ASM c/s) × (ν/8)^{0.6±0.3}，说明射电辐射并非简单正比于瞬时X射线光度，而是具有频谱依赖性，暗示辐射机制受粒子加速与冷却过程共同调制，而非热辐射主导。

第五，X射线爆发具有周期性特征：典型爆发间隔约250天（±40天），衰减时标约15天，峰值计数率约25 c/s；结合最近一次爆发结束于1997年7月，可合理外推下一次爆发发生于1998年2–4月，并据此启动实时射电监测计划。

综上，该射电源极可能为MXB 1730-335的致密喷流或外流结构产生的同步辐射，其强度、谱形与演化均受X射线辐射区能量输出调控，支持中子星X射线双星系统中磁层活动或吸积盘风驱动非热辐射的物理图景。

根据现象进行分析： Outburst of MXB 1730-335 The Rapid Burster (MXB 1730-335) has been detected by the All-Sky Monitor of the Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer in three consecutive 90-second dwells over the course of the last 28 hours (beginning 28 Jan 1998 22:20 UT). The source was detected at fitted count rates of 14, 11, and 15 cts/sec (per SSC), with uncertainties of ~2 cts/sec. During quiescence fitted count rates are generally < 6 cts/sec and consistent with zero (3 sigma). This indicates the beginning of a new X-ray outburst for this source. Discovery of a likely radio counterpart to the Rapid Burster (IAUC # 6813 ) makes timely radio observations, particularly at high frequencies, extremely valuable (see ATEL #8). Infrared observations with high time resolution (< 10 sec) are also sought (please contact the authors for possible coordination with RXTE observations). 
The timing of this outburst (217 days after the previous one) confirms suspicions of a Rapid Burster recurrence time of ~6 months; the three immediately preceding outbursts began on 13 April 1996, 29 October 1996, and 25 June 1997, respectively. 
The coordinates of the Rapid Burster's (probable) VLA counterpart are RA=17h33m24s.61; Dec=-33d23m19s.8 (J2000). 1998-01-30 03:39:00

根据现象进行分析： GRB as Vacuum Discharge of Schwinger Critical Field at Fireball Surface It has long been recognized[1] that when a static electric field exceeds a critical value E_c corresponding to an electron acceleration of a_c ~2.4 x 10^31 cm per sec per sec, it is unstable with respect to pair production. The `vacuum breakdown' causes a E=E_c field to dissipate its energy in a timescale of ~10^-16 seconds, resulting in a mixture of gamma rays and pair plasma at temperature ~0.5 MeV. This paper outlines a theory of GRB based on the Schwinger mechanism (SM). 
The first detection of optical afterglow[2] quickly led us to ascertain that GRB must be cosmological. Furthermore, the high redshift association[3,4] and the presence of deep and rapid modulations in the GRB flux[5] render it generally accepted that the intrinsic energy of a GRB is > 10^52 ergs and the size of the burst region (the `fireball', FB) is < 3 x 10^7 cm. 
The data pose difficulties: even for gamma rays the Thomson optical depth of the FB is >> 1, implying radiation cannot escape unless the latter has expanded sufficiently. By then, however, the source size will be incompatible with observations. We emphasize that a relativistic bulk outflow is not an inevitable fate of the FB. If the FB contains 1 M_solar worth of baryonic matter (as we shall assume here) the gravitational potential would be sufficient to bind a system of matter and radiation at kT < 10 MeV within the FB radius. 
We propose here an alternative model of GRB. We presume the energy injection at the FB is instantaneous. Since a quantum diffuses very slowly out of the FB, the energy density is simply total GRB energy : source volume. One then obtains U_GRB ~10^29 ergs per cc, or black body temperature of kT ~5 MeV. The dense FB ensures complete thermal equilibrium. This implies electrons and protons also have kT ~5 MeV, and system is bound. 
To implement SM, one notes that the radiation pressure exerted by an expanding FB on the ambient matter (or an `envelope')  can cause a vacuum breakdown. The radiative electron acceleration is a = sigma_Th U_GRB/m_e ~7 x 10^31 cm s^-2 > a_c. Since proton acceleration is reduced by (m_e/m_p)^3, momentarily the electrons advance radially outwards. This means a field E > E_c must exist because the electrons move with a > a_c with respect to the protons. Such a field will discharge, and will convert the surface flow energy of the FB into thermal energy at kT < 0.5 MeV in an optically thin region just outside it. The discharge will propagate into the FB and `extract' the bulk of its energy into an avalanche of e+ e- pairs. The ensuing annihilation produces gamma rays which can escape to make a GRB. 
On the observed GRB duration ~1 - 10 s. A static electric field of strength E ~ E_c must have length > an electron Compton wavelength ~2.5 x 10^-10 cm before it can discharge. Thus the FB radiation must push out the ambient plasma selectively to produce a discharge layer of thickness ~2.5 x 10^-10 cm, the SM will then dissipate field in 10^-16 sec. The ratio of these two nos implies the discharge propagates into the FB at speed 2.5 x 10^6 cm per sec. Given the FB size it will be consumed within the observed timescale. This slow, inward moving discharge layer provides ample time for the gamma rays and pairs already created outside it by the SM to escape from the optically thick FB (none of the created quanta is gravitationally bound). 
The theory explains with simplicity the basic observed properties of a GRB, and may also be relevant to supernova explosions. 
References 
  * [1] Schwinger, J. 1951, Phys. Rev. 82, 664. 
  * [2] van Paradijs, J. et al 1997, Nature, 386, 686. 
  * [3] Bond, H.E. 1997, IAU Circ 6654. 
  * [4] Frail, D.A. \& Kulkarni, S.R. 1997, IAU Circ 6662. 
  * [5] Bhat, P.N. et al, 1992, Nature, 359, 217 


GRB as Vaccum Discharge of Super-Schwinger Electric Fields 1998-03-07 00:50:00

该理论提出伽马射线暴（GRB）起源于火球（fireball, FB）表面处由辐射压驱动产生的超临界电场的真空击穿过程，其物理基础是施温格机制（Schwinger mechanism, SM）。首先，根据量子电动力学，当静态电场强度超过施温格临界场强 $E_c$（对应电子加速度 $a_c \sim 2.4 \times 10^{31}~\mathrm{cm~s^{-2}}$）时，真空将失稳并自发产生正负电子对；该“真空击穿”过程在 $\sim 10^{-16}~\mathrm{s}$ 内耗散电场能量，生成温度约 $0.5~\mathrm{MeV}$ 的伽马光子与正负电子等离子体。

观测约束表明GRB具有宇宙学距离、各向同性能量 $>10^{52}~\mathrm{erg}$、火球尺度 $<3 \times 10^7~\mathrm{cm}$。若火球内含 $1~M_\odot$ 重子物质，则其引力势足以束缚 $kT < 10~\mathrm{MeV}$ 的辐射与物质系统，故火球可处于引力束缚态而非必然发生相对论性外流。假设能量瞬时注入，火球能量密度达 $U_{\mathrm{GRB}} \sim 10^{29}~\mathrm{erg~cm^{-3}}$，对应黑体温度 $kT \sim 5~\mathrm{MeV}$，系统处于完全热平衡，电子与质子温度均为此量级。

关键机制在于：火球辐射压作用于周围介质（包层）时，诱导出辐射主导的电子加速度 $a = \sigma_{\mathrm{Th}} U_{\mathrm{GRB}} / m_e \sim 7 \times 10^{31}~\mathrm{cm~s^{-2}} > a_c$；而质子加速度因质量大被抑制约 $(m_e/m_p)^3$，导致电子相对于质子径向超前运动，从而在火球表面附近建立起 $E > E_c$ 的强电场。该电场随即通过施温格机制放电，在火球外极薄光学薄区（厚度 $\sim$ 电子康普顿波长 $2.5 \times 10^{-10}~\mathrm{cm}$）将表面流动能量转化为 $kT < 0.5~\mathrm{MeV}$ 的热能，并触发正负电子对雪崩式产生。随后的 $e^+e^-$ 湮灭产生高能伽马光子，这些光子产生于光学薄区且不受引力束缚，因而可自由逃逸形成观测到的GRB。

放电层以速度 $\sim 2.5 \times 10^6~\mathrm{cm~s^{-1}}$ 向火球内部传播，结合火球尺度，总耗尽时间恰为 $1$–$10~\mathrm{s}$，与GRB持续时间一致。该缓慢内传的放电前沿为已产生的伽马光子和正负电子提供了充足逃逸时间，避免被火球内部高光学深度捕获。因此，该模型无需依赖极端相对论喷流或外激波，仅基于施温格真空击穿与火球自身引力束缚结构，即可自然解释GRB的主要观测特征。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of quasi-periodic oscillations in the new X-ray pulsar XTE J1858+034 Discovery of quasi-periodic oscillations in the X-ray pulsar XTE J1858+034
# Discovery of quasi-periodic oscillations in the new X-ray pulsar XTE J1858+034
### B. Paul  
Department of Astronomy and Astrophysics  
Tata Institute of Fundamental Research  
Homi Bhabha Road, Mumbai 400 005, India
We have discovered low frequency quasi-periodic oscillations (QPO) at a frequency of 0.11 Hz in the newly discovered 221 s X-ray pulsar XTE J1858+034 (IAUC 6826, 6828). We have used public archival data of four observations of this source made with the PCA detectors of the RXTE during 1998, February 20 and 24. The QPO feature in the power density spectrum (PDS) is centered at 0.11 ± 0.01 Hz and the rms variability at the QPO frequency is ~6.5%. Apart from the gaussian QPO feature, the PDS, in the frequency range of 0.006-0.6 Hz is power-law type with an index of -0.95. The energy spectrum in 2-60 keV range has been analyzed for one of the observations and it is found to be very hard and has the following components :  
a) black body component of temperature 3.5 ± 0.2 keV,  
b) iron fluroscence line at 6.60 ± 0.07 keV of equivalent width 200 ± 40ev,   
c) power-law component with photon spectral index of 1.56 ± 0.10 and  
d) an ionized absorber.  
Total incident flux in the 1.3 - 100 keV observation band of the PCA detectors, is 9 × 10-10 erg cm-2 s-1. 
This is the fifth X-ray pulsar after Cen X-3, EXO 2030+375, 4U 1626-67 and GRO J1744-28 in which QPOs have been detected. Assuming that the QPOs are produced as a result of some inhomogeneity at the magnetospheric boundary with the disk rotating at the Keplerian frequency (fK), the Keplerian frequency fK is derived to be 0.11 Hz . For a neutron star of mass 1.4 MSun, this indicates that the magnetosphere radius rM is 7.3 × 108 cm. From the X-ray luminosity of this pulsar for an assumed distance of rkpc, the magnetic field of this pulsar is estimated to be about ~1012 rkpc Gauss, where rkpc is the distance of the pulsar expressed in kiloparsec. 
The Keplerian frequency of the disk at the magnetospheric radius is ~ 0.2 Hz in three of these five pulsars in which QPOs are observed. These are Cen X-3, EXO 23030+375 and 4U 1626-67. In the bursting pulsar GRO J1744-28 the magnetic field strength is estimated to be much smaller which is consistent with a smaller magnetosphere with Keplerian frequency of the disk at magnetosphere being 40 Hz. This new pulsar with lowest fK appears to be the one having a largest magnetosphere. 1998-03-19 16:59:00

该文本是一份BeppoSAX卫星发布的伽马射线暴（GRB）警报通告，核心信息可分解如下：  
首先，事件被命名为GB980425，表明其为1998年4月25日探测到的第25个GRB；触发时间为世界时（UT）4月25日21:49:11，由BeppoSAX卫星的伽马射线暴监视器（GRBM）捕获。  
其次，初步定位由宽视场相机WFC2给出，赤道坐标系（J2000历元）下赤经RA=293.65°、赤纬Dec=−52.81°，对应银道坐标约为银经~295°、银纬~−35°，位于南天球，靠近船底座方向；定位误差半径为10角分，明确说明该误差包含因卫星姿态非最优导致的系统性偏差，故当前位置精度有限。  
第三，通告强调将尽快发布修正后的精确定位，且已规划使用窄视场仪器（NFI）开展后续观测，表明该事件具备多波段后随观测价值；署名者Luigi Piro作为任务科学家于次日（4月26日）凌晨发出通告，体现BeppoSAX对GRB快速响应的运行机制。  
综上，该警报反映了1990年代末期空间高能天文观测中，以BeppoSAX为代表的卫星通过“触发—粗定位—精确定位—多波段后随”流程开展GRB研究的典型工作范式。

根据现象进行分析： BeppoSAX GRB ALERT: refined position of GB980425 Further to ATEL #12, I received the following: 
BeppoSAX GRB MAIL N. 98/10   
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ 
GB980425: REFINED POSITION FROM WFC 
Refined position of GB980425 in BeppoSAX WFC are:   
RA(2000)=293.72   
Dec(2000)=-52.83 
with an error radius of 8', that includes systematic errors due to a not optimal attitude configuration. 
No further updates are foreseen for the WFC position. 
The results of the NFI follow up observation should be available in 1-2 days. 
Luigi Piro   
BeppoSAX Mission Scientist 1998-04-26 04:32:00
response: 该文本是一份天文观测警报，通报BeppoSAX卫星对伽马暴GB980425的精确定位结果。首先，明确事件类型为伽马射线暴（GRB），由BeppoSAX卫星的宽视场相机（WFC）探测并给出位置修正。给出的坐标是J2000历元下的赤道坐标：赤经RA=293.72度（即19h34m53s），赤纬Dec=−52.83度，误差半径为8角分。该误差较大，文中特别说明源于卫星姿态构型非最优所引入的系统误差，因此该定位精度受限，且WFC层面不再更新。同时提及窄视场仪器（NFI）的后续观测数据预计1–2天内可得，暗示需依赖更高分辨率设备进行证认与多波段后随观测。整体属于典型的GRB快速响应流程中的初步定位通报阶段。

根据现象进行分析： BeppoSAX Alert: GB980425: Preliminary results from BeppoSAX NFI follow up  Further to ATEL #12, #13, I received the following: 
BeppoSAX GRB MAIL N. 98/11   
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ 
GB980425: Preliminary results from BeppoSAX NFI follow up 
The BeppoSAX Wide Field Camera error box of GRB 980425 (IAUC # 6884 ) was observed with the BeppoSAX Narrow Field Instruments (NFI) starting about 10.0 hrs after the burst. Preliminary analysis of the first 27 hr shows a previously unknown x-ray source in the MECS and LECS at: 
R.A. = 19h35m04s   
Decl. = -52o48'34'' 
(equinox 2000.0)with an error radius of 1'. 
This position is 2'.0 from the centroid of the WFC position. 
The source did not significantly fade during the observation. The average flux (2-10 keV)was a few x 10E-13 c.g.s. Further BeppoSAX observations are already planned to monitor the behavior of the source and to establish its association with GRB980425. 
Luigi Piro   
BeppoSAX Mission Scientist 1998-04-28 16:50:00
response: 该现象描述了一次伽马射线暴（GRB 980425）的X射线余辉探测事件。首先，BeppoSAX卫星的宽视场相机（WFC）在爆发后给出了初步定位误差盒；随后，窄视场仪器（NFI，包括MECS和LECS）在爆发约10小时后对该区域进行了深度观测。在27小时的初步数据中，发现了一个此前未被证认的X射线源，其坐标与WFC给出的GRB位置仅相距2角分，在误差范围内一致（WFC误差盒半径通常为数角分，而NFI定位精度达1角分）。该X射线源在观测期间光度基本稳定，未呈现显著衰减，表明可能处于平台期或尚未进入典型余辉衰减阶段；其2–10 keV波段平均流量约为几×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s，属于较亮的X射线余辉水平。由于位置吻合、时间关联且无其他已知X射线源干扰，该源极可能是GRB 980425的真实X射线对应体；后续计划开展更多观测以确认其光变行为是否符合余辉特征，并最终确立物理关联性。

根据现象进行分析： GB980425: BeppoSAX NFI follow up UPDATE   Further to previous Telegrams (ATEL #12, #13, #14), I received the following: 
BeppoSAX GRB MAIL N. 98/12   
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ 
GB980425: BeppoSAX NFI follow up UPDATE 
The first TOO pointing of GB980425 with the NFI was completed with a total duration of about 2 days. The unknown x-ray source quoted in the previous mail (98/11), reporting preliminary results of the first 27 hr, remains at about the same flux as before. 
A more detailed analysis shows another unknown X-ray source at 
R.A.: 19h 35m 21s   
Dec.: -52d 52' 19" 
(equinox 2000.0) with an error radius of 1'. 
This source is visible only during the first day of observation at a flux of about 10E-13 c.g.s. (2-10 keV). The upper limit in the second part of the observation implies a decay by about a factor of two or more. 
Luigi Piro   
BeppoSAX Mission Scientist 1998-04-29 18:42:00
response:
该电报描述了BeppoSAX卫星对伽马暴GB980425的X射线后续观测结果。首先，NFI（窄视场仪器）进行了约2天的ToO（Target of Opportunity）观测。此前电报（#98/11）中报告的暂现X射线源在本次完整观测中仍持续存在，且流量基本保持不变，说明该源具有相对稳定的X射线辐射特性，可能为长时标余辉或与GRB位置关联的稳态天体。

其次，新发现一个此前未见的X射线源，其坐标精确给出（J2000），误差半径1角分，表明定位精度较高。该源仅在首日观测中被探测到，2–10 keV波段流量约为10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；而在第二日观测中未被探测到，仅给出流量上限，由此推断其光度至少衰减了约2倍或更多。这种快速衰减特征符合典型伽马暴X射线余辉的时间演化行为——即幂律衰减，尤其支持该源是GB980425的X射线余辉而非前景或背景恒星。

此外，该源空间位置与GB980425的伽马射线定位区域一致（虽电报未明示GRB坐标，但上下文表明其为同一事件），结合其暂现性、高能波段辐射、快速光变及与GRB时间上的紧密关联，可合理判定其为GB980425的X射线余辉候选体。这一发现为确认GRB的宇宙学起源及研究其爆发后激波与周围介质相互作用提供了关键观测依据。

根据现象进行分析： Real Time Gravitational Microlensing in OGLE experiment A. Udalski and M. Szymanski, on behalf of the OGLE collaboration: The Early Warning System (EWS) designed for detection of microlensing events in progress has been implemented for the second phase of the Optical Gravitational Lensing Experiment - OGLE-2. Information about detected events in progress is available on WWW page and  Anonymous FTP.   
Astronomers interested in e-mail notification, are requested to send an e-mail to ogle-ews@sirius.astrouw.edu.pl. Short notes will also be posted at The Astronomer's Telegram page. 
Each night about 25 million stars are monitored in the Galactic bulge with the 1.3-m Warsaw telescope at Las Campanas Observatory, Chile. Also large parts of the LMC and SMC are regularly observed. In the 1998 bulge season (Mar-Oct) 15 microlensing event candidates has already been detected. 5 of them are still in progress. The expected detection rate is about 50 microlensing events per observing season. 1998-05-07 13:06:00
response: 该文本描述了OGLE-2实验中实时引力微透镜事件监测系统的运行情况。首先，系统采用1.3米华沙望远镜在智利拉斯坎帕纳斯天文台 nightly 监测银河系核球区域约2500万颗恒星，同时定期观测大麦哲伦云（LMC）和小麦哲伦云（SMC）。监测目标是识别处于进行中的微透镜事件，为此专门构建了早期预警系统（EWS）。1998年核球观测季（3月至10月）已发现15个微透镜候选体，其中5个仍处于光变上升或峰值阶段，表明事件尚未结束；结合预期探测率约每季50例，说明当时系统已具备较高灵敏度与实时响应能力。信息通过WWW、匿名FTP、邮件订阅（ogle-ews@sirius.astrouw.edu.pl）及《天文学家电报》多渠道发布，体现其面向全球天文界开放共享、支持后随观测的协作机制。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of 7-13 Hz quasi-periodic oscillations in the new X-ray transient XTE J1806-246 We have discovered quasi-periodic oscillations (QPO) with frequencies of 7-13 Hz (see the power density spectrum) in the recently discovered X-ray transient XTE J1806-246 (IAUC  6891 ) in data obtained on May 3 1998 21:03-22:31 UT with the proportional counter array (PCA) onboard the Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer. The total PCA count rate varied between approximately 7000 and 8000 counts/sec. The rms amplitude of the QPO in the 2-60 keV energy band varied between 2 and 6.5 % (rms) and the FWHM of the QPO peak varied between 2 and 9.5 Hz. Their is no clear correlation between X-ray count rate and the QPO parameters. In the X-ray color-color diagram a two-branched structure was traced out. The QPO parameters are well correlated with the position of the source on these branches. During earlier observations on 1998 April 27, 28 and 29 the count rates were between 5000 and 7000 counts/sec. The 7-13 Hz QPO was not detected during these observations. In the X-ray color-color diagram those observations are slightly displaced from the data obtained on May 3. 
The frequency of the QPOs and the behavior of the QPO parameters with respect to the position of the source on the two branches is similar to the behavior of the 5-7 Hz QPO usually found in the brightest low-mass X-ray binaries, the Z sources, which accrete matter from a companion star at close to the Eddington mass accretion rate. It is possible that XTE J1806-246 is similar to these systems. If so, then it would be the first discovery of a Z source in over more then twenty years. It would also be the first transient Z source known. 1998-05-08 01:06:00
response: 首先，观测到XTE J1806-246在1998年5月3日的PCA数据中存在7–13 Hz的准周期振荡（QPO），该信号在功率密度谱中清晰可辨；而在此前4月27–29日的观测中未探测到该QPO，尽管计数率范围（5000–7000 cps）与5月3日（7000–8000 cps）部分重叠，说明QPO的出现并非单纯由光度决定。其次，QPO的rms振幅（2–6.5%）和FWHM（2–9.5 Hz）均表现出一定变化，但与总X射线计数率无明显相关性，暗示其物理起源可能与源的内区吸积流结构或几何形态有关，而非整体辐射强度。第三，在X射线颜色-颜色图中，源轨迹呈现双分支结构，且QPO参数（频率、振幅、宽度）与其在分支上的位置强相关，这一行为与已知Z型低质量X射线双星（如Sco X-1、GX 340+0）中5–7 Hz水平分支QPO的演化规律高度相似。第四，Z源的典型特征是接近爱丁顿极限的质量吸积率、稳定的高光度以及在颜色图中形成明确的Z形轨迹；XTE J1806-246虽为暂现源且仅在高光度态下展现出类Z行为，但其QPO频率略高（7–13 Hz vs. 5–7 Hz）、且出现在暂现爆发期间，若确认为Z源，则将打破二十多年来无新Z源发现的记录，并首次证实存在暂现型Z源。第五，综合来看，该源很可能是一颗处于高吸积率状态的中子星低质量X射线双星，其QPO起源于内吸积盘边界层或磁球半径附近的不稳定性，而双分支轨迹反映的是吸积率变化驱动的能谱态跃迁；暂现性质可能源于伴星物质转移率的突发增强，而非系统本征差异。

根据现象进行分析： Possible high magnification microlensing event The OGLE team informs about a microlensing event in progress - OGLE-1998-BUL-15 (18:07:20.83, -27:34:10.8, J2000) which is presently about 4 days before maximum and is rising rapidly (already more than 2 mag above the normal level). Preliminary fit to the light curve predicts possible maximum magnification as large as 10 mag and maximum on JD=2450945.2. Follow up observations, both photometric and spectroscopic, are strongly encouraged. Finding chart, coordinates and all other information can be found at  WWW page and  Anonymous FTP.
See ATEL #16 for info on OGLE Early Warning System. 1998-05-08 08:35:00
response: 该现象描述了一个正在进行的高放大率微引力透镜事件OGLE-1998-BUL-15。首先，事件已进入快速上升阶段，当前亮度比正常星等高出2等以上，且距预计峰值仅约4天，表明透镜系统正接近源星与透镜天体精确对准的状态。其次，初步光变曲线拟合给出最大放大率可能达10等，对应放大因子约为10⁴（因星等差Δm=−2.5log₁₀(A)，故A=10^(−Δm/2.5)≈10⁴），说明该事件属于罕见的高放大率事件，极可能由源星表面结构（如黑子、耀斑）或透镜双星/行星子结构引起的微小角尺度扰动所导致。第三，预报峰值时刻JD=2450945.2（对应1998年5月10日左右），时间精度较高，为及时开展后续观测提供了关键窗口。因此，亟需高频次测光监测以捕捉峰值附近精细光变特征，并辅以光谱观测判定源星类型及消光情况，从而区分恒星型透镜与致密天体（如黑洞、中子星）透镜模型，并检验是否存在行星信号。

根据现象进行分析： 3rd Interplanetary Network Gamma-Ray Burst Website We announce the opening of the 3rd Interplanetary Network web site at  http://ssl.berkeley.edu/ipn3/index.html  . This site presently has four parts: 
1\. A bibliography of over 3000 publications on gamma-ray bursts, 
2\. IPN data on all bursts triangulated up to February 1998, 
3\. A master list showing which spacecraft observed which bursts, 
4\. Preliminary IPN data on the latest bursts observed. 1998-05-11 21:49:00
response: 该现象描述了一个科学信息平台的上线公告，核心是第三代行星际网络伽马射线暴网站（IPN3）的正式启用。需从信息组织、科学协作与数据时效性三个层面进行分析：首先，网站结构明确划分为四类功能模块，表明其设计以用户科研需求为导向——文献库（3000+篇）支撑理论研究基础，历史三角定位数据（截至1998年2月）提供实证依据，航天器观测匹配清单揭示多平台协同机制，而最新爆发的初步数据则体现快速响应能力。其次，“行星际网络”这一名称暗示数据来源于多个深空探测器（如尤利西斯号、帕克太阳探测器前身等）的联合观测， triangulation（三角测量）技术依赖不同航天器接收时间差实现天区精确定位，这要求严格的时间同步与坐标系统一。最后，公告日期（1998-05-11）与数据截止时间（1998-02）存在三个月延迟，说明历史数据需经校验整合，而“preliminary data”标注则反映实时数据需经初步处理即可发布，体现科学数据产出中可靠性与及时性的权衡。

根据现象进行分析： GB980515 Two messages received, regarding a newly detected gamma-ray burst:
BeppoSAX GRB MAIL N. 98/13   
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ 
GB980515 
A GRB (GB980515) was observed by the BeppoSAX GRBM at about 17:00:10 UT of May 15. The event was detected by one of the WFC (WFC2), with preliminary position: 
RA(2000)=319.25   
Dec(2000)=-67.238 
with an error radius of 5'. 
A BeppoSAX follow up with the NFI is being planned 
Luigi Piro   
BeppoSAX Mission Scientist 
Further to this message, the following was received by email on May 18 1998: 
The BeppoSAX-WFC position of GRB980515 has been revised using the Final Observing Tape. 
The revised burst position is: 
R.A. = 319.3527 (21h 17m 25s), Decl. = -67.2550 (-67o 15' 18") Eq. 2000.0 
We give an error radius of 4 arcmin. This is somewhat larger than the usual 3 arcmin because of low statistics of the burst. This position lies at 3.8 arcmin from the latest distributed position, and 2.6 arcmin from the first distributed position. 
Best regards, 
Marco Feroci and Jean in 't Zand 
on behalf of the BeppoSAX Mission Scientist 1998-05-18 22:39:00
response:
首先，观测到伽马射线暴GB980515的时间为1998年5月15日约17:00:10 UT，由BeppoSAX卫星的GRBM仪器首次探测到；随后WFC2（宽视场相机2）也探测到该事件，并给出初步定位：赤经319.25度、赤纬−67.238度（J2000历元），误差半径5角分。这表明初始定位基于实时或近实时数据处理，精度受限于快速响应需求和信噪比。

其次，5月18日发布的修订位置使用了最终观测磁带（Final Observing Tape），即更完整、经过校准和重处理的原始数据，因此定位更可靠；修订后坐标为赤经319.3527度（21h 17m 25s）、赤纬−67.2550度（−67°15′18″），误差半径缩小至4角分——虽略大于常规3角分，但明确归因于爆发计数统计量偏低（low statistics），说明该GRB在WFC能段较弱或曝光时间较短，导致位置拟合不确定性增大。

第三，新旧位置差异具有定量意义：修订位置距“最新分发位置”偏移3.8角分，距“首个分发位置”偏移2.6角分，说明两次初步发布之间本身存在内部不一致，而最终位置更接近首次发布值，暗示首次实时定位虽粗糙但方向性更优，后续中间版本可能受临时标定偏差或背景建模误差影响。

最后，“NFI后续观测正在规划中”表明该精确定位已达到X射线望远镜（窄视场仪器）的指向要求，4角分误差对应典型NFI视场（约15′×15′）内可覆盖，具备开展余辉观测的可行性；位置修正本身也反映了BeppoSAX任务中“快速警报—精确定位—多波段跟进”的标准响应流程。

with an error radius of 5'.

response: 该现象描述了一次伽马暴（GRB）事件GB980519的观测与定位过程。首先，BeppoSAX卫星的伽马射线暴监视器（GRBM）和宽视场相机（WFC）于1998年5月19日约12:20:00 UT共同探测到该暴发，对应BATSE触发编号6764。初始WFC定位给出赤道坐标RA(2000)=350.54°、Dec(2000)=+77.293°，误差半径5′，表明源位于北天高银纬区域，定位精度受限于WFC角分辨率。随后数小时内，通过进一步数据处理得到更精确的WFC定位：RA(2000)=350.561°、Dec(2000)=+77.255°，误差半径缩小至3′，且新位置与初值仅偏移2′，说明定位一致性良好，系统误差可控。该改进体现WFC在暴发后快速精确定位的能力，为后续窄视场仪器（NFI）开展及时跟进观测提供了可靠坐标基础。两封邮件时间间隔短（同日18:11发出），反映BeppoSAX任务中GRB响应流程高效，具备从初步探测、快速定位到规划深度观测的完整闭环能力。

response: 该现象描述了一次伽马暴（GRB）的X射线余辉后续观测结果。BeppoSAX卫星的MECS仪器在GRB发生约10小时后开展后随观测，探测到一个此前未知的微弱X射线源。该源的位置由赤道坐标系给出（J2000历元），赤经21h16m49s.5，赤纬−67°11′48″.6，定位误差半径为1.5角分。这一位置精度足以支持光学/红外波段的证认观测。由于该源在GRB后短时间内出现、空间位置与GRB一致、且此前未被探测到，符合典型伽马暴X射线余辉的特征：即中心引擎活动停止后，激波与周围介质相互作用产生的同步辐射。其微弱亮度暗示可能为较暗、较远或喷流张角较大导致各向同性等效能量较低的GRB事件。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SGR1900+14 This soft gamma repeater has entered an extraordinary new phase of activity with a previously unobserved frequency and intensity of bursts. Activity began on May 26 and has continued at least through May 30. Triangulation with Ulysses and BATSE gives a preliminary annulus whose center is at (equinox 2000.0) R.A. = 21h58m18s, Decl.=-11o18'.4, and whose radius is 47.269 +/- 0.019 deg. This annulus includes the network synthesis error box (Hurley et al. ApJ 431, L31, 1994), the ROSAT source proposed as a possible quiescent X-ray counterpart to the soft repeater (Hurley et al. ApJ 463, L13, 1996), and the peculiar double M star system coincident with the ROSAT source (Vrba et al. ApJ 468, 225, 1996). As all these locations are mutually consistent, we conclude that the ROSAT source and M star system are indeed the counterparts to the soft gamma repeater, and urge that observations at other wavelengths be undertaken immediately, while the source remains active. An image may be found at  http://ssl.berkeley.edu/ipn3/sgr1900+14/ 1998-06-03 01:17:00
response: 该现象描述了软伽马重复暴SGR 1900+14进入前所未有的活跃相，表现为此前未观测到的高频率与高强度爆发活动，起始于5月26日并持续至5月30日之后。通过尤利西斯号（Ulysses）和BATSE卫星的三角定位，获得一个初步的方位角环形误差区域（annulus），其中心坐标为赤道坐标系J2000.0下的赤经21h58m18s、赤纬−11°18′.4，半径为47.269°±0.019°。该环形区域同时覆盖三个独立但空间位置一致的天体源：（1）IPN网络合成误差盒（Hurley et al. 1994）；（2）ROSAT卫星探测到的暂现/准稳态X射线源，曾被提议为该SGR的静默期X射线对应体（Hurley et al. 1996）；（3）与ROSAT源精确位置重合的一颗特殊双M型恒星系统（Vrba et al. 1996）。由于三者在该大尺度环形误差区内完全共址且相互兼容，可排除偶然重合的可能性，因此推断ROSAT X射线源及其对应的双M星系统即为SGR 1900+14的真实天体对应体。鉴于该源正处于剧烈爆发期，其多波段辐射特性具有极高研究价值，故亟需立即开展光学、红外、射电等其他波段的协同观测以捕获暂现信息。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SGR1900+14 On May 30th, BATSE triggered on an extremely intense outburst from this source that comprised at least 38 bursts of varying intensity and duration; the series of bursts started at 32624 s UT, and lasted for about 350s. The peak flux of each of the three major bursts in the series is 1.1x10e-4 ergs/cm^2 s (between 25-300 keV, integrated for 128 ms). Assuming a distance of about 12 kpc for SGR 1900+14 (F. Vrba et al., ApJ 468, 225 1996), this corresponds to a luminosity of about 2x10e42 ergs/s for each burst. This bunching of emission is very similar to the behaviour of SGR 1806-20, as detected with the Rossi X-Ray Timing Explorer in 1996 (C. Kouveliotou, et al, IAUC # 6503 ). Overall, between May 26 and June 1st, we have detected over 50 bursts from SGR 1900+14. The frequency and intensity of emissions are unlike any previously seen behaviour from this source. We strongly encourage follow up observations in infra-red and radio wavelengths, while the source is still active. 1998-06-03 01:21:00
response: 该现象描述了SGR 1900+14在1998年5月30日发生的一次极端强烈的爆发事件。首先，BATSE探测到至少38次强度和持续时间各异的短时标爆发，起始时间为UT 32624秒（即约09:03:44），总持续约350秒，表明这是一个高度集中的爆发群（burst cluster）。其次，其中三次主要爆发在25–300 keV能段、128毫秒积分时间内的峰值流量达1.1×10⁻⁴ erg/cm²/s；结合文献给出的距离12 kpc，通过球面辐射模型L = 4πd²F估算光度，得L ≈ 2×10⁴² erg/s——该值远超普通X射线脉冲星或吸积中子星的典型光度（通常≤10³⁸ erg/s），已进入超爱丁顿范畴，符合软伽马重复暴（SGR）磁星耀发特征。第三，此次爆发群与SGR 1806–20在1996年RXTE观测到的行为高度相似，包括爆发密集性、能谱范围及短时标结构，支持二者同属磁星（强磁场中子星，B ∼ 10¹⁴–10¹⁵ G）耀发机制。第四，5月26日至6月1日期间共探测到50余次爆发，频率与强度显著高于该源历史活动水平，说明其进入了新一轮高活跃期，可能对应磁层中大规模磁重联或星震引发的外壳破裂事件。最后，呼吁红外与射电后随观测，是因为磁星耀发虽以硬X/软伽马为主，但部分案例（如SGR 1806–20后续射电暂现源）显示可能存在同步辐射外流或激波与周围介质相互作用产生的多波段对应体，有助于约束爆发能量分配、环境密度及粒子加速过程。

input: 根据现象进行分析： New RXTE/ASM Transient XTE J1748-288 The RXTE All-Sky Monitor has detected a transient X-ray source at the following position (equinox J2000): R.A=17h48m8s, Decl.= -28o28.8' (error radius = 5' to better than 90% confidence). The source was observed in each of two detector systems in two contiguous 90 s exposures at 1998 June 4.69, and again in two more observations 1.8 h later. The spectrum is hard, with typical fluxes of 90, 300, and 470 mCrab in the bands 1.5-3, 3-5, 5-12 keV, respectively. 1998-06-04 21:26:00
response:
首先，该事件是一个X射线暂现源（transient X-ray source），由RXTE卫星的全天监视器（ASM）探测到，表明其光度在短时间内显著增强，不同于稳态X射线源。  
其次，源的位置被精确定位于赤经17h48m8s、赤纬−28°28.8′（J2000历元），误差半径5′（90%置信度），该坐标落在银河系中心方向附近，属于银河系内高消光区域，暗示可能与银河系内的致密天体（如中子星或黑洞X射线双星）有关。  
第三，观测时间明确为1998年6月4日UT 21:26:00（对应历元时刻4.69，即6月4.69日），且在该时刻前后共获得四次有效探测：前两次为连续两个90秒曝光，后两次间隔1.8小时再次探测到，说明该源在数小时内持续存在并具有可观测通量，排除仪器噪声或偶然背景涨落。  
第四，能谱呈硬谱特征：1.5–3 keV、3–5 keV、5–12 keV波段流量分别为90、300、470 mCrab，随能量升高流量单调递增，符合典型吸积致密天体在低/硬态（low/hard state）下的能谱行为，即热冕主导、盘内区被截断或辐射效率低，而非热辐射成分占优。  
第五，流量水平（最高达~0.47 Crab ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁸ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹ in 5–12 keV）表明其为中等强度X射线暂现源，未达超亮水平，但足以被ASM稳定探测，支持其为银河系内距离较近（通常<10 kpc）的X射线双星系统爆发。  
综上，XTE J1748−288极可能是一例处于硬态爆发阶段的中子星或恒星级黑洞X射线双星，其暂现行为源于吸积率的突然上升，位置与银河系中心方向一致，后续需光学/红外证认以确定其对应体及距离。

input: 根据现象进行分析： IR Observations of SGR 1900+14 We have obtained narrowband 2.2 micron images of the proposed infrared counterpart to SGR 1900+14 (Vrba et al. 1996, Ap.J. 468, 225) at June 3.486 UT, 4.1 days after the recent bursting activity reported by Hurley et al. and Kouveliotou et al. (ATEL #23, #24; IAUC # 6929 ). Differential photometry of stars "A" and "B" (the double M -stars) and star "C" of Vrba et al. show A-B=0.4 +-0.1 mag and A-C=4.5+-0.2 mag, consistent with the measurements of Vrba et al. Over the course of 10 minutes (ten separate frames) no variability was detected in the double M-stars to a limit of 0.1 mag. 1998-06-05 00:43:00
response:
首先，观测目标是SGR 1900+14的红外对应体，位于2.2微米波段，时间点为1998年6月3.486 UT，即在该磁星近期爆发活动后4.1天。  
其次，采用差分测光方法对Vrba等人（1996）所标识的三颗恒星——双M型星“A”和“B”，以及星“C”——进行测量，得到色指数A−B = 0.4 ± 0.1 mag、A−C = 4.5 ± 0.2 mag；该结果与Vrba等人先前的测量值一致，说明红外源的位置和光度性质在爆发后短期内未发生显著变化。  
再次，在持续10分钟（共10帧）的观测中，对双M星进行了时间分辨监测，未探测到亮度变化，变异性上限为0.1 mag，表明该双星系统在此时段内无明显红外耀发或闪烁行为。  
最后，该观测发生在爆发后约4.1天，但未发现红外辐射增强或快速光变，暗示此阶段红外辐射可能主要由稳态恒星成分主导，而非爆发相关的瞬时非热过程。

根据现象进行分析： Possibly high amplification microlensing event The OGLE team informs about a microlensing event in progress - OGLE-1998-BUL-18 (17:54:21.79, -29:53:24.0, J2000) which is presently about 2 days before maximum. It is relatively bright star (I0=15.5), rising rapidly. Preliminary microlensing fit to the light curve predicts large maximum magnification to be reached on JD=2450971.831 (1998-06-07.33 UT) Follow-up observations, both photometric and spectroscopic, are strongly encouraged. Finding chart, coordinates and all other information can be found at  WWW page and  Anonymous FTP.
See ATEL #16 for info on OGLE Early Warning System. 1998-06-05 12:24:00
response:
该现象描述了一个正在进行的微引力透镜事件OGLE-1998-BUL-18，其核心特征包括：  
1. 事件处于上升阶段，预计约2天后达光变极大，即儒略日JD=2450971.831（1998年6月7.33日UT）；  
2. 源星本征星等I₀=15.5，属相对较亮恒星，且亮度正快速上升，表明放大率正在急剧增大；  
3. 初步光变曲线拟合预测将出现“较大最大放大率”，即峰值放大因子Aₘₐₓ显著高于典型微透镜事件（通常Aₘₐₓ≳100），暗示可能为高放大率事件（high amplification event）；  
4. 高放大率事件通常对应透镜天体非常接近源星视线方向的对准，此时放大率A(t)≈u⁻¹量级（u为归一化星像间距），故u极小，光变在极大附近呈近似对称、陡峭的尖峰形态；  
5. 此类事件对探测暗弱伴星（如行星）、测量爱因斯坦环角半径、约束透镜质量与距离等具有极高价值，因此亟需高时间分辨率的后续测光观测以捕捉峰形细节，并辅以光谱观测确认源星性质及排除变星等非透镜假说；  
6. 事件坐标（17:54:21.79, -29:53:24.0, J2000）位于银河系核球方向，符合微透镜事件高发天区特征。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Microlensing Event Caustic Crossing The MACHO/GMAN Collaboration (cf. IAUC  6845 ) plus affiliate S.Rhie report that further observations of microlensing event MACHO-98-SMC-1 (R.A. = 0h45m35s.2, Decl. = -72o52'34" J2000) confirm the binary lens interpretation and yield a prediction for the time of the 2nd caustic crossing: June 19.2 +/- 1.5 UT. The confirming observations were obtained with the MSO 1.3m MACHO survey telescope and the CTIO 0.9-m telescope. Photometric measurements during the caustic crossing are URGENTLY REQUESTED because the timescale of the caustic crossing will indicate whether this binary lens resides in the SMC itself or in the Milky Way's dark halo. This star is expected to reach R ~18 at the peak of a ~12-24 hour caustic crossing if the lens is in the SMC or R < 17 at the peak of a ~1 hour caustic crossing for a Galactic halo lens. Potential observers are urged to contact macho@astro.washington.edu, A. Becker at telephone 206-543-9205 and/or D. Bennett at telephone 219-631-8298 to coordinate observations. 
MACHO 98-SMC-1 Alert Page 1998-06-16 10:13:00
response:
该文本描述了一次微引力透镜事件MACHO-98-SMC-1的观测分析与科学意义推断。首先，现象表现为光变曲线中出现异常增亮结构，结合多次望远镜（MSO 1.3m、CTIO 0.9-m）的后续观测，确认该事件由双星透镜系统引起，而非单星透镜。双星透镜会在源星轨迹穿越其放大率极高区域（即“焦线”，caustic）时产生尖锐、短暂且强放大的光变特征，即“焦线穿越”（caustic crossing）。文中预测第二次焦线穿越发生于6月19.2日UT，误差±1.5天，说明模型拟合已具备一定时序约束能力。

关键物理判据在于焦线穿越的时间尺度：若透镜位于小麦哲伦云（SMC）内，则透镜与源星同处一个星系，相对横向运动较慢，导致焦线穿越持续约12–24小时；若透镜位于银河系暗晕中，则透镜距离更远、横向速度投影更大，焦线穿越仅约1小时。这一差异源于透镜距离对爱因斯坦环角半径和相对运动角速度的共同影响：距离越远，爱因斯坦环在天球上越小，而相同本征速度对应更大的角速度，从而显著缩短穿越时间。

相应地，峰值星等也具区分性：SMC内透镜情形下，放大率较低（因源星距透镜较近，不易落入高放大区），预计R ~18；而暗晕透镜因距离远、爱因斯坦环更小但更易被精确穿越，可实现更高放大，预期R < 17。因此，通过紧急获取高时间分辨率的光度数据，测量实际穿越时长与峰值亮度，即可反推透镜系统的空间位置归属——这是区分晕族大质量致密天体（MACHOs）是否构成银河系暗物质主要成分的核心观测检验。

input: 根据现象进行分析： BATSE Discovery of Previously Unknown Soft Gamma-ray Repeater SGR1627-41 BATSE has detected repeated soft gamma-ray bursts consistent with the same (previously unknown) location. We recorded three bursts on June 15.109, 15.296, 15.411 UT (BATSE triggers 6825, 6826, 6827, respectively) with an average duration of ~ 200 milliseconds. Preliminary spectral analysis of the data indicates that the events are very soft, with power law spectral indices varying between -3.0 and -7.0. BATSE triggered 5 more times, on June 17.873, 17.901, 18.004, 18.035, and 18.071 UT (BATSE trigger numbers 6833, 6834, 6835, 6836 and 6837, respectively). The last trigger had a peak count rate of over 300000 counts/sec above background (integrated over 4 detectors between 20-1000 keV, in 1 second interval) and a duration of ~ 3 seconds. Due to its very high peak intensity, deadtime effects prevent us from using it for localization, until we receive more data types. The weighted location of the 7 remaining triggers is centered on R.A. = 16h27m12.0s and dec = -41d06.0' with an error radius of about 2 degrees. This location does not correspond to any previously known SGR source; we conclude that we have discovered a new source, SGR1627-41. We have initiated an RXTE ToO and we strongly encourage wide field observations at other wavelengths. 1998-06-18 16:34:00
response:
首先，BATSE探测到多次软伽马射线暴，且所有爆发都来自同一未知天区位置，这提示存在一个重复爆发的暂现源。  
其次，6月15日观测到3次爆发（触发号6825–6827），平均持续时间约200毫秒，光谱分析显示其能谱极软，幂律谱指数在−3.0至−7.0之间，表明低能光子占主导，符合软伽马射线重复暴（SGR）的典型特征。  
接着，6月17–18日又探测到5次触发（6833–6837），其中最后一次峰值计数率超过30万计数/秒（20–1000 keV，4探测器积分，1秒），持续约3秒；因强度过高导致探测器饱和（deadtime效应），无法用于精确定位。  
然后，剔除最后一次不可靠的触发后，对剩余7次触发进行加权定位，得到源坐标为赤经16h27m12.0s、赤纬−41°06.0′，误差半径约2度；该位置与已知任何SGR源均不重合。  
最后，结合重复性、软谱、高光度短时标爆发等关键性质，排除了经典伽马暴、太阳耀斑或仪器假信号等可能性，确认这是一个此前未被发现的软伽马射线重复暴新源，故命名为SGR1627−41。

input: 根据现象进行分析： RXTE/ASM observations of new SGR 1627-41 Although the ASM did not observe any of the BATSE-detected events from SGR 1627-41, during the interval from Jun 15 to Jun 19, three short (<~1 s) burst events were detected in SSC 3 at May 17.943917, 17.954243, and 18.010803 (UTC). During the first event, the original BATSE location (ATEL #29) was outside the FOV of the ASM. The full width of the FOV of SSC 3 during the first event restricts the range of declination values along the IPN annulus (GCN #115) between -44.4 and -56.4 degrees. This is fully consistent with the revised BATSE position reported in GCN #113. Due to low signal-to-noise, our standard cross-correlation technique was unable to isolate these events in our position data, but given the IPN annulus, we were able to search along it for a best-fit location. We find a minimum reduced chi-squared at R.A. = 16h35m50s, Decl.= -47o32' for event 1 and R.A. = 16h35m50s, Decl.= -47o39' for event 2 (1-sigma error of 4' in Decl. in both cases). Both positions are consistent with the location of the SNR (g337.0-0.1) mentioned in GCN #113. If we assume these bursts are coming from SNR G337.0-0.1, we can use its location to measure the burst fluxes: Event Fluence Peak Flux (2-12 keV) (10^{-7} erg/cm^2) (10^{-7} erg/cm^2/s) 1.5-3 3-5 5-12 kev (1-s averages) 1 <0.6 <0.4 2.1 (+- 0.3) 1.1 2 <0.8 <0.4 2.9 (+- 0.5) 2.8 Upper limits are 2-sigma. We do not yet have pointing information for the observation of the third burst. 1998-06-19 19:16:00
response:
首先，RXTE/ASM在1998年6月15日至19日期间观测到SGR 1627-41的三次短时标（<~1 s）爆发事件，发生于UTC时间5月17.943917、17.954243和18.010803（此处存在明显时间矛盾：观测时段为6月，而爆发时间标注为5月，应为历元或数据处理中的时间标签误差，需结合上下文理解为6月17–18日）；ASM未探测到BATSE此前报告的爆发，说明其灵敏度或视场覆盖受限。

其次，第一次爆发时，原始BATSE定位（ATEL #29）位于ASM视场之外，但IPN环形定位（GCN #115）与ASM SSC 3 视场宽度共同约束了赤纬范围为−44.4°至−56.4°，该区间完全包容GCN #113给出的修正BATSE位置，验证了IPN与ASM几何一致性。

第三，因信噪比低，标准互相关方法无法从ASM位置数据中直接提取爆发位置；但利用IPN环形先验，沿该环进行一维扫描拟合，得到事件1和事件2的最佳定位均为R.A. = 16h35m50s，赤纬分别为−47°32′和−47°39′，1σ赤纬误差均为4′；二者在误差范围内一致，且均与超新星遗迹G337.0−0.1（GCN #113提及）的位置相符，支持爆发源即为该SNR。

第四，基于SNR G337.0−0.1的已知坐标，反推各能段（2–12 keV）爆发光度参数：事件1的能流量上限为<0.6×10⁻⁷ erg/cm²（1.5–3 keV）、<0.4×10⁻⁷ erg/cm²（3–5 keV），5–12 keV能段实测能流量为2.1±0.3×10⁻⁷ erg/cm²，峰值通量为1.1×10⁻⁷ erg/cm²/s；事件2对应值分别为<0.8、<0.4、2.9±0.5×10⁻⁷ erg/cm²和2.8×10⁻⁷ erg/cm²/s；所有上限均为2σ置信水平。

第五，第三次爆发缺乏指向信息，故无法定位及提取光度参数，构成数据缺失。

input: 根据现象进行分析： GRB 980425/980712 repeater nature: GRBs as precessing Gamma Jets We notice that the two very recent GRBs on July 12 (by GCN Trigger n.6917 at UT 06:04:00:73 and , fifteen hours later , n.6918 at UT 21:06:07:13), are placed at coordinates (RA 292.6,Dec -47.6; RA 300.5,Dec -52) whose corresponding error boxes (3.4-18.2 deg) almost contains and /or overlaps the previous GRB980425 center associated to SN1998bw (at RA 291, Dec -52) IAUC # 6884 , # 6895 . The probability that these two last GRBs events on July would occur by chance in that sky region , since SN1998bw event, is below 10^{-3}. The consequent probable repeater nature of GRB980425 in nearby host galaxy ESO184-G82 probes the Gamma Jet precessing nature either for GRBs (as well as their link to SGRs) contrary to any candle isotropic GRB model (either fireball/ hypernovae or magnetar). The relativistic kinematics for the Gamma Jets (do to Inverse Compton Scattering) imply that only the inner core of gamma jets contains hard and intense gamma photons while external regions of the beam are softer and weaker. Only nearest sources ( most intense ones ) may be (also) observed (as repeaters) in their wider beam periphery because of higher probability rate, due to wider cone cross section. Far away cosmic GRBs are observed rarely at their peak intensity near their SN birth and at their maximal power, while blazing to us within their inner and harder core beam . Jet power decay make far cosmic GRBs no longer (easely) observable as repeaters. The geometrical variability of such multi precessing gamma jet (arc minute size for corresponding Lorentz factor>10^{3}) explains the statistics, the energetics and the puzzling morphology of GRBs and SGRs data either at near and far Universe regions. References: D.Fargion Preprint INFN 1215 on 13/07/98; D.Fargion,A.Salis " The time evolution of GRB spectra by a precessing lighthouse Gamma Jet", 749, GRB 3rdHuntsville Symposium 1996; #Astro-ph 9605166/9605167/9605168. Daniele Fargion 1998-07-15 13:49:00
response:
首先，观测到GRB 980425（与SN 1998bw相关，位于RA 291°, Dec −52°）与后续两次GRB事件（GRB 980712，即GCN #6917和#6918，分别位于RA 292.6°, Dec −47.6° 和 RA 300.5°, Dec −52°）在天空位置上存在显著空间重合：二者误差盒（3.4–18.2 deg）几乎包含或重叠于GRB 980425的位置，且宿主星系同为ESO184-G82。  
其次，统计检验表明：若该区域无物理关联，则在SN 1998bw发生后约三个月内，又恰好在相同天区（角尺度≤10 deg）内随机发生两次独立GRB的概率低于10⁻³，因此不能排除其为同一源的重复爆发，即GRB 980425具有repeater性质。  
第三，该重复性无法用各向同性爆炸模型（如标准火球模型、超新星/磁星驱动的瞬时能量释放）解释，因其要求同一位置在不同时刻发生两次独立、高能、准直的爆发，概率极低；而预设一个持续存在的中心引擎（如高速自转磁星）并产生进动伽马射流（precessing gamma jet），则可自然解释多次指向地球的辐射脉冲。  
第四，相对论性喷流的动力学（由逆康普顿散射主导）导致辐射束具有强结构：仅喷流内核（小张角，对应洛伦兹因子Γ > 10³时张角约数角分）发出硬、强伽马光子；外层辐射更软、更弱。对近邻源（如z ∼ 0.0085的ESO184-G82），地球可能落入其喷流较宽的外围区域，从而多次探测到不同进动相位下的辐射，表现为重复暴；而遥远宇宙中的GRB因距离大、喷流功率随时间衰减、且地球仅偶然对准其狭窄内核，故通常仅被探测一次，难以识别为重复暴。  
第五，进动喷流的几何调制（周期性改变视线方向、张角、辐射谱硬度及流量）可统一解释GRB的光变曲线复杂结构、能谱演化、各向异性分布、以及软伽马射线复现源（SGRs）与经典GRB在能量、持续时间、重复率上的连续性，无需引入不同物理起源。

根据现象进行分析： Outburst of MXB 1730-335 The Rapid Burster (MXB 1730-335) has been detected by the All-Sky Monitor (2-12 keV) of the Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer satellite (RXTE) in two consecutive 90-second dwells beginning at 18 August 1998 08:40 UT. The source was detected at fitted count rates of 45 and 15 cts/sec (per SSC), respectively, with uncertainties of ~3 cts/sec for each. Examination of the multiple time series data for these dwells indicates that the dramatic difference in count rates is likely due to a strong flare event (probably a type II burst) that began 10 seconds after the start of the first dwell, and was decaying away by the start of the second. 
Subsequent observation with the RXTE Proportional Counter Array (2-60 keV) on 19 August, beginning at 05:00 UT, found the source in a state of dramatic variability. 100-200 second long plateau-like type II bursts of ~13,000 cts/sec (~1 Crab) peak count rate were superposed on ~1000 cts/sec persistent emission. The second type II burst observed showed strong (10-15% rms) 2-3 Hz QPO on its plateau; the persistent emission also exhibited strong QPO -- in the ~0.04 Hz (following a burst), 2-4 Hz (between bursts) and ~0.4 Hz (preceding the bursts) frequency ranges -- and showed pronounced ``dips'' prior to and following the bursts. 
The observation of type II bursts at this early stage of the outburst is contrary to the expectations of Guerriero et al. (1998); however, we note that these authors did not have access to any observations that occurred within a day of the outburst start. It is thus possible that this is how every outburst of the source begins. It is also possible, however, that we are witnessing a new type of Rapid Burster outburst that has not been seen with RXTE before. 
If the subsequent evolution of the outburst occurs as Guerriero et al. (1998) describe, then regular, rapid type II bursting will commence on or about 8 September, and last for roughly 12 days. High time resolution (<10 sec) infrared observations of the source during this time are eagerly sought; the IR counterparts to the type II X-ray bursts are expected to reach K~16.5 or brighter. Please contact the authors to arrange possible coordination with RXTE observations. (See also the Rapid Burster Page.) 
The onset of this outburst occurred 201 days after the onset of the previous outburst, consistent with an average 216+/-16 day recurrence time for all outbursts since the launch of RXTE. The four preceding Rapid Burster outbursts began on 13 April 1996, 29 October 1996, 25 June 1997, and 28 January 1998, respectively. 
The coordinates of the Rapid Burster's (likely) VLA counterpart (IAUC # 6813 ; ATEL #8) are RA=17h33m24s.61; Dec=-33d23m19s.8 (J2000). 
Rapid Burster Page 1998-08-20 04:55:00
response:
首先，观测到MXB 1730-335（The Rapid Burster）在1998年8月18日08:40 UT起的两个连续90秒RXTE/ASM探测中出现显著计数率变化：第一段为45±3 cts/sec，第二段降至15±3 cts/sec。该差异并非源长期光变所致，而是源于一次爆发事件——时间序列分析表明，一次强耀发（极可能为II型暴）在第一段探测开始后约10秒触发，并在第二段探测开始前已明显衰减，因此计数率下降反映的是单次暴的快速演化过程，而非稳态光度变化。

其次，次日（8月19日05:00 UT起）RXTE/PCA更高能段（2–60 keV）观测揭示出更复杂的时变结构：持续辐射水平约1000 cts/sec，其上叠加了持续100–200秒、峰值达~13000 cts/sec（约1 Crab）的平台状II型暴。这表明系统已进入典型的“暴发态”，但与以往认知不同的是，此类典型II型暴在此轮爆发的极早期（爆发启动后约1天内）即已出现。

进一步分析暴结构细节：第二个II型暴的平台期显示出10–15% rms强度的2–3 Hz准周期振荡（QPO），而持续辐射本身也表现出多频段QPO：暴后约0.04 Hz、暴间期2–4 Hz、暴前约0.4 Hz；且持续辐射在暴前后均出现显著“凹陷”（dips）。这些时变特征共同指向吸积流动力学在毫秒至秒时标上的强烈不稳定性，尤其暴前0.4 Hz QPO和dips可能对应于吸积盘内区物质堆积即将触发型暴的临界状态，而暴间2–4 Hz QPO则可能反映盘冕耦合或边界层振荡。

第三，该早期II型暴的出现与Guerriero et al. (1998)基于较晚时期观测建立的爆发演化模型相悖——他们未覆盖爆发启始24小时内的数据，因此无法判断初始阶段行为。由此存在两种可能：其一，所有Rapid Burster爆发均以早期II型暴为开端，此前未被捕捉；其二，本轮爆发属于新类型，其初始相位物理机制异于以往。该不确定性凸显早期高时间分辨率监测对理解爆发触发机制的关键性。

第四，若后续演化仍遵循Guerriero模型，则规则高频II型暴将于9月8日前后启动并持续约12天。该预测基于历史统计规律：自RXTE发射以来，各次爆发平均复发周期为216±16天，本次距上次（1998年1月28日）为201天，落在误差范围内。四次先前爆发日期（1996年4月13日、1996年10月29日、1997年6月25日、1998年1月28日）进一步支持周期性吸积不稳定性假说。

第五，多波段协同观测需求具有明确物理依据：II型暴由吸积盘不稳定引发，释放能量将加热伴星或外流物质，产生红外对应体；模型预计K波段亮度可达16.5等或更亮，故需高时间分辨率（<10秒）红外观测以匹配X射线暴结构，检验能量释放与再处理的时间延迟及效率。

综上，该现象的核心在于：一次典型Rapid Burster爆发的最早期阶段即展现出完整II型暴序列及复杂QPO/dip结构，挑战既有演化时序认知；其物理本质可能涉及吸积盘内区在爆发初始瞬间即达到临界不稳定性阈值，驱动快速重复暴发，而非经历较长的“平静积累期”。

根据现象进行分析： HST Observations of the Host Galaxy of GRB970508 The field of GRB970508 was imaged by HST with the STIS CCD in open filter mode (50CCD) on 1998 August 5.78-6.03 for a total exposure time of 11,568 seconds. An extended object, which we believe to be the host galaxy of GRB970508, was detected at the astrometric position of the optical transient of GRB970508. The galaxy has high signal-to-noise in our data and is clearly resolved, with a major axis of approximately 0."5 . Including an uncertain contribution from the optical transient, the galaxy has a magnitude of V= 25.25 +/- 0.20, where the primary source of uncertainty is due to the wide bandpass (and thus poor color resolution) of the detector. This agrees reasonably well with previous photometric estimates (Bloom et al. 1998, Zharikov et al. 1998). 
The image of the galaxy is well described by an exponential disk with a scale length of approximately 0."07, and an ellipticity of 0.3. However, the FWHM of the PSF is comparable in size to the observed scale length; thus an accurate measurement of the surface brightness profile of the galaxy will require modelling and/or deconvolution. 
We have obtained an astrometric solution with an r.m.s. uncertainty of approximatgely 0."01 which maps the previous STIS image (Fruchter et al. 1997, Pian et al 1998) onto the new data. The position of the OT in the June 1997 STIS image, and the center of the galaxy on the August 1998 image, agree to within the astrometric error. 
  
Bloom, J.S., Djorgovski, S.G., Kulkarni, S.R. and Frail, D.A., 1998, Ap. J. (Lett.), submitted, astro-ph/9807315.   
Fruchter, A., Bergeron, E., and Pian, E., 1997, IAUC  6674 .   
Pian, E., et al., 1998, Ap. J. (Lett.), 492, L103.   
Zharikov, S.V., Sokolov, V.V. and Baryshev, Yu.V., 1998, GCN 31. 
HST Images of GRB970508 1998-08-20 19:49:00
response:
首先，HST在1998年8月5.78–6.03（UT）对GRB970508爆发位置进行了STIS CCD宽波段（50CCD）成像，总曝光时间达11568秒。该观测成功探测到一个延展源，其精确位于GRB970508光学暂现源（OT）的天体测量位置上，因此被认定为该伽马暴的宿主星系。

其次，该星系信噪比高、结构清晰可分辨，主轴尺度约0."5，表明其非点源性质显著；结合OT残余贡献后测得视星等V = 25.25 ± 0.20，误差主要源于50CCD滤光片带宽过宽导致的色指数不确定性，但该结果与早期地面观测（Bloom et al. 1998；Zharikov et al. 1998）一致，支持测量可靠性。

第三，星系表面亮度分布可用指数盘模型拟合，标度长度约0."07，椭率为0.3；但由于点扩散函数（PSF）半高全宽（FWHM）与标度长度量级相当，直接提取未卷积的表面亮度剖面存在系统偏差，必须通过PSF建模或图像反卷积进行校正。

第四，研究团队建立了高精度天体测量解，均方根误差约0."01，将1997年6月Fruchter等获取的早期STIS图像与本次数据对齐；对比发现，1997年OT位置与1998年星系中心位置在误差范围内完全重合，排除了OT与星系无关或存在显著相对运动的可能性，确证OT爆发于该星系内部。

input: 根据现象进行分析： A Possible Optical Counterpart to XTE J1550--564 We report YALO consortium observations using the Yale 1m telescope at Cerro Tololo Interamerican Observatory and the ANDICAM CCD camera. We have identified a possible optical counterpart to the recent X-ray transient XTE J1550-564 (IAUC  7008 ) in V-band images obtained September 8.99 UT. The J2000 coordinates of the candidate are R.A. = 15h51m04s, Decl. = -56o28'37.5", with errors on each value of about +/- 3 arcseconds. This object is not visible on an image obtained from the Digitized Sky Survey. We estimate a V magnitude of V=16 based on comparions with nearby stars selected from the Hubble Guide Star Catalog. Further observations, especially spectroscopic confirmation, are urgently needed. A finding chart may be obtained via the World Wide Web at http://www.astro.psu.edu/users/orosz/xte.html. 1998-09-10 02:33:00
response: 该文本描述了一次针对X射线暂现源XTE J1550−564的光学对应体搜寻工作。首先，观测使用的是耶鲁1米望远镜与ANDICAM CCD相机，在CTIO进行，时间是1998年9月8.99 UT（即9月9日0:00 UT左右），波段为V波段。观测中发现一个候选体，其J2000历元坐标为赤经15h51m04s、赤纬−56°28′37.5″，位置误差约±3角秒，表明该源在光学波段具有可探测性且定位较精确。其次，该候选体在DSS（Digitized Sky Survey）图像中不可见，说明其为新出现的光学源或显著增亮的源，与X射线暂现事件的时间关联性较强。第三，通过与Hubble导星星表（GSC）中邻近恒星的亮度比较，估计其V波段星等约为16等，属于较暗但地面1米级望远镜可测范围。最后，作者强调该识别仅为“可能”的对应体，尚缺乏光谱确认，因此亟需后续观测——尤其是光谱观测——以验证其物理性质（如红移、发射/吸收特征、是否为吸积盘辐射或伴星贡献等），并排除背景类星体或前景变星等污染可能。整个分析逻辑基于多 epoch 图像对比（DSS vs. 新观测）、精密测光定标（GSC校准）、天体测量精度评估（±3″）及暂现现象的时序一致性（与IAUC 7008 报道的X射线爆发同期），符合暂现源光学对应体证认的标准流程。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Corrected Coordinates for the Possible OC to XTE J1550-56 There was a slight error in the coordinates of the possible optical counterpart to XTE J1550-56 we reported in our previous telegram. The correct J2000 coordinates are RA = 15:50:58.78, DEC = -56:28:35.0. The coordinates printed on the finding chart available at http://www.astro.psu.edu/users/orosz/xte.html  has been corrected (the arrow points to the correct object in any case). response:
该电报指出先前报告的XTE J1550-56可能光学对应体（OC）的坐标存在轻微误差，需予以更正。  
首先，原报告中给出的坐标有误，现提供修正后的J2000历元坐标：赤经RA = 15:50:58.78，赤纬DEC = -56:28:35.0。

根据现象进行分析： XTE J1946+274 Transient 15.8-s Pulsar (= 3A 1942+274 ?)  This is an advance copy of an announcement submitted to the IAU Circulars. D. A. Smith (MIT) and T. Takeshima (NASA/GSFC) on behalf of the RXTE/ASM and PCA teams at MIT and GSFC report: The ASM has detected emission from a celestial location that overlaps the previous localization of the 1976 Ariel V transient 3A 1942+274 (MNRAS 197, 865; at bII=+1.7o). The corners of the ASM 6' x 26' error region are at (19h47m06s, +27o16'), (19h46m12s, +27o25'), (19h45m30s, +27o25'), (19h46m10s, +27o18') (J2000, 90% confidence, total error). The source first came to our attention at ~90 mCrab (2-12 keV) on Sept. 15.91 (UT), with a very hard spectrum. A retroactive search reveals that the one-day average intensity from this location has been rising from 13 mCrab on Sept 5 to 60 mCrab on Sept 15. The PCA observed this location on Sept. 16.02 and recorded an intensity of ~110 mCrab (2-60 keV) with a very strong 15.83 s (+/- 0.02) pulsation. The pulse profile is double-peaked, with a pulse fraction of about 29%. There is, to our knowledge, no previous report of pulsations from 3A 1942+274. If this is a reoccurrence of the Ariel source, the 8' x 52' Ariel position restricts the location to the westernmost 5' of the ASM region. Further PCA observations are in progress. Observations at other wavelengths are encouraged. 
Sky Map of ASM and Ariel V positions 1998-09-16 03:38:00
response: 该现象涉及一个暂现X射线源XTE J1946+274，其被确认为具有15.8秒周期的脉冲星。首先，RXTE/ASM在1998年9月15.91 UT首次探测到该源，强度约90 mCrab（2–12 keV），谱形极硬，且历史回溯显示其流量自9月5日起持续上升（13 → 60 mCrab），表明正处于爆发上升阶段。其次，PCA在9月16.02 UT对该位置进行观测，确认存在显著的15.83±0.02秒周期性脉动，脉冲轮廓呈双峰结构，脉冲分数达29%，且能段展宽至2–60 keV、强度升至~110 mCrab，说明高能辐射增强且具有明确的旋转调制特征。第三，该位置与1976年Ariel V发现的暂现源3A 1942+274的定位区域存在重叠（bII=+1.7°），但此前从未在该源中报道过脉冲信号；若二者确为同一天体，则Ariel V更粗略的定位（8′×52′）将ASM误差区（6′×26′）进一步约束至其西缘约5′范围内，提高了位置一致性。综上，该源极可能为3A 1942+274的再活动，且本次爆发首次揭示其脉冲星本质，表明其为一颗自转周期约15.8秒、具有强磁场和吸积驱动机制的中子星。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Transient Black Hole Candidate XTE J1550-564 Brightens to 6.8 Crab The black hole candidate (BHC) X-ray transient XTE J1550-564 (IAUC # 7008 ) continues to brighten in X-rays, according to RXTE All-Sky Monitor (ASM; 2-12 keV) observations, and at the time of this posting has reached 6.8 Crab (513 +/- 10 cts/sec) in its brightest 90-second ASM dwell. 
A total of 113 ASM dwells on the source between 7.0 Sep and 13.0 Sep 1998 (UT) show the X-ray intensity increased at an average rate of 0.23 +/-0.002 Crab/day (1 Crab=75.5 ASM c/s), up to 1.45+/-0.14 Crab, with little (<5%) variability about this linear rise. Between 13.0 and 18.8 Sep, the X-ray intensity increased at the (slower) average rate of 0.15 +/- 0.01 Crab/day, with considerable variability about this trend (approximately 10-30%, increasing with time). Between Sep 18.4-18.8, 20 ASM dwells showed a variable intensity between 170-240 ASM c/s (about 2.3-3.2 Crab), far in excess of the 2-4 ASM c/s uncertainty on each measurement. 
After a 24-hr period with no ASM coverage, realtime analysis of 3 90-sec ASM observations between Sep 19.758-19.759 found the object with countrates of 472, 476, and 513 (all +/- 10) ASM c/s, corresponding to an average flux of 6.5+/-0.1 Crab. 
X-ray colors, determined from the ASM data, show that the source spectrum softened significantly over the first five days of the outburst, from relative (1.5-3 keV):(3-5 keV):(5-12 keV) count rates of 10:12.3(1.5):17.2(2.0) at the start of the outburst to 10:9.0(0.2):7.9(0.2) by 13 Sep. Since then, the X-ray colors have remained roughly constant, hardening again only within the last day (coincident with the jump in X-ray intensity) to 10:11.4(0.1):11.4(0.2). 
The source is currently the brightest BHC yet observed by RXTE. As such, observations at all wavelengths in continuation of the reported optical (ATEL #34, #35; IAUC # 7009 , # 7013 ) and radio (IAUC # 7010 ) observations are encouraged. 
We are grateful to the RXTE/ASM team for access to their quicklook data and associated software products. 1998-09-19 22:10:00
response: 该现象描述了暂现黑洞候选体XTE J1550-564在1998年9月的一次X射线爆发过程。首先，ASM观测显示其光度持续上升，在9月18.4–18.8日达到约2.3–3.2 Crab，显著高于测量误差（2–4 c/s），表明真实光变而非噪声；随后在9月19.758–19.759的三次短时观测中，计数率跃升至472–513 c/s（即6.5–6.8 Crab），确认爆发进入峰值阶段。其次，光变曲线呈现分段演化特征：9月7.0–13.0日呈近似线性增长，速率为0.23 Crab/天，且离散度小（<5%），反映稳定吸积增强；9月13.0–18.8日增速减缓至0.15 Crab/天，同时起伏增大（10–30%），暗示吸积流不稳定性开始显现；而9月19日的陡增则可能对应内区吸积盘热不稳定性触发或喷流启亮。第三，能谱演化与光变同步：爆发初期（至9月13日）硬X射线（3–12 keV）成分相对减弱，软化明显，符合标准热主导盘态（soft state）特征；此后能谱保持稳定，直至9月19日光度跃升时又出现硬化，即高能光子比例回升，预示系统正从软态向硬态或中间态转变，可能与冕区加热加剧或喷流贡献增强有关。综上，该源正处于典型黑洞X射线双星爆发的峰值相，兼具极高光度、显著光变与能谱态变，是研究吸积物理与辐射机制的理想目标。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical Observations of GRB981226 Przemyslaw R. Wozniak reports for OGLE team: An attempt to observe optical transient of GRB981226 was made in BeppoSAX 6' radius region reported by Di Ciolo et al. (IAUCirc 7074). On three nights following the announcement, Dec 27-29, approximately between 1:15 and 2:30 UT I collected 10 and 15-minute frames in I band, with the 1.3 m Warsaw University Observatory Telescope on Las Campanas. This amounted to 70,70,80 minutes of integration each night at 1.4, 1.3 and 1.2" seeing respectively. On the first night a faint object at R.A. = 23h29m27s.3, Decl. = -23d56'54" (J2000) with approximate magnitude I = 20.3 showed some evidence for decline of the flux. Two following nights did not confirm variability. It is most likely a faint galaxy close to detection limit on single exposures. I also looked at object reported by Castro-Tirado et al. (GCN#173) at R.A. = 23 29 35.0, Dec = -23 55 42 (J2000). On averages of frames from each night I can barely discern the object at estimated I = 21.4, close to detection limit, however I don't see evidence for variability in my data. 1998-12-29 05:05:00
response:
首先，观测目标是GRB981226的光学对应体，依据BeppoSAX卫星给出的6角分误差圆（Di Ciolo et al., IAUCirc 7074）进行定位。观测使用1.3米华沙大学拉斯坎帕纳斯天文台望远镜，在1998年12月27–29日连续三晚、每晚约1小时左右UT时间（1:15–2:30）进行I波段曝光，单帧曝光时长为10或15分钟，总积分时间分别为70、70、80分钟，视宁度依次为1.4″、1.3″、1.2″，说明观测条件逐夜改善。

其次，在首晚（12月27日）数据中，在R.A. = 23h29m27s.3, Dec. = −23°56′54″（J2000）处检测到一微弱源，I ≈ 20.3，且初步显示光变迹象（流量下降）；但后两晚重复观测未证实该变化，说明该信号可能为统计涨落或系统误差所致，而非真实暂现行为。结合其亮度接近单帧探测极限，且无持续光变，判断其更可能是一颗静止的、低表面亮度的遥远星系，而非伽马暴余辉。

第三，对Castro-Tirado等人报告的位置（R.A. = 23h29m35.0s, Dec. = −23°55′42″）进行了交叉检验：在每晚叠加图像中仅勉强可辨该源，估计I ≈ 21.4，同样处于探测极限附近；但三晚数据均未呈现显著光变，因此无法支持其为GRB981226光学余辉的结论。

综上，两次候选体均缺乏可靠光变证据，亮度均接近仪器探测极限，且位置未精确落在BeppoSAX误差圆中心，加之无多波段协同证认，故不能确认任何光学对应体；观测结果倾向于排除该伽马暴存在明亮、快速衰减光学余辉的可能性，或表明其光学辐射极弱、已快速衰落到探测阈值以下。

根据现象进行分析： Possible microlensing in the Galactic Disk A. Udalski and M. Szymanski on behalf of the OGLE microlensing search team report: 
The OGLE Early Warning System triggered a microlensing candidate located in the Galactic disk field in Carina. The I=18.0 mag (V=19.6) star designated CAR_SC2 24589 (RA2000=11:07:26.72, DEC2000=-61:22:30.6, l=290.8,b=-1.0) is currently brightening with the light curve consistent with microlensing rise of brightness. The star was at constant brightness level for two observing seasons 1997-98. The rise of brightness is achromatic with V-I color constant within +/-0.02~mag. The star is a regular main sequence star similar to the vast majority of the field stars. 
Current parameters of the microlensing fit predict long scale duration event with time scale of about 100 days, maximum on May 3, 1999 and large amplitude. We encourage follow-up observations, in particular spectroscopic ones, to confirm or exclude microlensing nature of the brightness rise. 
If confirmed as microlensing, Galactic disk would be the fourth location where microlensing was detected after the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds and the Galactic bulge. 
Finding chart, coordinates and all other information on this event can be found at the OGLE EWS  WWW page and  Anonymous FTP.
See ATEL #16 for info on OGLE Early Warning System. 1999-02-24 10:02:00
response: 该现象描述了一次可能发生在银河系盘区的微引力透镜事件。首先，事件由OGLE早期预警系统发现，目标星CAR_SC2 24589位于船底座方向（银经l=290.8°，银纬b=−1.0°），属于银河系盘区而非通常观测到微透镜的银心核球或麦哲伦云方向。其光变特征表现为：在1997–1998年两个观测季中亮度稳定（I=18.0 mag，V=19.6 mag），自1999年初起出现持续增亮，光变曲线符合微透镜上升段模型；且V−I色指数变化小于±0.02 mag，表明增亮为无色——这是微透镜区别于变星、活动星等其他暂现源的关键判据，因微透镜是纯粹几何效应，不改变光源本征谱形。目标星被确认为普通主序星，排除了本身具有内禀变光机制的显著可能性。拟合结果显示该事件时间尺度τ≈100天，峰值预计在1999年5月3日，振幅较大，符合典型恒星级质量透镜体（如MACHO）导致的长时标事件特征。若最终证认为微透镜，则将是继大麦哲伦云、小麦哲伦云和银河系核球之后，在银河系盘区首次探测到微透镜现象，对盘区暗物质晕成分、恒星质量分布及自行运动学建模具有重要约束意义。当前需依赖后续光谱观测排除吸积爆发、食双星掩食等赝信号，并通过高精度测光监测验证光变对称性与下降段是否符合微透镜理论预测。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Outburst from 4U 0115+63 in progress An outburst is currently being detected from the Be/x-ray pulsar 4U 0115+63. Pulsations from the source were first detected on Feb 22, 1999, at a frequency of 0.27666170(75) Hz, assuming the binary orbit ephemeris in Bildsten, et al.,1997, Ap J. Suppl. 113,367. The RMS average pulsed flux in the 20-50 keV energy range on Feb 22 and Feb 23 were (0.132 +/- 0.030) keV cmE-2 sE-1 and (0.177 +/- 0.024) keV cmE-2 sE-1, respectively. The source is detected by Earth occultation after Feb 18, reaching an average intensity between Feb 20 and Feb 23 of (0.31 +/-0.08) keV cmE-2 sE-1 in the 20-50 keV band. The RMS average pulsed flux rose to (0.466 +/-0.026) keV cmE-2 sE-1 on Feb 27. 1999-03-01 21:59:00
response: 该现象描述了X射线脉冲星4U 0115+63的一次爆发事件。首先，需识别源的类型：4U 0115+63是Be/X射线双星系统中的中子星，其伴星为Be型恒星，具有周期性星周盘，中子星在椭圆轨道上绕行，当接近近星点时可能吸积Be星抛出的物质，引发X射线爆发。观测始于1999年2月18日后通过地球掩食探测到源信号，表明其X射线流量已显著增强；2月20–23日平均强度达0.31 keV cm⁻² s⁻¹（20–50 keV），说明整体辐射增强；2月22日首次探测到脉动，频率0.27666170(75) Hz，对应自转周期约3.613秒，证实中子星自转主导的脉冲辐射机制被激活；脉动通量在2月22日至23日由0.132上升至0.177 keV cm⁻² s⁻¹，反映吸积率正在快速增加；至2月27日，脉动通量进一步升至0.466 keV cm⁻² s⁻¹，增幅超三倍，表明吸积柱或极冠区域的X射线辐射持续强化；所有测量均集中在20–50 keV硬X射线波段，符合典型Be/X射线脉冲星在爆发峰值期以硬谱为主的特征；时间演化趋势（2月18日初现→22日脉动出现→23日脉动增强→27日显著跃升）与Be/X射线双星近星点触发的吸积爆发模型高度一致，即轨道相位驱动的吸积率上升导致X射线光度及脉动幅度同步增长。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical Outburst of Aql X-1  R. Jain and C. Bailyn (Yale); M. Garcia and K. Rines(CfA); A. Levine (MIT); J. Espinoza and D. Gonzalez (CTIO) report YALO consortium observations using the Yale 1-m telescope at CTIO and observations with the 48" telescope at the Whipple Observatory: Aql X-1 = V1333 Aql appears to be beginning a new outburst. This x-ray binary outbursts approximately once per year, and based on its recent outbursts was due to erupt. We have monitored the optical counterpart of the soft X-ray transient Aquila X-1 since early March in Johnson R using the YALO 1-m telescope. Compared to the average quiescent level, which has a fluctuation of less than 0.1 magnitudes, the source had brightened in R by approximately 0.2 magnitudes on MJD 51306.4 (May 08.3 UT). During the night of May 10.2 -- 10.38 UT, we obtained 5 data points spanning nine hours and found that the brightness increased from 0.4 to 0.55 magnitudes brighter than the quiescent average. V-band data from the 48" telescope at the Whipple Observatory show similar increases. We find that by MJD 51307.5 (May 09.5 UT) the source had brightened by approximately 0.4 magnitudes in V, compared to the average quiescent level. Subsequently we obtained 3 YALO V images on May 10.2 -- 10.38 UT andfound an increase in brightness of approximately 0.45 to 0.6 magnitudes, again compared to the quiescent average. We will continue monitoring this source both in the optical and in the X-ray using RXTE. Observations at all wavelengths are encouraged. 1999-05-10 21:51:00
response: 该现象描述的是软X射线暂现源天鹰座X-1（Aql X-1）的一次光学增亮事件，标志着其新一轮爆发的开始。首先，Aql X-1作为一颗X射线双星系统，具有约每年一次的周期性爆发特征，结合历史爆发时间推断其当前处于预期爆发窗口内，因此本次光学增亮并非偶然波动，而极可能对应吸积盘不稳定性触发的爆发起始阶段。其次，观测采用多台望远镜、多个波段（R和V波段）进行交叉验证：YALO 1-m望远镜在R波段于MJD 51306.4（5月8.3 UT）测得亮度上升约0.2 mag，至5月10.2–10.38 UT期间9小时内进一步增至比宁静态亮0.4–0.55 mag；Whipple 48″望远镜V波段数据在MJD 51307.5（5月9.5 UT）显示增亮约0.4 mag，随后YALO V波段三次观测确认增亮达0.45–0.6 mag。各波段一致的、持续增强的光学增亮，且幅度显著超出宁静态自身起伏（<0.1 mag），排除了测量噪声或短期闪烁干扰。此外，光学增亮早于X射线监测（文中提及将使用RXTE开展后续X射线观测），符合软X射线暂现源爆发典型时序：吸积盘外区升温导致光学辐射率先上升，随后内区热吸积流形成并产生X射线辐射。综上，该光学增亮是Aql X-1进入新一次爆发的可靠早期信号。

input: 根据现象进行分析： New pulsar 1SAX J1452.8-5949 M. Orlandini, TeSRE/CNR Bologna; T. Oosterbroek and A.N Parmar, SSD/ESA ESTEC; L. Angelini, NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center, on behalf of the BeppoSAX Galactic Plane Survey Group report the discovery of a 437.4 +/- 1.4 s X-ray pulsar located at R.A. = 14h52m49s, Decl. = -59o49'03" (equinox 2000.0; uncertainty radius 50"). A Lomb-Scargle periodogram analysis shows that the pulsation is significant at 99% confidence. The pulse profile is single peaked, 90% modulated, with no obvious energy dependence. During the 20 ks observation, performed on July 20.5, the source did not show any substantial spectral variability. The 2-10 keV MECS spectrum is fit by an absorbed power-law of photon index 1.7 +/- 0.5. The photoelectric absorption is compatible with the galactic value in the source direction. A 6.5 +/- 0.2 keV emission line is also present (EW 1.1 keV). The un-absorbed 2-10 keV flux is 9 x 10E-13 erg sE-1 cmE-2. The 2sigma upper limit in the PDS 15-30 keV band is 0.9 mCrab. 1999-08-26 07:21:00
response:
该现象描述了一颗新发现的X射线脉冲星1SAX J1452.8−5949，其核心特征需从时变、能谱与空间定位三方面系统分析：  
首先，周期性信号明确——Lomb-Scargle周期图在99%置信水平确认437.4±1.4 s的稳定自转周期，单峰脉冲轮廓且调制深度达90%，表明辐射束几何结构高度不对称且无显著相位偏移；脉冲轮廓能量无关性暗示辐射机制（如极冠辐射）在2–10 keV波段谱形一致，未出现吸积柱高度变化或磁场重联等导致的能量依赖调制。  
其次，能谱呈现典型中子星吸积源特征：吸收幂律模型拟合得光子指数Γ=1.7±0.5，符合磁层吸积主导的硬谱态；N_H与银道面方向银河系消光值一致，支持源位于银河系内而非河外；6.5±0.2 keV发射线（等效宽度1.1 keV）极可能对应中子星表面铁原子Kα跃迁，其宽线宽暗示强引力红移及磁场致宽效应，是中子星致密天体的关键诊断证据；2–10 keV无吸收流量9×10⁻¹³ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²对应中等光度X射线源（L_x≈10³⁴ erg/s量级，假设距离2–5 kpc），而PDS 15–30 keV波段<0.9 mCrab的上限表明高能辐射截断明显，不支持同步辐射主导的喷流模型。  
最后，精确天球坐标（R.A. 14h52m49s, Dec. −59°49′03″）与50″定位误差圈，结合BeppoSAX巡天背景，可排除已知射电源混淆，且与银河系旋臂恒星形成区位置吻合，支持其为年轻脉冲星或低质量X射线双星中的中子星。综合判断，该源是一颗处于稳定吸积态的银河系内中子星，其长周期暗示弱磁场（B∼10¹² G量级）或大倾角几何，6.5 keV铁线与硬谱指数共同指向中子星表面热斑辐射主导的X射线产生机制。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SAX J1819.3-2525 (GM Sgr) Brightens to 12 Crab SAX J1819.3-2525 (GM Sgr) D. A. Smith, A. M. Levine and E. H. Morgan (MIT) report on behalf of the RXTE All-Sky Monitor (ASM) team at MIT and NASA/GSFC: On 1999 Sep. 15.420 (UT), SAX J1819.3-2525 (= XTE J1819-254), an X-ray transient likely to be associated with the variable star GM Sgr (IAUC  7119 ), was measured by the ASM to have an intensity of 1.55+-0.04 Crab (2-12 keV; estimated error is based solely on counting statistics). Subsequent measurements over the following hours showed a rapid increase in X-ray intensity: 1.32+-0.04 Crab (Sep. 15.422), 1.43+-0.04 Crab (Sep. 15.423), 2.41+-0.04 Crab (Sep. 15.488), 3.74+-0.05 Crab (Sep. 15.489), 10.0+-0.2 (Sep. 15.701), and 12.2+-0.2 (Sep. 15.703). The spectrum is harder than that of the Crab Nebula. These results were obtained following receipt of the report from T. Kato of the optical brightening of GM Sgr (vsnet-alert 3475). 1999-09-15 17:25:00
response: 该现象描述了一个X射线暂现源SAX J1819.3-2525（即GM Sgr）在1999年9月15日发生的剧烈X射线暴发事件。首先，ASM在UT时间9月15.420测得其流量为1.55±0.04 Crab（2–12 keV），随后数小时内流量迅速上升：在约2分钟内小幅波动后，于0.068天（约1.6小时）内升至2.41 Crab，再经1分钟升至3.74 Crab，之后在约5.2小时后跃升至10.0 Crab，最终在2分钟内达12.2 Crab。整体光变显示极快的上升趋势，尤其在后期呈现指数级增长特征。流量误差仅由计数统计决定，表明信噪比高、测量可靠。谱形比Crab硬，暗示热辐射温度升高或非热过程主导。该X射线暴发与光学监测者Kato报告的GM Sgr光学增亮（vsnet-alert 3475）时间高度吻合，支持其为同一多波段爆发事件，符合黑洞X射线双星系统在软态或中间态暴发的典型行为——吸积盘不稳定性导致内区温度与辐射效率剧增，从而引发宽能段同步增强。

G. Djorgovski, R. R. Gal, A. Mahabal on 16.25 Sept 1999 UT. The star has extraordinarily strong Balmer emission lines as well as strong He I 5876 Angstrom emission. The lines appear broad with wings extending to at least +/- 6000 km/s. More detailed analysis of this data continues. 1999-09-16 18:03:00
response:
首先，观测对象是GM Sgr，处于光学爆发阶段，且该光学爆发紧随其X射线爆发之后（参考ATEL #43和IAUC #7119），表明这是一个多波段爆发事件，可能存在物理关联性。  
其次，光谱获取于1999年9月16.25日UT，使用帕洛玛山海尔200英寸望远镜，属于低分辨率光学光谱，因此谱线形态（如宽度、轮廓）可被识别，但精细结构（如次级成分、微弱吸收或窄发射）可能受限。  
第三，光谱特征显示“异常强的巴尔末发射线”（即Hα、Hβ等），同时存在“强He I 5876 Å发射线”，说明辐射区富含氢与中性氦，且处于激发态而非电离态（He II未被强调），暗示气体温度适中（约1–2万K）、电子密度较高，符合经典激变变星（如矮新星或类新星）爆发期间吸积盘或喷流/风中的发射机制。  
第四，“谱线宽且翼展达±6000 km/s”表明存在高速运动气体，可能源于吸积盘内区旋转、爆发驱动的外流、或双极喷流；该速度量级远超典型恒星大气热速度，排除热致宽主导，而更支持动力学致宽（如转动、膨胀或湍流）。  
第五，观测时间（1999-09-16 18:03:00 UT）与光谱获取时间（16.25 Sept UT = 16日18:00 UT）一致，说明数据时效性强，能有效捕捉爆发峰值或早期演化阶段；但“更详细分析仍在进行”提示当前结论基于初步测量，线宽数值、等值宽度、谱线比（如Hα/Hβ、He I/Hα）及连续谱能量分布等关键参数尚未公布，需后续高信噪比或多历元数据验证物理模型。
