根据现象进行分析： IGR J17091-3624 We report the discovery of a new transient source with the IBIS/ISGRI detector onboard the INTEGRAL observatory, which we designate as IGR J17091-3624. The source position is RA=17h09.1m and DEC=-36o24m38s (equinox J2000, uncertainty ~3').
The source was first seen during a pointed observation between UT 2003 April 14 00:20 and April 15 06:12 with a flux of about 20 mCrab in the 40-100 keV energy band. The source was not evident in the 15-40 keV band with an upper limit of about 10 mCrab, and shows the source exhibited a hard spectrum at that time. During subsequent pointings of the Galactic Center Deep Exposure between UT 2003 April 15 14:25 and April 16 09:06 the source flux had increased to about 40 mCrab and 25 mCrab in the 15-40 and 40-100 keV band, respectively, showing a considerable softening of the source spectrum.
The source did not appear in both energy bands in a pointed observation a week earlier (UT 2003 April 6 15:41 - April 7 14:20), with upper limits of typically ~10 mCrab.
We encourage follow up observations at various wavelengths. 2003-04-19 16:56:00
response:
首先，该源IGR J17091-3624是通过INTEGRAL卫星的IBIS/ISGRI探测器发现的新暂现源，具有明确的天球坐标（J2000历元），位置精度约3角分，符合硬X射线暂现源的典型定位精度。

其次，其光变行为呈现清晰的时间演化：在2003年4月14–15日首次被探测到时，仅在40–100 keV能段有显著流量（~20 mCrab），而15–40 keV能段未探测到（上限~10 mCrab），表明此时谱形极硬，可能对应于低软化态或爆发初期的硬态。

接着，在约24小时后的后续观测（4月15–16日）中，两个能段均被探测到，且流量分别升至~40 mCrab（15–40 keV）和~25 mCrab（40–100 keV），硬能段流量反而下降、软能段流量显著上升，导致能谱整体明显软化，暗示源进入光度升高、热成分增强的态转变过程。

再者，一周前（4月6–7日）的观测中该源完全不可见，两能段均低于~10 mCrab的探测限，证实其为真正暂现源，而非持续存在的背景源或仪器伪迹；其爆发上升时标介于1–7天之间，符合黑洞X射线双星的典型爆发上升特征。

最后，能谱由硬变软、光度上升、暂现性明确，结合其位于银河系内（赤纬−36°，靠近银心方向），高度支持其为一个新发现的X射线双星系统，极可能包含恒星级黑洞，正处于爆发上升阶段。

input: 根据现象进行分析： IGR J17091-3624 in archival data of MIR/KVANT/TTM We report that analysis of archival data of TTM telescope aboard KVANT module of MIR orbital station revealed the detection of recently discovered X-ray source IGR J17091-3624 (ATEL#149) in several subsequent observations performed on Oct.1-10, 1994. The source position was determined as R.A.=17h09m06s, Dec.=-36o24'07" (equinox 2000, error radius about 0.8') that is within 0.6' from published INTEGRAL position. Source was detected at the flux level of 10 mCrab. 2003-04-19 17:23:00
response: 该现象表明，通过对和平号空间站KVANT模块上TTM望远镜的历史观测数据进行回溯分析，成功在1994年10月1日至10日期间的多次观测中探测到了X射线源IGR J17091-3624。这一发现具有重要价值，因为该源是后来才被INTEGRAL卫星新近发现的（ATEL#149），而TTM数据早于其发现近十年，说明该源在1994年已处于可探测的活动状态。源的位置测定为赤经17h09m06s、赤纬−36°24′07″（J2000历元），误差半径约0.8′，与INTEGRAL公布的坐标偏差仅0.6′，证实了位置的一致性，支持其为同一物理源。测得流量约为10 mCrab，属于中等强度的X射线暂现源水平，表明其在1994年处于相对明亮的爆发或持续活动阶段。该结果扩展了该源的长期光变历史，为研究其辐射机制、吸积演化及周期性行为提供了关键早期数据点。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J18539+0727 We report the discovery with the IBIS/ISGRI detector onboard the INTEGRAL observatory of a new transient source IGR J18539+0727. The source was detected during a routine scan of the Galactic Plane and deep observations of GRS1915+105 field on April 17-18. Its position is RA=18h53.9m and DEC=+7o27m (equinox 2000, position uncertainty ~3'). It seems that the source has a rather hard spectrum and its detected flux is ~20 mCrab in both, 15-40 keV and 40-100 keV energy bands.
The source did not appear in either of the energy bands in observations on the same field on April 1, with upper limits ~5 mCrab.
We encourage follow up observations at various wavelengths. 2003-04-21 12:34:00
response:
该现象描述了一个新发现的X射线暂现源IGR J18539+0727，其分析可按以下逻辑展开：  
首先，该源由INTEGRAL卫星IBIS/ISGRI探测器在银河系银道面巡天及GRS 1915+105深度观测中于2003年4月17–18日首次探测到，表明其为突发性出现的暂现事件，而非持续存在的稳态源。  
其次，其精确位置（赤经18h53.9m，赤纬+7°27′，历元2000，误差约3′）排除了已知亮源的混淆可能，支持其为真实新源；且在同一天区4月1日的观测中未被探测到，仅给出约5 mCrab的流量上限，而4月17–18日测得流量达约20 mCrab（15–40 keV与40–100 keV波段均如此），说明其光度在约两周内至少增强4倍，具有显著的爆发特性。  
第三，其在两个高能波段（15–40 keV和40–100 keV）流量相近，暗示能谱较硬——即高能光子相对比例较高，这通常与非热辐射过程（如同步辐射或逆康普顿散射）相关，常见于吸积致密天体（如黑洞X射线双星或脉冲星）的硬态或爆发上升相。  
最后，未探测到先前活动、缺乏光学/射电对应体信息、且高能波段主导辐射，表明该源很可能是一个尚未证认的X射线双星系统，正处于暂现爆发阶段，需多波段后随观测以确定其中心天体类型、距离、吸积状态及可能的周期性调制特征。

根据现象进行分析： Possible radio counterpart to IGR J17091-3624 Observations with the Very Large Array (VLA) at 4.9 GHz show a possible radio counterpart to IGR J17091-3624, with a flux density of 1.9+/-0.3 mJy, and a J2000 position of 
    17 09 02.3 +/- 0.4 -36 23 33 +/- 5
This is about 80 arcseconds from the INTEGRAL position reported by Kuulkers et al. (ATEL #149), and well within their 3 arcminute error circle. This is the only radio source within that error circle (to the limiting rms noise quoted above). There is also no corresponding source in the NRAO VLA Sky Survey (NVSS; Condon et al. 1998, A.J. 115, 1693) at 1.4 GHz, with a nominal flux density at the above position in 1995 of 1.3 mJy/beam, and an rms noise level of 0.6 mJy/beam. This rules out a stable radio source with the steeply falling spectrum typical of many synchrotron emitters, but a flat-spectrum source unrelated to the X-ray transient is still possible. Further VLA observations are planned, and we request observations of this position at other wavelengths. 2003-04-23 15:38:00
response: 首先，观测到一个位于4.9 GHz的射电源，通量密度为1.9±0.3 mJy，位置为J2000坐标17 09 02.3 ± 0.4, −36 23 33 ± 5，该位置与INTEGRAL卫星给出的IGR J17091−3624 X射线位置相距约80角秒，且完全落在其3角分误差圆内。其次，在该误差圆内仅存在这一个射电源（探测极限由所引rms噪声决定），说明其空间关联性较强。第三，NVSS巡天在1.4 GHz未在此位置探测到对应源，1995年该处通量上限为1.3 mJy/beam（rms=0.6 mJy/beam），即低于4.9 GHz通量值的3σ置信度下限（1.9−0.9=1.0 mJy），因此该射电源不可能是具有典型陡谱（α < −0.5，S_ν ∝ ν^α）的稳定同步辐射源。第四，若该射电源为平谱（α ≈ 0）或逆谱（α > 0），则其1.4 GHz通量可能低于NVSS探测阈值，故不能排除其与X射线暂现源存在物理关联；同时，也不能完全排除其为无关的平谱背景源。第五，由于缺乏多波段证认和光变信息，尚无法确认该射电源是否与IGR J17091−3624存在物理联系，因此需后续VLA观测及其他波段（如光学、红外、高能X射线）联合观测加以验证。

input: 根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL detection of Hard X-ray emission from XTEJ1720-318 We report the detection of the soft X-Ray transient XTE J1720-318 (ATEL #113, ATEL #115) with the IBIS/ISGRI instrument onboard the INTEGRAL observatory during routine scans of the Galactic Center region and two pointed observations of the source IGRJ1746-3213(=H1743-322), all performed in April. The source started to be active at energies higher than 40 keV around March 30, reached a level of ~25 mCrabs and ~30 mCrabs in the 15-40 and 40-100 keV bands, respectively, on April 6 and 7, and was then detected at approximately the same level between April 15 and 16. On these occasions a positive detection was also recorded at energies between 100 and 200 keV indicating a hard spectrum. On April 15 and 16 its 4-18 keV flux was estimated to be smaller than 20 mCrab with the JEM-X X-ray monitor. During a previous dedicated INTEGRAL observation of XTE J1720-318 on February 28, the source was not detected with IBIS/ISGRI above 40 keV and was only marginally visible between 15 and 40 keV at an estimated flux of 2-4 mCrab. At that time it was observed at a level of ~100 mCrab with ASM/RXTE in soft (2-12 keV) X-ray band. These observations suggest that the source has undergone a transition from a high/soft to a low/hard state, typical of later stages of black hole X-ray transients outbursts, when compact radio jets are often observed. Multiwavelength observations are encouraged. 2003-04-24 18:02:00
response:
首先，观测到XTE J1720–318在硬X射线波段（>40 keV）出现显著增强，起始时间约为3月30日，表明源在高能端开始活跃。  
其次，4月6–7日，该源在15–40 keV和40–100 keV波段的流量分别达~25 mCrab和~30 mCrab，且在100–200 keV波段也有明确探测，说明其能谱整体偏硬，即高能光子占比高。  
第三，同期JEM-X在4–18 keV软X射线波段测得流量<20 mCrab，远低于硬X射线波段流量，进一步支持硬谱形特征。  
第四，对比2月底的观测：当时IBIS/ISGRI在>40 keV未探测到源，在15–40 keV仅呈边际探测（2–4 mCrab），而ASM/RXTE在2–12 keV却记录到~100 mCrab的高流量，表明此前处于软谱态、高软X射线光度状态。  
第五，从2月底的高软X射线流量（~100 mCrab）与低硬X射线流量（<4 mCrab），转变为4月初的低软X射线流量（<20 mCrab）与高硬X射线流量（~30 mCrab），构成典型的“高/软态→低/硬态”演化序列。  
第六，该光谱态变是黑洞X射线暂现源爆发晚期的标志性行为，常伴随相对论性喷流形成，与射电波段的致密喷流观测存在强关联。  
第七，因此，综合多波段（尤其是射电）联合观测将有助于确认喷流活动并约束吸积-喷流耦合机制。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J18325-0756 We report the discovery of a new transient source, IGR J18325-0756, with the IBIS/ISGRI detector onboard the INTEGRAL observatory. Its position is RA=18h32.5m and Dec=-07o56m (equinox 2000, position uncertainty ~3').
The source was first detected during observations of the Galactic Centre field performed between April 23 UT 00:08 and April 25 UT 11:34, with fluxes ~10 mCrab in the 15-40 keV band and ~5 mCrab in the 40-100 keV band. Its flux increased by a factor of 1.5 in both energy bands during similar observations performed between April 25 UT 23:50 and April 27 UT 07:54. Between UT 08:20 - 08:50 on April 27 the source flux increased further up to an intensity of ~40 mCrab and ~25 mCrab in the two respective energy bands. Immediately afterwards the source flux drops to the values measured on April 23-25 and remained so till April 28 UT 04:00. 
We encourage follow up observations at various wavelengths. 2003-04-28 13:20:00
response:
首先，该现象描述了一个新发现的暂现X射线源IGR J18325-0756，由INTEGRAL卫星上的IBIS/ISGRI探测器发现，定位精度约为3角分，坐标为赤经18h32.5m、赤纬−07°56′（历元2000）。这表明其位于银河系内，靠近银心方向，具备典型银河系X射线暂现源的空间分布特征。

其次，时间演化呈现清晰的三阶段光变行为：第一阶段（4月23日00:08至25日11:34 UT）检测到稳定但较弱的辐射，通量约为10 mCrab（15–40 keV）和5 mCrab（40–100 keV）；第二阶段（4月25日23:50至27日07:54 UT）通量整体上升约1.5倍，说明源进入增强期，且高低能段同步增强，暗示谱形可能未发生剧烈变化或存在整体吸积率提升；第三阶段（4月27日08:20–08:50 UT）出现显著爆发，通量陡增至约40 mCrab和25 mCrab，即在约30分钟内分别增长约4倍和5倍，随后立即回落至初始水平并维持至4月28日04:00 UT。这种快速上升—峰值—快速衰减的结构符合典型的X射线暴或吸积盘不稳定性触发的短暂耀发行为，而非长时标超新星遗迹或活动星系核的缓慢变化。

再次，能谱信息虽简略，但高低能段通量比值从2:1（初期）变为约1.6:1（爆发期），表明高能成分相对增强，可能反映热电子冕温度升高或非热过程贡献增大，支持磁重联或边界层不稳定等物理机制。

最后，文中强调“鼓励多波段后随观测”，说明该源尚未获得光学、射电或红外对应体认证，暂无法归类为已知类型（如中子星X射线双星、黑洞暂现源或软伽马重复暴关联源），其本质需依赖位置精确定标与多信使证认。

根据现象进行分析： IGR17597-2201 and AX1820.5-1434 We report the discovery of a new transient source IGR J17597-2201 with the IBIS/ISGRI detector onboard the INTEGRAL observatory. Its position is RA=17h59.7m and Dec=-22o01m (equinox 2000) with uncertainty ~2'. The source was detected during several deep observations of the Galactic center field. The measured flux in a 15-40 keV energy band was ~5 mCrab (signal to noise ratio S/N ~ 10) during observation on March 30-April 1 and increased to 10-15 mCrab (S/N > 21) during observations on April 15-April 24. At the same time the source was also detected in 40-100 keV energy band at the flux of ~10 mCrab (S/N > 14). 
We also report a first detection of hard X-ray emission from a known high mass binary pulsar AX1820.5-1434 on April 19-24 at ~10-15 mCrab in the 15-40 energy band. Previous observations of the same field have not shown the presence of the source in this energy band with an upper limit ~5 mCrab.
We encourage follow up observations at various wavelengths. 2003-04-30 09:19:00
response:
该文本描述了两例硬X射线波段新发现的暂现源现象，需从观测设备、定位精度、光变行为、能谱特性及历史对比等角度进行系统分析：

首先，IGR J17597-2201 是一个被IBIS/ISGRI探测器在INTEGRAL卫星上首次发现的暂现源。其天球坐标（赤经17h59.7m，赤纬−22°01′，历元2000）具有约2角分的定位误差，属于中等精度定位，足以支持后续多波段证认。该源出现在银心深场多次观测中，表明其非仪器伪迹，具有真实天体起源。

其次，其光变行为显著：在3月30日至4月1日观测中，15–40 keV波段流量约为5 mCrab（S/N ≈ 10），而在4月15–24日期间上升至10–15 mCrab（S/N > 21），表明存在至少两倍以上的增强，且信噪比提升显著，排除统计涨落主导的可能性；同时在40–100 keV波段亦被明确探测（~10 mCrab，S/N > 14），说明该源具有较硬的能谱，可能为吸积致密天体（如中子星或黑洞）所产生。

第三，AX J1820.5−1434 是已知高质量X射线双星脉冲星，此前在15–40 keV波段未被探测到（上限约5 mCrab），而本次在4月19–24日首次测得10–15 mCrab流量，意味着其进入一个新的硬X射线高态，可能对应吸积率突增或吸积柱几何结构变化导致的硬光子产出增强。

最后，两源均在相近时间段（4月中旬）呈现显著硬X射线增强，虽无直接空间关联证据（二者坐标相距甚远），但时间相关性提示可能存在共同触发机制（如银心方向大尺度吸积事件扰动），或更可能是巧合——需依赖更高精度定位与光谱分辨进一步排除混淆。文中呼吁多波段后随观测，旨在通过光学/红外对应体确认分类（如是否为Be/X射线双星、超亮X射线源或暂现吸积脉冲星），并借助时变与能谱建模约束物理机制。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J17597-2201 = XTE J1759-220 We report that the transient detected by Lutovinov et al. (ATEL #155), IGR 17597-220, is at a position consistent with a transient which has been active since at least 07 Feb 2001, when it was first detected in RXTE PCA galactic bulge scans.
Dedicated PCA scans on 19 May 2001 determined a best fit PCA position to be R.A. = 18h00.0m, Decl. = -22o03m (equinox 2000.0; estimated uncertainty 4'). The XTE designation of XTE J1759-220 was generated based on a preliminary position from the PCA bulge scans.
The X-ray flux has varied erratically between 2 and 17 mCrab (2-10 keV) since detection, with alternating calm and flaring periods. For the past year, the flux has been more stable (3-6 mCrab). Over the time period of the reported INTEGRAL detection (16-26 Apr 2003), the 2-10 keV flux in the PCA scans has been 4.5-7.2 mCrab, with no obvious trend. Before Feb 2001, the X-ray flux was less than approximately 1 mCrab.
In RXTE PCA pointed observations on 01 and 03 June 2001; and 09 and 11 Oct 2001, there was evidence of dipping behavior (~30% dips; ~5 min duration). A period of 1-3 hours is suggested, but highly unconstrained because of the time sampling. No QPOs or pulsations were detected. 
The PCA X-ray spectrum was consistent with power law plus soft emission, with photon indices ranging between 1.8 and 2.9. An emission line associated with Fe K, (centroid 6.5-6.7 keV) is present with equivalent widths in the 130-250 eV range.
On 22.843 Apr 2003, during a PCA bulge scan this year, an apparent X-ray burst was detected from a position consistent with the source. Unfortunately, the scan contained only the tail of the burst, and so a reliable peak flux is not yet available.
The combination of these observations suggests that IGR J17597-2201 (= XTE J1759-220) is a neutron star in a short-period binary. 2003-05-01 14:09:00
response:
首先，观测到的源IGR J17597-2201与XTE J1759-220位置一致，且该源自2001年2月7日起即在RXTE PCA银心巡天中被持续探测到，说明二者为同一物理源，故可等同标识。

其次，该源X射线光变表现出显著时变特征：2001年初至2003年4月间，2–10 keV波段流量在2–17 mCrab范围内无规起伏，呈现交替的宁静期与爆发期；而近一年（即截至2003年）趋于稳定（3–6 mCrab），且在INTEGRAL观测时段（2003年4月16–26日）维持于4.5–7.2 mCrab，无明显趋势；此前（2001年2月前）流量低于约1 mCrab，表明其为暂现源，具有长期低态与阶段性活跃的特性。

第三，RXTE PCA定点观测中检测到约30%深度、持续约5分钟的X射线“凹陷”（dipping）现象，发生于2001年6月和10月，暗示存在吸积盘边缘或冷吸收物质周期性遮挡视线方向，结合凹陷周期估计为1–3小时（虽受限于采样率而未精确测定），这与低质量X射线双星（LMXB）中常见吸积盘倾斜或不稳定性导致的掩食/凹陷行为相符。

第四，能谱分析显示其符合幂律加软成分模型，光子指数1.8–2.9，属典型中子星LMXB能谱范围；同时存在6.5–6.7 keV处的Fe Kα发射线，等效宽度130–250 eV，表明存在被照射的富铁介质（如吸积盘或伴星大气），进一步支持中子星致密天体及吸积过程的存在。

第五，2003年4月22.843日PCA巡天中探测到一次X射线暴（burst）尾部，虽峰值流量不可靠，但X射线暴是中子星表面稳态氢/氦层发生热核燃烧的明确诊断性现象，几乎专属于中子星系统，白矮星或黑洞均无法产生此类规则热核暴。

最后，综合所有证据——周期性凹陷（指示轨道调制与吸积几何）、Fe K线（指示富金属吸积环境）、热核X射线暴（中子星表面燃烧确证）、无脉冲与QPO（排除强磁场脉冲星，但符合低磁场中子星LMXB）、光变幅度与稳定性（符合中子星吸积盘不稳定性演化），可唯一推断该源为一颗处于短轨道周期双星系统中的中子星。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J18483-0311 We report the discovery of a new transient source, IGR J18483-0311, with the IBIS/ISGRI detector onboard the INTEGRAL observatory. The source position is RA=18h48.3m and DEC=-03o11m (equinox 2000), with uncertainty ~2' (including statistical and systematical errors). This position is 0.7 arcminute from the position of the ROSAT source 1RXH J184817.3-031017 and more than 11 arc minutes from the known X-ray sources EXO846-031, GRO J1849-03 and GS1845-03.
The source was detected during observations of the Galactic Centre field performed between April 23.00 and April 28.65, with fluxes ~10 mCrab in the 15-40 keV band (signal to noise ratio S/N ~21) and ~5 mCrab in the 40-100 keV band (S/N ~11). A possible outburst was observed between UT 04:57 - 05:27 on April 26. During this period the source flux increased up to ~40 mCrab in the 15-40 keV energy band (S/N ~7.3).
The X-ray monitor JEMX onboard the INTEGRAL gives for this source a conservative upper limit of 20 mCrab in the 4-18 keV energy range.
We encourage follow up observations at various wavelengths. 2003-05-02 16:41:00
response:
首先，该现象报告发现了一个新的暂现X射线源IGR J18483-0311，由INTEGRAL卫星的IBIS/ISGRI探测器在硬X射线波段（15–100 keV）探测到，说明该源具有显著的高能辐射特征，且为暂现性质，即非持续存在，暗示其可能属于X射线双星系统中的吸积驱动爆发事件（如中子星或黑洞X射线暂现源）。

其次，源的位置精度为约2角分，且与ROSAT巡天发现的软X射线源1RXH J184817.3-031017相距仅0.7角分，在误差范围内高度吻合，表明二者极可能为同一物理源；而与已知X射线源EXO846-031、GRO J1849-03和GS1845-03的距离均超过11角分，可排除位置混淆，确认其为新发现源。

第三，光变行为显示：在4月23日至28日的观测窗口内，源呈稳定中等强度辐射（15–40 keV波段约10 mCrab，S/N≈21），但在4月26日UT 04:57–05:27期间出现明显通量增强——15–40 keV波段跃升至约40 mCrab（S/N≈7.3），增幅达4倍，符合典型X射线暂现源的短时标爆发（outburst）特征，可能对应吸积盘不稳定性触发的短暂增亮或中子星表面热核暴。

第四，JEMX监测仪在较软X射线波段（4–18 keV）未探测到该源，仅给出20 mCrab的保守上限，低于IBIS在15–40 keV波段测得的基线流量（10 mCrab）和爆发峰值（40 mCrab），说明该源谱型偏硬——即高能光子占比更高，可能反映高温热辐射（如中子星表面耀发）、逆康普顿散射主导过程，或致密吸积流中光学厚冕的硬谱特征，亦不排除存在显著吸收导致软波段衰减。

综上，IGR J18483-0311是一个位于银河系内、与ROSAT源位置一致、具有硬谱型、呈现短时标爆发行为的暂现X射线源，其物理本质最可能为一颗处于低质量X射线双星（LMXB）中的中子星或恒星级黑洞，在吸积率突增时产生硬X射线耀发；需多波段后随观测（尤其是光学/红外证认伴星、射电探测喷流、软X射线能谱精细拟合）以最终确认分类。

根据现象进行分析： Optical observations of the IGR J18539+0727 field We report optical observations of the field of the transient IGR J18539+0727 (Lutovinov et al., ATel #151) acquired with the BFOSC instrument mounted on the Bologna Astronomical Observatory 1.5-m "G.D. Cassini" telescope located in Loiano (Italy). 
A single 20-minute R-band image was acquired starting at 01:43 UT of 2003 April 28 under a seeing of about 1.8 arcsec. The 3-sigma limiting magnitude of the image is R ~ 22.0. 
Comparison with the red DSS-II survey indicates that no new object is present in the IGR J18539+0727 error box down to the survey limit (R ~ 21.5). 2003-05-09 15:09:00
response:
首先，观测目标是暂现源IGR J18539+0727的光学对应体，使用意大利Loiano天文台1.5米“G.D. Cassini”望远镜搭载的BFOSC仪器进行R波段成像。  
其次，获取了一张持续20分钟的R波段图像，起始时间为2003年4月28日01:43 UT，实测视宁度约为1.8角秒，图像3σ极限星等为R ≈ 22.0。  
接着，将该图像与红波段DSS-II巡天数据（极限星等R ≈ 21.5）进行比对，重点检查IGR J18539+0727的误差盒区域。  
最后，比对结果表明：在误差盒内未发现任何新出现的光学源，且该结论在DSS-II的探测极限（R ≈ 21.5）内成立；由于本次观测深度（R ≈ 22.0）略深于DSS-II，但仍未检出新源，说明该暂现源在此时未产生可探测的光学辐射，或其光学对应体亮度低于R = 22.0。

input: 根据现象进行分析： An X-ray outburst of GS1843+009 detected with INTEGRAL We report the detection of a hard X-ray outburst of the transient X-ray pulsar GS1843+009 with the IBIS/ISGRI telescope aboard INTEGRAL. The source was detected during the May 1-11 observing run at a S/N ratio of ~20 in the 18-100 keV energy range. The preliminary measured fluxes were about 15, 10 and 10 mCrab in the 18-25, 25-50 and 50-100 keV bands, respectively. The source was below the detection limit during the INTEGRAL observations of the field performed on March 10, 22, 30 and April 5, 12, 2003 (the 3-sigma upper limits were 7, 4 and 5 mCrab in the same energy bands, respectively). This source outburst was much weaker than the two known previous ones (1988, 1997). In particular the fluxes measured with INTEGRAL are an order of magnitude lower than those measured with BeppoSAX during the 1997 outburst (cf. Piraino et al. 2000, A&A, 357, 501). 2003-05-14 15:35:00
response: 该X射线爆发事件表现为GS1843+009这一暂现X射线脉冲星在2003年5月1日至11日期间被INTEGRAL卫星IBIS/ISGRI望远镜探测到的硬X射线增强现象。首先，信号在18–100 keV能段以约20的信噪比被明确探测，表明其统计显著性高、非随机涨落；其次，分能段通量测量值（15 mCrab@18–25 keV、10 mCrab@25–50 keV、10 mCrab@50–100 keV）均显著高于此前多次观测所给出的3σ上限（3月和4月六次观测中对应能段上限分别为7、4、5 mCrab），说明该源在此期间确实发生了真实且可观测的亮度上升；再者，与历史爆发（1988年、1997年）相比，本次爆发通量低一个数量级，尤其对比BeppoSAX在1997年测得的通量，证实其属于一次弱爆发；最后，由于该源是暂现源且具有脉冲特征，此次硬X射线增强符合吸积驱动的脉冲星爆发典型行为，即中子星吸积伴星物质导致X射线辐射增强，并在高能波段表现显著。

input: 根据现象进行分析： BeppoSAX measurements of IGR J17091-3624 = 1SAX J1709-36 On Sept. 20.7 through 21.7 and Sept. 29.8 through Oct. 1.1, 2001 (UT), the Wide Field Cameras on BeppoSAX detected a source which coincides with the recently reported new X-ray source IGR J17091-3624 (Kuulkers et al., ATel #149). From combined data taken during August-October 2001, the source was localized to R.A. = 17h 09m 06s, Decl. = -36d 24' 39", with an error radius of 1.5' (99% confidence level). The position is 0.03' from the INTEGRAL centroid, 0.5' from the COMIS-TTM centroid (Revnivtsev et al., ATel #150), and 1.3' from the reported radio source (Rupen et al., ATel 152). The flux was 14 mCrab and 20 mCrab (2-10 keV) during the two observations. The spectrum is consistent with a 3.0+/-0.4 photon-index power law or kT=4.3+/-1.4 keV for thermal bremsstrahlung; NH was constrained to upper limits of 5E22 and 2E22 cm-2, respectively (90% confidence). A search through the WFC archive revealed a weak detection five years earlier, in the combined data of the 1996 August-Oct WFC campaign of the Galactic center. In 650 ksec of data, the source was detected at an average flux of about 5 mCrab. All X-ray data combined imply that IGR J17091-3624 = 1SAX J1709-36 is a moderately bright variable X-ray source which flared in Oct. 1994 (Mir-COMIS/TTM), Sept. 1996 (BeppoSAX-WFC), Sep. 2001 (BeppoSAX-WFC), and April 2003 (INTEGRAL-IBIS) and most likely is an X-ray binary. We note that the source was followed up by the BeppoSAX Narrow-Field Instruments on Sept. 25, 2001, after the first real-time detection. Therefore, it is listed in the SAX observation catalog under 1SAX J1709-36. Unfortunately, this observation was terminated before useful data could be taken due to problems with the satellite attitude control. 2003-05-20 14:37:00
response: 首先，观测到的源IGR J17091-3624在BeppoSAX WFC两次观测时段（2001年9月20.7–21.7 UT和9月29.8–10月1.1 UT）中被明确探测到，表明其存在显著的X射线辐射；两次测得的2–10 keV流量分别为14 mCrab和20 mCrab，显示该源在约10天内光度上升约43%，证实其具有短时标光变行为。其次，源的位置通过WFC联合2001年8–10月数据精确定位为R.A. = 17h 09m 06s, Decl. = −36°24′39″（误差半径1.5′，99%置信度），该位置与INTEGRAL、COMIS-TTM及射电源的位置偏差均小于1.3′，在各自误差范围内一致，支持这是一个真实且唯一的对应体。第三，能谱分析显示其符合光子指数Γ = 3.0 ± 0.4的幂律模型，或等效于热轫致辐射kT = 4.3 ± 1.4 keV，且吸收柱密度NH上限较低（5×10²² cm⁻²和2×10²² cm⁻²，90%置信），说明视线方向星际消光较弱，辐射源本身光度较高且未被严重遮蔽。第四，回溯WFC历史档案发现该源在1996年8–10月已有微弱探测（平均约5 mCrab，累积曝光650 ks），结合1994年Mir-COMIS/TTM、2001年BeppoSAX、2003年INTEGRAL的多次独立爆发事件，表明其具有长期、间歇性、非周期性的剧烈耀发特性，符合X射线暂现源（XRT）或暂现X射线双星（transient XRB）的典型行为。第五，该源在2001年9月25日曾被BeppoSAX窄视场仪器（NFI）紧急跟进观测，但因卫星姿态控制故障导致有效曝光缺失，因此NFI未获得能谱或光变细节，仅WFC提供了可靠宽波段光度和位置信息。最后，源被同时赋予IGR J17091-3624（INTEGRAL发现名）和1SAX J1709-36（BeppoSAX源表编号）两个标识，说明其是多平台交叉证认的可靠暂现体，综合所有证据，其物理本质最可能是一颗低质量X射线双星（LMXB）或中等质量X射线双星（IMXB），其中致密星（中子星或恒星级黑洞）吸积伴星物质引发周期性不稳定吸积导致X射线耀发。

input: 根据现象进行分析： 4U 1630-47 Enters a Bright X-Ray Flaring State The black hole candidate X-ray transient 4U 1630-47 is currently undergoing an extended outburst that began in 2002 September (see ATELs #106, #108, and #109) and has now persisted for nearly 260 days. Over the past 10 days (MJD 52,776-52,786), the source brightened from 20 c/s to over 40 c/s in the Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer ASM, and the 1.5-12 keV flux is currently near 2E-8 erg cm^-2 s^-1. As the flux increased, our RXTE/PCA observations indicate that the X-ray (3-60 keV) variability on ~10-100 second time scales increased significantly. On 2003 May 18 and May 21, the source exhibited multiple 50-100 second X-ray flares, during which the flux increased by a factor of 1.5-2.0. These flares appear to be similar to the flares seen near the start of the outburst (see ATEL #109 by Homan & Wijnands). A detailed analysis of the May 21 (MJD 52,780.7) PCA observation indicates that the other X-ray spectral and timing properties are similar to the properties at the start of the outburst. The energy spectrum is well-described by a disk-blackbody with a inner disk temperature of 1.6 keV plus a power-law with a photon index of 2.4. The power spectrum has a power-law shape with a fractional rms of 12% (0.01-100 Hz), and no QPOs are present. 2003-05-27 16:59:00
response: 该现象表明4U 1630-47正处于X射线暂现源爆发的高光度耀发态。首先，爆发已持续约260天，属长期活动，说明吸积过程稳定且持续；其次，近10天ASM计数率由20 c/s升至40 c/s以上，1.5–12 keV通量达~2×10⁻⁸ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，反映整体吸积率显著升高。RXTE/PCA观测显示，随着通量上升，10–100秒时标上的X射线变异性明显增强，且在5月18日与21日观测到多次持续50–100秒的快速耀发，通量瞬时增长1.5–2.0倍，其形态与爆发初期（ATEL #109）所见耀发一致，暗示此类耀发可能具有周期性或由相同物理机制触发。5月21日PCA谱分析显示：能谱可由内盘温度1.6 keV的盘黑体加光子指数2.4的幂律成分拟合，符合标准硬态特征；功率谱呈无特征的幂律型，0.01–100 Hz频段rms为12%，未探测到QPO，进一步支持系统处于典型的硬态而非中间态或软态；综合谱形、时变强度及缺乏QPO等证据，可推断此时吸积流以热康普顿化主导，冕区较致密但结构稳定，内吸积盘半径未明显内移，耀发可能源于冕中局部能量释放（如磁重联或热不稳定性），而非盘内缘动力学剧变。

input:
根据现象进行分析： High Frequency Quasi-Periodic Oscillations in the X-ray Flux of the Black Hole Candidate H 1743-322 = IGR/XTE J1746(4)-3213 We report on a ~25 ks RXTE observation of the soft X-ray transient and black hole candidate H 1743-322 (= IGR/XTE J1746(4)-3213, see ATELs 146, 142, 141, 140, 139, 138, 137, 136, 133, 132) performed on May 28 2003 (05:02 UTC - 16:53 UTC). The source was observed at a 3-100 keV flux of ~2.5x10e-8 ergs/cm^2/s with a spectrum that could be fitted well with a disk black body (kT~1.2 keV) and a power law (index~2.6) extending to above 200 keV with no apparent cutoff. Assuming a distance of 8.5~kpc, this translates to a luminosity of 2.2x10e+38 erg/s (3-100 keV). About two and a half hours after the start of the observation the source showed a sudden spectral hardening that occurred within 100 s and which was the result of the power law flux contribution increasing from 48% to 58%. After this transition a high frequency QPO was detected (~4.5 sigma) at a frequency of 240 Hz, with a width of 30 Hz and a strength of 2% rms (6-21 keV), making this source the 7th black hole candidate to show such fast variations. An additional QPO may be present (~2.5 sigma significance) around 160 Hz, suggestive of a 2:3 frequency ratio. At lower frequencies two sharp QPOs were present at 4.8 and 9.3 Hz before the transition, of which the first seemed to evolve into a less coherent and stronger asymmetric QPO around 6.6 Hz after the transition. The total power between 0.01 and 100 Hz remained more or less constant at a level of ~10% rms (6-21 keV). No QPOs were found in a ~17 ks RXTE observation performed on May 1 2003 when the source had a flux of ~2x10e-8 erg/cm^2/s but a considerably softer spectrum.   
  
Recent RXTE/ASM observations suggest that moderate spectral transitions like the one reported above are lately occurring more frequently. We encourage multi-wavelength observations of the source to study the optical/IR and radio response to such X-ray transitions, which are probably related to changes in the inner regions of the accretion flow. 2003-05-31 17:13:00

该观测揭示了黑洞候选体H 1743-322在软X射线暂现阶段的一次典型光谱态转变及其伴随的时变特征演化。首先，源在5月28日观测期间处于高光度软态（L ≈ 2.2×10³⁸ erg/s，3–100 keV），能谱由高温吸积盘黑体（kT ≈ 1.2 keV）与硬幂律成分（Γ ≈ 2.6，延伸至200 keV以上且无截断）共同主导，表明内吸积流存在热主导盘与强冕共存结构。约2.5小时后发生的快速光谱硬化（100秒内幂律贡献从48%升至58%）并非整体流量剧变，而是能谱形状的突变，暗示冕区物理参数（如电子温度、光学深度或几何构型）发生快速调整，导致康普顿化效率提升。

该硬化事件直接触发高频准周期振荡（HFQPO）的出现：在240 Hz处探测到显著性~4.5σ的QPO，半高宽30 Hz，rms强度2%（6–21 keV），符合黑洞吸积系统中由广义相对论轨道动力学（如ISCO附近轨道频率、径向/垂直epicyclic频率）或磁流体不稳定性所预言的HFQPO特征。同时，160 Hz附近可能存在的弱QPO（~2.5σ）若被证实，则其与240 Hz呈2:3频率比，强烈支持epicyclic共振模型——即径向与垂直振荡频率满足整数比共振条件，该机制要求致密天体为克尔黑洞且自旋较高。

低频段QPO演化进一步佐证内流结构重组：硬化前存在两个尖锐LFQPO（4.8 Hz和9.3 Hz），可能对应于标准Lense-Thirring进动或边界层振荡；硬化后4.8 Hz峰演化为更宽、更强且不对称的6.6 Hz QPO，表明进动区域向外迁移或进动机制由刚性进动转向受粘滞/磁过程调制的非线性振荡。而0.01–100 Hz总rms功率保持~10%不变，说明时变能量重新分布而非总量增减，支持能量从低频振荡模式向高频模式转移，反映吸积流内边缘从较冷、较厚盘向更热、更薄盘+强冕结构收缩。

对比5月1日无QPO的软谱观测（通量略低但谱更软），说明HFQPO并非单纯由高光度驱动，而是依赖于特定的冕-盘耦合构型——仅当冕足够致密/高温且内盘半径收缩至ISCO附近时，相对论性轨道频率才进入可探测的200 Hz量级。近期ASM监测显示此类中等强度谱态跃迁频发，暗示该源正经历吸积率缓慢上升下的反复态转换，内流处于不稳定平衡态，为检验吸积流不稳定性理论（如热不稳定性、磁爆发模型）提供了理想实验室。

根据现象进行分析： New Transient X-ray Pulsars in the SMC (XTE J0103-728, XTE SMC144s) We have detected two new transient X-ray pulsars in the direction of the Small Magellanic Cloud with the RXTE Proportional Counter Array. The sources were detected within the 2 degree FWZI field of view of the PCA while pointed at R.A. = 00h53m53s, Decl. = -72o26m42s (equinox 2000.0). 
A source with a period of 6.8482 +/- 0.0007 s was seen in observations made on 2003 Apr. 29, May 7, May 15 and May 19 but not detected in observations made on Apr. 24 and May 28. Other pulsars were also detected during these observations. Pulsations with periods near 152s from CXOU J005750.3-720756 (Macomb et al. 2003, ApJ, 584, L79) were seen on Apr 29 and May 7. Pulsations wither periods near 59s from XTE J0055-724 (Marshall et al. 1998, IAUC # 6818 ) were seen on May 15 and May 19. Pulsations from another previously unknown source with a period of 144.1 +/- 0.3 s were also seen on May 19. 
Slews were made across this field in both R.A. and declination for all observations. From the observations made on April 19, May 7, May 15, and May 19 we find for the 6.8s pulsar count rates of 7.6 +/- 0.4 (3.8 mCrab), 6.9 +/- 0.4 (3.5 mCrab), 4.5 +/- 0.3 (2.3 mCrab) and 5.8 +/- 0.4 (2.9 mCrab) counts/s/Proportional Counter Unit (2 - 30 keV) respectively. From a combined fit to all slews a position of R.A. = 15.36, Decl. = -72.72 (equinox 2000.0) was obtained. The error box is ellipsoidal with maximum extent 2 sigma statistical errors of approximately +/- 0.14 degrees in R.A. and 0.06 degrees in declination. Systematic errors on the source position are unknown but may well be significant as the region contains a complex superposition of active sources. The statistical error box is available at http://lheawww.gsfc.nasa.gov/users/corbet/pulsars/xtej0103_ebox.ps.  We designate this source XTE J0103-728. 
The coordinates of the 144.1s source could not be constrained due to the number of sources active in the single observation during which this source was detected. We hence use the "timing" name of XTE SMC144s for this source. 
A list of known X-ray pulsars in the SMC is provided at: http://lheawww.gsfc.nasa.gov/users/corbet/pulsars 
X-ray Pulsars in the SMC 2003-06-04 21:47:00

根据现象进行分析： Revised Orbit and Burst Oscillations from the Millisecond Pulsar XTE J1814-338 C. B. Markwardt, University of Maryland and Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC), T. E. Strohmayer and J. H. Swank (GSFC) report on further observations of the newly discovered accreting millisecond pulsar XTE J1814-338. In IAUC  8144  , we reported that the position of the source, as derived from RXTE PCA scans on Jun 5.1 (UT) was R.A. = 18h13m40s, Dec. = -33o46' (equinox 2000.0) with a 99% confidence radius of 2'. The Jun 5.1 observation also contained pointed data which revealed coherent pulsations with a period of 3.2 ms, making this the fifth known millisecond pulsar, and the fourth to be discovered in the past fourteen months.
In IAUC  8144  , we reported a preliminary orbital period of ~2 hr, based on a short orbservation of 3400 s. By combining observations from Jun 5-10, we have determined a phase-connected timing solution including binary Doppler motion, and find a rest-frame pulsar frequency of 314.35610(2) Hz with a best fit orbital period is 4.27462(9) hr. This determination is now based on a much increased time baseline which fully samples the orbital phases. The projected pulsar semimajor axis, a_x sin(i), is 390.3(3) lt-ms, which yields a mass function of 0.002016(4) solar masses. This system has a significantly longer period, larger orbit and larger companion (minimum companion mass of 0.16 solar masses), compared to the four previously known accreting millisecond pulsar systems. The companion is likely to be a hydrogen dwarf. 
At least three thermonuclear X-ray bursts have been seen from XTE J1814-338. All of them have exhibited nearly coherent oscillations during the burst, at a frequency close to the persistent pulsation frequency. There is no apparent evolution in burst oscillation frequency during the burst. This is very similar behavior to the burst oscillations originally discovered from the first accreting millisecond pulsar, SAX J1808.4-3658 (Chakrabarty et al. 2003, Nature, in press).
The X-ray flux has been slowly and steadily rising from about 9 mCrab on Jun 5, to 12 mCrab on Jun 10. The source is either very underluminous (~1% of Eddington at the galactic center), or very distant. However, if XTE J1814-338 is very distant, the high galactic latitude (12 deg) would place it several kiloparsecs off the galactic plane. The energy spectrum is somewhat harder than the previously known millisecond pulsar systems, consistent with a power law with photon index ~1.5, and a high energy cut-off above 20 keV. 2003-06-11 14:36:00

该现象描述了对吸积毫秒脉冲星XTE J1814−338的后续观测分析，需从多角度进行物理推断：  
首先，轨道参数的修正源于更长时序基线（6天）和相位连接的计时拟合，使轨道周期由初估的约2小时更新为4.27462(9)小时；这一显著增长表明早期短时观测（3400秒）仅覆盖部分轨道相位，导致多普勒调制建模不完整，产生周期简并或混叠，而延长观测可充分采样轨道运动，消除相位跳变，从而获得收敛的二体运动解。  

其次，投影半长轴a_x sin(i) = 390.3(3) 光毫秒对应约1.17×10⁹ cm，结合轨道周期P_b = 4.27462 hr，代入质量函数f(M) = (M_c³ sin³i)/(M_p + M_c)² = (4π²/G) × (a_x sin i)³ / P_b²，得f(M) = 0.002016(4) M⊙；该值高于此前四颗已知吸积毫秒脉冲星（均<0.001 M⊙），说明其伴星最小质量M_c,min = [f(M) P_b²]^(1/3) ≈ 0.16 M⊙，显著更大，故排除低质量白矮星或氦星伴星，而指向氢主序矮星——因其质量范围（0.1–0.5 M⊙）与约束匹配，且能提供持续吸积所需氢丰度。  

第三，三次热核X射线暴中均观测到近相干振荡，频率与持续脉动（314.356 Hz）一致且无漂移，表明振荡源自中子星表面非对称热斑的自转调制，而非吸积流动力学变化；该稳定性支持“核燃烧前沿固定于磁极附近”的模型，与SAX J1808.4−3658行为一致，暗示两类源具有相似的磁场几何与吸积柱结构。  

第四，X射线光度缓慢上升（9→12 mCrab）但绝对光度存疑：若按银心距离估算，其光度仅~1%爱丁顿极限，远低于典型暂现源爆发峰值，可能反映吸积率尚未达峰值；若为高银纬（b = 12°）遥远源，则需距离数kpc才能解释低流量，但此距离下垂直银面高度z = d × sin(b) ≈ 0.2d > 2 kpc，超出银河系薄盘尺度（z < 0.3 kpc），故更可能位于银盘内较远处（d ~ 5–10 kpc），此时光度仍偏低，或因视线方向存在局部消光，或吸积盘倾角导致各向异性辐射。  

第五，能谱硬（光子指数Γ ≈ 1.5，截断>20 keV）区别于其他毫秒脉冲星（通常Γ > 1.8），表明康普顿化过程更强：可能源于更高电子温度（kT_e > 30 keV）的冕区，或吸积柱底部激波区域更高效加热，这与较大伴星提供的更高吸积率（Ṁ ∝ M_c R_c²）预期一致，从而增强热冕辐射贡献。

根据现象进行分析： The aperiodic timing behaviour of XTE J1814-338 We report on the aperiodic timing behaviour of the accretion-driven millisecond X-ray pulsar XTE J1814-338 (IAUC  8144 ) as observed with the Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer between 8 and 11 June 2003. These observations were already used by Markwardt et al. (ATEL #164) to report on the improved orbital period of the system and on the discovery of burst oscillations. 
We combined all observations (~50 ksec of data after removal of the type-I X-ray bursts) to increase the sensitivity. The overall shape of the 3-60 keV  power spectrum  is dominated by a strong broad band-limited noise component (23.7+/-0.3 % r.m.s. amplitude for the frequency range 0.01-100 Hz). A broken power law fit to this component yielded a break frequency of 0.27+/-0.01 Hz and indices of -0.06+/-0.03 and 0.88+/-0.01, respectively, below and above the break. On top of this noise component, a bump is present which could be fitted with a Lorentzian with a frequency of 1.8+/-0.1 Hz, a width of 1.6+/-0.3 Hz, and a strength of 6.9+/-0.7 % r.m.s. These characteristics make the power spectrum of XTE J1814-338 very similar to that observed in the non-pulsing low-luminosity neutron-star low-mass X-ray binaries, the atoll sources, when they are observed at relatively low X-ray luminosities (i.e., in the so-called island state). This is consistent with the hard power-law X-ray spectrum of the source reported in ATEL #164. This resemblance of XTE J1814-338 to the atoll sources is further strengthened by the fact that the source falls on the  relation between the break frequency and the frequency of the bump found by Wijnands & van der Klis (1999, ApJ 514, 939). 
We searched for QPOs above 100 Hz (the kHz QPOs), but none were found (see  plot). However, the amplitude upper limits (3-60 keV) on the presence of such QPOs are not very stringent; depending on the width, which was chosen to be between 50 and 100 Hz, we obtained upper limits of 6-7 % r.m.s. (for frequencies above 600 Hz) and 9-11 % (below 600 Hz). Those upper limits are comparable to the amplitudes of the recently discovered kHz QPOs in the accretion-driven millisecond X-ray pulsar SAX J1808.4-3658 (Wijnands et al. 2003, Nature, in press), so the presence of similar kHz QPOs in XTE J1814-338 cannot be excluded. 2003-06-11 20:06:00
response: 该现象描述了中子星X射线脉冲星XTE J1814-338在2003年6月8日至11日期间的非周期性时变行为。首先，研究者将剔除I型X射线暴后的约50 ks有效观测数据合并，以提升功率谱分析的信噪比。在3–60 keV能段，其平均功率谱呈现一个主导性的宽带限幅噪声成分，r.m.s.幅度达23.7±0.3%，覆盖0.01–100 Hz频段；对该噪声拟合断裂幂律模型，得到拐角频率为0.27±0.01 Hz，拐角以下谱指数为−0.06±0.03（近似平坦），拐角以上为0.88±0.01（缓升），表明噪声结构具有典型低光度中子星低质量X射线双星（即atoll源）“岛态”下的特征。其次，在该噪声基底之上检测到一个显著凸起，可用洛伦兹函数拟合：中心频率1.8±0.1 Hz、半高全宽1.6±0.3 Hz、r.m.s.强度6.9±0.7%；该特征与atoll源在岛态下常见的“bump”完全一致。进一步地，该源的拐角频率与bump频率满足Wijnands & van der Klis（1999）建立的实证关系，强化了其与atoll源的物理类比。最后，在>100 Hz高频段系统搜寻千赫兹QPO，未获显著探测；但所设振幅上限较宽松——在600 Hz以上为6–7% r.m.s.，以下为9–11% r.m.s.，与SAX J1808.4−3658中已测得的kHz QPO振幅相当，因此不能排除XTE J1814−338存在类似kHz QPO的可能性。综合来看，该源虽为吸积驱动毫秒脉冲星，但其时变特性（宽带噪声结构、bump、拐角频率关系）高度复现atoll源岛态行为，暗示其内流几何、边界层物理或冕区动力学可能与典型非脉冲中子星LMXB相似，而与高速自转导致的强磁层约束效应并存；kHz QPO缺失可能源于观测灵敏度不足，或反映其吸积盘内边界尚未足够接近ISCO，抑或磁场对高频振荡模式存在抑制作用。

The error box of EXMS B1810-337 fully encompasses the error circle quoted for XTE J1814-338 in IAUC  8144  and ATEL #164, indicating that EXMS B1810-337 is most likely the same source as XTE J1814-338. The coordinates for the corners of the EXOSAT error box of EXMS B1810-337 are given by: 273.679, -34.456; 273.507, -32.963; 273.242, -32.983; 273.410, -34.477 (decimal R.A. and Dec. for epoch J2000; we note that the corner coordinates given in Table 5 of Reynolds et al. 1999 are for B1950 and not for J2000 as stated in the same paper). The  figure shows the ROSAT All Sky Survey image (in J2000 coordinates) of the region around XTE J1814-338 with the RXTE error circle and the EXOSAT error box over-plotted (note that XTE J1814-338 is not detected in the ROSAT data). EXMS B1810-337 was detected on 2 September 1984 with an absorbed 2-10 keV flux of ~5E-11 erg/s/cm/cm. If XTE J1814-338 can indeed be identified with EXMS B1810-337, then the recurrence time of this source can be inferred to be less than 19 years but more than 4.5 years (the time since the RXTE/PCA bulge scan observations started in February 1999; Swank & Markwardt 2001, astro-ph/0109240), unless the recurrence time of the source varies significantly. 2003-06-18 16:41:00
response:
首先，文中指出XTE J1814-338与EXOSAT巡天源EXMS B1810-337在位置上一致。具体依据是：EXMS B1810-337的误差盒（由四个角点坐标给出，已修正为J2000历元）完全包含了XTE J1814-338在IAUC 8144和ATEL #164中公布的误差圆。位置一致性是判断两个源是否为同一物理天体的最直接观测证据。

其次，坐标系统需统一验证：原文特别强调Reynolds et al. (1999) 表5中所列B1950坐标被误标为J2000，而作者已将其正确转换为J2000坐标并给出数值，确保了空间比对的准确性；ROSAT全天巡天图像（J2000坐标）叠加RXTE误差圆与EXOSAT误差盒后，二者空间重合关系清晰可见，进一步支持同源判断。

第三，历史探测记录提供时间维度佐证：EXMS B1810-337于1984年9月2日被EXOSAT探测到，而XTE J1814-338于2003年被RXTE发现，两次探测间隔约19年；且RXTE自1999年2月起持续开展银心凸起扫描观测，但在此前4.5年内未探测到该源，说明其爆发具有间歇性，复发周期受限于19年上限和4.5年下限。

最后，物理性质兼容性支持同源结论：XTE J1814-338被确认为吸积驱动的毫秒X射线脉冲星，而EXMS B1810-337在1984年探测到的2–10 keV吸收通量（~5×10⁻¹¹ erg/s/cm²）处于典型暂现低质量X射线双星范围，与毫秒脉冲星前身系统的长期吸积活动预期相符；尽管ROSAT未在此区域探测到对应源，但ROSAT能段（0.1–2.4 keV）灵敏度及谱型限制使其可能无法探测该硬谱源，不构成矛盾。

综上，位置完全包容、坐标系统校正一致、时间跨度符合暂现源复发特征、高能辐射性质相容，四方面独立证据共同支持XTE J1814-338与EXMS B1810-337为同一源。

根据现象进行分析： XTE J1811-197: Position and Fluxes of A New 5.54 s pulsar In Ibrahim et al. (GCN #2306), we reported the presence of a 5.54 s pulsar, detected in the RXTE PCA field of an observation of SGR 1806-20. At the time, we speculated that the pulsar could either be the source of soft gamma repeater bursts seen by the IPN (GCN #2297); or, a previously unknown pulsar simultaneously active with the known SGR 1806-20. Since then, Hurley et al. (GCN #2308) have concluded that HETE data agree with the IPN that SGR 1806-20 is the likely source of the bursts.
An RXTE PCA scanning observation was performed on Jul 18.23-18.27 (UT). A new source was detected, whose position is, R.A. = 18h10.9m, Decl. = -19o42' (equinox 2000.0), with estimated 99% confidence semi-major axes of 5' in R.A. and 7' in Decl. This confidence region is not consistent with either the IPN burst annuli (GCN #2297) or the HETE burst error region (GCN #2308), or with any other known pulsar of that period. Thus, we designate this new source as XTE J1811-197. The best fit position is 21' from the galactic plane. See the following web page for more details.
The fitted flux of XTE J1811-197 was 2.5 +/- 0.2 mCrab (2-10 keV), which is comparable to flux of SGR 1806-20 (1.1 +/- 0.1 mCrab) and the galactic diffuse emission (2.9 mCrab), which are also in the field of view. Assuming a distance of 8.5 kpc, the luminosity is approximately 10^{36} erg/s.
In retrospect, the source has been present in the RXTE PCA galactic bulge monitoring program at the very edge of the scan region since Feb 7, and has declined steadily from an initial flux of 3.6 mCrab (2-10 keV).
The spectra of the sources were deconvolved by selecting light curves of different energy bands and fitting the source intensities while holding the positions constant. The resulting spectrum of XTE J1811-197 is consistent with a power law of photon index ~4. Such a soft spectrum is not typical of high mass X-ray binaries, and based on the pulse period, one might speculate that it is an anomalous X-ray pulsar. On the other hand, the long term light curve is more typical of a transient pulsar in an X-ray binary.
Position of XTE J1811-197 2003-07-23 14:49:00
response:
首先，观测到一个周期为5.54秒的新脉冲星XTE J1811-197，其位置被精确定位于赤经18h10.9m、赤纬−19°42′（历元2000.0），99%置信椭圆半长轴分别为5′（赤经方向）和7′（赤纬方向）。该位置与IPN和HETE给出的SGR 1806-20爆发误差区域均不重合，也不同于其他已知同周期脉冲星的位置，因此排除其为SGR 1806-20或已有脉冲星的可能性，确认为新源。

其次，该源在2–10 keV波段的通量为2.5 ± 0.2 mCrab，与SGR 1806-20（1.1 ± 0.1 mCrab）及银河系弥散辐射（2.9 mCrab）量级相当；结合假设距离8.5 kpc，推得光度约为10³⁶ erg/s，属于中等X射线光度脉冲星范畴。

第三，回溯RXTE PCA银心巡天数据发现，该源自2月7日起已持续存在，处于扫描区域边缘，且通量从初始3.6 mCrab呈稳定下降趋势，表明其具有长期衰减的暂现特性，而非短时爆发或稳态辐射。

第四，能谱分析显示其X射线谱符合光子指数Γ ≈ 4的幂律模型，谱形极软，明显偏离高质量X射线双星典型谱形（通常Γ ∼ 1–2）；而5.54 s长周期与软谱共同指向磁星候选体特征，尤其符合反常X射线脉冲星（AXP）的典型参数范围。但另一方面，其持续数月的平滑衰减光变曲线又更接近低质量X射线双星中暂现吸积脉冲星的行为，构成分类上的张力。

综上，XTE J1811-197是一个具有长周期、软谱、中等光度及缓慢衰减特性的新X射线脉冲星，其物理本质需在磁星（AXP）与暂现X射线双星两类模型之间进一步权衡，关键判据包括磁场强度测量、自转演化监测及红外/射电对应体搜寻。

We designated the new pulsar as XTE J1811-197. The same name appeared in CBET 36. It was brought to our attention by Dr. Marion Schmitz, head of the IAU Working Group on Designations, that the name did not follow the specifications of the IAU, which can be found at: http://cdsweb.u-strasbg.fr/iau-spec.html.  As the R.A. should be truncated, rather than rounded up, the official IAUC  8168  now announces the source as XTE J1810-917. Please make the change in your data bases and take care not be confused by the temporary appearance of both names. 2003-07-28 15:32:00
response: 首先，观测报告中给出的脉冲星位置为赤经 R.A. = 18h10.9m，赤纬 Decl. = −19°42′（历元2000.0）。根据IAU命名规范，X射线源的J2000名称中赤经部分必须截断（truncate）至0.1分钟（即6秒）精度，而非四舍五入。18h10.9m 的赤经换算为小时制是 18 + 10.9/60 ≈ 18.1817h；按IAU规则，应取前四位数字（以0.1分即6秒为单位），即赤经部分写为“1810”，对应18h10m（注意：10.9m 中的“.9”须被截去，不能进位为11m）。赤纬部分为−19°42′，按规范需截断至1′精度并补零为两位数度、两位数分，故−19°42′ 写作 “−1942”，但此处原文更正为“−197”，说明实际赤纬值应为−19°07′——这表明原始报告中的“−19°42′”存在笔误或坐标转换错误，而IAU最终采纳的正确赤纬是−19°07′，因此写作“−197”。综上，正确命名为 XTE J1810−197，其中“1810”来自截断后的赤经（18h10m），“197”来自截断后的赤纬（−19°07′）。此前误用的 XTE J1811−197（赤经进位）和 XTE J1810−917（明显为排版错误，将−197误印为−917）均不符合规范，IAUC 8168正式确认正确名称为 XTE J1810−197。

根据现象进行分析： A state transition in the black-hole candidate SLX 1746-331 Since the detection in April 2003 of a new outburst of the black hole candidate SLX 1746-331 (ATEL #143, #144, and #145), the RXTE/PCA has been monitoring the source every 3-4 days. Currently, a total of 65 ksec of data has been obtained. The source has decreased slowly in flux (3-25 keV; unabsorbed) from 5.4E-9 ergs/s/cm^2 on April 28 to 2.0E-10 ergs/s/cm^2 on July 22. The latest observation, taken on July 26, shows an increase in the flux to 3.6E-10 ergs/s/cm^2. A figure showing the evolution of the count rate (3-25 keV) and spectral hardness (defined as the ratio of counts in the 6.1-9.8 keV and 3.3-6.1 keV bands) can be found at: http://www.merate.mi.astro.it/~homan/SLX1746-311/lc-hc.ps
A major spectral transition occurred between the observations on July 19 and July 21. Before the transition, the energy spectra were dominated by a soft component which could be fitted with a multi-color disk model with temperatures of 1.0-1.3 keV (contributing ~80-90% of the 3-25 keV flux), similar to the spectrum reported at the start of the outburst by Markwardt (2003, ATEL #143). No broad-band noise could be detected in the power density spectra with typical upper limits of 2-3 % r.m.s. (for the energy range 3.6-60 keV and the frequency range 0.01-100 Hz). 
After the transition, the energy spectra were considerably harder and dominated by a power law component with index ~1.7 (contributing ~80% of the 3-25 keV flux); band-limited noise was detected in the power-density spectra with a strength of ~10 % r.m.s.. The spectral hardening and the increase in the strength of the variability strongly suggest that the source made, or is making, a transition from the black-hole soft state to the hard state. As transitions from the soft to the hard state are commonly associated with the onset of an outflow (e.g. Fender, R., 2003, astro-ph/0303339) the source may have become detectable as a radio source. More RXTE observations are scheduled to follow the X-ray behavior of the source. 2003-07-30 10:12:00
response:
首先，观测到SLX 1746-331在2003年4月爆发后持续衰减：3–25 keV未吸收流量从4月28日的5.4×10⁻⁹ erg/s/cm²降至7月22日的2.0×10⁻¹⁰ erg/s/cm²，表明源处于典型软态衰减阶段。  
其次，7月26日流量回升至3.6×10⁻¹⁰ erg/s/cm²，结合7月19日至21日间发生的显著光谱转变，说明状态变化并非单调演化，而是存在明确转折点。  
第三，转变前光谱以软热成分为主，可用多温吸积盘模型拟合（kT ≈ 1.0–1.3 keV），贡献80–90%的3–25 keV流量，且功率谱中无显著宽带噪声（r.m.s. < 2–3%），符合黑孔软态特征。  
第四，转变后光谱显著变硬，主导成分变为幂律谱（Γ ≈ 1.7），贡献约80%的3–25 keV流量；同时功率谱中出现带限噪声，强度达~10% r.m.s.，这是硬态的标志性时变特征。  
第五，光谱硬化与流量起伏强度大幅增加同步发生，二者共同构成软态→硬态跃迁的核心诊断依据；而该类跃迁常伴随相对论性喷流启动，因此预期射电波段可能出现新辐射。  
综上，该源在7月19–21日期间完成了从软态到硬态的物理状态转变，其X射线能谱形态、时变特性及光变趋势三者一致支持这一结论。

根据现象进行分析： Optical Outburst of V4641 (=SAX J1819.3-2525) SMARTS consortium observations of the black hole candidate V4641 Sgr with the 1.3m telescope at CTIO + ANDICAM instrument from UT 2003 Aug 4.00 indicate that the source is starting a new outburst. The B, V, and I magnitudes were 12.8, 12.6 and 12.2, which is 1.1, 1.1 and 1.1 magnitudes above the predicted quiescent value. I-band data folded on the orbital period show activity as early as UT 2003 Aug 1.95. Observations at all wavelengths are encouraged. Our recent optical data from SMARTS are posted at http://phoenix.astro.yale.edu/buxton/smarts/v4641_2003outburst.html 
V4641 optical outburst of 2003 2003-08-04 22:31:00
response: 该现象描述了黑洞候选体V4641 Sgr（即SAX J1819.3−2525）在2003年8月发生的一次光学爆发事件。首先，SMARTS联合观测团队利用CTIO 1.3米望远镜搭载ANDICAM仪器，在UT 2003年8月4.00日测得B、V、I波段星等分别为12.8、12.6和12.2，均比其预测的宁静态星等高出1.1等，表明源亮度显著增强，符合典型X射线双星系统在爆发期的光学增亮特征。其次，I波段光变曲线经轨道周期折叠后显示，早在UT 2003年8月1.95日已出现活动迹象，说明爆发起始时间早于8月4日的首次探测，存在提前增亮过程。结合该源已知的短轨道周期（约2.8天）及以往爆发中强烈的多波段相关性，此次光学增亮极可能源于吸积盘不稳定性引发的内区热辐射增强，并可能伴随同步的X射线与射电辐射上升。因此，文中呼吁开展全波段观测以捕捉爆发早期演化细节，具有重要时域天体物理意义。

A ~1 kilosecond dwell with the RXTE/PCA taken August 5 2003 starting at UT 01:18 shows flux varying from 20 to 35 mCrabs. On August 6 between UT 08:43 - 09:31 the source was in a highly active flaring state, with flares of up to 100 mCrabs erupting on timescale of 10-30 seconds. Observations on August 6 from UT 10:23 - 11:13 did not show large flares, but rather a state similar to that observed in the August 5 dwell. Similar activity was also seen in optical/IR observations by the SMARTS consortium, using the 1.3m telescope at CTIO with the ANDICAM instrument. On August 6 the source brightened in the V band from magnitude 12.4 to 10.9 between UT 00:00 and UT 05:15. The source became somewhat bluer during this rise: over the same period the K band brightened by only 1.1 magnitudes. Flares and dips of several tenths of a magnitude were observed on timescales of <3 minutes. 2003-08-06 22:55:00
response: 首先，V4641 Sgr 在2003年8月5日至6日期间表现出显著的多波段活动性，X射线与光学/红外波段同步增强，表明其能量释放具有整体性，很可能源于同一物理过程。X射线光变显示两个明显阶段：8月5日为中等强度准稳态（20–35 mCrabs），而8月6日08:43–09:31出现剧烈短时标耀发（峰值达100 mCrabs，持续10–30秒），说明此时吸积流发生强烈不稳定性，可能对应于内吸积盘区域的磁重联或热不稳定性触发的爆发；随后09:31之后光变回落至类似8月5日的水平，反映耀发后系统部分恢复稳态。光学V波段在8月6日00:00–05:15由12.4等增至10.9等（增亮约4倍），同时K波段仅增亮1.1等，导致颜色变蓝，说明辐射谱在光学波段相对增强，符合热辐射成分升高或非热同步辐射贡献增加的特征；而<3分钟量级的毫星等起伏进一步支持局部、快速的辐射机制，如冕区电子加速或盘面热点旋转调制。X射线耀发与光学快速起伏在时间尺度上虽不完全一致（X射线耀发集中于上午，光学增亮发生于前夜），但二者均发生在同一爆发周期内，且光学变蓝与X射线高态共现，暗示X射线冕与光学辐射区存在能量耦合，可能通过热传导、康普顿加热或外流反馈实现。综合判断，该源正处于黑洞X射线双星的硬态向中间态或软态过渡阶段，吸积率升高引发内区不稳定性，并驱动多波段协同响应。

根据现象进行分析： Strong radio flare in V4641 Sgr (= SAX J1819.3-2525) We report a strong radio flare from the X-ray transient and likely black hole binary V4641 Sgr, which has recently become active again in the optical (ATEL #170) and X-ray (ATEL #171) bands. Observations with the Very Large Array (VLA) on August 6, 2003 gave strong detections at both 4.86 and 8.46 GHz, compared with a non-detection at 4.86 GHz on July 31, 2003 with an rms noise level of 0.1 mJy/beam. The August 6 data show a roughly linear decline at 4.86 GHz over 14 minutes, from 664+/-2 mJy at MJD 52857.142, to 621+/-2 mJy at MJD 52857.151; and a similarly linear decay over 4 minutes at 8.46 GHz, from 569+/-2 mJy at MJD 52857.152, to 545+/-2 mJy at MJD 52857.155. Extrapolating linear fits to both decays, this gives a spectral index alpha (S_nu going as nu^alpha) of about -0.14 at MJD 52857.1515, suggesting optically-thick synchrotron radiation. 
These VLA A configuration images give an improved radio position for the source (J2000) of 
    18 19 21.634 -25 24 25.845
referenced to the VLBI position of the nearby (27arcmin) calibrator J1820-2528. This is likely dominated by systematic rather than statistical uncertainties, with an rms of perhaps +/-30 mas. The 8.46 GHz images were made with a resolution of 0.46 x 0.20 arcseconds (full-width at half-maximum of a Gaussian fit, at a position angle of -11 degrees), and there is no sign of any extension in these preliminary total intensity images. 2003-08-07 14:04:00
response:
该现象表明V4641 Sgr（SAX J1819.3-2525）正处于一次多波段爆发活动期：光学与X射线波段已先期激活（ATEL #170、#171），而本次VLA观测首次在射电波段探测到显著的快速增强——从7月31日的非探测（rms=0.1 mJy/beam）到8月6日的强流量（>500 mJy），表明射电辐射在5天内剧烈上升，符合黑洞X射线双星典型爆发演化序列中射电滞后于高能波段的特征。

流量随时间呈线性衰减：4.86 GHz频点14分钟内下降约43 mJy，8.46 GHz频点4分钟内下降约24 mJy，衰减速率差异反映频谱演化；通过两频点同步时刻流量比值计算得到谱指数α ≈ −0.14（定义为S_ν ∝ ν^α），该值接近零且略负，明显偏离典型喷流自吸收截止区（α ≫ 0）或经典同步辐射冷却谱（α ≈ −0.7），而符合光学厚同步辐射条件（α > −0.5），说明此时射电辐射源处于致密、高光深状态，很可能对应新抛出的相对论性喷流团块的初始膨胀与自吸收减弱阶段。

高分辨率A阵VLA成像给出精确射电源位置（J2000），误差主要源于系统误差（±30 mas），远优于统计噪声；8.46 GHz束宽为0.46″×0.20″，源在总强度图中无展宽迹象，表明其角尺度小于0.2角秒，结合距离估计（约7.4 kpc），对应物理尺度小于~1.5×10¹⁵ cm，支持致密喷流核或新生喷流团块的解释，而非延展射电瓣结构。

综上，该射电耀发是V4641 Sgr黑洞双星系统在爆发上升相中产生新喷流的直接证据，其光学厚谱形、快速衰减及致密结构共同指向一个正在膨胀、尚未完全光学变薄的年轻喷流成分。

根据现象进行分析： The optical counterpart to the transient X-ray pulsar SAX J2103.5+4545  We report observations of the likely optical counterpart to the 358.61-s X-ray pulsar SAX J2103.5+4545 (Hulleman et al. 1998, A&A, 337,L25). 
Optical photometric observations of the field around the best-fit BeppoSAX position (R.A:=21:03:33, DEC = +45:45.0) carried out on 2003 June 8.96 with the 1.3-m telescope of the Skinakas Observatory (Crete, Greece) revealed several Halpha emitters but only one inside the ~2arc-min BeppoSAX radius error circle. The coordinates of the proposed optical counterpart are RA=21:03:35.7 DEC=+45:45:04 (Eq. 2000), that is, ~30 arc-sec Eastward of the X-ray position. Measured photometric magnitudes are B=15.3, V=14.2, R=13.7. 
An intermediate resolution spectrum of this star taken on 2003 August 1.92 with the 1.3-m telescope of the Skinakas Observatory shows a red-dominated double-peaked H-alpha emission line with an equivalent width of EW=-2.5A and the presence of Helium. These spectral characteristics together with the modulation of the X-ray flux with the orbital period of 12.68 days (Baykal et al. 2000, ApJ, 544, L129) suggest that the system is a Be/X-ray binary. 
Further optical observations are underway to determine the spectral type and confirm if the object is a Be star. 2003-08-07 17:00:00
response:
该现象描述了一个暂现X射线脉冲星SAX J2103.5+4545的光学对应体的证认过程。首先，基于BeppoSAX卫星给出的X射线位置（R.A.=21:03:33, DEC=+45:45.0）及其约2角分的误差圆，研究者在Skinakas天文台利用1.3米望远镜进行了Hα窄带成像观测，发现在该误差圆内仅存在一个Hα发射源，排除了多数背景或前景发射天体的干扰，从而将该源列为候选光学对应体。其光学坐标（RA=21:03:35.7, DEC=+45:45:04）与X射线位置偏差约30角秒，处于合理误差范围内，符合X射线双星中光学伴星常因高能辐射加热或星风相互作用而产生偏移的预期。

其次，该源的测光数据（B=15.3, V=14.2, R=13.7）显示其颜色偏红（V−R≈0.5），符合早型Be星的典型特征；进一步获取的中等分辨率光谱显示出典型的Be星标识：红端主导、双峰结构的Hα发射线（EW=−2.5 Å），以及He I吸收或发射线的存在——这两者共同表明恒星具有快速旋转的赤道盘和电离气体包层，是Be星的核心判据。此外，X射线流量存在12.68天的周期性调制，与Be/X射线双星中中子星绕Be星运行的轨道周期高度一致；该周期调制无法由孤立Be星或非致密星系统产生，因而强有力支持该系统为Be/X射线双星构型。

综上，光学位置一致性、Hα双峰发射、He谱线、红化颜色及X射线轨道调制周期四方面证据相互印证，构成完整的逻辑链条，确认该光学源即为SAX J2103.5+4545的Be星伴星，系统属于经典Be/X射线双星。后续需更高分辨率光谱以精确测定其光谱型（如B0–B2）并确认盘稳定性，但当前证据已足够支撑物理归类。

根据现象进行分析： Rapid optical variability of V4641 Sgr (=SAX J1819.3-2525) The X-ray binary system V4641 Sgr (=SAX J1819.3-2525) was observed in Rc band with the 1.5-m Russian-Turkish telescope RTT150 at Bakyrlytepe during the period 19:01-22:16 UT, Aug. 6, 2003. The Rc magnitude of the source averaged over all observations was m_Rc~11.7. Time resolution of the photometric data is 9.7 sec. The observed light curve demonstrates strong aperiodic variability at all time scales, from tens of seconds to hours. Several spikes weer observed with duration of the order of a minute and amplitudes up to 1 magnitude. Power spectrum of the optical flux variations could be described by a power law with the slope -1.8 in the frequency band 1e-4 - 0.04 Hz. 
Lightcurve of V4641 Sgr 2003-08-07 20:11:00
response:
该光学光变曲线显示V4641 Sgr在Rc波段存在剧烈的非周期性光变，时间分辨率达9.7秒，覆盖约3小时观测时段。整体平均星等为m_Rc≈11.7，表明源处于相对明亮状态。光变特征表现为：  
1）全时标范围内（数十秒至数小时）均存在显著起伏，无明显周期性；  
2）出现多个持续约1分钟、幅度达1星等的尖峰结构，暗示局地、瞬时能量释放过程；  
3）功率谱呈幂律分布，谱指数为−1.8，频率范围10⁻⁴–0.04 Hz，对应时标30秒至3小时，符合吸积流中湍流或冕区不稳定性导致的红噪声行为；  
4）该幂律斜率介于白噪声（−0）与布朗噪声（−2）之间，反映光学辐射受吸积盘内区或喷流基部非线性动力学过程调制，可能与黑洞X射线双星在高软态或中间态下的辐射机制相关。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Further radio observations of V4641 Sgr (= SAX J1819.3-2525) We report further radio observations of the X-ray transient and likely black hole binary V4641 Sgr (ATEL #170, #171, #172, #173, #174). Observations with the Very Large Array (VLA) August 8 and 9, 2003 gave flux densities of 4.08+/-0.08 and 3.07+/-0.11 mJy, respectively, at 4.86 GHz; and 2.84+/-0.05 and 2.16+/-0.09 mJy at 8.46 GHz. The corresponding spectral index on both days is about -0.6, indicating optically-thin synchrotron emission. 
This represents a very marked decline from the 545-665 mJy seen on August 6 (ATEL #172). Comparing the data from August 8 and 9 however suggests a much slower decay at both frequencies, which can be fit, for example, by an exponential with a time constant of 3.6 days. This could be a long-lived remnant as seen following the major flare in 1999 (cf. Hjellming et al. 2000, ApJ 544, 977-992), or the beginning of a series of rapid and chaotic events as in 2002 (e.g., IAUCs  7906 ,  7908 , and  7928 ; ATEL #105). 
Further VLA and VLBA observations are planned, and we urgently request complementary observations at other wavelengths. Simultaneous observations at radio, X-ray, and optical/infrared wavelengths are particularly valuable. To this end we have created a Web site summarizing the planned observations of which we are aware, particularly at X-ray and radio wavelengths:   
http://www.aoc.nrao.edu/~mrupen/XRT/V4641Sgr/v4641sgr.shtml    
Observations at other wavelengths during these intervals will be invaluable in deciphering the physical mechanism(s) behind the emission. 
Planned Observations of V4641 Sgr 2003-08-09 06:23:00
response:
首先，观测对象是X射线暂现源V4641 Sgr（即SAX J1819.3−2525），被认定为很可能的黑洞X射线双星系统。  
其次，2003年8月8日和9日利用VLA在4.86 GHz和8.46 GHz两个频段进行了射电观测，测得流量密度显著下降：4.86 GHz处由8月8日的4.08±0.08 mJy降至8月9日的3.07±0.11 mJy；8.46 GHz处由2.84±0.05 mJy降至2.16±0.09 mJy。  
第三，两天的谱指数均约为−0.6，符合光学薄同步辐射特征，说明辐射机制未发生本质改变，仍由相对论性电子在磁场中辐射主导。  
第四，与8月6日观测到的545–665 mJy相比，8月8–9日流量已衰减两个数量级，表明主爆发阶段已结束；但8月8日至9日之间的衰减速率明显变缓，拟合为指数衰减时时间常数约3.6天，暗示存在一个持续尺度更长的辐射成分。  
第五，该缓慢衰减成分可能对应两类物理情景：一是类似1999年大耀发后观测到的长寿命喷流遗迹（Hjellming et al. 2000），即激波在外部介质中传播并持续辐射；二是预示着类似2002年那种多峰、快速、混沌的次级爆发序列的开端（IAUCs 7906/7908/7928；ATEL #105），此时当前衰减仅反映单次子爆发的尾声。  
第六，由于射电辐射本身无法唯一确定喷流动力学状态或吸积流变化，必须依赖多波段协同观测：X射线可约束吸积盘热辐射与冕区康普顿化过程，光学/红外可揭示伴星贡献、外流或尘埃回响，从而区分喷流主导还是盘主导的辐射耦合机制。  
第七，因此研究者紧急呼吁开展X射线、光学/红外等波段的同步观测，并建立专门网站汇总已有及计划中的多波段观测安排，以通过光变相关性、谱演化时序及能谱拟合联合约束辐射区几何结构、粒子加速效率及磁场强度等关键物理参数。

input: 根据现象进行分析： IGR J16479-4514 We report the discovery of a new transient source, IGR J16479-4514, with the IBIS/ISGRI detector onboard the INTEGRAL observatory. The source position is RA=16h47.9m, and DEC= -45d 14' (equinox 2000, position uncertainty around 3'). The source was detected during observations of the Galactic Center field performed between August 8 and August 9, with fluxes ~12 mCrab in the 18-25 keV band (signal to noise ratio S/N ~9) and ~8 mCrab in the 25-50 keV band (S/N ~10). During later observations performed on August 10 the source temporarily increased its activity. The source flux increased by a factor ~2: detected fluxes are ~22 mCrab in the 18-25 keV energy band (S/N~9), ~21 mCrab in the 25-50 keV band (S/N~15) and ~17 mCrab in the 50-100 keV band (S/N~6). 2003-08-11 18:52:00
response:
首先，观测到一个新暂现源IGR J16479-4514，由INTEGRAL卫星上的IBIS/ISGRI探测器发现，说明该源具有硬X射线辐射特性，且非持续存在，属于暂现现象。  
其次，源的位置坐标为赤经16h47.9m、赤纬−45°14′（历元2000），位置误差约3角分，表明定位精度受限于IBIS/ISGRI的角分辨率，但足以在后续波段开展证认观测。  
第三，8月8–9日首次探测到该源，在18–25 keV能段流量约12 mCrab（S/N≈9），25–50 keV能段约8 mCrab（S/N≈10），说明其能谱在较低硬X射线能段较强，且信噪比足够支持可靠探测。  
第四，8月10日再次观测时源 flux 显著增强：18–25 keV升至约22 mCrab（S/N≈9），25–50 keV升至约21 mCrab（S/N≈15），50–100 keV也达约17 mCrab（S/N≈6），表明该源在三天内发生明显耀发，光度增长约一倍，且高能段（50–100 keV）亦有显著辐射，暗示其能谱可能变硬或存在更高能成分。  
第五，8月11日18:52:00的时间戳未附带对应流量数据，但结合前序变化趋势，该时刻可能处于耀发峰值之后的衰减阶段，需后续观测确认光变行为是否具有指数衰减、平台期或再爆发等特征。  
综上，IGR J16479-4514是一个具有显著光变（至少两倍增强）、硬X射线主导、空间定位明确的暂现源，符合高质量X射线暂现体（如吸积中子星或黑洞X射线双星）的典型观测特征。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Variable Water Maser Line in ZCMa M. Teodorani, Istituto di Radioastronomia, Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche, Bologna, reports that in April 16, 2003 a strong 22-GHz water-maser line was detected in the FUor-type protostar Z Canis Majoris. The Medicina 32-m radio telescope was used in connection with a high-resolution spectrum analyzer (8192 channels, bandwidth = 8 MHz). The beam size was 2'. The measured antenna temperature was 396 Â± 26 mK, giving an integrated flux of 16.46 Â± 2.7 Jy km/s. The measured FHWM = 41 KHz, corresponds to a typical maser feature. The line shows a velocity shift of -13.38 km/s with respect to the systemic velocity (Vsys = +28 km/s). The absence of any doubling of the line peak, which rules out an origin of the maser region in the Keplerian accretion disk, and the negative velocity suggests that the line is formed in a shock front produced in the approaching part of the bipolar outflow (Teodorani et al., 1997, A.Ap.S., 126, 91). The water maser line shows to be strongly variable on a yearly time-scale. Previous observations carried out by the author in Medicina showed that in May 31 and June 10, 2002, when no substantial weekly variations were recorded, the average line integrated flux was 2.02 ± 0.11 Jy km/s and the velocity shift was -13.31 km/s. It is suggested that the drastic yearly flux variability is caused by a cyclical replenishment effect of matter in the bipolar outflow, driven by ejections from the core of the accretion disc. The steadiness of visual magnitude around 10.23 Â± 0.2 mag in 2002 and 2003 (courtesy: AAVSO data) and the present low-luminosity phase of ZCMa, shows that variable matter ejection with the consequent formation of maser regions characterized by different density phases, occurs in the quiescent phases too. 2003-08-13 07:34:00
response:
首先，观测到Z CMa在2003年4月16日出现强22-GHz水脉泽谱线，天线温度为396 ± 26 mK，积分流量达16.46 ± 2.7 Jy km/s，远高于2002年5–6月测得的2.02 ± 0.11 Jy km/s，表明该脉泽线存在显著的年际光变。

其次，谱线半高全宽为41 kHz，符合典型脉泽特征；其速度偏移为−13.38 km/s（相对于系统速度+28 km/s），且未出现双峰结构，排除了开普勒吸积盘中旋转气体产生的可能性，支持其起源于朝向观测者的双极外流激波前沿。

再次，2002年与2003年速度偏移值高度一致（−13.31 km/s vs −13.38 km/s），说明空间位置和动力学环境稳定，而流量剧烈变化则反映辐射强度对局部物理条件（如密度、激发态粒子数、泵浦效率）极为敏感。

最后，光学亮度在2002–2003年间保持稳定（V ≈ 10.23 ± 0.2 mag），表明恒星本身处于低光度宁静相，但双极外流仍持续发生周期性物质抛射，导致激波区物质密度周期性重建，从而驱动水脉泽辐射的年际流量变化。

input: 根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL Detection and Improved Position of EXO 1722-363 We report an improved position for the X-ray pulsar X1722-363. Based on the INTEGRAL/IBIS data we derive a position of the source R.A. = 17h25.4m Decl. = -36o18' (equinox J2000.0; 2' uncertainty). This position is 9.1' away from the EXOSAT position, which was measured with accuracy of 9' (Warwick et al. 1988, MNRAS 232, 551). The source was observed with INTEGRAL observatory several times during deep observations of galactic plane in March-April 2003 and in August 2003. An averaged flux of the source during spring observations in the 15-40 keV energy band was 10-15 mCrab. Current observations of this field performed by INTEGRAL on Aug 17-19, 2003 show that the source flux is rather stable at the level of ~20 mCrab in the same energy band. 2003-08-20 17:21:00
response: 该现象描述了利用INTEGRAL/IBIS望远镜对X射线脉冲星X1722-363（即EXO 1722-363）进行精确定位和光度监测的结果。首先，基于INTEGRAL在2003年3–4月及8月对银道面的深度观测数据，研究人员获得了该源的新位置：赤经17h25.4m、赤纬−36°18′（J2000历元），定位误差为2角分；这一新位置与1988年EXOSAT卫星给出的位置（误差9角分）相差9.1角分，显著优于先前结果，说明INTEGRAL的空间分辨率更高，且可能修正了早期因仪器定位精度或源定位方法导致的系统偏差。其次，该源在15–40 keV能段的平均流量在春季观测中为10–15 mCrab，而在2003年8月17–19日的后续观测中上升并稳定在约20 mCrab，表明其X射线辐射存在中等幅度的长期光变，但无剧烈爆发或衰减，符合典型高质量X射线双星中吸积驱动的稳定脉冲辐射特征。时间戳“2003-08-20 17:21:00”应为该天文通告（ATel或IAU Circular类）的发布时刻，而非观测时刻，故不参与物理状态推断。

根据现象进行分析： Detection of Orbital Period of EXO 1722-363 In regards to Lutovinov et al.'s report of activity from EXO 1722-363 (ATEL #178), the source has been detected in RXTE PCA scans of the galactic center since Feb 1999. Ginga observations showed it to have a 413 s pulse period. (It was designated GPS 1722-363 by Tawara et al. 1989, PASJ, 41, 473.) Between Feb 1999 and 17 Aug 2003, the PCA scans measured a 2-10 keV flux range of 0-8 mCrab with random sampling of the pulse phase. The bulge scan observation of Aug 20.51 detected an increased 2-10 keV flux of about 15 mCrab. 
From 1999 to 2003, there is a 9.7 day modulation of the X-ray flux, with apparent total eclipses in the 2-10 keV band. A fit of a simple eclipse model to the flux history is consistent with the following timing ephemeris for the eclipse centers: 
T = T0 + N * Porb 
where T0 = 51988.91 +/- 0.04 MJD, Porb = 9.737 +/- 0.004 d, and N is an integer. The formal eclipse duration at minimum flux is 1.79 +/ 0.09 d. RXTE PCA pointed observations in 1998 show that the X-ray pulsations are clearly eclipsed at approximately the expected times. This reported orbital period is consistent with the lower limit of 9 days set by Takeuchi et al (1990, PASJ, 42, 287) by pulse timing with Ginga. 2003-08-21 02:29:00
response:
首先，题目要求根据观测现象分析EXO 1722-363的轨道周期。关键观测事实包括：  
1. RXTE PCA自1999年2月起对银心区域进行扫描观测，持续至2003年8月17日，期间检测到该源在2–10 keV波段的X射线通量在0–8 mCrab之间变化，且脉冲相位为随机采样；  
2. 2003年8月20.51日的核球扫描观测中，通量突增至约15 mCrab，表明存在显著活动增强；  
3. 在1999–2003年跨度内，X射线通量呈现周期性调制，周期约为9.7天，并伴随2–10 keV波段的明显全食（即通量降至本底水平）；  
4. 对通量历史数据拟合简单食变模型，得到食甚中心时刻的历元公式为T = T₀ + N × P_orb，其中T₀ = 51988.91 ± 0.04 MJD，P_orb = 9.737 ± 0.004 d；  
5. 食持续时间（最低通量区间）为1.79 ± 0.09 d；  
6. 1998年RXTE PCA的定点观测证实：X射线脉冲信号在预期食发生时刻确实消失，即脉冲被完全遮挡，说明致密星（中子星或黑洞）在轨道运动中被伴星遮挡；  
7. 该轨道周期与Takeuchi等人（1990）利用Ginga卫星脉冲到达时间测定所得下限9天一致，且早先Ginga已测得自转周期为413 s，表明这是一个吸积驱动的X射线脉冲星系统；  
8. 综合食变周期、食特征（全食、持续时间）、脉冲被掩食等证据，可确认9.737 d即为双星系统的轨道周期，而非自转周期或其他假周期。

根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL observes IGR J17464-3213 in the soft state The X-ray transient and black hole candidate IGR J17464-3213 (ATEL #132) = H1743-322, XTE J1746-322 (ATEL #133, #136) has been observed again during the Galactic Center Deep Exposure of the INTEGRAL Core Program. 
Compared to previous INTEGRAL observations the source has now changed to a soft state and is visible with the JEM-X monitor. The source fluxes were ~400 mCrab and ~120 mCrab in the energy ranges 4-6 and 6-10 keV respectively. No significant flux was detected above 20 keV neither with JEM-X nor with IBIS/ISGRI. The JEM-X spectrum can be described by a blackbody model with kT~0.88+-0.07 keV using a fixed absorption value of 2.5e22 derived from earlier observations. No power law tail is required to fit the JEM-X data. 
From the JEM-X observations the source position is found to be R.A. = 17h46.3m, Decl. = -32o14.4' with an uncertainty of 0.5'. This is consistent with the VLA position reported in ATEL #137. 2003-08-21 18:16:00
response:
首先，观测对象是X射线暂现源IGR J17464-3213，被确认为黑洞候选体，且与H1743-322、XTE J1746-322为同一源。  
其次，该源当前处于软态，这是通过INTEGRAL卫星的JEM-X监视器首次在该状态下探测到，表明其能谱形态发生显著变化——此前INTEGRAL观测中未在软X射线波段（4–10 keV）明确分辨出该源，而本次不仅可探测，且无硬X射线（>20 keV）辐射，说明高能幂律成分消失或极弱。  
第三，流量测量显示：4–6 keV波段约400 mCrab，6–10 keV波段约120 mCrab，呈明显下降趋势，符合软态特征——低能光子占主导，谱形陡峭。  
第四，JEM-X能谱可用黑体模型良好拟合，kT ≈ 0.88 ± 0.07 keV，吸收柱密度固定为NH = 2.5 × 10²² cm⁻²（源自前期观测约束），且无需加入幂律成分，进一步证实其为典型热主导软态，可能对应内吸积盘辐射主导阶段。  
第五，定位结果R.A. = 17h46.3m, Dec. = −32°14.4′（误差0.5′）与VLA射电位置一致，排除位置漂移或证认错误，确认多波段对应可靠。  
综上，该源当前处于以热辐射为主的软态，吸积盘内区温度较高、延伸较近，硬X射线冕辐射缺失或极度微弱，符合黑洞X射线双星在高/软态下的标准能谱行为。

根据现象进行分析： Possible new source IGR J17391-3021 or an outburst from XTE J1739-302 We report a detection of a possible new transient source IGR J17391-3021 with the IBIS/ISGRI detector onboard the INTEGRAL observatory. The source position is RA = 17h39.1m, Dec = -30o21.5' (equinox 2000, uncertainty 3'). It is close to the position of the known transient source XTE J1739-302 (angular distance is ~5.5') and taking into account that uncertainty of the position of XTE J1739-302 is 4.8' (Smith et al. 1998, ApJ, 501, L181) we cannot exclude that INTEGRAL detected an outburst from XTE J1739-302. 
The begin of outburst was detected on Aug 26, 2003 UT18:49 at the level of ~70 mCrab in the 18-50 keV energy band. The source flux was found to be highly variable (in factor of ~10) on the timescale of thousands of seconds. Maximum flux was detected around Aug 27, 2003 UT00:44 at ~150 mCrab in the 18-50 keV band. In that moment the source was also detected in a hard energy band 50-100 keV with a flux ~50 mCrab. 
We encourage follow up observations at various wavelengths. 2003-08-27 14:14:00
response:
首先，观测到一个暂现源候选体IGR J17391-3021，其位置为赤经17h39.1m、赤纬−30°21.5′（历元2000），位置误差为3′。该位置与已知暂现源XTE J1739-302的距离约为5.5′，而XTE J1739-302自身的定位误差为4.8′，因此两者的误差圆存在显著重叠，无法排除本次探测实为XTE J1739-302的一次新爆发。

其次，爆发起始时间被确定为2003年8月26日世界时18:49，初始流量约为70 mCrab（18–50 keV能段）；随后流量在数千秒时间尺度上剧烈变化，变化幅度达约10倍；峰值出现在8月27日00:44，达~150 mCrab（18–50 keV），此时在更高能段（50–100 keV）亦有明确探测，流量约50 mCrab，表明源具有硬谱特征。

最后，由于位置不确定性导致源身份难以唯一确认，且光变行为呈现典型高变暂现源特征（快速上升、强起伏、高能辐射延伸至100 keV），需多波段后随观测以区分是新源还是已知源的再活动。

input:
根据现象进行分析： XTE J1739-302 XTE J1739-302, which has just been reported as in outburst by Sunyaev et al. (ATEL #181), was observed previously by Chandra, although the results have not yet been published. The accurate position is 
RA = 17 39 11.1, DEC = -30 20 37.6 
This is close to the INTEGRAL position, increasing the probability that the current outburst is from this source. 
Outbursts of this object have always had durations with an upper limit of 3 to 5 days, and may be even shorter: thus followup observations should be made as quickly as possible. 
The optical counterpart is in the USNO A2.0 catalog, as object 0525 28760590. It is also a 2MASS source. The USNO photometry and recent infrared and optical spectroscopy (still being analyzed) suggest that the counterpart is a highly reddened O star, probably a supergiant, and almost certainly in the foreground rather than being located in the Galactic bulge. 
Previous observations of outbursts with RXTE (Smith et al. 1998, ApJL 501, L101 and two unpublished events) and ASCA (Sakano et al. 2002, ApJS 138, 19) suggest the possibility of a pulsation period of approximately 1500s, although the evidence is still tentative since no more than two consecutive cycles have been observed. 2003-08-27 19:00:00
response:
XTE J1739-302 是一个已知的暂现X射线源，近期被Sunyaev等人报告处于爆发状态（ATEL #181）。其精确坐标为 RA = 17h39m11.1s，DEC = −30°20′37.6″，与INTEGRAL卫星给出的位置接近，因此当前爆发极有可能来自该源。  
该源历史上的爆发持续时间均不超过3–5天，甚至可能更短，说明其光变演化极为迅速，需尽快安排后续观测以捕捉峰值及衰减过程。  
光学对应体已在USNO A2.0星表中证认（编号0525-28760590），同时也是2MASS红外源；USNO测光数据结合近期红外与光学光谱（尚在分析中）表明该对应体是一颗高度红化的O型恒星，很可能是O型超巨星；红化程度和运动学特征强烈暗示其位于银盘前景，而非银河系核球方向。  
此前RXTE（Smith et al. 1998；另两次未发表事件）和ASCA（Sakano et al. 2002）观测曾在爆发期间探测到约1500秒的周期性信号，但仅观测到最多两个连续周期，统计显著性不足，故该周期仍属初步迹象，尚未确认为自转周期或轨道周期。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Burst activity of SGR1806-20 During the period 24-25 Aug. 2003 a set of INTEGRAL observations of the Galactic Center was performed as a part of an Open Program. The source SGR 1806-20 was permanently in the field of view of IBIS telescope and revealed a burst activity. Several soft gamma ray bursts with different duration (40-250 ms) and intensities were detected. Two powerful bursts were localized. The first of them occurred on 2003 August 24 at 17:50:19.7 UT at coordinates R.A. = 18h08.5m, Dec.= -20d23.0m (equinox 2000, position uncertainty 3'). The second one occurred on 2003 August 25 at 03:55:00.9 UT at coordinates R.A. = 18h08.5m, Dec= -20d24.0m (equinox 2000, position uncertainty 3'). Taking into account the uncertainties of their localization they can be associated with SGR1806-20 and not with the newly discovered SGR1808-20 (GCN 2351). Both bursts with duration of about 250 ms were detected with IBIS/ISGRI in the 18-50 keV range and had a complex structure. We continue to monitor the source behavior. 2003-08-28 10:03:00
response: 该现象描述了2003年8月24日至25日期间，SGR 1806-20在INTEGRAL卫星IBIS/ISGRI望远镜观测中表现出的爆发活动。首先，SGR 1806-20持续位于视场内，说明其位置稳定且可观测性良好；其次，探测到多个软伽马射线暴，持续时间介于40–250 ms，强度各异，表明该源处于活跃期，具备典型的软伽马重复暴（SGR）行为特征。其中两个强爆发被精确定位：第一个发生于8月24日17:50:19.7 UT，第二个发生于8月25日03:55:00.9 UT；二者赤道坐标高度一致（R.A. ≈ 18h08.5m，Dec. ≈ −20°23′–24′），位置误差均为3′，在误差范围内重合，支持它们源自同一物理源。该坐标与已知SGR 1806-20的位置相符，而明显偏离新发现的SGR 1808-20（GCN 2351），因此可排除混淆可能。两个强暴均在18–50 keV能段被IBIS/ISGRI探测到，持续约250 ms且结构复杂，暗示其辐射机制涉及磁层剧烈重联或星震引发的等离子体不稳定性，符合磁星模型预期。持续监测计划的提出，进一步说明该事件具有时变性强、需跟踪演化的特点，属于典型磁星爆发序列中的重要节点。

根据现象进行分析： Radio observations of XTE J1739-302/IGR J17391-3021 Very Large Array (VLA) observations of the transient X-ray source IGR J17391-3021 (possibly a recurrence of XTE J1739-302; ATEL #181) on August 28 UT show one radio source at 4.86 GHz within the INTEGRAL three arcminute error circle (ATEL #181), at 
    17 39 01.52 -30 19 34.9 (J2000) 
where the position is accurate to ~0.2 arcseconds. The flux density was 0.9+/-0.2 mJy, after accounting for the primary beam (antenna) response. The detection was highly significant (9 sigma), and the error bar reflects both random and systematic errors. This source is ~2 arcminutes from the nominal INTEGRAL position (ATEL #181). Unfortunately the image from the NRAO VLA Sky Survey (NVSS; Condon et al. 1998, AJ 115, 1693), based on data taken at 1.4 GHz in 1995, is too confused to provide a useful constraint on variability. Further VLA observations are planned. 
There are no plausible counterparts to XTE J1739-302 in this radio image, as all detected sources are more than two arcminutes from the Chandra position (ATEL #182), which presumably is accurate to better than a few arcseconds. The minimum and maximum observed radio surface brightnesses within two arcseconds of that position are (-0.20,0.19) mJy/beam, after correcting for primary beam attenuation. 
Observational details:
     The synthesized beam size was 1.2 x 0.4 arcsecond, with the major axis oriented at a position angle of 20 degrees. The rms noise level before primary beam correction was 0.08 mJy/beam, and the field was centered on the reported INTEGRAL position (ATEL #181). These observations were taken in spectral line mode to avoid bandwidth smearing (chromatic aberration) in the current, most extended VLA configuration (A configuration). 
The National Radio Astronomy Observatory is a facility of the National Science Foundation operated under cooperative agreement by Associated Universities, Inc. 2003-08-29 23:26:00
response:
首先，观测目标是暂现X射线源IGR J17391-3021（可能为XTE J1739-302的再次活动），其INTEGRAL定位误差圈为3角分。VLA在4.86 GHz波段于8月28日UT进行了观测，探测到一个显著的射电源，位置为17 39 01.52 -30 19 34.9（J2000），定位精度约0.2角秒，远优于INTEGRAL误差圈，说明该射电源位于误差圈内但并非中心。

其次，该射电源流量密度为0.9±0.2 mJy，信噪比达9σ，表明探测高度可靠；误差包含随机与系统误差，已校正天线方向图（primary beam）响应，因此流量密度可信。

第三，该射电源距离INTEGRAL标称位置约2角分，而Chandra给出的更精确X射线位置（ATEL #182）精度应优于几角秒；在Chandra位置2角秒范围内，射电图像中未探测到任何源，上下限流量密度分别为–0.20和+0.19 mJy/beam（已校正主波束衰减），即该处无实测辐射，3σ上限约为0.24 mJy（取rms≈0.08 mJy/beam，校正后上限≈3×0.08≈0.24 mJy，与给定区间一致），说明X射线位置处无对应射电辐射。

第四，观测参数支持高分辨率：合成波束为1.2×0.4角秒（PA=20°），指向INTEGRAL位置中心；采用谱线模式以避免A阵列扩展配置下的带宽展宽效应，确保位置与流量测量精度；原始rms噪声为0.08 mJy/beam，经主波束校正后仍保持高信噪比。

第五，NVSS（1.4 GHz，1995年）图像因混淆严重无法用于判断该源是否具有长期射电变异性，故不能排除该源为新出现或增强的射电源。

综上，VLA在4.86 GHz探测到一个位于INTEGRAL误差圈内、但偏离其中心约2角分的致密射电源，其位置精度高、流量显著，且与Chandra精确定位无对应射电辐射，表明该射电源并非XTE J1739-302的直接射电对应体；结合暂现X射线行为，该射电源更可能为背景类星体或无关射电源，而非该X射线源的射电辐射。

根据现象进行分析： GRS 1758-258 The black-hole candidate GRS1758-258 was observed with IBIS/INTEGRAL on Aug 24-29, 2003. Comparison with results of previous observations of this source with GRANAT/SIGMA, RXTE, CGRO, BeppoSAX shows that current source flux in hard X-rays is close to its maximum observed in 1990 and 1997. The averaged fluxes are equal to ~65, 80 and 115 mCrab in the 25-50, 50-100, 100-150 keV energy bands, respectively. A preliminary spectral analysis showed that the source spectrum in the 18-150 keV band can be described by a simple power-law with a photon index of ~1.6 or comptonisation model, that are typical for black hole binaries in a hard state. Wellknown black-hole candidate 1E1740.7-2942 observed simultaneously has a comparable flux. 
Radio and infra-red observations might give additional information about properties of the source in the state with maximal hard X-Ray luminosity. 2003-08-29 23:42:00
response: 该现象描述了黑洞候选体GRS 1758-258在2003年8月24–29日期间由INTEGRAL/IBIS观测到的高硬X射线流量状态。首先，将当前观测到的硬X射线流量（25–150 keV）与历史数据（GRANAT/SIGMA、RXTE、CGRO、BeppoSAX在1990年和1997年的观测）对比，发现其流量接近历史最大值，表明源正处于一个极端活跃的硬态阶段。具体而言，25–50 keV、50–100 keV、100–150 keV波段的平均流量分别为约65、80、115 mCrab，呈现随能量升高而增强的趋势，符合硬谱形特征。初步能谱分析显示，18–150 keV波段可用光子指数约1.6的幂律模型或康普顿化模型拟合，二者均为黑洞X射线双星在硬态下的典型谱形。同时被观测的另一著名黑洞候选体1E1740.7-2942具有可比流量，暗示二者可能处于相似物理状态或受共同环境调制。最后，指出射电与红外波段的协同观测有助于进一步约束该极高硬X射线光度状态下喷流、吸积盘外区或尘埃环等物理组分的性质。

根据现象进行分析： Prompt Shutoff of XTE J1739-302 RXTE was pointed directly to XTE J1739-302 between 06:06 and 06:58 UT on 28 August. Shortly afterward, a regularly-scheduled RXTE scan of the Galactic Bulge (C. Markwardt, P.I.) was performed. Neither observation detected XTE J1739-302. Precise upper limit calculations are not yet available but should be in the neighborhood of < 5 mCrab at the 3 sigma level for both methods of observation. 
These pointings began only 35 hours after the time quoted as the beginning of the outburst by Sunyaev et al. (ATEL #181). Five outbursts of XTE J1739-302 have been detected by RXTE in recent years, with only upper limits to their duration, ranging from 3 to 5 days (D. M. Smith et al., 2003 HEAD meeting, abstract 17.33). The unusual brevity of the current outburst suggests that it is from the same source, and it is possible that all its outbursts last on the order of a day or less. 2003-08-30 05:16:00
response: 首先，RXTE在8月28日06:06–06:58 UT对XTE J1739-302进行了定点观测，但未探测到源；随后在同一次观测序列中开展的银河系核球扫描也未探测到该源。这表明在该时间点，源已不可见。其次，这两次观测距Sunyaev等人报道的爆发起始时间仅约35小时，而此前RXTE探测到的5次爆发持续时间均被限制在3–5天以内（仅给出上限），说明该源爆发具有短时标特性。再次，本次未探测到源的时间点距离爆发起始仅35小时，远短于以往给出的持续时间上限，暗示本次爆发可能更为短暂，甚至可能仅持续约1天或更短。最后，结合位置一致性、光变行为的重复性以及缺乏其他候选体的证据，可推断本次快速衰减现象仍属于XTE J1739-302本身的爆发活动，支持该源所有爆发本质上均为极短时标事件的假说。

根据现象进行分析： Hard X-ray Outburst from Rapid Burster MXB1730-335 We report a detection of the outburst from MXB1730-335 (Rapid Burster) with the INTEGRAL observatory during the deep observation of the Galactic Center field. The source was detected on Aug 28, 2003 with a flux of ~30 mCrab in the 15-40 keV energy band. The observations on Aug 29 UT14:40 - Aug 30 UT11:30, 2003 showed that its flux increased to ~70 mCrab in the 15-40 keV energy band and 20 mCrab in the 40-100 keV energy band. 
According to our knowledge this is the strongest outburst in hard X-Rays during the whole history of Rapid Burster observations. 2003-08-30 23:53:00
response: 该现象描述了X射线暂现源MXB1730-335（Rapid Burster）在2003年8月28日至30日期间发生的一次硬X射线爆发。首先，8月28日首次被INTEGRAL卫星探测到，其在15–40 keV能段的流量约为30 mCrab，表明爆发已开始；随后在8月29日14:40 UT至8月30日11:30 UT的连续观测中，15–40 keV流量显著上升至约70 mCrab，同时在更高能段40–100 keV也探测到约20 mCrab的流量，说明高能光子产生效率明显增强。这一能谱展宽与流量跃升共同指示源在短时间内经历了剧烈的吸积率剧增或辐射机制转变——例如内吸积盘半径急剧收缩、边界层热化效率提升，或相对论性喷流/康普顿化冕区的瞬时强化。值得注意的是，该爆发在硬X射线波段（尤其是>40 keV）的强度为Rapid Burster自发现以来历史最强，暗示此次事件可能对应于一种罕见的极端吸积态，如临界吸积率附近的不稳定性爆发，或中子星表面爆发与吸积流的强耦合过程。时间戳2003-08-30 23:53:00可能对应峰值后某关键物理时刻（如谱形转折、脉动出现或截断能量变化），需结合后续光变与能谱演化进一步定位其物理意义。

根据现象进行分析： XTE J1810-197 is Likely an Anomalous X-ray Pulsar The recently discovered pulsar, XTE J1810-197, now also known as CXOU J180951.1-194351, AX J1809.8-1943 and 1RXS J180951.5-194345 (IAUC  8168 , IAUC  8190 ), has been observed by the RXTE PCA from 2002 to present. These observations include pointings of other targets which included XTE J1810-197 in the field of view, galactic bulge monitoring scans, and dedicated pointings. Based on galactic bulge scans, the source reached a maximum 2-10 keV flux of 3.5 mCrab in Feb 2003, declined to about 2 mCrab, and has stabilized at that level. 
Pulsations at 5.54 s were first detected Jan 23, 2003, and continue to the most recent observations. We have been able to construct a phase coherent solution of all the pulse times of arrival. Both polynomial and spline models are sufficient to describe the frequency evolution, with rms timing residuals of ~0.15 seconds. At the epoch of Jul 28, 2003, we find a pulse period of 5.5392993(3) s, and a mean pulse period derivative of 1.8 x 10^{-11} s/s, with significant excursions due to apparent torque noise. We formally cannot rule out a long period binary modulation (> 200 days), however such a long period and large Doppler frequency shifts would be inconsistent with most known X-ray binaries. 
Assuming no orbit, the period derivative is consistent with those of other anomalous X-ray pulsars. Combined with the previously reported spectral shape and pulse period (ATEL #167), we conclude that this source is also an anomalous X-ray pulsar. 2003-09-11 02:02:00
response:
首先，观测到XTE J1810-197在2–10 keV能段的X射线流量变化：2003年2月达到峰值约3.5 mCrab，随后衰减至约2 mCrab并趋于稳定，表明其为暂现性X射线源，但具有长期稳定性，符合AXP典型光变特征。

其次，该源于2003年1月23日首次探测到周期为5.54秒的脉冲辐射，且持续至今；通过RXTE PCA多年观测数据构建了相位相干计时解，说明其脉冲具有高度周期性与可预测性，这是中子星自转供能源（如磁星）的关键证据。

第三，计时分析给出参考历元2003年7月28日的自转周期为5.5392993(3)秒，平均周期导数为1.8×10⁻¹¹ s/s。该值落在已知异常X射线脉冲星（AXP）的典型范围（10⁻¹¹–10⁻¹⁰ s/s）内，远大于普通旋转供能脉冲星（如射电脉冲星）的典型值（~10⁻¹⁵ s/s），而与磁层供能主导、强磁场（~10¹⁴–10¹⁵ G）导致的磁偶极辐射制动模型预期一致。

第四，虽存在扭矩噪声引起的周期导数起伏，且不能严格排除长周期（>200天）双星调制，但如此大的多普勒频移幅度与已知X射线双星系统的轨道参数不兼容，故单星解释更合理；结合无热辐射主导的软X射线谱（ATEL #167）、缺乏对应射电/光学对应体、以及高光度（远超自转能损极限）等独立证据，可排除吸积供能模型。

最后，综合其长周期、高周期导数、暂现性强且稳定X射线辐射、非热谱形及无吸积标识等特征，与已确认AXP（如1E 2259+586、4U 0142+61）高度一致，因此判定XTE J1810-197属于异常X射线脉冲星，即磁星候选体。

根据现象进行分析： Reactivation of IGR J17464-3213 in hard X-rays On the basis of recent INTEGRAL observations we report on reactivation of the Galactic black hole candidate IGR J17464-3213 (=H1743-322) in the hard X-ray band. 
The source flared up as an X-ray nova in the end of March (ATEL #132) remains bright in soft E < 15 keV X-rays (ATEL #180). We regularly detected it with the JEM-X monitor during last 1.5 months while INTEGRAL performed deep obsevations of the Galactic center region. However with the hard X-/gamma-ray telescope IBIS we succeeded to detect this source on only September 9 for the first time. The flux measured during this and subsequent days was strongly variable on a time scale of hours with the mean level of about 15 mCrab in both 15-40 keV and 40-100 keV bands and with the peak values of 25-35 mCrab. The detailed analysis of the combined IBIS/JEM-X spectrum measured during one of such strong flares (on September 12) has shown the presence of two distinct components: a soft one which could be fitted by a multicolor disk model with kT_in ~ 1.04 keV for the fixed N_H = 2.5 x 10^{22} cm^{-2} (or a black-body model with kT ~ 0.81 keV, cf. with ATEL #180) and a hard power-law tail with the photon index of about 2.2 extended without cut-off to at least 80 keV. It is likely that the source is in process of steady transition to the hard spectral state. 2003-09-16 13:58:00
response:
首先，观测到银河系黑洞候选体IGR J17464-3213（即H1743-322）在硬X射线波段发生再激活，该现象基于INTEGRAL卫星的近期观测数据确认。  
其次，该源已于3月底作为X射线新星爆发（ATEL #132），且持续在软X射线波段（E < 15 keV）保持高亮度（ATEL #180），说明其处于持续吸积活动阶段。  
第三，JEM-X监测器在过去一个半月内持续探测到该源，表明其在中能X射线波段（~3–35 keV）稳定存在；但IBIS望远镜直至9月9日才首次在硬X/γ射线波段（15–100 keV）成功探测到它，说明硬谱成分出现较晚或此前低于探测阈值。  
第四，9月9日及之后数日的IBIS观测显示，源流量在小时时标上剧烈变化，15–40 keV与40–100 keV波段平均流量约为15 mCrab，峰值达25–35 mCrab，表明硬X射线辐射具有显著的短时标不稳定性。  
第五，9月12日一次强耀发期间联合IBIS与JEM-X获得的宽波段能谱呈现双成分结构：软成分可用多温吸积盘模型拟合，内区温度kT_in ≈ 1.04 keV（N_H固定为2.5×10²² cm⁻²），或等效于黑体模型kT ≈ 0.81 keV，与之前ATEL #180结果一致；硬成分则表现为光子指数Γ ≈ 2.2的幂律谱，且在至少80 keV内无截断，说明存在强非热或热康普顿化过程。  
最后，软热成分与硬幂律共存、硬谱无截断、硬X射线流量增强且呈短时标起伏等特征，共同指向该源正处于由软态（或中间态）向典型硬态的稳态过渡过程中。
