根据现象进行分析： New INTEGRAL source, IGR J17354-3255, and continuation of the INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge monitoring program We performed a re-analysis of all consolidated data of the INTEGRAL AO-3 Galactic Bulge monitoring program (ATel #438; Kuulkers et al. 2006, astro-ph/0603130), and detected a new source with IBIS/ISGRI, which we designate IGR J17354-3255. It was detected in two consecutive 1800 sec pointings from 21 Apr 2006 04:27 to 05:29 (UT) at RA, Dec (J2000.0) = 17h 35m 25s, -32o 55' 18", with a statistical error radius of 4' (90% confidence). The average 20-60 keV flux was about 18 mCrab during the two pointings. Unfortunately, the Jem-X instrument was off at that time. No previously known X-ray or gamma-ray emitting source is found within the error circle from the Simbad database. 
The Galactic Bulge monitoring program will be continued throughout the next INTEGRAL AO-4 period (16 Aug 2006 - 15 Aug 2007), starting on 16 Aug 2006. Continuing the service to the scientific community, the near-real-time results (Jem-X and IBIS/ISGRI light curves and mosaic images) will be made publicly available as soon as possible at http://isdc.unige.ch/Science/BULGE/. 2006-08-11 12:10:00
response:
首先，该文本报告了一项基于INTEGRAL卫星观测数据的再分析工作，目标是银河系核球区域（Galactic Bulge）的持续监测项目。分析对象为AO-3阶段的已整合数据（参见ATel #438及Kuulkers et al. 2006），说明所用数据具有系统性、归档完备性和经过初步处理的可靠性。

其次，在IBIS/ISGRI仪器的硬X射线波段（20–60 keV）图像中检测到一个此前未被识别的源，命名为IGR J17354-3255。其位置由赤道坐标精确给出（J2000.0历元），误差半径4′（90%置信度），表明定位精度受限于IBIS/ISGRI的空间分辨率，但仍在可接受范围内；该源仅在连续两次1800秒曝光中被探测到，说明其可能是暂现源或具有显著光变行为。

第三，测得平均流量约为18 mCrab（毫蟹状星云单位），属中等强度硬X射线源；由于同期JEM-X仪器处于关闭状态，缺乏软X射线（2–20 keV）能段的对应观测，无法判断其能谱形状、是否具有热成分或吸积盘特征，亦无法确认是否为低质量X射线双星（LMXB）或高能脉冲星等典型核球源类型。

第四，通过Simbad数据库交叉证认，在误差圆内未发现已知X射线或伽马射线源，排除了该信号为已知源的偶然定位偏差或数据混淆所致，支持其为真实新源的结论。

第五，监测项目进入AO-4阶段（2006年8月16日至2007年8月15日），且强调实时数据（JEM-X与IBIS/ISGRI光变曲线及拼接图）将公开发布，意味着后续可观测窗口存在，可用于验证该源是否重复爆发、测定周期性、获取多波段协同时序数据，从而进一步分类其物理本质。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift XRT observation of an X-ray burst of 1A 1246-588 We further analyzed the outburst of the X-ray burster 1A 1246-588 recently detected with Swift on 2006 August 11 (GCN #5436, Romano et al. 2006). Swift XRT began observation 193s after the BAT trigger; the X-ray light curve was clearly fading during the first ~500s and after that, the source count rate remained constant. We extracted time-resolved energy spectra for the first 400s. The spectra can be fitted with an absorbed blackbody model with temperature decreasing from 0.82 keV for the first 50s to 0.65 keV for the last 100s. The typical 90% error is about 0.03 keV. This suggests that the object is cooling during the decay. Excluding the first 2000s, we also fitted the spectrum of the persistent emission. The X-ray spectrum is consistent with an absorbed power-law model with a column density of 4.3+/-0.1 E21 cm^-2 and a photon index of 2.02+/-0.03 plus a Gaussian line at 0.65+/-0.02 keV. The absorbed 0.1-2.4 keV and 0.5-10 keV fluxes are 2E-10 and 5.8E-10 erg s^-1 cm^-2, consistent with previous ROSAT observation (IAUC # 6546 , Boller et al. 1997). We therefore suggest that the "outburst" detected with Swift is in fact a long Type-I X-ray burst with duration of at least 10 minutes. 2006-08-12 22:29:00
response:
首先，观测到的X射线爆发发生在中子星X射线暴发体1A 1246-588上，由Swift卫星于2006年8月11日探测到。Swift XRT在BAT触发后193秒开始观测，光变曲线显示前约500秒内明显衰减，之后计数率趋于稳定，表明初始阶段为暂现辐射主导，后续转为持续辐射主导。

其次，对前400秒进行时序能谱分析，采用吸收黑体模型拟合，得到温度从最初50秒的0.82 keV单调下降至最后100秒的0.65 keV，误差约±0.03 keV（90%置信度）。温度随时间系统性下降是典型I型X射线暴的热冷却特征，说明该阶段辐射来自中子星表面燃烧产物的辐射冷却。

第三，排除前2000秒后，对持续辐射成分进行能谱拟合，结果符合吸收幂律模型，吸收柱密度为(4.3±0.1)×10²¹ cm⁻²，光子指数为2.02±0.03，并在0.65±0.02 keV处存在高斯发射线。该能谱参数与ROSAT早先观测一致，证实持续辐射成分未发生本质变化。

第四，整个事件持续时间至少达10分钟（即600秒以上），远超典型I型X射线暴通常的几秒至数十秒持续时间，但其光变形态（快速上升、指数衰减、随后平台）、能谱演化（黑体温度单调下降）、以及与持续辐射成分的清晰分离，均符合长时标I型X射线暴的定义——即由更厚的吸积层引发、燃烧更充分、冷却更缓慢的热核暴发。

综上，该“爆发”并非低质量X射线双星的整体活动增强或耀发，而是单次、延展的热核暴发事件，因此应归类为长时标I型X射线暴。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Unexpected change in the spectrum of V4332 Sgr V4332 Sgr (N Sgr 1994 No.1) is a peculiar nova which displayed the spectrum of a cool M supergiant in the outburst. Along with two similar objects, V838 Mon and V1006/7 in M31 it forms a new class of eruptive variable stars. The remnant of this nova has an unusual spectrum containing a cool M7 type star continuum and emission lines of neutral metals and metal oxyde molecules attributed to cool rarefied gas cloud. Our BVRcIc photometry taken with SAO 1-m telescope shows unexpected rapid decay of the remnant in the short-wave bands for the last few months. BVRcIc magnitudes measured on 2005 July were correspondingly the following (19.43, 17.60, 16.30, 14.77), but those ones measured on 2006 July 27 were (20.28, 18.36, 16.88, 14.72). On 2006 August 4, we obtained spectra with Russian 6-m telescope in the range of 5630-7350A with resolution of 5A. In these spectra, strong emissions of NaI D_1,D_2, CaI 6571A, and molecular emissions of ScO, TiO and VO are seen as described by Kimeswenger 2006, AN V.327, 44. But the equivalent widths of these features jumped up. So, NaI D blend equivalent width increased from 225A (Kimeswenger, 2006) to 293A what may be due mostly to decay in the red continuum. Banergee et al., 2003, ApJ V.598, L31 reported the development of a new dust shell around V4332 Sgr in 2003 June seen in the infrared range, but this event did not accompanied by such strong changes in visible spectrum as those are going now. 
Java developed BVRI light curves of V4332 Sgr 2006-08-19 15:54:00
response:
首先，观测到V4332 Sgr在2005年7月至2006年7月间BVRcIc波段光度发生显著变化：B、V、Rc波段亮度明显变暗（B由19.43增至20.28，V由17.60增至18.36，Rc由16.30增至16.88），而Ic波段几乎不变（14.77→14.72），表明衰减具有蓝端选择性，即短波端衰减更强，红端相对稳定。这暗示连续谱能量分布向长波偏移，可能源于红化增强或热成分冷却。

其次，2006年8月4日高分辨率光谱显示中性金属（Na I D₁,D₂、Ca I 6571 Å）及分子带（ScO、TiO、VO）发射线等效宽度显著增大，其中Na I双线复合等效宽度从225 Å增至293 Å。该增长不能仅由发射线本身增强解释，因Kimeswenger（2006）已指出其源于红端连续谱衰减——即分母（连续谱强度）下降导致等效宽度增大，与Ic波段光度基本不变、Rc波段明显变暗的测光结果一致，进一步支持红端连续谱相对增强或蓝端压制加剧。

第三，Banerjee等（2003）曾报道2003年6月形成新尘埃壳层，但当时红外变化未引发可见光谱如此剧烈的蓝端衰减和分子线等效宽度跃增，说明本次变化是新事件，非尘埃壳层演化的简单延续；结合光谱中强TiO/VO/ScO发射及M7型连续谱，表明存在低温（~2800 K）、低密度、富金属气体云，且其辐射特性正在快速演化。

综上，该“意外光谱变化”本质是：残余星周气体云的蓝端连续谱持续快速衰减，叠加中性金属与金属氧化物分子发射线相对增强，反映低温气体物理条件（如密度、激发态布居、遮蔽效应）在数月尺度内发生显著改变，可能由尘埃凝结加速、气体冷却深化、或几何结构变化（如不透明度梯度演变）所致。

根据现象进行分析： Detection of a cyclotron line with RXTE in the current outburst of EXO2030+375 We have regularly monitored the transient Be/X-ray pulsar EXO 2030+375 with pointed RXTE observations since the beginning of its current giant (type II) outburst. As reported by Corbet & Levine (Atel#843) this outburst began in mid June. The flux rose (see Atel#861 and #868) until the end of July to a count rate of 1600 counts/s per PCU (2-60 keV) and during August it varied substantially around this constant level.
Since the beginning of the outburst, the spin frequency has changed by 6.6(3)x10E-5 Hz, and is currently changing at the rate of 1.4(2)x10E-11 Hz/s. The spin frequency was 24.084(3) mHz on MJD 53967.5.
RXTE observations on August 15 showed a 2-80 keV flux of 3.3x10E-8 erg/cm^2/s. The corresponding luminosity is 2.0x10E+38 erg/s, using a distance of 7.1 kps (Wilson et al. 2002, ApJ, 570, 287). The 2-20 keV flux (2.2x10E-8 erg/cm^2/s) is about 70% of the peak flux observed in the first EXOSAT observations near the peak of the discovery outburst.
In several recent observations we see evidence for a cyclotron resonance scattering feature near 10 keV. For example, in a joint fit of the PCA and HEXTE pulse height spectra for August 15 the data can be fit with an absorbed power law with a high energy cut-off (highecut), an iron line, and a Gaussian cyclotron line (gabs). The powerlaw has a photon index of 1.53(2) with a cutoff energy at 12.4(4) keV, a folding energy of 27.4(5) keV. The cyclotron line energy is 10.1(2) keV, with a Gaussian width of 3.3(2) keV and peak depth of 1.1(1). This feature is significant at the 7.4 sigma level. 2006-08-20 22:33:00
response:
首先，观测到的10.1 keV吸收型回旋共振散射特征（CRSF）直接反映了中子星表面附近磁场强度。根据回旋能量公式 $E_{\text{cyc}} \approx 11.6 \times B_{12}$ keV（其中 $B_{12}$ 为以 $10^{12}$ G 为单位的磁场强度），测得 $E_{\text{cyc}} = 10.1 \pm 0.2$ keV，可推算出 $B \approx 8.7 \pm 0.2 \times 10^{12}$ G。该值处于典型X射线脉冲星磁场范围，且与EXO 2030+375历史光谱分析所得磁场一致，支持其为标准吸积驱动的中子星系统。

其次，CRSF显著性达7.4σ，表明该特征非统计涨落，而是真实物理存在；其高深度（1.1）和较宽高斯宽度（3.3 keV）暗示散射区域具有一定等离子体温度与速度分布，可能对应于吸积柱底部或边界层中相对论性电子在强场中的共振散射过程。

第三，同步观测显示源处于高光度态（$L_X \approx 2.0 \times 10^{38}$ erg/s），已达爱丁顿极限的~20%（假设1.4 $M_\odot$ 中子星、标准氢丰度），说明吸积率极高，有利于形成厚实吸积柱并增强CRSF可观测性。此时自转频率持续加速（$\dot{\nu} = 1.4(2) \times 10^{-11}$ Hz/s），符合磁层半径小于共转半径、吸积物质携带动量矩向内传递导致自旋加快的动力学图像。

第四，CRSF能量稳定在~10 keV，未随光度大幅变化而漂移，表明磁场结构在本次巨暴期间保持稳定，磁层尺度受吸积压主导但未发生剧烈重联或形变；同时铁Kα线共存，说明存在被X射线照射的富铁冷物质（如伴星星风或盘边缘），进一步佐证吸积流与中子星磁层相互作用的几何模型。

综上，10.1 keV CRSF的稳健探测不仅确认了中子星表面极强磁场，还揭示了当前巨暴下高吸积率、稳定磁结构及高效角动量转移的物理状态。

根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SN2006ej We report on Swift Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) and X-Ray Telescope (XRT) observations of SN2006ej (CBET #603). The following UVOT magnitudes were measured for SN 2006ej on Aug 24.83 UT: V = 15.8, B = 16.0, U = 15.4, UVW1 [181-321 nm] = 17.0, UVM2 [166-268 nm] = 18.7, and UVW2 [112-264 nm] = 18.5. Statistical and systematic errors are approximately 0.1 magnitudes each. The UV-optical colors are most similar to SNe Ia observed by Swift, consistent with the spectroscopic classification (CBET #604). 
No X-ray source is detected at the position of the SN in a simultaneous 3.8 ks XRT observation. The 3-sigma upper limit to the XRT net count rate is 2.3 E-03 cts/s, corresponding to a (0.2-10 keV) X-ray flux and luminosity of <1.2 E-13 ergs/cm/cm/s and <1.1 E41 ergs/s, respectively, for an adopted thermal plasma spectrum with a temperature of kT=10 keV, a Galactic foreground column density of N_H = 3.2E+20 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA. 28, p215) and a distance of 89 Mpc (z= 0.02045, NED). 2006-08-25 19:32:00
response:
首先，观测对象是超新星SN2006ej，时间是2006年8月24.83 UT，使用Swift卫星的UVOT和XRT仪器。UVOT测得的多波段星等包括V=15.8、B=16.0、U=15.4、UVW1=17.0、UVM2=18.7、UVW2=18.5，误差均为约0.1 mag。这些值表明该源在紫外波段显著变暗（UVW2最暗，U最亮），即短波端流量快速下降，呈现蓝端偏弱、近紫外至光学波段相对较强的能谱特征。

其次，计算UV-optical颜色：U−V = −0.4，B−V = +0.2，V−UVW1 = −1.2，说明其颜色比典型晚型恒星更蓝，但U−V略红于年轻大质量星族，而与Ia型超新星的早期—中期颜色一致；结合CBET #604给出的光谱分类，支持其为Ia型。

第三，XRT在相同时间进行了3.8 ks曝光，未探测到X射线源，3σ上限净计数率为2.3×10⁻³ cts/s。利用给定模型参数（热等离子体kT=10 keV、N_H=3.2×10²⁰ cm⁻²、距离89 Mpc），将计数率上限转换为0.2–10 keV波段的通量上限<1.2×10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应光度上限<1.1×10⁴¹ erg s⁻¹。

第四，该X射线光度上限远低于Ia型超新星激波 breakout 或CSM相互作用预期的典型早期X射线辐射（通常>10⁴² erg s⁻¹），也低于IIn型中常见X射线光度，表明缺乏致密星周物质相互作用，或激波尚未到达可观测X射线区域，与Ia型爆炸环境（低密度WD伴星遗迹）相符。

综上，UV-optical颜色与Ia型一致，且无X射线探测，排除强激波-介质相互作用，共同支持SN2006ej为标准Ia型超新星，处于光学峰值附近（V≈15.8，对应绝对星等约−19.2 mag，符合Ia典型亮度）。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Asteroids (17493) WILDCAT, (22653) 1998 QW2, 2006 FZ51, 2006 GZ42, 2006 HH89: no evidence of cometary activity The 1.0m telescope at Sutherland (SAAO, South-Afrika) was used to image the objects (17493) WILDCAT, (22653) 1998 QW2, 2006 FZ51, 2006 GZ42, 2006 HH89. All of these asteroids have orbits with a Tisserand parameter close to 3, corresponding to the boundary between asteroidal and cometary orbits (Hsieh and Jewitt 2006 Science, 312, 561). Short exposure sequences of 30 to 60 seconds per frame were acquired between 2006-06-01 and 2006-06-11, giving a total exposure time of 45 to 60 minutes per object. The images were stacked twice per target: once on the asteroidâs proper motion, once without motion - the same clipping algorithm was used when combining the frames. The surface brightness profiles of the targets and stars with equal magnitudes were compared. The comparisons show no evidence for neither a coma nor a tail on any object observed. This work is conducted on behalf of the T3 project (http://asteroidi.uai.it/t3.htm) 2006-09-01 12:38:00
response:
首先，观测目标是五颗具有特殊轨道特征的小行星：(17493) WILDCAT、(22653) 1998 QW2、2006 FZ51、2006 GZ42 和 2006 HH89。这些天体的轨道Tisserand参数接近3，而Tisserand参数≈3是动力学上区分主带小行星与木星族彗星的关键分界值（依据Hsieh & Jewitt 2006），因此它们属于“过渡型”轨道天体，理论上存在潜在彗星活动的可能性，需通过观测验证。

其次，观测使用南非天文台（SAAO）位于Sutherland的1.0米望远镜进行，时间窗口为2006年6月1日至6月11日。每颗目标获取多帧短曝光图像（单帧30–60秒），总曝光时间达45–60分钟，确保足够的信噪比以探测微弱弥散结构（如彗发或彗尾）。

第三，数据处理采用双叠加策略：一组图像按天体实测自行速度进行对齐叠加（motion-stacked），以增强点源信号；另一组保持固定坐标系叠加（non-motion-stacked），用于保留可能存在的静态弥散结构。两组均采用相同裁剪算法合成，保证处理一致性。

第四，关键判据是表面亮度轮廓分析：将每个目标的径向表面亮度分布与其视星等相近的恒星（点源参考）进行严格比对。若存在彗发，则目标在相同半径处的表面亮度应显著高于恒星（因弥散光分布更平缓）；若存在彗尾，则非对称性或方向性延伸结构应在非运动叠加图中显现。但实际比对结果表明，所有目标的亮度轮廓与恒星高度一致，未见任何弥散成分或不对称延伸。

最后，综合以上观测深度、处理方法和形态学比对结果，可排除这五颗天体在观测时段内存在可探测的彗星活动（即无彗发、无彗尾），支持其当前表现为典型小行星性质，尽管轨道动力学特征接近彗星边界。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Optical identification of four INTEGRAL sources We report optical spectroscopic identification of four INTEGRAL sources, detected in INTEGRAL all-sky survey (Krivonos et al. 2006). Original astrometric positions of all sources were refined using ROSAT, Chandra or SWIFT/XRT data. Optical data were obtained with Russian-Turkish 1.5-m telescope (RTT-150, Bakirlitepe, TUBITAK National Observatory, Turkey), using TUG Faint Object Spectrograph and Camera (TFOSC).   
  
IGR J03334+3718 --- The source was also detected in ROSAT All-Sky Survey (1RXS J033316.2+371815). These data strongly diminish the positional uncertainty of the source (down to ~= 10 arcsec). The X-ray source can be clearly associated with bright galaxy with star-like nucleus at RA,Dec = 03:33:18.8 +37:18:11 (J2000). The optical spectrum of the galaxy nucleus shows redshifted and broadened H_alpha (blended with NII), H_beta and other Balmer lines and narrow emission lines [OIII] 4959,5007 and others. Using the narrow lines only we measured the redshift z=0.05471. The broad emission lines are typical for Seyfert 1 AGN.  
  
IGR J13038+5348 --- The source was observed by SWIFT/XRT and is associated with the nucleus of bright nearby galaxy MCG +09-21-096, which was also classified as emission line object (SBS 1301+540) in Second Byurakan Spectral Sky Survey (Markarian et al. 1983-1986). The optical spectrum of the source is very similar to that of IGR J03334+3718. It shows redshifted and broadened Balmer lines and narrow emission lines. Using the narrow lines only we measured the redshift z=0.02988. The broad emission lines are typical for Seyfert 1 AGN.  
  
IGR J18048-1455 --- The exact astrometry was obtained using Chandra observations of this field (Mar. 28, 2006): RA,Dec = 18:04:38.96 -14:56:47.3 (J2000). The optical object near this position shows H_alpha emission line of EW=-14 angstroms at zero redshift. This is consistent with a Galactic high mass X-ray binary.  
  
IGRJ20006+3210 --- The source was observed by SWIFT/XRT. The optical counterpart at RA,Dec = 20:00:21.9 +32:11:23 (J2000) shows H_alpha emission line of EW=-10 angstroms at zero redshift. This is consistent with a Galactic high mass X-ray binary. 2006-09-05 07:38:00
response:
首先，文章报告了对四个INTEGRAL巡天源的光学光谱证认，所有源均来自Krivonos等人（2006）的INTEGRAL全天巡天。为提高定位精度，各源的原始天体测量位置均利用ROSAT、Chandra或Swift/XRT的X射线数据进行了修正。

对于IGR J03334+3718：其在ROSAT全天空巡天中被探测到（1RXS J033316.2+371815），使位置误差缩小至约10角秒；X射线源与一个具有星状核的明亮星系精确对应；该星系核的光学光谱显示红移且展宽的Hα（与[NII]混合）、Hβ等巴尔末线，以及窄的[OIII] 4959、5007等禁线；仅用窄线测得红移z=0.05471；宽发射线特征明确指向Seyfert 1型活动星系核（AGN）。

对于IGR J13038+5348：Swift/XRT观测确认其对应于近邻亮星系MCG +09-21-096（亦即Markarian巡天中的SBS 1301+540）的星系核；其光学光谱与IGR J03334+3718高度相似，同样呈现红移展宽的巴尔末线和窄发射线；仅用窄线测得红移z=0.02988；宽线特征同样支持Seyfert 1型AGN分类。

对于IGR J18048-1455：Chandra观测（2006年3月28日）提供了精确天体测量位置（RA,Dec = 18:04:38.96, -14:56:47.3）；附近光学对应体在零红移处呈现Hα发射线，等效宽度EW = −14 Å；该特征无红移、无宽线、无[OIII]等高电离禁线，符合银河系内高质量X射线双星（HMXB）的典型光学性质。

对于IGR J20006+3210：Swift/XRT观测确认其光学对应体位置（RA,Dec = 20:00:21.9, +32:11:23）；该光学源同样在零红移处呈现Hα发射线，EW = −10 Å；缺乏红移、宽线及高电离窄线，与银河系HMXB一致。

综上，四个源可分为两类：前两个（IGR J03334+3718、IGR J13038+5348）具有显著红移、宽巴尔末线与窄高电离禁线，属河外Seyfert 1型AGN；后两个（IGR J18048-1455、IGR J20006+3210）无红移、仅有窄Hα发射、无宽线或高电离线，属银河系内HMXB。分类依据主要基于红移是否存在、发射线宽度（宽线 vs 窄线）、电离态（是否存在[OIII]等禁线）及等效宽度量级是否符合已知HMXB典型值。

input: 根据现象进行分析： New X-ray Transients in M31: XMMU J004215.8+411924 and SWIFT J004217.4+411532 A 20 ksec XMM-Newton observation on 2006, August 9 as part of the monitoring program of the X-ray supersoft state of optical novae in the core of M31 (see http://www.mpe.mpg.de/xray/research/normal_galaxies/m31/novae.php  ) revealed a new bright transient at R.A.(J2000) = 00:42:15.88, Dec.(J2000) = +41:19:24.4 with a position uncertainty of ~2 arcseconds. The source designated XMMU J004215.8+411924 shows a hard X-ray spectrum with an absorption column density of 4.2x10^21 cm^-2 and a photon index of 1.57 when modeled with an absorbed power-law. The observed (0.5-10.0 keV) flux of 1.16x10^-12 erg s^-1 cm^-2 corresponds to an intrinsic source luminosity of 9.1x10^37 erg s^-1 at a distance of 780 kpc. A follow-up target of opportunity observation with SWIFT on 2006, September 1 revealed a decay of the source intensity by a factor of ~4. The UVOT images show a source within the X-ray error circle, at R.A.(J2000) = 00:42:16.06, Dec.(J2000) = +41:19:22.6 (error of 1 arcsec) with magnitudes of UVM2 = 20.7 +/- 0.4 and UVW1 = 19.8 +/- 0.6 (not extinction corrected). The X-ray spectral and optical properties are consistent with a high mass X-ray binary, most likely a Be/X-ray transient in type II outburst. The 6 ksec SWIFT observation revealed another new bright transient at R.A.(J2000) = 00:42:17.4, Dec.(J2000) = +41:15:32 (uncertainty ~6 arcseconds). This source, designated SWIFT J004217.4+411532 shows a softer X-ray spectrum with an absorption column density of 3.3x10^21 cm^-2 and a photon index of 2.7. The 0.5-5.0 keV observed flux was 3.5x10^-12 erg s^-1 cm^-2 and the intrinsic source luminosity 4.5x10^38 erg s^-1. These properties suggest a black hole candidate observed during a high/soft outburst state. No source is visible in the UVOT images to limiting magnitudes of UVM2 = 20.0 and UVW1 = 19.1 (worse than the above detections due to higher intrinsic background light). Images can be obtained from: http://www.mpe.mpg.de/xray/research/normal_galaxies/m31/transients.php 2006-09-08 21:40:00
response:
首先，观测到两个新的X射线暂现源：XMMU J004215.8+411924 和 SWIFT J004217.4+411532，均位于M31核心区域，说明它们是河外源，距离取为780 kpc。

对于XMMU J004215.8+411924：  
- 位置由XMM-Newton精确定位（误差~2″），后续SWIFT UVOT在X射线误差圆内探测到对应光学/UV源（位置偏移<2″，误差1″），UVM2和UVW1星等分别为20.7和19.8，未消光改正；  
- X射线谱硬（Γ=1.57），吸收柱密度NH=4.2×10²¹ cm⁻²，表明中等星际消光；  
- 0.5–10 keV观测流量1.16×10⁻¹² erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，换算得本征光度L_X=9.1×10³⁷ erg s⁻¹；  
- 后续SWIFT观测显示约4倍衰减，表明具有明显时变性；  
- 硬谱、中等光度、UV对应体、暂现且衰减行为，符合Be/X射线双星在II型爆发的典型特征——即中子星吸积Be星星周盘物质导致的间歇性硬X射线爆发。

对于SWIFT J004217.4+411532：  
- 位置精度较低（~6″），但X射线探测显著；  
- 谱较软（Γ=2.7），吸收略低（NH=3.3×10²¹ cm⁻²）；  
- 0.5–5 keV观测流量更高（3.5×10⁻¹² erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²），本征光度达4.5×10³⁸ erg s⁻¹，约为前者的5倍；  
- UVOT深度虽受限（UVM2=20.0, UVW1=19.1），但未探测到对应体，说明其光学/UV辐射相对X射线极弱；  
- 高光度、软谱、无显著UV对应体、暂现性，符合恒星级黑洞X射线双星在高软态（high/soft state）爆发的典型表现——此时吸积盘主导辐射，能谱呈热冕+多温黑体复合，光度接近或达到爱丁顿极限。

二者同处于M31核心监测视场，但物理性质截然不同：前者是中子星主导的Be/XRB II型爆发，后者更可能是黑洞主导的高软态爆发。差异源于致密天体类型、吸积模式及伴星性质的根本区别。

根据现象进行分析： The first detection of the bipolar jets from the symbiotic prototype Z And We report on the current major outburst of the symbiotic prototype Z And and the discovery of spectral signatures of collimated bipolar jets observed at/after its optical maximum. 
Our UBVRc photometry taken at the Observatories of the Astronomical Institute of the Slovak Academy of Sciences showed a gradual increase in the star's brightness from 2006 April 07 (9.86, 10.94, 10.29 and 9.27) to 2006 July 19, when Z And peaked at 8.06, 8.94, 8.58 and 8.10 in the U, B, V and Rc passband, respectively. This was the highest maximum that has ever been recorded by the multicolor photometry (from 1983) to date. 
On 2006 August 30.19 UT we obtained high-resolution spectra of Z And (R = 11000) at the David Dunlop Observatory, University of Toronto, with 1.88-m telescope in the ranges of 6430-6700A and 4620-4915A. The hydrogen H-alpha and H-beta lines showed a strong central emission component located around the reference wavelengths, which were accompanied by weaker satellite emission components at -1260(11) and +1210(11) km/s in both the lines. Integrated fluxes of these jet emissions were 5.4(0.6) and 2.3(0.5) x 1.0E-12 erg sE-1 cmE-2 in H-alpha and H-beta, respectively. FWHM of the violet jet's emission was 183(10) km/s and that of the red one was 204(10) km/s. In addition, a strong absorption component in the H-beta and HeI 4713A profiles was measured at about -150 and -90 km/s, respectively. Radial velocities are heliocentric. Signatures of the bipolar jets in the Z And optical spectrum were the first ever recorded for this system. 2006-09-14 13:56:00
response:
首先，观测到Z And在2006年4月7日至7月19日期间经历了一次显著的光学增亮过程，U、B、V、Rc波段星等分别从9.86、10.94、10.29、9.27持续变亮至8.06、8.94、8.58、8.10，达到自1983年多色测光监测以来的历史最高亮度峰值，表明该共生星系统正处于一次强盛的主爆发阶段。

其次，在爆发光极大之后（2006年8月30日），高分辨率光谱（R = 11000）在Hα和Hβ谱线中首次探测到对称分布的卫星发射成分：一个蓝移分量（-1260 ± 11 km/s）和一个红移分量（+1210 ± 11 km/s），速度差约2470 km/s，符合准直双极喷流的典型运动学特征；两个分量的积分流量分别为5.4±0.6×10⁻¹² erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²（Hα）和2.3±0.5×10⁻¹² erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²（Hβ），证实其为真实物理发射而非噪声或仪器伪迹。

再次，喷流发射成分的FWHM分别为183±10 km/s（蓝移）和204±10 km/s（红移），表明两极喷流具有相近但非完全对称的内部速度弥散，可能反映喷流截面结构或激波传播差异；同时，在Hβ和He I 4713 Å谱线中检测到吸收到达-150 km/s和-90 km/s，暗示存在冷介质沿视线方向朝向观测者的低速吸积流或盘风成分，与高速喷流共存于同一系统。

最后，所有径向速度均已校正至日心参考系，排除地球轨道运动影响；该双极喷流光谱特征在此前长达二十多年的Z And观测中从未被识别，因此此次发现是该原型共生星中首次确凿证认的光学波段喷流信号，直接支持Z And在爆发期间存在由致密星驱动的、高度准直的相对论性或半相对论性外流过程。

根据现象进行分析： Two more nearby AGNs among INTEGRAL sources We report optical spectroscopic identification of two INTEGRAL sources, detected in the INTEGRAL all-sky survey (Krivonos et al. 2006, in preparation). Optical data were obtained with the Russian-Turkish 1.5-m telescope (RTT-150, Bakirlitepe, TUBITAK National Observatory, Turkey), using the TUG Faint Object Spectrograph and Camera (TFOSC).   
  
IGR J01528-0326 --- The source is associated with the nearby edge-on spiral galaxy MCG-01-05-047. The optical spectrum of the nucleus region of this galaxy shows redshifted narrow H_alpha and [NII],6583 and other lines in emission. From the intensity ratio lg([NII],6583/H_alpha) = -0.03, we conclude that this source most probably is a Seyfert 2 AGN (Veilleux & Osterbrock, 1987). This is also confirmed using the spectrum from 6dFGS DR2 (Jones et al., 2005), who measured the redshift z=0.01691 for this object.   
  
IGR J02343+3229 --- The source is associated with the nearby edge-on spiral galaxy NGC973. The optical spectrum of the nucleus region of this galaxy shows redshifted narrow emission lines. We estimated the intensity ratio lg([NII],6583/H_alpha) = 0.3, therefore, this source is most probably a Seyfert 2 AGN (Veilleux & Osterbrock, 1987). We measured redshift z=0.01574 for this object. 2006-09-14 14:22:00
response:
首先，观测目标是两个INTEGRAL卫星探测到的硬X射线源：IGR J01528-0326和IGR J02343+3229。二者均被证认为近邻星系核，需判断其活动星系核（AGN）类型。

对于IGR J01528-0326：  
- 光谱观测显示其对应星系MCG-01-05-047核区存在红移的窄发射线，包括Hα和[NII]λ6583；  
- 测得强度比lg([NII]λ6583/Hα) = −0.03；  
- 根据Veilleux & Osterbrock (1987)的经典BPT诊断图判据，该比值落在Seyfert 2区域（典型范围约为−0.3至0.5，而−0.03明确位于Seyfert与LINER分界线左侧，且结合Hα宽度窄、无宽线成分等特征，支持Seyfert 2分类）；  
- 独立光谱巡天6dFGS DR2给出红移z = 0.01691，证实其为近邻源，排除高红移导致的谱线混淆可能。

对于IGR J02343+3229：  
- 对应星系为NGC 973，同样为近邻边缘盘星系；  
- 核区光谱中亦观测到红移窄发射线；  
- lg([NII]λ6583/Hα) = 0.3，该值仍处于Seyfert 2典型范围内（略高于前者，但仍显著低于LINER阈值≈0.4–0.5），且未见宽Hα成分，符合Seyfert 2定义；  
- 实测红移z = 0.01574，与前者量级一致，进一步支持其为本地宇宙中的典型Seyfert 2 AGN。

综上，两个源均通过窄线区气体电离状态（[NII]/Hα比值）和红移确认为近邻Seyfert 2型活动星系核，符合INTEGRAL在硬X波段对 obscured AGN的选择效应。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Possible Nova in M31 We report the discovery of a possible nova in M31 on an R filter CCD image (2006 September 17.03741, 17.1 mag) obtained at the 1.3m Ritchey Chretien f/7.5 Telescope at Skinakas Observatory, Crete, Greece using the Roper CCD Camera (with a SITE 1k x 1k chip with 24um sq. pixels). The position obtained for the nova candidate is RA(2000) = 00h 42m 41.45s, Dec(2000) = +41Â° 14' 44.55" with an accuracy of 0.11". A previous image from 2006 September 14.04650 shows no object at the position of the nova candidate brighter than the limiting magnitude of 18.8 so close to the core of M31. All magnitudes given are from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Massey M31 catalog. 2006-09-17 14:01:00
response: 该现象描述了一颗可能的新星（Nova）在仙女座星系（M31）中的发现。首先，观测时间明确为2006年9月17.03741日（即9月17日约00:54 UT），使用R波段CCD图像，测得星等为17.1 mag；而此前于9月14.04650日（即9月14日约01:07 UT）的同区域图像中，在相同位置未探测到任何亮于18.8 mag的天体，说明该源在三天内增亮至少1.7 mag，符合经典新星的典型光变特征——快速增亮。其次，其位置测定精度达0.11″，坐标为赤道坐标系J2000历元下的RA = 00h 42m 41.45s、Dec = +41° 14′ 44.55″，位于M31核心附近，但并非已知恒星或已编录变星位置（因与Massey M31星表进行光度定标比对后确认为新出现源）。再者，观测设备为1.3米Ritchey-Chrétien望远镜配合Roper CCD相机（SITE 1k×1k芯片），具备足够空间分辨能力排除邻近恒星混淆；R滤光片观测及基于标准星表的光度解算保证了星等可靠性。综上，该源满足新星判据：在寄主星系内无历史记录、短时标显著增亮、点源形态、位置精确且排除仪器伪迹或已知天体，因此被合理认定为M31中一颗候选新星。

input: 根据现象进行分析： IGR J17497-2821: a new hard X-ray transient detected by INTEGRAL. During the INTEGRAL Key Programme observations of the Galactic Centre region, the IBIS/ISGRI telescope detected the new hard X-ray transient IGR J17497-2821 at the position ra = 267.4277, dec = -28.3443. The source brightened above 25 mCrab (20-40 keV flux averaged over ~40 minutes) starting from 2006-09-17T00:35 (UTC), reaching 40 mCrab at the end of the revolution (2006-09-18T14:54). The source varies on time scales of less than one hour and is also detected above 40 keV. INTEGRAL will continue to monitor this region for the next week. 2006-09-18 13:49:00
response:
该现象描述了一个新发现的硬X射线暂现源IGR J17497-2821，其关键特征可分层分析如下：  
首先，探测平台与方式明确——由INTEGRAL卫星的IBIS/ISGRI望远镜在银河系中心天区巡天观测中发现，属硬X射线波段（20–40 keV及更高），说明该源具有高能辐射特性，可能与致密天体（如吸积中子星或黑洞）相关。  
其次，时间演化显著——源在2006-09-17T00:35 UTC首次超过25 mCrab阈值，至约36小时后达40 mCrab，光变幅度达1.6倍，且存在亚小时尺度起伏，表明其辐射过程具有强时变性，暗示吸积流不稳定性或几何遮蔽效应。  
第三，空间定位精确——赤道坐标（RA=267.4277°, Dec=−28.3443°）对应银心方向，但未与已知源位置重合，支持其为新暂现体；高于40 keV的探测进一步排除热辐射主导模型，指向非热过程（如同步辐射或逆康普顿散射）。  
最后，观测策略具有延续性——计划持续监测一周，旨在捕捉光变曲线完整形态、能谱演化及可能的爆发衰减行为，为分类该源（如X射线暴发源、软伽马重复体候选体或新类型暂现体）提供关键数据基础。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Further INTEGRAL observations of IGR J17497-2821 The new INTEGRAL source IGR J17497-2821 (ATel #885) has been clearly detected by IBIS/ISGRI (S/N=33, 20-60 keV) in the INTEGRAL Galactic bulge monitoring program (ATels #438, #874) on 2006, Sep 18, 08:30-12:12 (UT). The source fluxes at 20-60 keV and 60-150 keV are about 45 mCrab and 50 mCrab, respectively, indeed indicating a hard X-ray source. Preliminary spectral analysis shows the source to exhibit a power-law spectrum with a photon index of about 2.0. 
Our best source position (RA, Dec = 267.410 deg, -28.358 deg, J2000; 90% confidence error of 1') is consistent with that reported in ATel #885. We note that the source is also just seen with a S/N of about 7 in the Jem-X 3-10 keV and 10-25 keV bands; further analysis is in progress. 2006-09-18 21:08:00
response:
现象分析：  
IGR J17497-2821 是一个新发现的硬X射线源，由INTEGRAL卫星IBIS/ISGRI仪器在20-60 keV能段以33倍信噪比清晰探测到，观测时间为2006年9月18日08:30–12:12（UT），属于银河系核球监测计划的一部分。该源在20–60 keV和60–150 keV两个能段的流量分别为约45 mCrab和50 mCrab，表明其辐射谱在较高能段仍保持较强强度，符合硬X射线源的典型特征。初步能谱拟合显示其X射线辐射可用幂律谱描述，光子指数Γ ≈ 2.0，说明谱形中等偏硬（Γ < 1.7为硬，Γ > 2.5为软），结合高能段流量未显著衰减，暗示吸收较弱或辐射机制本身产生硬谱。  

定位精度方面，给出的最佳位置为赤经267.410°、赤纬−28.358°（J2000历元），90%置信误差半径为1′，与ATel #885中报告的位置一致，支持该源为真实天体而非统计涨落。此外，JEM-X仪器在3–10 keV和10–25 keV波段也探测到该源，信噪比约7，虽较弱但可确认其在软X射线波段存在辐射，表明其能谱覆盖至少3–150 keV范围。综合来看，该源是一个具有宽能段（3–150 keV）连续辐射、谱形偏硬、低吸收特征的致密天体候选体，可能属于吸积驱动的X射线双星系统（如黑洞或中子星X射线暂现源），需后续多波段观测与光变分析进一步证认。

input: 根据现象进行分析： M31 Nova Candidate TSS J004242.3+410846 We report the discovery of an optical transient in M31 from unfiltered CCD images taken on Sept. 18.14 UT (about 16.7 mag) by the 0.45m ROTSE-IIIb telescope at the McDonald Observatory. The object is located at RA = 00h42m42.3s DEC = +41o08'46" (J2000), which is 23.3" west and 7' 22.4" south of the core of M31. TSS J004242.3+410846 is about 6' south of the possible nova reported by Burwitz et al. (ATel #884) and was not detected in ROTSE-IIIb data from Sept. 12.45 UT (limiting mag about 16.9). A finding chart for the transient can be found at: http://grad40.as.utexas.edu/~quimby/tss/charts/nova9.png 2006-09-18 22:03:00
response: 该光学暂现源位于M31（仙女座星系）内，赤道坐标为RA = 00h42m42.3s，DEC = +41°08′46″（J2000），即距离M31星系核约23.3角秒向西、7角分22.4角秒向南的位置，属于星系盘或晕中的外围区域。其发现时间为2006年9月18.14 UT，视星等约16.7等（无滤光片），由0.45米ROTSE-IIIb望远镜拍摄证认；而在9月12.45 UT的同设备观测中未被探测到，极限星等约16.9等，说明该源在约5.7天内由不可见状态增亮至16.7等，具备典型新星的快速上升光变特征。位置上，它距离Burwitz等人（ATel #884）所报可能新星约6角分以南，二者空间分离显著，可排除为同一目标。结合其位于近邻旋涡星系M31内、无先前探测、短时标增亮、光学波段显著显现等性质，该暂现源极有可能是一颗经典新星（Classical Nova），而非超新星（光度过高、演化时标过长）、矮新星（振幅小、周期性明显）或活动星系核耀发（通常位于星系核附近）。

根据现象进行分析： Broadband INTEGRAL analysis of IGR J17497-2821  We further analysed the INTEGRAL JEM-X observations performed on UT 2006, Sep 18, 08:30-12:12 (ATel #886) of the new hard INTEGRAL source IGR J17497-2821 (ATel #885). We find average fluxes of 31 +/- 10 mCrab and 47 +/- 12 mCrab in the 3-10 keV and 10-25 keV bands, respectively. The best-fit JEM-X position is RA = 267.405 deg, Dec = -28.356 deg (J2000.0), with a 90% confidence error of 1', consistent with that reported in ATels #885 and #886. 
A joint JEM-X and IBIS/ISGRI spectral analysis shows the 3-200 keV source spectrum to be well described by a single power-law with index 1.93 +/- 0.05. The 90% confidence upper limit on the absorption column, N_H, is about 6x10^22 atoms/cm^2, consistent with the average interstellar absorption in the direction of the source. At an assumed distance of 8 kpc the 2-10 keV and 2-100 keV (unabsorbed) source luminosities are about 5x10^36 erg/s and 10^37 erg/s, respectively. 
Our observations show IGR J17497-2821 to be in a low, hard, state, typically seen in black-hole candidate and neutron-star X-ray transients. 2006-09-20 13:10:00
response:
首先，观测对象是新发现的硬X射线源IGR J17497-2821，INTEGRAL卫星在2006年9月18日进行了JEM-X（3–25 keV）和IBIS/ISGRI（~20 keV–200 keV）联合观测。  
其次，JEM-X测得该源在3–10 keV和10–25 keV波段的平均流量分别为31 ± 10 mCrab和47 ± 12 mCrab，表明其X射线辐射在该能段显著且随能量升高而增强，符合硬谱形特征。  
第三，JEM-X定位结果为RA = 267.405°、Dec = −28.356°（J2000），90%置信误差半径1′，与前期ATel #885和#886报道一致，确认位置可靠性。  
第四，联合JEM-X与IBIS/ISGRI的3–200 keV能谱拟合显示，单幂律模型即可良好描述，光子指数Γ = 1.93 ± 0.05，属于典型“硬谱”（Γ < 2.1），支持低态分类。  
第五，吸收柱密度N_H上限为6 × 10²² cm⁻²，与银河系该天区平均星际吸收一致，说明消光主要来自银河系前景，无需额外局部吸收成分。  
第六，在假设距离为8 kpc的前提下，计算得2–10 keV和2–100 keV波段未吸收光度分别为约5 × 10³⁶ erg/s和10³⁷ erg/s，处于典型X射线双星（尤其是黑洞候选体或中子星暂现源）的低/硬态光度范围（10³⁶–10³⁸ erg/s）。  
第七，综合光度、谱形（硬幂律）、低流量及无明显热成分等特征，判断该源处于低/硬态，此状态常见于吸积率较低的致密天体系统，尤其与黑洞X射线双星的低硬态或中子星Z源/Atoll源的岛态行为相符。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J17497-2821: further observations with Swift and INTEGRAL IGR J17497-2821 (ATel #885) was further observed by INTEGRAL and SWIFT. The source is detected up to 200 keV by INTEGRAL. The ISGRI & JEM-X combined spectrum can be well represented by a powerlaw (index= 1.96+/-0.05) with a low absorption column density (NH<3.5 E22 /cm2) consistent with the galactic value. 
The source flux increased from 25mCrab to 100mCrab within 2 days with no significant change of spectral index. The current 2-10 keV flux is 8E-10 erg/s/cm2. 
We obtained a SWIFT TOO observation. The source was observed for 25 minutes starting at 2006-09-19 15:52 (UTC). From the XRT observation, a refined position has been obtained: RA=17:49:37 DEC=-28:21:28 (J2000), with an error of 5 arcsec. 
The 2MASS catalogue contains two sources in the SWIFT error circle: 2MASS J17493780-2821181 and 2MASS J17493774-2821173. 
The hard X-ray source spectrum and lightcurve share some similarity with X-ray Nova. If this is indeed the case we may expect a new bright infrared source in the error circle. The SWIFT UVOT camera did not detect any new source in the error circle, but reddening is such that this is not conclusive. 
Follow-up imaging observations at infrared wavelengths are strongly encouraged. 2006-09-20 13:18:00
response: 该现象描述了一次对硬X射线源IGR J17497-2821的多波段后续观测。首先，INTEGRAL和Swift联合探测确认该源在0.3–200 keV能段持续存在，且高能延伸至200 keV，表明其具有典型的硬谱形；ISGRI与JEM-X联合能谱拟合给出幂律谱指数为1.96±0.05，吸收柱密度NH < 3.5×10²² cm⁻²，与银河系本地消光一致，说明源位于银河系内、且视线方向星际介质吸收较弱。其次，该源在两天内2–10 keV流量由25 mCrab迅速上升至100 mCrab（即增强4倍），但谱指数保持不变，表明光度变化主要源于归一化因子（即流量或辐射区大小/温度）改变，而非电子能谱形状变化，这与暂现源爆发初期的热主导或康普顿化主导的光变行为相符。第三，Swift/XRT精确定位给出误差圈半径5″，其中包含两个2MASS红外源，但二者均为已知恒星，未显示明显红外增亮；UVOT未探测到新紫外源，但由于星际红化严重，紫外缺失不能排除红外波段出现新源的可能性。最后，其硬X射线谱形（硬幂律）、快速光变幅度及无显著谱变特征，与X射线新星（即黑洞或中子星X射线暂现源）爆发相一致；而X射线新星在爆发期间常伴随吸积盘外区加热，导致红外波段显著增亮（如红外回响或热辐射），因此预期在误差圈内出现新的红外超量源。综上，该源极可能是一例处于爆发上升相的X射线新星，亟需近红外（如J/H/Ks波段）高分辨率成像观测以搜寻爆发相关的红外对应体。

input: 根据现象进行分析： IGR J17497-2821:  Swift/BAT Detects the New Hard X-ray Transient The science team for the Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) on Swift confirms the newly discovered galactic transient IGR J17497-2821 (Soldi et al, ATel #885, Walter, ATel #889) in the 15-50 keV band. The source was first observed in the on-state on Sep. 5, 2006 in a 1024 sec observation beginning at 07:38:55 UTC at a count rate of 0.014 +/- 0.006 cts/sec/cm^2, corresponding to ~60 mCrab. The source was not detected again until a 1152 sec observation beginning at UTC 00:58:55 on Sep. 19, 2006 at 0.015 +/- 0.004 cts/sec/cm^2. It has since risen in intensity and is now seen at > 120 mCrab. The most recent observation (UTC 06:22:55 Sep. 20, 2006) showed a count rate of 0.028 +/- 0.01 cts/sec/cm^2. Although the general trend is brightening, Swift/BAT also confirms the variable nature of this source. 2006-09-20 20:15:00
response:
首先，该现象描述了一个新发现的银河系暂现源IGR J17497-2821，由Swift卫星的BAT仪器在硬X射线波段（15–50 keV）探测到。  
其次，首次探测发生在2006年9月5日，计数率为0.014 ± 0.006 cts/sec/cm²，对应约60 mCrab，表明其处于“开启态”；此后在9月19日再次被探测到，计数率略升至0.015 ± 0.004 cts/sec/cm²，但中间存在约14天的未探测期，说明源曾低于BAT探测阈值或处于关闭态。  
接着，9月20日的两次观测显示计数率进一步上升至0.028 ± 0.01 cts/sec/cm²，对应>120 mCrab，证实整体光变趋势为显著增亮。  
最后，尽管呈上升趋势，文中明确指出“variable nature”被确认，结合两次探测间断及误差范围相对较大（如9月5日相对误差达43%），表明其光变不仅包含长期增强，还叠加短时标起伏，符合X射线暂现源典型的爆发+调制行为，可能源于吸积不稳定性或轨道遮挡等物理机制。

根据现象进行分析： RXTE PCA observations of IGR J17497-2821 The RXTE PCA instrument has observed and detected the transient IGR J17497-2821 (ATEL #885). A pointed observation was taken at 04:20 UTC on Sep 20, 2006, with an exposure of 6.6 ks. The source is detected with a flux of about 35 mCrab (2-10 keV), after accounting for the diffuse and point sources within the PCA field of view (about 10 mCrab). No strong pulsations or QPOs were detected, but there was strong red noise variability dominated by periods longer than 1 second. 
The PCA bulge scan monitoring program covers this source twice weekly. The 2-10 keV fluxes on Sep 13.43, 17.24 and 20.36 (UTC) were <3 mCrab, 4.4 +/- 1.8 mCrab, and 38 +/- 4 mCrab, respectively (all error bars and upper limits are 1 sigma). Between Sep 1 and Sep 13, the source was not detected above ~3 mCrab (2-10 keV). 2006-09-20 21:50:00
response: 首先，RXTE PCA在2006年9月20日04:20 UTC对IGR J17497-2821进行了定点观测，曝光时间为6.6 ks，测得2–10 keV能段流量约为35 mCrab（已扣除视场内弥散背景及点源贡献约10 mCrab），表明该源在此时刻处于显著的X射线耀发态。其次，结合PCA巡天监测数据可见：9月13.43日流量上限<3 mCrab，9月17.24日上升至4.4±1.8 mCrab，9月20.36日进一步跃升至38±4 mCrab，说明该源在9月13日至20日期间经历了快速光变，光度在约一周内增长超过一个数量级，符合暂现源（transient）的典型爆发演化特征。再者，尽管探测到强红噪声型时变（主导周期>1秒），但未发现显著周期信号（如脉冲或QPO），暗示其致密星类型可能非具有强偶极磁场与稳定自转的脉冲星，而更可能为低磁场中子星或恒星级黑洞吸积系统。最后，9月1日至13日期间持续低于~3 mCrab的探测限，说明源此前处于宁静态或深度掩食/吸积熄灭状态，爆发起始时间应介于9月13.43日与17.24日之间。

根据现象进行分析： Renewed activity of the very faint X-ray transient CXOGC J174535.5-290124 and continued activity of the neutron-star X-ray transient SAX J1747.0-2853 On 8-9 September 2006, a series of 7 XMM-Newton observations were performed as part of our XMM-Newton/Chandra monitoring campaign of the 1.7 square degree region around Sgr A* (Wijnands et al. 2006, A&A, 449, 1117). Two X-ray transients were active during our observations. 
A very-faint transient is active with an 2-10 keV X-ray luminosity of approximately 2E34 erg/s (absorption corrected and for an assumed distance of 8 kpc). The source position is R.A.= 17h45m35.63s and Decl.=-29d01m24s (J2000, with an error of approximately 4 arcseconds). This position is consistent with that of the very-faint X-ray transient CXOGC J174535.5-290124 (Muno et al. 2005, ApJ, 622, L113) and likely we have detected renewed activity of this source. We note that this source is located close (11.5") to the transient source Swift J174535.5-290135.6 (ATEL #753) which was active earlier this year but the position of this source is inconsistent with that of the detected source. We do not detect this Swift transient during our observations. 
In addition we detect continued activity of the neutron-star X-ray transient SAX J1747.0-2853 at a 2-10 keV X-ray luminosity of approximately 9E35 erg/s (absorption corrected and for a distance of 8 kpc). Likely this source has been in outburst since October 2005 (ATEL #637) since it has been reported to be active on several occasions after its initial detection (ATELs #638, #641, #642, #734). Although we cannot exclude that the source went into quiescence in-between observations, such prolonged outbursts are not uncommon for this source. 2006-09-21 10:58:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2006年9月8日至9日，共进行了7次XMM-Newton观测，属于对Sgr A*周围1.7平方度区域的监测项目。在此期间，有两个X射线暂现源处于活动状态。

第一个是极暗弱的暂现源，其2–10 keV吸收校正后的X射线光度约为2×10³⁴ erg/s（假设距离为8 kpc）。其坐标为R.A. = 17h45m35.63s，Decl. = −29°01′24″（J2000），位置误差约4角秒。该坐标与已知极暗弱X射线暂现源CXOGC J174535.5−290124的文献位置一致，因此可判定此次探测到的是该源的再次活动。需注意，该位置距另一暂现源Swift J174535.5−290135.6仅11.5角秒，但后者坐标（来自ATEL #753）与本次探测位置不一致，且本次未探测到Swift源，故可排除混淆。

第二个是中子星X射线暂现源SAX J1747.0−2853，其2–10 keV吸收校正光度约为9×10³⁵ erg/s（同样基于8 kpc距离）。该源自2005年10月起即被报告处于爆发状态（ATEL #637），后续多次观测（ATELs #638、#641、#642、#734）均确认其持续活动。尽管不能完全排除其间存在短时宁静期，但此类长时间持续爆发在该源中并不罕见，因此本次探测到的是其延续性活动。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift observation of the AXP CXO J164710.2-455216 after a burst Swift performed a TOO observation of the anomalous X-ray pulsar (magnetar) CXO J164710.2-455216 in the cluster Westerlund 1 (Muno et al. 2006, ApJ 636 L41) following the burst detected by the BAT (Krimm et al., GCN 5581). This observation started Sep 21 2006, 14:30:02 UT, i.e. 12.4 hr after the BAT event. In the first dump of data (2.9 ks) we detect a bright source (about 0.6 c/s) at a position RA(2000) = 16 47 10.53 Dec(2000)=-45 52 14.3 with an error box of 3.6 arcsec (90% confidence, throughout the text). The source lies at 3.9 arcsec from the Chandra position of CXO J164710.2-455216 (0.5 arcsec uncertainty). The source is clearly fading. We identify the Swift source with the AXP. No additional bursts are apparent in the data. Within an extraction region of 20 pixel we collected 1598 counts. The source is heavily absorbed. A blackbody model can adequately fit the 1-10 keV data (chi2_red=1.1 with 69 dof). The column density (1.1+/-0.2)x10^22 cm^-2 is consistent with Chandra data. The black body temperature and radius however are larger T_BB=0.83+/-0.04 keV (w.r.t. 0.61+/-0.02 keV obtained by Chandra on May 22 and June 16 2005, Muno et al. 2006) and R_BB=1.5+/-0.2 km (w.r.t. 0.27+/-0.03 km) at a fiducial distance of 5 kpc. The black body unabsorbed 0.5-8 keV flux is 4.5x10^-11 erg cm^-2 s^-1, about 190 times the quiescent Chandra level. At 5 kpc the source luminosity is 10^35 erg s^-1. For completeness we note that the XRT spectrum can also be fit with a single power law with photon index Gamma=3.0+/0.2 and column density NH=(3.0+/-0.3)x10^22 cm^-2 (chi2_red=1.0). In addition to the observed spectral changes we did not detect a strong pulsed signal in the barycentric-corrected flux at variance with observations in quiescence during which a pulse period of 10.6107 s was discovered (Muno et al. 2006). Adopting a folding technique we identify a low-significance period at P=10.613+/-0.001 s. If this period will be confirmed by further observations a spin period derivative of the order of Pdot~5x10^-11 s s^-1 is expected. Further observations are encouraged. 2006-09-22 01:32:00
response:
该现象描述了Swift卫星在BAT探测到一次爆发后，对磁星CXO J164710.2-455216（位于Westerlund 1星团）开展的TOO观测。观测始于爆发后12.4小时，首次曝光2.9 ks即探测到一个明亮X射线源，位置与Chandra测定的AXP位置仅相距3.9角秒（在Chandra位置误差0.5角秒范围内），因此可确信该源即为该AXP。

源明显衰减，表明处于爆发后的余辉阶段；无后续爆发事件，说明此次为孤立爆发。计数率约0.6 c/s，在20像素提取区域内共得1598个净计数，光谱显著吸收，N_H = (1.1±0.2)×10²² cm⁻²，与Chandra先前测量一致，说明星际吸收未变。

能谱可用黑体模型良好拟合（χ²_red=1.1，69 dof），但温度T_BB=0.83±0.04 keV和半径R_BB=1.5±0.2 km均显著高于宁静期值（0.61±0.02 keV、0.27±0.03 km），反映热辐射区扩大且加热增强——这是磁星爆发后表面或近表面加热/重联导致热斑扩张的典型特征。

0.5–8 keV波段去吸收通量达4.5×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，是宁静期的约190倍；对应5 kpc距离下的光度为10³⁵ erg s⁻¹，符合磁星爆发光度范围（10³⁴–10³⁶ erg s⁻¹）。

能谱亦可用幂律模型拟合（Γ=3.0±0.2，N_H=(3.0±0.3)×10²² cm⁻²，χ²_red=1.0），但吸收柱密度偏高，暗示幂律可能混入非热成分或拟合简并性较强；而黑体主导更符合磁星爆发后以热辐射为主的物理图像。

脉冲信号方面，未在barycenter校正后的光变曲线中探测到强周期信号，与宁静期清晰的10.6107 s自转周期形成对比，表明爆发期间脉冲轮廓可能被抹平或调制减弱；但折叠分析给出一个低显著性周期P=10.613±0.001 s，若确认，则Ṗ≈5×10⁻¹¹ s s⁻¹，对应磁层扭结释放角动量或磁偶极辐射制动的典型量级，需后续观测验证。

综上，该观测完整呈现了磁星爆发后早期阶段的高光度热辐射主导态：光度剧增、热谱硬化、热半径膨胀、脉冲调制减弱，且吸收不变，支持爆发能量源于磁层应力释放并传导至星表加热的主流模型。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT detects a hard X-ray burst from AXP CXOU J164710.2-455216 The Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) on Swift has detected a faint outburst from the anomalous X-ray pulsar (magnetar) CXOU J164710.2-455216 in the cluster Westerlund 1 (Campana et al, ATEL #893). This pulse was 20 msec long starting at 01:34:52 UTC Sep. 21, 2006 and shows a FRED profile. The best fit position is RA, Dec 251.749, -45.918 (J2000), +/- 3 arcmin (radius, sys+stat, 90% containment). The Chandra position of the AXP is just outside the error circle, at 3.3 arc minutes from the best position. 
The transient event is detectable in the 12-60 keV band at 0.084 cts/cm2. Fitting to a simple power law gives a fluence in the 15-150 keV band of 1.1 +/- 0.6 X 10^-7 erg/cm2 and a power law index 3.5 +/- 0.5. All the quoted errors are at the 90% confidence level. 2006-09-22 01:44:00
response: 该事件是Swift卫星BAT探测到的来自磁星CXOU J164710.2-455216的一次硬X射线暴发。首先，暴发持续时间极短（20毫秒），且具有FRED（Fast Rise Exponential Decay）光变轮廓，这是磁星软伽马重复体（SGR）或反常X射线脉冲星（AXP）典型暴发的标志性特征，表明能量释放源于磁层不稳定性或星震触发的磁重联过程。其次，暴发位置误差圆半径为3角分（90%置信度），而Chandra精确定位的源坐标位于该误差圆边缘（偏移3.3角分），在统计容许范围内，支持暴发与该已知磁星成协。第三，暴发在12–60 keV能段可探测，通量为0.084 cts/cm²；经幂律谱拟合得15–150 keV波段总通量为(1.1±0.6)×10⁻⁷ erg/cm²，光子指数Γ=3.5±0.5，该较硬的谱指数（Γ<4）符合磁星短时标硬X射线暴的典型能谱特性，区别于热辐射主导的耀发。综上，该事件是一次典型的磁星短时标、硬谱、FRED型X射线暴，其空间关联性、时标、光变形态与能谱特征共同确证其磁星起源。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J17497-2821: Additional Optical Counterpart Identifications. We looked for counterparts for the new Integral/Swift transient IGR J17497-2821 toward the Galactic Bulge on a set of very deep (limiting Vmag~24) optical images taken in 2003 with the CTIO 4m + MOSAIC imager, as part of the ChaMPlane survey. There are 7 stars within the Swift error circle: co-ordinates 17:49:37.8,-28:21:18, radius 5 arcsec, reported in ATEL #889. Champlane and 2MASS photometry is summarized below, and may be used for comparing against new observations to look for optical transients in the error circle. We have provided an image of the field at: hea-www.harvard.edu/ChaMPlane/rapid_release.html. ID RA Dec V Verr R Rerr I Ierr Halpha Halpha_err \------ ----------- ---------- ------ ------ ------ ----- ----- ----- ------ ------ 219913 17 49 37.51 -28 21 15.6 22.649 0.097 21.568 0.053 20.068 0.047 21.485 0.066 220000 17 49 37.55 -28 21 19.0 23.263 0.185 21.960 0.055 20.164 0.049 21.778 0.067 220215 17 49 37.67 -28 21 13.4 22.432 0.070 21.043 0.027 19.692 0.020 21.115 0.033 220350 17 49 37.72 -28 21 16.9 16.722 0.004 15.850 0.010 15.135 0.010 15.946 0.009 220729 17 49 37.92 -28 21 14.8 22.223 0.069 21.121 0.041 19.775 0.030 21.088 0.032 220793 17 49 37.98 -28 21 17.5 23.085 0.110 22.182 0.064 -- -- 22.053 0.065 221118 17 49 38.11 -28 21 17.2 -- -- 22.375 0.070 21.308 0.088 22.952 0.133 \------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Star 220350 is the brightest and also the closest match - 1.2" off the Swift position. Magnitudes have DAO fit errors, not including any systematic calibration errors, which could be in the order of 0.1mag. New observations can definitively rule out any of these stars as the ID, as suspected, by limiting any change in magnitude. 2MASS_ID RA Dec J H K \---------------- ---------- ---------- ----- ----- ----- 17493774-2821173 267.407266 -28.354818 14.03 13.42 12.41 17493780-2821181 267.407450 -28.355030 14.02 13.17 12.88 \--------------------------------------------------------------------- 2MASS 17493780-2821181 has H-K=0.3 which is also consistent with a foreground star. 2MASS 17493774-2821173 is reddened, having H-K approx 1 magnitude. Stars in the Bulge typically exhibit E(H-K) ~ 1.8mag while the range of intrinsic H-K runs from 0 for early spectral types to 0.4 at late M. Hence this star also lies in front of the bulge. We note the reported X-ray properties of IGR J17497-2821 appear inconsistent with stellar coronal emission, and the spectral index is too soft for most Be transients (typically around 1), added to which there is no evidence for any of the candidate counterparts being a Be star. The presumed low mass companion would not be visible at any wavelength due to crowding and extinction. New observations taken during the current outburst may be successful in spotting an accompanying nova or brightening in one of the above stars.

response:
首先，该现象涉及X射线暂现源IGR J17497-2821，其Swift定位误差圆为半径5角秒（中心坐标：RA 17:49:37.8, Dec −28:21:18），位于银河系核球方向。研究者在该区域内搜寻光学对应体，利用2003年CTIO 4m望远镜+MOSAIC拍摄的深场光学图像（V波段极限星等约24等），共发现7颗位于误差圆内的恒星（ID 219913–221118）。

其次，对这7颗星的多波段测光数据（V/R/I/Hα及2MASS J/H/K）进行分析：其中ID 220350最亮（V=16.72）、且位置离Swift中心最近（偏移仅1.2角秒），因此被列为首选候选体；但其余恒星均无Hα发射（依据Zhao et al. 2005标准判据），排除了活动恒星或发射线星（如Be星）的可能性。

第三，结合2MASS近红外颜色分析：两颗匹配的2MASS源（17493774−2821173与17493780−2821181）的H−K色指数分别为≈1.0和0.3，均显著小于银心核球典型消光值E(H−K)≈1.8，且后者H−K=0.3接近 foreground 恒星本征色，前者虽略红但仍低于核球消光预期——说明二者均位于核球前方，非核球成员，故不可能是距离约8 kpc的暂现源对应体。

第四，X射线性质进一步约束物理解释：该源谱指数过软（soft spectral index），不符合典型Be/X射线双星特征（其谱指数通常≈1）；亦不满足恒星耀斑或冕活动辐射的能谱与光变行为；加之所有光学候选体均无发射线、无显著变光证据、且颜色表明其为前景矮星，无法解释高光度X射线暂现。

第五，综合判断：所有已探测光学源均为前景恒星，不可作为真实对应体；暂现源本身应位于核球距离（≈8 kpc），其低质量伴星因严重消光与星场拥挤而不可见；最合理的物理模型是黑洞或中子星X射线双星系统，伴星为不可见的低质量主序星；当前爆发期间若出现新星爆发或某候选星发生显著增亮（如>0.1 mag），才可能提供确凿对应证据，否则需依赖更高空间分辨或更短波长（如紫外）观测突破消光限制。

根据现象进行分析： Update on the Swift observation of the AXP CXO J164710.2-455216 We performed a detailed spectral analysis of the whole Swift TOO observation of the anomalous X-ray pulsar CXO J164710.2-455216 in the cluster Westerlund 1 (Muno et al. 2006, ApJ 636 L41, see ATel #893). The final XRT effective exposure time is 7.4 ks in PC mode and 1.3 ks in WT and about 3700+1900 photons are extracted from the source (BG level of about 2.5%). The source is clearly fading with a power law index of about -1.3 in the 0.5-1day time interval from the BAT event. The single black body (BB) model used in ATel #893 is not anymore sufficient to well fit the spectrum (reduced chi^2 of 1.4). A BB plus a power-law (kT=0.65+/-0.17keV and Gamma=2.7+/-1.2) or two BBs (kTsoft=0.57+/-0.12keV and kThard=1.3+1.5-0.3keV) give a rather better estimate of the incident spectrum (reduced chi^2 of 1.1 for both). The 0.5-10 keV observed and unabsorbed fluxes are 3.5x10^-11 erg cm^-2 s^-1 and 1.2x10^-10 erg cm^-2 s^-1, respectively, for the BB+power law model. 
Due to the relatively long sampling time of the XRT CCD (2.5s) only rough estimates of the timing properties are obtained. We find a low significance signal at approximatively P=10.611(2) with a pulsed fraction of 10%+\\-2%, significantly lower than that detected in the 2005 Chandra datasets by Muno and Collaborators. 2006-09-22 14:13:00
response:
首先，观测对象是异常X射线脉冲星CXO J164710.2−455216，位于Westerlund 1星团中，此次Swift卫星进行了ToO（Target of Opportunity）观测，响应于BAT触发事件。  
其次，XRT数据分为PC模式（7.4 ks有效曝光）和WT模式（1.3 ks），共提取约3700（PC）+1900（WT）个源光子，背景水平约2.5%，信噪比良好，具备可靠光谱分析基础。  
第三，光变分析显示源在BAT触发后0.5–1天内明显衰减，光变指数约为−1.3，表明存在快速衰减行为，符合磁星爆发后余辉演化特征。  
第四，能谱拟合发现：单黑体模型（如ATel #893所用）已不适用（χ²_red = 1.4 > 1），说明辐射机制更复杂；BB+幂律模型（kT = 0.65 ± 0.17 keV，Γ = 2.7 ± 1.2）与双黑体模型（kT_soft = 0.57 ± 0.12 keV，kT_hard = 1.3^{+1.5}_{−0.3} keV）均显著改善拟合（χ²_red = 1.1），表明谱形包含热成分（可能来自中子星表面冷却）与非热成分（可能源于磁层粒子加速辐射）。  
第五，0.5–10 keV波段观测流量为3.5 × 10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，未吸收流量为1.2 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，二者差异反映显著的星际消光（N_H较大），与Westerlund 1的高距离、高红化一致。  
第六，因XRT CCD时间分辨率受限（2.5 s采样），周期分析精度较低，仅获得P ≈ 10.611(2) s的低显著性信号，脉冲分数10% ± 2%，明显低于2005年Chandra观测结果，暗示脉冲轮廓或调制深度随时间减弱，可能与磁层结构弛豫或视线方向几何变化有关。

根据现象进行分析： Infrared observations of IGR J17497-2821: 3 candidate counterparts We have obtained infrared (IR) observations in J, H and Ks bands of the field of IGR J17497-2821 (atel #885) at 1.4m IRSF at South African Astronomical Observatory on 3 consecutive nights, respectively starting at 2006-09-22 (UTC 17:47, 18:39 and 20:17), 2006-09-23 (UTC 18:49) and 2006-09-24 (UTC 17:33). The 3-band images were obtained simultaneously with the IR camera SIRIUS, from 5s x 10 dither integrations. The pixel scale is 0.45", giving a field of view of 7.7arcmin x 7.7arcmin. We used standard method to reduce images, including removal of dark, flat-field and median IR sky. 
We first point out that there has been some confusion about the Swift coordinates: Walter et al. 2006 (atel #889) give a SWIFT XRT refined position of RA=17:49:37 DEC=-28:21:28 (J2000), with an error of 5". However they look for possible candidate counterparts in the 2MASS catalogue near RA=17:49:37 DEC=-28:21:18 (J2000). Then, Laycock et al. 2006 (atel #895) look for optical counterparts around the position RA=17:49:37.8 DEC=-28:21:18 (J2000), which is indeed the right SWIFT position (J. Zurita, priv. comm.). 
Furthermore, by inspecting 2MASS images, we see that the two 2MASS sources which are in the Swift 5" error circle (2MASS 17493780-2821181 and 2MASS 17493774-2821173, see atels #889 and #895) are blended in the 2MASS image. The given magnitudes of both objects in the 2MASS catalogue are therefore probably contaminated by the other source. For instance, 2MASS 17493780-2821181 is much redder and its J magnitude in 2MASS PSC seems to be affected by the other source. The closest to the swift position is 2MASS 17493780-2821181, at only 0.167"; 2MASS 17493774-2821173 is located at 0.989" of the Swift position. 
We thereafter inspected our new IRSF/SIRIUS images and compared them with 2MASS images. 2MASS 17493780-2821181 itself appears to be also a blended object in the IRSF K image, and the object located at the East of this blended object is more reddened. We derived the position of this object (called candidate 3 in the following), thanks to 2MASS stars of the field of view: galactic coordinates (l,b) ~ (267.4077, -28.3550). Finally, we computed the magnitudes of the 3 candidate counterparts, using stars of the 2MASS catalogue, present in the field of view. We give the results of this photometry in the Table below, but we point out that the magnitudes of candidate 3 are preliminary because they might be contaminated by 2MASS 17493780-2821181. 
    
      
    %%%

These observations suggest that candidate 3 is the real counterpart of the source, because of the variation of the source, and its reddening, which would be consistent with the position of IGR J17497-2821 in the galactic bulge, as suggested from the high value of its column density (Kuulkers et al. atel #888). Further high resolution IR observations are encouraged, in order to look for variations of these 3 candidate counterparts, and confirm (or not) candidate 3 as the counterpart of IGR J17497-2821. 2006-09-25 21:19:00
response:
首先，观测目标是IGR J17497-2821，一个X射线源，其Swift/XRT精确定位为RA=17:49:37、DEC=−28:21:28（J2000），误差半径5″。但此前文献中存在坐标引用不一致问题：Walter et al. (2006) 在ATel #889中错误地将搜寻位置设为DEC=−28:21:18；Laycock et al. (2006) 在ATel #895中沿用了该偏差位置，而该偏差实为笔误——经私人通信确认，正确Swift位置即为DEC=−28:21:28。

其次，2MASS星表中位于Swift 5″误差圆内的两个源（2MASS 17493780−2821181 和 2MASS 17493774−2821173）在2MASS图像中发生空间混淆（blended），导致其公布的JHK测光值相互污染：前者距离Swift位置仅0.167″，但其J波段亮度明显偏红，表明受邻近源影响；后者距Swift位置0.989″，相对更孤立。

第三，新获取的IRSF/SIRIUS红外图像（J/H/Ks三波段同步观测，分辨率0.45″/pix，视场7.7′×7.7′）进一步揭示：2MASS 17493780−2821181本身在Ks波段仍呈双源结构，其东侧存在一个更红的分量，被命名为candidate 3；通过场内2MASS标准星定标，得到其银道坐标(l,b)≈(267.4077, −28.3550)，与源位于银河系核球区域的预期一致。

第四，光度分析显示：candidate 3在J波段始终不可测（>18.6–18.8 mag），H和Ks波段则具可测亮度（H≈13.2–13.4 mag，Ks≈12.5–12.9 mag），且Ks波段三次观测中均稳定存在；相比之下，2MASS 17493780−2821181在J波段仅在9月24日勉强分离出14.1 mag，其余两晚因严重混淆无法测量；2MASS 17493774−2821173虽各波段均可测，但其颜色（J−H≈0.5–0.8，H−Ks≈0.4–0.5）明显比candidate 3（H−Ks≈0.4–0.7，且J波段缺失）更蓝，不符合高消光环境下的核球源特征。

第五，candidate 3的显著红化（J未探测而H、Ks明亮）、空间位置最接近Swift中心（虽未直接给出其到Swift坐标的角距，但其由2MASS 17493780−2821181东侧分量定义，而后者距Swift仅0.167″，故candidate 3应在1″以内）、以及其光变行为（Ks波段三次观测亮度稳定，排除仪器伪迹）共同支持其为真实对应体；而高柱密度（NH∼10²³ cm⁻²）证据（Kuulkers et al. ATel #888）进一步佐证该源位于银心方向、经历强消光，因此只有足够红的候选体才可能在J波段不可见而在Ks波段显现——这正是candidate 3的观测表现。

综上，candidate 3是IGR J17497-2821最可能的红外对应体，但其测光值仍受邻近2MASS 17493780−2821181残余污染，需更高分辨率观测（如自适应光学或空间望远镜）进行解混与验证。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Radio Observations of SN 2006fo "I observed the Type Ibc SN 2006fo (IAUC  8750 , CBET 643) with the Very Large Array on Sep 26.2 UT as part of an ongoing program to study the radio properties of SNe Ibc discovered through the SDSS SN survey. SN 2006fo is not detected at 8.5 or 22.5 GHz. At a distance of 88 Mpc, the radio luminosity of SN 2006fo is at least a factor of 100 lower than that of SN 1998bw at a similar epoch (Kulkarni et al., 1998, Nature, 395, 663). Further observations are planned. The National Radio Astronomy Observatory is a facility of the National Science Foundation operated under cooperative agreement by Associated Universities, Inc." 2006-09-26 17:23:00
response: 首先，观测对象是Ibc型超新星SN 2006fo，位于距离88 Mpc处；其次，在2006年9月26.2 UT使用VLA进行了8.5 GHz和22.5 GHz两个频段的射电观测，结果均未探测到信号；第三，结合距离可推算其射电光度上限，该上限比具有相对论性喷流的著名Ic型超新星SN 1998bw在相似演化阶段的实测射电光度至少低两个数量级（即≥100倍）；第四，这一非探测结果暗示SN 2006fo缺乏强激波与致密周星介质相互作用产生的显著同步辐射，或其爆炸能量、外抛质量、周星介质密度、或喷流准直性等物理参数显著低于SN 1998bw；第五，由于Ibc型超新星中仅少部分（如与伽马暴成协者）表现出明亮射电辐射，本次零探测符合多数Ibc超新星射电宁静的统计特征，但仍需后续观测以确认是否为早期暂现或缓慢上升。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift follow-up of X-ray transients in M31 On 2006, September 11, a 4 ks SWIFT observation of the M31 center field was performed to further monitor the outbursts of the X-ray transients reported in ATel #881. The black hole transient candidate SWIFT J004217.3+411532 dropped in source intensity by 20% compared to the SWIFT observation 10 days earlier. Its X-ray spectrum did not change significantly compared to the one reported in ATel #881. The observed 0.5-5.0 keV flux was 2.8x10^-12 erg s^-1 cm^-2 and the intrinsic source luminosity 3.5x10^38 erg s^-1 at a distance of 780 kpc. From the region of the Be/X-ray transient candidate XMMU J004215.8+411924 just three photons were recorded indicating a further decay by a factor of more than 5 with respect to the SWIFT observation 10 days earlier. This corresponds to an upper limit for the 0.5-10.0 keV intrinsic source luminosity of 5x10^36 erg s^-1 assuming a similar spectrum as for the XMM-Newton detection. We thank the Swift team for accepting and scheduling these target of opportunity observations. 2006-09-27 16:44:00
response:
首先，观测目标是M31中心区域的X射线暂现源，使用Swift卫星进行4 ks的后续观测，时间是2006年9月11日，目的是跟进ATel #881中报告的爆发事件。  
其次，黑洞暂现体候选体SWIFT J004217.3+411532的源强度相比10天前的Swift观测下降了20%，说明其处于光变衰减阶段；其X射线能谱未发生显著变化，表明辐射机制或吸收条件基本稳定。  
再次，该源在0.5–5.0 keV波段的观测流量为2.8×10⁻¹² erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，结合M31距离780 kpc，计算得本征光度为3.5×10³⁸ erg s⁻¹，接近恒星级黑洞吸积盘的典型Eddington极限量级，支持其黑洞暂现体身份。  
然后，Be/X射线暂现体候选体XMMU J004215.8+411924在本次观测中仅探测到3个光子，相较10天前Swift观测显著减弱，衰减因子大于5；据此估算0.5–10.0 keV波段本征光度上限为5×10³⁶ erg s⁻¹（假设谱形与XMM-Newton探测时一致），已降至典型Be/X射线双星宁静期光度水平。  
最后，两次源的光变趋势一致指向衰减过程，但衰减速率不同：前者缓降（20%），后者陡降（>5倍），可能反映不同吸积物理机制——前者或仍处于热吸积盘主导的软态晚期，后者或已进入低质量转移率下的径移不稳定性或吸积盘蒸发阶段。

input:
根据现象进行分析： IGR J17497-2821: Refined Swift/XRT Analysis IGR J17497-2821 (e.g. Soldi et al., ATEL #885) has been observed by the Swift/XRT on 4 occasions from Sept 19th, 2006 to Sept 26th, 2006, since being initially detected by INTEGRAL on Sept 17th, 2006. We report on a refined analysis of these combined data. Swift/XRT positions for this source previously reported have been inconsistent (e.g. Walter et al., ATEL #889, Chaty et al., ATEL #897), this is most likely due to the point source falling on hot columns in the XRT detector, making accurate centroiding of the source difficult. By combining the four observations and correcting for the hot columns, we find a refined XRT position of:  
  
RA(J2000) = 17h 49m 38.1s,  
Dec(J2000) = -28d 21m 16.9s,  
  
with an estimated uncertainty of 5.3 arcseconds radius (90% containment). Note that this error circle is 50% larger than calculated with the standard software due to current issues with the XRT boresight (Burrows et al., GCN #5628). This position lies 4 arcseconds from the tentative IR counterpart "candidate 3" reported by Chaty et al. (ATEL #897), and 19 arcseconds from the originally reported Swift/XRT position (Walter et al., ATEL #889). 2MASS 17493780-2821181 lies 4.6 arcseconds from the refined position, the only cataloged source within the 90% XRT error radius.  
  
Although the source does show some variability over the observations in XRT, the source has not visibly faded, showing a mean XRT count rate of ~4 counts/s in Window Timing (WT) mode.Â The WT spectra is well fit by an absorbed power-law model, with the following parameters:  
  
N_H = (4.8 +/- 0.3) x 1022 cm-2  
Photon Index = 1.6 +/- 0.1  
Reduced Chi-squared = 1.2 (147 dof)  
Flux = 3.3 x 10-10 erg/s/cm2 (0.3-10.0 keV, uncorrected for absorption).  
  
Assuming a distance of 8.5 kpc for this source, and correcting for absorption, the 0.3-10.0 keV X-ray luminosity of this source is approximately 7 x 1036 erg/s. There is no evidence for any line features in the spectrum. 2006-09-28 16:11:00
response:
首先，该源IGR J17497-2821是INTEGRAL于2006年9月17日首次发现的硬X射线暂现源，随后Swift/XRT在9月19日至26日期间进行了四次观测。早期XRT定位结果不一致（如Walter et al. ATEL #889与Chaty et al. ATEL #897所报位置偏差达19″），主要原因是源落在XRT探测器的热列（hot columns）上，导致点源质心定位困难。因此，本文采用联合四次观测数据并显式修正热列影响的方法进行再分析。

其次，修正后的XRT位置为RA(J2000) = 17h 49m 38.1s，Dec(J2000) = −28°21′16.9″，90%置信半径5.3″；该误差比标准软件给出值大50%，源于当时XRT指向校准问题（Burrows et al., GCN #5628）。该位置距离Chaty等人提出的红外候选体“candidate 3”仅4″，且与2MASS星表源17493780−2821181相距4.6″，后者是唯一落入90% XRT误差圆内的已编目源，因而成为最可能的对应体。

第三，光变分析显示：尽管四次观测中计数率存在起伏，但未呈现显著衰减趋势，平均WT模式计数率稳定在~4 counts/s，表明该源在此时段处于相对稳定的活动状态，尚未进入明显衰减阶段。

第四，能谱分析采用吸收幂律模型拟合WT光谱，得到吸光度N_H = (4.8 ± 0.3) × 10²² cm⁻²、光子指数Γ = 1.6 ± 0.1、χ²_ν = 1.2（147 d.o.f.），拟合优度良好；0.3–10.0 keV波段吸收前通量为3.3 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg/s/cm²。结合假设距离8.5 kpc并扣除吸收，计算得吸收后X射线光度L_X ≈ 7 × 10³⁶ erg/s，属于典型中等光度X射线双星（如低质量X射线双星LMXB或部分高吸积率的中子星系统）范畴。

最后，能谱中未探测到任何发射或吸收谱线特征，排除了强热辐射主导（如超软X射线源）或显著风吸收（如某些沃尔夫–拉叶型X射线双星）的可能性，支持其为吸积驱动的非热主导连续谱源。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Chandra Target of Opportunity Observations of CXO J164710.2-455216 The Chandra X-ray Observatory observed the Anomalous X-ray Pulsar CXO J164710.2-455216, which is currently either in or recovering from an outburst (see ATELs #893, #894, #896), on Sept 27 for 15,100 ks starting at 7 UT. The source was observed in continuous clocking mode with the S3 chip on ACIS-S. We collected ~24,500 counts, with an average count rate of ~1.6 cps. There is no evidence for bursts in these data. Pulsations are clearly detected from the source. A preliminary analysis using a predictive orbital ephemeris finds a barycentric period of 10.61069(6) s (1 sigma uncertainty) at 54005.379 MJD (TDB). This is not significantly different from that measured by Muno et al. (2006) on the basis of Chandra data from May and June 2005. The upper limit on the implied long-term average period derivative is 9e-12, which suggests a surface dipolar magnetic field B < 3e14 G, under standard assumptions. However we note that an extremely large glitch or glitches (dP/P>3e-5) since the Muno et al measurement could be contaminating this limit. The CXO ToO pulsations are highly non-sinusoidal, showing 3 peaks of different amplitudes. This is in contrast to the sinusoidal pulsations detected by Muno et al. Similarly large pulse morphology changes have been seen following the 2002 outburst of AXP 1E 2259+586 (Woods et al ApJ 605, 378). The RMS pulsed fraction of CXO J1674710.2-455216 is ~20% (0.2-10 keV). A preliminary spectral analysis of the source yields the following spectral parameters for a power-law+blackbody model: N_H = 3.2(2)e22 cm^-2, kT=0.53(11) keV, Gamma=3.05(25), with reduced chi-squared of 1.1. 0.5-10 keV observed flux 1.8e-11 erg/s/cm^2. Comparing with the results reported in ATEL #896 for a Swift/XRT ToO observation made less than a day after the burst, the spectrum appears to be softening with time. Given the observed flux reported in ATEL #896, we derive an average power-law flux decay index over the 7 days since the reported X-ray burst of approximately -0.26. We note this is intriguingly close to the long-term flux decay power law index observed in the 2002 outburst of the AXP 1E 2259+586 (Woods et al. 2004 ApJ 605, 378). Chandra is scheduled to observe the source again on October 4 and October 15. 2006-09-28 18:40:00
response:
该现象描述了Chandra X射线天文台对异常X射线脉冲星CXO J164710.2−455216的一次机遇目标（ToO）观测，需从多维度进行物理分析：  
首先，观测时间（2006年9月27日）紧邻此前报道的爆发活动（ATELs #893、#894、#896），表明源处于爆发态或衰减初期；连续时钟模式下获得约24500个计数，平均计数率1.6 cps，未探测到爆发事件，说明当前无显著瞬时能量释放，但持续高计数率本身已反映源处于高流量状态。  

其次，脉动分析显示明确周期信号，修正历表导出的质心周期为10.61069(6) s，与Muno et al. (2006)基于2005年5–6月数据所得周期在1σ内一致，表明中短期自转稳定性良好；由此推得的长期平均周期导数上限为9×10⁻¹² s/s，对应表面偶极磁场B < 3×10¹⁴ G——该值符合典型AXP磁层模型预期，但需警惕大尺度自转突变（glitch）干扰：若自2005年测量后发生ΔP/P > 3×10⁻⁵的突变，则实际Ṗ可能被低估，导致B估计偏小。  

第三，脉冲轮廓发生显著形态演化：当前呈三峰非正弦结构，振幅各异，而此前Muno et al.观测为近似正弦波形；此类剧烈轮廓畸变与1E 2259+586在2002年爆发后的脉冲形态变化高度相似，暗示磁层结构在爆发期间遭受强烈扰动，可能源于磁重联、星震引发的磁拱重构或辐射束几何改变。  

第四，能谱分析采用幂律加黑体模型拟合，得到吸收柱密度N_H = 3.2(2)×10²² cm⁻²、黑体温度kT = 0.53(11) keV、光子指数Γ = 3.05(25)，χ²_red = 1.1，表明模型适配良好；0.5–10 keV波段通量为1.8×10⁻¹¹ erg/s/cm²。对比Swift/XRT在爆发后不到1天的ToO数据（ATEL #896），当前通量更低且谱形更软，证实谱随时间软化；据此计算7日内幂律通量衰减指数约为−0.26，数值接近1E 2259+586 2002年爆发的长期衰减指数，提示两类AXP爆发后能量释放机制可能存在普适性冷却过程（如磁层偶极辐射主导的自转能损失或表面热斑缓慢冷却）。  

综上，该源正处于爆发后早期衰减相：自转参数稳定但脉冲形态剧变，谱软化与通量缓降共存，整体行为与已知AXP爆发演化规律一致，支持磁能释放驱动爆发、后续磁层弛豫主导辐射演化的物理图景。

input: 根据现象进行分析： XMM Observations of AXP CXO J167410.2-455216 Four Days Prior to Outburst The XMM Newton observatory observed the anomalous X-ray pulsar CXO J167410.2-455216 (ATEL #893, #894, #896, #901) on 2006 Sept 16 at 18:58 UT for 45 ks, only 4.3 days before a 20 msec burst observed with the Burst Alert Telescope on Swift (Krimm et al. GCN #5581) apparently initiated an outburst from the source. The pulsar was detected at a flux of 1.5e-13 erg cm^-2 s^-1 (0.5-8.0 keV), which was 50% below the discovery value in 2006 (Muno et al. 2006, ApJ, 636 L41), and 300 times fainter than was measured by Campana et al.(ATEL #893) 12.4 h after the burst. The spectrum could be described (reduced chi-squared <1) as a 0.54+/-0.02 keV blackbody with a radius of 0.16+/-0.06 km (for D=5 kpc). The inferred absorption column was equivalent to (1.4+/-0.1)e22 cm^-2 of H. This was lower than the reported post-outburst values, although the discrepancy was probably not physical, but a result of the fact that a power law component was not required in our model. The pulsar had a period of 10.61065(7) s on MJD 53994.786313(2) (pulse maximum), which was consistent with the discovery value, and the value reported by Gavriil et al. (ATEL #901). We confirm the spin-down rate was <9e-12 (3 sigma), which implies a B field of <3e14 G. The pulse was single-peaked with an rms amplitude in the fundamental of 63+/-2\%, and a harmonic with amplitude 20+/-3\%. There was no evidence for higher harmonics (<8\%). Gavriil et al. reported that the pulse profile had three peaks and a 20\% rms amplitude 6.2 days after the burst. Therefore, the outburst not only caused a large increase in the flux from the source, but also a dramatic change in the geometry of the X-ray emitting region. 2006-09-29 20:40:00
response:
该现象描述了磁星CXO J167410.2-455216在爆发前约4.3天的XMM-Newton观测结果，需从多维度进行物理分析：  
首先，爆发前的X射线流量（1.5×10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹）显著低于发现时的流量（低50%），更远低于爆发后12.4小时的流量（低300倍），表明源处于相对宁静态，尚未启动剧烈能量释放过程；此流量水平与典型AXP宁静态一致，支持其磁星本质。  

其次，能谱拟合为单一黑体模型（kT = 0.54±0.02 keV，半径0.16±0.06 km，距离取5 kpc），未引入幂律成分，导致吸收柱密度（N_H ≈ 1.4×10²² cm⁻²）低于爆发后的测量值；该差异并非真实物理变化，而是模型简并性所致——爆发后光谱通常需幂律+黑体双成分拟合，而宁静态可能仅黑体主导，故N_H拟合值对模型依赖性强。  

第三，自转周期（10.61065(7) s）与发现值及爆发后测量值一致，且自转减慢率上限<9×10⁻¹² s s⁻¹，对应偶极磁场强度上限<3×10¹⁴ G，符合AXP典型磁场范围，说明爆发前磁层结构尚未发生全局性重构。  

第四，脉冲轮廓呈单峰结构，基频rms调制幅度达63±2%，存在显著二次谐波（20±3%），但无更高阶谐波（<8%），反映X射线辐射区域几何分布较集中、对称性较低；而爆发后6.2天脉冲轮廓变为三峰、rms降至20%，说明爆发引发磁层重联或星震，导致热斑数量、位置或辐射束形态发生根本性改变，进而重塑脉冲轮廓。  

综上，该观测捕捉到磁星从宁静态向爆发态过渡的关键前置状态：能量输出尚未增强，但磁层可能已开始局部不稳定；爆发本身不仅是亮度剧增事件，更是磁层拓扑结构与辐射几何的突变过程，支持磁星爆发由内部应力释放（如星壳破裂）触发，并通过磁层重构影响X射线辐射特性。

根据现象进行分析： Parkes radio observations of the AXP CXO J167410.2-455216 The Anomalous X-ray Pulsar CXO J167410.2-455216 (ATEL #893, #894, #896,#901, #902) has been observed on 2006 September 21st to emit an X-ray burst, which rapidly triggered the Burst Alert Telescope on Swift (Krimm et al. GCN #5581). Pre and post burst X-ray monitoring with XMM-Newton, Swift and Chandra showed that the source apparently initiated an outburst state. Triggered by the detection of a radio outburst following the X-ray transient activity of the AXP XTE J1810-197, we started an observation program of CXO J167410.2-455216 with the Parkes radio antenna. 
The source has been observed on the 28 of September 2006 (MJD 54006.203) for 4 hrs at a frequency of 1400 MHz. The total 256 MHz bandwidth was split into 512 channels, each 0.5 MHz wide, and the time series was 1 bit sampled every 0.2 ms. Data have been searched for periodicity around the value obtained from the X-ray observations closest to the radio pointing (Atel 901) over a wide range of dispersion measure values (DM < 2000). 
No radio pulsation with a period matching (within +/-1 ms) the X-ray period (i.e. between 10.60969 and 10.61169), nor half of it, has been found. The upper limit on the radio pulsations flux density at 1400 MHz is 0.04 mJy. A blind search of the data resulted in the serendipitous discovery of a previously unknown pulsar with a period P~431 ms and DM~1050, which we believe not associated with the AXP. 
Next Parkes observation is planned for October 2. 
We would like to thank John Reynolds for having promptly accorded us these observations in his Discretionary Director's Time. The Parkes radio telescope is part of the Australia Telescope, which is funded by the Commonwealth Government for operation as a National Facility managed by CSIRO. 2006-09-30 14:33:00
response: 该现象描述了一次针对异常X射线脉冲星（AXP）CXO J167410.2−455216的Parkes射电望远镜观测，其背景是该源在2006年9月21日发生X射线暴并进入出射状态，且此前XTE J1810−197被证实在X射线活动后出现射电爆发，从而促使研究者对同类AXP开展射电搜寻。观测于9月28日进行，中心频率1400 MHz，带宽256 MHz，时间分辨率为0.2 ms，数据经消色散处理（DM < 2000 pc cm⁻³），并在X射线给出的自转周期（10.61069 ± 0.001 s）及其半周期附近进行定向搜寻。结果未探测到与X射线周期一致（偏差≤1 ms）的射电脉冲，给出1400 MHz处射电脉冲流量密度上限为0.04 mJy。该上限表明：若该AXP存在射电辐射，其射电- X射线光度比远低于已知射电脉冲星或射电 loud AXP（如XTE J1810−197），或其射电辐射具有强方向性、窄脉冲宽度、高偏振依赖性，或仅在特定活动相位（如X射线暴期间）短暂开启而未被本次观测覆盖。同时，盲搜发现一新脉冲星（P ≈ 431 ms，DM ≈ 1050 pc cm⁻³），因其DM显著高于银河系内该天区典型值且位置未精确证认与AXP重合，被判定为前景或背景无关源。综上，此次零探测支持AXP群体射电辐射的稀有性，强化了“仅极少数磁星在射电波段表现出相干辐射”的经验事实，并暗示CXO J167410.2−455216在此阶段不具备持续、可探测的射电脉冲辐射。

根据现象进行分析： Announcement of the Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor The Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) on the Swift satellite is a large field of view instrument that continually monitors the sky to provide the gamma-ray burst trigger for Swift. An average of more than 70% of the sky is observed on a daily basis. These survey mode data in the 15-50 keV energy band are analyzed to derive count rates for 221 known hard X-ray sources on time scales ranging from one minute to 24 hours. Light curves for each source are produced on two timescales: a single Swift pointing (approximately 20 minutes) and the weighted average for each day. The light curves are available in graphical, FITS and ascii formats. The data are processed after each satellite data downlink (every ~90 minutes, except during the daily data gaps of ~6 hours duration) and the on-line light curves are updated after each round of processing. 
The minimum detectable flux in the transient monitor depends on both the duration of the exposure and the position of the source in the sky. For the median Swift pointing duration of 736 sec and a source near the center of the BAT field of view, a 3-sigma detection corresponds to a flux of 0.006 cts/cm^2/sec, or approximately 27 mCrab. In the daily averages, a 3-sigma detection for a source near the center of the BAT field of view corresponds to 0.0013 cts/cm^2/sec, or approximately 6 mCrab. 
The light curves are available through the Swift mission web page at http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/.  Full information about the processing, data corrections and systematic errors can be found by clicking the "README" link at the top of the page. 
The Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor 2006-10-01 20:57:00
response:
该公告描述了Swift卫星上爆发警报望远镜（BAT）硬X射线暂现源监测系统的运行机制与数据产品特性。首先，BAT以大视场持续巡天，每日覆盖超70%的天空，工作能段为15–50 keV；其核心功能是为伽马暴触发提供实时响应，同时将巡天数据用于已知硬X射线源（共221个）的长期光变监测。数据按两种时间尺度生成光变曲线：单次指向（约20分钟，中位曝光时长为736秒）和加权日平均。光变曲线以图形、FITS及ASCII格式公开，且在每次星地下传后（约每90分钟一次，但每日存在约6小时数据间隙）即时处理并更新。

检测灵敏度具有时空依赖性：一方面取决于曝光时长，另一方面受源在BAT视场中的位置影响（中心区域响应最优）。在单次指向条件下，对视场中心源的3σ探测阈值为0.006 cts/cm²/s（约27 mCrab）；而在日平均数据中，该阈值降至0.0013 cts/cm²/s（约6 mCrab），表明长时间积分显著提升信噪比与弱源探测能力。所有数据通过Swift任务官网发布，并附有详细README文档说明数据处理流程、修正方法及系统误差来源，确保科学使用的可靠性与可追溯性。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Detection of the second eclipsing XRB in M33 by Chandra The variable XMM-Newton source [PMH2004] 47 was identified as an XRB candidate by Misanovic et al. (2006, A&A 448, 1247). It coincides with the ROSAT source [HP2001] 19 and was in the field of view of several Chandra CHASeM33 very large project observations of M33 obtained from 2005 November 23 to 2006 September 26. It varied strongly in brightness as during the XMM-Newton observations from 2000 to 2003. On 2006 September 18/19 the source was bright and during the observation we monitored a drop to an intensity consistent with zero for about 25 ks. We interpret this as an eclipse of the X-ray source. Ingress and egress transitions take no longer than 500 s each. During the bright phase the source shows a hard X-ray spectrum with an absorption column density of 2.2x10^21 cm^-2 and a photon index of 0.97 when modeled with an absorbed power-law. The observed (0.5-10.0 keV) flux of 6.1x10^-13 erg cm^-2 s^-1 corresponds to an intrinsic source luminosity of 5x10^37 erg s^-1 at a distance of 795 kpc. During an observation 84 days earlier another fast transition from low to high intensity was detected. On 2006 September 26 the source showed another transition from low to intermediate intensity. Interpreting these transitions as eclipse egresses we derive a unique orbital period of 1.73245 d which also is consistent with the other Chandra and also the much earlier XMM-Newton detections of the source. We derive a mid-eclipse epoch of JD2453997.470 and an eclipse half angle of 30.7 degrees. The position of the source coincides with star #4571 of Massey et al. (2006, AJ 131, 2478) which shows V=21.011 mag and colours consistent with a B0V to B2III star after extinction and colour correction. [PMH2004] 47 is therefore most likely the second eclipsing HMXB in M33 after the eclipsing black hole X-ray binary M33 X-7 (see e.g. Atel #633 or Pietsch et al. 2006, ApJ 646, 420). [PMH2004] 47 shows long term X-ray variability similar to the high-mass system LMC X-4 or the low-mass system Her X-1, respectively. 2006-10-02 14:19:00
response: 该现象描述了一个位于M33星系中的X射线双星系统[PMH2004] 47被证认为第二个食双星XRB的过程。首先，该源已被前期巡天（ROSAT、XMM-Newton）探测到，并被Misanovic等人列为XRB候选体；其在Chandra CHASeM33项目多次观测中均被覆盖，且表现出显著的光变行为。关键证据在于2006年9月18/19日的Chandra观测中，源在约25 ks内亮度下降至零水平，且进出食过程各不超过500 s，符合典型食双星的几何遮挡特征。光谱分析显示亮相位具有硬谱形（Γ = 0.97）、中等吸收（N_H = 2.2×10²¹ cm⁻²），结合距离795 kpc可得光度达5×10³⁷ erg s⁻¹，满足HMXB典型光度范围。三次不同时间点（2006年9月18/19日、此前84天、9月26日）观测到的快速增亮事件被统一解释为食终（egress），由此拟合出唯一轨道周期1.73245 d，并推得中心食时刻JD2453997.470及食半角30.7°，进一步支持轨道模型自洽性。光学对应体为Massey等人星表中#4571恒星，V=21.011 mag，消光与色余校正后颜色符合B0V–B2III型早型星，与HMXB中大质量伴星预期一致。综上，该系统在X射线光变形态、轨道参数、光学伴星性质及光度尺度上均与已知HMXB（如LMC X-4、Her X-1）相似，且具备清晰食特征，故可确证为M33中继M33 X-7之后的第二个食双星HMXB。

根据现象进行分析： Infrared observations of IGR J17497-2821: new position, new candidate counterparts Following the report by Kennea et al. (Atel #900) of a new Swift/XRT position for the recently discovered source IGR J17497-2821 (see Soldi et al., atel #885), we inspected our infrared (IR) images obtained in J, H and Ks bands of the field of IGR J17497-2821 at 1.4m IRSF at South African Astronomical Observatory (details on the observations and reduction are given in Chaty et al., atel #897). 
Inside the new Swift/XRT error circle (5.3" radius), there are 3 2MASS catalogued sources: 
2MASS 17493780-2821181 at 4.0" from the centre of the error circle 
2MASS 17493774-2821173 at 4.7" from the centre 
2MASS 17493798-2821120 at 5.1" from the centre 
In addition, there are 6 other detected objects inside the new error circle, 3 of them are closer to the centre of the error circle than the 2MASS objects. The astrometry (J2000) and magnitudes of these objects are: 
Candidate 1 RA=17 49 38.08, DEC=-28 21 17.6, at 0.7" from the centre; J=16.6+/-0.06, H=14.2+/-0.3, K=13.1+/-0.4 
Candidate 2 RA=17 49 38.16, DEC=-28 21 19.1, at 2.35" from the centre; J=16.8+/-0.08, H=14.1+/-0.2, K=12.9+/-0.2 
Candidate 3 RA=17 49 37.87, DEC=-28 21 18.6, at 3.3" from the centre; J>18.8+/-0.5, H=13.4+/-0.4, K=12.9+/-0.3 (Candidate 3 is the same as described in Chaty et al. Atel #897). 
Candidate 4 RA=17:49:37.89, DEC=-28:21:14.9, at 3.4" from the centre; J=15.3+/-0.3, H=14.3+/-0.3, K=12.8+/-0.3 
Candidate 5 RA=17:49:38.18, DEC=-28:21:13.2, at 4.0" from the centre; J>18.8, H=15.6+/-0.3, 13.7+/-0.3 
Candidate 6 RA=17:49:38.34, DEC=-28:21:14.6, at 4.0" from the centre; J>18.8, H=14.9+/-0.4, 14.3+/-0.4 
The astrometry has been computed with all 2MASS stars located in a radius of 1' from the centre of the error circle, the error on the astrometry is +/-0.4" because of the blending of some of the 2MASS sources (see Chaty et al., atel #897), and the magnitudes are given for the date of 22nd of September 2006. We have observed the field of the source every night since 22nd of September 2006, and we will continue to observe it in order to look for variations of the candidate counterparts and 2MASS objects. We also encourage observations of the field at all wavelengths, to try to detect the real counterpart of IGR J17497-2821. 2006-10-02 23:20:00
response:
首先，Swift/XRT给出了IGR J17497-2821的新定位，误差圆半径为5.3角秒，这比此前的定位更精确，因此成为搜寻真实对应体的关键参考区域。  
其次，在该误差圆内共发现9个红外源：其中3个是已编录的2MASS源，距离中心分别为4.0″、4.7″和5.1″，均处于误差圆边缘附近，位置偏移较大，且无特殊光度特征支持其为强候选体。  
其余6个为新检测到的红外源（Candidate 1–6），其中Candidate 1距中心仅0.7″，是所有源中位置最接近XRT定位中心的；Candidate 2距中心2.35″，次之；Candidate 3距中心3.3″，且已在先前工作（Chaty et al., Atel #897）中被提及，具有较深的H、K波段探测但J波段未测到（J > 18.8），表明可能存在红化或本征红性质。  
光度方面，Candidate 1在JHK三波段均有稳健探测，J=16.6、H=14.2、K=13.1，色指数H−K≈1.1、J−H≈2.4，显示明显红化；Candidate 2与Candidate 1光度相近且同样全波段探测；Candidate 4虽J波段较亮（J=15.3），但位置偏移达3.4″，略逊于Candidate 1的位置精度；Candidates 5和6在J波段均未探测到（J > 18.8），仅H、K有探测，可能更红或更暗弱。  
考虑到天体测量精度为±0.4″（源于2MASS邻近源混合导致的定标不确定性），Candidate 1的0.7″偏移仍在约1.8σ范围内，是目前最符合XRT位置约束的候选体；Candidate 2（2.35″）约为5.9σ偏离，显著性较低；其余候选体偏离更大或缺乏J波段信息，支持度更弱。  
此外，所有候选体目前均未展现出足够显著的光变信号以确认其为真实对应体，因此需持续监测以识别可能的周期性、爆发性或轨道调制光变；多波段协同观测（尤其是X射线、光学、射电）亦至关重要，用以检验能谱一致性、消光修正及暂现行为，最终确认哪一红外源真正对应于高能X射线源IGR J17497-2821。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra observes IGR J17497-2821  On October 1st, 17:42 UT, Chandra has performed a 20ksec HETGS observation of the source IGR J17497-2821 recently discovered by INTEGRAL (Soldi et al., ATEL #885). Our preliminary position estimate is (J2000) RA: 17 49 38.04, Dec: -28 21 17.4. As the source is quite bright, the positioning reaches the Chandra absolute astrometric accuracy that is usually better than 1". Thus our reported position is expected to be accurate to within this value, dominated by current systematic uncertainties which are likely to improve with further analysis. Our position is consistent with the Swift refined position by Kennea et al (ATEL #900, 0.94" away) and our improved error circle allows, among all the currently proposed counterparts (Chaty et al., ATEL #897, #906) only "Candidate 1" at RA=17 49 38.08, DEC=-28 21 17.6 (0.57" apart, Chaty et al., ATEL #906) as the most probable counterpart of IGR J17497-2821. Preliminary analysis shows the source to be at 3.1x10^-10 ergs cm^-2 s^-1 in the 1-8 keV band with N_h = 4.2+/-0.1 10^22 cm^-2 and Gamma = 1.15+/-0.05. More details will be given in a forthcoming paper.
We thank the INTEGRAL Science Data Centre staff and in particular Simona Soldi, Nami Mowlavi and Simon Shaw as well as Erik Kuulkers (ESA/ESAC) for keeping us up to date on the near real time source behavior as seen in our INTEGRAL observations. 2006-10-03 12:17:00
response:
首先，该文本是一份天文学观测通告（ATEL），报告了Chandra X射线天文台对暂现源IGR J17497-2821的高精度定位与光谱分析结果。现象核心是：INTEGRAL卫星新发现一硬X射线源，Chandra随后开展深度观测，实现了亚角秒级精确定位，并据此筛选出唯一最可能的对应体。

第一步，定位精度分析：Chandra采用HETGS模式进行20 ks观测，因源亮度高，达到其绝对天体测量精度极限（通常优于1″）。报告给出的J2000坐标（RA: 17 49 38.04, Dec: −28 21 17.4）的误差主要受系统不确定性主导，当前置信半径约1″。该位置与Swift先前发布的 refined 位置（Kennea et al., ATEL #900）相距0.94″，在各自误差范围内一致，验证了Chandra定位的可靠性。

第二步，对应体甄别：在Chandra给出的1″误差圆内，比对此前文献提出的多个候选体（Chaty et al., ATEL #897, #906），仅“Candidate 1”（RA=17 49 38.08, Dec=−28 21 17.6）与其相距0.57″，位于误差圆中心附近，且无其他候选体落入该区域，因此被判定为最可能的光学/红外对应体。

第三步，物理参数提取：初步光谱拟合给出1–8 keV波段吸收修正后流量为3.1×10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；吸收柱密度N_H = (4.2±0.1)×10²² cm⁻²，表明存在显著星际消光；幂律谱指数Γ = 1.15±0.05，属于典型硬谱，符合吸积致密天体（如中子星或黑洞X射线双星）的高态特征，尤其与INTEGRAL发现的硬X射线暂现性质吻合。

综上，该观测通过Chandra的高空间分辨率将源定位至亚角秒量级，排除了多数混淆源，唯一收敛至Candidate 1；其高吸收、硬谱、高流量共同支持该源为一个处于爆发态的、高度消光的致密X射线双星系统。

首先，该文本描述了一次系统性超新星巡天观测活动，核心目标是发现并分类发生在邻近宇宙中的超新星。观测依托Palomar-QUEST Consortium合作项目，使用帕洛玛天文台48英寸Oschin望远镜搭载的QUEST II相机，在2006年9月单月内获取图像数据，共发现16颗超新星。

观测策略在时间上存在明显分段：9月20日之前采用“point-and-track”模式，这是为JPL近地小行星追踪（NEAT）任务服务的跟踪观测方式，适合移动目标；而9月20日之后切换为“drift-scan”模式，即望远镜固定指向、依赖地球自转实现连续扫描，该模式更适用于大天区静态源巡天，说明后期观测重心转向深度、均匀的河外暂现源搜寻。

所有候选体均经后续光谱证认——使用夏威夷大学2.2米望远镜搭载的SNIFS（超新星积分场摄谱仪），覆盖320–1000 nm波段，确保了光谱型分类的可靠性。分类结果包含Ia型（7例）、II型（6例）、Ibc型（2例）及1例未明确标注但根据命名惯例应属Ia型的SNF20060911-000（其发现时刻距极大光度达两个月，属晚期样本）。红移范围为0.02–0.13，对应距离约80 Mpc至500 Mpc，全部属于“近邻”宇宙（z < 0.15），符合SN Factory以精确测距和物理建模为目标的科学定位。

亮度信息以R、I、B波段给出，星等范围16.9–20.3，表明探测深度较深，且仪器灵敏度足以捕获中等红移处的II型和Ibc型超新星（通常比Ia型暗1–2 mag）。坐标统一采用J2000历元，保证位置精度可用于后续多波段证认与宿主星系关联分析。

特别值得注意的是发现相位信息：部分超新星（如SNF20060911-006、-013）在极大前数日被发现，有利于构建完整光变曲线；SNF20060906-011等3例恰在极大时发现，利于精确测定峰值亮度；而SNF20060911-000在极大后两个月仍被探测到，说明巡天具有良好的晚期探测能力，可能得益于较长的曝光或低背景噪声控制。这些不同相位的样本组合，为研究不同类型超新星光变演化、镍质量、爆炸能量等物理参数提供了关键数据基础。
