根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT observations confirm the AGN nature of IGR J14175-4641, IGR J14552-5133 and IGR J16351-5806 Three INTEGRAL sources, IGR J14175-4641, IGR J14552-5133 and IGR J16351-5806 have recently been observed and detected with the Swift/XRT X-ray telescope. In all cases, the XRT position confirms a previous association with 3 AGNs (Masetti et al., 2006, A&A, 459, 21; Kuiper et al., 2006, Atel 684). In the following we report the results of these measurements: 
IGR J14175-4641   
The XRT observation locates the source at RA(J2000) = 14h17m03.8s and Dec(J2000) = -46d41m39.7s, with an error box of 10 arcsec, thus confirming the association with the Seyfert 2 galaxy LEDA 511869 at z = 0.076; the source is too weak to allow spectral analysis, but the 2-10 keV XRT flux of 5.8 x 10-14 erg cm-2 s-1, compared with the 20-100 keV IBIS flux of 3.9 x 10-11 erg cm-2 s-1, suggests that this may be a Compton thick AGN. 
IGR J14552-5133   
The XRT observation locates the source at RA(J2000) = 14h55m17.93s, Dec(J2000) = -51d34m13.27s, with an error box of 3.32 arcsec, thus confirming the association with the Narrow Line Seyfert 1 galaxy WKK4438 at z = 0.016; the X-ray spectroscopy indicates a mildly absorbed power law spectrum (Gamma = 2.06 and NH = 1.2 x 1021 cm-2) with a 2-10 keV flux of 9 x 10-12 erg cm-2 s-1. 
IGR J16351-5806   
The XRT observation locates the source at RA(J2000) = 16h35m13.17s, Dec(J2000) = -58d04m49.68s, with an error box of 5.1 arcsec, thus confirming the association with the Seyfert 2 galaxy ESO 137-34 at z = 0.009. The X-ray spectrum (although of low statistical quality) is compatible with an unabsorbed steep (Gamma = 2.3) power law with a 2-10 keV flux of 2.4 x 10-13 erg cm-2 s-1. 2007-02-07 16:04:00
response:
首先，题目描述了Swift/XRT对三个INTEGRAL源（IGR J14175-4641、IGR J14552-5133、IGR J16351-5806）的X射线观测结果，并确认它们均为活动星系核（AGN）。需逐一分析各源的定位精度、对应光学/红外证认目标、红移、光谱特性及物理推断依据。

对于IGR J14175-4641：XRT定位误差为10角秒，与Seyfert 2型星系LEDA 511869（z=0.076）位置一致，证实其AGN性质；虽因流量弱无法进行光谱拟合，但对比能段通量比——2–10 keV波段XRT通量为5.8×10⁻¹⁴ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，而20–100 keV波段IBIS通量高达3.9×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹——显示高能端相对更强，符合Compton厚AGN的典型特征（即软X射线被严重吸收，硬X射线穿透逃逸）。

对于IGR J14552-5133：XRT定位更精确（误差仅3.32角秒），与NLS1星系WKK4438（z=0.016）严格对应；光谱拟合给出幂律指数Γ=2.06及吸收柱密度N_H=1.2×10²¹ cm⁻²，属中等吸收水平（典型NLS1特征），2–10 keV通量为9×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，支持其为吸积率较高、黑洞质量相对较小的NLS1型AGN。

对于IGR J16351-5806：XRT定位误差5.1角秒，匹配Seyfert 2星系ESO 137-34（z=0.009）；尽管光谱统计显著性低，但仍可拟合为无吸收、陡谱幂律（Γ=2.3），2–10 keV通量为2.4×10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；低红移+低吸收+陡谱可能反映该源处于低吸积态或视线方向未穿过厚重尘埃环，但Seyfert 2分类暗示其统一模型中存在遮蔽结构，需更高信噪比数据进一步验证。

综上，三者均通过XRT精确定位与已知AGN光学对应体匹配，结合红移、光谱参数及宽能段通量比，分别支持Compton厚Seyfert 2、中等吸收NLS1、低吸收陡谱Seyfert 2的物理图像，共同印证其AGN本质。

All sources are extremely variable, with the first two being visible only in a single 2 ks INTEGRAL pointing (Paizis et al., 2006, Atel 865), and the other two being detected in a limited number of observation sequences (Gotz et al. 2006, A&A, 448, 873; Revnivtsev et al., 2006, A&A, 448, 873). In each of the above cases, we do not detect any X-ray object above 3 sigma confidence level within the published IBIS/ISGRI error box; similarly, no X-ray source is visible around the INTEGRAL uncertainty circle. Only in the case of IGR J05319-6601, a bright X-ray source, known as the High mass X-ray binary RX J0531.2-6609, is detected at 7.5 arcmin from the IBIS/ISGRI position. 2007-02-07 16:24:00
response:
首先，题目描述了Swift/XRT对四个尚未证认的INTEGRAL源（IGR J10043−8702、IGR J10500−6410、IGR J05319−6601、IGR J11321−5311）的后续X射线观测结果。这些源均被标记为“still unidentified”，说明其天体物理本质（如是否为X射线双星、活动星系核、磁星等）尚未确定。

其次，所有四个源均表现出“extremely variable”特性：前两个（J10043−8702和J10500−6410）仅在一次2 ks的INTEGRAL指向上被探测到，表明其X射线辐射具有短时标、低占空比的爆发或暂现特征；后两个（J05319−6601和J11321−5311）虽在多个INTEGRAL观测序列中被探测，但次数有限，也支持其为间歇性或暂现源。

第三，Swift/XRT深度观测在各源公布的IBIS/ISGRI定位误差盒（error box）内未探测到任何≥3σ的X射线源，且在其定位不确定性圆（uncertainty circle）周围亦无可见X射线对应体。这说明：（1）这些源在Swift观测时段处于极低光度态甚至完全关闭；（2）或其X射线辐射谱型较软/硬，导致Swift/XRT灵敏度不足；（3）或真实位置存在系统性偏移，超出当前误差范围——但文中未提及其他波段对应体，故暂不支持精确定位偏差主导。

第四，唯一例外是IGR J05319−6601：在距IBIS/ISGRI位置7.5角分处探测到已知HMXB RX J0531.2−6609。该距离显著大于典型IBIS/ISGRI定位误差（通常为1–3角分），因此RX J0531.2−6609不太可能是其光学/X射线对应体；更可能二者物理无关，属巧合投影。该情况反而强化了J05319−6601本身缺乏可靠对应体的结论。

综上，四者共性为：高变异性、Swift/XRT不可见、无可靠X射线对应体。这暗示它们可能是：（1）极低占空比的暂现源（如超长周期中子星吸积系统、潮汐撕裂事件余晖）；（2）被高度消光的源（X射线吸收柱密度极高，致软X射线被完全吸收，而Swift/XRT能段以软光子为主）；（3）非热主导的硬X射线源（峰值在>30 keV，超出XRT有效能区）。需结合更高能段（如INTEGRAL/JEM-X、NuSTAR）或长时间监测进一步验证。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT observations of INTEGRAL detections in the Coma Field Four excesses (IGR J11567+3700, IGR J12488+3315, IGR J13371+1520 and IGR J13103+2001) detected by INTEGRAL/IBIS in a deep observation of the Coma region (Krivonos et al., 2005, ApJ, 625, 89) have recently been observed with the Swift/XRT X-ray telescope. Within the 4 arcmin IBIS error box we do not detect any X-ray source above 3 sigma confidence level. We further notice that none of the above excesses has been reported in the literature afterwards nor is listed in recent INTEGRAL/IBIS survey catalogs (Bird et al., 2007, ApJ Supp in press, astro-ph/0611493 ; Krivonos et al., 2007, astro-ph/0701836). We therefore conclude that they are probably spurious detections and do not correspond to real INTEGRAL sources. 2007-02-07 16:42:00
response:
首先，INTEGRAL/IBIS在Coma区域的深度观测中报告了四个X射线过剩源（IGR J11567+3700、IGR J12488+3315、IGR J13371+1520和IGR J13103+2001），但这些源均位于较大的IBIS误差盒内（半径约4角分）。  
其次，后续Swift/XRT对该区域进行了更高空间分辨率和更高灵敏度的X射线观测，在每个IBIS误差盒内均未探测到任何显著性高于3σ的X射线点源。  
第三，这四个源未被后续任何独立观测或文献工作证认，且未出现在更新的INTEGRAL/IBIS巡天星表中（如Bird et al. 2007、Krivonos et al. 2007），表明它们缺乏可重复性和交叉验证。  
综上，这些过剩信号缺乏多仪器、多历元的观测支持，既无X射线对应体，又无后续证认，因此最合理的解释是统计涨落、系统误差或数据处理伪迹所致，即属于假阳性（spurious）探测，而非真实天体源。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Large X-ray Burst from Anomalous X-ray Pulsar 4U 0142+61 At approximately 10:04:19 UTC on 7 February 2007 (MJD 54138.42), the Anomalous X-ray Pulsar 4U 0142+61 exhibited a large fast-rise X-ray burst, followed by a lengthy tail, during routine RXTE/PCA monitoring observations. On a 31-ms time scale, the count rate at the burst peak was approximately 3600 counts/s for 2 operational PCUs, in the 2-60 keV range, which corresponds roughly to a peak flux of ~4x10^-8 erg/s/cm^2. The burst was followed by an extended tail that lasted 20-30 mins upon which were superimposed, for approximately the first minute, bright single pulses at the nominal pulse period. Further details will be provided as available. Observations at all wavelengths, particularly optical, near and mid-infrared are encouraged. 2007-02-08 02:35:00
response: 该现象描述了一次来自反常X射线脉冲星4U 0142+61的大型X射线暴发事件。首先，暴发具有典型的快升慢降结构：在UTC时间2007年2月7日10:04:19（MJD 54138.42）被RXTE/PCA探测到，上升时间极短（毫秒量级），峰值计数率达3600 counts/s（2个有效PCU，2–60 keV），换算为峰值通量约4×10⁻⁸ erg/s/cm²，表明能量释放极为剧烈。其次，暴发后存在持续20–30分钟的长尾，说明存在持续的能量释放或辐射过程，并非瞬时耗尽；更值得注意的是，在长尾起始约前1分钟内，叠加了与自转周期一致的明亮单脉冲，表明磁层或表面活动在暴发后仍保持相干调制能力，暗示暴发未完全破坏脉冲星的全局磁结构。第三，该源属于反常X射线脉冲星（AXP），其能量来源通常归因于强磁场衰减（磁星模型），因此此类大暴发很可能源于磁层中大规模磁重联或地壳星震引发的磁自由能突然释放。最后，通报呼吁多波段观测，尤其是光学和红外波段，是因为磁星暴发可能伴随非热同步辐射或尘埃再加热等次级过程，跨波段对比有助于区分辐射机制（如纯磁层过程 vs. 周围介质相互作用）。

根据现象进行分析： The fifth outburst of IGRJ11215-5952 observed with Swift/XRT IGR J11215-5952 is the first member of the new class of Supergiant Fast X-ray Transients which displays periodic outbursts, with a recurrence time of 329 days (Sidoli et al. 2006,A&A,450,L9; Smith et al.2006,ATEL #766), likely indicative of the orbital period of the binary system. 
Based on this periodicity, we are performing a monitoring of the source field with Swift/XRT during the times around the fifth outburst, expected to occur on February 8-10. 
Two 2-ks pointings were performed on February 4 and February 5 (see linked table) which resulted in only 3-sigma upper limits (count rate <6E-03, and <6E-03 counts/s, respectively, in the 1-10keV energy band). The first observations of marginal detection were performed on February 6 where a count rate of 3.507E-03 +/- 1.9E-03 counts/s (S/N=1.9, 1-10keV) was observed. Observations performed on February 7 and 8 yielded firmer detections. 
A clear renewed flaring activity is observed starting on February 7-8 when the source was observed with a signal to noise ratio of 2.93, after 328 days from the latest outburst occurred on 2006, March 16, fully confirming the periodicity of the outbursts, with a count rate of (1.06+/-0.36)E-02 counts/s. This translates into about (1.3+/-0.5) E-12 ergs/cm2/s (1-10 keV, correcting for the absorption and assuming a spectral shape similar to the one observed in March 2006). 
The best-fit position of the X-ray source is RA(J2000)=11 21 46.7 Dec(J2000)=-59 51 38.5, with an estimated uncertainty of 7 arcsec. This position is consistent (<4 arcsec) with the one obtained in March 2006 (Steeghs et al.2006, ATEL #768). 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for making these observations possible, in particular N. Gehrels, the duty scientists M. Chester, J. Kennea, and C. Gronwall, as well as the science planner C. Pagani.

该现象描述了一颗X射线暂现源IGR J11215-5952在2007年2月9日发生的周期性亮爆发。首先，需确认其周期性特征：上一次爆发发生于2006年3月，本次爆发发生在329天之后，与理论预期的约165天轨道周期（即双星系统轨道周期的两倍，符合超巨星高吸积率中子星系统的典型行为）存在偏差；但考虑到观测覆盖不完整及爆发触发机制的复杂性（如非球对称星风吸积），329天可能对应于两次相邻可探测爆发间隔，而非严格轨道周期，仍支持其为Be/X射线双星或超巨星X射线双星中的周期性暂现源。

其次，爆发光变特征显示典型的快上升、快下降型亮耀：起始于2月9日01:30 UT，峰值流量达2×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s（1–10 keV），持续时间仅约2–3天，符合经典脉动式中子星吸积爆发的时间尺度。短时标表明吸积物质在磁层边界发生不稳定性释放，而非稳态盘吸积。

能谱分析给出单幂律拟合结果：光子指数Γ = 0.93⁻⁰·²⁰₊₀·₂₄，显著偏硬（Γ < 1.7），反映非热主导或极端康普顿化过程；吸收柱密度N_H = (1.02⁻⁰·³⁰₊₀·₄₂)×10²² cm⁻²，高于银河系前景值，说明源本身处于高消光环境，与其位于银河系旋臂内、距离6.2 kpc的定位一致。

由观测流量换算得1–10 keV光度L_X ≈ 7×10³⁵ erg/s，在中子星爱丁顿极限（≈1.5×10³⁸ erg/s）的0.05%量级，属亚爱丁顿吸积；结合硬谱形与短时标，支持磁层主导的节拍式吸积模型，其中中子星自转周期（已知为187 s）调制吸积流截断与能量释放。

综上，该爆发是IGR J11215-5952作为一颗具有强磁场、长自转周期的中子星与大质量伴星组成的高质量X射线双星，在穿越伴星星风稠密区时触发的周期性磁控吸积事件。

首先，该现象涉及对超巨星快X射线暂现源IGR J11215−5952新一轮爆发的多波段监测。Swift/XRT数据用于开展计时分析，目的是验证此前RXTE在上一次爆发中探测到的可能脉动信号（Smith et al. 2006，ATel #773）。

第三，XMM-Newton观测已于2月9日16 UT开始，旨在提供更高信噪比和更宽能段的能谱与光变信息；INTEGRAL观测计划于2月11日15 UT启动，可覆盖硬X射线波段（>20 keV），有助于判断是否存在截断幂律谱或康普顿化成分，进而约束吸积柱物理条件。  
最后，呼吁其他波段（如光学、红外、射电）协同观测，是因为该源属于超巨星伴星系统，多波段数据可限制伴星星风密度、轨道参数及吸积过程的几何结构，从而区分不同爆发机制模型（如随机星风吸积 vs. 轨道相位相关吸积）。

(2007, ATel #993), Swift observed the anomalous X-ray pulsar 4U 0142+61 on Feb. 8th 2007 (36.7 hr after the burst). The XRT instrument collected 4844 s in Photon Counting (PC) mode and 138 s in Window Timing (WT) mode. The source is well detected at a piled-up rate of 2.7 c/s (corresponding to about 5 c/s of true rate). We extracted spectra for the two modes (in PC in an annulus 5-30 pixels wide to avoid pile-up) and fit them with the usual absorbed black body plus power law model. The best fit parameters are N_H=(1.0+/-0.2)x1E22 cm-2, T_BB=0.43+/-0.03 keV (R_BB=3.9+/-1.8 km assuming a source distance of 3 kpc) and photon index 3.7+/-0.2 (all errors are at 90% c.l.). The fit is good with a reduced chi2 of 1.0 with 171 d.o.f., the black body component is required (F-test probability of 1E-6). The 0.5-10 keV unabsorbed flux is (8.2+/-1.0)x1E-10 erg/cm2/s. These parameters are in line with previous XMM-Newton (Gohler et al. 2005, A&A 433 1079) and Chandra (Patel et al. 2003, ApJ 587 367; Juett et al. 2002, ApJ 568 L31) and recent (July 2006) Swift observations. The PC light curve shows a significant flux decrease consistent with an exponential decay (starting at the time of the X-ray burst) with an e-folding time tau=39+/-10 ks (even if the XRT light curve can be fit equally well with a linear decay). We analysed separately the PC spectra of the two consecutive orbits, keeping fixed the black body temperature and the photon index at their best overall values. We find a small (30%) decrease in the black body normalization, although it is not statistically significant. No bursts were clearly detected in either PC or WT data. However, one short burst could have triggered the automatic mode change (from PC to WT) that occurred during the middle of the first orbit data. A weak pulsation is detected at the expected period of 8.688 s with a semi-amplitude of 5+/-2%. 2007-02-09 21:32:00
response: 该现象描述了Swift卫星在一次明亮X射线暴（由Gavriil等2007年报告）后约36.7小时对磁星4U 0142+61的快速观测。首先，XRT探测到源在PC和WT两种模式下均有显著计数率，其中PC模式总曝光4844秒、WT模式138秒；源在PC模式下存在明显堆积效应（pile-up），实测率2.7 c/s对应真实率约5 c/s，因此光谱提取采用5–30像素环形区域以规避堆积影响。其次，联合PC与WT光谱拟合采用标准吸收黑体加幂律模型，得到吸光度N_H = (1.0±0.2)×10²² cm⁻²、黑体温度T_BB = 0.43±0.03 keV（对应半径R_BB = 3.9±1.8 km，假设距离3 kpc）、幂律光子指数Γ = 3.7±0.2；χ²_red = 1.0（d.o.f. = 171），F检验显示黑体成分统计显著（P = 10⁻⁶），表明热辐射成分不可忽略；0.5–10 keV未吸收通量为(8.2±1.0)×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s。这些参数与此前XMM-Newton、Chandra及2006年7月Swift观测结果一致，说明该源在暴后仍处于典型稳态辐射状态。第三，PC光变曲线显示通量随时间单调下降，可被指数衰减模型较好拟合，特征时标τ = 39±10 ks（约10.8小时），虽线性衰减亦可接受，但指数形式更符合磁星暴后热冷却预期。第四，将两次连续轨道数据分开展开光谱分析，固定T_BB与Γ取全局最优值后，发现黑体归一化因子下降约30%，但未达统计显著性，暗示热辐射区面积或温度变化微弱；未在PC/WT数据中明确识别出后续暴事件，但一次短时暴可能触发了第一轨中段PC→WT的自动模式切换。最后，在已知自转周期8.688 s处检测到弱脉动信号，半振幅5±2%，证实源仍维持稳定自转及磁层调制辐射机制。综上，该观测呈现磁星在强暴事件后的典型演化特征：热成分主导的软X射线辐射缓慢衰减、非热幂律成分持续存在、整体光谱形态稳定、脉动结构完好，支持磁星暴起源于磁层能量释放并引发星震加热表面的物理图像。

根据现象进行分析： RXTE PCA Pointed Observations of IGR J11215-5952 RXTE has performed pointed observations of IGR J11215-5952 on Feb 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, 2007, at various times, for a total exposure of 23.3 ks. 
During the observations of Feb 6-8, the source was mostly quiescent. However, in the observations on Feb 9, 01:20 - 03:20 UTC, the source exhibited strong pulsations. Using a Lomb-Scargle periodogram, the pulse period was found to be 186.78s, with an approximate error of 0.3 s. The source became faint again after 03:20 UTC. On Feb 10, at 02:32 UTC, it was also low, but active enough to detect the pulsations and at 04:26 UTC, the intensity rose to about half the intensity of the Feb 9 peak until the end of the observations at 06:07 UTC. 
In observations Feb 6-8 the Swift XRT (Romano et al. ATel #994) found that the source was below the PCA's sensitivity limits. The PCA flux through early Feb 8 (06:43 UTC), 0.8 mCrab 2-10 keV, is probably from other sources of emission in the galactic ridge (l=291.8, b=1.53). Spectra were analyzed for the subsequent observations, starting Feb 8 21:43 UTC, in terms of the excess over this amount. A typical pulsar spectrum of a power law with a high energy cutoff was always acceptable. The column density was low enough that it could not be independently constrained and fixing it to the value measured by Mangano et al. (ATel #995) with the Swift XRT (1.02e22 cm^-2) always allowed an acceptable fit. Then the best value for the power law when the pulses were present was 1.07+-0.08, with a cutoff starting at 5.8 +-0.7 keV and an e-folding energy of 15 +-2 keV. There is a marginal indication of an iron line, but less than a 3 sigma upper limit of 220 eV equivalent width. The amount of line emission could also be diffuse. 
The pulse-averaged fluxes in the 2-10 keV band were 0.18 mCrab at the end of Feb 8; 3.0 mCrab at maximum on Feb 9, falling to 0.13 mCrab; initially 0.13 mCrab on Feb. 10, rising to 1.7 mCrab. In the 10-30 keV band, the range was 0.06-5.1 mCrab. In the light curves shown at the link below, 3 mCrab corresponds to about 9 counts/s. 
Brief RXTE observations will monitor the source for 3 more days. 
RXTE PCA Light curves of IGR J11215-5952 2007-02-10 22:24:00
response:
现象分析：  
IGR J11215-5952 在2007年2月6–8日处于准静止态，RXTE PCA未探测到显著脉冲辐射，Swift XRT亦确认其流量低于PCA灵敏度极限；此时测得的0.8 mCrab（2–10 keV）通量很可能源于银道面背景（l=291.8, b=1.53）而非源本身。因此，后续光谱分析以该背景水平为基准扣除本底，仅拟合超出部分。

2月9日01:20–03:20 UTC出现强烈脉动，Lomb-Scargle周期图给出脉冲周期为186.78 ± 0.3 s，表明中子星自转主导调制；此后流量迅速衰减至低态。该爆发具有典型暂现X射线脉冲星特征：短时标、高幅度、周期稳定。2月10日02:32 UTC仍处低态（0.13 mCrab），但04:26 UTC起强度回升至约峰值一半（1.7 mCrab），并维持至观测结束（06:07 UTC），显示次级增强事件，可能对应吸积盘不稳定性或伴星风密度局部升高导致的二次吸积率上升。

能谱始终可用带高能截断的幂律模型（Γ ≈ 1.07 ± 0.08，E_cut ≈ 5.8 ± 0.7 keV，E_fold ≈ 15 ± 2 keV）良好拟合，且N_H固定为1.02×10²² cm⁻²时拟合可接受，说明吸收较弱、未显著影响谱形；铁Kα线信号不显著（<3σ，等效宽度上限220 eV），可能源于稀薄热等离子体弥散辐射或信噪比不足，无法确认吸积柱或表面荧光特征。

光变与能谱协同表明：该源在2007年2月经历一次主爆发（2月9日）及一次较弱再增亮（2月10日），符合超巨星HMXB中间歇性风吸积系统的典型行为——轨道相位接近近星点时，致密星穿越伴星致密星风区，引发吸积率突增，产生X射线脉冲爆发；爆发后吸积率回落，但残余风物质持续供给导致次级增亮。186.78 s周期与已知超长周期脉冲星一致，支持其为慢速旋转中子星吸积系统。

根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL observations of GX339-4: preliminary spectral fit results We present the results of preliminary spectral fits to the first 130 ksec INTEGRAL ToO observation of GX 339-4 (see ATel #980, #986), obtained between 2007, Jan 30, 15:56 and Feb 01, 06:11. We made joint spectral fits to spectra obtained with the JEM-X (5-20 keV) and IBIS/ISGRI (23-300 keV) instruments. 
The model that best phenomenologically fits the joint spectrum consists of an absorbed multi-color black-body disk plus a powerlaw with a high-energy cut-off at 22 +/- 5 keV and a folding energy of 68 +/- 5 keV. The presence of curvature between 20-30 keV and line-like residuals revealed between 6-8 keV, is likely due to disk reflection. We will explore fits with reflection models in future work. 
The presence of the radiation coming from the disk is significant, and we find a color temperature of the inner disk of T = 1.5 +/- 0.1 keV. The powerlaw has a photon index of 1.67 +/- 0.07. These parameters are broadly consistent with rising hard states. The implied luminosity of the source in the 5-300 keV band was L = 1.3-1.7 E+38 erg/s, calculated taking into account a distance to the source of 8.5 kpc. 
We examined the JEM-X and IBIS/ISGRI light curves with a time binning of 1000 sec, in the 3-6, 6-10, 10-15, 15-35, 20-40, 40-60, 60-100, 100-200 keV energy ranges. The source was slowly increasing its brightness since the beginning of the observation in the overall energy range of 3-200 keV. 
PostScript figures of the preliminary spectral fit results, as well as the JEM-X and IBIS/ISGRI light curves, can be found at http://isdc.unige.ch/~kuulkers/GX339-4/. 2007-02-11 09:48:00
response:
首先，观测对象是黑洞X射线双星GX 339-4，使用INTEGRAL卫星的JEM-X（5–20 keV）和IBIS/ISGRI（23–300 keV）仪器进行了联合能谱拟合，总曝光时间为130 ks。  
其次，最佳现象学拟合模型包含两个主要成分：一是吸积盘辐射，用吸收的多温黑体（multi-color black-body）描述，其内区颜色温度为T = 1.5 ± 0.1 keV；二是硬X射线连续谱，用带高能截断的幂律函数描述，光子指数Γ = 1.67 ± 0.07，截断能量为22 ± 5 keV，折叠能量为68 ± 5 keV。  
第三，能谱在20–30 keV区间呈现明显弯曲，且在6–8 keV存在类线残差，这些特征共同暗示存在来自吸积盘的反射成分，但当前拟合未显式引入反射模型，仅作为后续工作计划。  
第四，源在5–300 keV波段的各向同性光度为L = (1.3–1.7) × 10³⁸ erg/s，该值基于8.5 kpc的距离假设计算得出。  
第五，光变分析显示，在3–200 keV全能量范围内，源亮度在观测期间（约2.5天）呈缓慢上升趋势，这一行为与硬态上升阶段的典型演化一致。  
综上，该观测捕捉到了GX 339-4处于硬态上升相位的物理状态，其能谱特征支持标准吸积盘+热冕共存图像，其中盘辐射显著、冕辐射呈强截断幂律，且存在反射迹象，符合低软化、高截断的硬态光谱标识。

根据现象进行分析： Swift XRT Observations of AXP 4U 0142+61: Evidence for a Modified Pulse Profile The anomalous X-ray pulsar 4U 0142+61 was observed with Swift XRT again on 10 Feb 2007 (MJD 54141) in Window Timing mode with 1.766 ms time resolution. At the observed XRT total count rate (5.0 c/s) pile-up was negligible. We find a good fit (chi^2/dof=291.2/272) to the data using an absorbed blackbody plus power law model with N_H=(0.90+/-0.08 ) x 1e22 cm^-2, PL index= 3.8 +/- 0.2 and kT_BB = 0.38 +/- 0.02 (errors are at 90% CL). These results are consistent with our earlier report (Campana et al, 2007, ATEL #998). We find a total unabsorbed flux (2-10 keV) of 7.9 (-0.7,+0.2) x 1e-11 erg s^-1 cm^2 and determine that 31% of the flux is from the thermal black body component. 
We determine a pulse frequency (using a Z^2,m=2 test) of 0.1150923(7) Hz (P = 8.68868(5) s), consistent with the extrapolation of the Dib et al. (2006, astro-ph/0610932) ephemeris, which was based in RXTE data from MJD 51610-53787. We find a pulse fraction of 14+/-3 % ([Fmax-Fmin]/[Fmax+Fmin]) using the full XRT energy range (~0.2-10 kev). The pulse profile has two peaks with the second peak slightly larger then the first, and with the dip preceding the first peak deeper than the one following it. For comparison we analyzed the 4U 0142+61 observation made with Swift XRT on 2 July 2006. We find that the dip between the first and second peak in the current observation is significantly deeper then the previous observation, which is counter to the trend reported by Dib et al. of this dip having grown shallower since 2000 in the 2-4 keV band. Since the XRT efficiently probes softer energies below the useful lower limit of RXTE (~2 keV), a direct comparison of the profiles is not possible. 2007-02-12 20:06:00
response:
首先，观测对象是异常X射线脉冲星4U 0142+61，使用Swift卫星XRT仪器在窗定时（Window Timing）模式下进行观测，时间分辨率为1.766 ms，观测日期为MJD 54141（2007年2月10日）。该时刻总计数率仅为5.0 c/s，因此堆积效应可忽略，保证了光变曲线和能谱分析的可靠性。

其次，能谱拟合采用吸收黑体加幂律模型，得到吸积柱或磁层辐射的典型双成分特征：吸收柱密度N_H = (0.90±0.08)×10²² cm⁻²，幂律谱指数Γ = 3.8±0.2，黑体温度kT_BB = 0.38±0.02 keV。χ²/dof = 291.2/272表明模型拟合良好，且参数与前期Swift/XRT结果（Campana et al. 2007, ATEL #998）一致，说明源在数月尺度上能谱形态稳定。

第三，通量计算显示2–10 keV波段未吸收总通量为(7.9₋₀.₇⁺⁰.₂)×10⁻¹¹ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，其中黑体成分贡献31%，表明热辐射在软X射线波段占显著比例，支持中子星表面热辐射主导低能段的物理图像。

第四，脉冲频率通过Z²ₘ=₂检验测得为0.1150923(7) Hz（周期P = 8.68868(5) s），与Dib et al. (2006)基于RXTE长期监测（MJD 51610–53787）构建的自转衰减历元表外推值一致，说明自转演化连续、无明显跃变（glitch）或扭矩突变。

第五，全能段（~0.2–10 keV）脉冲分数为14±3%，反映调制深度中等；脉冲轮廓呈双峰结构，第二峰略高于第一峰，且第一峰前的凹陷（pre-peak dip）比第一、二峰之间的凹陷更深——这一不对称性暗示辐射束几何或磁层结构存在非对称性，可能与视线方向穿过扭曲磁层或热点非均匀分布有关。

第六，与2006年7月2日的Swift/XRT观测对比发现：当前观测中两峰之间凹陷显著加深，而Dib et al.曾报道该凹陷在2–4 keV波段自2000年以来持续变浅。这一矛盾并非物理矛盾，而是源于仪器响应差异：XRT有效低能阈值（~0.2 keV）远低于RXTE（~2 keV），因此XRT对软光子更敏感，所见轮廓反映的是更宽、更偏软的能段加权平均；而RXTE仅覆盖硬端，其轮廓演化趋势不能直接外推至全软X射线波段。故二者差异本质上是能段依赖性所致，而非源本身发生反常演化。

根据现象进行分析： The NIR counterpart to IGR J17497-2821 We report follow-up observations confirming the near-infrared (NIR) counterpart to the X-ray transient and suggested black hole candidate IGR J17497-2821 (Soldi et al., ATel #885). A Ks=15.9 mag candidate was suggested in Torres et al. (ATel #909) on the basis of its coincidence with the Chandra localization for the X-ray source (Paizis et al. ATel #907; astro-ph/0611344). The candidate appeared blended with a brighter nearby NIR source to the east which partially overlaps the 0.6 arscec Chandra error circle. 
Our observations consist of a series of Ks-band images obtained with the 6.5m Magellan Baade telescope between 2007 Feb 10 08:45-08:58 UT using the PANIC camera and totaling 450s on source. The frames were acquired with a seeing of 0.6 arcsec and the projected pixel size was 0.127 arcsec. Photometric and astrometric scales were defined with the same 2MASS references used in ATel #909. 
Our images show that the proposed counterpart candidate has faded significantly and is no longer detected with a 3-sigma upper limit magnitude of Ks > 17.8. This limit is consistent with a late-type companion at a typical distance of the Galactic center. 
This large decrease in brightness relative to the observations reported when the transient was in outburst confirms the candidate reported in ATEL #909 as the NIR counterpart to IGR J17497-2821. 
Updated finding chart: 2007-02-14 05:46:00
response:
首先，该现象描述了一个X射线暂现源IGR J17497-2821的近红外（NIR）对应体的证认过程。关键观测事实是：在Chandra X射线定位误差圆（半径0.6角秒）内，Torres等人（ATel #909）曾识别出一个Ks=15.9 mag的NIR候选体，但该源与东侧一个更亮的NIR源部分重叠，存在混淆风险。

其次，本文作者利用麦哲伦Baade望远镜（6.5米口径）和PANIC相机，在2007年2月10日获取了总曝光450秒的Ks波段图像，视宁度为0.6角秒，像素尺度0.127角秒/像素，并采用与ATel #909相同的2MASS参考星进行光度定标和天体测量校准，确保坐标与亮度标度的一致性。

第三，对比发现：该候选体在后续观测中显著变暗，3σ探测极限为Ks > 17.8 mag，即亮度至少下降了约1.9等。这一衰减幅度与X射线源处于爆发期（此前观测时）到宁静期（本次观测时）的典型行为一致——X射线暂现源在爆发期间加热其伴星表面或吸积盘内区，导致NIR辐射增强；爆发结束后，热辐射冷却，NIR亮度回落。

第四，该显著变暗排除了它是一个普通、稳定的晚型恒星（如红巨星）的可能性，因为此类恒星在短时间内不会发生如此剧烈的光变；而与已知黑洞X射线双星系统的NIR光变特征相符，即NIR辐射受X射线再处理主导，随X射线光度同步变化。

第五，由于该候选体的空间位置严格落在Chandra高精度定位误差圆内，且其光变行为与X射线活动状态严格对应（爆发期亮、宁静期暗），因此可排除背景星或前景星的概率性巧合，确认其物理关联性。

综上，该NIR候选体的时变特性、位置一致性及光度演化规律共同构成多重独立证据，确证其为IGR J17497-2821的真实NIR对应体。

根据现象进行分析： Swift observations of the possible radio supernova in NGC 3628 Swift Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) and X-Ray Telescope (XRT) observed the possible radio supernova in NGC 3628 (CBET #842) on 2006-11-12.08 UT as part of the Swift Survey of Nearby Galaxies. The following upper limits (at a 3-sigma level) to the UVOT magnitudes were measured: V > 18.1 (199 s exposure time), B > 19.2 (199 s), U > 18.9 (199 s), UVW1 [181-321nm] > 19.6 (406 s), UVM2 [166-268 nm] > 19.9 (328 s), and UVW2 [112-264 nm] > 20.5 (813 s). The magnitudes have not been corrected for extinction. We note that the SN is located along the dense central dust lane of the host galaxy which might have obscured the opt/UV emission. 
An X-ray source is detected at the position of the radio source at a 5.5-sigma level of confidence in the merged 2.4 ks Swift XRT observation obtained simultaneously with the UVOT. The XRT net count rate is (1.6+/-0.3) E-02 cts/s, corresponding to an unabsorbed (0.2-10 keV band) X-ray flux of (8.1+/-1.5) E-13 ergs/cm/cm/s and a luminosity of (1.5+/-0.3) E40 ergs/s for an adopted thermal plasma spectrum with a temperature of kT = 10 keV, a Galactic foreground column density of N_H = 2.23E+20 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA 28, 215) and a distance of 11.4 Mpc (Saha et al. 1999, ApJ 522, 802). Due to the small offset of the radio source from the nucleus of the host galaxy (~2 arcsec), the X-ray source might be due to the nucleus of the galaxy and unrelated to the radio source.

response:

第三，该X射线源与射电源的位置偏移仅约2角秒，接近星系核，因此不能排除其本质是星系核活动（AGN）而非超新星激波辐射；即X射线辐射可能与射电暂现源无关。

最后，为判别该X射线源是否具有时变性（从而支持其为爆发源而非稳态核），已安排后续Swift观测。

根据现象进行分析： Two active X-ray transients in the Galactic Center region as seen by INTEGRAL The first of a new series of INTEGRAL Galactic bulge monitoring observations (ATel #438, #874) performed between UT 2007, Feb 15 18:35 and 22:17 shows two transient X-ray sources to be active in the Galactic Center region. 
One is the recently found source IGR J17453-2853 at RA, Dec (Degrees) = 266.32, -28.89, with a 90% confidence error region of 2 arcmin (Kuulkers et al. 2007, A&A, in press, astro-ph/0701244). The IBIS/ISGRI 20-60 keV flux was about 11 mCrab, with a detection significance of 8. It is not detected in the JEM-X 3-10 and 10-25 keV bands with upper limits of about 5 mCrab in both bands. This source was last seen to be active at similar flux levels between 2005, April 3 and 14. As noted by Kuulkers et al. (2007), if the non-detection with JEM-X is due to absorption in the line of sight, N_H should be larger than about 10^23 atoms per cm^2. 
The other source is detected with JEM-X at RA, Dec (Degrees) = 266.40, -29.05, with a 90% confidence error region of 2 arcmin. There are various known X-ray transients within the error circle, such as Swift J174535.5-290135.6 (e.g., ATel #753, #756) or CXOGC J174535.5-290124 (e.g., ATel #753, #892). It is detected at about 22 mCrab in 3-10 keV, with a detection significance of 14. The source is clearly variable on a 15-minute time scale. It is not detected in the JEM-X 10-25 keV band with an upper limit of about 5 mCrab. Follow-up observations with more position sensitive instruments are needed to pin-point the exact origin of the transient X-ray emission. 2007-02-16 21:20:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2007年2月15日18:35至22:17 UT，属于INTEGRAL卫星对银河系核球区（Galactic bulge）的系列监测任务之一。该次观测在银河系中心区域探测到两个暂现X射线源，表明该区域存在显著的瞬时高能活动。

第一个源IGR J17453-2853位于赤经266.32°、赤纬−28.89°，90%置信误差半径为2角分。其在IBIS/ISGRI仪器20–60 keV能段测得流量约为11 mCrab，探测信噪比达8σ，说明信号显著可靠；但在JEM-X的3–10 keV和10–25 keV波段均未探测到，仅给出约5 mCrab的流量上限。这表明该源在硬X射线波段占主导，而软X射线被严重吸收或本身谱型极硬。结合Kuulkers等人（2007）的分析，若JEM-X未探测源于视线方向吸收，则氢柱密度N_H需大于10²³ cm⁻²，符合银河系中心方向典型的高吸收特征。此外，该源曾在2005年4月3–14日期间以相似流量水平爆发，提示其具有周期性或准周期性暂现行为。

第二个源位于赤经266.40°、赤纬−29.05°，同样具有2角分定位误差，与多个已知暂现源位置重合，包括Swift J174535.5-290135.6和CXOGC J174535.5-290124等。它在JEM-X 3–10 keV波段被明确探测，流量约22 mCrab，信噪比高达14σ；但在JEM-X 10–25 keV波段未被探测，上限约5 mCrab，说明其辐射主要集中在较软X射线能段。更重要的是，该源在15分钟时间尺度上呈现明显光变，表明其物理过程具有快速时标，可能对应吸积盘不稳定性、磁重联或中子星/黑洞暂现吸积事件中的剧烈变化。由于INTEGRAL的空间分辨率有限（误差圈内存在多个候选体），无法唯一确认其真实对应体，因此需要更高精度的位置测量设备（如Chandra、XMM-Newton）进行后随观测以精确定位。

综上，这两个暂现源分别展现出截然不同的能谱和时变特性：前者为硬谱、高吸收、长周期暂现源，后者为软谱、强短时标光变、低吸收暂现源，暗示它们可能属于不同类型的致密天体系统（例如，前者可能是高度遮蔽的黑洞X射线双星，后者可能是低吸收的中子星X射线暂现源或活动吸积脉冲星），共同反映了银河系中心复杂环境中多样的高能暂现现象。

根据现象进行分析： Renewed activity of the Galactic center transients Swift J174535.5-290135.6 and GRS 1741.9-2853 as observed with Swift/XRT Following the detection of a new Galactic center transient in our new series of INTEGRAL Galactic bulge monitoring observations (ATEL #1005), we obtained a short pointing with the XRT aboard Swift to improve significantly on the source position of this transient. This observation was performed on 16-17 Feb 2007 from 21:39 to 00:37 UT for a total on-source time of nearly 4 ksec. 
The XRT data shows a clear bright transient in the INTEGRAL JEM-X error circle (ATEL #1005) at a position (J2000) of R.A. = 17h 45m 35.4s and Dec. = -29d 01m 38s with an error radius of 3.6 arcseconds. This position is consistent with that of Swift J174535.5-290135.6 (ATEL #753) but not consistent with that of CXOGC J174535.5-290124 strongly indicating that it is Swift J174535.5-290135.6 which is active again. The XRT source spectrum could be fitted by a strongly absorbed power-law with a photon index of ~2.1 and a column density Nh of ~1.7E23 atoms/cm^2. The averaged absorbed and unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux was 6E-11 and 1.4E-10 erg/s/cm^2, respectively. 
In addition to Swift J174535.5-290135.6, we detected another bright transient at R.A. = 17h 45m 02.0s and Dec.= -28d 54m 54s (J2000; error radius of 3.6 arcsecond). This position is ~6 arcseconds away from the neutron-star X-ray transient GRS 1741.9-2853 (Muno et al. 2003, ApJ, 598, 474). Although GRS 1741.9-2853 is located outside the XRT error circle, the source is located close to the edge of the FOV which likely increases the systematic error on the source position. Furthermore, we detected a type-I X-ray burst from the source consistent with the bursting behavior observed from GRS 1741.9-2853. Therefore, we think it is likely that we have detected another outburst of GRS 1741.9-2853. The source spectrum could be fitted with an absorbed power-law model with Nh = 9.5+/-2.5 E22 atom/cm^2 and an index of 1.4+/-0.5. The averaged absorbed and unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux was 9.1e-11 erg/s/cm^2 and 1.5e-10 erg/s/cm^2, respectively. We note that this transient is located in the error circle of the X-ray burst detected with Swift/BAT on 22 January 2007 (BAT trigger 257213; GCN #6020) and likely this transient was the origin of this burst (moreover, no other source was detected in the BAT error circle). This would suggest that the source has already been active for over 4 weeks. 2007-02-17 15:04:00

首先，观测目标是银河系中心区域的新暂现源，该源最初由INTEGRAL卫星在银心凸起监测中发现（ATEL #1005），随后Swift/XRT于2007年2月16–17日进行了约4 ks的定点观测，以精确定位。

XRT数据在INTEGRAL JEM-X误差圆内探测到一个明亮暂现源，位置为R.A. = 17h 45m 35.4s，Dec. = −29°01′38″（J2000），误差半径3.6″。该位置与Swift J174535.5−290135.6（ATEL #753）高度一致，但明显偏离CXOGC J174535.5−290124（角距超限），因此可确认该次活动对应Swift J174535.5−290135.6的再激活。

其X射线谱可用高吸收幂律模型拟合：光子指数Γ ≈ 2.1，吸收柱密度N_H ≈ 1.7 × 10²³ cm⁻²；2–10 keV波段平均吸收/未吸收通量分别为6 × 10⁻¹¹ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²和1.4 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，表明存在显著星际消光，且源具有典型吸积致密天体的硬谱特征。

此外，XRT在同一次观测中还探测到第二个暂现源，位置为R.A. = 17h 45m 02.0s，Dec. = −28°54′54″（J2000），误差半径同样为3.6″。该位置距离已知中子星X射线暂现源GRS 1741.9−2853约6″，虽略超出XRT定位误差圆，但处于视场边缘——该区域系统误差增大，使得位置偏差合理；更重要的是，XRT明确探测到一次I型X射线暴，其光变与能谱行为与GRS 1741.9−2853历史爆发完全一致，构成强识别依据。

该源谱拟合得N_H = (9.5 ± 2.5) × 10²² cm⁻²、Γ = 1.4 ± 0.5；2–10 keV吸收/未吸收通量分别为9.1 × 10⁻¹¹ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²和1.5 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²。值得注意的是，其位置落在Swift/BAT于2007年1月22日触发的X射线暴（BAT trigger 257213）误差圆内，且该BAT误差圆内无其他可证认源，因此该暴极可能源于此源；结合BAT触发时间与本次XRT观测时间（2月17日），说明GRS 1741.9−2853此次爆发已持续超过4周，符合中子星低质量X射线双星长时标爆发的典型行为。

综上，本次XRT观测确认了两个银河系中心暂现源的同时再活动：Swift J174535.5−290135.6（黑洞或中子星候选体）呈现高吸收硬谱态；GRS 1741.9−2853（已证认中子星）正处于一次持续数周的爆发中，并表现出特征性I型X射线暴，二者均位于银心强消光区域，N_H达10²³ cm⁻²量级，反映典型的银心方向视线吸收特性。

input: 根据现象进行分析： ATCA radio observations of GX 339-4 Following the recent reactivation of GX 339-4 in X-rays as detected by INTEGRAL (see ATel #1000), we have conducted several radio observations with the Australia Telescope Compact Array (ATCA) located in Narrabri, Australia. We report the results of the observations (at 3.5 and 6 cm) covering the period from February 4 to February 18. GX 339-4 has been detected in all radio observations and is very variable on timescale of days with flux density ranging from 1 to 25 mJy. The spectral shape also changes over time ranging from flat to very steep spectrum, likely suggesting that GX 339-4 is currently undergoing a series of plasma ejection events (similar to the oscillations a la GRS 1915+105). 2007-02-20 11:10:00
response:
首先，观测对象是GX 339-4，这是一个已知的黑洞X射线双星系统。  
其次，该源近期在X射线波段被INTEGRAL卫星探测到重新激活，表明其进入新的活动期。  
接着，ATCA在2007年2月4日至18日期间对其开展了3.5 cm和6 cm波段的射电观测，覆盖了这一活跃阶段。  
所有观测中均成功探测到GX 339-4，说明其射电辐射持续存在且较强。  
通观数据，射电流量密度在1–25 mJy之间变化，变化时间尺度为天量级，表明射电辐射具有显著的短期时变性。  
同时，射电谱形随时间演化，从平坦谱到极陡谱均有出现，这种谱形变化通常对应于不同辐射机制或辐射区物理条件的改变。  
结合流量剧烈变化与谱形动态演化，最合理的物理解释是：源正在经历一系列等离子体喷流抛射事件；这类行为在GRS 1915+105中已有明确先例，表现为周期性或准周期性的喷流爆发，常伴随射电亮态与谱形振荡。  
因此，当前GX 339-4很可能正处于喷流主导的硬态或硬中间态，并正在进行间歇性相对论性喷流活动。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J17453-2853 = Granat 1741.9-2853? The position of the recently found source IGR J17453-2853 as derived by INTEGRAL IBIS/ISGRI (see ATel #1005) is about 4 arcmin from that of Granat 1741.9-2853 (see ATel #1006; Muno et al. 2003, ApJ 598, 474). Formally, given the statistical 90% error regions of both sources (IGR J17453-2853: about 2 arcmin; Granat 1741.9-2853: about 1 arcsec), they can be regarded as two different sources. 
However, Granat 1741.9-2853 was found to be the only X-ray transient active in the near vicinity of IGR J17453-2853 by the Swift/XRT, about a day after the INTEGRAL observations (ATel #1006). Moreover, combining our Galactic bulge monitoring observations obtained on UT 2007, February 15 18:35-22:17, February 17 14:52-18:34, and February 20 00:51-04:32, with JEM-X we find a source at RA, Dec (degrees, J2000.0) = 266.265, -28.92, with a positional error of about 2 arcmin. This is consistent with the X-ray emission being also due to Granat 1741.9-2853. It was detected at the 10 sigma level with an average JEM-X 3-10 keV flux of 7.5+/-1 mCrab; it was just at the detection limit in the JEM-X 10-25 keV band (about 5 mCrab). 
In addition, the quoted Swift/XRT 2-10 keV flux and X-ray spectrum of Granat 1741.9-2853 (ATel #1006) are consistent with the quoted 20-60 keV IBIS/ISGRI flux of IGR J17453-2853 and its inferred high absorption column density, a day earlier (ATel #1005). Note that in April 2005 both sources were also reported to be active in the same time period with similar fluxes (Kuulkers et al. 2007, A&A, in press, astro-ph/0701244). 
Although we cannot exclude that two different sources were active at the same time, we regard this as unlikely. We, therefore, suggest that IGR J17453-2853 and Granat 1741.9-2853 are one and the same source. 
We note that the other source active in the Galactic Center region, Swift J174535.5-290135.6 (ATels #1005, #1006), was still seen during our observations on February 17 (about 13 mCrab, 8 sigma, JEM-X 3-10 keV) and February 20 (about 15 mCrab, 9 sigma, JEM-X 3-10 keV). 2007-02-22 08:43:00
response:
首先，题目要求判断IGR J17453-2853与Granat 1741.9-2853是否为同一源。需综合位置、时间、光度、能谱及历史活动等多维度证据进行分析。

位置方面：INTEGRAL测得IGR J17453-2853的位置与Granat 1741.9-2853的已知位置相差约4角分；其90%统计误差半径分别为约2角分和1角秒。仅从误差椭圆看，二者中心距离超出各自误差范围之和（2角分 + 1角秒 ≈ 2.017角分 < 4角分），形式上不重叠，因此单凭位置无法确认同一性，但也不能排除——因系统误差、坐标系转换偏差或源定位在强背景（如银心）中精度下降等因素可能使实际误差大于标称值。

时间关联性关键：Swift/XRT在INTEGRAL观测后约一天内，在IGR J17453-2853标称位置附近探测到唯一活跃的X射线暂现源，即Granat 1741.9-2853。这表明两者在时间上紧密衔接，且空间邻近区域内无其他显著暂现体，极大降低了巧合概率。

JEM-X独立观测提供强佐证：在2007年2月15日、17日、20日三次银心巡天中，JEM-X在RA=266.265°, Dec=−28.92°（J2000）处探测到一源，误差约2角分，该位置与Granat 1741.9-2853一致，且与IGR J17453-2853的标称位置偏差仍在2角分误差范围内（因IGR位置误差亦为~2′，故二者位置相容）。该源在3–10 keV波段以10σ显著性被探测，通量7.5±1 mCrab，与Swift/XRT所报2–10 keV通量及IBIS/ISGRI所报20–60 keV通量在考虑吸收和能谱响应后自洽；尤其高吸收柱密度推断一致，说明能谱硬化特征相同，支持同一物理源。

历史活动佐证：2005年4月，两源曾被同时报告在相同时间段内活跃，且通量水平相似（Kuulkers et al. 2007），表明其光变行为具有同步性，进一步削弱“双源偶然共现”的可能性。

对照源Swift J174535.5-290135.6持续被JEM-X探测（2月17日13 mCrab、2月20日15 mCrab），说明观测灵敏度足以分辨邻近源，而未在IGR位置附近发现除Granat外的其他新源，反证Granat即IGR的对应体。

综上，尽管位置名义偏差较大，但时间连续性、空间邻近性（在实际观测误差容限内）、光度演化一致性、能谱特征匹配以及历史共现规律共同构成强收敛证据链，因此应判定IGR J17453-2853与Granat 1741.9-2853实为同一X射线暂现源。

根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopic confirmation of an optical nova in M31 We report the spectroscopic confirmation of an optical nova candidate in M31 (RA=00:41:40.32, Dec=+41:14:33.5, J2000) discovered by K. Hornoch on 2007 Feb. 3.798 UT. The spectrum was taken using the Russian 6 m telescope and SCORPIO spectral camera on 2007 Feb. 13.674 UT. The spectrum covers the range 340-760 nm, resolution 1.3 nm. 
The spectrum shows strong Balmer emission lines (H_alpha FWHM=1760 km/s), FeII emission lines, and possibly weak He and N lines. This is most likely a hybrid nova several days after outburst. 
CCD observations taken by K. Hornoch with the 0.35 m telescope at Lelekovice are the following: 2007, Jan. 27.775 UT, R=[19.9 mag; Feb. 3.798 16.7; 9.862, 17.3; 14.795, 17.5; 17.773, 17.7. In the BTA image taken before the spectrum on Feb. 13.65, the nova had a brightness of 18.2 mag in the V band. 
Continued optical/NIR monitoring of the decay of the M31 nova would be useful. 
The nova spectrum is available at: 
SCORPIO m31 nova spectrum 2007-02-22 14:20:00
response: 该光学新星位于仙女座星系（M31）中，坐标为赤经00:41:40.32、赤纬+41:14:33.5（J2000历元），由K. Hornoch于2007年2月3.798 UT发现。光谱观测于2月13.674 UT利用俄罗斯6米望远镜及SCORPIO摄谱仪完成，波长覆盖340–760 nm，分辨率1.3 nm。光谱呈现显著的巴耳末发射线（Hα线宽FWHM对应1760 km/s）、Fe II发射线，以及可能较弱的He和N发射线，表明其处于爆发后数日的演化阶段，光谱特征符合混合型新星（hybrid nova）的典型表现。亮度监测数据显示：1月27.775 UT时R波段星等为19.9；2月3.798 UT升至16.7；随后缓慢变暗，2月9.862 UT为17.3，2月14.795 UT为17.5，2月17.773 UT为17.7；在2月13.65 UT BTA望远镜V波段图像中测得星等为18.2。综合光谱形态与光变趋势，可判定该源为M31中一颗处于早期衰减阶段的混合型经典新星，其高速膨胀包层（由Hα线宽推断）与丰富的Fe II辐射共同支持这一分类。持续的光学及近红外波段监测对其光度衰减规律研究具有重要价值。

The data from detector 2 (which has the particle protection of a propane layer) give a 3 sigma upper limit contribution of V1280 Sco of 0.15 mCrab or 3.6x10^-12 ergs cm^-2 s^-1, 2-10 keV. Detectors 0 and 1 were also used during the observation. Preliminary analysis of detectors 0, 1, and 2 together gives a best fit of 0.12 mCrab, but only at a level of 2.4 sigma due to higher background variations. 2007-02-22 23:44:00
response:
首先，观测目标是新星V1280 Sco，使用RXTE卫星的PCA仪器进行X射线探测；  
其次，观测于2007年2月21日18:54–19:27 UT进行，采用两条相互垂直的扫描路径覆盖源位置，以提高定位鲁棒性；  
第三，探测器2配备了丙烷层粒子屏蔽，背景较低，因此其单独分析给出可靠的3σ上限：0.15 mCrab（即3.6×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，2–10 keV）；  
第四，探测器0和1虽参与观测，但缺乏同等水平的粒子屏蔽，导致本底涨落更大；  
第五，联合分析三个探测器数据得到最佳拟合流量为0.12 mCrab，但统计显著性仅2.4σ，低于通常认定为探测的阈值（3σ），故不能确认探测到源；  
第六，因此，该次观测未获得V1280 Sco在2–10 keV波段的可靠X射线探测，仅能给出置信度为3σ的流量上限，反映源在此时刻的X射线辐射极弱或已衰减至探测极限以下。

根据现象进行分析： Swift X-ray flux limits for the recent novae V1280 and V1281 Sco Swift observed V1280 Sco and V1281 Sco shortly after their discovery by Nakamura & Sakurai (IAUC # 8803 ) and by Nakamura & Nakano (IAUC # 8810 ), respectively. No X-ray flux was detected in either case. 
V1280 Sco was observed by Swift at 21-Feb-2007 12:17 UT for 1.0 ksec, this was 16.7 days after discovery and ~2.5 days from visual maximum. Because of the brightness of this object at the time (www.aavso.org V~4.7), the UVOT filter wheel was set to the blank position. The X-ray telescope was set to observe in Windowed Timing mode (resolution = 1.8 msec) to minimise the effects of optical light in the on-board X-ray event recognition process. The one-dimensional nature of WT mode data reduces the sensitivity of the XRT to faint point sources however. V1280 Sco was not detected, we derive a 3-sigma upper limit to the 0.3-10 keV WT grade 0-2 count rate of 26 c/ks. Assuming an optically thin thermal spectrum with kT=10 keV absorbed by NH=1x10^20 cm^-2, this corresponds to an unabsorbed 0.3-10 keV flux of <1.7x10^-12 erg/cm^2/s and a luminosity limit at 1 kpc of L<2.9x10^32 erg/s. 
V1281 Sco was observed by Swift at 22-Feb-2007 17:20 UT for 3.9 ksec, this was 2.9 days after discovery. This object was at V~9-10 at the time (www.aavso.org), the UVOT UV grism was used and the XRT was in its normal Photon Counting mode. V1281 was not detected, we derive a 3-sigma upper limit to the 0.3-10 keV PC grade 0-12 count rate of 0.87 c/ks. Assuming an optically thin thermal spectrum with kT=10 keV absorbed by NH=1x10^20 cm^-2, this corresponds to a 0.3-10 keV flux of <5.0x10^-14 erg/cm^2/s and a luminosity limit at 1 kpc of L<6.1x10^30 erg/s. 
The luminosity limits we derive, while admittedly uncertain because of the unknown distances, are orders of magnitude below the luminosity of 4.5x10^34 erg/s measured from V382 Vel at 20.5 days by Mukai & Ishida (ApJ, 551, 1024, 2001). RXTE has also measured an X-ray flux limit for V1280 Sco (Swank 2007, ATEL #1010). 
We acknowledge with thanks the variable star observations from the AAVSO International Database contributed by observers worldwide and used in this research. We thank the Swift PI, Neil Gehrels, the Swift science team, and the Swift mission operations team for their support of these observations. 2007-02-23 17:22:00
response:
现象：Swift卫星对新星V1280 Sco和V1281 Sco进行了X射线观测，均未探测到X射线辐射，仅给出3σ流量上限。

分析：  
首先，两次观测的仪器模式与观测条件不同。V1280 Sco极亮（V~4.7），为避免光学光子污染XRT探测器，被迫采用Windowed Timing（WT）模式，该模式时间分辨率高（1.8 ms）但空间信息为一维，导致点源探测灵敏度显著下降；同时UVOT使用空白滤光片，说明光学波段饱和，进一步反映目标强光学辐射背景。其1.0 ks曝光仅得26 c/ks（0.3–10 keV）3σ上限，换算为0.3–10 keV未吸收流量上限为<1.7×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s（NH=1×10²⁰ cm⁻², kT=10 keV），对应1 kpc距离下的光度上限L<2.9×10³² erg/s。

其次，V1281 Sco较暗（V~9–10），可采用标准Photon Counting（PC）模式，具备二维成像能力，信噪比更高；且曝光时间更长（3.9 ks），但仍无探测，仅得0.87 c/ks 3σ上限，对应流量上限<5.0×10⁻¹⁴ erg/cm²/s，光度上限L<6.1×10³⁰ erg/s（同假设谱型与吸收）。该上限比V1280 Sco低约两个数量级，反映PC模式灵敏度更高，也说明V1281 Sco本身X射线辐射更弱或尚未进入热核燃烧主导的硬X射线阶段。

第三，二者光度上限均远低于经典案例V382 Vel在相似演化时标（~20天）测得的L≈4.5×10³⁴ erg/s，表明V1280/V1281 Sco在早期未产生显著热核持续燃烧产生的高温等离子体X射线辐射；结合其光学衰减行为与缺乏硬X射线信号，暗示其白矮星质量可能较低、爆发抛射物包层较厚，或处于“类新星”延迟X射线辐射相，尚未进入超软X射线源（SSS）阶段，亦不排除吸积盘主导光学辐射而核燃烧被严重遮蔽。

最后，流量上限的物理意义受限于距离不确定性（文中假设1 kpc仅为参考），但量级差异（>10²倍于V382 Vel）足以排除二者在该时期具有类似强度X射线辐射的可能性，支持其为弱X射线新星或处于X射线沉默期。

根据现象进行分析： Second set of INTEGRAL observations of GX339-4: preliminary spectral fit results  We present the results of preliminary spectral fits to the second period of 115 ksec public INTEGRAL ToO observations of GX 339-4 (see ATels #980, #986, #1000), obtained between UT 2007, Feb 17, 18:53 and Feb 19, 04:39. We made joint spectral fits to spectra obtained with the JEM-X (5-20 keV) and IBIS/ISGRI (23-200 keV) instruments. The spectrum has softened considerably with respect to our first set of INTEGRAL ToO observations (ATel #1000). 
The model that best phenomenologically fits the joint spectrum consists of an absorbed multi-color black-body disk plus an unbroken power-law up to about 200 keV. Contrary to our first set of observations, we do not see any reflection feature in the spectrum during the second period. Also, we do not see any line-like feature the residuals in the range of 6-8 keV greater than 10%. 
The relative flux of the disk compared to the power-law emission is about 0.9 (i.e., it has almost doubled with respect to our first set of observations). We find a color temperature of the inner disk of T=0.91 (+0.02-0.03) keV; the power-law has a photon index of 2.68+/-0.08. These parameters are broadly consistent with that seen during soft states in black-hole (candidate) binaries. The implied unabsorbed luminosity of the source in the 5-200 keV band was L=(2.3-3.7)E+37 erg/s, assuming a distance to the source of 8.5 kpc. 
We also examined the JEM-X and ISGRI light curves with time bins of 1000 sec, in the 3-6, 6-10, 10-15, 15-35, 20-40, 40-60, 60-100, 100-200 keV energy ranges. Strong flaring activity with a peak up to about 70 mCrab was seen in the 20-60 keV band near the end of the observation. 
PostScript figures of the preliminary spectral fit results, as well as the JEM-X and IBIS/ISGRI light curves, can be found at http://isdc.unige.ch/~kuulkers/GX339-4/. 2007-02-26 13:05:00
response: 该现象描述了GX339-4在2007年2月17–19日第二轮INTEGRAL卫星ToO观测期间的X射线能谱与光变特征。首先，联合JEM-X（5–20 keV）和IBIS/ISGRI（23–200 keV）数据的谱拟合显示，相比第一轮观测，整体谱形显著变软，表明源处于更典型的软态。谱形可用吸积盘多色黑体加无截断幂律模型良好拟合，且未探测到反射成分（如铁Kα线或康普顿反射肩），也未在6–8 keV残差中发现>10%强度的谱线特征，说明硬X射线照射冷物质的几何结构或电离状态发生改变，可能源于内吸积盘半径扩大、冕区收缩或消散。盘辐射与幂律辐射的流量比达0.9，较第一轮几乎翻倍，结合内盘色温T=0.91 keV（误差小、精度高），符合标准薄盘内缘接近ISCO的软态预期。幂律光子指数Γ=2.68±0.08，属典型高软态幂律陡峭值，进一步支持热主导态主导。5–200 keV波段未吸收光度L≈(2.3–3.7)×10³⁷ erg/s（取距8.5 kpc），处于Eddington光度的~1–2%量级，符合GX339-4软态典型光度范围。光变分析显示，在观测末期20–60 keV能段出现强耀发，峰值达~70 mCrab，但该耀发未在低能段（如3–6 keV）同步显著增强，暗示耀发可能源于热冕的瞬时增强而非盘辐射变化，反映软态下仍存在局部、短暂的非热过程。综上，该时期GX339-4处于标准高软态，以热主导、内盘延伸至内最稳定圆轨道、弱或缺失冕反射为特征，但光变上保留短时标硬X射线耀发能力，体现软态并非完全无冕，而是冕被压制但未完全消失。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra Detection of Three Enigmatic X-ray Transients: GRS 1741.9-2853, The Chandra X-ray observatory ACIS-I observed the locations of two transient low-mass X-ray binaries, GRS 1741.9-2853 (see ATel #1005, #1006, #1008) and GRO J1744-28, and the unidentified very faint X-ray transient XMM J174457-2850.3 starting on 2007 Feb 22 at 03:29:33, for 39 ks. All three sources were detected. 
GRS 1741.9-2853 was detected at 17h 45m 2.34s, -28o 54' 49.9" (J2000; 0.5" uncertainty), consistent with Muno et al. (2003, ApJ, 598, 474). Although it was located 5.5' off-axis from the aimpoint, it was bright enough that photon pileup affected the total number of counts recorded. We measured 24,417 photons within 90% of the PSF, but examining the number of counts obtained in an annulus excluding the inner 70% of the PSF, we estimate that the true count rate was 30% higher. We applied the standard model for ACIS pile-up, and we find the spectrum is consistent with a Gamma=0.9+/-0.1 power law absorbed by N_H=9.0+/-0.5e22 cm^-2. The observed 2-8 keV flux (corrected for pile-up) was 3e-11 erg cm^-2 s^-1, and the estimated intrinsic 2-8 keV luminosity for D=8 kpc was 4e35 erg s^-1. This source was probably identified by both Swift and INTEGRAL (as IGR J1745-2853) in the last two weeks. We note that in the formal 2' error circle of IGR J17453-2853 (ATel 1005) Chandra detects no sources, where sources brighter than 2e-14 erg cm^-2 s^-1 (2-8 keV, Gamma=1.5 power law) would be detected in 50% of trials. This further supports the Swift identification of IGR J17453-2853 with GRS 1741.9-2853 (ATel #1008). It has been active at this level several times over the past 7 years (e.g., Muno et al. 2003, ApJ, 598, 474). 
GRO J1744-28 was detected at 17h 44m 33.09s, -28o 44' 27.2" (J2000; 0.5" uncertainty) at 6.7' from the aimpoint. We detected 602 photons from the source. The spectrum could be modeled as a Gamma=2.3+/-0.4 power law absorbed by N_H=6.5+/-0.1e22 cm^-2. The observed 2-8 keV flux was 4.1e-13 erg cm^-2 s^-1, and the intrinsic 2-8 keV luminosity for D=8 kpc was 6.0e33 erg s^-1. This is about a factor of three brighter than was observed on 2001 July 18 (Wijnands & Wang 2002, ApJ, 568, L93), indicating some enhanced activity from this source. 
The very-faint X-ray transient XMM J174457-2850.3 was detected at 17h 44m 57.46s, -28o 50' 21.0" (J2000; 0.5" uncertainty) at 2.0' from the aimpoint. We detected 158 photons from the source. The spectrum could be modeled with an absorbed power law with Gamma = 0.6+/-0.6 and a N_H of 5+/-3e22 cm^-2. The absorbed 2-8 keV flux was 1.3e-13 erg cm^-2 s^-1 and the 2-8 keV luminosity was 1.3e33 erg s^-1 for D=8 kpc. This is intermediate between its luminosity in full outburst (4.5e-12 erg cm^-2 s^-1; e.g., Sakano et al. 2005; Wijnands et al. 2006) and quiescence (<2e-14 erg cm^-2 s^-1; Sakano et al. 2005). Therefore, this source also shows enhanced X-ray activity. 2007-02-27 00:07:00
response:
首先，观测目标是三个暂现X射线源：GRS 1741.9−2853、GRO J1744−28 和 XMM J174457−2850.3，均位于银河系中心方向，距离取为8 kpc。Chandra ACIS-I在2007年2月22日进行了一次39 ks的深度观测，三者均被成功探测到，说明它们在此时段均处于X射线活跃态。

对于GRS 1741.9−2853：其位置与Muno et al. (2003)给出的位置一致，证实了源识别的可靠性；由于离轴角达5.5′且亮度高，导致光子堆积（pile-up），需校正。原始计数24417（90% PSF内）低估真实流量，通过环形区域（排除中心70% PSF）估计真实计数率比观测值高约30%，进而应用标准ACIS pile-up模型拟合能谱，得到硬谱指数Γ = 0.9 ± 0.1和高吸收柱密度NH = 9.0 ± 0.5 × 10²² cm⁻²，表明存在显著星际消光；经堆积校正后的2–8 keV观测通量为3 × 10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应光度4 × 10³⁵ erg s⁻¹；该光度水平与Swift和INTEGRAL近期探测到的IGR J1745−2853一致，且Chandra在IGR J17453−2853官方2′误差圆内未探测到其他源（探测限~2 × 10⁻¹⁴ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹），进一步支持两者为同一源；该源在过去7年中多次以相似强度爆发，属重复暂现体。

对于GRO J1744−28：位置精确（0.5″误差），离轴6.7′，仅探测到602个光子，信噪比较低；能谱拟合得较软谱指数Γ = 2.3 ± 0.4及中等吸收NH = 6.5 ± 0.1 × 10²² cm⁻²；观测通量4.1 × 10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应光度6.0 × 10³³ erg s⁻¹；相比2001年观测（Wijnands & Wang 2002），当前光度高出约3倍，表明存在明显增强活动，但仍未达历史最高水平（如爆发峰值可达~10³⁶ erg s⁻¹量级），可能处于上升段或次级峰。

对于XMM J174457−2850.3：离轴仅2.0′，探测光子数158，统计相对可靠；能谱极硬（Γ = 0.6 ± 0.6）且吸收中等（NH = 5 ± 3 × 10²² cm⁻²）；2–8 keV吸收后通量1.3 × 10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，光度1.3 × 10³³ erg s⁻¹；该值介于文献报道的完全爆发态（4.5 × 10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹）与宁静态（< 2 × 10⁻¹⁴ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹）之间，明确指示其处于衰减阶段或中间态，即从爆发向宁静过渡的增强活动期。

综上，三源虽性质各异（分别为重复爆发的LMXB、经典爆裂星、以及新发现的极暗暂现体），但在本次观测中均呈现高于典型宁静水平的X射线辐射，反映其共同处于某种形式的增强活动状态；其中GRS 1741.9−2853表现出强堆积和高光度，暗示其处于明亮爆发相；GRO J1744−28和XMM J174457−2850.3则分别表现为中等增强和过渡态，可能对应不同吸积物理过程（如盘不稳定性、热核闪光余辉、或暂现吸积启动）。

根据现象进行分析： Candidate Near-IR Counterpart to the X-ray Transient Pulsar GRO J1744-28 We previously obtained near-IR multiband images of the field containing the quiescent X-ray transient pulsar GRO J1744-28 (the "Bursting Pulsar") on 2004 Feb 11 using the PANIC camera on the 6.5-meter Magellan/Baade telescope at Las Campanas Observatory in Chile. The exposure times were 5 min in J-band and 2.5 min in each of H- and K-bands. We find a candidate counterpart within the error circle (0.6" radius; this includes the uncertainty from our astrometric calibration) of the reported X-ray position (Muno et al. 2007, ATEL #1013). The magnitudes of this source were J = 19.21, H = 16.16, and Ks = 14.69, with 0.05 mag uncertainty (1-sigma). However, the target field is crowded; the number density of stars that were as bright as our candidate in Ks band was 0.13 stars/arcsec^2, indicating a 14% chance coincidence probability.
Assuming a source distance of 8 kpc for GRO J1744-28, the object's colors are consistent with a normal K2 III giant reddened by Av = 21 mag. However, the low binary mass function of the pulsar (1.3*10^-4 M_sun; Finger et al. 1996, Nature, 381, 291) implies a low mass range (0.2-0.7 M_sun) for the companion, suggesting that the companion is a giant star that has lost most of its hydrogen-rich envelope (Rappaport & Joss 1997, ApJ, 486, 435). Using the predicted colors and magnitudes of Rappaport & Joss, we derive a source distance of approximately 4 kpc for the source, but with an anomalously high Av (=22 mag). However, this distance is roughly consistent with the value derived from the Eddington luminosity limit of the X-ray source (Giles et al. 1996, ApJ, 469, L25). 
Given that the X-ray brightness of the quiescent source was higher than usual on 2007 Feb 22, we encourage further near-IR imaging observations to search for correlated near-IR flux changes in order to verify this candidate counterpart. 2007-02-27 22:45:00
response:
首先，观测团队在2004年2月11日利用智利拉斯坎帕纳斯天文台6.5米麦哲伦/巴德望远镜搭载PANIC相机，对暂现X射线脉冲星GRO J1744−28所在天区进行了近红外多波段成像，曝光时间分别为J波段5分钟、H和Ks波段各2.5分钟。在X射线位置（Muno et al. 2007）的0.6角秒误差圆内发现一个候选对应体，测得其J=19.21、H=16.16、Ks=14.69，测光精度为0.05 mag（1σ）。但该区域恒星密度高，Ks≤14.69的恒星面密度达0.13 arcsec⁻²，由此估算随机叠加概率为14%，说明不能完全排除场星污染。

其次，若采用文献普遍采纳的距离8 kpc，则该源的J−H=3.05、H−Ks=1.47色指数与一颗经AV≈21 mag消光的正常K2 III型巨星相符；但该脉冲星的二元质量函数极小（1.3×10⁻⁴ M⊙），结合Rappaport & Joss (1997)模型约束，其伴星质量应在0.2–0.7 M⊙之间，属已剥离大部分氢包层的演化后巨星，而非主序或正常巨星。将Rappaport & Joss模型预测的伴星颜色与绝对星等代入实测值反推，所得距离约为4 kpc，对应AV≈22 mag——虽略高于8 kpc假设下的消光，但该距离与Giles et al. (1996)基于X射线爱丁顿光度极限推算的距离一致，增强了其物理合理性。

最后，注意到2007年2月22日该源X射线流量处于异常高的准静止态，因此需通过后续近红外监测检验其是否呈现与X射线光变相关的同步亮度变化：若存在显著相关性，则可强有力支持该候选体即为真实光学对应体；反之则需重新评估其身份。

根据现象进行分析： V1118Ori: The quiescence near IR spectrum becomes featureless On Sept. 5th, 2006 a new near-IR spectrum of the EXor variable V1118 Ori was taken with the AZT-24 telescope at Campo Imperatore (Italy), by using the same instrumental equipment described in ATEL #619. While the first spectrum was taken during the post-outburst declining phase, the present one refers to the quiescence stage. Surprisingly, all the emission features present before (HI, HeI, other ionic lines and CO bands) now disappeared, given our sensitivity limit (1σ approximately 7Â·10^-15 erg s^-1 cm^-2): Brγ, taken as an example, decreased by more than a factor of 5. This circumstance represents one of the very first indication that when disk accretion events (responsible for the outburst) fade, mass loss phenomena (i.e. winds responsible for line emission) fade as well. 
V1118 Ori observations from Campo Imperatore 2007-02-28 12:28:00
response:
首先，V1118 Ori 是一颗 EXor 型变星，其光变行为由盘吸积事件驱动，典型表现为间歇性光学/近红外增亮（即爆发），随后进入宁静期（quiescence）。  
2006年9月5日获取的近红外光谱对应于该星的宁静期，而此前（ATEL #619）的光谱则处于爆发后的衰减阶段。  
对比发现：原先在衰减期显著存在的多种发射线——包括氢原子线（如 Brγ）、氦原子线（HeI）、其他离子线以及 CO 振转带——在宁静期光谱中全部消失，且该消失并非仪器灵敏度所致，因探测极限达 1σ ≈ 7×10⁻¹⁵ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，而 Brγ 流强下降超过5倍，远超噪声水平。  
这表明发射线的消失具有物理本质，而非观测限制；而这些发射线通常起源于与吸积相关的外流过程（如磁离心驱动风或盘风），其激发依赖于高吸积率下的激波、光致电离或碰撞激发等机制。  
因此，发射线在宁静期的系统性消失，直接反映出吸积率大幅下降后，相关外流活动亦同步熄灭，从而为“吸积驱动质量损失”这一物理图像提供了早期观测证据。

input: 根据现象进行分析： New X-Ray Transient in M31: CXO J004412.4+412548 We report the discovery of a new X-ray source detected in a 5ks observation starting on 2007-02-14.08 UT as part of our ongoing Chandra/HST M31 transient program. The source was detected at coordinates RA(J2000) 00:44:12.4, Dec(J2000) 41:25:48.2, at the edge of the ACIS-S field of view, which results in larger than usual position errors of 2.2" and 2.5", respectively. This location is ~19' from the centre of M31. Modeling the X-ray spectrum with an absorbed disk blackbody, fixing nH = 6.66e20 atoms/cm2 (the Galactic value towards M31), we find Tin ~ 0.63 keV. The luminosity (assuming a distance of 780 kpc to M31) is Lx ~ 9.4e37 erg/s in the 0.5-10 keV range. The presence of a very soft component in the spectrum and the high X-ray luminosity are consistent with the source being a black hole transient in a thermal (high-soft) state. Further optical and X-ray observations of this source are encouraged. 2007-02-28 16:48:00
response: 该X射线暂现源CXO J004412.4+412548位于M31星系边缘（距中心约19角分），由Chandra卫星在2007年2月14日的一次5千秒观测中发现。其位置误差较大（RA方向2.2角秒，Dec方向2.5角秒），源于其处于ACIS-S探测器视场边缘。光谱拟合采用吸积盘黑体模型，并固定银河系视线方向的吸收柱密度nH = 6.66×10²⁰ cm⁻²，得到内盘温度Tin ≈ 0.63 keV。结合M31距离780 kpc，计算得0.5–10 keV波段X射线光度Lx ≈ 9.4×10³⁷ erg/s。该光度显著高于典型中子星低质量X射线双星的热态光度上限（通常≲2×10³⁷ erg/s），且光谱呈现极软成分，符合恒星级黑洞X射线双星在热态（高软态）下的典型特征：高光度、低Tin（通常0.5–1.0 keV）、强热主导能谱。因此，该源极可能是一例处于热态的黑洞暂现源，需后续多波段观测以确认其性质及演化状态。

根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SN 2007aa Swift Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) and X-Ray Telescope (XRT) observed the type II SN 2007aa (CBET #850, IAUC # 8814 ) on 2007-02-24.63 UT. The following UVOT magnitudes were measured: V = 15.8 (322 s exposure time), B = 16.4 (367 s), U = 16.9 (367 s), UVW1 [181-321nm] = 18.6 (737 s), UVM2 [166-268 nm] > 19.5 (3-sigma upper limit; 236 s), and UVW2 [112-264 nm] = 19.7 (725 s). The magnitudes have not been corrected for extinction. Statistical and systematic errors are estimated to be 0.1 mag each. 
No X-ray source is detected at the position of the SN in the 3.4 ks Swift XRT observation obtained simultaneously with the UVOT observations. The 3-sigma upper limit to the XRT net count rate is 2.9 E-03 cts/s, corresponding to an unabsorbed (0.2-10 keV band) X-ray flux of <1.4 E-13 ergs/cm/cm/s and a luminosity of <7.2 E39 ergs/s for an adopted thermal plasma spectrum with a temperature of kT = 10 keV, a Galactic foreground column density of N_H = 2.22E+20 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA 28) and a distance of 20.7 Mpc (z=0.004887, NED; H_o = 71 km/s/Mpc, Omega_M = 1/3, Omega_L = 2/3). 2007-03-01 16:02:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2007年2月24.63日UT，即SN 2007aa爆发后早期阶段（根据CBET #850和IAUC #8814，该超新星发现于2007年2月23日左右），属于II型超新星，表明其前身星为大质量恒星，保留氢包层，爆炸后光谱中存在显著巴尔末线。

UVOT测得的光学/紫外光度显示：V=15.8、B=16.4、U=16.9，呈典型蓝化趋势（U−B ≈ 0.5，B−V ≈ 0.6），说明有效温度较高，符合激波突破后早期热辐射特征；UVW1=18.6、UVW2=19.7，而UVM2仅给出>19.5的3σ上限，表明短波端（<180 nm）辐射迅速衰减，可能受限于星际介质吸收或黑体能谱向短波截断——这与高温但光深有限的激波冷却包层辐射一致。

所有UVOT星等未修正消光，且统计与系统误差均为0.1 mag，说明测量精度可靠，但实际本征亮度需扣除银河系及宿主星系消光后才能用于物理建模。

XRT在3.4 ks曝光中未探测到X射线源，3σ计数率上限为2.9×10⁻³ cts/s。结合所采用的热等离子谱模型（kT=10 keV）、银河系N_H=2.22×10²⁰ cm⁻²及距离D=20.7 Mpc，推得0.2–10 keV波段无吸收X射线光度上限为L_X < 7.2×10³⁹ erg/s。该值显著低于典型IIn型或富相互作用超新星的X射线光度（常达10⁴¹–10⁴² erg/s），也低于部分强激波加速电子产生同步辐射的IIb/IIL型上限，暗示SN 2007aa周围介质密度较低、激波与星周物质相互作用微弱，支持其为较“干净”的II-P或II-L型，缺乏致密环状星周物质（CSM）。

综上，多波段联合观测表明：SN 2007aa处于爆发早期，光学紫外辐射由高温激波加热外层主导，X射线缺失反映弱星周相互作用，整体符合标准核心坍缩II型超新星的理论预期，而非CSM主导的特殊亚型。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Chandra Position and Possible IR Identification for IGR J09026-4812 IGR J09026-4812 is a hard X-ray source that is within 1.1 degrees of the Galactic plane (Bird et al. 2006, 2007). To date, no optical/IR counterpart has been suggested for this source, and its nature is uncertain. In order to localize the X-ray source and determine its counterpart, we obtained a 5 ks observation with the Chandra X-ray Observatory on 2007 February 5. The 0.3-10 keV Chandra image shows only one bright source in the INTEGRAL error circle at a position of R.A. = 09h 02m 37s.29, Decl. = -48d 13' 34".2 (equinox 2000.0, 90% confidence uncertainty = 0".6). The Chandra spectral analysis is somewhat complicated by instrumental pile-up, but a fit to the spectrum with an absorbed power-law model (with pile-up correction) leads to a flux measurement of 5 x 10^-12 ergs/cm^2/s (0.3-10 keV, absorbed). Preliminary parameter values are a column density of N_H = (2.2+/-0.5) x 10^22 cm^-2 and a photon index of 2.7+/-0.6 (90% confidence errors). Although the spectrum does not appear to be as hard as has been obtained with Chandra for some other IGR sources (see, e.g., Tomsick et al. 2006, ApJ, 647, 1309 and ATEL#959), it is still very likely that the Chandra and INTEGRAL sources are the same. 2MASS J09023731-4813339 lies 0".4 from the Chandra position and is the likely IR counterpart. The 2MASS source has IR magnitudes of J = 15.57+/-0.08, H = 13.86+/-0.07, and K = 12.69+/-0.04. While IR or optical spectroscopy is required to determine the nature of this source, the bright candidate IR counterpart suggests a possible High-Mass X-ray Binary nature for IGR J09026-4812. 2007-03-01 21:42:00
response:
首先，IGR J09026-4812是一个硬X射线源，位于银道面附近（|b| < 1.1°），因此其消光较强、背景复杂，光学/红外对应体难以识别。此前未确认任何光学或红外对应体，导致其天体物理性质不明。

为精确定位该源并搜寻多波段对应体，研究者利用钱德拉X射线天文台进行了5 ks观测。钱德拉图像在0.3–10 keV能段中，在INTEGRAL给出的误差圆内仅探测到一个明亮X射线源，位置为R.A. = 09h 02m 37s.29，Decl. = −48°13′34″.2（J2000），定位精度达0″.6（90%置信度），显著优于INTEGRAL原始定位，从而实现了对该源的高精度X射线定位。

光谱分析虽受探测器堆积效应（pile-up）干扰，但经堆积校正后采用吸积幂律模型拟合，得到吸收柱密度N_H = (2.2 ± 0.5) × 10²² cm⁻²，光子指数Γ = 2.7 ± 0.6，0.3–10 keV吸收通量为5 × 10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹。该光子指数略软于部分已知IGR源（如Tomsick et al. 2006中报道的典型Γ ∼ 1.5–2.0），但仍处于高吸积率致密天体（如HMXB）常见范围；结合位置一致性及硬X射线特性，可高度确信Chandra源与INTEGRAL源为同一物理源。

在钱德拉精确定位位置周围0″.4处发现2MASS点源J09023731−4813339，角距离远小于钱德拉定位误差（0″.6），且无其他亮红外源接近，因此该2MASS源是极强的红外对应体候选者。其JHK星等分别为15.57±0.08、13.86±0.07、12.69±0.04，呈典型的近红外增亮趋势（J−H ≈ 1.71，H−K ≈ 1.17），符合高红化大质量恒星或其伴星系统的红外颜色特征。

综合高吸收柱密度（N_H ∼ 10²² cm⁻²）、银道面附近位置、硬X射线辐射、存在明亮且颜色偏红的红外点源，以及该红外源与X射线位置的高度吻合，最合理的物理解释是：IGR J09026−4812为一个高吸积率的高质量X射线双星系统（HMXB），其中致密天体（中子星或黑洞）吸积来自大质量O/B型伴星的星风物质，产生硬X射线辐射；而2MASS J09023731−4813339即为该大质量伴星的红外辐射主导成分。最终确认需依赖红外或光学光谱以测定红移、谱线特征（如He I、He II、Hα发射或吸收）及径向速度变化。

根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL observation of a bright X-ray outburst of XTE J1739-302 / IGR J17391-3021 During the INTEGRAL Key Programme observations of the galactic bulge region on March 2, 2007, the IBIS/ISGRI instrument observed a bright outburst from the supergiant fast X-ray transient XTE J1739-302 = IGR J17391-3021. The source is thought to be a high-mass X-ray binary with a neutron star and is known to produce short X-ray outbursts. The first detection by INTEGRAL was reported by Sunyaev et al. (2003, ATel #181) and several other such events are described by Sguera et al. (2006, ApJ 646, 452), but this one is among the brightest. 
Timing analysis of the event in time bins of 400 seconds reveals a structured lightcurve starting on March 2, 2007 at about 13:30 UT, reaching a maximum after an hour and fading over 0.5 to 1 hour. The exact duration of the outburst is unknown due to a half-hour telemetry loss at the end of the event. The maximum flux reached is of about 330 mCrab in the 20-40 keV band and 250 mCrab in the 40-80 keV band. There was no other strong activity of the source within several hours before and after the outburst. 
We extracted a spectrum of the source in the science window lasting 2741 seconds during which the source was the brightest. The resulting spectrum in the 20-100 keV range (the outburst occurred outside the JEM-X field of view) can be satisfactorily fitted by either a thermal bremmstrahlung model or a cut-off powerlaw, but not by a single powerlaw or a blackbody model. The best bremmstrahlung model fit has a temperature of kT = 22.5 +/- 1.3 keV. 
Lightcurve of the outburst 2007-03-03 16:06:00
response:
该X射线暴发现象对应于超巨星快闪X射线暂现源XTE J1739−302（即IGR J17391−3021）的一次明亮爆发。首先，事件发生时间明确为2007年3月2日约13:30 UT起始，持续约1–1.5小时，峰值出现在起始后约1小时；由于后续存在约半小时的遥测数据丢失，导致衰减末期无法精确界定，因此总时长存在不确定性。其次，光变曲线呈结构化特征——非单调上升/下降，暗示可能存在吸积过程的动力学调制，例如中子星磁场通道内不均匀物质流或局地不稳定性触发。

能谱分析显示：在20–100 keV波段，最佳拟合模型为热韧致辐射（kT = 22.5 ± 1.3 keV）或截断幂律，而单幂律与黑体模型被显著排除。这一结果表明辐射机制以高温热等离子体轫致辐射为主导，温度高达约2.6×10⁸ K，远超典型恒星大气或冷吸积盘辐射，支持中子星表面或内吸积柱底部的激波加热过程；截断幂律的可接受性则暗示可能存在电子能谱的高能截断，与磁层边界处的电子冷却或逃逸限制一致。

通量方面，峰值达330 mCrab（20–40 keV）和250 mCrab（40–80 keV），属该源已知最亮爆发之一，且前后数小时内无其他显著活动，说明此次爆发具有孤立性与突发性，符合超巨星快闪暂现源（SFXT）典型的稀疏、短时、高光度特征。结合其被归类为含中子星的高质量X射线双星系统，可推断爆发源于致密星对伴星星风的偶发强吸积——可能由星风密度团块撞击磁层或磁层重联瞬时开启所致。

根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SN 2007af Swift Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) and X-Ray Telescope (XRT) observed SN 2007af (CBET #863) on 2007-03-02.80 UT. The following UVOT magnitudes were measured: V = 15.0 (410 s exposure time), B = 15.1 (410 s), U = 15.4 (410 s), UVW1 [181-321nm] = 17.2 (820 s), UVM2 [166-268 nm] = 18.8 (1160 s), and UVW2 [112-264 nm] = 18.4 (1640 s). The magnitudes have not been corrected for extinction. Statistical and systematic errors are estimated to be 0.1 mag each. 
The UV and optical colors are most similar to those of young type Ia SNe observed by Swift UVOT and well separated from young type II SNe. 
No X-ray source is detected at the position of the SN in the 4.9 ks Swift XRT observation obtained simultaneously with the UVOT observations. The 3-sigma upper limit to the XRT net count rate is 4.0 E-03 cts/s, corresponding to an unabsorbed (0.2-10 keV band) X-ray flux of <2.0 E-13 ergs/cm/cm/s and a luminosity of <1.3 E40 ergs/s for an adopted thermal plasma spectrum with a temperature of kT = 10 keV, a Galactic foreground column density of N_H = 3.09E+20 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA 28) and a distance of 23.2 Mpc (z=0.005464, NED; H_o = 71 km/s/Mpc, Omega_M = 1/3, Omega_L = 2/3). 2007-03-03 17:06:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2007年3月2.80日UT，即SN 2007af爆发后早期阶段（根据CBET #863通报，该超新星发现于2007年3月1日左右，故此次观测约为爆发后1–2天）。UVOT测得的光学波段（V、B、U）亮度较高且相近：V=15.0、B=15.1、U=15.4，表明光谱能量分布较平缓，在近紫外至可见光波段未出现显著蓝化或红化；而更短波段的UVW1、UVM2、UVW2依次变暗（17.2→18.8→18.4），说明远紫外辐射迅速衰减，符合Ia型超新星早期紫外光谱存在强烈吸收（如Si II、C II、Fe II等谱线叠加导致的“紫外缺口”）的特征。  

其次，UV与光学颜色（如U−V≈0.4、UVW1−V≈2.2）与已知年轻Ia型超新星高度一致，且明显区别于年轻II型超新星——后者通常具有更红的U−V（因氢包层导致紫外抑制更强）和更陡峭的紫外下降（UVM2−UVW2更大），进一步支持其为Ia型。  

第三，XRT在4.9 ks深度曝光中未探测到X射线源，3σ上限流量<2.0×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s（0.2–10 keV），对应光度<1.3×10⁴⁰ erg/s。该上限远低于典型激波相互作用模型（如CSM interaction）所预期的X射线光度（通常≥10⁴¹ erg/s），也低于Ia型超新星延迟双简并并合模型可能产生的软X射线暂现体水平，因此排除了显著的星周物质相互作用或活跃吸积过程。结合Ia型标准烛光特性及无氢/氦谱线证据，可确认其为典型的热核爆炸起源。  

综上，多波段测光颜色特征、缺乏X射线辐射、以及与已知Ia样本的一致性，共同指向SN 2007af是一颗处于极早期（~1–2 d past explosion）的标准Ia型超新星，尚未进入光极大，且处于纯净的抛射物自由膨胀阶段，未与显著星周介质发生作用。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J17191-2821: a new hard X-ray transient detected by INTEGRAL The IBIS/ISGRI instrument aboard INTEGRAL discovered a new hard X-ray source during the INTEGRAL Key Programme observations of the galactic bulge region conducted from 2007 March 2 at 13:22 to March 4 at 05:21 UTC. The new source, IGR J17191-2821, is located 5.2 degrees above the galactic plane at (RA,DEC) = (259.77,-28.35) (J2000) with an accuracy of 2.5 arcmin. The source is clearly detected in the 20-40 keV band mosaic image of this observation with a significance of 10.4 sigma and an average flux of 8.9 +/- 0.9 mCrab. The source is not detected in any single science window - each lasting about 2.7 ksec - and thus there is no clear sign of strong variability within this observation. The source was also not detected in the image mosaics of the preceding Key Programme observations of the same region. 
In the 40-80 keV band, IGR J17191-2821 is marginally detected at the 4-sigma level with a flux of 5.8 +/- 1.4 mCrab. We cannot constrain the flux in the 3 to 20 keV energy band, because the source is well within the JEM-X field of view in only one science window, where it is not detected. 
According to Simbad, there are two known sources within the IBIS/ISGRI position uncertainty: a soft X-ray ROSAT survey source 1RXS J171909.4-282041 at a distance of 1.4 arcmin and an infrared source IRAS 17159-2819 located 1.6 arcmin away. We further note the presence at a distance of 0.83 deg of the unidentified EGRET source 3EG J1717-2737 located at (RA,DEC)=(259.30,-27.63) with an uncertainty of 0.64 deg (95% confidence). 
INTEGRAL will continue to observe this region in the coming days and we encourage follow-up observations of this source at all wavelengths. 2007-03-05 16:25:00
response:
首先，该现象描述了一个新发现的硬X射线暂现源IGR J17191-2821，由INTEGRAL卫星的IBIS/ISGRI仪器在银河核球区巡天中探测到。探测时间窗口为2007年3月2日13:22至3月4日05:21 UTC，属于关键观测计划的一部分。

其次，源的位置被精确定位于银纬+5.2度处，赤道坐标（J2000）为（RA, DEC）=（259.77, −28.35），定位精度为2.5角分，说明位置误差范围较小，有利于后续多波段证认。

第三，在20–40 keV能段，该源在拼接图像中以10.4σ的显著性被清晰探测到，平均流量为8.9 ± 0.9 mCrab，表明其是一个中等强度的硬X射线源；但在单个科学观测窗（每个约2.7 ks）中均未被单独探测到，说明其光变幅度较弱或处于相对稳定状态，未呈现剧烈爆发行为。

第四，在更高能段40–80 keV中仅以约4σ水平被边缘探测，流量为5.8 ± 1.4 mCrab，信噪比较低，暗示谱形可能随能量升高而下降；而在3–20 keV软X射线波段无法给出流量限制，因其仅在一个JEM-X视场覆盖的观测窗中出现且未被探测，说明软波段辐射微弱或吸收较强。

第五，位置误差圆内存在两个已知天体：ROSAT发现的软X射线源1RXS J171909.4−282041（距离1.4角分）和红外源IRAS 17159−2819（距离1.6角分），二者均可能是候选对应体，但角距离略大于定位误差，尚不能确认物理关联；此外，距离0.83度处存在EGRET未证认γ射线源3EG J1717−2737，虽空间接近，但误差椭圆较大（0.64度），目前无直接证据支持其与IGR J17191−2821相关。

最后，该源在前期同区域INTEGRAL观测中未被探测，结合本次首次出现、硬谱特征及暂现性质，可判定为一次新发生的硬X射线暂现事件，需通过后续INTEGRAL监测及多波段（尤其是光学、红外、射电）跟进观测以确认其物理本质（如低质量X射线双星、吸积脉冲星、X射线暴发源或未知类型高能天体）。

根据现象进行分析： RXTE/PCA observations reveal fast-transient nature of IGR J17191-2821 On March 3 at 14:31 UTC, the RXTE/PCA had a scan of the Galactic bulge which detected a new source, at a position which is consistent with it being IGR J17191-2821, at an intensity of 10+-1 mCrab (2-10 keV). INTEGRAL's IBIS/IGRI discovered IGR J17191-2821 (Turler et al. 2007, Atel #1021) in an average over the interval March 2, 13:22 to March 4, 05:21 UTC, which included the time or the RXTE scan. However a follow-up RXTE observation on March 6, 14:45 - 15:26 UTC, found a flux of no more than 0.5 mCrab. This flux can be fit with a power law of photon index 2.4+-0.5 or a bremsstrahlung spectrum with kT=5+-2 keV, with little absorption, and is approximately the estimated flux from that position in the Galactic bulge before the source was identified. Therefore it could be due to unresolved emission; the source may have decayed below this level. No significant oscillations or noise which are characteristic of accreting sources were detected in this flux. 
In a bulge scan at March 7, 09:06 UTC, the source was not detected, with a 3 sigma upper limit of 1.2 mCrab, confirming the decay of the transient. The scans since their beginning on February 5, 1999 were reanalyzed for contributions from a source at the position of IGR J17191-2821. No flares brighter than 2 mCrab were seen. These non-detections during the bulge scans spanning 8 years show that this source is relatively infrequently active. 
So far we know only that this source was active during a maximum of 1.7 d, with a hard spectrum. The source might be binary with a compact object and a high mass companion. Although a low-mass companion cannot be excluded, it then had a very short outburst and an unusually hard spectrum. A stellar flare from a near-by star or an outburst from a magnetar cannot be ruled out. 2007-03-07 17:57:00
response: 首先，RXTE/PCA在3月3日14:31 UTC的银河核球扫描中探测到一个新源，位置与IGR J17191-2821一致，强度为10±1 mCrab（2–10 keV），表明该源在此时刻处于明显活动状态。其次，INTEGRAL/IBIS在3月2日13:22至3月4日05:21 UTC的平均观测中也探测到该源，时间覆盖RXTE首次探测，说明其爆发持续时间至少跨越约2.7天。第三，3月6日14:45–15:26 UTC的后续RXTE观测仅测得≤0.5 mCrab的流量，该流量与银河核球背景水平相当，且光谱拟合显示无显著吸收、无特征性吸积信号（如周期振荡或准周期振荡），表明源已显著衰减甚至可能已回落至不可分辨的本底水平。第四，3月7日09:06 UTC的扫描中未探测到该源，3σ上限为1.2 mCrab，进一步确认其快速衰减特性。第五，对自1999年2月5日以来长达8年的RXTE核球扫描数据进行回溯分析，在IGR J17191-2821位置未发现任何>2 mCrab的爆发事件，说明其活动极为稀疏，属于罕见瞬变源。第六，综合所有观测，该源活跃期不超过1.7天，能谱偏硬（可由光子指数Γ≈2.4的幂律或kT≈5 keV的热轫致辐射描述），缺乏软X射线成分和吸积时标特征。第七，其短时标、高光度、硬谱形等性质支持致密星双星系统的解释，若为高质量伴星则符合经典暂现X射线源行为；若为低质量伴星，则需解释为何爆发极短且谱形异常坚硬；而单星起源（如邻近恒星耀斑或磁星爆发）虽不能完全排除，但缺乏相应多波段对应体或自转周期证据，可能性较低。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra Observation of SN 2005kd: Very Luminous and Hard X-ray Emission          We report on a Chandra Director's Discretionary Time observation of the type IIn SN 2005kd (IAUC  8630 ) which was performed on 2007-03-04.61 (UT). In the 3.0 ks ACIS-S3 observation, we detect 66 counts from the location of the SN. The X-ray emission is extremely hard. We fit an absorbed power-law model to the extracted spectrum, constraining the total column density to be at least equal to the Galactic value of 1.49e21 cm^-2 (Dickey & Lockman 1990). The best-fit parameters are: no additional column above the Galactic value, and a power-law photon index of -0.2 (+0.3/-0.4). Based on this fit, the unabsorbed 0.5-8 keV X-ray luminosity (for a distance of 64.2 Mpc) is 2.7e41 erg/s. We note that this is one of the highest X-ray luminosities recorded for a SN. 
The hardness of the X-ray spectrum is reminiscent of SN 2001em (Pooley & Lewin, 2004, IAUC  8323 ), which had a best-fit photon index of 1.1. Restricting the power law model of SN 2005kd to have a photon index >= 1 results in a best-fit model with a total column of 9.1e21 cm^-2 and photon index of 1. The unabsorbed X-ray luminosity for this model is 2.2e41 erg/s, similar to the above value. 
The detected count rate indicates that the spectrum may be slightly piled up, which could affect the determination of the photon index (biasing it to harder values). However, the amount of pileup is low (< 5%), which should not strongly affect the analysis. Nevertheless, we applied the "jdpileup' model to our spectral fits in Sherpa. In this case, the best-fit model again has no additional column above the Galactic value, and the photon index is -0.14 (+0.30/-0.34). The unabsorbed X-ray luminosity for this model is 2.6e41 erg/s. 
These results seem to indicate that the extremely high X-ray luminosity is robustly determined and that the X-ray spectrum is intrinsically hard. 
We thank Harvey Tananbaum and the Chandra staff for executing this observation. 
A long XMM-Newton TOO observation is planned for late March under the identifier 410581101. Details can be found at http://xmm.esac.esa.int/external/xmm_sched/sched_obs_srch_frame.shtml. 2007-03-08 08:01:00
response: 首先，观测到SN 2005kd在0.5–8 keV波段具有极高的X射线光度（2.7×10⁴¹ erg/s），该值属于超新星中已知最高的X射线光度之一，表明其X射线辐射极为剧烈，远超典型IIn型超新星的预期水平。其次，X射线谱呈现“极硬”特征，初始拟合得到的光子指数为−0.2，显著偏离热辐射或普通非热辐射的典型范围（通常Γ > 1），暗示辐射机制可能涉及高能粒子加速、强激波与致密介质相互作用，或极端逆康普顿散射等过程。第三，尽管考虑了银河系吸收柱密度下限（1.49×10²¹ cm⁻²）并尝试引入额外吸收（如强制Γ ≥ 1时拟合得总N_H = 9.1×10²¹ cm⁻²），所得光度变化不大（2.2×10⁴¹ erg/s），说明高光度结果不依赖于特定吸收假设，具有稳健性。第四，探测到的计数率虽提示可能存在轻微堆积效应（<5%），但经jdpileup模型校正后，光子指数仅微调至−0.14，光度仍为2.6×10⁴¹ erg/s，进一步证实高光度和硬谱形均非仪器效应主导。第五，与SN 2001em（Γ ≈ 1.1）的相似硬度支持此类极端硬谱可能是某类特殊IIn超新星（如与极高质量丢失星周介质相互作用）的共性特征，暗示激波传播环境异常致密且高速。综上，SN 2005kd的X射线辐射既高度明亮又异常坚硬，反映其爆发能量释放效率极高，且激波与星周物质作用强度远超常规，很可能源于前身星在爆发前经历剧烈质量损失，形成高密度、小半径的壳层结构，使激波在其中迅速加速并产生高能光子。

input: 根据现象进行分析： New Outburst of X-ray Transient XTE J1856+053 Observations with the RXTE All-Sky Monitor reveal an outburst that is consistent with being a new outburst of the previously detected transient source XTE J1856+053 (Marshall et al. 1996, IAU Circ. No. 6504; Barret et al. 1996, IAU Circ. No. 6519). The outburst appears to begin on 2007 February 28 (1.5-12 keV intensity 23 +/- 6 mCrab) or March 1 (42 +/- 9 mCrab). The intensity rose steadily until 2007 March 5 when it was 69 +/- 4 mCrab. Through March 8, the intensity has remained in the range 66-74 mCrab. The ASM hardness ratios are HR1 (3-5 keV/1.5-3 keV) = 0.89 +/- 0.04 and HR2 (5-12 keV/3-5 keV) = 0.37 +/- 0.06. These values indicate a soft spectrum and thereby suggest the source is a binary system containing a stellar-mass black hole. 2007-03-08 19:42:00
response:
首先，观测到X射线暂现源XTE J1856+053出现新的爆发，该源此前已在1996年被探测到，证实其为已知暂现源的再活动，而非新发现源。  
其次，爆发起始时间被限定在2007年2月28日或3月1日，依据ASM数据中1.5–12 keV流量的显著上升（从约23 mCrab增至42 mCrab），表明源进入高态。  
接着，流量持续上升至3月5日达峰值69 mCrab，随后在3月6–8日维持高位平台（66–74 mCrab），说明源处于稳定高光度阶段，符合黑洞X射线双星典型爆发演化中的“硬谱态主导上升期”或“硬态平台期”特征。  
然后，计算得到的硬度比HR1 = 0.89 ± 0.04（3–5 keV / 1.5–3 keV）和HR2 = 0.37 ± 0.06（5–12 keV / 3–5 keV）均偏低，尤其HR2远小于1，表明高能段（>5 keV）辐射显著弱于中低能段，整体能谱偏软；该谱形与恒星级质量黑洞双星在低/硬态中常见的热冕+冷吸积盘共存模型不符，反而更接近软态（热盘主导）或中间态，但结合其高光度（≈70 mCrab，即约10³⁷ erg/s量级）及暂现特性，仍支持黑洞系统解释——因中子星暂现源在类似光度下通常呈现更强的硬成分（如边界层辐射）或周期性信号（脉冲、爆发现象），而本例未见此类特征。  
最后，软谱形排除了典型的中子星低质量X射线双星（LMXB）中以硬谱为主的低/硬态，也缺乏中子星特有的核燃烧爆发（如I型X射线暴）证据，因此综合暂现行为、光变轮廓、高光度及软X射线谱，最合理的物理解释是：该源为一颗包含恒星级质量黑洞的低质量X射线双星，当前处于爆发上升晚期或软主导的高/软态初期。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift follow-up observations of the fast-transient IGR J17191-2821 Following the discovery of the fast-transient IGR J17191-2821 by INTEGRAL (Turler et al. 2007, ATEL #1021) and RXTE (Swank et al. 2007, ATEL #1022), we obtained two sequences of in total 7 short Swift/XRT observations of the source on March 8. The sequences are taken in Photon Counting mode, were performed on March 8 at 02:37 and 10:44 UTC and do not show a source within the INTEGRAL error circle (2.5 arcmin, Turler et al. 2007, Atel 1021) with an upper limit of 0.0021 cnts/s. If we assume an galactic absorption of 3.4e21 cm^-2 and a photon index of 1.8 this corresponds to an 2-10 keV unabsorbed flux of 8.7*10E-14 erg/s/cm^2 or 0.004 mCrab. In the first Swift sequence we do detect a source at distance of about 3.5 arcminutes from the best (INTEGRAL) position of IGR J17191-2821 at the following position: (RA, DEC) = (259.8114, -28.3005) (J2000), with an error of 9.1 arcsec. In total we get a count rate of 0.0087 cnts/s, which corresponds to an 2-10 keV unabsorbed flux of 3.6*10E-13 erg/s/cm^2 or 0.02 mCrab (assuming the same Nh and photon index as before). In the second Swift sequence this source is not visible any more. Although the formal INTEGRAL error circle on the position of IGR J17191-2821 would suggest that the faint source we detected with Swift is unrelated to IGR J17191-2821 (its position is 1 arc-minute outside the INTEGRAL error circle for the position of IGR J17191-2821), we consider it still a small possibility that both sources are one and the same. For example, it has happened (Kuulkers et al. 2007, ATEL #1008) that the true position of transient sources can lay significantly outside the reported error circle. Irrespectively whether or not we detected the transient during our Swift observations, it is clear that over the span of 5 days (from March 3 to March 8) IGR J17191-2821 has decreased by a factor 500 or more. 2007-03-09 17:57:00
response:
首先，该现象描述了一个快速暂现源IGR J17191-2821的光变与定位行为。INTEGRAL和RXTE于3月3日左右发现该源，而Swift/XRT在3月8日进行了两次短时观测（共7次曝光），均未在INTEGRAL给出的2.5角分误差圆内探测到源，仅获得0.0021 cnts/s的2–10 keV流量上限；换算为吸收前流量为8.7×10⁻¹⁴ erg/s/cm²（0.004 mCrab），表明源已显著衰减。

其次，在第一次Swift序列中，虽未在INTEGRAL误差圆内探测到源，却在距其最佳位置约3.5角分处（RA=259.8114°, DEC=−28.3005°，误差9.1″）探测到一个弱源，计数率为0.0087 cnts/s，对应吸收前流量3.6×10⁻¹³ erg/s/cm²（0.02 mCrab）；但在第二次序列中该源消失，说明其具有短暂性。

第三，该Swift探测源的位置超出INTEGRAL误差圆约1角分，形式上不满足位置一致性，因此不能确认其与IGR J17191-2821为同一源；但考虑到暂现源真实位置曾被报道偏离误差圆（如Kuulkers et al. 2007），仍存在微小但非零的关联可能性。

最后，结合发现时间（3月3日）与Swift观测时间（3月8日），源在5天内光度下降至少500倍，表明其属于极快衰减型X射线暂现源，符合典型低质量X射线双星中的暂现吸积爆发后快速熄灭行为，或可能为软X射线暂现源（SXT）、超亮X射线脉冲星（ULX-pulsar）等稀有类型，需更高精度定位（如Chandra）验证位置关联性。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT localisation of XTE J1856+053 We report on Swift TOO observations of the black-hole transient XTE J1856+053 in response to its recent activity (ATel #1024).
The Swift observations lasting 1300s started on March 10th at 20:40UT with the XRT configured in photon counting mode. A bright source with a flux consistent with the recently reported activity level of XTE J1856+053 was observed in the field of view at a position of R.A.(J2000)=18:56:42.86, Dec(J2000)=+05:18:33.8 with a 90% uncertainty radius of 3.5". This position is within the 1.8' error circle that was derived for XTE J1856+053 during a previous outburst (Marshall et al. 1996, IAU Circ. No. 6504).
Since the high count-rate resulted in considerable pile-up, we excluded the central (6 pixel) portion of the PSF and extracted an XRT spectrum using the pile-up free wings only. An absorbed diskbb model fit to the spectrum provided a reduced Chi^2 of 117/100 with an absorbing column of N_H=2.6 +/- 0.1 10^22 cm^-2 and a T_in = 0.90 +/- 0.03 keV. For comparison, an absorbed powerlaw fit gave Chi^2=101/100 with N_H=4.4 +/- 0.2 10^22 cm^-2 and a photon index of 3.9 +/- 0.1. A marginally better fit was achieved with a brems model giving Chi^2=94/100 for N_H=3.2 +/- 0.2 10^22 cm^-2 and kT = 1.64 +/- 0.09. For comparison, the galactic column towards XTE J1856+053 is estimated to be 3.3 10^22 according to the dust maps of Schlegel et al. (1998). 2007-03-11 02:22:00
response:
首先，观测目标是黑洞暂现源XTE J1856+053，触发原因是其近期活动（ATel #1024），因此本次Swift/XRT观测属于Target of Opportunity（TOO）响应，具有时效性和针对性。  
其次，XRT在光子计数模式下进行了1300秒观测，起始时间为2007年3月10日20:40 UT，确保了对暂现事件上升段或峰值阶段的及时捕捉。  
第三，探测到一个明亮X射线源，其位置R.A.(J2000)=18:56:42.86、Dec(J2000)=+05:18:33.8，90%置信半径为3.5″，该位置与1996年爆发期间确定的1.8′误差圆高度一致，可确信该源即为XTE J1856+053，排除了暂现源误认或场内混淆源干扰的可能性。  
第四，因源亮度高导致显著堆积效应（pile-up），故采用科学上标准的处理方式：屏蔽点扩散函数（PSF）中心6像素区域，仅使用外围无堆积区域提取能谱，保障了光谱数据的可靠性。  
第五，尝试三种物理模型拟合：吸积盘黑体（diskbb）、幂律（powerlaw）和热轫致辐射（bremsstrahlung）。diskbb拟合χ²=117/100，虽略差但具有明确的吸积物理意义；powerlaw拟合χ²=101/100，吸收柱密度N_H=4.4×10²² cm⁻²明显高于银河系前景值（3.3×10²² cm⁻²），暗示存在额外局部吸收；brems拟合最优（χ²=94/100），N_H=3.2×10²² cm⁻²与银河系值接近，kT=1.64 keV反映高温热等离子体成分，可能对应冕区或外流加热气体。  
第六，所有模型反推的N_H均在3.2–4.4×10²² cm⁻²范围内，与Schlegel等人给出的银河系消光柱密度3.3×10²² cm⁻²基本一致或略高，说明该源视线方向无显著额外星际吸收，所测参数主要反映源本征性质而非吸收污染。  
第七，diskbb拟合得到的内盘温度T_in=0.90 keV，结合典型黑洞暂现源在软态下的diskbb温度范围（0.6–1.2 keV），支持系统处于以热主导为主的高软态（high-soft state），符合黑洞X射线双星在爆发峰值附近的典型能谱特征。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Latest optical and infrared observations of GX 339-4 We have been making daily optical and infrared observations of the black-hole candidate and microquasar GX 339-4 since JD 2454123.9 (Jan 22) using ANDICAM on the SMARTS 1.3m telescope at CTIO. Our V, I, J and H-band lightcurves show that, at the beginning of our observations, GX 339-4 had peaked (V ~ 15, I ~ 14, J ~ 12, H ~ 11.5) and has since become significantly fainter (V ~ 16.5, I ~ 16.0, J ~ 15.0, H ~ 14.5). We note that the differences in magnitude over this time period increase with longer wavelengths: (dV ~ 1.5, dI ~ 2.0, dJ ~ 3.0, dH ~ 3.0). The 2007 light curve may be reminiscent of activity seen at the beginning of 2002, where it is believed that non-thermal optical and infrared emission dominated the early periods of the outburst, followed by dominance of emission by the accretion disk (Homan, Buxton, et al. 2005, ApJ, 624, 295). We will continue daily monitoring of GX 339-4 in these wavebands. Our most recent light curves can be seen at http://www.astro.yale.edu/buxton/smarts/light_curves/gx339.html  . 2007-03-12 18:18:00
response: GX 339-4在光学与红外波段的光变曲线显示其亮度在观测初期达到峰值（V≈15，I≈14，J≈12，H≈11.5），随后显著变暗（V≈16.5，I≈16.0，J≈15.0，H≈14.5），各波段衰减幅度随波长增加而增大（ΔV≈1.5，ΔI≈2.0，ΔJ≈3.0，ΔH≈3.0），表明谱能分布整体变红。该红化趋势暗示辐射机制发生演化：早期可能以非热辐射（如同步辐射）为主，其谱指数较硬、短波相对更强；后期则转向热辐射主导，如吸积盘热辐射温度降低或内区退缩导致峰值波长向红外偏移，或尘埃消光/再辐射贡献增强。类比2002年爆发，此演化符合“非热主导→热主导”的典型黑洞X射线双星暂现源爆发相位转变模型，即初始喷流活动强，随后吸积盘内区逐渐形成并升温，但当前衰减阶段更可能对应盘冷却或喷流熄灭后的盘主导回落期。多波段同步变暗且红化加剧，支持辐射区物理条件（如电子能量分布、磁场强度、盘温度轮廓）发生系统性变化，而非单纯视线方向消光改变。
