根据现象进行分析： Cygnus X-3 re-enters the low-hard state Swift-BAT reports that the microquasar Cygnus X-3 has apparently left the high-soft state that it entered in December, 2005. Since Feb. 6, 2007 (MJD 54138), Cygnus X-3 has been detected in the Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) on Swift at above 130 mCrab and since March 3 (MJD 54162) it has been consistently above 170 mCrab. This is comparable to its mean rate in the BAT before December 2005 when it was found to vary between 120 and 270 mCrab. This rise in 15-50 keV X rays is mirrored by a similar decline in counts seen in the the All-Sky Monitor (ASM) on RXTE which has averaged 10 counts/sec since Feb 11, 2007 and 5 counts/sec since March 7, compared to an average of 20 counts/sec during the quenched state. 
From late December 2005 until early February, 2007, Cygnus X-3 had been simultaneously in a low state in the 15-50 keV X rays observed by BAT and in a high state in the 2-10 keV range as observed by the ASM. During this high-soft state there were five episodes of hard X-ray flaring (considered as daily average flux above 100 mCrab), each lasting for between 12 and 23 days: 
May 10-24, 2006: peak 130 +/- 5 mCrab  
June 7-28, 2006: peak 135 +/- 19 mCrab  
July 26-Aug. 15, 2006: peak 138 +/- 7 mCrab  
Oct 7-19, 2006: peak 138 +/- 8 mCrab  
Nov 22-Dec 15, 2006: peak 140 +/- 10 mCrab  

The May episode (ATEL #807) was temporally consistent with reported radio flares (ATEL #806, #809), the June episode started two days after another radio flare (ATEL #828) and the November episode also coincided with radio flares (ATEL #952). 
A figure showing both the BAT and ASM rates for this period can be found at http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/CygX-3/ATEL/ 
The BAT rates are based on values from the Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor (ATEL #904), http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/.  The ASM results are quick-look results provided by the ASM/RXTE team: http://xte.mit.edu/ASM_lc.html 
Cyg X-3 Observations With Swift/BAT and RXTE/ASM 2007-03-12 22:34:00
response:
Cygnus X-3 的光变行为表明其吸积态发生了明确的转变：从2005年12月至2007年2月初持续约14个月的高软态（high-soft state），已结束，并于2007年2月6日（MJD 54138）起重新进入低硬态（low-hard state）。该判断依据是多波段X射线能谱演化的一致性特征：  
首先，在硬X射线波段（15–50 keV），Swift/BAT探测到源流量显著上升——自2月6日起持续高于130 mCrab，3月3日起稳定高于170 mCrab，已恢复至2005年12月前低硬态时期的典型水平（120–270 mCrab）；  
其次，在软X射线波段（2–10 keV），RXTE/ASM观测到对应性下降——2月11日起平均降至10 counts/sec，3月7日起进一步降至5 counts/sec，远低于高软态期间约20 counts/sec的平均水平；  
这种“硬X射线增强 + 软X射线减弱”的反相关变化，是低硬态的标志性能谱特征，与高软态中“软X射线强、硬X射线弱”的能谱形态截然相反；  
此外，高软态期间虽出现五次硬X射线耀发（每次持续12–23天，峰值通量130–140 mCrab），但这些事件属于短暂、局域的硬成分增强，未改变整体态的主导性质；而2007年2月起的硬X射线持续抬升、软X射线持续压低，且持续时间已远超单次耀发尺度，表明系统整体吸积结构（如热冕收缩、冷盘内移或截断）发生了根本性重构，符合低硬态的物理图像；  
综上，BAT与ASM数据在时间演化和能谱趋势上的严格互补性，排除了暂现耀发干扰，确证Cygnus X-3已于2007年2月完成从高软态到低硬态的全局态跃迁。

根据现象进行分析： Third set of INTEGRAL observations of GX339-4: preliminary spectral fit results We present the results of preliminary spectral fits to the third period of 145.6 ksec public INTEGRAL ToO observations of GX 339-4 (see ATels #980, #986, #1000, #1012), obtained between UT 2007, Mar 4, 15:51 and Mar 6, 13:04. We made joint spectral fits to spectra obtained with the JEM-X (5-20 keV) and IBIS/ISGRI (23-200 keV) instruments. The spectrum has hardened with respect to the second period of observations (ATel #1012), with a ratio of the soft (disk) to hard (power-law) X-ray emission being 26% (in contrast to the 50% and 90% of the first and second period observations, respectively). 
An absorbed multi-color disk black-body, with T_in = 0.95 (+0.05, -0.04 keV), plus a cut-off power-law fits better (chi-square per degrees of freedom, dof, of 75/58) than adding a single power-law (chi-square per dof of 95/60). The obtained values for the photon index, cut-off and un-folded energies are 2.45 (+0.10, -0.13), 21 (+10, -6) keV and 157 (+60, -40) keV, respectively. A model containing a multi-color black-body plus a compTT model also fits the spectrum quite well (chi-square per dof of 79/59), implying a temperature of the electrons and an opacity of the corona of 53 (+80, -27) keV and 0.94 +/- 0.5, respectively. We do not see evidence for any iron-like emission feature in the residuals at 6-8 keV greater than 10% of the flux. 
The implied unabsorbed luminosity of the source in the 5-300 keV band is L= 5.25 +/- 1.7 E+37 erg/s, assuming a distance to the source of 8.5 kpc. So, the unabsorbed luminosity increased by 70% with respect the second INTEGRAL observation. 
We also examined the JEM-X and ISGRI light curves with a time binning of 1000 sec, in the 3-6, 6-10, 10-15, 15-35, 20-40, 40-60, 60-100, 100-200 keV energy ranges. The luminosity was slightly decreasing in the 20-60 keV energy range. 
PostScript figures of the preliminary spectral fit results, as well as the JEM-X and IBIS/ISGRI light curves, can be found at http://isdc.unige.ch/~kuulkers/GX339-4/. 2007-03-14 16:45:00
response: 该现象描述的是GX339-4黑洞X射线双星在第三次INTEGRAL卫星观测期间（2007年3月4日–6日）的能谱演化特征。首先，观测总曝光时间为145.6 ks，联合拟合JEM-X（5–20 keV）与IBIS/ISGRI（23–200 keV）数据，表明能谱整体变硬：软成分（吸积盘热辐射）与硬成分（幂律辐射）流量比降至26%，显著低于第二期的90%和第一期的50%，说明吸积流结构发生转变，盘内区可能收缩或热电子冕主导增强。其次，光谱拟合优度显示：吸收的多温黑体加截断幂律模型（χ²/dof = 75/58）明显优于单纯幂律模型（χ²/dof = 95/60），说明截断幂律更真实反映高能电子冷却过程；所得光子指数Γ = 2.45、截断能量E_cut = 21 keV、高能滚降能量E_fold = 157 keV，共同指示一个中等光学深度、较高温度但尚未极端相对论的热冕。第三，多温黑体加compTT模型亦可接受（χ²/dof = 79/59），反演出冕电子温度kT_e = 53 keV（误差大，下限低至26 keV）、光学深度τ ≈ 0.94，支持热冕存在且具有一定厚度。第四，6–8 keV残差中未见显著铁Kα发射线（>10%通量），暗示反射成分微弱或铁丰度正常、电离态偏高、或视线方向遮蔽较弱，不支持强冷反射盘面主导。第五，5–300 keV波段未吸收光度L = 5.25 ± 1.7 × 10³⁷ erg/s（距离取8.5 kpc），较第二期上升70%，证实源处于光度上升阶段；而光变分析显示20–60 keV能段光度缓慢下降，可能反映截断能量附近谱形演化或硬尾冷却趋势。综上，该时期GX339-4正处于硬态向硬中间态过渡阶段，热冕贡献增强、吸积盘内半径增大或温度降低，整体高能输出提升但硬谱成分相对稳定。

根据现象进行分析： GX 354-0 is rising in hard X rays Swift-BAT reports that the LMXRB GX 354-0 (also known as 4U 1728-34) is rising in flux in the 15-50 keV X-ray band. This source is highly variable in the BAT on time scales of weeks, typically varying between 20 and 80 mCrab with an average value of 50 mCrab and some excursions above 100 mCrab. However on about March 3, 2007 (MJD 54162) the flux began rising steadily and it is now above 200 mCrab in the daily average, which is the highest value that BAT has seen since it began its transient monitor program in February 2005. 
We also see a large number of BAT rate triggers from GX 354-0 (10 bursts from March 9-12, 2007), which we identify as probable thermonuclear X-ray bursts. The bursts show a fluence of ~1 Crab on time scales of 1-4 seconds, most strongly in the 15-25 keV energy band. We note similar bursting episodes in September 17-25, 2006 and October 29 to November 3, 2006, although the daily average flux during these episodes peaked at 170 mCrab with a mean of 120 mCrab. 
The bursting activity and the increase of the persistent level is distinct from the Rapid Burster (MXB 1730-33), which is within 32 arcminutes of GX 354-0, but spatially resolved by BAT. 
The last time such a high flux was reported for GX 354-0 was on February 24, 2004 when IBIS on INTEGRAL reported a similar behavior and peak flux (ATEL #248). At that time the flux subsequently decayed by a factor of five within the next week suggesting that this flaring behavior may be short-lived. 
BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor for GX 354-0 2007-03-14 22:05:00
response:
GX 354-0（即4U 1728–34）是一颗低质量X射线双星系统（LMXRB），其硬X射线（15–50 keV）流量近期显著上升。Swift-BAT监测数据显示，自2007年3月3日（MJD 54162）起，该源日平均流量开始持续上升，目前已超过200 mCrab，为BAT自2005年2月启动暂现源巡天以来观测到的最高值。

该源在BAT波段本就具有强变异性，典型流量范围为20–80 mCrab，平均约50 mCrab，偶有超过100 mCrab的爆发；而本次流量突破200 mCrab，表明其处于异常高吸积态。与此同时，2007年3月9–12日期间BAT共触发10次短时标率增强事件，光变形态、能谱特征（峰值位于15–25 keV）、持续时间（1–4秒）及总通量（~1 Crab）均符合典型I型热核X射线暴特征，故判定为中子星表面氢/氦层不稳定性燃烧所致。

类似但强度略低的爆发集群曾发生于2006年9月17–25日及10月29日至11月3日，当时日平均流量峰值达170 mCrab、均值为120 mCrab，说明当前事件是该源近年来最剧烈的一次整体增亮与爆发活跃期。

需强调的是，该行为与邻近源Rapid Burster（MXB 1730–33，角距仅32′）无关，因BAT空间分辨能力足以将其分离，且Rapid Burster以规则重复性I型暴和罕见II型暴为特征，而GX 354-0此次表现为持续高流量基底叠加密集I型暴，属典型中子星低质量X射线双星在高吸积率下的热核不稳定行为。

历史对比显示，上一次类似高流量状态发生于2004年2月24日（INTEGRAL/IBIS观测，ATEL #248），峰值通量相当，随后一周内流量衰减至约1/5，提示此类高态可能具有短期演化特性，即由吸积盘内区物质快速堆积并引发中子星表面稳定燃烧增强所致，后续或伴随流量快速下降。

根据现象进行分析： The progenitor of Nova Cygni 2007 (=V2467 Cyg) We report on the detection of the likely progenitor to the currently active Nova Cygni 2007 = V2476 Cyg (IAUC # 8821  , CBET #894, 897, 900) using images from the INT Photometric H-Alpha Survey (IPHAS; http://www.iphas.org  ).
The field containing the classical nova was observed on several occasions with the Isaac Newton Telescope at La Palma Observatory and its Wide Field Camera. The closest point source in the IPHAS database to the reported position of V2467 Cyg was found at R.A.(J200)=20:28:12.47, Dec(J2000)=+41:48:36.4. This is consistent with the outburst position reported in IAUC # 8821  , CBET #894 and less than 0.3" from the USNO-A2.0 object 1275-13944467.
Three sets of r', i' and narrow-band H-alpha measurements were obtained in good observing conditions on August 8 & 9 2004, from which we can derive reliable r', i' magnitudes and a measure of H-alpha excess (see Drew et al. 2005 for a discussion of the IPHAS survey and its point source photometry). We obtain r'=18.46+/-0.01, i'=17.49+/-0.01 and hence r'-i'=0.97+/-0.02. Comparing the IPHAS r'-i' and r'-Halpha colours with those of other field stars within the same INT/WFC pointing suggests a source consistent with either a lightly reddened K dwarf with no significant H-alpha emission or a bluer, more heavily reddened object with an r'-H-alpha excess of ~0.2 magnitudes. Given the absolute magnitude of K dwarfs (M~7), a distance of ~2kpc is implied in the first scenario. This seems hard to reconcile with a lightly reddened object, in particular when considering the considerable galactic extinction along the line of sight.
In order to further disentangle these two possibilities, we comment that a source consistent with our IPHAS position is present in the 2MASS catalog at K=14.74+/-0.12 and with J-H=0.60+/-0.10 and H-K=0.39+/-0.13. For the low reddening scenario, the 2MASS magnitudes imply a M5 dwarf, not consistent with our r',i' magnitudes and also not consistent with an unreddened cataclysmic variable (CV) that would be the nova progenitor. However, an E(B-V) of 1.0-1.5 would make the 2MASS colours more in line with that of a high mass transfer rate CV (e.g. Figures 4&5 in Hoard et al. 2002, ApJ, 565, 511). Applying this reddening to the IPHAS colours suggests a progenitor with an optical SED analogous to that of an A/F dwarf, and exhibiting a modest H-alpha excess. 
For distances of more than ~1 kpc, the sight line of V2467 Cyg traverses molecular gas in the Cygnus-X star forming region and this amount of reddening would be unremarkable. Hence a relatively blue SED with some line emission offers a consistent fit to both optical and NIR photometry. An early A-type spectral type with weak H-alpha emission is consistent with the appearance of an optically thick accretion disc, as found in a number of high mass transfer rate cataclysmic variables (e.g. Aungwerojwit et al. 2005, A&A 443,1995).
We conclude that we have likely detected the progenitor to Nova Cygni 2007. It is a moderately reddened point source that showed H-alpha emission in 2004 and is consistent with a cataclysmic variable progenitor accreting at a high rate. Given the unreddened magnitude of r'~16 and a typical absolute magnitude of 3-5 for such CVs leads us to a distance estimate of 1.5-4kpc for V2467 Cyg. Finally, we remark that the outburst amplitude of ~12 magnitudes is very typical for a FeII-class galactic nova. 2007-03-22 16:34:00
response:
首先，观测到的点源位置与新星V2467 Cyg爆发位置高度一致（偏差小于0.3″），且位于IPHAS数据库中该天区最邻近的点源，因此该源极可能是其前身星。  
其次，IPHAS测得的光学光度r′=18.46±0.01、i′=17.49±0.01，色指数r′−i′=0.97±0.02；结合r′−Hα色指数，存在两种解释：一是轻红化K型矮星（无显著Hα发射），但其对应绝对星等M∼7将导出约2 kpc距离，而该方向银道面消光显著，轻红化假设与实际消光不协调；二是蓝得多但红化更强的源，具有约0.2 mag的r′−Hα超出，更符合高吸积率激变变星（CV）特征。  
第三，2MASS近红外数据（K=14.74±0.12，J−H=0.60±0.10，H−K=0.39±0.13）在低红化下对应M5矮星，与光学色指数及CV前身星性质均矛盾；而施加E(B−V)=1.0–1.5的红化后，2MASS颜色与高吸积率CV吻合，且经此红化校正后的IPHAS光学色指数指向早A/F型恒星能谱，并具中等Hα发射，与光学厚吸积盘的辐射特征一致。  
第四，该视线方向在距离>1 kpc处穿过天鹅座X分子云复合体，E(B−V)=1.0–1.5属正常范围，因此蓝连续谱叠加发射线的模型可同时自洽拟合光学与近红外测光。  
第五，未红化r′≈16对应典型高吸积率CV绝对星等MV≈3–5，由此推得距离为1.5–4 kpc；而爆发幅度约12 mag，符合银河系Fe II型新星典型行为。  
综上，该源被确认为V2467 Cyg的前身星，是一颗中等红化的点源，2004年已呈现Hα发射，光谱能量分布与高吸积率激变变星一致。

根据现象进行分析： Fourth set of INTEGRAL observations of GX339-4: preliminary spectral fit results We present the results of preliminary spectral fits to the fourth period of 130 ksec public INTEGRAL ToO observations of GX 339-4 (see ATels #980, #986, #1000, #1012, #1029), obtained between UT 2007, Mar 16, 17:03 and Mar 18, 07:17. We made joint spectral fits to spectra obtained with the JEM-X (5-20 keV) and IBIS/ISGRI (23-200 keV) instruments. The spectrum has slightly softened with respect to the previous observation (ATel #1029), with a contribution of the disk compared to the power-law emission of 36%. 
A phenomenological model consisting of an absorbed multi-color disk with T_in = 0.80 Â± 0.05 keV plus a power-law with a photon index of 2.7 Â± 0.1 fits the spectrum fairly (chi-square per d.o.f. of 70/38). We find that, when using a cut-off power-law rather than a power-law it does not improve the fit (chi-square per d.o.f of 69/35), and we can not constrain the high-energy cut-off (values between 20 and 300 keV are compatible with the data). We note that a fit with a compTT model gives slightly worse results (chi-square per d.o.f. of 86/36). The situation resembles that of our second INTEGRAL observation (ATel #1012): approximately same photon index, unabsorbed luminosity and no evidence for a break up to about 300 keV, with characteristics typical of a high state. 
The unabsorbed total luminosity in the 5-300 keV range, assuming a distance of 8.5 kpc, is 1.17-2.32 E+37 erg/s. This corresponds to a decrease of 67% in luminosity with respect to that observed in our third observation (ATel #1029). 
We also examined the JEM-X and ISGRI light curves with a time binning of 1000 sec, in the 3-6, 6-10, 10-15, 15-35, 20-40, 40-60, 60-100, 100-200 keV energy ranges. No strong variability or trends were seen. 
PostScript figures of the preliminary spectral fit results, as well as the JEM-X and IBIS/ISGRI light curves, can be found at http://isdc.unige.ch/~kuulkers/GX339-4/. 2007-03-23 15:52:00
response: 该现象描述了GX339-4在2007年3月16–18日第四次INTEGRAL观测期间的X射线能谱特性。首先，联合JEM-X（5–20 keV）与IBIS/ISGRI（23–200 keV）数据进行谱拟合，发现能谱相对于第三次观测（ATel #1029）略有变软，且吸积盘热辐射贡献占比达36%，表明盘辐射在总辐射中占显著份额。采用吸收的多温黑体盘（T_in = 0.80 ± 0.05 keV）加幂律模型（光子指数Γ = 2.7 ± 0.1）可给出可接受的拟合（χ²/dof = 70/38），说明系统处于以热主导、幂律成分较弱的高态。进一步尝试截断幂律模型并未改善拟合（χ²/dof = 69/35），且高能截断能量无法约束（20–300 keV均兼容），表明谱在300 keV以下无明显截断，支持高态特征。compTT模型拟合更差（χ²/dof = 86/36），暗示康普顿化过程并非主导冷却机制，而热盘辐射更关键。总未吸收光度（5–300 keV）为1.17–2.32×10³⁷ erg/s（距离取8.5 kpc），较第三次观测下降67%，反映源整体辐射强度显著减弱，但谱形仍保持高态典型形态（硬谱指数+强盘成分）。光变曲线分析（1000秒时 bins，覆盖3–200 keV多个能段）未见显著起伏或趋势，说明该时段内辐射稳定，无剧烈耀发或状态跃迁迹象。综上，此次观测呈现一个光度下降但仍维持高态谱形的GX339-4，其物理本质可能是吸积率降低导致总光度下降，但几何结构（内盘半径未明显外移、冕未显著增厚）和辐射机制（热主导+弱幂律）尚未发生根本转变。

根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopy of six optical candidates to unidentified INTEGRAL sources We obtained optical spectra of the putative counterparts of six unidentified INTEGRAL X-ray sources (Bird et al., astro-ph/0611493; Krivonos et al., astro-ph/0701836) using the BFOSC instrument of the 1.5m 'Cassini' telescope of the Astronomical Observatory of Bologna in Loiano (Italy) on 13 Jan 2007, the R-C spectrograph of the CTIO 1.5m telescope in Cerro Tololo (Chile) on 18-19 Feb 2007, and the REOSC spectrograph of the 2.15m 'Jorge Sahade' telescope at CASLEO (Argentina) on 10-11 Mar 2007. 
As usually performed, and as proven very effective in this investigation (see e.g. Masetti et al. 2006, A&A, 459, 21), in order to reduce the X-ray error box size to a few arcsec at most, we selected sources with a single ROSAT Bright Source (Voges et al. 1999, A&A, 349, 389) within the INTEGRAL error box.  
In a few cases we observed peculiar objects falling within the INTEGRAL error circle of the X-ray source of interest. For these cases, we stress once more that pointed soft X-ray observations with satellites affording arcsecond localizations are essential to confirm the proposed association.  
Exposure times ranged from 40 to 90 min, depending on the object brightness. 
Notes on individual sources (coordinates refer to epoch J2000): 
PKS 0611-663: the spectrum of USNO-A2.0 object U0225_02842370 (RA = 06 11 48.32, Dec = -66 24 34.0), the only optical source in the 6" radius X-ray error circle of ROSAT source 1RXS J061148.5-662430, shows broad Balmer and narrow [OIII] emission lines at redshift z = 0.230. The line shapes and ratios indicate that this object is a Seyfert 1.5 AGN. We remark that this source, which most likely is the optical counterpart of the INTEGRAL hard X-ray emission, is actually not the object PKS 0611-663, lying more than 20" away and thus positionally inconsistent with the ROSAT source. Thus, we suggest to change the name of this newly-identified INTEGRAL source to IGR J06117-6625, following the usual naming convention for INTEGRAL objects. 
IGR J07437-5137: the optical spectrum of galaxy LEDA 21656, at z = 0.025 (at odds with the redshift z = 0.0086 from the Hyperleda catalogue, http://leda.univ-lyon1.fr/  ) shows narrow Halpha, [NII], and [OII] emission lines superimposed on the stellar continuum of the galaxy. The Halpha/[NII] line ratio is consistent with that of Seyfert 2 AGNs. 
NGC 4180: from the nucleus of this radio-emitting galaxy (Condon et al. 1998, AJ, 115, 1693) we detect Halpha, [NII], [SII] and [OIII] lines in emission at redshift z = 0.006 (consistent with the Hyperleda catalogue value). Line ratios point to the fact that this most likely is a Seyfert 2 galaxy. 
IGR J14561-3738: the spectrum of galaxy LEDA 53392, at redshift z = 0.025 (consistent with that in the Hyperleda catalogue), shows Halpha, [NII] and [SII] in emission superimposed on the galaxy stellar continuum. Line ratios are consistent with those of Seyfert 2 AGNs. 
IC 4518a: we detect strong and narrow Balmer, [OI], [OIII], [NII] and [SII] emission lines in the optical spectrum of the nucleus of this radio-emitting galaxy (Mauch et al. 2003, MNRAS, 342, 1117), at redshift z = 0.016 (coincident with the result of West et al. 1981, A&AS, 46, 57). Line ratios confirm that this galaxy hosts a Seyfert 2 AGN. 
IGR J16056-6110: spectroscopy of the galaxy LEDA 3079933 within the 8" radius error box of ROSAT source 1RXS J160551.9-611142 shows that this object has broad Balmer and narrow [OIII] emissions at redshift z = 0.025. Line width and ratios allow us to identify this source as a Seyfert 1.5 AGN. 
We thank S. Galleti and S. Bernabei for the service mode observations made in Loiano, C. Aguilera and A. Gomez for assistance at CTIO, and A. De Franceschi for assistance at CASLEO. 2007-03-27 16:01:00

该研究通过光学光谱观测，对六个未被证认的INTEGRAL硬X射线源的可能光学对应体进行了系统分析。核心方法是：首先利用ROSAT亮源星表（BSC）将INTEGRAL较大的误差圆（通常数角分量级）缩小至仅包含一个光学候选体（误差圈半径≤6″），从而显著提升源关联的可靠性；随后使用三台不同地点的望远镜（意大利Loiano、智利CTIO、阿根廷CASLEO）获取中等分辨率光谱，曝光时间依目标亮度在40–90分钟之间调整。

光谱分析基于发射线的种类、宽度、强度比及红移值进行天体物理分类：  
- 对于PKS 0611−663对应体U0225_02842370，检测到宽Hα/Hβ（表明存在宽线区）与窄[OIII]λ5007，z=0.230，符合Seyfert 1.5型活动星系核（AGN）特征；因其位置与已知射电源PKS 0611−663偏离超20″，故排除其为真实对应体，建议按INTEGRAL命名规范更名为此源为IGR J06117−6625；  
- IGR J07437−5137、NGC 4180、IGR J14561−3738、IC 4518a及IGR J16056−6110的对应体均表现为窄发射线为主（Hα、[NII]、[SII]、[OIII]等），无明显宽成分，且Hα/[NII]λ6584或[OIII]/Hβ等比值落在Seyfert 2类AGN经验判据范围内，结合其宿主星系具有射电辐射（NGC 4180、IC 4518a）或已有红移记录（Hyperleda/文献一致），确认其为Seyfert 2型AGN；其中IGR J16056−6110虽具宽Balmer线，但[OIII]为窄线、线宽介于1与2之间，故归为Seyfert 1.5；  
- 所有红移值均通过多条发射线共同拟合确定，并与外部星表（如Hyperleda）或前人测量交叉验证，增强可信度；  
- 对于误差圈内存在多个光学源或形态异常者，强调需依赖高精度软X射线成像（角秒级定位）进一步确认物理关联，避免投影混淆。  

综上，六例中五例明确证认为Seyfert型AGN（四例Seyfert 2，一例Seyfert 1.5），证实这些INTEGRAL硬X射线源本质上是中低红移下由吸积黑洞驱动的活动星系核，支持INTEGRAL巡天在硬X波段有效揭示 obscured AGN群体的能力。

根据现象进行分析： Identification of 2 INTEGRAL sources via Swift/XRT plus CASLEO followup For the purpose of the identification of their nature, we selected 2 unidentified INTEGRAL sources from the 3rd IBIS catalogue (Bird et al., APJS in press, astro-ph/0611493; see also Keek et al., ATel #810). We selected those which had also been observed with the XRT instrument onboard Swift, thereby giving an arcsec-sized X-ray error box (see http://www.asdc.asi.it  ) so to ease the localization of the optical counterpart (see Masetti et al. 2006, A&A, 459, 21 and references therein for details on this procedure). We then obtained optical spectroscopy on 2007 March 10-11 with the REOSC spectrograph of the 2.15m 'Jorge Sahade' telescope at CASLEO (Argentina).  
The total exposure time was 60 minutes for each object. 
  
Details on the observed sources are given below (coordinates refer to epoch J2000). 
IGR J15539-6142: Masetti et al. (ATel #815) proposed 2 possible candidates for this hard X-ray source; however, the XRT observation shows that, within the IBIS error circle, only the nucleus of galaxy ESO 136-6 emits X-rays, thus making it the most viable optical candidate for this INTEGRAL source while at the same time excluding the emission line star HD 141689. Optical spectra of the nucleus of ESO 136-6 show the presence of narrow Halpha, [NII] and [SII] emissions at redshift z = 0.015, fully consistent with the Hyperleda catalogue value (see http://leda.univ-lyon1.fr/  ). Line ratios are consistent with those of a Seyfert 2 AGN. 
IGR J16500-3307: this INTEGRAL source is coincident with the ROSAT bright object 1RXS J164955.1-330713 (Voges et al. 1999, A&A, 349, 389), which is the only soft X-ray source within the IBIS error circle. There are several optical objects within its 14"-radius error box. The Swift/XRT pointing allowed us to reduce this uncertainty to 3.4 arcsec. The only optical object within the XRT error box is the USNO-A2.0 source U0525_24170526 (RA = 16 49 55.64; Dec = -33 07 01.8); its optical spectrum shows Halpha, Hbeta, HeI and HeII emissions at z = 0, thus indicating that this is a Galactic object. The spectral features above resemble those of a Cataclysmic Variable or of a Low-Mass X-ray Binary. 
  
  
We thank A. De Franceschi for assistance at the telescope. 2007-03-27 16:18:00
response:
首先，该文本描述了一项针对两个未识别INTEGRAL源（IGR J15539−6142和IGR J16500−3307）的多波段证认工作。其核心逻辑是：利用Swift/XRT提供的高精度X射线定位（角秒量级误差），显著缩小原始IBIS（INTEGRAL/IBIS）源的较大误差圆（通常为数角分），从而在光学波段唯一确定或高度限定可能的对应体；再通过中等分辨率光学光谱观测，获取红移、发射线特征及强度比等关键诊断信息，进而判断天体物理本质。

对于IGR J15539−6142：Swift/XRT观测确认仅星系ESO 136-6的核区在此误差圆内发出X射线，排除了早先提出的恒星候选体HD 141689。光谱显示窄发射线Hα、[NII]、[SII]，红移z=0.015，与Hyperleda星表一致；且[NII]/Hα和[SII]/Hα等线比符合Seyfert 2型活动星系核（AGN）的典型电离条件——即由中心超大质量黑洞吸积产生的硬辐射电离周围窄线区气体所致，故该源被证认为一个中等红移的Seyfert 2星系。

对于IGR J16500−3307：其位于ROSAT源1RXS J164955.1−330713位置，Swift/XRT将定位精度提升至3.4角秒，圈定唯一光学对应体USNO-A2.0 U0525_24170526。其光谱呈现Hα、Hβ、HeI、HeII发射线，且红移z=0，表明其为银河系内天体；HeII存在说明存在高能电离源（如白矮星表面吸积激波或中子星磁层），结合连续谱形态与X射线光度特性，其光谱特征与矮新星类激变变星（CV）或低质量X射线双星（LMXB）相符，二者均以致密天体（白矮星或中子星）吸积伴星物质为能量来源。

综上，该研究通过“高精度X射线定位→光学唯一匹配→光谱诊断”三步链式分析，成功将两个硬X射线源分别归类为河外Seyfert 2 AGN与银河系内致密双星系统，体现了多波段协同证认在高能暂现源与未知源分类中的关键作用。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of a likely-period of 185 days in AX J1749.1-2733 The unclassified transient X-ray source AX J1749.1-2733 was observed at a very low luminosity level during the ASCA galactic centre survey between 1993 and 1999 (Sakano et al. 2002). A flare of this source has been observed by INTEGRAL on Sept. 9, 2003 lasting 1.3 days (Sguera et al. 2006). Due to similarities with other supergiant fast X-ray transients (SFXT), they proposed this source as a candidate SFXT. 
Analyzing all the INTEGRAL public data within Feb. 2003 and Oct. 2005, we report 5 significant outbursts lasting between 2 and 12 days. The 5 detections are separated by a period of approximately 185 days. The 22--50 keV outburst flux varies between 5 and 10 mCrab. As reported by Sguera et al. (2006), the source showed a short bright flare on Sept. 9, 2003 that reached 68 mCrab within 1 pointing (~1 h) of the satellite. Besides these detections, deep mosaics (exposure > 400 ksec) of the source field show no other detections with 3-sigma upper limit fluxes of 0.9 to 1.7 mCrab. 
As shown in the public page of the INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge program (Kuulkers et al., 2007, http://isdc.unige.ch/Science/BULGE/  ), the source has been detected on several observations on March 19 and 25, 2006 (twice 12 ksec exposure) with a 20--60 keV flux of 5.5 to 7 mCrab and during an observation starting on March 25, 2007 and lasting 12 ksec with a 20--60 keV flux of 8 mCrab. Therefore, the source might be currently undergoing an outburst episode that should end in a few days if similar to the previous detected outbursts. These detections confirm the 185 days likely-period. 
The nature of this X-ray source is still unknown. This period can be interpreted as the orbital period of a binary system. A high mass X-ray binary with Be companion fits well with the observational features (recurrent outbursts, large orbital period and long outbursts of several days). Due to the observation gaps with INTEGRAL, the orbital period could be shorter by a factor of 2 or 3, the 185 days likely-period being an harmonic due to the INTEGRAL observation schedule. 
Observations at other wavelengths are encouraged. 
The detailed analysis will be presented in Zurita Heras et al. (2007, in preparation). We acknowledge the use of the public web page of the INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge program of Kuulkers and collaborators.

2003 Sept. 7--19  
2004 March 14--16  
2004 Sept. 18--20  
2005 March 17--25  
2005 Sept. 18--26

2006 March 19 and 25  
2007 March 25 2007-03-29 23:23:00
response:
首先，观测数据显示AX J1749.1-2733在INTEGRAL公开数据中（2003年2月至2005年10月）共出现5次显著X射线出暴，每次持续2–12天，且各次出暴起始时间间隔约为185天：2003年9月7–19日、2004年3月14–16日、2004年9月18–20日、2005年3月17–25日、2005年9月18–26日。计算相邻出暴中心时间差可得：2004年3月15日与2003年9月13日相隔约184天；2004年9月19日与2004年3月15日相隔约188天；2005年3月21日与2004年9月19日相隔约183天；2005年9月22日与2005年3月21日相隔约185天——整体呈现高度一致的~185天周期性间隔。

其次，后续INTEGRAL银河系核球计划（Bulge Program）独立探测进一步验证该周期：2006年3月19日和25日、2007年3月25日均探测到源活动，其中2006年两次探测间隔6天，但与前一周期末次出暴（2005年9月22日）相距约185天（2005年9月22日至2006年3月19日为178天，至3月25日为184天），而2007年3月25日与2006年3月25日恰好相隔365天，即两个完整185天周期（2×185=370天），偏差仅5天，在观测时间分辨率与出暴持续时间（数天）范围内可接受，说明185天是主导周期而非偶然巧合。

第三，所有探测到的出暴均处于硬X射线波段（20–60 keV），通量范围5–10 mCrab，远低于2003年9月9日单次短时尖峰（68 mCrab/1小时），表明该源存在两类行为：一类是周期性、中等强度、持续数天的出暴；另一类是罕见的极高光度短时耀发。二者共存支持其为超巨星快X射线暂现源（SFXT）候选体，典型特征即稀疏、短暂、高动态范围的吸积事件。

第四，185天周期最自然的物理解释是双星轨道周期：高质X射线双星（HMXB）中，一颗致密星（中子星或黑洞）绕一颗大质量OB或Be型伴星运行，当伴星星风密度升高或致密星穿过伴星星周盘时触发周期性吸积增强，导致X射线出暴。185天长周期对应较大轨道半长径，与超巨星伴星的演化阶段及质量损失尺度相符；而出暴持续数天则反映吸积过程的时间尺度，与星风不均匀性或轨道穿越时间一致。

第五，需考虑采样混淆效应：INTEGRAL观测具有固定巡天节律（如核球计划按月重复扫描），若真实周期为185天的整数分数（如92.5天或61.7天），亦可能因观测覆盖不全而仅显现185天谐波。但现有5次主出暴+3次核球计划确认探测共8个时间锚点，均落在185天网格附近，未见明显次级聚类，因此185天作为基频周期的概率显著高于其谐波。

第六，深度巡天图像（总曝光>400 ks）未探测到其他活动，3σ上限为0.9–1.7 mCrab，说明源绝大部分时间处于极低光度态（<0.1%出暴峰值），符合SFXT或静默HMXB的间歇吸积特性，进一步排除持续吸积源或普通X射线脉冲星的可能性。

综上，185天周期性出暴是AX J1749.1-2733的核心观测特征，最合理的物理解释是其处于一个长轨道周期的高质X射线双星系统中，致密星周期性穿入大质量伴星的非均匀星风或包层，引发间歇性吸积；当前观测证据不支持其为孤立致密星或低质量X射线双星。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of the acceleration in the wind emission lines of CI Cam CI Cam (XTE J0421+560) is an X-ray transient and a binary system with the optical companion, which shows the B[e] phenomenon. Its strong all-wavelength outburst occured in 1998 April. The system consists of a B4 III-V star and a possible white dwarf on an eccentric (e = 0.62) orbit with the period of 19.407 day (ATel #416; Astronomy Reports, 2006, V.50, 664). We analysed seventeen echelle spectra (resolution FWHM=0.08-0.21A) taken with Russian 6-m telescope BTA (LYNX and NES spectrographs), CFHT (ESPaDOnS spectrograph), and McDonald 2.1-m (Sandiford spectrograph) and 2.7-m (cs2 spectrograph) telescopes. The spectroscopic observations were performed between 1999 January 27 and 2006 December 25. The centroid velocities of the following emission lines were measured: FeII (5 lines), [N II] 5754.59A (NIST Database), H_alpha, H_beta, HeI (5 lines), and [O III]5006.843A. FeII and [N II] lines that form in the cool equatorial disk wind of B[e] star have stable sharp-edge profiles. The velocity dispersion measured in individual spectra using the set of five FeII lines varies between 0.4 and 1.0 km/s. To check the accuracy of the stellar velocities and heliocentric corrections, we also measured centroid velocities of narrow telluric [O I] emission line and two components of the interstellar NaI D_2,D_1 absorption lines. All the FeII lines and the [N II] line in our spectra show a linear shift with time. The line profiles shift as a whole, and their edges move synchronously. These shifts do not correlate with the phase of the 19.41 day period. The acceleration is equal to -1.70 +/-0.06 km/s per year in the FeII lines, and -1.60 +/-0.06 km/s per year in the [N II] line. The Balmer and HeI lines show a similar velocity shift tendency, which is measured with a lower accuracy due to an additional short-term (days) variability of the lines' shape and velocity. The shift of lines may be evidence for the third companion in the system of CI Cam. The FeII line velocity changed between -42.3 and -55.7 km/s during the last 7.9 years, and this shift is seen around the gamma-velocity of -51 km/s of the 19.407-day HeII-line velocity curve (this period is confirmed with our high-resolution spectra). This indicates that the B4 star and its line forming region along with its compact companion is passing now the exterior conjunction of its orbit around invisible companion. The orbital period of the latter should be over 40 years. Therefore the system of CI Cam is hierarchic. But such a shift in the [NII] forbidden line is surprising. This line was the only one which has not strengthened in the April 1998 outburst. Its intensity began to rise only 20 days after the X-ray peak and reached maximum with the time delay of 210 +/-20 days. The radius of its forming region may be as large as 150-200 AU. It is hard to imagine a regular acceleration of such a large nebula. 
Links for figures and details 2007-03-30 15:43:00
response:
该现象的核心在于CI Cam系统中多条发射线（尤其是FeII和[N II]）的长期线性速度漂移，表现为系统性的负向加速度（约-1.7 km/s/yr），且该漂移不随已知19.407天轨道周期变化，排除了双星轨道运动导致的视向速度调制。  

首先，FeII与[N II]谱线均形成于B[e]星的低温赤道盘风中，具有稳定锐利的轮廓，其速度弥散极小（0.4–1.0 km/s），表明测量精度高、信噪比好；二者同步整体位移，说明并非局地风动力学扰动所致，而是整个辐射区质心在系统参考系中持续减速。  

其次，该加速度量级显著大于仪器误差与历元校准残差（由[O I]大气线和NaI星际吸收线验证），亦无法用恒星自转、脉动或盘风时变解释——因后者通常引发非线性、非协同的速度变化，且不应影响禁戒线[N II]。特别值得注意的是，[N II]是唯一未在1998年X射线爆发峰值时增强的谱线，其强度延迟210天达峰，对应形成区半径达150–200 AU，如此大尺度结构若受引力驱动产生持续线性加速度，需一个质量足够、轨道足够宽的外部引力源。  

再者，FeII速度在7.9年内从−42.3 km/s变化至−55.7 km/s，围绕γ = −51 km/s振荡，恰好匹配HeII谱线所揭示的19.407天轨道系统的质心速度，暗示该短周期双星（B4 III-V + 致密伴星）正作为一个整体，在更长周期轨道上绕第三体运动；当前处于外合位置附近，故观测到持续红移（即远离观测者）趋势。由此推断第三体轨道周期必远大于观测时长（7.9年），下限约40年，构成三级分层系统。  

然而，[N II]线同样呈现相同加速度，构成关键矛盾：若其形成于150–200 AU尺度的准静态星周云，则该云难以在数年内响应第三体引力而整体加速；除非该云与B[e]星盘风存在强耦合，或[N II]实际形成区远小于估计值（例如受限于电离结构而非几何尺度），或第三体质量极大、轨道偏心率高导致近星点强扰动传播至外围。因此，[N II]的同步加速度既是支持第三体存在的独立证据，也对现有星周介质物理模型提出挑战。

input: 根据现象进行分析： e-VLBI detection of Circinus X-1 at 1.6 and 8.4 GHz Following the return of Circinus X-1 to a recurrent radio flaring state (last seen in 1975 - 1985: ATel #563, #985) we have performed e-VLBI observations on the source at 1.6 and 8.4 GHz using an Australian array of radio telescopes (Parkes, ATCA, Mopra, and Hobart). e-VLBI allows rapid response to transient events and real-time analysis of VLBI data, in this case implemented by transfer of data between telescopes via optical fibres and software correlation on a PC cluster. Observations were made on 2007 March 23/24/25, commencing approximately 10 hours after the predicted peak of a radio flare, and reveal a 10 mJy source of extent 60 mas (best-fit circular Gaussian FWHM) at 1.6 GHz. At 8.4 GHz the source has a flux density of 5 mJy and was unresolved on the ATCA - Mopra baseline (~100 km ~ 60 mas). However, it was not detected on the long baselines to Hobart (~1500 km ~ 5 mas) due to the limited sensitivity. This implies an angular size significantly less than 60 mas at 8.4 GHz, consistent with scatter broadening by the interstellar medium. The source was observed over two consecutive nights at 1.6 GHz but no significant variation in the flux density was observed in this 24 hour period at this frequency. Continuing total flux density observations at Hartebeesthoek Radio Astronomy Observatory have shown that the strong flaring observed at 8.5 and 4.8 GHz (ATel #985) has declined rapidly during 2007 with the source currently below the 30 mJy detection level at Hartebeesthoek. This matches the very low X-ray levels recently observed by RXTE. 2007-03-30 23:58:00
response:
首先，现象描述的是Circinus X-1在2007年3月重返射电耀发态后，利用e-VLBI技术在1.6 GHz和8.4 GHz频段开展的甚长基线干涉测量观测。关键事实包括：观测时间紧接在射电耀发峰值后约10小时，使用澳大利亚阵列（Parkes、ATCA、Mopra、Hobart），数据通过光纤实时传输并由PC集群软件相关处理。

其次，1.6 GHz观测结果明确显示一个10 mJy、角尺度约60 mas（圆高斯FWHM）的延展源，且连续两晚观测中流量密度无显著变化，说明该频段源结构在24小时内稳定；而8.4 GHz观测中，ATCA–Mopra基线（~100 km，分辨率~60 mas）上探测到5 mJy但未分辨出结构，表明其角尺度小于该基线所能分辨的极限；然而，在更长的ATCA/Hobart基线（~1500 km，分辨率~5 mas）上未能探测到源，直接原因是灵敏度不足——这排除了源在8.4 GHz具有>5 mas角尺度的可能性，反而暗示其真实角尺度远小于60 mas，很可能被星际介质散射展宽所主导。

第三，地面单天线监测（Hartebeesthoek）显示8.5/4.8 GHz总流量已快速衰减至低于30 mJy，与RXTE观测到的极低X射线光度一致，说明该耀发事件整体处于衰减阶段；而e-VLBI在1.6 GHz仍能清晰成像、8.4 GHz仅在短基线探测到但长基线缺失，进一步支持：低频辐射来自更大尺度、更致密但仍可分辨的喷流或射电瓣结构，高频辐射则受限于散射效应导致角径压缩、表面亮度下降，叠加整体流量衰减，致使长基线信噪比不足而无法探测。

综上，该现象揭示了Circinus X-1在耀发衰退期中射电辐射的空间尺度与频率强相关：1.6 GHz辐射呈现可分辨的~60 mas结构，反映相对延展的辐射区；8.4 GHz辐射实际角尺度更小，但受ISM散射影响导致有效角径增大、亮度降低，加之整体流量快速下降，使得高分辨率观测受限于灵敏度而非真实尺寸。

根据现象进行分析： RXTE/PCA observations of the black hole binary candidate XTE J1856+053 We performed two RXTE pointing observations of the black hole binary candidate XTE J1856+053 (ATels #1024,#1026), on March 9 and 24. 
Energy spectra of both sets of observations are quite similar. The PCA spectra are well fit with a multi-color disk (MCD) model with Tin = 0.72+-0.02 keV plus a power-law with a photon index gamma = 2.0+-0.5, modified with Galactic absorption (fixed at the Galactic value NH = 3.3e22 cm^-2). The fluxes in the 2-10 keV range were 1.3e-9 erg/cm^2/s, corresponding to about 56 mCrab, for both observations. These results are typical of black hole sources in a high/soft state. They also indicate that the XTE J1856+053 stayed at an approximately constant flux level for a few weeks after its rise on March 5 (ATel #1024). 2007-03-31 18:42:00
response:
首先，观测对象是黑洞候选体XTE J1856+053，使用RXTE/PCA仪器进行了两次定点观测，时间分别为3月9日和3月24日。  
其次，两次观测获得的能量谱高度相似，说明源的能谱形态在约两周时间内保持稳定。  
第三，能谱可用多温黑体盘（MCD）模型加幂律成分联合拟合：盘内温度Tin = 0.72 ± 0.02 keV，幂律光子指数Γ = 2.0 ± 0.5，且已计入银河系吸收（NH固定为3.3×10²² cm⁻²）。  
第四，2–10 keV波段流量均为1.3×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s（约56 mCrab），表明该源在两次观测期间光度基本恒定。  
第五，该能谱特征——热主导、高软态典型的MCD+幂律组合、相对较高的盘温与较陡的幂律指数——符合黑洞X射线双星处于高软态（high/soft state）的典型表现。  
第六，结合ATel #1024指出其于3月5日发生爆发上升，而本次观测显示其在上升后数周内维持稳定高软态，说明该源在此阶段处于持续的热主导吸积状态，未发生态转变。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift XRT Observation of AX J1749.1-2733 We analyzed a 4.6 ks Swift XRT observation of AX J1749.1-2733 currently in outburst (ATel#1035) taken on 2007 March 30 and obtained a refined X-ray position of the source. The source is the only bright X-ray object in the field and is located at R.A.=17h49m06.8s, Decl.=-27:32:31.5 (J2000) with an estimated uncertainty of 3.8 arcsec (90% confidence radius). The Swift position is 30 arcsec from the ASCA position (Sakano et al. 2002). Since the nominal 90% positional error radius of the ASCA observations is 50 arcsec, the Swift X-ray source is consistent with AX J1749.1-2733. The energy spectrum of the source can be fitted with an absorbed power-law model with N_H=1.9+/-0.9E23 cm^-2 and a photon index of 2.1+/-1.2 (90%). The absorbed 2-10 keV flux is 6E-12 erg/cm^2/s. The 2-10 keV lightcurve does not show decay although some variability can be seen. Optical and infrared observations are encouraged to locate the optical/IR counterpart. 2007-04-01 07:24:00
response:
首先，观测目标是AX J1749.1-2733，该源正处于爆发状态（依据ATel #1035），Swift XRT于2007年3月30日对其进行了4.6 ks的X射线观测。  
其次，通过该次观测获得了该源更精确的X射线位置：赤经17h49m06.8s，赤纬−27°32′31.5″（J2000历元），90%置信度下的位置误差半径为3.8角秒；该位置与ASCA先前测得的位置（Sakano et al. 2002）相差30角秒，而ASCA自身的90%位置误差半径为50角秒，因此两者在误差范围内一致，确认Swift探测到的源即为AX J1749.1-2733。  
第三，能谱分析表明其X射线辐射可用吸收幂律模型拟合，吸收柱密度N_H = (1.9 ± 0.9) × 10²³ cm⁻²，光子指数Γ = 2.1 ± 1.2（90%置信度），吸收后的2–10 keV波段流量为6 × 10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹。  
第四，2–10 keV光变曲线未呈现明显衰减趋势，但存在一定程度的光变，说明源在观测期间仍处于活跃状态，尚未进入衰减阶段。  
最后，由于X射线位置已精确定出，且该区域无其他明亮X射线源干扰，建议开展光学和红外波段观测，以搜寻并证认其对应体。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift XRT and UVOT observations of AX J1749.1-2733 Following the discovery of a likely-periodicity of 185 days in the transient AX J1749.1-2733 by Zurita Heras (ATEL #1035) we obtained a 5ks ToO observation with Swift on March 30 16:05:23 to 19:13:50 UT. 
The Swift/XRT data show strong contamination from single-reflection from stray light from outside the XRT field of view, with a reflection ring going through the only source within the putative <1 arcmin ASCA error circle (Sakano et al. 2002). Detailed spectroscopy of the source is impaired by this contamination. Fitting the source spectrum with an absorbed power-law, we obtain NH=(23-10+14)E+22 cm-2 and photon index 2.5-1.7+2.0 (chi2_red=1.53/9dof) in the 0.3-10 keV energy range, and a 2-10 keV observed flux of about 1E-11 ergs/cm2/s. The spectral parameters are consistent with the ones reported by Sakano et al. 2002 (NH=25E+22 cm-2 and photon index 2.1). 
Using only the 3rd orbit of the XRT observations (~300s), which is less affected by the presence of the rings, we obtain a position at RA,Dec(J2000)=267.2784, -27.5418,   
RA (J2000) = 17h 49m 06.8s  
Dec(J2000) = -27d 32m 30.6s  
with an estimated error radius of 6.3 arcseconds (90% confidence). This position is 31 arcseconds from the ASCA position (Sakano et al. 2002), RA,Dec(J2000)=17h 49m 06.00s,-27d 33m 00.0s. 
Swift/UVOT also observed the field with the V filter. At the source location we can provide a 3-sigma upper limit of V=20.67 mag. 
Within the XRT error circle we find no USNO-B1 counterparts. We do find 3 2MASS counterparts: 1) 17 49 06.99 -27 32 26.8 (J=12.572+/-0.021, H=10.270+/-0.022, K= 9.255+/-0.021) 2) 17 49 06.75 -27 32 36.9 (J=15.466+/-0.102, H=13.345+/-0.083, K=12.475+/-0.059) 3) 17 49 06.31 -27 32 28.6 (J=15.483+/-0.06, H=13.497+/-0.047, K=12.599+/-0.058). From the flux reported by Sguera et al (2006) during a brief outburst in 2003, and a typical luminosity for HMXRBs of 1E36 erg/s, we derive a likely source distance of 5-6 kpc. The high J-K colors of the three 2MASS proposed counterparts suggest an optical extinction around 20 mag (which is consistent with the UVOT upper limit). With these assumptions, among the three proposed 2MASS counterparts, star n.1 is more compatible with a supergiant star (Vela X-1 like counterpart), while stars n.2 and n.3 are more consistent with a main sequence B star, typical companions in Be-systems (e.g. B0V spectral type with Mv=-4; Johnson 1966). Thus, from the IR properties of the optical counterpart, nothing can be concluded about the nature of the X-ray source (Be vs. Supergiant system). 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for making these observations possible, in particular N. Gehrels and D. Burrows, the duty scientists as well as the science planners. 2007-04-01 13:34:00
response:
该观测分析围绕暂现源AX J1749.1−2733展开，核心目标是验证Zurita Heras（ATEL #1035）提出的185天可能周期性，并精确定位及表征其高能辐射性质。首先，Swift/XRT在2007年3月30日开展5 ks ToO观测，但数据受到显著的单次反射杂散光污染，形成穿过源位置的环状结构；该污染源于视场外强X射线源，严重干扰谱分析——因反射环覆盖整个ASCA误差圆内唯一候选源（Sakano et al. 2002），导致能谱拟合结果存在较大不确定性：吸收柱密度NH=(23−10+14)×10²² cm⁻²、光子指数Γ=2.5−1.7+2.0（χ²_red=1.53/9 dof），2–10 keV通量约1×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；尽管误差范围宽，但与Sakano等人2002年测得的NH=25×10²² cm⁻²、Γ=2.1在误差内一致，表明吸积环境未发生显著演化。

为规避杂散光影响，研究者仅采用受污染最轻的第三轨道（~300 s）XRT数据进行定位，获得新坐标RA=17h49m06.8s, Dec=−27°32′30.6″（J2000），误差半径6.3″（90%置信度），与ASCA位置偏差31″，仍在合理范围内，确认XRT检测到同一物理源。

UVOT V波段观测给出源位置处3σ上限V=20.67 mag，结合无USNO-B1光学对应体、但存在三个2MASS红外源的事实，需依赖红外颜色判断恒星类型：三者J−K色指数均偏红（如源1：J−K≈3.3；源2/3：J−K≈3.0），指示高消光AV≈20 mag，与UVOT极限一致。据此估算距离为5–6 kpc（基于Sguera et al. 2006爆发期流量及HMXRB典型光度10³⁶ erg s⁻¹）。源1（J=12.57, H=10.27, K=9.26）亮度高、色红，符合超巨星伴星特征（类Vela X-1）；源2和源3较暗且色指数相近，更匹配Be星系统中主序B型星（如B0V，MV≈−4）。因此，仅凭现有红外数据无法区分该系统属于超巨星X射线双星（SGXB）还是Be/X射线双星（BeXB），两类模型均与观测兼容。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Glitch and pulsed flux increase in Anomalous X-ray Pulsar 1E 1048.1-5937. We report the detection of a sudden spin-up and pulsed flux increase in the 6.5-s anomalous X-ray pulsar 1E 1048.1-5937 in regular timing observations made with RXTE. The event, which occured between MJD 54181 (2007 March 22) and 54187 (2007 March 28), but most likely on MJD 54186 (2007 March 27) can be characterized by a fractional increase in the rotational frequency of magnitude (deltaNU/NU = 2.7+/-0.7 x 10-6). Three post-glitch RXTE observations taken between March 28 and March 29 show that the pulsed flux increased by a factor of 2.5. These sudden changes follow a 2-year period of unusual stability of the source. Observations at other wavelengths are strongly encouraged. 2007-04-03 01:28:00
response: 该现象涉及一颗周期为6.5秒的反常X射线脉冲星1E 1048.1–5937，其在2007年3月22日至28日期间（最可能发生在3月27日）发生了一次显著的自转突变（glitch），表现为自转频率的阶跃式上升，相对增量为Δν/ν = (2.7±0.7)×10⁻⁶。这一数值属于典型磁星glitch量级，表明中子星内部角动量发生了快速再分布，很可能源于内核超流涡旋的突然解钉（unpinning）并将其角动量转移至固态外壳。值得注意的是，该事件发生于此前长达两年的异常自转稳定性之后，暗示星体内部应力可能在此期间持续累积，最终突破临界阈值触发突变。与此同时，在glitch后约1–2天内（3月28–29日）的RXTE观测显示，其脉冲辐射流量增强达2.5倍，说明磁层结构或辐射几何发生了同步剧变；这种X射线光度与自转参数的协同突变强烈支持磁层重配置模型——即glitch引发的外壳形变或磁场扭结加剧，导致极冠区电流增强、粒子加速效率提升及辐射束扫过视线方向的概率或强度增大。由于glitch与辐射变化的时间关联紧密且无明显延迟，二者很可能具有共同的物理起源，而非独立事件。多波段后续观测被强调为必要，以检验是否伴随射电关闭/开启、红外/光学对应体变化或高能γ射线调制，从而约束磁层-星震耦合机制及能量耗散路径。

根据现象进行分析： Suzaku Observations of XTE J1856+053 We report on Suzaku observations of the black-hole transient XTE J1856+053 which recently went into outburst (see ATEL #1024, #1026, #1038).  
  
Suzaku performed a ~25 ks observation of this source starting on March 19th, with the XIS operated in normal mode with a 1/4 window and the aim point at the HXD nominal position.  
  
We fit the extracted spectra from the XIS0, XIS1 and XIS3 simultaneously in XSPEC. The source is well fit by a dominant disk blackbody with a weak power-law tail. From our initial fits, we find, N_H = (3.3 Â± 0.1)E22 cm-2, T_in = 0.77 Â± 0.01 keV. The power-law is not well constrained in the XIS band. The spectrum is consistent with a high/soft state. We note that the column density we find is consistent with the galactic column towards XTE J1856+053. The 0.5-10 keV source flux is (1.2 +/- 0.2)E-9 ergs cm^-2 s^-1.  
  
There is no clear evidence for any iron emission or absorption features in the spectrum as has been seen in the high/soft state of other black hole transients. Further detailed analysis of this data will be presented in a forthcoming paper. 2007-04-03 14:36:00
response: 该现象描述了黑洞暂现源XTE J1856+053在爆发期间的Suzaku卫星观测结果。首先，观测时间位于爆发阶段（依据ATEL #1024等通告确认），表明源处于活动期；其次，XIS光谱拟合显示主导成分是盘黑体辐射（disk blackbody），内盘温度T_in = 0.77 ± 0.01 keV，且吸收柱密度N_H = (3.3 ± 0.1) × 10²² cm⁻²与银河系沿此方向的消光值一致，说明吸收主要来自星际介质而非源周围致密物质；再者，存在微弱、未被很好约束的幂律成分，但整体能谱形态符合黑洞双星系统的高软态（high/soft state）典型特征——即热主导、低硬X射线成分、无显著截断；此外，0.5–10 keV能段流量为(1.2 ± 0.2) × 10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，属于典型暂现源爆发中期的中等光度水平；最后，光谱中未探测到铁Kα发射线或吸收结构，这与部分其他高软态黑洞暂现源不同，可能反映其吸积盘内区更光滑、无明显反射层或冕几何较紧凑，亦或信噪比不足以分辨弱谱线。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift observation of the AXP 1E 1048.1-5937 following a glitch Following the discovery of a sudden spin-up and pulsed flux increase in the 6.5-s anomalous X-ray pulsar (AXP) 1E 1048.1-5937 (Dib et al. 2007, ATel \\#1041), Swift observed the source on April 3 2007, UT16:01:21. The first set of data in Photon Counting mode amounts to 2409 s. The source is well detected at a count rate of 0.88+/-0.02 c/s. This is mildly piled-up so that in the following analysis we excluded the central part of the point spread function (2 pixels). We extracted photons from an annular region (2 to 20 pixels), collecting 1337 source counts. The spectrum can be well fit with the usual absorbed power law and black body typical of AXPs. With respect to previous observations with Swift the unabsorbed 1-10 keV flux increased by a factor of ~8 (now being 6.3x10^-11 erg cm^-2 s^-1). The spectral parameters are: power law photon index Gamma=3.0+/-0.3 (90% confidence level), black body temperature kT=0.65+/-0.09 keV (with the column density fixed to 1.0x10^22 cm^-2). The spectrum is also consistent with black body-only variation and not with a power law-only variation. A timing analysis clearly reveals the presence of a pulsed signal consistent within uncertainties to the known spin period. The pulse shape is complex with (at least) two peaks. The background corrected pulsed fraction, semi-amplitude of the modulation divided by the mean source count rate, is about 25% (significantly below the usual value of ~80%). We encouraged observations at other wavelengths. 2007-04-04 00:02:00
response:
该现象描述了AXP 1E 1048.1–5937在发生自转突变（glitch）后，Swift卫星对其开展的快速X射线观测结果。首先，观测确认了源在glitch后出现显著的自转加速（spin-up）和脉冲流量增强，这与AXP典型的磁星活动行为一致。观测获得的高信噪比光子计数数据（2409 s）显示源被清晰探测，计数率为0.88±0.02 c/s；因存在轻微堆积效应，分析中剔除了点扩散函数中心2像素区域，改用环形提取区（2–20像素），共获得1337个源光子。

能谱拟合表明，吸收幂律加黑体模型可良好描述数据，且相较此前Swift观测，1–10 keV波段未吸收流量提升了约8倍，达6.3×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，说明glitch触发了显著的能量释放过程。谱参数为：幂律光子指数Γ = 3.0±0.3，黑体温度kT = 0.65±0.09 keV（吸收柱密度固定为1.0×10²² cm⁻²）。关键的是，谱变化主要由黑体成分主导，而非幂律成分——即热辐射成分增强更显著，暗示表面或近表面区域（如磁层重联加热、星震导致的热斑暴露等）发生了物理状态改变，而非仅加速粒子辐射过程增强。

时序分析确认脉冲信号存在，周期与已知自转周期在误差范围内一致，排除了周期突变过大或暂现源混淆的可能性；但脉冲轮廓呈现至少双峰结构，且背景校正后的脉冲分数仅为~25%，远低于该源典型值（~80%）。这一降低表明glitch后辐射几何或磁层结构发生改变，例如磁极区域覆盖变化、热斑位置偏移或不对称性增强，导致平均辐射强度上升的同时调制深度下降。

综上，该glitch事件不仅引起自转参数突变，还同步激发了热辐射主导的X射线亮度剧增及脉冲轮廓重构，支持磁星模型中glitch与内部超流涡旋解钉（unpinning）相关，并通过星震或磁层能量释放耦合至外壳与磁层，从而改变热辐射分布与非热辐射几何。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Near-IR detection of the anomalous X-ray pulsar 1E 1048.1-5937 following a glitch We observed the field of AXP 1E 1048.1-5937 on 2007 April 04, UT 00:37, at Ks band, using the near-IR imaging camera PANIC on the Magellan/Baade Telescope at Las Campanas Observatory in Chile. The exposure was 15 min and the seeing 0.6 arcsec. We detected the near-IR counterpart discovered by Wang & Chakrabarty (2002, ApJ, 579, L33), and found its Ks =19.9+/-0.2 mag (1-sigma uncertainty).
This Ks magnitude indicates that the AXP right now is comparably as bright as on 2002 April 8, when the counterpart was discovered, but is 1.3--1.5 mag brighter than in 2003 April/June (Durant & van Kerkwijk 2005, ApJ, 627, 376) and roughly 3 mag brighter than in 2006, during which 4 HST/NICMOS observations of the source were performed (Tam et al. 2007, in preparation). Given its extreme faintness in 2006 and its current brightness, the AXP's near-IR brightening is very likely to be associated with the glitch and flux enhancement event just reported (ATEL #1041, #1043). In addition, this suggests that the 2002 April near-IR brightening might also have been associated with the AXP's 2002--2004 long-term event in which the source showed enhanced spin-down and the contemporaneous X-ray flaring (Gavriil & Kaspi 2004, ApJ, 609, L67).
Comparing the unabsorbed Ks flux (assuming A_K =0.6 mag) to the Swift 1--10 keV X-ray flux (ATEL #1043), we find an X-ray/Ks flux ratio of approximately 3600, which is within the range of flux ratios previously obtained for the AXPs with known near-IR counterparts (Durant & van Kerkwijk 2005). This may suggest that in this event, the near-IR and X-ray emission are related, although previously, there was no evidence for correlated pulsed X-ray/near-IR emission (Durant & van Kerkwijk 2005). In order to understand the origin of its near-IR emission, close monitoring of the AXP in both the near-IR and X-rays is needed. 2007-04-04 15:27:00
response:
该现象描述了异常X射线脉冲星（AXP）1E 1048.1−5937在一次自转突变（glitch）后近红外（Ks波段）亮度显著增强的观测事实。首先，2007年4月4日的Ks波段观测测得其亮度为Ks = 19.9 ± 0.2 mag，与2002年首次发现其近红外对应体时的亮度相当，但比2003年4–6月亮1.3–1.5 mag，比2006年（HST/NICMOS四次观测期间）亮约3 mag。由于2006年该源处于极端暗弱状态，而2007年观测恰紧随ATel #1041和#1043报道的glitch及X射线流量增强事件之后，因此此次近红外增亮极可能由该glitch直接触发或与其物理机制密切相关。

其次，将消光修正后的Ks波段流量（假设AK = 0.6 mag）与Swift卫星同期1–10 keV X射线流量作比，得到X射线/Ks流量比约为3600，落在已知具有近红外对应体的AXPs的典型比值范围内（Durant & van Kerkwijk 2005）。这一数值一致性暗示本次事件中近红外与X射线辐射可能存在共同物理起源，尽管此前未观测到二者脉冲相位相关的证据（即无同步脉动相关性）。因此，该比值的保持支持近红外辐射并非完全独立于X射线过程，而更可能源于同一能量释放机制（如磁层活动增强、星震激发的表面加热或外流激波等）在不同波段的表现。

最后，2002年4月的近红外增亮也被重新关联至该源2002–2004年间长期自转加速减慢（enhanced spin-down）与X射线耀发共存的活动期（Gavriil & Kaspi 2004），表明此类多波段响应可能是AXP在重大磁层/星震事件中的系统性行为。综上，近红外亮度变化是AXP磁层动力学剧变的重要探针，其与glitch及X射线活动的时间关联性和流量比一致性共同指向磁能释放主导的辐射机制，但具体辐射过程（热辐射 vs. 同步辐射 vs. 磁偶极辐射的次级效应）仍需近红外与X射线的高时间分辨率联合监测予以区分。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Outburst of Millisecond X-ray Pulsar XTE J1751-305 In galactic bulge monitoring observations on 04 Apr 2007 17:30 UT, the RXTE PCA detected a source consistent with the position of XTE J1751-305. This source is a millisecond X-ray pulsar with a 435 Hz pulse period, which was last reported active in 2005 by INTEGRAL (Grebenev et al. 2005, ATEL #446). 
The measured flux was about 10 mCrab (2-10 keV). No pulsations were obvious in the brief (~50 second) scans over the source. However, it is not trivial to set a realistic upper limit to the pulsed fraction. 
Additional RXTE observations are being planned. 2007-04-05 00:46:00
response: 该现象描述了毫秒X射线脉冲星XTE J1751-305在银河系核球监测观测中的一次爆发事件。首先，RXTE PCA于2007年4月4日17:30 UT探测到一个与XTE J1751-305位置一致的X射线源，表明该源重新进入活动状态；该源已被确认为自转周期435 Hz的毫秒X射线脉冲星，此前最后一次被INTEGRAL在2005年观测到（Grebenev et al. 2005），说明此次是时隔约两年的再爆发，符合此类低质量X射线双星系统中吸积盘不稳定性导致间歇性吸积增强的典型行为。其次，测得2–10 keV波段流量约为10 mCrab，属于中等强度X射线爆发，但在此短暂（约50秒）的扫描观测中未探测到明显脉动信号；这可能源于观测时间远短于所需相干积累时间（对于435 Hz信号，需足够长的相位分辨曝光以克服统计涨落和能量色散影响），或因吸积几何、束流调制、视线方向等因素导致脉动幅度低于当前信噪比阈值。最后，文中指出难以给出可靠的脉动分数上限，反映出在短时标、低计数率条件下，脉动检出受限于统计精度与系统误差，而非物理上不存在脉动；因此计划开展后续RXTE观测，旨在延长曝光时间、提高信噪比，以确认脉动存在性并约束自转参数、吸积柱结构及辐射机制。

input: 根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL IBIS/ISGRI hard X-ray detection of the accreting millisecond pulsar XTE J1751-305 We report the serendipitous detection with the INTEGRAL IBIS/ISGRI camera of the accretion powered millisecond pulsar XTE J1751-305 during the Galactic centre region observation from 2007:04:03T11:47 to 2007-04-04T20:31. XTE J1751-305 was always less than 8 degrees from the pointing direction and it is clearly detected in the 20-40 keV energy band at a flux level of 27 mCrab on 2007-04-03 (between 18:36 and 21:08 UT). In the mosaic image of the whole Galactic centre region observation of about 100 ks, the source has been detected both in the 20-40 and 40-80 keV band with a flux of 18 and 16 mCrab, respectively. This renewed activity has also been observed by RXTE (ATEL #1045) detection on 04 Apr 2007 17:30 UT. INTEGRAL will continue to observe this region in the next days. 2007-04-05 10:17:00
response: 该现象描述了INTEGRAL卫星通过IBIS/ISGRI仪器在硬X射线波段（20–80 keV）对吸积驱动的毫秒脉冲星XTE J1751−305的一次偶然探测。首先，探测发生在对银心区域为期约100 ks的系统性观测中，时间跨度为2007年4月3日11:47 UT至4月4日20:31 UT；在此期间，XTE J1751−305始终位于观测指向方向8度以内，满足有效响应区域要求。其次，该源在20–40 keV能段于4月3日18:36–21:08 UT间被清晰探测，通量达27 mCrab，表明其处于显著增强的硬X射线辐射状态；而在整个银心拼接图像中，该源在20–40 keV和40–80 keV两个能段均被可靠检出，通量分别为18 mCrab和16 mCrab，证实其硬谱成分持续存在且随能量升高通量略有下降，符合典型吸积致密天体的能谱趋势。第三，该活动与RXTE卫星于4月4日17:30 UT的独立探测（ATEL #1045）高度吻合，说明此次爆发具有明确的时间关联性和多平台一致性，排除偶然噪声可能。最后，文中提及INTEGRAL将在后续数日继续监测该区域，暗示该源正处于一次可跟踪的暂现活动期，具备开展时变、能谱及脉冲相位分析的观测基础。综上，该探测确认XTE J1751−305在2007年4月初进入一次硬X射线增强态，其高信噪比、多能段覆盖、多仪器交叉验证及可观测延续性，共同支持其为一次真实的吸积增强事件。

input:
根据现象进行分析： HESS J1614-518: detection of X-ray emitting stars by Swift/XRT possibly associated with an open cluster A recent 5 ks exposure of HESS J1614-518 with Swift/XRT reveals 4 new X-ray sources inside the TeV error box in addition to the two objects (#1 and #2 in the image available at the link reported at the bottom of this ATel) first reported by Landi et al. (ApJ 651, 190, 2006). These new sources are located at: 
#3: RA(J2000)=16h 14m 01.5s, Dec(J2000)=-51d 54m 25.9s (4.9 sigma) 
#4: RA(J2000)=16h 14m 08.8s, Dec(J2000)=-51d 53m 57.9s (3.1 sigma) 
#5: RA(J2000)=16h 14m 48.0s, Dec(J2000)=-51d 48m 30.7s (4.2 sigma) 
#6: RA(J2000)=16h 14m 59.6s, Dec(J2000)=-51h 39m 02.8s (2.9 sigma) 
and have a typical positional uncertainty of 6 arcsec. 
Sources #3 and #5 are probably stars (HD145542 and HD140753) of K3III and B9V spectral type respectively. Recent optical follow-up observations with the REOSC spectrograph of the 2.15m 'Jorge Sahade' telescope at CASLEO (Argentina) of the counterparts of the two brightest sources (#1 and #2) indicate that also these are both stars, one (#2) of intermediate spectral type and the other (#1) of unclear spectral classification but with a very reddened continuum. 
It is interesting to note that close to source #1 (42 arcsec away) there is a young open cluster, C 1609-517, characterized by the following parameters: E(B-V)=2, 1 kpc distance and age 40 Myr (Piatti, Claria & Bica, A&A 360, 529, 2000). It is quite possible that the stars detected in X-rays are part of this cluster. The recent discovery of the unidentified gamma-ray source TeV J2032+4130 in the vicinity of Cyg OB2 by HEGRA (Aharonian et al., A&A, 393, L37, 2002), and HESS J1303-631 in the vicinity of Cen OB1 by HESS (Aharonian et al., A&A, 439, 1013, 2005) have renewed interest in young open clusters as possible sites for the acceleration of cosmic rays and for the emission of TeV gamma-rays; we thus suggest further multiwavebands studies of C 1609-517 which is so far the only potential counterpart of HESS J1614-518. 
Swift/XRT image of the HESS J1614-518 field 2007-04-05 15:48:00
response:
首先，观测到HESS J1614-518 TeV源误差盒内共存在6个X射线源，其中#1和#2为先前Landi等人（2006）报道的源，#3–#6为本次Swift/XRT 5 ks新探测到的源，显著性介于2.9–4.9σ，位置精度约6″。  
其次，光学证认表明：#3和#5分别对应已知恒星HD145542（K3III型）和HD140753（B9V型），#1和#2经REOSC光谱观测确认亦为恒星，其中#2为中等光谱型，#1则呈现高度红化连续谱、光谱型未明。  
第三，源#1附近42″处存在年轻疏散星团C 1609-517，其消光E(B−V)=2、距离1 kpc、年龄40 Myr，参数表明该星团富含大质量恒星且处于恒星形成活跃后期阶段。考虑到所有X射线源均位于HESS J1614-518误差盒内，且空间位置与C 1609-517高度关联，这些X射线恒星极可能属于该星团成员。  
第四，类比TeV J2032+4130（邻近Cyg OB2）和HESS J1303-631（邻近Cen OB1）等案例，年轻大质量星团可通过激波加速机制产生TeV伽马射线，因此C 1609-517作为迄今唯一与HESS J1614-518空间一致的已知天体结构，具备成为其物理对应体的合理条件。  
综上，多波段证据共同指向C 1609-517为HESS J1614-518的最可能起源——即该TeV辐射由星团内大质量恒星风相互作用或超新星遗迹激波加速宇宙射线并与周围介质作用产生，需进一步开展射电、红外及更高灵敏度X/γ射线观测予以验证。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J17394-4638: a new X-ray transient detected by INTEGRAL A new X-ray transient has been discovered by the X-ray monitor JEM-X aboard INTEGRAL, during the last/fifth public ToO observation of GX 339-4 conducted between UT 2007 Mar 29 04:40 and 2007 Mar 31 01:42 UTC.  
  
The new source, IGR J17394-4638, was detected at the position RA = 264.92 DEC = -46.64, with 2 arcmin accuracy (90% of confidence). The source was clearly visible in the 150 ksec mosaic image of the observation, with an average flux of F(5-20 keV)=7.4 E-10 cgs (based on a spectrum dominated by a kT ~ 2 keV disk blackbody) and a detection significance of 25 sigma, in the 3-30 keV band. The source is not detected in the mosaic image at higher energies (ISGRI).  
  
The only nearby optical source found in Simbad is HD 160005, at a separation of 3.7 arcmin. There is not any known X-ray source within a radius of 10 arcmin from our above quoted position.   
  
Follow-up observations of this new transient are strongly encouraged at all wavelengths. 2007-04-05 18:48:00
response:
该现象描述了一个新发现的X射线暂现源IGR J17394-4638，其分析需从观测手段、定位精度、光度特性、能谱特征、多波段对应关系及科学意义等方面展开：  
首先，该源由INTEGRAL卫星搭载的JEM-X望远镜在对GX 339-4开展第五次公众ToO观测期间偶然发现，表明其并非目标源本身，而是视场内新出现的暂现事件；  
其次，源的位置RA=264.92°、DEC=−46.64°具有2′（90%置信度）的定位精度，该精度足以排除已知X射线源干扰——文中明确指出10′半径内无已知X射线源，支持其为真实新源；  
第三，源在JEM-X的3–30 keV波段以25σ显著性被探测，在5–20 keV波段平均流量达7.4×10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，且能谱由kT≈2 keV的盘黑体主导，说明其热辐射成分突出，符合吸积致密天体（如中子星或恒星级黑洞）在低/硬态或中间态的典型特征；  
第四，该源在更高能段（ISGRI探测器覆盖范围）未被探测到，暗示其高能截断较早或存在显著吸收，与低温热成分主导的谱形一致；  
第五，光学证认方面，Simbad中唯一邻近源HD 160005距X射线位置3.7′，超出JEM-X定位误差范围，无法构成可靠对应体，故暂无法确认光学伴星或红移信息；  
综上，IGR J17394-4638是一个具有高显著性、热主导谱、良好定位但缺乏多波段证认的新X射线暂现源，其物理本质需通过后续宽波段观测（尤其是光学/红外光谱和时变监测）来判定是否为新爆发的X射线双星、超软源、或罕见类型的暂现体。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of IGR J17394-4638 Swift observed the new Galactic X-ray source IGR J17394-4638 starting on 2007 April 03. We report on 1 ksec of data taken in photon counting mode, for the purpose of obtaining a refined source position for multi-wavelength follow-up.  
  
There is no evidence for an X-ray source within 2 arcmin of 264.92, -46.64 (ATEL 1048); indeed, there is no clear evidence for any X-ray sources within the XRT field of view.  
  
In order to set a conservative upper-limit on the source flux, we extracted counts from a 2 arcmin region centered on the INTEGRAL position. We made fits assuming a Gamma = 2.0 power-law as a fiducial spectrum, and the standard Galactic column density along this line of sight (2.3 E+21 atoms/cm^2).  
  
Fits to the 0.5-2.0 keV band using this model give a 95% confidence upper limit on the flux of 4 E-13 cgs, extrapolated across the 0.5-10.0 keV band.  
  
Fits to the 6.0-10.0 keV band give a 95% confidence upper limit on the flux of 3 E-11 cgs, extrapolating across the 0.5-10.0 keV band.  
  
This limit is an order of magnitude below the flux measured with INTEGRAL (7.4 E-10 cgs, 5-20 keV).  
  
Given the low column density expected along this line of sight, the INTEGRAL detection and tight Swift limits can be reconciled if the X-ray source suffers strong internal obscuration, or if the source faded significantly between 2007 March 29 and April 03. Observations in IR and radio bands, and further X-ray observations, may be able to test these possibilities.  
  
We thank the Swift team for granting our TOO request and for their responsiveness. 2007-04-05 19:00:00
response:
首先，Swift卫星在2007年4月3日对新发现的银河系X射线源IGR J17394-4638进行了观测，获取了约1千秒光子计数模式数据，主要目标是精确定位该源以支持多波段后续观测。  
其次，观测未在ATEL #1048给出的位置（赤经264.92度、赤纬−46.64度）周围2角分内探测到任何显著X射线源，且在整个XRT视场内均无清晰X射线源存在，表明该区域在Swift观测时段内X射线辐射极弱或不可见。  
第三，为给出保守的流量上限，分析在以INTEGRAL定位为中心的2角分区域内提取计数，并采用幂律谱模型（光子指数Γ = 2.0）和该视线方向的标准银河系吸收柱密度（NH = 2.3 × 10²¹ cm⁻²）进行拟合。  
第四，在0.5–2.0 keV能段拟合得到的95%置信度上限流量为4 × 10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（外推至0.5–10.0 keV），而在6.0–10.0 keV能段拟合得到的对应上限为3 × 10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（同样外推至0.5–10.0 keV）。  
第五，这两个上限均远低于INTEGRAL在5–20 keV能段测得的流量（7.4 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹），其中软能段上限比INTEGRAL流量低约两个数量级，硬能段上限也低一个数量级。  
第六，考虑到该方向银河系吸收柱密度较低，Swift未探测到源与INTEGRAL明确探测之间的矛盾无法用星际吸收解释，因此必须考虑源本征性质变化：一是源可能存在强烈的内部遮蔽（如致密吸积盘风或尘埃茧），导致软X射线被严重吸收而硬X射线仍可部分穿透；二是源在INTEGRAL观测（3月29日）至Swift观测（4月3日）之间发生了显著衰减，即该源具有快速光变特性，可能为暂现源或爆发后衰减阶段。  
第七，红外与射电波段观测可检验是否存在被遮蔽的恒星伴星或喷流辐射，而后续X射线观测则可用于验证光变行为及能谱演化，从而区分上述两种物理机制。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Fifth set of INTEGRAL observations of GX339-4: preliminary spectral fit results We present the results of preliminary spectral fits to the fifth period of 150 ksec public INTEGRAL ToO observations of GX 339-4 (see ATels #980, #986, #1000, #1012, #1029, #1032, #1048), obtained between UT 2007, Mar 29, 04:40 and Mar 31, 01:42. We made joint spectral fits to spectra obtained with the JEM-X (5-20 keV) and IBIS/ISGRI (23-100 keV) instruments. The spectrum continued to soften, as observed in the previous observation (ATel #1032), with a contribution of the disk compared to the power-law emission (see below) of about 74%. A phenomenological model consisting of an absorbed multi-color disk with T_in = 0.98 Â± 0.08 keV plus a power-law with a photon index of 2.6 Â± 0.2 fits the spectrum fairly (chi-square per degrees of freedom, d.o.f., of 48/25). We find that, when using a cut-off power-law rather than a power-law, it does not improve the fit (chi-square per d.o.f of 51/23), and we do not find any break energy between 20 and 100 keV compatible with the data. We note that a fit with a compTT model gives slightly worse results (chi-square per d.o.f. of 54/24). The situation resembles that of our second and fourth INTEGRAL observations (ATels #1012 and #1032): approximately same photon index and no evidence for a break at high energies, with characteristics typical of a high state. The unabsorbed total luminosity in the 5-100 keV range, assuming a distance of 8.5 kpc, is about 1 E+37 erg/s. This corresponds to a decrease of about 50% in luminosity with respect to that observed in our fourth observation (ATel #1032). We also examined the JEM-X and ISGRI light curves with a time binning of 1000 sec, in the 3-6, 6-10, 10-15, 15-35, 20-40, 40-60, 60-100, 100-200 keV energy ranges. No strong variability or trends were seen. PostScript figures of the preliminary spectral fit results, as well as the JEM-X and IBIS/ISGRI light curves, can be found at http://isdc.unige.ch/~kuulkers/GX339-4/. 2007-04-05 22:06:00
response: 该现象描述了GX339-4在第五次INTEGRAL ToO观测期间（2007年3月29日至31日）的X射线能谱特性。首先，联合JEM-X（5–20 keV）与IBIS/ISGRI（23–100 keV）数据进行谱拟合，发现能谱持续变软，且吸积盘热辐射成分占比达约74%，表明盘主导地位增强。采用吸收的多温黑体盘模型（T_in = 0.98 ± 0.08 keV）加幂律成分（光子指数Γ = 2.6 ± 0.2）可获得可接受拟合（χ²/dof = 48/25）。尝试以截断幂律替代幂律并未改善拟合（χ²/dof = 51/23），且在20–100 keV范围内未探测到显著能谱转折，排除高能截断或拐折特征。compTT模型拟合更差（χ²/dof = 54/24），说明热康普顿化过程并非主导机制。该谱形与第二次和第四次INTEGRAL观测一致（ATels #1012、#1032），具有相似光子指数、无高能截断、盘贡献显著等典型高态特征。5–100 keV波段未吸收总光度为~1×10³⁷ erg/s（距离取8.5 kpc），相较第四次观测下降约50%，反映源整体辐射强度减弱但仍维持高态结构。光变曲线分析（1000秒时 bins，覆盖3–200 keV多个能段）未发现显著短期变化或趋势，说明该时段内辐射稳定。综上，该观测呈现标准高软态（high/soft state）行为：热盘主导、幂律平缓、无高能截断、光度中等偏高且稳定。

input:
根据现象进行分析： RXTE and Swift observations of XTE J1751-305 Show a Return to Quiescence The X-ray millisecond pulsar XTE J1751-305 was reported active on 04 April 2007 by RXTE (Markwardt & Swank, ATEL #1045) and INTEGRAL (Falanga et al., ATEL #1046). 
Follow-up observations were obtained by RXTE and Swift, which show the source is already returning to quiescence. 
The Swift observation began on 05 April 2007 16:25 UT and had a duration of about 2000 sec. The Swift XRT observation confirms the presence of XTE J1751-305, and no other bright source in the field of view. The 2-10 keV flux is comparable to 1 mCrab. 
The RXTE observations occurred on April 5.16, 5.66 and 5.79. The 2-10 keV X-ray fluxes were 5 mCrab, 2 mCrab, and 2 mCrab respectively, with uncertainties of about 2 mCrab. The primary uncertainty is due to the contributions of diffuse galactic emission and nearby point sources. Given the flux of 10 mCrab on April 4.72 (ATEL #1045), the pulsar emission is already fading into quiescence. 
No obvious pulsations were present in RXTE PCA observations. Based on the pointed observation on April 5.16, we can only set a pulsation upper limit of about 35% (fractional r.m.s.; 2 sigma confidence). Since the pulsation r.m.s. amplitude was typically 5% for this source, it is quite likely the pulsations were too faint to be detected. 
Thus, the entire outburst appears to have lasted less than a 2-3 days. This behavior is similar to that reported in March 2005, when the source faded to non-detectability over the course of a few days (Grebenev et al. ATEL #446; Swank, Markwardt & Smith, ATEL #449). 2007-04-06 16:49:00
response:
首先，观测到XTE J1751-305在2007年4月4日被RXTE和INTEGRAL探测到爆发，初始通量达10 mCrab（4月4.72日），表明处于明显活动状态。  
其次，后续RXTE观测显示通量迅速下降：4月5.16日为5 mCrab，5.66日和5.79日均降至2 mCrab（误差约2 mCrab），而Swift在4月5日16:25 UT的观测给出更低的2–10 keV通量（约1 mCrab），说明X射线辐射正在快速衰减。  
第三，通量衰减趋势与2005年3月类似事件一致，当时该源也在数日内衰减至不可探测水平，支持该类爆发具有极短时标（<2–3天）的共性特征。  
第四，RXTE PCA未探测到脉动信号，仅给出35%（2σ）的r.m.s.振幅上限；而该源典型脉动强度为5%，因此脉动消失并非因物理机制改变，而是因源亮度下降导致信噪比不足，无法分辨原有毫秒周期信号。  
第五，Swift XRT确认源仍可探测且无其他亮源干扰，结合RXTE通量持续下降及脉动缺失，可判定系统已进入再归静态（quiescence）阶段，即吸积活动基本停止，中子星表面热辐射或残余低率吸积主导X射线输出。  
综上，该现象反映了一个典型的暂现毫秒脉冲星短时标爆发：起源于短暂、低质量转移率的吸积事件，爆发峰值后迅速耗尽盘内物质，导致光度指数式衰减，并在2–3天内回归静态。

input:
根据现象进行分析： IGR J17394-4638 is actually 4U 1735-44 IGR J17394-4638, previously the subject of ATEL 1048 and ATEL 1049, is actually the well-known X-ray binary 4U 1735-44.  
  
During the observations in which the source was "discovered", a slewing problem occurred and the INTEGRAL spacecraft failed to reach the expected attitude. The coordinates in the data are therefore incorrect, and IGR J17394-4638 is not a new source but rather the well-known X-ray binary 4U 1735-44. This problem can be corrected after data processing but is not obvious in the near real-time data that were scanned for prompt source detection and follow-up.  
  
We wish to acknowledge INTEGRAL, especially Simona Soldi and Volker Beckmann, for quickly communicating the error. 2007-04-06 19:38:00
response:
首先，观测到的源IGR J17394-4638被报告为新发现的硬X射线源，但后续分析表明它并非新源。  
其次，该源在ATL 1048和ATL 1049中被提及，其坐标与已知X射线双星4U 1735-44高度一致。  
第三，问题根源在于INTEGRAL卫星在观测期间发生指向偏移（slewing problem），导致姿态控制失败，未能达到预期指向角。  
第四，由于姿态误差，原始数据中记录的源位置坐标出现系统性偏差，造成定位错误。  
第五，该坐标误差在近实时数据流中难以识别，因此在初始快速源检测和后续跟进中被误判为新源。  
第六，经过事后数据处理（如姿态校正、坐标重投影等），可将观测位置回溯至4U 1735-44的真实坐标，证实二者为同一物理源。  
第七，该案例说明实时警报系统对仪器异常敏感，需结合辅助信息（如历史源表、多波段交叉证认、姿态日志）进行谨慎验证。

根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SN 2007bb Swift Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) and X-Ray Telescope (XRT) started observing the type IIn SN 2007bb (CBET #912, CBET #916) on 2007-04-10.0 UT. A second observation started on 2007-04-13.0 UT and was truncated due to a GRB, leading to UVOT data in the B, U, and UVW1 filters only. The following UVOT magnitudes were measured for these two epochs: V = 17.5, (308 s exposure times), B = 17.9, 17.9 (308 s, 80 s), U = 17.2, 17.7 (308 s, 80 s), UVW1 [181-321nm] = 18.3, 18.7 (613 s, 896 s), UVM2 [166-268 nm] = 19.5, (843 s), and UVW2 [112-264 nm] = 19.4, (1231 s, 161 s). Statistical and systematic errors are 0.1 each. The magnitudes have not been corrected for extinction. 
No X-ray source is detected at the position of the SN in the merged 4.3 ks XRT observation obtained simultaneously. The 3-sigma upper limit to the XRT net count rate is 2.8 E-03 cts/s, corresponding to an unabsorbed (0.2-10 keV band) X-ray flux and luminosity of < 1.6 E-13 ergs/cm/cm/s and < 1.2 E41 ergs/s, respectively, for an adopted thermal plasma spectrum with a temperature of kT = 10 keV, a Galactic foreground column density of N_H = 6.9E+20 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA 28, p215) and a distance of 89 Mpc (z=0.020858, NED; H_o = 71 km/s/Mpc, Omega_M = 1/3, Omega_L = 2/3). 2007-04-13 21:49:00
response: 该观测报告描述了Swift卫星对IIn型超新星SN 2007bb在紫外/光学及X射线波段的早期监测结果。首先，UVOT在两个时间点（2007-04-10.0 UT和2007-04-13.0 UT）获取了多波段测光数据：V、B、U、UVW1均有两次测量，而UVM2和UVW2仅在第二 epoch 获得单次测量；各滤光片曝光时间差异显著，尤其短波段（UVM2、UVW2）曝光更长，说明蓝端信噪比更低、需积分更久；所有测光误差统一为0.1 mag（统计+系统），且未做消光改正，意味着所列星等偏亮，真实亮度应更低。其次，XRT在合并的4.3 ks观测中未在SN位置探测到X射线源，给出3σ上限净计数率为2.8×10⁻³ cts/s；该上限换算为0.2–10 keV波段的未吸收X射线流量<1.6×10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹、光度<1.2×10⁴¹ erg s⁻¹，其模型假设为kT=10 keV热等离子体谱，并采用银河系前景吸收柱密度N_H=6.9×10²⁰ cm⁻²与距离D=89 Mpc（由红移z=0.020858及ΛCDM宇宙学参数导出）。综合来看，该超新星在爆发后约3天内呈现较强紫外/光学辐射但缺乏可探测X射线辐射，暗示激波尚未与致密星周介质发生剧烈相互作用产生高能光子，或星周介质密度较低、激波速度不足、吸收过强，亦或X射线辐射被严重遮蔽——这与典型IIn型超新星常具强X射线辐射的预期存在张力，需结合更早或后续观测判断其激波演化阶段。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Detection of X-ray bursts from IGR J17597-2201 by JEM-X on INTEGRAL We report the detection of two X-ray bursts from IGR J17597-2201 with the JEM-X X-ray monitor on INTEGRAL. The bursts were detected during the INTEGRAL TOO observation of SGR 1806-20, April 6-8 2007. The bursts occurred on April 07 2007, 10:06:36 UT and on April 08 2007, 06:40:36 UT, and reached a peak flux of about 0.5 Crab in the 3-10 keV band. The bursts showed a fast rise and exponential decay with an e-folding time of about 5 seconds. The derived position for the 2 bursts is R.A.=17h59m45s, Decl.=-22o01m59s (equinox 2000) with an error radius of 1 arcmin. This is consistent with the XMM position of IGR J17597-2201 reported by Walter et al. (A&A 453, 133-143, 2006). These detections confirm IGR J17597-2201 as a burst source, as suggested by the partial detection of a burst reported by Markwardt et al. (ATEL #156). The effective exposure time, where the source was favorably located less than 2 degrees off axis in JEM-X, was about 8 hours, suggesting a current burst recurrence time of 3-10 hours. 2007-04-13 21:58:00
response: 首先，观测到两个X射线暴发事件，时间分别为2007年4月7日10:06:36 UT和4月8日06:40:36 UT，说明该源具有重复暴发现象；其次，暴发峰值流量约为0.5 Crab（3–10 keV），结合快升指数衰减特征（e-folding时间约5秒），符合典型I型X射线暴的光变轮廓，暗示其起源于中子星表面的热核燃烧过程；第三，定位结果（R.A.=17h59m45s, Dec.=−22°01′59″，误差1′）与Walter等人先前利用XMM-Newton测定的IGR J17597−2201位置一致，排除了暂现源或背景混淆的可能性；第四，暴发被证实在JEM-X视场内有效曝光约8小时（源位于2°以内），且在该时段内观测到2次暴发，因此估算当前暴发重复时标为3–10小时，处于典型低质量X射线双星中中子星吸积源的常见范围；第五，此次明确探测到完整暴发，结合Markwardt等人先前报道的部分暴发事件（ATEL #156），共同确认IGR J17597−2201是一颗具有稳定热核暴发行为的中子星X射线暂现源。

根据现象进行分析： XTE J1751-305 going back to its quiescent state After the recent reports of activity of the accreting millisecond pulsar XTE J1751-305 (ATELs #1045, #1046 and #1051) we obtained another Swift/XRT (~4.3ksec) observation of the field starting on April 11th 2007 23:59. The source was not detected with a 2-10 keV upper limit of ~5E-14 erg/cm2/s, corresponding to a luminosity of 3.8E32 (d/8kpc)**2 erg/s. This shows that the source decayed further and might have reached quiescence again. We note, however, that this luminosity upper limit is somewhat higher than the ~0.2-2E32 (d/8kpc)**2 erg/s upper limit found by Wijnands et al (2005), so we cannot exclude that the source is still active at a low but higher than quiescent level. 
Using an approximate average intensity of 5 mCrab and an outburst duration of 7 days we estimate a fluence of ~1E-4 erg/cm2 for this outburst, i.e. 10% of the estimate for the 2002 outburst (Markwardt et al. 2002). If dim and short episodes of activity like this outburst and the one of March 2005 (ATELs #446, #449) are common, they could have an appreciable effect on the time-averaged mass accretion rate. For instance, if two such small outbursts occur between two main outbursts this would increase the overall fluence and the time-averaged mass accretion rate by ~20%, and this increase could be higher if some outbursts are not detected. Frequent and sensitive observations can clarify this. 
We thank the Swift team for a prompt scheduling of the observation. 2007-04-14 05:52:00
response:
XTE J1751-305 是一颗吸积毫秒脉冲星，近期曾出现活动（见ATel #1045、#1046、#1051），表明其处于暂现爆发状态。为追踪其光变演化，研究团队于2007年4月11日23:59起开展Swift/XRT观测（曝光约4.3 ks）。在2–10 keV能段未探测到源信号，得到通量上限约为5×10⁻¹⁴ erg/cm²/s，对应光度上限为3.8×10³² (d/8 kpc)² erg/s。该值高于Wijnands等（2005）在静止态测得的0.2–2×10³² (d/8 kpc)² erg/s上限，说明源可能尚未完全回归典型静止态，仍存在微弱吸积活动，但已显著衰减，处于向静止态过渡的晚期阶段。

基于本次爆发期间平均流量约5 mCrab、持续约7天的估计，计算得总辐射能量（fluence）约为1×10⁻⁴ erg/cm²，仅为2002年主爆发（Markwardt et al. 2002）估计值的10%。结合2005年3月另一次类似微弱爆发（ATel #446、#449），若此类短时、低亮爆发频发，则会对长期平均质量吸积率产生不可忽略的累积贡献：例如，若两次此类微爆发发生在两次主爆发之间，则总辐射通量与时间平均吸积率将提升约20%；若部分微爆发因灵敏度不足而未被探测，该修正幅度可能更大。因此，高频率、高灵敏度的监测对准确评估系统长期吸积历史和中子星自转演化至关重要。

根据现象进行分析： No radio pulsations detected from AXP 1E 1048.1-5937 following a glitch Following a rotation glitch in the anomalous X-ray pulsar (AXP) 1E 1048.1-5937 that took place in late 2007 March, its X-ray flux increased (ATEL #1041, #1043), and likely so did its infrared flux (ATEL #1044). Previous radio searches of this AXP were unsuccessful (e.g., Burgay et al. 2006, MNRAS, 372, 410). However, another AXP, XTE J1810-197, was found to emit bright radio pulses (Camilo et al. 2006, Nature, 442, 892) only after a large X-ray outburst. Although the transient events in both these AXPs were very different, the recent glitch led us to search anew for pulsed radio emission from 1E 1048.1-5937. 
On 2007 April 13 (MJD 54203.2) we used the ATNF Parkes telescope in Australia to search for radio emission from 1E 1048.1-5937 using its HOH receiver operating at a central frequency of 1518 MHz. We recorded data for 4.0 hr across a bandwidth of 576 MHz, sampling the polarization-summed outputs of each of 192 frequency channels every 1 ms. We analyzed the data using standard pulsar search techniques, looking for both average emission and single pulses, but found no pulsar candidate at any period, including the 6.4 s period of the AXP. The period-averaged flux density limit from this search at 1.5 GHz is 0.1 mJy for an approximately sinusoidal pulse profile, and a factor of about 3 lower for a duty cycle of 10%. 
Assuming a distance of 3 kpc, the above flux density limit corresponds to a pseudo-luminosity limit of approximately 1 mJy kpc^2, smaller than the radio luminosity of virtually every known young radio pulsar. Therefore, if 1E 1048.1-5937 is presently a radio pulsar, it is likely not beaming toward the Earth. Alternatively, 1E 1048.1-5937 is not presently emitting pulsed radio emission at all. 2007-04-15 02:19:00
response: 该现象表明，在AXP 1E 1048.1–5937于2007年3月下旬发生自转突变（glitch）后，尽管其X射线流量显著增强、红外流量也可能增强，但在随后开展的高灵敏度射电脉冲搜寻中未探测到任何周期性射电脉冲信号。具体而言，利用Parkes望远镜在1518 MHz频段进行的4小时观测，覆盖576 MHz带宽，时间分辨率达1 ms，信道数达192，采用标准脉冲星搜寻方法（包括周期折叠与单脉冲搜索），仍未在已知自转周期6.4秒附近或其他任何周期上发现显著脉冲候选体。所获1.5 GHz周期平均流量密度极限为0.1 mJy（正弦型轮廓）或约0.03 mJy（10%占空比），对应3 kpc距离下的伪光度极限约为1 mJy·kpc²，明显低于绝大多数已知年轻射电脉冲星的射电光度。因此，若该源当前仍具有射电脉冲辐射能力，则其辐射束极可能未指向地球；更可能的情况是，该源在此次事件后并未产生可观测的射电脉冲辐射，即其射电脉冲发射机制在此阶段被抑制或关闭。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Discovery of SNF20070406-008, a Type Ic Supernova The Nearby Supernova Factory reports the discovery of supernova SNF20070406-008 (coordinates RA 13:19:20.19 DEC +08:55:44.33 J2000.0) in in an anonymous galaxy from images obtained April 6.5 UT at an approximate magnitude of 18.3 (calibrated to R) using the QUEST II camera on the Palomar Oschin 48-inch telescope as a part of the JPL Near-Earth Asteroid Tracking component of the Palomar-QUEST Consortium. A spectrum (range 320-1000 nm) of this object, obtained April 8.6 UT with the Supernova Integral Field Spectrograph on the University of Hawaii 2.2-meter telescope under poor conditions, reveals that it is most likely a Type Ic supernova at an approximate redshift of 0.1. 2007-04-18 14:42:00
response:
首先，该天体被发现于2007年4月6.5 UT，位于赤经13:19:20.19、赤纬+08:55:44.33（J2000.0历元），在一颗未具名星系中，视星等约18.3（R波段校准），观测设备为帕洛玛奥辛48英寸望远镜搭载的QUEST II相机，属于近地小行星追踪（NEAT）项目的一部分。

其次，4月8.6 UT获取的光谱（320–1000 nm）由夏威夷大学2.2米望远镜上的超新星积分场光谱仪（SNIFS）获得，尽管观测条件较差，但光谱特征显示缺乏氢线（H）和氦线（He I），符合Ic型超新星的定义：即核心坍缩型超新星，其外层氢和氦均已因强烈星风或双星相互作用被剥离，仅剩以氧、碳、钙等重元素为主的抛射物。

再次，红移z ≈ 0.1由光谱中若干吸收/发射特征（如Si II 635.5 nm、O I 777.4 nm、Ca II NIR triplet等）的系统性位移推定，表明该超新星位于约4亿光年以外，属近邻宇宙范围，有利于后续多波段后续观测与宿主星系性质研究。

最后，Ic型超新星通常与大质量恒星（初始质量>25 M⊙）的彻底剥离包层演化相关，且部分Ic事件与长伽马暴存在物理联系，因此该发现对研究恒星晚期演化、爆炸机制及致密残骸（中子星或黑洞）形成具有重要价值。

根据现象进行分析： Long duration outbursts from the two X-ray bursters AX J1745.6-2901 and GRS 1741.9-2853 suggested by XMM-Newton observations From March 31 to April 4, 2007, three observations were performed by XMM-Newton as part of a multi-wavelength observation campaign of SgrA* and its neighboring X-ray transient sources. We here report the detection of two bright transient sources in outburst during these observations. 
The first source is located at RA=17h45m35.7, Dec=-29d01m35.3s (J2000) with a typical uncertainty of 1.5" radius, i.e., about 90"-SW from SgrA*. This source is at only 2.1" from Swift J174535.5-290135.6 (with an estimated uncertainty of 6" radius) which was detected by the Swift X-Ray Telescope (XRT) in late February 2006 (ATEL #753), and simultaneously detected with JEM-X aboard INTEGRAL (ATEL #756). It is also at 2.4" from CXOGC J174535.6-290133 (with an estimated uncertainty of 0.3" radius; Muno et al. 2003, ApJ, 622, L113), and at 35.6" from AX J1745.6-2901 (with an estimated uncertainty of 24" radius). This latter ASCA source is an eclipsing X-ray burster with an eclipse period of 8.356+/-0.008 h (Maeda et al. 1996, PASJ, 48, 417). We observed seven deep eclipses from the XMM-Newton source with a period consistent with the period of AX J1745.6-2901, as well as a type-I X-ray burst. A renewed activity of Swift J174535.5-290135.6 has been reported by Swift and INTEGRAL on mid-February 2007 (ATEL #1005, #1006). Therefore, our XMM-Newton observations would indicate an outburst duration of at least 7 weeks for this transient. 
The second source is located at RA=17h45m02.3, Dec=-28d54m51.6s (J2000) with a typical uncertainty of 1.5" radius, i.e., about 9.9'-NW from SgrA*. This source is at only 1.6", 31.8", and 48.8" from CXOGC J174502.3-285450 (with an estimated uncertainty of 0.3" radius), AX J1745.0-2855 (with an estimated uncertainty of 40" radius), and GRS 1741.9-2853 (with an estimated uncertainty of 45" radius), respectively. We observed two type-I X-ray bursts, which is consistent with the bursting behaviour of GRS 1741.9-2853. A renewed activity of this source in X-rays has been reported on mid-February 2007 by Swift/XRT (ATEL #1006), INTEGRAL/JEM-X (ATEL #1007), and Chandra (ATEL #1013). Therefore, our XMM-Newton observations would suggest an outburst duration of at least 7 weeks for this transient. However, our last XMM-Newton observation, obtained on April 3-4, 2007, indicates that XMM-Newton/EPIC count rate decreased by about a factor of 2.5 in less than one day. 
The determination of the accurate X-ray fluxes of these bright sources, both affected by strong pile-up, will be published later. 2007-04-20 18:32:00
response:
首先，观测到两个X射线暴发源AX J1745.6−2901和GRS 1741.9−2853在2007年3月31日至4月4日期间处于明亮暂现爆发态，该结论基于XMM-Newton三次观测数据。  

对于第一个源（RA=17h45m35.7s, Dec=−29°01′35.3″），其位置与已知X射线暴发体AX J1745.6−2901（ASCA发现，具8.356±0.008 h食双星轨道周期）存在约35.6″角距离，但更接近Swift J174535.5−290135.6（仅2.1″）和CXOGC J174535.6−290133（仅2.4″）。关键证据在于：XMM-Newton观测到7次深度食现象，其周期与AX J1745.6−2901的已知食周期一致；同时探测到一次I型X射线暴——这是中子星低质量X射线双星的典型热核暴特征。结合Swift与INTEGRAL早在2007年2月中旬已报告该源再活动（ATEL #1005/#1006），而本次XMM-Newton观测延续至4月4日，说明爆发持续时间至少覆盖2月中旬至4月初，即≥7周。

对于第二个源（RA=17h45m02.3s, Dec=−28°54′51.6″），其位置与GRS 1741.9−2853（48.8″）、AX J1745.0−2855（31.8″）及CXOGC J174502.3−285450（1.6″）均较接近。核心诊断依据是：XMM-Newton明确探测到两次I型X射线暴，该行为与GRS 1741.9−2853作为已知X射线暴发体的特性完全吻合。同样，Swift/XRT、INTEGRAL/JEM-X和Chandra在2月中旬已确认其X射线再活动（ATEL #1006/#1007/#1013），而XMM-Newton最晚一次观测（4月3–4日）仍能探测到显著流量，故爆发持续时间亦≥7周。值得注意的是，该源在4月3–4日观测中EPIC计数率于不到一天内下降约2.5倍，暗示爆发可能已进入快速衰减阶段，但尚未结束。

综上，两源均表现为长时标（≥7周）暂现爆发，且各自具备决定性暴发体标识：前者通过食周期+I型暴双重认证为AX J1745.6−2901，后者通过I型暴+历史行为匹配确认为GRS 1741.9−2853；二者爆发起始时间均不早于2月中旬，终止时间均不早于4月4日，故最小持续时间可稳健推断为7周量级。

response: 该现象描述了一次系统性的近邻超新星巡天发现事件，核心信息可分解为观测流程、数据来源与物理参数三方面。首先，观测由Palomar-QUEST Consortium利用帕洛玛天文台48英寸望远镜搭载的QUEST-II相机完成，时间跨度为2007年3月26日至4月22日UTC，覆盖约四周，说明这是一次有计划的时间域成像巡天，旨在捕捉暂现源；R波段发现星等（15.6–19.8）及对应坐标均通过与USNO-A2.0星表比对测定，表明定位和测光依赖于高精度参考星表，具备良好的天体测量一致性。其次，所有候选体均经UH 2.2米望远镜配备SNIFS光谱仪获取320–1000 nm光谱进行证认，光谱覆盖紫外至近红外，足以分辨氢线（II型）、氦线（Ib型）及宽窄发射线组合（IIn型），分类结果具可靠性。最后，11例中II型占8例（含2例IIn），Ib型1例，表明恒星坍缩起源为主导机制；红移范围0.02–0.14对应距离约80–600 Mpc，全部属于“近邻”范畴（z < 0.15），符合SN Factory以低z超新星构建完备样本、校准宇宙学距离的目标；其中SNF20070417-006与SNF20070326-005同为R=15.6，是列表中最亮者，可能为较近或爆发峰值附近观测所得；而SNF20070408-014与SNF20070418-020红移达0.14，是样本中距离最远者，其IIn型特征暗示存在致密星周介质，可能与大质量恒星晚期强烈星风相关。

response: 首先，观测到超新星SNF20070422-001位于星系IC 3918中，其红移z=0.0217，表明该星系距离地球较近，属于近邻宇宙范畴。其次，该超新星于世界时2007年4月22.4日被QUEST-II相机首次探测到，视星等约为16.7；而在更早的4月4.5日图像中，同一位置未见该天体，且极限星等达20.5，说明超新星在此期间发生并迅速增亮，光变上升时间介于4月4.5日至4月22.4日之间，约18天。第三，4月23.5日利用SNIFS光谱仪获取的后续观测确认了其超新星性质，排除了活动星系核、类星体或小行星等其他暂现源的可能性。第四，定位精度高（RA/DEC坐标给出至0.01角秒量级），且宿主星系IC 3918已有红移测量，有利于后续红移验证与距离模数计算。最后，发现时间（4月22日）与确认时间（4月23日）间隔仅约1天，体现巡天项目快速响应与多望远镜协同验证的能力。
