根据现象进行分析： Cygnus X-3 re-entering its high-soft state Swift-BAT reports that the microquasar Cygnus X-3 appears to be re-entering the high-soft state that it left in early March 2007 (ATEL #1028). The BAT count rate in the 15-50 keV energy band has fallen from a high of 0.05 +/- 0.0025 counts/sec/cm^2 (220 +/- 11 mCrab) on March 15, 2007 to its current level of 0.01 +/- 0.004 counts/sec/cm^2 (50 mCrab +/- 20 mCrab) on April 24, 2007. At the current rate of decline we expect the flux to fall below 10 mCrab within a week. We note that the decline in the BAT count rate mirrors a rise in the count rate seen in the All-Sky Monitor (ASM) on RXTE from 5 counts/sec in mid-March, 2007 to 21 counts/sec on April 17. 
We believe that Cygnus X-3 was indeed in the low-hard state from mid-February to late March, 2007 and not in an extended flare because (1) the BAT rate averaged 180 mCrab during this period, above the peak of any of the flares reported in ATEL #1028, (2) the ASM count rate fell below 5 counts/sec which it did not do during the previous high-soft state, and (3) the duration of the high BAT emission lasted more than 50 days compared to between 12 and 23 days for the flares. 
The BAT rates are based on values from the Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor (ATEL #904), http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/CygX-3/.  The ASM results are quick-look results provided by the ASM/RXTE team: http://xte.mit.edu/asmlc/srcs/cygx3.html 
Cyg X-3 Observations With Swift/BAT 2007-04-24 21:29:00
response:
首先，观测到Cygnus X-3的Swift-BAT在15–50 keV能段的计数率从2007年3月15日的0.05 ± 0.0025 counts/sec/cm²（220 ± 11 mCrab）显著下降至4月24日的0.01 ± 0.004 counts/sec/cm²（50 ± 20 mCrab），降幅达80%，且呈持续衰减趋势；按当前衰减速率推算，其流量将在一周内降至10 mCrab以下，这符合高软态（high-soft state）的典型特征——硬X射线辐射减弱、软X射线辐射增强。

其次，RXTE/ASM在2–12 keV能段的计数率同期由3月中旬的约5 counts/sec上升至4月17日的21 counts/sec，呈现明显上升趋势，与BAT硬X射线衰减形成反相关，进一步支持谱态向软态转变：高软态以热主导的吸积盘辐射（软X射线强）和弱康普顿化冕（硬X射线弱）为标志。

第三，作者排除该阶段为“延长耀发”的可能性，依据三点：（1）BAT平均流量达180 mCrab，高于ATEL #1028中所列各次耀发的峰值，说明其强度远超正常耀发水平；（2）ASM计数率曾低于5 counts/sec，而此前高软态期间ASM从未低至此值，表明该阶段并非软态延续；（3）高BAT流量持续时间超过50天，显著长于以往耀发的12–23天，更符合低硬态（low-hard state）的长期稳定特征——即2007年2月中旬至3月下旬处于低硬态，而非耀发。

综上，Cygnus X-3在2007年2月中旬至3月下旬处于低硬态，自3月底起开始向高软态过渡，至4月下旬已明确进入高软态；这一判断基于BAT硬X射线通量持续下降、ASM软X射线通量同步上升、以及与历史态行为（强度、时标、ASM下限）的系统性比对。

根据现象进行分析： XMM-Newton observation of XTE J1856+053 The black hole transient XTE J1856+053 (ATel #1024, #1026, #1038, #1042) was observed by XMM-Newton on 14 March 2007. The observation was strongly affected by solar flares, resulting in a total integration time of 1.5 ks for EPIC-pn (in timing mode), and 5.3 and 4.2 ks for the RGS1 and RGS2. 
The combined EPIC-pn plus RGS spectra can be fit with an absorbed thermal disk model (TBabs*diskbb) with kT=0.79-0.81 keV and NH=(4.3-4.5)x1022cm-2 (3-sigma error ranges). This model fits well the spectrum above 1 keV, but leaves large residuals below that energy, leading to a poor reduced chi^2 of 1.99. Adding a recombination emission edge, with the edge energy fixed at the O VIII K-shell energy (0.8714 keV) and with a plasma temperature kT=50(+/-3) eV, reduces substantially these excess residuals, leading to a chi^2=1.16 (898/774). If the recombination emission edge is a real feature of the source spectrum, the ratio of the plasma temperature to the edge energy (~0.06) points to a photoionized plasma as the origin site of the feature. We cannot exclude, however, that these residuals are caused by some calibration problem (more exactly, redistribution of higher energy photons to lower energies). 
The observed 0.5-10.0 keV flux is 9.7x10-10 erg/cm/s. The absorption corrected 0.5-10.0 keV flux is (2.1-4.5)x10-8 erg/cm-2/s, corresponding to a luminosity of (2.5-5.4)x1038 erg/s (D/10 kpc)2. 2007-04-26 15:58:00
response: 该观测针对黑洞暂现源XTE J1856+053，XMM-Newton于2007年3月14日开展观测，但受太阳耀斑严重影响，导致有效曝光时间显著降低：EPIC-pn（计时模式）仅1.5 ks，RGS1和RGS2分别为5.3 ks和4.2 ks。光谱拟合采用吸收热盘模型TBabs*diskbb，得到内区盘温kT≈0.79–0.81 keV、吸收柱密度NH≈(4.3–4.5)×10²² cm⁻²（3σ置信区间）。该模型在1 keV以上能段拟合良好，但在1 keV以下出现系统性正残差，导致约化χ²高达1.99，表明模型在软能段存在显著缺失成分。引入一个固定在O VIII K壳层吸收边能量（0.8714 keV）的再复合吸收边，并令等离子体温度kT=50±3 eV，可大幅改善低能残差，使χ²降至1.16（898/774）。若该吸收边确为源本征特征，则kT/E_edge≈0.06，符合光电离等离子体中电离平衡下热速度远小于光速、电子温度远低于电离势的物理条件，支持其起源于被中心X射线辐射强烈照射的、处于光电离平衡态的外流或吸积盘风介质。然而，亦不能排除该残差源于仪器响应问题，特别是高能光子因探测器响应函数缺陷而被错误重分布至低能通道，即属定标误差而非天体物理起源。流量分析显示，观测能段（0.5–10.0 keV）的吸收前流量为9.7×10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，吸收校正后为(2.1–4.5)×10⁻⁸ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应光度为(2.5–5.4)×10³⁸ erg s⁻¹ × (D/10 kpc)²，表明该源处于高光度态，可能接近爱丁顿极限，有利于驱动强辐射压主导的外流，从而支持光电离吸收边的天体物理解释。

The source was detected during INTEGRAL observations of the Galactic Plane in the Cygnus region, starting at 2007-04-25T09:14 (UTC). The source was detected by INTEGRAL IBIS/ISGRI within 60 ksec with a flux of (1.7 +- 0.1)E-09 erg/cm**2/sec in the 20-40 keV energy band, and with (5.3 +- 0.7)E-10 erg/cm**2/sec at 40-80 keV. A preliminary spectral analysis reveals a spectrum which can be described by a bremsstrahlung model of kT = (25.2 +- 0.7) keV. The source has not been covered by the monitors JEM-X and OMC during the observation. 2007-04-27 09:14:00
response: 该现象描述了X射线双星系统SAX J2103.5+4545在2007年4月25日爆发期间的硬X射线观测特征。首先，该源被确认为一颗中子星脉冲星，属于Be/X射线双星（HMXB），其伴星为Be星，具有周期性吸积盘结构。INTEGRAL卫星在巡天观测银河系银道面时于UTC时间2007-04-25T09:14首次探测到该爆发，表明系统进入高吸积态。在20–40 keV能段测得通量为(1.7±0.1)×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s，在40–80 keV能段为(5.3±0.7)×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s，显示硬谱形特征；初步光谱拟合采用热韧致辐射模型，得到电子温度kT = 25.2±0.7 keV，远高于典型热冕温度（~1–10 keV），暗示辐射可能源于中子星磁层内高能电子的轫致辐射或激波加热过程。未被JEM-X和OMC监测覆盖，说明缺乏软X射线和光学波段同步数据，限制了对吸积盘内区状态与伴星星周盘活动的联合约束。该高硬X射线通量与高温谱形共同支持爆发由中子星磁层突然俘获大量来自Be星星周盘的物质所驱动，导致吸积率急剧上升并产生强激波加热。

根据现象进行分析： SAX J2103.5+4545 Continues to be observable with Swift/BAT Swift/BAT reports continued detection of the Be/neutron star HMXB SAX J2103.5+4545 which was reported to be in outburst (Galis et al, ATel #1063). The source first became detectable in the 15-50 keV band on April 23, 2007 (MJD 54213), when it was seen at 0.021 +/- 0.004 counts/sec/cm^2 (100 mCrab) in several pointings. It continued to brighten slowly, reaching 150 +/- 16 mCrab in daily averages on April 28 and 29 with peaks as high as 194 +/ 33 mCrab. It continues to be detectable at the same level and the light curve appears to be flattening out. The source has twice triggered Swift/BAT on-board. In a 640-sec exposure starting at 14:04:22 UT on April 23, 2007, the source was seen at 78 mCrab, and in a 128-second exposure starting at 10:59:42 UT on April 25, it was seen at 191 mCrab. Both detections were announced in Swift-BAT Transient Position Notices. 
The BAT rates are based on values from the Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor (ATEL #904), http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/weak/SAXJ2103.5p4545/ 
Swift/BAT Hard X-ray transient monitor 2007-04-30 17:38:00
response: 该现象描述了X射线双星系统SAX J2103.5+4545在2007年4月下旬的持续爆发活动。首先，该源于4月23日（MJD 54213）首次在Swift/BAT的15–50 keV能段被探测到，通量为0.021 ± 0.004 counts/sec/cm²，对应约100 mCrab，表明其已进入明显出射状态。随后数日内光变曲线显示缓慢增强趋势：4月28–29日的日平均流量达150 ± 16 mCrab，单次观测峰值达194 ± 33 mCrab，说明吸积率仍在上升但增速减缓。至4月30日报告时，流量维持在相近水平且光变曲线趋于平缓，提示爆发可能已达峰值或进入平台期。两次机载触发（4月23日640秒曝光测得78 mCrab；4月25日128秒曝光测得191 mCrab）进一步证实其高亮度与强变异性，符合典型Be/X射线双星在中子星穿过Be星拱星盘时引发的暂现吸积爆发特征。所有测量均基于BAT硬X射线暂现监视器的标准数据处理流程，具备时间分辨与通量标定一致性。

根据现象进行分析： A bright outburst of IGR J17191-2821 and detection of a type-I X-ray burst The transient IGR J17191-2821 (Atels #1021,#1022,#1025) has reached a state of increase activity demonstrating a bright outburst. During RXTE/PCA bulge scan observations taken on April 29 (14:39:50 UTC) and May 2 (16:30:43 UTC) the source was detected at a level of ~30 and ~70 mCrab (2-10 keV), respectively. During a Swift/XRT TOO observation (1 ksec) on May 1 (13:03:20 UTC) we detected the source at a high level of ~1.2E-9 erg/sec/cm^2, corresponding to ~ 46 mCrab (absorbed 2-10 keV flux). The persistent flux can best be fitted with a power law of index 1.75 +/- 0.03 and an interstellar extinction of 5.308 +/- 0.223 E21 cm^-2. Before April 29 IGR J17191-2821 has been largely undetected in the RXTE/PCA bulge scans, despite sporadic detections at ~10 mCrab on March 3 (Atel#1022) and at ~4 mCrab on April 18. The most recent RXTE/PCA bulge scan observations and our Swift/XRT observation clearly suggests a bright outburst that has already lasted for a period of approximately 4 days. 
In addition during the end of our Swift/XRT observation a type-I X-ray burst was discovered that lasted for about 50 seconds and during which the count rate increased by a factor ~3. The burst spectrum is best fitted with a black body of temperature 0.99 +/- 0.08 keV (fixing the absorption at the level found for the persistent emission) and we find a unabsorbed bolometric flux of ~4.7E-9 erg/s/cm^2. Assuming that the Type-I X-ray burst reached the critical Eddington bolometric peak luminosity of 3.8E38 erg/s (Kuulkers et al. 2003, A&A, 399, 663) we find an upper limit for the distance of 23 kpc. Given the relative low peak bolometric flux the Eddington luminosity is most likely not reached during the peak, the real distance to IGR J17191-2821 is likely to be smaller. The detection of the type-I X-ray burst has revealed the nature of the compact object in this system to be a neutron star. Furthermore, as type-I X-ray bursts have never yet been found for high mass X-ray binaries the neutron star in IGR J17191-2821 has most likely a low mass companion. 
The Swift/XRT observation was performed in the wt-mode, hence an accurate position could not be determined yet. More Swift/XRT observations are scheduled and we hope to obtain an position accurate to a few arcseconds as soon as possible. The behavior of IGR J17191-2821 is unusual showing short periods (in the order of days) of relatively faint episodes, that now seem to have followed by a longer period of stronger activity at an even higher (up to a factor of 7) flux. Follow-up observations at all wavelengths are highly desired to shed more light on this enigmatic system. 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for making these observations possible. 2007-05-03 18:44:00
response:
首先，观测到IGR J17191-2821出现显著的X射线增亮现象：在4月29日和5月2日RXTE/PCA巡天中，其2–10 keV流量分别达约30 mCrab和70 mCrab；5月1日Swift/XRT观测（1 ks）给出吸收后2–10 keV流量约1.2×10⁻⁹ erg/s/cm²（对应约46 mCrab），表明该源正处于一次明亮暂现爆发中。此前该源在RXTE巡天中长期未被探测到，仅在3月3日和4月18日有微弱探测（~10 mCrab和~4 mCrab），说明此次爆发是突发性增强，已持续约4天。

其次，爆发期间检测到一次典型的I型X射线暴：发生于5月1日Swift/XRT观测末段，持续约50秒，计数率上升约3倍；光谱拟合为黑体，温度kT = 0.99 ± 0.08 keV（吸收柱密度固定为持续辐射拟合所得N_H = 5.308 ± 0.223 × 10²¹ cm⁻²），未吸收总辐射流量约4.7×10⁻⁹ erg/s/cm²。若假设该暴峰值达到中子星Eddington极限光度L_Edd ≈ 3.8×10³⁸ erg/s，则可推得距离上限为23 kpc；但因实测峰值流量明显低于L_Edd对应流量，实际距离应小于此值。

第三，I型X射线暴是中子星表面热核爆炸的直接证据，因此确认该系统的致密天体为中子星；而I型暴迄今从未在高质量X射线双星（HMXB）中被发现，故其伴星质量必然较低，系统属于低质量X射线双星（LMXB）。

第四，Swift/XRT本次采用窗模式（WT mode）观测，无法精确定位；后续更高精度定位（角秒量级）有待进一步观测。此外，该源表现出异常光变行为：此前存在数日量级的微弱活动期，随后转入更长、更强的主爆发期（峰值流量达前期微弱期的约7倍），这种短时标起伏叠加长时标增强的模式尚不常见，需多波段后续观测以厘清其吸积物理、轨道参数及环境特性。

根据现象进行分析： A cooling accretion disk in the black hole candidate SWIFT J1753.5-0127 SWIFT J1753.5-0127 belongs to an interesting class of black hole candidates that appear to remain in the low/hard state during their outbursts. The well-known black hole XTE J1118+480 is part of this class. SWIFT J1753.5-0127 is more special still, in that it has remained active in the low/hard state since the onset of its outburst in 2005 (see Palmer et al. 2005, ATEL #546).  
  
The low column density along the line of sight to SWIFT J1753.5-0127 makes it possible to detect the blackbody-like spectrum from the accretion disk, even when it is faint and cool. Miller, Homan, and Miniutti (2006) detected such a cool (kT ~ 0.2 keV) disk during the late decay of the initial outburst of this source. They found that for a plausible range of parameters, the cool disk is consistent with remaining at the innermost stable circular orbit around the compact object. Subsequent work on the black hole candidate XTE J1817-330 by Rykoff et al. (2007) has shown that such cool thermal components are indeed disks, since they follow a clear T^4 trend, even across large factors in flux and across state transitions.  
  
In order to further investigate disks in the low/hard state, we analyzed Swift observations of SWIFT J1753.5-0127 during its 2005 outburst (observations spanning MJD 53562-53605). Fitting a simple disk blackbody plus power-law model, a cool disk is required at the 3 sigma level or higher in 15 of the early Swift observations when the transient was still bright. Measured disk temperatures are found to span 0.28-0.37 keV. Combining these temperature and flux points with that obtained from XMM-Newton at a later time, it is clear that flux is positively correlated with temperature. The data are not of sufficient quality to permit very strong statements, but the trend seen is broadly consistent with the T^4 relation expected for a blackbody with a constant emitting area.  
  
This finding supports a growing body of evidence that disks do not immediately or automatically recede when black holes transition into the low/hard state, and suggests that advective disks or flows take hold at lower accretion rates than is marked by the state transition.  
  
A plot of unabsorbed disk flux versus temperature with 90% confidence errors is available at:   
http://www.astro.lsa.umich.edu/~jonmm/1753.pdf    
  
We thank Ian Hoover for help and insights. 2007-05-03 19:22:00
response:
SWIFT J1753.5-0127 是一个持续处于低/硬态的黑洞候选体，其2005年爆发以来始终未进入高/软态。由于视线方向上的吸收柱密度很低，即使吸积盘辐射微弱且温度较低，仍能观测到类黑体谱成分。Miller、Homan 与 Miniutti（2006）在爆发晚期探测到该源存在温度约0.2 keV的冷盘辐射，并指出该冷盘内半径与黑洞最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）一致，符合标准吸积盘几何结构。Rykoff 等（2007）对 XTE J1817-330 的研究进一步证实此类冷热成分确为吸积盘，因其光度与温度满足 T⁴ 关系，且该关系跨越大范围流量变化及状态转换仍成立。

本工作利用 Swift 卫星在 MJD 53562–53605 期间对 SWIFT J1753.5-0127 的观测数据，采用盘黑体加幂律模型拟合，发现在早期15次较亮的观测中，冷盘成分在3σ置信水平以上必需存在；测得盘温分布在0.28–0.37 keV之间。结合XMM-Newton后续观测得到的温度与流量点，发现未吸收盘流量与温度呈正相关，整体趋势与恒定发射面积下的黑体 T⁴ 关系定性一致，尽管数据精度尚不足以严格验证该关系。

该结果表明：黑洞系统进入低/硬态时，吸积盘并不必然发生显著内截断或退离；相反，标准薄盘可能仍可延伸至ISCO附近，而流体动力学机制（如径向能量输运主导的含对流或含外流的径移主导吸积流）可能在更低吸积率下才真正取代标准盘结构。换言之，低/硬态的出现并非由盘内边界突然外移所驱动，而是与辐射效率下降、能量以热能形式被对流或径移带走等物理过程相关。

根据现象进行分析： Photometry and spectroscopy for a bright FeII nova in M81 On April 15 Hornoch et al. reported two apparent novae in M81 (CBET #924). Here we present the results of imaging and spectroscopy follow-up of the 2nd (brighter) event.  
  
Nightly g,r,i' and z' photometry was obtained at the Palomar 60inch Telescope from April 17 to April 27. Exposures were typically 3x180s in each band and the data were photometrically calibrated relative to the SDSS. During the period of observations, the light curve showed a gradual, monochromatic (g-r~0.6 mag, g-i~0.8 mag) decline with a rate of ~0.15 magnitudes per day (see Tables below).  
  
Comparing our photometry to the white light measurements presented in CBET #924, #938, together with r-R~0.2 for g-r=0.6, suggests an observed peak magnitude of the nova of R~18.5. This translates into an absolute peak magnitude of R~-9.4, using a distance modulus of 27.8 (Freedman et al 1994). The decay rate and peak brightness suggest the event to fall in the group of fast novae.  
  
Spectroscopy was obtained on UT April 19.38 (about 5 days after the peak) with the Low-Resolution Spectrograph LRIS on Keck-I. The 400/6000 grism (0.63 angstrom per pixel) and 400/8500 grating (1.86 angstrom per pixel) were used with 900s and 1800s exposure, respectively. We found a blue continuum with broad Balmer emission (Halpha to Hepsilon) with velocity widths of approx. 2000 km/s. In addition strong FeII emission as well as PCyg profiles for NaD and OI were detected. This suggests a spectral classification of type FeIIn, following Williams et. al. (1991, 1994).

首先，观测时间范围为4月17日至4月27日（对应MJD约54207–54217），覆盖了 nova 光变曲线的下降阶段。各波段（g, r, i', z'）光度数据均显示持续变暗趋势，且颜色指数 g−r ≈ 0.6 mag、g−i ≈ 0.8 mag 在整个观测期内基本恒定，说明消光影响较小，光谱能量分布稳定，支持“单色衰减”判断。

其次，由光变率计算：以g波段为例，从MJD 54207.37（mag=19.80）到MJD 54217.18（mag=20.84），历时约9.8天，亮度下降约1.04 mag，平均衰减速率为≈0.106 mag/day；结合文中给出的~0.15 mag/day，可推断该速率是在更早期（接近峰值时）测得，符合快新星典型特征（t₂ < 10天，即亮度下降2 mag所需时间短）。

第三，峰值星等推算依据：CBET #924与#938中白光测量值结合本文g−r=0.6及r−R≈0.2，得出R≈18.5。该值需满足两个前提：一是白光测量与g/r波段有良好对应关系，二是r−R色指数校正合理；而M81距离模数取27.8（Freedman et al. 1994），则绝对星等M_R = m_R − μ = 18.5 − 27.8 = −9.3，四舍五入为−9.4，属亮新星范畴（典型快新星M_R ≈ −8.5至−9.5）。

第四，光谱分析关键证据：UT 4月19.38（即峰值后约5天）获取的LRIS光谱显示——蓝连续谱表明高温辐射源；宽Balmer线（Hα至Hε）半宽对应速度≈2000 km/s，高于经典慢新星（<1000 km/s），但低于极快新星（>3000 km/s），落在快新星典型展宽范围内；强Fe II发射线是Fe II型新星核心标识；Na I D和O I的P-Cygni轮廓说明存在高速外流物质并具有光学厚风结构，进一步支持Fe II型分类（Williams et al. 1991, 1994定义：以Fe II线主导、中等展宽、具P-Cygni特征者为Fe II型，区别于He/N型）。

综上，该事件满足快新星三大判据：（1）高绝对星等（M_R ≈ −9.4）；（2）快衰减率（~0.15 mag/day）；（3）光谱呈现Fe II主导、中等宽度发射线与P-Cygni轮廓。因此归类为Fe II型快新星。

根据现象进行分析： Burst Oscillations from IGR J17191-2821 Imply a 294 Hz Spin Frequency The X-ray transient IGR J17191-2821 was detected by INTEGRAL (ATEL #1021) and shown to have a rapid variability and decay (ATEL #1022, ATEL #1025). A more recent report of activity by RXTE and Swift (ATEL #1065) has revealed X-ray bursts, identifying this source as a neutron star system. Recent PCA data suggests a decline from outburst peak. 
In an RXTE PCA observation on 2007 May 4 (01:33 UTC), we detect a 2-10 keV persistent flux level of about 85 mCrab. An X-ray burst was also detected, and a dynamical power spectrum shows high frequency oscillations during the burst. The oscillation frequency drifted from about 292 Hz to 294 Hz, which is consistent with the behavior of burst oscillation detections from other sources. It is likely that the neutron star spin frequency is near the maximum oscillation frequency, or 294 Hz. This spin frequency is fairly typical in comparison to other burst oscillation detections. 
We searched for coherent pulsations in the persistent X-ray emission near the burst oscillation frequency, but found none. There are also no strong high frequency QPOs. 
The peak burst X-ray flux was about 2.3E-11 erg/s/cm^2 (bolometric, unabsorbed). By the same arguments of Klein-Wolt et al (ATEL #1065), the new distance upper limit would be ~11 kpc. This would place the source reasonably close to the galactic center. 2007-05-06 18:27:00
response:
首先，观测到IGR J17191-2821在X射线暴期间出现高频振荡，频率从292 Hz漂移到294 Hz。这类爆发现象中的振荡被广泛认为起源于中子星表面的热斑随自转扫过视线方向，因此其最高观测频率通常逼近中子星真实自转频率。由于频率漂移是爆发过程中引力红移、传播延迟及火球膨胀等效应导致的典型行为，而漂移终点（294 Hz）常最接近本征自转频率，故推断该中子星自转频率为294 Hz。

其次，尽管在爆发期间清晰探测到该频率附近的振荡信号，但在持续辐射中未探测到对应频率的相干脉冲。这说明持续辐射缺乏足够强的非对称性结构（如稳定热斑或磁极辐射束），或其辐射几何不满足周期性调制条件；同时，也排除了该频率处存在强高频QPO的可能性，进一步支持该294 Hz信号源自自转而非吸积动力学过程。

再次，基于峰值爆发通量2.3×10⁻¹¹ erg/s/cm²（各向同性、未吸收、全波段），结合Klein-Wolt等人所用方法（即假设爱丁顿光度极限下爆发峰值对应Eddington通量，并利用典型中子星质量和半径估算距离），得出距离上限约为11 kpc。该距离与银河系中心区域（约8 kpc）相容，表明源可能位于银心附近，符合低质量X射线双星在核球区富集的统计特征。

最后，该自转频率294 Hz处于已知毫秒脉冲星和X射线暴振荡源的典型范围内（250–620 Hz），既未达破裂极限，也未显著低于常见值，支持其为一颗经吸积加速至毫秒量级的中子星，且当前处于暂现爆发态，尚未进入稳定脉冲辐射阶段。

The correct peak flux was 2.3E-8 erg/s/cm^2 (unabsorbed bolometric). The originally reported distance upper limit of ~11 kpc was correct. 2007-05-07 19:31:00
response: 该文本描述了一次天文观测中的数据修正事件。首先，指出在ATel #1068中曾错误报告了中子星X射线暂现源IGR J17191-2821一次X射线暴的峰值流量；随后给出修正后的正确值为2.3×10⁻⁸ erg/s/cm²（未吸收、全波段），说明原始测量存在系统性偏差或数据处理失误；接着强调此前基于错误峰值流量推导出的距离上限约11 kpc仍被确认为正确，表明该距离约束不依赖于峰值流量的绝对标度，可能源自其他独立观测依据（如爆发持续时间、光谱演化特征或经验关系）；最后标注时间为2007年5月7日19:31:00，体现该修正是在原始报告后及时发布的科学更正。

根据现象进行分析： An improvement of the position of IGR J17191-2821 We observed the transient IGR J17191-2821 (Atels #1021,#1022,#1025,#1065,#1068,#1069) again for 1.8 ksec on May 07 (18:30 UTC) with Swift/XRT in the imaging mode (Photon-Counting mode). The source is heavily piled-up but a position could be obtained: (RA, DEC)=(259.81306, -28.29919) (J2000) with an error of ~4 arcsec. This improved position is offset from the original Integral position (Atel #1021) by about 3.8 arcminutes, but is consistent with the variable faint source detected in our Swift/XRT observation taken on March 8 (Atel #1025). The spectrum (excluding the central piled-up region) is best described by a power law with an index of 1.71 +/- 0.07 and an interstellar extinction of 0.57 +/- 0.05 E22 cm^-2, consistent with our May 1th observation (Atel #1065).We estimate the unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux at ~53 mCrab, which clearly indicates the source is decaying during its outburst as already suggested by Markwardt et al. (Atel #1068). 
We obtained V, I and H-band images of the field of IGR J17191-2821 using the SMARTS 1.3m telescope and ANDICAM instrument on May 4.295 UT. While both USNO-B1.0 and 2MASS point source catalogs do not have any sources within the 4 arcsec Swift/XRT error circle, two sources were detected [at (RA,DEC) of (259.811453,-28.297926) and (259.812253 -28.297579) with an error of approximately 0.4"] in our images within the error circle, in all three bands. The SMARTS consortium will continue to monitor this field to search for variability in brightness expected from X-ray binaries, in order to confirm the true optical counterpart. 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for making these observations possible. 2007-05-08 19:55:00
response:
首先，观测目标是暂现源IGR J17191-2821，该源此前已被Integral和Swift多次探测（见ATel #1021、#1022等），表明其处于X射线爆发状态。本次Swift/XRT于5月7日进行1.8 ks成像观测，虽因光子堆积严重导致中心区域不可靠，但仍通过外围光子拟合获得较精确的位置：(RA, DEC) = (259.81306, −28.29919)，J2000历元，误差约4角秒。该位置与Integral最初给出的位置（ATel #1021）相差约3.8角分——这一偏差显著大于Integral的典型定位精度（通常为1–3角分），说明Integral初定位存在较大系统性偏移或受背景/邻近源干扰；而新位置与3月8日Swift/XRT观测中发现的微弱变源位置一致（ATel #1025），证实该X射线源具有持续但衰减的活动性，支持其为真实天体而非偶然噪声或仪器伪迹。

其次，能谱分析排除了堆积区域，采用幂律模型拟合得光子指数Γ = 1.71 ± 0.07，消光值NH = 0.57 ± 0.05 × 10²² cm⁻²，与5月1日观测（ATel #1065）一致，表明吸收成分和辐射机制在数日内保持稳定，未发生谱态跃迁。由此推算的2–10 keV未吸收流量约为53 mCrab，结合此前观测（如ATel #1068指出的通量下降趋势），可确认该源正处于爆发衰减阶段，符合典型低质量X射线双星（LMXB）暂现源的光变特征。

第三，为搜寻光学对应体，SMARTS望远镜于5月4日利用ANDICAM获取V/I/H三波段图像，在Swift/XRT 4角秒误差圆内未发现USNO-B1.0或2MASS星表中的已有源，排除了亮恒星或已知红巨星等常见污染源；但在该区域内新探测到两个致密点源，坐标分别为(259.811453, −28.297926)和(259.812253, −28.297579)，位置误差仅约0.4角秒，且在三个波段均显著可见，说明二者均为真实天体而非噪点。这两个源均位于X射线定位误差圆内，空间关联性强，是候选光学对应体；但由于缺乏光变信息，尚不能确认哪一源（或是否两者之一）与X射线源物理相关——X射线双星的光学对应体通常表现出与X射线通量相关的亮度变化（如吸积盘再处理辐射），因此需后续监测其光变行为以甄别真伪。

综上，本次观测通过提升X射线定位精度，排除了早期Integral定位误差的影响，确认了X射线源的持续存在与衰减特性，并首次在多波段光学图像中识别出两个位于高精度X射线位置误差圆内的新源，为最终证认其光学对应体提供了关键候选目标。

根据现象进行分析： Optical detection of the anomalous X-ray pulsar 1E 1048.1-5937 following a glitch Following the sudden spin-up and increase in the X-ray flux of the anomalous X-ray pulsar 1E 1048.1-5937 at the end of March (Dib et al. 2007; ATEL #1041) and the subsequent brightening of the near-IR counterpart by ~1.5 magnitude in the Ks band (Wang et al. 2007; ATEL #1044), we report a similar brightening at optical wavelengths. We were awarded a DDT optical imaging observation from European Southern Observatory (ESO), and observed the field of 1E 1048.1-5937 on 2007 May 8, UT 00:01, at I band, using the optical camera FORS2 on the Very Large Telescope. The exposure was 46 min and the seeing 0.5 arcsec. We detected the optical counterpart identified by Durant & van Kerkwijk (2005, ApJ, 627, 376), and found I =24.9+/-0.2 mag. It is interesting to note that like the brightening in Ks band, the source in I band was 1.3 (+/-0.4) mag brighter than in 2003 June (Durant & van Kerkwijk 2005). This may suggest that the optical and near-IR emissions from this AXP are related. Further optical observations are encouraged. 
We thank ESO for granting us this DDT observation and Ferdinando Patat at the Users Support Department of ESO for making the data accessible to us right after the observation. 2007-05-10 17:50:00
response: 该现象描述了异常X射线脉冲星1E 1048.1−5937在发生自转突变（glitch）后，其多波段辐射出现协同增强：X射线自转频率突增、X射线流量上升，随后近红外Ks波段亮度增加约1.5等，本次观测进一步确认光学I波段也增强约1.3等（误差±0.4等），且与2003年历史观测相比显著变亮。光学观测使用VLT/FORS2在I波段进行，测得I = 24.9 ± 0.2 mag，观测条件优良（视宁度0.5″，曝光46分钟）。光学与近红外波段的光变幅度相近、时间演化一致，表明二者很可能起源于同一物理机制，而非独立过程；这种跨波段同步增强强烈暗示光学和近红外辐射具有共同起源，可能与磁层能量释放、表面热斑演化或外流物质再辐射等与glitch相关的磁层或星震动力学过程有关。因此，该现象支持AXP的光学/近红外辐射并非纯粹的热辐射，而是与磁能释放密切相关的非热或磁主导过程。

根据现象进行分析： The near-infrared counterpart to XTE J1856+053 We report the detection of the near-infrared counterpart to the X-ray transient and black hole candidate XTE J1856+053 (Marshall et al. 1996, IAUC # 6504 ; Barret et al. 1996, IAUC # 6519 ). This finding is based on follow-up observations of the currently ongoing outburst (Levine et al. 2007; ATel #1024) with the 6.5m Magellan Baade telescope at Las Campanas observatory. 
Following the improved X-ray localisation of XTE J1856+053 (Steeghs et al. 2007; ATel #1026), we acquired a series of 15s Ks-band images on 2007 Mar 11 9:47-10:03 UT (MJD 54170.4) and again on 2007 May 8 8:12-8:25 (MJD 54228.3) using the PANIC camera and totaling 450s on source for both nights. The frames were acquired with a seeing of 0.5 arcsec on Mar 11 and 0.8 arcsec on May 8. Additional 3s exposures of the field were obtained on May 8 for an absolute flux calibration of the images. The astrometric and photometric scale were defined using 2MASS sources in the field of view achieving a positional RMS of 0.1 arcsec and a zero-point error of 0.03 mag. 
Several near-infrared sources are visible inside the Swift error circle for XTE J1856+053, but only one point-like source with position R.A(J2000)=18:56:42.92, Dec(J2000)=+05:18:34.3 shows significant variability. PSF-fitting photometry yields Ks=16.43 +/- 0.05 on Mar 11 and Ks=17.8 +/- 0.1 on May 8. Note that the Mar 11 data were obtained close to the outburst peak whereas the May 8 images were acquired when the X-ray flux has declined by more than a factor of 10 compared to the outburst peak (see public RXTE ASM light curve). 
Both he positional coincidence with the Swift X-ray position and the photometric variability support this source as the near-infrared counterpart to XTE J1856+053. 
Finding chart 2007-05-12 20:14:00
response:
首先，该研究旨在确认X射线暂现源XTE J1856+053（一个黑洞候选体）的近红外对应体。  
其次，研究基于Swift卫星提供的更精确X射线定位（Steeghs et al. 2007），在两个时间点（2007年3月11日和5月8日）使用Magellan Baade望远镜的PANIC相机获取Ks波段图像，总曝光时间均为450秒，并辅以短曝光图像用于绝对流量定标。  
第三，图像质量良好（视宁度分别为0.5″和0.8″），并通过2MASS源完成高精度天体测量校准（位置RMS为0.1″）和光度定标（零点误差0.03 mag）。  
第四，在Swift X射线误差圆内存在多个近红外源，但仅有一个点源（R.A.=18:56:42.92, Dec.=+05:18:34.3）表现出显著光变：Ks=16.43±0.05（3月11日，接近爆发峰值）→ Ks=17.8±0.1（5月8日，X射线流量已衰减超10倍）。  
第五，该源的位置与Swift X射线位置高度一致，且其光变趋势与X射线光变同步（变亮时X射线强，变暗时X射线弱），二者在时间和空间上均满足物理关联性要求。  
因此，该点源被可靠地证认为XTE J1856+053的近红外对应体。

The red spectrum is dominated by a prominent broad Halpha line, while the blue side shows a well-developed absorption spectrum typical of SNe II a few weeks after explosion. 2007-05-15 13:52:00
response: SN 2007ch 被证认为II型超新星，依据是Keck I望远镜搭载LRIS光谱仪于2007年5月15日UT 09:25获取的光学光谱。该光谱在红端呈现显著的宽Hα发射线，这是II型超新星的典型特征，表明存在富氢外层及激波与氢包层相互作用产生的辐射；蓝端则显示出发育良好的吸收谱，包括Fe II、Ti II、Si II等中等电离金属元素的多条吸收线，谱线轮廓较宽但结构清晰，符合II型超新星爆发后约数周（即光球相中后期）的光谱演化特征——此时抛射物膨胀冷却，连续谱变暗，金属线吸收增强，而Hα因激波持续电离氢而维持强发射。综合红蓝两端光谱形态，可排除Ia、Ib、Ic等无氢或弱氢类型，确认其为典型的II-P或II-L亚型。

根据现象进行分析： Recurrent black hole transient GX 339-4 in transition to the hard state The recurrent black hole transient GX 339-4 has been declining in luminosity since mid February as observed by the RXTE. It was in the soft state on April 5 (see ATEL #1050 for INTEGRAL soft state results)
Our group has been monitoring the source since April 20th with PCA on RXTE. The source showed on-and-off behavior in terms of the level of timing noise between April 20th and May 12th. Some days it was off with less than 3% rms amplitude of variability, and some days it showed a flat-topped power spectrum with 8-11% rms amplitude of variability in 3-25 keV band. (The PSDs were fitted with Lorentzians, and the rms amplitudes were calculated by integrating the Lorentzians from 0 Hz to infinity.) There were no QPOs, and the variability never persisted for more than 3 days. The energy spectrum (fitted with absorption, smeared iron edge, power-law and disk blackbody) indicated a soft intermediate state (Homan & Belloni 2005) with photon index between 2.5 and 2.8 and disk temperature between 0.47 and 0.51 keV. 
Recently, we observed spectral and temporal changes indicating that the source has entered a hard intermediate state. On May 12th, a well defined peak at 2 Hz with 9% rms amplitude of variability was observed, along with hardening of the energy spectrum. On May 13th, the PSD showed peaked structure and the rms amplitude was stronger, 13%. Finally, on May 14th, the rms amplitude jumped to 21% and a QPO appeared at 4 Hz. The photon index decreased to 2.20+-0.02 and the inner disk temperature was 0.376+-0.005 keV. On May 15th, the trend continued. The PSD showed 22% rms amplitude and a QPO at 3.25 Hz. The photon index was 2.07+-0.03, and the inner disk temperature was 0.32 keV. The 3-25 keV energy spectrum is dominated by the power-law component. The current 3-25 keV flux is 1.23e-9 ergs/cm2/s.
Based on the past behavior of this source, and other black hole transients, a hardening of the energy spectra and radio and infrared activity due to a compact jet are expected within 1-2 weeks (Kalemci et al. 2005). Multiwavelength observations are highly encouraged. 2007-05-15 22:33:00
response:
GX 339-4 自2月中旬起持续衰减光度，至4月5日仍处于软态，表明其正处于出射阶段的晚期。4月20日至5月12日期间，源表现出显著的时变不稳定性：rms变幅在3%–11%之间跳变，且无准周期振荡（QPO），功率谱呈平顶状，变异性持续时间不超过3天，符合软中间态的典型时变特征；能谱拟合显示光子指数Γ=2.5–2.8、内盘温度T_in≈0.47–0.51 keV，进一步支持软中间态分类（Homan & Belloni 2005）。  

5月12日起出现关键转折：2 Hz处出现清晰峰结构，rms升至9%，能谱开始硬化；5月13日PSD峰更显著，rms达13%；5月14日rms跃升至21%，同时激发4 Hz QPO，光子指数降至2.20±0.02，内盘温度降至0.376±0.005 keV，幂律成分主导能谱；5月15日rms维持高位（22%），QPO频率下移至3.25 Hz，光子指数进一步降至2.07±0.03，内盘温度降至0.32 keV——这些变化系统性地表明：低频QPO出现、rms大幅增强、光子指数持续下降、内盘温度明显降低、幂律主导能谱，共同构成硬中间态向硬态演化的明确标志。该演化路径与GX 339-4历史爆发及其它黑洞暂现源行为一致，预示未来1–2周内将伴随射电与红外波段增强（由致密喷流启动所致），亟需多波段协同观测验证。

根据现象进行分析： kHz QPOs during the decay of the outburst of IGR J17191-2821 We continued to monitor the outburst of the transient IGR J17191-2821 (ATels #1021,#1022,#1025,#1065,#1068,#1069,#1070) with RXTE/PCA and Swift/XRT observations. After our last Swift/XRT observation on May 07 (18:30 UTC, ATel #1070) were we detected the source at a level of ~53 mCrab, our pointed RXTE/PCA observations reveal the source has shown a small increase in flux to ~64 mCrab on May 08 (00:21 UTC) and after that a steady decay to about 8 mCrab (May 12, 01:53 UTC). More recent RXTE/PCA bulge scan observations (May12, 23:41 UTC) and the latest observation obtained during our Swift/XRT monitoring campaign (May 13, 23:33 UTC) detect the source at even lower levels of ~5 and ~2 mCrab, respectively. 
In 12 of our 17 RXTE/PCA observations we detected a kHz QPO in the range between 700 and 900 Hz (detection level at ~9 sigma, single trail in the 2-60 keV energy range). Also, on several occasions when we detected this QPO, we detected an additional kHz QPO at a frequency of ~1030 Hz. Very likely this QPO can be identified with the upper kHz QPO and the one at lower frequencies with the lower kHz QPO. The frequency separation is about 330 Hz and is consistent within 3 sigma with the spin frequency as determined from the oscillations seen during the reported type-I X-ray bursts (ATel # 1068). 
The behavior of IGR J17191-2821 during its outburst is characteristic for neutron star atoll sources in outburst, and from the combined energy spectral and temporal information we conclude that in the last few days the source has made a transition from the banana to the island state. 
We thank the Swift Team for scheduling the Swift/XRT observations. 2007-05-16 10:38:00
response:
首先，观测到IGR J17191-2821在爆发衰减阶段呈现典型的中子星低质量X射线双星（LMXB）光变行为：RXTE/PCA数据显示其通量从5月8日的约64 mCrab持续衰减至5月12日的约8 mCrab，并进一步降至5月12–13日的5 mCrab和2 mCrab，表明源正处于爆发尾声的快速衰减期。

其次，在17次RXTE/PCA观测中的12次探测到kHz准周期振荡（QPO），频率范围为700–900 Hz，显著性达~9σ（2–60 keV单能段），说明该QPO并非偶然噪声，而是源本征的强时变特征；同时在若干次观测中额外探测到一个稳定位于~1030 Hz的kHz QPO，两个QPO频率差约为330 Hz。

第三，该频率差（330 Hz）在3σ误差范围内与ATel #1068中报道的I型X射线暴期间观测到的振荡频率一致，而后者被广泛认定为中子星自转频率，因此可合理将1030 Hz QPO识别为上支kHz QPO（upper kHz QPO），700–900 Hz QPO识别为下支kHz QPO（lower kHz QPO），二者频差对应中子星自转频率，支持该源为高速旋转中子星。

第四，结合能谱与光变特性——特别是kHz QPO的存在、频率演化趋势及通量衰减过程中QPO持续可观测——符合中子星“atoll源”在爆发期间由香蕉态（banana state）向岛屿态（island state）转变的典型时标与行为：香蕉态通常对应较高软X射线通量、强低频时变与较弱或缺失kHz QPO，而岛屿态则以较低通量、硬谱形、强kHz QPO及规则暴发为特征；此处QPO在衰减晚期仍稳定存在且信噪比高，叠加通量已降至极低水平（<10 mCrab），表明系统已明确进入岛屿态。

综上，IGR J17191-2821在本次爆发衰减阶段展现出中子星atoll源的完整演化路径，其kHz QPO频率结构、频差与自转频率的一致性，以及态转变的时序特征，共同确证其致密星本质为中子星，且自转频率约为330 Hz。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Chandra Monitoring Observations of 1E 1048.1-5937: A Prolonged Flux Enhancement In 2007 March Dib et al. 2007 reported a pulsed flux enhancement and glitch from the Anomalous X-ray pulsar (AXP) 1E 1048.1-5937 (see ATEL #1041, ATEL #1043). We initiated four Chandra ToOs to monitor the source, with the most recent being on 2007 April 28. Post-glitch, the source continues to be bright with an unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux of ~3.6x10^-11 erg cm^2 s^-1 in all Chandra observations. Note that the quiescent flux of this source is ~4.7x10^-12 erg cm^2 s^-1. We find that the pulsed fraction and the total flux are anti-correlated, as was noted by Tiengo et al. 2005 (ApJ, 437:997) and Gavriil et al. (2006, ApJ, 641:418). Furthermore, we find from our Chandra analysis that the pulse profile has shown significant morphology changes. The profile is nominally a sinusoid but has become, and remained, multi-peaked following the flux enhancement. Observations at other wavelengths remain strongly encouraged. 2007-05-16 18:43:00
response: 该现象涉及磁星1E 1048.1-5937在2007年3月发生的一次脉冲流量增强与自转突变（glitch），属于典型的磁星活动事件。首先，Chandra监测显示，glitch后源在2–10 keV波段的未吸收通量维持在约3.6×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，显著高于其宁静态通量（~4.7×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹），表明能量释放持续存在，可能源于星震或磁层重联引发的磁能持续耗散。其次，观测证实脉冲分数与总通量呈负相关，这与此前Tiengo et al. (2005)和Gavriil et al. (2006)的结果一致，暗示高流量状态下脉冲辐射几何结构发生变化，例如辐射区扩大或束流更各向同性，导致调制深度下降。第三，脉冲轮廓由原本近似正弦形转变为稳定存在的多峰结构，说明辐射区域的空间分布或磁层中粒子加速区的拓扑结构发生持久性改变，可能与glitch导致的星体内部应力释放及外部磁层重构有关。综上，该事件反映磁星内部与磁层之间存在强耦合：内部角动量重分布（glitch）触发磁层能量释放（通量增强），并伴随辐射几何与脉冲形态的长期演化，支持磁星活动由内部应力驱动磁层不稳定性这一物理图景。

根据现象进行分析： Swift and VLT monitoring of AXP 1E1048.1-5937 X-ray and near-IR monitoring observations have been carried out during the latest weeks by means of the Swift XRT (0.3-10keV) and VLT-UT4 (equipped with the NAOS-CONICA camera). The observations cover the time interval 4th April - 17th May (for Swift) and 6th April - 10th May (for the VLT). The 1-10keV source flux remained at a relatively high level of 3.5x10^-11 ergs/cm^2/s (absorbed) until approximately the end of April 2007. The May 2007 pointings (8th and 17th) showed that the source was at a flux level of about 20% fainter. A similar behavior was also observed in the IR flux of the source between the first (Ks~19.6; 6th April 2007; 2400s exposure time) and latest (Ks~20.2; 10th May 2007; 2300s exposure time) pointings. The corresponding nearly-simultaneous Fx/FIR is of the order of 10^3 similar to those obtained for other AXPs. 
The first Swift observation (4th April 2007; Campana & Israel, ATEL #1043) showed that the X-ray pulse shape and pulsed fraction have largely changed after the glitch reported by Dib et al. (2007, ATEL #1041), and recently confirmed by Chandra data (Gavriil et al. 2007, ATEL #1076). Moreover, the subsequent Swift monitoring observations found that the pulsed fraction (defined as semi-amplitude of the modulation divided by the mean source count rate) increased from about 22%+/-2% up to almost 38%+/-3% (the quiescent level being around 90%), while the pulse shape varied from being multi-peaked to almost sinusoidal. We also confirmed the anti-correlation between the count rate and the pulsed fraction first reported by Mereghetti et al. (2005) 
We thank the Swift and Paranal teams for their support and effort in optimizing observations. 2007-05-18 21:05:00
response:
该现象描述了AXP 1E1048.1-5937在2007年4月至5月期间的X射线与近红外多波段监测结果。首先，X射线（Swift/XRT，1–10 keV）与近红外（VLT/NAOS-CONICA，Ks波段）流量均呈现一致的衰减趋势：X射线吸收通量在4月底前维持在较高水平（3.5×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s），而5月8日和17日观测显示通量下降约20%；对应地，Ks波段星等由4月6日的~19.6变暗至5月10日的~20.2，表明近红外辐射同步减弱。这种X射线与IR光变的一致性暗示二者可能具有共同的辐射起源或受同一物理机制调制。

其次，脉冲特性发生显著演化：首次Swift观测（4月4日）显示脉冲轮廓与脉冲分数（pulsed fraction）较 glitch（Dib et al. 2007报告）后已明显改变；后续监测进一步揭示脉冲分数从约22%持续上升至近38%，同时脉冲轮廓由多峰结构逐渐演化为近正弦形。该演化过程与计数率呈反相关——即源变暗时脉冲调制增强，这与Mereghetti et al. (2005)早先报道的AXP中普遍存在的反相关关系一致，支持磁层扭结模型或电流片重联导致的辐射区几何收缩假说：当磁层应力释放后，辐射区域收缩、束流更集中，导致脉冲分数升高但总流量下降。

最后，Fx/FIR ≈ 10³的数量级与其它AXP一致，表明其X射线与红外辐射能量分配符合AXP典型能谱分布特征，进一步确认其作为典型磁星候选体的分类可靠性。综合来看，该系列变化反映glitch后磁层处于持续弛豫过程，辐射几何与粒子加速效率发生系统性调整。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT observations of the very-faint X-ray transient XMMU J174716.1-281048 We observed the very-faint X-ray transient XMMU J174716.1-281048 during a total of 5.5 ksec Swift/XRT pointings, performed on May 13 and May 17 2007. We have clearly detected the source during our observations. By fitting the source spectrum with an absorbed powerlaw model (nH=9.0E22 cm-2, photon index=2.25), we find an unabsorbed flux of 7.4E-12 erg/cm2/s (2-10 keV). Del Santo et al. (2007; astro-ph/0704.2134) suggested a distance toward the source of approximately 3 to 4 kpc, based on the type-I X-ray burst detected by INTEGRAL (ATEL #970). Assuming a distance of 3.5 kpc, the derived flux translates to a luminosity of 1.1E34 erg/s. The XRT position of the source is found to be RA (J2000.0)=17 47 16.2, Dec J2000.0)=-28 10 46.81 (with an uncertainty of 3.8 arcsec), which is consistent with the XMM-Newton position of the source (ATEL #147). 
The neutron star X-ray binary XMMU J174716.1-281048 was detected in outburst with XMM-Newton in 2003 and 2005 (ATEL #147 and Sidoli et al., 2006, A&A 456, 287). At these times the source displayed a luminosity of Lx~1E34 (d/3.5kpc) erg/s, with spectral parameters similar to the ones we find now. XMMU J174716.1-281048 was not detected during Chandra and XMM observations of the field performed in 2000 and 2001, which indicates that this source is a transient system with a quiescent emission at least two orders of magnitude lower. With such an anomalous low accretion rate during outburst, XMMU J174716.1-281048 can be classified as a very-faint X-ray transient. Based on the properties of the type-I X-ray burst detected from this source, Del Santo et al. (2007; astro-ph/0704.2134) argued that XMMU J174716.1-281048 is undergoing an accretion episode of several years and is therefore a quasi-persistent X-ray transient. Motivated by their paper, we proposed a short Swift/XRT observation to determine the current state of this system. The fact that we again detect XMMU J174716.1-281048 at similar fluxes as during the XMM-Newton observations strengthens the suggestion that the system is undergoing a prolonged accretion episode of many years. Studying this system at all wavelengths can be of great value for our understanding of binary evolution models. 
It is a pleasure to thank the Swift team for making these observations possible. 2007-05-19 08:00:00
response: 该现象描述了一个极暗X射线暂现源XMMU J174716.1-281048的Swift/XRT观测结果。首先，观测在2007年5月13日和17日共进行5.5 ks，成功清晰探测到该源，表明其仍处于活动状态。光谱拟合采用吸积幂律模型（nH=9.0×10²² cm⁻²，光子指数Γ=2.25），得到2–10 keV波段未吸收通量为7.4×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s。结合INTEGRAL探测到的I型X射线暴所推断的距离（3–4 kpc，取中值3.5 kpc），换算得X射线光度约为1.1×10³⁴ erg/s。该光度与2003年和2005年XMM-Newton观测到的爆发期光度Lₓ∼10³⁴ erg/s（按相同比例距离归一化）一致，说明当前仍处于同一高光度阶段。而2000–2001年Chandra与XMM-Newton对该天区的观测未探测到该源，表明其宁静态光度至少比爆发态低两个数量级，符合暂现源定义。I型X射线暴的存在确认其中子星本质，且暴特征支持其正处于持续数年的准稳态吸积过程，而非典型短时标爆发；本次Swift再次测得相似通量，进一步佐证该系统属于“准持久性X射线暂现源”——即爆发持续时间远超常规（数年量级），但峰值光度显著低于典型低质量X射线双星（仅约10³⁴ erg/s）。这种异常低的爆发光度可能反映极低的吸积率（∼10⁻¹⁰ M⊙/yr量级），对理解弱吸积下中子星表面核燃烧、边界层辐射机制及演化晚期低质量双星的吸积稳定性具有关键意义。

根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL  detects an early stage of a new outburst of Aql X-1 We monitored the region around GRS 1915+105 with INTEGRAL since March 7, 2007 with one 20 ks observation performed every second revolution (the approximative separation between two consecutive observations is 6 days).   
During our last observation performed between May 20, 16h 59 UTC and May 20, 22h45 UTC (INTEGRAL revolution 561) a source, whose position is consistent with that of the transient Atoll Aql X-1 (within 0.5 arcmin between 20 and 40 keV), is clearly detected with ISGRI in the 20-40 and 40-80 keV mosaic images.   
This source, we can safely associate with Aql X-1, has respective fluxes of 7.44 cts/s (~43.5 mCrab, SNR=17.2 ?) and 3.01 cts/s (45 mCrab, SNR 8.3 ?) in the 20-40 keV and 40-80 keV energy ranges. Inspection of the last RXTE/ASM pointings of the source (up to May 20 2007) indicates a marginal detection on May 20 ( at 2.9 ?) with a 2-12 keV flux of 32 mCrab. 
We extracted an ISGRI spectrum from the real time data. A single power law fits the 22-80 keV spectrum well. The power law photon index is ?=2.2 +-0.3 and the 20-100 keV flux 6.4 e-10 erg/s/cm2. Although the last spectral points are of poor statistical quality they may indicate the presence of a cut-off in the spectrum. Replacing the powerlaw with a powerlaw with a high energy cut-off leads to Gamma= 2.1+-0.3 with a cut off energy>48 keV (the e- folding energy was frozen to 30 keV). With the latter model the 20-200 keV flux is only 30% of the maximum 20-200 keV flux reported for the faint April 2005 outburst (Rodriguez et al. 2006, A&A, 451, 1045). The source is unfortunately outside the field of view of JEM-X so no information on the soft X-rays is available, however the parameters of the spectral fitting, and the marginal detection by the RXTE/ASM are compatible with the source being in a hard spectral state. Significance maps can be found at http://isdcul3.unige.ch/~rodrigue/Aql/AqlX1_2007.jpg  while the 22-80 keV ?-F? spectrum and the cut off power law fit can be found at http://isdcul3.unige.ch/~rodrigue/Aql/Spec_Aql_2007.gif    
Inspection of the individual pointings shows the source is detected in 4 out of 6 science windows in the 20-40 keV energy range with a flux varying from 40 to 55 mCrab (when detected), and a 3 sigma upper limit of ~25-30 mCrab when it is not detected. The source was not detected by ISGRI in our previous observation performed on May 12 (INTEGRAL revolution 559) with a 3-sigma upper limit of about 8.5 mCrab between 20 and 40 keV. The clear detection during rev. 561 indicates that Aql X-1 is likely to be entering a new episode of outburst. The fact that the source was not detected in our previous observation, and the hard spectral state of the source inferred from our preliminary spectral analysis, indicate that we have caught Aql X-1 in an early stage of the outburst. Further observations at all wavelengths are strongly encouraged to monitor this still poorly known rising phase of outburst of transients source, and possibly catch a spectral transition if the source undergoes a major outburst. 2007-05-21 15:00:00
response:
该现象描述了Aql X-1在2007年5月进入新爆发的早期阶段，判断依据如下：  
首先，INTEGRAL/ISGRI在2007年5月20日（历元561）的观测中，在20–40 keV和40–80 keV波段清晰探测到一个源，其位置与已知暂现源Aql X-1在0.5角分内一致，可可靠证认为该源；其硬X射线流量分别为~43.5 mCrab和~45 mCrab，信噪比分别为17.2和8.3，显著高于背景。  
其次，对比前一次观测（5月12日，历元559），ISGRI在20–40 keV波段未探测到该源，3σ上限仅为~8.5 mCrab，表明源流量在约6天内至少增长了5倍以上，符合爆发上升相的典型光变特征。  
第三，光谱分析显示22–80 keV能段可用幂律模型良好拟合，光子指数Γ = 2.2 ± 0.3，且存在高能截断迹象（截断能量>48 keV），结合RXTE/ASM在2–12 keV波段仅给出2.9σ边际探测（32 mCrab）以及JEM-X无软X射线数据，整体谱形偏硬，符合低频暂现源在爆发初始阶段常处的硬态特征。  
第四，多窗口数据分析显示该源在历元561的6个科学窗中于20–40 keV波段有4次明确探测，流量在40–55 mCrab间变化，未探测时3σ上限为25–30 mCrab，进一步支持其处于不稳定的快速上升期。  
综上，位置一致性、流量突增、硬谱态、缺乏软X射线辐射及时间演化序列共同表明：Aql X-1正处于一次新爆发的早期阶段。

根据现象进行分析： Optical/IR Confirmation of Outburst of Aql X-1 Ongoing optical/IR monitoring of Aql X-1 with the SMARTS 1.3m telescope and ANDICAM instrument at CTIO show a steady rise over the past week. This confirms the INTEGRAL detection of the beginning of a new outburst of the source as reported by Rodriguez et al. (ATEL #1079). Our most recent data show that on May 22, 7.8h UTC (mid-exposure) the source was at R=17.2, J=15.8, compared to mean quiescent values of R=18.8, J=16.7. These magnitudes include the unrelated star 0.5" away (Chevalier et al. 1999 A&A 347, L51). SMARTS light curves can be seen at http://www.astro.yale.edu/maitra/AqlX-1/AqlX-1.lc.jpg  . Multiwavelength observations are highly encouraged. 
OIR light curve of Aql X-1 2007-05-22 16:43:00
response: 首先，观测到天鹰座X-1（Aql X-1）在光学/红外波段出现持续增亮现象，SMARTS 1.3m望远镜与ANDICAM仪器在过去一周内记录到其亮度稳定上升。这一变化与INTEGRAL卫星探测到的新爆发起始事件一致，验证了Rodriguez等人在ATEL #1079中的报告。其次，5月22日7.8小时UTC（中曝光时刻）的测光数据显示：R波段星等为17.2，J波段为15.8；而该源在宁静态下的平均星等分别为R=18.8、J=16.7，表明R波段增亮约1.6等，J波段增亮约0.9等，证实爆发已进入光学/红外可观测阶段。第三，需注意所测光度包含距离目标0.5角秒处一颗无关恒星的贡献（Chevalier et al. 1999），因此实测亮度略高于Aql X-1本体真实值，可能影响对爆发光度演化的精确建模。第四，该光变曲线对应于2007年5月22日16:43:00（UTC）时刻的OIR观测，属于多波段协同监测的关键时间节点，支持将此次光学/红外增亮与高能X射线爆发在时间与物理机制上关联起来，符合低质量X射线双星爆发时吸积盘热不稳定性导致多波段同步响应的典型模型。

根据现象进行分析： Cygnus X-3 in extreme soft state INTEGRAL observed the Cygnus region 2007-05-21T09:45 until 23:37 UT.  
During this observation the HMXB Cyg X-3 was within the field of view of IBIS and JEM-X1 for 9.5 ks. JEM-X1 data show a high state with a flux of (9.4 Â± 1.1)E-09 erg/cm**2/sec (551 mCrab) and (0.34 Â± 0.08)E-09 erg/cm**2/sec (60 mCrab) in the 3-10 and 10-20 keV energy range, respectively. The spectrum is well represented by a blackbody model with temperature kT = (1.15 Â± 0.05) keV. At the same time IBIS/ISGRI shows a flux of only (8.7 Â± 1.6)E-11 erg/cm**2/sec (11 mCrab) in the 20 - 40 keV energy band and no significant detection above 40 keV. This extreme soft state appears to be the continuation of a trend observed by Swift/BAT as reported by Krimm et al. (ATEL #1061).
INTEGRAL will observe the Cygnus region again starting on 2007-05-25. 
Images and spectra 2007-05-22 17:00:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2007年5月21日09:45至23:37 UT，INTEGRAL对天鹅座区域进行了观测，期间高质X射线双星Cyg X-3位于IBIS和JEM-X1视场内共9.5 ks。  
其次，JEM-X1在3–10 keV和10–20 keV能段分别测得流量为(9.4±1.1)×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s（551 mCrab）和(0.34±0.08)×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s（60 mCrab），表明源处于高光度态；其能谱可被黑体模型很好拟合，温度kT = 1.15±0.05 keV，说明辐射主导成分是热辐射，且特征能量较低。  
第三，IBIS/ISGRI在20–40 keV能段仅探测到微弱流量(8.7±1.6)×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s（11 mCrab），且40 keV以上无显著探测，证实硬X射线辐射极度缺乏，与JEM-X1所见的强软X射线形成鲜明对比，构成“极端软态”的核心判据。  
第四，该状态并非孤立事件，而是Swift/BAT此前观测到的软化趋势的延续（参见ATEL #1061），说明源正处于持续演化中的特殊吸积态。  
最后，结合多仪器数据：JEM-X1覆盖软X射线、IBIS/ISGRI覆盖中硬X射线，二者联合揭示了宽能段谱形的急剧截断——能量分布集中于<20 keV，峰值约在~1.15 keV对应波长≈10.8 Å，进一步支持热主导、低截断能量的物理图像。  
因此，“极端软态”定义为：在高光度前提下，X射线谱以低温黑体为主导，硬X射线（>20 keV）辐射强度比软X射线低两个数量级以上，且缺乏非热成分的显著贡献。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Radio non-detection of SN 2006gy with GMRT in the L-band SN 2006gy was observed with the GMRT on 18 May 2007 at the mean observing epoch of 6.01 UT. The L-band observation (mean frequency 1398 MHz) with a total bandwidth of 32 MHz does not detect the Supernova. The time on source was 3 hrs. The two sigma upper limit to the flux density at the position of SN 2006gy is 450 uJy (microJansky). 2007-05-22 18:43:00
response: 首先，观测目标是超新星SN 2006gy，使用设备为巨米波射电望远镜（GMRT），观测频段为L波段（中心频率1398 MHz，总带宽32 MHz）。观测时间是2007年5月18日世界时6.01时，实际积分时间为3小时。该次观测未在SN 2006gy的位置上探测到任何射电辐射信号。根据观测数据的噪声水平和积分时间，计算得到该位置处的2σ流量密度上限为450 μJy。这一非探测结果表明，在L波段、该时刻及该灵敏度下，SN 2006gy的射电辐射强度低于450 μJy；结合其已知距离与爆发年龄（约340天后），可进一步约束其激波与周围介质相互作用的物理参数，例如质量损失率、星际介质密度或激波速度等。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Unidentified Optical Transient From the PQ Survey We detected a strong optical transient in the Palomar-Quest (PQ) survey drift scans obtained at the Palomar 48-inch Samuel Oschin Telescope on 19 May 2007 UT. The transient is unresolved, at the coordinates (J2000): RA = 14 33 04.39 Dec = +15 07 7.1 For finding charts and offsets, please see: http://palquest.org/transients/  At the discovery epoch, the magnitudes (calibrated to the SDSS system) were: g = 20.26, r = 19.53, i = 20.13, and z > 22 mag. By 21 May 2007 UT, the object has faded slightly to r = 19.90 mag, and it does not have a detectable proper motion; no subsequent data were obtained. The source is not present in the previous PQ images (reaching down to ~ 21 - 22 mag), the archival SDSS or DSS images, in NED, or the FIRST and NVSS radio surveys. The source was observed 5.4 arcsec E and 10.0 arcsec S from an anonymous, ~ 18 mag galaxy. The two may or may not be associated. Further observations, especially spectroscopy, are strongly encouraged. 2007-05-23 19:40:00
response: 该光学暂现源具有以下关键特征：首先，它在2007年5月19日UT被PQ巡天首次探测到，位置精确（J2000历元下RA=14h33m04.39s，Dec=+15°07′07.1″），且呈点源结构，无分辨延展；其次，多波段测光显示其在g、r、i波段均有显著流量（g=20.26, r=19.53, i=20.13），z波段未探测到（z>22），色指数g−r≈0.73、r−i≈−0.40，呈现蓝—红—蓝的异常颜色趋势，暗示可能非典型恒星连续谱；第三，两天后（5月21日）r波段变暗至19.90，表明存在真实光变，衰减约0.37 mag，符合暂现源演化特征；第四，历史影像（PQ前期数据、SDSS、DSS）、星表（NED）及射电巡天（FIRST/NVSS）均未检出对应体，排除已知恒星、活动星系核或射电源；第五，其与一颗~18等邻近星系存在5.4″E、10.0″S的空间偏移，投影距离约数十kpc量级（取决于红移），但缺乏红移信息，无法确认物理关联；第六，未探测到自行，排除太阳系内天体；综上，该源是一次孤立、快速光变、无先存对应体、无射电辐射的光学暂现事件，候选类型包括：Ia型超新星早期爆发、潮汐撕裂事件（TDE）、致密天体并合后的千新星余辉，或罕见的激变变星爆发，亟需光谱观测以确定红移、发射/吸收线特征及物理起源。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Radio observations of SN 2006gy with MERLIN The position of SN2006gy was observed using six telescopes of MERLIN at 1.658 GHz on May 9/10 with a resolution of 0.2", and 4.994 GHz on May 11 2007 with a resolution of 0.07". Both observations used 16x1MHz channels and were phase referenced using 3C84. A run of 5 hours at 1.658 GHz found no source at the position of SN2006gy to a 3-sigma limit of 0.28 mJy. At 4.994 GHz, an 8 hour observation found no source to a 3-sigma limit of 0.18 mJy. 2007-05-25 10:07:00
response:
首先，题目描述的是对超新星SN 2006gy进行的射电观测实验，使用MERLIN阵列在两个不同频率（1.658 GHz和4.994 GHz）下开展，时间分别为2007年5月9/10日和5月11日。观测分辨率分别为0.2″和0.07″，说明空间分辨能力在高频时更高，有利于精确定位。

其次，两次观测均采用相位参考校准技术，以3C84为相位参考源，这保证了绝对位置定标精度，使射电位置与光学位置可比对，从而确认是否探测到对应于SN 2006gy光学坐标的射电源。

第三，数据采集参数一致：均使用16个1 MHz宽的通道，表明频谱采样方式相同，有利于后续谱指数分析（尽管未探测到信号，此点暂不可用）。

第四，积分时间不同（5小时 vs 8小时），但所达3σ噪声水平反而在更高频率（4.994 GHz）更低（0.18 mJy < 0.28 mJy），说明高频观测不仅分辨率更高，且灵敏度更优——这既得益于更长积分时间，也可能源于高频波段系统温度较低或带宽效率更高。

第五，关键结果是：在SN 2006gy的精确光学位置上，两个频段均未探测到射电辐射，3σ流量密度上限分别为0.28 mJy（1.658 GHz）和0.18 mJy（4.994 GHz）。该非探测结果具有强物理意义：排除了存在中等强度同步加速辐射源（如激波与周围介质相互作用产生的射电辐射）的可能性，对限制爆炸能量、环境密度、粒子加速效率等模型参数构成重要约束。

最后，结合SN 2006gy作为极亮超新星（SLSN-IIn型）的性质，其光学光度极高且持续时间长，通常被解释为强激波与致密星周物质（CSM）相互作用所致；而射电非探测意味着该相互作用尚未产生可观测的同步辐射，可能暗示：CSM密度不够高、激波速度尚不足以有效加速电子、或观测时尚处于射电沉默期（即激波还未到达足够远、低密度区域以产生可探测辐射），需结合其他波段（如X射线、光学谱线变宽）联合建模判断。

input: 根据现象进行分析： H alpha emission in SAX J2103.5+4545 The high-mass X-ray binary SAX J2103.5+4545 was observed from Skinakas observatory (Crete) on 2007 May 14 (UT 22:24) and 20 (UT 22:12). The H alpha line showed a double-peak profile and weak emission with equivalent width 2.5+-0.2 and 1.9+-0.2 angstrom, respectively. This is the first report of H alpha emission since 2003 August. The optical activity coincides with renewed X-ray activity (Galis et al, ATel #1063; Krimm et al. ATel #1064). The 2007 May optical observations took place at the end of the X-ray outburst, when the X-ray flux had already fallen to pre-outburst values. The weak H alpha emission and split profile and X-ray activity agree with optical/X-ray observations performed during the end of the previous bright state in 2003 (Reig et al. 2004, A&A, 673, 680). 2007-05-25 16:06:00
response: Hα发射线的双峰轮廓表明存在围绕中子星的吸积盘或星周盘，其旋转运动导致多普勒分裂；等效宽度较小（约2.0 Å）说明发射强度较弱，对应盘内气体密度较低或电离程度不高；该发射在X射线爆发末期出现，且X射线流量已回落至爆发前水平，说明光学辐射并非由瞬时X射线再处理主导，而更可能源于盘的残余吸积活动或盘的弛豫过程；与2003年类似相位的观测一致，反映该系统在每次X射线爆发结束阶段均存在类似的光学谱线行为，支持其具有稳定的、与X射线活动耦合的盘-中子星相互作用机制。

input:
根据现象进行分析： The accreting millisecond pulsar HETE J1900.1-2455 is returning to quiescence We report ongoing Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer (RXTE) monitoring observations of the accretion-powered millisecond pulsar HETE J1900.1-2455 (Kaaret et al. 2006, ApJ 638, 963). This source has been X-ray active continuously since it first went into outburst in June 2005 (see e.g. ATel #657), although the 377.3 Hz pulsations became undetectable in August 2005 and have not been detected since. 
The last two RXTE observations have found HETE J1900.1-2455 at the faintest flux level yet seen. On 21 May the flux was 3.7e-11 erg/cm^2/s (2.5-25 keV), a factor of approximately 10 fainter than in the previous observation (14 May). On 27 May the source was even fainter, at 1.3e-11 erg/cm^2/s. Twice before in 2007 (on 3 February and 11 March) the flux decreased below the lowest level seen during 2005-6, reaching 3.1 and 3.6e-10 erg/cm^2/s respectively. However, the flux subsequently recovered each time, within a week. That the source has been consistently faint and fading for at least a week strongly suggests that HETE J1900.1-2455 is returning to quiescence. 
The source was the brightest yet seen just a month earlier, on 15 April, at 1.34e-9 erg/cm^2/s; more typically the flux was within a factor of two of the outburst-averaged mean value, 7.5e-10 erg/cm^2/s. Since the source became visible again to RXTE in February 2007, the X-ray flux has been significantly more variable, by a factor of ~4 on time-scales of ~50 d. During 2005 and 2006 the flux varied quasi-periodically on a time-scale of ~120 d with rms amplitude of ~20%. Accompanying the increased variability in 2007 were changes in the X-ray color evolution, with the source spectrum switching frequently to low hard color (i.e. a softer spectrum) characteristic of a flare observed early in the outburst, in 2005. 
We will continue our RXTE observations until the source becomes undetectable. More sensitive X-ray observations, as well as observations at other wavelengths, are strongly encouraged. 2007-05-28 05:18:00
response:
首先，观测到HETE J1900.1-2455的X射线流量持续下降：5月21日为3.7×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，5月27日进一步降至1.3×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，比5月14日观测值低约10倍，且为该源自2005年爆发以来所测得的最低流量。

其次，虽然该源在2007年2月和3月也曾出现低于2005–2006年最低流量的暂态低光度（分别为3.1×10⁻¹⁰和3.6×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s），但每次均在一周内恢复，表明此前的低光度是短期波动；而本次自5月21日起连续至少一周持续变暗且无回升迹象，与以往暂态行为明显不同。

第三，该源在4月15日仍处于高光度状态（1.34×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s），仅一个月内流量下降超两个数量级，衰减速率远超此前准周期变化（~120 d周期、rms~20%）或2007年以来的~50 d尺度、因子~4的起伏，说明当前衰减已脱离常规吸积不稳定性范畴。

第四，2007年以来X射线能谱行为亦发生改变：频繁呈现低硬色指数（即软谱），类似2005年爆发初期耀发特征，暗示吸积流结构可能正从稳定盘主导态向低率、几何厚、辐射效率降低的状态演化。

第五，毫秒脉冲信号自2005年8月起始终未再探测到，结合当前流量已逼近RXTE探测极限（10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s量级），且持续衰减，表明中子星表面热辐射与吸积柱辐射均显著减弱，符合进入静止态（quiescence）时吸积率降至10⁻⁵–10⁻⁶ Ṁ_Edd以下、边界层/磁层活动基本熄灭的理论预期。

综上，流量持续下降、时间尺度延长、光变模式转变、能谱软化及脉冲消失共同指向吸积流整体坍缩，因此判断该源正在返回静止态。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift observations of Aql X-1 The neutron star X-ray transient Aql X-1 has been reported to start a new outburst in ATEL \\#1079 and ATEL \\#1080. We analyzed two Swift observations of Aql X-1 carried out on May 28 (Photon Counting mode, 1828 s) and May 29 (Window Timing mode, 164 s). We fit together the two spectra finding a slightly fading X-ray source (about 20%) and a power law photon index moving from 1.58+/-0.05 to 1.83+/-0.08 (90% confidence level). The column density was held fixed to the best fit value of (3.9+/-0.3)x10^21 cm^-2. The unabsorbed 0.5-10 keV luminosity is (2-3)x10^36 erg s^-1 (at 4 kpc). Inspection of RXTE-ASM and Swift-BAT data do not provide a clear indication if the source is still rising to the outburst peak or it is in its decaying phase. Further optical and X-ray observations are encouraged. 2007-05-30 17:27:00
response:
首先，观测对象是中子星X射线暂现源Aql X-1，其新爆发已被ATEL #1079和#1080通报。Swift望远镜于5月28日和29日进行了两次观测，分别采用光子计数模式（1828秒）和窗定时模式（164秒），覆盖不同时间尺度与能谱响应特性。

其次，将两次观测的能谱联合拟合，发现源流量存在约20%的衰减，表明X射线辐射在两天内呈下降趋势。同时，幂律谱光子指数由1.58±0.05增至1.83±0.08（90%置信度），说明能谱变软，符合X射线暂现源在爆发衰减阶段常见的谱演化特征——即随着吸积率降低，热冕冷却或几何结构变化导致高能光子比例减少。

第三，吸收柱密度被固定为(3.9±0.3)×10²¹ cm⁻²，该值来自前期最佳拟合结果，表明视线方向的星际介质吸收相对稳定，未发生显著变化，因此流量与谱形的变化主要源于源本征性质而非吸收变化。

第四，计算得0.5–10 keV波段的去吸收光度为(2–3)×10³⁶ erg s⁻¹（距离取4 kpc），处于中子星低质量X射线双星典型爆发光度范围（10³⁵–10³⁸ erg s⁻¹），支持其处于爆发态，但尚未达到峰值光度（典型峰值常达10³⁷–10³⁸ erg s⁻¹）。

第五，RXTE-ASM与Swift-BAT的长期监测数据未能明确判定当前处于上升支还是衰减支，可能因采样间隔较粗、灵敏度不足或爆发形态非对称所致；结合两天内已观测到明显衰减及谱变软，更倾向于源已过峰并进入衰减初期，但仍需更高频次观测确认拐点。

最后，光学与X射线后续观测被强调为必要，因光学辐射可反映外盘吸积流变化，X射线高频监测可捕捉时变特征（如千赫兹QPO、爆发现象），从而约束吸积物理过程与系统参数。

根据现象进行分析： Swift observations of the unidentified optical transient PQT 070519 The unidentified optical transient PQT 070519 reported in ATel #1083 has been observed with Swift for a total of 9.8 ks over 3 epochs on 2007 May 24, 2007 May 27 and 2007 May 28.
The source is not detected in the 0.3-10 keV X-ray band down to a 3-sigma limiting flux of 3E-13 erg/cm2/s (assuming a nearby Gamma = 2 intrinsically unabsorbed power law source, and taking into account the Galactic absorption at this position of nH = 1.5E20 cm-2).
The source is marginally detected in the UVOT V-band filter with the following magnitudes:  Date-obs |  Texp (s) | mag |  detection significance  
---|---|---|---  
2007-05-24|  1240 |  20.70+/-0.53|  2.2-sigma  
2007-05-27|  2301 |  20.75+/-0.41|  2.8-sigma  
2007-05-28 | 1619 |  20.79+/-0.50|  2.3-sigma  
There is no evidence of fading in our observations.  
  
The nearby galaxy (RA, Dec (J2000) = 218.26674,+15.12142 deg, 11.3 arcsec from the transient source) is clearly detected with the following V-band magnitudes:  Date-obs |  Texp (s)|  mag  
---|---|---  
2007-05-24 | 1240 | 18.16+/-0.06  
2007-05-27 | 2301 | 18.19+/-0.05  
2007-05-28 | 1619 | 18.11+/-0.05  
Magnitudes are not corrected for the Galactic extinction of E(B-V) = 0.018 mag. Quoted errors do not include the error in the zeropoint.
  

The long duration optical transient (>9 days), together with the X-ray non-detection suggests that this is not a Gamma-ray Burst or AGN, while the large distance between the source and the nearby galaxy does not favour a stellar capture event, ULX or supernova origin.  
  
The faint pre-outburst limit suggests that any Galactic object must be in the halo or of very late spectral type. The duration and the >3 magnitude amplitude suggest a stellar flare is unlikely. Rather, we propose that a distant nova or dwarf nova eruption is consistent with the data to hand. 
No further Swift observations are planned. We thank the Swift team for performing this ToO observation. 2007-05-30 18:14:00
response: 该光学暂现源PQT 070519在Swift的三次观测中（2007年5月24日、27日、28日）总曝光9.8 ks，X射线波段（0.3–10 keV）未探测到信号，3σ极限流量为3×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s，排除典型伽马暴（GRB）和活动星系核（AGN）——因二者通常具有显著X射线辐射；UVOT V波段仅呈边缘性探测（2.2–2.8σ），亮度维持在约20.75 mag且无衰减趋势，表明光变平稳而非爆发后典型衰减；其持续时间>9天，与短时标GRB余辉或多数超新星早期光变不符；暂现源与邻近星系（角距11.3″，V≈18.1 mag）空间分离明显，不支持其为该星系成员的超新星、潮汐撕裂事件（TDE）或超亮X射线源（ULX）；预爆发深度限制较暗，若为银河系内天体，则需位于银晕或为极晚型矮星；光变幅度>3 mag但时标长、无快速峰后衰减，亦不满足典型恒星耀斑特征（通常持续分钟至小时量级且快速衰减）；综合光度、时标、缺乏X射线对应体、准稳态光学光变及与宿主星系的距离，最合理的物理解释是遥远星系中的经典新星（nova）或矮新星（dwarf nova）爆发——二者均可呈现持续数日至数周的V波段增亮、幅度数个星等、X射线辐射微弱或缺失（尤其在非高吸积率相位），且空间位置可偏离星系中心。

根据现象进行分析： Swift uncovers that SAX J0840.7+2248 is not a X-ray Binary, but BeppoSAX X-ray Rich GRB980429 The transient source SAX J0840.7+2248 has recently been observed by Swift/XRT and UVOT for a total of 10.6ks on May 29 00:35:49 to 23:21:57 UT. The Swift/XRT data show no X-ray counterpart within the BeppoSAX/WFC position error circle of 3 arcmin radius centered on RA,Decl(J2000)=08h 40m 40s, +22d 48m 18s (Heise et al., 1998, IAUC  6892  ). A 3sigma upper limit on a source within the SAX error box can be placed at 4.5E-14 erg cm-2 s-1 (for a spectrum of photon index 2, no intrinsic absorption, and a Galactic Hydrogen column of NH=(3.45)10^+20 cm-2). Assuming a distance of 8 kpc (1 kpc), we obtain a 3sigma upper limit on the luminosity of 3x10^32 (5x10^30) erg s-1. These values are quite low for a Galactic X-ray Binary. 
Prompted by this finding, we performed a reanalysis of the BeppoSAX/GRBM data on this transient. We discovered that the X-ray Fast Transient (IAUC  6892  ) is an X-ray rich gamma-ray burst, ~100s long, with an onset time of 1998-04-29 08:46 UT. The GRBM spectrum was fit with a simple power law. We find a total 40-700 keV fluence of 1.7 (-0.4, +0.5) x10^-6 erg cm-2 and a photon index of 3.4 (-0.6,+0.7). The peak flux evaluated over 16s (40-700 keV) is (2.7 +/- 0.9)x 10^-8 erg cm-2 s-1 with a photon index of 2.5+/-0.8. All quoted errors are at the 90% level. 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for performing these observations. 2007-05-31 13:03:00
response:
首先，Swift/XRT和UVOT对SAX J0840.7+2248进行了约10.6 ks的观测，覆盖时间从2007年5月29日00:35:49至23:21:57 UT。观测在BeppoSAX/WFC最初报告的位置（RA=08h40m40s, Dec=+22d48m18s，J2000；误差圆半径3′）内未探测到任何X射线源。据此可给出3σ上限流量为4.5×10⁻¹⁴ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（假设光子指数Γ=2、无本征吸收、银河系氢柱密度N_H=3.45×10²⁰ cm⁻²）。  

其次，若该源位于银河系内（取距离为8 kpc或1 kpc），则对应3σ上限光度分别为3×10³² erg s⁻¹或5×10³⁰ erg s⁻¹。这两个值均显著低于典型银河系X射线双星的持续X射线光度（通常≥10³⁵ erg s⁻¹），因此可排除其为经典X射线双星的可能性。  

第三，受上述非探测结果启发，研究者重新分析了BeppoSAX/GRBM在1998年4月29日的数据，发现该瞬变事件实为一次持续约100秒的X射线富集型伽马暴（X-ray rich GRB），爆发起始时刻为1998-04-29 08:46 UT。GRBM在40–700 keV能段测得总通量为(1.7±0.45)×10⁻⁶ erg cm⁻²（90%置信度），光子指数Γ=3.4⁺⁰·⁷₋₀.₆；16秒峰值通量为(2.7±0.9)×10⁻⁸ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应光子指数Γ=2.5±0.8。这些高能光谱与时间特征符合伽马暴典型行为，而非X射线双星的吸积辐射特征。  

综上，SAX J0840.7+2248并非X射线双星，而是BeppoSAX于1998年探测到的一次X射线富集型伽马暴GRB980429，其后续无X射线余辉被Swift探测到，与伽马暴余辉快速衰减或指向性喷流导致的低流量预期一致。

根据现象进行分析： Optical decline of HETE J1900.1-2455 Following the recently reported decline of the X-ray flux from the millisecond pulsar HETE J1900.1-2455 (Galloway et al. 2007, ATel #1086), we acquired images of its optical counterpart using the Wide Field Camera mounted on the 2.5m Isaac Newton Telescope at La Palma. The images were obtained on 2007 May 29 4:10-4:33 UT and May 30 3:42-4:17 UT and photometrically calibrated using the standard stars SA 113-260 and BD+33 2642.
PSF photometry of a single 10 min r-band image acquired each night yields r=20.61 +/- 0.06 on May 29 and r= 20.24 +/- 0.03 on May 30. This indicates that HETE J1900.1-2455 has faded by more than 2 magnitudes compared to the optical brightness reported during outburst (R~18; Fox et al. 2005, ATel #526; Steeghs et al, ATel #543). The data also supports significant variability between our two epochs.
Additional observations of the source at optical and near-infrared wavelengths in support of the ongoing X-ray monitoring is planned. 2007-05-31 14:05:00
response:
首先，观测目标是毫秒脉冲星HETE J1900.1−2455的光学对应体，其X射线流量已被报道出现下降（Galloway et al. 2007, ATel #1086），因此开展光学后随观测以检验是否同步发生光学变暗。  
其次，使用加那利群岛拉帕尔马岛2.5米 Isaac Newton望远镜上的宽视场相机（WFC）在两个时间点获取r波段图像：2007年5月29日04:10–04:33 UT和5月30日03:42–04:17 UT；光度定标采用标准星SA 113-260与BD+33 2642，确保测光精度可靠。  
第三，对每晚单帧10分钟r波段图像进行PSF测光，得到r = 20.61 ± 0.06（5月29日）和r = 20.24 ± 0.03（5月30日），两晚间亮度变化Δr ≈ 0.37 mag，表明该源在约23小时内显著变亮；但需注意：该短期变亮发生于整体长期衰减背景中——相比爆发期光学亮度R ∼ 18（Fox et al. 2005; Steeghs et al.），当前r ∼ 20.4（取两晚平均），已变暗约2.4 mag，证实光学与X射线同步衰减。  
第四，两次观测间Δr = 0.37 mag > 0.07 mag（误差合成上限），且信噪比足够高（误差仅0.03–0.06），因此该光变具有统计显著性，支持该源存在短时标光学闪烁或不规则衰减行为。  
最后，结合X射线衰减现象、光学大幅变暗（>2 mag）及两晚间显著光变，可推断HETE J1900.1−2455正处于爆发后的快速衰减相，吸积活动整体减弱，但残余吸积流或喷流可能仍引发短时标扰动，后续多波段监测将有助于区分热辐射衰减与非热辐射贡献。

根据现象进行分析： Continuing flux decay of HETE J1900.1-2455 as observed with Swift/XRT Galloway et al. (2007; ATEL #1086) reported that the X-ray luminosity of the accreting millisecond pulsar HETE J1900.1-2455 exhibited a steady decay between 14 and 27 May, and suggested that the source may be finally returning to quiescence after an outburst of ~2 years. A similar declined was seen in the optical flux of the source (ATEL #1090). To follow the X-ray luminosity and spectral behavior of the source, we observed it with Swift/XRT during a ~1 ksec exposure performed on May 31, 2007 (00:02-00:18 UT). The source was clearly detected at an absorbed flux of ~2.7E-12 erg/s/cm^2 (2-10 keV; using an absorbed power-law model with Nh of ~1.4E21 cm^-2 and an power-law index of 2.5+-0.5). This extrapolates to a flux of ~3.0E-12 erg/s/cm^2 in the 2.5-25 keV band, which is a factor of ~4 fainter than during the RXTE observation on 21 May (ATEL #1086). The continued fading of the X-ray flux confirms that HETE J1900.1-2455 is returning to quiescence after an outburst episode of about 2 years. Swift/XRT observations will continue throughout June; a Chandra observation is currently planned for the last week of June. 
It is a pleasure to thank the Swift team for making the XRT observations possible. 2007-05-31 15:06:00
response:
首先，观测到HETE J1900.1-2455的X射线光度在5月14日至27日期间持续衰减，Galloway等人（2007；ATEL #1086）据此推测该源可能正结束约两年的爆发期、回归宁静态。  
其次，光学波段也观测到类似衰减趋势（ATEL #1090），表明多波段辐射同步减弱，支持整体吸积活动系统性下降的物理图像。  
第三，Swift/XRT于2007年5月31日进行约1 ks观测，测得2–10 keV吸收通量约为2.7×10⁻¹² erg/s/cm²，光谱拟合采用吸收幂律模型，得到柱密度N_H ≈ 1.4×10²¹ cm⁻²、光谱指数Γ = 2.5 ± 0.5。  
第四，将该模型外推至2.5–25 keV波段，得到通量约3.0×10⁻¹² erg/s/cm²，较5月21日RXTE观测结果低约4倍，证实X射线流量仍在持续下降。  
第五，通量的单调递减、多波段一致性、以及光谱参数无显著突变（如Γ保持典型热谱或硬谱特征），共同表明吸积率正在平稳降低，而非发生状态跃迁或遮挡等暂现过程。  
因此，综合时间序列通量演化、能谱稳定性及多波段协同行为，可确定该源正处于长时标爆发后的衰退出相，正向宁静态过渡。

input: 根据现象进行分析： A expected bright radio flare of Cygnus X-3 We detected a new powerful flare from the microquasar Cygnus X-3 with the RATAN-600 radio telescope on June 1. The measured flux densities are 3.2, 4.73, 3.42, 2.7, 2.34, 1.54 and 1.15 Jy at 1, 2.3, 4.8, 7.7, 11.2, 21.7 and 30 GHz respectively (MJD54252.05). Thus the spectral index is -0.54 at frequencies higher 2.3 GHz. The spectrum is similar to one on Jan 28 in the beginning of the powerful Jan-Feb flare of Cygnus X-3: http://cats.sao.ru/~satr/XB/CygX-3/c3_sp_2007Jun1.png  . Last X-ray data (ATEL #1028, #1061 and #1081) from Swift-BAT and INTEGRAL clearly indicated a probable following jet ejection as it was observed in 2006 (ATEL #984). Indeed after a one year such jet activity Cygnus X-3 has left the high-soft state in February (see the RATAN/Swift-BAT light curves at http://cats.sao.ru/~satr/XB/CygX-3/c3_ratan_swift.png  ) and now entered this state again. The detected flare coincides with a fast increase of the hard X-ray flux during last two days (see http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/CygX-3/  ). 2007-06-01 08:33:00
response: 首先，观测到天鹅座X-3在MJD 54252.05（2007年6月1日）发生一次新的强射电耀发，RATAN-600望远镜在1–30 GHz频段测得7个频点的流量密度，呈幂律衰减趋势；其次，计算高于2.3 GHz的谱指数为−0.54，表明该射电谱为典型的倒置或平谱，符合微类星体喷流自吸收同步辐射特征；第三，该射电谱形态与2007年1月28日强耀发初期高度相似，暗示二者可能源于同种物理机制——即相对论性喷流的爆发性形成；第四，近期Swift-BAT与INTEGRAL的硬X射线监测（ATEL #1028、#1061、#1081）显示硬X射线通量快速上升，且与历史喷流喷发前兆一致（如2006年ATEL #984所报道），支持本次射电耀发对应新喷流的抛射；第五，天鹅座X-3在2007年2月刚结束高软态，而本次射电/X射线联合活动标志着其再次进入高软态，符合微类星体在高软态向硬态跃迁或态转换临界期易触发喷流的理论预期；第六，射电耀发时间（6月1日）与硬X射线流量突增的时间（此前两天）严格对应，表明射电辐射滞后于X射线变化极短，符合喷流底部同步辐射区在吸积流状态突变后迅速被激发的动力学时标。

根据现象进行分析： XTE J1856+053 observed by Swift/BAT Swift/BAT reports a detection of the X-ray transient source XTE J1856+053. This source was seen in the 15-50 keV band in three separate pointings on May 28 and 30, 2007, with times and count rates: 
MJD 54248 17:04:39 (1696 sec): 0.010 +/- 0.002 cts/sec/cm^2 (40 mCrab)  
MJD 54250 19:05:03 (1312 sec): 0.016 +/- 0.003 cts/sec/cm^2 (70 mCrab)  
MJD 54250 20:52:55 (840 sec): 0.013 +/- 0.002 cts/sec/cm^2 (55 mCrab)  
MJD 54250 22:17:59 (1608 sec): 0.010 +/- 0.002 cts/sec/cm^2 (45 mCrab) 
Although this source was not in the catalog for the Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor, we have examined archived sky images and see that the source has been detectable in daily averages since May 22, 2007 and that it also had a smaller hard X-ray outburst (reaching ~15 mCrab) from approximately Feb. 22- March 1, 2007, which was just before the outburst reported in the RXTE All-Sky Monitor (ASM) as beginning on Feb. 28, 2007 (ATEL #1024). The RXTE/ASM light curve (http://xte.mit.edu/asmlc/srcs/xtej1856+053.html ) shows a decline in flux to background levels by early May. The relative timing of the earlier BAT and ASM detections suggests that the source spectrum underwent a "pivot" from low-hard (detectable in BAT, but not ASM) to high-soft around March 1 and has now returned to the hard state. The current hard X-ray activity could presage renewed activity in the 2-10 keV band. 
Swift/BAT Hard X-ray transient monitor observations of XTE J1856+053 2007-06-01 13:54:00
response: 首先，XTE J1856+053 是一个X射线暂现源，Swift/BAT在2007年5月28日和30日的多次观测中于15–50 keV能段明确探测到其硬X射线辐射，共四次有效曝光，对应MJD 54248和54250，计数率介于0.010–0.016 cts/sec/cm²（即约40–70 mCrab），表明该源处于显著的硬态活动期。其次，尽管该源未被纳入BAT瞬变源监测星表，但回溯归档全天图发现：其硬X射线辐射自2007年5月22日起已持续可测，且更早存在一次较弱的硬X射线暴发（2007年2月22日至3月1日，峰值约15 mCrab），该暴发时间与RXTE/ASM记录的软X射线暴发起始时间（2月28日）高度重叠但略早，且ASM显示其软波段流量在5月初已衰减至背景水平。第三，BAT与ASM探测的时间序列存在系统性偏移：早期（2月底至3月初）BAT先于ASM探测到增强，而ASM随后上升、BAT减弱，表明能谱发生“枢轴”（pivot）行为——即能谱整体硬化（光子指数变小、高能截断升高或不变），导致辐射能量向硬X射线转移，使BAT灵敏而ASM不敏感；至3月1日前后能谱由低硬态转向高软态；当前（5月下旬）BAT再次强探测而ASM无响应，说明能谱已重新回到硬态。最后，硬态重现意味着源可能正处于状态转换前期，其高能辐射增强很可能是软X射线波段（2–10 keV）新一轮活动的先兆，符合黑洞X射线双星或中子星低质量X射线双星典型的硬-软-硬状态演化规律。

根据现象进行分析： First detection of a type I X-ray burst from AX J1754.2-2754 We report the detection of an intense type I X-ray burst from the unidentified source AX J1754.2-2754 (Sakano et al. ApJS, 2002, 138, 19). The burst occurred on April 16, 2005. It was found in archival data of both the JEM-X and IBIS/ISGRI telescopes of the INTEGRAL observatory (with the S/N ratio 28 and 16 respectively). In the JEM-X 3-15 keV band the burst started at UT 22h10m25s and lasted more than 150 s showing a typical FRED profile (with a 10 s rise time and 65 s e-folding time). In the ISGRI 15-25 keV band the profile was almost symmetric with a 70 s duration and a maximum at UT 22h11m13s. The peak fluxes were equal to 2.01 and 0.85 Crab in the 3-15 and 15-25 keV bands respectively.
The position for the burst derived with JEM-X was R.A.=17h54m12s, Decl.=-27o54m58s, equinox 2000.0, error radius 1 arcmin (with ISGRI R.A.=17h54m13s, Decl.=-27o54m11s, error radius 2 arcmin) that is only 28 (42) arcsec away from the position of AXJ1754.2-2754.
There are some indications of the presence of photospheric cooling and radius expansion at the initial stage of this burst. Assuming that the Eddington luminosity for the source is equal to 2x10^{38} erg/s we can estimate its distance to be 6.8+/-0.7 kpc. The persistent emission from the source was not detected during these observations. 
This is the first report of bursting behaviour from this source, suggesting a neutron star as its compact object. 2007-06-01 15:01:00
response:
该现象描述了一次在X射线波段观测到的I型热核暴（type I X-ray burst），源自暂未明确证认的源AX J1754.2−2754。首先，爆发被INTEGRAL卫星的JEM-X（3–15 keV）和IBIS/ISGRI（15–25 keV）仪器在2005年4月16日的存档数据中独立探测到，信噪比分别为28和16，表明信号显著且可靠。JEM-X能段中爆发呈现典型的FRED（Fast Rise Exponential Decay）轮廓：上升时间约10秒，e-folding衰减时间为65秒，持续超过150秒；而ISGRI能段中轮廓近似对称、持续约70秒，峰值出现在UT 22h11m13s，说明高能光子辐射与低能光子在时间演化上存在细微差异，可能反映辐射机制或谱形随时间变化。

位置分析显示，JEM-X与ISGRI各自给出的爆发定位误差圆半径分别为1′和2′，且二者中心均与AX J1754.2−2754的已知坐标相差仅28″–42″，远小于定位误差，因此可高度确信该爆发源自该源，而非偶然叠加或背景涨落。

关键物理特征包括：爆发初期存在光球冷却及半径膨胀迹象——这是I型暴中典型的质量吸积层发生失控热核燃烧并导致辐射压暂时超越引力、驱动外层膨胀的表现；结合假设Eddington光度为2×10³⁸ erg/s，反推距离约为6.8±0.7 kpc，该值合理落在银河系内典型中子星X射线双星的距离范围内；此外，本次观测中未探测到该源的持续X射线辐射（persistent emission），暗示其处于低吸积率状态（如过渡态或熄灭态），而爆发本身则证实其表面存在富氢/氦吸积物质，具备发生稳态热核燃烧的条件。

综上，这是AX J1754.2−2754首次被确认具有I型X射线暴行为，而I型暴是中子星表面热核爆炸的直接诊断证据，其发生严格依赖于致密星强引力场下稳定吸积与核燃烧过程，黑洞系统无法产生此类暴。因此，该观测结果强有力地支持AX J1754.2−2754的致密天体成分为中子星，而非黑洞或其他类型致密天体。

input: 根据现象进行分析： XMM-Newton observed the X-ray binary pulsar XTE J0103-728 in outburst During an XMM-Newton observation on 2006, Oct. 2 of a field in the Small Magellanic Cloud a bright X-ray transient was observed. Timing analysis revealed X-ray pulsations with a period of 6.85 s which identifies the source, designated XMMU J010253.1-724433 with XTE J0103-728 = SXP6.85. The X-ray spectrum is well represented by a powerlaw with photon index 0.45 +/- 0.03 and an additional soft component. The derived X-ray luminosity (0.2-10.0 keV) was 1.7x10^37 erg/s. The improved X-ray position of R.A.(J2000) = 01:02:53.1 Dec.(J2000) = -72:44:33 (2 arcsec systematic error) is consistent with the position of object 54787 in the UBVR CCD Survey of the Magellanic Clouds by Massey (2002, ApJS, 141, 81). Optical brightness (V = 14.59 mag) and colors are consistent with a Be star, confirming the Be/X-ray binary pulsar nature of XTE J0103-728. 2007-06-01 15:46:00
response:
首先，XMM-Newton在2006年10月2日对小麦哲伦云（SMC）某天区进行观测时，探测到一个明亮的X射线暂现源；  
其次，通过时间分析发现该源存在周期为6.85秒的X射线脉冲，据此确认其为已知X射线双星脉冲星XTE J0103-728，即SXP6.85，并赋予新X射线源名XMMU J010253.1-724433；  
第三，X射线能谱可用幂律模型拟合，光子指数为0.45±0.03，并需加入一个软成分才能良好描述，表明辐射机制可能包含非热主导过程及额外的热或散射贡献；  
第四，计算得0.2–10.0 keV波段的X射线光度为1.7×10³⁷ erg/s，处于典型Be/X射线双星在爆发态的光度范围，支持其为中子星吸积系统；  
第五，获得的高精度X射线位置（R.A.(J2000) = 01:02:53.1，Dec.(J2000) = −72:44:33，系统误差2角秒）与Massey（2002）UBVR测光巡天中编号54787的恒星位置一致；  
第六，该光学对应体的V波段星等为14.59 mag，颜色信息符合Be星特征，即具有发射线和红外超的主序B型星，从而确证XTE J0103-728是一个Be/X射线双星系统，其中中子星通过吸积Be星抛出的星周盘物质产生X射线辐射。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Chandra non-detection of the neutron star X-ray transient IGR J17191-2821 We report on a Chandra/HRC-I observation of the neutron star transient IGR J17191-2821 which was recently in outburst, with activity beginning on April 29 and lasting approximately two weeks (ATels #1021, #1022, #1025, #1065, #1068, #1069, #1070, #1075). The 1.1 ks observation was performed starting May 27 (23:31 UTC). No sources are detected within 30 arcsec of the improved Swift/XRT position (4 arcsec accuracy; Atel #1070). We find a 90%-confidence upper limit on the source rate of <2.0E-3 counts/s. This corresponds to a 2-10 keV source flux of <6.9E-14 erg/cm^2/s (<3.2E-3 mCrab), assuming a power-law spectrum of index 1.71 and a neutral hydrogen column density of 5.7E21 cm^-2 (Atel #1070). Previously, a distance upper limit of 11 kpc was determined from a thermonuclear X-ray burst (Atel #1068). This implies that the 0.3-10 keV luminosity at the time of the Chandra observation was <1.2E33 ergs/s. 2007-06-01 20:50:00
response:
首先，观测目标是中子星暂现源IGR J17191-2821，该源在2007年4月29日开始爆发，持续约两周，至5月中旬已结束。Chandra/HRC-I观测于5月27日23:31 UTC开始，曝光时间仅1.1 ks，属于爆发后约28天的晚期余辉或宁静期探测。

其次，观测在Swift/XRT给出的改进位置（误差半径4角秒）周围30角秒内未探测到任何X射线源，表明该源在Chandra观测时刻无显著X射线辐射。由此导出90%置信度下的计数率上限为<2.0×10⁻³ counts/s。

第三，将该计数率上限转换为物理流量时，采用了标准谱模型假设：幂律谱指数Γ=1.71，吸收柱密度N_H=5.7×10²¹ cm⁻²（源自同一源的前期XRT光谱分析）。据此得到2–10 keV能段的通量上限为<6.9×10⁻¹⁴ erg/cm²/s，即<3.2×10⁻³ mCrab。

第四，结合由热核暴（type-I X-ray burst）推断的距离上限D < 11 kpc（ATel #1068），可进一步将流量上限转化为0.3–10 keV波段的光度上限。需注意能量范围扩展至0.3 keV，因此需对原2–10 keV通量进行能谱外推积分；在相同谱形与N_H下，0.3–10 keV通量约为2–10 keV通量的约1.7倍（典型值），再乘以4πD²（取D=11 kpc），最终得出L_X < 1.2×10³³ erg/s。

综上，该非探测结果表明：源在爆发结束后近一个月已衰减至极低光度水平，低于典型中子星低质量X射线双星（NS-LMXB）在宁静期的典型光度（通常为10³³–10³⁴ erg/s），暗示其可能处于深度宁静态，或吸积已基本停止；同时该光度上限对理论模型（如冷却中子星表面、残留吸积盘辐射、脉冲星风制动辐射等）构成强约束。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT observation of MGRO J2019+37 Swift/XRT observed MGRO J2019+37 on November 8, 2006 for 5.5 ks; within the source positional uncertainty, as reported by Abdo et al. 2007 (astroph.0705.0707), we find 3 X-ray sources located at the following positions (positional uncertainty 6"): 
#1: RA(J2000) = 20 20 43.4, Dec(J2000) = +36 49 27.8 (4.3 sigma) 
#2: RA(J2000) = 20 20 34.7, Dec(J2000) = +36 50 57.1 (2.9 sigma) 
#3: RA(J2000) = 20 19 40.8, Dec(J2000) = +36 45 02.1 (3.1 sigma) 
Source #1 is associated to a faint ROSAT Survey source 1RXS J202043.4+364932, which has an optical (USNO-A2) and infrared (2MASS) counterpart. 
Source #2 has no optical nor near-infrared counterpart but it is possibly associated to an MSX6C (8 micron) source; it is also 35" from the radio source NVSS J202036+365123 (25.8 mJy at 20 cm and 11" positional uncertainty). 
Source #3 has an optical (USNO-B1) and 2 near-infrared (2MASS) counterparts; the far-infrared sources IRAS 20178+3635 and MSX6C G074.9762+00.2833 are located 27" and 15" away from this source. 
The 2-10 keV fluxes estimated assuming a Crab-like spectrum are 1.3 x 10-13, 1.5 x 10-13 and 2.0 x 10-13 erg cm-2 s-1 for source #1, #2 and #3, respectively. 
Follow-up observations at various wavelenghts of these possible counterparts to MGRO J2019+37 are highly encouraged. 2007-06-05 14:51:00
response:
首先，题目描述了Swift/XRT对MGRO J2019+37的一次X射线观测：时间是2006年11月8日，总曝光5.5 ks；观测位置精度受限于Abdo et al. 2007给出的甚高能γ射线源定位误差范围（即“within the source positional uncertainty”），在此区域内共探测到3个X射线点源，各自具有统计显著性（4.3σ、2.9σ、3.1σ）和约6″的位置误差。

其次，需逐一分析各源的多波段对应体情况：  
#1位于RA=20 20 43.4, Dec=+36 49 27.8，与ROSAT巡天源1RXS J202043.4+364932位置一致，且该ROSAT源已有USNO-A2光学与2MASS近红外对应体，说明其为一个已知的较亮X射线源，具备完备的多波段证认；  
#2位于RA=20 20 34.7, Dec=+36 50 57.1，无光学或近红外对应体，但存在MSX6C 8μm中红外源可能关联，且距NVSS射电源J202036+365123仅35″（该射电源流量25.8 mJy、位置误差11″），提示其可能为射电宁静但中红外活跃的致密天体，如年轻恒星体、掩食双星或低光度活动星系核；  
#3位于RA=20 19 40.8, Dec=+36 45 02.1，有USNO-B1光学及两个2MASS近红外对应体，表明其为恒星候选体；此外，IRAS 20178+3635（远红外）和MSX6C G074.9762+00.2833（中红外）分别在27″和15″处，暗示可能存在延展尘埃包层或星周盘结构，符合大质量恒星形成区或演化晚期恒星特征。

再次，三源的2–10 keV通量（假设Crab谱形）分别为1.3×10⁻¹³、1.5×10⁻¹³、2.0×10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，量级相近，均属较暗X射线源（比典型脉冲星或X射线双星低1–2个数量级），但#3最强，可能反映其本征光度更高或吸收更弱。

最后，综合判断：MGRO J2019+37作为甚高能γ射线源，其X射线对应体并非单一目标，而是包含至少三个空间上分离、物理性质各异的候选体——#1为已知恒星/活动星系核类X射线源，#2为缺乏光学辐射但具中红外和射电关联的致密源，#3为具光学-红外恒星特征并邻近远红外源的复合系统。三者均不能被排除为γ射线辐射起源，因此需开展后续多波段观测（如光谱证认、高分辨射电成像、红外光变监测）以区分真实对应体。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT non-detection of HETE J1900.1-2455 During a ~0.8 ksec pointed Swift/XRT observation performed on June 6, 2007 (18:26-21:38 UT), we did not detect the accreting millisecond pulsar HETE J1900.1-2455. We can set a 2-10 keV upper limit on the source flux of ~(5-15)E-14 erg/cm2/s (depending on the assumed spectral model). This is more than a factor of 10 weaker than the X-ray flux observed with Swift/XRT last week, on May 31 (ATEL #1091). The distance to HETE J1900.1-2455 is ~5 kpc (inferred from type-I X-ray bursts; e.g., ATELs #534 and #657), which means that its X-ray luminosity is currently below ~5E32 erg/s. The current low flux and its rapid decay strongly indicate that HETE J1900.1-2455 is now back in quiescence or will very soon be. 
We would like to thank the Swift-team for making these XRT observations possible. 2007-06-07 14:32:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2007年6月6日18:26–21:38 UT，持续约0.8 ks，使用Swift/XRT进行定点观测；在此期间未探测到HETE J1900.1−2455，说明其X射线辐射极弱或已消失。  
其次，基于非探测结果，结合不同谱模型假设，得到2–10 keV能段的通量上限为(5–15)×10⁻¹⁴ erg/cm²/s；该上限比5月31日（ATEL #1091）观测到的通量低一个数量级以上，表明源在一周内经历了显著的光度衰减。  
第三，源距离取~5 kpc（由I型X射线暴推断，如ATELs #534、#657），将通量上限转换为光度上限：L_X ≈ 4πd²F_upper ≈ 4π×(5×10³ pc)²×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s量级，计算得L_X ≲ 5×10³² erg/s。  
第四，该光度已接近或低于典型中子星低质量X射线双星在宁静态下的典型X射线光度（10³⁰–10³² erg/s），结合其“快速衰减”的时变特征，可合理推断：HETE J1900.1−2455目前已进入宁静态，或正处于向宁静态过渡的末期阶段。

response:
该文本描述了一次系统性超新星巡天观测的结果，需从观测手段、数据处理流程、物理分类依据及个别源特殊性四个层面进行分析：

首先，观测由“近邻超新星工厂”（SNF）项目执行，使用帕洛玛天文台48英寸奥斯钦望远镜搭载的QUEST-II相机，在2007年4月27日至5月30日UTC时段内获取图像。R波段发现星等和J2000坐标均通过与USNO-A2.0星表比对得出，说明定位与测光依赖于高精度参考星表校准，确保位置和亮度测量具备可比性和系统一致性。

其次，所有候选体均经后续光谱证认：利用夏威夷大学2.2米望远镜上的超新星积分场摄谱仪（SNIFS）获取320–1000 nm全波段光谱，据此完成类型分类与红移测定。光谱覆盖紫外至近红外，足以分辨氢、氦、氧、硅、钙等关键吸收/发射特征线，是区分Ia、Ib、Ic、II型超新星的核心依据；红移则由窄线（如[O II]、Ca H&K或Hα）或连续谱拟合获得，反映宿主星系退行速度。

第三，所列8颗超新星中，6颗为II型（含氢包层），2颗为Ib/c型（无氢，Ic缺氦，Ib有氦），其中SNF20070517-000明确归为Ic型，SNF20070517-014归为Ib/c但被特别指出具有高初速度特征，类比SN 1998bw——后者是首例被证实与伽马暴GRB 980425成协的超新星，其谱线展宽对应膨胀速度达~3×10⁴ km/s，暗示极强爆炸能量与可能的致密残骸（如黑洞）形成。文中强调该源“just before peak brightness”，说明光谱获取时机处于光变上升段末期，此时谱线轮廓最能反映抛射物初始动力学结构，而非后期混杂的辐射转移效应。

最后，红移范围集中于0.04–0.08，对应距离约170–350 Mpc（按H₀=70 km/s/Mpc估算），属近邻宇宙样本，有利于后续多波段后随观测与宿主星系性质研究；发现时间跨度达34天，显示巡天具备持续监测能力，而单次发现8颗表明探测深度（R∼19.7 mag）与视场覆盖率已达到较高水平。

根据现象进行分析： GMRT Low frequency radio observation  of Cyg X-3 at the time of flare Trushkin et al. (#Atel 1092) detected beginning of a new flaring activity in galactic black hole candidate Cygnus X-3. We have observed the source from UT 2.99 June to 3.08 June, 2007 in 243 and 614 MHz frequencies using Giant Meterwave Radio Telescope (GMRT). The source was variable and seemed to rise during our observation. The rising phase is also clear from swift data http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/CygX-3/  . The average flux density during our observation in 614 MHz is 3.4+-0.2 Jy and in 243 MHz is 1.1+-0.2 Jy and the corresponding spectral index in this low frequency region is 1.1. 
Further observations are planned. 2007-06-08 14:17:00
response:
首先，观测对象是银河系黑洞候选体天鹅座X-3（Cyg X-3），其在2007年6月初正处于耀发活动初期。ATel #1092（Trushkin et al.）已确认该新耀发的开始，本工作在此基础上开展了GMRT低频射电观测。

观测时间覆盖UT 2007年6月2.99日至6月3.08日，即约2.99–3.08日（即6月2日23:46至6月3日20:55左右），属于耀发早期阶段。使用GMRT在两个低频波段——243 MHz和614 MHz——同步观测，具备频率覆盖能力，有利于谱形分析。

观测结果显示源具有明显变异性，且在观测时段内呈现上升趋势：这一结论既来自GMRT实测数据，也得到Swift卫星高能波段（X射线）光变曲线的独立支持（URL给出的Swift瞬变源页面显示同期X射线流量上升），表明多波段协同增强，支持整体耀发正在发展。

定量方面，614 MHz平均流量密度为3.4 ± 0.2 Jy，243 MHz为1.1 ± 0.2 Jy。二者均处于较高水平，且误差范围不重叠，说明测量可靠。据此计算低频谱指数α（定义为S_ν ∝ ν^α），代入公式α = log(S₁/S₂) / log(ν₁/ν₂)，其中S₁=3.4 Jy、ν₁=614 MHz，S₂=1.1 Jy、ν₂=243 MHz，得α ≈ log(3.4/1.1)/log(614/243) ≈ log(3.09)/log(2.53) ≈ 0.49/0.40 ≈ 1.2，文中报道为1.1，在误差范围内一致，表明该波段谱呈显著正谱（α > 0），符合致密喷流自吸收主导的射电谱特征，暗示耀发可能源于新生喷流或激波传播导致的同步辐射增强。

综上，本次观测捕捉到Cyg X-3耀发初始上升相的低频射电行为，谱指数偏高指示低频段处于光学厚 regime，结合多波段上升趋势，支持喷流启动模型；后续观测计划合理，旨在追踪谱演化与峰值行为。
