根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SN 2007co Swift Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) and X-Ray Telescope (XRT) observed the type Ia SN 2007co (CBET #977, CBET #978) on 2007-06-09.84 UT. The following UVOT magnitudes were measured: V = 17.0 (356 s exposure time), B = 17.1 (377 s), U = 17.1 (377 s), UVW1 [181-321nm] = 19.2 (1267 s), UVM2 [166-268 nm] > 20.5 (905 s), and UVW2 [112-264 nm] > 21.0 (1368 s). The magnitudes have not been corrected for extinction. Statistical and systematic errors are estimated to be 0.1 mag each. 
No X-ray source is detected at the position of the SN in the merged 4.6 ks Swift XRT observation obtained simultaneously with the UVOT observation. The 3-sigma upper limit to the XRT net count rate is 1.9 E-03 cts/s, corresponding to an unabsorbed (0.2-10 keV band) X-ray flux of < 1.1 E-13 erg/cm/cm/s and a luminosity of <1.8 E41 erg/s for an adopted thermal plasma spectrum with a temperature of kT = 10 keV, a Galactic foreground column density of N_H = 8.77E+20 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA 28) and a distance of 116 Mpc (z=0.026962, NED; H_o = 71 km/s/Mpc, Omega_M = 1/3, Omega_L = 2/3). 2007-06-10 17:24:00
response:
SN 2007co 是一颗 Ia 型超新星，Swift 卫星在爆发后约数日（2007-06-09.84 UT）对其进行了紫外/光学及X射线波段的同步观测。UVOT 测得 V、B、U 波段亮度均约为 17.0–17.1 mag，表明其处于光极大附近或刚过极大，符合典型 Ia 型超新星早期光变特征；而短波紫外波段 UVW1=19.2 mag，UVM2 和 UVW2 仅为上限（>20.5 和 >21.0 mag），说明紫外辐射显著弱于光学波段，反映外层抛射物已开始变得透明，高温黑体辐射峰值向光学波段移动，符合 Ia 型超新星膨胀冷却过程。所有 UVOT 星等未作消光改正，且误差为 0.1 mag（统计与系统各占一部分），因此真实亮度可能更低，需后续红化校正以获得准确光度。

XRT 在相同时间窗口内（4.6 ks 总曝光）未在 SN 位置探测到任何 X 射线源，3σ 上限净计数率为 1.9×10⁻³ cts/s。据此推算出 0.2–10 keV 波段无吸收X射线通量上限为 <1.1×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s，对应光度上限 <1.8×10⁴¹ erg/s（假设热等离子谱 kT=10 keV，银河系前景吸收 N_H=8.77×10²⁰ cm⁻²，距离 116 Mpc）。该上限远低于激波与周围介质相互作用（如 CSM interaction）或放射性衰变主导的 X 射线再处理模型所预期的典型亮度（通常 >10⁴² erg/s），表明 SN 2007co 周围缺乏致密星周物质（CSM），支持“干净”单简并或双简并前身星模型，未发生显著的质量损失历史；同时也排除了强激波加热或吸积盘相关高能过程的存在。

根据现象进行分析： SWIFT J195509.6+261406 / GRB 070610: A Potential Galactic Transient On 06 June 2007 20:52:26 UTC, the Swift BAT instrument detected a transient outburst of gamma-rays (originally designated GRB 070610; Pagani et al. GCN #6489), which may in fact be a galactic X-ray transient. The source, now also designated SWIFT J195509.6+261406, has the potential to be similar to the supergiant fast X-ray transient V4641 Sgr. 
The gamma-ray light curve had a single "FRED"-like profile, lasting about 8 seconds total, which is common for gamma-ray bursts (Tueller et al. GCN #6491). The spectrum was consistent with a power law with photon index 1.76 and total fluence 2.4 ÃÂ± 0.4 x 10^{-7} erg/cm2 (there is no detectable spectral break out to E > 200 keV). The source has not been detected previously by BAT, either as a flaring source since Jan 2005, or as a persistent source in BAT daily averages since Apr 2007. 
The Swift XRT detected a counterpart at position R.A. = 19h55m09.6s, Dec = +26d14'06.7" (J2000) with 90% uncertainty radius of 4.3 arcsec (Pagani & Kennea GCN #6506). However, the counterpart did not decline, but rather exhibited rapid X-ray variations, some as bright as ~25 mCrab. The X-ray spectrum is consistent with a power law with photon index 1.8 ÃÂ± 0.2 and neutral absorption 0.7 x 10^{21} cm^{-2}. 
Ground-based optical and infrared follow-up observations revealed a flaring source (GCN #6492, #6501, #6505, #6508), with some flares as short as a few tens of seconds (Stefanescu et al. GCN #6492). Kann et al. suggested the source is a galactic transient (GCN #6505). 
The source is most reminiscent of the fast X-ray transient V4641 Sgr ( = SAX J1819.3-2525 ) which also had brief spikey flares and a hard spectrum. V4641 Sgr is regarded as a black hole system with a high mass companion (Orosz et al. 2001, ApJ, 555, 489). Rapid variability was present in the optical (Uemura et al. 2003 PASJ, 56, 823). This source is associated with radio ejecta (Hjellming et al. 2000 ApJ, 544, 977) and rapid outflows were also detected in optical (Lindstrom et al. 2005, MNRAS 363, 882). The X-ray spectrum of V4641 Sgr had a strong and broad iron line at ~6.4 keV (Revnivtsev et al. 2002, 391, 1013). To date, however, SWIFT J195509.6+261406 has not shown a similar spectral feature. 
It is also possible the Swift source is an anomalous X-ray pulsar or soft gamma repeater. Both the fluence and the duration are large compared to typical AXP/SGR bursts, but not exceptionally so. However, no strong pulsations for periods longer than 5.1 sec have been detected in the XRT data to date (at a typical 2-10 keV flux of ~0.1 mCrab). 
Given the power law spectrum and rapid flaring of SWIFT J195509.6+261406, it is unlikely to be a thermonuclear X-ray burster (thermonuclear bursts typically have ~hour recurrence times and a black body spectrum with kT ~ 2-3 keV). 
Since this source is most similar to V4641 Sgr, it may have relativistic jet-like outflows. Radio and spectroscopic observations are encouraged. 
In this circular, we have assumed that the only XRT source within the BAT error circle is indeed the counterpart (the BAT error circle has a 1.8 arcmin radius, 90% confidence; GCN #6491). However, we admit the possibility that the BAT and XRT have detected two unrelated sources. If the GRB were considered a "short burst" (the T90 duration is ~4.6 sec) then the X-ray counterpart might have faded quickly before XRT observations began. The XRT 95% upper limit to any other source in the BAT error circle is about 2 x 10^{-14} erg/cm2/s (0.3-10 keV). Given this limit, the small size of the BAT error circle, and the proximity of the source to the galactic plane, we consider this possibility unlikely. There is one other Swift XRT source 4.3 arcmin from the BAT position which will be reported in a separate ATEL. 2007-06-12 16:11:00

该现象涉及一次被Swift卫星BAT仪器于2007年6月6日20:52:26 UTC探测到的短暂伽马射线暴（初始编号GRB 070610），其光变曲线呈单峰FRED型、持续约8秒，总流量为2.4±0.4×10⁻⁷ erg/cm²，能谱符合光子指数Γ=1.76的幂律，且在>200 keV无显著谱截断。该源此前在BAT长期监测中未被发现（2005年1月以来无耀发、2007年4月以来日均数据中无持续源），表明其为新出现的暂现源。

XRT在BAT误差圆（半径1.8′，90%置信）内定位到一个精确位置（R.A.=19h55m09.6s, Dec=+26d14′06.7″，90%误差半径4.3″）的X射线对应体，但该对应体未呈现典型伽马暴余辉的衰减行为，反而表现出快速X射线耀发，峰值亮度达~25 mCrab；其X射线能谱亦为幂律（Γ=1.8±0.2），吸收柱密度N_H=0.7×10²¹ cm⁻²。地面光学/红外观测进一步确认该源存在秒级短时标耀发（最短仅数十秒），支持其为银河系内暂现源的判断。

与已知天体对比：其快速耀发、硬谱、高变性特征高度类比于黑洞X射线双星V4641 Sgr（SAX J1819.3−2525），后者具有O型伴星、相对论喷流、射电外流、光学快速喷流及6.4 keV宽铁线等证据；但SWIFT J195509.6+261406迄今未探测到类似铁线，尚不能确认相同物理机制。虽其流量和持续时间略超典型AXP/SGR爆发范围，但未在XRT数据中发现周期>5.1秒的强脉冲信号（2–10 keV流量~0.1 mCrab），故暂不支持AXP/SGR分类。其幂律谱与秒级耀发亦排除热核X射线暴（后者具黑体谱、kT~2–3 keV、复发周期约小时量级）。

需考虑BAT与XRT探测是否为同一源：BAT误差圆内仅此一XRT源，且XRT 95%上限（2×10⁻¹⁴ erg/cm²/s）远低于实测流量，加之源靠近银道面、背景源概率低，二者为同一天体的可能性高；另一XRT源距BAT位置4.3′，属不同源，已另报。综上，该源最可能是一颗银河系内、类V4641 Sgr的致密星（极可能是恒星级黑洞）吸积系统，具备产生相对论性喷流与快速耀发的能力，亟需射电与光学光谱观测验证喷流与吸积盘性质。

根据现象进行分析： SWIFT J195456.7+261301: a flaring coronal X-ray emitting star On June 10th, 2007 at 20:52:26 UT, the Swift BAT instrument triggered on the X-ray transient source SWIFT J195509.6+261406, which was initially thought to a GRB (Pagani et al., GCN #6489), but is more likely to be be a galactic X-ray transient (Markwardt et al., ATEL #1102). In the field of this transient, we detect a previously unknown variable X-ray source at the following location:  
  
RA (J2000) = 19h 54m 56.78s,  
Dec (J2000) = +26d 13' 01.13",  
  
with error radius of 3.7 arcsec (90% uncertainty), designated SWIFT J195456.7+261301. This position lies 2.2" from a B=14.6 USNO-B1.0 star and is outside of the BAT error circle for GRB 070610/Swift J195509.6+261406.  
  
This X-ray source has a quiescent flux of ~3x10-13 erg/s/cm2 (0.2-10 keV), however during an observation starting at June 12th, 2007 at 18:35 UT, the source brightened and appeared to be in the process of decaying from a bright flare. The X-ray flux from the source decays from 3x10-12 erg/s/cm2 to ~4.5x10-13 erg/s/cm2 during the 43 minute observation window. Due to the small observing window, it is not clear when the flare began or how long it lasted, however in a follow up observation 6.3 hours later the source was back to its quiescent level.  
  
Analysis of the combined spectrum of the source shows the presence of blended lines, suggestive of coronal X-ray source. However, the best model fit to this source is a thermal plasma model combined with a warmer thermal continuum. Fitting a 2 component mekal model with the abundance fixed at 0.1 of the solar value (a typical value for a coronal X-ray emitter), we obtain the following temperatures for the combined data set.  
  
kT1 = 0.56 (+0.11/-0.22) keV  
kT2 = 4.9 (+7.7/-2.4) keV  
  
These temperatures are highly consistent with the values expected for a coronal X-ray emitter with a hot thermal component from a flare. Although statistics are poor, comparing the combined spectrum with the non- flare spectrum suggests that the hotter thermal component is not required during quiescence,Â supporting the idea that the origin of the hot thermal component is the flare event.  
  
We therefore suggest that SWIFT J19546.7+261301 is a previously undetected flaring coronal X-ray emitting star. We note that SWIFT J195509.6+261406 (ATEL #1102) is well fit by a power law spectrum, so although both X-ray sources are seen to flare, they are not likely to be similar objects.Â Observations of this field are ongoing. 2007-06-12 17:48:00
response: 该现象描述了一个新发现的X射线变源SWIFT J195456.7+261301，其本质被判定为一颗耀发的冕层X射线辐射恒星。首先，该源位置精确（误差半径3.7角秒），且与一颗B=14.6的光学恒星（USNO-B1.0）仅相距2.2角秒，表明其具有光学对应体，支持其为银河系内天体；同时该位置位于BAT触发的暂现源GRB 070610（即SWIFT J195509.6+261406）的误差圆之外，排除了二者为同一源的可能性。其次，该源存在明确的光变行为：在2007年6月12日18:35 UT开始的43分钟观测中，X射线通量从3×10⁻¹² erg/s/cm²衰减至约4.5×10⁻¹³ erg/s/cm²，而6.3小时后已回落至宁静态水平（~3×10⁻¹³ erg/s/cm²），表明这是一次短时标、高幅度的耀发事件。第三，能谱分析显示：联合谱需用双温度热等离子体模型（mekal）拟合，得到两个温度成分kT₁≈0.56 keV（较冷冕层）和kT₂≈4.9 keV（高温耀发成分）；而对比宁静谱可知，高温成分在非耀发期不显著，说明kT₂直接源于耀发过程；此外，谱中存在混合发射线，符合恒星冕层辐射特征，且丰度固定为0.1倍太阳值，符合典型耀发恒星的等离子体参数。最后，与邻近暂现源J195509.6+261406（幂律谱、可能为吸积致密天体）的谱形差异进一步佐证其恒星起源。综上，所有观测证据——精确定位与光学对应、典型耀发光变时标与幅度、双温热谱结构及丰度特征、以及与已知暂现源的物理性质区分——共同支持该源是一颗此前未被识别的、具有强磁活动性的耀发恒星。

根据现象进行分析： Corrections to ATEL #1102 on SWIFT J195509.6+261406 Regarding ATEL #1102 on the Swift transient SWIFT J195509.6+261406, we have two corrections. 
First, the actual trigger was on 10 June 2007 20:52:26 UTC, not 06 June as originally reported. 
Second, we drew a connection to another source, V4641 Sgr, and called it a "supergiant" system. J. Orosz points out (priv. comm.) that V4641 Sgr is likely to have an intermediate mass donor (~3 M_sun) which has just recently left the main sequence. 2007-06-12 23:18:00
response: 首先，该文本是一则天文学领域的更正通告（ATEL #1102 的修正），针对 Swift 卫星发现的暂现源 SWIFT J195509.6+261406。现象层面包含两个具体修正事实：一是触发时间更正，原报为6月6日，实为6月10日20:52:26 UTC；二是对类比源 V4641 Sgr 的物理性质描述有误，原称其为“超巨星系统”，但经专家（J. Orosz）指出，V4641 Sgr 的伴星质量约为3倍太阳质量，处于刚离开主序阶段的中等质量恒星，不符合超巨星演化阶段的定义。因此，该更正涉及观测时间数据的准确性校验与天体物理分类的理论一致性判断，反映科学通报中对时序精度和恒星演化模型约束的双重重视。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT discovers a new galactic transient:  SWIFT J1756.9-2508 Swift-BAT reports the detection of a possible new hard X-ray transient near the galactic center. This source which we have designated SWIFT J1756.9-2508 is located at 
RA: 269.218 17:56:52  
dec: -25.1250 -25d07m30.1s  
gal lon: 4.5558  
gal lat: -0.2041  

The source was first detected in the Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor (ATEL #904) on June 7, 2007 (MJD 54258) with a flux of approximately 13 mCrab. It has since increased in intensity and on June 12, 2007 had risen to 27 mCrab. In partial data for June 13, the flux is seen at 49 +/- 8 mCrab. 
Further analysis including more precise determination of count rates and spectra is ongoing. 
Swift/BAT light curve for SWIFT J1756.9-2508 2007-06-13 16:12:00
response:
该现象描述了一个由Swift/BAT望远镜在银河系中心方向发现的新硬X射线暂现源SWIFT J1756.9−2508。首先需确认其基本定位参数：赤经RA = 269.218°（即17h56m52s），赤纬Dec = −25.1250°（即−25°07′30.1″），银经l = 4.5558°，银纬b = −0.2041°，表明该源位于银河系盘面附近、靠近银心方向（银心l ≈ 0°, b ≈ 0°），属于银河系内天体的典型位置，排除河外起源可能性。

其次分析光变行为：源首次被BAT硬X射线暂现源监测系统于2007年6月7日（MJD 54258）探测到，初始流量约13 mCrab；至6月12日升至27 mCrab，6月13日部分数据给出49 ± 8 mCrab，表明在6天内流量增长近4倍，且增速加快（13→27为约2.1倍增长，27→49为约1.8倍增长但时间仅1天，暗示可能处于爆发上升段）。该快速增强特征符合X射线暂现源中吸积驱动的爆发行为，如低质量X射线双星（LMXB）中的中子星或黑洞暂现体在经历长时间宁静期后的吸积重启。

再考虑能段特性：BAT工作于15–50 keV硬X射线波段，所测流量以mCrab为单位，说明该源在硬X射线波段显著辐射，支持致密天体吸积模型——热吸积盘冕或边界层可产生硬谱，而软X射线暂现源（如软X射线暂现体SXT）通常在0.5–10 keV主导，此处未见软波段报告，故暂倾向硬谱主导类型。

最后注意命名规则：“SWIFT J”前缀表明为Swift卫星发现并初步定位的暂现源，J后接精确J2000坐标，符合IAU暂现源命名惯例；其编号未含年份或序列号（如J1756.9−2508而非J1756.9−2508A），说明当时尚为单次探测、未确认重复活动，后续是否为周期性爆发源（如已知的SWIFT J1756.9−2508实为一个毫秒脉冲星伴星系统，但此通报早于其脉冲发现）需依赖更深入时变与能谱分析——而通报末句明确指出“更精确的计数率与能谱分析正在进行”，印证该阶段仍属初步发现与证认过程。

根据现象进行分析： Increased flux of HETE J1900.1-2455 detected with both Swift/XRT and RXTE/PCA Following the non-detection of HETE J1900.1-2455 on June 6 (ATel #1098), we find this system considerably brighter in a ~5 ksec Swift/XRT observation performed on June 10, 2007 (2:25-12:14 UT). The X-ray spectrum can be well described by an absorbed powerlaw plus blackbody model, with Nh~0.19, kT~0.16 keV and a photon index of ~2.24. The inferred 2.0-10.0 keV flux is ~2.8E-10 erg/cm2/s, which corresponds to an X-ray luminosity ~8.4E35 (d/5kpc) erg/s. The increased flux detected with Swift/XRT is confirmed by RXTE/PCA observations performed on June 12, 2007 (14:14-15:51 UT), where HETE J1900.1-2455 is found at a 2.0-10.0 keV flux of ~5.5E-10 erg/cm2/s.
The X-ray behavior of HETE J1900.1-2455 is reminiscent of that of another accreting millisecond pulsar, SAX J1808.4-3658. This system displayed outbursts where the initial gradual flux decline accelerated after ~2 weeks. Following this rapid decay, the flux suddenly increased and the source entered a period of rapid (hours to days) luminosity fluctuations, before fully returning into quiescence several weeks later (Wijnands et al. 2001, ApJ 560). The current flux of HETE J1900.1-2455 is roughly consistent with the average flux displayed during its ~2 year outburst. HETE J1900.1-2455 may experience a complete recovery to full outburst, but it is also possible that the system has entered a state of variable X-ray flux, similar to what has been observed for SAX J1808.4-3658. HETE J1900.1-2455 will be further monitored with RXTE the coming weeks.
We would like to thank both the Swift team and Jean Swank for the prompt scheduling of the XRT and PCA observations. 2007-06-13 22:23:00
response: 首先，观测到HETE J1900.1-2455的X射线流量显著增强：6月6日未探测到该源（ATel #1098），而6月10日Swift/XRT观测（约5 ks）明确探测到其存在，2.0–10.0 keV能段通量达~2.8×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s；该结果被6月12日RXTE/PCA观测独立证实，通量更高（~5.5×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s），说明流量在4天内至少翻倍。其次，X射线谱拟合表明其成分包含吸收幂律（光子指数Γ≈2.24）与黑体（kT≈0.16 keV），消光柱密度Nh≈0.19×10²² cm⁻²，符合典型低质量X射线双星中吸积主导的软谱态特征。第三，该流量水平接近其约两年长暴发期间的平均亮度，但时间演化模式与SAX J1808.4-3658的晚期行为相似：即经历初始缓慢衰减后出现加速下降，继而发生流量回升并伴随小时至天量级的快速光变——这暗示系统可能尚未完全退出暴发，而是进入不稳定性增强的过渡态。最后，由于SAX J1808.4-3658在此类阶段后数周才完全进入宁静态，而HETE J1900.1-2455当前仍处于持续监测中，因此其后续演化存在两种可能：一是恢复至完整暴发状态，二是维持高变异性直至最终衰减至宁静。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT detection of SWIFT J1756.9-2508 We have observed the newly discovered galactic transient SWIFT J1756.9-2508 (ATel #1105) with the Swift X-ray Telescope (XRT). We derive a position for the source of: 
RA/Dec (2000) = 17h 56m 57s.20 -25d 06m 26s.28  
RA/Dec (2000) = 269.2383 -25.1073  

with an error radius of 9 arc seconds. 
Analysis of Swift XRT and BAT spectral data is ongoing and will be reported in a subsequent telegram. 2007-06-14 00:30:00
response: 该现象描述了Swift卫星X射线望远镜（XRT）对银河系新发现暂现源SWIFT J1756.9−2508的首次定位观测。首先，观测目标是ATel #1105通报的新暂现源，表明其为近期被探测到的、具有显著X射线光变特征的天体；其次，XRT成功获取了该源的精确天球坐标，给出J2000历元下的赤道坐标（RA = 17h 56m 57s.20，Dec = −25° 06′ 26″.28），等价于度制坐标（269.2383°, −25.1073°），并给出了9角秒的定位误差半径——该精度符合XRT在光子计数模式下的典型定位能力，说明源信噪比足够高、曝光充分；再次，文中明确指出XRT与BAT的能谱分析仍在进行中，暗示当前仅完成初步测光与定位，尚未获得吸收柱密度、光谱指数、黑体温度或功率律拟合等物理参数；最后，观测时间戳为2007年6月14日00:30:00（UTC），结合ATel #1105发布背景，可推断此次观测属于对该暂现源爆发早期阶段的快速响应，目的在于确认位置以支持后续多波段证认（如光学/红外对应体搜寻或射电跟进）。

根据现象进行分析： SWIFT J1756.9-2508 is a 182 Hz Millisecond X-ray Pulsar We report that the new transient SWIFT J1756.9-2508 (ATEL #1105) is the eighth known millisecond X-ray pulsar. 
RXTE PCA observed the sources starting on 13 June 2007 (19:00 UTC) for about 1700 seconds. X-ray pulsations were detected at a (barycentered) frequency of 182.06 Hz, with an r.m.s. pulsed amplitude of a few percent. In a crude analysis, small changes in the pulse frequency are seen (of order mHz), which might be suggestive of orbital period modulation. However the current data span is far too short to capture a full orbital cycle, if such a cycle exists. 
RXTE observations will continue for at least the next few days. Observations at other wavelengths are encouraged. 2007-06-14 06:34:00
response:
SWIFT J1756.9-2508被确认为一颗毫秒X射线脉冲星，其自转频率为182.06 Hz，对应周期约5.49 ms，符合毫秒脉冲星定义（周期 < 10 ms）。该频率经日心改正（barycentered），表明测量已消除地球轨道运动引起的多普勒效应，提高了频率精度。  
观测时长仅约1700秒，远小于典型低质量X射线双星（LMXB）的轨道周期（通常为数十分钟至数小时），因此无法分辨完整的轨道调制；但检测到约mHz量级的脉冲频率变化，该尺度与轨道运动引起的多普勒频移预期一致——例如，对周期~1小时、伴星质量~0.1 M⊙的系统，轨道速度导致的频率变化幅度恰在mHz量级。  
r.m.s.脉冲幅度为百分之几，说明X射线辐射具有明显周期性调制，支持中子星吸积柱或热斑几何模型；同时，短时标频率漂移尚未能区分是轨道运动、自转减慢（\dot{ν}）、或吸积扭矩扰动所致，需更长时序数据分离各贡献。  
当前RXTE持续观测及多波段协同，旨在确认轨道参数、识别光学/射电对应体，并判断其是否属于红背或黑寡妇型蜘蛛脉冲星——因该源为暂现体且具X射线脉冲，极可能处于短暂吸积活跃相，暗示伴星存在显著物质损失或遮挡结构。

根据现象进行分析： Flare at OIR wavelengths in GX 339-4 We have continued our observations of GX 339-4 with the SMARTS 1.3m and ANDICAM instrument since the source transitioned into the hard state around MJD 54233 (13th May 2007, ATEL #1074). The optical and infrared (OIR) fluxes reached a minimum at MJD 54239, and then began to rise. Since that time the brightness of the source has increased as follows:
Filter  | Mag at MJD 54239 |  Mag at MJD 54260  |  Delta (mag)   
---|---|---|---  
V | 17.6 |  17.0  |  0.6  
I  | 16.7  | 15.8 | 0.9  
J  | 15.5  |  14.0  |  1.5  
H | 15.0  | 13.3  |  1.7  
The large increase in the infrared implies that this is likely an IR-dominated flare, like that seen for example in 4U1543-47 (Buxton & Bailyn 2004 ApJ 615, 880). The latest observations suggest that the OIR fluxes may now have peaked. Observations in other wavelengths, especially infrared and radio, are strongly encouraged.
A plot of our lightcurves can be found at the URL provided below. 2007-06-14 18:39:00
response: GX 339-4在MJD 54233进入硬态后，OIR波段流量于MJD 54239达到极小值，随后开始上升；从MJD 54239到MJD 54260，各波段星等变化显示：V波段变亮0.6 mag，I波段0.9 mag，J波段1.5 mag，H波段1.7 mag；红外波段（J、H）的增亮幅度显著大于光学波段（V、I），表明能量释放主要集中在红外，符合IR-dominated flare的特征；该行为与4U1543-47中观测到的类似红外主导耀发一致；当前光变曲线显示OIR流量可能已达峰值，暗示耀发已进入衰减阶段；由于硬态下同步辐射和喷流辐射常主导红外至射电波段，该红外增强很可能源于喷流活动增强；因此需加强红外和射电波段监测，以检验喷流模型并确认谱能分布演化。

根据现象进行分析： Optical measurements of HETE J1900.1-2455 with the Large Binocular Telescope We acquired a series of 200 s r-band images of the optical counterpart of HETE J1900.1-2455 beginning 2007 June 13 09:37 UT with the Large Binocular Camera (Blue), mounted on the 8.4 m Large Binocular Telescope, Mt. Graham, Arizona. PSF photometry yielded a Sloan R-band magnitude of 18.64 +/- 0.02, or 18.54 +/- 0.02 mag in Johnson-Cousins R-band. This is consistent with previous reports that the X-ray flux has increased again (Degenaar et al. 2007, ATel #1106), and that the object has returned (more or less) to its outburst state. In the R-band, it is currently ~1.7 mag brighter than the measurements from 2 weeks ago (Torres et al. 2007, ATel #1090), and only ~0.5 mag fainter than its previous outburst magnitude (Steeghs et al. 2005, ATel #543).   
  
The LBT is an international collaboration among institutions in the United States, Italy and Germany. The LBT Corporation partners are: * The University of Arizona on behalf of the Arizona university system * Istituto Nazionale di Astrofisica, Italy * LBT Beteiligungsgesellschaft, Germany, representing the Max Planck Society, the Astrophysical Institute Potsdam, and Heidelberg University * The Ohio State University * The Research Corporation, on behalf of The University of Notre Dame, University of Minnesota and University of Virginia 2007-06-14 21:41:00
response:
首先，观测目标是HETE J1900.1-2455的光学对应体，使用位于美国亚利桑那州格雷厄姆山的8.4米大型双筒望远镜（LBT）及其Large Binocular Camera（Blue）进行。观测始于2007年6月13日09:37 UT，获取了一系列曝光时间为200秒的r波段图像。

其次，通过点扩散函数（PSF）测光方法，得到该源在Sloan r波段的星等为18.64 ± 0.02，在Johnson-Cousins R波段则为18.54 ± 0.02。该亮度值与此前X射线流量再次增强的报道一致（Degenaar et al. 2007, ATel #1106），表明该源已基本回归至爆发态。

接着，将本次测量结果与两周前的光学观测对比（Torres et al. 2007, ATel #1090），发现当前R波段亮度约亮1.7等；再与该源上一次爆发期间的亮度比较（Steeghs et al. 2005, ATel #543），仅暗约0.5等，进一步支持其处于近似完全恢复的爆发状态。

最后，文中提及LBT为美、意、德三国合作项目，但该信息属于仪器背景说明，不直接影响对HETE J1900.1-2455物理状态的判断，故在核心现象分析中属次要信息。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT and RXTE/PCA results from SWIFT J1756.9-2508 We report on further analysis of the newly discovered millisecond pulsar SWIFT J1756.9-2508 (ATel #1105, #1107, #1108), including Swift XRT and RXTE PCA observations. 
Based on about 5 ks of Swift XRT data, the revised position for SWIFT J1756.9-2508 is:  
RA = 17h 56m 57.1s (269.23794)  
Dec = -25d 06m 26.7s (-25.10743)  
with an estimated error of 3.5" radius (90% confidence). 
We analyzed 1.1 ksec of XRT data from the first Swift observation of the source. After correction for pile-up and the removal of scattered light from GX 5-1, we find that the data is well fit by an absorbed power law with a photon index of 2.2 +/- 0.4 and an absorption of nH = (6.2 +/- 1.4) X 10^{22} cm^2. The unabsorbed / absorbed flux in this model is (1.15 / 0.20) X 10^-9 erg/cm^2/s for 0.2-10 keV. Fitting to an absorbed black body yields kT = 1.2 +/- 0.1 keV and nH = (2.9 +/- 0.8) X 10^{22} cm^2. The unabsorbed / absorbed fluxes in this model for 0.2-10 keV are (2.51 / 1.84) X 10^{-10} erg/cm^2/s. Fitting the 0.3-10 keV pile-up corrected light curve with a constant yields a mean count rate of 2.1 +/- 0.1 cps. Quoted uncertainties are at the 90% confidence level. 
Preliminary analysis of the Swift observations from June 14 shows similar results. 
The RXTE PCA observed the source starting at 13 June 2007 at 19:00 UTC for about 1700 seconds. Because of the nearby bright source GX 5-1, an offset pointing was performed. The source was detected up to energies ~30 keV, and the spectrum is consistent with an absorbed power law with photon index 1.9 +/- 0.1 (with absorption fixed to 5 x 10^{22} cm^{-2}). Contamination from the galactic ridge was present at about the 2 mCrab level (Raymond-Smith model, kT = 3 keV). After subtracting the estimated contamination, the fluxes in the 2-10, 10-20 and 20-40 keV bands were 3.3, 2.2 and 2.4 in units of 10^{-10} erg/cm^2/s. The PCA and XRT spectral results are in reasonable agreement. 
PCA bulge scan monitoring observations are not possible in this region of the sky for most of the month of June, due to RXTE spacecraft slewing constraints. The most recent observation was June 6. The source has not been detected in the past month, with a 95% upper limit of about 1 mCrab (2-10 keV). 2007-06-14 23:48:00
response: 该现象描述了对新发现的毫秒脉冲星SWIFT J1756.9−2508的多仪器X射线观测分析结果，核心在于通过Swift/XRT与RXTE/PCA数据联合约束其位置、能谱特性、光度及暂现行为。首先，XRT约5 ks数据将源位置精确定至RA=17h56m57.1s、Dec=−25°06′26.7″，误差半径3.5″（90%置信），显著提升了定位精度。其次，XRT能谱拟合显示两种物理模型均成立：吸收幂律模型给出光子指数Γ=2.2±0.4、吸收柱密度nH=(6.2±1.4)×10²² cm⁻²，未吸收通量为1.15×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s（0.2–10 keV）；吸收黑体模型则得kT=1.2±0.1 keV、nH=(2.9±0.8)×10²² cm⁻²，未吸收通量为2.51×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s——二者通量差异达4.6倍，反映模型简并性，但nH值均显著高于银河系平均值，表明存在强局部吸收。XRT光变曲线呈平稳态，平均计数率2.1±0.1 cps，支持稳定吸积态。RXTE/PCA观测虽受邻近亮源GX 5-1干扰而需偏置指向，但仍探测到源信号延伸至~30 keV，其幂律谱指数Γ=1.9±0.1（nH固定为5×10²² cm⁻²）与XRT结果一致；扣除银道面热辐射污染（~2 mCrab）后，2–10 keV通量为3.3×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s，与XRT吸收幂律模型下同一波段的吸收通量0.20×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s量级相当（考虑误差与模型系统差），验证了谱形一致性。值得注意的是，RXTE巡天在六月大部分时间因卫星指向限制无法覆盖该天区，仅6月6日有最近一次扫描，此后一个月内未再探测到源，给出95%置信度2–10 keV流量上限约1 mCrab，暗示该源可能处于暂现爆发后的衰减阶段或具有间歇性活动特征。综合来看，多波段能谱参数一致指向一个被中等高吸收遮蔽、处于低吸积率稳定态或衰减期的毫秒脉冲星系统。

Available R-band magnitudes from 3x300s CCD images taken with the 50/70cm Schmidt telescope at NAO Rozhen, Bulgaria: June 14.022, 19.1; 15.012, 18.9. The nearest variable is M31 V0708 (GCVS4.2, 2004) at distance 3.52". 2007-06-15 13:13:00
response: 该现象描述了一颗位于M31（仙女座星系）附近的暂现源，被初步认定为新星候选体。首先，其天球坐标（J2000历元）明确给出，且相对M31中心的角距离为西向518.5角秒、南向117.9角秒，表明该源位于M31的外晕或邻近场区，尚未能直接确认是否属于M31本星系成员，需结合距离模数与消光进一步判断。其次，R波段光度观测显示：6月14.022日为19.1等，6月15.012日为18.9等，在约24小时内变亮0.2等，符合经典新星早期快速增亮的典型光变特征。两次观测均基于相同仪器（NAO Rozhen 50/70 cm Schmidt望远镜）与相同曝光参数（3×300 s CCD），数据具备可比性，排除了显著的系统误差或测光异常。第三，该位置附近已知变星M31 V0708（GCVS 4.2版收录，2004年证认）距此仅3.52角秒，属于极近邻；因此必须严格排除该暂现源是否为M31 V0708的再次爆发、掩食伴星活动、或图像重叠导致的误识别。最后，当前仅含两 epoch 的R波段数据，缺乏多波段、高时间分辨率及后续衰减期观测，尚不能确认其光谱型、绝对星等、衰减时标（如t₂或t₃）、以及是否具有新星光谱特征（如Fe II型或He/N型），故暂定为“新星候选体”是恰当且审慎的结论。

根据现象进行分析： 4U 1608-522 in X-ray outburst The Swift BAT instrument detects a new outburst of the LMXB transient 4U 1608-522, beginning around June 12 and still rising to a current level of 250 mCrab (15-50 keV) as of June 15. This is the first outburst of this source in nearly a year (ATEL #851, #855, #857, #858). 
The BAT light curve can be viewed on the Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor page (ATEL #904) http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/H1608-522/ 2007-06-15 22:43:00
response: 首先，观测到4U 1608-522在X射线波段发生新的爆发，起始时间约为6月12日；其次，Swift/BAT在15–50 keV能段测得其流量持续上升，截至6月15日已达250 mCrab；第三，该爆发是该源近一年来的首次活动，此前上一次爆发记录见于ATEL #851等系列通告；第四，BAT光变曲线可通过Swift/BAT硬X射线暂现源监测页面获取，证实了爆发的时序演化特征；第五，作为一颗低质量X射线双星（LMXB）暂现源，其爆发行为符合吸积盘不稳定性触发的典型模型，即长期积累的物质在临界条件下发生热核不稳定性或粘滞不稳定性，导致吸积率陡增，从而产生X射线光度显著上升。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Orbital Parameters of SWIFT J1756.9-2508 We report on high time resolution properties of the 182 Hz X-ray pulsar SWIFT J1756.9-2508 (ATEL #1105, #1107, #1108, #1111). 
The RXTE PCA instrument has performed several observations of the source since its discovery for a total of 13 ksec. Over 1.3 days, the source has faded from 20 to 17 mCrab (2-10 keV). 
Pulsations continue to be detectable in the PCA data, and the clear signatures of orbital Doppler modulation are present. The orbital period is 54 minutes, and the pulsar mass function is (1.66 +/- 0.25) x 10^{-7} M_sun (i.e. minimum companion mass of ~0.007 M_sun). The orbital period and mass function place J1756 as one of the "ultra-compact" X-ray binary systems, and very similar to the two other short orbital-period millisecond X-ray pulsars XTE J0929-314 and XTE J1807-294. 
No strong high or low frequency QPOs are detected. 2007-06-16 01:14:00
response: 该现象描述了X射线脉冲星SWIFT J1756.9−2508的轨道参数观测结果。首先，RXTE/PCA对源进行了总计13 ks的高时间分辨率观测，覆盖约1.3天，期间其X射线流量（2–10 keV）从20 mCrab衰减至17 mCrab，表明源处于光度缓慢下降阶段，但仍未熄灭。其次，持续探测到182 Hz的相干X射线脉冲，证实其为毫秒级自转的中子星；更重要的是，在脉冲到达时间中清晰识别出轨道多普勒调制效应，说明中子星处于双星系统中并围绕质心运动。通过拟合脉冲到达时延曲线，得到轨道周期为54分钟，极短，属于超紧凑X射线双星（UCXB）范畴。由此导出的质量函数为(1.66±0.25)×10⁻⁷ M⊙，该值仅依赖于轨道周期、轨道速度振幅和中子星质量，且对应伴星最小质量约为0.007 M⊙，进一步支持伴星为氦白矮星或低质量剥离星核的典型UCXB物理解释。此外，该系统与另两个已知短轨周期毫秒X射线脉冲星XTE J0929−314和XTE J1807−294在轨道周期和质量函数上高度相似，暗示其具有共通的演化起源——即经历长时间吸积导致中子星自转加速，并因角动量损失使轨道持续收缩至目前超短周期状态。最后，未探测到显著的高低频准周期振荡（QPO），暗示内吸积盘结构可能较简单或未激发强不稳定性，这与UCXB中吸积流受强引力场和小轨道尺度限制的理论预期一致。

根据现象进行分析： New X-Ray Transient in M31: CXOM31 J004258.6+411527 We report the discovery of a previously unseen X-ray point source detected in a 10ks observation starting on 2007-06-02.93 UT as part of our ongoing Chandra/HST M31 transient program. The source was detected by ACIS-I at coordinates RA(J2000) 00:42:58.63, Dec(J2000) +41:15:27.00, with centroid position errors of 0.05" and 0.04", respectively (subject to the standard bore-sight correction).   
  
The 0.6-5.0 keV spectrum can be modelled using an absorbed disk blackbody+powerlaw. Fixing nH = 6.67e20 atoms/cm2 (the Galactic value towards M31), we find Tin ~ 0.93 keV and a photon index of 2.6. The luminosity (assuming a distance of 780 kpc to M31) is Lx ~ 5.2e37 erg/s in the 0.5-10 keV range, with a powerlaw contribution of ~25%.   
  
A 5ks follow up observation of the source on 2007-06-18.28 found its luminosity to have decreased to Lx ~ 3.5e37 erg/s in the above energy range. Using the same parameters as in the first observation, the 0.4-3 keV flux is well modelled by a disk blackbody with Tin ~ 0.72 keV and a powerlaw with photon index of 2.5.   
  
The presence of a very soft component in the spectrum and the X-ray luminosity are consistent with the source being a black hole transient in a thermal (high-soft) state. Further optical and X-ray observations of this source are encouraged. 2007-06-19 20:33:00
response: 该X射线暂现源CXOM31 J004258.6+411527位于M31中，首次探测到于2007年6月2.93日UT的Chandra观测，持续10 ks。其精确位置由ACIS-I测定，坐标误差极小（RA 0.05″，Dec 0.04″），表明为点源且定位可靠。光谱分析显示其在0.6–5.0 keV能段可用吸积盘黑体加幂律模型拟合；固定银河系视线方向的吸收柱密度nH = 6.67×10²⁰ cm⁻²后，得到内盘温度Tin ≈ 0.93 keV，幂律光子指数Γ ≈ 2.6，0.5–10 keV波段光度Lx ≈ 5.2×10³⁷ erg/s，其中幂律成分贡献约25%。16天后（2007年6月18.28日）的后续5 ks观测显示光度下降至Lx ≈ 3.5×10³⁷ erg/s，同时软谱成分增强：0.4–3 keV谱可由单一吸积盘黑体（Tin ≈ 0.72 keV）与幂律（Γ ≈ 2.5）联合拟合。光度显著高于中子星暂现源典型热态上限（~10³⁶–10³⁷ erg/s），且存在强软热成分、光度处于恒星质量黑洞暂现源典型高软态范围（10³⁷–10³⁸ erg/s），光谱演化符合黑洞X射线双星在高软态下随光度下降而内盘温度降低的预期行为，因此综合判断该源极可能是一颗处于热主导高软态的恒星质量黑洞暂现源。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT and UVOT detection of the optical nova M31N 2006-11a We report the detection of the optical nova M31N 2006-11a with the XRT and UVOT instruments in a 19.4 ks Swift observation starting at June 1, 2007 at 16:40 UT, about 190 d after the nova outburst. The optical nova M31N 2006-11a was detected by K. Itagaki on November 24.67, 2006 and reached 17.3 mag at maximum on unfiltered CCD images (see http://cfa-www.harvard.edu/iau/CBAT_M31.html#2006-11a  ).   
  
During the Swift observation five U and 14 UVW2 exposures were collected with about 1 ks integration time each. During one of the U and six of the UVW2 exposures the nova was outside the Field of View (FOV) leaving a total exposure for the nova area of 4.2 ks in U and 7.7 ks in UVW2. The nova was clearly detected in both filters at magnitudes of 20.15+/-0.19 and 21.12+/-0.16, respectively, i.e. about 3 mag below outburst brightness. The emission in UVW2 may originate in the ejected shell, excited by the soft X-ray emission. The observed flux in the UVW2 band (180+/-20 nm) may well result from the CIII] 190.9 nm, NIII] 175.0 nm and/or OIII] 166.3 nm lines, typical for the spectra of novae in the nebular phase.  
  
A soft X-ray source with about 26 cts is detected at the nova position, just inside the boarder of the XRT, with all photons below 530 eV. No X-ray source has been reported previously near this position in XMM-Newton and Chandra observations covering the area. The temperature of a blackbody fit to the source spectrum can be constrained to 40 eV < kT < 90 eV (90% confidence) using the Galactic foreground absorption (6.6^20 cm^-2) as lower bound and constraining the luminosity to below 3.5^38 erg/s (using the Eddington luminosity of a white dwarf at the Chandrasekhar mass limit, and assuming a He-rich atmosphere for a conservative upper luminosity limit). Column density - temperature confidence contours inferred from the Swift/XRT spectrum of M31N 2006-11a can be seen from the figure at http://www.mpe.mpg.de/~m31novae/xray/swift/index.php  .  
  
We would like to thank the Swift team for the scheduling of the XRT and UVOT observations. 2007-06-20 09:58:00
response:
该现象描述了对M31N 2006-11a光学新星在爆发约190天后开展的Swift卫星XRT与UVOT多波段观测结果。首先， nova于2006年11月24.67日被Itagaki发现，峰值亮度达17.3 mag（无滤光CCD），表明其为一次典型光学新星爆发；而Swift观测始于2007年6月1日16:40 UT，即爆发后约190天，此时系统已进入晚期演化阶段。

UVOT数据中，U波段总有效曝光4.2 ks，测得星等20.15±0.19 mag；UVW2波段总有效曝光7.7 ks，测得21.12±0.16 mag，两者均比爆发极大时暗约3 mag，说明光学连续谱已显著衰减。UVW2波段中心波长约192.8 nm，覆盖180±20 nm范围，其中可能包含CIII] 190.9 nm、NIII] 175.0 nm和OIII] 166.3 nm等禁线——这些谱线是新星进入星云相（nebular phase）的标志性特征，反映激波加热或中心热源紫外辐射电离膨胀壳层所产生的发射线主导辐射，而非热连续谱。

XRT探测到一个软X射线源，共26个计数，全部能量低于530 eV，位于XRT视场边缘、与光学位置一致，且此前XMM-Newton与Chandra巡天未在此位置报告过X射线源，排除了背景源或恒星残留的可能性。该X射线辐射极软，暗示辐射来自温度极低的热等离子体或黑体辐射。通过黑体拟合，在固定银河系前景吸收柱密度NH = 6.6×10²⁰ cm⁻²（下限）并限制光度不超过白矮星爱丁顿极限（假设Chandrasekhar质量、He富集大气，得L < 3.5×10³⁸ erg/s）的约束下，得到kT置信区间为40–90 eV（90%置信度）。此温度对应黑体峰值波长约1.4–3.1 nm，远短于UVW2波段，但可有效电离气体并激发远紫外禁线，从而解释UVW2波段强发射；同时，如此低温黑体辐射在0.5–10 keV能段积分光度极低，与仅26个低能光子的探测一致。

综上，该现象揭示M31N 2006-11a在爆发后190天已过渡至星云相：光学波段由膨胀壳层的禁线发射主导，X射线则来自冷却中的白矮星表面或边界层产生的软热辐射，二者存在物理关联——X射线电离并激发壳层，产生观测到的远紫外谱线。这符合经典新星演化模型中“X射线开启—光学星云相持续”的时序预期。

We can set a 1-10 keV upper limit on the source unabsorbed flux of F(1-10)=3.2e-12 erg/cm2/s (assuming the spectral model that fits the longest XRT observation performed on 2007-06-15 for 9.1ks). This is more than a factor of 300 weaker than the X-ray flux observed with Swift/XRT on Jun 13 (ATEL #1111) and weaker by a factor of ~10 than the last Swift/XRT detection on June 19. We would like to thank the Swift-team for performing these XRT observations. 2007-06-22 10:14:00
response: 该现象表明SWIFT J1756.9-2508在2007年6月21日的约1.9 ks Swift/XRT定点观测中未被探测到。基于2007年6月15日长达9.1 ks的XRT观测所拟合的光谱模型，可推得1–10 keV能段的未吸收通量上限为F(1–10) = 3.2 × 10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s。该上限比6月13日ATEL #1111报道的X射线通量低300倍以上，也比6月19日最后一次XRT探测结果弱约10倍。通量显著下降表明该毫秒X射线脉冲星在此期间处于极低光度态或暂现熄灭状态，可能反映其吸积过程发生剧烈减弱或中断，例如吸积盘内区物质耗尽、吸积率骤降，或存在遮挡效应；考虑到其作为伴星质量较小的低质量X射线双星（LMXB）系统的性质，此类通量变化可能与吸积不稳定性、轨道相位相关调制或状态转换有关。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of a Nova in the M31 Globular Cluster Bol 111 We report the discovery of a nova coincident with the cataloged globular cluster Bol 111 in M31. The object was discovered in unfiltered images taken around June 19.4 UT (about 16.8 mag) and June 21.4 (about 16.9 mag) by the 0.45m ROTSE-IIIb telescope at the McDonald Observatory. The nova is located at RA = 00h42m33.14s DEC = 41o00'25.9" (J2000; +/- 0.3" in each coordinate), which is 2' 6.0" west and 15' 42.6" south of the core of M31, and consistent to within the errors of the location of Bol 111. 
Photometry from the Palomar 60" telescope indicate the source (including light from the globular cluster) faded in the i-band by 0.24 mag between June 21.374 and June 22.469 UT.  

A spectrum (420-890 nm) obtained on June 22.44 UT with the 9.2m Hobby-Eberly Telescope (+ Marcario Low-Resolution Spectrograph) by M. Shetrone and V. Riley shows the object is a nova. Broad emission features including H-alpha (HWZI ~3100 km/s), H-beta, and H-gamma are detected, and the presence of N III 4640 blended with He II 4686 suggests membership in the He/N class of novae. He/N novae are relatively rare and make up only about 15% of the novae with measured spectra in M31. The lines are blueshifted by ~400 km/s, consistent with the lineshift observed for Bol 111 (Galleti et al. 2006).  

We note that there have been only two other classical novae firmly associated with globular clusters (e.g. Shara et al. 2004). 
A finding chart can be found at: http://grad40.as.utexas.edu/~quimby/tss/charts/nova13.png 2007-06-22 23:46:00
response: 该现象描述了一颗位于M31球状星团Bol 111内的新星爆发事件。首先，观测时间与亮度变化表明该源在6月19.4 UT至21.4 UT期间亮度稳定在约16.8–16.9等，属于典型新星早期光变平台期；随后在6月21.374至22.469 UT的i波段观测中出现0.24 mag的快速衰减，符合经典新星爆发后初期光度下降特征。其次，精确的位置测量（RA=00h42m33.14s, DEC=+41°00′25.9″）与Bol 111星团中心位置在误差范围内一致（±0.3″），且相对M31核心的偏移量（西2′6.0″、南15′42.6″）与Bol 111已知坐标吻合，排除了前景恒星或背景星系干扰的可能性。第三，HET获取的光学光谱显示宽发射线（Hα半宽约3100 km/s），证实其为热、高速膨胀的激波电离气体，是新星的决定性光谱证据；N III 4640与He II 4686的混合特征明确将其归类为He/N型新星，该类型在M31已测光谱的新星中仅占约15%，具有特殊物理意义；谱线整体蓝移约400 km/s，与Bol 111星团自身的系统速度（Galleti et al. 2006）一致，进一步支持该新星物理上隶属于该星团而非投影重叠。最后，结合历史记录——迄今仅有两例被确证的球状星团内经典新星（Shara et al. 2004），本次发现显著增加了此类稀有事件的样本数量，对理解球状星团中白矮星吸积条件、双星演化通道及新星触发机制具有重要价值。

Bond (STScI) obtained an low dispersion (R=2000) blue (3700-5300A) spectrum of the star 2.2" from the position of SWIFT J195456.7+261301 (ATEL #1103) at 2007 21 June 0630 UT. The spectrum was obtained with the SMARTS 1.5m RC spectrograph at Cerro Tololo. Conditions were thin clouds; the spectrum is noisy. The spectral type is about K0; the chromospheric Ca II H & K lines show prominent emission reversals. This could be an RS CVn-like system, consistent with Kennea et al.'s conjecture (ATEL #1103) that this is a flaring coronal star. 2007-06-23 03:12:00
response: 该光学对应体的光谱观测显示其光谱型约为K0，表明这是一颗中低温的主序星或亚巨星。Ca II H&K线呈现显著的发射反置，说明色球层存在强烈的非热活动，如磁重联或耀斑加热所致。结合其位置与Swift卫星发现的X射线暂现源SWIFT J195456.7+261301高度吻合（角距仅2.2″），且观测到的色球活动特征与RS CVn型双星典型行为一致——即密近双星中因快速自转和强磁场导致的剧烈色球与日冕活动。此外，Kennea等人先前基于X射线光变提出的“耀发日冕星”假说，与此处光学谱中Ca II发射反置所反映的强烈色球活动相互印证，支持该源为一颗具有强磁活动性的晚型恒星，极可能处于密近双星系统中，并正在经历由磁活动驱动的X射线与光学联合耀发。

根据现象进行分析： V79 in the globular cluster Messier 3 returns to fundamental mode V79 was known as an RRab type star or fundamental mode pulsator with the period of about 0.483 day during the century after its discovery by S.I.Bailey in 1895. In 1996 it was unexpectedly found to pulsate in double mode (J. Kaluzhny et al., 1998, MNRAS V.296, p.347). The first overtone with the period of 0.359 day became the dominant mode. The switch of mode occured in April 1992. This phenomenon was unprecedented for the class of RR Lyrae stars. We perform CCD observations of V79 since 2007 June 5 using 60-cm telescope of the Sternberg Institute's Crimean Station and 100-cm telescope of the Special Astrophysical Observatory, Russia. Observations at SAI Crimean Station still continue. Number of our observations made in V filter exceeds 500. The observations show that V79 passes through the reverse switch from the dominant first overtone to fundamental mode. Periodogram analysis gives the only period of 0.4825 day, but not of 0.359 day. The light curve is typical for an RRab star with the amplitude of 1.2 mag, and shows the pattern of pronounced amplitude modulation resembling Blazhko effect (the last 15 years its amplitude did not exceed 0.7 mag in V). The period of this modulation is unusually small and equal to 1.389 day, that suggests the beat period or resonance motion between the fundamental mode and the first overtone. Further monitoring of V79 is encouraged. 
Light curve and table of observations for V79/M3 2007-06-23 19:05:00
response: V79是球状星团M3中的一颗RR Lyrae型变星，长期被归类为RRab型（即以基频模式脉动），脉动周期约为0.483天，这一状态自1895年Bailey发现以来持续近一个世纪。1992年4月，该星发生首次模式转换，由基频主导转为一阶泛音主导（周期0.359天），成为首例被观测到双模脉动的RR Lyrae星，此现象在当时属前所未见。1996年该状态被确认（Kaluzhny et al. 1998）。自2007年6月起开展的长期CCD观测（V波段，超500次观测）显示：V79已发生反向模式转换，重新回归基频主导脉动；周期图分析仅检测到0.4825天单一显著周期，未见0.359天信号；光变曲线呈现典型RRab形态，振幅达1.2 mag，但近15年振幅始终≤0.7 mag，表明存在显著振幅调制；该调制周期极短，为1.389天，数值上接近基频与一阶泛音周期的拍频（1/(1/0.4825 − 1/0.359) ≈ 1.388天），暗示二者间可能存在非线性共振或拍频机制；因此当前状态反映的是基频模式恢复主导、但受残余泛音成分调制的过渡态，其物理本质涉及脉动模式间的能量再分配与非线性耦合。

根据现象进行分析： XMM-Newton ToO observation of the outburst decay of the AXP 1E1048.1-5937 On the 22nd of March 2007 the anomalous X-ray pulsar (AXP) 1E1048.1-5937 showed a glitch (ATEL #1041) and an increase of its X-ray flux observed by RXTE (ATEL #1041), Swift (ATEL #1043; #1077) and Chandra (ATEL #1076). Following this event the source was detected in the near-IR and optical band at a high flux level (ATEL #1044; #1077; #1071). 
XMM-Newton observed 1E1048.1-5937 for 48ks starting on June 14th 2007. Preliminary results show that the source flux is still enhanced in the soft X-ray range with respect to pre-glitch observations (Mereghetti et al. 2004; Tiengo et al. 2005). The source EPIC-PN spectrum is well fitted (in the 1-10keV energy range; 2% systematics added; reduced chi^2 = 1.1 (184dof)) by an absorbed blackbody plus a power-law with Nh = 1.1(1)x10^22 cm^-2, kT = 0.74(1) keV and photon index Gamma=3.2(1) (all errors are given at 90% confidence level). The unabsorbed 2-10keV flux is 2.7(1)x10^-11 erg/s/cm^2, which is decreasing with respect to the latest Swift and Chandra post-glitch observations carried out on April/May. However, the AXP is still a factor of ~5 brighter than its quiescent level. 
We measure a spin period of 6.45826(1) s, with a fundamental component pulsed fraction of ~46%, highly energy dependent (from 35% to 52% from lower to higher energies; pulsed fraction defined as the background-corrected semi-amplitude of the best fitting sine component). Note that following the glitch, the nominal sinusoidal pulse profile of this source changed drastically in a multipeak profile (ATEL #1043; #1076; #1077): in this XMM-Newton observation the profile is still structured. 
Monitoring observations at other wavelengths are strongly encouraged in order to follow the decaying phases of the outburst of 1E1048.1-5937. 
We thank Norber Schartel and the XMM-Newton team for carrying out this ToO observation. 2007-06-28 10:18:00
response: 该现象描述了磁星1E1048.1-5937在2007年3月22日发生自转突变（glitch）后进入X射线暴发衰减期的多波段观测特征。首先，glitch事件触发了X射线光度显著增强，并伴随近红外和光学波段的同步增亮，表明能量释放不仅限于高能波段，而是涉及磁层与星震耦合导致的全局磁活动增强。XMM-Newton在6月14日开展的ToO观测显示，尽管软X射线流量已较4–5月Swift/Chandra观测时有所下降，但仍比宁静态高出约5倍，说明暴发处于缓慢衰减阶段，尚未回归基态。能谱拟合表明其由吸收黑体（kT ≈ 0.74 keV）与硬幂律（Γ ≈ 3.2）共同主导，该双成分结构支持磁星标准辐射模型：黑体成分源于表面热辐射（可能由星震加热或磁重联加热地壳所致），幂律成分则来自磁层中粒子加速产生的非热辐射。Nh值（1.1×10²² cm⁻²）与先前一致，排除视线方向吸收变化主导光变的可能性。自转周期精确测定为6.45826(1) s，脉冲分数高达46%且随能量升高而增大，反映辐射几何结构具有强能量依赖性；而脉冲轮廓仍保持多峰结构，不同于glitch前的单正弦形态，说明磁层拓扑或辐射区分布尚未恢复至暴发前平衡态。综上，该源正处于glitch驱动的磁星暴发衰减相，其X射线余辉、能谱演化与脉冲轮廓持续畸变共同指向磁层应力弛豫与地壳热扩散的联合过程。

根据现象进行分析： LMC X-3 Enters a Faint Hard State Monitoring observations of LMC X-3 by the Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer (RXTE) show that this black-hole candidate has entered the hard state for the first time since frequent monitoring began in March 2005. Luminosity was declining, and the contribution of the power-law component increasing, over the past several weeks. By June 15, 2007, the disk blackbody and powerlaw components had comparable contributions to the 2-10 keV flux, which was approximately 1.3x10^(-10) erg/cm2/s. On June 22, the source could be fit with a power law of index -2.2 (+/- 0.1), with no thermal component required, and a flux of 2.9x10^(-11) erg/cm2/s. On June 27, the best-fit power-law index was still -2.2 (+/- 0.2), but the flux had dropped to 1.0x10^(-11) erg/cm2/s, more than an order of magnitude below the flux of 12 days earlier.
Deep observations with RXTE have been scheduled. Radio observations to look for changes associated with the possible appearance and/or disappearance of a jet are encouraged, as are x-ray observations with other observatories. Judging from past behavior (Boyd et al. 2002, ApJL 542, L127; Wilms et al. 2001, MNRAS 320, 327) the source will probably return to its usual soft state within a month or less. 2007-06-29 20:28:00

该文本描述了21颗超新星的发现与初步分类结果，需从观测方法、数据来源、分类依据、物理参数及时间演化特征等方面进行系统分析：

首先，所有超新星均由“近邻超新星工厂”（Nearby Supernova Factory）项目通过QUEST II相机在帕洛玛奥欣48英寸望远镜上于2007年5月4日至6月26日期间获取图像发现，说明该批样本具有统一的巡天策略、仪器响应和时间覆盖，有利于统计比较。

其次，光谱分类依赖于夏威夷大学2.2米望远镜搭载的SNIFS（超新星积分场光谱仪），波长范围320–1000 nm，覆盖紫外至近红外，足以分辨Ia型超新星光谱中显著的Si II 635.5 nm吸收线、Ca II H&K、S II等特征，以及II型超新星的氢巴耳末线、Ibc型的无氢/氦谱线等关键标识；因此分类结果（Ia / II / Ibc）具有较高可靠性。

第三，R波段发现星等（17.9–20.3）表明这些超新星普遍较暗，结合红移z=0.01–0.16（对应距离约40–700 Mpc），可推断多数处于低红移近邻宇宙，适合后续高信噪比光谱与测光跟进；其中z≈0.01的SNF20070530-000、SNF20070604-003等II型事件可能宿主星系较近，而z≈0.16的SNF20070524-000（Ia，m_R=20.3）则位于更远处。

第四，相位信息（如“1–2周前极大”“around max”“3周后极大”）基于Ia型超新星标准光变模板（如MLCS或SALT2）拟合得出，反映其爆发演化阶段；值得注意的是，Ia型占比最高（共14/21），且红移集中于z≈0.03–0.12，符合Ia型作为宇宙学标准烛光的典型巡天选择效应；而II型（6颗）和Ibc型（1颗）多集中在低红移（z≤0.07），与其较强光度但快速衰减、易被遗漏的特性一致。

第五，坐标归算采用不同星表：6月1日前用USNO-A2.0，之后改用更高精度的USNO-B1.0，可能导致微小系统偏移，但对同一批次内相对位置分析影响有限；J2000.0历元坐标格式规范，便于交叉证认宿主星系。

第六，发现日期与光谱分类日期存在1–8天延迟（如SNF20070504-012：发现于5月4.4日，分类光谱获于5月5.4日），说明该项目具备快速响应能力，有利于捕获早期辐射特征；而部分II型超新星（如SNF20070626-002）未标注相位，可能因光变模型不适用或缺乏足够光谱时序数据。

综上，该样本集体现了系统性、多波段、快速响应的近邻超新星巡天特征，Ia型主导且相位分布广泛，为研究爆发物理、前身星系统及宇宙学应用提供了高质量基准样本。

该文本是一则天文通报（ATEL）的勘误声明，核心现象是：原通报ATEL #1124中发布的表格缺失列标题（即未标注各列所代表的物理量或观测参数），导致读者无法准确理解表格数据含义。为此，发布方“The Nearby Supernova Factory”正式致歉并提供修正后的完整表格。

分析要点如下：

1. **错误性质**：属于元数据缺失错误，非观测数据错误。所有数值内容本身未被修改，仅补充了缺失的表头行——“Target Name”, “RA”, “Decl”, “Disc Date”, “Disc Mag”, “Spec Date”, “Type”, “Redshift”, “Disc Phase”。

2. **表头语义解析**：
   - “Target Name”：超新星暂现源编号，遵循SNFYYYYMMDD-NNN命名规则，含发现年月日及序号；
   - “RA”与“Decl”：赤道坐标（J2000历元），单位为时分秒（RA）和度分秒（Decl），用于精确定位天体；
   - “Disc Date”：发现日期，格式为“Month DD.D”，其中小数部分表示当日UTC分数（如May 04.4 ≈ 04日09:36 UTC）；
   - “Disc Mag”：发现时的视星等，反映亮度，数值越大表示越暗；
   - “Spec Date”：光谱观测日期，用于分类和红移测定；
   - “Type”：光谱分类结果，含Ia、II、Ibc等类型，Ia型为热核爆炸，II/Ibc为核塌缩型；
   - “Redshift”：光谱测得的宇宙学红移z，用于估算距离（如z=0.03对应约130 Mpc）；
   - “Disc Phase”：发现时刻相对于光变极大期（maximum light）的相位，单位为周或天，对Ia型超新星可用于限制爆发时间与物理模型约束。

3. **数据一致性观察**：
   - 所有Ia型超新星红移集中在0.03–0.16，对应z < 0.2，属近邻宇宙样本（< 700 Mpc）；
   - “Disc Phase”描述存在不统一：部分条目写为“1-2 weeks before max”，部分为“around max”或“few days past max”，说明相位估计依赖于模板拟合或历史光变曲线外推，并非实测值；
   - 三例II型与一例Ibc型超新星未给出“Disc Phase”，暗示其光变行为更复杂、极大期难以界定，或尚未获得足够光变采样；
   - 最后一行SNF20070626-009的“Redshift”字段末尾多出“2007-06-30 00:20:00”，明显为时间戳误植，属排版错误，应仅保留“0.03”。

4. **科学意图推断**：该表服务于时域巡天项目的快速发布需求，强调目标基本信息、分类状态与初步红移，以支持后续跟踪观测（如光谱确认、光变监测、宿主星系研究）。未提供误差信息、仪器参数或信噪比等细节，符合ATEL简报性质。

5. **勘误必要性**：无表头时，“May 04.4”可能被误读为RA或Decl；“18.8”可能被误认为红移而非星等；“Ia”若无“Type”标识则无法区分是分类还是其他缩写。因此表头缺失会直接导致数据不可解释，影响科学使用，故必须修正。

其次，观测坐标与星等定标方法明确：R波段发现星等及J2000.0赤道坐标均通过与USNO-B1.0星表比对获得，表明位置和亮度测量具备标准参考基准，系统误差可控。

第三，从表格数据可归纳出关键统计特征：6颗中4颗为Ia型（占比2/3），2颗为II型（占比1/3）；红移范围为0.03–0.11，全部属于近邻宇宙（z < 0.15），符合“Nearby Supernova Factory”的巡天定位；发现星等介于18.1–19.8 mag，属中等深度巡天探测能力；光谱观测统一集中在7月2日（UTC），即发现后约3–5天，保证了分类时效性与相位一致性。

第四，相位信息仅标注于部分Ia型超新星：SNF20070627-009处于极大光度后数日，SNF20070628-002为极大前数日，SNF20070629-001在极大附近，SNF20070630-005已达极大后一个月——这反映Ia型样本覆盖了光变曲线多个关键阶段，有利于后续光谱演化或绝对星等校准研究；而两颗II型未标注相位，可能因光变形态复杂、缺乏统一参考模板，或当时尚未拟合出爆炸时刻。

第五，命名规则体现时间与序号逻辑：“SNF20070627-009”表示2007年6月27日发现的第9个候选体，说明该巡天采用每日独立编号，且单日最多发现9例（6月27日）、最少2例（6月28、29、30日各2例），反映观测效率与候选体提取率存在日间波动，可能受天气、月相或仪器状态影响。

最后，所有光谱日期均为7月2日，但发现日期横跨4天，说明存在集中后续观测策略：将多日发现目标统一安排在同一次望远镜夜进行光谱确认，提高了大型望远镜使用效率，也暗示该团队具备快速响应与协调观测的能力。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SN2007cv Swift's Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) observed SN 2007cv (CBET #989) on 2007-06-30.76 UT. The following UVOT magnitudes were measured: V = 16.0 +/- 0.1 (206 s exposure time), B = 16.4 +/- 0.1 (206 s), U = 16.3 +/- 0.1 (206 s), UVW1 [181-321nm] = 18.5 +/- 0.1 (412 s), UVM2 [166-268 nm] > 19.4 (117 s), and UVW2 [112-264 nm] = 20.0 +/- 0.2 (824 s). In a second observation on 2007-07-02.77 the SN brightened to V = 15.7 +/- 0.1 (203 s), B = 15.9 +/- 0.1 (203 s), U = 15.6 +/- 0.1 (203 s), UVW1 = 17.6 +/- 0.1 (406 s), UVM2 > 19.5 (125 s), and UVW2 [112-264 nm] = 19.8 +/- 0.2 (812 s). These magnitudes have not been corrected for extinction. The optical colors best match a young Ia (Poznanski, Gal-Yam, Maoz, Filippenko, Leonard, & Matheson, 2002, PASP, 114, 833) as do the red UV-optical colors (e.g. Brown et al., 2005, ApJ, 635, 1192; Immler et al., 2006, ApJL, 648, 119). 2007-07-04 00:08:00
response: 首先，Swift卫星的UVOT仪器在2007年6月30.76 UT对超新星SN 2007cv进行了首次观测，测得多波段光度值：V=16.0±0.1、B=16.4±0.1、U=16.3±0.1、UVW1=18.5±0.1、UVM2>19.4、UVW2=20.0±0.2；两天后即7月2.77 UT第二次观测显示所有光学波段（V、B、U）和近紫外波段UVW1、UVW2均明显变亮，其中V波段由16.0降至15.7（增亮约0.3 mag），B由16.4降至15.9（增亮约0.5 mag），U由16.3降至15.6（增亮约0.7 mag），UVW1由18.5降至17.6（增亮约0.9 mag），UVW2由20.0降至19.8（增亮约0.2 mag），而UVM2仍为下限值且略有加深，表明该波段未探测到显著变化或亮度增长受限于信噪比。各波段曝光时间基本保持稳定，测量误差较小（典型±0.1 mag），说明光变趋势可靠。未进行消光改正，但光学颜色（如U−B≈−0.1、B−V≈0.4）与Ia型超新星早期光谱特征一致；同时UV-optical颜色（如UVW1−V≈1.6、UVW2−V≈4.0）也符合年轻Ia型超新星的红化分布，支持其分类为Ia型。综合光变上升趋势、颜色演化及与已知Ia模板的匹配性，可推断SN 2007cv处于爆炸后早期上升阶段，光度仍在增长，符合Ia型超新星典型光变行为。

根据现象进行分析：  ATCA non-detection at 8.7 GHz of the Millisecond X-ray Pulsar SWIFT J1756.9-2508 We did not detect the Millisecond X-ray Pulsar SWIFT J1756.9-2508 (ATel #1105, #1107, #1108, #1111, #1114, #1117) during an observation performed on June 26, 2007 (08:55 to 19:00 UT) at the Australia Telescope Compact Array (ATCA) under the TOO proposal CX136. 
We used array configuration 6C, a central frequency of 8.7 GHz, a bandwidth of 256 MHz, and observed for ~12 ks on-source (2 of the 6 antennae were unavailable). The synthesized beam was 0.95 arcsec x 1.85 arcsec. The flux calibrator 0823-500 and the phase calibrator 1752-225 (~600 milliJy/beam at 8.7 GHz) were used. We pointed at the position reported in ATel #1111 (RA = 17h 56m 57.1s Dec=-25d 06m 26.7s, epoch 2000.0). No pointlike source was found within the 90% confidence positional error circle of the X-ray source (3.5" radius, ATel #1111), down to a flux density level (~0.27 milliJy/beam) corresponding to 5 times the rms noise. 2007-07-04 08:54:00
response: 该现象表明，在8.7 GHz频段对毫秒X射线脉冲星SWIFT J1756.9−2508进行的ATCA射电观测中未探测到射电辐射。首先，观测条件具备基本可靠性：采用6C阵列构型、中心频率8.7 GHz、带宽256 MHz、有效积分时间约12 ks，校准源（通量标准源0823−500和相位标准源1752−225）使用恰当，指向位置依据ATel #1111给出的精确X射线定位（误差圆半径3.5″），合成波束分辨率为0.95″×1.85″，满足对点源探测的空间分辨要求。其次，探测限达0.27 mJy/beam（5σ水平），对应于典型毫秒脉冲星在8.7 GHz可能具有的射电流量范围下限；未检出信号说明其在此频段的射电辐射强度低于该灵敏度阈值。需考虑多种物理可能性：该源可能属于“射电寂静”毫秒脉冲星，即射电辐射束未扫过地球视线方向；或存在强色散/散射导致脉冲展宽而淹没于噪声；亦或其射电辐射具有显著频谱陡变特性，在8.7 GHz处本征流量已急剧衰减；此外，暂现性射电辐射（如伴星相互作用引发的耀发）在观测窗口内未发生亦不能排除。因此，非探测结果本身构成对该源射电性质的重要约束，尤其支持其射电辐射具有方向性、时变性或强频谱依赖性的假设。

根据现象进行分析： WSRT Non-Detection of Radio Pulsations from the New X-ray MSP SWIFT  J1756.9-2508 During its Recent Outburst                                      We have searched for coherent radio pulsations from the new 182-Hz X-ray pulsar SWIFT J1756.9-2508 (ATel #1105, #1107, #1108, #1111, #1114, #1117, #1128) with the Westerbork Synthesis Radio Telescope (WSRT) in the Netherlands. We observed SWIFT J1756.9-2508 (pointing at RA = 17:56:57.2, DEC = -25:06:26.28 J2000) for 3000s (> 90% of the source's orbital period) on MJD 54266.103 (15 June 2007) with WSRT in a tied array (non-imaging) mode, using the PuMa pulsar backend. PuMa provided 25-us sampling and 0.16-MHz channels covering 60 MHz of RFI clean bandwidth centered at 1.4 GHz. 
Given the unknown dispersion measure (DM) towards this source, we searched trial timeseries dedispersed from DM 0-700 pc cm^-3 in steps of 1-4 pc cm^-3 (the step size being larger at higher DMs). These timeseries were searched using a Fourier-based linear acceleration search (Ransom et al. 2002, AJ, 124, 1788) of the full data span, as well as overlapping chunks of 750s each. This was done to partially account for Doppler shifting of the signal due to orbital motion. Furthermore, these timeseries were folded at the known spin period of the pulsar, allowing for a small search in spin period and period derivative to account for orbital motion. 
No pulsations were detected in these searches. Assuming the radio signal was not overly smeared by intra-binary or interstellar scattering, or orbital motion, we can place a 1.4-GHz flux upper limit of ~ 0.5 mJy on pulsed radio emission from SWIFT J1756.9-2508. These radio observations were taken shortly after the source's discovery, during which it was X-ray active. The availability of a more precise rotational ephemeris would allow deeper searches of this data for radio pulsations. Recent observations, now that this source is X-ray quiet (ATel #1117), have failed to detect a radio point source at this position (ATel #1128). 2007-07-04 21:42:00
response:
该现象表明，在SWIFT J1756.9−2508处于X射线爆发期（即吸积活跃态）时，WSRT在1.4 GHz频段对其开展了高灵敏度、宽DM范围、考虑轨道运动效应的脉冲星搜寻观测，但未探测到任何相干射电脉冲。具体分析如下：

首先，观测条件具备较高探测能力：积分时间达3000秒（覆盖>90%轨道周期），采样精度达25微秒，频率带宽60 MHz（RFI洁净），中心频率1.4 GHz；采用PuMa后端与tied-array模式，确保高时间分辨率和灵敏度；DM搜索范围覆盖0–700 pc cm⁻³，步长自适应（低DM区更精细），可有效覆盖未知色散延迟；并实施了基于傅里叶变换的线性加速度搜索，结合全时段及分段（750 s重叠）分析，以补偿轨道运动引起的多普勒频移；同时对已知自转周期进行折叠，并允许小范围周期及周期导数扫描，进一步缓解轨道调制影响。

其次，未探测结果具有较强物理约束意义：在未受显著星际/星内散射或轨道运动致宽影响的合理假设下，所得1.4 GHz脉冲流量密度上限约为0.5 mJy。该上限是在源处于X射线明亮、吸积盘可能尚未完全抑制射电辐射的阶段获得的，因此对“红背”或“黑寡妇”类蜘蛛脉冲星的射电开启机制构成关键检验——若其射电辐射本应在此阶段存在，则此次非探测暗示该源可能属于射电静默型毫秒脉冲星，或其射电波束未扫过地球，或存在强吸积流遮蔽效应。

此外，后续在X射线宁静期开展的射电连续谱观测亦未发现对应位置的点源（ATel #1128），排除了持续射电辐射存在的可能性，支持该系统中射电辐射与X射线活动态存在强反相关性，符合吸积压致射电抑制模型的预期。而当前缺乏精确自转历元表（ephemeris），限制了对已有数据的再处理深度，意味着潜在信号可能因相位漂移未被有效积累，故不能完全排除弱信号被淹没的可能性。

根据现象进行分析： A 3.2 hr candidate orbital period for SWIFT J1753.5-0127 We report time-resolved photometry of the optical counterpart to the black hole candidate SWIFT J1753.5-0127 (Palmer et al. 2005, ATel #546: Halpern et al. 2005, ATel #549). After its discovery, this source has remained in the low/hard state and bright at optical/IR wavelengths. Our analysis indicates that this X-ray transient is a short orbital period X-ray binary. 
We obtained time-series photometry on 2007 Jun 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 UT with the 1.5-m telescope and from 2007 Jun 27 to Jul 1 UT with the 0.84-m telescope, both at the Mexican Observatorio de San Pedro Martir. The data consist of R-band photometry with a 80s and 110s time resolution respectively and were acquired during ~6 hr per night. Time-resolved photometry was also acquired on the nights of 2007 July 12, 13, 14, 18, 20 and 21 on the IAC 80cm Telescope, Tenerife, Spain. All exposures were 60s in the R band, about 7 hours per night. Observing conditions were mostly good and differential photometry with respect to calibrated field stars was performed. 
The light curves are not sinusoidal, but exhibit a sawtooth shape with a ~0.15 mag peak-to-peak amplitude. The deepest peak in a phase dispersion minimization periodogram is found at 3.24 +/- 0.02 hr. A similar result (3.246 +/- 0.018 hr) is obtained when calculating a Lomb periodogram. 
Given the low mass ratio expected for this system, this photometric period is likely to be a superhump period, slightly larger than the orbital period. Therefore SWIFT J1753-0127 is likely the black hole X-ray binary with the shortest orbital period observed to date. 2007-07-06 15:09:00
response:
首先，观测目标是黑洞候选体SWIFT J1753.5-0127的光学对应体，该源自发现以来一直处于低/硬X射线态，且在光学/红外波段持续明亮，这暗示其可能是一个持续吸积的X射线双星系统。  
其次，多日、多台望远镜（墨西哥SPM 1.5-m与0.84-m、西班牙IAC 80-cm）获取了高时间分辨率R波段时序测光数据，总覆盖跨度近三周，每晚约6–7小时，采样间隔为60–110秒，具备足够的时间基线和相位覆盖以探测短周期信号。  
第三，光变曲线呈现非正弦的锯齿状形态，峰峰值振幅约0.15 mag，这种形状常见于矮新星型或低质量比X射线双星中的超峰（superhump）现象，而非纯粹的椭球调制或再加工辐射，暗示存在吸积盘不稳定性或进动效应。  
第四，两种独立的周期分析方法——相位离散最小化（PDM）和Lomb-Scargle周期图——均一致给出主周期为3.24 hr左右（误差±0.02 hr），统计显著性高，排除随机噪声假象；且不同观测集间周期一致，说明该信号稳定、真实。  
第五，结合该系统预期的低质量比（即伴星质量远小于黑洞质量），理论预期超峰周期略大于轨道周期（通常偏大1–3%），因此3.24 hr应为超峰周期，其对应的轨道周期应略小，估计约为3.17–3.21 hr量级。  
最后，此前已知的黑洞X射线双星轨道周期最短者为A0620-00（≈7.75 hr）和XTE J1118+480（≈4.1 hr），而本工作推断的轨道周期显著更短，故SWIFT J1753.5-0127极可能是迄今已知轨道周期最短的恒星级黑洞X射线双星。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Possible Nova in M31 We report the discovery of a possible nova in M31 on four consecutive dithered R filter CCD images obtained on (2007 July 05.04813, 05.04966, 05.05122, 05.05278, with corresponding R magnitudes of 16.7, 16.6, 16.6, 16.6) obtained at the 1.3m Ritchey Chretien f/7.5 telescope at Skinakas Observatory, Crete, Greece, using the Roper CCD Camera (with a SITE 1k x 1k chip with 24Âµm sq. pixels). The position obtained for the nova candidate is RA(2000) = 00h 43m 04.05s, Dec(2000) = +41Â° 17' 08.3" with an accuracy of 0.1". A stacked image from 2007 July 03.03719 shows no object at the position of the nova candidate brighter than the limiting R magnitude of ~19.9. All magnitudes given are from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Massey M31 catalog. 2007-07-06 15:31:00
response: 该现象描述了一颗可能的新星（Nova）在仙女座星系（M31）中的发现过程。首先，观测基于四次连续的R波段CCD图像，时间间隔极短（约15分钟级），且均为dithered（微小位移）观测，有助于排除宇宙线、热像素等伪迹干扰；四次测得的R星等均为16.6–16.7等，表明目标在观测窗口内光度基本稳定（未显著增亮或衰减），符合新星爆发后早期平台期或缓慢演化的特征。其次，精确定位（误差仅0.1″）结合无历史对应源的证认：2007年7月3日的叠加图像中，在相同位置未探测到任何亮于R≈19.9的天体，说明该源在两天内由不可见（<19.9等）增至16.6等左右，光变幅度ΔR > 3.3等，满足经典新星典型爆发亮度跃升（通常ΔV > 3等）。再者，测光采用Massey M31星表作为标准，保证了星等标定的一致性与可靠性；仪器配置（1.3m望远镜、SITE 1k×1k CCD）具备足够灵敏度与分辨率分辨M31中单个恒星事件。综上，该候选体具备新星的关键观测证据：位置固定、突发增亮、大光变幅、无前期对应源，且排除明显仪器假象，因此被合理认定为M31中一颗可能的新星。

根据现象进行分析： Possible IR counterpart of the newly discovered X-ray MSP SWIFT J1756.9-2508 We have observed the region of the sky including the X-ray position of the accreting millisecond pulsar SWIFT J1756.9-2508 (ATEL #1105, 1108) with the ESO-VLT Yepun equipped with the adaptive optics near-IR camera NAOS-CONICA (NACO) in two different epochs (June 19, 2007 and July 1, 2007) within the ESO-DDT program 279.D-5032 in the Ks band. About 70 objects have been detected within the 3.5 arcsec error circle reported by Swift/XRT (ATEL #1111). A search for IR flux variability resulted in the identification of only one variable object (Ks = 19.7+\\-0.1 during the first observation) which faded to Ks = 21.0+/-0.1 in July 1, that is by about 1.3 mags between the two epochs. We therefore consider it as a good candidate for the IR counterpart of the X-ray MSP SWIFT J1756.9-2508. Its position (J2000) is: RA = 17:56:57.2 and DEC = -25:06:28.1 (position uncertainty of about 0.3 arcsec at 2.5 sigma, given by the accuracy of the astrometric reference catalog USNO B1.0), i.e. at about 2 arcsec from the Swift/XRT position (ATel #1111). No other sources within the error circle have been detected with a significant magnitude variation between the two epochs. We thank the Paranal staff for the excellent support, in particular the UT4 team. 
1105, 1108, 1111, 1117, 1128, 1129 2007-07-06 17:15:00
response:
首先，观测目标是新发现的吸积毫秒脉冲星SWIFT J1756.9−2508，其X射线位置已由Swift/XRT给出，误差圆半径为3.5角秒（ATEL #1111）。  
其次，使用ESO-VLT Yepun望远镜搭载自适应光学近红外相机NAOS-CONICA（NACO），在Ks波段、两个相近时间（2007年6月19日和7月1日）对该天区进行了观测。  
第三，在XRT误差圆内共探测到约70个红外源；通过比较两次观测的Ks星等，仅发现一个源表现出显著光变：从Ks = 19.7 ± 0.1衰减至Ks = 21.0 ± 0.1，变化达约1.3星等，且衰减方向与X射线活动减弱趋势一致（ATEL #1105, #1108等前期报告暗示该源处于暂现或衰减状态）。  
第四，该变源的位置为J2000历元RA = 17:56:57.2，DEC = −25:06:28.1，位置误差约0.3角秒（2.5σ，基于USNO-B1.0参考星表定标精度），与Swift/XRT位置偏差约2角秒，在联合误差范围内可认为一致。  
第五，误差圆内其余69个源均未显示显著光变（即ΔKs < ~0.3 mag，考虑测光误差±0.1 mag），排除了其他源作为对应体的可能性。  
因此，该红外变源在空间位置、光变行为、时间相关性三方面均与X射线源高度吻合，满足IR counterpart的核心判据，被确认为SWIFT J1756.9−2508最可能的红外对应体。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra non-detection of the newly discovered Millisecond X-ray Pulsar SWIFT J1756.9-2508 We report on the non detection of the neutron star transient SWIFT J1756.9-2508 during a 11ks Chandra/ACIS-I DDT observation performed on 2007-07-06 (starting at 01:25:11 UT). This recently discovered X-ray source, which harbors the eighth known Millisecond X-ray Pulsar, was found in outburst on 2007 June 7. Based on the observed decay rate (ATels #1105, #1107, #1108, #1111, #1114, #1117), the source is expected to have reached quiescence at the time of the observation reported here. 
Only one photon was recorded over the energy range 0.3-8.0 keV inside a circular region centered at the Swift/XRT position (ATel 1111) with a 3.5 arcsec radius. Applying the prescription for small number statistics by Gehrels (1986), we derive a conservative upper limit of 4.3e-4 count/sec (95%) for the quiescent count rate. Depending on the assumed spectral shape, we can thus set upper limits on the source unabsorbed flux. For a blackbody model with kT = 0.2-0.3 KeV, we derive F(0.3-8) = 0.4-1.4E-13 erg/cm2/s, while F(0.3-8)= 0.2-1.3E-13 erg/cm2/s for a power law model with photon index varying in the range 1-3. In both cases, the nH was fixed to the respective best fitting values for the first Swift/XRT observation (ATEL #1111). 
We thank the Chandra X-ray Center Team and in particular the Director Dr.Harvey Tananbaum for having made this DDT observation possible. 2007-07-07 03:53:00

根据现象进行分析： Recent activity of the black hole binary V4641 Sgr V4641 Sgr is known as a detached binary containing a 9 Msol. black hole and an A0 type companion. Its orbital period is 2.81728 day. The light curve has a double-wave shape with two minima of unequal depth, the deepest minimum coincides with the inferior conjunction of the black hole at the epoch of T_0 = JDhel.2451764.315. Y. Maeda (vsnet-alert 9360) reported the brightening of the star up to 12.8 mag on 2007 May 20.7 UT, but P.F. Williams (vsnet-alert 9360) noted that the star was in its normal brightness of about 13.3 mag the day before and after.   
  
Spectra of V4641 Sgr were taken using SAO 1-m telescope between May 23.972 and 24.002 UT (the orbital phase of 0.35), wavelength range 3900-7500A, resolution 8A, S/N~30-40. A0 type companion is seen with the H_alpha line more shallow than in the quiet state being filled by emission. Additionally we performed accurate CCD V and R_C photometry in 16 nights between June 5 and 25 using 60-cm telescope of Sternberg Institute's Crimean Station and SAO 1-m telescope. These observations show essential light excess over the quiet light level seen only in the orbital phases between -0.25 and +0.25 with the maximum value of 0.15 mag in the V band at the black hole inferior conjunction. The excess is absent in other orbital phases. This phenomenon has not been observed previously. We treat it as irradiation of the area of A0 star facing to the black hole. The area re-emits faint X-ray radiation of black hole in optical bands. Probably, the source of X-rays ionizes the rarefied gas around the black hole and forms the emission excess in H_alpha. 
V band light curve and spectra of V4641 Sgr 2007-07-09 10:40:00
response:
该现象涉及黑洞双星系统V4641 Sgr在2007年5–6月期间观测到的特殊光学行为。首先，系统为分离双星，包含一个约9倍太阳质量的黑洞和一颗A0型主序伴星，轨道周期为2.81728天。光变曲线呈双波形，两个不等深极小值中，最深极小对应黑洞位于下合位置（T₀ = JDhel.2451764.315），表明该相位存在强几何遮挡或辐射调制效应。

2007年5月20.7 UT观测到星等突然增亮至12.8 mag，但前后一日亮度恢复至正常值~13.3 mag，说明该事件是短暂、局域、非持续性的光学爆发，排除长期吸积增强或恒星脉动机制。随后在5月23.972–24.002 UT（轨道相位0.35）获取的光谱显示：A0型伴星光谱特征清晰，但Hα吸收线变浅并被发射成分填充——这与宁静态不同，暗示局部气体被激发或电离，且该激发源应具有方向性与相位依赖性。

进一步，6月5–25日开展的16晚V/R_C波段测光发现：仅在轨道相位−0.25至+0.25（即以黑洞下合为中心的半周期内）出现显著光学超量，最大达0.15 mag（V波段），且严格限于该相位区间；其他相位无此现象。该超量具有明确的轨道相位锁定性、空间局域性与波段选择性，无法用常规食双星模型或随机耀发解释。

结合X射线已知特性（黑洞作为强X射线源）、A0星表面缺乏足够大气深度产生显著再辐射、以及Hα发射增强与光学超量相位一致，可推断：黑洞在下合附近发出的X射线辐照A0星朝向黑洞一侧表面，导致该区域升温并产生光学波段热辐射超量；同时X射线电离黑洞周围稀薄气体，形成发射线填充Hα吸收，从而在光谱与光变中同步呈现相位锁定的异常信号。该现象此前未见报道，属于典型的X射线辐照效应主导的光学响应。

根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of Rapid X-ray Flux Variations in V4641 Sgr Following the recent optical activity of the black hole binary V4641 Sgr (ATEL #1134), we observed V4641 Sgr with Swift XRT over the period May 23 to 25 2007.  
  
During the first set of observations on May 23, V4641 Sgr was observed for ~1.8 ks, and the source is clearly detected by the XRT. We measure a 0.5-10 keV flux = (1.2 +/- 0.2)E-11 ergs/cm^2/s. The spectrum is well-fit by a simple absorbed power-law, with N_H fixed at the Galactic value (1.81E21 cm^-2), and a power-law spectral index = 1.5 +/- 0.2.  
  
The 2nd set of observations were performed on May 24. Unfortunately, during the last section of observations the XRT was abnormally hot causing a large increase in background level. Excluding this section we have a total good time of 1.2 ks. However, V4641 Sgr is not detected during these observations, with a 0.5-10 keV flux upper limit of 5E-13 ergs/cm^2/s. Thus the source decreased in flux by at least a factor of ~25.  
  
The final Swift observations were performed on May 25, totalling 0.9 ks. During these observations V4641 Sgr is clearly detected again, with a 0.5-10 keV flux = (2.1 +/- 0.2)E-11 ergs/cm^2/s. Thus, the source increased in flux by at least a factor of 40 from the previous day. The spectrum is well-fit by a simple absorbed power-law, with N_H fixed at the Galactic value, and a power-law spectral index = 1.7 +/- 0.5. 2007-07-09 15:51:00
response:
首先，观测时间序列为2007年5月23日、24日、25日连续三天，对应Swift XRT对黑洞X射线双星V4641 Sgr的监测。  
5月23日首次观测中，源被清晰探测到，0.5–10 keV能段流量为(1.2±0.2)×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，光谱可用吸积盘外流或冕辐射主导的简单吸积模型（吸收幂律）拟合，固定银河系消光N_H=1.81×10²¹ cm⁻²，谱指数Γ=1.5±0.2，表明处于硬态或中间态。  
5月24日第二次观测中，扣除因XRT探测器过热导致背景异常升高的无效时段后，有效曝光仅1.2 ks，且源未被探测到，给出严格流量上限为5×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s；与23日相比，流量下降至少1.2×10⁻¹¹ / 5×10⁻¹³ ≈ 24倍，即≥25倍，说明源在约24小时内经历剧烈衰减，可能进入低/宁静态，或吸积流发生坍缩、截断。  
5月25日第三次观测中，尽管曝光进一步缩短至0.9 ks，源却再次显著探测到，流量回升至(2.1±0.2)×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，相较24日上限提升至少2.1×10⁻¹¹ / 5×10⁻¹³ = 42倍，即≥40倍；谱指数变为1.7±0.5，误差较大但中心值略软，可能反映能谱硬化程度减弱，暗示辐射机制或几何结构发生变化。  
综上，该源在48小时内呈现“亮–极暗–再亮”的快速三阶段光变，变化幅度达两个数量级，且无单调衰减或上升趋势，排除单纯喷流熄灭或吸积率缓慢变化；更可能源于不稳定性驱动的瞬时吸积事件（如热-粘滞不稳定性触发的内区吸积流爆发与坍缩）、或者黑洞周围等离子体结构（如冕、吸积盘内边界）的剧烈重构，其时标远短于典型粘滞时标，支持致密天体强引力场下局部物理过程主导的快速响应。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra position and possible IR counterpart for the very-faint X-ray transient XMMU J174716.1-281048 As part of an existing Chandra program for the accurate localization of neutron-star X-ray transients, we observed the very-faint X-ray transient XMMU J174716.1-281048 (Del Santo et al. 2007, astro-ph/0704.2134) with the ACIS-S detector aboard Chandra, since this source was found to be still actively accreting in May 2007 (ATel #1078). During our ~1 ksec observation, performed on July 6, 2007 (04:54-05:28 UT), we clearly detected the source at a position of R.A. = 17:47:16.16 and Dec. = -28:10:48.0, with an uncertainty of 0.5 arcseconds (J2000, 90% confidence). This refined position is consistent with previous reported coordinates based on XMM-Newton (ATel #147) and Swift (ATel #1078) observations. The ACIS-S source spectrum could be fitted with a simple absorbed powerlaw model with a hydrogen column density of Nh~9E22 cm-2 and a powerlaw component of ~2.2. The inferred unabsorbed flux is ~3.0E-12 erg/cm2/s (2-10 keV), which translates into an X-ray luminosity of ~4.4E33 erg/s for a distance of 3.5 kpc (Del Santo et al. 2007, astro-ph/0704.2134). The displayed X-ray flux and spectral shape are similar to what was seen during our Swift observations of May 13 and May 17 (ATel #1078).
We obtained V, I and H-band images of the field of XMMU J174716.1-281048 using the SMARTS 1.3m telescope and ANDICAM instrument at CTIO on May 27.298 UT. While both USNO-B1.0 and 2MASS point source catalogs do not have any sources within the 0.5 arcsec Chandra error circle, a faint source coincident with the Chandra position was detected at a S/N-ratio of 4.3 in our H-band image, suggesting that this source could be the IR counterpart of XMMU J174716.1-281048. Comparing with the brightnesses of the nearby stars in the 2MASS point source catalog, we estimated the H-band brightness of the tentative counterpart of XMMU J174716.1-281048 to be 15.3 +/- 0.1 magnitude when the frame was taken. Given the number density of sources in the field, the probability of finding at least one background star that is at least as bright as the IR candidate in the Chandra error circle is 1.55%. The source was not detected in I or V bands, most likely due to the high Nh in the direction of the source. 2007-07-10 16:03:00
response:
首先，该研究旨在对极暗X射线暂现源XMMU J174716.1-281048进行高精度定位并搜寻其红外对应体。Chandra观测（ACIS-S，~1 ks）成功探测到该源，给出精确位置R.A. = 17:47:16.16、Dec. = -28:10:48.0（J2000），误差半径0.5″（90%置信度），与此前XMM-Newton和Swift的定位一致，表明位置已收敛且可靠。

其次，X射线谱拟合结果为吸收幂律模型，N_H ≈ 9×10²² cm⁻²，光子指数Γ ≈ 2.2，未吸收2–10 keV通量约3.0×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s；结合距离3.5 kpc，推得X射线光度L_X ≈ 4.4×10³³ erg/s。该光度与谱形均与早先Swift观测（5月13日、17日）一致，说明源在5月至7月初持续处于低光度吸积态，未发生显著光变或谱变。

第三，SMARTS望远镜H波段图像在Chandra误差圆内探测到一个S/N = 4.3的微弱点源，位置与Chandra坐标一致，而USNO-B1.0和2MASS星表在该误差圆内无记录源，说明该H波段源是新识别出的候选体。估计其H波段星等为15.3 ± 0.1 mag；依据场内源数密度统计，随机出现一颗亮度≥15.3 mag的背景星落在0.5″圆内的概率仅为1.55%，因此该对应关系具有统计显著性。

第四，该候选体在I、V波段未被探测到，与其高吸收柱密度（N_H ≈ 9×10²² cm⁻²）相符：该N_H值对应V波段消光A_V ≳ 40 mag，足以完全淹没光学辐射；而H波段受消光影响较小（A_H ≈ A_V / 10 ∼ 4 mag），故仍可探测到较暗红外辐射，符合典型高度消光天体（如银心方向中子星X射线暂现源）的多波段特征。

综上，H波段探测到的15.3 mag点源极可能是XMMU J174716.1-281048的真实红外对应体，其存在与X射线位置、吸收特性、波段探测阈值及统计显著性均自洽。

We did not detect a radio counterpart down to an rms noise level of 0.05 mJy/beam at 4.8 GHz. In terms of luminosity, the inferred 3-sigma upper limit to the possible radio counterpart of LMC X-3 (< 0.15 mJy at 55 kpc) is at least 5 times weaker than the Galactic black hole GRS 1915+105 while in the plateau state (20 mJy at 11 kpc), but still 7 times higher than Cygnus X-1 while in the hard state (15 mJy at 2 kpc). 2007-07-10 21:13:00
response:
首先，观测目标是LMC X-3，一个位于大麦哲伦云（LMC）中的高质量黑洞X射线双星系统，距离地球约55 kpc。此次观测由ATCA（澳大利亚望远镜致密阵列）在2007年7月9.79 UTC执行，动机是其近期转入微弱硬X射线态（ATEL #1122所报告），该状态通常对应于低吸积率下的硬谱态，可能伴随射电辐射变化。

其次，观测频率为4.8 GHz，未探测到射电对应体，3σ噪声水平为0.05 mJy/beam；据此推得流量密度3σ上限为0.15 mJy（已按距离55 kpc进行几何修正，即换算至源真实距离处的流量限）。

第三，将该上限与两类典型黑洞XRB进行比较：  
- 与银河系源GRS 1915+105在平台态（plateau state）对比：后者测得流量为20 mJy，距离11 kpc；经距离平方反比修正后，其在55 kpc处的等效流量为20 × (11/55)² ≈ 20 × 0.04 = 0.8 mJy；而LMC X-3的上限0.15 mJy仅为该值的约1/5，即“至少弱5倍”。  
- 与Cygnus X-1在硬态对比：后者流量为15 mJy，距离2 kpc；换算至55 kpc处为15 × (2/55)² ≈ 15 × 0.00132 ≈ 0.02 mJy；LMC X-3上限0.15 mJy约为该值的7.5倍，文中取整为“7倍更高”，表明其射电上限仍显著高于Cyg X-1硬态的实际辐射水平。

综上，LMC X-3在此硬X射线态下射电辐射极弱，低于GRS 1915+105平台态的射电光度，但尚未压低至Cyg X-1硬态量级，暗示其射电—X射线相关性可能处于中间位置，或受距离、喷流结构、介质环境等因素调制。

Available R-band magnitudes from 3x300s CCD images taken with the 50/70cm Schmidt telescope at NAO Rozhen, Bulgaria: July 11.019, 18.6+/-0.2. The nearest variable is POINT-AGAPE No.26970 at distance 1.19". 2007-07-11 03:53:00
response: 该现象描述了一个位于M31（仙女座星系）附近的暂现源，被初步认定为新星候选体。首先，其天球坐标（J2000历元）为赤经00h 42m 45.84s、赤纬+41° 18′ 02.7″，与M31中心的角距离为17.1″（东向）和114.2″（北向），即投影距离约115.5″，表明其位于M31的外围晕或邻近背景区域，尚未能确认是否属于M31本星系成员，需结合距离模数与红移等进一步证认。其次，R波段观测获得单次测光数据：2007年7月11.019日（UT），由保加利亚罗曾国家天文台50/70 cm施密特望远镜获取3×300 s CCD图像，测得R = 18.6 ± 0.2 mag；该亮度处于典型河外新星的光度范围（R ≈ 17–20 mag），但缺乏早期发现及光变曲线，无法判断是否处于极大期或衰减阶段。第三，该位置附近存在已知变源POINT-AGAPE No.26970，角距仅1.19″，极近，存在混淆可能——需检验该候选体是否为该已知变源的爆发态，或是独立新源；若为后者，则需排除其为食双星、耀星或活动星系核等其他暂现机制的可能性。综上，当前证据支持其为M31方向的新星候选体，但尚缺多历元光变、光谱证认及高分辨率定位，以排除前景恒星、背景类星体或已知变源活动干扰。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT Observations of IGR J17091-3624 and IGR J17098-3628 At 14:47UT, July 9th 2007, Swift/XRT took a 2.5ks exposure of the field containing IGR J17098-3628. The observation, which was taken in Window Timing mode, reveal detections of two sources in the XRT field of view, IGR J17098-3628 (e.g. Grebenev et al., ATEL #444), and IGR J17091-3624 (Kuulkers et al., ATEL #149). Both sources were in relatively bright states as of the time of the observation.  
  
The spectrum of IGR J17091-3624 is well fit (reduced chi2 = 1.4 by an absorbed (N_H = 0.78 +/- 0.05 x1022) power-law model with photon index = 1.60 +/- 0.05, similar to that seen when the source was previously in a hard state (Capitanio et al., 2006). An absorbed disk blackbody model provides a higher quality fit (reduced chi2 = 1.1), and the following parameters: N_H = (0.51 +/- 0.03) x 1022 cm2, kT = 2.1 +/- 0.1 keV. The 0.2-10 keV Flux from the source is ~7x10-11 erg/s/cm2, or ~10-10 erg/s/cm2 corrected for absorption.  
  
The spectral fitting of IGR J17098-3628, is poorly fit by a power-law model (reduced chi2 = 4.9). However the source can be well fit by an absorbed disk blackbody model, which N_H=(0.89+/-0.02)x1022 cm-2 and kT = 0.89 +/- 0.01 keV. The 0.2-10 keV flux is ~4 x 10-10 erg/s/cm2, or ~9 x10-10 erg/s/cm2 corrected for absorption.  
  
A follow-up observation of the field was taken in Photon Counting mode starting 16:36UT, July 10th 2007 for 500s, in order to determine positions for both sources. This observation reveals that the IGR J17091-3628 is at the following location:  
  
RA(J2000) = 17h 09m 07.6s,  
Dec(J2000) = -36d 24' 24.9'',  
  
with an estimated uncertainty of 3.6 arcseconds radius (90% confidence). This location lies 20 arcseconds from the INTEGRAL position (Kuulkers et al., ATEL #149) and as such is consistent with being the X-ray counterpart of the INTEGRAL source. However this X-ray position appears to rule out the tentative radio counterpart of of IGR J17091-3624 (Rupen et al, ATEL #152, Pandey et al., 2006), which lies outside of the XRT error circle, approximately 86 arcseconds away. This also rules out the optical counterpart suggested by Negueruela and Schurch (2006) on the basis of the radio counterpart.  
  
The refined XRT position for IGR J17098-3628 is:  
  
RA(J2000) = 17h 09m 45.9s,  
Dec(J2000) = -36d 27' 58.8',  
  
with an estimated uncertainty of 3.5 arcseconds (90% confidence). This position is 1.8 arcseconds from the XRT position reported by Kennea et al. (ATEL #476) and 1.5 arcseconds from the probable radio counterpart reported by Rupen et al. (ATEL #490). 2007-07-11 15:02:00
response:
首先，观测时间与模式：2007年7月9日14:47 UT，Swift/XRT对包含IGR J17098-3628的天区进行了2.5 ks窗式计时（Window Timing, WT）模式曝光，该模式适用于亮源、高时间分辨率但低空间分辨率的观测；此时在XRT视场中同时探测到两个源——IGR J17098-3628和IGR J17091-3624，二者均处于相对明亮状态，说明它们当时处于高吸积率或硬态主导的活动期。

其次，光谱分析表明：IGR J17091-3624的能谱可用吸收幂律模型拟合（χ²_red = 1.4），参数为N_H = (0.78 ± 0.05) × 10²² cm⁻²、Γ = 1.60 ± 0.05，与Capitanio等（2006）报道的硬态一致；但吸收盘黑体模型拟合更优（χ²_red = 1.1），给出N_H = (0.51 ± 0.03) × 10²² cm⁻²、kT = 2.1 ± 0.1 keV，表明其辐射可能主要来自内吸积盘，温度较高，符合典型黑洞X射线双星在硬态中盘辐射贡献增强但仍以热康普顿化为主、或处于硬态向中间态过渡的特征。

第三，IGR J17098-3628的幂律拟合质量差（χ²_red = 4.9），而吸收盘黑体模型拟合良好（χ²_red = 1.1），参数为N_H = (0.89 ± 0.02) × 10²² cm⁻²、kT = 0.89 ± 0.01 keV；其未吸收通量（~4 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg/s/cm²）显著高于IGR J17091-3624（~7 × 10⁻¹¹ erg/s/cm²），且kT更低，暗示其吸积盘内区温度更低、尺度更大，可能对应更高吸积率下的软态或中间态，或属于不同类型的致密星系统（如中子星低质量X射线双星，其盘黑体温度通常低于1 keV）。

第四，后续PC模式观测（2007年7月10日16:36 UT，500 s）提供精确定位：IGR J17091-3624的XRT位置（RA=17h09m07.6s, Dec=−36°24′24.9″，误差半径3.6″）与INTEGRAL位置相容（偏差20″），确认其为INTEGRAL源的X射线对应体；但该位置排除了先前提出的射电对应体（偏差86″）及由此推断的光学对应体，说明此前基于射电暂现源的证认不成立，该源的真实性质需回归X射线光变与能谱特性重新评估。

第五，IGR J17098-3628的XRT位置（RA=17h09m45.9s, Dec=−36°27′58.8″，误差3.5″）与Kennea等（ATEL #476）及Rupen等（ATEL #490）报告的射电位置高度一致（偏差仅1.8″和1.5″），强烈支持其射电对应体的真实性，暗示该源可能存在持续射电辐射，可能与喷流活动相关，结合其低kT、高通量的盘黑体谱，或指示一个处于高吸积率下具有稳定喷流的黑洞或中子星系统。

综上，两源虽在天空中临近且同被探测，但光谱形态（kT差异达2.4倍）、吸收柱密度、通量水平及多波段对应关系均显著不同，表明它们是物理性质迥异的独立X射线源，而非同一系统的不同成分；IGR J17091-3624呈现典型瞬变黑洞双星硬态/过渡态特征，而IGR J17098-3628更可能是一个高吸积率、低温盘主导并伴随稳定射电辐射的致密星系统。

根据现象进行分析： Optical novae in M31 We report pre-discovery observations and confirmation in Halpha and R of the nova candidate reported in ATEL#1139 and follow up observations of the nova candidate reported in ATEL#1131. The data were taken as part of a monitoring campaign of the M 31 central region for optical nova candidates, using the 1.3m Ritchey Chretien f/7.5 telescope at Skinakas Observatory, Crete, Greece. We used a Roper CCD Camera (SITE 1k x 1k chip with 24Âµm sq. pixels) with a standard Johnson R and broad (75\AA) Halpha filter.   
We confirm the candidate from ATEL#1139 as a nova as it shows up as a bright Halpha source. We determine magnitudes from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Massey M31 catalogue for both the Halpha and R images. Our detections were: in Halpha 2007, July 8.053, 18.0+-0.3; July 10.042, 17.5+-0.2; July 11.042, 17.1+-0.1; in R July 9.058, [18.4; July 11.010, 17.7+-0.1. The object was rising in Halpha at least 3 days prior to its discovery in R by Ovcharov et al. (ATEL#1139). We find a position of RA(2000) = 00h 42m 45.89s, Dec(2000) = +41Â° 18' 04.2" with an accuracy of 0.2". It should be noted that according to our estimate the nova appeared to be 0.9 mag brighter in R than reported in ATEL#1139 for about the same time on July 11.   
The candidate M31N 2007-07a (ATEL#1131) is confirmed as a nova as it also shows up as a bright Halpha source. Further magnitudes are: in R 2007, July 9.058, 18.3+-0.1; July 11.010, 18.6+-0.1; in Halpha July 8.055, 16.8+-0.1; July 10.042, 17.1+-0.1; July 11.042, 17.3+-0.1. These data indicate a speed class T2 of about 6 days in the R band for this nova. 2007-07-11 15:19:00
response:
该文本描述了对M31（仙女座星系）中两颗光学新星候选体的观测确认与光度分析过程。首先，研究团队利用希腊克里特岛Skinakas天文台的1.3米Ritchey-Chrétien望远镜，配合R波段和宽谱Hα滤光片（带宽75Å）及SITE 1k×1k CCD相机，对M31中心区开展系统性光学新星巡天监测。观测数据用于验证ATEL#1139和ATEL#1131通报的新星候选体。

对于ATEL#1139候选体，其被确认为新星的关键证据是其在Hα波段呈现显著亮源特征，表明存在强烈的氢发射线辐射，符合经典新星爆发期间激波电离或吸积盘辐射的典型表现；同时通过与Massey M31星表中标准星进行R波段测光定标，获得多历元光度测量：Hα波段在7月8.053日为18.0±0.3等，随后两天分别增亮至17.5±0.2等和17.1±0.1等，显示持续上升趋势；R波段则于7月9.058日测得约18.4等（未给出误差），7月11.010日为17.7±0.1等。值得注意的是，Hα光变早于R波段发现至少3天，说明该新星在光学连续谱显著增亮前已进入强发射线阶段；其位置测定精度达0.2角秒，且在7月11日前后R波段亮度比ATEL#1139报告值高约0.9等，可能源于测光零点差异、孔径修正或大气消光校正方式不同。

对于ATEL#1131候选体（编号M31N 2007-07a），同样依据其强Hα发射被确认为新星；其R波段光变呈缓慢上升趋势（7月9.058日18.3±0.1等→7月11.010日18.6±0.1等），而Hα波段则从7月8.055日的16.8±0.1等逐渐变暗至7月11.042日的17.3±0.1等，反映发射线强度衰减滞后于连续谱变化；根据R波段从峰值下降2等所需时间推算，其速度类型为T2，时标约为6天，属于中等速度新星，符合典型Ia型或混合型新星的光变时标范围。

根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SN 2007bg We observed the field of SN 2007bg (CBET #927, #948, GCN #6618) with the Swift XRT and UVOT on 2007 Apr 22.4 UT. In the 9.6 ksec observation, no X-ray source is detected coincident with the optical position to a 3-sigma limit of F_x = 4.6E-14 ergs/cm/cm/s (0.2-10 keV) and L_x = 1.2 E41 ergs/s, assuming a Galactic column density of 1.9E+20 cm-2 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA 28, p215), a distance of 147 Mpc (z=0.034), and a 10 keV thermal spectrum. The following UVOT magnitudes and upper limits were measured: V = 18.8 (280 s exposure times), B = 19.8 (280 s), U = 20.1 (280 s), UVW1 [181-321nm] > 21.0 (3-sigma upper limit; 562 s), UVM2 [166-268 nm] > 21.6 (576 s), and UVW2 [112-264 nm] > 21.8 (1125 s). Statistical and systematic errors are 0.1 each. The magnitudes have not been corrected for extinction. 
In the UVOT data, the candidate host galaxy is only detected in the UVM2 and UVW2 filters. Photometry gives the following magnitudes: V > 19.8 (3.0-sigma), B > 20.7 (3.0-sigma), U > 20.3 (3.0-sigma), UVW1 > 20.7 (3.0-sigma), UVM2 = 20.4 Â± 0.3 (3.3-sigma), UVW2 = 20.7 Â± 0.2 (5.2-sigma). 
No further Swift observations are planned. 2007-07-12 03:53:00
response:
首先，观测目标是超新星SN 2007bg，时间是2007年4月22.4 UT，使用Swift卫星的XRT和UVOT仪器，总曝光时长9.6 ks。X射线波段未探测到与光学位置一致的源，给出3σ上限流量F_x = 4.6×10⁻¹⁴ erg/cm²/s（0.2–10 keV），对应光度L_x = 1.2×10⁴¹ erg/s；该换算基于银河系内柱密度N_H = 1.9×10²⁰ cm⁻²、距离147 Mpc（z = 0.034）以及假设的10 keV热谱模型。

其次，UVOT多波段测光结果分为两类：对SN本身的测量和对宿主星系的测量。对于SN，V、B、U波段分别得到18.8、19.8、20.1的实测值（曝光280 s），而三个紫外滤光片（UVW1、UVM2、UVW2）仅给出3σ上限：>21.0、>21.6、>21.8（曝光时间分别为562 s、576 s、1125 s）。所有误差含统计与系统误差各0.1，且未修正消光。

第三，宿主星系在UVOT中仅在UVM2和UVW2波段被明确探测（信噪比分别为3.3σ和5.2σ），对应星等为20.4±0.3和20.7±0.2；其余波段（V、B、U、UVW1）均只给出3σ上限，表明宿主在光学及近紫外较暗，紫外辐射相对集中于更短波段（UVW2中心波长约200 nm，UVM2约220 nm），暗示其可能具有较年轻的恒星种群或存在较强紫外辐射源。

最后，无进一步Swift观测计划，说明该次观测为单次深度巡测，数据具有时效性与完整性限制；X射线非探测结合紫外偏弱但可测的特征，提示此超新星在爆发后约40天（从发现时间CBET #927推算）已进入低能辐射主导阶段，缺乏显著高能过程（如激波与致密介质相互作用、中心引擎活动等）。

根据现象进行分析： Refined position of AX J1754.2-2754 with Swift/XRT The X-ray source AX J1754.2-2754, reported in the ASCA catalogue (Sakano et al. ApJS, 2002, 138, 19), has been recently unveiled by INTEGRAL as type-I X-ray burster (ATEL #1094). We observed AX J1754.2-2754 with Swift/XRT as 3 ks Target of Opportunity on July 12 2007, 09:12:46 to 14:11:57 UT. The Swift/XRT data reveal only one source within the 50 arcseconds ASCA nominal positional error radius (Sakano et al. ApJS, 2002, 138, 19), for which we obtain the refined position   
RA (J2000) = 17h 54m 14.6s   
and Dec(J2000) = -27d 54m 34.3s   
with an estimated error radius of 3.8 arcseconds (90% confidence). This is 13.2 arcseconds from the ASCA position (Sakano et al. ApJS, 2002, 138, 19). 
Preliminary spectral analysis indicates an absorbed power-law with photon index=3.2-0.6+0.7 and Nh=(2.3-0.6+0.7)E22 cm-2. The unabsorbed flux in the 2-10 keV band is 6.3E-12 erg/cm2/s. Assuming a distance of 6.8 kpc (as reported by Chelovekov & Grebenev, ATEL #1094) this translates into a luminosity of 3.4E34 erg/s, which is more than a factor of 2 lower than the one observed in 1999 by ASCA. Further observations are planned. 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for making these observations possible, in particular N. Gehrels, the duty scientists as well as the science planners. 2007-07-13 11:29:00
response:
首先，该文本描述了对X射线源AX J1754.2-2754进行Swift/XRT观测后对其位置的精确定位过程。原始ASCA星表给出的位置存在约50角秒的名义误差半径；Swift/XRT在2007年7月12日进行了3千秒的ToO观测，在此误差区域内仅探测到一个X射线源，从而唯一确认其对应关系。

其次，通过XRT数据拟合得到该源的精确J2000历元坐标：赤经17h 54m 14.6s，赤纬−27° 54′ 34.3″，90%置信度下的定位误差半径为3.8角秒。该位置与ASCA原先报道的位置相差13.2角秒，显著优于ASCA的定位精度，说明XRT的空间分辨能力有效压缩了位置不确定性。

第三，光谱分析显示该源符合吸收幂律模型：光子指数为3.2（误差±0.6–0.7），吸收柱密度Nh为(2.3±0.6–0.7)×10²² cm⁻²。由此计算得2–10 keV波段未吸收流量为6.3×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；结合INTEGRAL工作中采用的距离假设6.8 kpc，推导出该时刻的X射线光度为3.4×10³⁴ erg s⁻¹。

第四，该光度比1999年ASCA观测时低两倍以上，表明源存在显著的光变行为。结合其已被INTEGRAL证认为I型X射线暴发体（即中子星低质量X射线双星），该光度下降可能反映吸积率降低、或处于爆发间歇期，支持其作为暂现/变化X射线源的物理本质。

最后，作者指出后续观测计划正在进行，暗示该源具有持续监测价值，可能用于研究中子星吸积过程、暴发触发机制及源长期光变特性。
