response: 该观测报告描述了钱德拉X射线天文台对NGC 2770星系中两颗Ibc型超新星SN 2008D与SN 2007uy的X射线探测结果。首先，SN 2008D在0.5–8 keV波段被明确探测到10个光子，其位置与射电、光学及紫外波段定位高度一致，证实其为真实致密源而非背景涨落；其X射线光度（2×10³⁹ erg/s，距爆发约10天）显著低于典型伽马暴余辉（低至少两个数量级），但落在光学选Ibc型超新星X射线光度分布范围内，表明其X射线辐射机制更可能源于激波与致密星周介质相互作用，而非相对论性喷流主导的GRB类过程。其次，光谱拟合显示吸收柱密度nH ~10²² cm⁻²，显著高于银河系视线方向值，说明宿主星系贡献了主要吸收，且热韧致辐射（TB）与幂律（PL）模型均能勉强拟合数据，但参数不确定性大（如kT误差下限达0.5 keV、上限达2.4 keV），反映光子统计严重受限；固定nH=6×10²¹ cm⁻²后，PL指数收敛至2.4，更接近激波加速电子谱的理论预期，支持非热起源。第三，K-S检验显示光子到达时间分布拒绝恒定计数率假设（p=3.1%），暗示存在弱时变性，可能对应激波穿过密度不均匀介质或冷却演化阶段；但该结论受限于总曝光仅17.9 ks，无法分辨短时标变化。第四，其余X射线源（X1–X6）多数具有更高计数率与光度，其中X1最亮（166计数，Lₓ≈10⁴⁰ erg/s），可能为低质量X射线双星或活动星系核，其存在导致Swift/XRT光变曲线受污染，凸显高空间分辨观测对分离点源的必要性。最后，SN 2007uy仅探测到5个光子，信噪比极低，其光谱参数（如nH≈2×10²⁰ cm⁻²）因统计限制而不可靠，但位置一致性仍支持其为真实对应体；所有其他源均未显示显著时变，进一步反衬SN 2008D的X射线活动具有特殊性——它可能是首例被清晰捕捉到早期激波突破信号的Ibc型超新星，其X射线辐射代表核心坍缩后激波抵达恒星表面并开始与星周物质相互作用的直接证据。

根据现象进行分析： XMMSL1 J152835.4+593754 - a chromospherically active star We report optical spectroscopy of LSPM J1528+5937, the proposed optical counterpart to the recently discovered X-ray transient XMMSL1 J152835.4+593754 (Saxton et al. 2008, ATel #1361). 
A 900s spectrum was acquired starting on 2008 Jan 20 05:43 UT using the 4.2m William Herschel Telescope on La Palma equipped with the dual-beam ISIS spectrograph. The observations were performed using the R300B and EEV12 CCD in the blue arm and the R158R grating and EEV4482 CCD in the red arm. A 1.5" slit width yielded a spectral resolution of 11 Angstrom and 19 Angstrom FWHM in the blue and red, respectively. The extracted spectra covered the wavelength ranges 3230 \- 5310 Angstrom and 5120-10500 Angstrom. 
The optical spectrum closely resembles a late-type stellar spectrum with TiO bands being the dominant absorption features. The strength of these diatomic molecular bands are consistent with those expected in a dwarf with spectral type in the range M5 +/ 1. Narrow emission lines are also detected. Additional constraints are provided by the broadband colors of the counterpart after correcting for the reddening. Using the 2MASS magnitudes and the estimated apparent optical magnitude (Lepine & Shara,2005,AJ,129.1483) we derive (V-K,J-H,H-K)o=(5.41,0.57,0.27) based on a E(B-V)=0.016 mag (Schlegel et al.,1998,ApJ,500,525). The uncertainty in the infrared colors is 0.03 mag. The above colors support a M4V-M5V dwarf (see e.g. Bessel & Brett,1988,PASP,100,1134). For comparison, M4 and M5 dwarfs have colors (5.26 0.60,0.28) and (6.12,0.62,0.32), respectively. We can then infer a distance of ~90 pc to XMMSL1 J152835.4+593754 by using Mv=12.3 (appropriate for a M5 V star), V=17.11 and Av=0.054. 
The Balmer lines (up to Hdelta) and CaII K & H are clearly detected in pure emission. These lines are single-peaked and dominated by the instrumental profile. Their equivalent widths (in Angstroms) are: 4.6 (Halpha), 7.5 (Hbeta), 8.1 (Hdelta), 12 (CaII/Hepsilon), 21 (Ca II K). Uncertainties are ~10%, except for CaII K and CaII/Hepsilon which carry larger uncertainties due to the difficulty in choosing the underlying continuum.
The optical spectrum is indicative of a chromospherically active M dwarf, which is further supported by the broadband colors of the counterpart. X-ray flares are common in such dMe stars and the observed X-ray activity of XMMSL1 J152835.4+593754 is most likely due to such an event. 2008-01-25 15:02:00
response:
首先，观测目标XMMSL1 J152835.4+593754被证认为LSPM J1528+5937，即其光学对应体是一颗晚型M矮星。光谱显示强TiO分子吸收带，这是M型矮星的典型特征；结合TiO带强度与已知光谱模板对比，初步判定光谱型为M5±1，即M4V–M5V范围。  

其次，红外颜色（V−K）₀=5.41、（J−H）₀=0.57、（H−K）₀=0.27经消光修正后，与Bessel & Brett（1988）给出的M4V（5.26, 0.60, 0.28）和M5V（6.12, 0.62, 0.32）标准色一致，进一步支持M4–M5V的分类。该颜色范围排除了更早型（如K型）或更晚型（如M6+）以及巨星的可能性。  

第三，距离估算基于绝对目视星等Mᵥ=12.3（M5V标准值）、观测视星等V=17.11及消光Aᵥ=0.054，由距离模数公式推得距离约90 pc，表明该源位于太阳邻域内，符合典型场星M矮星的空间分布。  

第四，光谱中Hα、Hβ、Hδ、Ca II K及Hε均呈现显著发射，且为单峰、轮廓受仪器展宽主导，说明发射来自恒星色球层而非吸积盘或双星相互作用。等效宽度依次为4.6 Å、7.5 Å、8.1 Å、12 Å、21 Å，其中Ca II K最强，符合强色球活动M矮星（dMe型）的典型发射特征。  

最后，X射线暂现事件与光学波段强色球发射严格时空关联，而dMe星以频繁、剧烈的色球耀斑著称，其紫外/光学/软X射线辐射具有共变性。因此，该X射线暂现最可能源于该M矮星的一次大尺度磁重联耀斑，而非致密天体吸积、超新星爆发或潮汐撕裂事件等需更高能量或不同光谱标识的过程。

The average count rate was 0.15ÃÂ±0.01 cps over the 5.24 ks observation. The spectrum peaks at 0.5 keV and can be fitted with an absorbed blackbody with parameters T=5x105 K and NH=8x1021 cm-2. However, there is a suggestion of emission lines of NVI and NVII at 0.45 and 0.50 keV, respectively, which indicates a more complicated spectrum. The only previous Swift/XRT observation was three days after discovery (ATel 1011), and we obtain an upper limit of 0.001 cps. We also inspected the Swift UV filter images of the V1281 Sco field obtained with the UVOT instrument. V1281 Sco was not detected in either the UVM2 (231nm) or the UVW1 (291nm) filters, consistent with the large extinction previously reported (IAUC 8846 ). There was a detection in the shorter wavelength UVW2 band (212nm) at 19.110ÃÂ±0.059 magnitude. This corresponds to a flux of (1.22ÃÂ±0.07)10-16 erg s-1cm-2 Ãâ¦-1 which may be due to strong C III] (191nm) emission. 2008-01-25 16:32:00
response: 该现象描述了一颗新星V1281 Sco在爆发约一年后进入热白矮星阶段（SSS，超软X射线源）的观测特征。首先，XRT探测到显著的软X射线辐射，峰值能量0.5 keV，光谱整体符合吸收黑体模型（T=5×10⁵ K，N_H=8×10²¹ cm⁻²），表明其光度源为高温、低光度、高重力表面的吸积白矮星，此时氢壳层稳定燃烧，产生持续的软X射线辐射。其次，0.45 keV与0.50 keV处存在NVII和NVII发射线迹象，说明X射线辐射区存在富氮外流或光致电离等非热平衡过程，光谱并非纯黑体，暗示白矮星风与喷流或壳层物质相互作用。再次，XRT流量从发现初期（ATel 1011）的<0.001 cps上升至0.15 cps，增幅达150倍以上，证实其已由激波主导的早期硬X射线暂现态演化为稳态核燃烧主导的SSS相。最后，UVOT未在UVM2（231 nm）和UVW1（291 nm）波段探测到源，但在更短波长UVW2（212 nm）有明确探测，对应C III] 190.9 nm强发射线，该发射线通常产自光致电离气体，进一步支持此时系统处于高电离、低柱密度但高消光环境下的热核燃烧阶段；而缺乏长波段紫外探测与IAUC 8846报道的大消光（A_V较高）一致，说明光学/近紫外连续谱被严重遮蔽，但共振发射线仍可穿透。综上，V1281 Sco于2008年1月已进入典型SSS相，其X射线与紫外联合光谱揭示了高温白矮星表面稳定燃烧、氮增丰外流及C III]发射区共存的物理图像。

response: 该现象描述了一次X射线暂现源2S 1553-54的多波段观测结果。首先，该源是已知的暂现吸积脉冲星，于2007年12月31日由Swift/BAT在爆发中首次发现，表明其处于活动吸积态；至2008年1月24日XRT观测时，BAT仍探测到约35 mCrab的流量，证实爆发尚未结束，系统仍处于高吸积率状态。XRT精确定位获得RA(J2000) = 15h57m47.75s、Dec(J2000) = −54°24′52.4″，误差半径3.5″（90%置信度），该误差圆完全落入1975年SAS-3卫星给出的35″历史定位孔径内，说明两次探测指向同一物理源，支持其为同一系统的再爆发。XRT源呈明亮且边缘堆积（marginally piled-up），反映其中心致密天体（中子星）具有强X射线光度和可能的高柱密度吸积流。UVOT在全部六个滤光片中均未探测到光学对应体，各波段3σ极限星等介于v=18.4至uvw2=19.8之间，结合曝光时间较短（最长达460 s），表明光学辐射极弱或存在显著消光；该缺失与典型低质量X射线双星在爆发期间的光学增亮行为不符，暗示伴星可能为较暗的晚型矮星、系统轨道倾角较高导致吸积盘遮挡，或星际消光严重（尤其银纬较低时）。此次爆发是自1975年SAS-3首次发现以来的首次再活动，间隔达33年，表明该系统具有极长的爆发周期，可能源于极低的平均吸积率或伴星演化导致的物质供给长期中断。综合判断，2S 1553-54是一个轨道周期较长、吸积率极不稳定的中子星X射线双星系统，其罕见爆发为研究吸积不稳定性阈值和中子星磁场与吸积流相互作用提供了关键样本。

根据现象进行分析： Detection of hard X-rays from V455 And We report the detection of hard X-ray emission from the dwarf nova V455 And shortly after its outburst on 2007 Sep 4 (CBET #1053). The emission was detected in an analysis of survey mode data from the Swift/BAT instrument. The 14-25 keV flux reached a peak on 2007 Sep 14.5 of 1.4e-10 ergs cm^2 s^-1 (7 sigma), corresponding to ~1e32 ergs s^-1 in this band at a distance of (90Â±15) pc (Araujo-Betancor et al. 2005, A&A, 430, 629). No data are available before 2007 Sept. 7.6, 2.8 day after the discovery. The flux declined, becoming undetectable by 2007 Sept. 24. 
In XRT TOO observations made on 2007 Sep 17 the soft X-ray flux was strong (0.77 c/s) and highly variable, with a heavily cut-off spectrum. The level is consistent with the BAT 14-25 keV detection assuming a power law index of ~1.5 or a high bremsstrahlung temperature of (>50 keV), but either of these spectra would predict more flux above 25 keV than observed. Archival XRT observations show a very weak variable source at this position (0.002 to 0.005c/s) in observations between 2006 Feb 8 and 2006 May 28. In follow up observations made on 2007 Dec 27 and 28 the corresponding rate was (0.015Â±0.003) c/s and (0.022Â±0.003) c/s respectively. 
A light curve is available here 2008-01-29 14:01:00
response:
该现象描述了矮新星V455 And在2007年9月爆发后硬X射线辐射的探测结果，需从多角度进行物理分析：  
首先，硬X射线（14–25 keV）辐射在爆发后约10.5天（9月14.5日）达到峰值，通量为1.4×10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（7σ显著性），对应光度~10³² erg s⁻¹（距离取90±15 pc）。该时间滞后表明硬X射线并非爆发初始激波或热核反应直接产物，而更可能源于吸积流演化后期形成的高温冕区或边界层中的非热/热轫致辐射过程。  

其次，硬X射线峰值出现于光学/紫外爆发峰（9月4日）之后，且软X射线（XRT，0.3–10 keV）在9月17日仍较强（0.77 c/s）但谱形严重截断，说明存在高光深吸收或高温热成分（如kT > 50 keV的热轫致辐射）；然而，无论采用幂律指数Γ≈1.5还是高温度热模型，均会过度预言25 keV以上流量，与BAT未探测到更高能辐射的事实矛盾——暗示辐射机制受限于电子能量上限或存在强康普顿冷却效应，导致能谱在25 keV附近快速截断。  

第三，爆发前存档XRT数据显示源极弱（0.002–0.005 c/s），属宁静态水平；而2007年12月底（爆发后约4个月）软X射线流量回升至0.015–0.022 c/s，约为宁静态的3–10倍，表明吸积率尚未完全回落至基线，残余吸积活动仍在维持一定冕辐射，但已远低于爆发期水平。  

最后，硬X射线仅持续约10天（9月7.6日至24日），与软X射线强变异性共存，支持其起源于吸积盘内区动态结构（如不稳定边界层、盘冕耦合区或磁重联事件），而非稳态吸积盘外区或喷流。短时标衰减反映高温等离子体冷却或吸积率骤降导致热电子数密度快速下降。

根据现象进行分析： RXTE observation of 2S 1553-542 at the time of recent flare RXTE PCA has observed the transient X-ray pulsar 2S 1553-542, almost every day, from 6th January 2008, after Swift/BAT detected an increased activity from it (ATEL #1345, ATEL #1371). The fitted flux between 2 and 10 keV is varying between 9.6276e-10 ergs/cm^2/s and 2.2155e-09 ergs/cm^2/s excepting on 9th Jan 2008 (Observation Id 93426-01-02-03) when the flux was found to be 3.4483e-09 ergs/cm^2/s. The pulse period is found to be 9.29+-0.01s which indicates that the pulse period is almost constant from the June 1975 outburst (Kelly et al., 1983, ApJ, 274, 765). The pulse profile has one strong and one weak components, both in 2-10 and 50-100 keV range.
The spectrum is well fitted with a broken power law with break energy varying between 13.3 to 14.1 keV. The fitted hydrogen column density was varying between 3.66e22 to 4.75e22, with exception on 9th and 15th January 2008, where the best fitted column density was found to be 2.21e22 and 2.23e22 respectively. The low energy and high energy power law photon indexes were varying between 1.40 to 1.51 and 3.15 to 3.87 respectively. We detected iron line with 1.3+-0.1 keV equivalent width. 
Further observation is planned by RXTE. 2008-01-29 17:48:00
response:
该现象描述了X射线暂现源2S 1553–542在2008年初爆发期间的RXTE/PCA观测结果。首先，Swift/BAT于2008年1月6日前后探测到其活动增强，触发RXTE进行密集监测（几乎每日一次），表明该源处于典型的暂现吸积相。通量在2–10 keV能段为(9.63–2.22)×10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，其中1月9日出现显著峰值（3.45×10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹），暗示当日可能存在吸积率突增或几何遮挡变化。脉冲周期稳定在9.29±0.01 s，与1975年爆发期测量值一致，说明中子星自转未发生显著自转加速或减速，吸积扭矩较弱或已达到平衡态。单峰主导、次峰较弱的双成分脉冲轮廓在软硬能段均存在，反映辐射束结构具有能量依赖性但整体几何稳定性高。

能谱分析显示为带折断的幂律模型，折断能量集中于13.3–14.1 keV，符合典型X射线脉冲星的康普顿化热冕模型特征，折断位置可能对应电子温度与光学深度共同决定的饱和散射能标。氢柱密度N_H总体较高（3.66–4.75×10²² cm⁻²），表明显著星际消光或局部吸积包层贡献；而1月9日与15日N_H骤降至~2.2×10²² cm⁻²，结合当日通量跃升，提示视线方向上的局部吸收物质（如扭曲吸积流或冷云）发生瞬时稀薄化。低能谱指数Γ₁=1.40–1.51偏硬，反映强康普顿化过程；高能谱指数Γ₂=3.15–3.87显著变陡，符合折断后光子被高效吸收或冷却主导的谱形特征。1.3±0.1 keV等效宽度的铁Kα发射线清晰可辨，证实存在富铁的冷反射介质（如吸积盘表面或伴星风物质），且线宽未给出但等效宽度较大，暗示反射区域致密且辐照强烈。综上，该爆发呈现经典高质量X射线双星（HMXB）脉冲星特征：稳定自转、吸积驱动辐射、部分遮挡调制、热冕主导能谱及冷物质反射，其短时标N_H与通量反相关行为为进一步研究吸积流不稳定性提供了关键约束。

根据现象进行分析： An Optical Transient from the Catalina Sky Survey We have detected an optical transients in the Catalina Sky Survey (CSS) obtained at the Mt. Bigelow 0.7m Catalina Schmidt Telescope between Jan 30 2008 UT. The transient is unresolved and at the following J2000 coordinates: 
ID | Detection Date| RA| Dec  
---|---|---|---  
CSS080130:033055-251255 |  2008-01-30 UT 04:18:33 |  03:30:55.66 |  +25:12:55.2   
For finding charts and additional information, please see: http://voeventnet.caltech.edu/feeds/ATEL/CSS/ 
CSS discovery observations consist of four images spanning approx 30 minutes. Transient CSS080130:033055-251255 was mag ~16.7 in all images when detected and does not match the location of any known object to ~21st magnitude in past CSS images and other archival data. However, there is some evidence of a nearby object which may be associated. Follow-up observations in Gunn-g and Gunn-r band were taken with the P-60 on 2008-01-31 UT 04:35 and showed that the transient was of similar brightness. Photometric and spectroscopic follow-up observations are requested.
All automatically selected CSS optical transients are published as VOEvents in real-time at http://voeventnet.org/feeds/Catalina.shtml  with RSS feed http://voeventnet.caltech.edu/feeds/Catfeed.xml    
A regularly updated list of by-eye selected transient candidates is also available here http://nesssi.cacr.caltech.edu/catalina/All.html 2008-02-01 07:02:00
response: 该光学暂现源CSS080130:033055-251255由卡塔利娜巡天系统（CSS）于2008年1月30日世界时04:18:33在基特峰大熊山0.7米卡塔利娜施密特望远镜上首次探测到，位置精确（J2000历元）为赤经03:30:55.66、赤纬+25:12:55.2，呈点源状、无空间延展。其在CSS四次连续曝光（跨度约30分钟）中均稳定呈现，测光星等约为16.7等，且在历史CSS数据及其他存档资料（深度达约21等）中未发现该位置存在已知天体，排除了恒星、小行星或已编录变星的可能性。尽管暂现源本身未见明显变化，但在其邻近区域存在一个可能相关的较暗天体，尚不能排除物理关联性。次日（2008年1月31日UT 04:35）使用P60望远镜在Gunn-g和Gunn-r波段开展的后续观测显示，该暂现源亮度基本保持不变，说明其光变时间尺度大于约1天，暂不支持典型经典新星或Ia型超新星早期快速上升行为。由于缺乏光谱信息及更密集时序测光，其物理本质尚无法判定，需进一步光谱证认以区分可能类别（如活动星系核耀发、潮汐撕裂事件、致密双星并合电磁对应体、或罕见类型激变变星等），同时需更高精度定位以验证与邻近天体的空间关联性。

根据现象进行分析： Optical identification of IGR J00333+6122 as a Seyfert 1 AGN We report on an optical spectroscopic follow-up observation of source USNO-A2.0 1500_00589511, positionally coincident with the Swift/XRT and Chandra/HRC-I X-ray source #1 reported in Landi et al. (ATel #1322) and in Jonker & Kuiper (ATel #1326) respectively, and likely associated with the INTEGRAL source IGR J00333+6122/J00335+6126 (Kuiper et al. ATel #939; Bird et al. 2007, ApJS, 170, 175). 
The observations were performed on 2008 January 5, starting at 22:34 UT, with the William Herschel Telescope (located in Canary Islands, Spain) plus ISIS-Red Arm using Grism R158R and a 1.5 arcsec slit. The total exposition time was 2000 s. The optical spectrum, which covers the useful range 5300-9000 Angstroms, shows several emission features, among which a very broad (observed FWZI ~ 680 Angstroms) Halpha+[NII] complex as well as narrow [OIII] lines. Using the narrow emission features, we determine a redshift z=0.105+-0.001 for the source. 
The Swift/XRT and Chandra/HRC-I X-ray source #2 (Landi et al. ATel #1322; Jonker & Kuiper, ATel #1326) within the IBIS error circle of IGR J00333+6122 is instead associated with star TYC 4015-206-1 of intermediate spectral type without peculiar spectral features (Masetti et al., ATel #941). This, together with its soft X-ray spectrum points out that this source is not a symbiotic X-ray binary, but more likely a star with coronal emission, and rules out its association with IGR J00333+6122. 
From all of the above we thus identify the hard X-ray source IGR J00333+6122 with the Seyfert 1 AGN USNO-A2.0 1500_00589511. 
  
  
We thank P. Rodriguez-Gil and A. Cardwell for Service Programme observations performed with the WHT. 2008-02-01 15:26:00
response:
首先，该研究旨在对硬X射线源IGR J00333+6122进行光学证认。已知该源位于INTEGRAL卫星IBIS仪器的误差圆内，并曾被Swift/XRT和Chandra/HRC-I在X射线波段探测到两个临近源（#1和#2），需判断哪一个对应于真实致密天体。

其次，针对X射线源#1（即USNO-A2.0 1500_00589511），作者利用威廉·赫歇尔望远镜（WHT）获取了光学光谱。光谱覆盖5300–9000 Å，信噪比足以分辨发射线特征：其中Hα+[N II]复合线呈现极宽的轮廓（观测FWZI ≈ 680 Å），表明存在高速宽线区；同时检测到窄的[O III] λ5007等禁线，其红移一致，据此测得系统红移z = 0.105 ± 0.001。

第三，宽Hα线是Seyfert 1型活动星系核（AGN）的关键光谱标识，反映中心超大质量黑洞吸积盘附近气体的宽线区运动学；而窄[O III]线则起源于更外围的低密度电离气体，二者共存且具有相同红移，支持其为典型Seyfert 1 AGN而非其他类型（如窄线 Seyfert 1 或类星体）。

第四，对于同一IBIS误差圆内的X射线源#2，已有光学证认为一颗普通中型恒星TYC 4015-206-1，无特殊发射或吸收特征，且其X射线谱偏软，符合恒星色球/冕活动辐射特征，排除其为激变变星、共生X射线双星或AGN的可能性，因此不能与硬X射线源IGR J00333+6122关联。

最后，综合位置一致性（X射线源#1与INTEGRAL源角距离最小）、光学光谱诊断（宽Hα + 窄[O III] + z=0.105）、X射线能谱硬度（硬X射线辐射与AGN吸积过程相符）三方面证据，确认IGR J00333+6122即为该Seyfert 1 AGN。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT Detects Increased Activity from the Accreting Pulsar GRO J1750-27 The Swift/BAT hard X-ray transient monitor reports an outburst of the X-ray pulsar GRO J1750-27 (also known as AX J1749.1-2639). The source was first detected at 0.031 +/- 0.005 cts/cm^2/sec (140 mcrab) in a 320-sec observation in the 15-50 keV energy range, beginning at 11:26:40 UT on Jan. 29, 2008 (MJD 54494). It has been observed above 100 mcrab in all pointings since this initial detection. The detection significances in individual pointings average 6-7 sigma. This source is normally below the BAT transient monitor detection threshold of 0.003 cts/sec/cm^2 (about 15 mcrab). GRO J1750-27 is currently too close to the sun to be observed with the Swift narrow-field instruments. The source was first detected in CGRO/BATSE in September 1995 (Scott et al, ApJ 488, 831, 1997) at a much lower level (< 30 mcrab). No outbursts have been reported since that time. 
BAT Transient Monitor observations of GRO J1750-27 2008-02-01 22:05:00
response: 该现象描述了X射线脉冲星GRO J1750-27在2008年1月29日发生的一次显著硬X射线暴发。首先，Swift/BAT硬X射线暂现源监视器在15–50 keV能段、320秒曝光中首次探测到该源，流量为0.031 ± 0.005 cts/cm²/sec（约140 mcrab），远超其常规不可探测水平（阈值约0.003 cts/cm²/sec，即15 mcrab），表明此次暴发幅度达正常背景的近10倍以上。此后所有指向观测中流量均持续高于100 mcrab，单次探测信噪比达6–7σ，说明信号高度显著、非随机起伏。该源此前仅于1995年9月由CGRO/BATSE低水平探测（<30 mcrab），且此后十余年无任何暴发报道，因此本次事件是其首次被确认的强暴发活动。由于当前该源天球位置过近太阳，Swift的窄视场仪器（如XRT、UVOT）无法开展后续观测，仅能依赖BAT宽视场监视数据追踪。综合判断，这是一次罕见的、高显著性的吸积驱动型X射线暴发，可能源于中子星吸积盘不稳定性增强或伴星物质输运突然增加所致。

GMRT observed the source as a Target of Opportunity between 2008 Jan 20 UT 16:20 and 2008 Jan 21 UT 00:05. The 16 MHz upper sideband data analysis reveals a source at RA 09h 09d 30.7s, DEC +33d 08' 22" (J2000.0) consistent with the optical position (Li and Filippenko CBET 1202) within our resolution of about 5 arcsec. The integrated flux obtained with JMFIT at the above position is 1.2 mJy (centroid frequency 1288.75 MHz). The deconvoluted source is consistent with a point source. The nominal map rms is 0.2 mJy. We thank the staff of the GMRT, especially C. H. Ishwar Chandra, who have made this observation possible. GMRT is run by the National Centre for Radio Astrophysics of the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research. 2008-02-02 17:04:00
response: SN 2008D（即XRF 080109）是发生在星系NGC 2770中的一次超新星爆发，其前身星可能为一颗大质量恒星。该事件最初被识别为一次软X射线闪（X-ray Flash），属于极低光度、弱各向异性喷流主导的Ibc型超新星候选体，暗示可能存在成功启动但能量较低的相对论性喷流。本次GMRT在L波段（中心频率约1288.75 MHz）的射电探测，是在爆发后约9天（2008年1月20–21日UT）开展的ToO观测，首次在射电波段明确探测到该源。所测得的射电源位置（RA 09h 09m 30.7s, DEC +33° 08′ 22″, J2000）与光学定位（Li & Filippenko, CBET 1202）在约5角秒角分辨率内完全一致，排除了背景星系或活动星系核污染的可能性；测得积分流量密度为1.2 mJy，显著高于图像噪声水平（rms = 0.2 mJy），信噪比达6；源结构经JMFIT去卷积后符合点源特征，表明射电辐射来自致密激波区域而非延展星云。该探测证实SN 2008D在早期即产生非热同步辐射，支持其爆炸产生了外向激波并与周围星周介质（CSM）发生相互作用——结合其X射线闪特性，暗示爆炸能量较低（~10⁴⁹–10⁵⁰ erg）、CSM密度较高（可能源于爆发前数年至数十年内的强烈星风损失），从而在较短时间内（≤10天）即可产生可观测的射电辐射。

根据现象进行分析： Galactic black hole transient H1743-322 in transition to the hard state Galactic black hole transient H1743-322 has been in outburst since Jan 4, 2008 (ATEL #1348, #1349, #1352). We have analyzed the RXTE PCA data taken on Jan 24 and Feb 1st. Quick fits to both data sets with a power law + diskbb + smedge model were performed. On Jan 24, the photon index was 2.3. The ratio of the power law flux to the overall flux in the 3-25 keV band was 70%. The power spectrum showed weak broad band noise with 8% rms amplitude of variability. The source perhaps entered the hard intermediate state at the time. 
A radio observation with ATCA on January 28 resulted in no detection with an rms upper limit of 0.15 mJy at 8.6 and 4.8 GHz.
On Feb 1st, the photon index was 1.55, and the power law flux was 90% of the overall flux. The power spectrum showed a QPO at 4.5 Hz, and stronger broad band noise with 15% rms amplitude. Based on these results, the source is about to, or has already transited to the hard state, and radio and OIR activity are expected, and multi-wavelength observations are encouraged. 2008-02-03 07:57:00
response:
首先，H1743-322自2008年1月4日爆发以来持续处于活动状态，表明其正处于吸积过程的增强阶段。  
其次，1月24日RXTE PCA观测显示光子指数为2.3，硬X射线波段（3–25 keV）中幂律成分占比达70%，且功率谱呈现弱宽带噪声（rms 8%），这些特征符合硬中间态的典型表现：即热盘辐射减弱、幂律辐射增强，但尚未完全主导，且时变特性介于软态与硬态之间。  
接着，1月28日ATCA射电观测未探测到源，3σ上限为0.15 mJy（8.6/4.8 GHz），说明此时尚未产生显著的射电喷流辐射，与硬中间态预期一致——喷流通常在向硬态进一步演化时才被激发。  
然后，2月1日观测显示光子指数显著硬化至1.55，幂律成分占比升至90%，同时功率谱出现4.5 Hz准周期振荡（QPO）并伴随更强的宽带噪声（rms 15%），这些是黑洞X射线双星进入硬态的关键诊断指标：QPO的出现反映内吸积流结构变化，高rms和低光子指数共同指示高温热冕主导辐射、冷吸积盘内区退缩或被截断。  
最后，综合X射线能谱、时变及射电非探测结果，可推断该源在1月24日至2月1日期间正经历从硬中间态向硬态的快速转变；射电与光学/红外辐射预期将在硬态确立后增强，因此需开展多波段协同观测以捕捉喷流启亮过程。

The EPIC pn count rate with the medium filter was 0.0315+-0.0019 counts/s. SMC 3 was still a luminous SSS without a significant change in the effective temperature of about 500,000 K, but the luminosity in the 0.15-1 keV range decreased by more than a factor of 4 since the previous XMM-Newton observation of 2006 (Orio et al., ApJ 2007, 661, 1105). The X-ray flux was 3.1 10^{-13} erg/cm^2/s, still about a factor of 10 higher than the flux measured a previous Chandra ACIS-S observation done in 2004, exactly 4 years and 8 months earlier. There are no significant spectral changes since the previous X-ray observations and the new measurement seems to confirm that SMC 3 undergoes an eclipse in X rays, lasting a few months and repeating itself with a period of about 4.5 years, as suggested by Kahabka (2004, A&A, 416, 57). In this last X-ray observation the source was probably just coming out of the eclipse. 2008-02-04 09:29:00
response:
首先，题目描述的是对共生星SMC 3的X射线观测现象，核心是其作为超软X射线源（SSS）的长期光变与光谱行为。需从时间序列、光度变化、温度稳定性、光谱一致性及周期性遮挡等维度进行逻辑递进分析。

第一步，确认观测时间线与数据可靠性：2007年10月28日XMM-Newton进行20 ks曝光观测，距1990年ROSAT首次探测已过去17年，且与2006年XMM-Newton观测相隔约1年，与2004年Chandra观测相隔4年8个月——时间跨度足够检验长期演化趋势；EPIC pn计数率0.0315±0.0019 counts/s具有明确统计误差，表明测量精度可靠。

第二步，分析光度演化：在0.15–1 keV能段，2007年X射线光度较2006年下降超4倍，但相比2004年仍高约10倍；结合通量值3.1×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s，说明源虽显著变暗，但仍处于SSS典型光度范围（10³⁶–10³⁸ erg/s量级，按SMC距离换算），排除完全熄灭或永久性衰减。

第三步，考察热状态稳定性：有效温度维持在约500,000 K，无显著变化——这表明白矮星表面核燃烧持续稳定，光度下降并非源于温度降低，而更可能由吸积率下降或视线方向上的遮挡导致。

第四步，验证光谱一致性：文中强调“无显著光谱变化”，即能谱形状（如黑体拟合参数、吸收柱密度、发射线特征等）与此前观测一致，进一步支持温度恒定，同时排除了喷流、激波加热等非稳态热辐射机制主导的可能性。

第五步，关联周期性现象：观测结果支持Kahabka（2004）提出的约4.5年周期性X射线食（eclipse），本次2007年观测恰在食结束之后（“just coming out of the eclipse”），与2004年Chandra观测（食中或食后早期）、2006年XMM观测（食前或食中）共同构成相位覆盖；几个月的食长符合共生双星中红巨星包层或风致物质盘对白矮星X射线的周期性遮挡模型。

综上，SMC 3的X射线行为可统一解释为：一个稳定燃烧的高温白矮星（Tₑff ≈ 5×10⁵ K）被周期性遮挡，遮挡由轨道运动调制，周期约4.5年，每次持续数月；光度变化是视线方向吸收变化所致，而非中心能源本身演化。

根据现象进行分析： Optical Nova Candidate in M 31 We report the discovery of an optical nova candidate in M 31 on a 12x60 s stacked R filter CCD image obtained with the robotic 60cm telescope with an E2V CCD (2kx2k) of the Livermore Optical Transient Imaging System (Super-LOTIS, located at Steward Observatory, Kitt Peak, Arizona, USA).  
The object was first detected on 2008 Feb 07.17 UT with a magnitude of 18.2 and is clearly visible on several of the individual 60 s images. The position for the nova candidate is RA = 00h42m30.40s, Dec = 41d09'53.9" (J2000, accuracy of 0.3"), which is 2'37" west and 6'16" south of the core of M 31.  
All magnitudes given are obtained from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Local Group Survey M 31 catalogue (Massey et al. 2006, AJ, 131, 2478). No object is visible (limiting R magnitude of ~19.0) at the position of the nova candidate on Super-LOTIS images of 2008 Feb 06.17 UT and before. There is no entry in VizieR/CDS for this object and no minor planet could be found on this position using the MPC/IAU Minor Planet Checker (see http://scully.harvard.edu/~cgi/CheckMP  ).  
  
Erratum: In ATel #1364 the nova candidate is located 2'41" east from the core of M 31 instead of 2'41" west. 2008-02-07 13:46:00
response: 该光学新星候选体的发现基于Super-LOTIS系统在2008年2月7.17 UT获取的R波段CCD图像，通过12帧60秒曝光叠加得到；其亮度为R=18.2，且在多帧单次曝光图像中均清晰可见，表明该源具有显著且稳定的光变特征。位置测定精度达0.3角秒（J2000历元），坐标为RA 00h42m30.40s、Dec +41°09′53.9″，位于M31星系核以西2′37″、以南6′16″处；此前同系统于2月6.17 UT及更早的观测中未探测到该位置任何天体，极限星等约R=19.0，说明该源在24小时内由不可见状态增亮至18.2等，符合经典新星典型的快速上升光变行为。测光定标采用Massey等人（2006）发布的M31本地星系群巡天R波段星表，保证了星等系统的可靠性；VizieR/CDS数据库及小行星中心（MPC/IAU）核查均无对应记录，排除了已知恒星、星云或太阳系小天体的可能性；前期通报（ATel #1364）中方位描述存在笔误（误将“西”写为“东”），但坐标本身准确，进一步佐证该位置确为一新出现的暂现源。综合观测时间、光变幅度、空间位置、测光精度与证认排除过程，可确认该目标为M31中一颗光学新星候选体。

根据现象进行分析： The nature of the rapid variability of CI Cam (XTE J0421+ 560) CI Cam is an X-ray transient and a multiple system which consists of a B4 III-V star displaying B[e] phenomenon, a compact object, probably a white dwarf on an eccentric orbit with the period of 19.407 day (ATEL #416), and a third massive companion of the unknown nature which causes the slow shift of the wind lines of B[e] star (ATEL #1036). As reported elsewhere, CI Cam showed different types of optical variability: large optical outburst accompanied the X-ray event in 1998 April, long-term changes in the scales of a few years, variation with a period of 372+/-15 day (ATel #820), 19.4 day orbital periodic changes, mini-outbursts and dips, and irregular intranight microvariability. Total amplitude of brightness variations in the quiet state is equal to 0.30 mag in the V band.   
  
We found that the nature of the intranight variability of CI Cam is the double-mode pulsation of its B4 type companion. We analyzed a set of V-band photometry taken using the SAI Crimean Station 50-cm Maksutov telescope and Meade Pictor-416 CCD during 18 nights in 2006 December. The set includes 2366 observations. The duration of night monitoring reached 13.2 hours in some nights, and the accuracy of measurements was between 0.003 and 0.002 mag.   
  
CI Cam showed the rapid variability in the time scales of hours with the maximum amplitude of 0.07 mag. Method of analysis was discrete Fourier transform and decomposition into periodic components including prewhitening procedure. The set was cleaned for the low-frequency noise with f<=0.2 c/d.   
  
In the light curve, two waves predominate with periods of 0.4152 and 0.2667 day with the full amplitudes of 0.019 and 0.017 mag, correspondingly. The ratio of periods is close to 3:2. There is a third wave with the period of 0.5216 day (Ampl.=0.008) which is approximately double relative to the second period. Additionally, other lower amplitude waves can be extracted from the light curve. Using 651 observations of CI Cam taken with the same CCD and telescope before December 2006 we established the coherence of dominant pulsations in the range of one and half year. Owing to resonant interaction of these waves, sometimes the pulsations are seen as mini-flares with the amplitude up to 0.07 mag. Pulsations of CI Cam resemble those of Be stars (Astron. & Astrophys. V.476, 927, 2007), but they are observed in a B[e] star for the first time. This result may be asteroseismologic clue to study an internal structure of stars with B[e] phenomenon. 
Fragment of the light curve and model. 2008-02-08 17:48:00
response:
首先，题目描述了CI Cam（XTE J0421+560）的多尺度光学变异性现象：包括1998年X射线暴发伴随的大光学爆发、数年尺度的长周期变化、372天周期、19.4天轨道周期调制、迷你爆发与凹陷，以及不规则的星夜微变异性（intranight microvariability）。其中，星夜微变异性表现为小时量级的快速光变，最大振幅达0.07 mag，处于宁静态总变幅0.30 mag范围内，说明该信号是叠加在较慢变化之上的高频成分。

其次，观测数据来自2006年12月18个夜晚、共2366次V波段测光，时间跨度单夜最长13.2小时，测光精度达0.002–0.003 mag，具备分辨小时级周期信号的足够时间分辨率和信噪比。数据经离散傅里叶变换（DFT）分析，并采用预白化（prewhitening）流程逐级剥离主周期成分，同时滤除f ≤ 0.2 c/d的低频噪声，确保高频脉动信号不受长周期趋势或轨道调制干扰。

第三，频谱分析明确识别出三个主导周期成分：P₁ = 0.4152 d（≈10.0 h）、P₂ = 0.2667 d（≈6.4 h）、P₃ = 0.5216 d（≈12.5 h），对应全振幅分别为0.019、0.017、0.008 mag。P₁/P₂ ≈ 1.556 ≈ 3/2，符合共振周期比；P₃ ≈ 2×P₂（0.5334 d），亦接近倍周期关系，暗示非线性耦合机制。这些周期均远短于已知轨道周期（19.4 d）和372 d长周期，排除轨道或吸积盘进动等外因主导，指向恒星本征脉动。

第四，利用此前651次同设备观测数据验证了P₁和P₂在一年半时间跨度内保持相位相干性，排除随机闪烁或仪器噪声可能；且脉动叠加可产生瞬时增强——即“迷你耀发”（mini-flares），振幅达0.07 mag，与观测到的快速光变峰值一致，证实脉动是微变异性物理起源。

第五，该脉动特征（双模、3:2共振、相干性强、振幅小但稳定）与经典Be星脉动高度相似，但首次在B[e]型星中发现。B[e]星具有禁线发射、红外超、星周盘等特殊性质，其内部结构（如辐射层稳定性、对流核大小、自转剪切效应）可能与普通Be星存在差异；因此，该双模脉动为利用星震学反演B[e]星内部密度、角动量分布及演化状态提供了关键约束。

input: 根据现象进行分析： VLA radio upper limit on Type IIn Supernova 2008S Poonam Chandra and Alicia Soderberg report on behalf of a larger collaboration: We observed type IIn supernova SN 2008S (CBET 1234) with the Very Large Array (VLA) on 2008, February 10.62 UT. We do not detect any radio emission at the supernova position (CBET 1234). The flux density at the supernova position is -62 +/- 36 uJy. 2008-02-11 00:58:00
response:
首先，观测对象是IIn型超新星SN 2008S，该类型以窄发射线（narrow lines）为特征，通常与致密的、富含尘埃的星周介质（CSM）相互作用相关，因此理论上可能产生较强的射电辐射。  
其次，使用VLA在2008年2月10.62 UT进行了射电观测，中心频率未明确给出，但VLA典型观测频段（如L、C、X波段）对应射电同步辐射探测敏感范围；未探测到显著射电辐射，测得位置处通量密度为–62 ± 36 μJy，该值在误差范围内与零一致，故给出的是严格意义上的射电流量上限。  
第三，负值通量密度源于测量噪声的随机涨落，实际物理通量不能为负，因此有效上限应取绝对值加一倍标准差，即约 |–62| + 2×36 ≈ 134 μJy（3σ上限），或更保守地采用 3σ = 108 μJy；文献中常直接以“non-detection”并给出1σ或3σ上限表述。  
第四，该射电宁静性暗示：SN 2008S爆发时激波尚未传播至足够远的、电子密度和磁场强度足以产生可探测同步辐射的星周介质区域；或CSM整体密度较低、或磁场较弱、或激波速度较低，导致同步辐射光度低于VLA探测极限；亦可能其前身星抛出的物质高度不均匀或存在遮蔽效应。  
第五，结合IIn型分类，光学谱中强窄线表明存在近距、慢速（~10² km/s）、高柱密度的冷CSM，但射电不探测说明该CSM可能缺乏足够高能电子或有效加速机制尚未启动，暗示激波仍处于早期传播阶段，或CSM电离度低、同步辐射效率受限。  
综上，该射电上限对激波与CSM相互作用模型构成约束：要求理论预测的射电光度在观测时刻必须低于~100 μJy，从而限制CSM质量损失率、外流速度、磁场强度及激波演化时标等关键参数。

根据现象进行分析： Radio observations of XMMSL1 J152835.4+593754 Observations with the Very Large Array (VLA) in its moderately extended 'B' configuration under observing code AR642 show no radio counterpart to the new X-ray transient XMMSL1 J152835.4+593754 (ATel #1361). Data taken at 8.46 GHz on 21 and 23 Jan 2008 show no believable sources within the entire (5.5 arcmin) field-of-view, with a root-mean-square noise level of 0.039 mJy/beam. The minimum/maximum within the 8 arcsec XMM error bar were (-0.13, +0.12) mJy/beam; the nominal flux density at the position of the suggested stellar counterpart (LSPM J1528+5937), accounting for the proper motion (see ATel #1361), was -0.028 mJy/beam. 
No further VLA observations are planned. 
The National Radio Astronomy Observatory is a facility of the National Science Foundation operated under cooperative agreement by Associated Universities, Inc. 2008-02-11 21:13:00
response: 该现象表明，在X射线暂现源XMMSL1 J152835.4+593754的位置上，甚大阵（VLA）在8.46 GHz频段的深度射电观测未探测到任何可信的射电对应体。观测采用B组态，视场为5.5角分，均方根噪声达0.039 mJy/beam，灵敏度较高；在XMM-Newton给出的8角秒误差圆内，像素级流量密度范围为−0.13至+0.12 mJy/beam，中心值接近零，且对候选恒星对应体LSPM J1528+5937按其自行校正后的位置所提取的流量密度为−0.028 mJy/beam，处于噪声水平以内，不构成显著探测。结合无后续VLA观测计划，可推断该X射线暂现源在射电波段无显著辐射，既不支持强同步辐射机制（如相对论性喷流或激波辐射），也不符合典型射电噪暂现源（如耀变体、射电噪潮汐撕裂事件或致密天体并合余辉）的特征；更可能属于射电静默型暂现源，例如射电静默的潮汐撕裂事件、低光度吸积爆发、或非相对论性外流主导的软X射线暂现源。

根据现象进行分析： On-going radio observations of H1743-322 We report on-going observations of the black hole transient H1743-322 (ATel #1348, #1349, #1352, #1378) with the Very Large Array (VLA) in its moderately extended 'B' configuration, under observing program AR642. The 8.46 GHz observations show the following flux density evolution: 
    
      
        Date       MJD    8.46 GHz flux density    
    
      
      
      Jan. 10   54475.72    6.39 +/- 0.06 mJy      
    
      
      
      Jan. 19   54484.67    1.05 +/- 0.07 mJy      
    
      
      
      Jan. 21   54486.76    0.81 +/- 0.06 mJy      
    
      
      
      Feb.  3   54499.74    0.50 +/- 0.07 mJy      
    
      
      
      Feb.  5   54501.64    0.54 +/- 0.08 mJy      
    
      
      
      Feb.  6   54502.56    0.39 +/- 0.09 mJy      
    
      
      
      Feb.  9   54505.66    0.56 +/- 0.05 mJy  
    
Interleaved observations on Feb. 9 gave a flux density of 0.56 +/- 0.06 mJy at 4.86 GHz. This flat spectrum and low radio flux density are consistent with the source entering the low/hard state (cf. ATel #1378). 
The error bars above are statistical, and do not include an additional ~10% systematic uncertainty, e.g., due to uncertainties in the flux density scale. 
We confirm the tentative detection of linearly polarized radio emission reported in ATel #1352, with an 8 +/- 1% detection on Jan. 10 at 8.46 GHz. This polarized emission was seen at roughly the same flux density (0.5 mJy) and along the same polarization angle (electric field vectors oriented east/west). The magnetic field vectors are thus perpendicular to the (previous) ejection axis, suggesting terminal shock rather than jet emission during the decay of the radio outburst. However, no extended ejecta are seen on any of the above dates. The best limits come from 22.46 GHz imaging on Jan. 10, with a resolution (FWHM) 0.69 x 0.25 arcsec oriented roughly north/south. 
Further VLA observations are on-going. 
The National Radio Astronomy Observatory is a facility of the National Science Foundation operated under cooperative agreement by Associated Universities, Inc. 2008-02-11 23:45:00
response:
首先，观测对象是黑洞暂现源H1743-322，处于持续射电监测中，使用VLA B阵列在8.46 GHz频段进行观测。从1月10日（MJD 54475.72）到2月9日（MJD 54505.66），其8.46 GHz流量密度从6.39 mJy显著衰减至约0.5–0.6 mJy，整体呈快速下降趋势，尤其在1月10日至19日期间下降幅度达约84%，表明射电辐射正在急剧减弱。

其次，2月9日同时获得4.86 GHz和8.46 GHz流量密度（分别为0.56±0.06 mJy和0.56±0.05 mJy），两者在误差范围内一致，说明谱指数α≈0（定义为S_ν ∝ ν^α），即射电谱呈平坦状；结合极低的绝对流量密度（<1 mJy），符合黑洞X射线双星进入低硬态（low/hard state）的典型射电特征——此时吸积流主导辐射，喷流被抑制或仅产生弱、准稳态射电辐射。

第三，1月10日检测到显著线偏振（8±1%），对应偏振流量约0.5 mJy，偏振角对应电矢量东西向，即磁场方向为南北向；而此前观测已知存在东西向喷流喷射轴（e.g., ATel #1352），因此磁场方向垂直于历史喷流轴。该几何关系更支持终端激波模型（terminal shock），即喷流与周围介质相互作用产生的同步辐射，而非喷流本体（jet core）辐射；但高分辨率22.46 GHz成像（分辨率为0.69×0.25 arcsec，NS向）未探测到任何延展结构，排除了大尺度外流或团块状喷出物的存在，暗示激波可能发生在非常靠近核心的区域，或喷流已基本熄灭，仅残留局部激波辐射。

最后，所有统计误差未包含约10%系统误差（如流量标定不确定性），因此实际流量不确定性略高于所列值，但不影响对演化趋势与物理状态的定性判断。综合来看，该源正处于射电光度快速衰减、谱形变平、偏振特征保留但无延展结构的过渡阶段，符合低硬态建立过程中喷流关闭或大幅减弱的物理图像。

根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL Galactic bulge monitoring observations of GRO J1750-27 (AX J1749.1-2639), H1743-322 and SLX 1746-331 A new season of the INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge monitoring program (see ATels #438, #874, #1005; Kuulkers et al. 2007, A&A 466, 595) started, with observations on UT 11 Feb 2008, 16:33-18:07. We here report on results from three currently active transient sources. 
The IBIS/ISGRI and JEM-X1 images show a bright source near GX 3+1, coincident with the position of the transient accreting X-ray pulsar GRO J1750-27 (AX J1749.1-2639). This X-ray pulsar became active recently (ATel #1376, GCN Circ #7249, #7274). The JEM-X1 3-10 keV, 10-25 keV, and IBIS/ISGRI 18-40 keV, 40-100 keV fluxes are about 230 mCrab, 350 mCrab, 190 mCrab and 25 mCrab, respectively. In JEM-X1 we see a pulsed signal at 4.454+/-0.002 s, consistent with that found previously (Scott et al. 1997, ApJ 488, 831). In IBIS/ISGRI the source is seen up to about 70 keV. The JEM-X1 (3-35 keV) and IBIS/ISGRI (18-70 keV) spectra, can be simultaneously well fit (reduced chi-squared = 1.2 for 181 degrees of freedom) by a high-energy cut-off power-law model, with a photon index of 0.25+/-0.07 and a cut-off energy of 6.7+/-0.2 keV, subject to a fixed absorption column of 1.4e22 atoms/cm2. (Errors quoted are from single parameters error scans using Delta_Chi^2 = 1.) 
In addition, the Galactic black-hole X-ray transient H1743-322 (IGR J17464-3213) has become active again since the beginning of the year (ATel #1348, #1349, #1352). Just prior to our observations the source entered a low state (ATel #1378, #1384). The IBIS/ISGRI 18-40 keV and 40-100 keV fluxes are 13+/-2 mCrab and 25+/-4 mCrab, respectively, indicating the source's spectrum is hard. The source is seen with IBIS/ISGRI all the way up to about 150 keV. A single power-law fit to the IBIS/ISGRI (18-150 keV) spectrum gives a reduced chi-squared = 0.7 for 8 degrees of freedom, with a photon index of 1.6+/-0.2. It is not seen with JEM-X1, corresponding to a 3-sigma upper limit of about 10 mCrab (3-25 keV). The observations are consistent with the source being in a low state. 
We also detected the Galactic black-hole X-ray transient SLX 1746-331, which is in outburst since October 2007 (ATel #1235). It is only seen in the JEM-X1 3-10 keV band, with a flux of 57+/-12 mCrab. It was not seen at higher energies (with 3-sigma upper limits of about 15 mCrab [10-25 keV], 10 mCrab [18-40 keV] and 15 mCrab [40-100 keV]), indicating the source's spectrum is soft. 
The next INTEGRAL Galactic bulge monitoring observation is foreseen on UT 20 Feb 2008, 13:45-17:27. 
Finally, we note that a re-analysis of all consolidated data of the INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge monitoring program has been performed, using the latest software available (OSA 7.0). To increase the sensitivity, and to improve the quality of the output, we have changed the IBIS/ISGRI energy bands used; they are now 18-40 keV and 40-100 keV. Continuing the service to the scientific community, the near-real-time results (JEM-X and IBIS/ISGRI light curves and mosaic images) are made publicly available as soon as possible after the observations have been performed at http://isdc.unige.ch/Science/BULGE/. 2008-02-12 16:06:00

该天文通报描述了INTEGRAL卫星对银河系核球区域的例行监测观测结果，聚焦于三个暂现X射线源：GRO J1750–27（AX J1749.1–2639）、H1743–322（IGR J17464–3213）和SLX 1746–331。分析需从现象出发，逐源梳理其观测特征、物理含义及状态判据。

首先，GRO J1750–27被明确识别为一颗吸积X射线脉冲星，其位置与GX 3+1邻近但可分辨；JEM-X1探测到显著周期性脉冲信号（P = 4.454 ± 0.002 s），与历史测量一致，确认其脉冲星本质。多波段流量显示：3–10 keV达230 mCrab，10–25 keV升至350 mCrab，而IBIS/ISGRI在18–40 keV和40–100 keV分别测得190 mCrab和25 mCrab，表明谱形在~25 keV附近开始陡降；光子指数Γ = 0.25 ± 0.07且存在低截断能Ec = 6.7 ± 0.2 keV，是典型高吸积率、强磁场中子星系统的硬谱特征——高能截断源于电子在磁层中回旋共振散射或热冕康普顿化饱和，而极硬谱形（Γ < 0.5）支持其处于主暴发相，且吸收柱密度NH = 1.4 × 10²² cm⁻²符合银河系内银心方向典型消光水平。

其次，H1743–322作为恒星级黑洞暂现源，当前未被JEM-X1探测（3σ上限~10 mCrab，3–25 keV），但在IBIS/ISGRI中清晰显现：18–40 keV和40–100 keV流量分别为13 ± 2和25 ± 4 mCrab，且信号延伸至~150 keV；单幂律拟合（Γ = 1.6 ± 0.2）在18–150 keV区间χ²/dof = 0.7，表明无明显高能截断或反射特征；结合JEM-X1不可见、硬谱、高能延伸等三重证据，可判定其处于典型的低/硬态（low/hard state），即吸积流以热冕主导，盘内区退缩至内史瓦西半径以外，导致软X射线辐射严重缺乏。

第三，SLX 1746–331仅在JEM-X1 3–10 keV波段被可靠探测（57 ± 12 mCrab），而在更高能段（10–25 keV及以上）均低于3σ上限，尤其40–100 keV上限仅15 mCrab，远低于其低能流量；这种能量截断发生在~10 keV以下，对应黑体温度约1–2 keV的热主导谱，是标准热主导态（thermal dominant state）或高/软态（high/soft state）的标志，暗示内吸积盘已延伸至最内稳定圆轨道，辐射主要来自薄盘热辐射，黑洞自转与吸积率均较高。

综上，三源呈现截然不同的能谱形态与态别：GRO J1750–27为硬谱+脉冲+低截断能，指示中子星强磁场吸积；H1743–322为极硬无截断谱+高能延伸+低能缺失，确证黑洞低/硬态；SLX 1746–331为陡峭软谱+低能集中+高能快速压低，表征黑洞高/软态。三者共存于同一监测视场，凸显银河系核球区域暂现源活动的多样性与态演化同步性，也为多波段协同研究吸积物理提供了理想样本。

The reanalyzed map noise is 0.143 mJy at 1288.75 MHz. The three sigma upper limit to the SN flux in our revised analysis is 0.43 mJy. We thank Poonam Chandra for help with the reanalysis. 2008-02-13 15:51:00
response: 首先，该文本报告了对超新星SN 2008D（即XRF 080109）在NGC 2770中的一次射电观测结果的重新分析。原始声明（ATel #1377）曾声称在GMRT L波段（中心频率1288.75 MHz）于2008年1月20日探测到了该超新星。但本次重新分析推翻了该结论。关键依据在于：重新处理后的图像噪声水平为0.143 mJy，据此计算出的三倍噪声（3σ）流量密度上限为0.43 mJy。由于未在该位置检测到显著高于此上限的射电信号，故原声称的“探测”不成立，应予撤回。这一修正体现了射电数据处理中噪声评估与统计置信度判断的核心作用：探测声明必须满足信号强度显著超过本地噪声起伏（通常以3σ或更高为标准），而重新分析更准确地估计了噪声，从而得出更可靠的非探测结论。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT observation of H1743-322 In order to follow the latest outburst (Atel #1348,#1349,#1352) of the Galactic black hole H1743-322 during its decreasing phase, we asked for a ToO monitoring campaign with Swift/XRT. The first observation lasting 2ks has been performed on 2008, February 12th at 01:31:00 UT. The source has been detected with a 0.1-10 keV count rate of 1.95+/-0.04 counts/s. The best fit is given by an absorbed power law model with a photon index of 1.8+/-0.2 and a column density of 2.4+/-0.3 cm-2. The power law slope, consistent with the value found by INTEGRAL (Atel #1385) in soft gamma-ray, indicates that the source is still in hard state (Atel #1378). We estimated an unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux of (1.8+/-0.1)E-10 erg/cm2/s which translates in about 9 mCrab according with the JEM-X upper limit (Atel #1385). We will continue to monitor the source flux in the next weeks with Swift/XRT. We would like to thank N. Gehrels and the whole Swift Team for making these observations possible. 2008-02-13 18:17:00
response: 该观测报告描述了Swift/XRT对银河系黑洞暂现源H1743-322在2008年2月爆发衰减阶段的首次ToO监测。首先，观测时间明确为2008年2月12日01:31:00 UT，持续2 ks，属于对ATel #1348/#1349/#1352所通报爆发的后续跟踪。其次，源被明确探测到，0.1–10 keV能段计数率为1.95±0.04 counts/s，表明其仍具有显著X射线辐射强度。光谱拟合采用吸积盘外流主导的吸收幂律模型（absorbed power law），得到光子指数Γ = 1.8±0.2、吸收柱密度N_H = 2.4±0.3 × 10²² cm⁻²（注意原文单位“cm-2”应为笔误，实际指10²² cm⁻²量级，符合典型黑洞XRB的ISM吸收水平）。该光子指数与INTEGRAL在软伽马射线波段测得的结果一致（ATel #1385），而硬态的典型判据正是Γ ≲ 2.0且能谱无明显热成分，结合ATel #1378已确认其处于硬态，说明此时吸积流仍以热同步辐射主导的径移主导流（ADIOS）或低效冷却的晕为主，未进入标准热不稳定的内区薄盘主导的软态。进一步，由该模型外推得到的2–10 keV未吸收通量为(1.8±0.1)×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s，换算为约9 mCrab，与JEM-X给出的上限（ATel #1385）相符，验证了流量标度的自洽性。综上，此次观测证实H1743-322在爆发衰减初期仍稳定维持硬态，且X射线光度处于典型硬态范围（~10⁻⁹–10⁻⁸ erg/cm²/s量级），支持其处于硬态—硬中间态过渡前期，尚未发生态转变。

根据现象进行分析： Possible Supernova from the Catalina Sky Survey We have detected an optical transient in Catalina Sky Survey (CSS) images obtained at the Mt. Bigelow 0.7m Catalina Schmidt Telescope on 13 Feb 2008 UT. The transient is unresolved, and at the following J2000 coordinates:   

CSS080213:024607--073833 |  2008-02-13 UT 02:23:00 |  RA 02:46:07.23 |  Dec -07:38:33.8  | Mag 17.6   
---|---|---|---|---  
For finding charts and discovery images please see: http://voeventnet.org/feeds/ATEL/CSS.    

The object is near the edge of a galaxy SDSS J024606.79-073803.7 (z=0.03, g ~ 15.2, r ~ 14.4, (m-M) = 35.45). The transient is consistent with a supernova at this distance. The CSS discovery observations consist of four images spanning ~ 24 minutes. The object is also clearly seen in images taken on 7 February UT when it was V ~ 17.3. It was not present in earlier CSS images including those taken on 13 January UT. The transient is not seen in archival PQ or SDSS images covering this location. Spectroscopic follow-up is requested.   

All stationary CSS optical transients are detected and published as VOEvents in real-time at http://voeventnet.org/feeds/Catalina.shtml  and here http://voeventnet.caltech.edu/feeds/Catfeed.xml  (RSS) 2008-02-13 18:49:00
response: 该光学暂现源位于SDSS J024606.79−073803.7星系边缘，红移z=0.03，对应距离模数(m−M)=35.45，即光度距离约12.3 Mpc。暂现源在2008年2月7日已亮至V≈17.3，2月13日达17.6等，且此前1月13日及更早的CSS、PQ、SDSS归档图像中均未检出，表明其为真实爆发事件而非噪点或活动星系核等持久源。其位置与宿主星系一致，且角距离足够近（约30角秒），支持其为该星系内超新星。光变时间尺度（至少7天内显著增亮并持续）符合核心坍缩型或Ia型超新星典型演化特征；未见前期活动排除了活动星系核耀发可能；未在深场巡天图像中出现，排除了矮星耀斑或小行星等前景天体。因此，该暂现源极可能是一颗发生在z=0.03宿主星系中的真实超新星，需光谱观测确认类型。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Discovery of a type II supernova ROTSE3 J122836.3+153449 We report the discovery of a type IIn supernova in unfiltered CCD images taken with the 0.45-m ROTSE-IIIb telescope at McDonald Observatory. The supernova, located at RA: 12:28:36.25 Dec:+15:34:49.1 (J2000), is 1.0" west and 0.6" south from the center of an anonymous galaxy seen in SDSS. It was discovered on Jan. 10.41 UT at 18.7+/-0.2 mag. The SN reached 18.2+/-0.2 mag on Jan. 15.36 UT and then decayed. The most recent detection showed it at 18.6+/-0.1 mag on Feb 12.27 UT. Magnitudes quoted above are unfiltered calibrated to SDSS r band. A finding chart of the SN can be found at: http://www.rotse.net/rsvp/j122836.3+153449/j122836.3+153449.jpg 
Optical spectra (420-890 nm) of ROTSE3 J122836.3+153449 obtained on Jan. 29.35 UT under poor conditions and again on Jan. 30.35 UT with the 9.2m Hobby-Eberly Telescope (+ Marcario Low-Resolution Spectrograph) by S. Rostopchin and V. Riley show it to be a Type II supernova. The spectra consist of blue continua superposed by Hydrogen Balmer emission lines (narrow + broad). Overall, the spectra are similar to the Type IIn supernova, 1996L at early times (Benetti et al. 1999, MNRAS 305,811). The Jan 30 data also clearly show narrow emission features from OIII 495.9,500.7-nm and OII 372.7-nm. All narrow features are consistent with a systematic redshift of z=0.234. 
A spectrum (330-980 nm) obtained on Jan. 31.50 UT by E. Ofek (Caltech) with the Palomar 200" telescope (+ Double Beam Spectrograph) and one obtained on Feb 08.12 UT by J. S. Bloom, R. J. Foley, M. Modjaz, and A. A. Miller (UC Berkeley) with the 10-m Keck I telescope (+LRIS) confirm the behavior described above and also exhibits narrow He I emission lines and weak, narrow absorption features corresponding to the MgII 279.6,280.4-nm doublet. The He I lines are further confirmation that the object is a SN and not an AGN. The Mg II absorption sets the minimum redshift for the supernova at z=0.234. We also note that the narrow [O II] 372.7-nm emission is more extended along the slit in the 2-D spectrogram than is the SN continuum, and it is offset as well. This indicates that ROTSE3 J122836.3+153449 is offset from its host galaxy and that the host light may contribute to the narrow emission features. 
Note that the redshift derived above implies a peak absolute magnitude of -22.1, which is comparable to that of 2006gy, the second brightest supernova observed and a possible pair-instability SN (Ofek et al. 2007, ApJ, 659, 13; Smith et al., 2007, ApJ, 666, 1116). 
ToO observations of ROTSE3 J122836.3+153449 were obtained with Swift XRT and UVOT on Feb. 6th, 7th and 13th UT. No X-ray emission is detected at the position of the supernova. The 1.1ks cleaned observation on Jan 6th yields a 3-sigma upper limit of 2e-13 erg/cm2/s in the 0.3-10keV energy range, assuming a power-law spectrum with photon index of 2. ROTSE3 J122836.3+153449 is detected by UVOT in all filters on Feb. 6th. The magnitudes are reported below. Note that the aperture used to get the UVOT photometry includes the center of the host, which introduced large uncertainty in the magnitudes. 
    
      
    Filter      Tstart      Tstop      T_exp(s)      Magnitude   
      
    v          16:48:10    19:59:55     211.9       18.8+/-0.2   
      
    b          16:41:35    19:54:35     211.9       19.2+/-0.2   
      
    u          16:40:13    19:53:28     211.9       18.2+/-0.2   
      
    uvw1       16:37:35    19:52:22     424.5       18.6+/-0.2   
      
    uvm2       16:49:30    18:26:59     270.3       18.5+/-0.2   
      
    uvw2       16:42:57    19:58:48     849.7       18.9+/-0.3 2008-02-16 14:44:00
response:
该现象描述了一颗被证认为IIn型超新星ROTSE3 J122836.3+153449的发现与多波段观测特征。首先，其位置位于SDSS所见一个无名星系中心以西1.0角秒、南0.6角秒处，表明存在空间偏移，暗示其可能起源于星系外围的恒星形成区或受到动力学扰动影响的恒星系统。光变曲线显示：1月10.41 UT发现时亮度为18.7±0.2 mag（未滤光，标定至SDSS r波段），1月15.36 UT达峰值18.2±0.2 mag，随后衰减，2月12.27 UT回落至18.6±0.1 mag，呈现典型IIn型超新星缓慢上升与较平缓衰减的光变行为，反映激波与致密星周物质相互作用主导能量释放过程。

光谱分析是关键判据：1月29–30日HET光谱显示蓝连续谱叠加氢巴尔末发射线（兼具窄成分与宽成分），窄线半宽对应低速气体（~几百km/s），宽线则指示高速抛射物（~数千km/s），符合IIn型定义——即II型超新星光谱中存在显著窄发射线，源于激波电离预先存在的致密星周介质。其光谱整体与SN 1996L早期相似，支持其为经典IIn型。进一步，1月30日光谱中明确探测到[O III] 495.9/500.7 nm与[O II] 372.7 nm窄发射线，所有窄线系统性红移z=0.234，由此确定宇宙学红移；2月1日Palomar与2月8日Keck光谱不仅确认上述特征，还新增He I窄发射线及Mg II 279.6/280.4 nm窄吸收线，后者为宿主星系星际介质吸收，独立验证z=0.234为最小红移值，排除AGN活动主导的可能性（He I发射在AGN中罕见且形态不同）。

值得注意的是，2D光谱中[O II]发射在狭缝方向上比连续谱更延展且存在位移，直接证实超新星位置与其宿主星系光度中心不重合，即存在物理偏移；因此，观测到的窄发射线可能混合了来自超新星自身星周物质和宿主星系ISM的贡献，需谨慎归因。由z=0.234推算出峰值绝对星等为−22.1 mag，与极亮超新星SN 2006gy相当，提示其可能具有高爆发能量，但区别于2006gy的持续增亮与极端光度，本例光变幅度较小、演化更快，更符合典型IIn型而非对不稳定超新星（PISN）候选体。

X射线观测（Swift/XRT）未探测到X射线辐射，3σ上限为2×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s（0.3–10 keV），说明激波与星周介质相互作用尚未产生强热X射线辐射，或星周介质密度虽高但尺度较小、激波尚未进入高效率X射线辐射阶段；而UVOT在全部紫外/光学滤光片中均探测到目标，u波段最亮（18.2±0.2 mag），表明存在较强紫外连续谱，符合IIn型中超高温激波加热星周气体并产生紫外辐射的预期。由于UVOT测光孔径包含宿主星系中心，测光结果存在较大系统误差，需后续高分辨率成像扣除宿主贡献以获得真实超新星紫外光度。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Nova 2005-09c in M31 Marina Orio and Thomas Nelson report that the M31 nova 2005-09 c (Quimby et al. 2005, ATel 600, and Hatzidimitriou et al., A&A 464, 1075) is detected as a luminous supersoft X-ray source (SSS) in an archival XMM exposure taken 10 months after the optical maximum of this nova, on 2006-06-28, with a count rate 0.0100$\pm$0.0018 cts/s in the 0.15-1 keV range. Despite the poor signal to noise, no significant counts above the background are measured above 0.8 keV and the spectrum is consistent with a blackbody with luminosity 2.5-3 $\times 10^{37$ erg/s, blackbody temperature T~60 eV and column density N(H)>=1.3 10$^{21}$ cm$^{-2}$. M31 N 2005-09 was a Fe nova, and this is the first time the SSS behaviour of a classical nova in M31 can be correlated with its spectroscopic and photometric properties in the optical range. 2008-02-18 16:58:00
response: 该现象描述了M31中经典新星2005-09c在光学极大后约10个月（2006年6月28日）被XMM-Newton探测到一个明亮的超软X射线源（SSS）。其0.15–1 keV能段计数率为0.0100±0.0018 cts/s，信噪比较低；在0.8 keV以上未探测到显著超出背景的光子，表明辐射谱截止明显，符合超软X射线源特征。能谱拟合结果支持黑体模型：光度为2.5–3×10³⁷ erg/s，温度T≈60 eV（对应黑体峰值波长约20 Å，即~0.2 keV），且氢柱密度N(H)≥1.3×10²¹ cm⁻²，说明存在显著的星际或包层吸收。该新星被证认为Fe型新星，而此次SSS探测首次实现了M31中经典新星的X射线SSS相与其光学光谱型（Fe型）及光变行为的直接关联，为验证新星白矮星质量较大、吸积率较高、核燃烧持续时间较长等理论预期提供了关键观测依据。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Radio Observations of Type Ia SN 2007on We observed the Type Ia supernova 2007on (CBET #1121) on 2007 Dec 7.26 UT with the Very Large Array at observing frequencies of 1.43 and 8.46 GHz. No radio emission is detected at the optical position of the SN. We report rms flux density values for the field of 178 (1.43 GHz) and 19 (8.46 GHz) microJy. We thank the NRAO scheduling committee for approving these Rapid Response observations. 2008-02-18 17:33:00
response: 该段文字描述了对Ia型超新星SN 2007on进行的射电波段观测结果。首先明确观测对象为Ia型超新星，这类超新星通常起源于碳氧白矮星在双星系统中吸积物质达到钱德拉塞卡极限后发生的热核爆炸，理论上不伴随显著的星周介质相互作用，因此预期射电辐射较弱。观测时间是2007年12月7.26 UT，即爆发后约数日至数周内（需结合SN 2007on的光学发现时间判断，但文中未给出，可推断为早期阶段），使用VLA在1.43 GHz和8.46 GHz两个频段进行。关键结果是：在光学位置处未探测到射电辐射，即上限制分别为178 μJy（1.43 GHz）和19 μJy（8.46 GHz，rms噪声水平）。由于8.46 GHz频段灵敏度更高（噪声更低），其更严格的流量上限对物理约束更有意义。未探测到射电辐射表明：爆炸周围缺乏致密星周介质（CSM），因为射电辐射主要来自激波与CSM相互作用产生的同步辐射；由此可排除该SN前身星为具有强星风（如红巨星或AGB星）的单简并模型，而更支持无显著质量损失的双简并模型，或质量损失率极低的单简并模型。此外，“Rapid Response”说明观测具有时效性，旨在捕捉早期射电信号，进一步强化了对早期CSM环境的限制。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of a 70.5 ms Pulsar in AX J1838.0-0655 Associated with HESS J1837-069 We have detected highly significant X-ray pulsations from the region of the TeV source HESS J1837-069 using the Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer (RXTE). The observatory was pointed at the steady X-ray source AX J1838.0-0655 (Bamba et al. 2003, ApJ, 589, 253) located within the HESS source, that has been conjectured to contain a pulsar wind nebula by Aharonian et al. 2006 (ApJ, 636, 777) and Malizia et al. 2005 (ApJ, 630, L157). This was recently confirmed using a Chandra observation that cleanly resolved AX J1838.0-0655 into a pulsar and its wind nebula (Halpern and Gotthelf 2008, ApJ, submitted). The Chandra unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux of the pulsar is 8.5E-12 ergs cm-2 s-1. We infer that AX J1838.0-0655 is the origin of the pulsations from the absence of any known comparably bright X-ray source in the RXTE field, and the evidence of a pulsar wind nebula. This result verifies that AX J1838.0-0655 is another example of a pulsar wind nebula connected with an extended TeV source. 
RXTE targeted the Chandra location of AX J1838.0-0655 on 2008 February 17 19:53 UT to search for the expected pulsar signal. A total of 9.14 ks of good RXTE data were acquired with the Proportional Counter Array (PCA) in GoodXenon mode spanning three satellite orbits (14.3 ks) with an average of 2.0 detector units (PCUs) active. Standard filters were applied to the resulting data and the photon arrival times were corrected to the solar system barycenter using the target coordinates. An FFT of the 2-14 keV (top PCA layer only) light curve, binned into 5 ms steps, produced a power of S = 117 at a period of 70.498 ms. This corresponds to essentially nil false detection probability. The folded light curve around the FFT signal provided a refined period of 70.49821(3) ms corresponding to a square-wave like pulse profile with complex structure. The measured pulsed fraction of 4.8% suggests an intrinsic pulsar modulation of roughly ~40% after allowing for the estimated RXTE background. The signal is also present in summed ~100 s dwells on the source by the RXTE PCA from 2004 - 2007. 
A prior pulsar search in the radio band using 6 ks of data acquired on 2007 September 14 with the ATNF Parkes telescope at a frequency of 3 GHz (to alleviate the effects of scattering due to the high column density) yields an upper limit on the flux density of S_3 < 0.075 mJy, assuming a pulsar duty cycle of 20%. 
Further X-ray timing observations are under way to improve the period measurement and future observations are planned to determine the spin-down rate and energetics of the pulsar. 2008-02-19 17:27:00
response: 该现象描述了在TeV源HESS J1837-069区域内、对应于稳态X射线源AX J1838.0-0655的位置，利用RXTE探测到显著的X射线周期性信号，周期为70.49821(3) ms。首先，观测目标明确指向Chandra已分辨出的脉冲星及其风云（Halpern & Gotthelf 2008），且该源被先前工作推测为脉冲星风云（Aharonian et al. 2006；Malizia et al. 2005），因此RXTE探测到的脉动极可能源自该脉冲星本身。其次，RXTE数据质量可靠：9.14 ks有效曝光、PCA GoodXenon模式、时间修正至太阳系质心、2–14 keV能段、5 ms时间分辨率，FFT检测到S = 117的功率峰，统计显著性极高（虚警概率可忽略）；折叠光变曲线进一步确认周期并揭示类方波但具复杂结构的脉冲轮廓；脉冲分数4.8%经背景扣除后推得本征调制约40%，符合年轻脉冲星特征。第三，该信号在2004–2007年RXTE历史短时观测中亦存在，说明其稳定性；而同期Parkes射电搜寻未探测到对应脉冲星，仅给出3 GHz流量密度上限S₃ < 0.075 mJy，暗示该脉冲星可能为X射线主导型（radio-quiet），常见于高消光、高色散路径上的年轻脉冲星。综上，该70.5 ms周期信号确证AX J1838.0-0655即为一新发现的X射线脉冲星，其与周围脉冲星风云及延展TeV辐射存在物理关联，支持其作为HESS J1837-069高能粒子加速引擎的起源。

input: 根据现象进行分析： No radio emission from SN 2006X after 2 years We observed Type Ia supernova SN 2006X (IAUC  8667 ) with the VLA for 2 hours in 8.46 GHz band at 2008 Feb 19.47 UT mean time. We did not detect any radio emission, indicating it to be a normal Type Ia supernova. The map rms is 18 uJy and the flux density at the supernova position is 4+/-18 uJy. We thank VLA staff for making this observation possible. The National Radio Astronomy Observatory is a facility of the National Science Foundation operated under cooperative agreement by Associated Universities, Inc. 2008-02-19 22:37:00
response: SN 2006X 是一颗 Ia 型超新星，其在爆发后约 2 年（2008 年 2 月）仍未能探测到射电辐射。观测使用 VLA 在 8.46 GHz 频段进行，积分时间为 2 小时，图像噪声水平（rms）为 18 μJy，超新星位置处测得的流量密度为 4 ± 18 μJy，即未探测到显著超出噪声的射电信号（信噪比 < 1）。该结果表明 SN 2006X 的射电光度上限约为 18 μJy。Ia 型超新星若发生在致密星周介质（CSM）环境中（例如由红巨星伴星风或近期质量损失形成），激波与介质相互作用会产生可探测的射电辐射；而未探测到射电辐射，说明其周围介质密度极低，缺乏显著的质量损失历史，支持其起源于双简并（DD）模型或延迟爆炸的单简并（SD）模型中伴星为弱风恒星（如主序星或白矮星）的情形，排除了具有强星风伴星（如红巨星）的典型单简并通道。因此，该射电非探测结果为其前身星系统性质提供了关键约束。

根据现象进行分析： AGILE gamma-ray detection of a variable source in the Musca region The AGILE satellite, currently in a Cycle-1 pointing centered approximately in the Musca region, during the observing period that started on 2008-02-14 12:00 UT, detected significant and variable gamma-ray emission from the Galactic plane from a source positionally consistent with 3EG J1410-6147. The AGILE Quicklook Analysis (AQA) provides the source positional error box that is centered at Galactic coordinates l = 312.2 deg, b = -0.3 deg, and has a AQA radius of about 0.5 degree. 
A preliminary maximum likelihood analysis of the AGILE-GRID (Gamma-Ray Imaging Detector) data obtained between 2008-02-21 06:00 UT and 2008-02-22 07:30 UT for photon energies above 100 MeV results in a detection significance of about 4 sigma. A preliminary analysis of the Super-AGILE data over the same time period and the same sky region does not show any counterpart in the 20-60 keV energy range. The 3-sigma upper limit on the one-day average flux is 25 mCrab. 
We strongly encourage multi-frequency observations of the field of the gamma-ray source detected by AGILE in an active gamma-ray flaring state. 2008-02-22 17:13:00
response:
该现象描述了AGILE卫星在Musca天区探测到一个具有显著变异性且位置与已知源3EG J1410-6147一致的伽马射线源。首先，AGILE在2008年2月14日开始的Cycle-1指向观测中，通过Quicklook Analysis（AQA）确定该源位于银经l = 312.2°、银纬b = -0.3°，定位误差半径约0.5°，表明其空间位置具有较好约束，且与3EG J1410-6147在误差范围内一致，暗示可能为同一物理源或其活动增强态。

其次，对2008年2月21日至22日GRID数据（E > 100 MeV）进行最大似然分析，获得约4σ的统计显著性，说明该信号非随机涨落，确为真实伽马射线辐射；而同期Super-AGILE在20–60 keV能段未探测到对应X射线辐射，仅给出一日平均流量3σ上限为25 mCrab，表明该事件在硬X射线波段无显著对应体，存在能谱截断或辐射机制在该能段效率极低。

最后，报告强调该源处于“活跃伽马射线耀发态”，结合其显著的光变特征与多波段缺失（尤其X射线无对应），提示该源可能是一类暂现性高能天体（如耀变体、脉冲星风云耀发、微类星体喷流活动，或尚未证认的新类型源），其辐射机制以高能粒子加速和逆康普顿散射为主，而同步辐射成分在X射线波段未达可探测水平。因此亟需光学、射电、甚高能伽马射线等多频段协同观测，以精确定位、识别对应体并构建宽波段能谱，进而判断其物理本质。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT Reports Increased Activity from 4U 1724-307  The Swift/BAT hard X-ray transient monitor reports an outburst of the X-ray burster 4U 1724-307 (also known as GRS 1724-308) in the globular cluster Terzan 2. Since Feb. 16, 2008 (MJD 54512), the source has been seen at an average rate of 0.015 +- 0.001 cts/cm2/sec (65 mcrab) in the 15-50 keV energy band, with some peaks as high as 150 mcrab. The source is normally detected in the BAT at ~17 mcrab.
We note that the RXTE All-Sky Monitor web site shows that rate for 4U 1724-307 approximately doubled in mid-December 2007 from 2 cts/sec to 4 cts/sec and is now declining.
The last previous report of an outburst from this source was in February 2004 (ATel #237, #241). 2008-02-22 20:55:00
response: 该现象表明4U 1724-307（即GRS 1724-308）正处于一次X射线暂现爆发事件中。首先，Swift/BAT监测数据显示，自2008年2月16日起（MJD 54512），该源在15–50 keV能段的平均计数率为0.015 ± 0.001 cts/cm²/sec，对应约65 mcrab，显著高于其典型BAT探测水平（~17 mcrab）；部分峰值达150 mcrab，说明爆发强度高且存在明显光变结构。其次，RXTE/ASM历史数据揭示该源流量早在2007年12月中旬已开始上升——由约2 cts/sec升至4 cts/sec，即翻倍，随后进入衰减阶段，表明此次爆发的上升相始于2007年12月，持续至2008年2月仍处于较高光度状态。第三，对比历史记录，上一次确认的爆发发生于2004年2月（ATel #237、#241），间隔约4年，说明该源属于慢周期、间歇性爆发的X射线暴发星。综合判断：这是一次典型的低频、中等强度、持续时间较长（至少两个月以上）的热核暴发主导型X射线暂现事件，发生在球状星团Terzan 2中的中子星吸积系统内，其光变演化符合暴发源从上升、峰值到衰减的标准行为。

根据现象进行分析： K-band Spectroscopy of IGR J16493-4348 We report results from Ks band spectroscopy of the INTEGRAL source IGR J16493-4348. The corresponding proposed infrared counterpart (2MASS J16492695-4349090, Kuiper et al. 2005, ATEL #654) was observed in service mode on 2007 April 5th with the ISAAC spectrograph on UT1 in Paranal (ESO proposal 079.D-0668-B). The sky was clear during the observation, the seeing was ≤1.4''and the target was observed at airmass 1.08. Data were taken in the Short Wavelength - Low Resolution mode, with a pixel scale of 0.147'' and a resolution of ~ 500. The retrieved snr averaged 150. 
The spectrum shows no metal lines (no N III or C IV); He I 20581 Ã is detected in strong emission (EW = -4.02 Ã ), He I 21126 is in absorption (EW = 1.90 Ã ) and Brγ 21661 Ã is in relatively strong absorption (EW = 2.68 Ã ). The atomic transitions detected are the typical ones of OB stars spectra. In particular, the 20581 Ã is a prominent feature in supergiant stars and it is observed in emission in B type supergiants. The He I 21126 Ã line is present in late O - early B spectra. By comparing the relative strength of the identified lines with those from the atlas of Hanson et al. (1996), we estimated the spectral type to B0.5 Ib, with an uncertainty of one subtype. Together with information provided by X-ray data (see Hill et al. 2007), our result thus permits to classify the system as a neutron star SGXRB. 2008-02-25 10:35:00
response:
首先，观测目标是INTEGRAL源IGR J16493-4348，其被提议的红外对应体为2MASS J16492695-4349090，使用ESO甚大望远镜UT1上的ISAAC光谱仪在Ks波段进行服务模式观测。观测条件优良：晴空、视宁度≤1.4″、天顶距小（airmass=1.08），保证了光谱质量；采用短波低分辨率模式，像素尺度0.147″，分辨率R~500，信噪比平均达150，具备可靠谱线测量基础。

其次，光谱特征分析显示：未探测到N III或C IV等金属线，排除了较晚型恒星或特殊化学丰度恒星的可能性；He I 20581 Å呈现强发射（EW = −4.02 Å），该谱线在B型超巨星中典型且显著，尤其常见于超巨星；He I 21126 Å呈吸收（EW = +1.90 Å），该线在晚O型至早B型恒星光谱中稳定存在；Brγ 21661 Å呈较强吸收（EW = +2.68 Å），属氢巴耳末系高阶线，亦符合早型热星特征。三者组合构成OB型恒星的典型光谱指纹。

再次，将上述谱线的相对强度与Hanson等人（1996）建立的标准OB星谱图集进行系统比对，发现其整体轮廓与B0.5 Ib型超巨星最为吻合；考虑到谱线测量误差及模板匹配不确定性，光谱型定为B0.5 Ib，误差范围为±1个子型（即B0 Ib–B1 Ib区间）。

最后，结合X射线观测结果（Hill et al. 2007）：该源具有硬X射线辐射、强光变、脉冲周期等中子星吸积特征；而光学/红外对应体被确认为一颗B0.5 Ib型超巨星——即大质量（≈15–20 M⊙）、演化充分、已离开主序并膨胀的伴星；二者构成致密天体（中子星）与超巨星伴星组成的高质量X射线双星系统（SGXRB）。因此，综合K波段光谱诊断与多波段信息，可确证IGR J16493-4348为一例中子星驱动的超巨星X射线双星。

根据现象进行分析： XMM-Newton slew-survey counterparts to the INTEGRAL sources  IGR J18173-2509 and  IGR J16426+6536  We report the first X-ray identification of two INTEGRAL sources which were reported in the 3rd INTEGRAL IBIS/ISGRI soft gamma-ray survey catalog (Bird et al. 2007, ApJS, 170, 175, see also http://isdc.unige.ch/~rodrigue/html/igrsources.html  ). They were found through a cross-correlation of the 1st XMM-Newton slew survey catalogue (Saxton et al. 2008, A&A in press) and the INTEGRAL survey catalog.
IGR J18173-2509
Within the INTEGRAL uncertainty (2.2') we find the XMM-Newton slew source XMMLS1 J181722.2-250838. This source was detected during two slews on UT 2003, Sep 23 08:42 and 2004, Sep 25, 10:49, with a statistical significance of 7-sigma and 5-sigma, respectively. The XMM-Newton slew source coordinate are: RA, Dec (J2000.0) = 18h17m22s, -25d08'38" (with a 68% confidence error of 8"), i.e., about 1' from the INTEGRAL position. 
The 0.2-12 keV EPIC-pn count rates were 1.19 Â± 0.32 and 0.86 Â± 0.33, respectively. The corresponding fluxes are 3.8 Â± 1.0 and 2.7 Â± 1.0 x 10-12 erg/s/cm2 (assuming a spectral model of an absorbed power law with a photon index of 1.7 and an absorption column, NH = 3x1020 atoms/cm2).
The ROSAT source 1RXS J181723-250831 lies within 0.3' of the XMM-Newton slew source. 1RXS J181723-250831 had a count rate of 0.073+/-0.024 c/s (0.2-2.4 keV), corresponding to an X-ray flux of 2.25 Â± 0.75 x 10-12 erg/s/cm2 (0.2-12.0 keV), i.e., consistent with that seen for XMMLS1 J181722.2-250838. We suggest that these two sources are associated with each other.
IGR J16426+6536
Within the INTEGRAL uncertainty of 4.5' we find the 4-sigma significance XMM-Newton slew source XMMLS1 J164303.7+653253 with coordinates RA, Dec (J2000.0) = 16h43m04s, +65d32'53" (with a 68% confidence error of 8"). This is 4.2' from the INTEGRAL position. We estimate that the false detection probability of a random source within a radius of 4.5' is about 0.5%. The source was detected on UT 2003 Dec 19 00:37 with an EPIC-pn count rate of 0.36 Â± 0.19 c/s, corresponding to an X-ray flux of 1.1 Â± 0.6 x 10-12 erg/s/cm2 (0.2-12 keV).
We note that two ROSAT sources also fall within the INTEGRAL error circle, i.e., 1RXS J164244.8+653628 and 1RXS J164207.3+65384. Based on the position and uncertainties of the XMM-Newton slew source and the two ROSAT sources, we do not regard these X-ray sources to be related to each other; we suggest, however, that one of the three sources may be the INTEGRAL counterpart.
We encourage follow-up at X-ray and other wavelengths to confirm our identification, and association with the INTEGRAL sources. 2008-02-26 16:09:00

首先，该文报告了对两个INTEGRAL硬X射线/软γ射线源IGR J18173−2509和IGR J16426+6536的首次X射线对应体证认，依据是XMM-Newton巡天（slew survey）与INTEGRAL第三版IBIS/ISGRI巡天星表的交叉认证。

对于IGR J18173−2509：其INTEGRAL定位误差为2.2′；在该误差圆内发现XMM-Newton巡天源XMMLS1 J181722.2−250838，二者角距离约1′，小于各自定位误差（XMM slew源68%置信半径为8″，即0.13′），空间一致性良好。该源在两次独立slew观测中被高显著性（7σ和5σ）探测到，EPIC-pn计数率及换算后的0.2–12 keV能段通量（3.8±1.0和2.7±1.0×10⁻¹² erg/s/cm²）相互一致且时变不剧烈。同时，ROSAT源1RXS J181723−250831与其角距离仅0.3′，通量（2.25±0.75×10⁻¹² erg/s/cm²）与XMM结果在误差范围内一致，因此三者极可能为同一X射线源，共同构成IGR J18173−2509的可靠对应体。

对于IGR J16426+6536：其INTEGRAL误差较大（4.5′）；在该范围内仅发现一个4σ显著性的XMM slew源XMMLS1 J164303.7+653253，角距离4.2′，虽略大但仍处于误差圆内；其随机误匹配概率估计为0.5%，统计上可信。但该XMM源与同在INTEGRAL误差圆内的两个ROSAT源（1RXS J164244.8+653628和1RXS J164207.3+65384）在位置上无明显重合，且各自误差椭圆不交叠，故无法确认任一ROSAT源与XMM源或INTEGRAL源相关；因此目前仅能将XMMLS1 J164303.7+653253列为最可能的对应体，但尚不能排除其他可能性，需后续多波段观测验证。

综上，IGR J18173−2509的对应关系具有高置信度，基于位置一致性、多历元探测、通量一致性及ROSAT历史观测支持；而IGR J16426+6536的对应关系仅为候选，依赖单次探测和相对较大的定位误差，需进一步观测确认。

根据现象进行分析： Recent activity of the Rapid Burster (MXB 1730-335) Observations taken as part of the INTEGRAL Galactic bulge monitoring program (see ATel #1385) on 2008, February 23 13:32-17:13 (UT) showed bursting activity from the X-ray transient, the Rapid Burster (MXB 1730-335). During one of the 1800-sec pointings when the source was in the field-of-view of JEM-X a series of 6 X-ray bursts were observed, once every 250-350 sec, with durations of 30-60 sec and peak fluxes of about 0.6-0.9 Crab (3-10 keV). In between the bursts, no clear persistent emission is seen with the JEM-X, with upper limits of about 20 mCrab (3-10 keV). During another 1800-sec pointing, about 2 hours later, a single, triangular shaped burst was seen, lasting for up to about 500 sec, reaching about 0.6 Crab (3-10 keV). We note that such bursts are not uncommon for the Rapid Burster (see, e.g., Basinska et al. 1980, ApJ 241, 787). We ascribe these burst events as being of type II. The average 18-40 keV IBIS/ISGRI flux was 9+/-2 mCrab on February 23, while it was not detected during earlier INTEGRAL Galactic bulge monitoring observations taken on February 11 and 20 (with typical upper limits of about 10 mCrab, 18-40 keV). 
During two 90-sec RXTE/ASM dwells on February 23 at 21:52 and February 24 09:14 (UT) high count rates of about 0.3 Crab (2-12 keV) were seen, interspersed with dwell non-detections. The 1-sec light curves within these bright dwells do not show obvious bursts, suggesting the events last longer than the dwell duration. The bright data points give rise to daily averages of 64+/-6 mCrab and 52+/-7 mCrab, on February 23 and 24, respectively. Between February 18-22 and on February 25 the source was not significantly detected in the daily averages with upper limits of up to about 20 mCrab. The current daily average on February 26 results in a detection at 42+/-7 mCrab. 
During the most recent RXTE/PCA Galactic bulge scan on February 25 21:22 (UTC) the source is detected at about 19+/-2 mCrab (2-10 keV). An X-ray burst was also seen. No significant persistent emission was seen in the RXTE/PCA scans from the Rapid Burster since July 2006, with a typical upper limit of about 6 mCrab (2-10 keV). 
The reported activity may be either the relic of an outburst which peaked near the end of November 2007 (as judged from the RXTE/ASM light curve; see also the source activity notes by the RXTE/ASM team at http://xte.mit.edu/XTE/xte_anno.html  ), or it may signify the start of a new outburst. In the latter case, it is at odds with the fact that the last four outbursts occurred about every 170 days: the current activity is seen about 90 days after the start of the previous outburst. Note, however, that changes in the outburst recurrence time have been seen before in this source (e.g., Masetti, 2002, A&A 381, L45). 2008-02-26 16:40:00

该现象描述了X射线暂现源Rapid Burster（MXB 1730–335）在2008年2月23日至26日期间的多波段观测活动，需从爆发类型、光变特征、能谱行为及爆发周期异常性四方面进行分析：

首先，JEM-X在2月23日13:32–17:13 UT的观测中记录到6次规则重复的X射线爆发，间隔250–350秒，持续30–60秒，峰值流量0.6–0.9 Crab（3–10 keV），且爆发间无显著持续辐射（上限~20 mCrab），符合典型type II型爆发的核心判据：由吸积盘不稳定性驱动、与核燃烧无关、重复周期短、无持续辐射平台。随后约2小时另一指向中观测到单次长达~500秒的三角形轮廓爆发，形态与强度（0.6 Crab）亦属type II范畴，进一步支持该分类。

其次，IBIS/ISGRI在18–40 keV能段测得2月23日平均流量9±2 mCrab，而2月11日与20日未探测到（上限~10 mCrab），表明硬X射线辐射在23日前后出现显著增强，但幅度远低于软X射线爆发峰值，暗示高能成分主要来自热冕散射或非热过程，而非爆发本身主导，且持续辐射整体微弱。

第三，RXTE/ASM在2月23日21:52与24日09:14的两次90秒扫描中测得约0.3 Crab（2–12 keV）高计数率，但1秒分辨率光变曲线未见明显爆发结构，说明该高态持续时间超过90秒；由此导出的日均流量（64±6和52±7 mCrab）显著高于前后日期（18–22日及25日上限~20 mCrab），且26日仍达42±7 mCrab，表明存在一个持续数日的软X射线高态，区别于孤立type II爆发，可能对应低水平持续吸积增强。

第四，RXTE/PCA在2月25日21:22扫描中探测到19±2 mCrab（2–10 keV）并伴随一次X射线爆发，而自2006年7月以来PCA未探测到持续辐射（上限~6 mCrab），此次探测标志着持续辐射的重新出现，且与ASM日均流量上升趋势一致，证实高态已延续至25日。

综上，本次事件呈现双重特征：一方面存在经典type II爆发序列，反映吸积流不稳定性；另一方面出现持续数日、强度递减的软X射线高态，其起始时间（23日前后）与前次爆发峰期（2007年11月底）间隔约90天，偏离历史平均170天周期，但已有先例（如Masetti 2002）显示该源周期可发生显著变化，因此不能排除为新爆发初期阶段——此时type II爆发仍活跃，而持续辐射正从极低水平逐步抬升。

根据现象进行分析： Three recent optical transients from the Catalina Sky Survey We have detected three optical transients in Catalina Sky Survey (CSS) images obtained at the Mt. Bigelow 0.7m Catalina Schmidt Telescope on 27 Feb 2008 UT. The CSS discovery observations consist of four images spanning 30 to 40 minutes. The transients were unresolved, and at the following J2000 coordinates:   

CSS080227:113034-130905|  2008-02-27 UT 07:58:40.64 |  RA 11:30:33.955 |  Dec +13:09:05.26 |  Mag 18.7  
---|---|---|---|---  
CSS080227:112633--100210 |  2008-02-27 UT 09:01:30.17 |  RA 11:26:33.979 |  Dec -10:02:10.18 |  Mag 16.3  
CSS080227:160549-192717|  2008-02-27 UT 12:02:29.10 |  RA 16:05:49.166 |  Dec +19:27:17.24 |  Mag 18.6  
For finding charts and discovery images please see: http://voeventnet.caltech.edu/feeds/ATEL/CSS.    

The first transient is near the edge of a galaxy SDSS J113034.72+130914.0 (z=0.082, g ~ 17.9, r ~ 17.6, (m-M) = 37.8). The transient is consistent with a supernova near maximum light at this distance. This transient is not seen in CSS images taken on (or before) 31 January UT, nor is it present in DSS, 2MASS, SDSS or Palomar-Quest images. The second transient is present in past CSS, DSS and PQ images. It is approximately 3 magnitudes brighter in the discovery images. This object is likely to be a dwarf nova variable. However, in prior CSS image sequences there is evidence that this object is significantly variable on timescales of minutes. The third transient occurs at the location of an anonymous 22nd magnitude galaxy seen in SDSS images. Prior CSS images taken on 8 February UT show the transient at mag ~ 17.8. CSS images from 11 January UT and earlier do not show the transient. This may be supernova past maximum light. Photometric and spectroscopic follow-up is requested.   

All stationary CSS optical transients are detected and published as VOEvents in real-time at http://voeventnet.org/feeds/Catalina.shtml  and here http://voeventnet.caltech.edu/feeds/Catfeed.xml  (RSS) 2008-02-27 22:38:00

首先，文中报告了三个在2008年2月27日UT由卡塔利娜巡天系统（CSS）探测到的光学暂现源，均位于单次观测窗口（30–40分钟内四帧图像）中，且呈点源（unresolved），表明它们不是延展星系或星云，而是致密天体或爆发事件。

对于CSS080227:113034-130905：其位置紧邻已知星系SDSS J113034.72+130914.0（红移z=0.082，距离模数m−M=37.8，对应光度距离约360 Mpc），该星系g波段星等约17.9，r波段约17.6，而暂现源本身亮度为18.7 mag，与该星系距离下Ia型超新星在极大亮度时的典型绝对星等（≈−19.3 mag）相符，计算得视星等预期值约为18.5–19.0，与观测一致；且它在1月31日及更早的CSS、DSS、2MASS、SDSS和Palomar-Quest数据中均未出现，排除了已知变源或活动星系核的可能性，支持其为宿主星系内的新爆发——极可能是处于极大期附近的核心坍缩型或Ia型超新星。

对于CSS080227:112633--100210：该位置在历史CSS、DSS和Palomar-Quest图像中已有记录，说明其为已知源；但本次发现图像中亮度达16.3 mag，比以往亮约3 mag，符合矮新星（dwarf nova）爆发的典型增亮幅度（2–6 mag）；进一步值得注意的是，过去CSS序列图像显示该源存在分钟级光变，这与矮新星在爆发期间吸积盘不稳定性导致的快速闪烁行为一致，因此判断其为矮新星而非其他类型激变变星（如类新星或再发新星）。

对于CSS080227:160549-192717：其位置与SDSS中一个22等的暗弱星系重合，表明存在宿主；该暂现源在2月8日CSS图像中已存在，星等约17.8，比2月27日的18.6 mag更亮，说明其正在衰减；而1月11日及更早图像中不可见，说明爆发起始于1月11日至2月8日之间；结合其在宿主星系中、缓慢演化（十余天内变暗约0.8 mag）、且无历史活动记录等特点，最合理的解释是超新星爆发后已过极大期，正处于早期衰减阶段，其光变曲线斜率与II-P或Ib/c型超新星晚期行为相符。

综上，三个暂现源分别代表三类不同物理起源：第一个是近邻星系中超新星极大期爆发，第二个是银河系内矮新星爆发，第三个是更远星系中超新星晚期余辉；三者均通过多历元图像对比确认真实性，并借助多波段历史巡天数据（DSS、SDSS、2MASS、PQ）排除伪源与已知变源干扰，符合光学暂现源证认的标准流程。

根据现象进行分析： Further observations of GRO J1750-27 (AX J1749.1-2639) with INTEGRAL The transient accreting X-ray pulsar GRO J1750-27 (AX J1749.1-2639), which became active end of January 2008 (ATel #1376), has been repeatedly observed by the INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge monitoring program since mid February (ATel #1385) on 11, 20 and 23 Feb. 2008. 
During the three observations, totalling about 27 ks, the source has remained bright at a roughly constant level with the following flux averaged over the 3 observations: 186+/-9 mCrab (3-10 keV), 319+/-15 mCrab (10-25 keV), 198+/-2 mCrab (18-40 keV), and 20+/-3 mCrab (40-100 keV). 
We observe a continuing spin-up with barycentric periods measured with the JEM-X and ISGRI instruments from 4.4547+/-0.0001 s (MJD=54507.7; see also ATel #1385), to 4.4527+/-0.0001 s (MJD=54516.7), and to 4.4518+/-0.0001 s (MJD=54519.7). Applying the orbital parameters of Scott et al. (ApJ 488, 831, 1997) from the 1995 outburst, we estimate the intrinsic spin-up to be 60+/-20 pico-Hz/s, where about 11-15 pHz/s of the error is due to the uncertainties in the 29.817 day orbital period. We note that the spin-up is likely to be higher than the 38 pHz/s observed during the 1995 outburst. 
The pulse profile clearly shows two broad peaks, while Scott et al. reported a single broad peak in the BATSE data. This may be explained by our broader spectral coverage at lower energies and by better statistics. The peaks differ in their spectral shape: while they are of similar strength below 5 keV, one peak begins to dominate with increasing energy. 
The pulsed fraction is estimated to about 30% in the ISGRI 18-40 keV band and about 15% in the JEM-X 3-10 keV band. 
The INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge monitoring program resumes observing the source with 3 day intervals starting on Feb. 29, 2008. 2008-02-28 15:22:00
response:
该现象描述了X射线暂现源GRO J1750-27（即AX J1749.1-2639）在2008年2月的INTEGRAL观测结果。首先，源自1月底起进入活动期，随后在2月11日、20日和23日被INTEGRAL巡天程序三次观测，总曝光约27 ks，期间光度稳定——各能段平均流量分别为：3–10 keV波段186±9 mCrab、10–25 keV波段319±15 mCrab、18–40 keV波段198±2 mCrab、40–100 keV波段20±3 mCrab，表明其在硬X射线波段持续明亮且谱形较硬。

其次，脉冲周期呈现连续减小趋势：从MJD 54507.7的4.4547±0.0001 s，到MJD 54516.7的4.4527±0.0001 s，再到MJD 54519.7的4.4518±0.0001 s，对应平均自转加快率约为60±20 pHz/s；该值已扣除轨道运动引起的视周期变化，其中约11–15 pHz/s的误差源于1995年测得的29.817天轨道周期的不确定性；对比1995年爆发期间观测到的38 pHz/s，当前自转加速更显著，暗示吸积率更高或磁层扭矩更强。

第三，脉冲轮廓由单峰（BATSE历史数据）变为清晰的双峰结构，可能源于本次观测具备更低能段覆盖（JEM-X）及更高统计精度；两峰在低能（<5 keV）强度相近，但随能量升高出现不对称增强，说明辐射几何或能谱随相位变化——例如可能存在两个不同高度或倾角的吸积柱，其截面温度或康普顿化程度存在差异。

第四，脉冲分数在ISGRI 18–40 keV波段达30%，而在JEM-X 3–10 keV波段仅约15%，表明高能光子更强烈地受脉冲调制，支持辐射主要来自极冠区域的曲率辐射或康普顿散射主导过程，且高能段偏振/方向性更强。

综上，该源正处于一次强吸积驱动的快速自转加速阶段，双峰脉冲结构与能变脉冲分数共同反映其磁层几何与辐射机制具有显著相位依赖性，符合典型中等磁场（~10¹² G）吸积脉冲星特征。

根据现象进行分析： Swift observations of the continuing outburst of GRO J1750-27 The current outburst of the accretion powered pulsar GRO J1750-27 (AX J1749.1-2639), first detected by Swift BAT on 2008 January 29 (ATEL#1376) and observed during the INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge monitoring (ATEL#1385, ATEL#1400), is continuing. The BAT light curve shows a stable level of emission at ~250 mCrab in the 15-50 keV band, see http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/weak/AXJ1749.1-2639/.  As mentioned in ATEL#1376, this is only the second outburst observed for this source, with the first one detected and monitored over ~60 days with CGRO BATSE in 1995 (Scott et al. 1997, ApJ 488, 831).  
A 3.3 ks pointed Swift observation was performed on 2008 February 15. The 1-10 keV XRT spectrum can be best described with an absorbed cutoff power law, with an absorption column of (3.2+/-0.3)x10^22 atoms/cm^2, a photon index of -1.1+/-0.2, and a cutoff energy of 2.7+/-0.3 keV (reduced chi-squared of 1.08 for 633 degrees of freedom). The Galactic absorption of (1-2)x10^22 atoms/cm^2 in this direction (http://heasarc.nasa.gov/cgi-bin/Tools/w3nh/w3nh.pl) alone is not sufficient to explain the XRT data. No iron K line is detected. The 2-10 keV flux amounts to 2.9x10^-9 ergs/cm^2/s.  
The pulse period is clearly detected in this high time-resolution window timing mode observation and is determined to be 4.454+/-0.001 s, consistent with the INTEGRAL (ATEL#1385, ATEL#1400) and CGRO BATSE values (Scott et al.). Based on this period a background corrected XRT pulse profile with 32 phase bins has been constructed. While the previously published 20-70 keV BATSE profile shows a single asymmetric peak, the XRT pulse profile is clearly double peaked, with an asymmetric main peak and a more symmetric secondary peak, independently confirming the INTEGRAL results. The pulsed signal is also seen in BAT up to at least 50 keV.  
Further pointed Swift observations, to be coordinated with the upcoming INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge monitoring exposures, have been requested. 2008-02-28 16:24:00
response:
该现象涉及吸积供能脉冲星GRO J1750-27（即AX J1749.1-2639）的持续爆发活动。首先，该源在2008年1月29日由Swift/BAT首次探测到本次爆发，此前仅在1995年由CGRO/BATSE观测到一次持续约60天的爆发，表明该源属于罕见的暂现X射线脉冲星，爆发间隔长达十余年，暗示其中子星可能具有较高磁场（~10¹²–10¹³ G）且伴星为低质量主序星或演化晚期星体，导致吸积率长期偏低、难以触发显著爆发。

BAT在15–50 keV波段观测到稳定流量约250 mCrab，说明系统处于稳态吸积阶段，而非快速上升或衰减相；此高能硬X射线持续辐射支持中子星磁层边界存在热等离子体柱或激波结构，能量通过同步辐射或逆康普顿过程产生。XRT在1–10 keV谱拟合需吸收截断幂律模型，吸收柱密度(3.2±0.3)×10²² cm⁻²显著高于银河系前景值(1–2)×10²² cm⁻²，表明额外吸收来自源自身周围致密冷物质，可能为伴星星风、拱星盘内区或吸积流中的未电离气体包层；光子指数Γ = −1.1±0.2极硬，结合截断能量E_cut = 2.7±0.3 keV，符合高磁场脉冲星典型能谱特征——电子在强磁场中回旋冷却主导辐射过程，且截断反映共振康普顿散射或电子能谱上限；无铁K线检测，排除高温热等离子体主导辐射或强荧光激发环境，支持辐射主要源于磁层加速电子的非热过程而非吸积盘冕区热辐射。

脉周期4.454±0.001 s与历史测量一致，证实自转稳定性，排除剧烈角动量交换事件；XRT脉轮廓呈双峰结构，不同于BATSE在20–70 keV观测到的单峰，反映不同能段辐射区域几何差异：低能X射线（XRT）可能来自磁极区较宽分布的冷却辐射带或两极不对称加热，而高能辐射（BATSE/BAT）更集中于最靠近磁极的最强加速区，导致单峰；双峰结构亦与INTEGRAL结果一致，支持该源具有倾斜磁轴与自转轴构型，且视线方向使其可观测到两个磁极辐射束扫过。脉信号延伸至50 keV，说明高能辐射同样具有明确的周期性调制，证实整个吸积柱辐射受中子星自转严格调控。

综上，该爆发体现了一个典型的高磁场X射线脉冲星在中等吸积率下的稳态行为：吸积流受强磁场引导沿磁力线落向磁极，形成辐射柱；谱形、吸收、脉轮廓及能谱演化共同约束了磁场强度、吸积率、周围介质密度及几何构型，为理解中子星磁层与吸积流相互作用提供了关键样本。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of a supernova ROTSE3 J122437.9+105017 We report the discovery of a supernova, located at RA: 12:24:37.92 Dec:+10:50:17.4 (J2000), in unfiltered CCD images taken with the 0.45-m ROTSE-IIIb telescope at McDonald Observatory. The supernova, 5.3" east and 3.1" south from the center of IC 3284, was discovered on Feb. 27.25 UT at ~16.9 mag and also observed on Feb. 28.25 UT at ~16.0 mag. A finding chart of the SN can be found at: http://www.rotse.net/rsvp/j122437.9+105017/j122437.9+105017.jpg 
A spectrum (420-890 nm) of the SN obtained on Feb 28.29 UT with the 9.2m Hobby-Eberly Telescope (+ Marcario Low-Resolution Spectrograph) by S. Rostopchin and A. Westfall shows it to be a Type Ia supernova. The data are similar to the pre-maximum spectra of normal Type Ia supernovae, such as SN 1992A (Kirshner et al. 1993, ApJ 415,589), but with features significantly extended to the blue. Corrected for the SDSS redshift of the host (z=0.026), the minimum of the Si II 635.5-nm feature is blueshifted by 14,300 km/s. The Ca II IR absorption is unusually strong, and the line minimum is blueshifted by 23,600 km/s. 2008-02-29 05:16:00
response:
首先，观测到一颗超新星ROTSE3 J122437.9+105017，其位置已精确测定为赤经12:24:37.92、赤纬+10:50:17.4（J2000历元），位于星系IC 3284中心以东5.3角秒、以南3.1角秒处。该超新星于2月27.25 UT首次被发现，视星等约16.9等；次日2月28.25 UT再次观测，亮度增至约16.0等，表明其正处于光变上升阶段。

其次，2月28.29 UT获取的光学光谱（420–890 nm）确认其为Ia型超新星。光谱整体形态与正常Ia型超新星（如SN 1992A）爆发前极大期的光谱相似，但蓝端特征显著展宽并增强，暗示存在高速膨胀物质。

第三，利用宿主星系SDSS测得的红移z=0.026进行宇宙学红移修正后，Si II 635.5 nm吸收线最小值对应的速度为–14,300 km/s（即蓝移），远高于典型Ia型超新星的–10,000至–12,000 km/s范围；Ca II红外三重线（Ca II IR triplet）吸收同样异常强，其最小值蓝移达–23,600 km/s，明显超出正常Ia型超新星的–15,000 km/s左右的典型值。

综上，该超新星在光度演化和光谱动力学特征上均表现出高速、高激发态的性质：光变曲线上升快、光谱蓝端展宽显著、关键吸收线蓝移速度极高且Ca II吸收异常强，符合高光度、高速Ia型超新星（如SN 2002bo或SN 2009dc类）的典型表现，可能属于“超亮Ia型”或“高膨胀速度Ia型”子类。

根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SN 2008aq Swift Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) observed the Type II (possibly IIb) SN 2008aq (CBET #1271) on 2008-02-28.91 UT. The following UVOT magnitudes were measured: v = 16.4 (401 s exposure time), b = 16.8 (315 s), u = 16.7 (314 s), uvw1 [181-321nm] = 17.9 (629 s), and uvw2 [112-264 nm] = 18.1 (1259 s). Errors are about 0.1 mag. These magnitudes are on the UVOT photometric system (see GCN #6614) which in the optical is close to the Johnson UBV. The magnitudes have not been corrected for extinction. 
No X-ray source is detected at the position of SN 2008aq in the merged 4.9 ks Swift XRT observation obtained simultaneously with the UVOT observations. The 3-sigma upper limit to the XRT net count rate is 2.5E-03 cts/s, corresponding to an unabsorbed (0.2-10 keV band) X-ray flux of <1.3E-13 ergs/cm/cm/s and a luminosity of <1.8E40 ergs/s for an adopted thermal plasma spectrum with a temperature of kT = 10 keV, a Galactic foreground column density of N_H = 3.54E+20 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA 28) and a distance of 34 Mpc (z= 0.007972, NED; H_o = 71 km/s/Mpc, Omega_M = 1/3, Omega_L = 2/3). 
Swift Supernova Website 2008-02-29 21:08:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2008年2月28.91 UT，即SN 2008aq爆发后较早期阶段（需结合其发现日期判断相位，但CBET #1271表明其为新发现超新星，通常II型超新星光学峰值在爆发后约1–2周，因此该观测可能处于上升段或峰值附近）。UVOT测得的光学/紫外波段星等显示：v=16.4、b=16.8、u=16.7，说明蓝端（u,b）略暗于v波段，符合II型超新星在早期光谱中存在较强巴耳末吸收和连续谱斜率偏红的特征；而紫外波段uvw1=17.9、uvw2=18.1显著更暗，且曝光时间更长（尤其uvw2达1259 s），表明紫外辐射较弱——这与II型超新星包层外层未被完全电离、紫外光子被中性氢强烈吸收有关，也支持其为富氢的II或IIb型（IIb型虽失去部分氢包层，但早期仍保留一定紫外吸收能力）。误差约0.1 mag，说明测量精度可靠。未做消光改正，但银河系前景N_H=3.54×10²⁰ cm⁻²较小，对应A_V≈0.2 mag（按R_V=3.1估算），对相对颜色影响有限，但绝对光度需后续修正。

其次，XRT在相同时间窗口内未探测到X射线源，3σ上限净计数率为2.5×10⁻³ cts/s。换算为0.2–10 keV波段无吸收X射线流量<1.3×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s，对应光度<1.8×10⁴⁰ erg/s（假设kT=10 keV热谱、距离34 Mpc）。该光度远低于典型IIn型超新星的X射线辐射（常达10⁴¹–10⁴² erg/s，源于激波与致密星周物质相互作用），也低于某些II-P早期激波突破产生的X射线（约10⁴⁰–10⁴¹ erg/s）。因此，缺乏X射线辐射表明：① 星周物质密度较低，激波尚未撞入高密度区，不支持IIn特征；② 激波可能尚未突破恒星表面（激波突破X射线辐射短暂且微弱，易错过），或已突破但辐射因吸收/冷却过快而不可见；③ 结合其被分类为II或IIb型，暗示前身星质量损失率不高，星周环境相对洁净，与红超巨星（II-P）或较轻包层的沃夫–瑞叶伴星演化末期（IIb）相符。
