根据现象进行分析： XTE J1810-189 is a Neutron Star  In a pointed observation of XTE J1810-189 (ATEL #1424, #1430, #1432, #1441) on 2008-03-26 at 12:47 UT, the RXTE PCA detected an X-ray burst from the source. The burst shows a clear thermal spectrum and cooling trend, which indicates it is a thermonuclear burst from a neutron star. 
No burst oscillations or other high frequency timing properties were detected. 
The peak burst X-ray flux was about 2.5E-8 erg/s/cm2 (bolometric, unabsorbed). Assuming that the Type-I X-ray burst reached the critical Eddington bolometric peak luminosity of 3.8E38 erg/s (Kuulkers et al. 2003, A&A, 399, 663), the distance upper limit is about 11.5 kpc. The absorbing column density was fixed at the value derived by Swift XRT, 3.8e22 cm-2(Starling et al., ATEL #1441). 
We note the discrepancy between the previously reported position by PCA (ATEL #1424) and follow-up observations by Swift and INTEGRAL (ATEL #1430, #1432, #1441). This discrepancy is likely caused by at least two factors. First, the source is quite variable, which may confuse the PCA scanning technique (i.e. an intensity variation could be mistaken for a position variation). Although the variability was accounted for in an average sense, it is impossible to account for individual fluctuations. Also, the source is near the galactic ridge and several other point sources, which may have also affected the position accuracy. 2008-03-27 01:03:00
response:
XTE J1810-189被确认为一颗中子星，依据是RXTE PCA在2008年3月26日12:47 UT的定点观测中探测到一次X射线暴。该暴具有清晰的热谱特征和随时间演化的冷却趋势，这是中子星表面发生热核燃烧（即I型X射线暴）的典型表现。  
未探测到暴振荡或其他高频时变信号，说明此次暴未呈现明显的中子星自转调制效应，可能与暴发几何结构、视线方向或信噪比有关。  
暴峰值流量为2.5×10⁻⁸ erg/s/cm²（各向同性、未吸收、全波段），结合I型暴达到爱丁顿极限光度3.8×10³⁸ erg/s的假设，可推得源距离上限约为11.5 kpc；该计算依赖于固定吸收柱密度N_H = 3.8×10²² cm⁻²（由Swift XRT测定）。  
PCA早期给出的位置与后续Swift及INTEGRAL观测结果存在偏差，原因有二：一是源本身光变剧烈，PCA扫描定位法易将强度起伏误判为位置偏移，尽管已对平均光变做了校正，但无法消除瞬时涨落的影响；二是该源位于银经致密区域（银河脊附近），周围存在多个邻近点源，造成PSF混叠与定位混淆，进一步降低PCA角分辨率下的位置精度。

根据现象进行分析： Swift observations of the SFXT IGR J11215-5952 at P/4 We performed two observations with Swift/XRT of the transient IGR J11215-5952, the unique member of the class of the Supergiant Fast X-ray Transients (SFXTs) which undergoes periodic outbursts. 
At first, the outbursts were found to be equally spaced by P=329 days (Sidoli et al. 2006, A&A,450,L9; Smith et al. 2006,ATel #766), but during a monitoring campaign with Swift/XRT at the supposed apastron passage, a new unexpected outburst was observed (Romano et al. 2007, ATel #1151; Sidoli et al. 2007, A&A,476,1307), after 165 days from the previous outburst, at half the period reported by Sidoli et al (2006,A&A,450,L9). This is probably the true orbital period of the system, although a period of 329 days is not completely ruled out (see Sidoli et al., 2007, A&A, 476, 1307, for a discussion on the two possible geometries). 
The current observation occurred at a quarter of the period reported by Sidoli et al (2006,A&A,450,L9), or half the period reported in Sidoli et al (2007,A&A,476,1307). 
The first observation lasted 1.8 ks, starting on 2008-03-25 at 00:16:42 UT, the second lasted 1.8 ks, starting on 2008-03-27 at 00:26:47 UT. 
The source was not detected in either observation. The 3sigma upper limits on the unabsorbed flux (obtained assuming the spectral parameters based on the 2007 February outburst reported in Romano et al. 2007,A&AL,469,L5; photon index=1.0, column density=1.0E+22 cm-2) are 1.7E-12 and 2.3E-12 erg/cm2/s (1-10 keV). The 3sigma upper limit on the unabsorbed flux of the cumulative observation is 1.1E-12 erg/cm2/s (1-10 keV), which translates into a 1-10 keV luminosity of 5E+33 erg/s at 6.2 kpc. The 3sigma upper limit on the unabsorbed flux can be compared with the 2.3E-12, 9.2E-12, 9.5e-12, erg/cm2/s obtained during the 2007 February outburst at T-48 hours, T-24 hours T+24 hours, respectively. 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for making these observations possible, in particular N. Gehrels, D. Burrows, the duty scientists as well as the science planners. 2008-03-27 12:12:00
response:
首先，观测目标是超巨星快速X射线暂现源（SFXT）IGR J11215−5952，该源具有周期性爆发特征，是此类源中唯一已知存在规则爆发的成员。初始研究（Sidoli et al. 2006；Smith et al. 2006）基于早期爆发时间间隔得出轨道周期为P = 329天，这一周期被解释为可能对应于双星系统的轨道周期，且爆发被推测发生在近星点附近。

然而，2007年Swift/XRT在预期的远星点（apastron）附近开展监测时，意外探测到一次新爆发，其发生时间距前次爆发仅约165天，恰好为329天的一半。该结果强烈暗示真实轨道周期更可能是165天（即P/2），因为165天与双星轨道运动的物理预期更为自洽——例如，若吸积盘或星风结构具有对称性，或轨道偏心率较高且爆发由恒星风不均匀性与轨道相位共同调制，则半周期爆发可能反映真实轨道周期。Sidoli et al. (2007) 指出，尽管329天周期未被完全排除（例如可能对应于某种长周期调制或轨道进动），但165天周期在几何和动力学上更具合理性。

本次Swift/XRT观测安排在原报告周期329天的四分之一处（即82.25天），也恰为修正后周期165天的二分之一处（即82.5天），因此处于两个候选周期框架下的同一相对相位点：若P = 165天，则此次观测位于上一次爆发后半个周期，即预期可能再次出现爆发的相位；若P = 329天，则此次位于四分之一周期，偏离典型爆发窗口，预期处于宁静态。

两次短时曝光（各1.8 ks）均未探测到源信号，得到严格的3σ无吸收流量上限：单次观测分别为1.7×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s 和 2.3×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s（1–10 keV），联合累积观测上限为1.1×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s，对应距离6.2 kpc下的光度上限为5×10³³ erg/s。该上限显著低于2007年2月爆发期间多个关键时间点的实测流量（T−48 h: 2.3×10⁻¹²；T−24 h: 9.2×10⁻¹²；T+24 h: 9.5×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s），表明此时源确实处于深度宁静态，未发生可探测的爆发活动。

综上，该次零探测结果支持165天为真实轨道周期的假说：因观测恰在半周期相位（即预期爆发相位），却未见爆发，说明爆发并非严格周期性发生，而可能依赖于额外条件（如局部星风密度阈值、磁场重联触发等），从而体现SFXT的本质特征——“快速”和“暂现”源于瞬态吸积过程，而非连续稳定吸积。同时，该结果也约束了爆发窗口的宽度与重复性，表明即使在有利相位下，爆发亦非必然发生，凸显源的间歇性吸积本质。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SuperAGILE detects an X-ray burst from a position consistent with IGR J17473-2721 During the AGILE pointing at the Galactic Center region SuperAGILE detected a burst from the sky position RA=266.842, Dec=-27.339 (error radius 3 arcmin). This position lies approximately 1.1 arcmin from the position of the source IGR J17473-2721 (Grebenev et al., ATel #467) and approximately 1 arcmin from the proposed counterpart detected by Swift/XRT (Kennea et al., ATel #500) and Chandra (Juett et al., ATel #521). The burst was detected on 26 March 2008, 23:19:40 UT, lasted approximately 40 s and it was significantly detected only in the energy range 17-25 keV. The average flux of the event was about 2.5 Crab. If the identification with IGR J17473-2721 is correct, assuming a distance of 8.5 kpc, the observed average flux corresponds to approximately 0.9 x 10^38 erg/s (17-25 keV), consistent with an Eddington limited flux for a neutron star mass. Considering the intensity, the temporal and spectral properties of the event as well as the spatial coincidence with the source IGR J17473-2721 near the Galactic Center, we propose that the burst observed by SuperAGILE was indeed a Type I X-ray burst, and suggest that IGR J17473-2721 is an X-ray burster. 2008-03-27 13:41:00
response:
首先，SuperAGILE在2008年3月26日23:19:40 UT探测到一次持续约40秒的X射线爆发，位置为赤经266.842度、赤纬−27.339度，误差半径3角分。该位置与已知源IGR J17473-2721（RA=266.822, Dec=−27.345）的距离约为1.1角分，在其误差范围内；同时也靠近Swift/XRT和Chandra分别报告的候选对应体（均距约1角分），空间一致性较强。

其次，该爆发仅在17–25 keV能段显著探测到，未在其他能段呈现明显信号，表明其谱型较硬，符合典型I型X射线暴在上升段或峰值附近的高能特征。平均流量约2.5 Crab，结合8.5 kpc的距离假设，换算得17–25 keV波段光度约为0.9 × 10³⁸ erg/s。

进一步分析：该光度接近中子星爱丁顿极限光度（LEdd ≈ 1.6 × 10³⁸ erg/s × (M/1.4 M⊙)），在合理质量范围内与中子星吸积系统一致；爆发时标（~40 s）处于典型I型暴持续时间范围（数秒至数百秒）；且爆发发生于银河系中心方向的已知硬X射线源附近，排除偶然定位重合的高概率。

综上，空间位置高度吻合、光度符合中子星Eddington限、时标与能谱特征均满足I型X射线暴判据，因此可判定该事件为I型X射线暴，进而支持IGR J17473-2721是一颗X射线暴发源（即中子星低质量X射线双星）。

根据现象进行分析：  NIR counterparts in the Swift error circles of the active transients SAX J1750.8-2900 and XTE J1810-189 We report on Swift TOO follow-up observations of the neutron star transient SAX J1750.8-2900 (Natalucci et al. 1999,ApJ,523,45) as well as infrared observations of the fields containing SAX J1750.8-2900 and the neutron star transient XTE J1810-189 (Markwardt et al. 2008, ATel #1424, #1443).
Swift/XRT observations were performed both in photon counting (PC) and windowed timing (WT) mode during March 24 14:47-15:04 UT and March 25 21:18-21:34 UT. The source was positioned away from any detector hot-columns on the PC data, allowing us to obtain a more accurate localization of this transient. The two observations reveal the source at a position consistent with that reported in Steeghs et al. (2008, ATel #1431). Based on the two independent detections (each with an uncertainty of 3.5"; 90% confidence level), we derived a mean position of: 
R.A.(J200) = 17:50:24.33, Dec(J2000) = -29:02:14.3 
Fits to the 338s X-ray spectrum acquired in WT mode on March 24 using an absorbed power-law model produced acceptable results. The data yield N_H= (2.3 +/- 0.4)e22 cm^-2, a photon index of 1.2 +/- 0.2 and reduced chi**2 = 0.83. Uncertainties are at the 90% level confidence. For the PC spectra we derive similar values. The N_H value is lower than the H column density of ~6e22 cm^-2 obtained from BeppoSAX X-ray spectra (Natalucci et al. 1999) or the 4.4e22 cm^-2 derived from RXTE/PCA observations (Kaaret et al. 2002,ApJ,575,1018).
From the above fits we derive an observed 2 - 10 keV flux of 5.5e-10 erg/cm^2/s on March 24. Analysis of the 92s WT mode data obtained on March 25 supports a 30% decrease in flux between the two Swift observations. Therefore the source has declined in 10 days from a peak brightness of 230 mcrab in the 2-10 keV (Markwardt & Swank 2008, ATel #1425) to a flux of about ~30 mCrab, a value close to the 10 mcrab low-level activity reported at the end of previous outbursts (see Natalucci et al. 1999, Kaaret et al. 2002). Here we have used 1 crab (2-10 keV) ~ 2e-8 erg/cm^2/s as in Kaaret et al. 
We have acquired Ks-band images of the fields containing SAX J1750.8-2900 and XTE J1810-189 on 2008 Mar 18 using the PANIC camera attached to the 6.5m Magellan Baade telescope. Seeing conditions were 0.4"-0.5". An astrometric scale was defined using 2MASS sources in the field of view. We caution that given the stellar densities in these low Galactic latitude fields, the odds of finding a non-related field star or unresolved sources within the Swift X-ray error circle are significant.
Our imaging of SAX J1750.8-2900 reveals several point sources within the 3.5" error circle for the improved X-ray location (see chart). The brightest object is visible in 2MASS frames. 2MASS 1810233-1904136, the proposed infrared counterpart to XTE J1810-189 (Starling et al. 2008, ATel #1441), is resolved in our images into a large number of individual sources that are all consistent with the Swift position (see chart). 
We plan to acquire additional imaging of these fields to identify the correct infrared counterparts (if detectable) through their variability as the outburst activity declines. 
Finding chart for J1810: http://hea-www.harvard.edu/~mtorres/XTEJ1810m189.html 
Finding chart for J1750.8: http://hea-www.harvard.edu/~mtorres/SAXJ1750.8m2900.html 2008-03-28 21:22:00
response:
该现象涉及对两个中子星暂现源SAX J1750.8−2900和XTE J1810−189的多波段观测分析，核心目标是确认其近红外（NIR）对应体。首先，Swift/XRT在2008年3月24日与25日开展了两次X射线观测，采用PC与WT模式，获得高精度定位：R.A.(J2000) = 17:50:24.33，Dec(J2000) = −29:02:14.3，误差半径3.5″（90%置信度），位置与Steeghs et al. (2008)一致。光谱拟合显示吸收柱密度N_H = (2.3 ± 0.4) × 10²² cm⁻²，显著低于BeppoSAX与RXTE历史测量值，暗示吸积盘几何结构或视线方向介质发生改变；光子指数Γ = 1.2 ± 0.2，符合硬谱态特征；2–10 keV能段通量由3月24日的5.5 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s下降约30%，对应流量从峰值230 mCrab衰减至约30 mCrab，接近历史低态水平（~10 mCrab），表明正处于爆发衰减阶段。

与此同时，利用Magellan望远镜PANIC相机于3月18日获取Ks波段图像，视宁度0.4″–0.5″，并以2MASS源完成天体测量定标。在SAX J1750.8−2900的X射线误差圆内发现多个点源，其中最亮者已被2MASS收录；而XTE J1810−189此前被Starling et al. (2008)指认为2MASS 1810233−1904136，但本次高分辨成像显示该位置实为多颗恒星的叠加，均落在Swift误差圆内。由于两源均位于低银纬区域，恒星密度极高，随机落入误差圆内的无关场星概率显著，因此单次静态成像无法唯一确定真实红外对应体。据此推断：必须依赖时域观测——即通过监测各候选体在X射线流量持续衰减过程中的红外光变行为（如相关性光变、颜色变化或消隐），才能排除背景污染、识别真正物理关联的吸积伴星或喷流辐射源。

response: 该光学暂现源由卡塔琳娜巡天系统（CSS）于2008年3月29日世界时07:55:16在Mt. Bigelow 0.7米Catalina施密特望远镜上首次探测到，位置精确对应J2000历元下的赤经13h02m58.75s、赤纬+10°30′27.0″，未分辨出结构，表明其为点源；测得视星等为17.2等；同一日世界时10:33:00再次观测确认存在，时间间隔约2.6小时，说明该源具有持续性而非瞬时噪声或宇宙线事件；其发现方式为系统性巡天，排除人为干扰或仪器伪迹的高概率；亮度处于典型核心坍缩超新星或Ia型超新星早期阶段的可观测范围，且位置无已知恒星或活动星系核记录，支持其为真实天文爆发现象；综合暂现性、点源性质、亮度演化初步一致性及巡天可靠性，判断该源极可能是一次超新星爆发。

根据现象进行分析： Astrometry and possible progenitor of SN 2008bk in NGC 7793 We have analyzed the discovery images of SN 2008bk in NGC 7793 taken by Berto Monard (c.f. CBET 1315) and also images taken with the 0.41-m "PROMPT 2" telescope at CTIO on Mar 28.41 UT. Using half a dozen stars for an astrometric solution, we derive the following precise position for the SN: 
* R. A. = 23h57m50s.42 
* Decl. = -32d33'21".5 (equinox 2000.0) 
which is 9".2 east and 126".4 north of the nucleus of NGC 7793. 
We further apply our astrometric solution to deep archival ground-based images taken with the Very Large Telescopes (VLT). Within the uncertainty of the solution (0".2 error radius), we identified a single point source on an I-band image taken on Sep 16, 2001 UT, which we propose as the possible progenitor for SN 2008bk. The source is not detected in the B and V band images, so it is a red source (likely a red supergiant star). The possible progenitor of SN 2008bk also resides in a cluster of bright blue and red supergiant stars. Based on the environment of SN 2008bk and its possible progenitor identification, we postulate that SN 2008bk is a core collapse (likely a Type II) event. Further analysis on the astrometry and photometry of the progenitor star is ongoing. A finder chart for the possible progenitor can be found at http://astro.berkeley.edu/~weidong/sn2008bk.vlt-prog.gif 2008-03-30 20:37:00
response:
首先，观测者利用发现图像和CTIO的PROMPT 2望远镜图像，通过六颗参考恒星构建了天体测量解，从而获得超新星SN 2008bk在NGC 7793中的精确位置：赤经23h57m50s.42，赤纬−32°33′21″.5（历元2000.0），该位置距离星系核9″.2向东、126″.4向北。  
其次，将该天体测量解外推至VLT存档的深场图像，发现在2001年9月16日拍摄的I波段图像中，存在一个位于误差圆（半径0″.2）内的单一恒星状源，且该源在B、V波段未被探测到，说明其颜色偏红，符合红超巨星的光谱能量分布特征。  
再次，该候选前身星位于一个包含明亮蓝超巨星和红超巨星的星团中，表明其所在环境具有近期恒星形成活动，恒星年龄较轻，支持大质量恒星演化末期发生核心坍缩。  
最后，结合前身星的红超巨星性质、所在年轻星团环境以及缺乏强氢吸收线以外的显著特征（如无He/N/O丰度异常或强激波相互作用迹象），可合理推断SN 2008bk是一次核心坍缩型超新星爆发，最可能为II型超新星（即保留氢包层的大质量恒星坍缩）。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT reports new flaring activity from Mrk 421 The Swift/BAT hard X-ray transient monitor reports a new episode of flaring activity from the blazar Mrk 421. This object has been rising in flux in the 15-50 keV band starting on March 17, 2008 (MJD 54542) when it reached 22 mcrab (~0.005 Â± 0.0006 cts/sec/cm^2). On March 30, 2008 it had an episode from about 01:53 UT to 06:44 UT in which the flux reached as high as 110 mcrab (0.025 Â± 0.003 cts/sec/cm^2). Normally Mrk 421 is barely detectable in the BAT one-day averages at 6 mcrab.
This is the brightest outburst since June 2006 (Lichti et al, ATel #840,#848) when the flux in the BAT reached similar levels for several weeks. 
Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient Monitor for Mrk 421 2008-03-30 21:13:00
response:
首先，观测到Mrk 421在硬X射线波段（15–50 keV）出现显著增强的辐射活动，表明该源正处于一次耀发事件中。  
其次，耀发起始于2008年3月17日（MJD 54542），当日流量升至22 mcrab（约0.005 ± 0.0006 cts/sec/cm²），显著高于其典型一日常平均流量（仅约6 mcrab），说明活动已持续增强。  
接着，3月30日01:53–06:44 UT期间出现峰值耀发，流量达110 mcrab（0.025 ± 0.003 cts/sec/cm²），是常态值的约18倍，证实此次为强耀发事件。  
再者，该耀发强度与2006年6月的历史最强爆发相当，且是此后近两年内最亮的一次，表明其具有罕见的高能量释放特性。  
最后，Swift/BAT作为全天硬X射线监测器，其高时间分辨率和灵敏度使得能可靠捕捉此类短时标、高幅度变化，支持该现象属于blazar典型的非热同步辐射+逆康普顿过程主导的喷流活动增强。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J16358-4726 and IGR J16393-4643: two new symbiotic X-ray binaries We report results from Ks band spectroscopy of the INTEGRAL sources IGR J16358-4726 and IGR J16393-4643. The proposed infrared counterparts 2MASS J16355369-4725398 (Kouveliotou et al. 2003, IAUC  8109 ) and 2MASS J16390535-4642137 (Bodaghee et al. 2006, A&A 447, 1027) were observed in service mode on 2007 April 5th with the ISAAC spectrograph on UT1 at Paranal (ESO proposal 079.D-0668-B). The sky was clear during the observation, the seeing was ≤1.4'' and the targets were observed at airmass 1.08 and 1.09 respectively. Data were taken in the Short Wavelength - Low Resolution mode, with a pixel scale of 0.147'' and a resolution of ~ 500. The snr averaged 150 for both spectra.
The two spectra are very similar, being their most prominent features the series of strong CO absorption bands between 2.29 and 2.40 Âµm, which are characteristic of late type stars. Several metallic lines are clearly recognizable as well (see details below), although at our resolution they are generally blended. He I 20581 Ã and Br gamma are also present in faint emission in both spectra; since they are not a proper spectral feature of late-type stars, these lines might be the signature of a circumstellar disk around a compact object. However, they are very weak, and they might be as well a residual artifact from the telluric line removal procedure. 
The most remarkable lines in each spectrum are the following:
IGR J16358-4726: He I 20581 Ã (EW = -0.03 Ã ), Mg I 21100 Ã (EW = 5.62 Ã ), Br gamma 21661 Ã (EW = -2.80 Ã ), Na I 22100 Ã (EW = 2.58 Ã ), Ca I 22600 Ã (EW = 1.35 Ã ), Mg I 22800 Ã (EW = 2.75 Ã ), 12CO 22900 Ã (EW = 9.91 Ã ), 12CO 23200 Ã (EW = 13.04 Ã ), 12CO 23500 Ã (EW = 7.84 Ã ), 13CO 23500 (2, 0) Ã (EW = 2.53 Ã ).
IGR J16393-4643: He I 20581 Ã (EW = -4.10 Ã ), Mg I 21100 Ã (EW = 4.98 Ã ), Br gamma 21661 Ã (EW = -0.94 Ã ), Na I 22100 Ã (EW = 2.63 Ã ), Ca I 22600 Ã (EW = 1.11 Ã ), Mg I 22800 Ã (EW = 1.58 Ã ), 12CO 22900 Ã (EW = 11.97 Ã ), 12CO 23200 Ã (EW = 12.92 Ã ), 12CO 23500 Ã (EW = 10.09 Ã ), 13CO (2, 0) 23500 Ã (EW = 3.32 Ã ).
Our ISAAC spectra clearly point to a late type star nature of both objects, and exclude that the systems are HMXBs with OB companions. From the identified spectral lines, our conclusion is that both stars are of K or M spectral type. The general morphology of the spectra and the comparison between the relative strength of CO 22900 Ã and both Na I and Na lines, which are luminosity indicators, reveal that both observed stars are giants. The forbidden [Fe II] transition at 22200 Ã detected in IGR J16358-4726 by Chaty et al. (2008, arXiv:0802.1774) is not present in our spectrum.
We propose that both systems belong to the class of symbiotic X-ray binaries, in which a compact object accretes from the stellar wind of a red giant or supergiant companion. 2008-03-31 11:30:00
response:
首先，观测目标是两个INTEGRAL发现的硬X射线源IGR J16358-4726和IGR J16393-4643，其红外对应体已被前期工作识别为2MASS源。本次使用VLT/UT1的ISAAC光谱仪在Ks波段（约2.0–2.5 μm）获取了高信噪比（SNR≈150）、中等分辨率（R~500）的近红外光谱。

其次，两颗源的光谱形态高度相似，最显著特征是在2.29–2.40 μm范围内呈现一系列强CO吸收带，这是晚型星（K型或M型）的典型光谱标志，直接排除了大质量X射线双星（HMXB）中常见的早型（O/B）伴星可能性。

第三，除CO吸收外，还清晰探测到多条金属吸收线（如Mg I、Na I、Ca I、Mg I），其等值宽度（EW）正值表明为吸收特征；同时在He I 20581 Å与Brγ 21661 Å处观测到微弱发射（负EW），这两条线并非晚型巨星本征谱线，可能源于致密天体周围吸积盘或星周介质的激发辐射；但因其强度极弱，亦不能完全排除是大气校正残余导致的伪信号。

第四，CO吸收带中12CO与13CO（2,0）跃迁的同时存在，且13CO相对强度合理，进一步支持恒星大气化学丰度特征，而非激波或外流主导环境。此外，Na I与CO吸收线的相对强度比是恒星光度型的重要判据，当前谱线强度关系符合红巨星（而非主序星或超巨星）的特征。

第五，[Fe II] 22200 Å禁戒线曾在IGR J16358-4726中被Chaty等人报道，但本工作未探测到该线，说明其可能具有时变性，或依赖于特定激发条件（如激波强度、电离状态），并非系统稳定成分。

综上，光谱证据一致指向：两系统均包含一颗处于红巨星演化阶段的K/M型伴星，其强星风可为轨道上的致密天体（中子星或黑洞）提供持续吸积物质；结合其X射线光度、能谱硬特性及红外光谱所揭示的冷伴星性质，二者应归类为共生型X射线双星（Symbiotic X-ray Binary, SyXB）。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT follow-up observation of the field of XTE J1719-291 We report on a Swift/XRT follow-up observation of the field of the newly discovered X-ray transient XTE J1719-291 (Markwardt & Swank, ATEL #1442). The observation was performed on 2008-03-30 and had a duration of approximately 5 ksec. The XRT data shows one clear source within the 7 arcminute RXTE error circle for XTE J1719-291 (ATEL #1442). The position coordinates (J2000) of this object, which we designate Swift J171916.9-290410, are found to be R.A. = 17:19:16.97 and Dec. = -29:04:10.35, with an uncertainty of 3.8 arcseconds. There are no known objects in the Simbad or Rosat source catalogs consistent with this Swift/XRT position, which suggests that Swift J171916.9-290410 is associated with the new X-ray transient XTE J1719-291.
The Swift/XRT spectrum could be fitted with a simple absorbed power law model with a hydrogen column density of Nh~0.67 (-0.15,+0.4) E22 cm-2 and a photon index of ~3.0 (-0.3, +0.9). With these parameters we find absorbed and unabsorbed 2-10 keV fluxes of ~1.1 E-12 erg/cm2/s and ~1.2 E-12 erg/cm2/s respectively. This is more than a factor of 10 lower than the RXTE/PCA detection of XTE J1719-291 on 2008-03-25 (ATEL #1442). If Swift J171916.9-290410 and XTE J1719-291 are indeed the same source, the current Swift/XRT detection is consistent with the reported decline in flux of XTE J1719-291 (ATEL #1442). For a distance of 8 kpc, the deduced Swift/XRT flux translates into a source luminosity of ~9 E33 erg/s (corrected for absorption). To conclusively identify Swift J171916.9-290410 with XTE J1719-291 requires further X-ray monitoring (to confirm a decline in flux). Observations in other wavelength regimes are encouraged as well.
We thank the Swift team for scheduling the observation. 2008-03-31 15:14:00
response: 该文本描述了一次Swift/XRT对新发现X射线暂现源XTE J1719-291的后续观测分析，需从现象出发进行逻辑推演：首先，观测时间（2008-03-30）晚于RXTE首次探测时间（2008-03-25），且位于RXTE给出的7角分误差圆内，空间位置匹配是建立源对应关系的基础前提；其次，XRT探测到唯一显著X射线源Swift J171916.9-290410，其J2000坐标精度达3.8角秒，远优于RXTE定位精度，且在SIMBAD和ROSAT星表中无已知对应体，排除了已知源干扰，增强了其作为XTE J1719-291候选体的可信度；第三，能谱拟合显示吸收幂律模型参数合理（Nh≈0.67×10²² cm⁻²，Γ≈3.0），所得2–10 keV吸收通量（~1.1×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s）比RXTE/PCA五天前测得的流量低一个数量级以上，与ATEL #1442中报道的光变衰减趋势一致，提供了时域行为支持；第四，基于8 kpc假设距离换算得到的吸积光度约9×10³³ erg/s，处于典型低质量X射线双星暂现源范围，物理合理性成立；最后，文中指出仅凭单次XRT观测尚不能完全确认两者同一性，因缺乏连续监测验证光变一致性，也缺少多波段证认，故结论保持审慎——需后续X射线监测确认衰减持续性，并建议开展光学/红外等波段观测以获取更多识别依据。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SUPERNOVA 2008bk IN NGC 7793 No radio emission has been detected near the position of the untyped supernova 2008bk (CBET 1315) with the Very Large Array (VLA) radio telescope with a three sigma upper-limit of 0.18 mJy at 8.46 GHz (wavelength 3.5 cm) and 0.46 mJy at 22.46 GHz (wavelength 1.3 cm) on 2008 Mar. 29.74 UT. SN 2008bk is unusually close (v = 227 km/s, z = 0.000757 d ~ 3.5 Mpc) and is suspected to be a type II SN (CBET 1319). Detailed observations are encouraged at other wavelengths. Radio observations are continuing. We would like to extend our thanks to the VLA scheduling officers for their support of our observing program. 2008-04-01 04:11:00
response: 该现象表明，对超新星SN 2008bk的射电波段观测未探测到显著辐射。VLA在2008年3月29.74 UT的观测中，在8.46 GHz（3.5 cm）和22.46 GHz（1.3 cm）两个频点分别给出3σ流量密度上限为0.18 mJy和0.46 mJy。由于SN 2008bk距离极近（约3.5 Mpc，红移z = 0.000757），若其为II型超新星，则预期可能产生可探测的射电辐射——通常源于激波与致密星周介质相互作用产生的同步辐射。未探测到射电辐射可能意味着：（1）星周介质密度极低，激波尚未进入足够致密区域，或（2）爆炸能量较低、抛射物速度较慢，导致激波传播缓慢、同步辐射尚未达到可观测水平；（3）观测时间过早，射电辐射尚未上升至峰值；（4）爆发本身缺乏强射电辐射机制（如无显著质量损失历史）。因此，该射电宁静特征需结合光学光谱分类（CBET 1319倾向II型）、光变曲线及后续多波段监测进一步约束前身星性质、爆炸参数与环境密度。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Identification of the Be/X-ray binary transient XMMU J004911.4-724939 in the SMC with the pulsar XTE J0055-727 During a 39 ks XMM-Newton observation on 2007 March 12-13 of the emission nebula N19 in the Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC) a bright X-ray transient at (J2000) R.A. = 00 49 11.4 Dec. = -72 49 39 was observed. Our timing analysis revealed X-ray pulsations with a period of 18.3814(1) s, which identifies the source, designated XMMU J004911.4-724939, with XTE J0055-727 = SXP18.3 (Corbet et al. 2003, ATEL #214), which was discovered with a period of 18.37 s +/- 0.1 s. The EPIC X-ray spectra are well represented by an absorbed powerlaw with photon index 0.65 +/- 0.05 and a column density of (2.0 +/- 0.2)E22 cm-2. The 0.5-10.0 keV flux was 1.2E-11 erg s-1 cm-2, corresponding to a source luminosity of 5.5E36 erg s-1, for a distance of 60 kpc. The X-ray position (systematic uncertainty ~2 arsec) is consistent with that of a V=16.0 mag star with typical properties of a Be star (Zaritsky et al. 2002, AJ 123, 855). Analysis of the extracted MACHO and OGLE light curves shows two optical outbursts, lasting about 330 and 270 days with brightness increases by ~0.55 and ~0.50 mag (in B), ~0.8 mag and ~0.6 (in R) for the two outbursts, respectively, and ~0.75 mag (in I) for the second outburst. Similar behaviour is also observed from other Be stars (Mennickent et al. 2002, A&A 393, 887). We conclude that XMMU J004911.4-724939 is a Be/X-ray binary pulsar in the SMC, and identical to XTE J0055-727. 2008-04-01 14:23:00
response:
首先，观测到一个位于小麦哲伦云（SMC）中发射星云N19区域的X射线暂现源XMMU J004911.4-724939，其J2000坐标为赤经00 49 11.4、赤纬−72 49 39。该源在2007年3月12–13日XMM-Newton长达39 ks的观测中被探测到，亮度显著。

其次，通过时间分析发现该源存在稳定的X射线脉冲，周期为18.3814(1)秒，与已知脉冲星XTE J0055-727（即SXP18.3）的周期18.37±0.1秒高度一致，因此可确认二者为同一物理源。

第三，能谱分析表明其EPIC观测数据可用吸收幂律模型良好拟合：光子指数为0.65±0.05，吸收柱密度为(2.0±0.2)×10²² cm⁻²；在0.5–10.0 keV波段测得流量为1.2×10⁻¹¹ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，结合SMC距离60 kpc，推算出对应光度为5.5×10³⁶ erg s⁻¹，符合中子星吸积系统的典型亮度范围。

第四，X射线位置（系统误差约2角秒）与一颗V=16.0等恒星精确吻合，该恒星具有Be星的典型光学特征（Zaritsky et al. 2002），支持其作为Be/X射线双星中供体星的身份。

第五，对MACHO和OGLE历史光变曲线的分析揭示该Be星经历了两次光学增亮事件：持续时间分别约为330天和270天；B波段增亮约0.55和0.50星等，R波段约0.8和0.6星等，I波段第二次爆发增亮约0.75星等；此类长期、中等幅度的光学爆发是Be星常见的盘活动现象（Mennickent et al. 2002），进一步佐证了Be星的存在及其星周盘演化可能触发X射线暂现事件。

综上，XMMU J004911.4-724939是一个位于SMC中的Be/X射线双星系统，其中致密星为自转周期约18.38秒的中子星，伴星为一颗具有活动星周盘的Be星；其X射线辐射源于中子星对Be星抛射物质的吸积，光学爆发与星周盘形成/消散过程相关；该源即先前发现的XTE J0055-727。

input:
根据现象进行分析： A new outburst from the Supergiant Fast X-ray Transient IGRJ17544-2619 caught by Swift The Swift satellite has observed a new outburst from IGR J17544-2619, a Supergiant Fast X-ray Transient discovered in September 2003 with INTEGRAL (Sunyaev et al., ATel#190). The Swift Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) triggered on March 31 at 20:50:45 UT, (trigger=308224). Swift immediately slewed to the target, so that the NFI onboard Swift started observing it about 162s after the trigger. 
The BAT mask-weighted light curve shows a long lasting plateau emission from about T-107 s to T+553 s, with an approximately 8 s long peak centered at 546 s. The estimated T90 (15-350 keV) is 614+/-77s (estimated error including systematics). The time-averaged spectrum from T-107 to T+553 s is best fit by a simple power-law model. The photon index of the time-averaged spectrum is 4.7+/-0.6. The fluence in the 15-150 keV band is about 1.1E-06 erg/cm2. The flux in the 15-150 keV band is 1.6544E-09 ergs cm^-2 s^-1. All the quoted errors are at the 90% confidence level. 
The Swift/XRT observations started on March 31, at 20:53:27 UT. The initial WT data (170-492s since the trigger) show a complex light curve with several flares and a count rate that reached about 20 counts/s. The following PC data (3724-5276s) show a count rate of (4.5+/-0.8)E-02 counts/s, so that a dynamic range of 400 is observed in about 1.5 hours. 
The peak of the outburst (WT data) is at 1E-9 erg/cm2/s (unabsorbed, 2-10 keV), showing a hard spectrum, well fit with a powerlaw with a photon index of 0.74+/-0.11, and highly absorbed with a column density of NH=(1.1+/-0.2)E+22 cm-2 (chi2_red=1.035 for 143 dof). A fit with a cutoff power-law yields a column density of NH=(0.7+/-0.3)E+22 cm-2, a photon index of -0.24(-0.56,+0.57), and a cutoff energy of 4.6(-1.7,+6.4) keV (chi2_red=0.986 for 142; Ftest probability with respect to simple power law is 5E-03). A 3sigma upper limit to the equivalent width of an iron line at 6.7 keV can be placed at 63 eV. 
The X-ray spectrum of the fainter emission (PC, ~5E-12 erg/cm2/s, unabsorbed) is significantly softer: fitted with a powerlaw model (Cash statistics), the resulting photon index is 1.53(-0.58,+0.70) and an absorbing column density of 1.1(-0.6,+0.9)E+22 cm-2. 
Previously, several bright flares have been observed with INTEGRAL (see e.g. Grebenev et al. 2004, ATel #252; Sguera et al. 2006 ApJ, 646, 452; Walter et al., 2007, A&A, 476, 335; Kuulkers et al. 2007, ATel #1266), with Chandra (in't Zand 2005, A&A, 441, L1) and in archival BeppoSAX/WFC data (in't Zand et al., 2004, ESASP, 552, 427). The last outburst has been observed 144 days ago with Swift/BAT (Krimm et al., Atel#1265), beginning at 1:31:04 UT on November 8, 2007 (MJD 54412), but unfortunately observations with Swift/XRT were not possible because of Sun constraints. 
The source position determined with XMM-Newton at arcsec level (Gonzalez-Riestra et al., IAUC 8202 ) was later refined with Chandra (R.A.(J2000) 17h 54m 25.284s, Dec (J2000)=-26deg 19' 52.62", 0.6 arcsec error radius; in't Zand 2005), which confirmed the association with the optical counterpart 2MASS J17542527-2619526 at first suggested by Rodriguez (2003, ATel#194), later identified as a O9Ib star (Pellizza et al. 2006) located at 3.6 kpc (Rahoui et al. 2008, arXiv.0802.1770). 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for making these observations possible, in particular the duty scientists as well as the science planners. 2008-04-01 15:52:00
response:
该现象描述了超巨星快X射线暂现源IGR J17544−2619的一次新爆发，由Swift卫星在2008年3月31日探测到。首先需明确其物理本质：SFXT是一类具有极端光变动态范围（可达10⁴–10⁵）、短时标（数百秒）强爆发、且大部分时间处于极低光度态（L_X ≲ 10³² erg/s）的高质X射线双星系统，通常由一颗O/B型超巨星与中子星组成，其爆发机制主流解释为中子星吸积超巨星星风物质的不稳定性所致——可能源于星风密度涨落、磁场通道调制或吸积流截断/重启。

本次爆发被BAT在15–350 keV波段触发，T90达614±77 s，表明是一次中等持续时间的硬X射线事件；光变曲线呈现“平台+尖峰”结构（T−107 s至T+553 s为平台，中心546 s处有约8 s窄峰），暗示吸积过程存在两阶段：长时间低效稳定吸积叠加一次短暂高效吸积事件。平台期平均谱指数Γ = 4.7±0.6，异常陡峭，远高于典型中子星吸积盘谱（Γ ∼ 1–2），表明此阶段辐射可能以热韧致辐射或冷却主导的低光度吸积流为主，光子产生效率低、软化显著；而峰值通量（1.1×10⁻⁶ erg/cm²，15–150 keV）对应瞬时吸积率激增，此时XRT WT数据显示2–10 keV能段未吸收流量达10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s，谱形极硬（Γ = 0.74±0.11），且吸收柱密度高（N_H ≈ 1.1×10²² cm⁻²），符合中子星表面热核燃烧或边界层辐射特征；进一步采用截断幂律拟合更优（F检验概率5×10⁻³），得到截断能量4.6⁺⁶·⁴₋₁·₇ keV，支持辐射来自高温（kT ∼ 几keV）、光学厚等离子体，与中子星磁层内区热辐射模型一致。

XRT后续PC模式观测显示光度下降约400倍（从∼20 cnt/s降至∼0.045 cnt/s），对应X射线光度跨越约2.5个数量级，验证其典型SFXT动态范围；低光度态谱显著变软（Γ = 1.53⁺⁰·⁷₀₋₀·₅⁸），N_H保持相似量级（1.1⁺⁰·⁹₋₀·₆×10²² cm⁻²），说明吸收主要来自超巨星星周介质而非局部吸积流变化，而谱软化反映吸积率降低后，辐射从热主导转向冷吸积盘主导或Compton冷却减弱所致。

位置精确定位于R.A.=17h54m25.284s, Dec.=−26°19′52.62″（Chandra），对应O9Ib超巨星2MASS J17542527−2619526，距离3.6 kpc，确认其为经典SFXT系统：大质量伴星提供稠密星风，中子星轨道偏心或倾角导致间歇性穿透高密度星风壳层，引发爆发。历史多波段观测（INTEGRAL、Chandra、BeppoSAX）均显示类似短时标、高动态范围爆发，本次是继2007年11月8日（间隔144天）后再次被Swift捕获的爆发，支持其爆发具有准周期性但非严格规则，符合星风不均匀性主导的随机触发模型。

综上，该事件完整呈现SFXT典型行为：硬X射线触发→短时标峰值（热主导、高吸收、截断谱）→快速衰减→软谱低光度态（冷吸积主导）→高N_H贯穿始终（星周介质吸收）。其物理核心在于中子星对超巨星星风的非稳态吸积，爆发时标由吸积流穿越磁层/边界层的时间尺度决定，而谱演化则反映不同吸积态下辐射机制的转变。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Radio Observations of SN 2008bk Our continued monitoring of the field of SN 2008bk with the Very Large Array shows no radio emission at the optical SN position (CBET 1315, ATEL #1448). We place a 3 sigma upper limit of 0.18 mJy at 4.86 GHz on 2008 Mar 31.66 UT. Radio follow-up observations are continuing. We would like to extend our thanks to the VLA scheduling officers for their support of our observing program. 2008-04-02 21:46:00
response: 该段文字描述了对超新星SN 2008bk的射电观测结果。首先，观测使用的是甚大阵（VLA），目标是SN 2008bk的光学位置；其次，观测未在该位置探测到任何射电辐射，说明该超新星在射电波段尚未产生可测的同步辐射；第三，给出了3σ置信水平下的流量密度上限为0.18 mJy（频率4.86 GHz，观测时间2008年3月31.66 UT），这一上限反映了当前观测灵敏度所能排除的最弱可能射电辐射强度；第四，射电后续观测仍在进行，暗示该超新星可能处于射电辐射尚未显著增强的早期阶段，或其前身星环境导致激波与周围介质相互作用较弱、辐射效率较低；最后，致谢VLA调度人员属于常规科研协作表述，不具物理分析意义。综合判断：未探测到射电辐射，结合严格流量上限，表明SN 2008bk在观测时刻尚未产生强射电辐射，可能对应于IIP型超新星典型的低质量红超巨星前身星、低速激波及稀薄星周介质环境。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT reports the detection of a new galactic source Swift J1816.7-1613 The hard X-ray transient monitor of the Swift Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) has detected a previously unknown galactic transient. This source, Swift J1816.7-1613, was first detected at a daily average rate of 0.005 Â± 0.001 counts/sec/cm2 (20 mcrab) in the 15-50 keV band on March 24, 2008 (MJD 54549). It rose to a peak brightness of 0.008 Â± 0.002 cts/sec/cm2 (35 mcrab) on March 29 and has remained between 10 and 20 mcrab for the past several days. The best BAT position was RA=274.176, Dec=-16.266 (J2000). Note that this source is on the galactic plane at coordinates L=14.587, B=0.094 degrees. 
On April 1, 2008 beginning at 18:47 UTC, Swift J1816.7-1613 was observed as a target of opportunity with Swift. An X-ray source, Swift J181642.3-161320, was detected at a count rate of 0.32 Â± 0.014 cts/s (0.3-10 keV) at a location:  
RA = 18h 16m 42.3s (274.176458 deg)  
dec = -16d 13m 20.5s (-16.222361 deg),  
with an estimated error of 3.6'' radius (90% containment). This is 2.6 arc minutes from the BAT position. 
A search of the USNO B1.0 catalog reveals a single star within the error circle. This star, designated 0737-0562754, has catalog magnitudes of B2=20.48 and I=17.18. 
BAT transient monitor for Swift J1816.7-1613 2008-04-02 23:47:00
response:
该现象描述了一个新发现的银河系暂现X射线源Swift J1816.7−1613，其分析需从多波段观测、时变特性、空间定位与证认三个层面展开：

首先，BAT在15–50 keV硬X射线波段首次探测到该源，起始时间为2008年3月24日（MJD 54549），日平均计数率为0.005 ± 0.001 cts/sec/cm²（对应20 mcrab），表明其为一中等强度硬X射线暂现体；随后在3月29日达到峰值0.008 ± 0.002 cts/sec/cm²（35 mcrab），之后维持在10–20 mcrab量级数日，说明其光变具有快速上升、缓慢衰减的典型暂现特征，符合X射线暂现源（如低质量X射线双星中的吸积爆发、磁星短时增强或软伽马重复暴余辉）的行为。

其次，Swift卫星于4月1日开展ToO观测，在0.3–10 keV能段精确定位到X射线源Swift J181642.3−161320，位置精度达3.6″（90%置信半径），与BAT初定位（RA=274.176°, Dec=−16.266°）相差2.6′，该偏差在BAT粗定位误差预期范围内（BAT角分辨率约15′–20′），证实二者为同一物理源；X射线计数率0.32 ± 0.014 cts/s远高于BAT的面亮度归一化值，反映能谱随能量下降显著——BAT探测的是硬X射线成分，而XRT探测到更亮的软X射线辐射，暗示存在较陡峭的X射线谱（可能为热辐射主导或高吸收环境下的幂律谱）。

第三，光学证认显示USNO-B1.0星表中在XRT误差圆内仅有一颗星（0737−0562754），B₂=20.48、I=17.18，色指数B−I≈3.3，显著偏红，结合其位于银道面附近（银经L=14.587°，银纬B=0.094°），表明存在强星际消光；该星极可能是该X射线源的光学对应体，但其暗弱且红，需进一步光谱观测确认是否为晚型矮星（LMXB伴星）、红巨星（ symbiotic系统）或高度消光的Be星（Be/X射线双星）。

综上，Swift J1816.7−1613是一例位于银道面附近的中等强度X射线暂现源，具有硬X射线先兆、软X射线主导的能谱结构、持续数日的平台期光变，以及一个高度消光的光学候选体，其物理本质最可能为一类被遮蔽的低质量X射线双星爆发、磁星活动，或罕见的Be/X射线脉冲星暂现事件。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift J1816.7-1613 is a 143 s HMXB Pulsar The transient X-ray source Swift J1816.7-1613 announced by Krimm et al. (ATel #1456) was also detected serendipitously in a 16 ks Chandra ACIS observation on 2007 February 11. Its position is 18h16m42.66s, -16d13'23.4" (J2000), not consistent with the USNO star mentioned in ATel #1456. Its spectrum can be fitted by a power law of photon index Gamma = 1.2+/-0.5 and column density N_H = (12+/-3)x10^{22} cm^{-2}. The 2-10 keV flux is 4x10^{-12} ergs cm^{-2} s^{-1}. We find a highly pulsed signal at a barycentric period of 142.9+/-0.2 s. Evidently a high mass X-ray binary pulsar, this source was also detected by XMM-Newton at a low flux of 7x10^{-13} ergs cm^{-2} s^{-1} as 2XMM J181642.7-161320 on 2003 March 8. 2008-04-03 01:32:00
response:
Swift J1816.7-1613 是一个暂现X射线源，其X射线辐射具有显著的周期性调制，测得的质心周期为142.9±0.2秒，与文中所述“143 s HMXB pulsar”一致，表明它是一颗旋转驱动的中子星。该周期处于典型高质量X射线双星（HMXB）脉冲星的周期范围（数十秒至数百秒），支持其HMXB分类。

其X射线能谱可用幂律模型拟合，光子指数Γ = 1.2±0.5，属于较硬的谱形，常见于吸积柱辐射主导的HMXB脉冲星；吸收柱密度N_H = (12±3)×10²² cm⁻²显著高于银河系平均值（~10²⁰–10²¹ cm⁻²），说明视线方向存在大量局部星际介质或伴星星风吸收，符合HMXB中致密星嵌入大质量伴星星风环境的特征。

2–10 keV波段流量在Chandra观测中为4×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，在XMM-Newton早期观测中仅为7×10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，相差约6倍，证实其暂现性质——即存在显著的光变，可能由吸积率变化（如伴星物质抛射不稳定性、轨道相位相关吸积或盘截断/恢复）引起。

位置精度高（Chandra ACIS角分辨率~0.5″），且与USNO星表中邻近恒星位置不一致，排除了光学对应体混淆；同时被XMM-Newton以另一编号2XMM J181642.7-161320独立探测，坐标匹配（18h16m42.7s, -16d13'20"），确认为同一物理源，增强证认可靠性。

综上，周期性脉冲、高吸收、硬谱、强光变、高置信度定位及多历元探测共同支持Swift J1816.7-1613是一个典型的暂现型高质量X射线双星脉冲星系统，其中中子星通过吸积大质量伴星（很可能为O/B型星）的星风或转移物质产生X射线辐射。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Binary period detected in new SMC X-ray transient SXP18.3 Analysis of the detrended OGLE III optical data of the counterpart to the transient SMC X-ray source XMMU J004911.4-724939 = XTE J0055-727 = SXP 18.3 (ATEL 1453)reveal a strong coherent period of 17.83d. This period, and the pulse period of 18s, would place the source comfortably in the centre of the Corbet diagram for such systems. Thus we conclude that the period of 17.8sd represents the binary period of SXP18.3. 2008-04-03 11:58:00
response:
首先，观测到SMC中新的X射线暂现源SXP18.3的光学对应体（即OGLE III数据）经去趋势处理后，显示出一个强而相干的周期信号，周期为17.83天。  
其次，该光学周期与已知的X射线脉冲周期（18秒）共同构成一对关键参数：前者对应轨道运动（即双星绕转周期），后者对应中子星自转周期。  
第三，将这两个周期代入Corbet图（横轴为脉冲周期，纵轴为轨道周期的对数），发现该源落在图中高质量X射线双星（HMXB）的典型分布中心区域，符合Be/X射线双星系统的经验规律。  
第四，17.83天与17.8天在测量误差范围内一致，且该周期具有强相干性，排除了非轨道起源（如不规则光变、耀发或仪器效应）的可能性。  
因此，17.83天周期应被认定为该系统的双星轨道周期，即SXP18.3的二元轨道周期。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT follow-up observations of  IGR J17473-2721 During an AGILE pointing at the Galactic Center region, a type-I X-ray burst was detected by SuperAGILE (ATEL #1445) from a position that is consistent with that of IGR J17473-2721 (ATEL #498 & #500, also known as XTE J1747-274, ATEL #467) suggesting that this source exhibit renewed activity. To conclusively identify the burst source with the XTE/IGR transient, we obtained a Swift/XRT observation of ~ 4.1 ksec on Monday 31st of March, 2008. Within the SuperAGILE error circle, there is only one source detected at a position (J2000) of R.A. = 17h47m18.12s, Dec. =-27:20:38.66, with an uncertainty of ~3.5 arcseconds. This is consistent with the Chandra position of IGR J17473-2721 (ATEL #521). Therefore, we confirm that the SuperAGILE X-ray burst has originated from this source, establishing that this is transiently accreting neutron star. The X-ray energy spectrum was extracted from pc-mode data. It can be fitted with an absorbed power law model with Nh=(3.8+0.48-0.14) x 10^22 cm^-2, photon index 1.68+0.21-0.07 and a final reduced Chi2 of 1.26. The 2-10 keV absorbed and unabsorbed fluxes are 2.27E-10 erg/cm2/s and 3.01E-10 erg/cm2/s, respectively. We have detected a ~100 seconds long X-ray burst (in one of the observations recorded in wt -non-imaging- mode). We have extracted the energy spectrum of the burst peak (first ~2 seconds) and fitted it with an absorbed black body model. By fixing Nh to the value obtained above, we find that the temperature is kT~2.29+0.22-0.18 keV, and the unabsorbed bolometric flux (as estimated in the 0.01-100 keV range) 1.1E-7 erg/cm2/s. We find no evidence for photospheric radius expansion, implying that the luminosity remained below the Eddington Limit. From this we infer upper limits to the distance between 3.9 and 5.4 kpc, depending on whether the neutron star photosphere is hydrogen-rich or poor, respectively (e.g., Kuulkers et al. 2003, A&A, 399, 663). With these upper limits on the distance, we estimate in 1x10^36 erg/s the upper limit of the 2-10 keV Luminosity (persistent emission). We note that the spectral analysis mentioned above was complicated by instrumental pile-up issues. We have tried to correct for this by excluding the inner source pixels from the data-analysis and applying a psf-correction. We thank the Swift team for scheduling the observation. 2008-04-03 16:34:00
response:
首先，AGILE卫星在指向银河系中心区域时，通过SuperAGILE探测器探测到一次I型X射线暴，其位置与已知暂现源IGR J17473-2721（即XTE J1747-274）的坐标一致，提示该源出现再活动。为确证爆发源身份，团队于2008年3月31日开展了Swift/XRT约4.1 ks的后续观测。在SuperAGILE给出的位置误差圆内，XRT仅探测到一个X射线源，其J2000坐标为R.A. = 17h47m18.12s，Dec. = −27°20′38.66″，位置不确定性约3.5角秒，与Chandra此前测得的IGR J17473-2721位置（ATEL #521）一致，从而确认该X射线暴确实起源于该源，表明其为一颗处于暂现吸积状态的中子星。

其次，对持续辐射谱（pc模式数据）进行拟合，采用吸收幂律模型，得到吸收柱密度Nh = (3.8⁺⁰·⁴⁸₋₀·₁₄) × 10²² cm⁻²，光子指数Γ = 1.68⁺⁰·²¹₋₀·₀₇，约化χ² = 1.26，说明模型拟合合理。对应2–10 keV波段，吸收通量为2.27 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，去吸收通量为3.01 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹。

第三，在wt模式（非成像模式）的一次观测中，探测到一次持续约100秒的X射线暴；提取爆发峰值（前约2秒）能谱，固定Nh取上述值，采用吸收黑体模型拟合，得到kT ≈ 2.29⁺⁰·²²₋₀·₁₈ keV，0.01–100 keV波段去吸收总辐射通量为1.1 × 10⁻⁷ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹。未观测到光球半径膨胀现象，表明爆发期间光度始终低于爱丁顿极限。

第四，基于无半径膨胀这一事实，结合中子星表面成分假设（氢丰度高低），参考Kuulkers et al. (2003) 方法，推导出距离上限：若为氢丰中子星，距离上限为3.9 kpc；若为氢贫中子星，则为5.4 kpc。由此进一步估算出2–10 keV波段持续辐射的光度上限为1 × 10³⁶ erg s⁻¹。

最后，需指出谱分析受到仪器堆积效应（pile-up）干扰；为校正此效应，分析中排除了源中心像素，并应用了点扩散函数（PSF）修正。

input:
根据现象进行分析： RXTE Confirms Persistent Activity of Burster IGR J17473-2721  Following reports of bursting activity of IGR J17473-2721 (= XTE J1747-274) by the AGILE team (Del Monte et al., ATEL #1445) and from Swift (Altamirano et al., ATEL #1459), we note that RXTE PCA monitoring scans of the source also reveal persistent activity. 
Scans on 2008-03-28 at 18:50 UT and 2008-03-31 at 15:10 UT found 2-10 keV fluxes of about 13 and 18 mCrab, respectively. Previous scans are consistent with quiescent level (with 2-sigma upper limits ~6 mCrab). 2008-04-03 16:58:00
response:
首先，观测报告指出IGR J17473-2721（即XTE J1747-274）存在爆发活动，该结论由AGILE和Swift望远镜独立确认（ATEL #1445与#1459）。  
其次，RXTE PCA的后续监测扫描进一步证实该源并非仅呈现短暂爆发，而是进入持续活跃状态：2008-03-28和2008-03-31两次扫描分别测得2–10 keV能段流量为约13 mCrab和18 mCrab，显著高于先前观测所约束的静止态上限（2σ上限约6 mCrab）。  
最后，流量在三天内从13 mCrab增至18 mCrab，表明其持续活动具有增强趋势；而此前数据与静止态一致，说明此次活跃是新发生的、非稳态的演化事件。因此，RXTE观测结果支持该源正处于一次持续性X射线增强阶段，而非孤立爆发。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Hard X-ray activity of IGR J17473-2721 Persistent X-ray activity has been reported by Swift/XRT (ATel #1459) and RXTE/PCA (ATel #1460) from the transient IGR J17473-2721 (= XTE J1747-274; ATels #467, #498) after the detection of an X-ray burst by SuperAGILE (ATel #1445). 
We report the detection of persistent activity at 18-100 keV with INTERAL/IBIS/ISGRI. The average hard X-ray flux during the Galactic bulge monitoring observations (see ATel #1385) which started on UT 2008 April 1, 16:55 of the source was 41+\\-2 mCrab and 42+\\-3 mCrab, at 18-40 keV and 40-100 keV, respectively, indicating a hard spectral state. During the previous Galactic bulge monitoring observation on 2008 March 22 the source was possibly seen near the detection limit, with a flux of about 6.5 mCrab (18-40 keV). See http://isdc.unige.ch/Science/BULGE/. 
Inspection of the Swift/BAT hard X-ray light curve shows that the source started to appear significantly in the daily averages on 2008 March 30, with a flux of 30+\\-5 mCrab (15-50 keV), and has been steadily increasing up to a daily average of about 45+\\-6 mCrab. See http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/IGRJ17473-2721/. 
Follow-up observations are encouraged. 2008-04-03 20:03:00
response:
首先，观测到IGR J17473-2721在硬X射线波段（18–100 keV）呈现持续活动，这发生在SuperAGILE探测到X射线暴之后，表明该源已从暂现暴发阶段转入持续辐射阶段。  
其次，INTEGRAL/IBIS/ISGRI数据显示：在2008年4月1日开始的银心区巡天观测中，该源在18–40 keV和40–100 keV波段的平均流量分别为41±2 mCrab和42±3 mCrab，二者接近且显著高于本底，说明其能谱较硬，符合硬谱态特征。  
再次，对比此前3月22日的巡天数据，流量仅约6.5 mCrab（18–40 keV），处于探测阈值附近，说明源在3月下旬开始明显增强。  
然后，Swift/BAT日平均光变曲线进一步证实这一演化：源于3月30日起在15–50 keV波段显著出现（30±5 mCrab），此后持续上升至约45±6 mCrab，与INTEGRAL测得的流量一致，表明硬X射线辐射在约一周内稳定增强并趋于饱和。  
最后，多设备（SuperAGILE、Swift/XRT、RXTE/PCA、INTEGRAL/IBIS、Swift/BAT）在不同能段的协同观测共同刻画出该源从X射线暴触发、软X射线持续辐射建立，到硬X射线成分同步增强并稳定维持硬谱态的完整过程，支持其为一类具有硬谱态持续辐射的吸积中子星X射线暂现源。

input: 根据现象进行分析： BeppoSAX/PDS detection of Swift J1816.7-1613 Following the discovery of galactic X-ray transient Swift J1816.7-1613 (Krimm et al. ATel #1456) and the accurate localization by Chandra (Halpern et al. ATel #1457), we performed a search of this source in our BeppoSAX PDS data archive. We find that on 1998 September 29 the Chandra source position was within the field of view (1.3 deg FWHM) of one of the offset positions (+3.5 deg) of the PDS rocking collimators. The source was observed for 66 ksec. A significant signal of 0.303 +/- 0.046 Cts/s (6.5 sigma) in 15-30 keV and of 0.320 +/- 0.065 Cts/s (4.9 sigma) in 15-50 keV was observed. These excesses were determined by subtracting the background level measured in correspondence of the other offset position (-3.5 deg). Both directions corresponding to these positions lie on the galactic plane, with a contribution from the galactic ridge that we have evaluated to be negligible in the above energy bands. The energy spectrum is quite soft. When fit with a power law, the photon index is 6.0 +/- 1.0 (for comparison the galactic ridge spectrum has a photon index of about 1.8 (Valinia and Marshall 1998. Apj 505, 134)). Correcting for the triangular PDS angular response (Frontera et al 2007, ApJ 666, 86), the following source energy fluxes are derived: (3.6 +/- 0.5)E-11 cgs in 15-30 keV and (3.8 +/- 0.8)E-11 cgs in 15-50 keV, corresponding to 4.5 and 2.9 mCrab, respectively. 2008-04-04 17:09:00
response: 该现象描述了利用BeppoSAX卫星PDS探测器在1998年9月29日对X射线暂现源Swift J1816.7−1613进行的回溯性探测。首先，源的位置已由Chandra精确测定（ATel #1457），据此确认其在BeppoSAX PDS一次岩石式扫描中处于+3.5°偏置位置的视场内（FWHM=1.3°），且有效曝光时间为66 ks。在15–30 keV波段测得净计数率0.303±0.046 Cts/s（6.5σ），15–50 keV波段为0.320±0.065 Cts/s（4.9σ），背景通过另一对称偏置位置（−3.5°）实测扣除；由于两方向均位于银道面，需评估银河脊辐射贡献，但分析表明其在此能量范围内可忽略。能谱显著偏软，幂律拟合得光子指数Γ=6.0±1.0，远陡于典型银河脊的Γ≈1.8，排除其为弥散背景成分的可能性。进一步考虑PDS三角形角响应修正后，导出15–30 keV和15–50 keV能段的能流分别为(3.6±0.5)×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹和(3.8±0.8)×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应4.5 mCrab与2.9 mCrab。综上，该信号是真实、致密、高变、极软谱的X射线点源，且早于Swift发现近十年，表明该源具有长周期暂现特性或存在历史活动遗迹。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SN 2008bo in NGC 6643 The Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) and X-Ray Telescope (XRT) on board the Swift satellite observed the supernova (SN) 2008bo in NGC 6643 (CBET #1324, #1325) on 2008-04-04.71 UT and 2008-04-06.31 UT. The following UVOT magnitudes were measured for the two epochs: 
v = 15.9Â±0.1 (157 s exposure time), 16.0Â±0.1 (258 s),   
b = 16.7Â±0.1 (157 s), 16.6Â±0.1 (258 s),   
u = 16.6Â±0.1 (157 s), 16.6Â±0.1 (258 s),   
uvw1 [181-321nm] = 17.1Â±0.1 (314 s), 17.2Â±0.1 (518 s),   
uvm2 [166-268nm] = 17.3Â±0.1 (491 s), 17.4Â±0.1 (796 s), and   
uvw2 [112-264 nm] = 17.3Â±0.1 (629 s), 17.3Â±0.1 (1,038 s). 
These magnitudes are on the UVOT photometric system (Poole et al. 2008, MNRAS, 383, 627) which in the optical is close to the Johnson UBV. The magnitudes have not been corrected for extinction. We note that a fraction of the UV emission of SN 2008bo could be due to enhanced star formation activity in the host galaxy which has a very patchy appearance in the UV. In the absence of UVOT template images of the host galaxy, the above magnitudes should therefore be regarded as tentative. 
No X-ray source is detected at the position of the SN in the merged 5.2 ks Swift XRT observation obtained simultaneously with the UVOT observations. The 3-sigma upper limit to the XRT net count rate is 3.9E-03 cts/s, corresponding to an unabsorbed (0.2-10 keV band) X-ray flux of <2.2E-13 erg/cm/cm/s and a luminosity of <1.2E40 erg/s for an adopted thermal plasma spectrum with a temperature of kT = 10 keV, a Galactic foreground column density of N_H = 5.45E+20 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA, 28, 215) and a distance of 21 Mpc (z=0.004950, NED; H_o = 71 km/s/Mpc, Omega_M = 1/3, Omega_L = 2/3). 2008-04-07 02:52:00
response:
首先，观测时间点为2008-04-04.71 UT和2008-04-06.31 UT，间隔约1.6天，属于SN爆发早期光变曲线的密集采样阶段。UVOT测得的v、b、u波段亮度基本稳定：v从15.9±0.1变为16.0±0.1，b从16.7±0.1变为16.6±0.1，u保持16.6±0.1不变，表明光学波段光度在此短时标内无显著衰减或上升，可能处于光极大附近或缓慢演化阶段。紫外波段uvw1、uvm2、uvw2均呈现微弱变暗趋势（如uvw1由17.1→17.2），但误差范围重叠，变化不显著；各波段信噪比受限于曝光时间差异及本底不确定性，需谨慎解读。

其次，所有UVOT星等未做消光改正，且明确指出宿主星系NGC 6643在紫外波段呈“patchy”结构，存在恒星形成区贡献的污染，而缺乏模板图像无法扣除星系本底，因此所列紫外流量仅为暂定值，真实SN紫外辐射可能被高估。该系统误差对紫外超量分析（如探测激波突破信号或CSM相互作用特征）构成关键限制。

第三，XRT在5.2 ks合并曝光中未探测到X射线源，3σ上限给出净计数率<3.9×10⁻³ cts/s，对应0.2–10 keV波段未吸收通量<2.2×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s、光度<1.2×10⁴⁰ erg/s。该上限显著低于典型Ia型SN热辐射模型预期（~10⁴¹ erg/s），也远低于富氢II型SN激波与致密星周物质作用产生的X射线光度（常达10⁴² erg/s量级），暗示SN 2008bo周围缺乏高密度CSM，或爆炸能量较低、激波传播较慢，未能产生可观测X射线辐射；同时排除了强相对论喷流或活动星系核混淆的可能性。

最后，距离取21 Mpc（z=0.00495，H₀=71 km/s/Mpc），结合v≈16.0 mag可粗估绝对星等M_v ≈ −17.5（未修正消光），落入II-P或II-L型SN典型范围，但需结合光谱分类确认；X射线缺失与紫外本底污染共同表明，该SN的高能辐射特征难以可靠提取，后续研究应优先获取宿主星系紫外模板及光学光谱以约束类型与消光。

根据现象进行分析： Near-IR photometry of possible progenitor of SN2008bk We report J and Ks photometry of the possible progenitor star, identified by W. Li et al. (Atel #1448), of SN 2008bk in NGC 7793, and give constraints on its mass and nature. Using archival ESO data, we measure in the Vega magnitude system: 
J=19.29+/-0.05, Ks=18.27+/-0.10 
The J and Ks measurements are from VLT-ISAAC images obtained on Oct 10, 2005. The photometry was calibrated relative to three 2MASS stars in the field having J and Ks errors of less than 0.1 mag. An image showing the possible progenitor star in the Ks image and the 2MASS calibration stars can be found at http://wise-obs.tau.ac.il/~dani/sn2008bk/sn2008bkKs.jpg  The colors of the star are therefore: J-Ks=1.02+/-0.12 . 
The distance modulus to NGC 7793, based on the tip of the RGB, is 27.96+/-0.24 (Karachentsev et al. 2003, A&A, 404, 93), resulting in absolute magnitudes: M_J=-8.67+/-0.29, M_Ks=-9.69+/-0.34 . 
To constrain the nature of the possible progenitor, we have transformed the temperatures, luminosities, and surface gravities of stellar evolution models to magnitudes and colors in the observed bands. For the ZAMS to AGB stages we have used the tracks of Girardi et al. (2000,A&AS, 141, 371) for 3-7 M_sun, and from Salasnich et al. (2000, A&A, 361, 1023) for 8-12 M_sun. For the thermal-pulse AGB phase of 3-5 M_sun stars we have used the models by Marigo \& Girardi (2007, A&A, 469, 239). With these tracks, we have used the Basel 3.1 stellar atmosphere models by Westera et al. (2002, A&A, 381, 524), and the observed bandpasses. The tracks were calculated for a range of metallicities. Pilyugin et al. (2004, A&A, 425, 849) find a gas-phase oxygen abundance in HII regions of NGC 773 of 12+log(O/H)=8.34, corresponding 0.45 solar. 
A K vs. J-K color-magnitude diagram can be seen at http://wise-obs.tau.ac.il/~dani/sn2008bk/sn2008bkcolormag.jpg  . Curves show tracks for ZAMS masses of 3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12 Msun, and metallicities of 0.2 and 1.0 solar. The measurements suggest acceptable progenitor masses of 9-12 M_sun within this range of metallicities. However, "super-AGB" stars with ZAMS masses of 6-8 M_sun, whose final stages of evolution are subject to large uncertainties (see, e.g. http://www.astro.keele.ac.uk/e-stars/ras2008/ras2008.html  ), could also be possible progenitors of this event. 2008-04-07 10:24:00
response:
首先，观测获得了SN 2008bk可能前身星在J和Ks波段的近红外测光数据：J = 19.29 ± 0.05，Ks = 18.27 ± 0.10（Vega系统），对应色指数J−Ks = 1.02 ± 0.12。这些数据来自2005年10月10日VLT-ISAAC的归档图像，并通过场内三颗2MASS标准星（J、Ks误差均小于0.1 mag）完成光度定标。

其次，利用NGC 7793的距离模数μ = 27.96 ± 0.24（基于红巨星支顶端法），将观测星等转换为绝对星等：M_J = −8.67 ± 0.29，M_Ks = −9.69 ± 0.34。该距离模数对应约3.9 Mpc的距离。

第三，结合恒星演化模型（Girardi et al. 2000用于3–7 M⊙，Salasnich et al. 2000用于8–12 M⊙，Marigo & Girardi 2007用于热脉冲AGB阶段），并采用Westera et al. (2002)的大气模型及实测滤光片响应函数，将理论T_eff、L、log g转化为J、Ks星等与颜色；模型考虑了金属丰度影响，而NGC 7793的氧丰度测定为12+log(O/H) = 8.34，即Z ≈ 0.45 Z⊙，因此在分析中采用了Z = 0.2 Z⊙和Z = 1.0 Z⊙两组金属丰度轨道进行对比。

第四，在Ks vs. J−Ks颜色—星等图中，观测点落在9–12 M⊙零龄主序（ZAMS）质量轨道的晚期演化阶段（如红超巨星或AGB晚期）所覆盖的区域内，且与该质量范围内的理论预测一致；同时，由于6–8 M⊙“超AGB星”在演化末期存在较大不确定性（如热脉冲强度、质量损失率、是否发生电子对不稳定性等），其最终状态亦可能产生类似光度与颜色的前身星，因此不能排除该质量区间。

综上，基于近红外测光、距离信息、金属丰度约束及多组恒星演化模型比对，SN 2008bk可能前身星的质量范围主要被限制在9–12 M⊙，但6–8 M⊙的超AGB星因理论不确定性仍属合理候选。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Radio Observations of SN 2008bk Our continued monitoring of the field of SN 2008bk with the Very Large Array (ATEL #1452, #1455) shows no radio emission at the optical SN position (CBET 1315 , ATEL #1448). We place a 3 sigma upper limit of 0.225 mJy at 22.5 GHz on 2008 Apr 5.71 UT. We would like to extend our thanks to the VLA scheduling officers for their support of this observing program. 2008-04-08 18:27:00
response: 该文本报告了对超新星SN 2008bk的射电观测结果。首先，研究者利用甚大阵（VLA）持续监测SN 2008bk所在天区，并特别关注光学位置是否对应射电辐射；其次，观测未在该位置探测到任何射电辐射，说明该超新星在22.5 GHz频段无显著射电对应体；再次，基于3σ置信水平，给出了射电流量密度的上限值为0.225 mJy，观测时间为2008年4月5.71 UT；最后，该上限值反映了当前观测灵敏度下所能排除的最弱可能射电辐射强度，可用于约束激波与周围介质相互作用的物理模型（如星周物质密度、爆炸能量、外流速度等）。

根据现象进行分析： Swift observes a new outburst from the Supergiant Fast X-ray Transient XTEJ1739-302/IGRJ17391-3021 A new outburst from the source XTEJ1739-302/IGRJ17391-3021 (Smith et al. 1998, ApJ 501, L101), the prototype of the class of the Supergiant Fast X-ray Transients (SFXT; Smith et al. 2005 ApJ, 638, 974; Negueruela et al. 2006 ApJ, 638, 982), was observed by the Swift Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) on 2008-04-08 at 21:28:15 (trigger=308797). Swift immediately slewed to the target, so that the narrow-field instruments began observing the field 387 s after the BAT trigger. 
Using the BAT data set from T-119 to T+950 s from the recent telemetry downlink, we obtained a nearly constant mask-weighted light curve at the level of 0.25 counts/cm2/s in the 15-150 keV band. The partial coding was 100%. We extracted two time-averaged spectra in the time intervals form T+0 s to T+341 s (before the slew to the target) and from T+373 s to T+850 s (after the slew, simultaneous with XRT observation). Both spectra can be fit with simple power law models with photon indices of 2.7 +/- 0.5 and 3.0 +/- 0.6, consistent with a constant slope. The 15-150 keV fluxes in the given time intervals are 1.8E-9 and 1.2E-9 ergs/cm2/s, respectively. 
The Swift/XRT light curve shows two distinct flares of decreasing intensity; during the first one, which was caught in its descending part, the source reached ~10 counts/s; the second flare is roughly half as bright as the first one (< 4 counts/s). The Swift/XRT data consist of the initial WT data, and subsequent PC data, when the source was fainter. The XRT spectrum from WT data (393-468s since the trigger) can be fit with an absorbed powerlaw with a photon index of 1.29(-0.58,+0.67) and an absorbing column density of NH=(11-3+4)E+22 cm-2 (chi2_red=1.253 for 21 dof). The peak of the flare reached 1.7E-9 erg/cm2/s (unabsorbed, 2-10 keV), which translates into a luminosity of 1.4E+36 erg/s (assuming the optical counterpart distance of 2.7 kpc, Rahoui et al. 2008, arXiV 0802.1770). The fainter X-ray emission (PC data, 565-6649s since the BAT trigger) resulted in a photon index of 1.27(-0.73,+0.92), NH=(10-4+6)E+22 cm-2 (chi2_red=1.252 for 14 dof) and an unabsorbed flux of 4.3E-10 erg/cm2/s (2-10 keV). 
In the past, several bright flares have been observed from this SFXT, mainly with RXTE (Smith et al. 2005 ApJ, 638, 974) and INTEGRAL (Sguera et al. 2005 A&A, 444, 221; Sguera et al. 2006 ApJ, 646, 452; Walter et al., 2007, A&A, 476, 335). The last outburst was observed with the IBIS/ISGRI instrument on-board INTEGRAL, about 403 days ago, on March 2, 2007 (Turler, et al., 2007 ATel#1019). 
In the BAT hard X-ray transient monitor (15-50 keV), this source has shown six past episodes of emission above 150 mcrab and 3.0 sigma significance including an onboard trigger on June 18, 2007. The IGR J17391-3021 light curve from the BAT monitor can be found at http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/weak/IGRJ17391-3021/ 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for making these observations possible, in particular the duty scientists as well as the science planners. 
BAT Transient Monitor page: IGRJ17391-3021/ 2008-04-09 15:16:00
response:
该现象描述了超巨星快X射线暂现源（SFXT）XTE J1739−302/IGR J17391−3021的一次新爆发事件，由Swift卫星于2008年4月8日探测到。首先，BAT在15–150 keV能段触发该事件，表明其为硬X射线暂现源；掩模加权光变曲线显示约0.25 counts/cm²/s的稳定计数率，且部分编码达100%，说明源定位可靠、信噪比高。随后Swift快速转向，XRT在387秒后开始观测，证实该源具有典型的SFXT双峰式短时标耀发结构：第一峰处于下降支，达~10 counts/s（WT模式），第二峰约为其一半（<4 counts/s），符合SFXT“快”（持续数百秒）、“强”（峰值光度达1.4×10³⁶ erg/s）、“短暂”、“间歇性强”的特征。

能谱分析进一步支持其SFXT本质：BAT能谱在爆发前后均可用幂律拟合，光子指数分别为2.7±0.5和3.0±0.6，无显著变硬或变软，表明硬X射线辐射机制相对稳定；而XRT能谱（2–10 keV）在耀发峰值与衰减期均呈现硬谱（Γ≈1.27–1.29）和高吸收柱密度（N_H≈10²³ cm⁻²量级），与超巨星伴星致密恒星风吸积模型一致——即X射线辐射源于中子星穿越伴星风中局部高密度团块时的短暂、剧烈吸积，导致高吸收、硬谱、短时标、高光度爆发。

时间尺度上，BAT观测覆盖T−119至T+950 s，XRT WT数据集中于T+393–468 s（耀发峰值），PC数据覆盖T+565–6649 s（余辉阶段），二者联合给出从硬X射线触发到软X射线演化全过程。流量对比显示：BAT 15–150 keV波段在转向前后通量由1.8×10⁻⁹降至1.2×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s，而XRT 2–10 keV未吸收通量由峰值1.7×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s衰减至4.3×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s，衰减速率与典型SFXT一致。历史对比表明，此次爆发是继2007年3月INTEGRAL探测后约403天的再次活动，且BAT监测显示该源在过去已发生6次显著（>150 mcrab，3σ）硬X射线增强，印证其作为SFXT原型源的反复、间歇性爆发行为。综上，该事件在时域特性、能谱形态、吸收特征、光度演化及历史活动规律等方面均严格符合SFXT定义，为吸积物理在极端恒星风环境下的关键观测证据。

根据现象进行分析： Re-brightening of XTE J1719-291 After our first Swift/XRT observation (ATEL #1451) of the new, very faint X-ray transient XTE J1719-291 (ATEL #1442), we acquired two additional observations to monitor the flux evolution of this source. The first additional observation was performed on April 3, 2008, and lasted ~2.6 ksec. The source was detected at a count rate which was slightly less than the previous observation (0.045 counts/s versus 0.051 counts/s). The source spectrum could be fitted with an absorbed power-law model using a column density of 6.7E21 cm-2, a photon index of ~2.8 and a 2-10 keV observed flux of ~1.1e-12 erg/cm2/s. The unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux was ~1.3e-12 erg/cm2/s. The values we obtained are consistent with the previous Swift/XRT observation (ATEL #1451). 
The second additional observation was obtained on April 9, 2008 and had an exposure time of ~2 ksec. Again the source was clearly detected and when fitting its spectrum with an absorbed power-law model, we obtained a column density of 6+/-1 E21 cm-2, a photon index of 2.5+/-0.2 and a 2-10 keV absorbed flux of ~1.4E-11 erg/cm2/s (unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux was ~1.5e-11 erg/cm2/s). Clearly, the source has become an order of magnitude brighter since the previous Swift/XRT observation and possibly also a bit harder. This brightening of the source strongly suggests that this Swift source is indeed the counterpart of XTE J1719-291. Observations at all wavelengths are encouraged to study this enigmatic transient. 
We thank the Swift team for scheduling these observations. 2008-04-10 19:20:00
response:
首先，观测到XTE J1719-291在2008年4月3日的Swift/XRT观测中光子计数率略低于首次观测（0.045 vs. 0.051 counts/s），谱形参数（吸收柱密度~6.7×10²¹ cm⁻²、光子指数~2.8）与前次一致，2–10 keV吸收后流量约1.1×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s，表明此时源处于稳定弱态或缓慢衰减阶段。  
其次，4月9日的第二次追加观测显示，吸收后2–10 keV流量跃升至约1.4×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，较4月3日提高约12.7倍，达到一个数量级量级的增强；同时光子指数变硬（2.5±0.2 vs. ~2.8），暗示辐射机制或吸积状态发生显著变化；吸收柱密度仍与前期一致（6±1×10²¹ cm⁻²），排除视线方向吸收变化主导亮度变化的可能性。  
第三，该再增亮现象具有时序上的突发性与幅度显著性，且谱演化方向（变硬+增亮）符合典型暂现源（如低质量X射线双星中的爆发源或暂现吸积盘不稳定性事件）在重新激活阶段的特征，因此可排除仪器效应或背景涨落；结合位置一致性，强有力支持Swift探测到的X射线源即为XTE J1719-291的真实对应体。  
最后，再增亮行为本身说明该源并非单次短暂闪现，而是具备多峰活动或持续演化的暂现性质，亟需多波段协同观测以识别其天体物理类型（如中子星或黑洞X射线暂现源、软X射线暂现体等）并约束吸积过程的动力学机制。

根据现象进行分析： Continuous brightening of IGR J17473-2721 Renewed accretion activity has been reported by Swift/XRT (ATel #1459), XTE/PCA (ATel #1460) and INTEGRAL/IBIS/ISGRI (ATel #1461) from the RXTE transient IGR J17473-2721 (= XTE J1747-274; ATels #467, #498) after the detection of an X-ray burst by SuperAGILE (ATel #1445). From the on-going Galactic bulge monitoring program (see ATels #1385, #1461) we report that the transient continues to brighten as seen with IBIS/ISGRI and JEM-X.
The average hard X-ray flux during our observations which started on UT 2008 April 08, 10:18 of the source was 111 +/- 1.3 mCrab at 18-40 keV and 111 +/- 2.1 mCrab at 40-100 keV, which represents a flux increase by a factor of about 3 compared with the Galactic bulge observation on 2008 April 1 (ATel #1461). The source is detected with IBIS/ISGRI from 20 up to about 250 keV with an average flux of 2.7e-9 erg/cm**-2/s. 
The JEM-X shows the average persistent flux to be 50+/-4 mCrab (3-10 keV) and 90+/-7 mCrab (10-25 keV). We observe a ~50 s long type-I X-ray burst on UT 2008, April 08, 13:36, which reached an unabsorbed peak flux of 3.7E-8 erg/cm**-2/s (~1.5 Crab) as estimated between 0.01-100 keV, and a blackbody temperature of 2.4+/-0.4 keV.
Inspection of the Swift/BAT hard X-ray light curve indicates that the source became progressively brighter in the daily averaged observations from 2008 March 30 onward, 30 mCrab (15-50 keV), increasing up to a flux of ~120 mCrab (15-50 keV) on 2008, April 9. 
More information about the INTEGRAL Galactic bulge monitoring 2008-04-11 08:08:00
response:
该现象表明IGR J17473-2721正处于一次显著的再吸积爆发事件中。首先，SuperAGILE探测到的X射线暴（ATel #1445）是触发后续多波段监测的关键标志，通常意味着中子星表面发生热核爆炸，进而揭示系统已进入高吸积率状态。随后Swift/XRT、RXTE/PCA和INTEGRAL/IBIS/ISGRI均确认其持续增亮，说明吸积盘物质正稳定地向致密星（极可能是中子星）输运，且吸积流已重建并增强。

硬X射线波段（18–100 keV）通量在4月1日至4月8日间增长约3倍，达111 mCrab量级，表明高温冕或边界层辐射显著增强，反映吸积功率上升；而JEM-X在软X射线波段（3–25 keV）测得的持续流量（50–90 mCrab）与硬X射线通量同步升高，符合中子星低质量X射线双星（LMXB）在爆发上升相的宽能谱特征。特别地，4月8日观测到的~50秒I型X射线暴，峰值光度达1.5 Crab（0.01–100 keV），黑体温度2.4 keV，进一步证实吸积物质已稳定堆积于中子星表面并触发失控热核燃烧——这是中子星吸积系统处于高ṁ状态的直接证据。

Swift/BAT日平均光变曲线显示，源从3月30日起持续增亮，至4月9日达~120 mCrab（15–50 keV），说明此次爆发并非瞬态闪现，而是典型的LMXB长时标爆发演化过程，上升时间尺度为~10天，符合吸积盘热不稳定性传播所需时间。综合多仪器数据，可判定该源正处于爆发主峰前期，吸积率持续上升，中子星表面稳态燃烧与偶发热核暴共存，且高能辐射延伸至250 keV，暗示存在强康普顿化过程或相对论性外流初现迹象。

input: 根据现象进行分析： MERLIN observations of SN2208ax SN2008ax in NGC4490 (CBET 1280) has been detected at 5GHz using MERLIN. Observations carried out using the Knockin, Darnhall and Tabley antennas (giving a maximum baseline of 67 km) between 14-17th March 2008 at 4.994 GHz result in a point source detection with an integrated flux density of 2.0 mJy with a 3-sigma noise limit of 0.23 mJy/beam. Further 5 GHz observations with five telescopes (maximum baseline of 217 km) between 23rd and 25th March 2008 show that the source brightened to 2.7 mJy (3-sigma = 0.11 mJy/beam). Observations with six telescopes on March 28th give a 5GHz flux density of 1.64 +/- 0.17 mJy while observations on March 31st (no data from the Defford or Cambridge antennas) give a flux density of 1.60 +/- 0.22 mJy. The MERLIN source is located at R.A. = 12h30m40.s8110 Dec = 41d38'14."770 (J2000). Observations are continuing. We acknowledge the use of Director's Discretionary Time and thank the MERLIN staff for making these observations possible. 2008-04-11 14:43:00
response:
首先，观测目标是超新星SN2008ax，位于星系NGC4490中，由MERLIN阵列在5 GHz频段进行射电观测。  
其次，第一轮观测（3月14–17日）使用Knockin、Darnhall和Tabley三台天线，最大基线67 km，在4.994 GHz获得点源探测，积分流量密度为2.0 mJy，3σ噪声水平为0.23 mJy/beam，表明该源显著高于噪声。  
接着，第二轮观测（3月23–25日）扩展至五台望远镜，最大基线增至217 km，测得流量密度上升至2.7 mJy，3σ噪声降至0.11 mJy/beam，说明源在约一周内发生了真实亮度增长，而非观测误差所致。  
然后，3月28日六台望远镜观测得流量密度下降至1.64 ± 0.17 mJy，3月31日因缺少Defford和Cambridge天线数据，测得1.60 ± 0.22 mJy，两次结果在误差范围内一致，表明流量在达到峰值后开始衰减。  
再者，所有MERLIN探测均定位在同一位置：R.A. = 12h30m40.8110s，Dec = +41d38′14.770″（J2000），证实信号来自SN2008ax本身，而非前景或背景混淆源。  
最后，流量随时间呈现“上升—峰值—下降”演化：从3月14–17日的2.0 mJy → 3月23–25日的2.7 mJy → 3月28日的1.64 mJy → 3月31日的1.60 mJy，符合Ib型超新星射电辐射典型行为，即激波与周围介质相互作用产生同步辐射，其光变由激波传播速度、密度分布及磁场强度共同决定。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Radio Observations of SN 2008be We observed the Type IIn SN 2008be (CBET #1303) with the Very Large Array at 8.46 GHz on Apr 8.14 UT. We do not detect a radio source coincident with the optical SN position and place a 3 sigma upper limit on the flux density of 0.12 mJy. We thank the scheduling committee and operators for making these observations possible. 2008-04-11 17:00:00
response: 首先，观测对象是IIn型超新星SN 2008be，该超新星被证认为CBET #1303通报的目标；其次，使用甚大阵（VLA）在8.46 GHz频段进行了射电观测，观测时间为2008年4月8.14 UT；第三，未在光学超新星位置探测到对应的射电源，说明该时刻射电辐射低于仪器探测阈值；第四，据此给出3σ置信水平下的流量密度上限为0.12 mJy，该上限反映了在该频率和时刻下激波与周围介质相互作用所产生的同步辐射强度的上限；最后，该非探测结果可能暗示：抛射物尚未与致密星周介质发生显著相互作用，或介质密度较低、激波速度较慢、磁场较弱，导致同步辐射效率不足，亦或观测时尚处于射电光变曲线的上升前期。

根据现象进行分析： Earlier activity from XTE J1739-302/IGR J17391-3021 detected by INTEGRAL The recently reported outburst from the supergiant fast X-ray transient XTE J1739-302/IGR J17391-3021 (ATEL #1466) began already about five hours earlier than the Swift/BAT trigger on 2008-04-08. 
The INTEGRAL/JEM-X monitor detected a flare starting at 16:18 (UTC) on the same day during recent Galactic Bulge monitoring observations (see ATEL #1385 and #1468). The flux averaged over the ~2 hour flare reached 42+/-8 mCrab (3-10 keV) and 80+/-15 mCrab (10-25 keV) with upper limits previous to the flare of 4 mCrab (3-10) keV and 8 mCrab (10-25 keV). 
The source was also detected with INTEGRAL/IBIS/ISGRI with fluxes of 31+-1.7 mCrab (20-40 keV) and 13+-2.7 mCrab (40-80 keV) on 2008-04-08T14:01 during a 8 ksec exposure. 2008-04-11 21:58:00
response: 该现象表明XTE J1739-302/IGR J17391-3021是一次典型的超巨星快X射线暂现源（SFXT）爆发事件，其关键特征在于爆发起始时间早于Swift/BAT触发约5小时，说明Swift/BAT并非首次探测到该爆发，而是滞后于INTEGRAL的监测发现。INTEGRAL/JEM-X在2008-04-08 16:18 UTC即已记录到显著增强的X射线辐射，且该增强具有明确的时序结构：此前存在严格上限（3–10 keV为4 mCrab，10–25 keV为8 mCrab），而 flare期间光度急剧上升至42±8 mCrab（3–10 keV）和80±15 mCrab（10–25 keV），增长幅度分别达10倍和10倍以上，证实为真实、快速的光变事件。同时，INTEGRAL/IBIS/ISGRI在同日14:01 UTC（即flare开始前约2.3小时）已探测到该源在更高能段（20–80 keV）的持续辐射（31±1.7 mCrab和13±2.7 mCrab），表明爆发可能具有早期高能成分或存在缓慢上升相，与典型SFXT的“快”特性（短时标、高振幅、间歇性）并不矛盾，反而提示其爆发可能包含多阶段演化：早期低水平硬X射线辐射→约2小时后软X射线波段剧烈增亮→峰值持续约2小时。这一时间序列支持SFXT爆发源于中子星穿越致密星风区引发的不稳定性吸积，而非稳态吸积过程。

根据现象进行分析： A candidate near-infrared counterpart to SAX J1750.8-2900 We report on follow-up observations of the field containing the currently active neutron star X-ray transient SAX J1750-2900 (Markwardt & Swank 2008, ATel #1425; see also ATels #1426, #1428). The observations consist of near-infrared imaging with the PANIC camera mounted on the 6.5m Baade telescope at Las Campanas Observatory.
In order to identify variable counterpart candidates, we obtained a series of 15s Ks-band images on 2008 Mar 30 09:52-09:59 UT to complement the Ks-band observations of the field acquired on 2008 Mar 18 09:06 UT (Torres et al. 2008, ATel #1446). Sky conditions were good during both nights with a similar seeing of ~0.4 arcsec. Additional 3s exposures of the field were obtained on Mar 18 to derive an astrometric and absolute flux calibration of the frames relative to 2MASS. The astrometric and photometric scales were defined using isolated 2MASS objects in the field of view achieving a positional RMS < 0.15 arcsec and a zero-point error < 0.1 mag.
Relative (PSF-fitting) photometry on the two data sets resulted in the identification of a variable source within the error circle for the improved X-ray location of SAX J1750.8-2900 (Steeghs et al. 2008, ATel #1431; Torres et al. 2008, ATel #1446). The measured magnitudes are Ks = 17.1 +/- 0.1 on Mar 18 and Ks = 17.8 +/- 0.2 on Mar 30. We determined a position of R.A(J2000)=17:50:24.43 and Dec(J2000)=-29:02:15.0 (+/- 0.1" uncertainty) for this source (see also finding chart). Note that the Mar 30 data set was acquired when the X-ray flux had declined by a factor of ~10 compared to the X-ray flux measured at the peak of the outburst on Mar 18 (Markwardt & Swank 2008, ATel #1425; Torres et al. 2008, ATel #1446).
We consider this variable source a likely infrared counterpart to SAX J1750.8-2900.
Finding chart for J1750.8: http://hea-www.harvard.edu/~mtorres/SAXJ1750.8m2900.html 2008-04-12 02:34:00
response:
首先，该研究旨在为X射线暂现源SAX J1750.8−2900寻找近红外对应体。研究人员利用Baade望远镜上的PANIC相机，在两个时间点（2008年3月18日和3月30日）对源所在天区进行了Ks波段成像观测，两次观测均在良好视宁度（~0.4角秒）下完成，保证了空间分辨能力。

其次，为实现精确定标，研究者在3月18日额外获取了3秒曝光图像，用于与2MASS星表进行天体测量和光度定标；通过选取视场内孤立的2MASS参考星，实现了位置精度RMS < 0.15角秒、零点误差 < 0.1星等的高精度校准。

第三，采用PSF拟合相对测光方法对两组数据进行处理，在X射线精确定位误差圆内（基于Steeghs等及Torres等给出的改进X射线位置）识别出一个亮度变化的源：Ks = 17.1 ± 0.1（3月18日）→ Ks = 17.8 ± 0.2（3月30日），即变暗约0.7星等；该光变趋势与X射线流量变化一致——3月30日X射线流量已比3月18日峰值下降约10倍，表明该红外源的光度演化与X射线活动存在时序相关性。

第四，该源的位置测定为R.A.(J2000) = 17:50:24.43，Dec.(J2000) = −29:02:15.0，不确定性仅为±0.1角秒，与X射线位置误差圆高度重合，空间关联显著。

综上，该变源在位置、光变行为（与X射线通量同步衰减）、观测信噪比及定标可靠性等方面均满足中子星X射线暂现源近红外对应体的关键判据，因此被合理认定为SAX J1750.8−2900的很可能红外对应体。

根据现象进行分析： X-ray identification of the prenova of V2491 Cyg We report on the possible X-ray counterpart to the prenova of the recently discovered bright nova, V2491 Cyg (IAUC # 8934 , CBET #1334). 
The last Swift observation of the prenova field before the outburst was on UT 2008 Jan 2 for an exposure of 5.6 ksec. We find a source in the XRT field of view at a position of (J2000.0) RA = 19h43m02.1s, Dec = +32d19'12.8", with an uncertainty of 4.1", with a net count rate of about 0.021 cts/s. The source lies only 1.5" from the optical nova position. We identify this source as the X-ray counterpart of the prenova, and designate it Swift J1943.0+3219. 
The 0.1-5 keV spectrum can be well described (Chi^2_red = 1.1 for 3 degrees of freedom) by an absorbed power-law. We fixed the absorption column, using the Leiden/Argentine/Bonn (LAB) Survey of Galactic HI, to a value closest to the source of N_H = 2.9e21 atoms cm^-2. We find a power-law index of 1.30+/-0.25 and an unabsorbed flux of about 1.1e-12 ergs/cm^2/s^1. 
We also found a source in the XMM-Newton full Slew Survey EPIC Source Catalogue, XMMSL1 J194301.9+321911, during a slew performed on 2006 Nov 15, at the following coordinates: (J2000.0) RA = 19h43m02.03s, Dec = 32d19'10.5", with error radius of 6.1". This source lies only 3.7" from the nova position, and is consistent with that found for Swift J1943.0+3219, and we therefore they are one and the same X-ray source. 
We further note that in the ROSAT All-Sky Survey Faint Source Catalog there is a source close to those quoted above, 1RXS J194259.9+321940. It lies about 38" away from the nova position with coordinates (J2000.0) RA = 19h42m59.90s, Dec = 32d19'40.5", with a positional uncertainty of about 28". 
We encourage follow up of the source at various wavelengths. 2008-04-12 20:54:00
response:
首先，观测目标是新星V2491 Cyg爆发前的前身星（prenova），需确认其X射线对应体。Swift卫星在2008年1月2日（爆发前）对该天区进行了5.6 ks曝光观测，在XRT视场中探测到一个X射线源，位置为J2000.0坐标RA = 19h43m02.1s，Dec = +32d19'12.8"，位置误差4.1″，净计数率约0.021 cts/s；该源与光学新星位置仅相距1.5″，空间一致性极高，因此可可靠认定为前身星的X射线对应体，并命名为Swift J1943.0+3219。

其次，能谱分析表明：0.1–5 keV波段谱形可用吸收幂律模型良好拟合（χ²_red = 1.1，自由度=3）；吸收柱密度N_H被固定为LAB巡天给出的银河系中性氢柱密度值2.9×10²¹ cm⁻²（最接近该方向的实测值）；拟合得到幂律谱指数Γ = 1.30 ± 0.25，未吸收流量为1.1×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，说明该源具有硬X射线谱形和中等光度，符合激变变星中吸积白矮星的典型X射线特征。

第三，多历元交叉证认增强可靠性：XMM-Newton巡天在2006年11月15日 slewing 观测中独立探测到XMMSL1 J194301.9+321911，位置RA = 19h43m02.03s，Dec = +32d19'10.5"，误差半径6.1″，与Swift源位置相差仅3.7″，在各自误差范围内完全一致，证实二者为同一稳定X射线源；更早的ROSAT全天空巡天也探测到1RXS J194259.9+321940，虽位置偏差较大（约38″，误差达28″），但仍在ROSAT较差定位精度允许范围内，构成该源长期存在的间接支持证据。

综上，Swift、XMM-Newton与ROSAT三台设备在不同时期、不同灵敏度与定位精度下均在相同天区探测到一致X射线源，且与光学新星位置高度吻合，结合其硬谱指数与中等X射线光度，可确凿判定该X射线源即为V2491 Cyg的前身星——一颗处于稳定吸积状态的激变变星系统。

input: 根据现象进行分析： GMRT observation of SN 2008ax in the L-band We report on a Target of Opportunity (ToO) observation of SN 2008ax on 2008 Mar 25 by the Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (GMRT) in the L-band (mean observing epoch 19.25 UT). Radio emission from the SN was not detected. The 2 sigma upper limit of the SN flux at the central frequency of 1397 MHz was 0.45 mJy. The corresponding map rms is 0.225 mJy. We thank the staff of GMRT who made this observation possible. GMRT is run by the National Centre for Radio Astrophysics (NCRA) of the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR). 2008-04-13 14:42:00
response: 该段文字描述了一次针对超新星SN 2008ax的GMRT L波段射电观测。首先，明确观测基本信息：使用印度巨米波射电望远镜（GMRT），在2008年3月25日UT时间19.25（即平均观测历元），工作频段为L波段，中心频率1397 MHz。其次，核心观测结果是未探测到该超新星的射电辐射，这是一个非探测（non-detection）结果。第三，需正确理解统计置信度与噪声的关系：文中给出“2σ上限为0.45 mJy”，而“对应图像rms为0.225 mJy”，这表明0.45 mJy = 2 × 0.225 mJy，符合高斯噪声下2σ通量密度上限的定义（即上限 = 2 × rms）。第四，该上限值反映了在该观测深度下，若存在射电辐射，其真实流量密度应低于0.45 mJy（置信水平约95.4%）。第五，该结果对超新星爆发后的激波与周围介质相互作用模型具有约束意义：较弱或未探测到的射电辐射可能暗示较低的抛射物速度、较低的周星介质（CSM）密度，或较晚的观测时机（此时激波尚未充分加速电子或进入高密度区）。最后，致谢部分属于标准观测报告格式，不参与科学推断。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical observations of the fast nova V2491 Cyg We report on optical spectral observations and UBVRI brightness estimations obtained with 60/90 cm Schmidt and 60 cm Cassegrain telescopes of the Nicolaus Copernicus University Observatory (Torun, Poland). The nova V2491 Cyg was discovered on Apr. 10.728 UT with about 7.7 mag on unfiltered CCD frames (IAUC# 8934  ). Additionally, the X-ray emission was detected for the prenova several months ago (ATel#1473). The magnitudes estimated on Apr. 13.957 UT were U=9.02, B=9.21, V=9.03, R=8.04, I=7.72 using HD 331150 as the comparison star and assuming 10.30, 10.254, 10.25, 10.26 and 10.27 for its UBVRI magnitudes, respectively. The accuracy of our photometry is about 0.01 magnitude. A comparison with the data from IAUC# 8934  shows that our photometry was obtained about 2.2-2.3 days after the maximum when the star reached about 7.1-7.4 magnitude in the V light. Prismatic optical spectra (4000-9500 AA), with a resolution ~18 A around H-alpha and ~6 A around H-beta, were obtained on Apr. 11.99 UT and Apr. 13.95 UT. In both spectra the Balmer lines from H-alpha to H-delta are seen in emission. The FWHM of H-alpha is ~4800 km/s on Apr. 11.99 and ~4600 km/s on Apr. 13.95. The H-beta FWHM is ~4860 km/s and ~4220 km/s, respectively. The equivalent width of H-alpha increased twice, from ~380 A on Apr. 11.99 to ~760 A on Apr. 13.95. In the same time the H-beta equivalent width changed from ~140 A on Apr. 11.99 to ~180 A on Apr. 13.95. The FWHM and equivalent width of H-alpha observed on Apr. 11.99 are very close to those observed near the maximum (CBET#1334). P Cyg absorptions with a velocity about -3900 km/s on Apr. 11.99 and about -4000 km/s on Apr. 13.95 are well visible in H-beta and H-gamma profiles. It is possible that a second P Cyg absorption component, with velocity of about -6400 km/s, appeared in H-beta on Apr. 13.95 UT. An additional emission component with a velocity about +2300 km/s presents in the H-beta and H-gamma profiles on both dates. A strong asymmetry of the red H-alpha wing is most probably caused by a similar emission component. In addition to the Balmer lines in the spectrum of V2491 Cyg, relatively strong lines of Fe II multiplets 37, 38, 42 and 49 and OI 8446 A are present as well. Both, the expansion velocities and rapid fading of the brightness, indicate that V2491 Cyg belongs to the group of the extremely fast novae. 2008-04-14 22:27:00
response:
首先，观测到V2491 Cyg是一颗快速新星，其光学发现时间为4月10.728 UT，未滤光CCD测得星等约7.7 mag；结合IAUC#8934的报道，该星在发现时已接近极大亮度，而本文UBVRI测光数据（4月13.957 UT）显示V波段为9.03 mag，比极大时（约7.1–7.4 mag）暗了约1.6–2.0 mag，对应时间滞后约2.2–2.3天，符合快速新星的典型衰减速率。

其次，两次光谱观测（4月11.99 UT和4月13.95 UT）均显示完整的巴尔末发射线（Hα至Hδ），且Hα和Hβ的FWHM高达~4800 km/s与~4860 km/s，显著大于普通恒星谱线展宽，表明存在高速膨胀的抛射包层；FWHM在两天内略有下降（Hα：4800→4600 km/s；Hβ：4860→4220 km/s），反映膨胀速度随时间减小，符合激波驱动抛射物减速的动力学演化。

第三，Hα等效宽度在两天内由380 Å增至760 Å，翻倍增长，而Hβ仅由140 Å增至180 Å，增幅较小；这说明低激发态（如Hα）的发射增强更显著，可能源于抛射物冷却导致电子温度下降、复合辐射效率升高，或光学厚化使低阶巴尔末线形成区扩大。

第四，P Cygni吸收成分清晰可见，速度约为−3900 km/s（4月11.99）和−4000 km/s（4月13.95），表明存在向外运动的连续谱遮蔽物质；Hβ中在4月13.95出现第二吸收成分（−6400 km/s），暗示存在更高初速的子结构或不均匀抛射；同时，Hβ与Hγ中均存在+2300 km/s的附加发射成分，且Hα红翼明显不对称，说明抛射包层存在非球对称性，可能存在双极外流、喷流或局部致密团块。

第五，谱中还检测到Fe II多重重线（37、38、42、49）及[OI] 8446 Å发射，这些是中等激发态金属谱线，常见于新星早期光谱，反映抛射物中富含金属、处于部分电离状态，且电子密度较高（Fe II需中等密度维持激发）；其存在进一步支持该新星处于爆发后数日内、包层仍较致密且未充分稀释的阶段。

最后，综合高膨胀速度（>4000 km/s）、短时标内显著变暗（2天内V减幅达1.6–2.0 mag）以及早期强发射谱特征，可判定V2491 Cyg属于“极快新星”（very fast nova），其白矮星质量应较大（接近钱德拉塞卡极限），导致吸积壳层点燃后产生极高温度与压力，引发剧烈核燃烧并驱动超高速抛射。

根据现象进行分析： e-VLBI observations of Cyg X-3 We observed the X-ray binary Cyg X-3 on April 9th, 2008 for 9.5 hours, between 03:30-13:00 UT, at 5 GHz with the European VLBI Network (EVN) in e-VLBI mode (the data from the radio telescopes are sent over optical fibers in real-time to the correlator for processing). The radio telescopes participating in the experiment were: Cambridge, Medicina, Jodrell Bank MkII, Onsala (25 m), Torun and Westerbork (phased array). 
In the last few weeks Cyg X-3 has been passing through a clear transition towards softer states, as indicated by the ASM detector onboard the Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer (RXTE). This kind of behaviour has been associated in previous observations of Cyg X-3, as well as other X-ray binaries, with intermittent relativistic ejections of matter, detectable at radio wavelengths. We therefore triggered the e-VLBI observations. 
The preliminary analysis reveals that the target is resolved and appears as two distinct compact emitting regions, with total flux density around 1.3 mJy (rms noise 0.09 mJy/beam). Both of these regions have been identified in one or more previous e-EVN images (Tudose et al. 2007 MNRAS 375, L11), but their nature is still not known. However, it is clear that Cyg X-3 shows structural changes on milliarcsecond scales even when the source does not show significant radio flaring activity. It is interesting to note that the radio "core" of the system (whose position was identified by Mioduszewski et al. 2001 ApJ 553, 766 and Miller-Jones et al. 2004 ApJ 600, 368) was not detected in any of the e-EVN observations in 2006-2008. 
e-VLBI developments in Europe are supported by the EC DG-INFSO funded Communication Network Development project 'EXPRES', contract No. 02662. The European VLBI Network is a joint facility of European, Chinese, South African and other radio astronomy institutes funded by their national research councils. 
We thank the EVN-PC for its support for this triggered e-VLBI observation and the JIVE staff (particularly R. Campbell) for their efforts in assuring the success of the experiment. 2008-04-15 10:04:00
response:
首先，观测目标是X射线双星系统Cyg X-3，时间是2008年4月9日UT 03:30–13:00，持续9.5小时，频率为5 GHz，采用欧洲VLBI网（EVN）的e-VLBI模式，即各台站数据通过光纤实时传输至相关器处理。参与观测的望远镜包括Cambridge、Medicina、Jodrell Bank MkII、Onsala（25 m）、Torun和Westerbork（相控阵）。

其次，触发此次观测的物理动因是Cyg X-3在观测前数周正经历明确的能谱软化转变，该现象由RXTE卫星上的ASM探测器确认；历史研究表明，此类软态转变在Cyg X-3及其他X射线双星中常与间歇性相对论性物质外流相关，而这类外流可在射电波段被VLBI分辨并探测到，因此启动了靶向e-VLBI观测。

第三，初步成像分析显示：Cyg X-3在5 GHz上被显著分辨，呈现两个分离的致密辐射区，总流量密度约1.3 mJy，图像rms噪声为0.09 mJy/beam；这两个结构曾在Tudose等（2007）的前期e-EVN图像中被识别，但其物理本质（如是否为喷流结、激波前沿或静止驻波结构）仍未确定。

第四，关键结构演化特征浮现：尽管本次观测期间未发生显著射电耀发（即无大振幅流量变化），系统在毫角秒尺度上仍表现出清晰的结构变化；更值得注意的是，此前高分辨率VLBI研究（Mioduszewski et al. 2001；Miller-Jones et al. 2004）所定位的射电“核”位置——通常对应吸积流最内区或喷流启始点——在2006–2008年间所有e-EVN观测中均未被探测到，表明该核心成分可能具有高度时变性、方向依赖性或仅在特定谱态下产生可探测射电辐射。

综上，该观测揭示Cyg X-3的射电结构演化并非严格耦合于整体射电光变，而可能受吸积态转变驱动的喷流动力学调制，其核心缺失暗示传统“静态核”图像不适用，需考虑喷流形成区的瞬时熄灭、视线倾角效应或辐射机制的谱态依赖性。

根据现象进行分析： Very Large Array Search for Radio Emission from Supernova 2008bo In NGC 6643 We report the possible detection of radio emission of the type II supernova 2008bo (CBET 1324, 1325) with the Very Large Array (VLA) radio telescope. The measured position of the radio emission of R.A. = 18h19m54.s30, Decl. = +741o348'21".1, (equinox 2000.0) is in good agreement with the measured optical position of (ending digits) R.A. = 54.s34, Decl. = 20".9 (CBET 1324). A flux density of 0.230 +/- 0.066 mJy was measured at 22.46 GHz (wavelength 1.3 cm) and 0.447 +/- 0.047 mJy at 8.46 GHz (wavelength 3.5 cm) on April 05.57 UT. We further report that no radio emission was detected near the vicinity of SN 2008bo with a three sigma upper-limit of 0.23 mJy at 8.46 GHz on April 07.10 UT. 
Our radio measurements also indicate the presence of diffuse radio emission, which may be indicative of the star-forming regions detected in the Swift UV observations in the vicinity of SN 2008bo (ATEL 1463). Given that SN 2008bo was only weakly detected in the first observation and not detected in the second observation, no further radio observations with the VLA are planned. We would like to extend our thanks to the VLA scheduling officers for their support of our observing program. 2008-04-15 15:28:00
response:
首先，该文本报告了对II型超新星SN 2008bo在NGC 6643星系中开展的甚大阵（VLA）射电观测结果。关键现象包括：  
1. 在4月5.57 UT首次观测中，在22.46 GHz（1.3 cm）和8.46 GHz（3.5 cm）两个频点分别测得射电流量密度为0.230±0.066 mJy和0.447±0.047 mJy，且其射电位置（R.A. = 18h19m54.30s, Dec. = +74°1′34.8″21″）与光学定位（R.A. = 54.34s, Dec. = 20.9″）高度一致，表明射电辐射很可能源于超新星本身，而非背景源或前景干扰。  
2. 在4月7.10 UT的第二次观测中，同一频点（8.46 GHz）未探测到射电辐射，仅给出3σ上限0.23 mJy，该值等于首次观测中22.46 GHz的测量值，暗示射电辐射可能已快速衰减或本就处于探测极限附近。  
3. 观测还识别出弥散射电成分，其空间分布与Swift紫外望远镜所发现的邻近恒星形成区吻合，说明该弥散辐射更可能源于宿主星系中的星族活动，而非超新星激波与周围介质相互作用产生的同步辐射。  
4. 综合两次观测结果——首期弱探测、二期未探测，且无显著光变特征支撑持续射电辐射模型——研究者判断该信号信噪比低、不可靠或属暂现事件，因此终止后续VLA观测计划。  
综上，该“可能探测”更可能反映观测统计涨落或残余恒星形成区贡献，而非超新星射电余辉的明确证认。
