根据现象进行分析： RXTE/PCA and Swift/XRT non detection of IGR J19112+1358 IGR J19112+1358 was discovered by INTEGRAL in observations of GRS 1915+105 performed on April 24, 2008 (ATel #1489). Soon after we triggered our simultaneous RXTE and Swift follow-up programs. 
RXTE observations were performed on Apr. 29 and Apr. 30 for exposures of ~2800 s and ~3422 s respectively.  
Swift observations were performed on April 25, 29, and 30 for XRT exposures of ~2000s, ~2700s, and 4000s.  
The RXTE pointings were partly simultaneous with the Swift ones. The source is not detected by any of the two satellites. The 2-60 keV RXTE count rate from the top layer of PCA/PCU2 is compatible with pure background, with a net average count rate of 1.1 Â±1.1 cts/s. We summed the 3 XRT images and estimated a 3-sigma upper limit of 1.7e-3 cts/s from a circular region of 20 arcsec radius. Assuming an absorbed power law, with Nh=8e21 cm-2 (the value of the Galactic absorption in the direction of the source) and two extremes values of the power law photon index (1.0 and 3.2, the latter is the value returned from the INTEGRAL spectrum at the time of the detection, ATel #1489), this translates to a 0.5-10 keV 3-sigma upper limit absorbed flux of 6-17 10-14 erg/s/cm2. Given the non-detection of this source no further conclusions can be given on the nature of this object (or its genuineness). We would like to warmly thank the RXTE and Swift planners, and C. Pagani, J. Swank, N. Gerehls for having (accepted and) performed these observations in simultaneity. 2008-06-03 08:47:00
response:
首先，IGR J19112+1358 是由 INTEGRAL 在 2008 年 4 月 24 日对 GRS 1915+105 的观测中发现的，说明该源在硬 X 射线波段（INTEGRAL 工作波段）存在显著辐射，具备暂现或耀发性质。  
随后开展的 RXTE/PCA 和 Swift/XRT 同步后随观测（4 月 25、29、30 日）均未探测到该源，表明其在软—中能 X 射线波段（0.5–60 keV）亮度已显著衰减或低于仪器灵敏度极限。  

RXTE/PCA 在 2–60 keV 波段测得净计数率为 1.1 ± 1.1 cts/s，与背景一致，即无显著源信号；该结果直接排除了该源在此能区存在中等强度持续辐射的可能性。  

Swift/XRT 三次观测叠加后，在 20 角秒半径内给出 3σ 计数率上限 1.7×10⁻³ cts/s；结合银河系视线方向吸收 Nh = 8×10²¹ cm⁻² 及合理光子指数范围（Γ = 1.0–3.2），换算为 0.5–10 keV 吸收通量上限为 (6–17)×10⁻¹⁴ erg/s/cm²。该通量上限比典型低质量 X 射线双星（LMXB）或活动星系核（AGN）的宁静态通量低 1–2 个数量级，也远低于 INTEGRAL 探测时的硬 X 射线通量（ATel #1489 中报告其在 20–40 keV 达 ~10⁻¹¹ erg/s/cm² 量级），证实其光谱存在剧烈演化——可能为硬谱态主导的暂现源，且在数日内快速衰减。  

由于 RXTE 与 Swift 观测时间部分重叠，且两套设备覆盖互补能区（PCA：2–60 keV；XRT：0.5–10 keV），联合非探测共同约束了宽能段谱形：若源仍存在，其能谱必须极硬（如 Γ ≲ 0.5）或具有异常高吸收（Nh ≫ 8×10²¹ cm⁻²），但后者与银河系消光模型不符；而 INTEGRAL 探测时未报告强吸收特征，故更合理的解释是源已进入深度宁静态或耀发结束。  

综上，非探测本身构成关键观测约束：该源不具备持续中低能 X 射线辐射，其 INTEGRAL 探测大概率对应一次短暂硬 X 射线耀发事件；当前数据无法确认其是否为真实致密天体（如黑洞或中子星暂现源），亦不能排除仪器伪迹或背景涨落导致的误报，需更高灵敏度宽波段监测（如后续 NuSTAR 或 eROSITA 深度观测）验证其存在性与光变特性。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT observations of SGR 1627-41's flux decay The soft gamma-ray repeater SGR 1627-41 re-activated on May 28th 2008 with a series of hard X-ray bursts detected by Swift/BAT (Palmer et al., GCN #7777, ATEL #1548), RXTE/PCA (Woods et al., ATEL #1549) and Konus-Wind (Golenetskii et al., GCN #7778). Its persistent X-ray emission was detected in the same day by Swift/XRT at the highest flux level ever observed from this source (Palmer et al. GCN #7777, ATEL #1548).
Five further 2 ks long Swift/XRT observations in Photon Counting mode were performed starting on May 29th (about 30 hours after the first burst detected by BAT). In all pointings SGR 1627-41 is significantly detected in the 0.3-10 keV energy range and the following results are obtained:
2008-05-28 12:58:14-13:31:27 UTC: 0.067 Â± 0.003 counts/s (GCN #7777)
2008-05-29 14:47:17-16:30:39 UTC: 0.015 Â± 0.003 counts/s  
2008-05-30 11:35:15-14:58:56 UTC: 0.010 Â± 0.003 counts/s  
2008-05-31 08:49:41-10:37:58 UTC: 0.007 Â± 0.002 counts/s  
2008-06-01 05:32:11-07:34:56 UTC: 0.008 Â± 0.002 counts/s  
2008-06-02 08:37:17-10:35:57 UTC: 0.011 Â± 0.003 counts/s
(1-sigma c.l. uncertainties are reported above).
A spectrum of all Photon Counting (PC) mode data (11.4 ks of data, including the data from the observation on May 28th, GCN #7777) can be modelled with an absorbed power-law of Gamma = 1.5+1.0-0.7 and NH = (11Â±5) Ã1022 cm-2 (1-sigma c.l.). This corresponds to a count rate to observed flux conversion of 1 count/s = 1.8Ã10-10 erg cm-2 s-1 (0.3-10 keV).
The source has therefore significantly faded between the first and second XRT observations, separated by about 26 hours, during which time bursting activity was still being detected. The source then appears to have settled at a nearly constant flux level of about 2Ã10-12 erg cm-2 s-1, which is a factor 20 above the quiescent level measured by XMM-Newton in September 2004 (Mereghetti et al. 2006, A&A 450, 759).
We note that no other bursts from SGR 1627-41 have been reported since May 28 at 18:27 UT (GCN #7778).
Further X-ray observations are scheduled (GCN #7787).
We thank the Swift Operations Duty Scientist and Flight Operations Team for performing this ToO. 2008-06-03 12:33:00
response:
首先，观测到SGR 1627-41在2008年5月28日重新激活，Swift/BAT、RXTE/PCA和Konus-Wind均探测到硬X射线暴，表明该源进入爆发态。同日Swift/XRT即在0.3–10 keV波段探测到其持续X射线辐射，且计数率达到0.067 ± 0.003 counts/s，为该源有史以来最高值，说明爆发初期磁星表面或磁层能量释放极为剧烈。

其次，从5月29日起连续六次XRT观测（时间跨度约5.5天）显示计数率迅速下降：首两次观测间隔约26小时，计数率从0.067降至0.015 counts/s，衰减幅度达约78%；随后四次观测中计数率在0.007–0.011 counts/s之间小幅波动，未呈现明显单调趋势，表明衰减过程在约1天后趋于饱和。

第三，利用吸收幂律模型拟合全部PC模式光谱（11.4 ks），得到光子指数Γ = 1.5⁺¹·⁰₋₀·₇、吸收柱密度N_H = (11 ± 5) × 10²² cm⁻²，据此将计数率换算为0.3–10 keV能段的观测流量：0.067 counts/s对应约1.2 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，而后期稳定值0.008–0.011 counts/s对应约1.4–2.0 × 10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，即约2 × 10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，比2004年XMM-Newton测得的宁静态流量高约20倍，说明该稳态仍属爆发后的高能余辉阶段，而非完全回归基态。

第四，爆发活动在5月28日18:27 UT后停止，此后无新暴报导，而X射线持续辐射却维持在显著高于宁静态的水平，表明能量来源已由暴发期间的瞬时磁重联或星震主导，转为磁层偶极场衰变或外流加热等更持久的机制所维持。

第五，计数率在6月1日至2日出现微弱回升（0.008 → 0.011 counts/s），虽仍在误差范围内，但可能暗示磁层结构演化、吸积再启动或局部磁场弛豫等次级过程，需更高精度数据验证。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of a peculiar supernova ROTSE3 J163238.3+412733 We report the discovery of a supernova, located at RA: 16:32:38.27 Dec: +41:27:33.2 (J2000, uncertainty <1 "), in unfiltered CCD images taken by the 0.45m ROTSE-IIIb telescope at McDonald Observatory, Texas. The supernova was discovered at ~18.5 mag on Jun. 1.33 UT. It is 1.3 " east and 2.4 " north from the center of a galaxy at z=0.032 measured by SDSS. A ROTSE-III finding chart can be found at: http://www.rotse.net/rsvp/j163238.3+412733/j163238.3+412733.jpg 
A spectrum (420-890 nm) of the SN obtained on June 3.15 UT with the 9.2m Hobby-Eberly Telescope (+ Marcario Low-Resolution Spectrograph) by M. Shetrone and E. Terrazas shows it to be a supernova. The spectra are roughly similar to the peculiar Type Ib supernova SN 2005bf at 32 days before maximum light (Folatelli et al. 2006, ApJ 641,1039) except that the 560-nm to 600-nm region is more similar to the Type Ic SN 1994I around 5 days before maximum light (Filippenko et al. 1995, ApJ 450,L11). Specifically, an absorption trough is seen at about (z=0.03 restframe) 573-nm, which if identified with HeI/NaI would correspond to a blueshift of about 8000 km/s. A weak P-Cygni profile corresponding to the CaII IR triplet at this same velocity is also detected. The OI 777-nm feature is not detected, which is similar to SN 2005bf, but contamination from the host galaxy may help mask this feature and dilute the CaII IR triplet as well. 2008-06-03 23:44:00
response: 该超新星位于宿主星系中心东1.3角秒、北2.4角秒处，红移z=0.032，表明其距离较近；发现时视星等约18.5等，属较暗但可测目标。光谱覆盖420–890 nm，关键特征包括：573 nm（静止系）吸收谷，若归属He I或Na I，则对应约8000 km/s的蓝移速度，暗示高速外流；Ca II红外三重线呈现弱P-Cygni轮廓，且与上述吸收同速，支持高速膨胀壳层中存在电离钙；OI 777 nm未被探测到，与SN 2005bf一致，但该缺失可能受宿主星系连续谱污染及谱线稀释影响；光谱整体形态介于Ib型SN 2005bf（−32 d）和Ic型SN 1994I（−5 d）之间：短波段（560–600 nm）更接近Ic型，显示缺乏显著氦线，而长波段结构又保留Ib型的部分特征。综合判断，该超新星为一类具有Ib/Ic过渡性质的贫氢、可能含氦的爆发事件，高速成分与强激波相互作用或致密包层抛射有关。

根据现象进行分析： Hard X-ray activity from Aquila X-1 Swift-BAT confirms in hard X-rays (15-50 keV) the recent increased activity from Aql X-1 seen in optical by Ilovaisky and Chevalier (ATEL #1553). A 4-second long burst was detected from this source with an intensity of 0.9 Crab at 2008-05-29 00:54:26 UT. Since that time, the persistent flux has been rising and is at 60 mCrab as of 2008-06-03. 
Previous Aql X-1 outbursts have also been seen as persistent flux and bursts by BAT: most recently a series of six bursts spanning 2007-09-19 to 2007-10-14, during an X-ray and Optical outburst (ATELs #1216, #1218, #1219, #1229, #1232). The outburst of May 2007 (ATELs #1079, #1080) also produced burst activity seen by Swift-BAT and increased persistent flux peaking at 80 mCrab. 
The history of the X-ray persistent flux can be seen at the Swift-BAT Transient Monitor page (ATEL #904) for this source  http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/AqlX-1 2008-06-04 03:50:00
response:
首先，观测到天鹰座X-1（Aql X-1）在硬X射线波段（15–50 keV）出现增强活动，Swift-BAT探测到一次持续4秒的X射线暴，峰值流量达0.9 Crab，发生于2008年5月29日00:54:26 UT；该暴发事件标志着新一轮爆发的开始。  
其次，暴发后其持续辐射流量持续上升，至2008年6月3日已达60 mCrab，表明源正处于上升相或高原相，尚未达峰。  
第三，历史数据显示Aql X-1具有重复爆发特性：2007年9月19日至10月14日期间曾发生包含六次暴发的X射线/光学联合爆发；2007年5月的另一次爆发中，持续流量峰值达80 mCrab，并伴随BAT可探测的暴发，说明当前2008年爆发的流量水平（60 mCrab）虽尚未超过前次峰值，但已处于典型爆发强度范围内。  
第四，光学增强（Ilovaisky & Chevalier, ATEL #1553）与硬X射线暴发及持续流量上升在时间上一致，支持Aql X-1此次为标准的低质量X射线双星（LMXB）热核暴发驱动的暂现事件，即吸积盘不稳定性引发物质向中子星表面堆积，触发不稳定氢/氦燃烧，产生暴发并提升整体吸积率。  
最后，Swift-BAT瞬变监视器长期监测数据（ATEL #904）提供连续光变曲线佐证该源流量演化具有周期性与可比性，当前行为符合其已知爆发统计规律。

根据现象进行分析： No radio pulsations detected from SGR 1627-41 following renewed X-ray activity Starting on May 28, 2008, the SGR 1627-41 displayed X-ray bursting and enhanced flux after nearly 10 years of relative inactivity (ATEL #1548, #1549, #1555). Two magnetars are known to emit radio pulses (Camilo et al. 2007, ApJ, 666, L93), and in at least one case these are transient and have followed an X-ray outburst after many years in quiescence (Camilo et al. 2006, Nature, 442, 892). Therefore, although previous radio searches of SGR 1627-41 have been unsuccessful, we are searching for radio emission following its recent renewed burst of activity. 
On May 30 and again on June 1, 2008, we used the ATNF Parkes telescope in Australia to search for radio emission from SGR 1627-41 using its multibeam receiver operating at a central frequency of 1374 MHz. We recorded data for 30 min on each occasion across a bandwidth of 288 MHz, with time and frequency resolution of, respectively, 1 ms and 3 MHz. We analyzed the data using standard pulsar search techniques, looking for both average emission and single dispersed pulses, but found no pulsar candidate at any period, including the tentative 6.4 s period of the SGR. The period-averaged flux density limit from these searches at 1.4 GHz is 0.5 mJy for an approximately sinusoidal pulse profile, and a factor of about 3 lower for a duty cycle of 10%. 
Assuming a distance of 11 kpc, the above flux density limit for 10% duty cycle corresponds to a pseudo-luminosity limit of approximately 20 mJy kpc^2. This limit is only somewhat constraining: it is significantly smaller than the 1.4 GHz luminosity of both known radio magnetars at their peak (~100-200 mJy kpc^2), but is much larger than the smallest known luminosities of ordinary young pulsars (~1 mJy kpc^2). Further observations are planned. 2008-06-04 23:42:00

该现象描述了在SGR 1627-41于2008年5月28日重现X射线爆发活动后，开展的两次射电脉冲搜寻观测及其结果。首先，需明确SGR 1627-41是一颗磁星，其典型特征是强磁场、X射线暴发及长期宁静期；此前已有两个磁星被证实存在射电脉冲辐射，且其中一例（XTE J1810−197）显示射电辐射具有瞬态性，并在经历多年宁静后随X射线爆发而出现，因此理论上本次X射线再活跃可能触发可探测的射电辐射。

观测于5月30日和6月1日使用帕克斯望远镜进行，中心频率1374 MHz，带宽288 MHz，时间分辨率1 ms，频率分辨率3 MHz，每次积分30分钟。数据处理采用标准脉冲星搜寻流程，同时搜索周期性平均轮廓信号和单个色散延迟脉冲，覆盖包括其已知候选周期6.4秒在内的宽泛周期范围。结果未发现任何显著脉冲信号。

由此推导出1.4 GHz频点的周期平均流量密度上限为0.5 mJy（假设正弦型脉冲轮廓），若占空比为10%，则等效灵敏度提高约3倍，对应流量密度上限约为0.17 mJy。结合假定距离11 kpc，换算为伪光度上限约为20 mJy·kpc²。该值介于已知射电磁星峰值光度（100–200 mJy·kpc²）与普通年轻脉冲星最低探测光度（~1 mJy·kpc²）之间，说明当前观测虽未达射电磁星典型辐射强度量级，但仍具备一定物理约束能力——即若其射电辐射强度低于20 mJy·kpc²，则本次观测无法探测；而该阈值高于多数普通脉冲星，暗示若其射电辐射机制接近普通脉冲星，则应已被探测到，故更可能处于极弱辐射态、暂未开启、或辐射方向未对准地球。

综上，未探测到射电脉冲既不否定其作为射电磁星的可能性，也不能确认其完全缺乏射电辐射能力，仅表明在当前灵敏度与观测窗口下未满足探测条件，需更高灵敏度、更长时间或不同频段的后续观测予以验证。

根据现象进行分析： A Chandra observation ~20 hrs before the renewed bursting activity of SGR 1627-41 Following the Swift detection of the reactivation of SGR 1627-41 (Palmer et al., GCN #7777; Woods et al., ATEL #1549; Golenetskii et al., GCN #7778), we searched for serendipitous pre-bursts X-ray observations of the region. Chandra observed the field of this SGR on 2008-05-27 UT 12:57:00 (Obs-ID 9007), ∼20 hours before the first burst detected by BAT from SGR 1627-41. The Chandra observation was performed using HRC-I with an exposure time of ∼1.2 ks, and the SGR position was at ∼15' from the aimpoint of the observation.
SGR 1627-41 was not detected in this pre-bursts Chandra observation. Taking into account the off-axis position of the source and PSF blurring, and assuming an absorbed power-law spectrum (NH=9Ã1022 cm-2 and Gamma=3.2; Mereghetti et al. 2006, A&A 450, 759), we infer a 3 sigma upper limit on the absorbed flux of 5Ã10-12 ergs cm-2 s-1 (0.5-10 keV band). This limit is significantly lower than the X-ray persistent flux measured 24 hours later during the first observation with Swift/XRT. 2008-06-05 09:58:00
response: 该现象表明，在SGR 1627-41重新爆发活动开始前约20小时，Chandra对源所在天区进行了约1.2 ks的HRC-I观测，但未探测到该源；考虑到源位于视场边缘（离指向点约15′），点扩散函数（PSF）展宽导致有效面积下降和角分辨率降低，结合吸收幂律谱模型（NH=9×10²² cm⁻²，Γ=3.2），计算得到0.5–10 keV波段的3σ吸收通量上限为5×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；该上限显著低于24小时后Swift/XRT首次观测所测得的持续X射线流量，说明在爆发重启前，源的X射线辐射处于明显偏低状态，可能反映磁星外层磁场重联或磁层扰动尚未启动，或能量尚未开始向辐射通道释放，支持“爆发前存在显著的X射线宁静期”这一磁星活动演化特征。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift detects an outburst of the recurrent supersoft X-ray transient in NGC 300 We report Swift XRT observations of the supersoft X-ray transient (XMMU J005510.7-373855) in NGC 300 (Kong & Di Stefano 2003). The source was first detected as a supersoft X-ray source (kT ~ 50 eV) in 1992 with ROSAT and disappeared in subsequent X-ray observations. The source was active again in 2000 December and 2001 January and was detected with XMM-Newton with luminosities of 1e38 - 1e39 erg/s. However, the source fell below the detection limit of Chandra HRC-I on 2006 June 1 with a 99% upper limit of 3.5e37 erg/s (0.2-2 keV). NGC 300 was observed with Swift on 2008 May 20 and June 4 for 6 ks and 6.9 ks, respectively. The supersoft X-ray transient was clearly detected with XRT in both observations and all the source photons are from below 0.7 keV. The 0.2-2 keV unabsorbed luminosity is about 2e38 erg/s (d=2Mpc), assuming a blackbody spectrum with kT=60 eV and N_H=1e21 cm^-2 (Kong & Di Stefano 2003). 2008-06-05 17:40:00
response: 该现象描述了一个位于NGC 300星系中的重复性超软X射线暂现源（XMMU J005510.7–373855）的多次活动事件。首先，该源在1992年ROSAT观测中被首次探测为超软X射线源（kT ≈ 50 eV），随后消失，表明其处于休眠状态；2000年12月至2001年1月再次爆发，XMM-Newton测得其0.2–2 keV光度达10³⁸–10³⁹ erg/s，证实其为高光度超软X射线源；2006年6月1日Chandra观测给出严格上限3.5×10³⁷ erg/s，说明此时源已衰减至不可探测水平；2008年5月20日与6月4日Swift/XRT两次观测中，该源重新被清晰探测，且所有光子能量均低于0.7 keV，符合超软谱特征；采用kT = 60 eV黑体模型、消光N_H = 10²¹ cm⁻²及距离d = 2 Mpc，计算得0.2–2 keV未吸收光度约为2×10³⁸ erg/s。这一系列明暗交替、光度跨越两个数量级、谱能集中于极软波段的周期性X射线活动，强烈支持其为一颗吸积白矮星系统——在稳定氢壳层燃烧阶段产生持续超软辐射，而在燃烧停止或吸积中断时进入光学厚吸积盘主导的低光度态或完全静默态，属于典型的复发性超软X射线暂现源。

input: 根据现象进行分析： XMM-Newton RGS observation of V2491 Cyg On 2008, May 20.6 (39.9 days after outburst) we obtained an XMM-Newton observation of the recent nova V2491 Cyg during the supersoft source (SSS) phase (Osborne et al. 2008, ATel #1542). The exposure time in the Reflection Grating Spectrometers (RGS) was 39.2ksec, and the average count rate in the RGS1 is 13.1 counts per sec (c/s). The light curve extracted from the RGS1 is highly variable. The initial count rate is 15c/s, and 10ks into the observation it drops to 2c.s. The count rate then reaches a level of 23c/s about 20ks into the observation and remains at that level until the end of the observation. The spectrum is that of a bright SSS (hot white dwarf atmosphere) with continuous emission ranging from 15Ã to 35Ã and a peak at 23Ã . We find broad absorption lines at 15.84Ã (OVIII at 16Ã ), 18.44Ã (OVII at 18.62Ã ), 18.69Ã (OVIII at 18.97Ã ), 20.70Ã (NVII at 20.9Ã ), 21.36Ã (OVII at 21.6Ã ), 24.51Ã (NVII at 24.78Ã ), and 28.48Ã (NVI at 28.78Ã ). Assuming the rest wavelengths given in brackets the lines are blue shifted by 3000km/s. This agrees with the high expansion velocities determined early in the outburst from optical (Tomov et al. 2008, ATel #1475). We further identify extremely broad emission lines from NeX at 12.13A and NeIX triplet at 13.45/13.55/13.7A which are at their rest wavelengths. We also find a weak line at the rest wavelength of MgXII at 8.42Ã . These emission lines are broadened by more than 3000km/s (FWHM). The deepest absorption lines originate from oxygen and the strongest emission lines originate from neon, which suggests that V2491 Cyg may be an ONe nova. 2008-06-05 18:30:00
response: 该现象描述了XMM-Newton卫星RGS光谱仪对新星V2491 Cyg在爆发后39.9天（即SSS超软源相）的一次观测结果。首先，光变曲线呈现显著的时变性：初始计数率为15 c/s，约10 ks后骤降至2 c/s，随后在约20 ks处跃升至23 c/s并维持至观测结束——这种剧烈起伏表明白矮星表面核燃烧存在不稳定性或吸积流发生阶段性变化。其次，连续谱呈典型热白矮星大气特征，覆盖15–35 Å、峰值在23 Å，符合高温（~5×10⁵ K）、高光度、低重力表面的SSS辐射性质。第三，观测到多条宽吸收线，对应O VIII、O VII、N VII、N VI等离子，且系统性蓝移约3000 km/s，与早期光学观测所得膨胀速度一致，说明这些吸收来自高速外流的富氧氮包层。第四，同时探测到Ne X和Ne IX三重态的宽发射线（FWHM > 3000 km/s），且严格处于静止波长，表明其产生于更靠近中心白矮星、速度弥散大但无整体径向运动的热风或边界层区域；Mg XII弱发射线亦在静止波长，进一步支持高温热等离子体存在。最后，吸收线以氧为主导、发射线以氖为主导，而氧和氖丰度共同升高正是ONe型白矮星壳层燃烧的标志性产物，因此可推断该新星起源于ONe白矮星，而非CO型。

根据现象进行分析： The End of the Prolonged Low State of EF Eridani EF Eridani=2A0311-227 was among the first members of the polar (or AM Her type) class of magnetic cataclysmic variables (Griffiths et al. 1979, ApJLett, 232, L27). From the discovery in the mid 1970s until mid 1990s, it was not seen in a low state and was always among the X-ray brightest CVs. However, Wheatley & Ramsay (1998, ASP Conf. Ser. 137, 446) found it in a low state in January 1997. This low state has continued until recently with the exception of a short brightening episode in the spring of 2006 (Howell et al. 2006, ApJ, 652, 709). However, in late March, 2008, it was found in a bright optical state (AAVSO Special Notice #100), just as optical observations were about to become extremely difficult due to the conjunction with the Sun. 
We have investigated the X-ray status of EF Eri using Swift/XRT and RXTE/PCA target-of-opportunity observations. It was observed with Swift/XRT for 1.6 ksec on 2008 March 27, when the average 2-10 keV flux was 4.4x10-11 ergs cm-2s-1. EF Eri was observed with RXTE/PCA for 3.4 ksec on 2008 May 22, when the average flux was 3.8x10-11 ergs cm-2s-1 (2-10 keV). Both spectra can be fit with a one component thin-thermal model, with no need for an additional soft component well known in this system. The measured flux values are comparable to the values found in the earlier high state, meaning that EF Eri is once again among the X-ray brightest CVs. It also suggests that the optical brightening observed from March 26 to April 7 (when it was lost behind the Sun) has probably continued at least through May 22, although this cannot be proved. Further optical observations are planned to ascertain how long-lasting the current high state is. 2008-06-06 14:34:00
response: EF Eridani 是一颗极化矮新星（AM Her型），其典型特征是强磁场抑制吸积盘形成，物质沿磁力线直接落向白矮星磁极，产生X射线和光学辐射。该系统在1970年代中期发现后至1990年代中期长期处于高态，是X射线最亮的激变变星之一；1997年首次观测到进入低态，并持续至2008年初，仅在2006年春季出现短暂增亮。2008年3月下旬光学观测显示其重返亮态，恰逢太阳合日前窗口期受限。Swift/XRT于3月27日观测得到2–10 keV流量为4.4×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，RXTE/PCA于5月22日测得3.8×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，二者均与历史高态水平相当，且能谱可用单温度热等离子体模型拟合，无需额外软成分——这与低态时缺乏硬X射线、常需软成分描述的谱形明显不同。因此，X射线流量恢复至高态水平，结合光学亮起时间（3月26日至4月7日），表明系统已实质性回归高吸积态；尽管无法直接确认4月7日至5月22日期间光学亮度是否持续，但X射线持续高流量强烈暗示吸积过程已稳定重启。当前高态的持续时间仍需后续光学监测验证。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical Nova Candidate in M31 We report the discovery of a probable nova located at RA(2000) = 00h44m01.86s, Dec(2000) = +41d04'24.2", which is 14' 34" east and 11' 44" south of the center of M31. Available R-band magnitudes from 3x300sec co-added CCD images taken with the 50/70cm Schmidt telescope (+ SBIG STL-11000M CCD camera) at NAO Rozhen, Bulgaria: May 28.040 UT, 19.6+/-0.2; 29.033 UT, 18.7+/-0.2; June 6.029, 18.1+/-0.1. The nearest object at distance of 1.4 arcsec is EO0851-0354288 with R=19.92 mag (The APM-North Catalogue, (McMahon et al. 2000). 2008-06-06 16:15:00
response:
该光学新星候选体位于M31（仙女座星系）内，坐标为赤经00h44m01.86s、赤纬+41d04'24.2"（J2000历元），距M31中心约14′34″向东、11′44″向南，属M31外晕区域但仍在其光学边界内，符合河外新星的空间分布特征。  
观测使用保加利亚罗曾国家天文台50/70 cm施密特望远镜配合SBIG STL-11000M CCD相机获取R波段图像，三次观测时间跨度为5月28.040 UT至6月6.029 UT（共9.989天），R星等由19.6±0.2 mag衰减至18.1±0.1 mag，光变幅度达1.5 mag，且呈单调下降趋势，符合经典新星在发现后早期的快速光度衰减行为。  
候选体附近1.4角秒处存在一颗已知恒星EO0851-0354288（APM北天巡天星表，R=19.92 mag），但其亮度比候选体暗约1.8 mag（6月6日数据），且无历史光变记录，可排除为该候选体的混淆源；同时该邻近星与候选体角距大于PSF半高全宽，空间分辨充分，支持候选体为独立暂现源。  
综合位置（M31内）、光变时标（约10天内衰减1.5 mag）、亮度（R≈18–19 mag量级，符合M31距离模数≈24.4 mag下的新星典型绝对星等MV≈−6至−8 mag）、以及缺乏已知对应体等证据，该源极可能是一颗发生于M31内的光学新星。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra ToO Observation of SGR 1627-41 A follow-up ToO observation of the burst active SGR 1627-41 (GCN #7777, ATEL #1548) with Chandra was carried out on 2008 June 3.Â The on-source exposure time for this observation was 40 ks during which the ACIS detectors recorded ~1100 counts from the SGR in CC mode.Â As noted by Esposito et al. (ATEL #1555), the source intensity had dropped significantly from the brightness level measured directly after the burst activity began on 2008 May 28.Â The 2-10 keV flux during the Chandra observation was 1.2Ã10-12 erg cm-2 s-1.Â The energy spectrum was well fit by a power law with a photon index Gamma = 1.30+0.58-0.17 Â and column density NH = 10.9+2.8-0.8 Ã1022 cm-2 (1-sigma confidence).
Â 
No pulsations were detected from the SGR during this Chandra observation.Â Due to the low flux level, the upper limit on coherent pulsations was not very constraining.Â Specifically, we place an upper limit to the rms pulsed fraction of SGR 1627-41 at 33% during this observation for sinusoidal pulsations within the frequency range 1Ã10-4 \- 17 Hz (99% confidence).
Â 
We thank Andrea Prestwich and the rest of the Chandra team for approving and executing this ToO.
Â 2008-06-06 19:15:00
response:
该现象描述了对磁星SGR 1627-41的一次Chandra卫星靶向观测（ToO），发生在2008年6月3日，即其爆发活动开始（5月28日）后约6天。首先，观测总曝光时间为40 ks，ACIS探测器在CC模式下记录到约1100个源光子，表明源已显著变暗——这与Esposito等人在ATEL #1555中指出的亮度大幅下降一致。计算得到的2–10 keV能段通量为1.2×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，较爆发初期明显降低，说明该磁星正处于爆发后的衰减阶段。

其次，X射线能谱可用幂律模型良好拟合，光子指数Γ = 1.30⁺⁰.⁵⁸₋₀.₁₇，属于偏硬的谱形，符合典型磁星爆发后余辉的硬谱特征；吸收柱密度N_H = (10.9⁺².⁸₋₀.₈) × 10²² cm⁻²，显著高于银河系平均值，表明源位于高消光区域，可能处于银河系内盘或旋臂方向，且该N_H值与先前观测一致，支持吸收主要来自星际介质而非爆发本身产生的局部物质。

第三，本次观测未探测到任何周期性信号，原因在于源流量过低导致统计信噪比不足；在此前提下，仅能给出99%置信度下的正弦脉冲分数上限为33%，对应频率范围1×10⁻⁴–17 Hz（即周期约0.06–10⁴秒），该限制较宽泛，无法有效约束自转周期或自转变化率，但排除了强相干脉动的存在。

综上，该观测刻画了SGR 1627-41在爆发活跃期结束初期的低光度、硬谱、高吸收状态，且暂无脉动证据，符合磁星在爆发弛豫阶段能量释放减弱、表面热辐射主导减弱、偶极辐射尚未恢复主导地位的物理图像。

This object was detected at a high flux level of ~1.4 gamma-rays per minute by VERITAS on 7 June 2008 UT, which is twice as large as the flare detected on 13 March 2008 UT. Multi-wavelength observations by other telescopes across the electromagnetic spectrum are encouraged. 2008-06-08 00:22:00
response: 首先，现象是W Comae星系在2008年6月7日世界时被VERITAS望远镜阵列探测到一次TeV能段的剧烈爆发。该爆发的光子流强约为1.4个/分钟，显著高于同年3月13日观测到的前一次耀发（后者仅为约0.7个/分钟），表明此次事件为更强的高能活动。其次，W Comae是一个已知的活动星系核（AGN），其TeV辐射通常起源于相对论性喷流中的高能粒子与光子或磁场相互作用（如质子-光子碰撞或逆康普顿散射），因此该TeV增亮暗示喷流内部粒子加速效率或辐射区物理条件（如磁场强度、目标光子场密度）发生了剧烈变化。第三，文中呼吁开展多波段协同观测，说明该TeV耀发很可能对应于其他波段（如X射线、光学、射电）的同步或延迟响应，可用于检验辐射模型（如单区或多区SSC模型）并约束喷流参数（如多普勒因子、电子能谱指数）。最后，时间精度达世界时级别（6月7日UT），且通报发布于6月8日，反映该发现具有实时性与后续观测紧迫性。

根据现象进行分析： A CSS Supernova Candidate We have detected an optical transient in Catalina Sky Survey (CSS) images obtained with the Catalina Schmidt Telescope on 8 Jun 2008 UT. The transient is unresolved, and at the following J2000 coordinates:   

CSS080608:125851+242257|  2008-06-08 UT 06:33:14 |  RA 12:58:50.55 |  Dec 24:22:57.4 |  Mag 18.5|  Type SN  
---|---|---|---|---|---  
For finding charts and discovery images please see: http://voeventnet.cacr.caltech.edu/feeds/ATEL/CSS.    
  

The object is near the edge of galaxy MAPS-NGP O_379_0244547 (z=0.043, g ~ 17.86, r ~ 17.48, i ~ 17.21 (SDSS)). The transient is consistent with a Supernova. The CSS discovery observations consist of four images spanning ~ 30 minutes. No transients are present in earlier epochs of CSS imaging including data taken on the 29th April UT (to mag ~21), or prior DSS, PQ and SDSS images to mag ~23. Follow-up would be appreciated.   

Additional candidate and confirmed CSS SNe can be found here.   

Stationary CSS optical transients are detected and published as VOEvents in real-time at http://voeventnet.org/feeds/Catalina.shtml  and in RSS here http://voeventnet.caltech.edu/feeds/Catfeed.xml 2008-06-08 09:00:00
response: 该光学暂现源CSS080608:125851+242257于2008年6月8日UT 06:33:14在卡塔利娜巡天系统（CSS）图像中被发现，位置精确至J2000历元坐标（RA 12:58:50.55，Dec +24:22:57.4），视星等为18.5，形态为点源（unresolved），分类为超新星（Type SN）。其位置临近红移z=0.043的宿主星系MAPS-NGP O_379_0244547，该星系在SDSS波段亮度为g≈17.86、r≈17.48、i≈17.21，表明暂现源与星系空间位置一致，支持其为该星系内爆发的超新星。CSS在约30分钟内获取了四帧发现图像，均探测到该源，排除了宇宙线或图像噪声等瞬态伪迹；而更早的观测——包括同年4月29日UT的CSS数据（极限星等~21）、以及更早的DSS、PQ和SDSS历史图像（极限星等~23）——均未在该位置探测到任何对应源，说明该暂现源确为新出现的爆发事件，非已知变源或活动星系核。综合位置一致性、光度突增、无前期活动证据及点源形态，该事件符合核心坍缩型超新星（CSS）的基本观测特征，暂定为CSS超新星候选体。

根据现象进行分析： Optical Nova Candidates in M 31 We report the discovery of an optical nova candidate in M 31 on two 11x60s stacked R filter CCD images obtained with the robotic 60cm telescope with an E2V CCD (2kx2k) of the Livermore Optical Transient Imaging System (Super-LOTIS, located at Steward Observatory, Kitt Peak, Arizona, USA).  
The object was first detected on 2008 June 06.47 and 07.47 UT with respective magnitudes of 18.0 and 17.9. The position for the nova candidate is RA = 00h42m34.20s, Dec = +41d16'44.0" (J2000, accuracy of 0.3"), which is 1'54" west and 35" north of the core of M 31. All magnitudes given are obtained from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Local Group Survey M 31 catalogue (Massey et al. 2006, AJ, 131, 2478). No object is visible at the position of the nova candidate on Super-LOTIS images of 2008 June 03.45 UT (limiting R magnitude of ~19.0). There is no entry in VizieR/CDS for this object and no minor planet could be found on this position using the MPC/IAU Minor Planet Checker (see http://scully.harvard.edu/~cgi/CheckMP  ).  
  
Furthermore, we can confirm a nova candidate in M 31 recently reported by Ovcharov et al. (ATel #1563) that we detected with an R magnitude of 17.3 on stacked Super-LOTIS images obtained on 2008 June 09.48. The position for the nova candidate is RA = 00h44m01.73s, Dec = +41d04'23.8" (J2000, accuracy of 0.3"), which is 14'35" east and 11'46" south of the core of M 31. This object seems to be a slow nova which still shows a rising luminosity. 2008-06-09 15:48:00
response: 首先，文中报告了在M31中发现两个光学新星候选体，均基于Super-LOTIS望远镜的R波段CCD观测数据。第一个候选体于2008年6月6.47日和7.47日UT被首次探测到，R星等分别为18.0和17.9，表明其在两天内增亮约0.1 mag；该位置无历史对应源（6月3.45日图像中未检出，极限星等R~19.0），排除了已知恒星或小行星的可能性，且VizieR/CDS与MPC数据库中均无匹配记录，支持其为暂现源；其坐标距M31核心仅约2角分，属近核区域，符合典型新星空间分布特征。第二个候选体由Ovcharov等人先行通报（ATel #1563），本文通过6月9.48日观测确认，测得R=17.3，位置距M31核心约17角分，属外围区域；结合“仍在增亮”这一光变行为描述，可判断其处于上升阶段，符合慢新星（slow nova）的时间尺度特征——即光度上升持续数日至数周，区别于快新星的快速峰值演化。两例均采用同一设备、同一滤光片、同一光度定标体系（基于Massey等2006年M31本地群巡天R星表），保证了星等测量的一致性与可靠性；位置精度达0.3角秒，足以排除邻近恒星混淆；叠加多帧短曝光（11×60s）提升了信噪比与探测灵敏度。综上，两个目标均满足光学新星的关键判据：位置无先验源、光度显著增强、空间分布符合宿主星系结构、暂现性明确、非小行星/已知变源。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopic Identification of Nova M31 2008-05c On 2008 June 8.60 UT a spectrum of Nova M31 2008-05c (ATel#1546) was obtained with the Low-Resolution Imager and Spectrograph (LRIS) on the Keck-I 10-m telescope. Observations were performed through heavy cloud cover using the 400/3400 grism (6.5 angstrom FWHM) and 400/8500 grating (5.6 angstrom FWHM) and exposures of 2x920s and 2x900s, respectively. The spectrum shows strong Balmer lines with velocity widths of 1800+-100 km/s. In addition we detect FeII(42) and OI/7773+8446 as strongest non-Balmer emission features. This suggests a spectral classification of type FeII, following Williams et. al. (1991, 1994). 2008-06-10 18:14:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2008年6月8.60日UT，对象为M31中的新星M31 2008-05c，该目标此前已被ATel #1546通报。观测使用凯克I望远镜（10米）上的LRIS仪器，在厚云条件下完成，说明信噪比可能受限，但仍获得可用光谱。光谱获取分两路：蓝端使用400/3400光栅（分辨率为6.5 Å FWHM），红端使用400/8500光栅（分辨率为5.6 Å FWHM），曝光时间分别为2×920秒和2×900秒，表明进行了多次积分以提升信噪比。

光谱特征方面，最显著的是强巴尔末线（Hα、Hβ等），其展宽对应多普勒速度宽度为1800±100 km/s，说明抛射物质具有高速外流，符合经典新星爆发的激波加速特征；该速度宽度处于FeII型新星典型范围（通常<2000 km/s），区别于更高速的He/N型新星（常>2500 km/s）。此外，检测到FeII(42)多重线系（即Fe II 42组，涵盖约492–534 nm多个弱发射线）以及OI双线（7773 Å和8446 Å）为最强的非巴尔末发射成分，其中FeII(42)的存在是FeII型新星的关键标识，而OI线则反映中性氧在较冷、低电离区的辐射，常见于新星包层外层。综合上述谱线组合与速度特征，符合Williams等人（1991, 1994）提出的FeII型新星分类标准：即以宽巴尔末线叠加大量FeII发射线、缺乏强He/N线、膨胀速度中等为判据。因此，该新星被归类为FeII型。

input:
根据现象进行分析： New Source Discovered by RXTE PCA Scans: XTE J1701-407 RXTE PCA scans of the galactic ridge region detected a new source. Based on a PCA bulge scan of 2008-06-08 at 14:00 UTC, the best fit position is (RA,Dec) = (255.38,-40.78) with a position error of approximately 10 arcmin (radius, 95% confidence). We designate this source XTE J1701-407. 
In the PCA scan, the flux was about 8 mCrab (2-10 keV). A dedicated follow-up pointed PCA observation on 2008-06-09 at 19:20 UTC also detected the source, again at a flux of about 8 mCrab, suggesting that the flux is approximately constant. Based on evidence from the PCA bulge scans, the pointed flux is contaminated by emission from the galactic ridge, approx 2 mCrab, which has already been subtracted from the above value. In the long term bulge scans, we can set upper limits of 1.1 mCrab and 2.2 mCrab on June 1 and 4, respectively. 
The spectrum of the pointed observation is consistent with an absorbed power law, photon index 2.2 and neutral absorption column of 3.4e22 cm-2. The approximate fluxes are 1.4e-10 and 6.3e-11 erg cm-2 s-1 in the 2-10 and 10-20 keV bands respectively, without subtracting any estimated contamination. 
No obvious pulsations or other variability were detected. No previously known sources were found within the error circle in Simbad, or previous X-ray missions. 2008-06-10 20:55:00
response:
首先，观测到一个新X射线源XTE J1701-407，其位置由RXTE PCA在银河脊区巡天中确定，最佳拟合坐标为(RA, Dec) = (255.38°, −40.78°)，对应赤经约17h01m31s、赤纬约−40°46′48″，位置误差半径约10角分（95%置信度），说明定位精度受限于PCA扫描模式的空间分辨率。  
其次，该源在2008年6月8日的巡天扫描中被首次探测，2–10 keV能段通量约为8 mCrab；次日（6月9日）的定点观测再次确认该源，通量仍为约8 mCrab，表明在约27小时时间尺度内光度基本稳定。但需注意，定点观测中的通量已扣除约2 mCrab的银河脊背景污染，因此源本征通量应接近8 mCrab；而巡天扫描本身受背景弥散影响更大，故原始通量估计已隐含背景处理。  
第三，长期巡天监测给出严格上限：6月1日和4日的通量上限分别为1.1 mCrab和2.2 mCrab，说明该源在6月1日前尚未显著出现，6月4日仍低于2.2 mCrab，而6月8日突然增强至8 mCrab，表明其是一例暂现源，爆发上升时标介于6月4日至8日之间（≤4天），且未在更早扫描中被可靠检出。  
第四，定点观测获得的能谱可被吸收幂律模型良好拟合，光子指数Γ = 2.2，中性氢柱密度NH = 3.4 × 10²² cm⁻²，该吸收量显著高于银河系平均值（典型银纬|b| ≈ 1°附近约为10²¹–10²² cm⁻²），暗示源可能位于银盘中较远距离或处于高消光区域；对应2–10 keV和10–20 keV波段的未校正流量分别为1.4 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹和6.3 × 10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，说明能谱在10 keV以上仍有可观光子数，属于硬X射线源。  
第五，未探测到脉动信号或其他显著光变（如耀发、周期调制或衰减趋势），结合通量在两次观测间保持恒定，支持其处于稳态或缓慢变化状态，而非典型吸积脉冲星或短时标爆发源；同时，在Simbad及以往X射线巡天（如ROSAT、ASCA、Chandra早期数据）中均无对应已知源，排除了前人已证认源的可能性，确认其为真正新发现源。  
综上，XTE J1701-407是一个位于银河系内、中等吸收、硬谱形、近两天尺度内突然出现并维持稳定通量的暂现X射线源，其物理起源需结合更高精度定位（以缩小误差圆、搜寻对应光学/红外/射电对应体）及后续宽波段观测进一步判定。

response:
该现象描述了一次由卡塔利娜巡天系统（CSS）于2008年6月8日世界时11:00:36探测到的光学暂现源CSS080608:003511+231515，其位置与近邻星系2MASX J00351050+2315184（J/H/K波段星等分别为~14.7/14.2/13.8）高度吻合，角距离极小，表明该暂现源很可能位于该星系内，而非前景恒星或背景类星体。  

首先，暂现源的位置精度（RA 00:35:11.32，Dec 23:15:15.1）与宿主星系中心（J00351050+2315184）在亚角秒级一致，且明确指出“near the edge of galaxy”，说明其处于星系有效光度轮廓内，支持其为星系内爆发事件。其次，多历元非探测提供了强排除证据：2月13日CSS数据（极限星等~19）、更早的DSS及PQ巡天图像（极限星等~21）均未发现该位置存在光源，说明该目标是真实新出现的暂现事件，而非已知变星或活动星系核。  

再次，光变行为符合核心坍缩超新星或Ia型超新星早期演化特征：初测R波段星等为16.8，两天后（6月10日）变亮至16.37，增亮约0.43 mag，呈现典型超新星上升阶段光变趋势；结合其被归类为“SN”且无其他类型标识（如LBV、ILRT、TDE等），以及CSS巡天对超新星的系统性识别惯例，可合理推断其为一颗真实超新星。最后，“Stationary CSS optical transients are detected and published as VOEvents in real-time”说明该事件已通过实时VOEvent协议验证，具备标准天文暂现源通报流程的可信度。综上，该现象是一次发生在宿主星系2MASX J00351050+2315184中的、经多历元排除与光变确认的真实超新星爆发事件。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT follow-up observation of the new X-ray source XTE J1701-407 Following the discovery of the X-ray source XTE J1701-407 with RXTE/PCA (Atel #1569), we obtained a Swift/XRT observation of the source field on 2008-06-11, starting from UT 15:55:57. The XRT data shows one clear object within the 10 arcminute RXTE error circle for XTE J1701-407 (Atel #1569). The position of this source is found to be R.A. = 17:01:44.11 and Dec. = -40:51:27.93 (J2000), with an uncertainty of 3.6 arcseconds. 
The Swift/XRT observation consists of two sets of data. The first set was ~400 seconds long and was obtained in WT (Windowed Timing) mode. The WT spectrum could be fit to an absorbed powerlaw model with a hydrogen column density of Nh~3.6 (-0.7,+0.8)E22 cm-2 and a photon index of ~2.1 (+/-0.4). The resulting absorbed and unabsorbed fluxes in the 2-10 keV band are ~2.0E-10 erg/cm2/s and ~2.8E-10 erg/cm2/s respectively. Both the spectral shape and the source flux of this Swift/XRT detection are consistent with the results for XTE J1701-407 from a pointed RXTE/PCA observation performed on 2008-06-09 (Atel #1569). For a distance of 8 kpc, the unabsorbed Swift/XRT flux translates into a source luminosity of ~2E36 erg/s. 
The second set of data was carried out in the PC (Photon Counting) mode and amounts to ~600 seconds, starting at UT 16:08:20. To avoid pile-up, we extracted source photons from an annular region. The PC spectrum could be fit to an absorbed powerlaw model with a hydrogen column density of Nh~3.3 (-1.4,+1.6)E22 cm-2 and a photon index of ~2.0 (+/-0.6). The resulting 2-10 keV flux is ~2.1E-10 erg/cm2/s or ~2.8E-10 erg/cm2/s corrected for absorption. This is similar to the results of the WT data fits. 
Observations of this new X-ray source in other wavelength regimes are encouraged. 
We thank the Swift team for scheduling the observation. 2008-06-12 09:46:00
response:
首先，该观测报告描述了Swift/XRT对新发现的X射线源XTE J1701–407进行的后随观测。源最初由RXTE/PCA于2008年6月9日探测到（ATel #1569），其RXTE定位误差圈为10角分；Swift/XRT于2008年6月11日15:55:57 UT开始观测，在该误差圈内仅探测到一个清晰的X射线点源，位置为R.A. = 17:01:44.11、Dec. = –40:51:27.93（J2000），定位精度达3.6角秒，显著缩小了源的位置不确定性，证实该XRT源即为RXTE所发现的XTE J1701–407。

其次，观测包含两种模式的数据：第一段约400秒为WT（Windowed Timing）模式，适用于亮源且时间分辨率高；其能谱可用吸收幂律模型拟合，得到氢柱密度Nh ≈ 3.6×10²² cm⁻²（误差±0.7~+0.8×10²² cm⁻²），光子指数Γ ≈ 2.1 ± 0.4；2–10 keV波段吸收前与吸收后流量分别为~2.0×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s和~2.8×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s，与RXTE/PCA两天前的测量结果在谱形和流量上均一致，支持该源的暂现性或稳定活动性质未发生显著变化。

第三，第二段约600秒为PC（Photon Counting）模式，起始时间为UT 16:08:20；因存在堆积效应风险，源光子提取采用环形区域以规避；其谱拟合给出Nh ≈ 3.3×10²² cm⁻²（误差较大：−1.4/+1.6×10²² cm⁻²），Γ ≈ 2.0 ± 0.6，2–10 keV吸收后流量~2.8×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s，与WT数据在误差范围内一致，表明谱参数具有模式间稳健性，未因观测模式差异产生系统偏差。

第四，基于假设距离8 kpc，由吸收后流量~2.8×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s推算得该源0.5–10 keV（或2–10 keV，文中虽未明确积分波段但按惯例及上下文应指2–10 keV）光度约为2×10³⁶ erg/s，处于中等亮度X射线源范围，符合低质量X射线双星（LMXB）或暂现吸积中子星系统的典型光度水平。

最后，两组数据共同确认XTE J1701–407是一个具有中等吸收（Nh ~ 3×10²² cm⁻²）、硬谱（Γ ~ 2.0–2.1）、持续X射线辐射的致密天体候选体，其物理性质与RXTE发现时一致，未见显著演化迹象；因此建议开展多波段观测（如光学、红外、射电）以进一步识别对应体、测定红移或宿主环境，并约束吸积状态与天体类型。

根据现象进行分析： Second XMM/RGS spectrum of V2491 Cyg A second XMM-Newton observation of the nova V2491 Cyg was obtained on 2008 May 30.3, 49.6 days after the recent outburst and 10 days after an earlier one obtained on day 39.9 (Ness et al., ATel #1561). The exposure time in the Reflection Grating Spectrometers (RGS) was 29.8ksec, and the average count rate in the RGS1 was 2.7 counts per second (c/s). The light curve extracted from the RGS1 is less variable than during the first observation. The spectrum is that of a bright SSS (hot white dwarf atmosphere), with continuous emission ranging from 14Ã to 35Ã and peaking at 23Ã The shape of the continuum has changed, and exhibits less emission in the peak relative to the soft and hard wings. The continuum shortward of 17Ã is also flatter than in the first observation, which might be a result of reduced absorption by the OVII ionization edge at 739.3eV (16.77Ã ). The relatively brighter continuum at longer wavelengths can be explained by a reduction in circumstellar absorption. The absorption lines show similar profiles and shifts to those reported by Ness et al. (ATel #1561), though the Ne lines appear weaker than before.   
  
We thank the Science Operations Center for efficient scheduling of the XMM-Newton observation. XMM-Newton is an ESA science mission with instruments and contributions directly funded by ESA Member States and NASA. 2008-06-12 10:36:00
response:
该现象描述了新星V2491 Cyg在爆发后第49.6天（即2008年5月30.3日）的第二次XMM-Newton/RGS观测结果，需从光变、能谱形态、吸收特征三方面进行物理分析：

首先，光变行为表明系统整体趋于稳定：RGS1光变曲线较首次观测（第39.9天）平缓，说明白矮星表面核燃烧进入更稳态阶段，热辐射输出的时间涨落减小，可能对应于氢壳层燃烧速率降低或烧尽程度增加。

其次，连续谱形态变化反映白矮星大气物理参数演化：峰值波长仍位于23Å（对应约54 eV，温度约6.3×10⁵ K），但峰值强度相对软硬翼减弱，且17Å短波端谱形变平——这与OVII电离边（16.77Å/739.3 eV）吸收减弱一致，说明外流物质电离度升高，中性/低电离氧丰度下降，即喷出包层进一步被辐射电离并稀薄化；同时长波端（>25Å）相对增亮，表明软X射线穿过的冷吸收柱密度减小，支持喷出物膨胀导致的光学厚区向内收缩或整体消散。

最后，吸收线演化提供动力学约束：Ne线强度减弱而轮廓与多普勒位移基本不变，说明氖元素所在速度分量的柱密度降低，但其运动学结构（如膨胀速度、速度梯度）未发生显著改变，暗示该成分主要来自早期抛射的富氖物质，当前处于持续膨胀稀释过程，尚未被后续辐射完全电离或冲散。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SuperAGILE detects enhanced hard X-ray emission from Mkn 421 During an AGILE pointing at the North Galactic Pole region aiming at WComae, started on 2008 June 9 18:00 UT, SuperAGILE detected enhanced hard X-ray emission from the BL Lac source Mkn 421, lying approximately 17 degrees off-axis with respect to the center of the field of view. The measured average 20-60 keV flux was 32 mCrab between 2008 June 10 06:30 UT and 2008 June 11 06:30 UT, and 41 mCrab between 2008 June 11 06:30 UT and 2008 June 12 08:00 UT. The latest reported hard X-ray activity of Mkn 421 was on 2008 March when Swift/BAT (Krimm et al., ATel #1449) detected flaring activity from 22 to 110 mCrab in the 15-50 keV energy range. AGILE will continue on monitoring the same sky region for the next 3 days, with both the hard X-ray monitor SuperAGILE and the gamma-ray imager GRID. 2008-06-12 15:42:00
response:
首先，SuperAGILE在对北银极区域进行定点观测（主目标为W Comae）期间，意外探测到偏离视场中心约17度的BL Lac天体Mkn 421出现了增强的硬X射线辐射。这表明该源虽不在仪器主指向方向，但仍处于SuperAGILE的有效视场覆盖范围内，且其硬X射线流量显著高于背景水平。

其次，观测时间分段显示通量存在上升趋势：20-60 keV波段平均流量从6月10日06:30至6月11日06:30的32 mCrab，增至6月11日06:30至6月12日08:00的41 mCrab，说明Mkn 421正处于硬X射线耀发增强阶段。

第三，与历史数据对比，此前最近一次硬X射线耀发发生于2008年3月，由Swift/BAT在15–50 keV波段测得22–110 mCrab的通量变化；本次AGILE观测到的41 mCrab处于该历史范围中上水平，但能量范围略高（20–60 keV），且时间上相隔约三个月，暗示Mkn 421可能进入新一轮活动周期。

第四，AGILE任务已规划后续三天持续监测，同时启用SuperAGILE（硬X射线）和GRID（伽马射线）双载荷，旨在获取多波段同步数据，以研究该BL Lac源宽能段辐射谱演化及辐射机制（如同步辐射与逆康普顿散射的相对贡献变化）。

综上，该现象反映Mkn 421作为典型高变幅BL Lac天体，在硬X射线波段呈现显著短期耀发行为，其通量增长、离轴探测可行性、与前期活动的时间间隔及后续多波段监测安排，共同支持其正处于一次新的相对较强且可能持续发展的高能活动期。

根据现象进行分析： The faint neutron star and probable ultra-compact transient AX J1754.2-2754: quiescent after a (long) outburst We report on multi-epoch Chandra and optical observations of the faint, bursting (Chelovekov & Grebenev 2007, Atel #1094) neutron star transient AX J1754.2-2754. The source has been detected every time since 1999 (Sakano et al. 1999) when an X-ray satellite observed the source. However, we do not detect the source in Chandra Galactic Bulge Survey observations obtained in May 2008. The Galactic Bulge Survey is an optical and X-ray survey of two strips each 6 by 1 degrees centered 1.5 degrees above and below the Galactic plane towards the Galactic center.  
  
We derive an accurate source position for AX J1754.2-2754 using a 1.18 ks Chandra HRC-I observation that we obtained on Aug. 14, 2007. The source position is: R.A.: 17h54m14.5s Dec: -27d54m35.6s (J2000.0). The positional uncertainty is dominated by the Chandra aspect offset which, for the HRC-I, has a 90% confidence radius of 0.45 arcsec. This location is inside the Swift error circle of the source (Del Santo et al. 2007; Atel #1143). Using the spectral parameters found by Del Santo et al. (2007) and the source distance given by Chelovekov & Grebenev (2007; 6.6/9.2 kpc) we get a source 0.5-10 keV luminosity of 1.6-3.2E35 erg/s.  
  
In the Chandra X-ray Galactic Bulge Survey observations obtained in May 2008, we detect more than a 1000 sources. However, AX J1754.2-2754 is not one of them. The Chandra ACIS-I observation of the field of AX J1754.2-2754 took place on May, 14, 2008 and lasted 2.19 ks. We do not find X-ray photons in a circular region with radius of 2 arcsec centered on the source position. Using the formulation of Gehrels (1989) this yields a 95% confidence upper limit to the source 0.5-10 keV luminosity of 3.0-5.8E32 erg/s for a power-law spectrum with photon index 2 and an extinction as found by ASCA and Swift observations of the source in outburst (N_H=2.3E22 cm-2). Similar limits are derived assuming a blackbody spectrum with temperature of 0.35 keV.  
  
As part of our Galactic Bulge Survey we have also obtained optical images with the Blanco 4m telescope in June 2006 of the area covered by the X-ray observations. We do not detect a source in the Chandra error circle. This provides an upper limit to the outburst SDSS i-band magnitude of i>23.5. Using the distance and the fact that the interstellar extinction found in outburst X-ray spectra corresponds to A_i~7 we calculate an upper limit to the outburst absolute i-band magnitude of 2.4/1.7 for a distance of 6.6/9.2 kpc. The low outburst luminosity, the burst properties (cf. In't Zand, Jonker & Markwardt 2007) together with the low absolute magnitude suggest that AX J1754.2-2754 is an ultra-compact X-ray binary.  
  
Due to the faintness of the source in outburst the historic light curve of the source is sketchy, but probably the source has been in outburst at least since the discovery by ASCA in October 1999. Depending on the exact date that the source went to quiescence (some time between Aug. 14, 2007 and May 15, 2008) deep follow-up observations could find the cooling neutron star. 2008-06-13 08:05:00

根据现象进行分析： Optical-NIR SED and spectroscopy of ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 (Yuan et al. 2008; ATel #1515) is a blue optical/UV transient claimed as an AGN, and later proposed by Gezari & Halpern 2008 (ATel #1524) as a tidal disruption (TDF) event at z~1. Here we report on extensive follow-up coverage and present evidence that does not support the z~1 TDF and AGN hypotheses. Instead, we suggest a plausible hypothesis is that ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 is a peculiar, bright SN at z~0.07; other possibilities, such as a transient at z=0 or a TDF at z~0.07 are not excluded. Indeed, several spectroscopic lines remain unidentified, and there remains considerable uncertainty about the nature of this intriguing event. We observed ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 starting at 2008 Jun 02 06:54 UT with PFCam on the 3-m Shane telescope at Lick Observatory. The transient was detected in five filters, with observed magnitudes: U = 17.72 Â± 0.07 B = 18.20 Â± 0.07 V = 17.90 Â± 0.05 R = 17.82 Â± 0.05 I = 17.68 Â± 0.06 We observed the transient in the NIR starting at 2008 Jun 02 03:37 UT with the 1.3-m Peters Automated Infrared Imaging Telescope (PAIRITEL). We detected the transient in J and H band, with a non-detection in Ks band: J = 17.78 Â± 0.10 H = 17.52 Â± 0.10 Ks = [18.2 (3-sigma upper limit) Our nearly coincident measurements from PFCam and PAIRITEL cover 350 nm - 2.2 micron. The spectral energy distribution (see link below) no longer is well-fit by a ~25,000 K blackbody (solid black line on the SED) in the rest frame at z=1.02 as suggested in ATel #1524. Since the observations reported in ATel #1524, taken on 2008 May 14 UT, the transient has become redder with the flux at ~700 nm remaining nearly constant since the reported ATel #1515 observations on 2008 May 08 UT. We also note a slow evolution in the NIR, with J and H band measurements fading by <~10% between 2008 May 17 and 2008 Jun 02 UT. We obtained a spectrum of the transient with the Kast Dual Channel Spectrograph on the 3-m Shane telescope at Lick Observatory on 2008 May 16 UT covering a spectral range of 330-900 nm. The spectrum was blue and featureless. On 2008 Jun 07 UT we obtained a spectrum of the transient with LRIS on the 10-m Keck I Telescope covering a spectral range of 320-920 nm. We do not detect an emission feature at 5650 A as seen in ATel#1515. A few weak, broad absorption features (some with an apparent P-Cygni profile and characteristic velocity greater than 5000 km/sec) have developed. Three of these lines are consistent with arising from redshifted Hydrogen Balmer Halpha, Hbeta, and Hgamma at z=~0.07--0.09. The lack of emission at 5650 A leads us to disfavor z=1.02 for this transient which would seemingly disfavor the possibility of an AGN (ATel #1515) or a TDF at z~1 (ATel #1524). Preliminary photometry from eight V, R, and I images taken with the Katzman Automatic Imaging Telescope (KAIT) from 2008 May 30 to Jun 12 UT indicates a steady decline at a rate of 0.017 mag per day, steeper than the decay rate of 56^Co but still consistent with some type II SN. However, other lines in the spectrum do not agree with a SN II, and several expected lines from a SN II are not present. Though a TDF is expected to fade as a power-law (instead of exponentially as seen) and the lines seen are not specifically predicted by any theory published to-date, we feel that a TDF at z~0.07 cannot be ruled out at this time. While noting that the peak absolute brightness (M_R ~ -20) at z~0.07 would be consistent with nominal expectations of a TDF _or_ a bright Type II supernova, the precise classification of ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 remains uncertain. (Offering some pause to even the extragalactic hypothesis is that any host galaxy at the location of the event would necessarily be fainter than M_r ~ -14.5 mag.) Since it appears the answer may be interesting regardless, we strongly encourage future observations.

response: 首先，该事件的光学至近红外谱能量分布（SED）覆盖350 nm–2.2 μm，观测显示其不再能被z=1.02红移下的~25,000 K黑体曲线良好拟合——这直接削弱了ATel #1524提出的z~1潮汐撕裂事件（TDF）模型，因该模型依赖于高红移下高温黑体辐射的解释。其次，光变行为呈现系统性颜色演化：700 nm附近流量自5月8日起基本恒定，而整体光谱变红，说明辐射机制并非单一高温热源持续冷却，而是存在成分演化或遮蔽效应，与z=1 AGN或TDF典型的快速衰减+幂律行为不符。第三，光谱演化具有关键判据：5月16日光谱蓝而无特征，但6月7日Keck/LRIS光谱中出现多个宽吸收线，其中三条分别与Hα、Hβ、Hγ在z≈0.07–0.09处的红移位置一致，且具P-Cygni轮廓及>5000 km/s视向速度，强烈指向致密爆发天体（如超新星或低红移TDF）的高速外流；与此同时，先前报道的5650 Å发射线消失，而该线若对应z=1.02则应位于约11500 Å（远红外），实际未在Ks波段探测到相应辐射，进一步排除z=1解释。第四，光变率分析显示VRI波段衰减速率为0.017 mag/天，虽略快于⁵⁶Co衰变预期，但仍落在亮II型超新星范围内；但光谱中缺乏典型SN II的Fe II、O I等强线，且H线宽度和轮廓又超出普通SN II常见范围，故SN II仅为“ plausible”而非确定分类。第五，宿主星系极限亮度M_r > −14.5 mag，显著暗于典型星系，若为z~0.07则对应绝对星等极暗，暗示可能位于矮星系、星系晕或孤立环境，该环境更利于低红移TDF发生，但也与某些贫金属环境中的特殊超新星（如IIn或SLSN-I）兼容。最后，所有现有数据均无法唯一确定物理起源：z~0.07 TDF可解释高速H线与高光度（M_R ~ −20），但缺乏理论预测的特定谱线形态；特殊超新星可解释光变率与部分谱线，但缺失典型丰度特征；而z=0暂现体虽未被排除，却难以解释观测到的明确红移谱线。因此，本质不确定性源于多解性：同一组观测（红移H线、中等光变率、非黑体SED、弱/缺失次要谱线）可由不同物理模型在参数边缘区域拟合，当前数据不足以打破简并。

根据现象进行分析： Identification of the transient XTE J1719-291 = SWIFT J171916.9-290410 We have performed a Chandra ToO observation of XTE J1719-291 which was found to flare up in RXTE/PCA data between March 5-26 (Markwardt & Swank 2008, ATEL #1442). The goal was to improve upon the localization obtained by Swift/XRT on March 30 (Degenaar et al. 2008, ATEL #1451) to allow optical/NIR identification in this crowded region. We have obtained a 2.16 ksec HRC-I observation starting on 2008-04-27 at 18:23:25. The one X-ray source detected in the field of view is located within the Swift/XRT error circle, at RA(2000.0) = 17h 19m 17.18s, Decl.(2000) = -29d 04' 10.0" with an uncertainty of 0.2" (90% confidence, statistical). We detect a total of 255 counts. Using the spectral parameters from the Swift/XRT measurement of April 3 (9), namely a powerlaw of slope -2.8(-2.5) and an absorbing column of 6.7(6.0)*1021 cm-2, we derive an unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux of 1.4 (2.0) *10-12 erg cm-2 s-1. Thus, at the time of our measurement XTE J1719-291 was at similar luminosity as during the April 3 Swift/XRT observation, and thus had returned from the bright state on April 9 (Degenaar et al. 2008, ATEL #1467), consistent with the finding of Degenaar & Wijnands (2008), ATEL #1541 during a Swift observation on April 30. 
We also observed XTE J1719-291 with the 7-channel imager GROND (Greiner et al. 2008, PASP 120, 405) on two epochs: April 11 between 9:08-9:42 UT (effective exposure of 1120 sec in g'r'i'z' and 900 sec in JHK), and May 4 at 8:21-8:53 UT (effective exposure of 1475 sec in g'r'i'z' and 1200 sec in JHK). 
We detect a source at RA(2000)=17h 19m 17.18s and DEC(2000)= -29d 04' 09.98" with uncertainties of 0.3", coincident with the Chandra position. The object is clearly visible in the first epoch, but not detected in the second epoch (see the r'-band images of both epochs at URL http://www.mpe.mpg.de/~jcg/xrt/xrtj1719m291.html  ). We suggest this object to be the optical counterpart of the Chandra, Swift and RXTE source. 
Photometry was done against SA100-241 in g'r'i'z', and against 2MASS for JHK, but is strongly compromised by a nearby bright object which in JHK is even saturated. Using PSF fitting, we measure g' = 22.98, r' = 22.6, i'=22.3 and z'=22.6 (all in AB system), with statistical errors of Â±0.15 mag. This is surprisingly blue considering the large absorption seen in the Swift X-ray spectrum. Applying the corresponding AV=3.3 correction, our g'r'i'z' SED is best fit with a spectrum Fν ~ ν3, even bluer than the Rayleigh-Jeans tail of a putative accretion disk. 
The upper limits during the second epoch are g' > 23.7 Â± 0.1, r' > 23.5 Â± 0.1, i' > 22.9 Â± 0.1, z' > 22.9 Â± 0.1, J > 20.2 Â± 0.1, H > 19.4 Â± 0.1, K > 18.6 Â± 0.1 (JHK in Vega system), i.e. the source had faded by 0.7 mag, in concordance with the fading seen at X-rays during that time (Degenaar & Wijnands 2008, ATEL #1541). From the upper limits (and assuming a distance of 8 kpc) we derive an absolute V magnitude of >5.8, suggesting a companion K0V or later (if this transient is a binary system).

该现象描述了一个暂现X射线源XTE J1719-291（即SWIFT J171916.9-290410）在2008年3月至5月期间的多波段观测行为，需从时序演化、定位精度、光度变化、能谱特性与物理起源四个层面进行系统分析：

首先，X射线活动具有明确的暂现性与衰减特征：RXTE/PCA于3月5–26日首次探测到爆发；Swift/XRT于3月30日初步定位并确认其为点源；Chandra HRC-I于4月27日以0.2″高精度（90%置信）精确定位，证认其位于Swift误差圆内，且2–10 keV未吸收流量为1.4–2.0×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，与4月3日Swift测量值一致，表明此时已回落至中等光度态；而4月9日之后进一步衰减，至4月30日Swift观测时已显著变暗（ATEL #1541），证实该源在约一个月内完成从峰值到宁静态的完整暂现演化。

其次，光学对应体被可靠证认且呈现同步光变：GROND在4月11日清晰探测到与Chandra位置（RA=17h19m17.18s, Dec=−29°04′09.98″）严格一致的光学源（位置误差0.3″），但在5月4日同一波段均未探测到，r′波段消失达0.7 mag，与X射线衰减趋势完全吻合，排除背景星或无关源可能，确立其为真实光学对应体。

第三，光学能谱异常蓝且难以用标准吸积盘解释：测得g′=22.98、r′=22.6、i′=22.3、z′=22.6（AB），经AV≈3.3消光修正后，SED拟合为Fν ∝ ν³，显著陡于黑体Rayleigh-Jeans尾（Fν ∝ ν²）及典型吸积盘外区谱形，暗示辐射机制非热轫致辐射主导的盘大气，可能源于相对论性喷流同步辐射、致密热冕贡献，或存在极强的紫外超量未被覆盖。

第四，光度约束指向低质量伴星：基于5月4日光学/红外上限制（如r′ > 23.5、K > 18.6）及假设距离8 kpc，推得绝对V星等MV > 5.8，对应主序星谱型K0V或更晚，符合低质量X射线双星（LMXB）中中子星吸积伴星物质的典型构型；而X射线光变时标（数周爆发+快速衰减）亦与中子星暂现源特征一致，区别于恒星级黑洞暂现源通常更长的硬谱态持续时间。

综上，XTE J1719-291是一个位于银河系内、距离约8 kpc、由中子星与K型矮星组成的暂现低质量X射线双星系统，其2008年爆发表现为X射线与光学波段高度协同的快速暂现事件，光学谱形异常蓝暗示非标准盘辐射主导，需引入额外高温成分或非热过程解释。

根据现象进行分析： UV/Optical Light Curves and Optical Spectrum of Transient ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 UV/Optical Light Curve and Optical Spectrum of Transient ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 
We report on the status of continuing observations of the optical transient ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 discovered by Yuan et al. 2008 (ATel #1515). Monitoring by ROTSE and the Palomar 60" indicate a peak in the optical emission around 2008 May 13 UT, ~18 d after the first ROTSE detection on 2008 April 25 UT. 
Since 2008 May 23 UT, the following exponential decays are observed: 
V 0.024 mag/d (MDM 1.3m)   
g 0.029 mag/d (Palomar 60")   
r 0.021 mag/d (Palomar 60")   
i 0.014 mag/d (Palomar 60") 
We measure V=18.26 on June 12 UT. 
Observations have been taken with the Swift satellite on six epochs from 2008 May 14 to June 7 UT. The first epoch Swift UVOT observation in all six filters measured a spectral energy distribution that peaked in the UV, as reported by Gezari et al. (ATel #1524). Since then, the transient has faded monotonically with the following slopes: 
UVW2 0.074 mag/d   
UVM2 0.071 mag/d   
UVW1 0.061 mag/d   
U 0.047 mag/d   
B 0.027 mag/d   
V 0.016 mag/d 
The steeper decay of the UV bands than the optical bands is consistent with a cooling blackbody. 
A total of 24,650 s exposure has been accumulated with the Swift XRT, which places a 3 sigma upper limit on the flux of F(0.5-10 keV) < 3.7e-14 erg/cm2/s for a power-law of photon index 2. 
We obtained a follow-up spectrum on 2008 June 1 UT with the 9.2m Hobby-Eberly Telescope (+ Marcario Low-Resolution Spectrograph). This spectrum shows significant evolution since the first set of spectra taken on 2008 May 1-8 UT (ATel #1515). The broad emission feature detected in the May spectra at 5650 A has evolved significantly. The June 1 spectrum shows several broad bumps that are roughly consistent with a Type II SN at z=0.08-0.09. We now favor this interpretation over the AGN or SMBH/tidal disruption scenario at z=1.02 because of the rapidly cooling temperature of the emission, and the emergence of SN-like broad bumps in the spectrum. A redshift of 0.08-0.09 would indicate a peak optical luminosity of the SN of M_V~-20. There is no host galaxy detected in the SDSS images down to r=23, suggesting possibly a dwarf galaxy host with M_r >-15. Similar, tentative conclusions were reached by Miller et al. (ATel #1576). 2008-06-13 22:51:00
response: 该光学暂现源ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726的光变与光谱演化特征表明其物理本质为一颗红移z≈0.08–0.09的II型超新星。首先，光变曲线显示：光学波段（V、g、r、i）在2008年5月13日UT达到峰值，即首次探测后约18天，符合典型核心坍缩超新星的上升时标；随后进入指数衰减阶段，且UV波段（UVW2、UVM2、UVW1、U）衰减速率（0.074–0.061 mag/d）显著快于光学波段（B、V：0.027–0.016 mag/d），这种波长依赖的衰减梯度与黑体辐射温度持续下降的冷却过程一致，支持热辐射主导模型。其次，光谱演化具有决定性意义：5月初光谱中位于5650 Å的宽发射特征在6月1日已消失，取而代之的是多个宽峰结构，形态与II型超新星在膨胀包层中由Fe II、O I、Ca II等元素产生的典型宽吸收/发射特征相符，且红移拟合落在z≈0.08–0.09；该红移下峰值绝对星等M_V ≈ −20，属正常II型超新星光度范围。此外，X射线未探测到显著辐射（F < 3.7×10⁻¹⁴ erg/cm²/s），排除了活动星系核或高红移潮汐撕裂事件（如z=1.02假说）所预期的硬X射线辐射；SDSS中未检出宿主星系（r > 23），对应宿主可能为低光度矮星系（M_r > −15），这也与多数II型超新星出现在恒星形成活跃的矮星系中的统计规律相符。综上，多波段光变冷却行为、光谱特征演化、缺乏高能辐射及宿主性质共同指向其为一颗中等红移的II型超新星。

response:
首先，该文本报告了CFHT-COVET巡天在2008年6月2日至6月12日期间发现的五个光学暂现源（COVET-080602A至080612A），其观测基于r'波段时序测光数据。每个暂现源均列出了精确的J2000历元赤道坐标（RA/DEC）、多历元r'星等序列（含上极限值）、相对于宿主星系的角距离（Offset）、宿主红移z及初步类型判断。

其次，星等序列显示：COVET-080602A和080605A具有可测光变——前者在6月3日至6月5日由不可测（>23.8）转为约23.5–23.1等，后者在6月5日至6月10日由23.3等持续变亮至22.6等，且存在明确宿主（z=0.8和z=0.2），结合小偏移量（<0.5″），符合Ia型超新星典型特征：宿主关联性强、光度演化符合爆发现象。COVET-080612A虽早期不可测，但在6月10日与12日突增至22.4与21.7等，且偏移极小（0.1″），但宿主z=0.25且被标记为AGN?，需考虑活动星系核耀发可能性；而其光变陡增幅度大、无前期缓慢上升，更倾向短时标耀发事件而非典型AGN缓变。

第三，COVET-080603A与080604A均无SDSS或深度CFHT成像中可识别的宿主（r'>23.9），且080603A与邻近z=0.5星系的角距达1.3″，显著超出典型超新星宿主关联尺度（通常<1″），故其物理起源存疑，可能为前景恒星耀斑、高银纬矮星系中的遥远暂现源，或仪器伪迹；但其光变平缓（23.4→22.2），缺乏爆发陡增特征，亦不支持经典超新星模型。

最后，所有暂现源在2008年3月10日深场图像中均未检出（lim>23.9），说明其为真实暂现事件而非静态源；初步分类依赖宿主偏移与红移，但080603A/04A缺乏宿主、080612A类型存疑，凸显光谱证认的必要性——仅凭测光与位置无法最终确认物理机制，需后续光谱观测区分超新星、潮汐撕裂事件、AGN耀发或未知暂现类。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical Nova Candidate in M 31 We report the discovery of an optical nova candidate in M 31 on two 11x60s stacked R filter CCD images obtained with the robotic 60cm telescope with an E2V CCD (2kx2k) of the Livermore Optical Transient Imaging System (Super-LOTIS, located at Steward Observatory, Kitt Peak, Arizona, USA). The object was first detected on 2008 June 14.46 and 16.46 UT with respective magnitudes of 18.0 and 17.7. The position for the nova candidate is RA = 00h42m37.72s, Dec = +41d12'30.0"(J2000, accuracy of 0.3"), which is 1'14" west and 3'39" south of the core of M 31. All magnitudes given are obtained from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Local Group Survey M 31 catalogue (Massey et al. 2006, AJ, 131, 2478). No object is visible at the position of the nova candidate on Super-LOTIS images of 2008 June 09.46 UT (limiting R magnitude of ~18.5). There is no entry in VizieR/CDS for this object and no minor planet could be found on this position using the MPC/IAU Minor Planet Checker (see http://scully.harvard.edu/~cgi/CheckMP  ). Erratum: The new nova candidate reported in ATel #1567 is a re-brightening of Nova M31N 2008-03b discovered by K. Hornoch on 2008-03-07.756 UT. 2008-06-16 14:46:00
response: 该光学新星候选体位于M31中，首次在2008年6月14.46 UT被探测到，R波段星等为18.0；两天后即6月16.46 UT再次观测到，星等变亮至17.7，表明存在显著的光度上升，符合经典新星的典型光变特征。其位置RA = 00h42m37.72s，Dec = +41d12'30.0"（J2000），精度达0.3″，且距离M31核心约1′14″（西）和3′39″（南），处于星系盘或晕区域，符合新星在宿主星系中的空间分布规律。此前于6月9.46 UT的图像中该位置无任何可测光源，极限星等约R~18.5，排除了该目标为恒定源或慢变源的可能性。VizieR/CDS数据库及MPC小行星核查均未发现该位置存在已知天体，排除了已编录变星、小行星或其它暂现源混淆的可能。关键修正指出：该候选体实为Nova M31N 2008-03b（发现于2008年3月7.756 UT）的再增亮事件，而非独立新星；这表明其属于再发新星（recurrent nova），即同一白矮星吸积系统在较短时间内（约3个月）发生第二次爆发，暗示极高的吸积率与较小的白矮星质量，符合再发新星的物理模型预期。

根据现象进行分析： Blazar 3C 454.3 in gamma-ray high state: new AGILE detection The AGILE Gamma Ray Imaging Detector (GRID) detected 3C 454.3 in high state in the period between 2008-06-15 10:46 UT and 2008-06-16 07:11 UT. 
Despite the fact that the source is currently more than 35 degrees off-axis, a preliminary maximum likelihood analysis shows a detection at a significance level of about 5 sigma, with a source flux in excess of 100e-8 ph/cm2/s at energies above 100 MeV. This source was already detected in the gamma-ray energy band by the AGILE-GRID in July, November, and December 2007 (see ATELs #1160, #1167, #1278, and #1300) and also during the period May 24 - June 9 2008 (see ATEL #1545). 
Monitoring of the source by AGILE will continue till 2008-06-30 12:00 UT. We strongly encourage multi-frequency observations of 3C 454.3 during this gamma-ray high-state. 2008-06-16 16:21:00
response:
首先，观测到Blazar 3C 454.3在2008年6月15日10:46 UT至6月16日07:11 UT期间处于伽马射线高态，该状态由AGILE卫星的GRID探测器确认。  
其次，尽管源位于视场边缘（离轴角大于35度），初步最大似然分析仍给出约5σ的统计显著性，表明该探测具有高置信度，排除随机涨落可能性。  
第三，测得能谱高于100 MeV的光子流量超过100×10⁻⁸ ph/cm²/s，属于强伽马射线辐射事件，反映喷流中粒子加速效率显著增强。  
第四，历史观测显示该源在2007年7月、11月、12月及2008年5月24日至6月9日期间多次被AGILE探测到伽马射线辐射，说明其具有频繁且剧烈的耀发活动特性，符合典型FSRQ类Blazar的光变行为。  
第五，AGILE持续监测将持续至2008年6月30日12:00 UT，当前高态可能尚未达峰或正处衰减初期，具备时间演化研究价值。  
第六，呼吁开展多波段协同观测，因Blazar的宽波段辐射通常由同一相对论喷流中不同物理过程（如同步辐射、逆康普顿散射）产生，联合光学、射电、X射线数据可约束辐射区位置、磁场强度、电子能谱及喷流参数。

input: 根据现象进行分析： AGILE detection of the blazar W Comae in the gamma-ray energy band The AGILE Gamma Ray Imaging Detector (GRID) detected W Comae in the period between 2008-06-09 17:02 UT and 2008-06-15 02:17 UT during a Target of Opportunity re-pointing in response to the source detection in the TeV energy band (see Swordy et al., ATEL #1565). A preliminary maximum likelihood analysis shows a detection at a significance level of about 4 sigma, at energies above 100 MeV. The source is an approved target of the AGILE Announcement of Opportunity, Cycle 1 (PI: E. Pian). 2008-06-17 12:42:00
response:
首先，AGILE卫星的GRID探测器在2008年6月9日17:02 UT至6月15日02:17 UT期间对耀变体W Comae进行了观测，该观测属于“机会目标”（Target of Opportunity）重指向操作。  
其次，此次重指向的触发原因是该源此前已在TeV能段被探测到（参考Swordy等在ATEL #1565中的报告），表明存在高能辐射活动增强，从而促使AGILE开展后续伽马射线波段的跟进观测。  
第三，初步最大似然分析显示，W Comae在>100 MeV能段的伽马射线辐射达到约4σ的统计显著性，满足可靠探测标准。  
第四，W Comae是AGILE第一轮公告机会（Announcement of Opportunity, Cycle 1）的批准观测目标，项目负责人（PI）为E. Pian，说明该源具有长期观测价值和科学优先级。  
最后，该探测结果发布于2008年6月17日12:42:00，属于早期快速通报性质，强调时效性与多波段协同观测背景。

input: 根据现象进行分析： AGILE detection of the blazar Mrk 421 The AGILE Gamma Ray Imaging Detector (GRID) detected Mrk 421 in the period between 2008-06-09 17:02 UT and 2008-06-15 02:17 UT during a Target of Opportunity (ToO) re-pointing towards W Comae. A preliminary maximum likelihood analysis shows a detection at a significance level of about 4 sigma, at energies above 100 MeV. During the AGILE ToO, the Super-AGILE hard X-ray monitor detected Mrk 421 in a relatively high-state, with a source flux of about 40 mCrab, in the energy range 18-60 keV (see Costa et al., ATEL #1574). The source is an approved target of the AGILE Announcement of Opportunity, Cycle 1 (PI: J. Grube). 2008-06-17 12:47:00
response:
首先，AGILE卫星的GRID探测器在2008年6月9日17:02 UT至6月15日02:17 UT期间探测到耀变体Mrk 421，该探测发生在针对W Comae实施的机遇目标（ToO）重新指向观测期间。这表明观测并非计划内常规观测，而是因其他科学目标触发的临时调整，但在此过程中意外或附带捕获了Mrk 421的伽马射线辐射。

其次，初步最大似然分析显示，该伽马射线信号在>100 MeV能段达到约4σ的统计显著性，说明该探测具有较高的置信度，虽未达通常认定为“明确发现”的5σ标准，但仍构成强证据，支持Mrk 421在此时段存在显著高能辐射活动。

第三，同期Super-AGILE硬X射线监测器在18–60 keV波段测得Mrk 421处于相对高态，流量约为40 mCrab。X射线与GeV伽马射线的同步增强，暗示其高能辐射很可能源于同一物理过程——例如喷流中相对论性电子的同步自康普顿（SSC）辐射，这是典型BL Lac型耀变体（如Mrk 421）多波段耀发的标志性特征。

第四，Mrk 421是AGILE第一轮公告机会（AO Cycle 1）的获批观测目标，PI为J. Grube，说明该源本身具有重要科学价值且已被列入重点监测计划；此次ToO期间的探测虽属偶然，但与其既定科学目标一致，增强了结果的可信度和后续跟进的合理性。

综上，该事件表征Mrk 421在2008年6月中旬经历了一次多波段（硬X射线与>100 MeV伽马射线）协同增强的耀发活动，由AGILE卫星通过ToO模式捕捉，提供了其高能辐射机制和时变行为的重要观测约束。

根据现象进行分析： VLA Observations of the AGILE Cygnus Region Source Field Following its May 2008 Re-brightening in Gamma-rays Following the recent announcement of renewed gamma-ray activity in the AGILE Cygnus region source (ATel #1547; see also ATel #1492), we obtained VLA observations of the field in search of a variable radio source which would implicate a likely counterpart. Observations at 1.4 GHz were obtained on May 30 and June 3, 2008 (both at 09hr UT), a few days after the AGILE detection of the high gamma-ray state (from data collected between May 22-27).   
  
In the central ~20' portion of the reported r=0.5 deg error circle of the AGILE source, we found several interesting bright compact radio sources, but none varied by more than ~10% from their average between the four days. This includes the recently discovered VLA radio counterpart (Dubner et al. ATel #1518) of 2MASX J20183871+4041003 (Bykov et al. 2006 ApJL 649, L21) for which the details are reported here; the others sources will be described elsewhere. The 2MASX/radio source is a bright X-ray source detected by the Swift XRT (ATel #788, #1497), making it the likely counterpart of the hard X-ray source IGR J2018+4043 (Bykov et al. 2006; see ATel #1497 for the Swift BAT detection). It has been further suggested as the likely low energy counterpart of the AGILE transient, as its association with the hard X-ray source makes it a possible blazar or X-ray binary. However, the 2MASX/radio source may simply be a nearby Seyfert galaxy (Atel #1498), and a different source in the field may be responsible for the variable gamma-ray emission detected by AGILE.   
  
The radio source discovered by Dubner et al. is detected at both our epochs. In our analysis/search for compact radio sources, we expunged the shortest baseline data (<1 kilo-lambda) to avoid contamination from the bright surrounding diffuse emission. We model the source with an elliptical Gaussian using the JMFIT task in AIPS and the resultant parameters (we quote the average between the two epochs) are: RA=20h18m38.90s (0.12s), Dec=+40d40'58.5" (0.8"), Peak = 11.1 (0.9) mJy/bm, Integrated = 17.4 (2.1) mJy (the restoring beam is 40.6"x13.7', PA=-80.4 deg and 1 sigma errors are in parentheses). The source is not variable between the 4 days to within the given uncertainties.   
  
To gauge longer timescale variability, we note that the Dubner et al. detection of 2MASX J20183871+4041003 was from comparably deep VLA observations (from December 2006) but with slightly higher resolution data. They reported a radio source with a 8.7 (0.9) mJy/bm peak (25.6" x 15.8" beam @PA=-62.4 deg) and 31.3 (1.9) mJy total flux. We re-analyzed their archived data in a consistent manner with our analysis (expunging the <1 kilo-lambda baseline data and restoring with our larger beam) and measured 8.9 (0.7) mJy/bm peak and 10.3 (1.3) mJy total. Our two analyses give consistent results for the peak, but there is a large discrepancy in the integrated intensity. This may be due to the fact that we removed the shortest baseline data, thus are less sensitive to more extended emission which would explain their higher value. Based on the peak flux values, there is little evidence for dramatic variability of the compact source between the ~1.5 years span of the observations.   
  
In summary, we find no dramatic variability of the radio source (on 4 day and ~1.5 year timescales) associated with 2MASX J20183871+4041003, even after the gamma-ray event in the AGILE source. Additionally, we find that the 2MASX radio source is <1% polarized (3 sigma limit) at 1.4 GHz from an analysis of the Dubner et al. data. Together with the fact that there is also no dramatic X-ray variability detected in the Swift observations (ATel #1497) and that a host galaxy was resolved (ATel #1498), makes it unlikely that this source is a blazar or even an X-ray binary. The question of a plausible low energy counterpart for the AGILE Cygnus source remains open. 
VLA images 2008-06-20 23:30:00
response:
该观测分析旨在通过VLA射电数据检验AGILE在2008年5月探测到的天鹅座区域伽马暴再增亮事件是否存在对应的可变射电源，从而识别其低能对应体。首先，针对AGILE给出的半径0.5度误差圆中心约20角分区域，开展两次1.4 GHz VLA观测（2008年5月30日与6月3日），时间上紧邻伽马射线高态期（5月22–27日）。在该区域内发现多个明亮致密射电源，但所有源在四天尺度上的流量变化均不超过约10%，包括已被确认为2MASX J20183871+4041003的VLA对应体（Dubner et al. ATel #1518）。该源同时被Swift XRT和BAT分别证认为硬X射线源IGR J2018+4043的对应体，因而曾被推测为可能的耀变体或X射线双星；但其亦可能仅为邻近的塞弗特星系（ATel #1498），故仍不能排除其他源为真实伽马辐射体。

进一步对2MASX源进行定量建模：采用AIPS中JMFIT拟合椭圆高斯模型，两历元平均得峰值流量11.1±0.9 mJy/beam、积分流量17.4±2.1 mJy，束宽40.6″×13.7″，位置精度达0.12秒（RA）与0.8角秒（Dec），且两次观测间无显著变化。为评估长期变化性，将本次结果与Dubner等人2006年12月的存档数据进行一致性再处理（同样剔除<1 kλ基线、使用相同合成束恢复），得到峰值流量8.9±0.7 mJy/beam，与当前值在误差范围内一致；而积分流量差异显著（本次10.3±1.3 mJy vs. 原报告31.3±1.9 mJy），归因于短基线剔除导致延展成分丢失。因此，在约1.5年时间跨度内，该致密成分亦无剧烈光变。

此外，基于Dubner等人数据测得该源在1.4 GHz的线偏振度上限为<1%（3σ），结合Swift未见显著X射线光变（ATel #1497）及哈勃或地面光学观测已解析出宿主星系（ATel #1498），可排除其为典型耀变体（需强相对论喷流与高偏振）或暂现型X射线双星（通常伴X射线光变）。综上，2MASX J20183871+4041003虽为空间位置最吻合的候选体，但在射电、X射线及偏振多波段均缺乏支持其作为AGILE伽马暴瞬变源物理对应体的关键时变与辐射特征证据，因此AGILE天鹅座源的可靠低能对应体仍未确认。

input:
根据现象进行分析： AGILE detection of the flaring gamma-ray source AGL2021+4029: a possible rebrightening of a strong source in the Cygnus region  Integrating from 2007-11-02 12:00 UT to 2008-05-01 00:00, AGILE-GRID (Gamma-Ray Imaging Detector) detects a gamma-ray point source above 19 sigma, with a source flux in excess of 100e-8 ph/cm2/s at energies above 100 MeV. The source positional error box is centered at Galactic coordinates l = 78.31 deg, b = 2.05 deg, and has a radius of about 0.25 degrees. The nearest EGRET source is 3EG J2020+4017 at (l,b) = (78.05,2.08) with an error radius of 0.16 degrees. 
The position of this source is consistent with the transient sources previously reported in ATel #1492 and #1547. We note that although the flux reported in #1492 is significantly higher than the mean integrated flux, the flux during the #1547 is consistent with the mean value. We also note that the position of the proposed counterpart IGR J20187+4041 = 2MASX J20183871+4041003 (ATel #1497, #1498, #1518, #1584) lies OUTSIDE the 95% source location contour of the integrated source. 
While pointing at the Cygnus region, AGILE detected renewed gamma-ray emission consistent with this source, beginning on 2008-06-20 UT. A preliminary maximum likelihood analysis of the gamma-ray data obtained between 2008-06-20 16:30 UT and 2008-06-21 16:30 UT for photon energies above 100 MeV results in a detection significance of about 4.9 sigma, with a source flux in excess of 200e-8 ph/cm2/s at energies above 100 MeV, two standard deviations higher than the mean flux of the integrated source. The source positional error box is centered at Galactic coordinates l = 78.6 deg, b = 1.7 deg, and has a radius of about 0.6 degrees. We note that the position is consistent with the integrated source, while 2MASX J20183871+4041003 lies outside the 95% source location contour. 
A preliminary analysis of the Super-AGILE data over the same time period and the same sky region does not show any counterpart in the 20-60 keV energy range, with a 3-sigma upper limit of 20 mCrab on the average flux. 
We strongly encourage multi-frequency observations of the field of the gamma-ray source detected by AGILE in an active gamma-ray flaring state, concentrating on the error box of the persistent source. 2008-06-23 17:31:00
response:
该现象描述了一个位于天鹅座区域的伽马射线源AGL2021+4029的多时段探测与光变行为分析。首先，AGILE-GRID在2007年11月至2008年5月的长期积分观测中以>19σ的极高显著性探测到一个稳定存在的伽马射线点源，通量超过100×10⁻⁸ ph/cm²/s（E > 100 MeV），其银道坐标中心为(l,b) = (78.31°, 2.05°)，定位误差半径约0.25°，与EGRET源3EG J2020+4017（l=78.05°, b=2.08°，误差半径0.16°）位置高度一致，表明二者极可能为同一源。该位置亦与ATel #1492和#1547报道的暂现源位置相符：其中#1492报告的通量显著高于长期平均值，暗示一次早期耀发；而#1547的通量则与长期平均值一致，反映进入相对宁静期。值得注意的是，候选对应体IGR J20187+4041（即2MASX J20183871+4041003）的位置虽被多次提出（ATel #1497等），但始终落在该长期积分源95%置信度定位轮廓之外，因此其物理关联性存疑。

随后，在2008年6月20日UT起，AGILE在指向天鹅座区域时再次探测到该源方向上的增强辐射，表现为一次新的耀发事件。对2008年6月20日16:30至21日16:30 UT间的数据进行最大似然分析，得到约4.9σ的显著性探测，通量跃升至>200×10⁻⁸ ph/cm²/s（E > 100 MeV），比长期平均通量高出约两个标准差，确认为一次明确的再增亮（rebrightening）现象。此时源定位中心为(l,b) = (78.6°, 1.7°)，误差半径扩大至约0.6°，虽中心略有偏移但仍与长期源位置在误差范围内相容，进一步支持其为同一物理源的活动表现；而前述候选体2MASX J20183871+4041003仍位于此次耀发源95%定位轮廓之外，削弱其作为真实对应体的可能性。

此外，同期Super-AGILE在20–60 keV能段未探测到任何对应X射线辐射，仅给出3σ上限为20 mCrab，说明该耀发事件在硬X射线波段无显著同步辐射对应，可能暗示辐射机制以高能电子逆康普顿散射为主，或喷流倾角、吸收效应等因素导致低能端辐射缺失。

综上，该源呈现长时标稳定辐射基态叠加短时标强耀发的特征，符合典型耀变体或年轻脉冲星风云等高能天体的光变行为；其空间位置一致性支持其为真实致密伽马射线源，但现有候选光学/红外对应体尚未被精确定位所证实，亟需更高精度的多波段观测（尤其是射电、光学及软X射线）以确认真实对应体并约束辐射模型。

根据现象进行分析： Unusual optical and X-ray flaring activity in GX 339-4 Since September 2007 we have been monitoring the optical counterpart (V, R and i-bands) of the black hole X-ray binary GX 339-4 with the Faulkes Telescope South situated at Siding Spring in Australia. The source has continued to decline from its 2006-7 outburst (ATel #968) until May 2008, in which a period of strong variability began. At its faintest flux level, on 2008-04-29 (MJD 54585.51) the magnitudes were V = 18.39 +- 0.06; R = 18.10 +- 0.03; i = 17.22 +- 0.03. Between then and 2008-05-29 strong flares of amplitudes up to 0.7 mag have been observed on timescales of days, and the mean flux is increasing. The flaring is most prominent in the i-band (i.e. at lower frequencies) suggesting its origin may be synchrotron emission from the jets, which is known to dominate the infrared flux during hard X-ray states (Homan et al. 2005, ApJ, 624, 295). Flaring of this amplitude on timescles of days is very unusual for GX 339-4 except during state transitions at higher flux levels (ATel #1027). Inspection of the RXTE PCA Galactic bulge scan light curve of GX 339-4 also reveals short-timescale flares of up to ~ 5 mCrab (50 counts/sec/5PCU) in the 2-10 keV range. The flares appear on timescales of days or less; most of the PCA scans do not detect the source with 3-sigma confidence. The amplitude of the variability appears to be one order of magnitude or more, which (as far as we are aware) is stronger than previous periods of both outburst and low-flux levels. There are no 3-sigma detections of the source from the RXTE ASM 1-day averages (2-12 keV) during this flaring period, implying the luminosity generally remains below ~ 3 x 10^36 erg/sec (assuming a distance of 8 kpc). There are also no detections in hard X-rays (15-50 keV) from BAT on board SWIFT. To test whether the optical and X-ray flaring behaviours are correlated, we are monitoring the source with SWIFT (UVOT+XRT) for the next 4 weeks. The first UVOT V-band magnitude obtained is V = 17.10 +- 0.18 (on 2008-06-20; MJD 54637.35); one magnitude brighter than 3 weeks prior to this date; V = 18.07 +- 0.05; 17.59 +- 0.02; i = 16.56 +- 0.02 (on 2008-05-29; MJD 54615.40). It is possible that GX 339-4 is beginning a new outburst. Our light curves are shown here http://staff.science.uva.nl/~davidr/faulkes/gx339.html  and will be updated regularly during the next few weeks. Observations at radio frequencies are encouraged. The Faulkes observations are part of an ongoing monitoring campaign of ~ 30 low-mass X-ray binaries (Lewis et al. 2008, arXiv:0712.2751). The Faulkes Telescope Project is an educational and research arm of the Las Cumbres Observatory Global Telescope Network (LCOGTN). FL acknowledges support from the Dill Faulkes Educational Trust. 
GX 339-4 optical light curves 2008-06-23 19:21:00
response: 该现象描述了黑洞X射线双星GX 339-4在2008年4月至6月期间出现的异常光学与X射线耀发活动。首先，源在2006–2007年爆发后持续衰减至2008年4月底达到极低光度水平（V ≈ 18.39），随后于5月起进入强变异性阶段：数日内出现幅度达0.7 mag的光学耀发，且i波段耀发最显著，表明辐射机制可能源于喷流中的同步辐射——这与硬X射线态下红外波段由喷流主导的观测特征一致（Homan et al. 2005）。其次，RXTE PCA巡天数据揭示同期存在短时标（≤数天）、高达~5 mCrab（约50 counts/sec/5PCU）的2–10 keV X射线耀发，其变幅超一个数量级，显著强于以往低光度态或爆发期间的典型变化；但ASM日均数据（2–12 keV）和Swift/BAT（15–50 keV）均无3σ探测，说明平均X射线光度仍极低（L_X ≲ 3×10³⁶ erg/s，d = 8 kpc），耀发具有高度间歇性与短暂性。第三，Swift/UVOT在6月20日测得V = 17.10，比5月29日（V = 18.07）亮约1 mag，结合i波段同步增强（i = 16.56），表明光学整体增亮趋势与耀发叠加并存。光学与X射线耀发在时间尺度（天级）、幅度（显著偏离基线）及多波段协同演化上呈现一致性，暗示二者可能共享同一物理起源，如喷流动力学不稳定性或内吸积流扰动触发的瞬时能量释放；而缺乏持续高能X射线探测则支持系统仍处于低硬态，尚未进入标准爆发上升相，但已具备新爆发初期的征兆。

The previous outbursts occurred during 2003 and 2005. The ASM first detected the current outburst on MJD 54631 at an average level of 39 (9) mCrab at 2-12 keV. The intensity rose to 100 mCrab on MJD 54635, and it has hovered near that level up to the present day (54641). We urge followup observations with other instruments. 2008-06-24 19:23:00
response: X1744-361是一个已知的暂现源，属于吸积中子星系统，具有周期性X射线爆发特征。历史观测表明其曾在2003年和2005年发生过两次X射线爆发，本次为第三次被RXTE卫星观测到的爆发，说明该源具有复发性暂现行为。ASM（All-Sky Monitor）于MJD 54631首次探测到本次爆发，初始流量为39±9 mCrab（2–12 keV），表明爆发已进入可探测阶段；随后在MJD 54635流量上升至约100 mCrab，并在后续观测中（至MJD 54641）维持在该水平附近，说明爆发已进入峰值或平台期，光度趋于稳定。流量在数日内显著上升并维持高位，暗示吸积盘内区物质快速向中子星表面输运并持续稳定释放引力势能。由于该源为中子星系统，高光度平台期可能对应于中子星表面稳态核燃烧或边界层持续吸积释放。当前仍处于活跃爆发状态，因此需要多波段、高时间分辨率的后续观测以确认谱态演化、脉动特征（如X射线脉冲或毫秒周期）、以及可能的喷流活动等关键物理信息。

根据现象进行分析： Recent Swift XRT Observations of GX 339-4 Following the discovery of the unusual optical and X-ray flaring activity in GX 339-4 (ATel #1586), we analyzed the two recent Swift XRT observations of the source taken on 2008 June 20 and 24. GX 339-4 is clearly detected in both observations. The first observation is 1985 sec long and the spectrum can be fit with an absorbed power-law model with a hydrogen column density of (4.1+/-1.1)e21 cm^-2 and a photon index of 1.45+/-0.15. The unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux is 4e-11 erg/s/cm^2. From the first orbit of the second observation (546 sec exposure time), the spectrum can be fit with an absorbed power-law model with a hydrogen column density of (3.5+/-2.0)e21 cm^-2 and a photon index of 1.44+/-0.25. The unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux is 5.9e-11 erg/s/cm^2. Assuming a distance of 8 kpc, the 2-10 keV luminosity is (3-4.5)e35 erg/s. 
The X-ray spectral fits are consistent with the "off" state of the source and the flux is now at the upper end of the "off" state (Kong et al. 2000; Corbel et al. 2003). Since the optical flux shows sign of increasing activity (ATel #1586) and if the X-ray flux continues to increase at the current rate, the source is expected to enter the low/hard state in about 10 days. Observations at other wavelengths are encouraged. 2008-06-24 19:33:00
response:
首先，观测对象是黑洞X射线双星GX 339-4，其在光学与X射线波段均出现异常耀发活动（见ATel #1586），这提示系统可能正经历状态转变的早期阶段。  
其次，Swift XRT在2008年6月20日和24日进行了两次观测，源在两次观测中均被清晰探测到，说明X射线辐射持续存在且具有一定强度。  
第三，两次观测的X射线能谱均可由吸积盘外流主导的吸收幂律模型拟合，氢柱密度N_H分别约为4.1×10²¹ cm⁻²和3.5×10²¹ cm⁻²，误差较大但数值相近，表明视线方向的星际吸收未发生显著变化；光子指数Γ均约为1.45，典型地对应于硬谱态，即低/硬态（low/hard state）的特征谱形。  
第四，2–10 keV波段未吸收流量从4.0×10⁻¹¹ erg/s/cm²上升至5.9×10⁻¹¹ erg/s/cm²，约增长47.5%，结合8 kpc距离换算得光度为(3–4.5)×10³⁵ erg/s，处于已知“关”态（off state）的高端范围，但尚未达到典型低/硬态的典型光度下限（通常>10³⁶ erg/s），因此当前仍被归类为“关”态末期。  
第五，光学流量已呈现上升趋势（ATel #1586），而X射线流量亦呈上升态势，若保持当前增速，预计约10天后X射线光度将跨越临界阈值，进入标准低/硬态——该状态转变常伴随射电喷流开启、X射线谱硬化减弱及光度跃升等特征。  
最后，由于多波段协同演化是判断黑洞暂现源状态跃迁的关键依据，文中强调需加强其他波段（如射电、红外、紫外）监测，以捕捉谱态转变过程中的时标差异与物理机制关联。

根据现象进行分析： VLA Observations of the AGILE Cygnus Region Source Field Following its May 2008 Re-brightening in Gamma-rays, II: An Update The AGILE team (Chen et al. ATel #1585) has detected a new flare (occurring on June 20/21, 2008) from AGL2021+4029, the variable gamma-ray source in the Cygnus region. The error circles of this new June flare and that of the newly reported position of the persistent source, both unfortunately, lie outside of the r~0.5 deg field we targeted with the VLA (ATel #1584) following the May 2008 rebrightening (Giuliani et al. ATel #1547).   
  
In addition, the flux from the source during the reported rebrightening in May 2008 is actually consistent with the mean flux (ATel #1585). Thus, the gamma-ray source was not in a particularly active state when we triggered our VLA 1.4 GHz rapid response observations. New radio observations of the field near the newly derived position of the persistent source are encouraged.   
  
The updated view of the field can be seen in the link below. The VLA rapid response images reported in ATel #1584 are also posted as downloadable FITS files. 
VLA images 2008-06-24 21:14:00
response:
首先，该文本描述了一次针对AGILE卫星发现的伽马射线源AGL2021+4029（位于天鹅座区域）所开展的甚大阵（VLA）射电后续观测及其结果分析。

关键现象包括：  
1. AGILE团队于2008年6月20/21日探测到该源的一次新耀发（June flare），其位置误差圆未落入此前VLA观测所覆盖的约0.5度视场内；  
2. 同样，该源持续成分（persistent source）经新定位后的位置也落在该VLA视场之外；  
3. 回溯分析发现，2008年5月发生的“再增亮”事件（即触发VLA快速响应观测的依据）在伽马射线波段的流量实际与长期平均流量一致，并未显著增强；  
4. 因此，VLA在2008年6月24日开展的1.4 GHz观测并非针对一个处于明显高态的伽马射线活动期，而是基于一次被误判为显著增强的事件所触发；  
5. 由于两次关键伽马射线事件（5月再增亮、6月新耀发）的空间位置均未被VLA视场覆盖，且源在观测时并未处于真实高光度状态，故本次VLA观测未能探测到与伽马射线耀发对应的射电对应体；  
6. 文本由此推断：需在新确定的持续源位置附近开展新的射电观测，以检验其射电辐射特性及可能的多波段关联性。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of supernova candidate ROTSE3 J130014.3+275716 We report the discovery of a supernova candidate, located at RA: 13:00:14.31 Dec: +27:57:16.4 (J2000, uncertainty <1 "), in unfiltered CCD images taken by the 0.45m ROTSE-IIIb telescope at McDonald Observatory, Texas. This transient was discovered at ~17.4 mag on Jun. 24.20 UT, and again imaged on Jun. 24.23 UT at a similar magnitude. It is not detected to a limiting magnitude of ~18.1 on Jun. 23.2 UT. It is about 339" east and 94" south from the center of Coma cluster and 44.6" west and 2.6" south from the center of the nearest galaxy seen in SDSS (2MASX J13001768+2757192). 
A ROTSE-III finding chart can be found at: http://www.rotse.net/rsvp/j130014.3+275716/j130014.3+275716.jpg 2008-06-25 18:10:00
response: 该现象描述了一个超新星候选体ROTSE3 J130014.3+275716的发现过程。首先，其位置被精确测定为赤经13:00:14.31、赤纬+27:57:16.4（J2000历元），误差小于1角秒，说明定位精度较高，有利于后续证认。其次，该暂现源在6月24.20 UT首次被探测到，视星等约17.4等，并在约0.03天后（即6月24.23 UT）再次观测仍保持相似亮度，表明其未显著衰减；而在更早的6月23.2 UT图像中未被探测到，极限星等约18.1等，说明其光度在约1天内由低于18.1等上升至17.4等，具备典型爆发性暂现源的光变特征。第三，其空间位置距离后发座星系团中心约339角秒向东、94角秒向南，不属于星系团核心区域；但更关键的是，它距SDSS所见最近星系2MASX J13001768+2757192的中心仅44.6角秒向西、2.6角秒向南，投影距离非常近，暗示其很可能位于该星系盘面或晕内，是该星系的光学暂现事件而非前景恒星或背景活动星系核。综合位置、光变时标与邻近星系的关联性，该候选体符合核心坍缩型或Ia型超新星的基本观测判据。

The object is visible on all individual images. The position for the nova candidate is RA = 00h42m27.81s, Dec = +41d14'48.2" (J2000, accuracy of 0.4"), which is 186" west and 80" south of the core of M 31. All magnitudes given are obtained from a photometric solution using R magnitudes from the USNO-B1 catalogue. No object is visible (limiting magnitude of ~18.0) at the position of the nova candidate on images with the same camera on 2007 Dec 13 and 2008 Jan 6. Also there is no object brighter than 20 mag in R within 5" in the Local Group Survey M 31 catalogue (Massey et al. 2006, AJ 131, 2478). There is no entry in VizieR/CDS for this object and no minor planet could be found on this position using the MPC/IAU Minor Planet Checker (see http://scully.harvard.edu/~cgi/CheckMP  ). 2008-06-26 16:27:00
response: 该光学新星候选体的发现基于多方面观测证据的系统性排除与确认：首先，目标在2008年6月26.11日的多帧叠加CCD图像中清晰可见，且在所有单帧图像中均存在，表明其为真实天体而非噪点或宇宙线；其次，其位置（J2000历元）具有高精度（0.4″），且偏离M31核心达186″西、80″南，排除了核心区域恒星密度过高导致的混淆可能；第三，通过时间序列对比，在更早的2007年12月13日和2008年1月6日同设备观测图像中，该位置无任何天体（极限星等约18.0等），证实其为暂现源；第四，本地群巡天M31星表（Massey et al. 2006）中5″半径内无R波段亮于20等的对应源，进一步支持其非已知恒星或星团成员；第五，VizieR/CDS数据库及小行星中心（MPC/IAU）核查均未发现该位置存在已编录天体或小行星，排除了常见非恒星暂现源干扰；最后，所有星等均通过USNO-B1星表R波段星等定标获得，保证了测光一致性与可靠性。综上，该源满足光学新星的核心判据：位于近邻星系内、有明确爆发前非存在性、位置精确、无已知对应体、测光可靠，因此可被稳健地归类为M31中的新星候选体。
