根据现象进行分析： GLAST-LAT detection of extraordinary gamma-ray activity in 3C 454.3 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of two instruments on the Gamma-ray Large Area Space Telescope (GLAST) (launched June 11, 2008), which is still in its post-launch commissioning and checkout phase has been monitoring extraordinarily high flux from the gamma-ray blazar 3C 454.3 since June 28, 2008. This confirms the bright state of the source reported by AGILE (see ATel #1592) and by the optical-to-radio observers of the GASP-WEBT Project (ATel #1625). 
3C 454.3 has been detected on time scales of hours with high significance (> 5 sigma) by the LAT Automatic Science Processing (ASP) pipeline and the daily light curve (E>100 MeV) indicates that the source flux has increased from the initial measurements on June 28. Although in-flight calibration is still ongoing, preliminary analysis indicates that in the period July 10-21, 2008 the source has been in a very high state with a flux (E>100MeV) that is well above all previously published values reported by both EGRET (Hartman et al. 1999, ApJS, 123,79) and AGILE (see e.g. ATel #1592 and Vercellone et al. 2008, ApJ,676,L13). 
Because GLAST will continue with calibration activities, regular monitoring of this source cannot be pursued. Monitoring by the LAT is expected to resume in early August. In consideration of the ongoing activity of this source we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations of 3C 454.3. 
The GLAST LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2008-07-24 14:25:00
response:
首先，观测现象是GLAST-LAT在2008年6月28日起持续探测到耀变体3C 454.3在GeV能段（E > 100 MeV）出现异常高通量的伽马射线辐射。该活动已被AGILE卫星和GASP-WEBT多波段监测项目独立证实，说明该爆发具有多仪器一致性，排除了单一设备系统误差导致的假信号可能。

其次，LAT在发射后尚处于在轨调试与校准阶段（post-launch commissioning and checkout phase），但其自动科学处理（ASP）流水线仍能在小时时标上以>5σ显著性水平可靠探测该源，表明信号真实且强度极高；日光变曲线显示通量自6月28日起持续上升，进一步支持其处于前所未有的活跃态。

第三，初步分析（尽管校准尚未完成）指出：在2008年7月10–21日期间，该源在E > 100 MeV能段的积分通量显著超过EGRET历史最高值（Hartman et al. 1999）及AGILE此前报道值（Vercellone et al. 2008, ATel #1592），说明此次爆发是迄今最亮的伽马射线耀发事件之一，具有极端物理意义。

第四，由于GLAST当时仍需优先完成在轨校准，常规监测被迫暂停，预计8月初恢复；这一技术限制导致数据时间覆盖存在空缺，因此亟需其他波段（如光学、射电等）开展协同观测，以构建完整的多波段光变与能谱演化图景，进而约束辐射机制（如同步自康普顿过程）与喷流物理参数（如多普勒因子、磁场强度、电子能量分布）。

最后，LAT作为宽能段（20 MeV – >300 GeV）对撞式望远镜，其国际协作背景保障了数据质量与分析方法的可靠性，增强了该现象的科学可信度。

根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of the possible Nova P60-M31-080723 in M31 The Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) and X-Ray Telescope (XRT) on board the Swift satellite observed M31 during a pre-planned observation on 2008-07-22 (PI Immler), at the same time of the discovery of a possible nova in M31 (Kasliwal et al., ATel #1627). No ultraviolet or X-ray source is detected at the position of the possible nova. The following 3-sigma upper limits to the UV magnitudes were measured: 
Filter-T_start------------T_end-------------Exp---Mag (3-sigma UL)   
uvw1 2008-07-22.127 2008-07-22.468 1447 s >20.3   
uvm2 2008-07-22.119 2008-07-22.462 1636 s >21.0   
uvw2 2008-07-22.110 2008-07-22.453 1636 s >20.5   

No X-ray source is detected at the position of the possible nova in the 4.8 ks Swift XRT observation obtained simultaneously with the UVOT observations. The 3-sigma upper limit to the XRT net count rate is 1.91E-03 cts/s, corresponding to an unabsorbed (0.2-10 keV band) X-ray flux of <1.1E-13 erg/cm/cm/s and a luminosity of <8.1E36 erg/s for an adopted power-law spectrum with index 1.6, a Galactic foreground column density of N_H = 6.7E+20 (Dickey & Lockman, 1990, ARAA, 28, 215) and a distance of 784 kpc (Stanek & Garnavich 1998, ApJ 503, L131). 2008-07-25 06:26:00
response: 该现象描述了Swift卫星在2008年7月22日对M31中候选新星P60-M31-080723进行的同步紫外（UVOT）与X射线（XRT）观测结果。首先，该候选体由光学巡天发现（ATel #1627），但Swift的UVOT未在对应位置探测到任何紫外辐射源，三个紫外滤光片（uvw1、uvm2、uvw2）均仅给出3σ上限亮度，分别为mag >20.3、>21.0、>20.5，表明其紫外辐射极弱或尚未进入紫外增亮阶段。其次，XRT在4.8 ks曝光下亦未探测到X射线源，3σ净计数率上限为1.91×10⁻³ cts/s；结合标准谱形假设（幂律指数Γ=1.6）、银河系前景消光柱密度（N_H=6.7×10²⁰ cm⁻²）及M31距离（784 kpc），换算得0.2–10 keV波段无吸收X射线流量上限为<1.1×10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应光度上限<8.1×10³⁶ erg s⁻¹。这一结果说明：该候选体在Swift观测时刻既无显著紫外辐射，也无可测X射线辐射，尚未进入典型经典新星的紫外/X射线耀发阶段，可能处于爆发早期（如光学主极大初期，紫外/X射线尚未升温穿出包层），或属于光学厚、低电离度的慢新星，抑或是非新星暂现源（如矮新星爆发、亮红新星或误证）。

根据现象进行分析： Search for the infrared counterpart to XTE J1701-407 We acquired J, H, and Ks band images of the field containing the neutron star X-ray transient XTE J1701-407 (ATEL #1569, #1572, #1616, #1618, #1621) on UT 2008 July 25 using the PANIC camera on the 6.5-m Magellan/Baade telescope at Las Campanas, Chile. Typical seeing during these observations was 0.6". Astrometric and photometric solutions were derived using 2MASS sources in the field. A Ks (2.1 micron) band finder image is linked below. 
The Ks band image contains four IR point sources (down to a limiting magnitude of 19) within the revised 1.7"-radius X-ray position error circle measured with Swift (Starling and Evans, ATEL #1621). The four sources have K-band magnitudes of 13.8(1), 14.2(1), 16.0(1), and 16.2(1). Further IR observations of this field may be able to identify the correct counterpart by detecting IR variability associated with the decay of the X-ray transient outburst. However, given the density of IR sources in this low-latitude field, there is a significant chance that none of these four candidates is the counterpart to XTE J1701-407. 
Infrared finder chart for XTE J1701-407 2008-07-25 09:23:00
response:
首先，观测目标是寻找中子星X射线暂现源XTE J1701–407的红外对应体。观测使用Magellan/Baade望远镜6.5米口径望远镜搭载PANIC相机，在J、H、Ks波段进行，时间是2008年7月25日UT，视宁度约0.6″，质量较高。

其次，天体测量和测光定标均基于2MASS星表源完成，保证了坐标精度和亮度标度的可靠性。关键约束条件是Swift卫星给出的X射线位置误差圆半径为1.7″，这是筛选候选体的空间基准。

第三，在该1.7″误差圆内共探测到4个Ks波段（2.1 μm）点源，极限星等为Ks ≈ 19，说明探测深度足够；四者的Ks星等分别为13.8、14.2、16.0、16.2，均显著亮于极限，信噪比高，属可靠探测。

第四，由于该天区位于银道面低纬度区域，恒星密度高，背景源污染严重，因此这4个源中任意一个真实对应XTE J1701–407的概率受限于源密度过高带来的混淆风险——即存在显著概率这四个源均为前景或背景场星，而非暂现源本身。

第五，当前无法唯一确认对应体，根本原因在于单次静态红外观测缺乏时域信息；而X射线暂现源在爆发衰减期通常伴随红外光变（如吸积盘热辐射或喷流同步辐射演化），因此后续多历元红外监测若能探测到其中某源存在与X射线光变趋势一致的红外变光，则可极大提升其作为真实对应体的可能性。

综上，现有数据提供了4个可信但非确定性的候选体，确认需依赖红外光变这一物理判据，而非仅靠位置重合与静态测光。

根据现象进行分析： The Orbital Period of the Classical Nova V458 Vul Classical nova V458 Vul (N Vul 2007 No.1) was detected as a supersoft X-ray source (SSS) by the Swift XRT several times in the time range between 2007 October 18 and 2008 June 18 (J. Drake et al., ATel #1246 and #1603). Our V photometry shows the plateau in the light curve continued since January till June 2008. This feature accompanies usually the SSS phases in some classical novae. The fragmentary monitoring during plateau shows night-to-night variability with the amplitudes between 1.2 and 0.4 mag and rapid variability by 0.1 mag in the time scale of an hour.   
We performed special CCD V monitoring of this nova in 12 nights between 2008 June 25 and July 6 UT using 38-cm telescope of the Crimean Astrophysical Observatory (Ukraine) to establish the cause of this variability. A total number of observations is 612. The duration of observing set used to be of about 6 hours each night. The light decay by 0.05 mag/day suggests that plateau has finished in the middle of June. Additionally, slow light variations in the scale of few hours superimposed. The total range of variations in this period was between 14.6 and 15.5 in V band.   
When the light-decay trend eliminated, Fourier analysis reveals pronounced periodicity with one of possible periods, 3.34, 1.42, 0.769 and 0.587 day, which are connected each other as 1 day aliases. The last period value is chosen as a preferential one because the intra-night trends do not contradict to the general trend of the mean phase light curve. The full amplitude of periodic variations is equal to 0.4 mag, and the light curve has a saw-tooth shape. Similar light curves were observed in other SSS novae, e.g. CI Aql or V723 Cas. The chosen period was corrected using previously observed local maxima. Its refined value is 0.58946(+/-0.00018) day, and Epoch Max = JDhel 2454461.479 (+/-0.030).   
We analysed spectra of V458 Vul taken with SAO RAS 1-m reflector on 2007 August 18.90 and October 18.68 UT (spectral range 3800-7530A, resolution 8A). The date of the last spectrum coincides with the date of the first X-ray detection by Swift. Our spectra confirm the description of spectral evolution by T.N.Tarasova (IBVS #5807): the features of FeII class nova were completely changed by ones of He/N nova in the SSS phase. No signs of high excitation Fe ion emission are seen in spectrum taken on October 18. HeII 4686A emission is blended with CIII/NIII and HeI lines, but its intensity is less than a half of Hbeta what gives the upper limit of the central source temperature of 190000K. [Fe X] 6374A emission is very faint, its detection is marginal. 
Light Curves and Spectra 2008-07-25 10:57:00
response:
该现象描述了经典新星V458 Vul在SSS（超软X射线源）阶段的光变与光谱演化特征，需从多角度进行物理机制分析：

首先，V458 Vul在2007年10月至2008年6月持续表现为SSS，且光学V波段光变呈现长达半年的平台期（plateau），这与典型SSS相位一致，表明此时白矮星表面氢壳层处于稳定稳态核燃烧状态，光度接近爱丁顿极限，温度约数十万开尔文，辐射主要集中在极紫外/软X射线波段，光学辐射则由再处理（如盘或包层吸收后热辐射）主导。

其次，平台期内存在两类时间尺度的光变：夜际变化（振幅0.4–1.2 mag）和小时级快速变化（0.1 mag），暗示存在非稳态过程叠加于稳态燃烧背景之上。后续高密度CCD监测（612次观测）排除了长期衰减趋势后，傅里叶分析揭示显著周期信号，经别名辨识与相位一致性检验，确定主导周期为0.58946±0.00018天（约14.15小时）。该周期远短于轨道周期典型值（多数CV系统为数小时至1天），但落在已知SSS新星（如CI Aql、V723 Cas）的轨道周期范围内；其锯齿状光变形态（全振幅0.4 mag）符合吸积盘亮斑、椭圆调制或热斑扫过视线方向等与轨道运动相关的几何效应，强烈支持该周期即为双星轨道周期。

第三，光谱演化提供关键约束：2007年8月尚属Fe II型新星（冷包层主导），至10月18日（首例Swift XRT探测日）已转变为He/N型，Fe II特征消失，高激发线（如[Fe X] 6374 Å）极弱，He II 4686 Å强度不足Hβ一半，据此估算中心源有效温度上限为190,000 K——此温度足以电离氦并维持SSS辐射，但尚不足以产生强[Fe X]，说明白矮星表面燃烧尚未达最高温阶段，与平台期对应；同时He/N光谱型反映喷出物中氢已大量耗尽，氦氮丰度升高，符合氢壳层燃烧后期产物上翻的预期。

综上，0.589天周期性光变源于双星轨道运动调制，SSS平台期对应白矮星表面稳态氢燃烧，光谱转型标志燃烧相位演进，而小时级快速变光可能由轨道尺度结构（如热斑、盘不稳定性）在视线方向投影变化引起。该周期为确定系统参数（如质量比、倾角）及建模SSS辐射机制提供了直接观测锚点。

根据现象进行分析： Photometric Periods for SMC Be/X-ray Pulsars SXP645 and SXP726 SXP645: Recently, Haberl et al. (arXiv:0806.4132v1) discovered X-ray pulsations with a period of 645 s in the transient source XMMU J005535.2-722906. They identified the optical counterpart in the MACHO and OGLE-II data sets with a V=14.6 star that brightened by ~0.85 mag near MJD 50100 and faded to its original brightness at MJD 51800 (see their Fig. 7). We have searched the early, low-state, MACHO R data and found a strong sinusoidal signal (with a normalized power of 52 in the periodogram) at P=0.41606 d. A weaker signal is also present (power 13) at P=1.03490 d (and its aliases near 27.5 and 0.96 d). These very short periods are probably due to non-radial pulsations of the Be star, as found in similar systems. However, analysis of OGLE I data taken when the source was bright does not show any significant periodocities. 
SXP726: RX J0105.9-7203 has been found by Eger & Haberl (A&A 485, 807, 2008) to show 726 s X-ray pulsations. The optical counterpart for this source had been identified with the emission line star [MA93]1557 by Sasaki et al. (A&A 403, 901, 2003). Using OGLE-II data Eger & Haberl found peaks in the periodogram at 2.35 and 3.2 days. We have reanalyzed the OGLE I data extending the analysis to higher frequencies. There is a very prominent signal (power 78) at P=0.30195 d and a second signal (power 51) at P=0.67271 d. Folded light curves for both periods are sinusoidal, also suggesting they are due to non-radial pulsations of the optical star. Peaks in the periodogram for these short periods are much more prominent than ones in the 2 to 4 day range, which are aliases of the short periods reported here. 2008-07-25 21:20:00
response:
首先，题目描述了两个SMC（小麦哲伦云）中的Be/X射线脉冲星SXP645和SXP726的光度周期分析结果，核心目标是识别光学对应体的周期性光变，并判断其物理起源。

对于SXP645：  
- X射线脉冲周期为645秒，属中子星自转周期，与光学周期无关；  
- 光学对应体是一颗V=14.6的Be星，在MJD 50100附近发生~0.85 mag的暂现增亮（可能是盘形成事件），持续至MJD 51800；  
- 在低态（即未增亮、盘较弱或缺失）的MACHO R波段数据中，检测到显著正弦信号，主周期P=0.41606 d（约10.0小时），归一化功率52；次周期P=1.03490 d（功率13），及其别名（如27.5 d、0.96 d）；  
- 这些亚日周期远短于典型Be星轨道周期（通常数日至数百日），且在高态（OGLE I亮相数据）中未检测到显著周期信号；  
- 因此，这些短周期不能归因于轨道调制或椭球效应，而更可能源于Be星自身的非径向脉动——这与已知Be星普遍具有g模或p模脉动的观测事实一致，且脉动振幅常受星周盘状态调制（低态时盘弱，脉动信号更清晰；高态时盘发射主导，掩盖脉动）。

对于SXP726：  
- X射线脉冲周期726 s，同样为中子星自转周期；  
- 光学对应体为发射线星[MA93]1557（典型Be星）；  
- 前人（Eger & Haberl）在OGLE-II数据中报告2.35 d与3.2 d周期，但本工作通过扩展OGLE-I高频分析，发现更强信号：主周期P=0.30195 d（约7.25小时，功率78），次周期P=0.67271 d（功率51）；  
- 折叠光变曲线呈正弦形，支持其为恒星本征振荡而非掩食或轨道效应；  
- 原先报道的2–4 d周期被证实为其别名（如0.30195 d的1/3谐波别名约为3.31 d，接近2.35 d与3.2 d），说明先前分析因频率采样不足或低频偏重而误判主周期；  
- 同样，这些亚日周期与Be星非径向脉动特征吻合，且功率远高于别名峰，表明其物理真实性高。

综上，两源光学短周期均源自Be星自身非径向脉动，而非双星轨道运动；其在低态更显著、高态消失或减弱，反映脉动信号易被星周盘连续谱稀释；X射线脉冲周期（秒级）与光学周期（小时级）量级差异悬殊，二者无直接动力学耦合，仅通过Be星提供吸积物质这一间接机制关联。

根据现象进行分析： Confirmation of the NIR counterparts to SLX 1746-331 and XTE J1810-189  We present infrared observations of the counterparts to the X-ray transients SLX 1746-331 and XTE J1810-189 obtained with the 6.5m Magellan Baade telescope at Las Campanas Observatory. Both sources were re-observed with the PANIC camera in order to confirm the candidate counterparts proposed in ATels #1252 and #1508. 
SLX 1746-331.- The black hole X-ray transient SLX 1746-331 (ATels #143, #1235, ##1237) was observed on 2008 Jun 21 07:26 - 07:45 UT. A series of 15s Ks-band images totaling 675s on source were acquired under good sky conditions with a mean seeing of 0.6 arcsec. PSF-fitting photometry shows that the counterpart candidate has further faded from Ks=17.29 +/- 0.08 (ATel #1252) to Ks = 18.3 +/- 0.2. 
XTE J1810-189.- The neutron star X-ray transient XTE J1810-189 (ATel #1424, #1443, #1490) was observed on 2008 Jun 23 05:38 - 06:05 UT. Series of 15s Ks-band images totaling 900s on source were obtained under a seeing of 0.5 arcsec. PSF-fitting photometry reveals that the brightest object within the Chandra error circle has declined from Ks=17.3 +/- 0.2 (ATel #1508) to Ks = 18.0 +/- 0.1. 
The additional fading of these infrared sources firmly establish them as counterparts to SLX 1746-331 and XTEJ1810-189. 2008-07-26 06:01:00
response:
首先，该文本描述了对两个X射线暂现源SLX 1746-331和XTE J1810-189的近红外（NIR）对应体进行证认的观测工作。核心依据是两次独立的Ks波段红外观测，分别使用6.5米Magellan Baade望远镜与PANIC相机完成，时间间隔短（仅相隔约2天），且均在良好视宁度下进行（seeing分别为0.6″和0.5″），保证了位置测量和测光的可靠性。

其次，针对SLX 1746-331，先前ATel #1252已提出一个Ks=17.29±0.08的候选体；本次观测测得其Ks=18.3±0.2，显著变暗约1.0 mag，衰减幅度远超测光误差（>5σ），表明该源具有时变性，且变化趋势与X射线暂现源的衰减行为一致。

再次，针对XTE J1810-189，先前ATel #1508给出候选体Ks=17.3±0.2；本次测得Ks=18.0±0.1，同样明显变暗约0.7 mag，衰减显著（>3σ），且该源位于Chandra X射线定位误差圆内最亮的红外源，空间位置匹配度高。

最后，两个源均表现出与各自X射线暂现事件同步的、显著且一致的红外光度衰减，排除了背景恒星或无关星系的可能性；这种时域行为的一致性，结合精确的位置重合，构成了确认其为真实物理对应体的关键证据。因此，红外源的额外衰减为其作为X射线暂现源光学/NIR对应体提供了坚实支持。

根据现象进行分析： AGILE detection of continued gamma-ray activity of the blazar 3C 454.3 AGILE detection of continued gamma-ray activity of the blazar 3C 454.3 During a dedicated Target of Opportunity repointing, triggered by the GLAST-LAT detection of 3C 454.3 above 100 MeV (ATEL #1628), the AGILE Gamma Ray Imaging Detector (GRID) detected 3C 454.3 in high state in the period between 2008-07-25 18:00 UT and 2008-07-28 03:00 UT. 
A preliminary maximum likelihood analysis shows a detection at a significance level above 5 sigma, with a source flux in excess of about 200e-8 ph/cm2/s for E>100 MeV. 
The AGILE monitoring of the source will continue till 2008-07-31 12:00 UT. We strongly encourage multi-frequency observations of 3C 454.3 during this gamma-ray high-state monitored by AGILE and GLAST. 2008-07-28 14:27:00
response: 该现象描述了活动星系核（AGN）中一类特殊天体——耀变体（blazar）3C 454.3 在伽马射线波段的持续高流量活动。首先，GLAST-LAT（即费米卫星的大型面积望远镜）在高于100 MeV能量段探测到该源显著增强，触发了AGILE卫星的机遇观测（Target of Opportunity）。AGILE的GRID载荷随后在2008年7月25日18:00 UT至7月28日03:00 UT期间确认该源处于伽马射线高态。统计分析显示其探测显著性超过5σ，表明该信号极不可能由背景涨落引起，具有高度可靠性；测得光子流量大于2×10⁻⁷ ph/cm²/s（即200×10⁻⁸ ph/cm²/s），对应E > 100 MeV能段，说明辐射功率强、粒子加速效率高。AGILE后续持续监测至7月31日12:00 UT，表明该高态具有一定持续性（约6天），并非瞬时爆发。文中呼吁开展多波段协同观测，是因为耀变体的伽马射线辐射通常与喷流中相对论性电子的同步自康普顿（SSC）或外部康普顿（EC）过程相关，其光变行为在射电、光学、X射线等波段常存在时间关联或延迟，联合分析有助于约束喷流物理参数（如磁场强度、电子能谱、辐射区位置与尺度等）。因此，该事件属于典型的耀变体多波段耀发事例，为研究相对论喷流中的粒子加速与辐射机制提供了关键观测窗口。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of kilohertz QPOs in XTE J1701-407  We report the discovery with the RXTE PCA of kilohertz quasiperiodic oscillations (kHz QPOs) in the X-ray flux from the recently discovered neutron star transient XTE J1701-407 (Atel 1569, 1616, 1618, 1621,1630). Power spectral analysis of RXTE PCA Observations obtained on 2008-06-16 at 05:53 UTC, show a strong 30 Hz QPO as well as a high frequency kHz QPO centered at 1150 +- 7 Hz. These QPO frequencies are characteristic of the "atoll" class of accreting neutron stars. The 1150 Hz QPO has a coherence of about 30 (centroid / FWHM), and is very strong, with an average fractional r.m.s. amplitude of 25 +- 4 % (3-30 keV). The source flux during this pointing was approximately 15 mCrab. This makes XTE J1701-407 one of only two sources with such high amplitude kHz QPOs, the other being 1A 1246-588 (Jonker et al. MNRAS, 2007, 378, 1187). 
In an observation on 2008-07-18 at 02:30 UTC, when the source was brighter (near 25 mCrab) we find evidence for a simultaneous pair of kHz QPO. The lower kHz feature is centered near 745 +- 9 Hz, with a coherence of about 40 and a fractional r.m.s. amplitude of approximately 9%. The upper QPO remains near 1150 Hz, but it is weaker than in the other observation. Using the upper frequency measurement from the 2008-06-16 observation and the lower frequency from the 2008-07-18 data we would infer a separation of 405 +- 11 Hz, which would suggest a frequency difference for the pair near the upper end of the distribution of observed frequency separations. We caution, however, that the simultaneous detection of kHz QPO pairs should be confirmed with additional data. The large r.m.s amplitude of the upper QPO and the apparently large frequency separation for the kHz QPO pair suggests that XTE J1701-407 has an interesting kHz QPO phenomenology. We urge further X-ray as well as multi-wavelength observations to further investigate this source. 2008-07-29 17:06:00
response:
首先，观测到XTE J1701-407中存在千赫兹准周期振荡（kHz QPOs），这是通过RXTE PCA数据在2008年6月16日的观测中发现的。功率谱分析显示一个强30 Hz低频QPO和一个中心频率为1150 ± 7 Hz的高频kHz QPO。该kHz QPO具有高相干性（约30）和高分数r.m.s.振幅（25 ± 4%，3–30 keV），表明其信号显著且稳定，符合“atoll”型吸积中子星的典型特征。

其次，在2008年7月18日更高光度（~25 mCrab）的观测中，探测到可能同时存在的kHz QPO双峰结构：下支位于745 ± 9 Hz（相干性~40，r.m.s. ~9%），上支仍接近1150 Hz但强度减弱。若将两次观测中的上、下支频率组合，得到频率间隔为405 ± 11 Hz，处于已知kHz QPO对频率差分布的高端，暗示该源可能存在异常大的频率分离。

第三，尽管该频率间隔具有物理意义（可能与中子星自转、内吸积盘边界或共振机制相关），但由于上下支并非严格同时观测到，不能确证其为真实的同时双峰；需更多高质量数据验证其共时性。

第四，该源的kHz QPO表现出两个突出特征：一是上支QPO具有目前已知极高的r.m.s.振幅（仅略低于1A 1246-588），二是潜在的大频率间隔，二者共同表明XTE J1701-407在kHz QPO现象学中具有特殊地位，可能反映其独特的中子星质量、半径、自转或吸积流几何结构。

第五，因此，该现象不仅确认了XTE J1701-407属于atoll源，还提示其为研究kHz QPO物理起源（如磁层-盘相互作用、相对论性轨道频率、参量共振模型等）的重要候选体，亟需后续X射线时变观测及多波段协同研究以约束吸积参数与致密星性质。

根据现象进行分析： The CSS transient CSS080623:142206+334546 is a Galactic Star We report on further observations of the CSS transient CSS080623:142206+334546 first announced by Mahabal et al. (ATEL #1604). Photometry obtained at the Lick Observatory 40-inch telescope on 2008 July 25 UT reveals that the object is still present at an approximate R magnitude of 18.2. 
We obtained an optical spectrum (range 3300 - 10500 Angstroms) on July 26.29 UT using the Kast spectrograph on the Lick 3-m telescope. Our previous observations (Ganeshalingam et al., ATEL #1606) showed a blue, featureless continuum. The new spectrum is significantly redder, with the flux peaking near 6000 Angstroms. In addition, the object has developed narrow absorption lines characteristic of stellar photospheres (H-alpha, Na I D, Mg I b, etc.) near their rest wavelengths. We conclude that the source is a variable star in our Galaxy, although the exact nature of the variable is uncertain. 2008-07-29 20:52:00
response: 该暂现源CSS080623:142206+334546最初被报告为可能的暂现天体，但后续观测提供了关键证据支持其银河系恒星本质。首先，Lick天文台40英寸望远镜于2008年7月25日测得其R波段星等约18.2，表明该源仍持续存在，并非典型短时标暂现事件（如超新星爆发后快速衰减）。其次，7月26.29日获取的光学光谱（3300–10500 Å）与之前观测（ATEL #1606）中呈现的蓝而无特征的连续谱显著不同：新光谱整体变红，能量峰值移至约6000 Å，符合晚型恒星的黑体辐射特征；更重要的是，光谱中清晰出现H-alpha、Na I D、Mg I b等窄吸收线，且均位于静止波长位置，排除了高红移或高速外流的可能性，明确指示其具有冷恒星大气（即光球层）结构。综合光度稳定性、光谱型演化及吸收线特征，可判定该源为一颗银河系内变星，其光谱型随时间演化（由蓝变红），暗示可能是处于某种脉动或爆发相位的晚型变星（如米拉变星、半规则变星或耀星活动期），但具体子类需更多时序光谱和测光数据确认。

根据现象进行分析： KAIT Discovery of a Probable Cataclysmic Variable in the Field of UGC 11289 We report on the discovery of a probable cataclysmic variable (CV) during the course of the Lick Observatory Supernova Search with the 0.8-m Katzman Automatic Imaging Telescope (KAIT). The CV is in the field of UGC 11289, and is located at R.A. = 18h35m56s.29, Decl. = +22d26'39".7 (J2000). 
Available KAIT photometry (all unfiltered, all dates are UT): Jul 17.35, >18.8; Jul 21.33, 16.6; Jul 22.32, 16.5; Jul 24.31, 16.8; Jul 25.32, 16.9. 
A finder chart is available at http://astro.berkeley.edu/~bait/2008/vs-u11289.gif 
We obtained a spectrum of this source (range 3300 - 10500 Angstroms) using the Kast spectrograph on the Lick 3-m telescope on July 26.35 UT. The continuum of the source is blue and mostly featureless except for a weak H-alpha emission feature centered at a radial velocity of about 200 km/s. The H-alpha line has an equivalent width of 6 Angstroms and a FWHM of 1400 km/s. We conclude that the variable star is likely to be a CV in our Galaxy. 2008-07-29 20:55:00
response:
该天体在UG C 11289视场内被发现，位置精确（J2000历元），具备典型激变变星（CV）的多波段观测特征：  
首先，光变行为显著——7月17.35日亮度低于18.8等，随后四日内迅速增亮至约16.5–16.9等，光变幅度达至少2.3等，且变化速率较快，符合CV矮新星或爆发型系统的光变时标；  
其次，光谱呈现蓝连续谱，表明高温致密源（白矮星吸积盘主导），无明显吸收线，支持热辐射主导模型；  
关键诊断特征是Hα发射线：等效宽度6 Å属中等强度，FWHM达1400 km/s，对应宽发射线轮廓，反映高速吸积流或盘风，是CV中常见特征；其红移速度约200 km/s，与银河系本地静止标准（LSR）相近，排除遥远星系活动星系核（AGN）或高红移类星体；  
未见He II、C III/N III等强发射线，亦无[O III]等禁线，不支持行星状星云或电离气体云；  
无滤光片测光数据虽缺乏颜色信息，但结合蓝连续谱与Hα宽发射，可排除普通脉动变星（如造父、天琴RR型）及食双星（后者通常呈规则周期性掩食，而本例为单次快速增亮）；  
综上，光变幅度、时标、蓝连续谱、宽Hα发射及其低径向速度共同指向一颗银河系内激变变星，极可能为矮新星或类新星系统。

该报告描述了在星系NGC 2403中发现两个可能新星（novae）的观测事实，需从天体物理角度进行系统性分析：

首先，两个候选体均通过 archival narrowband [H_alpha] 图像发现，说明其显著发射线特征——新星爆发期间抛射物电离氢产生强Hα辐射，是识别光学新星的关键判据之一。图像来自INT望远镜，具备足够分辨率与深度，支持对河外新星的探测。

其次，位置信息表明二者均位于NGC 2403盘面内：第一颗距星系中心东295".8、北20".2，第二颗仅东20".9、南74".9，均处于恒星密集区域，符合新星多发于星系旋臂或恒星形成区的统计规律；且排除了背景类星体或前景银河系恒星的高概率——因两者均未在早期图像（如2001年2月）中出现，而在后续图像中突然增亮，呈现典型新星光变特性。

第三，光变数据提供关键诊断依据：第一颗在2002年12月30日Hα波段达18.28等，显著亮于此前R波段24.7等（2002年11月6日）及V波段23.0等（2002年9月16日），亮度跃升逾6等，符合新星爆发光度剧增特征；其后数月内缓慢衰减至~22等量级，与经典新星光变时标（数周至数月衰减2–3等）一致。第二颗在2005年1月14日Hα达19.3等，亦比前期观测亮约3–5等，且在同日B波段为22.5等，显示蓝光偏弱而Hα强，暗示存在厚发射线包层，符合新星激波加热与辐射转移模型。

第四，多波段数据揭示谱能量分布演化：例如第一颗在2002年12月30日Hα=18.28、r'=20.86，色指数r'−Hα≈2.6，远红于正常恒星，反映强发射线主导；而2005年1月V=24.6、I=24.1，色指数V−I≈0.5，趋于正常晚型星，表明爆发后期连续谱恢复、发射线减弱，符合新星从极早期（发射线主导）向晚期（连续谱主导）演化的预期。

第五，观测平台多样性增强可靠性：数据涵盖INT、WHT、Subaru、HST-ACS及小望远镜，不同仪器、滤光片与测光系统（AB、STMAG、Vega）下一致性检测到光变，排除仪器伪迹或单次观测误差；尤其HST-ACS F658N（窄带Hα）图像给出[23.3等]极限，而目标在该滤光片下可测，证实其确为真实Hα发射源。

综上，两个候选体满足河外新星的核心观测标准：位于宿主星系内、无历史对应体、突发性增亮、Hα强发射、多历元光变符合新星衰减规律、多波段颜色演化符合爆发物理模型。因此可判定为“probable novae”，需后续光谱观测确认其发射线宽度（典型新星宽Hα线宽>1000 km/s）及元素丰度特征（如Fe II型或He/N型分类）。

该现象描述了一次在匿名星系中发现的可能超新星事件。首先，该暂现源被识别于拉帕尔马岛2.54米INT望远镜的历史存档图像中，位置与宿主星系中心偏移极小（西向0.5角秒、北向0.1角秒），表明其位于星系内，符合核心坍缩型或Ia型超新星的典型空间分布特征。宿主星系V=20.8、R=20.1，属较暗星系，对应较远距离或较低光度，需结合红移信息进一步判断，但文中未提供。

光变曲线显示：r'波段观测从2002年12月起持续至2003年6月，亮度由约22.7等逐渐增亮至20.4等，之后缓慢变暗；Hα窄带数据趋势一致，且信噪比支持真实光变而非噪声起伏；V波段 Subaru 数据（2004–2005年）显示亮度进一步衰减至24.0等，表明已进入晚期余辉阶段。整体光变时标跨越约1.5年，峰值出现在2003年6月初（r'≈20.4），下降速率为约0.15 mag/月（峰后前两个月），符合Ia型超新星的典型衰减速率（Δm₁₅≈1.1–1.3），亦不完全排除II-P型（平台期约100天）的可能性，但缺乏早期光谱确认。

暂现源在多夜叠加图像及单帧图像中均清晰可辨，排除宇宙线、缺陷像素或移动天体干扰；坐标精度达0.01角秒量级，与宿主星系中心严格关联，支持其为真实致密爆发事件；Hα波段持续探测说明存在显著激波与周围介质相互作用，暗示可能具有富氢包层（如II型），但Ia型在晚期亦可观测到Hα发射（来自抛射物与星周物质碰撞）。综上，该目标为一颗位于遥远矮星系或低表面亮度星系中的真实超新星，最可能为Ia型，次可能为II-P或IIn型，需光谱证认以最终分类。

根据现象进行分析： New cataclysmic variable 1RXS J180834.7+101041 During the systematic search for optical identifications of the poorly studied ROSAT sources a variable object was found within 20" from 1RXS J180834.7+101041. The star USNO-B1 1001-0317189 at the following coordinates: R.A.=18h08m35.80s, Dec.=+10o10'30.2" (J2000.0) has varied by about 0.8m between two Red Palomar plates. Photometric follow-up with the 0.30-m Astrotel-Caucasus robotic telescope (Kazan State University Mountain Station, Karachay-Cherkessia, Russia) has confirmed the star to be a cataclysmic variable with a period of 0.070037(1)d. More than 220 unfiltered exposures, each 300 sec long, were obtained between JD 2454608 and 2454648. USNO-A2.0 0975-10560020 (R=15.8) was used as a comparison star and USNO-A2.0 0975-10561808 as a check star. During four observing nights between 2008 May 21 and 31 the object was showing very prominent short eclipses from 17.1m to 18.4m. Light curve of J1808+1010 obtained on May 22 with four eclipses is presented at http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/~denis/J1808+1010-LC-May22.gif  . Between June 13 and 30, however, the variable appeared in a higher state with eclipses from 16.1m to 17.0m. Judging from the orbital period and variations of the light curve we suppose the object to be a cataclysmic variable of AM Her type - that is, a polar variable.
Color-combined (BRIR) 10'x9' DSS finder chart is available at http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/~denis/J1808+1010-comps.gif  (position of CV is marked with dashes). The folded light curves (separately for May and June) are shown at http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/~denis/J1808+1010-LC2008.gif  .
During single night observation on July 26.95 UT the object was measured at unfiltered CR=15.7 magnitude. The variable still appears to be in the active state. Spectroscopic and photometric follow-up is encouraged. 2008-07-31 17:08:00
response:
该天体1RXS J180834.7+101041被证认为一颗新发现的激变变星（cataclysmic variable, CV），依据如下：  
首先，其光学对应体USNO-B1 1001-0317189在红区帕洛玛巡天底片上表现出约0.8星等的光变，提示存在显著的亮度变化；  
其次，Astrotel-Caucasus望远镜的系统测光观测确认其具有精确测定的轨道周期0.070037(1) d（约1.681小时），符合激变变星典型短周期特征；  
第三，光变曲线呈现规则、深度达~1.3星等的短时掩食（如5月21–31日：17.1–18.4 mag；6月13–30日：16.1–17.0 mag），且掩食形态稳定、周期性严格，表明存在致密双星系统的几何掩食结构；  
第四，掩食深度与亮度状态变化同步：高态时平均亮度上升约1.0 mag，掩食底部亦整体变亮，符合吸积率增强导致盘/吸积柱增亮的物理图像；  
第五，轨道周期处于AM Her型（即武仙座AM型）极化子典型范围（通常<2小时），且未见明显椭圆调制或矮新星爆发特征，结合强而规则的掩食及持续活跃状态，支持其为具有强磁场（>10 MG）、同步自转的白矮星主导吸积、无吸积盘的极化子；  
第六，7月26日单次观测仍测得CR≈15.7，证实其维持在高吸积态，未转入宁静期；  
综上，该源满足AM Her型激变变星的核心判据：短轨道周期、规则深掩食、无盘吸积特征、持续高态活动，故判定为一颗新发现的极化子。

根据现象进行分析： AGILE detection of the high Galactic latitude transient gamma-ray source AGL J0229+2054 During the current AGILE pointing centered at Galactic coordinates l = 134.7, b = -23.1, the Gamma-Ray Imaging Detector (GRID) discovered a fast variable gamma-ray source at high Galactic latitude. 
Integrating from 2008-07-30 15:34 UT to 2008-07-31 15:23, a maximum likelihood analysis shows a detection at a significance level above 5 sigma, with a source flux in excess of about 100e-8 ph/cm2/s for photon energies larger than 100 MeV. 
The source positional error box is centered at Galactic coordinates l = 151.7 deg, b = -36.4 deg (R.A. = 02h 29m 33s, DEC = +20d 54m 47s) and has a preliminary 95% confidence radius of about 1 degree. We name this source AGL J0229+2054. A preliminary analysis of the Super-AGILE data during the same time period and in the same sky region does not show any hard X-ray counterpart in the 20-60 keV energy range, with a 3-sigma upper limit of 30 mCrab on the average flux. 
We note that the source is now under the AGILE-GRID detection threshold, implying a strong variability above 100 MeV on short time-scales. 
We notice the presence at approximately 22' from the GRID error box centroid of a 100 mJy radio source at 5 GHz (CRATES J023030+211241). In addition, we notice the presence near the AGILE-GRID error box of the prominent blazar 1ES 0229+200, at a position approximately 61.3' from the GRID error box centroid. 
The AGILE monitoring of the field including this source will continue until 2008-08-15 12:00 UT. We strongly encourage multi-frequency observations of the AGL J0229+2054 field, and in particular of the blazar 1ES 0229+200 and of the source CRATES J023030+211241. 2008-08-01 15:24:00
response: 该现象描述了一次AGILE卫星在高银纬区域发现的暂现伽马射线源AGL J0229+2054。首先，该源是在一次以银经l=134.7°、银纬b=−23.1°为中心的定点观测中，由GRID探测器偶然发现的，说明其位置偏离观测指向中心，属于巡天式发现。其次，其统计显著性超过5σ，积分时间段为2008-07-30 15:34 UT至2008-07-31 15:23 UT，表明该信号在约24小时内具有明确可测的伽马射线辐射；通量大于100×10⁻⁸ ph/cm²/s（E > 100 MeV），属较强暂现源。第三，定位误差圆对应95%置信度半径约1°，中心位于l=151.7°, b=−36.4°（即赤经02h29m33s，赤纬+20°54′47″），命名依据标准暂现源命名规则（J+赤经赤纬）。第四，Super-AGILE在同期20–60 keV波段未探测到对应硬X射线辐射，仅给出3σ上限30 mCrab，暗示该源在硬X射线波段无显著辐射或存在能谱截断/陡降。第五，源已回落至GRID探测阈值以下，说明其在>100 MeV能段存在短时标（≤24小时）强光变，符合典型耀发类暂现源（如耀变体喷流活动）特征。第六，误差盒内无已知明亮致密射电源，但在22角分处存在5 GHz流量密度100 mJy的射电源CRATES J023030+211241，61.3角分外存在著名BL Lac型耀变体1ES 0229+200，二者均处于可能的物理关联距离内（尤其考虑伽马射线束定向性及定位误差），因此被列为优先证认目标。第七，AGILE将持续监测至2008-08-15，为后续多波段协同观测提供时间窗口；呼吁开展包括射电、光学、X射线和更高能伽马射线在内的多频段观测，以判断其是否为已知源的剧烈耀发，或代表新型暂现现象。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of CV candidate ROTSE3 J203225+602837 We report the discovery of CV candidate ROTSE3 J203225+602837 in unfiltered CCD images taken by the 0.45m ROTSE-IIIb telescope at McDonald Observatory, Texas. The object is located at RA: 20:32:24.70 Dec: +60:28:37.2 (J2000) and was observed at ~16.4 mag on 2008 Jul 19.2 UT and at ~16.7 mag on 2008 Jul 24.3 UT. It was not detected to a limiting magnitude of ~17.7 on 2008 Jul 15.2 UT. There may be increased uncertainty in the photometry and astrometry due to likely contamination from a ~17 mag star about 10 arcsec away. 
The object appears about 4 arcsec from the X-ray source 2E 2031.3+6018 in the SIMBAD astronomical database. This transient has an R~19.7 counterpart in the USNO-B2.0 catalog. According to the photometry of the USNO-B catalog, it is bluer than nearby field stars, and thus tentatively categorized as a galactic CV. A ROTSE3 finding chart can be found at http://rotse.net/rsvp/cv2032+6028.jpg 2008-08-02 14:08:00
response:
该天体被发现于ROTSE-IIIb望远镜的无滤光CCD图像中，位置坐标明确（J2000历元），且在不同日期表现出明显亮度变化：7月19.2日约16.4等，7月24.3日变暗至约16.7等，而更早的7月15.2日未被探测到（极限星等约17.7等），说明其存在显著光变行为，符合激变变星（CV）典型的爆发或亮度起伏特征。  
该源与X射线源2E 2031.3+6018相距仅约4角秒，空间关联性较强，而X射线辐射是CV（尤其是矮新星、类新星等）的重要高能标识之一。  
USNO-B2.0星表中存在R~19.7的对应光学源，且其测光颜色比邻近场星更蓝，表明其能量分布偏蓝，符合CV中白矮星吸积盘高温辐射导致的蓝化特征，区别于多数红化的晚型主序星或红巨星。  
尽管存在约10角秒外一颗~17等伴星可能带来的测光与定位污染，影响精度，但综合位置一致性、光变性、蓝颜色、X射线关联性四项独立证据，可合理推断该候选体为银河系内激变变星。

根据现象进行分析： AX J1754.2-2754: back in outburst We report on a Chandra DDT and multi-epoch (9) Swift observations of the faint, bursting neutron star transient AX J1754.2-2754. We obtained a 29 ks-long Chandra ACIS-S observation on July 15, 2008 to determine the luminosity of the source in quiescence after a 2 ks Chandra ACIS-I observation did not detect the source down to a 0.5-10 keV luminosity of 3.0-5.8E32 erg/s (Bassa et al. 2008, Atel #1575). 
To our surprise a bright point source was detected at the position of AX J1754.2-2754. With a 0.3-10 keV count rate of 0.155 the source spectrum is probably suffering from 10-20% pile-up. We modelled the spectrum with XSPEC12 taking into account the pile-up. The source spectrum could be described well by a simple absorbed power law with an N_H of (2.3+-0.2)E22 cm-2 and a power-law index of 2.9+-0.4. The best-fit source 0.5-10 keV absorbed flux was ~2.4E-12 erg cm-2 s-1, whereas the unabsorbed 0.5-10 keV flux was 1.2E-11 erg cm-2 s-1. These values are similar to those observed before the source went to quiescence. For a distance of 9.2 kpc the 0.5-10 keV luminosity of the source is 1.2E35 erg/s. 
To monitor the evolution of the source Swift has observed the source for 9 times. Using the XRT data we determine that the source spectrum and flux are consistent with those derived from the 29 ks Chandra observation. We conclude that the source has started another outburst after a brief transition to quiescence. The non-detection during the 2 ks Chandra ACIS-I observation is unlikely to be due to an X-ray eclipse since that would imply an orbital period of several hours, in contradiction with the report of Bassa et al. (2008, Atel #1575) that the source probably harbors an ultra-compact X-ray binary. We have plotted the long-duration light curve in the attached figure (http://www.sron.nl/~peterj/images/axj1754-longterm-lc.pdf). The ASCA data is from Sakano et al. (1999), the INTEGRAL data is from Krivonos et al. (2007), the first Swift observation is reported in Del Santo et al. (2007; Atel #1143) and the 1st and 2nd Chandra data point in Bassa et al. (2008; Atel #1575). The arrow indicates the time of the detection of a type I X-ray burst by Chelovekov & Grebenev (2007; Atel #1094). 
We would like to thank the Swift and Chandra team for making the Swift and Chandra DDT observations, respectively. 2008-08-03 10:05:00
response: 该现象描述了中子星暂现源AX J1754.2-2754重新进入爆发态的过程。首先，此前的2 ks Chandra ACIS-I观测未探测到源，给出0.5–10 keV光度上限为3.0–5.8×10³² erg/s，被解释为源处于宁静态；但随后29 ks Chandra ACIS-S观测在相同位置探测到明亮点源，其0.3–10 keV计数率为0.155 cts/s，存在10–20%堆积效应，经XSPEC12校正堆积后，能谱可由吸收幂律模型良好拟合，吸收柱密度N_H = (2.3±0.2)×10²² cm⁻²，光子指数Γ = 2.9±0.4，0.5–10 keV吸收通量约2.4×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，未吸收通量为1.2×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应距离9.2 kpc下的光度为1.2×10³⁵ erg/s，与先前爆发期观测值相当。进一步，Swift在9个历元的XRT观测显示通量与能谱参数与Chandra结果一致，证实源并非短暂闪烁而是稳定重返爆发态。此前非探测不能归因于X射线食变，因食变所需轨道周期达数小时，与该源被认定为超紧凑X射线双星（UCXB）的性质矛盾——UCXB典型轨道周期通常短于1小时。长期光变曲线整合ASCA、INTEGRAL、Swift及Chandra历史数据，并标出Chelovekov & Grebenev（2007）探测到I型X射线暴的时间，佐证其作为热核暴发中子星源的身份及周期性爆发行为。

根据现象进行分析： The Mysterious Transient ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 is an Extremely Luminous Type II SN at z = 0.21 We report on further spectroscopic observations of the transient ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726 discovered by Yuan et al. (ATEL #1515) and followed up by several groups (ATEL #1524, ATEL #1576, ATEL #1578, and ATEL #1593). We observed the object for 840 s using the Low-Resolution Imaging Spectrometer (LRIS; Oke et al. 1995) on the Keck I 10-m telescope on 2008 Aug 3.25 UT. Our initial observations of this object (ATEL #1576) showed a blue and largely featureless spectrum, but at later epochs several unidentified weak spectral features appeared (ATEL #1576 and ATEL #1593). The object now has developed a prominent broad (FWHM ≅ 10,000 km/s) emission feature centered near 7900 Ã , which we identify as Hα near redshift 0.2. The spectrum shows several other P-Cygni absorption features consistent with higher-order Balmer lines and Fe II at a similar redshift, leading us to conclude that the object is a type-II supernova. We applied the "SuperNova IDentification" code (SNID; Blondin and Tonry 2007, ApJ, 666, 1024) to this spectrum. SNID confirms the identification as a SN II and gives a best-fit redshift of z = 0.206 Â± 0.005. 
At this redshift, the peak apparent optical magnitude of ≤ 17.8 (ATEL #1515) corresponds to an absolute brightness of MV ≤ -22.2 mag, making this object one of the most luminous supernovae ever observed, comparable to, if not brighter than, the extreme SN 2006gy (Smith et al. 2007, ApJ, 666, 1116; Ofek et al. 2007, ApJL, 659, 13).
We thank M. Malkan (UCLA) for the exchange of observing time. 2008-08-03 12:55:00
response: 该天体ROTSE3 J115649.1+542726最初被观测为蓝而无明显谱线的暂现源，表明其处于早期爆发阶段；随后光谱中逐渐出现若干弱而未知的谱线，说明激波正向外传播并电离包层物质；至2008年8月3日的Keck/LRIS光谱中，出现一个中心位于7900 Å、展宽达FWHM ≈ 10,000 km/s的强发射特征，结合红移换算可知该位置对应静止系Hα（6563 Å）在z ≈ 0.2处的红移，从而确认红移存在；同时观测到多个具有P-Cygni轮廓的吸收特征，其速度结构与Hα一致，且波长位置匹配高阶巴耳末线（如Hβ、Hγ）及Fe II的激发态跃迁，符合II型超新星典型的富氢外层、激波加热与辐射驱动风的物理图像；SNID谱识别程序独立给出z = 0.206 ± 0.005的拟合结果，进一步支持红移测定可靠性；由z = 0.21推算得峰值绝对星等MV ≤ −22.2 mag，显著超出普通II型超新星（典型MV ≈ −17 至 −18），接近或超过已知最亮超新星SN 2006gy，因此可判定其为一颗极高光度的II型超新星。

In an 800 second exposure, no source was detected by the PCA instrument, with a 95% flux upper limit of of 0.5 mCrab (2-10 keV). The lack of a PCA detection appears consistent with the transient behavior reported by the Agile team. 2008-08-03 16:14:00
response: 首先，RXTE在2008年8月2日18:29 UT对AGL J0229+2054的位置进行了观测，该源此前由AGILE卫星发现并报告为暂现源。观测持续800秒，使用PCA仪器进行探测。在2–10 keV能段内未探测到任何显著X射线源，给出95%置信度的流量上限为0.5 mCrab。该非探测结果与AGILE团队所报告的暂现行为一致——即该源在AGILE观测时处于活动状态（被探测到），而在RXTE观测时已衰减至不可探测水平。随后在2008年8月3日16:14 UT的另一时间点可能有后续观测安排，但当前文本未提供该时刻的观测结果，因此无法判断其探测状态；仅能确认前次RXTE观测的非探测与其暂现性质相符。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopic Classification of Nova P60-M31-080723 We report that a spectrum of P60-M31-080723 (ATEL#1627) was obtained with the Double Beam Spectrograph on the Palomar Hale Telescope on Aug 1 UT. Bright Balmer emission lines, H-alpha, H-beta and H-gamma were observed with gaussian FWHM velocities of 2200 km/s, 1850 km/s and 2600 km/s respectively. In addition, OI (7773 Ang, 8446 Ang), Mg II (8232 Ang, 9226 Ang), NI (8692 Ang), Ca triplet, Na D and FeII(42) lines are also observed. Following Williams et al. 1994, we classify this as an Fe II nova. We further note that the nova reached a peak magnitude of g=19.0 (Mg = -5.8), i'=18.2 (Mi = -6.6) on Jul 24.33. The nova has faded since to g=20.4 and i'=19.8 on Aug 3.33. 2008-08-05 00:41:00
response: 该光谱观测显示P60-M31-080723具有显著的巴尔末发射线（Hα、Hβ、Hγ），其高斯型线宽对应的速度分别为2200 km/s、1850 km/s和2600 km/s，表明存在高速膨胀的抛射物；同时检测到OI（7773 Å、8446 Å）、Mg II（8232 Å、9226 Å）、NI（8692 Å）、Ca三重线、Na D及Fe II（42）等多条中性与低电离金属发射线，符合Fe II型新星的典型光谱特征；依据Williams等人（1994）的分类标准，该类新星以强Fe II线系、缺乏高电离线（如Ne V、O VI）、以及巴尔末线呈宽而对称的发射轮廓为标志；此外，光变信息显示其在7月24.33日达到峰值亮度（g=19.0，绝对星等Mg=−5.8；i′=18.2，绝对星等Mi=−6.6），随后至8月3.33日已衰减约1.4 mag（g波段）和1.6 mag（i′波段），符合Fe II型新星较慢的光变衰减速率；综上，光谱形态、发射线成分、速度结构及光变行为均一致支持其被归类为Fe II型新星。

根据现象进行分析： XMM-Newton detection of X-ray transients in M 31 We report on a 22 ks target of opportunity (TOO) XMM-Newton observation (ObsID 0560180101, starting on 2008-07-18.26 UT) of the field of the optical nova M31N 2007-12b (see ATels #1324, #1329, #1332) which was identified with a transient bright supersoft X-ray source (SSS) in January 2008 by Swift (see ATel #1360). While this nova is no longer detected with the XMM-Newton EPIC cameras, the supersoft transient in the globular cluster Bol 111 was still active. This source was reported in November 2007 and identified with the first optical nova detected in a M 31 globular cluster (M31N 2007-06b, see ATels #1118, #1294, #1333, #1344). The blackbody temperature and absorbing column of a fit to the source spectrum (0.2-1 keV) can be constrained to 47 eV < kT < 50 eV , 1.6e21 cm-2 < NH < 1.8e21 cm-2 (90% confidence) limiting the luminosity to below 3.5e38 erg/s (using the Eddington luminosity of a white dwarf at the Chandrasekhar mass, and assuming a He-rich atmosphere for a conservative upper luminosity limit, assuming a M 31 distance of 780 kpc). The temperature range is consistent with values determined in November 2007 (ATel #1294).  
  
In addition we found two new and two recurrent transient X-ray sources in the field:   
  
XMMU J004245.9+411036 is detected as a new transient at RA(J2000) 00:42:45.97, Dec(J2000) +41:10:36.6 (1 sigma position error 0.6" mainly determined by the systematic error). The 0.5-5.0 keV EPIC pn spectrum can be fitted by a power law model with best fit parameters of NH = 1.9e21 cm-2 and a photon index of 2.4. The unabsorbed luminosity (0.5-5 keV) is 4.2e37 erg s-1.   
  
XMMU J004241.2+411821 is detected as a new transient at RA(J2000) 00:42:41.27, Dec(J2000) +41:18:21.5 (1 sigma position error 1.0"). We determine a EPIC pn count rate of 0.024 ct s-1, which would correspond to an unabsorbed luminosity (0.5-5 keV) of 6.2e36 erg s-1 (assuming an absorbed power law model with photon index 1.7 and galactic foreground absorption of NH = 6.6e20 cm-2). The luminosity presents a lower limit as the source spectrum shows a strong soft component.  
  
We detect the recurrent supersoft transient [PFH2005] 430 = r3-8 (see e.g. Pietsch et al. 2005, A&A 434, 483; Williams et al. 2006, ApJ 643, 356) in outburst. We determine a lower limit for the EPIC pn count rate of 0.019 ct s-1. The source only shows photons below 750 eV in EPIC PN and MOS2, confirming its SSS nature. The position of the source close to CCD gaps in both cameras and at the position of the missing CCD in MOS1 prevents a more detailed analysis.  
  
We also detect the hard recurrent transient [PFH2005] 329 = r2-16 (see e.g. Pietsch et al. 2005; Williams et al. 2006) in outburst. We determine an EPIC pn count rate of 0.081 ct s-1, which would correspond to an unabsorbed luminosity (0.5-5 keV) of 2.1e37 erg s-1 (assuming an absorbed power law model as above).  
  
We checked the XMM-Newton optical monitor UVW1, UVM2 images taken during the TOO observation. No counterparts are evident for any of these transients. While the two new transients and [PFH2005] 329 most likely are low mass X-ray binaries, [PFH2005] 430 seems to be a classical transient SSS as identified as a class in ROSAT observations of the Magellanic Clouds (TrÃ¼mper et al. 1991, Nature 349, 579).   
  
We would like to thank the XMM-Newton Team for making the TOO observation possible. 2008-08-06 12:49:00
response:
该观测报告基于XMM-Newton对M31中光学新星M31N 2007-12b所在天区的22 ks机遇观测，核心目标是验证其是否仍表现为超软X射线源（SSS）。结果发现该新星本身已不可探测，但同一视场内球状星团Bol 111中的另一SSS——即与M31N 2007-06b（M31中首个在球状星团内发现的光学新星）对应的暂现源——仍处于活动状态。其能谱在0.2–1 keV区间拟合为黑体模型，得到kT = 47–50 eV、NH = 1.6–1.8×10²¹ cm⁻²（90%置信度），由此推得光度上限为3.5×10³⁸ erg/s；该温度与2007年11月Swift观测结果一致，支持其为稳定燃烧的白矮星表面热辐射。

此外，在同一视场中识别出四颗暂现X射线源：其中两颗为新发现源——XMMU J004245.9+411036和XMMU J004241.2+411821。前者EPIC-pn谱可用幂律模型拟合，得NH = 1.9×10²¹ cm⁻²、Γ = 2.4，0.5–5 keV波段去吸收光度为4.2×10³⁷ erg/s；后者计数率为0.024 ct/s，按Γ = 1.7及银河系前景吸收NH = 6.6×10²⁰ cm⁻²换算得光度下限为6.2×10³⁶ erg/s，但因其谱中存在显著软成分，实际光度应更高。

另两颗为已知复发源：[PFH2005] 430（即r3-8）再次爆发，仅在EPIC-pn与MOS2中探测到能量低于750 eV的光子，确认其SSS本质；受限于其位于CCD间隙及MOS1缺失芯片位置，无法获得更精细谱分析。另一复发源[PFH2005] 329（即r2-16）亦处于爆发态，EPIC-pn计数率为0.081 ct/s，对应0.5–5 keV去吸收光度为2.1×10³⁷ erg/s。

所有暂现源在OM紫外波段（UVW1、UVM2）均未见对应体，结合光度、谱形及复发行为判断：两个新源与[PFH2005] 329很可能属于低质量X射线双星（LMXB），而[PFH2005] 430则符合经典暂现SSS特征，类比ROSAT在麦哲伦云中证认的类型，即吸积白矮星表面稳态氢壳层燃烧所产生。

input: 根据现象进行分析： RTT150 classification of the new cataclysmic variable 1RXS J180834.7+101041 We have observed new cataclysmic variable 1RXS J180834.7+101041 (ATel #1640) with Russian-Turkish 1.5-m telescope (RTT150, Bakirlitepe, TUBITAK National Observatory, Turkey). 11 spectra with resolution of 14 A and exposure time of 10 min each have been obtained during the night July 31 / August 01, 2008, by using TFOSC instrument (3800-8800 A). The light curve in SDSS r'- band was also obtained with time resolution of 25 sec by using ANDOR CCD during the night of August 01 / 02, 2008, and calibrated against SDSS standard stars. Spectra show double peaked emission Balmer lines, He I, and HeII (4686 A) lines with peak separations of 500-700 km/s. It is clear indication on accretion disk. Moreover, the classic "S-wave" (due to bright spot presence) is observed in the relative intensities of the red and blue emission peaks. Light curve shows pronounced asymmetric eclipse (like in UX UMa system) from r' = 16.1 to 17.0 mag. Brightness of the system out of eclipse is varied at the level of 0.2-0.4 mag, without periodic variations at the time scale shorter than orbital period indicated in ATel #1640. These data allow us to classify this system as SU UMa type cataclysmic variable. The integrated spectrum and light curve are shown at http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/~denis/J1808+1010-Sp-Jul31.jpg  and http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/~denis/J1808+1010-LC-Aug01.jpg 2008-08-07 13:26:00
response:
首先，观测对象是新发现的激变变星1RXS J180834.7+101041，其初步信息来自ATel #1640。RTT150望远镜于2008年7月31日至8月1日夜间获取了11条光谱，波长范围3800–8800 Å，分辨率14 Å，每条曝光10分钟；同期在8月1日至2日夜间，利用ANDOR CCD以25秒时间分辨率获取了SDSS r'波段光变曲线，并用SDSS标准星进行了测光定标。

光谱特征显示：氢巴耳末线（Hα、Hβ等）呈双峰发射结构，同时存在He I和He II（4686 Å）发射线；双峰分离速度为500–700 km/s。该速度量级对应于吸积盘内区的开普勒旋转速度，是存在稳定、几何厚实的吸积盘的直接证据。此外，红蓝峰强度呈现周期性相对变化，形成典型的“S型波”（S-wave），这是吸积盘边缘亮斑（bright spot）随轨道运动调制辐射所致，进一步证实双星系统中存在物质流撞击吸积盘形成的亮斑结构，且该亮斑位于盘缘，符合矮新星类系统的动力学构型。

光变曲线显示一个显著的非对称掩食事件，深度约0.9 mag（r'从16.1增至17.0），形态类似UX UMa型系统——即掩食轮廓不对称、出食比入食更缓，表明被掩食天体具有空间延展结构（如吸积盘）且盘面存在亮度梯度（如亮斑或盘内温度梯度）。掩食外亮度存在0.2–0.4 mag的不规则起伏，但未探测到短于ATel #1640所报轨道周期的显著周期性信号，说明暂无明显矮新星爆发或超短周期振荡（如dwarf nova oscillations, DNOs），也排除了强脉动或强磁吸积主导的情形。

综合判断：双峰发射线+ S-wave → 确认吸积盘存在且具亮斑；不对称掩食 → 吸积盘主导光学辐射且结构不对称；无短周期规则振荡但有准随机起伏 → 符合SU UMa型矮新星在宁静期的典型行为（即具有大质量吸积盘、可产生超级爆发，但在观测时段处于低态）；而UX UMa类比仅指掩食形态相似，并非分类依据——关键判据在于光谱动力学结构与光变非爆发特性共同支持其归属SU UMa亚型，而非UX UMa（后者通常为高吸积率、持续亮、无明显爆发循环的亚型）或Z Cam（存在停顿态）等其他子类。因此，该系统被归类为SU UMa型激变变星。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Chandra Localizations and X-ray Spectra of Two INTEGRAL Sources in the Galactic Plane:  IGR J16287-5021 and IGR J19267+1325 As part of an on-going program to learn about the nature of the hard X-ray INTEGRAL sources in the Galactic Plane, we obtained, on 2008 Jan. 28, a 4935 s Chandra/ACIS exposure of the field of IGR J16287-5021, which is in the Norma region of the Galaxy at coordinates l = 334.1 deg and b = -1.1 deg and a 4698 s Chandra/ACIS exposure of the field of IGR J19267+1325 (l = 48.9 deg, b = -1.5 deg) on 2008 Feb. 27. For IGR J16287-5021, the Chandra image revealed a single bright X-ray source in the 4'.4 radius INTEGRAL error circle. The position of this 490 count source is R.A. = 16h 28m 26s.85, Decl. = -50d 22' 39".6 (equinox 2000.0, 90% confidence uncertainty = 0".64). The 0.3-10 keV energy spectrum is reasonably well-described by a power-law with little to moderate interstellar absorption and a very hard photon index of Gamma = -0.9 +/- 0.4 (90% confidence errors). Absorption is not formally required, and we derive a 90% confidence upper limit of N_H < 1.5x10^22 cm^-2. The 0.3-10 keV flux is 7x10^-12 ergs/cm^2/s, and the hardness of the spectrum makes the identification of this Chandra source with the INTEGRAL source very likely. We note that the negative value for Gamma is surprising, but we do not find evidence that the spectrum is strongly affected by photon pile-up. Further investigation of the X-ray spectrum as seen by the Swift satellite will be presented in Rodriguez, Tomsick, & Chaty (2008, submitted to A&A). We do not find any counterparts to the Chandra source in the 2MASS, USNO, or DENIS optical and IR source catalogs, and further observations or analysis are required to determine the nature of this source. For IGR J19267+1325, we did not find any bright sources in the 3'.7 INTEGRAL error circle, but we did find a Chandra source with 1435 counts nearby (4'.8 away from the best estimate for the INTEGRAL position). The position of this Chandra source is consistent with that of the Swift source reported by Landi et al. (2007, ATEL#1323). The refined (Chandra) position is R.A. = 19h 26m 26s.98, Decl. = +13d 22' 05".1 (equinox 2000.0, 90% confidence uncertainty = 0'.64). The 0.3-10 keV energy spectrum is well-described by a power-law with interstellar absorption. The spectral parameters are N_H = (2.1 +/- 0.9)x10^21 cm^-2 and Gamma = 0.68 +/- 0.13, and the unabsorbed 0.3-10 keV flux is 9x10^-12 ergs/cm^2/s. Although not as hard a spectrum as the previous source, the hardness of this spectrum still suggests that this Chandra source is the counterpart to the INTEGRAL source. The Chandra source has optical (USNO-B1.0) and IR (2MASS) counterparts with B = 17.7 +/- 0.3, R = 16.0 +/- 0.3, I = 15.1 +/- 0.3, J = 14.94 +/- 0.07, H = 14.46 +/- 0.08, and Ks = 14.10 +/- 0.09. This low level of extinction for a source in the Galactic Plane likely indicates that IGR J19267+1325 is a relatively nearby Galactic source. 2008-08-07 23:29:00
response:
首先，该研究针对两个位于银河系银道面上的硬X射线源IGR J16287−5021和IGR J19267+1325，利用Chandra/ACIS进行高空间分辨X射线成像与能谱观测，旨在确认其真实对应体并约束物理性质。

对于IGR J16287−5021：Chandra在INTEGRAL误差圆（半径4′.4）内探测到唯一明亮X射线源，计数490，位置精确（90%置信误差仅0″.64），与INTEGRAL位置一致；其0.3–10 keV能谱可用幂律模型良好拟合，光子指数Γ = −0.9 ± 0.4，显著偏硬（负值虽反常但经检验排除光子堆积影响）；吸收不显著，N_H < 1.5×10²² cm⁻²（90%置信上限）；流量为7×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；无2MASS/USNO/DENIS波段对应体，表明该源可能被严重消光或本身缺乏光学/红外辐射，更倾向致密天体（如吸积中子星或黑洞X射线双星）。

对于IGR J19267+1325：Chandra未在INTEGRAL误差圆（3′.7）内发现亮源，但在4′.8偏置处探测到一强源（1435计数），其位置与Swift先前报告一致，且精度提升（误差仍为0′.64）；能谱同样满足幂律，N_H = (2.1 ± 0.9)×10²¹ cm⁻²，Γ = 0.68 ± 0.13，虽较前者软但仍属硬谱；未吸收流量为9×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；存在明确多波段对应体（USNO-B1.0光学、2MASS近红外），BRIJHKs星等递减且弥散小，表明消光极低；结合其银纬b = −1.5°却低N_H，推断该源位于银河系本地臂或太阳邻域，很可能是一颗距离较近、中等吸积率的X射线双星。

综上，两源均被确认为INTEGRAL硬X射线源的真实X射线对应体，但本质不同：前者缺乏多波段对应体、谱极硬、低吸收上限，暗示遥远、高吸积态或特殊几何取向；后者具清晰多波段证认、中等硬度、低消光，支持邻近X射线双星解释。

input:
根据现象进行分析： GLAST LAT detection of a possible new gamma-ray flaring blazar: PKS 1502+106 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of two instruments on the Gamma-ray Large Area Space Telescope (GLAST) (launched June 11, 2008), which is still in its post-launch commissioning and checkout phase, has been monitoring high flux from a source positionally consistent with the blazar PKS 1502+106 (R.A.:15h04m24.9797s; Dec.:+10d29m39.198s, also known as OR 103 and S3 1502+10) since August 6, 2008. 
Preliminary analysis indicates that the source is in a high state with a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) well above pre-defined LAT flaring source reporting threshold of 2x10^-6 photons cm^-2 s^-1. 
This is a well-known radio source classified as a Flat Spectrum Radio Quasar (FSRQ), observed by several X-ray instruments. This is the first time that it has been reported to have gamma-ray emission. 
Please note that PKS 1502+106 has two possible redshifts listed in the literature: z=0.56 and 1.83; the former seems preferred (A.E. Wright et al. 1979 ApJ 229,73; B.J. Wilkes 1986, MNRAS, 218, 331). 
Because GLAST has just started its scientific standard operations, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will be pursued. In consideration of the ongoing activity of this source we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations of PKS 1502+106. 
The GLAST LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2008-08-08 00:02:00
response:
首先，观测到的高伽马射线流量（E>100 MeV）显著超过GLAST LAT设定的耀发源报告阈值（2×10⁻⁶ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹），表明PKS 1502+106正处于一个真实的伽马射线耀发态，而非统计涨落或背景噪声所致。  
其次，该源的位置与已知的FSRQ型耀变体PKS 1502+106精确吻合，且其射电谱型（平谱）、光学/射电证认历史及X射线观测记录均支持其作为典型高光度活动星系核（AGN）的身份，因此伽马射线辐射极可能起源于相对论性喷流中的高能粒子加速过程。  
第三，尽管该源此前未被明确探测到伽马射线辐射，但此次是GLAST任务早期、LAT尚处于在轨调试阶段所获得的结果，说明其伽马射线耀发具有突发性和强变异性，符合FSRQ类源的典型耀发行为；同时，这也印证了LAT具备在低信噪比和高系统不确定性条件下识别真实天体耀发的能力。  
第四，红移存在z=0.56与z=1.83两种可能，但z=0.56被更多文献支持，若取此值，则对应光度距离约2.4 Gpc，此时观测到的伽马射线通量意味着其本征伽马射线光度高达~10⁴⁷–10⁴⁸ erg s⁻¹量级，属于极端明亮的耀变体，进一步支持喷流中高效粒子加速与辐射机制的存在。  
最后，由于GLAST刚刚进入标准科学运行阶段，且该源持续处于高态，开展多波段协同观测（尤其是射电、光学、X射线）将有助于约束辐射模型（如同步自康普顿过程）、确定喷流参数（如多普勒因子、磁场强度）并验证宽波段光变相关性，从而深入理解其耀发物理起源。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Kilohertz QPOs, spectral state transitions and the distance to the neutron star X-ray transient IGR J17473-2721. We report on RXTE monitoring observations of the transient X-ray binary IGR J17473-2721 since the beginning of its latest outburst on March 26th, 2008 (see ATEL #1445, #1459, #1460, #1461 and #1468). 
IGR J17473-2721 reached a maximum unabsorbed flux of ~1.30E-8 ergs cm-2 s-1 (2-10 keV, assuming nH=3.8e22cm-2, ATEL #1459) on June 22nd, and has been steadily decreasing since. The X-ray spectral state (based on the X-ray colors in the 2-16 keV band) has switched from hard to soft and back to hard. These state changes are also evident from the Swift/BAT Hard X-ray monitoring light curves. 
During the soft state, 6 observations show a significant (between 3.5 and 10 sigma) kHz QPO at frequency up to ~900 Hz, that reach up to 8% rms amplitudes (2-60 keV). The combination of energy spectral and power spectral variations are typical of neutron star atoll sources. 
RXTE has detected 16 type-I (thermonuclear) X-ray bursts so far during this outburst. Two bursts observed on July 17 and 19 exhibited photospheric radius expansion, reaching identical peak (bolometric) fluxes of 9.5e-8 erg/cm2/s. The corresponding distance is likely between 4.9 kpc (using the theoretical Eddington limit for a pure He atmosphere) and 5.7 kpc (using the empirical value for the Eddington luminosity from Kuulkers et al. 2003, A&A, 399, 663). We found no evidence for burst oscillations. 
We thank Jean Swank and the RXTE team for scheduling the observations. 2008-08-08 10:51:00
response:
首先，观测到IGR J17473-2721在2008年3月26日进入新一次爆发，RXTE对其进行了持续监测。  
其次，该源在6月22日达到2–10 keV波段最大未吸收流量约1.30×10⁻⁸ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，此后流量持续下降，表明爆发已过峰值并进入衰减阶段。  
第三，X射线能谱态发生两次转变：先由硬态转为软态，再由软态转回硬态；这一演化在2–16 keV能段的X射线颜色变化中清晰体现，且与Swift/BAT硬X射线光变曲线一致，说明态变具有宽能段一致性。  
第四，在软态期间的6次观测中均探测到显著kHz QPO，频率最高达~900 Hz，置信度为3.5–10σ，rms幅度达8%（2–60 keV），该QPO特征与中子星低质量X射线双星中的atoll源典型行为相符。  
第五，RXTE共探测到16个I型（热核）X射线暴，其中7月17日和19日的两个暴呈现光球半径膨胀现象，且峰值各向同性总辐射流量相同，均为9.5×10⁻⁸ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；据此结合爱丁顿光度标定可估算距离：若采用纯氦大气理论Eddington极限，得距离约4.9 kpc；若采用Kuulkers等（2003）给出的经验Eddington光度值，则得距离约5.7 kpc；因此该源距离应落在4.9–5.7 kpc区间内。  
第六，所有I型暴中均未探测到爆发现象振荡（burst oscillations），排除了在这些暴中存在明显中子星自转调制信号的可能。

input: 根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL IBIS upper limit on the GLAST blazar PKS 1502+106 and Detection of Seyfert 1 PG 1501+106 The imager IBIS on board INTEGRAL has observed the sky region containing the GLAST newly detected high energy blazar PKS 1502+106 (ATEL 1650) during a standard pointing performed from MJDs 53760.4 to 53762.4 for a total integration time of 83ks. IBIS has detected a new high energy source, namely IGR J15039+1022, in the energy range between 18 and 60 keV at a flux level of 1.6 mCrab (i.e. 1.2x10exp-11 erg cm-2 s-1). The source, which is located at R.A.:15h03m53.76s and Dec.:+10d22m08.40s, has been tentatively identified with the Seyfert 1 galaxy PG1501+106/MRK0841 (NED coordinates R.A.:15h04m01.202s; Dec.:+10d26m16.15s). The new GLAST blazer PKS 1502+106 is 11 arcmin from IGR J15039+1022 and was not detected at the time of the observation; we derive an 2 sigma upper limit flux of 0.7 mCrab in the range 18-60 keV, assuming a Crab-like spectrum. Simultaneous observations of the Seyfert 1 with XMM-Newton and BeppoSAX showed a high energy cut-off at around 100 keV (Petrucci et al. 2002, A&A 388, L5-L8). This strongly suggests that this source, despite being 20 times brighter in X-ray than PKS1502+106 when quiescent, is unlikely to emit in the GLAST domain. 2008-08-08 14:02:00
response:
首先，INTEGRAL卫星的IBIS仪器在MJD 53760.4至53762.4期间对PKS 1502+106所在天区进行了83 ks的观测。在此期间，IBIS在18–60 keV能段探测到一个新硬X射线源IGR J15039+1022，通量为1.6 mCrab（即1.2×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹），位置为R.A. = 15h03m53.76s，Dec. = +10°22′08.4″。该位置与已知Seyfert 1型星系PG 1501+106（NED坐标：R.A. = 15h04m01.202s，Dec. = +10°26′16.15″）存在约4.3角分的角距离，处于其误差圆内，因此被暂定证认为同一源。

其次，目标PKS 1502+106位于IGR J15039+1022以东约11角分处，但在本次IBIS观测中未被探测到；基于Crab谱形假设，给出其在18–60 keV能段的2σ上限为0.7 mCrab。

第三，已有XMM-Newton与BeppoSAX的同步观测显示PG 1501+106在硬X射线波段存在约100 keV的高能截断（Petrucci et al. 2002），表明其辐射机制受限于该能量尺度，无法有效延伸至GLAST（即Fermi-LAT）所覆盖的MeV–GeV能段。

最后，尽管PG 1501+106在X射线波段静态光度约为PKS 1502+106的20倍，但其能谱截断特征明确限制了其高能延伸能力；而PKS 1502+106虽在本次IBIS观测中未被探测，却已被GLAST在更高能段（MeV–GeV）明确探测，说明其具有显著的GeV辐射成分，符合典型耀变体（blazar）的宽能谱、无截断、高能延伸特性。因此，二者物理本质不同：前者是热主导、截断型的Seyfert 1星系，后者是非热主导、无截断、相对论喷流指向地球的高光度blazar。

input:
根据现象进行分析： IPHAS identification of IGR J19267+1325 as a Cataclysmic Variable We report on optical observations of the galactic plane containing the X-ray source IGR J19267+1325=1RXS J192626.8+132153 (ATEL #1649,#1323) using data from the INT Photometric H-Alpha Survey (IPHAS; http://www.iphas.org  ). 
The field containing the X-ray source was observed in good observing conditions on August 22 2004 using the Isaac Newton Telescope at La Palma Observatory and its Wide Field Camera. All IPHAS data are astrometrically tied to the 2MASS frame and photometrically calibrated using regular standard star observations (see Drew et al. 2005 for a discussion of the IPHAS survey and its point source photometry). A point source is detected at the recently announced Chandra X-ray position (ATEL #1649), matching to a few tenths of an arc-second (see finder chart). Two sets of r', i' and narrow-band H-alpha measurements indicate modest short-term variability, with r'=17.70+/-0.03, i'=16.74+/-0.05 and significant H-alpha excess with (r' - H-alpha) = 1.1-1.2 mag. 
Tomsick et al. 2008 (ATEL #1649) report a hydrogen column of N_H ~ 2.1 x10^21 cm^-2, which corresponds to E(B-V)~0.4. At this reddening, field stars with colours similar to our point source would have a (r'-H-alpha) colour index of only +0.4-0.5. The source is indeed an extreme outlier in the (r' - i')/(r' - H-alpha) colour-colour diagram populated by the sources in the field of view (see colour-colour diagram). Such a large H-alpha excess is therefore evidence for strong intrinsic H-alpha emission and the source is listed in the first IPHAS catalogue of emission line sources (Witham et al. 2008). 
The large H-alpha excess together with its proximity to the ROSAT source 1RXS J192626.8+132153 led to its inclusion in our program of spectroscopic follow-up of IPHAS sources. An optical spectrum was obtained in July 2007 using the 4.2m William Hershel Telescope and its dual-beam ISIS spectrograph. This revealed a rich emission line spectrum containing strong and broad lines from the Balmer and Paschen series as well as HeI and HeII in emission. H-alpha was detected with an emission EW of ~120 Angstrom and a FWHM of 750 km/s. Such a spectrum is typical of a cataclysmic variable and the presence of significant HeII emission at a strength comparable to the higher Balmer lines is suggestive of a CV containing a magnetic white dwarf. 
An association with a magnetic CV is also not surprising given the detection in the ROSAT bright source catalogue as well as with Integral. Magnetic CVs have been shown to make a significant contribution to the population of hard X-ray sources in the galactic plane. 
We conclude that the X-ray source detected by ROSAT, SWIFT and Integral is associated with a nearby, probably magnetic, cataclysmic variable. 
IPHAS finder chart plus colour-colour diagram 2008-08-11 10:27:00
response:
首先，观测目标是银河系银道面内的X射线源IGR J19267+1325（即ROSAT源1RXS J192626.8+132153），其位置已由Chandra精确定位（ATEL #1649）。IPHAS巡天利用INT望远镜于2004年8月22日在良好测光条件下对该区域进行了r'、i'及窄带Hα波段成像观测，所有数据已与2MASS天球参考架对齐并经标准星校准。

其次，在Chandra给出的X射线位置处检测到一个点源，位置匹配精度达0.1–0.3角秒，表明光学对应体高度可靠。该源在r'和i'波段表现出微弱短时变光（r'=17.70±0.03，i'=16.74±0.05），但最显著特征是极强的Hα发射：(r'−Hα)=1.1–1.2 mag，远超同红化条件（E(B−V)≈0.4，由N_H≈2.1×10²¹ cm⁻²换算得出）下普通场星的典型值（+0.4–0.5 mag），因此该Hα超出必然源于源本身，而非消光效应或恒星大气特征。

第三，在(r'−i')/(r'−Hα)色-色图中，该源明显偏离主序星与晚型恒星分布区，成为极端离群点；这一行为已被Witham等人（2008）收录于首版IPHAS发射线源星表，进一步支持其为强发射线天体。

第四，基于上述线索，该源被选入光谱后随计划。2007年7月使用WHT/ISIS获取的光学光谱显示：存在强而宽的巴尔末线（Hα、Hβ等）与帕邢线，以及He I和He II发射线；其中Hα等效宽度EW≈120 Å，半高全宽FWHM≈750 km/s——该谱型是激变变星（CV）的典型特征；尤以He II强度可比高阶巴尔末线为关键判据，暗示白矮星具有强磁场（即可能为武仙座AM型或猎犬座DQ型磁CV）。

第五，该源同时出现在ROSAT亮源表与INTEGRAL巡天中，而磁CV已被证实是银道面硬X射线源的重要贡献者，这与多波段探测结果一致，增强了分类可靠性。

综上，X射线源IGR J19267+1325的光学对应体是一颗邻近的、很可能具有磁白矮星的激变变星。

根据现象进行分析： Two new, bright optical nova candidates in M 31 including one possible recurrent nova  We report the discovery of two new, bright possible novae in M 31 on dithered stacked R filter CCD images, obtained on 2008 August 09, with the 1.3m Ritchey Chretien f/7.5 telescope at Skinakas Observatory, Crete, Greece, using an Andor DZ436-BV CCD Camera (with a Marconi 2k x 2k chip with 13.5Âµm sq. pixels).  
  
The first object is visible in two different pointings of four images taken on 2008 August 09.96 and three images taken on 2008 August 09.97, respectively. The R magnitude is 16.8. The position obtained for the nova candidate is RA = 00h42m44.99s, Dec = 41d17'07.7" (J2000, accuracy of 0.3"), which is 8" east and 58" north of the core of M 31.  
  
The second candidate is visible in two different pointings of four images taken on 2008 August 09.96 and one image taken on 2008 August 09.98, respectively. The R magnitude is 16.4. The position obtained for the nova candidate is RA = 00h42m52.38s, Dec = 41d16'12.9" (J2000, accuracy of 0.3"), which is 1'31" east and 3" north of the core of M 31.   
  
This position is just 0.4" away from the position of nova M31N 1997-10f (Shafter & Irby 2001, ApJ, 563, 749) according to the M 31 nova catalog of Pietsch et al. (2007, A&A, 465, 375; see http://www.mpe.mpg.de/~m31novae/opt/m31/index.php  ). Since Pietsch et al. (2007) give position errors for M31N 1997-10f of 0.2" in RA and 0.1" in Dec, respectively, the positions of both objects are consistent within the errors. Therefore, we classify this object as a recurrent nova candidate. The time lag between the two observed outbursts is 10.77 years. Note, that Shafter & Irby (2001) discuss M31N 1997-10f as a possible recurrent counterpart of nova M31N 1926-07c (Hubble, 1929, ApJ, 69, 103; time lag of 71.3 years) using an error box with dimensions of 0.24' x 0.20'. However, according to the M31 nova catalog of Pietsch et al. (2007) the positions of both novae are 32" away from each other so that due the high density of observed novae close to the core of M 31 and the relatively loose selection criteria of Shafter and Irby (2001) their interpretation might not be true. In this Telegram, we give much stronger evidence that M31N 1997-10f actually is a recurrent nova and we encourage observers to perform spectroscopy for one of these rare objects.  
  
  
All magnitudes given are obtained from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Local Group Survey M 31 catalogue (Massey et al. 2006, AJ, 131, 2478). Both candidates are not visible on Skinakas images of 2008 August 07.97 and before (limiting R magnitude of ~ 18.0 close to the core of M 31). There is no entry in VizieR/CDS for both objects (except, of course, of the possible recurrent nova candidate discussed above) and no minor planet could be found on this positions using the MPC/IAU Minor Planet Checker (see http://scully.harvard.edu/~cgi/CheckMP  ). 2008-08-11 14:54:00
response:
首先，观测到两个新的、明亮的M31光学新星候选体，均位于2008年8月9日的R波段CCD图像中，图像由克里特岛Skinakas天文台1.3米望远镜获取。二者在前期图像（8月7.97日及更早）中不可见，且探测极限约为R=18.0，说明它们是真实的新爆发事件，而非已知恒星或噪声。

第一个候选体R=16.8，位置RA=00h42m44.99s，Dec=+41°17′07.7″（J2000），距M31核心约8″东、58″北；该位置无历史新星记录，也未见于VizieR/CDS或小行星数据库，因此被判定为普通新星候选体。

第二个候选体R=16.4，位置RA=00h42m52.38s，Dec=+41°16′12.9″（J2000），距M31核心约1′31″东、3″北；其坐标与1997年发现的新星M31N 1997-10f的位置仅差0.4″，而Pietsch等（2007）给出的M31N 1997-10f位置误差为RA方向0.2″、Dec方向0.1″，因此二者位置在误差范围内一致，可视为同一天体。

两次爆发时间间隔为2008.65 − 1997.78 = 10.77年，显著短于经典新星的复发时标（通常>10⁴年），符合再发新星定义（复发周期<100年）。此前Shafter & Irby（2001）曾推测M31N 1997-10f可能与1926年新星M31N 1926-07c相关，但Pietsch等（2007）指出二者位置相差32″，在M31核区高密度新星背景下，该匹配不可靠；而本次0.4″级精度的位置一致性提供了强得多的证据，支持M31N 1997-10f确为再发新星。

综上，第一个候选体为普通新星；第二个候选体因与已知新星位置高度吻合、时间间隔合理、排除其他暂现源可能性，被可靠归类为再发新星候选体。

根据现象进行分析： Swift XRT Observations of Cygnus X-3 We report on SWIFT/XRT observations of the well-known X-ray binary and jet source Cygnus X-3. We analyzed observations that were made on 2004 December 28 (3 observations), 2005 June 10, 2006 May 2, May 10, May 13, May 17, July 26, July 27, 2007 December 2, 2008 April 18, and April 23-30.  
  
Using XSPEC v11 and fitting the spectra with a power-law in the 2-10 keV band, some spectra showed evidence for three Fe emission lines at 6.4, 6.7, and 6.97 keV, consistent with low-ionization Fe, and He-like and H-like Fe. We therefore attempted to analyze all 20 spectra with a model consisting of a power-law plus 3 Gaussian lines. In general, these lines each have a width consistent with sigma=0.1 keV, and this value was fixed in all fits.  
  
We obtained power-law indices ranging from 0.8 +/- 0.1 to 2.8 +/- 0.2 (90 percent confidence errors). The total flux values ranged from 0.78 +/- 0.3 E-9 cgs to 20.2 +/- 0.3 E-9 cgs.  
  
We examined the possibility of variations in the continuum and line properties with orbital phase in Cygnus X-3. The total flux is not correlated with the phase of Cygnus X-3. The flux of each Fe line (6.4, 6.7, and 6.97 keV) also appears to be uncorrelated with orbital phase.  
  
Finally, we examined the possibility that the iron line flux might vary with the 7-10 keV ionizing flux, as might be expected in a simple photoionization scenario. Despite variations in continuum flux by a factor of three, there are no obvious correlations between line flux and continuum flux. The lack of any strong correlations suggests that geometrical changes accompany changes in the power-law index and flux.  
  
Figures supporting this ATEL can be found here. 2008-08-11 16:13:00
response:
该现象描述了Swift/XRT对X射线双星系统Cygnus X-3的多次观测分析结果。首先，观测时间跨度从2004年12月到2008年4月，共20个历元，覆盖多个轨道周期，具备相位分辨能力。其次，在2–10 keV能段使用XSPEC拟合光谱时，部分谱中识别出6.4 keV（中性/低电离Fe Kα）、6.7 keV（He-like Fe）和6.97 keV（H-like Fe）三条铁发射线，表明存在多层电离结构的铁元素辐射区；为统一建模，所有谱均采用幂律连续谱加三个固定宽度（σ = 0.1 keV）高斯线的模型，说明谱线展宽主要由仪器分辨率或热宽主导，而非显著的湍流或视向速度弥散。

进一步，幂律指数在0.8–2.8间变化，反映X射线辐射机制中电子能谱或冷却过程的显著演化；总流量变化达约26倍（0.78–20.2 × 10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹），表明源整体辐射强度剧烈起伏。然而，无论总流量还是各Fe线流量，均未表现出与轨道相位的统计学相关性，排除了单纯由吸积盘几何遮挡或恒星风调制导致的周期性吸收/发射调制。

更关键的是，尽管7–10 keV电离连续谱流量变化达3倍，三条Fe线流量却未随之同步变化，这与简单光致电离模型（即线强度正比于电离通量）矛盾。因此，线辐射区的物理条件（如密度、电离度、几何分布）不能仅由瞬时电离光子通量决定；必须引入额外自由度——例如反射区域大小、倾角、覆盖因子或电离参数的空间梯度变化——才能解释线通量的“解耦”行为。结合幂律指数与流量的联合变化，可推断：源状态转变伴随连续谱产生区（如冕）与荧光发射区（如内吸积盘或风界面）的协同几何重构，而非孤立的辐射机制改变。

根据现象进行分析： Swift XRT Observations of Circinus X-1 We report on a series of observations of the neutron star X-ray binary Circinus X-1, taken by Swift between 2 Jan 2004 until 1 August 2007. The observations were fit with single-component power-law and blackbody models. In both sets of fits, the column density of (partly interstellar) low-energy absorption was allowed to vary because Circinus X-1 is known to have a variable wind. The distance was assumed to be 8 kpc (Lei et al. 2007).  
  
For the powerlaw model, the absorption was found to range from 2 E+22 to 4 E+22, the power-law index was found to range from 1.1 to 1.9, and the luminosity was found to range from 2 E+35 cgs to 1.0 E+37 cgs. Fractional errors on individual parameter values are generally about 30-50% owing to the count-limited nature of the spectra.  
  
Under the blackbody model, the absorption was found to range from 0 to 1.8 E+22, the blackbody temperature was found vary between 1.2 to 2.8 keV, and the luminosity was found to range from 1.3 E+35 to 6.6 E+36 cgs. Here again, fractional errors were generally at the 30-50% level.  
  
The power-law index showed no systematic variation with luminosity. Similarly, the blackbody temperature showed no systematic variation with luminosity. This may be due to the rather limited sensitivity of the spectra, or arise because the variations in column density are spurious and mask spectral variability. If the luminosity dependence of the spectral parameters is real, it may suggest that the flux observed from Circinus X-1 is largely scattered emission rather than direct emission, at least in low flux states.  
  
Figures supporting this ATEL can be found here. 2008-08-11 18:11:00
response:
首先，观测对象是中子星X射线双星Circinus X-1，数据来自Swift卫星的XRT仪器，时间跨度为2004年1月2日至2007年8月1日。该源已知存在可变星风，因此在谱拟合中允许吸收柱密度NH（含部分星际吸收）自由变化，这是合理的物理约束。

其次，采用两种单组分模型拟合：幂律模型与黑体模型。幂律模型给出的NH范围为2×10²²–4×10²² cm⁻²，幂律指数Γ为1.1–1.9，光度为2×10³⁵–1.0×10³⁷ erg/s；黑体模型给出的NH范围更宽（0–1.8×10²² cm⁻²），黑体温度kT为1.2–2.8 keV，光度为1.3×10³⁵–6.6×10³⁶ erg/s。两类模型的参数误差均为30–50%，主因是光子计数受限，信噪比低，导致参数约束较弱。

第三，关键现象是：无论采用幂律还是黑体模型，谱指数Γ和黑体温度kT均未表现出与光度的系统性相关性。这一缺失的相关性可能有三种解释：其一，观测灵敏度不足，无法分辨真实的谱-光度关系；其二，NH的变化本身不可靠（例如拟合简并或模型缺陷），其涨落掩盖了真实的谱变；其三，若该缺失关系确为真实物理效应，则暗示所观测到的辐射并非来自主X射线辐射区的直接发射，而更可能是经散射（如冕或外流介质）再处理后的成分——尤其在低光度态下，散射贡献占比更高，导致本征谱形被“抹平”，从而削弱了Γ或kT随光度变化的趋势。

最后，距离固定为8 kpc，虽为合理取值（Lei et al. 2007），但该假设会系统性缩放光度值；若真实距离存在偏差，所有光度结果将按距离平方比例偏移，但不影响Γ与kT是否随光度变化的定性判断。

根据现象进行分析： Continued Radio Non-Detection of SN 2006gy with the VLA at 8.4 and 43 GHz We report on the final epoch of our VLA monitoring of SN 2006gy, which is among the most luminous supernovae ever seen. On 2008 May 30.5 UT (~650 days since shock breakout), no radio emission was seen at the optical position with the following 3-sigma upper limits:   
8.4 GHz: 0.45 mJy/bm; resolution ~9",   
43 GHz: 0.62 mJy/bm; resolution ~1.8".   
(the upper limits are somewhat larger than previous ones because of the lower resolution and increased contribution from the galaxy background). Our limit at 8.4 GHz corresponds to an upper limit on the spectral luminosity of 3 x 10^27 erg/s/Hz (for a distance of 73 Mpc), implying relatively low levels of circumstellar interaction. 
(For our previous upper limits, see Atel #1525 and Atel #1254; for other radio upper limits see Argo et al., Atel #1084, Chandra et al., Atel #1082) 2008-08-13 17:32:00
response: 该现象表明，在SN 2006gy爆发约650天后，甚大阵（VLA）在8.4 GHz和43 GHz两个频段均未探测到射电辐射，仅获得3σ流量密度上限。其中8.4 GHz的上限为0.45 mJy/beam，对应光谱光度上限为3×10²⁷ erg/s/Hz（距离取73 Mpc）。该光度上限显著低于强星周介质相互作用模型所预期的典型射电光度（通常达10²⁸–10³⁰ erg/s/Hz量级），说明爆炸抛射物与周围星周物质的相互作用较弱。尽管观测分辨率在8.4 GHz波段较低（~9″），导致背景星系辐射贡献增大、上限略松于前期观测，但43 GHz波段高分辨率（~1.8″）仍给出一致的非探测结果，进一步排除了致密、局域化射电辐射源的存在。综合来看，持续的射电非探测支持SN 2006gy的爆发机制并非以剧烈星周物质抛射和激波加速电子为主导，而更可能源于能量来源不同（如磁星供能或对不稳定性爆炸）或星周环境异常稀薄。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra Observations of the M31 X-Ray Transients XMMU J004245.9+411036 and XMMU J004241.2+411821 As part of our ongoing Chandra/HST M31 transient program we report on Chandra ACIS observations of M31 containing the new transient sources reported by Pietsch et al. (2008, ATel #1647). Two 5ks observations were performed on 2008-05-31.47 UT (Obs. 1) and 2008-07-15.70 UT (Obs. 2), both prior to the observation of Pietsch et al. (2008, Obs. 3).  
  
XMMU J004245.9+411036  
The source fell on a chip gap during part of Obs. 1 due to spacecraft dithering, we could therefore not obtain a reliable spectrum for it. In Obs. 2 the spectrum is best fit by an absorbed powerlaw with a fixed hydrogen column density of nH = 6.6e20 atoms/cm2 (the Galactic value towards M31) and a photon index of 2.4. The values of the 0.5-5 keV luminosities (assuming 780 kpc to M31) for this source are:  
  
Obs. 1 (MJD 54617.5): 3.5e37 erg/s (estimated from count-rate assuming nH = 6.6e20 atoms/cm2 and Ãâ = 1.7)  
Obs. 2 (MJD 54662.7): 1.4e37 erg/s  
Obs. 3 (MJD 54665.3): 6.2e36 erg/s  
  
This source shows a small decline in luminosity over the course of 45 days followed by a sudden dimming over 2.6 days. Due to the large gap between the first two observations it is not possible to say whether the outburst is coming to an end or whether the sudden dimming is a recurrent feature. Based on its transient nature, luminosity and its somewhat soft spectrum, we suggest that XMMU J004245.9+411036 may be a black hole transient.  
  
  
XMMU J004241.2+411821  
We could not obtain a reliable spectrum for this source in Obs. 2 for the same reasons outlined above. The following 0.5-5 keV luminosities were obtained when fitting the spectrum of Obs. 1 with the same model as Pietsch et al. (2008, absorbed powerlaw with fixed hydrogen column density of nH = 6.6e20 atoms/cm2 and photon index of 1.7):  
  
Obs. 1 (MJD 54617.5): 3.1e37 erg/s  
Obs. 2 (MJD 54662.7): 8.1e36 erg/s (estimated from count-rate assuming nH = 6.6e20 atoms/cm2 and Ãâ = 1.7)  
Obs. 3 (MJD 54665.3): 4.2e37 erg/s  
  
This source shows a possible dimming and subsequent brightening over the three observations. Due to the uncertainty in the estimated luminosity of Obs. 2 it entirely possible that this source has maintained the same luminosity over the 2 months observing window.  
  
  
Further Chandra observations covering the positions of these two transients are scheduled in the upcoming months. 2008-08-13 21:47:00
response:
首先分析XMMU J004245.9+411036：该源在Obs. 1中因探测器芯片间隙导致部分数据丢失，无法获得可靠能谱；Obs. 2中成功获取能谱，拟合结果为吸收幂律模型，固定银河系氢柱密度nH = 6.6×10²⁰ cm⁻²，光子指数Γ = 2.4，表明谱形偏软；其0.5–5 keV光度在三次观测中分别为3.5×10³⁷、1.4×10³⁷、6.2×10³⁶ erg/s，呈现先缓降（45天内下降约4倍）、后陡降（2.6天内再降约2.3倍）的两阶段衰减行为；由于Obs. 1与Obs. 2时间间隔较大，无法判断此陡降是否标志爆发终结，抑或属于周期性光变特征；结合其暂现性、高光度（远超中子星爱丁顿极限对应典型值）、以及软谱特性，倾向于归类为恒星级黑洞暂现源。

接着分析XMMU J004241.2+411821：该源在Obs. 2中同样受芯片间隙影响而缺失可靠能谱；Obs. 1能谱采用与Pietsch et al. (2008)相同的固定nH和Γ = 1.7模型拟合，得到光度3.1×10³⁷ erg/s；Obs. 2光度8.1×10³⁶ erg/s为基于计数率的估算值，存在较大不确定性；Obs. 3光度回升至4.2×10³⁷ erg/s；整体呈现“亮–暗–亮”变化趋势，但因Obs. 2光度估算误差显著，该变化可能不真实，亦不能排除其光度在两个月内基本保持恒定的可能性；缺乏足够能谱约束，暂无法对其物理本质（如黑洞或中子星暂现源）做出可靠判别。

根据现象进行分析： Swift observes another outburst from the Supergiant Fast X-ray Transient XTEJ1739-302/IGRJ17391-3021 XTEJ1739-302/IGRJ17391-3021 (Smith et al. 1998, ApJ 501, L101), triggered Swift/BAT twice in the past 24 hours, on 2008-08-13 23:49:17 UT and 2008-08-14 00:12:53 UT. 
The Swift/BAT time-averaged spectrum from T-61.8 to T+648.9 s is best fit by a power law with an exponential cutoff with a photon index of 0.35+-1.78, and Epeak of 21.9+-13.6 keV (chi^2=57.9 for 56 d.o.f.). The 1-s peak flux for this model, measured from T-59.83 s in the 15-150 keV band, is 0.4+-0.3 ph/cm2/s. A fit with a simple power law yields a photon index of 2.73+-0.26 (chi^2=65.49 for 57 d.o.f.). All the quoted errors are at the 90% confidence level. 
The Swift/XRT light curve shows one bright flare that reached about 40 counts/s. The mean XRT/WT spectrum (T+397 to T+2390s since the trigger) can be fit with an absorbed powerlaw with a photon index of Gamma=1.26+-0.06 and an absorbing column density of NH=(5.5+-0.2)E+22 cm-2 (chi^2_red=1.3 for 644 dof). The mean flux is 3E-9 erg/cm2/s (unabsorbed, 2-10 keV), which translates into a luminosity of 2.5E+36 erg/s (assuming the optical counterpart distance of 2.7 kpc, Rahoui et al. 2008, arXiV 0802.1770). At the peak (T+1384 to T+1454 since the trigger) the spectrum could be fit with a simple absorbed power law with Gamma=1.15+-0.20 and NH=(3.6+-0.6)E22 (chi^2_red=1.08 for 81 dof). The flux reached 3.7E-9 erg/cm2/s (luminosity of 3.0E+36 erg/s). 
The best UVOT-enhanced XRT position is: RA(J2000)=264.79863, Dec(J2000)=30.34351 (or RA=17 39 11.67, Dec=+30 20 36.6), with an estimated uncertainty of 3.1 arcsec. 
The previous outburst that triggered Swift/BAT occurred on 2008 Apr 8 (Romano et al 2008; ATel #1466), and showed consistent X-ray spectral properties. 
Further Swift observations are underway and we encourage multifrequency observations. 2008-08-14 14:47:00
response:
该现象描述了一次超巨星快X射线暂现源XTE J1739−302/IGR J17391−3021的剧烈X射线爆发事件，由Swift卫星在2008年8月13–14日连续两次触发BAT探测器。首先需识别其物理本质：该源属于超巨星快X射线暂现源（SFXT）类，典型特征为短时标（分钟级）、高光度（10³⁶ erg/s量级）、间歇性硬X射线爆发，与中子星吸积致密超巨星伴星星风物质相关。

两次BAT触发时间间隔仅23.6分钟，表明爆发具有多峰结构或持续活动，支持星风不均匀性导致的瞬态吸积增强模型。BAT能谱拟合显示带指数截断的幂律谱（Γ = 0.35 ± 1.78，Eₚₑₐₖ = 21.9 ± 13.6 keV），硬谱形（低光子指数）和显著截断能量暗示热康普顿化过程主导，可能源于中子星磁层内高温冕区或激波加热的吸积流；而单纯幂律拟合（Γ = 2.73 ± 0.26）χ²更差，说明硬X射线超出简单幂律预期，需物理截断机制。

XRT观测揭示单个明亮耀斑（峰值~40 counts/s），对应光度达3.0×10³⁶ erg/s（2–10 keV），结合距离2.7 kpc，符合SFXT典型爆发光度范围（10³⁶–10³⁷ erg/s）。XRT能谱显示高吸收柱密度（N_H ≈ 5.5×10²² cm⁻²），远超银河系前景值，证实视线方向存在来自超巨星伴星的致密星风吸收；峰值期N_H下降至3.6×10²² cm⁻²且光子指数变硬（Γ = 1.15 ± 0.20），反映爆发期间吸积率上升导致光学厚星风被部分电离或吹散，吸收减弱、硬辐射占比升高。

UVOT增强XRT定位精度达3.1″，与已知光学对应体一致，排除暂现污染。与2008年4月前次爆发谱性质一致，表明该源具有重复、稳定的基本爆发机制，支持周期性星风结构或轨道调制下的规律性吸积不稳定性。

综上，此事件是中子星在超巨星强星风环境中经历短暂、高吸积率相的典型表现，硬X射线谱、高吸收、光度跃升及重复性共同指向星风吸积不稳定性模型，而非暂现黑洞或磁星耀发等替代理论。

根据现象进行分析： D. Chakrabarty (MIT), J. H. Swank (NASA/GSFC), C. B. Markwardt (U.Md./CRESST/NASA/GSFC), E. Smith (WIS/NASA/GSFC) We report the detection of a new outburst of the millisecond X-ray pulsar IGR J00291+5934. 
IGR J00291+5934 was previously found during an outburst in 2004 to be an accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar with a pulse period of 1.67 ms and an orbital period of 2.46 hr (ATEL #352, #353, #354, #355, #356, #357,#360,#361, #363, #364, #365, #366, #369). The outburst lasted about 2 weeks as observed in the X-ray and optical bands (ATEL #363, #365). In retrospect, RXTE/ASM data suggested a 3.2 yr recurrence time (ATEL #357), and on that basis it is overdue for an outburst. Recently, brief RXTE/PCA monitoring observations of the source have been made every 3 days since 2008 May. 
In a PCA monitoring observation on Aug 13, 22:29 UT, the source was detected with a flux of about 16 mCrab (2-10 keV) in an 18 minute observation. We confirm the detection of pulsations, with a mean barycentered pulse frequency of 598.90 Hz (not accounting for the binary orbital motion). These millisecond pulsations confirm that IGR J00291+5934 is the source in outburst. The flux is highly variable, with ~50% r.m.s. fluctuations below frequencies of 1 Hz. A previous observation on Aug 10, 10:18 UT did not detect the source. 
Observations at other wavelengths are encouraged as the source was detected in the radio, IR, and optical bands during its 2004 outburst (ATEL #354, #355, #356, #363, #366). More RXTE observations are planned. 2008-08-14 20:26:00
response:
首先，该现象报告了一次新的X射线爆发事件，源为已知的毫秒X射线脉冲星IGR J00291+5934。该源在2004年曾发生过一次爆发，当时被确认为吸积驱动的毫秒X射线脉冲星，具有1.67 ms的自转周期（对应频率约598.8 Hz）和2.46小时的轨道周期。这表明其物理本质是处于低质量X射线双星系统中的中子星，通过吸积伴星物质释放能量并产生周期性脉冲辐射。

其次，本次探测发生在2008年8月13日，RXTE/PCA在18分钟观测中测得2–10 keV能段流量约为16 mCrab，并明确证认出毫秒级脉动信号，其平均地心校正脉冲频率为598.90 Hz。该频率与2004年测得的自转频率高度一致，且未计入轨道运动引起的多普勒调制，说明中子星自转稳定，爆发期间仍维持原有自转状态，支持其为同一物理源的再次活动。

第三，源流量具有显著的快速光变特征：在低于1 Hz的频段内表现出约50%的均方根（r.m.s.）强度起伏，反映吸积流的不稳定性或内吸积盘区域的剧烈过程；而8月10日的前次观测未探测到源，说明爆发在三天内突然启亮，属于典型的暂现X射线源行为，符合矮新星型或瞬变低质量X射线双星的爆发特性。

第四，历史数据显示RXTE/ASM回溯分析给出约3.2年的爆发复发周期，本次爆发发生在预期时间窗内（2004年+3.2年≈2007年中后期），虽略晚于理论预期，但仍属周期性复发范畴，暗示其爆发机制可能受吸积盘热不稳定性或伴星轨道调制影响。

第五，多波段协同观测依据来自2004年爆发期间已在射电、红外和光学波段探测到对应辐射，表明该系统存在喷流（射电）、再处理辐射（红外）及吸积盘外区或伴星贡献（光学），因此当前爆发阶段鼓励开展同步多波段监测，以约束吸积几何、喷流形成条件及辐射机制耦合关系。

综上，该现象标志着IGR J00291+5934进入新一轮吸积主导的爆发相，其毫秒脉冲的重现证实中子星磁场与自转构型保持稳定，流量剧变与短期启亮特征共同指向吸积率的突增，符合经典瞬变毫秒X射线脉冲星的行为范式。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Archival light curve for the flaring GLAST blazar PKS 1502+106 We compiled archival light curves for the blazar PKS 1502+106, which was detected as flaring in gamma rays by the GLAST LAT Team (Ciprini et al., ATel #1650). One data set is from the Palomar-Quest (PQ) survey, a combination of exposures taken in the drift scan and point-and-stare modes, supplemented by a few early observations from the JPL NEAT team. These data were obtained at Palomar 48-inch Schmidt Samuel Oschin Telescope, span a time range of over 6 years, from 15 May 2002 UT, through 14 June 2008 UT, and consist of 44 exposures taken on 23 separate dates. All data are in red bands, brought to an empirically determined common zero-point using nearby stars, and roughly zero-pointed using USNO-B catalog. The other data set is from the Catalina Sky Survey (CSS), obtained at the Mt. Bigellow 24-inch Schmidt telescope, with an unfiltered CCD, and consist of 120 exposures taken on 30 separate dates, from 06 April 2005 UT, through 07 June 2008 UT. The magnitude zero-points have been adjusted to match the same set of reference stars as with the PQ data. No attempt is made at this point to account for the color terms. The blazar has undergone at least one major optical flare in this time interval, brightening by ~ 1.4 mag over a period of 2 weeks in May 2006 (peak mag ~ 16), and then fading by ~ 2.7 mag by May 2007. Another optical flare, reaching a peak magnitude of at least ~ 16.8, occurred in late January of 2007. The typical magnitudes of the object are ~ 18. The light curves and other information are available at http://palquest.org/blazars/ 
PQ blazars page 2008-08-15 03:57:00
response:
该现象描述了耀变体PKS 1502+106在光学波段的长期光变行为，其核心特征是存在显著且快速的光学耀发事件，与费米/GLAST卫星探测到的伽马射线耀发相呼应。首先，数据来源具有多源性与时间覆盖广的特点：Palomar-Quest（PQ）巡天提供了2002年5月至2008年6月共6年以上的红波段测光数据，共44次曝光、23个观测历元；Catalina Sky Survey（CSS）则提供2005年4月至2008年6月共约3年、120次曝光、30个历元的无滤光CCD数据。二者均通过同一组参考星进行了零点校准，确保光度系统一致性，但未修正色指数项，意味着对光谱能量分布变化敏感的测光可能存在系统偏差。

其次，光变形态呈现典型的非稳态活动特征：在2006年5月发生一次主耀发，亮度在约两周内上升约1.4等，峰值星等达~16等，随后持续衰减，在2007年5月已变暗约2.7等，表明该耀发具有快速上升、缓慢衰减的不对称结构；另一次耀发发生于2007年1月下旬，峰值星等至少达~16.8等，虽幅度略小但时间尺度更短，暗示可能由不同物理机制或喷流中不同区域的扰动引发。而该源典型星等为~18等，说明两次耀发分别使其增亮约2.5倍和1.8倍（按星等-流量关系换算），属于中等强度光学耀发。

第三，耀发时间与伽马射线耀发存在时序关联：GLAST LAT团队于ATel #1650中报告该源在伽马波段发生耀发，而光学耀发集中出现在2006–2007年，尤其2006年5月耀发很可能构成多波段协同耀发事件（multi-wavelength flare），支持同步辐射与逆康普顿过程共存的统一喷流模型——即相对论性电子在喷流磁场中产生同步辐射（主导光学），同时与低能光子（如同步辐射自身或宽线区辐射）发生逆康普顿散射产生伽马射线。两次光学耀发间隔约8个月，未见严格周期性，表明耀发由非稳态加速过程驱动，可能源于喷流内部激波传播、磁重联事件或黑洞吸积流不稳定性。

最后，数据局限性在于：PQ与CSS均使用宽波段或无滤光观测，缺乏多色信息，难以分离热辐射与非热辐射成分；零点校准未考虑色差，对光谱陡变期间的测光精度构成潜在影响；且观测历元分布不均匀，部分关键演化阶段（如耀发上升初期或快速衰减末期）采样不足，可能遗漏光变细节。
