response:
首先，该现象报告了CRTS在2008年9月20日至23日UT期间发现的12个光学暂现源，需逐一分析其共性与差异以判断物理本质。  

从时间维度看，所有事件均集中于4天内，且检测时间精确到秒级，表明CRTS具备高时间分辨率的实时巡天能力；但暂现源本身的时间演化特征各异：CSS080920:005959-090032和CSS080921:204110-043803被明确标注为“getting brighter”，CSS080922:011307+215250已被确认为SU UMa型矮新星（具周期性爆发特性），CSS080923:230115+224111和CSS080921:010522+110252则注明“fading”或“past outbursts”，说明光变行为存在上升、峰值、衰减等不同阶段，暗示暂现机制多样性。

从空间位置看，12个源中至少7个（如CSS080923:021134+235249、CSS080923:011149+143826、CSS080922:011307+215250等）明确关联已知星系或星系群（如NGC 326），红移z≈0.04–0.05，对应宇宙学距离约150–200 Mpc；而CSS080920:005959-090032虽无SDSS探测到的宿主星系（r > 22.5），但其光谱证认为Ia型超新星（z=0.05），结合M ≲ −14.1的宿主星系绝对星等上限，说明该宿主可能为低光度矮星系或处于星系晕外，不影响其超新星本质判定。

从测光参数看，视星等分布于15.3–19.0，跨度约3.7 mag，对应流量变化超20倍；其中CV类（矮新星/激变变星）多集中在15.3–17.5 mag（如CSS080922:011307+215250为15.3，最亮；CSS080921:012706+031305为17.5），而SN类多为16.7–19.0 mag（如CSS080922:020008-112029达19.0，最暗），反映CV通常更近或本征光度更高，SN则因宇宙学距离导致观测亮度偏暗。颜色信息进一步佐证分类：CSS080923:230115+224111“appears red not blue”，符合矮新星衰减期SED变红特征；CSS080921:02706+031305为“blue object”，与激变变星吸积盘高温辐射一致；而SN-Ia在早期应呈蓝色，但CSS080920:005959-090032未提供颜色，依赖光谱确认。

从分类标签看，“SN”有4例（含1例光谱确认）、“CV”有3例（含1例SU UMa确认）、“SN?”有4例、“CV/Var”和“CV/SN?”各1例，表明多数暂现源需后续观测证认。值得注意的是，所有“SN?”候选体均缺乏宿主星系直接成像证据（如CSS080922:020008-112029仅“source appears in PQ”，CSS080921:204110-043803“no SDSS source”），但其位置精度（RA/Dec误差≤0.5″）足以排除太阳系天体；而“CV”类普遍具有历史爆发记录（“past outbursts”）或多波段光变监测（P60测光数据），体现激变变星的重复性特征。

综上，这12个暂现源是CRTS在短时标内捕获的异质样本：核心成因分为两类——一类是恒星尺度爆发现象（矮新星爆发、激变变星耀发），表现为快速光变、宿主无显著星系关联、颜色可蓝可红；另一类是恒星死亡遗迹（Ia型超新星），表现为单次不可逆爆发、与星系动力学关联、需光谱确认。部分中间态（如“SN?”、“CV/SN?”）源于观测限制：信噪比不足导致光谱缺失、宿主星系面亮度过低难以分辨、或暂现相位处于难以分类的过渡期（如超新星早期与矮新星极大期光度重叠）。因此，后续光谱观测是区分爆炸型与吸积型暂现源的关键，而多历元测光可约束光变时标，进而判别物理模型。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical observations of the outburst of blazar AO 0235+16 Observations at the Colgate University Foggy Bottom Observatory confirm the spectacular nature of the current optical outburst in the blazar AO 0235+16 reported by Villata et al (ATEL #1724). The blazar has reached a brightness level, R ~ 14.1, comparable to outbursts in 1990-91, 1992, 1998, and 2007. Preliminary reductions of CCD images indicate the blazar was at R ~ 16.2 on September 4.2 (UT), R ~ 15.4 on September 20.2 - observations hindered by the close proximity of the Moon, R ~ 15.0 on September 21.2, R ~ 14.2 on September 23.2, and R ~ 14.1 on September 24.2. 2008-09-24 05:46:00
response: 该现象描述了耀变体AO 0235+16在2008年9月发生的一次显著光学爆发。首先，观测确认其R波段亮度已升至约14.1等，达到历史强爆发水平（如1990–91、1992、1998、2007年爆发的亮度），表明此次事件属于该源典型的剧烈活动阶段。其次，时间序列光度变化清晰显示亮度在短期内快速上升：从9月4.2日的R≈16.2等，经9月20.2日（R≈15.4，受月光干扰）、9月21.2日（R≈15.0）、9月23.2日（R≈14.2），到9月24.2日已达R≈14.1等，即约20天内增亮约2.1个星等，对应流量增强约7倍，说明辐射过程具有显著的非热、相对论性喷流主导特征。再次，亮度持续攀升且尚未达峰（9月24.2日仍为14.1等，较前一日仅微降0.1等），暗示爆发可能处于上升晚期或峰值初期，后续仍需监测是否出现衰减。最后，该爆发被多个独立观测（Villata et al. ATEL #1724与Colgate观测）共同证实，排除偶然误差或观测假象，增强了其作为典型耀变体多历元高态活动样本的可靠性。

input:
根据现象进行分析： EXO0748-676 Currently at Very Low Flux Level We regularly monitor the X-ray eclipses of the LMXB source EXO0748-676 with the Rossi X-Ray Timing Explorer (RXTE) Proportional Counter Array (PCA). EXO0748-676 was discovered by the EXOSAT satellite in February 1985 (Parmar et al. 1985, IAUC # 4039 ). The compact object is known to be a neutron star since it shows X-ray bursts (Gottwald et al. 1986, ApJ, v.308, p.213). Since the beginning of the RXTE mission in 1996 this source has maintained a low but consistent flux (but also with occasional flares) near 8 mcrab in the 2-20 keV energy range. Recent measurements (ObsIDs 92040-05-01-00 - 92040-05-04-00, August 12, 2008) of the X-ray flux from EXO0748-676 by the RXTE PCA, however, show that EXO0748-676 is currently at a very low flux level. During these observations, the PCA count rate in the post-egress 2-20 keV energy range (layer 1 only) was roughly 7.5 counts/s/PCU. Past PCA count rates are usually above 15 counts/s/PCU in this energy band. Fits to the post-egress X-ray spectrum show the flux level is 6.83E-11 ergs/cm^2/s or about 3.4 mcrab in the 3-12 keV energy band in mid-August 2008. During September 2008, the flux level appears to be near the detection threshold of the RXTE All Sky Monitor.
If EXO0748-676 ceases X-ray activity after being a steady accreting X-ray binary since February 1985 then it is essential to look at the source both as it turns off and in the period after it ceases X-ray activity. Past observations of EXO0748-676 have yielded a result for the neutron star mass near 2.1 solar masses (Ozel 2006, Nature, v.441, p.1115) based on spectra from combined X-ray burst spectra (Cottam et al. 2002, Nature, v.420, p.51) and results from Eddington-limited X-ray burst measurements (Wolff et al. 2005, ApJ, v.632, p.1099). This high mass estimate should be confirmed in as many independent ways as possible. The cessation of accretion onto the neutron star in this system may make possible the observation of the neutron star surface directly, which, in turn, will possibly constrain the equation of state of neutron star matter. 2008-09-24 14:12:00
response: EXO0748-676 是一个已知的低质量X射线双星（LMXB），其中致密天体被确认为中子星，依据是其观测到的热核X射线暴。自1985年发现以来，该源长期表现为持续但较低水平的吸积活动，在RXTE任务期间（1996年起）通常维持约8 mcrab（2–20 keV）的稳定流量，并偶有耀发。然而，2008年8月的RXTE/PCA观测显示其流量显著下降：后食阶段（post-egress）2–20 keV能段计数率降至约7.5 counts/s/PCU，远低于历史典型值（>15 counts/s/PCU）；光谱拟合给出3–12 keV波段流量为6.83×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，即约3.4 mcrab；至2008年9月，流量已接近RXTE全天监视器（ASM）的探测阈值。这一急剧变暗表明吸积流可能已大幅减弱甚至中断，系统正进入静默或熄灭状态。若该源确已终止X射线辐射活动，则其从活跃吸积态向宁静态的演化过程具有重要物理意义：一方面，熄灭后中子星表面冷却辐射可能浮现，提供直接观测中子星热辐射的机会；另一方面，结合已有高精度质量测量（约2.1 M⊙），多信使、多方法验证该质量值将有助于约束中子星物态方程（EOS），尤其在超核密度条件下。因此，对熄灭过程及后续宁静期的监测，既是理解吸积物理关闭机制的关键，也是开展中子星基础物理研究的宝贵窗口。

The spectrum of P60-M31-080913 is dominated by Balmer and Fe II emission features (FWHM Hα ~ 1500 km/s) superimposed on a flat continuum, and is typical of an Fe II nova approximately a week post maximum. P60-M31-080915, on the other hand, displays significantly narrower Balmer and Fe II emission lines (FWHM Hα ~ 900 km/s) arising from a blue continuum. This spectrum is also characteristic of an Fe II nova, but one taken closer to maximum light. 2008-09-24 21:29:00
response:
首先，文中提到对两个M31新星候选体P60-M31-080913和P60-M31-080915进行了光谱观测，时间分别为发现后约9天和5天。这说明两者的观测相位不同，前者处于衰减阶段较晚时期，后者更接近极大亮度时刻。

其次，P60-M31-080913的光谱以Balmer线系和Fe II发射线为主，Hα线宽约为1500 km/s，叠加在平坦连续谱上。根据新星光谱分类标准，Fe II型新星在极大后约一周时通常呈现较宽的发射线（因抛射物膨胀速度较高）和相对平坦的连续谱，这与该目标特征一致，故判定为典型的Fe II型新星晚期。

再次，P60-M31-080915的Balmer和Fe II发射线明显更窄（Hα FWHM ≈ 900 km/s），且连续谱呈蓝色。较窄的谱线表明外层抛射物运动速度较低，常见于爆发初期、光球尚未完全收缩、激波或辐射区仍较致密的阶段；蓝色连续谱则反映有效温度更高，符合接近极大光度时热辐射占主导的物理状态。因此该光谱也属Fe II型，但相位更早，处于极大附近。

最后，两者虽同属Fe II型新星，但谱线宽度与连续谱形态的系统性差异，直接反映了其在爆发演化序列中的不同时间位置：P60-M31-080915更年轻，处于光度上升末期或极大附近；P60-M31-080913已进入早期衰减阶段。这一对比印证了Fe II型新星光谱随时间演化的典型规律。

response:
首先，观测时间是2008年9月23日UT 08:51–12:34，INTEGRAL卫星通过JEM-X和IBIS/ISGRI仪器在银河系核球区域监测中探测到H1743-322（即IGR J17464-3213）出现新的X射线爆发。该源被确认为银河系黑洞候选体与X射线暂现源。

其次，多能段流量测量显示其硬X射线辐射显著增强：3–10 keV波段约10 mCrab，10–25 keV约12 mCrab，18–40 keV约17 mCrab，40–100 keV达31 mCrab；该能谱随能量升高而增强，表明辐射谱较硬，符合黑洞X射线双星处于硬态或硬中间态的典型特征。

第三，对比此前2008年8月18日至9月20日的多次核球监测数据，该源均未被探测到，各能段3σ上限分别为：3–25 keV为10–20 mCrab，18–40 keV及40–100 keV为5–10 mCrab；此次探测流量明显高于所有前期上限，证实为一次真实的新爆发事件，而非之前已存在的稳定或弱活动状态。

第四，该源已有历史爆发记录（见ATels #132, #136等），本次是其再次进入活动期，结合其暂现源属性与黑洞候选体身份，可推断此爆发源于吸积流不稳定性导致的吸积率突然上升，进而引发冕区热电子康普顿化辐射增强，表现为硬X射线流量显著抬升。

综上，该现象是一次典型的黑洞X射线双星软X射线暂现源的硬态再爆发，由吸积盘内区物质供给突增所驱动，在硬X射线波段表现出强而硬的连续谱辐射。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Multi-wavelength sources in the vicinity of LS I +61 303 Recently, a SGR-like burst was detected by the Swift BAT on 2008 September 10th (de Pasquale et al. GCN 8209). The BAT on-board location of the burst was placed at 140 arcsec from LS I +61 303 with a 3 arcmin location error. The ground calculated location was refined to an error of 2.2 arcmin placed at 88 arcsec from the High Mass X-ray Binary (Barthelmy et al. GCN 8215). It has been proposed that this burst has been associated to magnetar-like activity linked to the presence of a young highly magnetized pulsar in the binary system (Dubus & Giebels, Atel #1715). In addition, an unusual X-ray activity (hard high flux and QPOs) on 2008 August 21 has been reported by Ray et al. (Atel #1730). Rea & Torres (ATel #1731) point out a population of faint X-ray sources in the vicinity of LS I +61 303 which might be the quiescent counterpart of a new transient magnetar. As part of an on-going multiwavelength study of the LS I +61 303 environment, and using archive Very Large Array (VLA) data (MuÃ±oz-Arjonilla et al. 2008, in prep.), we have obtained one of the deepest (rms 13 microJy) radio maps of the surroundings of this gamma-ray binary. In addition to LS I +61 303, our 6 cm VLA map displays 16 compact radio sources within a 10 arcmin field of view with a peak flux density above four times the rms noise. The relevant part of this map covering the Swift BAT error circles (GCN 8209 and 8215) can be found here. Three compact radio sources (labelled 03, 09 and 11) are located within or very close to the refined BAT location. Their 6 cm flux densities are measured to be 0.15, 0.17 and 0.17 mJy, respectively. If either the SGR-like burst behavior or the X-ray activity presenting QPOs are not connected with LS I +61 303, then these radio sources appear as potential alternative counterparts for such detections. Furthermore, we have obtained near infrared JHKs observations of the region with the 3.5 m telescope at CAHA. As a result, radio source 03 has a bright star-like counterpart with about J=11.4, H=10.3 and Ks=10.0 mag. Source 09 is also consistent with a J=19.2, H=17.8 and Ks=16.7 mag point like source. We have also obtained an X-ray source list from the Chandra ACIS-I obsid 6585 (performed on 2006 April 7th,  Paredes et al. 2007, ApJ, 664, L39) with the CIAO tool wavdetect. We have used an exposure map to obtain photon fluxes and used wavelet scales according to the range of PSF sizes in the box shown. In the map of the region, the red crosses show the X-ray sources with a signal-to-noise-ratio above 3. Interestingly, one of these X-ray sources is consistent with the VLA radio source #11 quoted above. The X-ray flux of this source in the 0.3-10 keV band is (3.07+/-0.82)*10^-6 ph/cm^2/s. This radio/X-ray emitter appears thus as an intriguing object whose connection with the SGR-like behaviour cannot be excluded. This object was already reported in the VLA observations by Marti et al. (1998, A&A, 329, 951) with extended radio emission around it (source D in their Table 1). No near infrared counterpart was detected in our CAHA observations brighter than about Ks=18 mag. Further observations are required in order to finally solve the nature of radio sources reported in this telegram. 2008-09-25 19:28:00
response:
现象分析：  
LS I +61 303 是一个已知的伽马射线双星系统，包含一颗大质量恒星和一颗致密天体（可能为中子星或黑洞）。近期在该源邻近区域观测到多种多波段异常活动，需系统梳理其时空关联性与物理可能性。

首先，2008年9月10日Swift/BAT探测到一次类SGR爆发（GCN 8209），初始定位误差为3角分，距离LS I +61 303约140角秒；后续地面精确定位（GCN 8215）将误差缩小至2.2角分，距离缩短至88角秒。该位置显著偏离LS I +61 303本身，表明爆发源未必是该双星系统本体，而更可能位于其周围致密天体群中。

其次，2008年8月21日曾报道异常X射线活动（Atel #1730）：硬谱、高流量、存在准周期振荡（QPOs），此类特征常见于磁星爆发或吸积不稳定过程，但时间上早于BAT事件约3周，空间位置未明，尚不能确认是否同源。

第三，Chandra X射线观测（2006年4月）在相同天区识别出多个X射线点源（Atel #1731），其中一源与VLA 6 cm波段探测到的射电源#11严格位置一致，且具有可测X射线光子流量（0.3–10 keV波段为(3.07±0.82)×10⁻⁶ ph/cm²/s），构成可靠射电–X射线对应体。该源早先已被Marti等（1998）在VLA观测中列为“源D”，并报告其具有延展射电结构，暗示可能存在星云或脉冲星风抛射物，但近红外（JHKs）观测未在Ks < 18 mag极限内探测到对应光学/红外源，排除了明亮恒星伴星的可能性。

第四，VLA深场图像（rms = 13 μJy）在10角分视场内共发现16个射电点源（信噪比 > 4σ），其中三个（#03、#09、#11）落入BAT精确定位误差圆内。其中#03和#09均具有光学/红外点源对应体（#03为亮星，J≈11.4；#09为暗源，Ks≈16.7），而#11无近红外对应体（Ks > 18），与Chandra检测到的X射线源位置重合，支持其为致密天体（如磁星或年轻脉冲星）而非普通恒星。

综上，三类多波段现象（BAT类SGR爆发、Chandra/XMM异常X射线源、VLA射电源）在空间上高度汇聚于LS I +61 303邻近区域，但均未精确落在该双星系统光学位置上。尤其射电–X射线对应体#11具备磁星典型特征（硬X射线、无亮红外对应、延展射电结构），且位于BAT误差圆核心，是最可能的类SGR爆发候选体。而#03和#09因存在明亮恒星对应体，更可能是前景或背景恒星，物理上难以解释高能爆发行为。因此，当前证据倾向于将该区域视为一个致密天体富集区，其中至少存在一个尚未被证认的、处于静默态或间歇活动态的磁星候选体，其爆发活动可能被误置于LS I +61 303方向，实则为独立天体。

response: 该现象表现为一个在CRTS巡天中发现的光学暂现源CSS080924:233423+391423，其核心特征是：在24小时尺度上持续存在，但呈现显著的分钟级快速光变——四次间隔10分钟的30秒曝光测得V波段星等分别为19.8、19.4、18.2、19.4，表明约20分钟内增亮约1.6等，随后回落，具有明显耀发行为。该源在历史联合CSS图像中完全不可见，排除了已知变星或活动星系核的长期存在；近红外DPOSS N波段底片仅显示“勉强可见”的微弱信号，而2MASS及其他DPOSS波段（如J、H、K）均无对应源，说明其红外辐射极弱或缺失，与典型恒星或AGN的能谱分布不符。后续Palomar 60英寸望远镜多波段观测（g、r、i、z）给出一致偏亮的星等（18.6–18.0），且色指数g−r≈0.2、r−i≈0.4、i−z≈−0.9，呈现异常蓝斜率，尤其i−z为负值，暗示z波段相对过亮或i波段吸收/消光异常，不符合普通恒星光谱能量分布。位置精度高（RA/Dec精确至角秒量级），无对应星表源，排除已知致密天体或小行星。其持续24小时以上的可观测存在性区别于经典激变变星耀发（通常数小时衰减）和伽马暴余辉（早期快速衰减），亦非超新星爆发初期（缺乏上升段及后续幂律衰减特征）。综合光变时标短、振幅大、多波段颜色异常、红外缺失、无先验对应体等特征，该源可能属于罕见的暂现类型，例如：磁白矮星系统中的极端耀发、低质量恒星超级耀斑、新型潮汐撕裂事件的早期阶段，或具有特殊吸积几何的矮新星爆发。需更高时间分辨率光变曲线、光谱观测以确认红移、发射线/吸收线特征及物理温度，同时开展X射线和射电波段协同观测以检验高能辐射关联性。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT detects renewed activity from 4U 1954+31 The Swift/BAT hard X-ray transient monitor reports increased activity in the 15-50 keV band for the symbiotic X-ray binary 4U 1954+31, which likely contains a pulsar with a 5-hour period (Corbet et al, ApJ 675, 1424, 2008). Starting on about 2008-08-09 (MJD 54687), the source has been steadily increasing in intensity from an undetectable level (one-sigma upper limit of 0.002 cts/cm2/sec or 8 mcrab) up to a current level of 0.013 Â± 0.002 cts/cm2/sec (58 mcrab) on 2008-09-25. This is the highest sustained rate seen in the BAT monitor since the end of a period of high activity that lasted from early 2005 through September 2005. Until the current activity, 4U 1954+31 has been undetectable in the BAT monitor. 
Scaled Map Transient Analysis for 4U 1954+31 2008-09-26 00:41:00
response:
首先，观测到4U 1954+31在Swift/BAT硬X射线波段（15–50 keV）出现显著增强活动，表明该源并非处于长期宁静态，而是发生了新一轮暂现事件。  
其次，活动起始时间约为2008年8月9日（MJD 54687），此后光度持续上升，从低于一倍标准差的探测上限（0.002 cts/cm²/sec，即8 mcrab）增至2008年9月25日的0.013 ± 0.002 cts/cm²/sec（58 mcrab），说明该增强具有明确的时间演化特征，且幅度达约7倍，显著超出背景噪声水平。  
第三，当前峰值流量（58 mcrab）是BAT监测器自2005年高活动期（2005年初至9月）结束后所记录到的最高持续流量，暗示此次爆发可能与2005年事件具有相似物理起源，但中间存在长达近三年的沉默期。  
第四，该源被归类为共生型X射线双星，且已有证据支持其中包含一颗自转周期约5小时的脉冲星（Corbet et al. 2008），因此光度增强很可能源于中子星吸积率的突然升高，可能由伴星物质抛射增强、轨道相位相关吸积不稳定性或盘不稳定性触发。  
第五，截至2008年9月26日00:41:00的Scaled Map瞬变分析仍将其标记为活跃源，证实该增强状态在时间上具有持续性，尚未进入衰减阶段，需后续观测确认其光变轮廓是否呈现典型脉冲星暂现的上升–峰值–衰减结构。

The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope (formerly GLAST) (launched June 11, 2008), has observed an increase of the gamma-ray activity starting on 13 September 2008, from a source positionally consistent with PKS 1510-089 (Position J2000.0: RA=15h12m50.5329s, DEC=-09d05m59.828s, Johnston, K. J et al., 1995, AJ, 110,880J). A source consistent with this object was also detected by the AGILE satellite on 03 March 2008 (F., D'Ammando et. al, ATEL #1436). 
Preliminary analysis indicates that the source has brightened to a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) greater than the pre-defined LAT flaring source reporting threshold of 2x10-6 photons cm-2 s-1. THOMPSON et al., 1990, PASP,102,1235T) with a pronounced UV excess, presenting strong analogies to 3C273 (Villata M. et al.1997,A&AS,121,119V). Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. In consideration of the ongoing activity of this source we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. For this source the Fermi LAT contact person is Andrea Tramacere (tramacer@slac.stanford.edu).

首先，观测到PKS 1510-089在2008年9月13日起出现伽马射线流量显著增强，该位置与已知耀变体PKS 1510-089的J2000坐标（RA=15h12m50.5329s，DEC=−09d05m59.828s）一致，排除了位置误认的可能性。  
其次，Fermi LAT测得其E > 100 MeV能段流量超过2×10⁻⁶ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹，突破了LAT设定的耀发源触发阈值，确认为一次明确的高能耀发事件。  
第三，该源此前已被AGILE卫星于2008年3月3日探测到活动迹象，说明其高能辐射具有持续性增强趋势，非孤立瞬时事件；而EGRET早先测得的流量仅约5×10⁻⁷ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹，表明本次耀发幅度至少达数倍增强。  
第四，PKS 1510-089被证认为红移z = 0.360的平谱射电类星体（FSRQ），具备典型FSRQ高能辐射特征：强紫外超量、与3C273高度相似的多波段性质，支持其喷流指向地球、相对论性聚束效应主导伽马射线辐射的物理图像。  
第五，由于Fermi LAT采用全天扫描模式，且该源被列入“LAT监测源”列表，其流量数据可实时获取，为后续光变分析、能谱演化研究及多波段协同观测（如射电、光学、X射线）提供了连续数据基础。  
最后，该事件触发多波段跟进观测的科学呼吁，源于FSRQ的辐射机制依赖于宽波段同步拟合以约束电子能谱、磁场强度、喷流功率等关键参数，单波段伽马射线数据无法唯一确定物理模型。

ATEL #1724；Balonek & Lam ATEL #1735），说明多波段协同增强，符合耀变体喷流指向地球时典型的同步辐射与逆康普顿辐射同步增亮特征。第三，对比EGRET历史数据（平均流量2.6×10⁻⁷ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹，峰值6.5×10⁻⁷ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹），当前LAT测得流量高出约3–8倍，证实此为一次罕见的强伽马耀发事件。第四，AO 0235+164被列为LAT重点监测源，其未定标光变曲线已实时公开，支持持续跟踪；结合其高红移（z = 0.940），该爆发对应本征光度极高，暗示喷流中粒子加速效率或磁场能量密度发生突变。最后，鼓励开展多波段协同观测，旨在通过谱能量分布（SED）建模约束辐射机制（如SSC或EC主导）、喷流物理参数（如多普勒因子、电子能谱截断）及爆发触发机制（如喷流内部激波、黑洞吸积率跃变或喷流-云碰撞）。

根据现象进行分析： More INTEGRAL observations of H1743-322/IGR J17464-3213: evolution of the source into outburst  INTEGRAL observations from the Galactic Center Key Program performed between UT 2008 Sep 23 12:36 and 2008 Sep 25 05:09 confirm the renewed activity of H1743-322/IGR J17464-3213 (See Kuulkers et al. 2008 Atel #1739). Previous observations of the field by INTEGRAL between 2008-09-20UTC02:44:28 and 2008-09-22UTC12:20:45 did not yield detections with 3-sigma upper limits of 1.5, 2.5, and 6.1 mCrab in the 20-40, 40-80 and 80-150 keV respectively. 
The source entered the field of view of IBIS/ISGRI on 2008-09-23 16:36:45.130 UTC and is clearly detected afterward. Our analysis shows a clear evolution of the 20-40 keV flux from 23 mCrab at the first detection to 55.3 mCrab on Sep 25 04:50 UTC. Although less significant a similar evolution of the flux is also seen at higher energies. We then divided the observations into two main intervals from which mosaics and spectra were accumulated.   
Between Sep 23 12:33 and Sep 24 12:59, the source is detected with fluxes of ~26 mCrab (20-40 keV), 36 mCrab (40-80 keV), and 50 mCrab (80-150 keV), with S/N ratio ranging from ~15 to 30 sigma for these ranges.   
The IBIS/ISGRI spectrum can be well fitted with a simple power-law in the 20-300 keV range. The photon index is 1.66 (Â±0.08) (reduced chi-squared =1.40 for 10 dof). We remark, however, that a power law with a cutoff (cutoffpl in XSPEC) provides a better fit (reduced chi square=1.11 for 9 dof) with a photon index of 1.3 (-0.3, +0.2), and a cutoff energy Ecut=151 (-66, +54) keV. The 20-200 keV flux is 8.9 e-10 erg/cm2/s.   
Between Sep 24 13:01 and Sep 25 04:47, the source is detected with fluxes of ~47 mCrab (20-40 keV), 66 mCrab (40-80 keV), 89 mCrab (80-150 keV), with S/N ratio ranging from 20 to 40 sigma for these ranges.   
Here a simple power law with a photon index 1.64 (Â±0.05) provides an acceptable fit to the spectrum (reduced chi square=1.75 for 10 dof). Adding a cut-off does not improve the fit. The 20-200 keV flux is 1.6 e-9 erg/cm2/s. Our results indicate that H1743-322/IGR J17464-3213 is in the Hard State seen at the beginning of outbursts of black holes binaries. This state is usually associated to a powerful steady outflow. We note that the detection of the source by INTEGRAL occurs very early in the outburst, a phase that is still rather unknown, and very rarely followed. The rapid evolution in the flux over the course of our monitoring may indicate that it could soon transit to softer states. Multiwavelength observations of this renewed outburst of H 1743-322 are strongly encouraged. 2008-09-26 12:58:00
response:
首先，观测时间序列显示源H1743-322/IGR J17464-3213在2008年9月20–22日未被探测到，各能段3σ上限分别为1.5、2.5、6.1 mCrab，说明此时处于宁静态或极低流量状态；而9月23日16:36:45.130 UTC起源进入IBIS/ISGRI视场并被清晰探测，表明爆发刚刚开始，属于爆发早期阶段。  
其次，20–40 keV波段流量在约36小时内从23 mCrab上升至55.3 mCrab，增幅超过一倍，且40–80 keV与80–150 keV波段也呈现一致的上升趋势，说明整体硬X射线辐射在快速增强，反映吸积流内区正在迅速建立并加热。  
第三，分时段光谱分析显示：第一时段（9月23日12:33–24日12:59）谱形需引入指数截断（cutoffpl）才能获得更优拟合（χ²_red=1.11 vs 1.40），截断能量Ecut≈151 keV，光子指数Γ≈1.3，符合典型黑洞X射线双星硬态特征——即热康普顿化主导、电子温度高、光学深度适中；第二时段（9月24日13:01–25日04:47）流量更高，但谱形可由简单幂律（Γ≈1.64）较好描述，截断项不再显著，暗示电子温度可能进一步升高或光学深度降低，但仍处于硬态范畴。  
第四，两时段20–200 keV能流量分别达8.9×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s和1.6×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s，后者为前者的约1.8倍，与mCrab流量增长趋势一致，证实辐射功率持续上升；同时各能段信噪比均高达15–40σ，保证了光谱参数的可靠性。  
最后，综合高硬谱形、强硬X射线辐射、快速流量上升及缺乏软成分等特征，可判定该源正处于标准硬态，对应于黑洞双星爆发初始阶段，常伴随稳态相对论性喷流；而INTEGRAL在此极早期的探测极为罕见，其后续可能向硬中间态或软态演化，因此亟需多波段协同观测以捕捉状态跃迁过程。

response: 该现象描述了对耀变体AO 0235+164（文中误写为0235+16）在光学及近红外波段的长期光变监测结果。首先，观测使用SMARTS 1.3米望远镜与ANDICAM仪器，具备同步获取B、R、J多波段数据的能力，说明其光变分析可覆盖紫外到近红外连续谱范围。其次，明确给出基准时间（2008年8月20日，JD 2454698.85）与后续观测期间的星等变化：B波段由18.2增至16.3（增亮约1.9 mag），R波段由16.3增至14.6（增亮1.7 mag），J波段由13.8增至12.3（增亮1.5 mag）。三波段增亮幅度呈随波长增加而略减的趋势，暗示光谱可能整体变蓝（即高频端增强更显著），符合典型blazar耀发中相对论性喷流辐射机制下的同步辐射谱硬化特征。此外，监测频率达近每日一次，保证了光变曲线的时间采样率足以分辨典型耀变体的快速光变特征；数据公开且持续更新，为多波段协同分析（如与Fermi-LAT伽马射线数据比对）提供基础。需注意原文中源名存在笔误（0235+164 vs AO 0235+16），但结合ATel #1744及标准命名惯例，应统一为AO 0235+164。

根据现象进行分析： Two SSS Swift X-ray spectra of Nova Cyg 2007 (V2467 Cyg) We have obtained two Swift observations of the fast nova V2467 Cyg (IAUC #8821, CBET #894, 897, 900). The first observation was taken 2008, June 15.17, 459 days after outburst, and the 5700-s exposure yields an average X-ray count rate of (0.017Â±0.002) counts per second (cps). We also obtained UV magnitudes from the UVOT filters uvw1, uvw2, and uvm2, and found 18.26Â±0.18, 19.41Â±0.37, and 20.28Â±1.11, respectively.  
100 days later, the second observation was taken (2008, September 23.3=559 days after outburst). The 5000-s observation yields a higher XRT count rate of (0.048Â±0.003) cps. The UVOT v filter yields a magnitude of 15.68Â±0.016. We found small variations in the X-ray and UV data, but no period with a strong signal in the periodogram is present. We also found no clear correlations between UV and X-ray count rates.   
The X-ray and UV light curves of both observations can be seen under http://erica.la.asu.edu/~ness/v2467_lc.gif and the spectra under http://erica.la.asu.edu/~ness/v2467_spec.gif.   
The X-ray spectra were both soft with their peak at ~0.5 keV. Blackbody fits to the XRT spectra yield the parameters kT=34 eV and NH=8.7Ã1021cm-2 for the first observation and kT=46 eV and NH=5.2Ã1021cm-2 for the second observation. With a total of 80 counts and 198 counts in the respective first and second observations, these parameters are poorly constrained.   
We thank the Swift PI and operations team for their support. 
http://erica.la.asu.edu/~ness/v2467_spec.gif 2008-09-27 04:57:00
response:
首先，观测对象是新星天鹅座V2467（Nova Cyg 2007），属于快速新星，两次Swift卫星X射线望远镜（XRT）观测时间分别为爆发后459天（2008年6月15.17日）和559天（2008年9月23.3日），间隔约100天。  

第一次观测曝光5700秒，X射线平均计数率为(0.017±0.002) cps；第二次曝光5000秒，计数率显著升高至(0.048±0.003) cps，约为首次的2.8倍，表明X射线辐射在约100天内增强。  

UVOT测光数据显示：第一次观测中uvw1、uvw2、uvm2波段星等分别为18.26±0.18、19.41±0.37、20.28±1.11，整体较暗；第二次仅给出v波段星等15.68±0.016，明显更亮（v波段中心波长约540 nm，比UV波段长，但数值更小说明亮度更高），提示光学/近紫外连续谱整体增亮，且v波段变化幅度远大于首次UV波段的测量值，可能反映不同波段演化不一致。  

X射线能谱均表现为软谱，峰值约0.5 keV，符合热辐射特征；黑体拟合得到kT从34 eV增至46 eV，NH从8.7×10²¹ cm⁻²降至5.2×10²¹ cm⁻²，即温度升高、吸收柱密度下降。该趋势与X射线光度上升一致：更高温度和更低吸收有利于更多软X射线光子逃逸，导致观测计数率上升。  

但需注意，两次XRT光谱总计数仅80和198，统计显著性低，参数约束较弱，因此kT和NH的变化虽符合物理预期，但不确定性较大。  

光变分析方面，未发现显著周期信号（周期图无强峰），且X射线与UV计数率之间无明显相关性，说明二者辐射机制可能不同源或受不同物理过程主导——X射线可能源于白矮星表面稳态核燃烧产生的热冕或边界层辐射，而UV/Optical主要来自膨胀包层的冷却辐射或伴星贡献，二者演化时标与响应机制不一致。  

综上，该新星在晚期（~1.2–1.5年之后）仍维持软X射线辐射，且呈现缓慢增亮、增温、减吸积柱密度的趋势，符合快速新星进入“超级软X射线源”（SSS）阶段的典型演化路径：核燃烧持续进行，白矮星表面温度逐渐升高，包层膨胀稀薄化导致消光减弱，从而X射线输出增强；但缺乏周期性和X-UV关联性，排除了明显双星轨道调制或共同瞬变驱动机制。

response:
该现象表明，在2008年9月26日对吸积毫秒X射线脉冲星SAX J1808.4−3658当前爆发期间，利用澳大利亚望远镜致密阵列（ATCA）在射电波段进行了约5小时的观测，但未探测到其射电对应体。  
观测给出的3σ流量密度上限分别为：4.8 GHz频段0.45 mJy/beam，8.6 GHz频段0.72 mJy/beam。  
由于该源是已知的暂现吸积毫秒脉冲星，其射电非探测可能反映以下物理情形之一：  
1. 该爆发阶段未产生显著的射电辐射，例如未触发射电喷流或喷流极其微弱；  
2. 射电辐射存在强各向异性或短时标变化，导致观测时段恰好处于辐射关闭期或极弱期；  
3. 射电辐射谱呈陡谱，使得在4.8 GHz和8.6 GHz处的流量低于当前灵敏度极限；  
4. 吸积流与磁场相互作用未满足射电辐射所需条件（如未形成稳定喷流或未达到射电辐射阈值的吸积率）。  
该结果与部分吸积驱动的毫秒脉冲星在爆发期间缺乏持续射电辐射的观测事实一致，支持“射电静默”吸积态的存在，暗示其射电辐射机制可能具有高度状态依赖性。

根据现象进行分析： CFHT Optical Observations of SAX J1808.4-3658 in Outburst After the transient X-ray binary SAX J1808.4-3658 was reported to be outbursting in X-rays on 2008 Sept. 21 (ATEL #1728), we have requested Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope (CFHT) TOO observations of the source. On 2008 Sept. 29 (UTC), our first one-hour r' imaging observation was carried out. The detector used is MegaPrime, a wide-field optical imager. In the observation, the source was detected, with r'= 17.41+/-0.04.
Using a color of V-R= 0.3 (Wang et al. 2001, ApJ, 563, L61) obtained during the source's 1998 outburst, we find V= 17.5. Also as V-I= 0.6 in 1998, we estimate I= 16.9 for the source. Comparing to I= 16.93 reported by Maitra et al. (ATEL #1748) six days ago, it is likely that the source has not been fading.
The source has brightened by 3.7 mag in r' compared to in quiescence. In our Gemini observations of the source made in 2008 May, it was found to have an average magnitude of r'=21.1.
We thank CFHT for granting us the TOO observations of the source. We also thank Nadine Manset at CFHT for helping with the observations. 2008-09-29 17:12:00
response:
首先，SAX J1808.4-3658 是一个暂现X射线双星系统，于2008年9月21日被报告进入X射线爆发态。  
随后，研究者申请并获得了CFHT的ToO（Target of Opportunity）观测时间，并于2008年9月29日（UTC）开展了首次一小时r'波段成像观测。  
观测使用MegaPrime宽视场光学成像仪，成功探测到该源，测得r' = 17.41 ± 0.04。  

为推算其他波段星等，研究者采用了Wang等人（2001）在1998年爆发期间测得的颜色指数：V−R = 0.3 和 V−I = 0.6。  
由r' ≈ R（因r'与R波段响应相近，且色差小），可近似取R ≈ r' = 17.41，代入V−R = 0.3，得V = R + 0.3 ≈ 17.71；但原文给出V = 17.5，说明实际采用了更严谨的r'–R零点校正或直接使用r'与V的实测关系，故以文中V = 17.5为准。  
再由V−I = 0.6，得I = V − 0.6 = 17.5 − 0.6 = 16.9。  

Maitra等人（ATEL #1748）六天前（即约9月23日）报告I = 16.93，与本次估算的I = 16.9在误差范围内一致，表明光学亮度在此期间未发生显著衰减，支持X射线爆发仍处于平台期或缓慢下降阶段。  

对比2008年5月（即爆发前宁静期）的Gemini观测，当时测得平均r' = 21.1，本次r' = 17.41，两者差值为21.1 − 17.41 = 3.69 ≈ 3.7 mag，即该源在r'波段比宁静期增亮约3.7星等，符合典型低质量X射线双星（LMXB）在爆发期间的光学增亮幅度。  

综上，光学r'波段探测确认了X射线爆发对应的光学对应体活动增强，颜色信息支持其光学辐射与以往爆发一致，光变趋势显示尚未进入明显衰减阶段，整体行为符合吸积盘不稳定性引发的爆发模型预期。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopy of CSS080924:233423+391423: A likely dwarf nova We observed the flaring optical transient, CSS080924:233423+391423, discovered by CRTS (ATel #1741), with the Double Beam Spectrograph on the 5-m Palomar Hale Telescope on Sep. 29.16 UT. The spectra (340-1000 nm) reveal numerous emission lines at zero redshift including H-Balmer, HeI, HeII, and CaII H&K features. These features are typical of Galactic dwarf novae. The FWHM measured from the Balmer lines is about 900 km/s. The photometric variations found by CRTS could indicate superhumps from a SU Uma like superoutburst, although the 1.6 mag variations on 10 minute time scales noted at discovery are perhaps atypically large. 2008-10-01 01:06:00
response: 该光学暂现源CSS080924:233423+391423的光谱观测显示：在零红移处存在多条发射线，包括H-Balmer线系、He I、He II以及Ca II H&K线，这些谱线特征与银河系内矮新星的典型光谱一致；Balmer线的FWHM约为900 km/s，属于矮新星中常见的宽发射线范围，反映吸积盘内高速运动气体；CRTS观测到的光变可能对应SU UMa型超爆发出的超峰（superhumps），支持其为矮新星系统；但发现时记录的10分钟内1.6 mag剧烈光变幅度偏大，超出典型矮新星短时标光变范围，需考虑观测误差、耀斑污染或特殊吸积不稳定性等因素；综合光谱与光变特征，该源极可能是一颗处于爆发态的矮新星。

根据现象进行分析： Increase in optical brightness of blazar PKS 0208-512 We are conducting a long-term monitoring campaign of the optical and near-IR brightness of gamma-ray bright blazars using the SMARTS 1.3m telescope and ANDICAM instrument. Note that parts of the site are still under construction. 
SMARTS observations of GLAST LAT blazars 2008-10-01 16:39:00
response:
现象：PKS 0208-512在2008年9月11日至30日期间，B波段亮度上升1.3星等，R波段上升1.4星等，表明其光学波段发生显著增亮。

分析：该增亮发生在伽马射线明亮耀变体的长期多波段监测框架下，由SMARTS 1.3m望远镜与ANDICAM仪器完成；B、R波段同步且幅度相近的增亮，暗示辐射机制具有宽波段一致性，可能源于喷流中相对论性电子的同步辐射增强；增亮持续约20天，时间尺度符合耀变体光学光变典型时标，支持其起源于喷流内区（pc尺度以下）的剧烈活动，如激波传播、磁场重联或喷流指向角微小变化导致的多普勒因子增大；该事件与费米/GLAST LAT卫星的伽马射线观测协同，有助于检验高能辐射与光学辐射的物理关联，例如是否满足同步自康普顿（SSC）或外康普顿（EC）模型预期的相关性。

input: 根据现象进行分析： ESO VLT spectral observations of SAX J1808.4-3658 in outburst We report on observations made using the ESO VLT of the ongoing outburst of the accreting millisecond pulsar SAX J1808.4-3658 (ATEL #1728). Spectra were obtained using Kueyen+FORS1 (1200B Grism, ~370-510 nm) and Antu+FORS2 (600B Grism, ~330-621 nm) on 27 Sept 2008 with a series of exposures starting at 01:03 UT (FORS1) and 00:10 UT (FORS2) and lasting for a total of ~1hr 40 each. Using the acquisition image, we determine the source was at R~17.2 (consistent with that reported in ATEL #1749). Analysis of the 1200B grism data reveals deep, broad Balmer absorption lines with weak emission features near the line cores. However, weak emission features from the Bowen blend near 4640 Ang (EW~-0.3 Ang) and He II at 4686 Ang (EW~-0.8 Ang) are also present. Although the trailed spectra are noisy, Doppler tomography provides tentative evidence for radial velocity shifts in the Bowen blend in both the 600B and 1200B Grism data. The phasing of the Bowen blend shifts is consistent with an origin on the secondary, with a velocity of ~300 km/s. This yields a mass function of ~0.2 Msolar: however, this is likely a lower limit, as it does not include the `K-correction' (Munoz-Darias et al. 2005, ApJ, 635, 502). We note that such a limit, when combined with the known value of asin(i) (e.g. Chakrabarty and Morgan 1998 Nature 394 346) would yield a lower limit to the system inclination of ~35 degrees, for a 1.4 Mo neutron star. The He II Doppler map shows circular emission associated with an accretion disc, with a brighter region of emission near the expected location of the hotspot. These preliminary estimates are subject to confirmation. We thank the DG of ESO for approving these observations. 2008-10-01 20:21:00
response: 该现象描述的是对吸积毫秒脉冲星SAX J1808.4−3658在爆发期间开展的ESO甚大望远镜（VLT）光谱观测。首先，观测使用FORS1和FORS2光谱仪分别覆盖370–510 nm与330–621 nm波段，时间集中在2008年9月27日约1小时40分钟内，获取了多组曝光数据；源星等R≈17.2，与前期报告一致，表明处于典型爆发亮度水平。其次，1200B光栅光谱中清晰呈现深而宽的巴尔末吸收线，说明存在较冷、光学厚的恒星大气成分，可能源自供体星；同时在线心附近检测到微弱发射，暗示局部高温或激波加热区域。进一步，在4640 Å处探测到Bowen复合线（C III/N III）的弱发射（等值宽度EW ≈ −0.3 Å），以及He II 4686 Å发射（EW ≈ −0.8 Å），二者均为高激发态谱线，指示存在温度≥3×10⁴ K的电离气体，通常与内盘、热斑或边界层相关。尽管信噪比较低，但通过时序光谱（trailed spectra）进行多普勒成像分析，发现Bowen线存在系统性视向速度变化，其相位演化与供体星轨道运动一致，拟合得到径向速度振幅K₂ ≈ 300 km/s；由此导出的质量函数f(M) ≈ 0.2 M⊙，该值未计入K-修正项，因此是中子星质量的保守下限。结合已知的asini ≈ 0.82 R⊙（Chakrabarty & Morgan 1998），可反推系统倾角i的下限约为35°（假设中子星质量为1.4 M⊙）。最后，He II多普勒图显示环状发射结构，符合吸积盘特征，并在预期热斑位置出现亮区，支持标准矮新星型吸积几何模型。综上，观测证实该系统在爆发期同时呈现供体星吸收、盘/热斑发射及可能的边界层辐射成分，动力学信息支持致密天体为中子星，且轨道参数与先前X射线测光结果自洽。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Discovery of >100 GeV Gamma-ray Emission from the Blazar 3C66A by VERITAS The VERITAS collaboration reports the discovery of very high-energy gamma-ray emission from the intermediate-frequency-peaked BL Lac object 3C66A with the VERITAS array of four 12 m imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes (Mt. Hopkins, Az). This blazar was detected by EGRET and is likely to be detected by the recently launched Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope. Even though this is a well-known AGN, its redshift is uncertain (see Bramel et al., 2005, ApJ, 629, 108 and Finke et al., 2008, A&A, 447, 513). 3C66A appears to be in an active state since at least Sept. 25, 2008 when VERITAS started observing it, resulting in a highly significant detection (> 8 standard deviations). The gamma-ray spectrum is soft, and the integral gamma-ray flux above 100 GeV is about 0.1 Crab. The VERITAS array will continue to observe 3C66A this month. Up to date information regarding the VERITAS observation schedule for this source will be available at the website below. Multi-wavelength observations across the electromagnetic spectrum are strongly encouraged. In particular, redshift measurements would be highly valuable given the possible implications of the detection of this gamma-ray source for extragalactic background light (EBL) studies. http://castor.adlerplanetarium.org/MWL/index.php/Multiwavelength_Campaigns 2008-10-01 21:43:00
response:
首先，观测到的>100 GeV伽马射线辐射来自耀变体3C66A，这是一个中间频峰型BL Lac天体，表明其同步辐射峰值位于光学/紫外波段附近，而高能伽马射线很可能源于逆康普顿散射过程。  
其次，VERITAS通过四台12米成像大气切伦科夫望远镜在亚利桑那州霍普金斯山完成探测，信噪比超过8σ，说明该源在此期间处于显著活跃态，且自2008年9月25日起持续可观测，排除偶然涨落可能。  
第三，能谱呈软谱特征，即通量随能量升高快速下降，结合积分通量约为0.1 Crab（即蟹状星云流量的10%），暗示辐射机制可能受Klein-Nishina效应压制或存在高能截断，也可能反映源区粒子加速效率或辐射冷却时间尺度的限制。  
第四，该源已被EGRET探测，并预期被费米望远镜观测到，说明其宽能段（MeV–TeV）辐射连续，支持单区或多区辐射模型中电子能谱的广延分布；但红移不确定（z未知），导致其本征光度、辐射区物理尺寸、γγ吸收截面等关键参数无法准确标定。  
第五，红移测量尤为关键：若z较高（如z > 0.3），则>100 GeV光子将与星系际背景光（EBL）发生显著对湮灭，观测到的软谱和通量水平可约束EBL密度模型；反之若z较低，则需考虑源内吸收或辐射机制本身的固有软化。  
第六，多波段协同观测被强烈推荐，因同步辐射成分（射电–X射线）可约束低能电子谱，而X射线至GeV能段数据可检验同步自康普顿（SSC）或外部康普顿（EC）主导模型，进而解释TeV谱的软化原因。

根据现象进行分析： Comet 29P/SW1 outburst COMET 29P/SCHWASSMANN-WACHMANN IN OUTBURST 
J. M. Trigo-Rodriguez, Institute of Space Sciences, Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Cientificas and Institut Estudis Espacials de Catalunya, reports that the present outburst experienced by this Centaur (#IAUC  8978 ) is the brightest detected since September 2004 [for more details see Trigo-Rodriguez et al. (2008) A&A485, pp. 599-606]. In the previously reported work the outburst frequency was established in 7.3 outbursts/year, typically reaching a +13 maximum magnitude or less. The comet recovery, after several months unobserved due to solar conjunction, was achieved by A. Sanchez (MPC 442) on Sept. 06.178 when the comet was imaged through a SC 36.0 f/6 exhibiting 14.9 R magnitude (all magnitudes here are given for a 10 arcsec standardized aperture). By Sept. 09.77 the outburst was confirmed visually by S. Yoshida (Gunma, Japan) by using a 0.40-m reflector reporting 12.8V to the ICQ. An increase in the CCD magnitude was observed by A. Sanchez on Sept. 13.158 when the comet was in magn. 14.1R. D. Rodriguez (MPC 458) confirmed the outburst on Sept. 15.177 when the comet was in magn. 14.2R. Since then this comet has developed the coma due to the released micron-sized grains that are expanding outwards. The increase in magnitude has continued as is suggested from ulterior observations by A. Sanchez (Sept. 25.118, 11.9R; Sept. 29.155, 12.4R, 12.3I, 12.9V; Oct. 01.154, 13.4R, 13.5I, 13.8V). In the Sept. 29 observation an asymmetric distribution of a 55 arcsec-wide coma is visible that at the current comet distance corresponds to a coma diameter of 255000 km. A bright fan of material extending from the nucleus was present in p.a. 235 deg. Such fan is usually reported in bright outbursts of this comet, being produced by micron-sized particles that are contributing to solar light scattering. In any case, this outburst seems to be quite unusual due to the long extent of the activity that is suggesting a continuous re-supply of large grains from the nucleus. Gunnarson (2003), A&A 398, 353 performed grain lifetime sublimation calculations, finding that the lifetime of mm-sized clusters producing the micron-sized particles should be of 2 or 3 days. As the magnitude of the comet has been increasing progressively in the last two weeks, seems evident that some active area has been massively re-supplying material to the coma. A future follow-up of the magnitude decay of this object can be very useful in order to perform an accurate modeling of 29P activity. 2008-10-02 12:12:00
response:
现象分析：  
该彗星29P/Schwassmann-Wachmann 1（29P/SW1）正处于一次显著的爆发活动中。首先，此次爆发是自2004年9月以来观测到的最亮爆发，表明其活动强度异常高。历史统计显示该彗星平均每年发生7.3次爆发，通常最大亮度不超过+13等；而本次爆发在9月25日已达11.9R等，明显亮于常态峰值，说明能量释放规模更大。

其次，爆发具有持续性与阶段性增强特征：9月6日刚恢复观测时为14.9R等，9月9日升至12.8V等，9月13日回落至14.1R等，但随后再度上升——9月25日达11.9R等，9月29日维持在12.3–12.9等区间，10月1日仍达13.4–13.8等。这种“回升—稳定—缓慢衰减”的光变形态不同于典型短时爆发，暗示存在持续的物质供给机制，而非一次性喷发。

第三，形态学证据支持持续活动：9月29日观测到直径达55角秒的不对称彗发，对应物理尺度约25.5万公里；同时存在方位角235度方向的明亮物质扇形结构，由微米级尘粒主导，散射太阳光形成。此类扇形结构以往仅见于该彗星强爆发事件，但本次不仅出现，且伴随长时间光度增长，说明喷发源区仍在活跃释放大量微米级颗粒。

第四，物理解释指向核内持续供料：Gunnarson（2003）计算表明，产生微米级尘粒的毫米级团块在当前距离处升华寿命仅为2–3天；而本次光度连续升高已持续两周以上，远超单次喷发产物的存活时间。因此，必须存在一个或多个活跃区域持续向彗发输送新鲜大颗粒物质，即核表层或浅层存在长期开启的活动源。

综上，本次爆发的异常性体现在亮度、持续时间、彗发尺度及结构稳定性四方面，核心机制应为彗核局部区域的长期、高强度挥发性物质释放，导致持续的尘埃喷发与彗发扩张。后续对光度衰减过程的监测将有助于约束活动区分布、喷发速率及挥发性组分性质等关键参数。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical and near-IR brightening of the blazar 3C  66A detected by the GASP With reference to ATel #1753 announcing the detection of >100 GeV gamma-ray emission from the blazar 3C 66A in September 25 â October 1, the GLAST-AGILE Support Program (GASP) of the Whole Earth Blazar Telescope (WEBT) reports on the observation of an optical and near-IR brightening of the source occurred in the same period: from R ~ 14.3 on September 24 to R ~ 13.7 on September 30, while the J mag varied from about 12.8 to 12.3. 2008-10-02 13:36:00
response:
首先，题目描述了类星体3C 66A在特定时间段（9月25日至10月1日）内被探测到>100 GeV伽马射线辐射增强（ATel #1753），与此同时，GASP（GLAST-AGILE Support Program）观测到其光学（R波段）和近红外（J波段）波段也发生显著增亮。具体表现为：R星等从9月24日的约14.3降至9月30日的约13.7，即变亮约0.6星等；J星等从约12.8降至12.3，同样变亮约0.5星等。星等数值减小对应亮度增加，且光学与近红外变化趋势一致、时间上高度重合。

其次，这种多波段（GeV伽马射线、光学、近红外）同步增强是耀变体（blazar）典型活动特征，表明喷流中相对论性电子的同步辐射（主导光学/近红外）与逆康普顿散射（主导高能伽马射线）过程可能由同一粒子加速事件驱动，支持单区辐射模型或存在紧密耦合的辐射区域。

最后，该现象暗示3C 66A在此期间经历了喷流内部剧烈活动，如激波传播、磁场重联或新喷发事件，导致宽波段辐射谱整体抬升，为研究高能辐射机制及多波段相关性提供了关键时序约束。

根据现象进行分析： The new SGR 1550-5418 is the old AXP 1E1547.0-5408 N. Rea (U. Amsterdam), P. Esposito (INAF-IASF, Milan), H. A. Krimm (CRESST/GSFC/USRA), D. M. Palmer (LANL), S. Mereghetti, A. Tiengo (INAF-IASF, Milan), G.L. Israel (INAF-OAR) 
Swift-BAT triggered today on several Galactic short bursts (Krimm et al. GCN 8311, 8312), which were claimed to come from a new Soft Gamma Repeater SGR 1550-5418. However, given the positional coincidence of this new putative SGR 1550-5418 with the Anomalous X-ray Pulsar (AXP) 1E1547.0-5408 (Gelfand & Gaensler 2007; Camilo et al. 2008; Halpern et al. 2008), and the enhanced X-ray flux observed from promptly downlinked XRT data of this source (Krimm et al. 8311), we now identify the source of these bursts being the AXP 1E1547.0-5408. 
See http://staff.science.uva.nl/~nrea/1E1546_XMM_CXO_GCNs.jpg  for an X-ray image of the field with superimposed the Swift-BAT and XRT error circles from Krimm et al. (GCN 8311, 8312). 
XMM-Newton and Chandra field of AXP 1E1547.0-5408 2008-10-03 14:34:00
response:
首先，观测到Swift-BAT在当天触发了多次来自银河系内的短时标爆发（Krimm et al. GCN 8311, 8312），这些爆发最初被暂定归因为一个新发现的软伽马重复暴源SGR 1550-5418。  
其次，该暂定位置与已知的反常X射线脉冲星AXP 1E1547.0-5408在空间上高度重合——二者坐标一致，且已有文献（Gelfand & Gaensler 2007；Camilo et al. 2008；Halpern et al. 2008）明确证认该天体为AXP。  
第三，Swift-XRT在爆发后快速下传的数据显示，该位置存在显著增强的X射线流量，这一光变行为符合AXP在爆发活跃期的典型特征（即进入“爆发态”并伴随X射线光度上升）。  
第四，结合Swift-BAT定位误差圆与XRT定位误差圆均与XMM-Newton和Chandra此前对1E1547.0-5408的高精度成像位置一致，可排除位置误差导致的误认。  
因此，所有观测证据共同表明：所谓“新SGR 1550-5418”并非独立新源，而是已知AXP 1E1547.0-5408在剧烈活动期间表现出的SGR型爆发行为，即该AXP在此刻展现出了软伽马重复暴源的典型现象。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Time-resolved Photometry of the Recently-discovered SU UMa Star, OT J011306.7+215250 We report the results of time-resolved CCD photometry obtained with the Mount Laguna Observatory 1-m reflector of the SU UMa star OT J011306.7+215250, which was discovered on 2008 Sep 22 UT by Drake et al. (ATel #1734) as part of the Catalina Real-time Transient Survey. A total of ~25 hours of V-band photometry over 5 nights (2008 Sep 25 - 29 UT) has enabled us to confirm its SU UMa nature, and to establish a revised superhump period of 0.09445(3) days (136.0 minutes), which is one of the longest superhump periods known. During our observations the system faded quite rapidly, by almost a magnitude per day, from V~15.5 on Sep 25.2 to V~19 on Sep 29.3 UT. Perhaps surprisingly, the superhump amplitude increased over the same time interval, from ~0.1 mag on our first night, to ~0.4 mag when the system reached V~19 on our last night of observation. 2008-10-03 21:05:00
response:
该现象描述了一颗新发现的SU UMa型矮新星OT J011306.7+215250的时间分辨测光观测结果。首先，SU UMa星是一类具有双周期光变的爆发变星，其特征包括规则的矮新星爆发（normal outbursts）和更亮、更长的超级爆发（superoutbursts），后者伴随周期略长于轨道周期的“超级晕”（superhumps）——即由吸积盘中椭圆畸变引发的周期性亮度调制。本文通过5晚共约25小时的V波段测光，确认了该源的SU UMa性质，并测定其超级晕周期为0.09445(3)天（136.0分钟），属目前已知最长的超级晕周期之一，暗示其轨道周期可能较长（因超级晕周期通常比轨道周期长约2–4%），或系统处于低质量比、高倾角等特殊参数区间。

其次，观测期间系统亮度快速衰减：从9月25.2日V≈15.5降至9月29.3日V≈19，即约3.8天内变暗约3.5等，对应平均衰减速率近1等/天。这一快速衰减符合超级爆发末期吸积盘迅速冷却与收缩的典型行为。然而，与常规预期相反——即亮度下降时常伴随超级晕振幅减弱（因盘面整体亮度降低、调制对比度下降）——本例中超级晕振幅反而从首晚约0.1 mag显著增大至末晚约0.4 mag。该反常增强表明：尽管总光度下降，但吸积盘的椭圆调制结构相对增强，可能源于盘边缘区域冷却更快、中心区域残留较强热辐射，或盘半径收缩导致椭圆畸变效应在观测视线方向上更显著；亦可能反映质量转移率虽整体下降，但残余流与盘的相互作用加剧了非轴对称扰动。因此，振幅增长与亮度衰减的耦合关系，暗示该系统在超级爆发衰退相中经历了特殊的盘动力学演化，对理解SU UMa星吸积盘不稳定性触发、维持及耗散机制具有关键约束意义。

根据现象进行分析： Possible NIR counterpart to the AXP 1E 1547.0-5408 On 2008 October 3rd, Swift-BAT triggered on several short bursts from the direction of the Anomalous X-ray Pulsar (AXP) 1E1547.0-5408 (Krimm et al. GCN 8311, 8312; Rea et al. Atel #1756). This is the second known transient radio AXP discovered to date (Gelfand & Gaensler 2007; Camilo et al. 2007), and it showed the previous X-ray outburst around June 2007 (Halpern et al. 2008). 
During the decay of the 2007 X-ray outburst we observed 1E 1547.0-5408 in the Ks band (on 2007 July 8th, 12th, and August 17th) with the NAOS -CONICA (NACO) instrument mounted at the ESO- VLT (Mignani, Rea, Testa, et al., 2008 submitted). We have detected four objects close to the source error circle (labeled 1-4 in the finding chart available at http://staff.science.uva.nl/~nrea/ESO_VLT_1E1547.png  ). The brightest one (object #3) has K= 16.22 +/-0.06, while objects #2 and #4 have K=18.51+/-0.06 and K=18.54+/-0.06, respectively. None of them was found to vary in the three nights. The faintest object, #1 (Ks = 20.3 +/- 0.07), was detected on the night of July 12th, 2007 only, although we could not claim any significant variability because the July 8th and August 17th observations were highly affected by bad atmospheric conditions. The source brightness is consistent with that of typical NIR counterparts of AXPs. 
Given the X-ray re-activation of the AXP 1E1547.0-5408, NIR follow-ups would be crucial to assess with higher significance the possible variability of source #1, a candidate NIR counterpart to this transient AXP. 
ESO-VLT NIR finding chart for the AXP 1E1547.0-5408 2008-10-03 22:37:00
response:
首先，观测到Swift-BAT在2008年10月3日触发于来自AXP 1E 1547.0−5408方向的多次短时X射线爆发，表明该源正处于新一轮X射线活动期（即“再激活”），这与其2007年6月左右发生的前一次X射线暴发事件形成时间上的呼应。

其次，为搜寻其近红外（NIR）对应体，在2007年7–8月X射线暴发衰减阶段，研究者利用ESO-VLT的NACO仪器在Ks波段进行了三次观测（7月8日、12日、8月17日），在X射线位置误差圆内共探测到四个近邻天体（标记为#1–#4）。

其中，#3最亮（K = 16.22 ± 0.06），#2与#4亮度相近且较暗（K ≈ 18.5），三者在三次观测中均未表现出显著光变；而最暗的#1（Ks = 20.3 ± 0.07）仅在7月12日被可靠探测到，其余两晚因大气条件恶劣导致信噪比不足，无法确认其是否存在或是否变化。

由于#1的亮度处于已知AXP NIR对应体的典型范围内，且其单次探测可能暗示光变行为（受限于观测条件未能充分验证），因此它被列为候选NIR对应体；而当前X射线再激活事件提供了关键契机——通过及时开展高精度NIR后随观测，可提升对#1是否真正随X射线活动同步变化的判别置信度，从而确认其物理关联性。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT detections of gamma ray activity in three blazars: 3C 66A, PKS 0208-512, PKS 0537-441          The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope (formerly GLAST) (launched June 11, 2008), has observed, since September 15, 2008, an increase of the gamma-ray activity in three sources positionally consistent with the blazars 3C 66A (RA: 02h22m39.6114s DEC: +43d02m07.799s), PKS 0208-512 (RA: 02h10m46.2004s DEC:-51d01m01.891s) and PKS 0537-441 (RA: 05h38m50.3614s DEC: -44d05m08.934s). 
Of these three sources, 3C 66A was already reported in a high state in the TeV band by VERITAS (Atel #1753) and in optical by Larionov et al. (Atel #1755), while PKS 0208-512 was reported in a high optical state by Buxton et al. (Atel #1751). 
3C 66A is a well known BL Lac object, with an adopted z=0.44 (but see, e.g. Finke, J.D. et al. 2008, A&A, 477, 513), marginally detected by EGRET as 3EG J0222+4253 (Hartman et al., 1999, ApJS, 123, 79), at a lower flux than the current one (EGRET average flux: 1.9x10-7 photons cm-2 s-1; peak flux 2.5x10-7 photons cm-2 s-1). 
PKS 0208-512 is a flat spectrum radio quasar (z=0.999, Wisotzki et al. 2000, A&A, 358, 77) detected by EGRET as 3EG J0210-5055. The current value of the flux is comparable to the average flux detected by EGRET (average flux: 8.5x10-7 photons cm-2 s-1; peak flux 1.3x10-6) photons cm-2 s-1). This source is one of the "LAT Monitored Sources" (http://fermi.gsfc.nasa.gov/ssc/data/policy/LAT_Monitored_Sources.html), and consequently, a preliminary, uncalibrated estimation of the gamma-ray flux observed by Fermi LAT is publicly available (http://fermi.gsfc.nasa.gov/ssc/data/access/). 
PKS 0537-441 is one of the most variable BL Lac objects (z=0.894, Peterson et al. 1976, ApJ, 207, L5-L8) and was detected by EGRET as 3EG J0540-4402. Fermi LAT observations indicate that the flux of this source is close to the maximum value observed by EGRET (average flux: 2.5x10-7 photons cm-2 s-1; peak flux 9.1x10-7 photons cm-2 s-1). 
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. In consideration of the ongoing activity of these sources we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. The Fermi LAT contact persons for these sources are Luis C. Reyes (lreyes@kicp.uchicago.edu) for 3C 66A, Werner Collmar (wec@mpe.mpg.de) for PKS 0208-512 and Gino Tosti (tosti@pg.infn.it) for PKS 0537-441. 
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2008-10-03 22:42:00
response:
首先，观测到三颗耀变体（3C 66A、PKS 0208-512、PKS 0537-441）在费米大天区望远镜（LAT）波段出现伽马射线活动增强，时间始于2008年9月15日。该现象表现为三源的伽马射线流量显著上升，且位置与已知耀变体精确吻合。

其次，多波段协同证据支持这是真实的高态活动：3C 66A 同时在TeV波段（VERITAS）和光学波段（Larionov等）被独立证认为高态；PKS 0208-512 也在光学波段（Buxton等）报告为高态。这表明伽马射线增强并非仪器伪迹，而是源本征辐射机制整体增强的表现，符合耀变体多波段同步变化的典型特征。

第三，对各源历史伽马射线数据的定量比较揭示活动强度差异：3C 66A 当前流量明显高于EGRET时期平均值（1.9×10⁻⁷ cm⁻² s⁻¹）及峰值（2.5×10⁻⁷ cm⁻² s⁻¹），属显著增强；PKS 0208-512 当前流量与EGRET平均值（8.5×10⁻⁷ cm⁻² s⁻¹）相当，接近其历史水平；PKS 0537-441 当前流量则逼近EGRET观测到的历史峰值（9.1×10⁻⁷ cm⁻² s⁻¹），显示其处于极端高光度状态。

第四，源物理分类与红移信息提供能谱解释约束：3C 66A 和 PKS 0537-441 均为BL Lac天体（低电离发射线、强相对论性喷流指向观测者），而 PKS 0208-512 是平谱射电类星体（FSRQ，具强宽发射线），暗示其高能辐射可能包含更多外光子场（如宽线区辐射）参与的逆康普顿过程；三者红移分别为z=0.44、0.999、0.894，说明PKS 0208-512和PKS 0537-441距离更远，其观测到的高流量意味着其本征光度极高。

第五，费米LAT的全天扫描模式保障了持续监测能力，结合其20 MeV–300 GeV宽能段覆盖，可构建精细能谱并追踪光变时标；三源均曾被EGRET探测，具备长期伽马射线演化对比基础；其中PKS 0208-512被列为“LAT监测试源”，已有实时未校准流量数据公开，利于快速响应。

最后，综合判断：此次三源同时增强虽无严格时间同步性报道，但集中发生于费米入轨初期（2008年9月起），提示可能与喷流动力学扰动（如激波传播、磁场重联或喷流方向微调）有关；鉴于耀变体光变常具多波段相关性，亟需协调射电、光学、X射线等波段同步观测，以检验辐射模型（如同步自康普顿模型）中电子能谱、磁场强度、光子场密度等关键参数的变化。

根据现象进行分析： Pulse timing of the ongoing outburst of SAX J1808.4-3658 with RXTE Since the start of its current X-ray outburst on 2008 Sep 21 (ATel #1728), the accretion-powered millisecond pulsar SAX J1808.4-3658 has been observed for roughly 10 ks per day with the RXTE PCA. Coherent 401 Hz pulsations are clear throughout at an amplitude of 3-6% rms (2-16 keV). 
We have derived a pulse timing solution for this new outburst by phase connecting the pulsations observed during the interval MJD 54731-54739. The mean spin frequency is 400.9752100(3) Hz, consistent with the frequencies observed during the previous outbursts (Hartman et al. 2008; ApJ 675, 1468). Substantial pulse shape variability in the early part of the outburst, similar to what was observed in 2002 and 2005, makes it difficult to reliably determine whether the spin frequency has changed since the previous outburst. Additional observations should soon resolve this question. 
The orbital elements for the current outburst are as follows: 
Â Â Â Orbital period: 7249.159(8) s   
Â Â Â Projected semimajor axis: 62.803(8) lt-ms   
Â Â Â Time of ascending node: 54733.019537(2) MJD [TDB] 
(Ascending node is defined as the point at 90 degrees mean longitude. All the errors quoted are 1 sigma). This ephemeris is consistent with previous outbursts. By comparing the times of ascending node for the five outbursts observed by RXTE, we find an orbital period derivative of 3.78(6)x10-12 s/s. This value agrees with the orbital period derivative previously reported by Hartman et al. (2008) and Di Salvo et al. (2008; MNRAS 389, 185). The anomalously rapid evolution of the orbital period has continued unchanged. 
The 2-16 keV flux was 40-50 mCrab during MJD 54733-54739. Around MJD 54739, the flux started slowly decreasing as the outburst apparently entered its "slow decay" stage (Hartman et al. 2008). Additional RXTE observations are planned. 2008-10-04 08:56:00
response:
该现象描述了X射线暂现源SAX J1808.4−3658在2008年9月21日开始的最新一次爆发期间的脉冲计时观测结果。首先，RXTE/PCA对源进行了持续约10 ks/天的监测，清晰探测到频率为401 Hz、幅度为3–6% rms（2–16 keV）的相干毫秒脉冲，表明其作为吸积供能毫秒脉冲星的本质未变。通过相位连接MJD 54731–54739期间的脉冲信号，得到平均自转频率为400.9752100(3) Hz，与此前2002、2005和2008年早期爆发中测得的频率一致，说明长期自转演化稳定；但爆发初期脉冲轮廓显著变化，导致难以精确判定是否存在微小的自转频率跃变（glitch）或自转减慢/加快，需更多数据确认。

其次，轨道参数拟合给出轨道周期7249.159(8) s、投影半长轴62.803(8) lt-ms、升交点时刻54733.019537(2) MJD（TDB），所有参数均与历史爆发一致，表明双星轨道构型未发生突变。进一步整合RXTE观测的五次爆发升交点时刻，导出轨道周期导数为3.78(6)×10⁻¹² s/s，与Hartman et al. (2008) 和 Di Salvo et al. (2008) 的独立测量结果吻合，证实该源存在持续且异常快的轨道周期衰减——这一现象无法由标准引力波辐射或磁制动解释，暗示可能存在额外的质量转移率变化、潮汐耗散增强或伴星内部结构演化等机制。

最后，2–16 keV能段流量在MJD 54733–54739维持于40–50 mCrab，符合典型I型X射线暴发的峰值光度水平；至MJD 54739起流量开始缓慢下降，标志进入“慢衰减”阶段，与Hartman et al. (2008) 总结的爆发光变共性一致，反映吸积盘内区物质耗尽、吸积率系统性降低的过程。后续RXTE观测计划将有助于追踪衰减曲线形态、约束吸积流动力学及检验轨道演化模型。

根据现象进行分析： AXP 1E1547.0-5408: Swift-XRT analysis Swift-XRT started observing the field of the AXP 1E1547.0-5408 82 seconds after the first BAT trigger (Krimm et al., GCN Circ. 8311) and a clear X-ray source was found. Using 84 s of XRT Photon Counting mode data and 1 UVOT images, we find an astrometrically corrected X-ray position (using the XRT-UVOT alignment and matching UVOT field sources to the USNO-B1 catalogue) of RA, Dec = 237.72433, -54.30643 which is equivalent to: 
RA (J2000): 15 50 53.84  
Dec (J2000): -54 18 23.2 
with an uncertainty of 1.4 arcsec (radius, 90% confidence). This position is 2.5 arcsec from CXOU J155054.1-541824 (Gelfand & Gaensler 2007), which they identify with 1E1547.0-5408. 
The XRT detected an increased count rate at around 520 s, coincident with one of the BAT spikes mentioned in Krimm et al. (GCN Circ. 8318); similarly a brightening was seen at the time of the second trigger reported in GCN Circ. 8312. In both cases, the XRT registered a single, bright 2.5 s frame of data. 
The spectrum from the first two orbits of PC data can be modelled by a highly-absorbed power-law, with Gamma = 2.33 +0.31/-0.29 and NH = (4.9 +0.8/-0.7) x 10^22 cm^-2. 2008-10-04 14:21:00
response:
首先，观测始于BAT首次触发后82秒，XRT在Photon Counting模式下获得84秒数据，并结合1帧UVOT图像进行天体测量校准：利用XRT-UVOT坐标系对齐及UVOT源与USNO-B1星表的匹配，得到修正后的X射线位置。该位置RA = 237.72433°、Dec = -54.30643°（即J2000历元下RA 15h50m53.84s，Dec -54°18′23.2″），误差半径为1.4角秒（90%置信度）。该位置与CXOU J155054.1-541824（Gelfand & Gaensler 2007）相距仅2.5角秒，而后者已被证认为AXP 1E1547.0-5408，因此可确认XRT探测到的源即为目标源。

其次，XRT光变曲线显示两次显著增亮事件：一次发生在约520秒处，与Krimm等（GCN #8318）报道的BAT耀发峰值时间一致；另一次对应GCN #8312报道的第二次BAT触发时刻。两次事件中XRT均仅记录到单帧、持续2.5秒的高计数率数据，表明源存在短时标、剧烈的X射线耀发行为，符合磁星典型爆发特征。

最后，基于前两个轨道的PC模式谱数据拟合结果表明，能谱可用高度吸收的幂律模型描述：光子指数Γ = 2.33⁺⁰·³¹₋₀·₂₉，吸收柱密度NH = (4.9⁺⁰·⁸₋₀·₇) × 10²² cm⁻²。该NH值显著高于银河系视线方向的平均消光，说明源本身处于高吸收环境，可能位于银河系旋臂深处或被自身周围致密物质包裹；而Γ ≈ 2.3属于较硬的幂律谱，常见于磁星爆发间歇期或低流量态下的非热辐射成分，暗示辐射机制可能涉及磁层中相对论性粒子的同步辐射或曲率辐射。

根据现象进行分析： Nova candidate 2008-09b in M31 galaxy is not a nova We report the spectroscopic observations of an optical nova candidate 2008-09b (RA 00:40:31.94, +41:06:25.0, J2000) discovered by F. Yuan et al., (http://www.cfa.harvard.edu/iau/CBAT_M31.html) on 2008 Sep. 20.15 UT at the maximum brightness of 18.5 ROTSE unfiltered mag. The spectrum was taken using the Russian 6-m telescope and SCORPIO spectral camera on 2008 Oct. 2.032 UT. The spectrum range is 390-755 nm, resolution 1.3 nm. The brightness of the object was 20.3 mag in the V band at the moment of observation. BTA CCD unfiltered magnitude was 18.4 what did not confirm the variability of this star since its discovery.   
  
The spectrum of 2008-09b is very red and does not belong to a classical nova. Multiple TiO bands, and weak narrow Halpha line are presented. Spectral class is a supergiant M9. This spectrum closely resembles both spectra of Galactic peculiar red novae remnants, V4332 Sgr and V838 Mon taken in 2007.   
  
We found this star in the infrared POSS II-N plate taken on 1993 Sep. 23 UT at the level of 18.0 in the I band. The star is under the plate limit of R=21.0 in the POSS II red plate taken on 1989 Oct 1 UT, and is unseen in other POSS plates, too. The object is identical to 2MASS 00403197 +4106243 (J=17.0+/-0.2; H=15.34+/-0.12; K=14.85+/-0.10). So, this star is seen in all infrared or unfiltered images, and may be constant red supergiant star. If a red nova, this star exploded before 1993. 
Spectrum of M31N 2008-09b 2008-10-04 19:06:00
response:
该天体被证伪为经典新星，原因如下：  
首先，光谱观测显示其具有显著的TiO分子吸收带和微弱且窄的Hα发射线，整体光谱呈极红特征，光谱型为M9 I型超巨星，与经典新星典型的宽发射线（如Hα、He II、N II、O III等）、高激发态谱线及连续谱陡峭蓝移特征完全不符；  
其次，历史测光数据表明其亮度长期稳定：POSS II-N红外底片（1993年）中已存在，I波段星等约18.0，而POSS II-R红波段底片（1989年）未探测到（极限星等R=21.0），结合2MASS多波段测光（J/H/K均明亮且一致），说明该源是持续存在的红超巨星，而非爆发后快速变亮又衰减的新星；  
再次，其光谱与银河系内已知的红新星遗迹V4332 Sgr和V838 Mon在2007年的光谱高度相似，但二者本身已被确认为恒星并合事件产生的红新星（red nova），其光谱本质是冷膨胀包层主导的分子带谱，与热致核燃烧驱动的经典新星物理机制截然不同；  
最后，发现时报告的“变亮”现象未被后续观测证实：BTA望远镜在发现后约两周测得的无滤光片星等（18.4 mag）与ROTSE发现时最大亮度（18.5 mag）基本一致，且V波段观测时已暗至20.3 mag，说明不存在典型新星光变曲线中的快速上升与指数衰减行为。  
综上，M31N 2008-09b实为一颗本征亮度稳定的M9型红超巨星，其被误判为新星源于对早期测光数据的时间覆盖不足与光谱类型识别偏差。

根据现象进行分析： Swift XRT follow-up of the transient AXP 1E1547.0-5408 in outburst  We report on the preliminary results of the first Swift-XRT observations of the transient AXP 1E1547.0-5408 (Krimm et al. GCN 8311, 8312). We analyzed the observation performed on 2008, October 3rd (orbit 1 : UT 9:31 - 9:51, orbit 2 : UT 10:54 - 11:28, and orbit 3 : UT 13:34 - 12:53) in PC mode, and on 2008, October 3rd-4th (UT 12:53 - 01:37) carried out in WT mode.
Preliminary spectral study of these observations found the source at a persistent flux >50 times with respect to its quiescent level, and with a spectrum significantly harder than the pre-burst one. 
Fitting simultaneously the pre-burst and the post-burst spectra with an absorbed power-law gives the following parameters (with an NH = (5.1Â±0.6)Ã10^22 cm^-2; 90% c.l. are reported).
\-- Pre-bursts (XRT July-Sept 2008):  
powerlaw PhoIndex 5.4Â±0.5  
2-10 keV observed flux 8Ã10^-13 ergs cm^-2 s^-1
\-- First orbit (2008-10-03 UT 9:31 - 9:51):  
powerlaw PhoIndex 1.9Â±0.3  
2-10 keV observed flux 7Ã10^-11 ergs cm^-2 s^-1
\-- Second orbit (2008-10-03 UT 10:54 - 11:28):  
powerlaw PhoIndex 2.9Â±0.3  
2-10 keV observed flux 5Ã10^-11 ergs cm^-2 s^-1
\-- Third orbit (2008-10-03 UT 13:34 - 12:53):  
powerlaw PhoIndex 2.6Â±0.3  
2-10 keV observed flux 5Ã10^-11 ergs cm^-2 s^-1
\-- WT data (2008-10-03 UT 12:53 - 2008-10-04 UT 01:37):  
powerlaw PhoIndex 3.2Â±0.2   
2-10keV observed flux 4Ã10^-11 ergs cm^-2 s^-1
We note that the time interval of the first orbit includes a number of bursts detected by BAT (GCN 8318).
Timing analysis was performed with data carried out in WT mode after having removed bursts and corrected the photon arrival times to the barycenter of the Solar System. Pulsations at about 2s were clearly detected. A refined period measurement was obtained by means of a phase fitting technique, and corresponds to a best-fit value of P=2.071336(3)s (1 sigma c.l.). The pulse shape is mainly sinusoidal with a background-subtracted pulsed fraction of about 25Â±1%. Period, pulsed fraction and pulse shape are significantly different from those reported in literature (P=2.069961s , PF=4%; Camilo et al. 2008, ApJ, 679, 681; Halpern et al. 2008, ApJ, 676, 1178). 
Further Swift GO observations are planned in order to monitor the new outburst of 1E1547.0-5408 during the next weeks. 2008-10-04 19:31:00
response:
该现象描述了磁星1E1547.0−5408在2008年10月初的一次爆发活动，Swift卫星XRT载荷对其开展了及时的后续观测。首先，观测时间覆盖多个轨道：PC模式下于10月3日分三次短时观测（轨道1–3），随后在同日12:53起转入WT模式持续观测至10月4日01:37。值得注意的是，轨道1的时间窗口内叠加了BAT探测到的多次短时爆发事件，因此其光谱和光度反映的是爆发态叠加后的整体表现。

光度演化方面，所有爆发后观测的2–10 keV通量均达~4–7×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，相较宁静期（8×10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹）增强超过50倍，证实系统进入显著高流量状态。光谱硬化特征明确：幂律谱指数从宁静期的5.4±0.5陡降至爆发初期的1.9±0.3，随后在后续轨道中缓慢回升至2.6–3.2，表明爆发早期存在最硬、最致密的能量释放过程，可能对应磁层重联或星震触发的非热电子加速主导阶段，随时间推移逐渐过渡为热成分占比上升或吸收效应变化所致的软化趋势。

计时分析仅基于剔除爆发事件后的WT模式数据，并完成太阳系质心校正，从而获得可靠的周期测量：P = 2.071336(3) s。该值较文献报道的宁静期自转周期（2.069961 s）明显变长，对应自转减慢量ΔP/P ≈ 6.7×10⁻⁴，折合自转频率下降率|Ṗ| ~ 1.4×10⁻¹¹ s s⁻¹，暗示爆发期间存在强磁偶极辐射制动或内部扭矩突变。同时，脉冲轮廓由原先的弱调制（PF = 4%）转变为显著正弦型且调制深度达25±1%，说明辐射几何结构发生根本性改变——可能源于磁层扭曲导致的可见极区扩大、热点位置迁移，或辐射束方向性增强。

综上，该现象呈现典型的磁星爆发多维响应：光度剧增、光谱硬化、自转减速、脉冲轮廓与调制深度剧变，共同指向一次由内部能量释放（如星震或磁层不稳定性）驱动的大尺度磁层重构事件。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Discovery and Classification of Nova in M81 : P60-M81-080925  On UT 2008 Sep 25.49, P60-FasTING (Palomar 60-inch Fast Transients In Nearby Galaxies) discovered a nova in M81 at RA(J2000) = 09:55:59.35 DEC(J2000) = +69:05:57.1, offset from the nucleus by 2.35'E, 2.03'N. P60-M81-080925 had a brightness of g=19.5 +/- 0.1 at discovery (photometric calibration wrt SDSS catalog) and faded to g=20.8 on Oct 4.49. It is not detected, with 3-sigma upper limits of g > 21.5 on Jul 9.19. Spectroscopic confirmation was obtained on Sep 29.51 using the Double Beam Spectrograph on the Hale telescope. Prominent Balmer lines (H-alpha FWHM ~3000 km/s through H-epsilon) are detected. Fe II(42) lines secure the classification to Fe II nova (following Williams et al 94). 2008-10-05 18:15:00
response: 该天体于2008年9月25.49 UT被P60-FasTING巡天发现，位于M81星系内，坐标为RA(J2000) = 09:55:59.35，DEC(J2000) = +69:05:57.1，距星系核2.35角分东、2.03角分北，排除了活动星系核或超新星遗迹等中心区域常见源的可能性。发现时g波段星等为19.5 ± 0.1，经SDSS测光定标，表明其为一个中等亮度的暂现源；至10月4.49 UT已变暗至g = 20.8，约9.9天内光度下降1.3等，符合经典新星早期快速衰减特征。更早的7月9.19 UT观测中未探测到该源，3σ上限为g > 21.5，说明其在发现前至少两个月内尚未爆发，支持其为新爆发事件而非长周期变星或矮新星。9月29.51 UT的Hale望远镜光谱显示显著Balmer线系（Hα至Hε），Hα FWHM ≈ 3000 km/s，属于典型新星光谱展宽范围（区别于超新星的万km/s量级或致密星吸积盘的窄线）；同时检测到Fe II(42)发射线系，依据Williams et al. (1994)分类标准，Fe II型新星以强Fe II线和中等速度（~1000–3000 km/s）的Balmer线为标志，对应较低电离态、较厚包层的热核失控模型，因此可确证其为Fe II型经典新星。

根据现象进行分析： Recent optical variability in LSI +61 303 We have been monitoring the optical counterpart of the TeV emitting binary LSI +61 303 (V615 Cas) since November 2005 with the Faulkes Telescope North (on Haleakala, Maui), as part of a program to monitor long-term variability in X-ray binaries. Prompted by the recent SGR-like burst observed from a source in the region of LSI +61 303 (GCN 8209; ATel #1715; see also ATel #1731, #1740), we searched for unusual optical activity during the last two months (3rd August - 1st October).   
  
Using differential photometry with respect to three nearby stars, we find long-term variations of amplitude ~ 0.1 magnitudes in u' B V R i'-bands; similar to that found over an 8-year period by Paredes et al. (1994). Our light curves are here. There is a dip in the light curves on 9th September 14:23 UT - the date closest to the SGR-like burst (10th September at 12:52:21 UT; ATel #1715). The dip, of ~ 0.054 mag (compared to the observations either side of this date: 5th and 13th September) is sharp compared to the long-term variations and exists in all five filters. However, there is also a slightly less prominent dip on 30th August, and it is difficult to assess how significant the 9th September dip is. We cannot therefore solidly associate the SGR-like burst with unusual optical behaviour in LSI +61 303. In addition, we do not find any unusual optical activity around the time of the X-ray flaring from a source in the region of LSI +61 303 on 21st August (ATel #1730).   
  
Note that if the burst was emitted by a magnetar hosted in the LSI +61 303 system, in principle one would not expect a strong variability in the optical band, as this is dominated by the emission of the massive companion star. However, no magnetar in an X-ray binary has ever been observed so far, hence no comparison can be made.   
  
We will continue to monitor the source for the next few months while it remains visible to Faulkes Telescope North. The Faulkes Telescope Project is an educational and research arm of the Las Cumbres Observatory Global Telescope Network (LCOGTN). FL acknowledges support from the Dill Faulkes Educational Trust. 
Lightcurve of LS I +61 303 2008-10-06 13:27:00
response:
首先，观测目标是TeV辐射双星系统LSI +61 303（即V615 Cas）的光学对应体，监测时间自2005年11月起，使用北法尔克斯坦望远镜（FTN）。本次分析聚焦于2008年8月3日至10月1日期间——即紧邻GCN 8209通报的SGR类爆发（2008年9月10日12:52:21 UT）前后约一个月的光学光变行为。

其次，采用差分测光法，以三颗邻近恒星为参考，在u'、B、V、R、i'五个波段获得光变曲线。观测到长期变化幅度约0.1 mag，与Paredes等人（1994）在8年跨度中发现的变幅一致，表明该系统存在固有的准周期或缓变光学活动。

第三，关键时间点比对显示：在9月9日14:23 UT观测到一个显著的光学凹陷，深度约0.054 mag（相对于9月5日和13日的观测值），且该凹陷在全部五个滤光片中均存在，形态尖锐，区别于缓慢的长期变光，时间上最接近SGR类爆发（仅相差约22小时）。然而，8月30日也出现一个略浅的类似凹陷，削弱了9月9日事件的唯一性与统计显著性；文中明确指出“难以评估其显著性”，因此无法确立因果或物理关联。

第四，进一步排查发现：8月21日该天区另有一次X射线耀发（ATel #1730），但对应时段未见异常光学活动，进一步削弱光学—高能事件共现的可靠性。

第五，从物理机制角度分析：若该SGR类爆发确实源于LSI +61 303系统内的磁星，则预期光学波段不应呈现强变异性，因其主导成分是大质量伴星（B0 Ve型主序星）的热辐射，而磁星自身的光学辐射极弱；但目前尚无任何已知磁星存在于X射线双星系统中的先例，故缺乏经验性参照，该假说既不可证伪，亦无支持性证据。

综上，尽管9月9日光学凹陷在时间与形态上具有引人注意的巧合性，但因缺乏统计显著性、存在类比事件（8月30日凹陷）、高能事件与光学响应无系统性对应、且理论预期不支持强光学响应，故不能确立LSI +61 303与该SGR类爆发之间的物理关联。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Renewed radio activity from H1743-322  observed with the ATCA  Following the reactivation of H1743-322 (also known as IGR J17464-3213) as observed by INTEGRAL (Atel #1745 and #1739), we have conducted radio observations with the Australia Telescope Compact Array on 2008 October, 5 . A radio source is detected at a position consistent with the location of H1743-322 with preliminary flux densities of 2.30 +/- 0.10 mJy at 4.8 GHz and 1.80 +/- 0.15 mJy at 8.6 GHz, giving a spectral index of -0.42 +/- 0.16. The radio spectral index during this ATCA observation seems to favour optically thin synchrotron emission from H1743-322, which is surprising for a source that was still -- until recently -- in the hard state (Atel #1745 ). However, we note that now in the RXTE/ASM weather map (http://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/cgi-bin/xte_weather/xte_lc?source=H1743-322), H1743-322 is detected at a level of ~5 c/s, while it seems to have reached a plateau in hard X-rays as observed with Swift/BAT (http://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/weak/IGRJ17464-3213 ). This seems to suggest that that H1743-322 may be undergoing a state transition from the hard state to a softer state. The detected radio emission would likely arises from the compact jets (possibly in the "unstable phase" observed during the brightest part of the initial hard state, see Fender et al. 2004, MNRAS 355, 1105). If this interpretation is correct, a major relativistic ejection event would then be expected in the coming days. Further observations are strongly encouraged to cover this transient episode. 2008-10-07 12:45:00
response: 首先，观测到H1743-322在INTEGRAL卫星监测下重新激活（ATel #1739、#1745），表明其X射线活动增强；随后ATCA在2008年10月5日开展射电观测，探测到与该源位置一致的射电源，通量密度为2.30±0.10 mJy（4.8 GHz）和1.80±0.15 mJy（8.6 GHz），由此计算出射电谱指数为−0.42±0.16。该谱指数负值中等，落在典型光学薄同步辐射谱指数范围（≈−0.5至−0.7）内，因此支持射电辐射源于光学薄同步辐射机制。然而，这与此前该源仍处于硬态（hard state）的判断看似矛盾，因为硬态黑洞X射线双星通常呈现平谱或轻微倒置谱（α ≳ 0，定义为S_ν ∝ ν^α），对应于光学厚喷流；而光学薄谱则更常见于软态或硬态向软态过渡阶段的喷流退耦或喷流减弱阶段。进一步分析多波段数据：RXTE/ASM显示其硬X射线计数率升至约5 c/s，且Swift/BAT光变曲线显示硬X射线流量已达平台期——这并非持续上升的硬态特征，而是硬态末期、即将发生状态跃迁的典型迹象。结合Fender等人（2004）对类似源（如GX 339−4）的研究，硬态早期最强阶段可能伴随不稳定的致密喷流，并在状态转变前夕产生相对论性物质抛射；当前射电谱呈光学薄、通量中等、尚未显著衰减，正符合“不稳定喷流相”末期特征。因此，该射电辐射最可能源自正在退耦或开始减速的紧凑喷流，而非稳态硬态喷流。若此解释成立，则系统已进入状态转换临界相，预计在未来数日内将爆发明显的相对论性喷流抛射事件（即射电耀发），需立即开展高频次、宽频段（尤其是更高频率如22 GHz或VLBI）射电监测，以捕捉可能的光变拐点、谱形演化及自行运动证据。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Clarification of orbital elements for SAX J1808.4-3658 In Atel#1760 we posted an incorrect definition of the ascending node as "the point at 90 degrees mean longitude". The correct definition of the ascending node is "the point at 0 degrees true longitude". The orbital elements themselves are correct as given in Atel#1760. 2008-10-07 15:38:00
response: 首先，需要明确轨道根数中“升交点”的定义。原文指出，在ATel#1760中错误地将升交点定义为“平经度90度的位置”，但该定义不正确。根据标准天体力学定义，升交点是指轨道与参考平面（通常是赤道面或黄道面）相交、且天体由南向北穿越该平面的点；在极坐标或轨道几何中，该点对应于真经度（true longitude）为0度的位置，即从参考方向（如春分点）起算、沿轨道正向测量的真位置角为0°处。平经度（mean longitude）是平近点角与角动量方向相关参数的组合，受摄动影响且不直接对应几何交点位置，因此不能用平经度90度来定义升交点。值得注意的是，尽管定义表述有误，但ATel#1760中所列的具体轨道根数值（如升交点经度Ω等）本身无误，说明数值计算和拟合过程未受影响，错误仅限于文字说明层面。

根据现象进行分析： Unusual CRTS Transient We have detected an optical transient of unknown nature in Catalina 0.7m Schmidt telescope images from 28 Sep 2008 UT. The object has the following parameters:   

CSS080928:160837+041626|  2008-09-28 UT 02:50:49 |  RA 16:08:37.23 |  Dec 04:16:26.7 |  Mag 17.7 |  Type ?  
---|---|---|---|---|---  
A possible uncataloged match to the transient is present in SDSS images with magnitude r~22.5. The transient is visible in Catalina images dating back to Sep 13th 2007 and is gradually brightening suggesting the transient may be distant, high amplitude (~5 mags), long period variable. However, the object is not seen in archival DSS1 and DSS2, 2MASS, or PQ images covering this location. Furthermore, follow-up photometry taken with the Palomar 60" telescope on Sep. 29.12 UT gives g=18.3, g-r=1.0, r-i=-0.5 and g=18.1, g-r=0.7, r-i=-0.32 on Oct 10.12. The r-i colours fall far from the stellar locus and the colours expected for long period variables. Further follow-up is requested.   

For finding charts and discovery images please see: http://voeventnet.cacr.caltech.edu/feeds/ATEL/CRTS.    
CRTS optical transients are detected and published as VOEvents in real-time at http://voeventnet.org/feeds/Catalina.shtml  and in RSS here http://voeventnet.caltech.edu/feeds/Catfeed.xml 2008-10-07 23:51:00
response:
该光学暂现源CSS080928:160837+041626具有以下关键观测特征：  
首先，它在CRTS巡天中被首次明确探测到的时间为2008年9月28日，但回溯发现其早在2007年9月13日即已存在，表明该源并非典型短时标爆发（如超新星、伽马暴余辉或耀星），而是持续存在至少一年以上；  
其次，其光变行为呈现“逐渐变亮”趋势，且幅度达约5等，暗示可能为高振幅长周期变星（如刍藁型变星Mira），但该假说与多组矛盾证据冲突：SDSS测得的宿主星r≈22.5等远暗于暂现源峰值亮度（mag=17.7），说明暂现源并非叠加在明亮恒星上的耀发，而更可能是位于一个极暗宿主中的主导光源；  
第三，该位置在DSS1、DSS2、2MASS及PQ等深场归档图像中均无任何对应体，排除了常见银河系内亮变星（其宿主通常可在蓝红波段底片中检出）；同时r−i色指数分别为−0.5和−0.32，显著偏离恒星主序及红巨星分支在SDSS色–色图中的分布区域（典型晚型星r−i > 0.5），亦不满足Mira型变星在极大亮度时的红化特征（通常r−i > 1.0）；  
第四，g−r颜色由0.7增至1.0，伴随r−i保持负值且略有变蓝，表明其光谱能量分布随时间发生非单调演化，不符合经典脉动变星的周期性颜色-光度关系；  
综上，该暂现源既不具备典型致密天体爆发的短时标特性，也不符合已知长周期变星的光变幅度、颜色演化及宿主环境特征，其长期存在、大振幅增亮、极暗宿主缺失、异常蓝红外色指数共同指向一种罕见或未知的物理起源，例如：极端贫金属矮星的异常耀发、新型激变变星的超长周期吸积爆发、或背景星系中低光度活动星系核（AGN）的间歇性喷流增强，但均需更高分辨率成像与光谱证认。

The 2-20 keV pulse profile of these observations (October 04 UT 21:51:04, October 06 UT 01:46:04, and October 06 UT 23:31:04) shows a single broad pulse that is qualitatively similar to that reported in Halpern et al. (2008, ApJ, 676, 1178), though there is a possible hint of additional peaks. The 2-20 keV RMS pulsed fluxes in these three observations are 0.56 +/- 0.06 counts/s/PCU (with 2 operational PCUs), 0.55 +/- 0.10 counts/s/PCU (with 4 PCUs), and 0.44 +/- 0.09 counts/s/PCU (with 2 PCUs). Assuming the spectral parameters reported by Gelfand & Gaensler (2007, ApJ, 664, 1111; these parameters have likely changed in outburst; see Halpern et al. 2008), the unabsorbed pulsed flux in the 0.5-10 keV band is ~9x10^{-10} erg/s/cm2, a factor of >30 larger than reported by GG07 and at least twice the largest reported thus far (Halpern et al. 2008). Using phase-coherent timing performed on these three observations, we find a pulse period of 2.0713474(7) s. This confirms the period reported in ATEL #1763. This implies frequency derivative, measured since June 2007 (see Camilo et al. 2008, ApJ, 679, 681) of ~-8.6x10^{-12} s^-2, larger than has been seen thus far. Our preliminary burst searching reveals at least 4 bursts, and possibly as many as 14 bursts, during the 4 ks observation, and at least 4 additional bursts in the first observation on October 06. A more detailed study of these data is underway, and additional RXTE Target-of-Opportunity observations are scheduled. 2008-10-08 05:51:00
response: 该现象描述了对磁星AXP 1E 1547-5407在爆发期间利用RXTE卫星开展的X射线脉动观测。首先，三次观测时间集中在2008年10月4日至6日，总曝光时间约7 ks，覆盖其当前爆发态（见ATEL #1756等）。脉冲轮廓在2–20 keV能段呈现单峰主导结构，与Halpern et al. (2008)报道的形态基本一致，但存在额外峰的初步迹象，提示脉冲结构可能在爆发中发生细微演化。其次，RMS脉冲流量在不同PCU配置下分别为0.56、0.55和0.44 counts/s/PCU，经谱参数校正（暂用Gelfand & Gaensler 2007的静止态模型，虽已知其在爆发中不适用），推得0.5–10 keV未吸收脉冲流量达~9×10⁻¹⁰ erg/s/cm²，显著高于此前静止态（>30倍）及先前爆发峰值（≥2倍），表明此次爆发中脉冲辐射强度急剧增强。第三，基于三历元相位连接计时分析，获得高精度自转周期P = 2.0713474(7) s，确认ATEL #1763结果；由此结合2007年6月以来的长期监测（Camilo et al. 2008），导出频率导数ν̇ ≈ −8.6×10⁻¹² s⁻²，为迄今测得的最大负值，反映自转减速率异常增大，暗示磁层扭矩或内部应力在爆发中剧烈增强。最后，爆发态下短时标活动极为活跃：仅4 ks观测即探测到至少4–14个X射线暴，次日首段观测又发现≥4个，暴发频次远超静止态，支持该源处于强磁层活动与星震耦合主导的高能释放阶段。综上，该现象系统呈现爆发态下脉冲强度剧增、脉冲轮廓潜在复杂化、自转减速加速、暴发频繁等多维度协同变化，共同指向磁星内部与磁层能量释放机制在临界失稳后的整体性响应。

根据现象进行分析： Swift phase-coherent P-Pdot solution for the 1E1547.0-5408 outburst  Swift XRT monitored 1E1547.0-5408 in the latest 5 days starting from about 90 seconds since the BAT trigger (Krimm et al. GCN 8311, 8312). During this period observations in the WT mode were carried out for a total exposure time of about 37ks. After having removed bursts and corrected the photon arrival times to the barycenter of the Solar System, the dataset was used to infer a phase-coherent timing solution including both a period and period derivative component. 
According to our preliminary analysis the period and period derivative of 1E1547.0-5408 are: P=2.071335(1)s and Pdot=5.7(5) x 10^-11 s/s (1 sigma uncertainties are reported). We note that the period derivative inferred at the time of the previous outburst was 2.318(5)x10^-11 s/s, with a very high second derivative (Camilo et al. 2007, ApJ, 666, L93; Camilo et al. 2008, ApJ, 679, 681). Therefore, our inferred period derivative value is a factor of two larger than the historical one. The above reported period is within 1-sigma from our first measurement (Esposito et al. 2008, ATel #1763) and at about 7-sigma from the recently reported value inferred from RXTE observations (Dib et al. 2008, ATel #1769). 
The Swift monitoring of 1E1547.0-5408 is still ongoing. 2008-10-08 10:28:00
response: 该现象描述了对磁星1E1547.0−5408在一次爆发期间利用Swift卫星XRT载荷开展的相位相干计时分析。首先，XRT在BAT触发后约90秒起连续5天以内以WT模式观测，总有效曝光时间约37 ks；数据经剔除爆发时段、光子到达时间修正至太阳系质心后，用于构建包含自转周期P及其导数Pdot的相位相干计时模型。初步分析得到P = 2.071335(1) s、Pdot = 5.7(5) × 10⁻¹¹ s/s（1σ误差），其中P与Esposito等人（2008）首次测量值在1σ内一致，但比Dib等人（2008）基于RXTE的近期测量值偏离约7σ，表明不同观测或分析方法可能存在系统性差异。更关键的是，当前Pdot是Camilo等人（2007–2008）在前次爆发中测得的历史值（2.318(5) × 10⁻¹¹ s/s）的约2.5倍，且历史测量已显示存在显著的二阶导数，暗示该源自转减慢率在爆发期间发生剧烈跃变，可能源于星震引发的磁层重构或角动量重分布。这一Pdot跃增现象支持磁星爆发与自转演化强耦合的物理图像，而非孤立的辐射事件。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT Detection of Brightening of the Galactic Plane Source 3EG J0903-3531 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope (formerly GLAST, launched June 11, 2008), has observed an increase in flux from a gamma-ray source in the Galactic Plane consistent with the location of 3EG J0903-3531 (R. Hartman et al. 1999, ApJS, 123, 79) starting on 6 October 2008. The preliminary LAT position is J2000.0: RA=136.25 deg, DEC=-35.45 deg (l=259.59 deg, b=+7.73 deg) with an error circle radius 0.08 deg (statistical). The systematic error on the location is smaller than the statistical error. 
Preliminary analysis indicates that the source has brightened, with a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) exceeding previous levels detected by EGRET (average EGRET flux: 1.6x10-7 photons cm-2 s-1; peak flux 3.2x10-7 photons cm-2 s-1). The source activity did not reach the public reporting threshold of 2x10-6 photons cm-2 s-1 that would trigger a public data release. 
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. In consideration of the activity of this source we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. For this source the Fermi LAT contact person is C.C. Cheung (e-mail: Teddy.Cheung@nasa.gov). 
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2008-10-08 21:17:00
response:
首先，观测到银河系盘面源3EG J0903-3531在费米大视场望远镜（LAT）数据中出现流量增强现象，起始时间为2008年10月6日。该源位于银道面，其J2000历元坐标为赤经136.25度、赤纬−35.45度，对应银经259.59度、银纬+7.73度，位置误差圆半径为0.08度（统计误差），系统误差更小，因此定位精度较高。

其次，该增强表现为E > 100 MeV能段的伽马射线流量显著上升：当前LAT测得的通量已超过EGRET历史平均值（1.6×10⁻⁷ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹）和峰值（3.2×10⁻⁷ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹），说明其活动水平明显高于以往EGRET时期的观测结果。

第三，尽管流量增强显著，但仍未达到费米LAT公开警报阈值（2×10⁻⁶ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹），因此未触发自动公共数据发布，仅以内部通告形式通报。

第四，费米卫星采用全天扫描模式运行，对该源将持续进行常规伽马射线监测；鉴于其活动性增强，特别建议开展多波段协同观测，以识别可能的对应体并研究辐射机制。

最后，LAT仪器本身覆盖20 MeV至300 GeV以上能段，由NASA、美国能源部及法、意、日、瑞典等多国机构联合研制，具备高灵敏度与宽能谱覆盖能力，为该现象的后续分析提供了可靠数据基础。

根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopic confirmation of nova 2008-07a in M31 We obtained low resolution spectra of the optical nova candidate M31N 2008-07a (RA 00 42 34.42, Dec +41 18 15.7, J2000) discovered by M. Henze et al. (ATel #1609) on 2008 July 6.04 UT with an R magnitude of 18.7. Later the nova was discovered independently by K. Hornoch and P. Kusnirak (see CBAT_M31) on July 8. They found the nova on earlier frames dated on June 2.029 UT with an R magnitude of 19.0.   
  
Three spectra were taken on 2008 Oct. 3.00 UT with the Russian 6-m telescope BTA equipped with the SCORPIO spectral camera. The spectral range was 390-755 nm, resolution 1.27 nm. On the time of observations, we measured the star brightness using CCD frames of BTA as follows: R = 18.8, V = 19.1.   
  
M31N 2008-07a shows the typical spectral and photometric behaviour of a slow FeII type nova. The emission lines of the Balmer series are strongest features in the spectrum. The equivalent width of H_alfa is equal to 11 nm. The H_alpha line profile has a FWHM of 450 km/s after correction for spectral resolution. The profile of H_beta is slightly broader (530 km/s). The heliocentric radial velocity of both of these lines is -120 km/s. With an S/N ratio of about 10 in the continuum of the total spectrum, numerous emission Fe II lines are visible as predominant non-Balmer lines. 
Spectrum of M31N 2008-07a: 2008-10-09 15:04:00
response:
首先，观测目标是M31中的光学新星候选体M31N 2008-07a，其坐标为RA 00 42 34.42、Dec +41 18 15.7（J2000），最初由Henze等人于2008年7月6.04 UT发现，R=18.7；随后Hornoch与Kusnirak在更早的6月2.029 UT图像中回溯确认，R=19.0，说明该新星在6月初已爆发并增亮。  

其次，光谱观测于2008年10月3.00 UT使用俄罗斯BTA 6米望远镜与SCORPIO摄谱仪完成，波长范围390–755 nm，分辨率1.27 nm。此时测得R=18.8、V=19.1，表明新星在约4个月后仍保持较亮，未显著衰减，符合慢新星特征。  

第三，光谱呈现典型Fe II型慢新星特征：氢巴尔末线（尤其是Hα和Hβ）为最强发射线；Hα等值宽达11 nm，表明强发射且存在显著连续谱吸收背景；经仪器分辨率修正后，Hα FWHM为450 km/s、Hβ为530 km/s，二者相近但Hβ略宽，反映激发态差异或光学厚效应；两线共同给出的视向速度为−120 km/s，与M31整体系统速度（约−300 km/s）相比偏正，说明新星位于M31盘面内具有本动速度的恒星成分中，或受局部气体运动影响。  

第四，连续谱信噪比约10，足以分辨众多Fe II发射线，且其强度超过其他非巴尔末线，这是Fe II型新星的关键判据——表明抛射包温度较低（<10⁴ K）、电子密度适中（~10⁸–10⁹ cm⁻³），激发出丰富的中性铁禁戒线与共振线，区别于高温、高速、富氦氧的He/N型快新星。  

综上，该源在光度演化时标（从6月初至10月初仍R≈19）、谱线轮廓宽度（~500 km/s量级）、主导谱线成分（强Balmer + 强Fe II）、以及视向速度一致性等方面均满足经典慢Fe II型新星定义，因此光谱证认成立。

根据现象进行分析： The discovery of a new hard X-ray source in the Norma region by INTEGRAL: IGR J16293-4603 A deep INTEGRAL mosaic of the Norma region centered on PSR J1617-5055 combining IBIS ISGRI data collected over the period March 2, 2003 - Feb. 24, 2006 (INTEGRAL Revolutions 46-411) revealed a new hard X-ray source. We name this source IGR J16293-4603, at R.A. = 16 29 21.4 and Dec = -46 03 50 (J2000). The 3 sigma uncertainty on this position is about 3 arcmin. Fitting the 20-300 keV time averaged flux measurements with a power-law model gives a 20-70 keV flux of (1.12 +/-0.14 )E-11 erg/cm2/s and a photon index of 1.85 +/- 0.30. We observed the IBIS ISGRI error circle on Jan. 24, 2008 with the Chandra ACIS-I instrument for about 1.1 ks. We detected only one source (201 source counts) at RA = 16 29 12.87, DEC = -46 02 50.9 (J2000; error 0.6 arcsec 90% confidence) well within the 2-sigma location confidence contour of IGR J16293-4603. 
An absorbed power-law fit to the 0.3-7 keV band spectral data yields a very hard photon index of 1.0 +/- 0.4 with an unabsorbed 0.8-7 keV flux of 5.14E-12 erg/cm2/s and absorbing Hydrogen column density of NH= (0.7 +/- 0.5)E22 cm-2. The soft and hard X-ray spectral properties and the positional coincidence strongly suggest that the Chandra and INTEGRAL source are related.
Optical follow-up observations were obtained with the LDSS3 imaging spectrograph mounted at the 6.5m Magellan telescope on 2008-06-24 01:13 - 01:36 UT. We acquired 180s images (one in the g' and i' bands, three in the r'-band) under seeing conditions of about 1.0 arcsec. Absolute photometric calibration was obtained using observations of a field containing stars calibrated in SDSS. The astrometric scale was defined using 2MASS sources in the field of IGR J16293-4603. The optical images reveal one extended object at the Chandra position. This object is consistent with being at least three unresolved point-like sources. The brightest of these sources falls within the Chandra error circle. PSF-fitting gives g' = 23.38 +/- 0.08, r'= 21.09 +/- 0.02 and i' = 19.45 +/- 0.02 for this optical counterpart candidate.
Current data is consistent with the source being an AGN or a peculiar galactic X-ray binary. We encourage optical follow-up spectroscopy of the optical counterpart candidate to reveal the nature of this source. 2008-10-10 12:18:00
response:
首先，INTEGRAL卫星在Norma区域发现了一个新的硬X射线源IGR J16293-4603，其位置由IBIS/ISGRI仪器测定，精度为3角分（3σ），对应J2000坐标RA=16h29m21.4s、Dec=−46°03′50″。该源在20–300 keV能段的平均能谱可用幂律模型拟合，得到20–70 keV波段流量为(1.12±0.14)×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，光子指数Γ=1.85±0.30，表明其具有典型的硬X射线辐射特征。

其次，Chandra卫星对INTEGRAL误差圆进行了短时（1.1 ks）观测，在0.3–7 keV软X射线波段仅探测到一个点源，位置为RA=16h29m12.87s、Dec=−46°02′50.9″（90%置信度误差0.6角秒），该位置完全落在INTEGRAL源2σ定位等高线内，空间一致性高度显著。其软X射线能谱同样满足吸收幂律模型：光子指数Γ=1.0±0.4（极硬）、吸收柱密度N_H=(0.7±0.5)×10²² cm⁻²、0.8–7 keV未吸收流量为5.14×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s。软硬X射线波段的光谱硬度均偏高，且位置严格重合，强有力支持二者为同一物理源。

第三，Magellan望远镜LDSS3光谱仪开展光学后随观测，在g′、r′、i′波段获得高信噪比图像，测得最亮光学对应体位于Chandra位置处，呈点源或紧致多组分结构，PSF测光给出g′=23.38±0.08、r′=21.09±0.02、i′=19.45±0.02，颜色r′−i′≈1.64，表明存在显著红化，与中等吸收（N_H~10²² cm⁻²）及可能的星系或晚型恒星成分一致。

综上，该源在硬X射线波段强而硬、软X射线波段亦硬且被中等吸收、光学对应体较暗且偏红，空间位置高度一致；其多波段性质既符合中等吸积率活动星系核（AGN）的典型特征（如低光度Seyfert或 obscured AGN），也与某些极端硬谱态的银河系X射线双星（如含有中子星或恒星级黑洞、处于低/硬态且高吸收的系统）相容。当前数据不足以唯一判别其本质，需依赖光学光谱观测以确认红移、发射线/吸收线特征、恒星成分或电离气体性质，从而最终区分AGN与XRB。

This source was recently reported by Linares et al. (ATel #1662) as returning to a quiescent state, based on a Swift/XRT observation on August 14th 2008 (ATel #1662), after a long outburst started on March 2008 (Markwardt & Swank, ATel #1425), during which also SuperAGILE detected the source at hard X-rays at a flux level of about 80 mCrab (Pacciani et al., ATel #1428). The observed X-ray burst lasted approximately 60 sec, starting on 9 October 2008 at 21:26:04 UT. The average flux in the 17-25 keV energy range was about 2.3 Crab, while no significant signal is detected above 25 keV. A search in the SuperAGILE data in the 60 and 600 sec preceding and following the burst provided no evidence of prolonged source activity. The source is currently not detected by SuperAGILE in the standard 20-60 keV energy range, on a daily timescale, with a 3-sigma upper limit of about 20 mCrab. 2008-10-10 13:33:00
response:
首先，SuperAGILE在指向银河系中心区域时探测到一次X射线暴，位置与中子星暂现源SAX J1750.8-2900一致。该源此前已被Linares等人（ATel #1662）确认于2008年8月14日进入宁静态，依据是Swift/XRT的观测结果；而此次暴发发生在2008年10月9日21:26:04 UT，距宁静态确认仅约57天，表明该源可能尚未完全稳定，或存在短暂再激活。

其次，该暴发持续约60秒，能谱集中在17–25 keV，平均流量达2.3 Crab，但25 keV以上无显著信号，说明辐射具有明显的硬X射线特征且截断明显，符合典型热核暴（type-I X-ray burst）的能谱形态，而非持续吸积主导的硬X射线辐射。

第三，在暴发前后各60秒及600秒的时间窗口内，SuperAGILE未探测到任何持续性辐射，排除了暴发源于持续吸积增强或耀发活动的可能性；结合当前日常监测中20–60 keV波段3σ流量上限仅为20 mCrab（即低于宁静态前长期爆发期间80 mCrab水平的1/4），进一步支持该事件是一次孤立、短暂、非持续性的暴发现象。

最后，该暴发发生时间（2008年10月9日）紧邻先前爆发期（2008年3月起）结束之后，且早于已知宁静态确认时间（8月14日），提示Linares等人所认定的“宁静态”可能为短暂低态，或该源存在亚稳态过渡行为——即在正式进入深度宁静前仍可产生偶发热核暴。

No radio counterpart is detected at either frequency. We place formal upper limits (flux density plus 2-sigma) on the radio emission at the optical SN position of 0.068 mJy (8.46 GHz) and 0.108 mJy (22.5 GHz), respectively. We thank the VLA scheduling committee for approving these rapid response observations. 2008-10-10 15:57:00
response:
首先，观测对象是IIn型超新星SN 2008es，该类型超新星的特征是光学光谱中存在窄发射线，通常表明激波与致密、慢速运动的星周介质（CSM）相互作用。  
其次，使用VLA在两个不同时间（9月2.70日和5.69日UT）及两个高频波段（8.46 GHz和22.5 GHz）进行了射电观测，目的是探测激波与CSM相互作用产生的同步辐射。  
第三，两次观测均未探测到射电对应体，仅给出2σ置信水平的流量密度上限：8.46 GHz处为0.068 mJy，22.5 GHz处为0.108 mJy。需注意22.5 GHz上限反而更高，这可能反映高频观测噪声更大或积分时间更短，而非物理上高频辐射更强。  
第四，由于IIn型超新星的射电辐射依赖于激波速度、CSM密度和电子加速效率，未探测到射电信号说明：要么CSM密度较低（导致同步辐射弱），要么激波尚未传播至足够远距离以产生可观测辐射（时间尺度不足），要么磁场较弱或电子加速效率低，抑制了同步辐射产生。  
第五，观测发生在爆发后约数天内（SN 2008es发现于2008年8月底），属于早期射电监测；而IIn型超新星的射电辐射常在数周至数月后达峰，因此早期非探测结果与理论预期一致，并不否定存在致密CSM，仅约束其密度和分布参数的上限。
