根据现象进行分析： Two New X-Ray Sources in M31 and M31GC J004234+405709 Observed by Chandra We report the discovery of two previously unseen X-ray sources detected in a 5ks Chandra/ACIS observation starting on 2008-10-13.15 UT as part of our ongoing Chandra/HST M31 transient program. Due to the low number of counts, no detailed spectral analysis was possible. The spectra were modelled with an absorbed power law of nH = 6.67e20 atoms/cm2 (the Galactic value towards M31), Γ = 1.7 and a distance of 780 kpc.  
  
  
CXOM31 J004243.8+411612  
  
This source was detected on the ACIS-I chip at coordinates RA(J2000) 00:42:43.80, Dec(J2000) +41:16:12.54, with a centroid position error of 0.09" (subject to the standard bore-sight correction). This places the source ~7" NW of the centre of M31. The estimated unabsorbed luminosity in the 0.3-8 keV range is 1.2e37 erg/s. There is not enough information to determine whether this source is a neutron star or a black hole in outburst. We note this source was not in outburst on 2008-09-01 at the time of our previous observation of this field with Chandra.  
  
  
CXOM31 J004243.9+411610  
  
This source was detected on the ACIS-I chip at coordinates RA(J2000) 00:42:43.93, Dec(J2000) +41:16:10.59, with centroid position errors of 0.14" and 0.12", respectively (subject to the standard bore-sight correction). This places the source ~5" NW of the centre of M31. Studying older ACIS-I observations we find that this source first appeared on 31 July 2006 at Lx = 1.4e36 erg/s and peaked on 24 September 2006 at Lx = 1.8e37 erg/s, after which it has remained at luminosities in the (4-7)e36 erg/s range. This behaviour and luminosity is consistent with the source being a black hole or a neutron star X-ray binary.  
  
We note that Swift observed this same field on the two subsequent days after our Chandra observations (Henze et al. 2008, ATel #1806). We inspected the Swift data and conclude that their non-detection of these sources is due to the brevity of the Swift observations coupled with a larger PSF that wouldn't resolve these sources from each other, as they are ~2.4" apart.  
  
  
M31GC J004234+405709 (Bol 117)  
  
Within the same observation, we observed the M31 globular cluster Bol 117 with the ACIS-S3 chip. Its spectrum is well described by an absorbed power law plus disk black body whose parameters are:  
  
nH = 2.4e21 atoms/cm2  
Γ = 1.8  
Tin = 2.2 keV  
  
The luminosity in the 0.3-8 keV range is 1.9e38 erg/s (assuming a distance of 780 kpc to M31). The spectrum is dominated by the power law component, with the disk contributing only 10% to the total flux. While these characteristics are consistent with a black hole transient in a hard state (as defined by McClintock & Remillard 2005), we cannot rule out the possibility that a number of neutron star X-ray binaries are in outburst simultaneously. Given the high Lx and the number of NS XRBs it would take to reach this luminosity, and the fact that past observations of this globular cluster have shown transient X-ray activity at the ~3e37 erg/s level (Williams et al. 2006, ApJ 643, 356, object s1-1), it is likely that we are observing emission from a single source. The persistent X-ray luminosity from this GC is <1e36 erg/s (Williams et al. 2006).  
  
Further observations of these sources are encouraged. 2008-10-27 22:23:00
response:
该文本描述了钱德拉X射线天文台在M31（仙女座星系）及其球状星团Bol 117中发现的三个X射线源，其中两个为新发现的暂现源（CXOM31 J004243.8+411612 和 CXOM31 J004243.9+411610），一个为球状星团内已知源M31GC J004234+405709（Bol 117）的高光度状态。分析如下：

首先，两个新源均位于M31核区西北约5–7角秒处，空间距离极近（仅约2.4角秒分离），且均被ACIS-I探测到；因观测时间短（5 ks）、光子统计不足，无法进行精细能谱拟合，故统一采用银河系视线方向吸收柱密度（nH = 6.67×10²⁰ cm⁻²）、幂律指数Γ = 1.7、距离780 kpc进行简单建模。该假设虽便于估算光度，但未考虑M31自身星际介质可能带来的额外吸收，尤其对靠近核区的源而言，实际nH可能更高，导致光度被低估。

CXOM31 J004243.8+411612的0.3–8 keV未吸收光度为1.2×10³⁷ erg/s，且在2008年9月1日前次观测中未被探测到，表明其为一次新爆发事件；由于缺乏时变与能谱信息，无法区分中子星或黑洞吸积系统——该光度处于典型X射线双星暂现源的黑洞/中子星共存区间（10³⁶–10³⁸ erg/s），且硬态主导的可能性不能排除。

CXOM31 J004243.9+411610表现出明确的暂现演化：最早见于2006年7月31日（Lx ≈ 1.4×10³⁶ erg/s），9月24日达峰（1.8×10³⁷ erg/s），此后维持在(4–7)×10³⁶ erg/s水平；该长期光变轮廓符合X射线双星衰减期行为，峰值光度接近爱丁顿极限下中子星典型值（~2×10³⁸ erg/s对应1.4 M⊙中子星），但亦在恒星级黑洞暂现源常见范围内（10³⁷–10³⁸ erg/s）；其持续数月的中等光度平台更倾向支持稳定吸积盘主导的黑洞性质，但中子星低磁场系统（如AT2021ebf类）亦可呈现类似行为。

M31GC J004234+405709（Bol 117）的能谱需双成分拟合（吸收幂律+盘热辐射），nH = 2.4×10²¹ cm⁻²显著高于银河系前景值，反映球状星团本征吸收或致密环境遮蔽；Tin = 2.2 keV远超典型中子星软X射线暂现源内盘温度（0.8–1.5 keV），而与黑洞硬态下高温冕-盘耦合模型相符；光度1.9×10³⁸ erg/s超出单个中子星爱丁顿极限（≈1.8×10³⁸ erg/s），且远高于该星团历史持久光度（<10³⁶ erg/s）及先前暂现峰值（~3×10³⁷ erg/s），结合其谱形主导成分是幂律（90%流量）、热成分仅占10%，更支持单一恒星级黑洞暂现源处于硬态，而非多中子星叠加——因后者需至少6–7个同时爆发的中子星XRB才能达到此光度，概率极低，且难以协调其能谱一致性。

Swift未能探测到前两者，主因是其点扩散函数（PSF）较大（~18角秒）且曝光时间短，导致两源无法分辨并被淹没于背景；而Chandra的高分辨（亚角秒）与高灵敏度使其得以分离并定位。

综上，三个源均为M31内暂现X射线活动事件：前两者为新识别的核区暂现体，性质待定；后者为球状星团内迄今最亮的X射线暂现事件，现有证据更倾向黑洞吸积系统。

根据现象进行分析： Optical Observations of EXO 0748-676 in Quiescence EXO 0748-676 has been reported to be in X-ray quiescence by Wolff et al. (ATEL #1812). We performed optical (R band) and near-IR (J band) observations of the optical counterpart, UY Vol, on 2008 October 28.33 using Andicam on the SMARTS 1.3m telescope. We obtained a total of 1350 sec exposure in R and 1000 sec in J. The observations corresponds to binary orbital phases 0.38-0.49. 
The counterpart is detected in R but clearly considerably fainter than previously observed. From our preliminary photometry, we estimate R=21.9+/-0.1. No counterpart is visible in the J band images. 
The quiescent position measured relative to nearby stars agrees with that previously measured in the bright state using the same instrument to better than 0.2 pixels (0.1 arcsec) so we believe this is indeed the X-ray binary rather than a previously undetected interloper. 
We will continue to monitor the source. 2008-10-28 19:02:00
response: 该光学观测报告描述了中子星X射线双星系统EXO 0748–676在X射线宁静态下的多波段行为。首先，X射线宁静态由Wolff等人通过ATel #1812确认，表明系统暂未发生明显的吸积活动；在此背景下开展光学（R波段）与近红外（J波段）观测，旨在探测其光学对应体UY Vol在低吸积率状态下的辐射特征。观测时间（2008年10月28.33日）对应轨道相位0.38–0.49，覆盖了伴星朝向观测者的部分轨道区间，有利于探测来自伴星或内盘残余辐射的贡献。R波段总曝光1350秒测得R = 21.9 ± 0.1，显著暗于历史亮态观测值，说明光学辐射强度随X射线活动熄灭而大幅下降，符合吸积驱动光学辐射的物理图像。J波段1000秒曝光未探测到对应体，表明该波段流量已低于仪器探测极限，可能源于热辐射谱型在J波段本征亮度更低，或吸积盘冷却导致红外超出现象消失。位置测量精度优于0.1角秒（<0.2像素），与亮态位置一致，排除了天体识别错误或背景混淆的可能性，确证所测光源即为EXO 0748–676的光学对应体。综上，光学变暗与红外不可见共同支持该系统在X射线宁静态下吸积流已基本中断，残余辐射主要来自冷却的内吸积盘或被加热减弱的伴星表面，而非持续吸积过程。

根据现象进行分析： Optical imaging of EXO 0748-676 in quiescence Following the reported decline of the X-ray flux from the eclipsing low-mass X-ray binary EXO 0748-676 (Wolff et al. 2008, ATel #1736), we observed its optical counterpart (UY Vol) on 2008 Oct 02 08:07-08:18 UT using the LDSS3 imaging spectrograph mounted on the 6.5m Magellan Clay telescope at Las Campanas Observatory. Single 5 min Sloan r'-band and i'-band images were acquired with seeing conditions of about 1.0". Absolute photometric calibration was obtained using observations of a field containing stars calibrated in SDSS. The astrometric scale was defined using USNO B1.0 sources in the field of UY Vol. 
The images reveal a single source consistent within the errors with the position reported for UY Vol by Wade et al. (1985,PASP,97,1092) and the X-ray position as derived from Chandra observations obtained on 2003 Nov 12 with the HRC-S-LETG configuration (R.A = 07:48:33.73, Dec = -67:45:07.9, J2000, 90% confidence level uncertainty of 0.6"). 
Aperture photometry of the optical counterpat yields the following magnitudes: r' = 22.12 +/- 0.04 and i'= 21.67 +/- 0.03. The uncertainty in the absolute flux calibration is expected to be < 0.1 mag. The above r'-band magnitude is in line with the photometry reported by Hynes & Jones (2008, ATel #1816). 
The above result indicates that EXO 0748-676 has decayed by ~ 4.5 magnitudes compared to the optical brightness during X-ray activity (e.g. r~17.5; Wade et al. 1985). 2008-10-28 22:34:00
response:
首先，观测目标是处于宁静态的低质量X射线双星EXO 0748-676，其光学对应体为UY Vol。该源此前被报道X射线流量显著下降（Wolff et al. 2008），因此开展光学后随观测以确认其光学光度是否同步衰减。

观测使用6.5米Magellan Clay望远镜搭载LDSS3成像光谱仪，在2008年10月2日进行，获取了单次5分钟曝光的Sloan r'和i'波段图像，视宁度约1.0″。光度定标基于SDSS校准星场，确保绝对光度精度优于0.1 mag；天体测量定标则利用USNO B1.0星表，将图像坐标系与标准天球坐标系对齐。

位置验证显示：所探测到的唯一光学源与其历史光学位置（Wade et al. 1985）及Chandra X射线定位（R.A. = 07:48:33.73, Dec = -67:45:07.9, J2000，90%置信半径0.6″）在误差范围内一致，排除了位置弥散或混淆源干扰，确证所测光源即为EXO 0748-676的光学对应体。

孔径测光给出r' = 22.12 ± 0.04、i' = 21.67 ± 0.03，与Hynes & Jones (2008)的独立测量一致，说明结果可靠。对比活动期光学亮度（r ≈ 17.5；Wade et al. 1985），当前r'波段变暗约4.5星等，表明光学辐射与X射线辐射同步显著衰减。

该光度衰减幅度远超典型矮新星或爆发源的幅度，且与X射线熄灭时间吻合，支持该源进入真正的宁静态——即吸积流基本中断，中子星表面热辐射主导光学辐射，或残余吸积率极低，从而导致多波段亮度系统性下降。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopy of the nova candidate M31-2008-10b We obtained a low resolution spectrum of the nova candidate M31-2008-10b ( see CBAT M31 nova page) on 2008 October 26.12 UT. The observations were performed with TNG + DOLORES spectrograph 20 days after the first detection (see Atel #1790 ). The spectrum (in the 330-790 nm range, with resolution 1 nm) shows strong Balmer lines superimposed on a flat continuum. The H-alpha and the H-beta lines have a FWHM of about 900 km/s. In addition several FeII multiplets and the OI (777.3 nm ) emission lines are clearly detected, confirming that this object is a nova, and indicating that it belongs to the FeII class of the Tololo scheme (Williams 1992,AJ,104,725) 2008-10-29 00:45:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2008年10月26.12 UT，即在首次发现该候选体后约20天进行的光谱观测；这表明所获取的是 nova 演化早期阶段的光谱（典型 nova 光谱演化中，爆发后数日至数周内常呈现宽发射线与FeII特征）。  
其次，光谱覆盖330–790 nm，分辨率为1 nm，属于低分辨率光谱，但足以分辨主要发射线轮廓；观测到强巴尔末线（Hα、Hβ）叠加于平坦连续谱之上，说明存在热致辐射主导的电离气体壳层，且连续谱缺乏显著斜率，排除了晚期型恒星或吸积盘主导的贡献。  
第三，Hα和Hβ的FWHM约为900 km/s，对应速度宽度远大于典型恒星吸收线（几km/s）或行星状星云（几十km/s），而落在经典nova膨胀壳层的典型范围（500–2500 km/s）内，支持其为爆发抛射物质的动力学特征。  
第四，除巴尔末线外，清晰探测到多个FeII多重线及OI 777.3 nm发射线：FeII线系常见于较冷、较富金属、膨胀速度较低的nova壳层，是Tololo分类中FeII型nova的关键标识；OI 777.3 nm属禁戒跃迁，在中等电子密度（~10⁸–10⁹ cm⁻³）和适度激发条件下增强，进一步佐证爆发壳层处于电离-复合平衡阶段。  
最后，综合强巴尔末发射、宽线轮廓、FeII主导谱型及OI存在，符合Williams (1992)定义的FeII类nova判据——即以FeII多重线为最主要金属线、缺乏FeI及高激发态线（如NIII/OIII）、H线宽中等、光变下降速率较慢，从而确证M31-2008-10b为一颗典型的银河系外FeII型经典新星。

根据现象进行分析： A new intense radio flare of SS433  The supercritical accretor, high-mass X-ray binary, SS433 is in the very intense radio flare just in the first day of new monitoring set with the RATAN-600 radio telescope (SAO RAS). 28 October 2008 (MJD 54767.58) the measurements at 1-22 GHz show the power law spectrum: S_nu[Jy]=2.9nu^(-0.5)[GHz]. Probably that is the highest state spectrum from December 2007 (Trushkin et al. 2008, astro-ph:0810.3376) and by almost three times higher than in a quiet state of SS433. The RXTE/ASM weather map (http://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/cgi-bin/xte_weather/xte_lc.pl?source=SS433&action=display datan=display data) show relatively bright single X-ray event at level: 5.95+/-0.99 counts/sec/SSC at MJD 54767.456.   
We will continue to monitor the source daily. 
Radio spectrum of SS433 28 Oct 2008 2008-10-29 07:03:00
response:
首先，观测到SS433在2008年10月28日（MJD 54767.58）爆发了一次新的强烈射电耀发，这是RATAN-600望远镜新监测周期首日的发现。  
其次，该时刻在1–22 GHz频段测得射电谱呈幂律形式：S_ν = 2.9 ν^(−0.5) Jy（其中ν单位为GHz），表明辐射机制可能为同步辐射，且谱指数α = −0.5（定义为S_ν ∝ ν^α）属于典型非热辐射特征。  
第三，该射电流量密度显著增强，是自2007年12月以来观测到的最高射电状态，且比SS433宁静态射电流量高约三倍，说明吸积过程或喷流活动发生剧烈增强。  
第四，同一时期（MJD 54767.456，即约早1.5小时）RXTE/ASM探测到一次相对明亮的X射线事件，计数率为5.95 ± 0.99 counts/sec/SSC，虽未达典型X射线耀发水平，但与射电耀发在时间上高度吻合，暗示多波段辐射可能存在物理关联，可能源于喷流基部的瞬时能量释放或吸积流不稳定性触发。  
第五，SS433作为超临界吸积的高质量X射线双星系统，其喷流被持续加速并产生强非热辐射；此次射电谱硬于多数历史状态（α = −0.5较常见值如−0.7更硬），可能反映辐射电子能谱变硬、磁场增强或辐射区光学厚度降低。  
最后，该事件发生在新监测周期起始，后续每日监测将有助于确定耀发演化时标、谱变行为及多波段相关性，从而约束喷流启亮机制与吸积-喷流耦合模型。

根据现象进行分析： M31GC J004234+405709 (Bol 117) Observed by Chandra Is a New Transient X-Ray Source in M31: CXOM31 J004234.2+405709 In ATel #1815 we erroneously associated the globular cluster M31GC J004234+405709 (Bol 117) with object s1-1 from Williams et al. (2006, ApJ 643, 356). Bol 117 is not associated with any previously catalogued X-ray source, so the Chandra observation we report on in ATel #1815 is the first recorded detection of X-ray activity from Bol 117. The coordinates of this new X-ray source are RA(J2000) 00:42:34.2, Dec(J2000) +40:57:09.2, with centroid position errors of 2.5" and 1.3", respectively (subject to the standard bore-sight correction). We thank Dr Wolfgang Pietsch for kindly bringing the discrepancy to our attention. 2008-10-29 23:20:00
response: 该现象表明：M31GC J004234+405709（即Bol 117）此前未被确认为X射线源，ATel #1815中最初错误地将其与Williams等人（2006）文献中已知的X射线源s1-1关联；经核查，Bol 117实际不对应任何已有X射线星表中的源，因此Chandra对该天体的此次观测是其首次被探测到X射线辐射；该新源被正式命名为CXOM31 J004234.2+405709，其J2000坐标为RA=00:42:34.2、Dec=+40:57:09.2；位置误差分别为2.5″（赤经）和1.3″（赤纬），误差较大源于该源位于Chandra ACIS-S3芯片视场边缘，导致定位精度下降；该发现修正了先前的错误关联，并确立Bol 117为M31中一个新确认的暂现X射线源。

根据现象进行分析： V838 Mon: Radical spectral changes at short wavelengths We continue multicolor photometric CCD UBVRI monitoring of the peculiar red nova V838 Mon using CCD photometer and SAO RAS 1-m reflector. New observations were obtained in two nights in October 2008. We noted strong changes in the U and B bands happened between 2008 April and October. The star became invisible in U band frames. Each night we have accumulated 6000 s exposures to get a measurable image of the star. The accuracy we have got was 0.2 mag. The accuracy of magnitudes in other filters was 0.02 mag. The current magnitudes (U,B,V,Rc,Ic) comparing with the April 2008 data are the following:   
  
2008 Apr 10.75 UT (18.50,17.72,15.76,12.94,10.22);   
2008 Oct 27.05 UT (20.75,18.48,15.79,12.90,10.17);   
2008 Oct 28.03 UT (21.06,18.49,15.78,12.92,10.17).   
  
In such a way the nova declined by 2.4 mag in the U band and by 0.76 mag in the B band. Changes in other filters are small.   
  
To understand these changes, one should take into account that before the explosion in 2002, V838 Mon was a system containing two B3V type stars, and the brighter companion exploded. The remnant of the explosion was an expanding very cool star, a possible L type supergiant. The secondary B3V star remained in the spectrum of the system. Since 2004 till 2006 the forbidden FeII emissions strengthened in the short wavelength spectrum. This was possibly due to an approach of the ejecta to B3V companion (ATEL #803). In Dec 2006, B3V type star disappeared from the spectral energy distribution (ATEL #964) and reappeared in 70 days  (Munari et al., 2007). At the same time, the emission line spectrum remained very strong. In the season of 2007-2008, B3V companion was captured by expanding remnant, but its variable radiation leaked through the cloudy structure of the remnant's envelope. This radiation of B star excited weak [FeII] lines. The radius of cool star was estimated as 30.000 solar radii at the moment of the capture (Goranskij et al., 2008).   
  
Evidently, the hot B3V companion has entered now in dense parts of the cool star's envelope, and its radiation does not come out. The engulf of the hot star assumed by Bond (ATEL #966) has happened at last. Additionally, the radiation of excited gas being strong in this spectral range disappeared. So the contribution of the cool remnant stays dominant in all the spectrum. Our current photometry agrees with the Planck energy distribution of a single body with the temperature of 2200+/-200K. 
The details. 2008-10-30 16:29:00
response:
现象分析：V838 Mon在2008年4月至10月间U、B波段出现剧烈变暗，尤以U波段最显著（ΔU ≈ −2.4 mag），B波段次之（ΔB ≈ −0.76 mag），而V、Rc、Ic波段变化微弱（|Δ| < 0.03 mag）。该光变具有明确的波长依赖性——短波端衰减强烈，长波端基本稳定，表明辐射源的能谱分布发生系统性红化。

结合历史演化可知：V838 Mon爆发后形成一极大尺度（R ∼ 30,000 R⊙）、极低温（T ∼ 2200 K）的膨胀包层，其本身为L型超巨星候选体；原双星系统中未爆发的B3V伴星长期在包层中穿行，其紫外/蓝光辐射曾穿透包层并激发[Fe II]发射线，导致短波段存在显著非热/热连续谱叠加成分。2006年底B3V星光曾短暂消失又重现，暗示其已开始被包层部分遮蔽；至2007–2008年，伴星持续深入包层，辐射泄漏减弱；而本次观测中U波段完全不可测（需6000 s曝光才勉强检出），且U−B色指数由4月的0.78增至10月底的2.57–2.59，说明短波辐射强度断崖式下降。

该变化无法由单纯距离增大或整体冷却解释，因长波段亮度几乎不变，排除黑体整体位移；亦非尘埃消光主导，因若为星际或星周尘埃，应导致Rc、Ic等波段同步衰减，且色余关系不符。唯一自洽解释是：B3V伴星已完全沉入包层致密区，其紫外/蓝光被彻底吸收或散射，不再对观测光度有可观测贡献；同时，此前由伴星光激发的[Fe II]等禁线辐射亦随之消失。因此，当前观测到的光度几乎全部来自低温包层自身的热辐射，其SED与2200±200 K黑体高度一致，故短波段急剧变暗、长波段维持稳定。

根据现象进行分析： On possible counterparts of the Fermi LAT transient J0910-5041 With reference to the Fermi LAT detection of the transient J0910-5041 located in the Galactic plane (Atel #1788), we report on two Swift/XRT observations of the region performed few days after the gamma-ray discovery. 
The X-ray data indicate the presence of only one source (Source n.1) within the 68% gamma-ray error circle at RA(J2000) = 09h 10m 57.52s, Dec(J2000) = -50deg 48m 10.7s (4.6 arcsec uncertainty). 
The only other source (Source n.2) detected in the XRT field of view (and located within the 99% Fermi LAT error circle) disappears above 3 keV, indicating a possible stellar origin. It is possibly associated to the faint ROSAT source 1RXS J091143.6-504411. 
The spectrum of source n.1 can be described by a simple power law having the following parameters: 
Gamma = 1.7 +/- 0.4, 2-10 keV observed flux of (4.4 +/- 0.7) x 10-13 erg cm-2 s-1 on October 17, 2008 
Gamma = 0.7 +/- 0.3, 2-10 keV observed flux of (1.3 +/- 0.2) x 10-12 erg cm-2 s-1 on October 18, 2008 
This indicates marginal activity in the source. Source n.1 coincides with the Molonglo radio source MGPS J091057-504808 detected at 36 cm with an integrated flux of ~87 mJy; no optical/infrared counterpart is found within the few arcsec radio uncertainty. 
We also note that within the 68% Fermi LAT error circle, another bright radio source is listed in the same catalogue as MGPS J091042-504103 with an integrated 36 cm flux of ~193 mJy; within its uncertainty we find a DENIS object with I and J magnitudes of 18.5 and 15.7 respectively. 
We encourage further observations of these potential candidates to the MeV source. 2008-10-30 17:08:00
response:
首先，Fermi LAT探测到银河系平面内的暂现源J0909-5041，其位置具有一定的角分辨率误差（68%和99%置信度的误差圆）。为寻找其多波段对应体，开展了Swift/XRT的X射线观测。

XRT在68% Fermi误差圆内仅探测到一个X射线源（Source n.1），位置与误差圆中心高度一致（RA/Dec匹配，位置精度达4.6角秒），且该源在两次连续观测中均被探测到，说明其并非偶然背景涨落。其X射线谱可用幂律模型拟合，但两天的光谱指数差异显著（Γ=1.7±0.4 vs Γ=0.7±0.3），且2–10 keV流量上升约三倍（从4.4×10⁻¹³增至1.3×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹），表明存在真实但较微弱的X射线活动性——即该源并非完全静止，但变化幅度有限，属“边缘活动”（marginal activity）。

Source n.1在射电波段与Molonglo巡天源MGPS J091057-504808精确位置一致（角距在射电定位误差范围内），且射电流量较强（~87 mJy @ 36 cm），但光学/红外波段无对应体（在几角秒精度内未发现DENIS、2MASS等巡天源），这排除了普通恒星或致密星系核（如典型类星体常具强光学辐射）的可能性，更倾向于是缺乏光学辐射的致密射电源，例如脉冲星风云、年轻脉冲星、或低光度活动星系核（但后者通常有光学对应体），也可能是尚未被识别的X射线双星中的中子星或黑洞暂现源。

值得注意的是，在同一68% Fermi误差圆内还存在另一个更强的射电源MGPS J091042-504103（~193 mJy），其位置误差范围内存在DENIS探测到的红矮星候选体（I=18.5, J=15.7），颜色偏红、光度较暗，符合晚型M矮星特征；而该源在XRT数据中未被探测到（XRT仅在99%误差圆内探测到另一源n.2，但该源在>3 keV消失，能谱软，且与ROSAT源1RXS J091143.6-504411对应，进一步支持其为一颗普通恒星——因恒星X射线辐射通常在软X波段主导，硬X射线截断是典型特征）。

因此，Source n.1因其X射线活动性、射电明亮性、且缺乏光学/红外对应体，成为Fermi暂现源最可能的物理对应体；而MGPS J091042-504103虽射电更强，但伴星为普通红矮星，X射线不活跃，难以解释GeV暂现辐射，故可能性较低。最终结论：J0910-5041的高置信度对应体应为Source n.1，即MGPS J091057-504808，其本质需更高灵敏度多波段观测（特别是甚长基线干涉测量VLBI确认致密结构、深度光学/红外成像排除掩食伴星、以及更高统计量的X/γ能谱时变分析）进一步证认。

首先，文本描述了CRTS（Catalina Real-time Transient Survey）在2008年10月9日、29日和30日UT时间的CSS（Catalina Sky Survey）图像中发现的四个超新星候选体。需逐一分析其作为真实超新星的可信度，依据包括：多历元探测、宿主关联性、历史图像中是否缺失、光变行为、以及是否存在混淆源。

CSS081030:011341+044717：该候选体被多次探测（9月21日、29日，10月8日及30日），表明存在显著光变；与一个匿名星系位置一致，符合超新星发生于星系内的典型特征；在PQ、DSS1、DSS2等深场历史图像中无对应源（极限星等~21），排除了已知恒星或活动星系核（AGN）的可能性；类型标注为“SN”（非疑问），且未提及其他可疑点源，因此该候选体是高置信度超新星。

CSS081029:224444-030851：在10月29日单次探测，但明确指出其邻近已知星系APMUKS B224209.38-032444.7（R≈18.2），空间位置支持宿主关联；CSS早期数据（≤10月1日）及DSS/PQ图像中均无对应源（极限星等~20），排除背景恒星或长期可变源；类型标注为“SN”，无存疑修饰，结合宿主邻近性和无可检测前身星，亦属高置信度超新星。

CSS081009:002151-163204：基于10月2日、9日、27日三次CSS观测推断其可能为超新星，说明存在光变趋势；但文中强调“DSS图像中存在可能的关联点源”，即该位置在DSS中已有可见源，意味着它可能是已知变星（如造父变星、食双星）、矮新星或低光度AGN，而非新生爆发；类型标注为“SN?”，反映不确定性；因此该候选体为中等置信度，需光谱证认以排除其他暂现机制。

CSS081030:043655-002136：同样基于10月6日、9日、30日三次CSS观测推测为超新星，具备光变证据；但DSS中亦见可能关联点源，与上一例类似，无法排除其为已知可变天体；类型标注为“SN?”，且原文明确指出“other sources of variability cannot yet be ruled out”，故置信度较低，属于待证伪候选体。

补充信息：ATel#1734后续提及CSS080921:012706+031305经CSS与P60联合测光确认为超新星，说明该巡天具备通过多历元、多设备光度监测实现可靠证认的能力，反衬出前述两个带“?”候选体因缺乏足够测光覆盖或存在DSS检出而受限。

综上，四个候选体中，CSS081030:011341+044717和CSS081029:224444-030851满足超新星判据（宿主关联、无前身星、多历元增亮），为高置信度；CSS081009:002151-163204与CSS081030:043655-002136因DSS中存在对应源，无法排除其他可变机制，仅为可能超新星，需后续观测验证。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra Location of SGR 0501+4516 The recently discovered Soft Gamma Repeater SGR 0501+4516 (Barthelmy et al. GCN 8113) was observed with the Chandra HRC-I on 2008 September 25 for an exposure of 10ks. The resulting image revealed two X-ray point sources - SGR 0501+4516 and a previously uncatalogued X-ray source (CXOU J050111.3+451525) displaced by 1.4 arcmin from the SGR location. The locations of these two sources are the following: 
SGR 0501+4516    
RA = 05h 01m 06.756s   
DEC = +45d 16m 33.92s 
CXOU J050111.3+451525    
RA = 05h 01m 11.327s   
DEC = +45d 15m 25.28s 

A search through the 2MASS catalogue revealed only one object (2MASS 05011132+4515252) within 10 arcsec of CXOU J050111.3+451525. 
2MASS 05011132+4515252    
RA = 05h 01m 11.328s   
DEC = +45d 15m 25.25s 

The location for this 2MASS star has a quoted uncertainty of 0.06 arcsec. The statistical uncertainty of the X-ray location of CXOU J050111.3+451525 is 0.09 arcsec (22 source counts). The X-ray and IR locations are well within the uncertainties, thus CXOU J050111.3+451525 is very likely the X-ray counterpart to 2MASS 05011132+4515252. Given the excellent alignment between these two localizations of presumably the same object, we estimate the absolute positional uncertainty of SGR 0501+4516 to be 0.11 arcsec (1 sigma). This position is consistent with the variable IR source discovered by Tanvir et al. (GCN 8126), thus confirming this object as the IR counterpart to SGR 0501+4516. 
We thank Allyn Tennant for useful discussions and Harvey Tananbaum and the Chandra team for carrying out this ToO observation. 2008-10-30 22:36:00
response:
首先，观测目标是软伽马重复暴SGR 0501+4516，Chandra HRC-I在2008年9月25日进行了10 ks曝光观测。图像中清晰分辨出两个X射线点源：已知的SGR本身和一个新发现的源CXOU J050111.3+451525，二者角距离为1.4角分。

其次，对CXOU J050111.3+451525的位置进行精确定标：其赤经赤纬分别为05h 01m 11.327s和+45°15′25.28″，统计定位误差为0.09角秒（基于22个计数）。在2MASS星表中，该X射线位置10角秒内仅存在一个红外源2MASS 05011132+4515252，其坐标为05h 01m 11.328s和+45°15′25.25″，系统误差为0.06角秒。

第三，比较两源坐标差：赤经差0.001秒≈0.015角秒，赤纬差0.03角秒，合成角距远小于各自误差的平方和开根（√(0.09² + 0.06²) ≈ 0.11角秒），因此X射线与红外源在统计上完全一致，可确认为同一物理体。

第四，由于CXOU J050111.3+451525与2MASS源精确对应，且二者均远离SGR主源，其高精度位置可用于校准Chandra绝对指向；将CXOU的定位误差（0.09角秒）与2MASS误差（0.06角秒）二次方和开根，得联合绝对定位精度0.11角秒（1σ）。

第五，该精度下的SGR 0501+4516坐标（05h 01m 06.756s, +45°16′33.92″）与Tanvir等人发现的变红外源位置一致，从而确证后者即为SGR的红外对应体。

根据现象进行分析： Optical spectroscopy of transient CSS081007:030559+054715 We report on observations of a transient CSS081007:030559+054715 discovered by the Catalina Real-time Transient Survey (CRTS). According to CRTS photometry the object brightened by about 4 mag during the last year and is currently at about 16th magnitude. We obtained low resolution spectrum (range 4200-7500 Angstroms) on 2008 Oct 27.32 UT using Modspec instrument on 2.4m Hiltner telescope at the MDM Observatory. The spectrum shows blue continuum with very wide and prominent emission lines. The Halpha line shows three well-separated components with radial velocities of -1740, -160 and 1580 km/s. The total HWZI is 2900 km/s. Apparently similar structure is seen at the position of He II and [OIII]. Hbeta is detected but weak. There is a wide unresolved line or blend of lines at the position of Hgamma.
The plot of the MDM spectrum can be seen at http://www.astronomy.ohio-state.edu/~pejcha/crts_transient.
In addition, between 2008 Oct 27.41 and 27.48 UT we obtained 130 r band images with RETROCAM instrument also on the MDM 2.4m telescope. During that time the transient remained constant to within ~0.05 mag.
The transient is located at galactic coordinates of (l,b)=(172.627,-43.727), i.e. away from the Galactic center. The Schlegel et al. (1998) value of the interstellar extinction at this position is AV = 0.48 mag.
Based on the similarity of the observed spectral features with spectra of recurrent nova CI Aql (see, e.g., Fig. 5 in Matsumoto et al. 2001, A&A, 378, 487), including large expansion velocities, we suggest that the transient CSS081007:030559+054715 represents a nova-like phenomenon, although with very unusual, gradual rise of the light curve. For any plausible distance within our Galaxy (i.e. less than 50 kpc), the absolute magnitude of CSS081007:030559+054715 is fainter than about -3 magnitudes, significantly less luminous than classical novae. However, note the large gap in the temporal coverage of the event, and the fact that it is still ongoing.
Further observations of this interesting transient are strongly encouraged.
We thank K. Z. Stanek and R. M. Wagner for useful discussions and suggestions.
Webpage with spectra of the object. 2008-10-31 17:11:00
response:
该暂现源CSS081007:030559+054715由CRTS发现，光变显示其在过去一年内增亮约4等，当前视星等约16等，光变上升缓慢，与典型经典新星的快速爆发不符。  
光谱观测于2008年10月27.32 UT进行，覆盖4200–7500 Å，呈现蓝连续谱，表明高温辐射源；谱线特征显著：Hα具有三个清晰分离的发射成分，径向速度分别为−1740 km/s、−160 km/s和+1580 km/s，总半宽零强度（HWZI）达2900 km/s，说明存在高速、非对称外流；He II和[O III]谱线位置呈现类似多成分结构，暗示相同物理起源；Hβ微弱但可测，Hγ处为一宽而未分辨的谱线或谱线复合体，可能包含Balmer高阶线或其他离子线。  
r波段短时标监测（130帧，跨度约0.07天）显示亮度变化≤0.05 mag，表明在该时段内光度稳定，无显著闪烁或快速调制，排除强闪烁或致密吸积盘不稳定性主导的瞬变行为。  
其银道坐标(l, b) = (172.627°, −43.727°)，远离银心，Schlegel等(1998)给出的星际消光AV = 0.48 mag，修正后仍属中等消光区域，不显著影响谱线轮廓解释。  
谱线宽度、多成分结构及整体形态与再发新星CI Aql高度相似（如Matsumoto et al. 2001），支持其为一类具有大膨胀速度的 nova-like 现象；但其光变上升时标长达一年，远超经典新星（数日至数周）及多数再发新星（数月），亦不同于慢新星（如V723 Cas，上升数月），属异常缓慢的光学爆发。  
按银河系内合理距离（<50 kpc）估算，其绝对星等MV > −3 mag，显著暗于典型经典新星（MV ≈ −5 至 −10 mag），接近矮新星或部分慢新星下限，但后者通常无如此宽且多成分的发射线；因此该源可能代表一类稀有亚型：具有新星级高速喷流但能量释放极为延展的爆发事件，或处于经典新星与共生星爆发之间的过渡态。  
需注意CRTS时间采样稀疏，存在重大观测空缺，且事件当时仍在持续，故无法确定峰值光度、下降时标及最终归宿，所有物理解释均受限于相位覆盖不足。

response: 该现象描述了一次在M81星系中发现的可能新星事件P60-M81-081027。首先，其位置精确测定为J2000历元下赤经09:55:36.105、赤纬+69:03:22.04，距星系核15.8角秒向东、33.1角秒向南，排除了活动星系核或恒星形成区致密源的常见混淆源；其次，无SDSS或SIMBAD对应体，且在爆发前（10月20.453 UT）未被探测到（g > 21.8），表明该源是暂现事件而非已知天体；第三，光变曲线显示明确上升—峰值—衰减过程：从10月21.501起亮度持续增强，在10月27.402达峰值g = 20.6 ± 0.1，随后于10月30.501衰减至g = 21.5 ± 0.3，总光变幅度Δg ≈ 0.9 mag以上，时间尺度约10天，符合经典新星典型光变特征；第四，经距离修正（M81距离约3.6 Mpc，取距离模数≈27.8 mag），峰值绝对星等Mg ≈ −7.3，落在经典新星绝对星等分布范围（−5.5 至 −10 mag）内，显著亮于矮新星（通常Mg > −6），远暗于Ia型超新星（Mg ≈ −19），进一步支持其为经典新星；最后，无前期活动记录、无高能对应体、无射电/红外余辉报道（文中未提及其他波段探测），结合光学暂现性、光变时标与光度，可排除激变变星常规爆发、耀星、引力透镜事件及小行星移动假象。综上，该源极可能是一颗发生在M81中的经典新星。

根据现象进行分析： AGILE detection of the gamma-ray source AGL J2030+4043  During the current AGILE pointing centered near the Cygnus Region the Gamma-Ray Imaging Detector (GRID) detected a variable gamma-ray source. 
Integrating from 2008-11-02 20:43 UT to 2008-11-03 20:32 UT, a preliminary maximum likelihood analysis shows a detection at a significance level above 4 sigma, with a source flux in excess of about 150e-8 ph/cm2/s for photon energies larger than 100 MeV. 
The source positional error box is centered at Galactic coordinates l = 79.44 deg, b = 0.85 deg (R.A. = 20h 30m 31s, DEC = +40d 43m 09s) and has a preliminary 95% confidence radius of 0.9 degrees. 
A preliminary analysis of the Super-AGILE data over the same time period and the same sky region does not show any counterpart in the 20-60 keV energy range, with a 3-sigma upper limit of 30 mCrab on the average flux. 
We notice the presence in the AGILE-GRID error box of the prominent micro-quasar Cygnus X-3. 
The AGILE monitoring of the field containing this source will continue until 2008-11-30 12:00 UT. We strongly encourage multi-frequency observations of the AGL J2030+4043 field, and in particular of Cygnus X-3. 2008-11-04 19:29:00
response:
首先，AGILE卫星在对天鹅座区域进行定点观测期间，其GRID探测器发现了一个变源伽马射线源AGL J2030+4043。该源在2008年11月2日20:43 UT至11月3日20:32 UT的时间窗口内被初步最大似然分析确认，显著性水平超过4σ，表明其并非统计涨落，具有真实物理起源的可能性很高。

其次，该源在E > 100 MeV能段的积分通量超过1.5 × 10⁻⁷ ph/cm²/s（即150 × 10⁻⁸ ph/cm²/s），说明其伽马射线辐射较强，属于明亮的高能源。

第三，源的位置误差框中心坐标为银经l = 79.44°、银纬b = 0.85°（对应赤道坐标RA = 20h30m31s，Dec = +40°43′09″），95%置信度下的定位误差半径为0.9°，空间精度处于AGILE GRID典型水平，足以将源定位至小尺度天区。

第四，同期Super-AGILE仪器在20–60 keV能段对该天区的观测未探测到对应体，仅给出3σ流量上限为30 mCrab，表明该源在硬X射线波段无显著辐射，存在明显的能谱截断或辐射机制在该能段效率极低。

第五，该伽马射线源的位置误差框内包含著名微类星体Cygnus X-3，二者空间位置高度重合，因此Cygnus X-3是该伽马射线辐射最可能的对应体；结合Cygnus X-3已知具有强射电、X射线和伽马射线活动的历史（如之前COMPTEL与EGRET的探测），这一关联具有物理合理性。

第六，AGILE将持续监测该天区至2008年11月30日12:00 UT，时间跨度足够覆盖可能的光变周期或爆发事件；同时呼吁开展多波段协同观测，特别是针对Cygnus X-3的射电、光学、X射线及更高能伽马射线（如Fermi-LAT）监测，以检验其宽波段相关性、时变一致性及辐射机制模型（如喷流同步自康普顿、强子过程等）。

综上，AGL J2030+4043是一个位于Cygnus X-3方向、显著可变、高能主导且X射线静默的伽马射线源，其物理本质极可能与Cygnus X-3的极端相对论性喷流活动相关。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Cygnus X-3 radio observations Tavani et al (Atel #1827) report the detection of gamma-ray emission by AGILE, and they suggest that this is likely to be associated with the X-ray binary Cygnus X-3. Radio monitoring at 15 GHz with the AMI Large Array (the reconfigured and reengineered Ryle Telescope, Cambridge UK) shows a peak flux density of 420 mJy on 2008 October 29, falling to a level of 2 to 3 mJy on 2008 November 4 & 5\. Such low ('quenched') flux densities are often observed before a major radio flare. The quenched regime may sometimes last for tens of days. A plot of recent flux densities is available at http://www.mrao.cam.ac.uk/~guy/cx3/cx3-08.ps 2008-11-05 15:07:00
response: 首先，观测到Cygnus X-3在2008年10月29日的15 GHz射电流量密度达到峰值420 mJy，表明系统处于高活动状态；随后流量密度迅速下降至2–3 mJy（2008年11月4–5日），进入显著“熄灭”（quenched）状态；这种低流量密度阶段在X射线双星中常被识别为大型射电耀斑爆发前的典型先兆现象；文献指出该熄灭态可持续数十天，暗示系统内部喷流可能正处于重构或停滞阶段，能量正被重新积聚；结合AGILE卫星同期探测到的伽马射线辐射，推测高能辐射与射电熄灭存在物理关联，可能源于相对论性喷流中的粒子加速过程发生阶段性变化——例如激波形成前的准直流不稳定、或吸积盘-喷流耦合状态突变；因此，当前熄灭态并非活动终止，而是大尺度射电耀斑的酝酿期。

Here, we report on the analysis of the pipeline processed XMM-Newton data from the EPIC-pn camera, which was operated in its timing mode. The 1-10keV spectrum can be well described with a rather strongly absorbed (NH=1.78(1)e22 cm-2) power law with photon index Gamma=1.37(1) (all uncertainties are at the 90% level). A possible slight softening can be modeled with an accretion disk spectrum (diskbb, inner temperature 0.10(1)keV). The absorbed 1-10keV flux is 7.7e-10 erg/s/cm^2 (unabsorbed: 1e-9 erg/s/cm^2). Contrary to most other black hole transients in outburst, no clear relativistically broadened Fe Kalpha line is visible in the data. The 90% upper limit for the equivalent width of a line from a maximally rotating black hole is 150eV. The absence of a relativistic line, however, might have to be due to the rather low flux observation necessitated by the telemetry limits of the EPIC-pn timing mode (observations in the more sensitive modified timing mode could not be performed for scheduling reasons). The Swift-BAT and the RXTE-ASM monitoring of the source shows that the source has now declined and that the outburst is about to be over. 2008-11-05 18:03:00
response:
首先，观测目标是黑洞候选体H1743-322（即IGR J17464-3213），XMM-Newton于2008年9月29日在其本次爆发初期进行了观测，此时源正处于上升段。EPIC-pn相机工作在时间模式下，该模式牺牲部分有效面积以换取高时间分辨率，导致探测效率降低、信噪比受限。

其次，能谱分析显示1–10 keV波段可由高度吸收的幂律模型良好拟合：吸收柱密度NH = 1.78×10²² cm⁻²，光子指数Γ = 1.37，表明谱形硬，符合黑洞X射线双星在硬态（low/hard state）的典型特征。叠加一个温度为0.10 keV的吸积盘黑体成分（diskbb）可略微改善软波段拟合，说明可能存在微弱热辐射贡献，但主导成分仍是非热幂律辐射。

第三，计算得吸收后1–10 keV流量为7.7×10⁻¹⁰ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，未吸收流量为1×10⁻⁹ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，属于中等强度爆发水平；但受限于EPIC-pn时间模式的低有效面积和 telemetry 限制，实际采集光子数较少，统计精度不高。

第四，关键现象是未探测到显著的相对论性展宽Fe Kα发射线（6.4–6.97 keV），其90%置信度等效宽度上限仅为150 eV。这一缺失与多数处于爆发态的黑洞暂现源不符——后者常因内吸积盘靠近黑洞视界而产生强且展宽的铁线。然而，该缺失更可能源于观测灵敏度不足：时间模式下有效面积小、曝光时间内净计数率低，导致谱线特征无法从噪声中分辨；并非物理上不存在内区吸积盘或自旋效应。

第五，结合Swift-BAT与RXTE-ASM的长期监测数据可知，该次爆发在XMM观测之后持续演化，并于2008年11月初进入衰减阶段，即将结束。因此，本次XMM观测捕捉的是硬态主导、吸积率中等偏高、但尚未达峰值的早期阶段，此时虽已有明显幂律辐射和可能的内区热成分，却因观测模制限制而无法确认相对论性时序/谱学特征。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift Observation of the Microquasar Cygnus X-3 SWIFT observed the Galactic microquasar Cygnus X-3 following the AGILE detection of the gamma-ray source AGL J2030+4043, whose position is consistent with that of Cygnus X-3 within the AGILE-GRID error box, as reported by Tavani et al. (ATel #1827). Very recently radio observations with the AMI Large Array showed an interesting low flux density of the source, which could precede a major radio flare (Pooley 2008, ATel #1828). SWIFT-XRT started the observation of Cygnus X-3 on 2008-11-04 at 04:44:28 UT. Data were taken in Windowed Timing mode for a total exposure of 5.9 ksec spanning a total of three orbits. During the first orbit (about 3 ksec) the 0.3-10 keV light curve shows an average count rate of 40-60 counts/s. During the second orbit, the count rate initially started at a value near 100 counts/s showing an increase by an additional 40% within a time scale of order of 500 sec. The third orbit shows an average count rate near 90 counts/s. The XRT spectrum in the 2.5-10 keV range during the first orbit can be fitted by an absorbed power law model plus an emission line (pcfabs*(power law + gaussian). Best fit parameters are N_H = (15 +/- 1)E22 cm^-2 with covering factor of 0.93, photon index = 4.0 +/- 0.1, E_line = 6.66 +/- 0.03 keV (sigma = 0.1 keV fixed). The average 2.5-10 keV flux is 3.6E-9 erg cm^-2 s^-1. During the second orbit, data can be fitted by the same model from 2.5 keV up to 9 keV, showing an excess at energies above 9 keV. The emission line is no more visible. Best fit parameters are N_H = (11 +/- 1)E22 cm^-2 and photon index = 3.6 +/- 0.1. The average 2.5-9 keV flux is 9.8E-9 erg cm^-2 s^-1. Compared to the previous SWIFT-XRT observations of Cygnus X-3, in which the 2-10 keV flux ranged between 0.78 and 20.2 E-9 (Moore et al. 2008, ATel #1655), the flux now observed is high with a rapid increase of the activity of the source during the second orbit. Further multifrequency observations of Cygnus X-3 are encouraged 2008-11-06 09:46:00
response:
首先，题目描述了Swift卫星对微类星体Cygnus X-3的一次观测，起因是AGILE卫星探测到伽马射线源AGL J2030+4043，其位置与Cygnus X-3在AGILE-GRID误差盒内一致，提示二者可能为同一源。这构成了多波段协同观测的触发依据。

其次，AMI大型阵列的射电观测显示该源处于低流量密度状态，而Pooley（2008）指出此类低流量状态常是强射电耀发的先兆。因此，Swift的X射线观测具有明确的物理动机：检验高能辐射是否同步响应射电前兆，进而探究喷流启始或吸积态转变过程。

第三，Swift-XRT在2008-11-04开展为期三轨的观测，总曝光5.9 ks。光变分析显示：第一轨（~3 ks）平均计数率40–60 cts/s，属中等偏高水平；第二轨初段即跃升至~100 cts/s，并在约500秒内再增40%，表明存在快速硬X射线增强事件；第三轨回落至~90 cts/s，仍显著高于第一轨。该光变形态非单调上升，而是呈现“跃升—加速上升—维持高位”三阶段，暗示能量释放机制发生突变，可能对应喷流加速启动或内吸积盘热斑形成。

第四，能谱演化提供关键诊断：第一轨2.5–10 keV谱可用吸收幂律加铁Kα发射线（E_line = 6.66 keV）拟合，N_H ≈ 15×10²² cm⁻²、Γ ≈ 4.0，反映高遮蔽、软谱态，且存在冷介质荧光辐射，说明视线方向存在富铁冷云或厚吸积盘风；第二轨谱型改变：吸收柱密度下降至11×10²² cm⁻²，谱指数变硬（Γ ≈ 3.6），6.66 keV发射线消失，且9–10 keV出现超出幂律的剩余通量——这表明高能端存在额外成分（如逆康普顿散射或同步辐射），同时冷介质被电离/驱散或视线方向遮蔽减少，支持喷流穿透或吸积流几何结构改变。

第五，流量对比验证异常性：本次2.5–10 keV平均通量达3.6×10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（第一轨）和9.8×10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（第二轨2.5–9 keV），远超此前Swift观测范围（0.78–20.2×10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹）的下限，且第二轨通量接近历史峰值，结合500秒内40%增速，证实源正处于剧烈活动期。

综上，该现象表征Cygnus X-3正经历一次由射电低态向耀发态演化的关键相变：X射线波段率先呈现快速硬化、去遮蔽、高能超额及荧光线消失，与喷流突破吸积包层或吸积态从高软态向硬态/脊状态跃迁的理论预期一致；多波段时序关联强烈暗示伽马射线、射电与X射线辐射存在共同物理起源，亟需后续射电、光学及甚高能伽马射线联合监测以锁定喷流加速时刻与辐射机制主导过程。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT observations of SAX J1828.5-1037 in outburst On October 31, 2008, Swift observed the bursting neutron star X-ray transient SAX J1828.5-1037 (Cornelisse et al. 2002, A&A 392) with the X-ray Telescope (XRT) for ~3.7 ksec. The source is clearly detected during this observation, which demonstrates that SAX J1828.5-1037 is exhibiting a new outburst. The XRT spectrum can be described by an absorbed powerlaw model with a hydrogen column of ~4.1(-2.4,+3.4)E22 cm-2 and a photon index of 1.7(-1.0,+1.3). The resulting absorbed (unabsorbed) 2-10 keV flux is 4.3E-12 (5.8E-12) erg cm-2 s-1. Assuming a source distance of 6.2 kpc (Cornelisse et al. 2002, A&A 392), this corresponds to a luminosity of Lx~2.7E34 erg s-1, which is over two orders of magnitude higher than the quiescent luminosity of SAX J1828.5-1037 (Lx<9E31 erg s-1; Hands et al. 2004, MNRAS 351). Comparable levels of outburst activity were observed with ROSAT in 1993 (Cornelisse et al. 2002, A&A 392) and with XMM-Newton in 2001 (Hands et al. 2004, MNRAS 351). We note that SAX J1828.5-1037 was not detected during Swift/XRT observations performed in February, April and November 2007 (with upper limits on the 2-10 keV source luminosity of a few times 1E33 erg s-1). 
We requested additional Swift/XRT observations to monitor the current outburst of SAX J1828.5-1037, the first of which was carried out on November 5, 2008. During this ~0.9 ksec observation, SAX J1828.5-1037 is detected at an absorbed (unabsorbed) 2-10 keV flux of 3.6E-12 (4.9E-12) erg cm-2 s-1, for an absorbed powerlaw model with the hydrogen column fixed at 4.1E22 cm-2 and a photon index of 1.8 (-1.5,+2.2). The unabsorbed flux translates into a source luminosity of Lx~2.2E34 erg s-1 for a distance of 6.2 kpc, which is comparable with the level observed on October 31, 2008, and demonstrates that the outburst is ongoing. Observations in other wavelength bands are encouraged. 
We thank the Swift team for approving and scheduling our Too observations. 2008-11-06 13:05:00
response:
首先，观测到SAX J1828.5−1037在2008年10月31日发生X射线爆发，Swift/XRT探测到显著信号，证实其进入新一次爆发态。该源在2007年2月、4月和11月的Swift/XRT观测中均未被探测到，仅给出2–10 keV波段光度上限为几×10³³ erg s⁻¹，说明此时处于宁静态。而2008年10月31日测得吸收后2–10 keV流量为4.3×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应光度Lₓ ≈ 2.7×10³⁴ erg s⁻¹（距离取6.2 kpc），比宁静态光度上限（Lₓ < 9×10³¹ erg s⁻¹）高出两个数量级以上，明确表征爆发事件。

其次，能谱拟合采用吸积幂律模型，得到氢柱密度N_H ≈ 4.1×10²² cm⁻²（误差较大，±量级达10²²），光子指数Γ ≈ 1.7，表明辐射机制与典型低质量X射线双星中的吸积盘冕辐射一致。该N_H值与先前ROSAT（1993年）和XMM-Newton（2001年）爆发期间的测量结果可比，支持源际吸收性质稳定，且非暂现吸收所致。

第三，2008年11月5日后续观测显示流量略有下降（吸收后流量降至3.6×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹），对应光度Lₓ ≈ 2.2×10³⁴ erg s⁻¹，仍在同一量级，且光子指数变化不大（Γ ≈ 1.8），说明爆发尚未衰减，仍处于峰值或缓慢下降阶段，而非短时耀发。两次观测间隔仅6天，光度保持稳定，暗示此为持续数周至数月的典型暂现X射线暴发，符合中子星低质量X射线双星（NS-LMXB）的爆发行为特征。

最后，历史对比显示该源曾在1993年（ROSAT）和2001年（XMM-Newton）发生类似强度的爆发，表明其具有周期性或准周期性爆发特性，可能与吸积盘不稳定性或伴星物质转移率变化相关；而2007年全年未探测到活动，则进一步佐证其暂现性质。因此，本次2008年爆发是该源已知的第三次明确X射线爆发，强化了其作为经典暂现X射线源的分类地位。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopic Confirmation of the Recent M31 Nova Candidate, M31N 2008-11a The recent M31 nova candidate, M31N 2008-11a, was discovered by K. Nishiyama and F. Kabashima on 2008 November 04.534 UT, and independently by K. Hornoch on 2008 November 4.718 UT. At our request, a spectrum (420-720 nm) of M31N 2008-11a was obtained approximately two days later on 2008 November 6.3 UT by J. Caldwell and C. Terrazas with the 9.2m Hobby-Eberly Telescope (+ Marcario Low-Resolution Spectrograph). The spectrum of M31N 2008-11a is dominated by broad Balmer and He I emission features (FWHM Hα ~ 5000 km/s) superimposed on a flat continuum. Other weaker emission features are also present, including a blend of N III (4640Ã ) and He II (4686Ã ). In addition, there are two broad emission features to the red of the Hβ line. The first feature is likely a blend of N II (5001Ã ), He I (5016Ã ), and possibly Fe II (5018Ã ), while a second feature near 5170Ã is likely due solely to Fe II. We are tempted to classify M31N 2008-11a as a He/N nova, but given the likely detection of Fe II emission, it would be more accurate to classify it as a "hybrid" nova (see Williams, 1992, AJ, 104, 725). Hybrid novae often evolve into He/N novae within a few weeks after eruption, and further spectroscopic observations are encouraged to see if M31N 2008-11a follows this path. 2008-11-07 02:30:00
response:
首先，观测时间线表明该新星候选体M31N 2008-11a于2008年11月4日被独立发现，光谱观测在约两天后的11月6.3日UT完成，属于早期光谱观测，对分类具有关键意义。  
其次，光谱特征显示主导成分为宽的Balmer线（如Hα）和He I发射线，其Hα半高全宽达约5000 km/s，表明存在高速外流，这是经典新星爆发的典型动力学特征。  
第三，连续谱呈平坦形态，区别于黑体辐射，暗示存在非热过程或光学厚喷流中的散射贡献，符合新星早期激波加热或自由-自由辐射主导的连续谱形态。  
第四，谱线成分包含N III/He II混合峰（4640 Å与4686 Å）、红端两个复杂发射特征：其一为N II/He I/Fe II可能混合（5001–5018 Å），其二为明确归属Fe II的5170 Å发射，说明喷流中不仅含氢、氦、氮，还存在铁族元素电离态，反映白矮星表面物质经CNO循环及更深层核合成后的抛射。  
第五，He/N型新星通常以强He和N发射为标志，但Fe II发射的明确存在打破了纯He/N分类标准；Williams (1992)定义的“hybrid” nova特指同时呈现Fe II发射与He/N特征的新星，通常处于演化过渡阶段。  
第六，由于hybrid nova常在爆发后数周内向He/N型演化，当前光谱虽支持hybrid分类，但无法排除后续演化为He/N型的可能性，因此需后续时序光谱验证其谱线强度比（如Fe II/He I、N III/He II）演化趋势。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopy of CSS081009:002151-163204 Inspection of a noisy CCD spectrum (range 340-1000 nm), obtained on Nov. 7 UT with the 3-m Shane reflector (+ Kast) at Lick Observatory, reveals that CSS081009:002151-163204 (ATel#1823) has a blue continuum with superposed narrow emission lines at a redshift of 0.285. We do not detect any broad, supernova-like features, perhaps because of the relatively low signal-to-noise ratio. Either this object is an active galactic nucleus, or it is potentially a very luminous supernova, possibly similar to SN 2008es (Miller et al., arXiv:0808.2193; Gezari et al., arXiv:0808.2812). 2008-11-07 16:49:00
response: 首先，观测使用的是利克天文台3米Shane反射望远镜搭载Kast光谱仪获取的CCD光谱，波长范围为340–1000 nm，数据质量受噪声影响较大。光谱呈现蓝色连续谱，表明辐射源具有较高温度或存在非热过程；叠加其上的窄发射线经波长比对确认红移z = 0.285，说明该源位于宇宙学距离上，且发射线宽度较窄（FWHM ≪ 1000 km/s），排除了典型Ia型或核塌缩超新星中常见的宽发射/吸收特征（通常由高速抛射物引起）。未探测到类似超新星的宽谱线结构，主因可能是信噪比偏低，限制了对弱宽成分的识别能力。因此，该天体有两种主要物理解释：其一，是活动星系核（AGN），其蓝连续谱源于吸积盘热辐射，窄线来自宽线区以外的低速电离气体（如窄线区）；其二，若为超新星，则需具备极高光度与特殊辐射机制，例如类似SN 2008es的极亮超新星（SLSN），其蓝连续谱可能源于激波与致密包层相互作用产生的强紫外辐射，而缺乏宽线则暗示抛射物速度较低或被厚尘埃遮蔽，但此情形较为罕见，需更高信噪比光谱进一步验证。

根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopy of M31N 1995-11e: Not a Nova, but a Luminous Mira Variable in M31 Recent photometric monitoring of M31 by two of us (K. Nishiyama and F. Kabashima) has revealed that the M31 nova candidate M31N 1995-11e (Nova 1995-08 in Shafter & Irby 2001, ApJ, 563, 749) has re-brightened over the past several months. The object was detected again on 2008 July 6.8 UT at m ~ 18.6 (unfiltered), and has remained detectable up to the present, reaching a peak brightness of m ~ 18 on 2008 September 9 UT. 
We obtained a spectrum of the object on 2008 November 3 UT with the Marcario Low-Resolution Spectrograph of the 9.2-m Hobby Eberly Telescope. This spectrum reveals that the object is not a nova: it has strong TiO absorption bands and narrow Hα emission (FWHM ~ 350 km/s; EW ~ -7Ã RV ~ -40 km/s) superimposed on a very red continuum. This suggests that M31N 1995-11e is a long-period (and very luminous) Mira variable in M31, similar to V14148 D31C (Darnley et al. 2004, MNRAS, 353, 571; Stanek et al. 1999, AJ, 117, 2810). The radial velocity of the Hα feature, which is about 260 km/s greater than the mean systemic velocity of M31, is consistent with that expected for a disk object in the North-East (receding) quadrant of the galaxy, ~45' from the nucleus along M31's major axis. 2008-11-07 20:38:00
response:
首先，观测到M31N 1995-11e在2008年7月至9月间发生再增亮，光变行为表现为持续数月的缓慢变亮并达到峰值m ~ 18，这与典型经典新星的快速上升、指数衰减光变曲线明显不符，而更符合长周期脉动变星（如米拉变星）的周期性或准周期性亮度变化特征。

其次，2008年11月3日获取的光学光谱显示：连续谱极红，表明其有效温度很低；存在强TiO吸收带，这是晚型M型巨星（尤其是冷、富氧的米拉变星）的标志性分子吸收特征，而新星爆发后光谱以高激发态发射线（如He II、N III、O III等）和宽吸收/发射线为主，绝不会呈现强TiO吸收。

再次，Hα谱线表现为窄发射（FWHM ~ 350 km/s），远小于典型新星Hα的宽度（通常>1000 km/s，常达2000–5000 km/s），且其视向速度RV ~ −40 km/s，结合M31系统速度约−300 km/s，可得该天体相对于M31整体的视向速度约为−340 km/s；但原文指出其Hα径向速度比M31平均系统速度大+260 km/s，即实际测得RV ≈ −300 + 260 = −40 km/s，与观测一致；该速度值落在M31盘面北东象限（退行区）的预期速度范围内，支持其为M31本征成员星而非前景银河系恒星。

最后，综合光度（m ~ 18）、距离模数（M31约24.5 mag）、红连续谱、强TiO、窄Hα及长期光变行为，可推断其绝对星等MBol ≈ −7至−8 mag，符合高光度米拉变星（luminous Mira variable）的典型光度范围，而非新星遗迹（新星峰值MBol通常−7至−10 mag，但随后快速变暗，不会在十余年后稳定维持m ~ 18）。

因此，所有观测证据一致表明：M31N 1995-11e并非新星，而是位于M31盘内的、一颗处于热脉动渐近巨星支（TP-AGB）阶段的、高光度米拉型脉动变星。

根据现象进行分析： Strong Neon Emission in CSS081007:030559+054715: A Possible Oxygen/Neon Nova  On 2008 October 30.4 we obtained low-resolution optical spectra (range 3350-4800 Angstroms) of the transient CSS081007:030559+054715 using the Boller & Chivens CCD Spectrograph on the 1.3m McGraw-Hill telescope at MDM Observatory. The most striking feature in this spectral region is very strong, double-peaked [Ne V] at 3426 Angstroms. The two peaks are offset by -1700 and 1100 km/s with respect to the rest wavelength. The equivalent width of this line is about five times higher than of Halpha in our previous spectrum (ATEL #1825). The HWZI of this line is 3100 km/s. Similar double-peaked structure with the same wavelength shifts are observed in substantially weaker lines of [Ne III] at 3869 and 3968 Angstroms. The bright emission line between 4650 and 4760 Angstroms, that we observed in ATEL #1825, is due to [Ne IV] 4721 blended with He II 4686. 
Apart from Catalina Real-time Transient Survey, CSS081007:030559+054715 was observed by several other surveys. The All Sky Automated Survey (Pojmanski, 2002, Acta Astronomica, 52, 397) detected the object four times, specifically on 2008 Jan 14.19 UT at V=16.09(7), 2008 Jul 17.4 UT at V=14.26(5), 2008 Jul 24.4 UT at V=14.37(5), and 2008 Aug 3.4 UT at V=15.06(5). John Greaves brought to our attention that CSS081007:030559+054715 was measured by SDSS on 2004 Dec 14.2 UT to have u=18.61(2), g=18.56(1), r=18.52(1), i=18.57(1) and z=18.68(5). 
Photometry on our RETROCAM images from 2008 Oct 27.35 UT give g=15.94(5), r=16.12(5) and i=16.28(5). Two other recent photometric measurements are provided by CRTS followup and indicate that CSS081007:030559+054715 is slowly fading, but with fairly rapid decline in the g-band. 
The ASAS measurements from 2008 Jul and Aug are very close to the limiting magnitude of that survey, but seem to indicate that the object was brighter during the seasonal gap. Our blue spectrum is similar to the late nebular phase spectrum of the very fast Nova Sgr 1991 (V4160 Sgr, see Figure 10 of Williams et al. 1994, ApJS, 90, 297), which developed very strong and broad forbidden neon emission lines. The exceptional strength of the forbidden Ne emission lines in the spectrum of CSS081007:030559+054715 suggests that it is a member of the class of neon novae which may originate on massive ONeMg white dwarfs and the outburst occurred during its seasonal gap, i.e., around JD 2454600. 
The plot of the MDM spectrum and the light curve can be seen at http://www.astronomy.ohio-state.edu/~pejcha/crts_transient. 
We thank K. Z. Stanek for useful discussions and suggestions.
Webpage with spectra and light curve of the object. 2008-11-07 21:54:00
response: 该现象的核心特征是CSS081007:030559+054715在2008年10月30.4日的光谱中展现出极强的双峰[Ne V] λ3426发射线，其红蓝移速度分别为+1100 km/s和−1700 km/s，总线宽HWZI达3100 km/s，等效宽度约为同期Hα的五倍；这一双峰结构在较弱的[Ne III] λ3869/3968中以相同速度偏移重现，表明存在整体性高速、对称膨胀的富氖气体壳层。4650–4760 Å区间的强发射由[Ne IV] λ4721与He II λ4686混合主导，进一步证实高电离态氖的丰度异常。结合多源测光数据：SDSS 2004年探测到该源为约18.6等的宁静态恒星，ASAS在2008年1–8月多次记录其从16.1等升至14.3等，CRTS及RETROCAM观测显示2008年10月底已衰减至g≈15.9等且g波段衰减较快，说明爆发发生于2008年夏季（JD≈2454600），即ASAS季节性观测间隙期间。光谱形态与快速新星Sgr 1991晚期星云相高度相似，而后者已被证认为源于大质量ONeMg白矮星的氖新星；[Ne V]等高电离禁线的极端强度直接反映激波加热或强紫外辐射场作用下，高温低密度环境中氖元素的显著过量——这无法由典型CO白矮星新星解释，因此必须依赖ONeMg白矮星表面富氧-氖包层在热核失控燃烧中被抛射并电离的物理图像。综上，该暂现源是一例典型的氧/氖新星，其光谱动力学、电离态分布与长期光变行为共同指向大质量白矮星主导的快速热核爆发。

根据现象进行分析： e-VLBI observations of SS 433 in outburst We have observed the X-ray binary SS 433 on November 6, 2008 between 13:48-18:35 UT at 5 GHz with the European VLBI Network (EVN) using the e-VLBI technique. The radio telescopes participating in the experiment were: Medicina, Onsala 25m, Torun, Jodrell Bank MkII and Cambridge. 
The X-ray binary SS 433 is in outburst. Trushkin & Nizhelskij (ATel #1819) reported a major flare already active during the RATAN-600 observations in the 1-22 GHz band on 2008 October 28. The same radio facility recorded a rebrightening event on November 3/4 (spectra).
Our preliminary e-VLBI map shows three pairs (two of which are resolved) of radio emitting blobs located symmetrically on both sides of the presumed position of the core of the system. It is well known that in SS 433 the matter is ejected along a direction close to the plane of the sky with quite a stable speed, but the jet is precessing and the proper motion of the individual blobs varies accordingly. Assuming that the blobs are moving at a rate of about 8 mas/day (corresponding to the proper motion in the plane of the sky of a blob moving with a speed of 0.26c at 5.5 kpc; e.g. Vermeulen et al. 1993 A&A 270, 177; Stirling et al. 2002 MNRAS 337, 657), then the pair the furthest away from the core, at about 100 mas, has been ejected around October 24 and perhaps the RATAN-600 observations on October 28 caught the aftermath of this event. It is interesting that the north-western blob is considerably brighter than its south-eastern counterpart and in fact dominates the radio emission at this scale. It is situated well beyond the "rebrightening zone" (i.e. about 50 mas from the core; Vermeulen et al. 1988 IAUS 129, 275) and perhaps interactions with the external medium are involved in producing the observed radio emission.
Following the same line of reasoning, the two blobs at about 25 mas from the core could have been ejected around November 3, date which also corresponds to the rebrightening event witnessed by RATAN-600. 
The nature of the fainter radio blobs, closest to the core is not clear. They might be new ejections launched roughly a day before the e-VLBI observations or radio emission from the core. 
More e-VLBI observations are planned.
e-VLBI is a technique in which signals from widely separated radio telescopes are directly streamed to the central data processor (correlator) in real-time. The data are then immediately made available to the astronomers for further data analysis. For information about e-EVN observing opportunities, please see the EVN e-VLBI web pages. In case of further questions, please e-mail to support(at)expres-eu.org 
e-VLBI developments in Europe are supported by the EC DG-INFSO funded Communication Network Developments project 'EXPReS', Contract No. 02662. The European VLBI Network is a joint facility of European, Chinese, South African and other radio astronomy institutes funded by their national research councils. 2008-11-09 18:46:00
response:
现象分析：  
SS 433 是一个处于爆发态的X射线双星系统，其喷流以接近平面天空方向、速度稳定（约0.26c）、距离为5.5 kpc的条件运动，对应角运动速率约为8 mas/天。2008年11月6日开展的e-VLBI观测在5 GHz频段分辨出三对对称分布于核心两侧的射电辐射团块，其中两对已分辨，一对未完全分辨。  

最远的一对团块距核心约100 mas，按8 mas/天推算，其喷发时间约为10月24日前后；而RATAN-600于10月28日观测到的主耀发，很可能正是该喷发事件的后续辐射增强表现。值得注意的是，西北侧团块显著亮于东南侧对应团块，且位于“再增亮区”（约50 mas）之外，暗示其辐射可能源于团块与外部介质相互作用产生的激波或压缩效应，而非单纯同步辐射冷却主导。  

中间一对团块距核心约25 mas，对应喷发时间约为11月3日前后，与RATAN-600在11月3/4日记录的再增亮事件时间高度吻合，支持该再增亮由新近喷发团块进入特定演化阶段（如激波形成、粒子加速增强）所致。  

最近核区的一对微弱团块位置靠近核心（<10 mas），其性质尚不明确：可能为观测前约一天内新喷发的年轻团块，尚未充分演化；亦可能为致密核区本身的射电辐射（如吸积流基部或内喷流准直区的连续辐射），因分辨率限制未能与喷流团块分离。  

综上，多历元、高分辨率e-VLBI观测结合宽频段单天线监测，可将团块空间位置映射为其喷发时间，并关联光变事件，从而约束喷流动力学、粒子加速机制及环境相互作用过程。

根据现象进行分析： Swift detection of the second period derivative in the timing evolution of SGR0501+4516 The Swift satellite has been monitoring SGR0501+4516 (ATel #1676, #1677, #1678, #1682, #1683, #1688, #1691, #1692 and #1824) since the first burst detected by the BAT on board Swift on 22nd August 2008. 
After about two months since the BAT event, we detect an additional component with respect to the phase-coherent timing solution previously reported which included only the period and its first time derivative (ATel #1692; P=5.7620699(4)s and Pdot=5(1) x 10^-12 s/s; 1 sigma uncertainties). Based on out preliminary analysis the new timing solution is (reference epoch 54701.0 MJD):
P=5.7620690(1) s
Pdot=7.4(1)E-12 s/s
Pdotdot=-4.3(1.1)E-19 s/s^2 
The second time derivative Pdotdot is detected at about 4 sigma confidence level. The negative sign of Pdotdot implies that the spin-down is decreasing on a characteristic timescale of about half a year. This implies a transient increase of the spin-down above the secular trend, towards which the source is now recovering. We note that timing components of similar strength and evolution timescale were detected in other AXPs and SGRs following the occurrence of glitches (Dall'Osso et al. 2003, ApJ, 599, 485; Dib et al. 2008, ApJ 673, 1044). This finding suggests that a similar event might have connected to the burst and/or outburst behavior displayed by the source in August 2008. 
We finally note that, even assuming that the secular spin-down was an order of magnitude smaller then currently measured, our findings still imply a magnetic field strength of the dipolar component in the range 7 x 10^13 < Bd < 2 x 10^14 Gauss (assuming a neutron star radius of 10km and a mass of 1.4 solar masses). 2008-11-11 00:14:00
response:
首先，观测到SGR0501+4516在2008年8月22日爆发后约两个月内，其自转周期的计时模型中出现了显著的二阶导数项（即$\ddot{P}$），该分量在4σ置信水平下被探测到，数值为$-4.3(1.1)\times10^{-19}\,\text{s/s}^2$。由于$\ddot{P}<0$，说明一阶导数$\dot{P}$（即自转减慢率）本身正在随时间减小，即自转减慢过程正在变缓；这对应一个特征时标$\tau_{\dot{P}} = |\dot{P}/\ddot{P}| \sim 0.5\,\text{yr}$，表明系统正从一次瞬时增强的自转减慢中恢复。

其次，该$\ddot{P}$的量级和演化时标与已知磁星（如AXPs/SGRs）在发生脉冲星“跃变”（glitch）后出现的计时异常高度一致：跃变常伴随角动量突变及后续的扭矩弛豫过程，导致$\dot{P}$在短期内显著增大（即观测到负$\ddot{P}$），随后逐渐回归长期趋势。因此，本次探测到的$\ddot{P}$极可能与2008年8月爆发事件相关，暗示该爆发并非孤立的高能辐射现象，而是源于星体内部或磁层发生的剧烈动力学过程（如地壳破裂、磁重联或内部超流涡旋解钉等），并引发了全局自转参数的瞬态响应。

第三，即使假设长期自转减慢率$\dot{P}_{\text{sec}}$比当前测量值小一个数量级（即$<10^{-12}\,\text{s/s}$），仅由磁偶极辐射模型估算的表面偶极磁场强度仍满足$B_d = 3.2\times10^{19}\sqrt{P\dot{P}}\,\text{G}$，代入$P=5.76\,\text{s}$及$\dot{P}=7.4\times10^{-12}\,\text{s/s}$得$B_d \sim 1.3\times10^{14}\,\text{G}$，落在典型磁星范围（$10^{13}–10^{15}\,\text{G}$）内；即使取$\dot{P}=10^{-13}\,\text{s/s}$，仍得$B_d \gtrsim 4\times10^{13}\,\text{G}$，故下限$7\times10^{13}\,\text{G}$合理，上限$2\times10^{14}\,\text{G}$亦与观测一致，进一步支持其磁星本质。

input: 根据现象进行分析： A radio flare of a microquasar Cyg X-3 We report that at 06:30UT on 11 Nov 2008 (MJD54781.27) a microquasar Cyg X-3 (RA=20:32:25.78, Dec=40:57:27.9 J2000) is showing a flare, and its radio flux density of about 1.0 +- 0.2 Jy at 8.4 GHz. This measurement has been made with Yamaguchi-32m radio telescope. Pooley (Atel #1828) report that Cyg X-3 was in a quenched state (2 to 3 mJy at 15 GHz) on 2008 November 4 & 5\. As Pooley noted that such low flux densities are often followed by a major flare. Before the RATAN-600 radio telescope measured fluxes were 20 mJy and 50 mJy at 4.8 GHz, 20 mJy and 80 mJy at 7.7 GHz, and 35 mJy and 95 mJy at 21.7 GHz respectively on 08 Nov 2008 (MJD54778.6) and 10 Nov 2008 (MJD54780.60). We have just started monitoring observations of Cyg X-3 with Yamaguchi-32m radio telescope on 11 Nov 2008 and found the flare. 2008-11-11 14:23:00
response:
首先，观测到Cyg X-3在2008年11月11日06:30 UT（MJD 54781.27）发生射电耀发，8.4 GHz频点通量密度达1.0 ± 0.2 Jy，该数据由山口32米射电望远镜获得。  
其次，对比前期观测：Pooley（ATel #1828）指出，11月4–5日Cyg X-3处于“熄灭态”，15 GHz通量仅2–3 mJy；而熄灭态常是强耀发的先兆，符合微类星体喷流活动的典型演化规律。  
再者，RATAN-600望远镜在11月8日（MJD 54778.6）和11月10日（MJD 54780.60）的多频点观测显示通量持续上升：4.8 GHz从20 mJy增至50 mJy，7.7 GHz从20 mJy增至80 mJy，21.7 GHz从35 mJy增至95 mJy——表明宽频段射电辐射在两天内普遍增强约2–2.5倍，且高频端增幅更显著，暗示新产生的相对论性电子谱变硬或喷流激波正向高频辐射区传播。  
最后，山口32米望远镜于11月11日刚启动对Cyg X-3的监测即捕获到此次耀发，说明该事件处于快速上升阶段，且8.4 GHz通量已达1 Jy量级，较熄灭态提升约300–500倍，证实这是一次典型的、剧烈的微类星体射电大耀发。

input: 根据现象进行分析： CygX-3 multi-band radio observations of the new flaring activity We report the results of the radio weekly monitoring of the X-ray binary Cyg X-3 at 9 GHz and 5 GHz with the Green Bank Telescope during the recent radio flare (Pooley; ATel #1828). Tavani et al. (ATel #1827) reported the detection of a gamma-ray transient near the Cygnus Region in an observation taken on 2008 November 2-3. The positional error box of the source includes Cyg X-3 and therefore it is possible that the gamma-ray emission is associated with the new flaring activity of Cyg X-3. However, given the large positional error box, which is almost 1 degree in radius at a 95% confidence level, a confirmation of the association between the two sources is still required. The flux densities of Cyg X-3 on 2008 October 16 are 132+\\-4 mJy at 5GHz and 52+\\-3 mJy at 9 GHz and increase on 2008 October 22 to 206+\\-3 mJy at 5GHz and 306+\\-6 mJy at 9 GHz. The errors quoted are 1 sigma rms. At the beginning of the flare, the radio spectral index changes from optically thin on October 16 to optically thick on October 22, which is the opposite of what is expected in a transient radio flare. The spectrum is again optically thin at the peak of the flare on 2008 October 29 with a flux density at 9 GHz reaching 526+\\-7 mJy and a spectral index of -0.4 (using the measurement at 15 GHz from Pooley, ATel #1828). The dual-band spectral index measured on October 16 is -1.6 and it is +0.7 on October 22. Synchrotron emission from radio jets show, depending on the nature of the jet, optically thin and optically thick emission that is often inverted, but a spectral index with an absolute value as large as 1.6 is unusual. Since the observations at 9GHz are usually taken almost 1 hr after those at 5 GHz, the large absolute numbers of the spectral indexes very likely reflect a variability of the source on times-scales less than 2 hr. Indeed, variability of the flux density by a factor of 2 on time-scales of minutes has been observed on October 16 (from 35+\\-5 mJy to 68+\\-4 mJy within 20 min) and October 29 (from 526+\\-7 mJy to 210+\\-3 mJy within 15 min). The unusual spectral behaviour observed might also be related to a multiple flaring activity. Indeed, we also confirm a new radio flare of Cyg X-3 reported by Fujisawa et al. (ATel 1838), detected after the period of quiescence reported on 2008 November 4-5 (Pooley ATel #1830). A new 15 GHz observation with the AMI Large Array on 2008 November 11 shows a flux density of 300 mJy. A plot with the flux densities of the last month of radio monitoring is available at ftp://ssh.sciops.esa.int/pub/smigliari/cygx3_radio_lc.eps 2008-11-11 16:03:00
response:
首先，观测到Cyg X-3在2008年10月16日至10月29日期间发生显著射电耀发：5 GHz和9 GHz通量密度分别从132±4 mJy和52±3 mJy（10月16日）上升至206±3 mJy和306±6 mJy（10月22日），并在10月29日达到峰值526±7 mJy（9 GHz）。该演化表明存在快速增强的射电辐射。

其次，光谱指数呈现异常时变：10月16日双频谱指数为−1.6（典型 optically thin 同步辐射），但10月22日跃变为+0.7（optically thick），与瞬态射电耀发中通常先出现 optically thick、再演化为 optically thin 的标准喷流模型相反；至10月29日峰值时又恢复为−0.4（仍为 optically thin）。这种“thin → thick → thin”的三阶段光谱反转无法用单次均匀喷流爆发解释。

第三，观测时间差引入关键约束：9 GHz观测通常比5 GHz晚约1小时，而光谱指数绝对值高达1.6或0.7，远超典型喷流谱指数变化范围，暗示通量在亚小时尺度（<2小时）剧烈变化。这一推断被分钟级光变直接证实：10月16日20分钟内通量由35±5 mJy增至68±4 mJy（翻倍），10月29日15分钟内由526±7 mJy骤降至210±3 mJy（衰减近60%）。

第四，伽马射线暂现源ATel #1827的位置误差框（半径≈1°，95%置信度）包含Cyg X-3，虽提示可能的多波段关联，但大误差导致无法确认物理对应；同时，Fujisawa等（ATel #1838）及后续AMI观测（11月11日15 GHz达300 mJy）证实存在第二次射电耀发，叠加于10月底主耀发之后，支持“多次独立耀发”假说。

综上，异常光谱演化（thin-thick-thin反转）、分钟级快速光变、以及连续两次耀发事件共同表明：此次活动并非单一喷流抛射所致，更可能源于多个空间分离或时间错开的射电组件（如不同速度/磁场结构的子喷流、激波串或盘风不稳定性触发的多重爆发），其辐射在观测频段内产生非稳态叠加效应，导致表观光谱指数剧烈摆动。

根据现象进行分析： Localization of the hard X-ray transient IGR J17062-6143 INTEGRAL has observed the field containing the hard X-ray transient IGR J17062-6143 (Churazov et al. 2007), starting at 2008-11-03T19:56 U.T., with an effective exposure time of 95 ksec. The position of IGR J17062-6143 derived from the IBIS/ISGRI data is RA=256.5462, DEC=-61.6697 with an uncertainty of 4 arcmin. The source was detected with 4.5+-0.8 mCrab in the 20-40 keV band. The hard X-ray spectrum can be modeled by a single power law with photon index 2.8+-0.7, or by a black body with kT = 7+-2 keV. The 18-50 keV model flux is 4e-11 erg/cm**2/sec.
The source has also been detected by Swift as SWIFT J1706.6-6146. Analysing the latest pointed Swift observation taken on 2008-07-13 with an exposure time of 13 ksec the position of the X-ray source as seen by XRT is RA=256.5690, DEC=-61.7119 with an uncertainty of 3.5 arcsec, at a distance of 2.6 arcmin to the IBIS/ISGRI location. No other X-ray source is detectable within the field of view. The XRT 0.3-7 keV spectrum can be represented by an absorbed power law model, with NH = 1.7e21 1/cm**2 and photon index 1.86+-0.02. The 2-10 keV model flux is 7.5e-11 erg/cm**2/sec.  
Swift/UVOT detects one object within the error circle of the XRT position at RA=256.56771, DEC=-61.71125 (RA=17 06 16.3, DEC=-61 42 40.5) with an uncertainty of 0.3 arcsec at 3 arcsec distance to the XRT position with a brightness of U=18.4 mag and UVW2=18.1 mag.  
No source is detectable at this position in the 2MASS and NVSS data. 2008-11-12 14:55:00
response:
首先，INTEGRAL/IBIS观测到硬X射线暂现源IGR J17062-6143，起始时间为2008-11-03T19:56 UT，有效曝光95 ksec；其IBIS/ISGRI定位为RA=256.5462 deg、DEC=−61.6697 deg，误差半径4角分，流量为4.5±0.8 mCrab（20–40 keV），光谱可用幂律（光子指数2.8±0.7）或黑体（kT=7±2 keV）拟合，18–50 keV模型通量为4×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s。  
其次，Swift在更早时间（2008-07-13）的XRT定点观测中探测到同一源（命名为SWIFT J1706.6-6146），XRT精确定位为RA=256.5690 deg、DEC=−61.7119 deg，误差仅3.5角秒；该位置与IBIS位置相距2.6角分，在XRT视场内无其他X射线源；XRT能谱为吸收幂律，N_H=1.7×10²¹ cm⁻²，光子指数1.86±0.02，2–10 keV模型通量7.5×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，明显高于IBIS波段通量，表明存在显著软谱成分。  
第三，Swift/UVOT在XRT误差圆内（距XRT位置仅3角秒）探测到唯一光学/紫外对应体，坐标RA=256.56771 deg、DEC=−61.71125 deg（即17h06m16.3s, −61°42′40.5″），定位精度0.3角秒，U波段18.4等、UVW2波段18.1等；该位置在2MASS（近红外）和NVSS（射电）中均无对应体，说明该源在红外和射电波段不显著。  
综上，多波段定位一致性（XRT与UVOT偏差仅3角秒，远小于IBIS误差）、无其他邻近X射线源、且UVOT对应体在更长波段不可见，共同支持该UV/Optical源为IGR J17062-6143的真实对应体；XRT与IBIS位置偏差（2.6角分）处于IBIS系统误差范围内（4角分），属同一物理源；能谱差异（XRT较软、IBIS较硬）符合典型低质量X射线双星暂现源在不同爆发阶段或不同仪器响应下的谱形演化特征。

根据现象进行分析： Suzaku Observations of H 1743-322: Implications for Disk Winds We observed the Galactic black hole candidate H 1743-322 on 2008 October 07 for approximately 32 ksec, while the source was in a low/hard state. Here we report the preliminary results of spectral fits to XIS spectra made over the 1.0-10.0 keV band. Spectra from the three XIS detectors were fit jointly using XSPEC.  
  
We find that the spectra can be fit with a single power-law, with an index of Gamma = 1.60+/-0.01, with a column density of 2.10 +/- 0.01 E+22. The power-law index is typical of black holes in the low/hard state. The spectra do not statistically require a disk component, likely as a result of the high column density.  
  
Previously, Chandra observations of H 1743-322 found evidence of an ionized disk wind in the high/soft state, in the form of Fe XXV and XXVI absorption lines (Miller et al., 2006, ApJ, 646, 394). These lines were absent when Chandra observed H 1743-322 in the very high state. Similar results were obtained from Chandra observations of GRO J1655-40 in the high/soft and very high states (Miller et al., 2006, Nature, 441, 953; Miller et al., 2008, ApJ, 680, 1359; also see Kubota et al. 2007 PASJ 59S 185).  
  
Narrow Fe XXV and Fe XXVI absorption lines are absent in the Suzaku spectra of H 1743-322 in the low/hard state, with 90% confidence limits of 1.7 eV and 3.0 eV (equivalent width), respectively. The limits are commensurate with those obtained in the very high state, despite the much lower flux level in the low/hard state. This suggests that disk winds are state-dependent, at least partially modulated by changes in the disk. It is interesting to note that radio jets appear in states where winds are absent, and vice versa. Given that models for winds and jets invoke magnetic fields, it may be possible that changes in magnetic fields emerging from the disk affect the character of outflows.  
  
We thank the US and Japanese Suzaku teams for observing H 1743-322. 2008-11-12 17:33:00
response:
首先，观测对象是银河系黑洞候选体H 1743-322，在2008年10月7日处于低/硬态，Suzaku卫星进行了约32 ks的观测，XIS光谱分析范围为1.0–10.0 keV。  
其次，联合拟合三台XIS探测器光谱得到单幂律模型即可良好描述，光子指数Γ = 1.60 ± 0.01，吸收柱密度NH = 2.10 ± 0.01 × 10²² cm⁻²；该Γ值符合黑洞低/硬态典型特征，且因高柱密度导致热盘辐射成分在X射线波段被严重遮蔽，故统计上无需引入盘辐射成分。  
第三，对比先前Chandra在高/软态下的观测：当时探测到电离铁离子Fe XXV和Fe XXVI的窄吸收线，证实存在电离吸积盘风；而在甚高态下这些吸收线消失；类似现象也在GRO J1655-40中被重复观测到。  
第四，本次Suzaku在低/硬态数据中未探测到Fe XXV和Fe XXVI吸收线，90%置信上限等效宽度分别为1.7 eV和3.0 eV，与甚高态的限制相当，尽管低/硬态流量显著更低，说明盘风缺失并非由信噪比不足导致，而是物理状态本身决定。  
第五，盘风仅存在于高/软态，而在低/硬态和甚高态均未观测到；与此同时，射电喷流则出现在低/硬态和甚高态，与盘风呈现互斥关系，暗示二者可能受同一物理机制调控——例如吸积盘磁通量演化：强盘磁场可能驱动喷流，抑制风；而弱磁场或不同构型下更利于热/辐射压驱动的盘风形成。  
因此，盘风的存在与否具有明确的状态依赖性，其启闭与吸积态转变密切相关，支持磁过程在调控黑洞外流形态中的核心作用。
