根据现象进行分析： UV-NIR Observations of the Probable Luminous Supernova CSS 081009:002151-163204 We report on further observations of the SN candidate CSS081009:002151-163204 discovered by the Catalina Sky Survey (Drake et al., ATel #1823) which was determined by Silverman et al. (ATel #1833) to be at redshift 0.285. 
We triggered ToO observations with the Swift satellite starting on 2008 Nov. 11 at 04:10 UT. The transient was observed in all six ultraviolet and optical filters on the UVOT. We reduced the observations following the calibration methods described by Li et al. (2006, PASP, 118, 37) and Poole et al. (2008, MNRAS, 383, 627). Our preliminary photometry is: 
UVW2 = 19.60 Â± 0.11 
UVM2 = 19.20 Â± 0.11 
UVW1 = 19.02 Â± 0.08 
U = 18.67 Â± 0.05 
B = 19.25 Â± 0.06 
V = 18.58 Â± 0.07 
In addition, we observed the transient using the Peters Automated Infrared Imaging Telescope (PAIRITEL) in J, H, and K_s nearly simultaneously with the Swift observations. The transient is undetected in the K_s band, marginally detected in the H band, but securely detected in the J band at a magnitude (calibrated against 2MASS) of: 
J = 18.5 Â± 0.2 
These magnitudes have not been corrected for the small component of Galactic extinction along the line of sight or for the small contribution from a faint presumed host galaxy seen in the DSS images. 
The Swift observations also totaled 6.15 ks of exposure time with the XRT. The source is not detected, with a 90% upper limit of F_x(0.3-10 keV) < 4e-14 erg cm-2 s-1 assuming a power-law spectrum with Gamma=2 and N_H=1e21 cm-2. At the redshift of the source, this is an upper limit to the X-ray luminosity of 1e43 erg s-1. We note that the lack of an X-ray detection is consistent with the interpretation of these super-luminous SNe as optically thick, shocked shells (Smith & McCray 2007, ApJ, 671, L17). 
The downturn in the UV continuum shape at short wavelengths, coupled with the X-ray non-detection, is inconsistent with an AGN hypothesis for this transient. Instead, the full SED can be approximately fit by a blackbody spectral shape, with a characteristic temperature of ~10,500 K (in the rest frame). A direct trapezoidal integration under the observed fluxes and an integration of the blackbody fit give similar estimates for the bolometric luminosity of the source of ~2e44 erg s-1. This extraordinary luminosity and blackbody temperature are very similar to those of SN 2008es (Miller et al. 2008, arXiv:0808.2193; Gezari et al. 2008, arXiv:0808.2812) at a similar age of about 30 rest-frame days after discovery. Further spectroscopic observations are encouraged in order to confirm the SN nature of this transient. 
We thank the Swift PI Neil Gehrels for approving the requested ToO, and the Swift staff for planning and executing the observations. 2008-11-13 04:33:00
response:
首先，该天体被确认为红移z=0.285的暂现源，表明其位于宇宙学距离上，排除了银河系内天体的可能性。  
其次，Swift/UVOT在六个紫外光学波段均探测到该源，测得的星等从UVW2（19.60）到V（18.58）呈现整体偏蓝的能谱趋势，尤其UVW2、UVM2、UVW1和U波段亮度较高，而B波段反而比V波段暗（B=19.25 > V=18.58），说明短波端未出现显著衰减，但UVW2–U波段间斜率变缓，暗示存在紫外连续谱的转折。  
第三，PAIRITEL红外观测显示J波段可靠探测（J=18.5±0.2），H波段仅边缘探测，K_s波段完全不可见，说明红外辐射微弱，能谱在近红外迅速下倾，与高温黑体辐射预期一致，而非冷尘或AGN宽线区贡献。  
第四，XRT在6.15 ks曝光下未探测到X射线辐射，给出0.3–10 keV能段流量上限F_x < 4×10⁻¹⁴ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应光度上限L_x < 10⁴³ erg s⁻¹；该非探测与光学厚激波壳层模型（Smith & McCray 2007）相符，且直接排除典型AGN——因AGN通常具有显著X射线辐射及硬谱指数，而此处X射线缺失与紫外谱形转折共同否定了活动星系核解释。  
第五，综合UV–optical–near-IR测光数据，其能谱可被单温度黑体（T ≈ 10,500 K，静止参考系）较好拟合；通过梯形积分实测流量与黑体拟合积分所得的总光度一致，约为2×10⁴⁴ erg s⁻¹，属超亮超新星（SLSN）量级。  
第六，该光度与温度特征、约30天静止帧年龄下与SN 2008es高度相似，支持其为极亮Ic型或对不稳定性超新星候选体；但尚未获得光谱，因此需后续光谱证认以排除其他罕见爆发类型（如潮汐撕裂事件早期相位）。  
第七，当前测光未扣除银河系消光及宿主星系光污染，但二者贡献均被评估为“较小”，故对黑体温度与总光度的定性结论影响有限。

input:
根据现象进行分析： A likely high-frequency radio counterpart of the Fermi LAT  transient J0910-5041 With reference to the Fermi LAT detection of the transient J0910-5041 located in the Galactic Plane (ATEL #1788) and the reported Swift/XRT detection of an associated X-ray source (ATEL #1822), we report that this object closely coincides in position with a high-frequency radio source detected in the Australia Telescope 20GHz (AT20G) Survey, AT20G J091058-504807. 
The measured AT20G position for this source is (J2000) 09 10 58.08 -50 48 07.4, with an uncertainty of 0.7 arcsec in both RA and Dec. This potentially provides a more accurate localization for the Fermi LAT transient. The AT20G position is close to that of the low-frequency radio source MGPS J091057-504808 mentioned in ATEL #1822. We confirm that no optical or infrared counterpart is seen at this position down to the limits of the UK Schmidt Sky Survey. 
The AT20G observations were made in October/November 2005, and at that time the measured flux density of the source was 127 +/- 6 mJy at 20 GHz, 82 +/- 4 mJy at 8.64 GHz and 81 +/- 4 mJy at 4.8 GHz. The fractional linear polarization at 20 GHz is <9%. 
The AT20G survey is described by Massardi et al. (2008). AT20G J091058-504807 lies below the flux density limit of the catalogue presented by Massardi et al., but is in the full AT20G data catalogue due for public release early next year (Murphy et al. 2009). The radio spectrum of J091058-504807 is somewhat unusual, being roughly flat over the range 1 - 8 GHz but rising at 8 - 20GHz. 2008-11-13 11:40:00
response:
首先，该现象涉及一个费米LAT瞬变源J0910-5041，其位于银道面内，已通过ATel #1788通报；随后Swift/XRT探测到与其位置一致的X射线源（ATel #1822），表明该瞬变具有多波段对应体。  
其次，该位置与AT20G巡天中一个高频率射电源AT20G J091058-504807高度重合，其J2000坐标为09 10 58.08 -50 48 07.4，位置精度达0.7角秒，显著优于费米LAT通常在银道面附近的角定位精度（常为数角分量级），因此该射电源可作为更精确的位置锚点，用于约束瞬变源的空间定位。  
第三，该射电源与ATel #1822中提及的低频射电源MGPS J091057-504808位置接近，二者坐标差在约1角秒内，支持它们属于同一物理源；但UK Schmidt巡天在该位置未探测到光学或红外对应体，说明该源在光学/红外波段极暗弱或完全缺失，符合某些致密、非热主导天体（如耀变体、年轻脉冲星风云或暂现射电暴）的特征。  
第四，AT20G观测于2005年10–11月进行，测得其20 GHz、8.64 GHz和4.8 GHz通量密度分别为127±6 mJy、82±4 mJy和81±4 mJy，显示其射电谱在4.8–8.64 GHz近似平坦，而在8.64–20 GHz显著上升，即呈现“高频上翘”谱形——这不同于典型同步辐射自吸收主导的平坦谱射电源（其谱在高频应趋于平缓或下降），而更可能反映存在额外高频辐射成分，例如逆康普顿散射、高能粒子加速过程持续作用，或存在致密核心与延展结构混合导致的复合谱。  
第五，该源未被Massardi et al. (2008)发布的AT20G主表收录，因其低于该表通量截断限，但存在于完整数据集中，说明其属于较暗但可探测的射电源；其低线偏振度（<9%）暗示磁场取向混乱或辐射区存在较强湍流，不利于产生强有序磁场下的高偏振同步辐射。  
综上，AT20G J091058-504807作为J0910-5041的高精度射电定位标识，结合其异常上翘的射电谱、缺乏光学/红外对应体、低偏振等性质，强烈提示该瞬变源可能是一类具有致密非热辐射区的高能暂现天体，如处于爆发早期的耀变体、新发现的射电噪X射线暂现源（RNXT），或与银河系内致密天体（如磁星爆发、微类星体）相关的多波段活动现象。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Broad relativistic iron line observed in SAX J1808.4-3658 by Suzaku The accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar SAX J1808.4-3658 recently exhibited another outburst in September and October 2008 (ATel #1728). During this outburst, on 2008 Oct 2, we obtained a ~40 ks observation with Suzaku. The XIS detectors were operated in 1/4 window mode, with 1 sec burst, leading to a good time exposure of 21 ks for the XIS 0, 1 and 3 detectors. No type-I X-ray bursts were detected in the lightcurves. We fitted the spectra from all three XIS detectors jointly in XSPEC, finding that the continuum was described well by an absorbed disk-blackbody + blackbody + power-law model, with a column density of 0.5E21 +/- 0.3E21 cm^-2, kT(disk) = 0.50 +/- 0.01 keV, kT(bbody) = 1.05 +/- 0.04 keV, and power-law index = 1.85 +/- 0.09 (all uncertainties quoted here at the 90% confidence level). We find that a broad, relativistic Fe K emission line is present in the spectrum, with a clearly asymmetric profile, as has been seen recently in other neutron star low-mass X-ray binaries (e.g., Bhattacharyya & Strohmayer 2007, ApJ, 664, L103, Cackett et al., 2008, ApJ, 674, 415). This is the first time an asymmetric iron line has been observed in an accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar. The iron line can be well fit by the diskline model (Fabian et al. 1989, MNRAS, 238, 729), with EW = 121 +/- 23 eV. From our initial analysis of the iron line, we find an inner accretion disk radius of 13 +/- 5 GM/c^2. During fitting, we only allowed the inclination to be within the range 36 - 67 degrees (Deloye et al., 2008, MNRAS, in press, arXiv:0810.0489), and found a best-fitting value of 50 +/- 6 degrees. We thank the US and Japanese Suzaku teams for performing the observation of SAX J1808.4-3658. 2008-11-14 15:09:00
response: 该现象表明，在吸积毫秒X射线脉冲星SAX J1808.4−3658的2008年爆发期间，Suzaku观测首次在该类源中探测到宽而不对称的相对论性铁K发射线。这一谱线特征无法用窄线或本征高斯轮廓解释，其显著的红翼展宽与蓝翼陡峭构成典型不对称轮廓，符合广义相对论框架下内吸积盘辐射在强引力场中经历的光子轨道弯曲、引力红移及多普勒效应——即相对论性反射特征。采用diskline模型拟合得到等效宽度EW = 121 ± 23 eV，说明铁荧光辐射具有较强相对论性增亮，且源于靠近中子星极端引力势阱的区域；反推得出的内盘半径R_in = 13 ± 5 GM/c²，落在中子星ISCO（最内稳定圆轨道）典型范围附近（对于1.4 M⊙中子星，ISCO约6–9 GM/c²），暗示吸积盘可能延伸至非常接近中子星表面的位置，支持中子星表面存在吸积边界层并主导硬X射线辐射的物理图像。倾角约束为50 ± 6°，处于合理观测范围内，排除了因视线方向导致的系统性模型退化。结合未探测到I型暴的事实，说明此时吸积流稳定、热核燃烧未被触发，有利于持续产生稳定的反射谱特征。因此，该铁线为吸积盘内区受中子星强引力场调制的直接观测证据，证实毫秒脉冲星系统同样具备产生相对论性反射谱的能力，拓展了此类源作为强场引力探针的应用范围。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Three M31 Microlensing/Nova Candidates We report the discovery of three optical transients in M31 by the Angstrom M31 bulge microlensing survey using the Liverpool Telescope (La Palma, Steele et al. 2004). These transients were discovered using difference imaging techniques by the Angstrom Project Alert System (APAS, Darnley et al. 2007) in a series of Sloan i'-band images of the bulge of M31.
ANG-08B-M31-01: The first transient is located at RA=00:42:48.5 Dec=+41:13:49.8 (J2000), 137.12" South and 52.12" East of the core of M31. No significant variation has been observed at this position through the past four M31 observing seasons. This event was observed at a peak i'-band magnitude of 18.99Â±0.06 on October 20.02 2008 and was resolvable in a single 200s background subtracted image. Subsequent behaviour of the light-curve suggests this object may be either a nova or possibly a binary microlensing event.
ANG-08B-M31-02: A second transient is located at RA=00:42:56.4 Dec=+41:15:46.7 (J2000), 138.12" East and 18.21" South of the core of M31. Periodic lightcurve behaviour is seen throughout the previous four seasons, consistent with a long-period variable at or close to the position of this event. However a stronger and sharper peak in the i' band was observed to reach a maximum of mi=20.3Â±0.2 on November 07.81 2008 and was just resolvable in a stack of seven 200s images following background subtraction. The light-curve of this object suggests that it is likely to be due to microlensing with peak magnification occurring at MJD=54774.1Â±0.6 days and with a full width at half maximum duration of 7Â±3 days. 
ANG-08B-M31-03: The third transient is located at RA=00:42:56.4 Dec=+41:16:18.1 (J2000), 137.15" East and 13.27" North of the core of M31. Periodic variation at or close to the position of this event has been observed throughout the previous four observing seasons. A stronger and sharper outburst was observed to peak at mi=18.74Â±0.05 in the i' band on November 07.81 2008 and was also just resolvable following background subtraction. This event shows a gradual rise consistent with microlensing rather than a nova but subsequent behaviour appears inconsistent with microlensing by a single lens. 
Further details of these events, including lightcurves and discovery images can be found at: http://wiki.astro.ljmu.ac.uk/angstrom/index.php/Angstrom_Transient_Alerts:_2008
Angstrom Project Web Site 2008-11-14 16:39:00
response:
首先，三起光学暂现源均位于M31星系核球区域，由Angstrom M31核球微引力透镜巡天项目利用利物浦望远镜的Sloan i'波段差分成像数据发现，说明其探测方法统一、数据处理流程一致，具备可比性。

其次，ANG-08B-M31-01在该位置过去四个观测季无显著光变，排除了长周期变星或已知脉动变星的可能性；其峰值亮度高（i'=18.99）、信噪比好（误差仅±0.06），且单帧200秒曝光即可分辨，表明暂现源本身较亮、点源性质明确；光变曲线后续演化未呈现典型 nova 的快速衰减或特征发射线证据，也未显示微透镜所需的对称性与可建模时标，故暂归为“nova 或双星微透镜事件”——这一模糊判定源于缺乏足够采样以区分二者：nova 通常具爆发上升快、下降慢、光谱含宽发射线等特征，而双星微透镜则可能产生非对称、多峰或畸变的光变轮廓，但当前仅凭i'波段单色光变难以确证。

第三，ANG-08B-M31-02在历史数据中存在周期性光变，说明其宿主是一颗长周期变星（如米拉型或半规则变星），本次事件表现为叠加其基底上的更强、更尖锐的i'波段峰（Δm ≈ 2–3 mag，FWHM ≈ 7天），且拟合得到微透镜特征参数：峰值时刻MJD=54774.1±0.6、半高全宽7±3天，符合典型恒星级微透镜事件的时间尺度（数日至数周）；其需多帧叠加（7×200s）才可分辨，暗示本征亮度较低或受宿主星晕影响，支持微透镜放大背景源而非自身爆发，因此更倾向判定为微透镜事件。

第四，ANG-08B-M31-03同样具有历史周期性光变，本次爆发更亮（i'=18.74）、精度更高（±0.05），且上升过程平缓，符合微透镜的渐进放大特征；但后续光变偏离单透镜模型预测——单透镜微透镜光变严格对称、可用Paczyński公式描述，而实际曲线出现不一致性，可能反映复杂透镜系统（如双星透镜、行星系统）或源星自行导致的有限源效应，亦不排除宿主星自身活动叠加干扰，故判断为“非单透镜微透镜”，即存在多体透镜或其它物理机制参与。

综上，三者虽同为i'波段暂现源，但本质差异显著：ANG-08B-M31-01缺乏先验光变历史，候选爆发型源；ANG-08B-M31-02与ANG-08B-M31-03均有周期性基底，其中前者光变特征高度吻合单透镜微透镜，后者则因偏离单透镜模型而指向更复杂的引力透镜构型。

input: 根据现象进行分析： XMM-Newton detects a relativistically broadened Iron Line in SAX J1808.4-3658 spectrum. The Accreting Millisecond Pulsar SAX J1808.4-3658 (P=2.49 ms) was observed by XMM Newton for 60 ks on 2008 October 1 (Start Time=MJD 54739.99517), during the outburst which began on 2008 September 21 (ATEL #1728). To model the continuum emission we used data acquired by EPIC PN (timing mode) and RGS1-2, which observed 600c/s and 40c/s respectively from the source. The absorbed 0.3-10 keV continuum emission is well fitted by a model composed by a multitemperature disc blackbody, a blackbody and a power law, but the addition of a relativistically broadened emission line at 6.5 keV is strongly required by the data. The parameters we obtain for the continuum are: nH=0.162(1)E22 cm^-2; kTdisk=0.20(1) keV; kTbb=0.34(1) keV; alpha=2.08(1). The normalization of the blackbody component is compatible with the size of the NS surface. Numbers in parentheses are the uncertainties in the last digit, quoted at the 90% confidence level. A line with an energy compatible with K emission of Iron is detected at more than 10 sigma. The line is well modeled by a diskline model (Fabian et al. 1989, MNRAS, 238, 729), which gives an energy of LineE=6.48(8)keV, and an equivalent width of 105 +/- 15 eV, for an inclination best fit value of (60+/-10)Â°. The energy of the line indicates a weakly ionized state for Iron. We note however that larger values are obtained for lower inclinations, which are indicated by the orbital evolution of the binary (Di Salvo et al. 2008, MNRAS, 389, 1851). We obtain an estimate for the inner disc radius of (11+/-5) GM/c^2; as the corotation radius is Rc=15GM/c^2 for a 1.4Msun NS accreting from a Keplerian disc in SAX J1808.4-3658, this value is perfectly in agreement with the disc being truncated in regions where accretion is not centrifugally inhibited. This is the first time that such an estimate can be made for an Accreting Millisecond Pulsar. We note that the line detection agrees with Suzaku observations (ATEL #1844). We thank Dr.N.Schartel and the XMM-Newton Team who made this ToO observation possible. 2008-11-17 00:14:00
response:
XMM-Newton在SAX J1808.4−3658爆发期间观测到一条显著的相对论性展宽铁Kα发射线，能量为6.48(8) keV，等效宽度105±15 eV，信噪比超过10σ，表明该谱线具有高度统计显著性。该线由diskline模型拟合良好，说明其起源于吸积盘内区受强引力场影响的辐射区域。线心能量对应弱电离态铁（Fe I–Fe XVII），支持冷、中性或低电离吸积盘物质的存在。

通过diskline拟合得到的倾角最佳值为60°±10°，对应内盘半径R_in = 11±5 GM/c²；而该源中子星质量取1.4 M⊙时，共转半径R_c = 15 GM/c²。由于R_in < R_c且二者在误差范围内一致，表明吸积盘在共转半径以内被磁层截断，即盘内边界位于磁压与离心力平衡处，未发生离心抑制型吸积——这与毫秒脉冲星标准磁层截断模型相符。

连续谱由三成分组成：吸收的多温吸积盘黑体（kT_disk = 0.20(1) keV）、热核黑体（kT_bb = 0.34(1) keV，归一化对应中子星表面尺寸，支持辐射来自NS表面）、以及幂律成分（α = 2.08(1)），说明存在热冕与热核辐射共存的复合辐射机制。N_H = 0.162(1)×10²² cm⁻²表明视线方向星际吸收较弱，谱形特征主要反映源本征物理。

该结果是首次在吸积毫秒脉冲星中通过相对论性铁线直接约束内盘半径，并验证磁层截断模型；且与Suzaku独立观测结果一致，增强了结论的可靠性。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift detection of Super Soft X-ray emission in nova CSS081007:030559+054715 Swift obtained simultaneous X-ray and UV observations of the recent ONe nova CSS081007:030559+054715 (ATEL #1825, ATEL #1835) on November 10 and 14, 2008. The ~ 4 ks observation revealed a strong and variable source in both the XRT and UVOT detectors. The average X-ray count rate was 0.183+/-0.009 counts/s while the UVW2 band (lambda_c ~ 1928 Angstroms) was 15.1+/-0.1 mag. The source is very soft in the X-ray spectrum with most photons below 0.6 keV. The X-ray spectrum can be modelled with an absorbed blackbody with kT ~ (38 +5/-7) eV and NH ~ (1.6 +0.9/-0.5)x10^21 cm^-2. The 0.3-1 keV X-ray flux is 6.3x10^-12 erg cm^-2 s^-1 (1.1x10^-10 unabsorbed). 
The unabsorbed bolometric flux of the model is 2.8x10^-9 erg cm^-2 s^-1. To convert this to a bolometric luminosity we estimate the distance through indirect methods since the initial outburst was not observed. Converting the SDSS ugriz photometry of the quiescent source to UBVRI photometry using the stellar transformations of Jester et al. (2005, AJ, 130, 873) gives V = 18.5 mag. The extinction maps of Schlegel et al. (1998 ApJ, 500, 525) show E(B-V) = 0.15 in the direction of CSS081007:030559+054715. 
The first method assumes an absolute visual magnitude of M_V(max) ~ -9 mag and an outburst amplitude between 12 and 15 magnitudes (e.g. Table 5.4 in Warner's "Cataclysmic Variable Stars" 1995), both are typical of very fast novae and CSS081007:030559+054715 is likely to be a member of this speed class based on the similarity of its optical nebular spectrum with the very fast novae V838 Her and V4160 Sgr (see Schwarz et al. 2007, ApJ, 657, 453). These assumptions suggest a distance range of 2.5 to 10 kpc. A second method assumes that the absolute visual magnitude at minimum for post-novae and some cataclysmic variables is 7 > M_V(min) > 4 mag (e.g. Fig. 4.20 in Warner 1995) for a wide range of orbital periods and inclination angles. The distance based on this second method is between 1.6 and 6.4 kpc. 
Therefore the bolometric luminosity ranges from 9x10^35 to 1.4x10^37 erg s^-1 for distances of 2.5 and 6.4 kpc. Note that luminosities based on blackbodies generally overestimate the true luminosity while underestimating the effective temperature. Interestingly, our distance estimate and the galactic coordinates (l,b = 172.6,-43.7) imply that the z-distance from the Galactic plane exceeds 1.7 kpc which is well above where most classical novae, particularly the ONe type, are found. Additional observations at other wavelengths of this interesting nova are strongly encouraged. 
We thank the Swift PI, Neil Gehrels, the Swift science team, and the Swift mission operations team for their support of these observations. 2008-11-17 14:30:00
response:
该现象描述了一次ONe型新星CSS081007:030559+054715在爆发后早期阶段的Swift卫星多波段观测结果，核心特征是探测到强烈的超软X射线辐射。首先，X射线谱极软，光子能量主要集中于0.3–0.6 keV以下，符合典型超软X射线源（SSS）特征，即热核燃烧持续发生在白矮星表面、光球温度约38 eV（对应有效温度约4.4×10⁵ K）、且存在中等程度吸收（N_H ≈ 1.6×10²¹ cm⁻²）。该黑体拟合给出的未吸收0.3–1 keV通量为1.1×10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，结合推导出的未吸收总辐射通量2.8×10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，表明该源正处于稳态氢壳层燃烧阶段，光度远高于爱丁顿极限下的典型白矮星吸积光度，支持其为质量较大（接近钱德拉塞卡极限）的ONe白矮星。

其次，距离估计存在两套独立方法：第一种基于最大光度M_V(max) ≈ −9 mag及光变幅度ΔV ≈ 12–15 mag，对应距离2.5–10 kpc；第二种基于宁静期视星等V = 18.5 mag与典型后新星最小绝对星等M_V(min) = 4–7 mag，得距离1.6–6.4 kpc。二者交集约束距离约为2.5–6.4 kpc，由此导出的光度范围为9×10³⁵–1.4×10³⁷ erg s⁻¹，落在超软X射线源典型光度区间内（10³⁶–10³⁸ erg s⁻¹），进一步佐证其物理本质。值得注意的是，该源银纬b = −43.7°，z高度|z| > 1.7 kpc，显著偏离银河系薄盘（典型经典新星集中于|z| < 0.5 kpc），暗示其可能属于晕族或高速逃逸系统，而ONe型新星通常形成于厚盘或晕中，与高z位置一致。

最后，UVW2波段（1928 Å）亮度达15.1 mag，说明同步存在较强的紫外连续谱辐射，与SSS阶段预期一致——此时光学厚风尚未完全遮蔽紫外/X射线辐射；X射线计数率0.183 cts/s及显著光变性，反映燃烧壳层不稳定性或吸积流调制。综上，该观测确认CSS081007:030559+054715是一颗处于超软X射线阶段的快速ONe新星，其高z位置、强SSS辐射与紫外辐射共存、以及适中的吸收柱密度共同指向一个大质量白矮星主导的、处于稳定核燃烧晚期的系统。

根据现象进行分析： AGILE detection of a possible rebrightening of  the gamma-ray source AGL J2021+4032  in the Cygnus Region  During the current AGILE pointing centered near the Cygnus Region the Gamma-Ray Imaging Detector (GRID) has detected a source positionally consistent with the gamma-ray source previously reported in ATel#1585. 
Integrating from 2008-11-16 14:33 UT to 2008-11-17 14:22 UT, a preliminary maximum likelihood analysis shows a detection at a significance level near 5 sigma, with a source flux more than two standard deviations above the mean flux reported in ATel#1585. The positional error box of the source AGL J2021+4032 (integrated over the total AGILE exposure of the field) is centered at Galactic coordinates l = 78.3 deg, b = 2.1 deg, and has a radius of about 0.2 degrees. 
The AGILE monitoring of the field containing this source will continue until 2008-11-30 12:00 UT. We strongly encourage multi-frequency observations of the Cygnus field containing the gamma-ray source AGL J2021+4032. 2008-11-17 20:19:00
response: 该现象表明AGILE卫星在对天鹅座区域进行定点观测期间，通过GRID探测器重新探测到了伽马射线源AGL J2021+4032，并发现其存在可能的再增亮现象。首先，该源的位置与ATel#1585中先前报道的位置一致，说明这是同一物理源的再次活动；其次，在2008年11月16日14:33 UT至11月17日14:22 UT的约24小时积分时间内，最大似然分析给出约5σ的显著性检测，表明该信号极不可能由背景涨落引起；第三，当前测得的流量超过ATel#1585所报平均流量两个标准差以上，支持其处于增强态；第四，源的位置误差圆以银经l = 78.3°、银纬b = 2.1°为中心，半径约0.2°，定位精度较高，有利于后续多波段证认；最后，AGILE将持续监测该天区至11月30日，结合呼吁开展多频段协同观测，暗示该再增亮可能对应于某种高能暂现事件（如耀发、吸积增强或激波再加速等），需通过射电、光学、X射线等波段数据联合分析其辐射机制与物理起源。

根据现象进行分析： Exceptional radio outbursts of the blazars AO 0235+16 and 3C 454.3 observed by the GASP With reference to ATels #1724, #1735, #1744, #1746, #1784, #1785 on the high radio-to-optical and gamma-ray activity of the blazar AO 0235+16, the GLAST-AGILE Support Program (GASP) of the Whole Earth Blazar Telescope (WEBT) reports on the recent observation of an exceptional radio outburst of the source. At 1 mm the flux density reached a maximum of 5.0+-0.4 Jy on October 28, 2008. Flux densities of 6.3+-0.4, 6.8+-0.3, and 6.5+-0.2 Jy were registered at 43, 22, and 8 GHz, respectively, on November 7-11. These brightness levels overcome those reached during the 2007 outburst, which were reported by Raiteri et al. (2008, A&A 480, 339), and are comparable to the brightest states observed during the huge 1992-1993 outburst (see e.g. Raiteri et al. 2006, A&A 459, 731). 
Another exceptional outburst observed in July-November 2008 at both mm and cm wavelengths concerns 3C 454.3. In particular, the 43 GHz peak level of 28.4+-0.9 Jy represents the highest flux density ever detected at this frequency (see e.g. Raiteri et al. 2008, A&A, in press, arXiv:0810.2424). This radio outburst follows the optical and gamma-ray activity observed in May-July (see ATels #1545, #1581, #1592, #1625, #1628, #1634). 2008-11-20 10:03:00
response:
首先，文本描述了两个耀变体AO 0235+16和3C 454.3在2008年发生的异常强烈的射电爆发事件，观测由GASP（GLAST-AGILE Support Program）开展，属于WEBT（Whole Earth Blazar Telescope）合作项目。  
其次，针对AO 0235+16：其毫米波（1 mm）流量密度在2008年10月28日达到峰值5.0±0.4 Jy；厘米波段（43、22、8 GHz）流量密度在11月7–11日期间分别达6.3±0.4、6.8±0.3、6.5±0.2 Jy；这些值均超过2007年爆发的记录（Raiteri et al. 2008），并接近1992–1993年历史最强爆发水平（Raiteri et al. 2006）。  
第三，针对3C 454.3：2008年7–11月同样观测到显著射电爆发；其中43 GHz峰值流量密度达28.4±0.9 Jy，为该频点有史以来最高值（Raiteri et al. 2008, arXiv:0810.2424）；该射电爆发滞后于同年5–7月的光学与伽马射线高活动期（ATels #1545等），呈现多波段辐射的时间序列关联性。  
最后，两次爆发均被置于更广泛的多波段监测框架下（ATels #1724等及#1545等），表明AO 0235+16和3C 454.3在2008年经历了极端同步加速辐射增强事件，可能源于喷流中新的激波传播、粒子再加速或磁场重联等物理过程，且射电波段响应存在时间延迟，符合相对论性喷流中辐射区向外传播导致的光变时标展宽特征。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT Observations of the Cygnus Region  The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope, has been observing the Cygnus region regularly since 3 August 2008 as part of its on-going sky survey, which covers ~20% of the sky at any instant and all points in the sky every 3 hours. The LAT has detected two persistent, bright sources within or near the error circle of the gamma-ray source AGL J2030+4043 reported by AGILE in ATEL #1827. These source positions are not consistent with gamma-ray emission from Cyg X-3. 
The first source is within the AGILE error circle and is positionally consistent with the EGRET source 3EG J2033+4118 (R. Hartman et al. 1999, ApJS, 123, 79). The LAT measures a persistent integral flux of about 50 x 10-8 ph cm-2 s-1 above 100 MeV when the object is modeled as a point source. The second, nearby but outside the AGILE error circle, is the bright source 3EG J2020+4017, for which the LAT measures a persistent integral flux of about 170 x 10-8 ph cm-2 s-1 above 100 MeV when it is modeled as a point source. These fluxes have an uncertainty of about 30% and should be considered preliminary. 
Firm locations, fluxes, and associated uncertainties of the LAT-detected sources will be reported in the forthcoming release of a LAT high-confidence source list. 
During the interval reported by AGILE in ATEL #1827 (MJD 54773), the LAT can place a preliminary 95%-confidence upper limit on >100 MeV gamma flux from Cyg X-3 of 80 x 10-8 ph cm-2 s-1, including systematic uncertainty. Similar limits are observed on neighboring days. Given the proximity of the other bright sources, and the unexceptional level of the flux upper limit on this particular day, we conclude that the emission reported by AGILE from this region is unlikely to be from Cyg X-3. 
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this region will continue. 2008-11-21 19:01:00
response:
首先，Fermi LAT自2008年8月3日起对天鹅座区域进行持续巡天观测，覆盖约20%的瞬时视场，且每3小时扫过全天任意一点，因此具有高时间覆盖率和系统性监测能力。  
其次，LAT在AGILE报告的伽马射线源AGL J2030+4043的误差圆内及附近探测到两个持久、明亮的点源：第一个位于AGILE误差圆内，位置与EGRET源3EG J2033+4118一致，测得>100 MeV积分通量约为50 × 10⁻⁸ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹；第二个位于误差圆外但邻近，对应EGRET源3EG J2020+4017，通量更高，约为170 × 10⁻⁸ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹；两者通量不确定性均为~30%，属初步结果。  
第三，这两个源的位置均不与Cyg X-3一致，且其通量水平显著高于Cyg X-3可能贡献的上限——在AGILE报告事件发生时刻（MJD 54773），LAT给出Cyg X-3在>100 MeV能段的95%置信度通量上限为80 × 10⁻⁸ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹（含系统误差），该上限值并不异常，且邻近日期的上限相似。  
第四，考虑到AGL J2030+4043误差圆内存在已知强源3EG J2033+4118，且Cyg X-3无对应显著辐射，而AGILE所报信号空间位置与该强源重合、时间上又无明显耀发特征，因此AGILE探测到的辐射更可能源于3EG J2033+4118等已知源，而非Cyg X-3。  
最后，Fermi的全天扫描模式确保该区域将持续被高频监测，未来高置信度源表将提供更精确的位置、通量及误差信息，进一步验证源识别结论。

根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopy of M31N 2007-11g: Another Luminous Mira-like Variable in M31 Masquerading as a Nova On 2008 November 17.23 UT observations made with the Livermore Optical Transient Imaging System (Super-LOTIS, located at Steward Observatory, Kitt Peak, Arizona, USA) revealed that the nova candidate M31N 2007-11g (Ovcharov et al. 2007; Atel #1312) had re-brightened to R~18.8, similar to its brightness at discovery a year earlier in November 2007. Since this behavior would be unusual for a nova (but typical of a Long-Period Variable), we decided to obtain a spectrum of M31N 2007-11g to determine its nature. 
On 2008 November 18.3 UT, we observed M31N 2007-11g with the Marcario Low-Resolution Spectrograph on the 9.2-m Hobby Eberly Telescope. The spectrum reveals strong TiO absorption bands and narrow Balmer emission (Hα: FWHM ~ 300 km/s; EW ~ -10Ã ; RV ~ -275 km/s) superimposed on a red continuum. Thus, as suspected, M31N 2007-11g is not a nova; but rather appears to be a luminous long-period Mira-like variable, similar to the nova candidate M31N 1995-11e (Shafter et al. 2008; Atel #1834). 2008-11-21 23:58:00
response: 该现象的核心在于对暂现源M31N 2007-11g的光谱证认与物理本质判定。首先，其在2008年11月17.23 UT的再增亮（R≈18.8）与一年前发现时亮度一致，这一重复性光变行为不符合经典新星的单次爆发衰减特征，而更符合长周期变星（如米拉变星）的周期性脉动光变规律，由此提出“非新星”的初步质疑。其次，获取的光学光谱呈现三个关键诊断特征：一是强TiO吸收带，这是冷（T_eff ≲ 3500 K）、富氧、高光度红巨星（特别是米拉型变星）的典型分子吸收特征；二是窄Hα发射线（FWHM ≈ 300 km/s），远窄于新星爆发中常见的宽发射线（通常FWHM > 1000 km/s），表明气体运动速度低，对应宁静包层或星周物质的低速外流，而非新星激波驱动的高速抛射；三是红连续谱，支持其为低温红巨星。综合这些光谱特征，可排除热核失控引发的新星爆发模型，确认其本质是一颗高光度、富氧、具有星周气体活动的米拉型长周期变星，与M31N 1995-11e性质一致。因此，该源属于被误分类的恒星变星，而非真实的新星。

根据现象进行分析： Multi-frequency radio spectra of the blazars AO 0235+16 and  3C 454.3 We have measured radio spectra of the blazars AO 0235+16 and 3C454.3 with the RATAN-600 radio telescope during 31 October - 11 November, 2008 at 1, 2.15, 4.8, 7.7, 11.2 and 21.7 GHz. Our data for AO 0235+16 do well (errors are 5-7%) agree with the radio data from ATEL #1849 by Bach et al., really being an extension in the lower frequency band, where spectral index is equal to +0.85 at 1 - 4.8 GHz. The spectrum of the 3C454.3 consists of two power law components crossed at 4.8 GHz: a low-frequency one with the spectral index -0.30, and a high-frequency one with the spectral index +0.20. Obviously, both blazars are in an active state at high frequencies. 
The epoch 2008.85 radio spectra of AO0235+16 and 3C454.3 2008-11-23 10:14:00
response:
首先，题目描述了对两个耀变体AO 0235+16和3C 454.3在2008年10月31日至11月11日期间（对应历元2008.85）利用RATAN-600望远镜开展的多频射电谱观测，频率覆盖1–21.7 GHz共6个频点。  
其次，对于AO 0235+16，观测数据在误差5–7%范围内与ATEL #1849中Bach等人发表的结果一致，且本工作将频谱向下延展至更低频段；在1–4.8 GHz区间测得谱指数为+0.85，表明该波段呈现明显的正谱（即流量随频率升高而增加），这是典型致密、自吸收主导或处于爆发上升相的喷流核心辐射特征。  
再次，3C 454.3的谱形明显偏离单幂律，其谱在4.8 GHz处发生转折：低频段（≤4.8 GHz）谱指数为−0.30（呈轻微倒谱，符合同步辐射自吸收区外延特征），高频段（≥4.8 GHz）谱指数为+0.20（正谱），说明存在两个物理成分叠加——可能分别对应扩展喷流（低频主导）与致密核心（高频主导），或不同辐射区（如不同光学深度、磁场强度或电子能谱分布区域）的贡献。  
最后，“两者在高频段均处于活动状态”这一判断依据在于：AO 0235+16在4.8–21.7 GHz仍保持正谱（+0.85延伸至更高频或至少未显著变负），而3C 454.3在4.8–21.7 GHz谱指数为+0.20，均表明高频辐射增强，符合耀变体在耀发期间核心区域同步辐射峰值向更高频漂移、光度上升的典型行为。

We first excluded camera dwells with a high background rate, filtering out dwells with channel A X-ray background < 12.0 ASM c/s. We then binned the flux measurements to intervals of one week. The resulting light curve shows that the source is a long-term, faint transient, and the current outburst began in late 2005 or early 2006. Between MJD 50088 (first observation) and 53600, the source is not detected. The weighted average flux is 1.3 (1.0) mCrab at 1.5-12 keV, with an uncertainty set by the systematic limit for ASM observations of faint sources. The source is weakly detected at 3.1 (1.0) mCrab during 53600 to 53800, rising to 5.1 (1.0) mCrab between 53800 and 54540, and 6.3 (1.0) mCrab between 54540 and the present day (54794). In the most recent interval, the X-ray color, HR2 = 1.3 (0.3), suggests a soft X-ray transient rather than a classical accretion-powered pulsar (see Cackett, Wijnands, and Remillard, 2006, MNRAS, 369, 1965). 2008-11-24 20:38:00
response:
首先，该分析基于RXTE ASM数据构建IGR J17062-6143的全天监视器光变曲线，采用Swift XRT给出的精确位置进行源提取。为保证信噪比，预处理中剔除了背景过高的观测段，具体标准是通道A的X射线背景计数率低于12.0 ASM计数/秒的dwells被排除。随后将有效数据按每周时间尺度进行binning，形成时间分辨率为一周的光变曲线。

其次，光变曲线揭示该源属于长期、低光度的暂现源：在MJD 50088（即1996年1月首次ASM观测）至MJD 53600（约2005年9月）期间未探测到任何显著信号，表明源处于宁静态；当前爆发始于2005年末或2006年初。定量来看，整个爆发期间加权平均流量为1.3±1.0 mCrab（1.5–12 keV），该误差主要由ASM对弱源观测的系统误差主导，而非统计误差。

第三，爆发演化呈现明显阶段性：在MJD 53600–53800（2006年2–7月）区间，源被弱探测到，流量为3.1±1.0 mCrab；随后在53800–54540（2006年7月–2008年3月）上升至5.1±1.0 mCrab；进一步在54540–54794（2008年3月–11月）达到6.3±1.0 mCrab，显示持续缓慢增强趋势。

最后，光谱信息提供物理分类线索：最新区间（MJD 54540–54794）测得硬X射线颜色HR2 = 1.3±0.3。根据Cackett等（2006）的判据，该HR2值偏低，符合软X射线暂现源（SXT）特征，而非典型吸积供能脉冲星（其HR2通常更高），暗示该源很可能是一颗低质量X射线双星中的中子星，处于以热核燃烧或低率吸积为主导的软谱态。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT reports the detection of a new galactic source Swift J1539.2-6227  The hard X-ray transient monitor of the Swift Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) has detected a previously unknown galactic transient. This source, Swift J1539.2-6227, was first detected at a daily average rate of 0.024 Â± 0.010 counts/sec/cm2 (100 mcrab) in the 15-50 keV band on November 24, 2008 (MJD 54794). It has continued at nearly the same brightness for the past three days of observations. The best BAT position is RA=234.804 Dec=-62.466, (J2000) with an estimated error of 3'. Note that this source is on the galactic plane at coordinates L=321.021, B=-5.643 degrees. 
This source is currently too close to the Sun to be observed with the Swift narrow-field instruments. It will come out of Sun constraint on Dec. 22, 2008. An RXTE observation is scheduled for later today. 
Swift/BAT light curve for Swift J1539.2-6227 2008-11-26 21:22:00
response: 该现象表明Swift/BAT在2008年11月24日首次探测到一个位于银河系内的新型硬X射线暂现源Swift J1539.2-6227。其15–50 keV能段的日平均计数率为0.024 ± 0.010 counts/sec/cm²，对应约100 mcrab，亮度在随后连续三天内保持稳定，说明该源处于相对持续的爆发或高态，而非快速衰减的短时标爆发。源的位置（RA=234.804°, Dec=−62.466°, J2000）误差为3角分，且位于银道面附近（银经L=321.021°, 银纬B=−5.643°），这一位置特征强烈暗示其为银河系内天体，可能属于低质量X射线双星（LMXB）、高质量X射线双星（HMXB）或磁中子星系统等典型银河系X射线暂现源类别。由于其当前太阳距角过小，Swift窄视场仪器（XRT/UVOT）无法观测，需等待12月22日脱离太阳约束；而RXTE已安排当日观测，旨在获取更高统计精度的能谱与光变信息，以进一步判别辐射机制、吸积状态及致密天体性质。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of a Type Ia Supernova in a Faint Dwarf Galaxy We have discovered a supernova in observations from CSS, Palomar 60 and the Plaskett Telescope starting from 22 Nov UT. The discovery has the following parameters: 
CSS081122:094326+251021|  2008-11-22 UT 10:18:11 |  RA 09:43:26.22 |  Dec 25:10:21.9 |  Mag 16.4|  Type SN Ia| z=0.027  
---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
CSS081122:094326+251021 is associated with a very faint anonymous galaxy seen in SDSS DR7 images (mags: u= 23.2, g=22.7, r=22.8, i=22.7, z=23.6). Photometric follow-up was taken with P60 on Nov 24.4 UT and provides the following colours: g-r = -0.12(+/-0.15), r-i= -0.61(+/-0.1). These values are consistent with a SN type Ia within 20 days of maximum light (Poznanski et al. 2002, PASP, 114, 833). Confirmation was obtained on Nov. 26.4 UT with the 1.82-m Plaskett Telescope of the National Research Council of Canada and shows it to be a type Ia supernova about 11 days past maximum light from SNIDs (Blondin and Tonry 2007, Ap.J. 666, 1024) with fit redshift 0.027. 
Based on the supernova's redshift and SDSS r-band magnitude, the host galaxy has Mr=-12.4. Additionally, assuming a peak magnitude for SN-Ia of -19.3, combined with the discovery magnitude at 7 days past maximum light (assuming a decline rate of 0.08 mags/day), the host galaxy is found to have Mr=-12.3. This result suggests that the supernova's host galaxy is an intrinsically faint Dwarf galaxy (or an Ultra-Compact Dwarf galaxy). Supernovae in such low stellar-mass systems are expected to be rare but have recently been observed for more than a dozen spectroscopically confirmed events by CRTS and others.   

For finding charts and discovery images please see: http://voeventnet.cacr.caltech.edu/feeds/ATEL/CRTS.    
Current candidate and confirmed SNe can be found here.  
CRTS optical transients are detected and published as VOEvents in real-time at http://voeventnet.org/feeds/Catalina.shtml  and in RSS here http://voeventnet.caltech.edu/feeds/Catfeed.xml 2008-11-27 18:11:00
response: 该超新星被证认为Ia型，红移z=0.027，对应光度距离约115 Mpc（采用标准宇宙学参数H₀=70 km/s/Mpc，Ωₘ=0.3，Ω_Λ=0.7），其发现时视星等为16.4 mag。根据SDSS DR7测光数据，宿主星系在r波段的视星等为22.8 mag；结合红移可得其绝对星等Mᵣ ≈ −12.4。另由超新星峰值光度标定法：假设Ia型超新星峰值绝对星等为−19.3 mag，发现时刻距峰值约7天，光变下降率为0.08 mag/天，则超新星发现时贡献的星等修正后反推宿主星系r波段绝对星等为−12.3 mag，与前述一致。该绝对星等显著低于典型矮星系下限（通常Mᵣ < −14 mag为矮星系，但极暗矮星系可低至−11 mag以下），且其多波段测光（u−z色指数跨度大、g−r和r−i色指数偏蓝）表明宿主星系恒星质量极低、恒星形成活动微弱或已熄灭，符合致密矮星系（如ultra-compact dwarf, UCD）或低表面亮度矮椭球星系（dSph）特征。Ia型超新星起源于碳氧白矮星热核爆炸，需双星演化通道提供质量累积，而在恒星质量仅约10⁶–10⁷ M⊙的极暗矮星系中发生Ia型爆发，说明此类系统仍保有足够老年的双星种群（年龄>1 Gyr），且经历了完整的恒星演化与质量传递过程，挑战了“低质量星系缺乏Ia前身星”的传统预期；近年CRTS等巡天已确认十余例同类事件，表明极暗矮星系中Ia型超新星虽率低但非极端罕见，暗示其前身星形成历史可能比当前恒星质量所暗示的更为复杂（例如早期高效恒星形成后经历强反馈剥离气体，或存在未被探测到的暗物质主导晕）。

根据现象进行分析： The Angstrom Project: two new microlensing/nova transients We report the discovery of two new optical transients in M31 by the Angstrom Project M31 bulge microlensing survey using the Liverpool Telescope (La Palma). These transients were discovered using difference imaging techniques by the Angstrom Project Alert System (APAS) in a series of Sloan i'-band images of the bulge of M31. 
ANG-08B-M31-04 is located at RA=00:42:57.3 Dec=+41:15:41.1 (J2000), 148.''05 East and 33.''52 South of the core of M31. Periodic light-curve behaviour is seen throughout the previous four Angstrom observing seasons, consistent with a long-period variable at or close to the position of this event. However a stronger and sharper peak in the i' band was observed to reach a maximum of mi=20.2Â±0.1 (provisional) on November 24.885 2008. The light-curve of this object suggests that it is likely to be an ongoing nova or possibly an exotic microlensing system. 
ANG-08B-M31-05 is located at RA=00:42:59.0 Dec=+41:17:15.5 (J2000), 164.''06 East and 72.''06 North of the core of M31. Periodic variation has been observed at this position through the past four Angstrom observing seasons. However the current rise is substantially stronger than previous variations. This event was observed with a magnitude of mi=20.4Â±0.1 (provisional) as of November 24.885. The current behaviour is consistent with microlensing with a full-width half-maximum time-scale of 30.43Â±1.89 days and a predicted peak occurring at MJD=54793.28Â±0.92 days. Follow-up observations of this event are encouraged. 
More information, including light-curves and imaging data, is available from the Angstrom Project Alert page. 
The Angstrom Project Website 2008-11-30 20:16:00
response:
首先，该文本报告了Angstrom Project在M31星系核球区通过微引力透镜巡天发现的两个光学暂现源：ANG-08B-M31-04和ANG-08B-M31-05。二者均使用利物浦望远镜（La Palma）获取的Sloan i'波段图像，经差分成像技术由Angstrom Project预警系统（APAS）识别。

对于ANG-08B-M31-04：其位置已精确测定（J2000历元），距M31核心东偏148.''05、南偏33.''52；过去四个观测季中持续呈现周期性光变，表明该位置存在一颗长周期变星；但2008年11月24.885日观测到一次显著更强、更尖锐的i'波段亮度峰值（mi=20.2±0.1），幅度和形态明显偏离历史周期行为；因此该爆发事件不能仅用已有变星模型解释，需引入瞬时物理机制—— nova爆发具备快速上升、高光度、单峰特征，与之相符；而特殊微引力透镜系统（如含致密伴星或极端质量比的透镜构型）虽理论上可能产生非典型光变，但概率较低且缺乏周期性先验支持，故nova为更可能的物理解释。

对于ANG-08B-M31-05：其位置同样精确定位（距核心东偏164.''06、北偏72.''06）；历史数据亦显示周期性光变，但本次增亮幅度远超以往；观测到mi=20.4±0.1，且光变轮廓符合标准微引力透镜事件特征：具有明确的FWHM时间尺度（30.43±1.89天）及可预测的峰值时刻（MJD=54793.28±0.92）；该参数化拟合结果与微透镜理论模型高度一致，而nova通常不具备如此对称、平滑、可精确拟合的时间尺度特性；因此该事件更倾向于典型的微引力透镜现象，而非恒星爆发现象。

综上，两目标虽同属暂现源且均叠加于周期性背景之上，但关键判据——爆发形态（尖锐vs平滑）、时间尺度可拟合性、与历史变光行为的偏离程度——指向不同物理起源：ANG-08B-M31-04以经典新星为主导解释，ANG-08B-M31-05则以微引力透镜为主导解释。

On three past occasions (one in 1992, two in 2006; H.E. Bond, 2008, ASP Conf Series 391, p. 129) the spectrum has changed temporarily to an emission-line [WCE] type, with strong emission at the C IV+He II complex near 4659-4686 A and O VI 5291\. A spectrum obtained on 2008 Nov 30.27 with the SMARTS 1.5m telescope at Cerro Tololo by M. Hernandez and F. Walter shows that a new emission-line outburst is underway. Spectroscopic and photometric monitoring, including high-speed photometry of the star's GW Vir-type pulsations, is desirable throughout the duration of the current event. 2008-11-30 23:42:00
response: 该现象描述了一颗行星状星云Lo 4中心星的光谱爆发事件。该星通常呈现PG 1159型吸收光谱，特征为O VI 3811–3834双线处于发射态，表明其大气富含氧、缺乏氢，属高温、演化晚期的后渐近巨星支（post-AGB）恒星。历史上曾三次观测到其光谱由吸收型突变为[WCE]型发射光谱：1992年一次，2006年两次。此类转变表现为C IV+He II复合发射线（4659–4686 Å）和O VI 5291 Å线显著增强，说明外层大气发生剧烈激发或质量抛射，导致高电离离子辐射主导光谱形态。2008年11月30.27日的新观测证实新一轮爆发正在发生，且该星同时具有GW Vir型脉动（即脉动白矮星/前白矮星脉动），暗示其内部结构对非稳态过程极为敏感。因此，当前事件需开展多波段光谱监测以追踪离子激发态演化，结合测光（尤其是高速测光）以探究爆发与脉动相位、振幅变化之间的关联，进而判别爆发机制是源于深层脉动不稳定性驱动的包层扰动，还是局部热核闪光、表面氦燃烧闪或瞬时吸积等暂现能量释放过程。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra Detection of a New Transient X-Ray Source in M31: CXOM31 J004245.9+411036; and Non-Detection of SWIFT J004320.5+411528 We report the discovery of a previously unseen X-ray source detected in a 5ks Chandra/ACIS observation starting on 2008-11-27.72 UT as part of our ongoing Chandra/HST M31 transient program. Its coordinates (subject to the standard boresight correction) are RA(J2000) 00:42:45.96, Dec(J2000) +41:10:36.60, with centroiding errors of 0.18" and 0.21", respectively. It is therefore identified as CXOM31 J004245.9+411036.  
  
Its spectrum is well described by an absorbed power law with Γ = 1.8 and nH = 2.4e21 atoms/cm2. The luminosity in the 0.3-8 keV range is 5.0e37 erg/s, with no photons having been detected above 3 keV.  
  
The presence of a soft component suggests that this new transient may be a black hole transient in the hard state, although the power law does not rule out the possibility of it being a neutron star transient.  
  
  
During this same observation, SWIFT J004320.5+411528 (Pietsch et al. 2008, ATel #1674; Galache et al. 2008, ATel #1693) was in the field of view of ACIS-I. We do not detect it above our limiting luminosity of ~5e35 erg/s. It was last observed to be active on 2008-10-21 (Henze et al. 2008, ATel #1806). We present a table with the known observations of this transient and its X-ray luminosities.

response:
该现象涉及两个关键X射线瞬变源在M31中的观测结果对比分析：  
首先，CXOM31 J004245.9+411036是一个新发现的暂现源，其被Chandra在2008年11月27日的5 ks观测中明确探测到。其位置精度高（误差<0.2″），光谱符合吸收幂律模型（Γ=1.8，nH=2.4×10²¹ cm⁻²），0.3–8 keV能段光度达5.0×10³⁷ erg/s，且无>3 keV光子——表明辐射显著软化；结合软成分存在与硬态幂律特征，最可能为黑洞X射线双星处于硬态，但中子星暂现体因同样可呈现类似谱形而不能完全排除。  

其次，已知暂现源SWIFT J004320.5+411528在同一Chandra观测中未被探测到，其上限光度为~5×10³⁵ erg/s（即<5×10³⁶ erg/s），较此前Swift与Chandra历次观测（2008年8–10月）所测光度（1.1–2.8×10³⁸ erg/s）下降至少两个数量级，表明该源已在2008年10月21日后进入深度宁静期；其光度衰减趋势在表中连续观测数据中清晰体现（从1.8×10³⁸ erg/s逐步降至1.1×10³⁸ erg/s，最终低于5×10³⁶ erg/s），符合典型X射线暂现源爆发后衰减至不可探测水平的演化规律。  

二者对比凸显M31中暂现源活动的时变性：一者正处于新爆发相，另一者已结束爆发并沉寂，反映不同暂现体在相同观测窗口下的演化阶段差异。

首先，观测到四个超新星候选体，均来自CRTS巡天在CSS望远镜图像中的发现，时间跨度为2008年10月30日至12月1日UT。每个候选体均给出精确的观测时刻、赤道坐标（RA/Dec）、测光星等及初步分类为SN。

其次，对各候选体的宿主环境与光变行为进行逐一比对分析：  
CSS081030:100500+142250与SDSS中一个较暗（u~22.6–z~21.4）的延展源位置一致，且在多日CSS及P60图像中持续可见，表明其宿主存在、光变可能为活动星系核或长时标暂现源，但被标记为SN，需进一步排除AGN耀发；  
CSS081119:015930-012621对应PQ叠加强度图中~21.5等的微弱源，且在连续四天（11月19日至12月2日）被多次探测，光变持续约两周，符合典型Ia型超新星上升至峰值后缓慢衰减的时间尺度；  
CSS081201:013055-014208在深度达~22等的PQ叠合图像中无任何宿主检出，暗示其可能位于极暗矮星系、潮汐尾或真正孤立的恒星形成区，该类环境虽稀少但已有先例（如SN 2002cv），结合P60测得颜色与年轻Ia型一致，支持真实超新星假说；  
CSS081201:023759+013029同样关联~21.5等PQ先验源，且观测时间覆盖11月17日至12月2日，时间基线更长，上升段特征更清晰，P60颜色亦支持Ia型，可信度较高。

再次，将本批候选体置于CRTS已公布超新星样本中考察共性：所列9个此前确认事件（如SN 2008hp、SN 2008hk等）全部对应光学亮度较暗（r/i > 21）的宿主，说明CRTS对低面亮度、低光度星系中超新星具有系统性探测能力，本批四例延续该统计趋势，强化了“CRTS倾向于发现宿主昏暗超新星”这一选择效应。

最后，必须考虑证伪性干扰源：包括活动星系核的偶然耀发（尤其对有SDSS对应体者）、食双星掩食、小行星误判（但小行星通常具显著自行，而所有候选体坐标稳定且有多历元匹配）、以及宇宙线或图像处理残差（但均获CSS与P60独立验证，且部分有颜色信息支撑）。因此，尽管不能完全排除非超新星起源，但多历元光变、宿主一致性、颜色证据及巡天统计背景共同指向真实核心坍缩或Ia型超新星的可能性占优，亟需光谱确认类型并测定红移。

根据现象进行分析： The Orbital Period of 4U 1210-64 The nature of 4U 1210-64 (= 1ES 1210-646) is not yet clear. Revnivtsev et al. (2007, ATEL #1253) propose that 4U 1210-64 may be an intermediate polar while Masetti et al. (2008, A&A in press, arXiv:0811.4085v1) find that the source is a high-mass X-ray binary. 
The RXTE ASM light curve of 4U 1210-64 obtained between MJD 50,087 and 54,797 shows that the source has exhibited different states with relatively low or high flux. We identify three main states: a high state followed by a low state and then another high state. During the interval from MJD 50,087 to 50,780 ("epoch 1") the mean flux was 0.62 +/- 0.01 cts/s (8.2 mCrab). Between MJD 50,780 to 53,500 ("epoch 2") the mean flux was 0.15 +/- 0.01 cts/s (2 mCrab). From MJD 53,500 to 54,797 ("epoch 3") the mean flux was 0.45 +/- 0.01 cts/s (6 mCrab). The errors are statistical and systematic errors during all three epochs are expected to be approximately 0.1 cts/s. 
A power spectrum of the ASM light curve from only the high flux states (i.e. excluding epoch 2) shows a highly significant modulation at a period near 6.7 days. This period is expected to be the orbital period of the system. In order to parameterize the modulation in a simple way we fitted a sine wave to the light curve and obtained a period of 6.7106 +/- 0.0006 days and epoch of maximum flux = MJD 54,006.0 +/- 0.2. However, when the folded light curve is examined, the modulation is not strictly sinusoidal. Maximum and minimum fluxes occur at phases of approximately 0.93 and 0.56 respectively. The shape of the folded light curve near minimum suggests the possibility that it is caused by an eclipse, although additional observations are needed to confirm this. 
An RXTE PCA observation of 4U 1210-64 was performed starting on 2008-12-04 at 00:33 UT (MJD 54,804.02), near the time of predicted orbital maximum, with a 10ks exposure. In a preliminary spectral analysis of the PCU 2 data, a good fit (reduced chi2 = 1.15) was obtained over the 2.5 - 20 keV range using a power law continuum (photon index 1.41) with an exponential cut-off (Ecut = 6.0 keV, Efold = 5.7 keV) and an Fe K line at 6.56 keV (equivalent width = 300 eV). The inferred flux is 3.5e-10 ergs/cm2/s, roughly corresponding to 1.1 cts/s with the ASM (14 mCrab). 
Both intermediate polars and HMXB neutron star systems are expected to exhibit pulsations. We therefore searched for pulsations in the PCA light curve. None were detected in a period range of 0.06 to 1,000s. For periods longer than 1,000 s a search for pulsations is complicated by the variability on timescales of hours seen in the light curve which gives a strong red noise component to the power spectrum. 
Further observations of this source over the 6.7 day cycle at X-ray and optical wavelengths are encouraged. 2008-12-04 23:37:00
response:
首先，题目要求根据现象进行分析，需围绕4U 1210-64的轨道周期这一核心事实展开逻辑推理。

观测到RXTE ASM光变曲线在高流量态（epoch 1和epoch 3）中存在显著的周期性调制，功率谱显示一个高度显著的周期约为6.7天。该调制仅在高流量态中清晰呈现，而低流量态（epoch 2）被排除在外——说明该周期信号与源的高态活动强相关，且不受低态本底起伏干扰，增强了其真实性。

进一步，研究者用正弦函数拟合高态光变曲线，得到精确周期为6.7106 ± 0.0006天，误差极小，表明该周期具有高统计置信度。同时给出极大值时刻MJD 54,006.0 ± 0.2，可用于相位校准。这说明周期测量并非粗略估计，而是基于参数化拟合的稳健结果。

值得注意的是，折叠后的光变曲线并非严格正弦形：极大值出现在相位≈0.93，极小值在≈0.56，相位偏移明显；且极小附近光变形态较陡、较窄，呈“凹陷”状，符合食双星系统中伴星遮挡致密天体或吸积柱时产生的掩食特征。虽然尚不能确证为掩食，但该形态学证据支持6.7天为轨道周期而非自转或进动等其他机制所致——因为掩食必然由轨道运动决定，且周期与轨道周期严格一致。

此外，该周期与两类候选模型均兼容：中间极（IP）通常轨道周期为几小时至数天，6.7天略长但非完全排除；而高质量X射线双星（HMXB）的典型轨道周期恰在数天量级（如Vela X-1为8.96天，4U 1700-37为3.41天），因此6.7天更自然地落在HMXB预期范围内。

再结合其他约束：PCA观测未在0.06–1000 s内探测到脉冲，排除了典型中子星自转周期（毫秒至百秒级）主导的调制；而长于1000 s的搜寻受小时尺度红噪声干扰，无法有效检验更长自转周期，但6.7天远超常见自转周期上限，故基本可排除自转调制解释。

最后，光变呈现三段式状态演化（高–低–高），且6.7天调制仅在高态显现，暗示轨道相位可能影响吸积率——例如在HMXB中，椭圆轨道导致距离变化，或风吸积几何随轨道相位改变；而在IP中，白矮星自转与轨道共振或吸积流稳定性对轨道相位敏感，但IP通常不表现如此规则的长周期光变。因此，轨道调制主导高态行为，与其作为HMXB的解释更自洽。

综上，6.7天周期最合理的物理解释是系统的轨道周期，其观测依据包括：高统计显著性、精确拟合、非正弦折叠形态指向掩食、与HMXB典型周期范围一致、排除自转起源、且与高态吸积活动强耦合。

The red UV-optical colors (see Brown et al. 2008, AJ, submitted, arXiv:0803.1265) and the early type galaxy suggest a type Ia SN (consistent with CBET #1599). b = 17.5 +/- 0.1

The red UV-optical colors and the early type galaxy suggest a type Ia SN. response:
首先，题目给出的是Swift卫星UVOT仪器对两颗超新星SN 2008hs和SN 2008hv在近紫外至光学波段的多历元测光数据，并附有颜色特征、宿主星系类型及已有分类线索（CBET通报）。需基于观测现象进行物理分析。

对于SN 2008hs：  
- 在两个观测历元（相隔约1.45天）间，所有光学波段（u, b, v）及近紫外uvw1均显著变亮：u由17.7→16.9（增亮约0.8 mag），b由17.9→17.3（增亮0.6 mag），v由17.9→17.4（增亮0.5 mag），uvw1由19.7→18.7（增亮1.0 mag）。  
- uvw2和uvm2在首历元仅为上限（>21.4, >20.8），次历元测得有限值（20.4±0.2, 21.2±0.3），说明其也在增亮，且uvw2增亮幅度更大（至少1.0 mag），表明短波端亮度上升更剧烈。  
- 所有波段光变一致呈现上升趋势，且短波（uvw2, uvw1）比长波（v）增亮更多，导致UV-optical颜色变蓝（如uvw1−v由2.0→1.3，u−v由0.8→−0.3），但原文指出“red UV-optical colors”，需注意：此处“red”指相对于正常恒星或Ia型超新星早期模板而言的相对红化——实际计算u−v=17.7−17.9=−0.2（首历元）和16.9−17.4=−0.5（次历元），均为负值，即本征偏蓝；但结合uvw1−v=19.7−17.9=1.8和18.7−17.4=1.3，仍属较红的UV−optical色（因正常Ia在极早期uvw1−v≈1.0–1.2），故支持其处于爆发初期。  
- 宿主为早型星系（低恒星形成率），排除核坍缩型超新星主导可能；颜色与正常Ia型超新星爆发前5–10天模板匹配，进一步支持其为Ia型且尚未达光极大。

对于SN 2008hv：  
- 仅单历元观测，但uvw2和uvm2仍为上限（>20.7, >21.3），而uvw1=19.6、u=17.7、b=17.5、v=17.1，同样呈现UV-optical红化（uvw1−v≈2.5，u−v≈0.6），比SN 2008hs首历元更红。  
- 结合早型星系宿主，亦指向Ia型；但单历元无法直接判断光变方向，颜色本身存在简并：既可能为极早期（爆发后<5天，膨胀包层致UV吸收强、谱形红化），也可能为极大后5–10天（Ni⁵⁶衰变主导、中红外辐射增强、UV陡降致相对红化）。  
- 然而CBET #1601报告其“rising”，即光学波段正在增亮，此动态信息打破简并——若处于上升段，则必为爆发初期（pre-maximum），与IR光谱（CBET #1603）显示的未电离铁族元素谱线（如Fe II）、弱Si II 635.5 nm吸收等早期特征一致，共同支持其为年轻Ia型超新星（年龄约−10天左右）。

综上，两颗超新星均位于早型星系中，UV-optical颜色偏红，且光变行为（SN 2008hs明确上升、SN 2008hv被报告为rising）与Ia型超新星爆发初期特征高度吻合；其颜色演化趋势（短波增亮更快）反映激波 breakout 后抛射物快速膨胀冷却、黑体峰值向光学波段迁移的过程，符合Ia型爆炸模型预期。

根据现象进行分析： The Angstrom Project: a new microlensing candidate We report the discovery of a new microlensing candidate in M31 by the Angstrom Project M31 bulge microlensing survey using the Liverpool Telescope (La Palma). The candidate was discovered using difference imaging techniques by the Angstrom Project Alert System (APAS) in a series of Sloan i'-band images of the bulge of M31. 
ANG-08B-M31-06 is located at RA=00:42:39.3, Dec=+41:16:54.9 (J2000), 56.3" West and 43.7" North of the core of M31. Periodic variation has been observed at this position through the past four Angstrom observing seasons due to a bright nearby variable. The current rise appears stronger than previous variations though the close proximity of the object to the M31 core means that it is visible only on difference images and so no reliable magnitude estimate is available. The current behaviour is consistent with microlensing with a full-width half-maximum time-scale of 19.2Â±1.2days and a predicted peak occurring at MJD=54795.0Â±0.5 days. 
More information, including light-curves and imaging data, is available from the Angstrom Project Alert page. 
The Angstrom Project Website 2008-12-05 15:44:00
response:
该现象描述了一个位于M31（仙女座星系）核球区域的新微引力透镜候选体ANG-08B-M31-06。首先，该候选体由Angstrom Project利用利物浦望远镜采集的Sloan i'波段差分图像数据发现，差分成像技术有效抑制了宿主星系恒星背景光，从而揭示出暂现源——这是微透镜事件探测的关键前提，因真实微透镜信号通常淹没在强而复杂的星系光晕或核球背景中。

其次，该源位置靠近M31核心（距核心仅56.3″西、43.7″北），导致其在原始图像中不可分辨，仅能在差分图像中被识别，因此无法获得可靠的绝对星等或基准亮度，这排除了经典变星（如造父变星、食双星）的常规证认路径，但反而支持微透镜解释：微透镜不改变源星固有亮度，仅通过相对运动产生暂现性放大，其可观测性高度依赖背景光扣除质量，与“仅见于差分像”这一特征一致。

第三，尽管该位置过去四年观测季中存在周期性变化（可能源于邻近一颗亮变星），但本次光变幅度更大，且形态符合单透镜微透镜的标准光变曲线特征：具有对称上升/下降、平滑峰值、以及可拟合的时间尺度参数——FWHM为19.2±1.2天，对应典型银河系晕或M31晕中恒星级致密天体（如白矮星、中子星或恒星级黑洞）作为透镜体时的特征时标；预测峰值时刻MJD=54795.0±0.5也满足微透镜事件时间可预报性要求。

最后，未报告颜色变化、伴星光谱特征、或射电/X射线对应体，排除了激变变星、超新星、活动星系核耀发等需多波段能量释放的过程；同时，周期性历史变化与本次非周期性强增亮并存，暗示邻近变星仅为污染源，而非事件本身起源，进一步凸显当前事件的暂现性、非重复性与几何聚焦本质——这三点正是微引力透镜区别于其他暂现现象的核心判据。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT detections of increasing gamma ray activity of blazar 3C 279 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope (formerly GLAST, launched June 11, 2008), has observed a weekly-averaged continuous and increasing trend in the gamma-ray flux from the blazar 3C 279 (J2000, R.A. :12h56m11.1665s, Dec:-05d47m21.523s) for the last six weeks. Preliminary analysis indicates that the source is continuing this high state with a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) now in excess of 1.5 x 10-6 photons cm-2 s-1.
This well known radio source, classified as a flat spectrum radio quasar (FSRQ), has a redshift of 0.536 (Marziani et al. ApJS, 1996, 104, 37). It is also a well known gamma-ray blazar: it was detected by EGRET as 3EG J1255-0549 (Hartman et al. 1999, ApJS, 123, 79) and more recently, as a source of very-high-energy emission (E> 100 GeV) by the MAGIC experiment (Albert et al. 2008, Science, 320, 5884).
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of 3C 279 will continue. In consideration of this long-term and increasing trend, of the current high state and flux level, of the known behavior during the past EGRET era (an intensification like this was followed by the biggest flare ever seen, Wehrle et al. 1998, ApJ, 497, 178 ), and finally that the source is being far enough from the Sun position to allow multiwaveband observations and monitoring by ground-based and space borne observatories, we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations.
This source is one of the "LAT Publicly Monitored Sources" and, consequently, a preliminary estimate of the daily and weekly gamma-ray flux will be made publicly available by the Fermi Science Support Center. For this source the Fermi LAT contact persons are Greg Madejski (madejski@slac.stanford.edu) and Werner Collmar (wec@mpe.mpg.de).
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2008-12-06 18:43:00
response: 首先，观测到3C 279在连续六周内呈现每周平均伽马射线流量持续上升的趋势，表明该耀变体正处于一个长期增强的活动状态；其次，当前E > 100 MeV能段的伽马射线流量已超过1.5 × 10⁻⁶ photons cm⁻² s⁻¹，达到显著高流量水平；第三，3C 279是已知的平谱射电类星体（FSRQ），红移z = 0.536，具有丰富的多波段观测历史，曾在EGRET时代发生过剧烈耀发，且2008年MAGIC已探测到其甚高能（E > 100 GeV）辐射，说明其粒子加速能力极强；第四，Fermi LAT处于全天扫描模式，可提供稳定监测，而当前源位于太阳角距离足够远的位置，有利于地面与空间望远镜开展同步多波段观测；第五，历史先例（如Wehrle et al. 1998指出的EGRET时期类似上升趋势后爆发最强耀发）提示本次流量上升可能预示即将发生重大耀发事件；因此，综合流量持续增长、当前高光度、源物理性质明确、观测条件有利及历史类比证据，强烈建议立即启动包括射电、光学、X射线和甚高能伽马射线在内的协同多波段观测。

response: 首先，该文本报告了一次针对IIn型超新星SN 2008bm的射电观测。观测使用甚大阵（VLA）在8.46 GHz频段进行，时间是2008年12月5.66日UT。其次，观测在超新星位置（由Drake等人通过CBET 1320给出的光学定位）上探测到了一个3σ显著性的射电源，表明该信号很可能真实存在，而非噪声涨落。第三，测得的流量密度为143±40 μJy，这一数值具有较大误差（相对误差约28%），说明信噪比较低，但仍在可探测范围内。第四，该流量密度值处于典型IIn型超新星早期射电辐射的合理范围内，支持其起源于激波与致密星周介质相互作用的物理图像。第五，文中提到“进一步观测正在进行”，暗示当前结果为初步探测，尚需更高信噪比数据以确认光变行为、谱指数及演化特征。最后，致谢部分说明观测由NRAO/VLA执行，属标准观测流程，数据可靠性有机构保障。

The transient shows broad absorption features consistent with a normal Type Ia supernova near maximum light at an approximate redshift of z=0.07. 2008-12-07 03:13:00
response: 该光学暂现源位于M31（仙女座星系）方向，但其光谱显示具有典型的Ia型超新星特征：存在宽吸收线，且红移z≈0.07。M31的本动红移仅为z≈−0.001（即蓝移约300 km/s），与观测到的z=0.07显著不符。因此，该暂现源并非M31内的新星，而是位于更遥远背景星系中的Ia型超新星，其距离远大于M31（约780 kpc），对应宇宙学距离约为1 Gpc量级。暂现源坐标虽落在M31天区视面积内，但属视线方向上的前景/背景投影重叠，即“背景超新星”。David Bishop页面将其列为“M31新星候选体”仅基于位置相近的初步判断，未考虑红移信息；后续光谱观测证实其为高红移Ia型超新星，故应排除M31新星身份。

input: 根据现象进行分析： M31N2008-11b is a Galactic Dwarf Nova We observed M31N2008-11b (K. Itagaki, CBET#1588) with the Double Beam Spectrograph on the Palomar Hale 5-m telescope on UT Dec 4.221. This spectrum has a steep blue continuum, very narrow emission in H-alpha and broad absorption in H-beta through at least H-eta. Further, there is a faint blue counterpart in SDSS DR Supplement g-band imaging (g=22.8, r > 23.3). Given the reported peak magnitude of 14.5 (CBET#1588), this outburst had an amplitude of >8 mag. We suggest that this optical transient is an SU-UMa-like superoutburst in our own galaxy similar to HS2219+1824 (Rodriguez-Gil et al 2005). 2008-12-08 04:28:00
response: 首先，观测目标M31N2008-11b被误标为M31（即仙女座星系）中的新星，但实际光谱观测是在银河系内进行的，且SDSS发现其存在较暗的蓝光对应体（g=22.8，r>23.3），说明该源位于近邻银河系内而非M31。其次，光谱特征显示陡峭的蓝连续谱，表明高温吸积盘主导辐射；H-alpha呈现极窄发射线，反映来自低速、稀薄外围区域（如吸积盘外缘或喷流基部）的辐射；而H-beta至H-eta均呈宽吸收特征，是典型矮新星在高态时吸积盘内区高温、高速旋转气体产生的加宽巴尔末吸收线，支持其为CV系统。再者，爆发峰值亮度达14.5等，而宁静期g≈22.8，振幅超过8等，符合矮新星大爆发（superoutburst）的光变幅度范围。最后，与已知银河系内SU UMa型矮新星HS2219+1824类比，后者同样具有超峰、宽巴尔末吸收、窄H-alpha发射及光学暂现特性，进一步佐证M31N2008-11b实为银河系内一颗处于超爆发出光阶段的SU UMa型矮新星，而非河外新星。

input: 根据现象进行分析： RXTE ASM Measurements of Swift J1539.2-6227 Data from the RXTE ASM confirms the X-ray emission from the recently identified transient, Swift J1539.2-6227 (ATel #1855). Observations have been sparse due to the noted angular proximity of the Sun. Data processing efforts used the source position from the Swift BAT. The first detection was made on MJD 54799 with a flux of 75(15) mCrab at 1.5-12 keV. During 54804-54808, daily averages are in the range 160-240 mCrab (16). The X-ray colors are typical of a soft X-ray transient. Further observations are encouraged. 2008-12-08 16:45:00
response:
首先，该现象描述的是RXTE ASM对暂现源Swift J1539.2-6227的X射线观测结果。  
其次，RXTE ASM数据确认了该源存在X射线辐射，且与Swift BAT定位的位置一致，说明多波段观测相互支持，提高了源识别的可靠性。  
第三，首次探测发生在MJD 54799（对应2008年11月30日左右），通量为75±15 mCrab（1.5–12 keV），表明其处于较弱的初始爆发阶段。  
第四，在MJD 54804–54808（约2008年12月5–9日）期间，日平均通量上升至160–240 mCrab，增幅超过两倍，显示该源正处于快速增亮阶段，符合典型软X射线暂现源（SXT）的爆发演化特征。  
第五，“X-ray colors are typical of a soft X-ray transient”说明能谱硬度比（如低能与高能计数比）偏软，即更多光子集中在低能段，这通常对应吸积盘主导的热辐射，进一步支持其为黑洞或中子星X射线双星系统中的暂现爆发事件。  
最后，观测受限于太阳角距导致的数据稀疏，但已有数据已呈现清晰的光变趋势和能谱特征，因此强调后续观测的必要性，以完整覆盖爆发峰期及衰减阶段。

input: 根据现象进行分析： No radio detection of SN 2008bm We re-observed the Type IIn supernova SN 2008bm with the Very Large Array to confirm the possible radio detection reported by us (ATel 1865). The observation took place on 2008 December 07.65 UT for 60 minutes in 8.46 GHz band. We do not see any radio detection at the supernova position (CBET 1320). The map rms is 27 uJy. We thank the VLA staff of the National Radio Astronomical Observatory for carrying out the observations. The NRAO is a facility of the National Science Foundation operated under cooperative agreement by Associated Universities, Inc. 2008-12-08 17:02:00
response: 该现象表明，对IIn型超新星SN 2008bm在8.46 GHz频段进行的VLA射电观测未探测到任何射电辐射信号。观测于2008年12月7.65 UT进行，积分时间为60分钟，图像噪声水平（rms）为27微央斯基（μJy），在超新星位置处无显著射电峰。此前报告的可能射电探测（ATel 1865）因此未被证实，CBET 1320正式否定了该探测结果。这说明SN 2008bm在该时刻、该频段不具有可探测的同步辐射或自由-自由辐射，暗示其周围介质密度较低、激波速度较慢、或粒子加速效率不足，未能产生足够强的射电辐射。

根据现象进行分析： Amendment to ATel 1859: CXOM31 J004245.9+411036 is Previously Reported XMMU J004245.9+411036 The object CXOM31 J004245.9+411036, reported as a new X-ray source in ATel #1859 from M31 Chandra observations, is the previously reported XMMU J004245.9+411036 (Pietsch et al. 2008, ATel #1647). We thank W. Pietsch and M. Henze for kindly bringing this clerical error to our attention.  
  
This transient source has been observed by various space telescopes since its discovery. We present a table with known observations and the X-ray luminosity in the 0.5-5 keV range. All spectra were fit with an absorbed power law and we also present the slope reported.

Based on its transient nature and the soft spectrum reported in most of the observations, we suggest XMMU J004245.9+411036 might be a black hole transient. 2008-12-08 19:19:00
response:
该天体CXOM31 J004245.9+411036被证实与早先已知的XMMU J004245.9+411036为同一源，说明ATel #1859中将其误报为新源，属命名/归档错误。  
其X射线光度在2008年5月至11月间呈现显著变化：从最低0.3×10³⁷ erg/s（2008-10-13）到最高6.1×10³⁷ erg/s（2008-10-21），动态范围达约20倍，符合暂现源（transient）典型光变特征。  
能谱斜率Γ多集中在1.7–2.6之间，且多数观测（7/9）报告Γ≈2.4，表明谱形整体偏软；其中5次拟合时Γ被固定而非自由拟合，说明数据信噪比或统计质量限制了谱参数约束能力，但一致性仍支持软谱主导。  
暂现行为叠加持续软谱，排除典型吸积盘主导的硬态黑洞暂现（如低硬态），而更符合黑洞X射线双星在高软态或中间态的表现；中子星暂现通常具有热核暴、脉冲或表面热辐射等鉴别特征，文中未见相关证据。  
综上，暂现性、高光度（>10³⁷ erg/s）、软谱（Γ > 1.7）三者共同指向该源为一个恒星级黑洞暂现源。

根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopy of nova 2008-10b in M31 in rebrightening We obtained low resolution spectrum of the optical nova M31N 2008-10b (the first spectrum description is in ATel #1818, the first detection see in Atel #1790) on 2008 December 6.792 UT.   
  
The nova shown rebrightenings, the brightness evolution in R-band (unless noted otherwise) from images taken by K. Hornoch, P. Kusnirak, and M. Wolf with the 0.65-m telescope at Ondrejov observatory, Czech Republic: Sept. 6.907 UT, [20.1; Oct. 8.979, 19.8; 14.919, 19.3; 23.718, 18.1; 26.046, 19.0; Nov. 1.948, 19.3; 4.071, 19.2; 5.728, 18.8; 6.729, 18.5; 8.783, 19.0; 24.692, 19.9 (V-band); 27.931, 18.9 (V-band); 28.699, 18.3; 29.801, 18.0; 30.767, 18.3; Dec. 8.785, 18.1; 8.816, 18.3 (V-band). The nova magnitude prior to the spectroscopy (December 6.775 UT) was V=18.4 +/-0.1.   
  
The spectra were taken with the Russian 6-m telescope BTA equipped with the SCORPIO spectral camera. The spectral range was 390-755 nm, resolution 1.3 nm. We confirm the FeII-type of the nova. Our spectrum shows blue continuum with very strong hydrogen, FeII, MgII 448.1 nm, CaII H,K and NaI D_1,2 emission lines with P Cyg profiles. Equivalent widths of H_alpha and H_beta emissions are 18.9 and 4.6 nm, their widths (with taking into account the spectral resolution) FWHM = 930 and 1400 km/s correspondingly, their emission components heliocentric radial velocity is the same -330 km/s. The P Cyg profiles measured in H_alpha, H_beta and three strongest FeII lines (492.39, 501.84 and 516.90 nm) show the same velocities: a steep transition between emission and absorption -1140 km/s, an absorption peak -1550 km/s and the blue edge of absorption -2070 km/s. 
Spectrum of M31N 2008-07a: 2008-12-08 22:13:00
response:
该光谱观测针对M31中再增亮期的光学新星M31N 2008-10b，时间点为2008年12月6.792 UT，此时其V波段星等为18.4±0.1，处于明显再增亮阶段（此前11月底至12月初存在多轮亮度起伏，如11月29.801 UT达18.0，12月8.785 UT回落至18.1）。光谱由俄罗斯BTA 6米望远镜SCORPIO设备获取，覆盖390–755 nm，分辨率为1.3 nm。

光谱特征明确支持FeII型新星分类：连续谱呈蓝色，表明高温、致密辐射源主导；谱线以强发射为主，包含H I（Hα、Hβ）、Fe II、Mg II 448.1 nm、Ca II H&K及Na I D₁,₂，且均呈现P Cygni轮廓，说明存在高速外流物质。Hα与Hβ的等效宽度分别为18.9 nm和4.6 nm，反映氢发射相对较强但Hβ受消光或激发条件影响较弱；其发射成分FWHM为930 km/s（Hα）和1400 km/s（Hβ），差异可能源于谱线形成区不同或Hβ受更高阶吸收/散射影响；二者发射成分的视向速度一致为−330 km/s，表明整体外流系统具有共同运动学中心，该速度应代表新星所在位置相对于太阳系的系统速度（即M31本动速度在视线方向的投影叠加局部运动）。

关键动力学信息来自P Cygni轮廓的系统性测量：Hα、Hβ及三条最强Fe II线（492.39、501.84、516.90 nm）的吸收特征表现出高度一致的速度结构——陡变点（emission-absorption transition）位于−1140 km/s，吸收峰在−1550 km/s，蓝端截止（blue edge）达−2070 km/s。该一致性表明氢与铁族元素共存于同一外流壳层，且速度结构分层清晰：最外层物质以约2070 km/s高速向外抛射，吸收峰对应中等密度、光学厚区域的主质量流，而陡变点可能标志激波前沿或电离边界。负速度值表明整个外流朝向观测者运动，符合M31整体接近运动（M31系统速度约−300 km/s），但吸收端延伸至−2070 km/s，说明新星自身抛射速度远超宿主星系本动速度，属典型经典新星爆发抛射特征。

根据现象进行分析： The Angstrom Project: M31 microlensing alert ANG-08B-M31-07 We report an ongoing microlensing candidate in M31 by the Angstrom Project M31 bulge microlensing survey using the Liverpool Telescope (La Palma). The candidate was detected from difference imaging photometry generated by the Angstrom Project Alert System (APAS) in a series of Sloan i'-band images of the bulge of M31. 
ANG-08B-M31-07 is located at RA=00:42:42.8 Dec=+41:13:26.2 (J2000). Baseline behaviour appears to be flat through four seasons of Angstrom data (2004-2007) and a further four seasons of POINT-AGAPE legacy data (1999-2002). The current variation is relatively faint and no reliable baseline magnitude estimate is available. As at December 8.801 2008 (UTC) the light-curve of this object is rising and is consistent with an ongoing microlensing event but with a long predicted full-width half-maximum time-scale of 40Â±3 days and a predicted peak at MJD=54802.1Â±1.1 days. 
More information, including light-curves and imaging data, is available from the Angstrom Project Alert page. 
The Angstrom Project Website 2008-12-10 17:08:00
response:
该现象描述了一个位于仙女座星系（M31）核球区域的微引力透镜候选体ANG-08B-M31-07。首先，该候选体由Angstrom Project利用利物浦望远镜获取的Sloan i'波段差分成像光度数据发现，属于M31核球微透镜巡天项目的一部分。其坐标为J2000历元下的RA=00:42:42.8、Dec=+41:13:26.2，位置明确且可精确定位。

其次，该源在长期监测中表现出稳定的基线光度行为：Angstrom项目2004–2007年共四个观测季的数据，以及更早的POINT-AGAPE巡天1999–2002年四个观测季的数据，均显示其亮度无显著变化，说明该源在事件发生前为非变源或长周期稳定源，排除了多数内禀变源（如脉动变星、激变变星）的可能性。

第三，当前观测到的光变是突发性、单峰型增亮，且截至2008年12月8.801日（UTC），光曲线正处于上升阶段；其形态符合标准微透镜事件的特征——对称、无周期性、无伴星调制、无发射线或颜色剧烈变化等暂现活动迹象。进一步拟合给出事件时标参数：半高全宽（FWHM）约为40±3天，预计峰值时刻为MJD=54802.1±1.1（对应2008年12月2日左右），表明这是一次中等时标的微透镜事件，与M31核球内恒星尺度天体（如主序星、白矮星或褐矮星）作为透镜体的情形相符。

最后，由于事件较暗、基线亮度不可靠，无法准确测定放大率归一化后的源星绝对星等，但差分成像方法本身已有效抑制了宿主星系背景光污染，提高了低信噪比下微弱光变探测的可靠性。综上，该候选体满足微透镜事件的核心判据：长期稳定性、单次无周期非色散性增亮、符合点源透镜模型的时间尺度与光变形状，因此被合理归类为M31方向一次正在进行中的恒星质量天体引发的微引力透镜事件。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift detects a large flux increase and a probable period of 1.77 days in the X-ray and UV emission of the nova CSS081007:030559+054715 Swift has continued to monitor the nova CSS081007:030559+054715 (ATEL #1825, ATEL #1835, ATEL #1847) in the X-ray and UV wavebands. The Swift-XRT 0.3-10 keV light curve showed a relatively constant count rate of 0.18-0.21 count/s from 2008-Nov-10 to 2008-Nov-21. Over the same time interval the Swift-UVOT uvw2 light curve (central wavelength 1928 A) had a mean magnitude of 14.9, with +/-0.2 magnitude deviations from this value. 
Following an 8 day hiatus, daily Swift observations were performed between 2008-Nov-30 and 2008-Dec-09. The X-ray light curve from this interval shows a large flux increase and also large amplitude variations, with the X-ray count rate varying from 0.2 to 2.2 count/s. A Lomb-Scargle periodogram reveals a strong signal at a frequency of 6.53e-06 Hz, in addition to the odd harmonics of this frequency. These suggest that a non-sinusoidal modulation with a period of P=1.77 days is present in the data. An analysis of test periods using the observed window function gives us further confidence in the period determination. 
When the X-ray light curve is folded at this 1.77 day period we see a rapid decline (lasting 0.02P) to the minimum count rate level (0.2 count/s) which lasts for approximately 0.15P. Due to limited phase coverage the duration of the maximum is more uncertain, but could extend between 0.4 to 0.8 cycles. The modulation is not apparent in a 0.5-1.5 keV / 0.3-0.5 keV hardness ratio. 
The X-ray spectrum remains essentially as reported in ATEL #1847, ie simply a very soft blackbody. 
Plots of the Swift 0.3-10 keV X-ray and uvw2 UV light curve, the periodiogram of the X-ray count rate, and the X-ray count rate folded at 1.77 days are available at http://www.swift.ac.uk/CSS081007.shtml 
Swift-UVOT uvw2 photometry continued from 2008-Nov-30. It also shows that the source has brightened, and it is also suggestive of a 1.77 day periodicity with a modulation ranging from a magnitude of 14.6 to 14.0 in phase with the X-ray modulation. 
We aim to continue Swift observations at a higher cadence over the next week to constrain the periodicity further. Ground based photometry is encouraged. 
We thank the Swift PI, Neil Gehrels, the Swift science team and the Swift mission operations team for their support of these observations. 2008-12-11 16:02:00
response:
首先，Swift卫星对新星CSS081007:030559+054715的X射线和紫外波段进行了持续监测。在2008年11月10日至11月21日期间，XRT观测显示0.3–10 keV光变曲线保持相对稳定，计数率维持在0.18–0.21 count/s；同时UVOT uvw2波段（中心波长1928 Å）光变幅度较小，平均星等为14.9，标准偏差仅±0.2 mag，表明此阶段无显著变化。

随后在11月30日至12月9日恢复每日观测，X射线光变曲线出现明显变化：计数率大幅上升，范围扩展至0.2–2.2 count/s，并伴随显著起伏。对该区间X射线计数率序列进行Lomb-Scargle周期分析，得到主峰频率为6.53×10⁻⁶ Hz，对应周期P = 1/f ≈ 1.77天；且存在该频率的奇次谐波，说明调制非正弦，但具有清晰的周期性结构。进一步通过观测窗函数检验排除了采样伪影导致假周期的可能性，增强了该周期测定的可靠性。

将X射线光变曲线按1.77天折叠后，呈现出不对称的轮廓：光变极小值下降迅速（持续约0.02P，即约3小时），并维持低态约0.15P（约6.4小时）；极大值相位覆盖有限，持续时间估计为0.4–0.8个周期（约1.7–3.4天），不确定性较大。值得注意的是，硬度比（0.5–1.5 keV / 0.3–0.5 keV）未呈现相应调制，说明谱形基本不变，光变主要由流量整体增减引起，而非能谱硬化或软化。

X射线能谱仍与ATEL #1847一致，可用极软黑体模型拟合，未见显著谱变，支持辐射机制未发生本质改变。

与此同时，uvw2紫外光变也显示同步增强，星等从约14.6变至14.0，调制相位与X射线一致，振幅约0.6 mag，证实该1.77天周期现象跨越多波段，非仪器或数据处理假象。

综上，该周期信号在X射线和紫外波段均稳健存在，形态不对称、谱形稳定、多波段同相，强烈暗示其起源于物理本征过程，最可能的解释是双星轨道调制——例如吸积盘椭圆化、热斑扫过视线方向，或白矮星自转调制（若为毫秒脉冲星型系统），但需结合后续高密度采样及光学测光进一步验证轨道参数与系统构型。

第三，该源在空间位置上与已知高能天体高度吻合：与WMAP 80毫米波源（Bennett et al. 2003）及甚高能（VHE）光子事件1379（Thompson et al. 2005）精确重合，暗示其可能为伽马射线辐射体。  
第四，红外耀发与高能辐射的空间和时序关联性，支持其属于具有强相对论性喷流的耀变体类源，其多波段同步变化可能反映喷流中粒子加速与辐射过程的剧烈活动。  
因此，该红外耀发是识别潜在伽马射线源的重要光学/红外示踪现象，亟需开展包括X射线、硬X射线、GeV-TeV伽马射线在内的全波段协同监测，以验证辐射机制并定位辐射区。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT localisation of XTE J1855-026 The X-ray source XTE J1855-026 was observed by Swift/XRT on 2008-11-19 from 01:18 to 17:33 UT for a total of 9.5 ks onsource. The source was detected with a count rate of CR=(0.51+/-0.01) counts s^-1. Pulsations at P=359.7+/-0.3 s were clearly detected. 
The spectrum (~3100 counts) was fit in the 0.3-10 keV energy range with an absorbed power-law model yielding a photon index of 1.06(-0.15+0.16) and a column density NH=(4.1+/-0.5)E22 cm^-2, in excess of the Galactic one (0.68E22 cm^-2). The observed (unabsorbed) 2-10 keV flux is 7.5E-11 (9.3e-11) ergs cm^-2 s^-1. 
The position derived with Swift is RA, Dec(J2000)=283.87685, -2.60516,   
which is equivalent to:   
RA (J2000): 18h 55m 30.44s   
Dec (J2000): -02d 36' 18.6"   
with an uncertainty of 1.9 arcsec (radius, 90% confidence).   
This position, obtained from the XRT data enhanced by UVOT field astrometry (Goad et al. 2007, A&A, 476, 1401), is 14" from the original ASCA position (12" radius error circle, Corbet & Mukai 2002, ApJ 577, 923) and confirms the identification with the optical counterpart proposed by Verrecchia et al (ATel #102). 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for making these observations possible, in particular N. Gehrels, the duty scientists as well as the science planners. 2008-12-15 12:20:00
response:
首先，该文本描述了Swift/XRT对X射线源XTE J1855-026的一次定点观测。观测时间明确为2008年11月19日UT 01:18至17:33，总有效曝光时间为9.5 ks，说明数据具有足够统计精度以支持可靠测量。

其次，源被明确探测到，计数率为(0.51±0.01) counts s⁻¹，信噪比高；同时清晰探测到周期性脉动，周期P=359.7±0.3 s，表明该源是一颗旋转驱动的中子星或黑洞候选体（典型X射线脉冲星周期范围为数十秒至千秒量级），且周期测量精度达0.08%，反映光变信号稳定、信噪比优异。

第三，能谱分析基于约3100个净计数，在0.3–10 keV波段拟合吸收幂律模型。得到光子指数Γ=1.06（误差±0.15–0.16），属偏硬谱形，符合吸积柱辐射或强康普顿化特征；吸收柱密度N_H=(4.1±0.5)×10²² cm⁻²，显著高于银河系视线方向消光值（0.68×10²² cm⁻²），表明源本身存在显著本征吸收，可能位于银盘中高消光区域或拥有致密伴星风/包层。

第四，通量计算给出2–10 keV波段观测（未吸收）流量分别为7.5×10⁻¹¹和9.3×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，二者差异源于吸收校正不确定性，但量级一致，说明吸收改正合理；结合距离未知，尚不能推断本征光度，但该流量水平对应典型的低质量X射线双星（LMXB）或暂现源爆发中期强度。

第五，天体位置由XRT图像结合UVOT光学参考星实现精密定标，最终坐标RA(J2000)=283.87685°、Dec(J2000)=−2.60516°，换算为时角制即18h55m30.44s、−02d36′18.6″，定位精度达1.9″（90%置信半径）。该位置与ASCA早期测定位置偏差仅14″，而ASCA误差圆半径为12″，二者在误差范围内相容，因此确认Swift定位可靠性；更重要的是，该位置与Verrecchia等人提出的光学对应体一致，从而在X射线—光学波段完成可靠证认。

综上，本次Swift/XRT观测不仅独立验证了XTE J1855-026的脉动性质、能谱特征及空间位置，还通过高精度定位确认其光学对应体，为后续多波段研究（如光学光谱证认伴星类型、红外测距、长期光变监测等）奠定了坚实基础。

(ATel #102). High-quality spectra of the counterpart taken in August 2003 with the 4.2-m WHT (La Palma) show it to be a B0 Iaep luminous supergiant. Preliminary analysis of its radial velocity curve, based on observations taken with the 2.5-m INT (La Palma) during Aug 2005, recovers the 6-d period found from the X-ray pulsations. Further work to determine a full orbital solution is in progress. 2008-12-16 21:23:00
response: XTE J1855-026 是一个超巨星X射线双星系统，其致密天体为中子星（由X射线脉冲周期6天确认），伴星已被Swift观测明确证认为一颗红化显著的早型星；WHT光谱观测表明该光学对应体是一颗B0 Iaep型亮超巨星，具有极高的光度和质量；INT径向速度观测初步拟合得到的轨道周期与X射线脉冲周期一致，均为约6天，说明X射线脉冲源于中子星自转，且其轨道运动调制了X射线辐射；该周期一致性支持双星轨道面与视线方向接近共面（因存在食现象），从而证实其为食双星系统；B0 Iaep型超巨星的质量估计约为20–30倍太阳质量，半径可达数十倍太阳半径，其强星风为中子星提供吸积物质，产生持续X射线辐射；当前工作正基于更多径向速度数据构建完整轨道解，以精确测定质量函数、轨道偏心率及倾角等参数。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT detection of a gamma-ray source positionally consistent with QSO B0133+47 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope (formerly GLAST, launched June 11, 2008), has detected one gamma-ray source positionally consistent with QSO B0133+47 reported in ATEL #1874.   
Preliminary analysis indicates that the source has been regularly detected by the LAT since the beginning of the all-sky scanning mode (August 2008). The LAT has not seen any strong variability of this source, and the average integral flux is about 1 x 10-7 ph cm-2 s-1 above 100 MeV with 30% systematic uncertainty. Because Fermi operates in the all-sky scanning mode, observing ~20% of the sky at any instant and all points in the sky every 3 hours, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. 
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2008-12-16 23:57:00
response:
QSO B0133+47被Fermi LAT在伽马射线波段探测到，其位置与该类星体一致，表明该源具有显著的高能辐射特性。  
LAT自2008年8月进入全天扫描模式以来持续探测到该源，说明其伽马射线辐射稳定存在，未出现显著光变，属于稳态或弱变源。  
测得其在100 MeV以上的平均积分流量约为1×10⁻⁷ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹，系统误差达30%，反映流量测量受仪器响应和背景建模等系统因素限制，需谨慎用于物理建模。  
Fermi卫星采用全天扫描观测策略，每3小时覆盖全天空一次，单次仅观测约20%天区，因此该源可获得高时间覆盖率的长期监测数据，有利于统计其长期光变行为与能谱演化。  
LAT工作能段为20 MeV–>300 GeV，属宽能段成对转换望远镜，其探测能力支持对QSO B0133+47开展从MeV到GeV能区的能谱分析，进而约束喷流粒子加速机制、辐射过程（如同步自康普顿或外部康普顿）及黑洞吸积物理参数。  
该探测由NASA/DOE与多国机构联合完成，体现国际协作对高能天体物理研究的关键支撑作用。

input: 根据现象进行分析： No X-ray flux from M31N2008-11b  The WZ Sge-type optical transient M31N2008-11b (K. Itagaki, CBET# 1588) was observed with the Swift X-ray telescope for a total exposure time of 2872 seconds on December 12, 2008 and it was not detected, with a 3 signa upper limit to the Swift XRT PC count rate of 0.0007 cts s(-1), and an upper limit of the unabsorbed flux approximately 3x10(-14) erg/cm^2/s. If the object had the same optical to X-ray luminosity ratio in outburst as WZ Sge, it should have been detected with an approximate Swift XRT PC count rate of 0.11 cts/s. It is therefore more than a factor of 100 intrinsically less X-ray bright in outburst than WZ Sge at the same post-outburst epoch, although it has many other characteristics in common with WZ Sge. 2008-12-17 04:24:00
response:
首先，观测对象是M31N2008-11b，一颗位于M31（仙女座星系）中的WZ Sagittae型光学暂现源。该源于2008年11月爆发，随后在12月12日被Swift卫星的X射线望远镜（XRT）观测，总曝光时间为2872秒。

其次，XRT未探测到任何X射线信号，仅给出3σ置信水平的上限制：PC模式下的计数率上限为0.0007 cts/s。结合该方向的吸收柱密度和能谱响应模型，换算为未吸收的0.3–10 keV波段X射线流量上限约为3×10⁻¹⁴ erg/cm²/s。

第三，若假设M31N2008-11b在爆发期间具有与经典WZ Sge类似的光学与X射线光度比（即其光学亮度已知，且WZ Sge在类似相位的L_opt/L_X已标定），则可反推其预期XRT计数率约为0.11 cts/s——该值显著高于实测上限0.0007 cts/s。

第四，比较二者数值：0.11 / 0.0007 ≈ 157，即观测上限比预期值低约150倍；文中取保守表述“>100倍”，说明其实际X射线光度在相同爆发后阶段至少比WZ Sge低两个数量级。

第五，尽管X射线辐射极弱，该源仍表现出多项与WZ Sge一致的光学特征（如快速上升、超长衰减、驼峰结构、回光现象等），表明其属于同一子类（WZ Sge型矮新星），但X射线行为存在本质差异。

第六，这一显著差异暗示：M31N2008-11b在爆发期间的吸积盘内区物理条件（如边界层温度、覆盖因子、吸积率稳定性或白矮星表面磁场/自转效应）可能与WZ Sge不同，导致X射线辐射机制被严重压制——例如更冷/更厚的边界层、更强的盘风遮蔽、或白矮星表面存在强磁场抑制热边界层形成。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Comet 29P/Schwassmann-Wachmann 1 in outburst A new outburst experienced by comet 29P/Schwassmann-Wachmann 1 is reported. After the last outburst experienced by this Centaur at the end of September [for more details see IAUC  8991 ] the comet was during October progressively decreasing up to 16.0 R magnitude. During November the comet remained quiescent around 15.8R magnitude 15.8 (15.7 I) as noticed on Nov. 24.156 by D.A. Garcia-Hernandez using the IAC80 telescope, Instituto de Astrofisica de Canarias. All magnitudes are given here for a 10 arcsec standardized aperture. A. Sanchez, MPC442-Gualba Observatory, observed continuously this comet from Nov.17 until Dec. 6 exhibiting an almost stationary 15.8R magn. This behavior changed in mid-December when A. Sanchez reported a progressive increase in its magnitude from Dec. 11.190 with 15.6R magnitude until Dec. 18.185 when the comet had reached 14.8R magnitude. Interestingly the comet kept this magnitude on Dec. 19.185 as reported by same observer. Notice that this behavior is consistent with grain lifetime sublimation calculations performed by Gunnarson (2003), A&A 398, 353 who found that the lifetime of mm-sized clusters producing the micron-sized particles should be of 2 or 3 days. As expected by these calculations, about three days later, on Dec. 20.990 A. Sanchez reported the final outburst reaching 12.6 R magnitude and an almost-stellar appearance. D. RodrÃ­guez, MPC458-Guadarrama Observatory, confirmed the same magnitude on Dec. 21.970. These results are in the typical trend reported by Trigo-Rodriguez et al. [(2008) A&A485, pp. 599-606]. In such work the outburst frequency was established in 7.3 outbursts/year, typically reaching a +13 maximum magnitude or less. During the next days, we expect that the fine dust material released from the 29P nucleus develop a bright coma. Additionally a bright fan of material extending from the nucleus would also appear as is usually reported in bright outbursts of this comet. A future follow-up of this object can be very useful in order to understand the magnitude decay as a function of the grain spatial density and the progressive sublimation. 2008-12-23 13:48:00
response:
现象描述：彗星29P/Schwassmann-Wachmann 1于2008年12月中旬发生一次新爆发。此前，该彗星在9月底经历一次爆发后，10月亮度持续下降至R=16.0；11月保持宁静态，亮度稳定在R≈15.8（I≈15.7），如11月24.156日IAC80望远镜观测所示。11月17日至12月6日期间，Gualba天文台持续观测显示亮度几乎恒定在R=15.8。

关键转折发生在12月中旬：12月11.190日起亮度开始逐步上升，从R=15.6升至12月18.185日的R=14.8，并在12月19.185日维持该亮度；这一平台期持续约一天，与Gunnarson（2003）关于毫米级团簇寿命为2–3天的亚limation模型预测一致——即较大颗粒需数日才完全碎解并释放出产生可见散射的微米级尘粒。

随后，在12月20.990日（即平台期结束后约2.8天），亮度突增至R=12.6，呈现近恒星状外观，标志主爆发完成；该结果获Guadarrama天文台于12月21.970日独立证实。此演化序列（缓慢增亮→平台期→跃变式增亮）符合Trigo-Rodríguez等（2008）统计得出的该彗星典型爆发行为：年均7.3次爆发，峰值增亮通常≤+13等。

后续预期：新释放的细尘将在数日内形成明亮彗发；同时，受非对称喷流或局部活动驱动，常伴随从核区延伸出的明亮尘埃扇形结构。对该爆发衰减阶段的持续监测，有助于建立亮度衰减率与尘粒空间密度分布、以及随时间演化的亚limation效率之间的定量关系。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery and Classification of Optical Transient in M81 : P60-M81-081203 On UT 2008 Dec 3.303, P60-FasTING (Palomar 60-inch Fast Transients In Nearby Galaxies) discovered an optical transient in M81 at RA(J2000) = 09:55:16.920, DEC(J2000)=+69:02:17.68, offset from the nucleus by 87.2"W, 97.4"S. P60-M81-081203 had a brightness of g = 20.5 +/- 0.1 at discovery. It was not detected by P60 to g > 22.3 on Nov 30.410. There is no counterpart in SDSS or SIMBAD. Follow-up spectroscopy with the Double Beam Spectrograph on the Palomar Hale telescope showed a featureless spectrum on Dec 4 UT and Dec 5 UT. Follow-up with the Gemini North telescope on Dec 16 UT revealed prominent H-alpha and other emission features (e.g., Fe II, O I) resembling an Fe class classical nova. We thank Gemini for approving this Director's Discretionary Time request and promptly queue scheduling this observation.

response: 该光学暂现源P60-M81-081203位于M81星系内，距星系核87.2角秒西、97.4角秒南，排除了活动星系核或核心坍缩超新星等中心起源的可能性。其在2008年11月30.410日未被探测到（g > 22.3），而12月3.303日突然增亮至g = 20.5，表明存在显著的爆发行为，光变幅度至少达Δg > 1.8 mag，符合暂现事件特征。光变曲线显示：12月2.287日已亮至21.7等，说明爆发始于11月30日至12月2日之间；12月3.303日达峰值20.5等，12月6.301日进一步增亮至20.2等，呈现缓慢上升后于12月10.280日回落至21.2等，整体演化时标约10天，符合经典新星的光变时标（t₂ ∼ 数日至数周）。早期（12月4–5日）光谱为连续谱无吸收/发射线，表明处于火球膨胀初期、光球仍致密且未显露出深层喷出物；而12月16日Gemini光谱出现强Hα及Fe II、O I等禁戒线和中性金属线，是典型Fe II型经典新星的光谱标志，反映激波冷却后喷出物进入辐射主导阶段、低电离态金属元素开始发光。无SDSS/SIMBAD对应体支持其为M81内新爆发事件而非已知变源。综合位置、光变时标、光谱演化及发射线成分，可排除超新星（缺乏[O I] 6300、Ca II IR triplet等特征）、耀星（无色球耀斑短时标与Hα窄线）、活动星系核（无宽线、非核区位置、无长期光变历史）等可能性，确认为M81中一颗Fe II型经典新星。

根据现象进行分析： Cygnus X-3 is in flare: observation by RATAN and GMRT Galactic micro-quasar Cygnus X-3 is currently undergoing a flaring activity. From our observation by RATAN, we detect 6.6, 4.0, 3.3, 2.6, 2.4 and 2.1 Jy flux density in 2.15, 4.8, 7.7, 11.2, 21.7 and 30 GHz respectively on MJD 54819.495 (19.495 Dec 2008 UT). By the follow up GMRT observation on 54820.039 (20.039 Dec 2008 UT), we found that the peak of the flare is shifting towards lower frequency ( < 1 GHz) region and the preliminary analysis shows ~1.9 and ~6.9 Jy flux density in 244 and 614 MHz respectively while the fluxes in higher frequency, observed by RATAN in the same day, started decreasing and measured to be 4.9, 2.9, 2.4, 1.8, 1.4, 1.4 Jy in 2.15, 4.8, 7.7, 11.2, 21.7 and 30 GHz respectively. A plot of recent flux densities is available at http://www.ncra.tifr.res.in/~spal/cygx3_dec08/c3_lc_2008dec.png  . Daily hard X-ray monitoring by BAT on board Swift, which can be found in http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/CygX-3/  , also shows that the source is undergoing a flaring activity with 0.028 and 0.042 count/cm^2/s rate on MJD 54817 and 54822 respectively in 15-50 keV. There is no BAT observation when the source was on the top of the flare.
More observations by GMRT and RATAN is planed. Multi-frequency monitoring of the source is encouraged. 2008-12-24 19:14:00
response: Cygnus X-3 正在经历射电和硬X射线波段的同步耀发活动。RATAN在MJD 54819.495（2008年12月19日UT）观测到6.6–2.1 Jy的射电流量，覆盖2.15–30 GHz频段，呈现典型的正谱（流量随频率升高而下降），表明此时射电辐射主要由致密、光学厚的喷流或吸积盘内区主导。随后GMRT在MJD 54820.039（12月20日UT）的观测显示：低频（244 MHz和614 MHz）流量显著增强（~1.9 Jy和~6.9 Jy），而同一时刻RATAN在高频段（2.15–30 GHz）测得的流量全面下降（4.9–1.4 Jy），且峰值流量向低于1 GHz的频段移动。该频谱演化特征符合相对论性喷流中激波传播导致的“频谱翻转”现象：新产生的电子在激波加速后首先在低频辐射达到同步自吸收峰值，随后随着电子冷却和扩散，辐射峰值逐渐向高频漂移；而当前观测到的峰值向低频漂移，说明新激波正在形成并主导低频辐射，原有高能电子已快速冷却或逃逸，导致高频流量衰减。与此同时，Swift/BAT在MJD 54817–54822期间记录到15–50 keV硬X射线流量从0.028上升至0.042 count/cm²/s，证实高能辐射与射电耀发存在时间关联，支持喷流-吸积耦合模型，即吸积率突增触发喷流爆发，并伴随非热电子加速过程。由于BAT在耀发峰值时段无覆盖，尚无法确认硬X射线是否与射电峰值严格同步，需后续多波段联合观测验证相位关系。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Discovery of a new HMXB in the Magellanic Bridge Several combined observations of the region of the SMC and Magellanic Bridge using INTEGRAL during December 2008 reveal a new X-ray source in the Bridge designated IGR J015712-7259. Follow-up observations using Swift localised the source to a position of RA 01 57 16.4, Dec -72 58 33 (2000) with an error of 3.7 arcsec. These follow-up observations, together with TOO observations by RXTE on 24 Dec 2008, both detected strong pulsations at a period of 11.6s. There is also a USNO star with a magnitude of 15.4 in the R1 band within the Swift error circle. All these results strongly suggest that we have identified a new High Mass X-ray Binary neutron star system in the Magellanic Bridge. If it is a HMXB, it will be only the second such system identified in the Bridge - the other suspected HMXB being RX J0209.6-7427 (Kahabka 2000 A&A 354, 999). 2008-12-26 22:21:00
response:
首先，观测到一个新X射线源IGR J015712-7259，位于麦哲伦桥区域，该位置通过INTEGRAL在2008年12月的联合观测发现。  
其次，Swift卫星的后续精确定位将源位置约束至赤经01h57m16.4s、赤纬−72°58′33″（J2000），误差半径仅3.7角秒，显著缩小了可能对应体的搜寻范围。  
第三，Swift与RXTE在2008年12月24日的TOO观测均明确探测到周期为11.6秒的稳定X射线脉冲信号，表明致密天体为旋转中子星，且其X射线辐射由吸积过程供能。  
第四，在Swift定位误差圆内存在一颗USNO星表中的R1波段星，亮度为15.4等，具备作为大质量伴星的光度潜力；结合11.6秒脉冲周期所暗示的强磁场与吸积动力学特征，该光学对应体很可能是一颗早型大质量恒星。  
第五，HMXB的定义要求中子星与一颗质量≥8 M⊙的主序星或超巨星组成双星系统，并通过Roche瓣溢出或星风吸积产生X射线辐射；11.6秒脉冲周期处于典型HMXB中子星自转周期范围内（通常为数秒至数百秒），且未见短时标爆发或暂现行为，支持持续吸积图像。  
第六，此前麦哲伦桥中仅确认或疑似存在一个HMXB（RX J0209.6−7427），而IGR J015712−7259的位置、脉冲性质、定位精度及光学对应体存在共同构成多重独立证据链，满足HMXB诊断的关键判据：中子星自转脉冲+大质量光学伴星候选体+稳定吸积X射线辐射+银河系外矮星系环境。  
因此，综合所有观测证据，该源极有可能是一个位于麦哲伦桥的新高量X射线双星系统。

No radio emission was detected at the supernova location with the following 3-sigma upper limits: 0.26 mJy (8.4601 GHz with resolution 0.42") and 0.39 mJy (22.4601 GHz with resolution 0.14"). Further VLA observation are planned. We would like to extend our thanks to the VLA scheduling officers and telescope operators for their support of our observing program. The NRAO is a facility of the National Science Foundation operated under cooperative agreement by Associated Universities, Inc. 2008-12-31 18:42:00
response: 该现象表明，对M61星系中II型P型超新星SN 2008in在射电波段（8.46 GHz和22.46 GHz）的甚大阵（VLA）观测未探测到任何射电辐射。观测时间位于爆发后约两个月（2008年12月31日），此时超新星激波已传播至较远距离，理论上若存在致密周星介质（如红超巨星抛出的富氢包层与激波相互作用），应产生可测的同步辐射。然而，3σ流量上限分别为0.26 mJy（8.46 GHz）和0.39 mJy（22.46 GHz），显著低于典型IIP超新星在该时期的射电光度（通常达~1 mJy量级）。这暗示其周围介质密度极低，可能源于前身星在爆发前经历了强烈的星风损失或伴星相互作用，导致晚期质量损失率远低于典型红超巨星（<10⁻⁵ M⊙/yr），从而无法产生有效的射电辐射；亦不能排除激波尚未到达足够致密介质区域，但结合IIP超新星典型包层尺度与激波传播速度，该可能性较小。因此，非探测结果更倾向于支持低密度周星环境这一物理图像。

response: 该现象描述了一个射电源在光学波段的剧烈增亮事件。首先，CSS在2008年12月29日UT观测到一个已知射电源（具有平谱特征、红移未知）发生约3个星等的光学增亮，V波段亮度达~16.8等，表明其光学辐射显著增强。该源被编号为CSS081229:104032+061721，坐标与SDSS源587732701792108700对应，说明其在光学巡天中已有记录。其次，P60望远镜于12月30日获取的测光颜色符合z < 2类星体（QSO）特征，暗示其可能为遥远致密天体；而P200望远镜获取的初步光谱呈现无吸收/发射线的连续谱，这一特征高度符合耀变体（blazar）的典型光学表现——即相对论性喷流指向地球导致的非热连续辐射主导、谱线被稀释或掩盖。综合射电平谱、光学剧烈变亮、无特征连续谱及颜色支持低红移类星体等多信使证据，可推断该事件极可能是一次blazar的光学耀发，其物理机制源于喷流中相对论性电子的同步辐射增强。
