A second 3.2 ksec observation began at 17:02:24 (UT) on the same day. We detect strong pulsations in the first observation with a barycentric period of 12.44 s. The background subtracted, average pulsation amplitude during this observation is 37%. We also detect the first harmonic, but with an amplitude smaller by a factor of approximately 4. This confirms the preliminary indications obtained with Swift/XRT (ATEL #1998), and that the object is most likely an accreting pulsar. The phase-averaged flux from the source is highly variable, with a mean intensity of about 5 cts/sec/PCU, but with excursions in the range from 1 - 30 cts/sec/PCU. The mean intensity corresponds to a flux of approximately 2 mCrab in the PCA band. There is some indication in the first observation that the phase-averaged variability is quasiperiodic, with variations on a time-scale near 190 seconds. The energy spectrum is well modeled by a power law, with photon index which varies over time in the range 1.5 - 1.9, and an iron line at 6.4 keV with equivalent width 360 eV. The fluxes in the 2-10, 10-20 and 20-40 keV bands are in the ranges 3.4-4.7, 1.6-3.4, and 1.7-4.8, respectively, in units of 1e-11 erg/s/cm2. Additional observations with RXTE are planned. 2009-04-02 04:35:00
response:
首先，观测对象IGR J19294+1816是一个新发现的INTEGRAL源，RXTE对其进行了两次X射线观测，时间均在2009年3月31日，总曝光时间分别为2.5 ks和3.2 ks。第一次观测中探测到显著的周期性脉冲信号，经日心改正后的脉冲周期为12.44秒，表明该源具有稳定的自转调制，这是X射线脉冲星的关键判据。脉冲轮廓的基频振幅达37%（背景扣除后），且存在第一谐波，其振幅约为基频的1/4，说明脉冲轮廓偏离正弦形式，具有非对称结构，符合典型吸积脉冲星的光变特征。

其次，Swift/XRT此前已给出初步线索（ATEL #1998），本次RXTE高信噪比探测确认了脉动性质，结合长周期（12.44 s）、强脉冲幅度及谐波存在，可排除其他暂现源类型（如磁星爆发、X射线暴或活动星系核闪烁），支持其为中子星主导的吸积系统，即吸积驱动的X射线脉冲星。

第三，相位平均光度表现出剧烈变化，计数率在1–30 cts/sec/PCU范围内波动，均值约5 cts/sec/PCU，对应PCA波段约2 mCrab流量。这种量级达数十倍的光变表明吸积流不稳定，可能源于吸积盘不规则供给、中子星磁层边界扰动或视线方向上的遮挡变化。首次观测中还发现约190秒的准周期光变成分，可能反映吸积盘进动、冕区振荡或磁层旋转调制等物理过程，需后续高时间分辨率分析验证。

第四，能谱分析显示其可用幂律模型良好拟合，光子指数在1.5–1.9之间随时间演化，属典型吸积脉冲星硬谱态范围；6.4 keV处存在等效宽度360 eV的铁Kα发射线，明确指示冷物质（如伴星风或吸积盘外区）被X射线照射产生荧光，证实存在富铁环境与致密天体吸积系统。各能段流量（2–10、10–20、20–40 keV）分别为3.4–4.7、1.6–3.4、1.7–4.8 × 10⁻¹¹ erg/s/cm²，呈随能量升高而缓慢衰减的趋势，符合吸积柱辐射冷却特征，未见明显高能截断，暗示磁场强度可能处于中等范围（~10¹² G），不足以产生显著回旋吸收线。

综上，多维度观测证据——稳定长周期脉动、高脉冲幅度与谐波结构、剧烈且可能准周期的光变、幂律主导能谱、显著铁线及宽能段流量分布——共同确证IGR J19294+1816是一颗处于活跃吸积状态的中子星X射线脉冲星。

根据现象进行分析： Renewed activity from IGR J17098-3628 detected by INTEGRAL/IBIS We report renewed activity of the Black-Hole Candidate IGR J17098-3628 (Atel #444, Chen et al. 2008, Capitanio et al. 2009) seen with the INTEGRAL/IBIS/ISGRI instrument during INTEGRAL Key Programme observations of the Galactic Centre (revolution 789, from 2009-03-30T14:14 to 2009-03-31T11:11). The source is detected in the 20-40 keV mosaic image at 10 sigmas, with a rate of 1.8Â±0.2 cps (about 11 mCrab) for an effective exposure time of 73 ksec. It is also detected at 5.2 sigmas in the 40-80 keV band, with a rate of 0.8Â±0.2 cps (about 10 mCrab). It is not detected at higher energies.
The source was not detected by INTEGRAL during previous observations of the field between 2008-09-18 and 2009-03-12. The upper limit on the flux at the source position during this period, with pointings of similar exposure, is about 0.5 mCrab. Between 2009-03-12 and 2009-03-30, Galactic Bulge observations give a typical 3 sigma upper limit of about 7 mCrab in the 18-40 keV band. At lower energies, the RXTE/ASM ligntcurve show a possible activity since 2009-03-25, in the 3-9 keV band.
The ISGRI spectrum can be represented by a simple power law model with photon index 2.05Â±0.35 (reduced chi squared 0.86, d.o.f. 9) with a model flux of F(20-200 keV) = 2.7E-10 erg/cm**2/sec. The spectral model is compatible with the Hard State spectrum of black hole candidates. Therefore, the new detection of IGR J17098-3628 at high energies and the spectral state inferred from the INTEGRAL spectrum suggest that the source is now entering a new outburst.
INTEGRAL will continue to observe this region regularly in the coming weeks, as part of its Key Programs. We encourage follow-up observations of this source at all wavelengths. 2009-04-02 11:04:00
response:
首先，观测到IGR J17098-3628在INTEGRAL/IBIS/ISGRI数据中于2009年3月30日至31日（历元789）出现显著高能辐射：在20–40 keV波段以10σ置信度被探测到，计数率为1.8±0.2 cps（约11 mCrab），有效曝光时间73 ks；在40–80 keV波段以5.2σ置信度被探测到，计数率0.8±0.2 cps（约10 mCrab）；更高能量波段未探测到。这表明源在硬X射线波段存在强且硬的辐射。

其次，该源在此前长达近六个月的INTEGRAL观测中（2008年9月18日至2009年3月12日）始终未被探测，同期源位置处的3σ流量上限仅为约0.5 mCrab；而在2009年3月12日至30日期间，银河系核球巡天给出的18–40 keV波段3σ上限约为7 mCrab，显著高于此前上限但仍远低于本次探测值，说明源流量在3月下旬发生突增。此外，RXTE/ASM在3–9 keV波段的光变曲线显示自3月25日起可能存在低能辐射增强，暗示多波段协同变亮，支持爆发起始时间约为3月下旬。

第三，ISGRI获得的能谱可由幂律模型良好拟合，光子指数为2.05±0.35（χ²_red = 0.86，dof = 9），20–200 keV能段模型通量为2.7×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s。该光子指数处于典型黑洞候选体硬态范围（通常为1.5–2.5），且缺乏软成分（如热盘辐射或明显康普顿化截断）的迹象，结合高硬X射线流量和未在更高能段（>80 keV）探测到辐射，进一步支持其处于标准硬态而非中间态或软态。

综上，该源在长期宁静后于2009年3月下旬突然增强，高能探测显著、光谱硬、流量跃升两个数量级以上，且光谱特征符合黑洞X射线双星硬态出射特性，因此可判定其正进入一次新的暂现爆发。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of burst oscillations near the spin frequency in the intermittent accreting millisecond pulsar HETE J1900.1-2455  RXTE observations of the intermittent accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar HETE J1900.1-2455 (Kaaret et al. 2006 ApJ 638, 963; Galloway et al. 2007 ApJ 654, L73) showed a Type I X-ray burst on April 2 2009 (08:57 UTC). We detect strong burst oscillations during the peak and initial decay of the burst, drifting upwards from 375.5 Hz to 376.5 Hz. Maximum Leahy power is in the range 25-45 in 4 independent consecutive 2s bins (using all photons in the 2-60 keV band), putting the detection beyond doubt. 
The burst oscillation frequency is just below the known spin frequency of 377.3 Hz (the satellite orbit file is not available yet so we could not barycenter the data at this stage, but shifts due to barycentering and orbital effects will not exceed 0.1 Hz). Several bursts from this source have been detected with RXTE (Galloway et al. 2008 ApJS, 179, 360), but this is the first to show burst oscillations. HETE J1900.1-2455 is the second of the three known intermittent pulsars, all of which burst, to show burst oscillations (Casella et al. 2008 ApJ, 674, L41; Altamirano et al. 2008 ApJ, 674, L45). This new result supports the general picture that burst oscillation frequency lies within a few Hz of spin frequency (see Watts 2008, AIP Conference Proceedings, 1068,199 for a review). 2009-04-02 18:07:00
response:
首先，观测到HETE J1900.1-2455在2009年4月2日发生一次I型X射线暴，时间精确至08:57 UTC。  
其次，在该暴的峰值及初始衰减阶段，检测到显著的暴振荡信号，频率从375.5 Hz向上漂移至376.5 Hz，表明存在非严格周期性的调制成分。  
第三，暴振荡的Leahy功率在25–45之间，分布在4个独立的2秒时间区间内（使用2–60 keV全能段光子），统计显著性极高，排除随机涨落可能。  
第四，已知该源自转频率为377.3 Hz，当前未完成日心改正（缺乏卫星轨道文件），但预计日心改正与轨道效应引起的频率偏移均不超过0.1 Hz，因此暴振荡频率（375.5–376.5 Hz）稳定地位于自转频率下方约0.8–1.8 Hz范围内。  
第五，尽管RXTE此前已探测到该源多个X射线暴（Galloway et al. 2008），但此为首次发现暴振荡；结合已有研究，该源成为第三个已知间歇吸积毫秒脉冲星中第二个展现暴振荡者。  
最后，该结果进一步支持理论共识：热核暴振荡频率通常紧邻中子星自转频率，偏差一般在数赫兹以内，反映其起源于中子星表面非对称热斑随自转产生的准周期调制。

根据现象进行分析： Palomar Transient Factory: Discovery and Follow-Up of 25 Transients The Palomar Transient Factory (see ATel #1964) reports the discovery of 25 optical transients with the Palomar Observatory 1.2-m Oschin telescope (+CFH12K camera). Imaging data were obtained on several nights between Mar 17 and Mar 28 with a g-band filter. Transient candidates were identified after subtracting off reference templates constructed from imaging data obtained prior to Mar 12. Spectroscopic follow-up was carried out on Mar 27, 28, 29, 30, and 31 with the 9.2-m Hobby-Eberly Telescope (+LRS), the 5.1-m Palomar Hale (+DBSP) telescope, and the 10.0-m Keck-I (+LRIS) telescope. Below we list the locations of each transient, the UT date in which the transient was first found, and the g-band magnitude at discovery.

PTF09o was detected at the same location in two visits separated by 2 hours, but we do not have further subtractions of this field. We performed a spectroscopic observation at this location on Mar 31 with Keck/LRIS, but no source was detected. This significant fading suggests a dwarf nova. Similarly, PTF09bf rose by more than 3 magnitudes from Mar 25th to the 26th but faded away by our P200/DBSP observations on Mar 30. We suggest this is a dwarf nova as well. We have not spectroscopically confirmed PTF09bx; however, from its association with a SDSS galaxy (z=0.03), we infer that this is a SN. Spectra of PTF09be show a nearly featureless blue continuum. PTF09as was independently discovered by CRTS. 2009-04-02 23:38:00

该现象描述了Palomar Transient Factory（PTF）在2009年3月17日至28日期间利用1.2米Oschin望远镜开展的光学暂现源巡天工作，共发现25个光学暂现源。分析需从观测方法、候选体筛选流程、后续证认手段及分类依据四个层面展开：

首先，观测采用g波段成像，时间覆盖3月17.1343 UT至3月28.4155 UT，数据经减法处理——即用早于3月12日获取的参考模板图像与新图像相减，从而识别出位置固定但亮度变化的暂现源；此方法对扣除静态星像和星系背景有效，是瞬变源搜寻的标准技术。

其次，暂现候选体的初步筛选依赖于减法残差中的显著正信号，其空间偏移量（如“5.3"W,6.3"N”）表明多数源位于宿主星系内或近邻区域，支持其为天体物理起源而非宇宙线或图像伪迹；而PTF09o和PTF09bd等未标注偏移量者，可能位于无清晰宿主结构的暗弱区域或图像边缘，亦或因信噪比不足难以精确定位。

第三，光谱后随观测集中于3月27–31日，动用三台大型望远镜（HET、Palomar Hale、Keck-I），覆盖不同红移和光度范围：已获红移z值者（如PTF09k, z=0.19）多具Ia型超新星典型吸收特征（Si II 635.5 nm等），且g波段发现星等（17.81–20.86）与Ia峰值绝对星等（≈−19.3 mag）及对应红移下的距离模数一致；PTF09cu（z=0.06, g=17.91）和PTF09aa（z=0.12, g=18.97）同样符合Ia光度—红移关系，佐证分类可靠性。

第四，非Ia类暂现源的判据呈现多样性：PTF09o与PTF09bf均显示快速光变（数小时内显著增亮后快速衰减），且光谱未探测到发射线或吸收线，结合其高光度变化幅度（>3 mag）及缺乏持续辐射，符合矮新星吸积盘热不稳定性模型；PTF09bi与PTF09ct、PTF09cu被标为II型或II?，因其光谱中存在氢巴尔末线（未直接给出但由分类推断），且红移较低（z=0.11/0.15/0.06），对应核心坍缩超新星典型特征；PTF09bw标记为IIn?，暗示存在窄发射线成分，可能源于激波与致密星周物质相互作用；PTF09bx虽无光谱，但其与SDSS星系（z=0.03）的位置关联，结合暂现光度与宿主距离模数匹配，支持其为河外Ia或II型超新星；PTF09be的“近似无特征蓝连续谱”则与年轻大质量恒星形成区、活动星系核或某些特殊激变变星一致，尚无法唯一确定类型。

综上，该批暂现源的分类结果建立在多历元测光演化、高精度定位、多望远镜光谱证认及宿主环境关联分析的综合证据链之上，其中Ia型超新星占绝对多数（17/25），其余为矮新星、II型超新星及未定类源，体现了时域巡天在暂现源系统性发现与物理分类中的有效性。

response: 该告示指出，对PTF09bf的进一步分析质疑其真实性，因此撤回此前将其归类为矮新星或真实暂现源的结论。这表明初始观测或数据处理中可能存在误判，例如信噪比不足、图像伪迹、恒星活动干扰、或数据校准偏差等；后续更严格的分析（如多历元测光、光谱验证、位置精确定位、排除已知变星或活动星系核等）未能证实其暂现性质，故判定其并非真实的天体爆发事件。

根据现象进行分析： XTE J1829-098 Predicted for Another Outburst in Early April XTE J1829-098 is a 7.8 second transient X-ray pulsar discovered by RXTE in 2004 (ATEL #317), having XMM, Chandra, and IR counterparts (Halpern & Gotthelf 2007, ApJ, 669, 579). 
A long term light curve of XTE J1829-098 from regular RXTE PCA monitoring observations shows that its outbursts have a recurrence period of ~246 days and a duration of ~7 days. Based on our earlier prediction, RXTE caught an outburst of the source in August 2008, appearing to peak around 2008-08-04. If the recurrence period holds, the source is due to have another outburst soon, peaking within a few days of 2009-04-07. 
Analysis of the pulsations observed during the August 2008 outburst reveal a period of 7.839783(6) s, and an apparent period derivative of about 6e-10 s/s. There is no additional obvious evidence for orbital modulation of the pulse arrival times. The fluxes at the peak of the August 2008 outburst in the 2-10, 10-20 and 20-40 keV bands were approximately 7.4, 6.9 and 2.2 respectively, in units of 1e-11 erg/cm^2/s. 
If we interpret the 246 day outburst cycle as the orbital period, then XTE J1829-098 would have a quite long orbital period compared to other sources in the Pspin vs. Porb "Corbet" diagram with a similar spin period. The properties of XTE J1829-098 strongly suggest that it is a wind-fed X-ray binary, probably a Be star binary. 
PCA Scan light curve of XTE J1829-098 2009-04-04 22:45:00
response:
首先，题目给出XTE J1829-098是一颗自转周期为7.8秒的暂现X射线脉冲星，2004年被RXTE发现。其长期光变曲线显示爆发具有约246天的重复周期和约7天的持续时间。此前基于该周期预测并成功捕获了2008年8月的爆发，峰值出现在2008-08-04；因此按246天周期推算，下一次爆发应于2009-04-07前后达到峰值。

其次，2008年8月爆发期间测得自转周期为7.839783(6) s，且存在微小的周期导数（~6×10⁻¹⁰ s/s），表明存在自转减慢趋势，符合吸积驱动的脉冲星演化特征；未观测到轨道调制的脉冲到达时间变化，说明轨道倾角可能较小或轨道偏心率低，导致多普勒效应不显著。

第三，峰值流量在2–10 keV、10–20 keV、20–40 keV波段分别为7.4、6.9、2.2 ×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，谱形整体随能量升高而下降，符合典型热轫致辐射主导的X射线暂现源特征，且高能段流量未急剧衰减，支持风吸积而非盘吸积模型（后者常在硬X射线波段呈现更强辐射）。

第四，若将246天爆发周期解释为轨道周期，则该源在Corbet图中位于P_spin ~ 7.8 s、P_orb ~ 246 d区域，显著偏离多数已知中子星X射线双星的分布，但与Be/X射线双星系统典型参数一致——Be星具有周期性星周盘形成与消散过程，可导致规则但非严格周期性的吸积事件，从而产生~100–1000天量级的爆发间隔。

第五，题目末尾给出“PCA Scan light curve of XTE J1829-098 2009-04-04 22:45:00”，即2009年4月4日22:45:00的扫描式光变数据，距预测峰值（4月7日）仅约2.5天，处于爆发上升段或早期峰值阶段；结合246天周期的稳定性及前次爆发验证，该时刻极可能已进入显著增亮阶段，光变曲线应呈现快速上升或平台状高流量状态，区别于宁静期本底水平。

综上，XTE J1829-098的246天爆发周期、无明显轨道调制、软硬X射线流量比、自转减慢率及长轨道周期推论，共同指向其为一颗风吸积型Be/X射线双星，当前（2009-04-04）正处于新一轮爆发的活跃初期。

根据现象进行分析： A 117-day Period in IGR J19294+1816 An analysis of the light curve of IGR J19294+1816 (Turler et al, ATel #1997) from the Swift/BAT hard X-ray transient monitor covering 2006 January 1 through 2009 April 2 reveals a strong signal with a period of 117 days. We associate this period with the orbital period of the binary system. The power spectrum of the light curve shows strong peaks near 117 days and its harmonic near 58 days. A folding analysis also reveals a modulation near 117 days. The smoothed light curve shows a non-sinusoidal variation with peaks at 117-day intervals. For the eleven 117-day cycles covered by the BAT data, eight predicted maxima correspond to peaks in the light curve where the daily average flux rose above 0.002 Â± 0.0009 ct/s/cm2 (10 mCrab) in the 15-50 keV band. Two other high points were at roughly half the assumed orbital period and are possible evidence for an interaction between the neutron star and an equatorial disk around the mass-donating star. These high points at half the orbital period account for the previous suggestion by Krimm et al. (ATel #1999) that the orbital period of IGR J19294+1816 is 56 Â± 4 days. 
Using the 8 maxima in the light curve which coincide with the times predicted by a 117 day period we derive:   
Tpeak (MJD) = 54,680.3 (+/- 0.6) + n x 117.2 (+/- 0.2) 
Using the pulse period of the system (Strohmayer et al, ATel #2002) of 12.44 seconds, we can place this binary system on the plot of pulse period vs. orbital period (Corbet 1986, MNRAS, 220, 1047). IGR J19294+1816 falls within the region of parameter space expected for a Be system. Such an interpretation is also consistent with the transient nature of the source. 
Swift BAT hard X-ray transient monitor light curves for IGR 19294+1816 2009-04-06 19:53:00
response: 首先，观测到IGR J19294+1816在Swift/BAT 15–50 keV波段的长期光变曲线中存在显著的117天周期性调制，该信号在功率谱中表现为强峰，并在折叠分析中得到确认，说明该周期具有统计稳健性。其次，117天周期对应于光变曲线中8个实际观测到的峰值时刻，这些峰值满足线性历元公式Tpeak = 54680.3 ± 0.6 + n × (117.2 ± 0.2) MJD，表明该周期具有良好的相位一致性。第三，功率谱中同时存在约58天的谐波峰，且光变曲线中另有两个高点出现在约58天位置，这解释了此前Krimm等人基于有限数据误判轨道周期为56 ± 4天的原因——实为117天基频的二次谐波响应，可能源于中子星与供质恒星赤道盘的对称性相互作用（如两次近星点扫掠或盘缘遮挡/增强）。第四，结合已知自转周期12.44秒，该系统在Corbet图（脉冲周期–轨道周期关系图）中落入Be/X射线双星典型区域，支持其为一颗中子星绕Be型发射线星运行的暂现源，其爆发由中子星穿越Be星赤道盘时吸积率突增所驱动。第五，光变形态呈非正弦、不对称，且峰值通量达10 mCrab以上，符合Be/X射线双星在盘穿越事件期间的典型行为，进一步佐证117天为真实轨道周期而非采样伪影或噪声巧合。

该现象描述的是CRTS（卡塔利娜实时瞬变巡天）项目利用帕洛玛5.1米海尔望远镜（配备DBSP光谱仪）对一批超新星（SNe）进行光谱证认的工作，重点在于这些超新星寄主星系普遍具有内禀亮度极低的特征。分析可分以下层次展开：

首先，观测样本共包含14颗已光谱确认的超新星（含首批9颗与后续补充5颗），其中Ia型占绝对多数（10/14），另有IIp、IIb、Ic、IIn及可能为AGN的个例；红移范围集中在z = 0.02–0.19，属近邻宇宙范畴，保证了宿主星系测光和光谱诊断的可靠性。

其次，关键证据在于宿主星系的绝对星等M_r：全部14个宿主中，有11个M_r > −16.0，其中5个更暗于−15.5，最暗者CSS090318:094055+011608达M_r = −13.8；而典型大质量旋涡或椭圆星系的M_r ≈ −20至−22，L*星系M_r ≈ −20.5。因此，这些宿主普遍比L*星系暗3–7 mag，对应恒星质量可能低至10⁷–10⁸ M⊙，属于矮星系或极低面亮度星系（ULBGs/LSBs）范畴。

第三，该分布并非选择效应所致：CRTS本身是广域巡天，探测极限较深（r ≈ 21.5 mag），但超新星发现依赖于宿主表面亮度与本征光度的联合信噪比；而表中多颗SN（如CSS090319:142155+260102, M_r = −18.0）出现在相对明亮的宿主中，说明巡天有能力探测亮宿主中的SN；相反，大量Ia型SN集中出现在M_r > −16的暗宿主中，暗示Ia型爆发在低质量、低金属丰度、恒星形成率低的矮星系中具有非低估的产率。

第四，物理含义需结合Ia型前身星模型审视：传统双简并模型（DD）对宿主环境无强依赖，而单简并模型（SD）要求存在持续吸积的伴星，其在贫金属、低恒星形成率的矮星系中应受抑制；然而观测显示矮星系中Ia型比例不低（10/14），且部分宿主M_r > −15.5（如CSS090401、CSS090303等），提示可能存在快速通道（t < 1 Gyr）的Ia型爆发，或DD通道在矮星系中仍高效，或存在未被识别的恒星种群（如古老、致密星团）提供合适前身星。

第五，非Ia型事件亦具启示性：CSS090318:094055+011608（IIp, z=0.02, M_r=−13.8）与CSS090219:095526−012821（IIb, z=0.03, M_r=−13.7）均位于最暗宿主中，支持核心坍缩超新星（CCSNe）在低质量星系中同样常见——这与矮星系富含大质量年轻恒星的观测一致（如Blue Compact Dwarfs），但需注意其宿主M_r值接近矮不规则星系（dIrr）典型值，故不违背恒星形成预期。

综上，该现象系统性证实CRTS在暗弱宿主星系中探测并证认超新星的能力，揭示近邻宇宙中Ia型超新星在矮星系中的显著占比，对Ia型前身星通道、星系-超新星关联、以及利用Ia型校准宇宙学距离时的宿主偏置修正均构成关键约束。

根据现象进行分析： CRTS Discovery of a very energetic Type IIn Supernova The Catalina Real-time Transient Survey (CRTS) has spectroscopically characterized CSS080928:160837+041626 (ATel 1768) as a Type IIn SN at z~0.041 using the SMARTS 1.5m telescope using Observations taken on March 27th UT with the following results:   

ID| RA| Dec | Type| z| Disc. ATel  
---|---|---|---|---|---  
CSS080928:160837+041626| 16:08:37.23| 04:16:26.7|  IIn |  0.041 | ATEL#1768  
The object was first marked as a transient by CRTS on 2008-09-28 (unfiltered mag=17.7). It was also present in the 2007-09-13 images, but blended with the brighter star nearby and hence not detected as a transient. Palomar-Quest images from 2007-02-24 do not reveal the presence of the SN. GALEX data from 2008-06-05 shows a well-detected source at this location (NUV 19.93+/-0.04, FUV 21.18+/-0.09). It was not seen in AIS images from 2004-05-17 indicating a brightening in NUV by at least 2.5 mags. Coadded images from SDSS (all filters) reveal the presence of a possible faint host at the location. Assuming that the galaxy has r=23, at z=0.041 it translates to M_r=~-13, almost a 100 times dimmer than the LMC. 
Palomar 60-inch (P60) data form 2009-03-21 reveals that it is still bright (r=17.60+/-0.04). It has stayed bright for over 500 days, and rising much of the time. In fact the SMARTS spectrum with its Balmer lines (strong H-alpha, H-beta, H-gamma), He I lines (5876, 7065 and possibly others), and an absence of Oxygen lines reveals it to be much more like SN1994Y at T=30 days (Filipenko A.V., ARAA, 1997, 35, 309-355, Fig. 14). There is also some evidence of Fe-I emission and the H-beta shows a P-Cygni like profile. The maximum P60 r-band magnitude was ~17.2 suggesting an absolute magnitude ~-18.8. The evidence is consistent with a type IIn supernova possibly with high density circumstellar material. 
Additional observations are requested. 
All current candidate and confirmed SNe as well as finding charts can be found here. 2009-04-10 22:45:00
response: 该现象描述了一颗被CRTS巡天发现并经光谱证认的高能量IIn型超新星CSS080928:160837+041626（z≈0.041）。首先，其光变特征显示异常持久：自2008年9月28日首次被探测（unfiltered mag=17.7）起，至2009年3月21日P60观测仍保持r≈17.6亮度，已持续亮于500天且多数时间处于增亮阶段，表明能量释放过程极为缓慢，这与IIn型超新星典型的与致密星周物质相互作用机制高度吻合。其次，SMARTS光谱显示强而宽的巴尔末线（Hα、Hβ、Hγ）、He I发射线（5876 Å、7065 Å等），缺乏[O III]等氧禁线，且Hβ呈现P-Cygni轮廓，说明存在高速外流与静止/低速致密壳层共存的结构；Fe I发射进一步支持晚期激波加热或热辐射主导的发光机制。再者，GALEX紫外数据（2008-06-05，NUV=19.93）较SDSS前GALEX AIS图像（2004-05-17）增亮≥2.5 mag，证实爆发前数月已开始显著紫外增强，暗示爆发前存在剧烈的质量损失活动。宿主星系甚暗（r=23，M_r≈−13），仅为LMC光度约1%——如此低质量矮星系中产生极高光度（M_r≈−18.8）的IIn型超新星，强烈暗示前身星为大质量恒星（可能>25 M⊙）在晚期经历极端脉动或喷发，形成高密度（n_H ≳ 10⁹ cm⁻³）、近距（R ≲ 10¹⁵ cm）星周介质，从而通过激波与CSM相互作用维持长期高光度。综上，该事件是典型IIn型超新星中能量尺度突出、CSM密度极高、宿主环境特殊的一例，其长期增亮行为与SN 1994Y相似，支持“激波与致密星周环相互作用主导光度演化”的物理图景。

根据现象进行分析： Swift and RXTE report the detection of a new transient pulsar Swift  J0513.4-6547 in the Large Magellanic Cloud The hard X-ray transient monitor of the Swift Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) has detected a previously unknown transient source. This source, Swift J0513.4-6547, was first detected at a daily average rate of 0.0018 Â± 0.0014 counts/sec/cm^2 (8 mcrab) in the 15-50 keV band on 2009 April 2 (MJD 54923). It has continued at nearly the same brightness for the past two weeks. Examination of archived data reveals that the source was first detectable around 2009 Mar 4 and reached a peak brightness of ~40 mCrab on 2009 March 6. 
Observing constraints prevented an observation with the Swift X-Ray Telescope (XRT) until 2009 April 11. A bright source was found in a 4.66 ks observation beginning at 01:34:47 (UT). The position was determined to be: 
RA (J2000): 05 13 28.05 (78.36688 deg)  
DEC (J2000): -65 47 20.0 (-65.78888 deg)  

The estimated error is 1.9 arcsec (radius, 90% confidence). 
RXTE observed Swift J0513.4-6547 for 1.2 ksec beginning on 2009 April 14 at 10:08:32 (UT). We detect strong pulsations from the source with a barycentric period of 27.28 seconds. The pulse profile is double peaked, and the amplitude (max - min / max + min) is high at about 85%. The average count rate was approximately 6 ct/s/PCU, corresponding to a flux of about 3 mCrab (2 - 20 keV). Additional observations with RXTE are planned. 
Examination of the DSS images reveals a bright star within the XRT error radius. The star is 2MASS 05132826-6547187 and is located at coordinates, RA=78.367757, dec=-65.788536. The star has reported magnitudes B=15.3, R=15.5 (USNO-B1.0), J=15.2, H=15.1, K=14.8 (2MASS). We propose that this star is the counterpart of the X-ray transient. This source is at galactic coordinates L=275.98685, B=-34.55446. The brightness of the optical source suggests that this system is a high-mass X-Ray binary. 
The star was also detected in the Swift UltraViolet Telescope (UVOT) at a position (J2000): 
RA (J2000): 05:13:28.28 = 78.36783 (deg)  
Dec (J2000): -65:47:18.4 = -65.78843 (deg)  

with an estimated uncertainty of 0.5 arcsec (radius, 90% confidence, statistical \+ systematic). This is 2.14 arcsec from the center of the XRT error circle. The magnitude of the source is u = 13.7 Â± 0.1. The magnitude error is fairly large because this is a crowded field. The Galactic extinction in this direction is E_{B-V} = 0.15 mag. Comparison with the catalog magnitudes above suggests that this source either has a very blue U-B color, or that it is variable. Further UVOT observations in multiple filters have been requested. 
The Swift location is consistent with the source being located in the Large Magellanic Cloud. This is somewhat unusual given that the LMC hosts relatively few HMXB X-ray pulsars, compared to the SMC. Liu, van Paradijs and van den Heuvel, A&A 442, 1135 (2005) note that there are 92 HMXBs in the SMC and 36 in the LMC. 
The XRT light curve varies between 0.7 and 1.0 ct/s (0.3-10 keV). The source spectrum can be fit to a power law with photon index 1.111 (+0.078, -0.063), and nH (intrinsic) = 7.6 (+28.5, -7.6) x 10^19 cm^-2 (nH (galactic) = 9.8 X 10^20 cm^-2. The unabsorbed flux (0.3-10 keV) is 5.6 x 10^-11 erg cm-2 s-1. At the distance of the LMC (50 kpc), this corresponds to a luminosity of 1.8 X 10^37 erg s^-1. The source is too faint in the BAT for spectral analysis. 
Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Monitor light curves for SWIFT J0513.4-6547 2009-04-14 20:38:00
response:
该现象描述了一个新发现的暂现X射线脉冲星Swift J0513.4−6547，位于大麦哲伦云（LMC）中。首先，Swift/BAT在2009年4月2日（MJD 54923）于15–50 keV波段以约8 mCrab的流量首次探测到该源，日平均计数率为0.0018 ± 0.0014 counts/sec/cm²；回溯归档数据发现其早在2009年3月4日已可探测，并于3月6日达到峰值亮度约40 mCrab，表明其为一个快速上升、持续约一个月的硬X射线暂现源。由于观测限制，Swift/XRT直至4月11日才完成首次观测，确认存在一个明亮X射线源，定位精度达1.9″（90%置信半径），坐标与LMC一致。

RXTE于4月14日开展1.2 ks观测，明确探测到强周期性脉冲信号，经日心改正后的自转周期为27.28秒，脉冲轮廓呈双峰结构，调制幅度高达85%（即(max−min)/(max+min)≈0.85），表明中子星磁层吸积具有高度几何不对称性和准直性；平均计数率6 ct/s/PCU对应2–20 keV波段约3 mCrab流量，进一步支持其为经典吸积驱动的X射线脉冲星。

光学证认方面，在XRT误差圆内发现一颗亮星2MASS 05132826−6547187（B=15.3, R=15.5, J=15.2, H=15.1, K=14.8），位置偏移仅约0.5″，与UVOT在u波段测得的位置（u=13.7±0.1）偏差2.14″，且u波段显著偏亮（相比B波段预期），结合低消光（E_{B−V}=0.15）及多波段颜色特征，说明该光学对应体具有蓝紫外超量，符合早型大质量伴星（O/B型）特征；其光度与谱型共同指向高光度、高吸积率的高质量X射线双星（HMXB）系统。

XRT能谱拟合给出0.3–10 keV波段光子指数Γ=1.111⁺⁰·⁰⁷⁸₋₀.₀₆₃，固有吸收柱密度n_H,int = (7.6⁺²⁸·⁵₋₇.₆)×10¹⁹ cm⁻²（远低于银河系前景吸收n_H,gal = 9.8×10²⁰ cm⁻²），说明本征吸收很弱，X射线辐射主要来自致密星附近未被严重遮蔽的吸积柱或极冠区；扣除吸收后的0.3–10 keV未吸收流量为5.6×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，按LMC距离50 kpc换算得各向同性光度L_X ≈ 1.8×10³⁷ erg s⁻¹，处于典型HMXB脉冲星光度范围（10³⁶–10³⁸ erg s⁻¹），且高于多数LMC已知脉冲星，暗示强磁场（可能>10¹³ G）与高吸积率共存。

值得注意的是，尽管LMC是邻近星系中研究最充分的恒星形成区之一，但其中已确认的HMXB脉冲星数量（36例）显著少于小麦哲伦云（92例），可能反映二者恒星形成历史、金属丰度或致密星形成效率的差异；本源的发现填补了LMC中此类天体的样本空缺，并因其高光度、长周期（27.28 s）、高调制深度及清晰的光学对应体，成为研究大质量双星演化、中子星吸积物理与脉冲星制动机制的重要新目标。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical Light Curve of the X-ray Pulsar Swift J0513.4-6547 We have identified the optical counterpart of the X-ray pulsar Swift J0513.4-6547 (Krimm et al. 2009, ATel #2011) as LMC star 59.5431.442 in the MACHO database, with R(mean)~15.6 and V-R~+0.05. The source shows ~0.3 mag (swooping) variations on time scales of a few hundred days. Such behavior is typical of some X-ray/pulsar systems. A detailed period analysis reveals no coherent periodicities between 0.3 and 1000 days. Thus, there is no signature of either an orbital period or short-period pulsations from the hot star. 2009-04-15 22:16:00
response: 首先，观测到光学光变曲线显示该X射线脉冲星的光学对应体在R波段平均星等约为15.6，色指数V−R ≈ +0.05，表明其光学谱型偏早型（接近B/A型），与大麦哲伦云中典型O/B型伴星一致。其次，光变呈现振幅约0.3 mag、时标数百天的“swooping”式准周期起伏，此类变化常见于高质量X射线双星（HMXB）中的非径向脉动、星风不稳定性或盘调制过程，而非规则轨道调制。第三，对0.3–1000天周期范围进行细致周期分析后未检测到任何显著相干周期信号，排除了该光学源本身存在短周期脉动（如β Cep或SPB型脉动）的可能性；同时，也未发现对应于双星轨道周期的光变调制，暗示轨道倾角可能较低、伴星光度占主导且无明显掩食或椭球调制，或轨道周期超出所搜寻范围（如>1000天）。综上，光学光变主要源于伴星自身的不规则活动或星周环境变化，而非轨道运动或恒星自转驱动的规则周期现象。

根据现象进行分析： GROND reveals optical/NIR brightening of Swift J0513.4-6547 GROND (Greiner et al. 2008, PASP 120, 405), the 7-channel imager mounted at the 2.2m ESO/MPI telescope at La Silla Observatory (Chile) started follow-up observations of the transient source Swift J0513.4-6547 (Krimm et al. 2009, ATEL #2011) on 14 Apr 2009, 23:55 UT simultaneously in the g'r'i'z'JHK bands. A total of 8 30-sec exposures in g'r'i'z' and 48 10-sec exposures in JHK were obtained.   
Within the 1.9 arcsec Swift XRT error circle (Krimm et al. 2009, ATEL #2011) we detect a single source, at position RA(2000.0) = 05:13:28.29, Decl.(2000.0) = -65:47:18.9 with an error of 0.3 arcsec. This is consistent with the object 2MASS 05132826-6547187, already proposed by Krimm et al. (2009, ATEL #2011) as the optical counterpart of Swift J0513.4-6547.   
We measure the following magnitudes (all in AB system): 
    
      
    g' (AB) = 14.6 Â± 0.1  
    r' (AB) = 15.0 Â± 0.1  
    i' (AB) = 15.1 Â± 0.1  
    z' (AB) = 15.3 Â± 0.1  
    J (Vega) = 14.7 -> J (AB) = 15.6 Â± 0.1  
    H (Vega) = 14.6 -> H (AB) = 16.0 Â± 0.1  
    K (Vega) = 14.6 -> K (AB) = 16.4 Â± 0.1  
    
Compared to the 2MASS magnitudes (exposures from 10 Dec 1998) of J (Vega) = 15.2 mag, H (Vega) = 15.1 mag, and K (Vega) = 14.8 mag, as well as the DENIS magnitudes (exposures from 22 Dec 1996) of I = 15.09 +/- 0.04 mag and J (Vega) = 15.20 +/- 0.14 mag, this object is now about 0.5 mag brighter.   
The majority of high-mass X-ray binaries are Be/X-ray systems, in which the blue part of the optical spectrum is usually dominated by the mass donor, and the red part normally has a significant contribution from the circumstellar disk. Our foreground-extinction corrected color r'-z' = -0.5 mag corresponds to about R-I = +0.55 mag, which is incompatible with the colors of an O or B star. This suggests that already the z'-band is strongly affected by the putative disk. Optical variability in Be/X-ray binaries is not unusual, and amplitudes of up to 0.8 mag over time scale of years have been reported (e.g. Coe et al. 2005, MN 356, 502). While X-ray outbursts are normally associated with the passage of the neutron star close to the circumstellar disk, our observations indicate a substantial brightening of the disk, suggesting that possibly increased mass loss of the donor is responsible for both, the brightening as compared to the 2MASS/DENIS epochs, as well as the X-ray outburst.   
We urge for spectroscopic observations to measure the strength and width of the expected emission lines. Given the relatively low degree of crowding (see finding chart at http://www.mpe.mpg.de/~jcg/xrt/swiftj0513p4m6547.html  ), a search for long-term variability in archival data might also be interesting. 2009-04-15 22:25:00
response:
现象：GROND在g'r'i'z'JHK波段观测到Swift J0513.4-6547光学/NIR亮度显著增强，相比2MASS（1998年）和DENIS（1996年）历史数据，整体变亮约0.5 mag。

分析步骤一：定位与证认。GROND在Swift XRT误差圆内探测到唯一对应源，位置与2MASS 05132826-6547187一致，且误差仅0.3″，确认该源为Swift J0513.4-6547的光学/NIR对应体。

分析步骤二：测光结果量化。AB系统下测得g'=14.6±0.1、r'=15.0±0.1、i'=15.1±0.1、z'=15.3±0.1；经Vega→AB转换后，J=15.6±0.1、H=16.0±0.1、K=16.4±0.1。对比2MASS（J=15.2、H=15.1、K=14.8，Vega），对应AB值约为J≈16.1、H≈16.5、K≈16.8，故各波段均亮约0.5 mag，表明整体谱能量分布同步增强。

分析步骤三：颜色特征排除主序星主导。r'−z' = −0.5 mag换算为R−I ≈ +0.55 mag，显著红于典型O/B型星（R−I通常为负值或接近0），说明z'及更长波段已受显著红化或额外红成分贡献，不支持光度主要来自高温恒星本身。

分析步骤四：结合Be/X-ray双星物理模型解释。高质X射线双星多为Be/X射线系统，其中蓝光主要来自B型伴星，红光则常由环绕Be星的消光盘贡献。当前全波段同步增亮、且红端颜色异常偏红，表明增亮并非源于伴星本身变化，而更可能源于 circumstellar disk 的整体变亮——即盘物质密度或尺度增大，导致光学/NIR连续谱辐射增强。

分析步骤五：关联X射线爆发机制。X射线暴发通常发生于中子星穿越Be星盘时吸积率陡增；而本次光学/NIR同步增亮暗示盘质量损失率升高，既可导致盘自身辐射增强，又可为X射线吸积提供更大物质供给，因此二者可能具有共同起源——即Be星近期增强的星风或盘不稳定性引发的质量抛射事件。

分析步骤六：后续验证必要性。因Be星盘常呈现发射线（如Hα）、宽线轮廓及时变特征，需光谱观测确认发射线强度与宽度，以直接诊断盘物理状态；同时低拥挤环境支持回溯 archival 成像数据，检验长期光变趋势，判断此次增亮是否属典型Be星准周期活动的一部分。

根据现象进行分析： Optical variability of 1RXS J173006.4+033813 In course of the search for optical identifications of poorly studied ROSAT sources we have found an unusual variable object coincident with 1RXS J173006.4+033813. The star USNO-B1.0 0936-0303814 at RA=17h30m06.45s, Dec.=+03o38'20.0" (J2000.0) is showing high-amplitude variability on the time scales from years to minutes, but no indications of orbital period has been found so far. The variability has become obvious from Digitized Sky Survey plates with the object varying by 1.5-3m in IR, R and B between different epochs (two POSS-II plates are available for each band covering the period of 1988-1997). Catalogue magnitude values are B2=17.09, R2=17.22 and I=18.16. The star was below the detection limit on the 1st epoch Blue and Red Palomar plates taken in July 1950, but appeared in its highest state on June 1982 Quick-V plate reaching ~16.5 mag. It is not present on 2MASS images taken 2000 May 27.
The analysis of 42 NEAT images available from the SkyMorph site has shown the unusual variability on the scale of 15-30 minutes. The light curve of J1730.1+0338 based on 17 nights between 1997 Aug. 30 and 2003 Aug. 11 is presented at http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/~denis/J1730+0338_LC-NEAT.gif  . The object's behavior is unusual for cataclysmic variables, and the X-ray-to-optical flux ratio is high for the binary systems with WD.
Following the discovery of variability on the archival images we have observed J1730.1+0338 remotely with the 0.30-m Astrotel-Caucasus robotic telescope located at the Kazan State University's Mountain Station in Karachay-Cherkessia, Russia. Several sets of 300-sec exposures were obtained in July-August 2008 and February-April 2009 with around 350 images in total. The object was fainter than 20m on most occasions, but during the April 13, 2009 session we have observed it going into an outburst by at least 1.5 mag (from 19.5 to 18.0) within 10 minutes between 2009-04-14 00:55 and 01:05 UT. 
The color-combined (BRIR) 10'x9' DSS finder chart is available at http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/~denis/J1730+0338-comps.gif  (position of the variable object is marked with dashes). Note that the real range of variability may be well above the indicated 16.8-20.0. The object appears to be in the high state now. Our observations were unfortunately interrupted by the weather conditions. Multi-wavelength follow-up, spectroscopy and long-term photometric monitoring are requested to uncover the nature of this mysterious object.

response: 该天体表现出跨越多个时间尺度的显著光学变异性：从数十年（1950年代至2000年代）、年际（1988–1997）、月际（1997–2003）、到分钟级（15–30分钟），甚至观测到10分钟内增亮≥1.5星等的快速爆发。其亮度变化幅度极大，在不同波段（B、R、I）达1.5–3星等，历史最低亮度低于探测极限（1950年未检出），最高达~16.5 mag（1982年），而近年多数时间暗于20 mag，仅在2009年4月13日观测到快速增亮事件。多历元测光数据（DSS、POSS-II、NEAT、Astrotel）一致证实其非周期性、非单调、无明显轨道周期特征的复杂光变行为。X射线与光学流量比值异常高，不符合典型白矮星主导的密近双星系统（如经典新星或矮新星）的能谱预期；其光变形态亦区别于已知的激变变星类别。2MASS未探测到该源，表明其在2000年5月处于极低光度态或完全熄灭。综合来看，该源并非普通恒星，亦不匹配常见致密天体双星模型，其物理机制可能涉及暂现过程、极端吸积不稳定性、罕见类型的致密星活动，或尚未被识别的新类型变源。

根据现象进行分析： Swift observation  of 1RXS J173006.4+033813 and Association with USNO-B1.0 0936-0303814  In ATel #2014, a variable optical source USNO B1.0 0936-0303814 is reported in the field of 1RXS J173006.4+033813. This USNO-B1.0 source is cataloged with a B=17.1 magnitude. 
The X-ray source was observed with Swift/XRT as part of our ongoing study of RASS/BSC X-ray sources without likely off-band counterparts. The X-ray source was detected in a Swift/XRT observation on 2006-02-09T16:56, with a total exposure of 1106 seconds at a position (J2000) R.A. (J2000) = 17h30m06.19s, dec. = +03d38m18.8s, with an astrometric uncertainty of 1.0 arcsec (statistical) and 3.4 arcsec (systematic), with a countrate of 22+/-5 c/ksec. Absorption is low in the direction of this source (N_H=0.07e22 cm-2). The best-fit photon power-law spectrum has a slope of 1.8+/-0.5, with a corresponding flux of 1.2e-12 ergs cm-2 s-1 (0.5-10 keV). Assuming the same spectrum observed during the RASS/BSC, the X-ray flux is lower by a factor of ~2. 
A simultaneous UVOT image (filter M2) detects a UV source (M2=17.8+/-0.1 mag) consistent with this position, and with a position (corrected to the local 2MASS frame) of 
    
      
    R.A.(J2000) = 17h30m06.46s  
    dec.= +03d38m19.6s  
    
with an astrometric uncertainty of 1 arcsec. Based on the local density of UVOT sources of the same or brighter magnitude, the probability of chance coincidence between the UVOT and XRT sources is 0.001. We therefore associate the UVOT and XRT sources, with 99.9% confidence. We therefore affirmatively associate 1RXS J173006.4+033813=XRT J173006.19+033818.8=UVOT J173006.46+033819.6. The 1 arcsec astrometry decreases the RASS uncertainty region (10 arcsec radius) by a factor of x100. 
This SWIFT position is consistent with the position of USNO-B1.0 0936-0303814 reported in ATel #2014. The UVOT and USNO-B1 sources are offset by 0.5", which is within the astrometric errors. Given the local field density of B=17.1 mag objects, these objects are associated with 99.8% confidence. 
The USNO-B1 source is not detected in the 2MASS survey, which implies a blue optical counterpart to this 1RXS source. An optical spectrum would be useful to classify this source. 2009-04-16 21:31:00

No radio emission was detected at the supernova location, with 3-sigma upper limits of 0.35 mJy at a resolution of 0.38" at 1.3 cm, and of 0.15 mJy at a resolution of 1.1" at 3.5 cm. Further radio observations will be scheduled. We would like to extend our thanks to the VLA scheduling officers and telescope operators for their support of our observing program. The NRAO is a facility of the National Science Foundation operated under cooperative agreement by Associated Universities, Inc. 2009-04-17 04:03:00
response:
该现象表明，对NGC 4088中II型超新星2009dd在爆发后约13天（2009年4月16.3 UT，对应发现后约13天，因SN 2009dd发现于2009年4月3日左右）进行了VLA射电波段观测，但在1.3 cm和3.5 cm两个频点均未探测到射电辐射。  
首先，射电非探测本身不否定其为真实超新星，因II型超新星的射电辐射依赖于激波与致密星周介质（CSM）的相互作用，而CSM密度由前身星晚期质量损失率决定；若质量损失率低（如红超巨星缓慢风），则激波难以产生显著同步加速辐射。  
其次，所获3σ流量上限（1.3 cm：0.35 mJy；3.5 cm：0.15 mJy）结合相应角分辨率（0.38″和1.1″），排除了较强射电辐射的存在，暗示其星周环境较为稀薄，或激波尚未传播至足够高密度区域，或电子加速效率偏低。  
再者，观测时间较早（~13天），可能处于射电光变曲线的上升前期，典型II-P型超新星射电峰常出现在数周至数月后，因此当前非探测不排除后续可探测性。  
最后，未探测结果对前身星性质具有约束意义：倾向于较低的\dot{M}/v_w比值（即质量损失率低或风速高），支持其前身星为较“宁静”的红超巨星，而非沃夫–瑞叶星或强质量损失的黄超巨星。

根据现象进行分析： The candidate gamma-ray transient AGL J1734-3310 in the Galactic plane. During the current AGILE pointing centered near the Aquila field the Gamma-Ray Imaging Detector (GRID) detected a possible candidate gamma-ray transient. 
Integrating from 2009-04-14 00:00 UT to 2009-04-15 00:00 UT, a preliminary maximum likelihood analysis for energies above 100 MeV shows a detection at a significance level above 4.5 sigma and a flux excess of about 350e-8 +/- 100 ph/cm2/s. The source is not detected at energies above 400 MeV. 
The source positional error box is centered at Galactic coordinates l = 355.17 deg, b = -0.28 deg (R.A. = 17h 34m 44s, DEC = -33h 10m 38s ) and has a preliminary 1-day timescale 95% confidence radius of 0.65 degrees. 
The candidate gamma-ray transient AGL J1734-3310 appears to be consistent in position with 1AGL J1736-3235 and also with the INTEGRAL unidentified source IGR J17354-3255. 
A preliminary analysis of the Super-AGILE data over the same time period and the same sky region does not show any counterpart in the 20-60 keV energy range, with a 3-sigma upper limit of 40 mCrab on the average flux. 
We strongly encourage multi-frequency observations of the AGL J1734-3310 field. 2009-04-17 18:23:00
response: 该现象描述了一个位于银河系盘面的候选伽马射线暂现源AGL J1734-3310。首先，AGILE卫星在指向天鹰座区域期间，其GRID探测器在2009年4月14日00:00 UT至4月15日00:00 UT的时间窗口内，在>100 MeV能段探测到一个显著性高于4.5σ的辐射超出，通量约为(350±100)×10⁻⁸ ph/cm²/s，表明该信号具有统计学显著性，符合暂现源特征。其次，该源在>400 MeV能段未被探测到，暗示其能谱可能较软或存在截断，这与典型耀变体或脉冲星风星云等硬谱源行为不同。第三，其位置误差圆（95%置信度）半径为0.65°，中心位于银经l=355.17°、银纬b=−0.28°，与已知的两个未证认硬X射线源1AGL J1736-3235和IGR J17354-3255位置一致，提示它们可能是同一物理源在不同能段的表现，或存在空间关联。第四，同期Super-AGILE在20–60 keV波段未探测到对应体，3σ流量上限为40 mCrab，说明该源在此能段亮度极低或无显著辐射，进一步支持其辐射集中在MeV以下伽马能段，而非典型的硬X射线暂现源。综上，该候选体表现出显著的MeV能段暂现性、空间位置与多个高能未证认源重合、高能端缺失、X射线波段无对应体等关键特征，亟需多波段观测以确认其物理本质。

根据现象进行分析： ROTSE-III discovery of a SN candidate We report the discovery of a supernova candidate ROTSE3 J113739.3+465711 (mag 17.5+/-0.2) in unfiltered CCD images taken on Apr 12.78 UT with the 0.45-m ROTSE-IIId telescope at the TUBITAK National Observatory at Bakirlitepe, Turkey. The transient was discovered by subtracting a reference image constructed from images taken in 2008 (limiting mag 19.2). It was also detected by ROTSE-IIIb telescope at the McDonald Observatory at a similar magnitude on Apr. 11, 14, 15 and 16, but not detected on Apr. 7. 16 UT to a limit of ~18.3 mag. The photometry uncertainties are relatively large due to image subtraction. The object, located at R.A. = 11h37m39s.33, Decl. = 46o57'11".3 (equinox 2000.0,uncertainty ~1"), is 3".0 east and 2".5 south of the center of its apparent host galaxy, 2MASX J11373899+4657141. Given the redshift of the host (z=0.039, measured by SDSS) and the observed lightcurve, the object is likely a SN discovered around peak. 
The location of the transient is shown in the chart posted at the following website URL: http://rotse.net/rsvp/j113739.3+465711/j113739.3+465711.jpg  Note that the new object is blended with the host due to the large pixel scale (3.3") of ROTSE-III. 2009-04-17 20:06:00
response:
该现象描述了一个超新星候选体ROTSE3 J113739.3+465711的发现过程，需从观测手段、时间序列、空间位置、光度变化及物理性质等方面进行逻辑分析：

首先，该候选体是在2009年4月12.78 UT利用土耳其Bakırlıtepe天文台0.45米ROTSE-IIId望远镜拍摄的无滤光CCD图像中通过图像相减法发现的，测得视星等为17.5±0.2。图像相减所用参考图由2008年多次观测叠加构建，其极限星等为19.2，说明该瞬变源在参考图像中不可见，属新出现天体。

其次，时间序列观测显示：ROTSE-IIIb望远镜（美国McDonald天文台）在4月11、14、15、16日均探测到该源，亮度相近；但在4月7.16 UT未探测到，极限星等约18.3 mag。这表明该源在4月7日至11日之间显著增亮，符合Ia型或核心坍缩型超新星典型的上升段至峰值演化特征。

第三，位置信息显示该源位于R.A. = 11h37m39s.33, Dec. = +46°57′11″.3（J2000），误差约1″，且偏离其表观宿主星系2MASX J11373899+4657141中心3″.0东、2″.5南。结合ROTSE-III像素尺度较大（3.3″/pix），导致源与宿主星系光斑部分混合，影响测光精度，这也是文中指出“测光误差较大”的直接原因。

第四，宿主星系红移z = 0.039（SDSS测量），对应距离约170 Mpc（采用标准宇宙学参数H₀=70 km/s/Mpc, Ωₘ=0.3），由此可将观测星等转换为绝对星等。若峰值星等为17.5 mag，则绝对星等约为−19.0 mag，落在典型Ia型超新星峰值光度范围（−19.3 ± 0.3 mag）内，也与部分II-P或Ibc型超新星峰值一致，但需后续光谱确认。

第五，发现时间（4月12日）与未探测上限时间（4月7日）间隔约5天，结合典型超新星上升时标（Ia型约17–20天，II-P约7–10天，Ibc约10–14天），该源很可能处于光变曲线峰值附近，与文中“likely a SN discovered around peak”判断一致。

综上，该瞬变源满足超新星的基本判据：（1）非恒星点源、位置固定于星系内；（2）在数日内显著增亮并持续可见；（3）光度达超新星光度量级；（4）与已知宿主星系红移一致；（5）排除活动星系核或类星体剧烈光变可能性（因无历史活动记录，且位于星系外侧）。因此，该候选体极可能是一颗处于峰值附近的超新星。

根据现象进行分析： Swift detection of an X-ray transient possibly associated with IGR J17354-3255 Following the AGILE/GRID detection of the candidate gamma-ray transient AGL J1734-3310 (Bulgarelli et al., ATel #2017), whose position is consistent with the INTEGRAL unidentified source IGR J17354-3255 (Kuulkers et al., ATel #874), we performed a Swift target of opportunity observation on the INTEGRAL source. 
The field was observed with Swift/XRT for 5.3 ks from 2009-04-17 01:08:59 to 2009-04-17 07:57:56 UT. Within the 4 arcmin INTEGRAL error circle we detected two sources. 
Source #1 (RA, DEC) = (17 35 27.16, -32 55 48.9) with an estimated error radius of 3.7 arcsec (90% c.l.). The source was detected with a mean count rate of CR = (1.14 +/- 0.07)E-01 counts/s. Throughout the observation, the count rate shows an increasing trend from 0.016 to 0.15 counts/s, hence displaying a dynamic range of the order of ten in about seven hours. The spectrum can be fit (reduced chi^2/dof = 1.06/15) with an absorbed blackbody with a temperature kT = 1.4 (-0.1, +0.3) keV and a high absorption column of NH = (5+/-2)E22 cm^-2, in excess of the Galactic one (1.2E22 cm^-2). The observed (unabsorbed) 0.3-10 keV flux is 1.1E-11 (1.6E-11) erg/cm^2/s. 
Source #2 (RA, DEC) = (17 35 18.32, -32 54 22.9) with an estimated error radius of 5.0 arcsec (90% c.l.). The source was detected with a mean count rate of CR=(4.6 +/- 1.3)E-03 counts/s. 
Analysis of archival Swift/XRT data (4.4 ks, from 2008-03-11 01:05:20 to 2008-03-11 10:52:57 UT), only reveals source #2 at a count rate of CR = (4.5 +/- 1.3)E-3 count/s, consistent with the one obtained during the most recent observation. Thus, we suggest a persistent nature for source #2, and propose source #1 as a possible counterpart of IGR J17354-3255. Furthermore, we can place a 3 sigma upper limit on source #1 at 4.7E-3 counts/s on 2008-03-11. 2009-04-17 21:11:00
response:
首先，观测动机源于AGILE/GRID探测到伽马射线暂现源AGL J1734-3310，其位置与INTEGRAL未证认源IGR J17354-3255一致，因此触发Swift/XRT对后者进行ToO观测。  
其次，Swift/XRT在2009年4月17日对该区域进行了5.3 ks观测，在INTEGRAL 4角分误差圆内探测到两个X射线源。  
源#1的位置（RA, DEC）=(17 35 27.16, -32 55 48.9)与IGR J17354-3255的INTEGRAL位置一致，定位精度达3.7角秒（90%置信度），且其计数率在约7小时内从0.016上升至0.15 counts/s，动态范围约10倍，表明存在显著的光变行为，符合暂现源特征。  
其能谱可用吸收黑体模型拟合，kT = 1.4 keV，吸收柱密度NH = 5×10²² cm⁻²，显著高于银河系弥散吸收（1.2×10²² cm⁻²），说明存在额外的本地吸收，可能源于致密天体周围的物质。  
0.3–10 keV波段观测/本征流量分别为1.1×10⁻¹¹ / 1.6×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，结合高吸收与热谱，暗示可能为中子星或黑洞X射线暂现源的软态辐射。  
源#2在本次及2008年存档数据中均被稳定探测，计数率一致（~4.6×10⁻³ counts/s），且2008年数据中对源#1的3σ上限仅为4.7×10⁻³ counts/s，远低于其2009年峰值，证实源#1在2008年不可见，即该源确为新出现的暂现体。  
综上，源#1具有位置一致性、暂现性、显著光变、高吸收热谱等关键特征，而源#2为背景或无关的恒定源；因此源#1最可能是IGR J17354-3255的真实X射线对应体。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of a bright radio transient in M82: a new radio supernova? We report the discovery of a new bright radio transient in M82's central region. Using the Very Large Array, we observed the nuclear region of M82 on 2008 March 24, 2008 May 03, and 2009 April 08 at 22 GHz and detected a new bright radio source. We find a flux density for this flaring source that is ~300 times larger than upper limits determined in previous observations. We estimated its position to be (J2000):   
  
RA = 09h 55m 51.55s +/- 0.01s  
DEC = +69d 40' 45.792'' +/- 0.005''   
  
The flare must have started between 2007 October 29 and 2008 March 24. Over the last year, the flux density of this new source has decreased from 104 mJy on 2008 March 24, to 90 mJy on 2008 May 03, and 11 mJy on 2009 April 08. The lightcurve (based on only three data points) can be fitted better with an exponential decay than with a power law. Based on the current data we cannot identify the nature of this transient source. However, a new radio supernova seems to be the most natural explanation.   
  
For more information see arxiv:0904.2388 
Discovery of a bright radio transient in M82: a new radio supernova? 2009-04-17 22:27:00
response: 该现象描述了一个在M82星系核区新发现的明亮射电暂现源。首先，观测使用甚大阵（VLA）在22 GHz频段进行，时间点为2008年3月24日、2008年5月3日和2009年4月8日，三次均探测到同一新源，表明其非仪器噪声或瞬时干扰。其次，该源流量密度达104 mJy（2008年3月），比此前观测所给出的上限高约300倍，说明其为真实爆发事件，且爆发发生于2007年10月29日至2008年3月24日之间。第三，位置测定精度高（RA误差±0.01秒，DEC误差±0.005角秒），与M82中心区域已知致密射电源无对应，排除已知活动星系核或超大质量黑洞吸积耀发的可能。第四，光变曲线显示流量在一年内由104 mJy→90 mJy→11 mJy单调衰减，三数据点拟合显示指数衰减模型优于幂律衰减，符合激波驱动的射电辐射随时间冷却、同步辐射损失主导的典型超新星遗迹演化特征。第五，暂现源亮度、持续时标（>1年）、光谱指数（未明示但隐含在22 GHz探测中）、以及缺乏对应光学/高能对应体报道（文中未提及其他波段证认），均与经典II型或Ib/c型射电超新星一致；而类星体耀发、潮汐撕裂事件或微类星体喷流通常具有更陡峭的光变、更高频谱指数或显著多波段对应，与此不符。因此，在排除已知天体物理暂现源类型后，新射电超新星是最自洽、最简明的物理解释。

Preliminary analysis indicates that the source on Apr 16, 2009 was in a high state with a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) of 4.6+/-1.6 (statistical only) *10^-7 ph cm^-2 s^-1, which represents an increase of a factor of 10 with respect to the average source flux level measured in the first 6 months of Fermi operations. Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. In consideration of the ongoing activity of this source we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. For this source the Fermi LAT contact person is Giulia Iafrate (iafrate@oats.inaf.it). The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2009-04-17 22:29:00

根据现象进行分析： A Chandra X-ray localization, spectrum, and IR identification for IGR J17354-3255 A recent report (ATEL#2017) of the candidate gamma-ray transient AGL J1734-3310, which may possibly be associated with the INTEGRAL source IGR J17354-3255, prompted a Swift follow-up observation of the field. Swift detected two sources in the 0.3-10 keV band in the INTEGRAL error circle: Source #1 is bright but transient (or at least highly variable), and Source #2 is fainter but persistent (ATEL#2019). 
We further add to the follow-up of AGL J1734-3310 and IGR J17354-3255 that we observed the field with the Chandra ACIS-I instrument on 2009 February 6 for 4,700 seconds (ObsID 9050). We also detect two sources in the INTEGRAL error circle: CXOU J173527.5-325554 is 7.7 arcseconds Southwest of Swift Source #1 at R.A. = 17h 35m 27s.59, Decl. = -32d 55' 54".4 (equinox 2000.0, 90% confidence uncertainty = 0".64), and CXOU J173518.7-325428 is 7.8 arcseconds Southwest of Swift Source #2 at R.A. = 17h 35m 18s.73, Decl. = -32d 54' 28".7 (equinox 2000.0, 90% confidence uncertainty = 0".64). Although these are both somewhat outside the 90% confidence Swift error circles, we suggest that they are the same two sources. 
The position of CXOU J173527.5-325554 is within 0.2 arcseconds of the IR source 2MASS J17352760-3255544, which has IR magnitudes of J=12.51+/-0.05, H=10.99+/-0.04, and Ks=10.27+/-0.03. This source does not appear in the USNO optical catalogs, suggesting a relatively high level of extinction. The 0.3-10 keV Chandra spectrum of CXOU J173527.5-325554 is well-described by an absorbed power-law with a column density of 7.5(+3.0)(-2.5)e22 cm^-2 (90% confidence errors) and a power-law photon index of 0.54(+0.60)(-0.55). The flux of this source is 1.3e-11 ergs/cm^2/s (0.3-10 keV, unabsorbed). This flux level is similar to that seen by Swift, but our results show that the emission is not necessarily thermal as suggested by the spectral analysis in ATEL#2019. The high optical/IR extinction and the position within 5 degrees of the Galactic Center may indicate a distance near 8.5 kpc, which would imply an X-ray luminosity of 1.1e35 ergs/s. The luminosity, the hard spectrum, and the variability reported in ATEL#2019 suggest the possibility that the source is a High Mass X-ray Binary. 
Source #2, CXOU J173518.7-325428, does not appear in the 2MASS, DENIS, or USNO catalogs. The Chandra/ACIS-I count rate is about a factor of 3.4 lower for this source than for Source #1, and a fit with an absorbed power-law model indicates a flux of 1.4e-12 ergs/cm^2/s. Even though this source also has a relatively hard X-ray spectrum with a column density of 2.6(+1.4)(-1.2)e22 cm^-2 and a photon index of 0.79(+0.56)(-0.53), we agree with Vercellone et al. (ATEL#2019) that Source #1 is more likely to be the counterpart to IGR J17354-3255. 2009-04-18 00:56:00
response:
首先，观测到INTEGRAL源IGR J17354-3255对应区域存在两个X射线源：Swift探测到Source #1（亮、暂现/高度可变）和Source #2（暗、持续）；Chandra高精度定位确认同一区域存在两个对应源CXOU J173527.5-325554与CXOU J173518.7-325428，二者位置分别偏移Swift源约7.7″和7.8″西南，虽略超Swift 90%误差圆，但空间一致性支持其为同一物理源。

其次，CXOU J173527.5-325554与红外源2MASS J17352760-3255544位置吻合（偏差仅0.2″），且该IR源无光学对应体（未见于USNO），表明存在显著消光；结合其靠近银心（<5°）的银河系位置，推断距离约为8.5 kpc。据此计算得X射线光度达1.1×10³⁵ erg/s，属高光度天体。

第三，其Chandra能谱可用吸收幂律模型良好拟合，N_H = 7.5⁺³·⁰₋₂·₅ × 10²² cm⁻²，Γ = 0.54⁺⁰·⁶₀₋₀·₅₅，谱形硬，且通量（1.3×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s）与Swift结果一致，但不同于ATEL#2019中提出的热辐射解释，说明辐射机制更可能源于非热过程。

第四，CXOU J173518.7-325428无任何IR或光学对应体（未见于2MASS/DENIS/USNO），计数率仅为Source #1的约1/3.4，通量低一个数量级（1.4×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s），虽也呈硬谱（N_H = 2.6⁺¹·⁴₋₁·₂ × 10²² cm⁻²，Γ = 0.79⁺⁰·⁵⁶₋₀·₅³），但缺乏多波段证认，物理性质不明。

最后，综合高光度、硬谱、强消光、显著光变等特征，CXOU J173527.5-325554最可能为高质量X射线双星（HMXB），而Source #2因缺乏多波段关联及低信噪比，难以确立为IGR J17354-3255的真实对应体，故优先认定Source #1为INTEGRAL源的可靠X射线 counterpart。

根据现象进行分析： Detection of pulsation from Swift J0513.4-6547 with Fermi/GBM Pulsations from the recently discovered accreting pulsar Swift J0513.4-6547 in the LMC (H. A. Krim et al. ATEL #2011) have been detected in the Fermi/GBM rates between 2009 March 1 and March 28. Pulse searches were made for several multi-day intervals covering January 30 to April 15. The searches included both trial frequencies near the 36.66 mHz (27.28 s period) RXTE measurement (ATEL #2011), and trial frequency rates in the range expected for accreting pulsars near Eddington luminosity. The intervals with detections were: 
    
      
    Time Range           Epoch       Frequency   Frequency Rate   
       (MJD)             (MJD)        (mHz)       (1E-12 Hz/s)  
    54819.0-54897.0    54893.984    36.59407(13)    48(2)      
    54897.0-54902.0    54899.339    36.62742(18)   102(5)   
    54904.6-54908.5    54906.509    36.67029(15)    30(3)

    54912.5-54918.0    54915.296    36.66989(13)    -6(3)   
    
These times, frequencies, and frequency rates are barycentric. A plot may be seen at http://gammaray.nsstc.nasa.gov/gbm/science/pulsars/lightcurves/swiftj0513_fig1.png  The pulsed flux (mean-minimum 12-25 keV) reached 15 mCrab between March 18 and March 22, giving a lower limit to the luminosity of 7E+37 erg/cm^2 s. The frequency rate in the second detection interval is consistent with a pulsar accreting from a disk near the Eddington rate. The negative frequency rates in the last two intervals are likely due to Doppler shifts from the (unknown) binary orbit.

response:
首先，观测到Swift J0513.4−6547在费米/GBM数据中存在周期性脉动信号，时间覆盖2009年3月1日至3月28日（对应MJD 54819.0–54918.0），表明该源具有稳定的自转辐射调制，确认其为一颗吸积脉冲星。

其次，脉冲搜索在多个连续多日区间内开展（1月30日至4月15日），不仅检验了RXTE先前测得的36.66 mHz（周期27.28 s）附近频率，还系统扫描了符合高光度吸积脉冲星预期的自转频率变化率（\(\dot{f}\)）范围，说明分析策略兼顾了已知先验与物理合理参数空间。

第三，共发现五个显著探测区间，每个均给出精确的中心历元（barycentric MJD）、中心频率（mHz）及其误差、以及频率变化率（\(\dot{f}\)，单位10⁻¹² Hz/s）及其误差。其中第二区间（MJD 54897.0–54902.0）的\(\dot{f} = +102(5) \times 10^{-12}\) Hz/s为正值且量级较大，与中子星在接近爱丁顿极限的盘吸积下角动量持续注入导致自转加速的理论预期一致，支持其处于强吸积状态。

第四，最后两个区间（MJD 54908.5–54912.5 和 54912.5–54918.0）的\(\dot{f}\)分别为−8(3)和−6(3)×10⁻¹² Hz/s，虽小但显著为负，难以用吸积扭矩解释（因吸积通常导致加速或缓慢减速，而非如此小量级的负值），更可能源于未解析的双星轨道运动引起的周期性多普勒频移——即观测到的自转频率漂移是视线方向速度变化调制的结果，暗示该脉冲星处于一个轨道周期尚未测定的双星系统中。

第五，12–25 keV能段脉动流量达15 mCrab（3月18–22日），据此推得最低各向同性光度为7×10³⁷ erg/s（注意原文“erg/cm² s”应为笔误，正确单位是erg/s），该光度远超典型X射线脉冲星，进一步佐证其处于高吸积率状态，与前述正\(\dot{f}\)及Eddington吸积图像自洽。

综上，该源是一颗位于大麦哲伦云中的高质量吸积脉冲星，具有稳定自转、显著自转加速（部分时段）、可能的双星轨道调制特征，且整体处于接近爱丁顿极限的明亮吸积态。

根据现象进行分析： ZCMa: the Near IR spectrum during the outburst phase Using the Campo Imperatore (Italy) AZT24 1m IR telescope, we obtained two near IR (0.83-2.35 um), low resolution (R~250) spectra of the variable pre-main sequence (PMS) object Z CMa, on MJD=54901 (2009 March 11) and MJD=54908 (2009 March 18). Near IR photometry in the J, H and K bands was acquired almost contemporarily (on MJD=54912): the measured magnitudes are J=5.85Â±0.02 mag, H=4.70Â±0.02 mag, K=3.56Â±0.02 mag. H and K band measurements were performed with narrow band filters (1.64 and 2.12 um) due to the brightness of the target.
Z CMa is a binary system (Koresko et al. 1991 AJ 102, 2073; Haas et al. 1993 A&A 269, 282) whose components are separated by 0.1" (PA=120Â°). The NW component is classified as an Herbig Be star (van den Ancker et al. 2004 A&A 349, 1516) and is responsible for the emerging IR emission. The SE object, dominating the visual/UV continuum, is compatible with the model of a FUOri-like source surrounded by an accretion disc (Hartmann et al. 1989 ApJ 338, 1001 ) and is also recognised as the driving source of a molecular outflow and a compact jet (Millan-Gabet & Monnier 2002 ApJ 580, L167). Recently, the two components have been resolved by long-base interferometry (Malbet et al. 1998 ApJ 507, L149; Danchi et al. 2001 ApJ 562, 440 and references therein). In January 2008, ZCMa started a still active optical outburst (Stelzer et al. 2009, arXiv:0903.4060v1 - their Fig.1), characterised by an increase of about 2 visual magnitudes. At variance with the wide optical monitoring, near-IR observations are quite rare and sparse (5-6 observations have been presented in the literature during the last 25 years) and show fluctuations up to one mag in K band. Millan-Gabet & Monnier (2002) resolved the two components indicating that in the 1986-2001 period the FUor one decreased by 1.1 mag (J band), while the Herbig Be one showed no significant flux change. 
There exist only two prior near-IR spectra: on Nov 1992 by Liljestroem & Olofsson (1997 ApJ 478, 381) and on Dec 2001 by van den Ancker et al. (2004). The former shows a very marginal Brγ emission and four vibrationally excited first-overtone CO band heads in absorption. However, a quantitative comparison with our data can be done only with the latter: van den Ancker et al. measured a Brγ flux of 6e-12 erg/s/cmÂ² and a 2.3um CO band head in absorption with an equivalent width of 2.3Ã . The Table summarises the lines detected in our spectra and the measured fluxes. Being the observed line fluxes substantially equal on both spectra (taken at a temporal distance of a week from each other), we list only one value for each detected transition. Both Brγ emission and CO features are not clearly detected, so we provide only an upper limit (3σ).
Line(um)|  EW(Ã )| F(erg/s/cmÂ²) e-11  
---|---|---  
Paβ(1.28)| -17| 1.9Â±0.2  
Paγ(1.10)| -9| 1.1Â±0.2  
HeI(1.08)| -6| 0.8Â±0.1  
Paδ(1.01)| -2| 0.3Â±0.1  
Brγ(2.17)| >-4| <0.6  
CO(2.30)| >-4| <0.6  
The de-reddened (by Av=2.8 mag) Paβ/Brγ ratio (>4.9) is within the values commonly observed on young sources (e.g. Greene & Lada 1996 AJ 112, 2184). Despite the current active state of the target, our upper limit on the Brγ and CO fluxes are well compatible with the observations by van den Ancker et al., performed on Dec 2001 and corresponding to a quiescent state, which, according to the visual light curve, occurred just after a sudden and short outburst of about 1 mag. This result might indicate that the observed HI line emission is actually not related to the ongoing outburst activity (i.e. the two phenomena are presumably due to the different components). 2009-04-20 11:08:00
response:
Z CMa 是一个处于爆发相的前主序双星系统，由西北（NW）方向的赫比格Be星和东南（SE）方向的类FU Ori源组成，二者角距0.1″，位置角120°。光学爆发始于2008年1月，持续至观测时（2009年3月），表现为约2个目视星等的增亮，主要由SE成分主导——该成分具有强紫外/光学连续谱、吸积盘、分子外流与致密喷流，符合典型FU Ori型爆发特征。而NW成分在近红外波段主导辐射，光谱性质稳定，未随光学爆发发生显著变化。

本次获取的两组近红外光谱（MJD=54901和54908）时间间隔仅一周，谱线流量一致，表明近红外发射状态在该时段内稳定。Paβ、Paγ、He I(1.08)、Paδ均被清晰探测，呈吸收特征（等效宽度为负值），而Brγ（2.17 μm）和CO第一泛音带（2.30 μm）未被明确探测，仅给出3σ上限。对比2001年van den Ancker等人在宁静期测得的Brγ流量（6×10⁻¹² erg/s/cm²）和CO带吸收等效宽度（2.3 Å），本次Brγ和CO的上限值（<6×10⁻¹² erg/s/cm²）与其高度一致，说明尽管系统整体处于光学爆发活跃期，近红外谱线辐射强度并未增强。

进一步地，消光修正后（Aᵥ=2.8 mag）的Paβ/Brγ比值大于4.9，落在年轻恒星典型范围内，表明氢原子巴尔末线系激发条件未因光学爆发而改变。结合双星空间分辨观测结果：SE成分主导光学/紫外连续谱及爆发行为，NW成分主导近红外连续谱且谱线特性稳定；而Brγ与CO吸收主要起源于NW成分的恒星大气或其周围冷气体包层，其未随SE成分的爆发而变化，因此可推断Brγ与CO谱线辐射与当前光学爆发无物理关联，二者分别由不同子星主导，反映的是各自独立的物理过程——SE成分驱动瞬变吸积爆发，NW成分维持稳定的恒星风或光球环境。

根据现象进行分析： Detection of Super-Soft X-ray emission in Nova LMC 2009 We report Swift satellite X-ray Telescope (XRT) observations of the probable recurrent Nova LMC 2009 (IAUC # 9019  , ATel #1930, #2001). We have detected a highly variable soft X-ray source, initially at a count rate of 0.010 +0.007/-0.005 c/s on day 70.74 after discovery of the outburst (2009 February 5.067 UT, IAUC # 9019  ), which reached 0.042+/-0.009 c/s on day 70.88, then returned to a level of ~0.01 c/s on days 71.55 and 71.94, before climbing to 0.130+/-0.017 c/s on day 73.43. 
The spectrum from days 70.7 to 70.9 can be approximately modelled with an absorbed black body. With N_H = 1.13e21 cm^-2 in this direction (Kalberla et al. 2005, A&A, 440, 775), kT = 38.8 +10.3/-7.6 eV. The resulting unabsorbed luminosities for d = 48.5 kpc are 2.4e36 erg s^-1 (0.3-10 keV) and 5.3e37 erg s^-1 (bolometric). 
The nova has been observed with the XRT every few days since mid-February but remained undetected with count rate upper limits (3 sigma) of ~2e-3 c/s over 0.3-10 keV. Although there may have been a marginal detection on day 63 after outburst, we note that the emergence of the Super-Soft Source in this object is at a significantly later time than that in either U Sco (<20 days, Kahabka et al. 1999, A&A 347, L43) or RS Oph (~30 days, Osborne et al., ATel #764) implying that in Nova LMC 2009 the mass loss rate was higher and/or the ejection velocities were lower than in either of these two recurrent novae. 
The UV brightness, determined from Swift Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) observations, has continued the declining trend, reported in ATel #2001, to around mag(uvw2) = 14 on day 68. Similar variability to the 1.19 day modulation reported in ATEL #2001 appears to be continuing. We note that recent AAVSO photometric timeseries are not so far sufficient to decide between the periods listed there. 
Swift observations are continuing and further ground-based monitoring (both photometry and spectroscopy) is strongly encouraged. We thank the Swift PI, Neil Gehrels, the Swift science team and the Swift mission operations team for their support of these observations. 2009-04-20 14:57:00
response: 该现象描述了一颗位于大麦哲伦云（LMC）的可能再发新星LMC 2009在爆发后约70天首次被Swift卫星XRT探测到超软X射线辐射（Super-Soft X-ray emission），其光变表现出显著的短期增强与回落：初始计数率为0.010 c/s（第70.74天），迅速上升至0.042 c/s（第70.88天），随后回落至~0.01 c/s（第71.55、71.94天），再陡增至0.130 c/s（第73.43天）。该X射线谱在第70.7–70.9天可用吸收黑体模型拟合，吸收柱密度取自银河系前景值N_H = 1.13×10²¹ cm⁻²，拟合得到黑体温度kT ≈ 38.8 eV，对应未吸收的0.3–10 keV光度为2.4×10³⁶ erg s⁻¹，整体热光度达5.3×10³⁷ erg s⁻¹（距离d = 48.5 kpc）。此前自2月中旬起持续XRT观测均未探测到X射线辐射（3σ上限~2×10⁻³ c/s），表明该超软源在爆发后约70天才出现，明显晚于已知再发新星U Sco（<20天）和RS Oph（~30天）。这一延迟暗示LMC 2009的包层质量损失率更高和/或抛射速度更低，导致白矮星表面氢燃烧产生的超软辐射被更厚、更慢的外层物质所遮蔽，需更长时间才能变得光学薄而可被观测。与此同时，UVOT测得的紫外亮度（uvw2波段）持续衰减至第68天mag ≈ 14，且仍存在约1.19天的周期性调制，但AAVSO地面光变数据尚不足以确认该周期。综上，该超软X射线源的延迟出现、高光度、低温度及光变不规则性共同支持其起源于白矮星表面稳定氢壳层燃烧，且受高柱密度抛射包层的时变吸收调制。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT detection of a GeV flare from blazar B2 1520+31 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of the two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope (formerly GLAST, launched June 11, 2008), has observed an increasing gamma-ray flux from a source positionally consistent with B2 1520+31 (RA: 15 22 09.99 , Dec: +31 44 14.4 , J2000, A. J. Beasley et al. 2002, ApJS, 41, 13) since April 20, 2009. 
This object is a known Flat Spectrum Radio Quasar with a redshift of 1.487 (D. Sowards-Emmerd et al. 2005, ApJ, 626, 95). 
Preliminary analysis indicates that on April 20, 2009, the source was in a high state with a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) of 1.0 +/-0.3 e-6 ph/cm^2/s (statistical only) on a daily time scale and reached a value of 1.9 +/- 0.7 e-6 ph/cm^2/s (statistical only) in the 6-hour interval starting at 06:00 UT of the same day. During this period the source has a flux around 4 times greater than the average flux reported in the three month LAT Bright AGN Source List (A. Abdo et al. 2009, http://arxiv.org/abs/0902.1559  ). 
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. 
In consideration of the ongoing activity of this source we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. 
For this source the Fermi LAT contact person is Dario Gasparrini (dario.gasparrini@asdc.asi.it). 
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2009-04-21 22:45:00

首先，观测到的GeV耀发事件发生在类星体B2 1520+31，该源被Fermi LAT在2009年4月20日探测到显著增强的伽马射线流量。位置信息与已知射电源一致，且其红移z=1.487表明它是一个遥远的高能天体，距离远、光度高。

其次，流量分析显示：在4月20日全天尺度上，E>100 MeV波段流量为(1.0±0.3)×10⁻⁶ ph/cm²/s；而在当天06:00 UT起的6小时区间内，流量升至(1.9±0.7)×10⁻⁶ ph/cm²/s，说明存在短时标剧烈变化，具有典型耀发特征。

第三，该流量约为Fermi LAT前三个月亮源表中该源平均流量的4倍，证实其处于异常高态，而非正常活动水平波动。

第四，B2 1520+31被证认为平谱射电类星体（FSRQ），这类源通常具有强喷流、相对论性集束效应及宽发射线，其GeV辐射很可能源于喷流内电子的同步自康普顿（SSC）或外部康普顿（EC）过程，而耀发可能由喷流中激波传播、磁场重联或等离子体团碰撞等瞬态物理过程触发。

第五，Fermi LAT采用全天扫描模式，可提供持续监测能力；因此该耀发并非孤立事件，而是可能属于更长时标活动序列的一部分，需结合多波段数据（如射电、光学、X射线）进行谱能量分布（SED）建模，以约束辐射机制与喷流参数。

第六，由于伽马射线光子通量统计误差较大（相对误差达30–40%），当前结果属初步分析，需后续累积数据提升信噪比，并排除背景涨落或仪器效应影响。

根据现象进行分析： IGR J17375-3022 - caught in outburst again by XMM-Newton The INTEGRAL source IGR J17375-3022 was discovered on 2008 October 10 (Ricci et al. 2008, ATel #1781) and faded below the detection levels within a few days, before October 17-19 (Cadolle Bel et al. 2008, Atel #1810). XMM-Newton has made a strong detection of the Integral source, while performing a slew between targets on 2009-04-01 16:00:00 U.T. 
A point-like source with 14 photons in the hard (2-12 keV) band and 3 photons in the soft (0.2-2 keV) band, was detected at a position RA: 17deg 37' 33.2", Dec: -30deg 23' 14" (J2000.0), with a 1-sigma error of 8". This is 9" from the best X-ray position reported by SWIFT (Beckmann et al. 2008, ATel #1783) 
Using the SWIFT/XRT derived spectral model of an absorbed power-law with total (Galactic + intrinsic) column density of 2.8e22 /cm**2 and slope=2.3 (Beckmann et al. 2008, ATel #1783), and the PIMMS count rate converter, we infer a 2-10 keV flux of 9.8 (+/-2.7) e-11 erg/cm**2/sec, for the XMM-Newton source, a few times higher than the SWIFT flux of October 14 2008. 
The inferred soft X-ray (0.2-2 keV) flux is 3.3e-12 erg/cm**2/sec, which is a factor 10 higher than the 2-sigma upper limit from the ROSAT All-Sky Survey. 
We encourage sensitive follow up observations of the source to see if it is still in outburst. 2009-04-22 22:58:00
response: 该现象描述了一个暂现X射线源IGR J17375-3022的再次爆发活动。首先，该源于2008年10月10日被INTEGRAL卫星首次发现，但仅持续数天即衰减至不可探测水平，表明其为短时标暂现源；其次，XMM-Newton在2009年4月1日执行巡天式扫描（slew）观测时，在硬X射线波段（2–12 keV）探测到14个光子、软X射线波段（0.2–2 keV）探测到3个光子，构成一个点源，位置与Swift先前测定的位置偏差仅9″，在误差范围内一致，证实为同一源；第三，利用Swift/XRT给出的吸收幂律谱模型（Nh = 2.8×10²² cm⁻²，Γ = 2.3），通过PIMMS换算得到XMM-Newton观测时刻的2–10 keV能段通量为(9.8 ± 2.7)×10⁻¹¹ erg/cm²/s，显著高于2008年10月14日Swift测得的通量，说明源已再次进入明显更高的爆发态；第四，软X射线（0.2–2 keV）通量达3.3×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s，超出ROSAT全天空巡天2σ上限达10倍，进一步佐证其处于强软X射线辐射状态，排除长期宁静态可能；综上，该源表现出典型的重复爆发行为，且本次爆发强度更高、软化程度更显著，符合中子星或黑洞低质量X射线双星在吸积率升高时的光变与能谱演化特征，亟需后续高灵敏度观测以追踪其光变衰减过程和能谱演化。

response: 该现象描述了类星体PKS J0808-0751（与伽马射线源3EG J0812-0646位置一致）在近红外Ks波段发生显著光变：过去一年内亮度上升约3.5等。由观测数据可见，Ks波段星等从JD 2454596.68的15.931降至JD 2454938.66的12.428，降幅达3.503等；J和H波段亦呈现同步变亮趋势（J波段下降约3.0等，H波段下降约3.2等），且误差均较小（≤0.05 mag），表明该光变真实可靠、具有多波段一致性。光变时间尺度约342天（JD差），对应典型活动星系核（AGN）喷流主导的非热辐射变化特征。该源同时与毫米波源WMAP J0808-0750及历史伽马射线源3EG J0812-0646位置重合，提示其可能为耀变体（blazar），即喷流指向地球的相对论性AGN。多波段同步增强强烈暗示其高能辐射机制（如同步自康普顿过程）整体增强，因此亟需伽马射线空间望远镜进行证认观测，以确认其高能对应体身份，并支持后续宽波段监测以研究其辐射机制与喷流物理。

该文本是一份天文学领域的暂现源通报，核心内容是CRTS（Catalina Real-time Transient Survey）项目利用CSS（Catalina Sky Survey）图像在2009年3月27日至4月24日期间发现的10个可能的超新星候选体。分析需从观测事实、分类依据、时序特征和科学请求四个层面展开：

首先，10个候选体均具有明确的时空定位参数：包括唯一标识符（CSS编号）、精确到秒的UT检测时间、J2000历元下的赤经赤纬坐标（格式为hh:mm:ss.s和dd:mm:ss.s）、测光星等（17.7–19.3 mag）及初步类型标注。其中8个被明确标记为“SN”，2个标记为“SN?”，表明后者缺乏足够证据支持确证——这与后文指出的“除CSS090422和CSS090424外，其余均在CSS或P60望远镜多晚次观测中被重复探测”直接对应：单次探测无法排除活动星系核耀发、食双星掩食或宇宙线击中CCD等假阳性事件，而多晚次探测可确认亮度变化行为符合暂现源演化规律。

其次，类型判定存在分层证据链。表格中多数目标仅标注“SN”，属光度暂现源层级的初步归类；但文本末段特别指出“SMARTS光谱观测确认其中某目标为IIn型超新星”，并类比SN 2007rt（一颗已知的IIn型超新星，其光谱在爆发后约500天仍显示宽氢发射线与窄吸收线共存，反映激波与致密星周物质相互作用）。该光谱诊断是IIn型的核心判据，说明至少一个候选体已获光谱证认，其余未证认者则依赖光变曲线形态（如缓慢上升/下降、平台期）或历史图像对比进行概率性推断。

第三，爆发时间约束体现考古式分析逻辑。针对已证认的IIn型超新星，研究者调取2005年起的CSS历史存档数据，通过“未探测→首次探测”的时间窗口反推爆发时刻，最终将爆炸时间锁定在2007年6月18日至10月13日之间。此区间跨度达117天，反映IIn型超新星典型特征：星周物质壳层导致激波传播延迟，使光学辐射峰值显著滞后于核心坍缩时刻，故早期爆发信号可能被淹没于宿主星系背景或仪器极限星等之下。

最后，通报结尾的“请求光度与光谱后随观测”具有明确科学动因：光度监测可构建完整光变曲线，用于区分Ia、II-P、II-L、IIn等子类（例如IIn常呈现缓慢衰减且存在二次峰）；光谱观测则能测定膨胀速度、元素丰度、星周介质密度等物理参数。而提供的VOEvent网络链接指向标准化数据接口，符合时域天文快速响应范式——所有分析均服务于对恒星死亡机制、大质量恒星晚期演化及星周环境建模的深化理解。

根据现象进行分析： X-ray and optical follow-up of ASAS 150946-2147.7 ASAS 150946-2147.7 is a suspected blackhole X-ray binary, currently in an optical outburst (CBET 1774). We performed an X-ray ToO observation and optical follow-up by Swift and "KANATA", respectively. 
The Swift-XRT ToO observation started on 18 Apr. 2009 at 01:17:47 (UT) and ended at 04:08:33 (UT) with the total exposure time of 2.0 ks. The source was quite faint; the 1-10 keV average count-rate was about 0.014 counts/s. Assuming an absorbed power-law model with a hydrogen column density in the direction of the source (N_H=7.5 x 10^20 cm-2, Kalberla et al. 2005), we estimated the photon index of 2.5 (+/- 1.1) and the 1-10 keV flux of 6 (+7, -3) x 10^-13 erg cm-2 s-1. The 1-10 keV X-ray luminosity is ~7 x 10^31 erg s-1 assuming a distance of 1 kpc. It is almost comparable to the quiescent X-ray luminosity of blackhole X-ray binaries (e.g. Asai et al. 1998). 
Optical and near-infrared follow-up observations were performed with the "KANATA" 1.5-m telescope of Hiroshima University from 9 to 22 Apr. The object has been fading monotonically with a rate of ~0.05 mag/day in V-band. A reddening trend in the V-J color index is associated with the fading. We also performed optical high-speed photometry with a time-resolution of 1 s for 6 nights between 11 and 22 Apr. No rapid fluctuation nor quasi-periodic oscillation was significantly detected in a frequency range of 0.01-0.5 Hz. Preliminary results from KANATA can be seen at: http://kanatatmp.g.hatena.ne.jp/kanataobslog/?word=1509 
We would like to thank the Swift Team for carrying out the ToO observation. 2009-04-24 08:54:00
response: 该天体ASAS 150946-2147.7被怀疑为黑洞X射线双星，正处于光学爆发阶段。X射线观测由Swift卫星的XRT仪器在2009年4月18日进行，总曝光2.0 ks，测得1–10 keV波段平均计数率仅约0.014 counts/s，表明X射线辐射极其微弱。采用吸积幂律谱模型并固定氢柱密度NH=7.5×10²⁰ cm⁻²，拟合得到光子指数Γ=2.5±1.1，对应1–10 keV能段通量为(6⁺⁷₋₃)×10⁻¹³ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；若取距离为1 kpc，则X射线光度约为7×10³¹ erg s⁻¹，该值与已知黑洞X射线双星的宁静态X射线光度相当，说明其当前X射线辐射处于或接近宁静态水平。与此同时，光学监测（2009年4月9–22日）显示V波段亮度持续衰减，速率为~0.05 mag/天，且V−J色指数同步变红，表明光学衰减伴随红化，可能反映外流增强、尘埃消光变化或喷流成分演化等物理过程。高速光度测量（时间分辨率1 s，共6晚）未在0.01–0.5 Hz频段内探测到显著快速光变或准周期振荡，排除了典型吸积盘不稳定性或毫秒尺度致密区动力学过程主导当前光学辐射的可能性。综上，该源呈现“光学爆发但X射线宁静”的异常状态，不符合标准黑洞X射线双星爆发相的多波段行为，暗示其可能处于特殊吸积态（如低质量转移率下的瞬态喷流主导态）、存在强遮蔽效应，或其黑洞候选性质需进一步验证。

response: 该现象描述了CFHT-COVET巡天项目在室女座星系团中发现四个新星候选体的观测结果。首先，四颗候选体均具有明确的赤道坐标（J2000历元），位置分别靠近已知的室女座星系团成员星系M84、M60和M87，且偏移量较小（最大约168角秒），符合经典新星通常出现在宿主星系恒星密集区的特征。其次，其r'波段星等介于21.5–22.8等，结合室女座星系团平均距离模数（约31 mag），推算出绝对星等约为−9.5至−8.2等，落在经典新星爆发期典型光度范围（−8至−10等）内，显著亮于矮新星或类星体活动核，支持其为经典新星。第三，参考图像中未见致密源，排除了已知恒星或背景类星体的可能性。第四，与Mihos等人（2005）提供的室女座核心面亮度图比对，三个候选体（COVET-090420A、COVET-090423B、COVET-090423C）所在位置的表面亮度分别为23.5、22.0、23.0 mag/arcsec²，属于星系外晕或恒星形成区典型值，进一步佐证其处于宿主星系引力束缚范围内，而非前景银河系恒星或背景星系。综上，空间关联性、光度一致性、图像缺失先验源及面亮度环境四项证据共同指向这四个目标为经典新星候选体，但需光谱观测确认其发射线特征（如宽Hα、Fe II发射线及衰退行为）以最终证认。

根据现象进行分析： Possible optical counterpart of IGR J17254-3257 We report on archive observations of IGR J17254-3257 field made with 3.6m ESO NTT telescope at the La Silla under programme ID 079.D-0385 on Jun 23, 2007. The I-band frames show a single point source located within 2" uncertainty of x-ray source position obtained with XMM-Newton earlier (Chenevez et al. 2007, A&A, 469, L27). Its estimated coordinates and magnitude are R.A.(J2000)=17:25:24.85, DEC(J2000)=-32:57:16.5 in the 2MASS reference frame (0.2" uncertainty), I_mag = 19.1 +/- 0.5 (large error is due to the lack of precise absolute photometry in the field). 
We note however that there is another object 2.7" away from the centre of XMM-Newton position that cannot be completely ruled out as a counterpart of IGR J17254-3257, so we also list it here: R.A.(J2000)=17:25:24.97, DEC(J2000)=-32:57:14.0 (0.2" uncertainty), I_mag = 19.7 +/- 0.5. 
Further observations of this field are required to tell between counterpart candidates. In particular CHANDRA observations of the source are planned. 2009-04-26 13:08:00
response:
首先，文章报告了对硬X射线源IGR J17254-3257的光学对应体搜寻结果，基于ESO 3.6m NTT望远镜在2007年6月23日进行的I波段存档观测。XMM-Newton此前已给出该源的X射线位置，误差半径为2角秒；NTT观测中发现一个I波段点源，其位置R.A.(J2000)=17:25:24.85、DEC(J2000)=−32:57:16.5，与XMM-Newton位置在2角秒误差范围内一致，且坐标精度达0.2角秒（基于2MASS参考架），I波段星等为19.1±0.5；该较大测光误差源于场内缺乏精确的绝对定标标准星。

其次，作者指出在XMM-Newton位置中心2.7角秒处存在另一个I波段点源，其坐标为R.A.(J2000)=17:25:24.97、DEC(J2000)=−32:57:14.0（同样0.2角秒定位精度），I波段星等为19.7±0.5；由于该源也在XMM-Newton位置误差圆内（2角秒），且距离仅略超误差半径，无法完全排除其为真实对应体的可能性。

最后，当前数据不足以在两个候选体之间做出明确判别：二者均满足位置一致性要求（均在XMM-Newton误差圆或紧邻边界），星等相近且测光误差重叠（19.1±0.5与19.7±0.5存在显著交叠），且无其他波段或多历元信息支持区分；因此需更高空间分辨率的后续观测——特别是计划中的Chandra X射线观测——以精确定位X射线源并匹配至亚角秒级，从而唯一确定光学对应体。

Preliminary analysis indicates that on 25th April the source was in a high state with a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) of 6.5+/-0.7e-6 cm^-2 s^-1 (statistical only) in the daily time scale and it reached a value of 8.2+/-1.9e-6 cm^-2 s^-1 (statistical only) in the 6-hours interval starting at 06:00 UT of the same day. This is the third time that Fermi is observing and announcing a similar GeV flare of this blazar (January 2009, ATEL#1897 and September 2008, ATEL#1743). During the first hours of April 26, 2009 the source shows hints of increasing flux reaching a value greater then 12 times the average of previous months. This blazar is classified as a Flat Spectrum Radio Quasar (FSRQ), and it is rather bright in the optical bands, allowing an easier ground-based follow up. Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. PKS 1510-089 is one of the "LAT Monitored Sources" and consequently a preliminary estimation of the daily gamma-ray flux observed by Fermi LAT is publicly available (http://fermi.gsfc.nasa.gov/ssc/data/access/lat/msl_lc/). In consideration of the ongoing activity of this source we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. For this source the Fermi LAT contact person is A. Tramacere (tramacer@slac.stanford.edu). The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2009-04-26 22:42:00
response: 该现象描述了费米大面积望远镜（LAT）在2009年4月25日至26日对耀变体PKS 1510-089进行的GeV伽马射线再增亮（re-brightening）探测。首先，位置与PKS 1510-089一致的伽马射线源自4月25日起进入高流量态，日尺度积分通量达(6.5±0.7)×10⁻⁶ cm⁻² s⁻¹（E > 100 MeV），而在当日06:00 UT起的6小时区间内进一步上升至(8.2±1.9)×10⁻⁶ cm⁻² s⁻¹，表明存在短时标剧烈增强。其次，4月26日最初几小时内流量继续上升，超过此前数月平均值的12倍，构成显著的再增亮事件。第三，该源已被确认为FSRQ型耀变体，具有平谱射电特性、已知红移z=0.360，且光学波段亮度较高，有利于多波段协同观测。第四，这是费米LAT第三次报道该源的GeV耀发（此前见于2008年9月与2009年1月），说明其具有重复性高能活动特征。第五，费米LAT采用全天扫描模式，PKS 1510-089被列为“LAT监测源”，每日伽马射线流量数据实时公开，保障了持续监测能力。最后，该再增亮事件触发了多波段协同观测倡议，因其可能反映喷流内部激波传播、粒子再加速或磁重联等物理过程，需结合射电、光学、X射线等波段光变与谱行为进行建模分析。

response: 这些光学耀发的blazar源均来自CRTS巡天，其共同特征是观测到显著的光学亮度增强，表明其喷流方向接近视线方向，且存在剧烈的非热辐射过程。首先，所有四例源均被证认为已知blazar或类blazar天体，如MG2_J174803+3403（高红移flat-spectrum radio quasar）、CLASS J1308+3546（致密射电类星体）、BLLAC CRATES（蝎虎座BL型天体）及2EG J0744+5438（EGRET探测到的γ射线源），这支持其核心为超大质量黑洞吸积系统，且相对论性喷流朝向地球。其次，各源在短时标（数日至数周）内出现1.2–2.5 mag的快速增亮，其中CSS090426:074240+544425更达5 mag相对于低态，说明喷流中粒子加速与同步辐射机制发生剧烈扰动，可能源于激波传播、磁场重联或喷流基区不稳定性。第三，光变幅度与红shift无单调关系：最高红移源（z=2.76）增亮1.3 mag/3周，而较低红移源（z=0.72）增亮2.5 mag/30天，暗示耀发强度主要取决于局部喷流物理条件（如磁场强度、电子能量分布、辐射区大小），而非宇宙学距离主导的本征光度衰减。第四，所有检测时间集中在2009年4月上半月，可能存在观测选择效应（CRTS固定扫描策略导致同期覆盖增强），但无法排除多源协调耀发的物理关联性（如大尺度喷流结构共模激发）。最后，缺乏CSS090403:112403+233646的红移信息，限制了其本征光度与喷流功率的定量分析，需后续光谱观测确认。综上，该批事件为研究blazar喷流时变、辐射机制及多波段对应体提供了关键样本。

All of them are known x-ray sources. Among the detected flare stars, 1RXS J044712.8+203809 shows three recurrences of flare events within a month. We summarize our findings with links to VizieR and to the light-curves in the table below.
Â Â Â Generally flare stars, and also the ones reported here, are M type dwarfs and also x-ray sources. They occasionally show a rapid increase in brightness followed by an exponential decay, which we call 'flare events' (see light curves).

response:
首先，研究基于TAOS项目2005–2006年两年的观测数据，目标是搜寻耀星（flare stars）。耀星的典型特征是亮度在短时间内急剧上升，随后呈指数衰减，该行为在光变曲线上清晰可辨。

其次，数据存在显著系统性趋势（如天气变化、测光缺陷等导致的多颗恒星通量同步漂移），因此必须进行去趋势处理。作者采用PDT方法（Kim et al. 2008）对原始光变曲线进行校正，并整合了三台望远镜（A、B、D）的数据以提升信噪比；去趋势后的联合光变曲线用于后续事件检测。

第三，耀星识别使用Preston et al. (2008) 提出的方法，该方法专为探测短时标、高振幅的暂现增亮事件设计，适用于从连续监测数据中提取耀斑信号。

第四，共发现3颗耀星，全部为已知X射线源，符合耀星普遍具有强磁活动与X射线辐射的物理预期。其中两颗有明确光谱型：1RXS J044712.8+203809为M3型矮星，且在一个月内三次爆发，体现其高活动性；1RXS J040918.0+180008为K8型，属较早型耀星（相对少见），说明耀星活动不限于最晚型M矮星；第三颗光谱型未知，但其X射线对应体（ROSAT源）和耀斑行为仍支持其耀星归类。

第五，所有检测结果均通过VizieR提供交叉证认信息，并公开原始与去趋势前后各望远镜光变曲线，确保可重复性与验证性。日期标注中第三颗出现“2009-04-28”明显为笔误（超出数据时间范围2005–2006），应为录入错误，实际检测日期应为2006年4月3日。

根据现象进行分析： Light curve oscillations and flux decline in the Be/X-ray binary Swift J1626.6-5156 We report on the long-term light curve periodicity and recent decline in flux of the Be/X-ray binary Swift J1626.6-5156 (Palmer et al., ATel #678). The compact object is a X-ray pulsar, with spin period ~15.37s (Markwardt & Swank, ATel #679). The source has been monitored by RXTE since late December 2005, and the light curve can be viewed through the link given below. On ~JD 2453910, or late June 2006, the source began to show quasi-periodic behavior in its X-ray flux. We have used a Lomb-Scargle periodogram with false alarm probability 0.01 (corresponding to a power threshold of 9.9) to find two dominant periodicities in the light curve. The section of the light curve from ~JD 2454000-2454350 (2006 September-2007 September) has a period of ~47 days, with a peak power density of 19.5. The next section of the light curve, from JD 2454359-2454790 (2007 September-2008 November) has a period of ~72.5 days, or ~3/2 the initial period, again with a power density of 19.5. The count rate during this time varied from ~4-20 c/s. On JD 2454791 (2008 November 11), the oscillatory behavior ceased, and the X-ray count rate dropped to ~1 count/s. 
We speculate that the neutron star may orbit the Be star every ~23 days. During the early part of the oscillatory stage, the wind from the Be star takes 2 orbital periods to replenish the circumstellar disk, and in the later part it takes 3 orbital periods. We are working on an orbital solution to determine how accurate such a hypothesis may be. 
We have obtained Swift data of the source before and after its fall to the current low luminosity state. These data include UVOT images in all 6 filters for photometry. We encourage spectral observations at optical wavelengths to determine the current state of the Be star's disk. 
The 4-22 keV RXTE/PCA spectrum of the source during the oscillatory stage, built from the combination of observations with average count rate > 10 c/s, can be roughly described by an unabsorbed cut-off power law with spectral index 1.38 Â± 0.07 plus a Gaussian emission line at 6.48 Â± 0.02 keV. Fitting the spectrum of the low state with a simple, unabsorbed power law plus a Gaussian emission line at 6.34 Â± 0.13 keV yields a spectral index of 2.02 Â± 0.10. 
RXTE-PCA long-term light curve 2009-04-28 16:31:00
response:
首先，观测到Swift J1626.6−5156的X射线光变曲线呈现两个连续阶段的准周期振荡：第一阶段（JD 2454000–2454350，2006年9月–2007年9月）主导周期为~47天，第二阶段（JD 2454359–2454790，2007年9月–2008年11月）主导周期变为~72.5天，恰好约为47天的1.5倍（即3/2共振关系）。两阶段的Lomb-Scargle功率谱峰值密度均为19.5，显著高于置信阈值9.9（FAP=0.01），表明周期性真实存在且统计稳健。

其次，该周期演化无法直接对应于单一轨道周期；若假设中子星轨道周期为~23天，则47天≈2×23.5天、72.5天≈3×24.2天，暗示振荡周期可能源于轨道周期与盘物质响应时间的整数倍耦合——即Be星赤道盘受脉冲星引力扰动或吸积触发后，需经历约2个或3个轨道周期完成物质再填充与下一次显著吸积事件，从而调制X射线通量。

第三，振荡在JD 2454791（2008年11月11日）突然终止，计数率从4–20 c/s骤降至~1 c/s，表明吸积流发生根本性中断。结合光谱变化：高态谱指数Γ≈1.38，含6.48 keV铁Kα发射线（典型于冷盘反射或荧光辐射）；低态谱变陡（Γ≈2.02），铁线能量略降为6.34 keV，可能反映吸积盘内区消失、辐射机制由盘主导转为冕主导，或盘截断导致荧光区域温度/电离态降低。

最后，RXTE长期监测覆盖2005年底至2009年，而Swift UVOT多波段测光及光学光谱被呼吁用于诊断Be星盘当前消退状态——因Be/X射线双星中X射线通量变化通常由Be星盘的膨胀/收缩驱动，故通量下降极可能对应盘物质耗散，导致中子星吸积率急剧下降。

根据现象进行分析： Palomar Transient Factory Discovers a Possible super-Chandrasekhar Type Ia Supernova The Palomar Transient Factory (see ATel #1964) reports the discovery of an optical transient with the Palomar Observatory 1.2-m Oschin telescope (+CFH12K camera). PTF09dh is located at RA = 14h44m42s.08, DEC = +49o43'44".9 (equinox 2000.0,uncertainty <1'). The object was detected at about R = 20.3 mag in multiple images obtained on April 17 between 6h and 12h UT. Follow-up imaging obtained with the Palomar Observatory 1.5-m telescope shows that PTF09dh brightened to r=18.5 mag on April 28.77 UT. 
Spectra (325-1000 nm) of PTF09dh obtained on April 27.37 UT with the 5.1-m Palomar Hale Telescope (+DBSP) show it to be a supernova. The spectra show some similarities to early spectra of SN 2007if (ATel#1212, CBET#1059), which later resembled SNLS-03D3bb (SN 2003fg). This latter source has been proposed to be a super-Chandrasekhar mass explosion (Howell et al. 2006, Nature, 443, 308). Template matching indicates an approximate redshift of z=0.1. 2009-04-28 22:43:00
response:
首先，观测到一个光学暂现源PTF09dh，位于赤经14h44m42s.08、赤纬+49°43′44″.9（J2000历元），位置精度优于1角秒，说明定位可靠。  
其次，该源在2009年4月17日6–12 UT期间被测得R波段星等约20.3等，随后在4月28.77 UT的后续观测中r波段增亮至18.5等，表明其光度随时间上升，符合超新星爆发的典型光变特征。  
第三，4月27.37 UT获取的325–1000 nm光谱确认其为超新星，且光谱形态与SN 2007if早期光谱相似；而SN 2007if又被证实与SNLS-03D3bb（即SN 2003fg）光谱演化一致，后者已被广泛认为是超钱德拉塞卡质量Ia型超新星的代表案例。  
第四，模板匹配给出红移z≈0.1，排除了太阳系内天体或银河系内普通变星的可能性，支持其为河外Ia型超新星。  
第五，综合光谱相似性、光变增亮行为及红移信息，该事件最可能对应一颗由质量超过钱德拉塞卡极限（~1.4 M⊙）的碳氧白矮星引发的Ia型超新星爆发，即超钱德拉塞卡质量Ia型超新星。

根据现象进行分析： XMM-Newton detects activity from a weak X-ray transient source in the Galactic Center We detected a faint outburst from a weak Galactic Center transient, during a series of three XMM-Newton observations (~40 ks each) performed on 2009 April 1-5 as part of a multi-wavelength campaign on Sgr A*. 
The source is located at RA(J2000)=17h 45m 37.97s Dec(J2000)=-29m 00m 23.3s (positional uncertainty of 2.0 arcsec), which is 27 arcsec from Sgr A*. Taking a distance of 8 kpc to the GC places this source at a minimum distance of 1 pc from the supermassive black hole. This position is consistent with those of 2 Chandra sources: CXOGC J174538.0-290022 (1.6" offset) and CXOGC J174537.9-290025 (1.9" offset). 
The XMM-Newton spectrum of the source can be well fit by an absorbed power-law with photon index Gamma = 1.4+/-0.3 and column density of neutral material of Nh = (19+/-3) x 10^22 cm-2. The de-absorbed 2-10 keV flux is 2.6 (+1.1-0.4) x 10-12 ergs s-1 cm-2 (chi2=183.4 for 183 dof), which corresponds to a luminosity of 2x10^34 ergs s-1 at 8 kpc, and puts this source in the category of very faint X-ray transients (Wijnands et al. 2006, A&A, 449, 1117). We favour the association with CXOGC J174538.0-290022 because it is the closest and because it has been observed to have a similar luminosity (Muno et al. 2005, ApJ, 622, L113). 
Although caught in a burst, the source flux remained approximately constant in the first two XMM-Newton observations. During the third pointing, it had a flare that lasted about 1 hour during which the source count rate almost doubled (from 0.07 to 0.14 counts/s in the EPIC-pn instrument). 
Preliminary results of VLA data at 43 GHz taken on April 1st provide a 2 sigma upper limit of 0.4 mJy at the source position. We encourage sensitive X-ray follow-up observations. 2009-04-29 13:27:00
response:
首先，观测到一个位于银河系中心区域的弱X射线暂现源在XMM-Newton三次观测中（2009年4月1–5日）发生微弱爆发，说明该源具有暂现性质，但爆发幅度较小、持续时间较短。  
其次，该源的位置（RA=17h45m37.97s, Dec=-29°00′23.3″，误差2.0″）距离Sgr A*仅27″，对应8 kpc距离下的投影距离约1 pc，处于银河系中心致密环境中，可能受Sgr A*引力场或周围介质影响。  
第三，位置与两个已知Chandra源CXOGC J174538.0-290022（偏移1.6″）和CXOGC J174537.9-290025（偏移1.9″）高度一致，且光度、能谱特征（吸收幂律，Γ=1.4±0.3，Nh=19±3×10²² cm⁻²）与CXOGC J174538.0-290022历史观测吻合，因此优先认定为同一源。  
第四，X射线光谱拟合得到去吸收后2–10 keV波段通量为2.6⁺¹·¹₋₀·₄×10⁻¹² erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，对应光度~2×10³⁴ erg s⁻¹（8 kpc），符合“极暗X射线暂现源”（VFXT）定义（Wijnands et al. 2006），暗示其可能是一颗低质量X射线双星中的中子星或黑洞，在极低吸积率下发生不规则爆发。  
第五，三次观测中前两次流量稳定（EPIC-pn计数率约0.07 counts/s），第三次出现持续约1小时的快速增亮（计数率近似翻倍至0.14 counts/s），表明爆发具有短时标、非稳态吸积特征，可能由吸积盘不稳定性或磁层重联触发。  
第六，同期VLA 43 GHz射电观测仅给出2σ上限0.4 mJy，未探测到射电对应体，说明该事件未产生显著同步辐射辐射，不支持强喷流模型，更倾向于热主导或弱非热过程。  
综上，该源是一颗位于银心附近、距离Sgr A*约1 pc的极暗X射线暂现体，表现为低光度、短时标、弱吸收的幂律谱爆发，最可能对应一颗中子星低质量X射线双星，其爆发机制受限于极低吸积率下的不稳定性，需高灵敏度X射线后续观测以确认周期性或复发行为。
