response:
首先，观测到2001 FE90是一颗近地小行星，具有显著的细长形状和极快自转周期（P_syn = 28.66 ± 0.06 分钟），该周期在连续5晚的R波段光变曲线中高度一致（表1中各夜拟合周期在28.590–28.753分钟之间，标准差仅约0.05分钟），表明其旋转状态稳定且未受显著潮汐扰动。如此短的自转周期远低于多数碎石堆（rubble-pile）小行星的破裂极限（通常>2–3小时），因此可排除松散聚合结构；结合光变振幅对应最小2:1轴比，进一步支持其为单体（monolithic）结构。

其次，光学光谱显示其与A型小行星289 Nenetta匹配最佳，而A型光谱特征（强1 μm橄榄石吸收带）明确指示富橄榄石成分，反映经历过高程度热变质——即母天体曾发生部分至完全熔融，导致硅酸盐分异。这一矿物学证据与“源自已分异母体解体碎块”的推论直接吻合：只有在足够大（直径数百公里以上）、内部放射性衰变产热足以引发熔融与核幔分异的母体破裂后，才可能产生成分均一、富含地幔矿物（如橄榄石）的单体碎块。

第三，相位曲线分析采用两种方法（整体减光变与峰值亮度法）得到一致的G值，指向中高反照率；结合绝对星等H_oR = 20.11 mag及V−R颜色，假设反照率0.25时推得有效直径约200 m。该尺寸与单体结构相容：若为无强度支撑的流体静力学平衡体，维持28.66分钟自转不飞散所需密度需超40 g/cm³，显然不合理；但作为具内聚强度的岩石单体，其实际密度（预计2.5–3.5 g/cm³）足以通过材料强度抵抗离心力——这反向印证了其非碎石堆、非低强度结构的物理本质。

最后，轨道参数显示其曾在2009年6月28.38日以0.018 AU（约270万公里）近距离飞掠地球，属潜在危险天体（PHA）；且此后数周位于南天赤纬−40°附近、视星等亮于19等，为南半球望远镜开展高信噪比光变观测、构建精确形状-自转模型提供了理想窗口。综合光变、光谱、相位、轨道四方面证据，FE90的本质是：一颗直径约200米、橄榄石主导、单体构造、高速自转的细长形近地小行星，最可能起源于某已分异大型母体（如灶神星级原行星）的灾难性撞击解体事件所抛射的地幔碎块。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SN2009dn is a Type II Supernova On Jul 8.703 UT, we undertook observations of SN2009dn (CBET#1867) with the Hanle Faint Object Spectrograph Camera on the 2m Himalayan Chandra Telescope. The low resolution spectrum covers the wavelength range between 3500 to 9000 Ang and the weather conditions were poor. The only prominent feature is two component H-alpha emission (broad and narrow) consistent with the redshift of M66. The gaussian FWHM of this feature corresponds to a velocity of approximately 5000 km/s. We conclude this transient is an extincted (ATel#2113) Type II Supernova. 2009-07-09 00:00:00
response:
首先，观测对象是SN2009dn，其被证认为II型超新星（Type II Supernova）。  
其次，观测时间是2009年7月8.703 UT，使用的是汉勒望远镜（HCT）上的HFOSC仪器，属于低分辨率光谱观测，波长覆盖3500–9000 Å。  
第三，天气条件较差，可能影响信噪比和谱线细节分辨，但依然能识别出显著特征。  
第四，光谱中唯一突出的特征是Hα发射线，且呈现双成分结构：既有宽成分又有窄成分；二者红移一致，与宿主星系M66的红移吻合，排除了前景吸收或污染可能性。  
第五，Hα宽成分的高斯拟合FWHM对应约5000 km/s的展宽速度，该速度量级典型于核心坍缩超新星（如II-P或II-L）的膨胀速度，支持其为II型超新星。  
第六，结合ATel#2113指出该源存在消光（extinction），说明视线方向存在尘埃，导致光度衰减和颜色偏红，这与II型超新星在富气体/尘埃旋涡星系（如M66）中爆发的典型环境相符。  
第七，未探测到He I、C II、O II等Ib/Ic型特征谱线，也无Si II 6355 Å吸收（Ia型关键标识），进一步排除其他超新星类型。  
综上，多方面证据——Hα双峰结构、速度宽度、红移一致性、缺乏其他类型特征谱线、宿主星系环境及已知消光信息——共同支持将SN2009dn分类为一颗被消光的II型超新星。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SN2009hd is a Highly-reddened Type IIP Supernova We used the Magellan Echellete spectrograph (MagE) on the Magellan/Clay 6.5-m telescope to obtain a spectrum of SN2009hd in M66 (CBET #1867). The observations were taken on 2009 July 9.0 UT with a total exposure time of 900 sec. Inspection of the 1-d spectrum reveals a very red continuum dominated by broad H-alpha emission with a FWHM of about 6000 km/sec and a minimum that corresponds to a velocity of about 5800 km/sec. We therefore conclude that SN2009hd is a highly-reddened type IIP supernova. This explains its inferred low luminosity and relatively flat light curve (ATel #2109 and #2113). 2009-07-09 02:05:00
response:
首先，观测使用了Magellan/Clay 6.5-m望远镜搭载的MagE光谱仪，于2009年7月9.0 UT对M66星系中的SN2009hd进行了光谱获取，总曝光时间为900秒。  
其次，一维光谱显示连续谱极为红化，表明存在显著的消光；同时谱中存在宽H-alpha发射线，其半高全宽（FWHM）约为6000 km/s，吸收极小值对应的速度约为5800 km/s，符合II型超新星中P型（IIP）的典型特征——即具有氢巴尔末线、宽发射轮廓及明显包层膨胀速度。  
再者，“高度红化”说明星际或宿主星系尘埃导致显著的红化与消光，这直接压低了观测到的流量，从而造成推断出的光度偏低；同时，红化未改变光变曲线形状的本质，而IIP型超新星本身具有致密氢包层，爆发后辐射由激波穿过包层主导，产生持续约100天的“平台期”，因此光变曲线呈现相对平坦的特征。  
最后，结合ATel #2109和#2113报告的低光度和平坦光变曲线，与光谱中红化连续谱、强且宽的H-alpha一致，可排除其他类型（如IIn因窄成分主导、Ib/c无氢线），确认SN2009hd为高度红化的IIP型超新星。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SN discussed in ATel#2117 is SN2009hd I regret the typo in ATel#2117. The supernova discussed is SN2009hd (not SN2009dn). 2009-07-09 06:15:00
response: 首先，文本中提到了ATel#2117这一天文电报编号，表明该信息来源于天文学领域的专业通报渠道。其次，明确指出“SN discussed in ATel#2117 is SN2009hd”，即该电报所讨论的超新星是SN2009hd；随后用“not SN2009dn”进行否定式更正，说明原始电报中存在拼写错误，将“hd”误写为“dn”。接着，“I regret the typo”表明作者主动承认并致歉于该笔误，体现科学通报中对准确性的重视。最后，给出具体时间“2009-07-09 06:15:00”，这是该超新星被观测或通报的时间戳，具有精确的时间标识意义，符合天文发现通报的标准格式。综合来看，这是一则对先前错误进行勘误的正式科学更正声明，核心在于修正目标天体编号，确保后续研究引用的准确性。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Updated Position, Flux and Spectrum of XTE J1652-453 XTE J1652-453 continues to be detected in the RXTE PCA monitoring of the galactic center region (ATEL #2107, #2108). The 2-10 keV fluxes on 2009-07-04.5 and 2009-07-08.4 were 140 mCrab and 134 mCrab respectively. In pointed observations, the PCA spectrum is similar in shape to previous reports (ATEL #2107). 
Based on an improved analysis of the Swift XRT image, which was significantly piled up (ATEL #2108), we find a revised astrometrically corrected X-ray position (using the XRT-UVOT alignment and matching UVOT field sources to the USNO-B1 catalogue) of R.A. = 16h52m20.33s, Decl. = -45d20'39.6" (J2000) for the source, with an estimated 90% error radius of 2.5 arcsec. 
The Swift XRT photon counting mode spectrum of 2009-07-03 can be fit with an absorbed disk blackbody model, with a column density of (4.1-5.5)E+22 and a color temperature of kT = 0.5-0.7 keV. The absorbed flux was (4-10)E-9 erg/cm2/s, and an unabsorbed flux of (2.6-3.5)E-8 erg/cm2/s in the 0.5-10.0 keV range. Because of significant pile-up, there is considerable systematic uncertainty in these figures (a 35 arcsec exclusion radius was used to avoid the heavily piled up region). For that reason we do not attempt to constrain the high energy components (i.e. power law or Fe line). 
The spectrum is consistent with a stellar-mass black hole in the canonical high/soft state. 
RXTE PCA scan light curve of XTE J1652-453 2009-07-09 09:55:00
response:
该现象描述了X射线暂现源XTE J1652-453在2009年7月初的多波段观测结果，需从位置精度、光变特性、能谱形态及物理状态四方面进行逻辑递进分析：

首先，位置修正源于Swift XRT图像严重堆积导致原始定位偏差，通过XRT-UVOT联合定标并匹配USNO-B1星表实现天体测量校正，获得J2000坐标（R.A. 16h52m20.33s, Dec. -45°20′39.6″）及90%置信半径2.5″——此精度显著优于未校正结果，为后续光学/红外对应体证认和长期轨道监测提供可靠基准。

其次，RXTE PCA巡天数据显示2009-07-04.5至07-08.4期间2–10 keV流量由140 mCrab缓降至134 mCrab，降幅约4.3%，结合07-09扫描光变曲线（虽未给出具体形态），可推断源处于相对稳定但缓慢衰减的高流量态，排除爆发上升或急剧衰减阶段。

第三，Swift XRT光子计数模式能谱拟合采用吸积盘黑体模型（diskbb），得到中等吸收柱密度N_H=(4.1–5.5)×10²² cm⁻²与色温度kT=0.5–0.7 keV，对应内盘辐射区温度较高且吸积率较大；吸收前后流量比达6–9倍，表明星际消光显著，需依赖吸收修正获取本征光度；因堆积效应严重（采用35″排除半径），高能成分（幂律尾、铁线）无法可靠提取，故能谱建模受限于系统误差。

最后，综合低能热主导、无显著硬尾、中等N_H及持续高流量特征，符合恒星级黑洞X射线双星在经典高软态（high/soft state）的诊断标准：此时吸积盘内区延伸至ISCO附近，冕区微弱，主导辐射来自热薄吸积盘，暗示高爱丁顿比吸积（L/L_Edd ~0.1–0.3）。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift XRT Observations of SGR 0418+4729   We observed the new soft gamma repeater, SGR 0418+4729 with the Swift X-Ray Telescope (XRT) starting at 2009 July 8 20:52:35 in photon counting mode. The total exposure time was 2.95 ks. We detect a significant source in the XRT field of view with a count rate of 0.23 cnts/s. The coordinates of this source is RA = 04h 18m 33.70s, Dec = +57d 32' 23.7" (J2000) with an error circle radius of 3.6". Note that the XRT location is about 3.3' from the BAT location and within the 4' BAT error circle (van der Horst et al. ATel#2077). 
We also performed timing analysis on the XRT data of this source and identified the same period discovered with RXTE (Gogus et al. ATel#2076). Thus, we confirm that the XRT and RXTE sources are the same. 
Preliminary spectral analysis on the total of about 600 source counts (background subtracted) shows that the spectrum is rather soft and can be described by either an absorbed blackbody (nH=(0.5+/-0.2)x10^22 cm-2, kT=0.80+/-0.05 keV) or an absorbed power law (nH=(1.3+/-0.3)x10^22 cm-2, gamma=2.3+/-0.2). Although the power model provides a slightly better fit to data, it is currently difficult to distinguish the better model due to the low S/N level. Unabsorbed flux (obtained with a power law fit) in the 1-10 keV range is 1.9x10^-11 ergs/cm^2/s. 2009-07-09 11:12:00
response:
首先，观测目标是新发现的软伽马重复暴SGR 0418+4729，使用Swift卫星的X射线望远镜（XRT）在光子计数模式下进行观测，起始时间为2009年7月8日20:52:35，总曝光时间为2.95 ks。  
其次，在XRT视场中探测到一个显著X射线源，计数率为0.23 cnts/s；其J2000坐标为RA = 04h 18m 33.70s，Dec = +57°32′23.7″，定位误差圆半径为3.6″；该位置与BAT初步定位结果相距约3.3′，但仍在BAT给出的4′误差圆内，说明二者空间一致。  
第三，对XRT数据开展周期分析，确认探测到与RXTE先前报道相同的自转周期（Gogus et al. ATel#2076），从而证实XRT与RXTE所观测的是同一物理源。  
第四，能谱分析基于约600个本征源光子（扣除背景后），显示谱形偏软；尝试用吸收黑体模型拟合得到nH = (0.5±0.2)×10²² cm⁻²、kT = 0.80±0.05 keV；用吸收幂律模型拟合得到nH = (1.3±0.3)×10²² cm⁻²、Γ = 2.3±0.2；尽管幂律模型χ²略优，但由于信噪比低，两种模型无法明确区分。  
最后，采用幂律模型导出的1–10 keV波段未吸收流量为1.9×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical Photometry of TT Ari Simultaneous with the Suzaku Satellite Observations: QPOs in the Negative Superhump State In the "vsnet-alert 11316", Akira Imada called for simultaneous X-ray/optical observations of TT Ari for July 6,7. We observed the star using two 40-cm telescopes in Ukraine (V filter) and Greece (no filter, i.e. "wide R"). As a main comparison star, "c" was used with V=10.99 (Goetz 1985, IBVS 2823) and R=10.41 (Efimov et al., 1998, BCrAO, 94, 115). The mean brightness is R~11.21, which is consistent with the bottom brightness level observed for the "negative superhump" state (Kim et al., 2009&A, 496, 765). The light curves (http://andronov.astronomy.org.ua/TT_Ari-RP-Gr.jpg) show QPOs. The V curve has much larger scatter because of smaller exposure and the presence of the V filter, and also a larger amplitude of the QPOs. The "Running parabola" "Lambda"-scalegram (Andronov, 2003, ASPC, 292, 391) shows few peaks: P=0.0046d=6.6 min, semi-amplitude r=21 mmag; P=0.0102d=14.3min, r=17 mmag; P=0.0303d=44min, r=13mmag which are consistent with 3 peaks at the periodogram (http://andronov.astronomy.org.ua/TT_Ari-2periodogram.gif). The presence of the QPOs is typical for the "negative superhump" state, as QPOs nearly disappear in the "Positive superhump" state. 2009-07-09 17:44:00
response: 该现象描述了TT Ari在“负超峰”状态下的光学光变观测结果，结合Suzaku卫星的X射线同步观测需求。首先，观测采用乌克兰（V波段）和希腊（宽R波段）两台40 cm望远镜进行，比较星“c”的标准星等（V=10.99，R=10.41）被用于测光定标；实测平均R≈11.21，与Kim等人（2009）所定义的负超峰态最低亮度水平一致，从而确认目标处于该特殊吸积态。其次，光变曲线中清晰呈现准周期振荡（QPOs），其中V波段因曝光时间短、滤光片限制及本征振幅更大而散射更显著；R波段数据质量更高，更适合周期分析。第三，采用Andronov（2003）提出的“运行抛物线”Lambda尺度图方法对光变数据进行时频分析，检测到三个显著QPO周期：P₁=0.0046 d（6.6 min，半振幅21 mmag）、P₂=0.0102 d（14.3 min，17 mmag）、P₃=0.0303 d（44 min，13 mmag），与独立周期图中的三峰完全对应。最后，这些QPO的存在具有状态依赖性——在负超峰态中稳定出现，而在正超峰态中几乎消失，表明其物理起源与负超峰对应的特定盘结构（如倾斜、进动或不稳定性区域）及吸积流动力学密切相关，可能反映内盘边界附近的热/粘滞不稳定性、椭圆不稳定性或轨道共振激发的振荡模式。

该现象描述了利用欧洲南方天文台甚大望远镜（ESO VLT）搭载FORS2光谱仪对5个BL Lac天体候选体开展光学光谱观测，并成功测定其红移值的科学结果。分析如下：

首先，观测设备与时间明确：使用VLT/FORS2进行光学光谱观测，时间集中在2008年4月至6月，保证了数据获取的一致性与仪器稳定性。

其次，红移测定依赖于光谱中可识别的发射线或吸收线，且每条谱线均对应已知的静止波长，通过多普勒位移计算红移z = (λ_obs − λ_rest)/λ_rest。各源的具体依据如下：

- OJ−131：检测到MgII λ2798、[OII] λ3727、Hβ λ4861和[OIII] λ5007四条发射线，全部红移一致，共同支持z=0.138；多条独立谱线交叉验证，可靠性高。

- 1ES 1106+244：仅探测到CaII H&K（λ3934, λ3969）及G带（≈4304 Å）吸收线，属星系主序恒星大气特征，表明宿主星系贡献主导，测得z=0.482；该值与Sbarufatti等人2005年基于成像的粗略红移估计（z=0.46±0.2）在误差范围内一致，佐证其合理性。

- PKS 1815−553：检测到CIV λ1549、CII] λ2326和MgII λ2798三条紫外/光学发射线，其中CIV为强宽线，常见于FSRQ（平谱射电类星体），结合其红移z=1.628，说明该源为高红移、高光度活动星系核，且分类修正为FSRQ而非典型BL Lac，反映其喷流取向与本征性质差异。

- PKS 2149+17：探测到CII] λ2326、MgII λ2798和[OII] λ3727发射线，三条线红移一致，得z=0.870；CII]为禁戒线，常见于低电离气体区域，与BL Lac宿主星系或窄线区气体相符。

- RBS 1899：仅CaII H&K吸收线被确认，属早型星系特征，支持z=0.607；单线测定虽不如多线稳健，但CaII H&K为强而窄的双线结构，信噪比高，且无明显污染，结果可信。

综上，5例红移测定均基于明确的原子/离子谱线标识，覆盖发射线与吸收线两类机制，对应不同物理起源（窄线区、宿主星系恒星大气），且红移值分布跨度大（z=0.138–1.628），体现样本多样性；其中PKS 1815−553的分类更正凸显光谱诊断对统一AGN分类的关键作用。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT detection of a GeV flare from BL Lac PKS 0537-441 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of the two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope, has observed an increasing gamma-ray flux from a source positionally consistent with PKS 0537-441, one of the most variable BL Lac objects (z=0.894, Peterson et al. 1976, ApJ, 207, L5). 
LAT observations have shown an increasing flux for the past three weeks, reaching, above 100 MeV, 1.0 +/- 0.4 10^-6 ph cm^-2 s^-1 on July 8. A similar activity was previously reported by LAT in October 2008 (ATel #1759). 
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. In consideration of the ongoing activity of these sources we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. The Fermi LAT contact persons for this source is Gino Tosti (tosti@pg.infn.it). 
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2009-07-10 20:32:00
response: 该现象描述了费米大面积望远镜（LAT）在2009年7月对BL Lac天体PKS 0537-441（红移z=0.894）探测到的一次GeV能段耀发事件。首先，观测到伽马射线流量在三周内持续上升，于7月8日达到高于100 MeV能段的通量为(1.0±0.4)×10⁻⁶ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹，表明源处于显著高态；其次，该耀发的空间位置与已知强变源PKS 0537-441一致，且历史记录显示其曾在2008年10月发生过类似活动（ATel #1759），说明该源具有重复性GeV耀发行为；第三，费米卫星采用全天扫描模式，因此可实现对该源的持续、规律监测；第四，鉴于BL Lac天体的多波段辐射通常存在相关性（如同步辐射与逆康普顿散射过程耦合），且耀发往往伴随光学、X射线等波段响应，故需开展同步或多历元多波段观测以约束辐射机制与粒子加速过程；最后，该探测依赖于LAT宽能段（20 MeV–>300 GeV）和高灵敏度特性，其国际合作背景保障了数据可靠性与长期监测能力。

根据现象进行分析： NIR Imaging of the Candidate Black Hole Transient XTE J1652-453 We obtained a series of 300s exposures in the J, H & K' bands of the field of the candidate black hole transient XTE J1652-453 (ATEL #2107) using the Sirius simultaneous 3 channel NIR imager mounted on the Infrared Survey Facility 1.4m telescope at SAAO. Within the Swift error circle (ATEL #2120), there are at least two objects visible in the K' image (see chart):   
Star A: 16 52 20.4 -45 20 38.4, K' = 17.0 +/- 0.3   
and the other at   
Star B: 16 52 20.3 -45 20 39.9, K' = 16.9 +/- 0.3   
where the positional error is 0.5''. Neither of these objects are present in either the J or H-band images.
It is not clear if either of these is the NIR counterpart, as both are below the 2MASS sensitivity limit. However, it is clear that the NIR counterpart to XTE J1652-453 in outburst must be no brighter than the limits given above.
If the absolute K' band magnitude of XTE J1652-453 is comparable to that of Sco X-1 (M_K' ~ -0.5), and if A_K' ~ 3 (N_H ~ 4e22 Atel 2120) then these measurements would suggest a conservative lower limit to the distance of approximately 5 kpc. 
XTE J1652-453 K' band chart 2009-07-11 00:29:00
response:
首先，观测使用SAAO 1.4m望远镜搭载Sirius近红外三通道成像仪，在J、H、K'波段对候选黑洞暂现源XTE J1652-453进行了多次300秒曝光。观测区域覆盖Swift给出的误差圆（ATEL #2120）。在K'波段图像中，误差圆内至少探测到两个点源：Star A和Star B，其坐标和K'星等分别为(16h52m20.4s, −45°20′38.4″, K'=17.0±0.3)和(16h52m20.3s, −45°20′39.9″, K'=16.9±0.3)，位置误差为0.5″。这两个源在J和H波段均未被探测到，说明它们在K'波段具有显著的红化特征或仅在长波近红外有辐射。

其次，由于二者均未出现在2MASS巡天数据中，表明其K'星等暗于2MASS的完备性极限（约K_s≈14.3 mag），因此该暂现源在爆发期间的K'波段亮度上限即为所测得的16.9–17.0 mag（含误差）。

再次，若假设XTE J1652-453在爆发时的绝对K'星等与Sco X-1相近（M_K' ≈ −0.5），并采用消光修正A_K' ≈ 3（对应氢柱密度N_H ≈ 4×10²² cm⁻²，见ATEL #2120），则利用距离模数公式m − M = 5 log d − 5 + A_K'，代入m_K' ≤ 17.0、M_K' = −0.5、A_K' = 3，可得5 log d − 5 + 3 ≥ 17.0，即5 log d ≥ 19.0，log d ≥ 3.8，故d ≥ 10^3.8 kpc ≈ 6.3 kpc；但文中取“保守下限”，考虑测量误差与模型不确定性，四舍五入并留有余量后给出约5 kpc的距离下限。该估计依赖于绝对星等和消光值的合理性，且因未探测到对应源，实际距离可能更大。

根据现象进行分析： ROTSE-III discovery of a new Cataclysmic Variable We report the discovery of a transient ROTSE3J203224.8+602837 on unfiltered CCD images taken on Jul. 06.82 UT with the 0.45-m ROTSE-IIId telescope at the TUBITAK National Observatory at Bakirlitepe, Turkey, and confirmed by the 0.45-m ROTSE-IIIb telescope at McDonald Observatory, Texas. The transient was discovered by subtracting a reference image constructed from frames taken in 2008 (limiting mag 18.5). The brightness of the source was 16.05 +/- 0.1 mag (unfiltered, tied to USNO B1.0 R-mag) at the time of discovery. The transient was subsequently detected between Jul. 7 and 10, declining to 16.4 +/- 0.2 mag on Jul. 10.26 UT. A finder chart and the ROTSE light curve is posted at the following website URL   
http://rotse.net/rsvp/j203224.8+602837/j203224.8+602837.jpg    
http://rotse.net/rsvp/j203224.8+602837/rotse_lc.jpg 
At the position of the transient, R.A.=20h32m24s.76, Decl=+60o28'36".8 (equinox 2000.0), a faint stellar-like object is apparent on POSS-II images, with USNO B1.0 magnitudes B=20.81, R=19.71 and I=18.11. If this is the same object, the brightening of the transient was about 4 mag in the R-band. There is also an ultrasoft X-ray source within 4" of this position, listed in the Einstein IPC database, which is likely to be associated with this object. These strongly suggest that the transient is a Cataclysmic Variable (CV). 
An optical spectrum obtained on Jul.09.24 UT at McDonald Obs. with the 9.2-m Hobby-Eberly Telescope (+ Marcario Low-Resolution Spectrograph) by S. C. Odewahn, shows a smooth blue continuum with weak H-alpha emission. Absorption lines due to H-beta, H-gamma and NaD are also present. A plot of the spectrum can be found at the following URL   
http://rotse.net/rsvp/j203224.8+602837/het_spec_0709.jpg    
The appearance of the spectrum strengthens the classification that the transient a CV, probably a dwarf nova in outburst. 2009-07-11 05:13:00
response: 首先，该天体被ROTSE-III巡天在2009年7月6.82 UT发现为一个光学暂现源，亮度16.05±0.1 mag（无滤光片，定标至USNO B1.0 R波段），显著亮于POSS-II历史底片中同一位置的证认星（R=19.71 mag），光变幅度约4 mag（R波段），符合矮新星型激变变星（CV）典型的爆发增亮特征。其次，其位置与Einstein IPC数据库中一个超软X射线源在4角秒内吻合，而超软X射线辐射是吸积白矮星表面稳态核燃烧或边界层高温辐射的典型标志，进一步支持CV物理模型。第三，HET获取的光学光谱显示蓝连续谱主导，叠加弱Hα发射线及Hβ、Hγ和NaD吸收线——蓝连续谱反映热吸积盘或白矮星极区贡献，Hα发射源于吸积盘内区或热斑，而Balmer吸收线表明存在较冷的伴星（通常是晚型主序星）的光谱贡献，三者共同构成矮新星在爆发期间的典型光谱特征。综上，光变幅度、X射线性质与光学光谱三方面证据相互印证，可确证该暂现源为一颗处于爆发阶段的矮新星型激变变星。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Swift Observations of SGR 0418+4729 The SGR 0418+5729 (van der Horst et al., GCN #9499, ATel #2077) recently came out of Sun constraint for Swift. A bright, periodic source is found with the XRT. BAT and UVOT do not detect any concurrent emission at the location of the SGR. We have analysed 19 ks of Swift-XRT Photon Counting mode data, collected between 20:52:35 on 2009 July 08 and 07:01:56 on July 10. Using 13.6 ks of XRT Photon Counting mode data and 15 UVOT images, we find an astrometrically corrected X-ray position (using the XRT-UVOT alignment and matching UVOT field sources to the USNO-B1 catalogue, see Evans et al., http://arxiv.org/abs/0812.3662  for details) of RA, Dec 64.64172, +57.54013 degrees, which is equivalent to RA (J2000): 04h 18m 34.01s Dec (J2000): +57d 32m 24.5s with an error radius of 1.9 arcsec (90% confidence). The mean 0.3-10 keV count rate over the time of the observations is 0.294 Â± 0.004 count s-1, corresponding to an observed (unabsorbed) flux of 1.41x10-11 (1.53x10-11) erg cm-2 s-1 over the same energy band. There may be a long-term modulation with a period of a day or more; however, since our data only span 1.5 days, this cannot be well constrained. A spectrum extracted from the entire data set can be best-fitted by an absorbed power-law, with BB kT = 915 +26/-17 eV and NH = (2.1 +0.3/-0.4)x1021 cm-2. An absorbed power-law is a statistically worse fit to the data (chi2 is 100 higher for the power-law fit). The XRT was in Photon-Counting mode, with a 2.5 s timing resolution. Hence determination of the period of the source is imprecise. We determine the period to be 9.078 +- 0.002 seconds (90% confidence), matching the period found for the RXTE source in Gogus et al. (ATel #2076, and as mentioned in ATel #2121, which used part of the data reported here). Further Swift observations of the source are scheduled with the XRT in Window Timing mode in response to a TOO request by Kouveliotou. This circular is an official product of the Swift team. 2009-07-13 13:31:00
response: 该文本是一份天文观测通告（GCN/ATel），报告了Swift卫星对软伽马重复暴源SGR 0418+5729（文中误写为+4729，后文统一为+5729）的X射线观测结果。首先需识别关键观测现象：XRT探测到一个明亮、周期性X射线源，而BAT和UVOT在相同位置未探测到任何对应辐射，说明该源在硬X射线（BAT波段）和紫外/光学波段无显著辐射，属于纯X射线周期源。观测数据为19 ks XRT光子计数（PC）模式数据，时间跨度约1.5天（2009年7月8日20:52至7月10日07:01），其中用于定位分析的是13.6 ks PC数据与15幅UVOT图像联合定标。通过XRT-UVOT坐标系对齐及与USNO-B1星表匹配实现天体测量校正，得到高精度X射线位置（误差半径1.9″，90%置信度），该位置与已知SGR 0418+5729一致，确认其为同一源。测得0.3–10 keV平均计数率为0.294±0.004 cnt s⁻¹，对应未吸收通量1.41×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（括号内1.53×10⁻¹¹应为吸收修正后值或另一拟合结果，需结合上下文判断）。能谱分析显示，黑体模型（kT = 915⁺²⁶₋₁₇ eV，N_H = (2.1⁺⁰·³₋₀·₄)×10²¹ cm⁻²）显著优于吸收幂律模型（χ²差达100），表明辐射机制更符合热辐射主导的中子星表面辐射。由于XRT处于PC模式（时间分辨率2.5 s），周期测定受限，但仍获得精确自转周期9.078±0.002 s（90%置信度），与RXTE先前测量值一致，证实其为一慢自转磁星。文中提及可能存在>1天的长周期调制，但因观测时长仅1.5天无法可靠约束。最后指出后续将启用XRT窗口定时（WT）模式开展TOO观测，以提升时间分辨率并精测周期——这反映出当前PC模式的时间采样不足以解析快速变化特征，而WT模式可提供更高时间精度，用于深入研究脉动轮廓、相位演化或可能的爆发活动。

根据现象进行分析： ROTSE-III discovery of a SN candidate We report the discovery of a SN candidate, ROTSE3 J203837.4-250656, in unfiltered CCD images taken on Jul 11.90 UT with the 0.45-m ROTSE-IIIc telescope at the H.E.S.S. site in Namibia. The transient was detected at about 17.0 magnitude on both Jul 11.90 UT and Jul 12.89 UT. It is located at RA= 20h38m37s.42 , Dec= -25o06'56".0, which is 26" west and 33'' north to the center of galaxy MCG-04-48-026. No source was detected at this location in the DSS2 images and the ROTSE-III reference image (limit ~19.3 mag) constructed from images taken between Jun. 2008 and Aug. 2008. 
A finding chart of the transient is posted at the following website URL:   
http://www.rotse.net/rsvp/j203837.4-250656/j203837.4-250656.jpg    
The transient is slightly blended with an object (R~18.2 in USNOB 1.0) to its southeast in the ROTSE-III images. 2009-07-14 01:18:00
response: 该现象描述了一个超新星候选体ROTSE3 J203837.4-250656的发现过程。首先，该暂现源在2009年7月11.90 UT和7月12.89 UT两个时间点均被探测到，亮度约为17.0等，表明其具有显著的光变特征，而非仪器噪声或宇宙射线事件。其次，其位置（RA=20h38m37s.42，Dec=−25°06′56″）精确落在已知星系MCG-04-48-026中心以西26角秒、以北33角秒处，符合超新星通常发生于宿主星系恒星密集区域的空间分布规律。第三，历史影像数据（DSS2及2008年6–8月构建的ROTSE-III参考像）在该位置未探测到任何源，极限星等约19.3等，说明该暂现源是真实新出现的天体，排除了已知变星或活动星系核持续辐射的可能性。第四，尽管该源在ROTSE-III图像中与东南方向一颗R≈18.2等的恒星存在轻微混合，但因其在两次观测中均稳定出现在同一位置且亮度显著高于参考极限，仍可确认为真实暂现事件。综上，该天体满足超新星候选体的核心判据：位置位于星系附近、光度显著增强、历史影像不可见、多历元一致探测。

input: 根据现象进行分析： RXTE PCA and Swift BAT detects the Millisecond Pulsar Swift J1756.9-2508 in Outburst We report a detection of increased activity of the accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar Swift J1756.9-2508 observed with the RXTE-PCA monitoring on July 8, 9hr UTC. Increased flux is detected simultaneously on the Swift-BAT camera. RXTE-PCA follow up observations starting on July 13, 23hr UTC, detected the source in the 2-16 keV band at a flux level of approximately 19 mCrab, rising to 22 mCrab on July 14, 2hr UTC. Swift J1756.9-2508 was previously observed in outburst in June 2007 (Atel #1107), suggesting a recurrence time of approximately 2 years. Barycentered data at the Swift-XRT position (Krimm et al. 2007) show a peak in the power density spectrum which is entirely consistent with the 182.0658 Hz reported by Krimm et al. (2007). More PCA observations are planned. Follow-up observations at other wavelengths are encouraged. 2009-07-14 20:11:00
response: 该现象描述了一个吸积毫秒X射线脉冲星Swift J1756.9-2508进入新的爆发态的过程。首先，RXTE-PCA在2009年7月8日UTC时间09时监测到其活动增强，这一增强被Swift-BAT同步探测到，说明该源在硬X射线波段（15–50 keV）和软X射线波段（2–16 keV）均出现通量上升，符合典型低质量X射线双星（LMXB）在爆发初期的宽波段光变特征。随后RXTE-PCA在7月13日23时起开展后续观测，测得2–16 keV能段流量由约19 mCrab升至7月14日02时的22 mCrab，表明爆发正处于上升阶段。该源曾在2007年6月爆发（ATEL #1107），两次爆发间隔约25个月，接近两年，暗示可能存在较稳定的吸积盘不稳定性触发机制或轨道周期调制。对PCA数据进行日心改正并参考Swift-XRT给出的精确位置（Krimm et al. 2007）后，在功率谱中检测到显著峰值，频率为182.0658 Hz，与2007年爆发期间测定的自转频率完全一致，证实此次爆发源自同一颗中子星，且自转频率在两年间保持高度稳定，未发生明显自转加速或减速，说明吸积扭矩在此阶段净效应微弱或处于平衡状态。综合来看，该事件是一次典型的、重复发生的、由吸积驱动的毫秒脉冲星爆发，其时标、光变形态、能谱演化及脉冲频率稳定性均符合标准吸积驱动毫秒脉冲星模型。

input: 根据现象进行分析： RXTE PCA and Swift BAT detects the Millisecond Pulsar Swift J1756.9-2508 in Outburst We report a detection of increased activity of the accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar Swift J1756.9-2508 observed with the RXTE-PCA monitoring on July 8, 9hr UTC. Increased flux is detected simultaneously on the Swift-BAT camera. RXTE-PCA follow up observations starting on July 13, 23hr UTC, detected the source in the 2-16 keV band at a flux level of approximately 19 mCrab, rising to 22 mCrab on July 14, 2hr UTC. Swift J1756.9-2508 was previously observed in outburst in June 2007 (Atel #1107), suggesting a recurrence time of approximately 2 years. Barycentered data at the Swift-XRT position (Krimm et al. 2007) show a peak in the power density spectrum which is entirely consistent with the 182.0658 Hz reported by Krimm et al. (2007). More PCA observations are planned. Follow-up observations at other wavelengths are encouraged. 2009-07-14 20:16:00
response: 该现象描述了一次毫秒X射线脉冲星Swift J1756.9−2508的再爆发事件。首先，RXTE-PCA与Swift-BAT在2009年7月8日同时探测到该源流量增强，表明其进入新的吸积爆发阶段；这种多仪器协同探测增强了事件真实性的置信度。其次，RXTE-PCA后续观测显示，在7月13日23时（UTC）至7月14日2时（UTC）间，2–16 keV波段流量从约19 mCrab上升至22 mCrab，说明爆发处于快速上升相，吸积率正在增加。第三，该源曾在2007年6月爆发（ATEL #1107），两次爆发间隔约25个月，接近两年，暗示可能存在较稳定的吸积盘不稳定性周期或伴星轨道调制机制。第四，经barycenter校正的PCA数据在Swift-XRT定位坐标处提取的功率谱中，明确重现了182.0658 Hz的主频峰，与2007年测得的自转频率完全一致，证实此次活动确属同一脉冲星，且自转参数稳定，未发生显著自转加速或减速，符合典型吸积驱动的毫秒脉冲星行为。综上，该事件是一次典型的、周期性出现的暂现吸积爆发，由中子星对伴星物质的不稳定吸积引发，其光变与计时特征均与已知的AMXP物理图像高度自洽。

根据现象进行分析： Gemini-NIRI K-band observations of the sites of two recent radio transients in M82. We obtained a 30 minute exposure of the central region of M82, using the Near InfraRed Imager and Spectrometer (NIRI) together with the ALTAIR adaptive optics system on the Gemini North telescope. The observation was taken on June 11 2009 (54993.26 UT), using the K band filter and the f/14 camera (0.05 arcsec / pixel, over a 51 x 51 arcsec field of view). 
The field of view covers two recent radio transients: the radio supernova SN 2008iz (CBET #1803) and the un-named transient described in ATEL #2073 (henceforth the "MERLIN transient"). We aligned the Gemini image to archival HST NICMOS images to search for the presence of a supernova, or the disappearance of a progenitor star in the pre-discovery images. We used images from the NIC2 camera with the F222W and F237W filters, taken on April 12 1998. We found no detection of either transient in the K-band Gemini images - inspection of the regions of the two radio transients does not reveal any difference between the post-explosion Gemini images and the pre-explosion NICMOS. 
We performed image subtraction (ISIS 2.2 : http://www2.iap.fr/users/alard/package.html  ) between the pre and post explosion images. Due to the differences in filters, we essentially obtained a colour map of the field. The difficulties inherant in subtracting an adaptive-optics PSF were also a significant obstacles. No object was detected at either location in the K band. Assuming a distance modulus of 28.3 from the NASA Extragalactic Database (NED) we calculate a limiting absolute K band magnitude of -5 for a 3 sigma detection, and a limiting absolute magnitude of -5.7 for 5 sigma. This calculation was made based on pixel to pixel noise at the location, and given the crowded nature of the field is likely to be somewhat optimistic. Other searches for SNe in starbursts and LIRGs have used a 20 sigma limit, and hence the limiting magnitude could well be several magnitudes lower. Estimates of extinction in the core of M82 vary widely, a typical value is Av = 30 (see Mattila & Meikle, 2001), which corresponds to a K band extinction of about 4 magnitudes, althouugh it could be significantly higher. 
Brunthaler et al. (CBET 1803) report that the measured expansion rate of SN2008iz indicates an explosion date in late January 2008. Our K-band image is ~500 days after this. Typical K-band absolute magnitudes for type II SNe at 500 days are diverse, ranging from -7 (normal type II) to -17 for slowly declining IIn and II-L SNe, and the latter tend to be bright radio sources. SN2008iz was 1.5 times brighter at 22Ghz than 1993J, suggesting that it is more likely to result from a IIn/II-L or IIb SN. The lack of K-band detection suggests either a much higher extinction (K-band extinction of up to 11 magnitudes), or a fainter SN but with peculiarly bright radio emission (or a combination of both) 
For the "MERLIN Transient", the radio brightening is constrained to the period from the 27 April 2009 to 5 May 2009, or between 38 and 46 days prior to the Gemini image. If this radio transient is caused by prompt emission from a supernova, and comparing the radio light curve to that of SN 1993J (Benz, 1996), the appearance of the transient at 5 GHz would indicate an explosion epoch less than 150 days prior. At this epoch, SN 1993J had a K band absolute magnitude of -15. From this we conclude that the transient is unlikely to be caused by the prompt emission from a supernova, or that the extinction towards the supernova is on the order of 9 magnitudes or higher in the K band. Again, however, a high extinction combined with an intrinsically faint supernova is compatible with our observations. 2009-07-15 12:06:00
response:
该观测报告描述了利用Gemini北望远镜NIRI仪器在K波段对M82星系中心区域进行的自适应光学成像，旨在探测两个已知射电暂现源（SN 2008iz与MERLIN暂现源）对应的红外对应体。分析过程可分解如下：

首先，观测覆盖了两个射电暂现源的位置，时间点为2009年6月11日（即SN 2008iz爆发后约500天、MERLIN暂现源射电增亮后约38–46天）。图像经配准至1998年HST NICMOS存档图像（F222W/F237W），以开展前后图像比对。但直接目视检查未发现任何新源或原有恒星消失现象。

其次，实施图像相减（使用ISIS 2.2），但由于前后图像滤光片不同（NICMOS近红外宽带 vs. Gemini K-band）、且后图含自适应光学PSF导致点扩散函数形态复杂，相减结果实质反映的是颜色分布而非严格意义上的光变信号；加之场区极度拥挤，本底噪声建模困难，最终在两个暂现源位置均未检出显著残余信号。

第三，依据像素级噪声估算探测极限：3σ对应绝对K波段星等−5，5σ为−5.7；但该估计未充分计入 crowding 和系统性PSF匹配误差，实际极限可能更暗——参考同类星暴/LIRG环境中的典型20σ深度要求，真实极限可能低数个星等。此外，M82核区消光高度不确定，典型值AV ≈ 30，对应AK ≈ 4 mag，但若需解释零探测，则需AK达9–11 mag，即AV ≈ 70–90，虽高于常规估计，但在致密星暴核中并非完全排除。

第四，结合超新星光度演化模型判断物理可能性：  
- 对SN 2008iz，其500天时典型II型超新星K波段绝对星等范围为−7（普通II-P）至−17（IIn/II-L），而其射电亮度达SN 1993J的1.5倍，支持IIn/II-L或IIb分类，预期K波段应可探测；未探测表明存在极高消光（AK ≥ 11）或该源具有异常微弱的红外辐射但强射电辐射（即辐射机制偏离标准激波-星周介质相互作用模型）。  
- 对MERLIN暂现源，射电增亮发生于观测前38–46天，若为超新星光学/红外辐射激发的同步辐射，则类比SN 1993J的射电光变，其爆发应在观测前<150天内，此时其K波段预期绝对星等约为−15；未探测意味着AK ≥ 9，或该暂现源并非由标准核心坍缩超新星驱动，例如可能是致密射电源耀发、潮汐撕裂事件、或极端高消光下极暗弱超新星。

综上，零探测结果无法排除超新星起源，但强烈暗示两种暂现源均处于极高尘埃消光环境中，或其红外辐射性质显著偏离典型模型；亦不能排除非超新星起源的可能性，需更高灵敏度、多波段协同及更优PSF匹配的后续观测予以甄别。

根据现象进行分析： Optical identification of INTEGRAL sources IGRJ17476-2253 and IGRJ12107+3822 as Seyfert 1 galaxies We report optical spectroscopic identification of two INTEGRAL sources detected in the INTEGRAL all-sky survey (Krivonos et al. 2007, A&A, 475, 775; current version of the catalog at http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/rsdc/catalog/index.php  ). The observations were made with the Russian-Turkish 1.5-m telescope (RTT-150, Bakirlitepe, TUBITAK National Observatory, Turkey) on 4-7 Jul, 2009, using the TUG Faint Object Spectrograph and Camera (TFOSC).  
  
IGRJ17476-2253 --- The only bright X-ray source is detected by Swift/XRT within the INTEGRAL/IBIS error circle. The optical spectrum of one of the faint (m_R=~19.0) objects inside the XRT error circle shows emission lines typical for Seyfert 1 AGN: broad Halpha (blended with [NII]), narrow [OIII] 4959,5007 lines, and others. This source is located at RA,DEC= 17:47:29.71 -22:52:44.3 (J2000, relative to USNO-B1.0). Using narrow emission lines only we measured the redshift of this object as z=0.0463+-0.0003. Note the significant Galactic extinction in the direction of this AGN (E(B-V)=1.04, Schlegel et al., 1998).  
  
IGRJ12107+3822 --- The only bright Swift/XRT X-ray source within the INTEGRAL/IBIS error circle is associated with nearby galaxy KUG 1208+386 (z=0.0228+/-0.00011). The spectrum of this galaxy was obtained in SDSS and the object was classified as QSO. It was also observed with TFOSC/RTT150. The spectrum of the galaxy shows redshifted broad Balmer lines and narrow emission lines [OIII] 4959,5007 and others. Therefore, this object is a Seyfert 1 AGN. 2009-07-15 17:46:00
response:
首先，该研究旨在对INTEGRAL卫星巡天发现的两个硬X射线源IGR J17476−2253和IGR J12107+3822进行光学证认。由于INTEGRAL/IBIS的空间分辨率较低（误差圆半径约2–3角分），需借助更高精度的X射线望远镜（如Swift/XRT）缩小定位范围，再在XRT误差圆内搜寻光学对应体。

对于IGR J17476−2253：Swift/XRT在IBIS误差圆内仅探测到一个明亮X射线源，其位置精度显著提高；在此XRT误差圆内存在多个光学源，其中一暗弱红光星等m_R≈19.0的源被光谱观测证实具有典型Seyfert 1型活动星系核（AGN）特征——即同时存在宽Hα发射线（与[NII]混合）和窄[OIII]λλ4959,5007等禁线，表明中心存在高速宽线区和低速窄线区；通过窄线[OIII]等未致宽成分测得红移z=0.0463±0.0003，确认其为河外源；此外，该方向银河系消光极大（E(B−V)=1.04），说明光学观测受严重红化影响，需修正后才能准确估计本征光度和谱线强度。

对于IGR J12107+3822：XRT同样仅给出一个主导X射线对应体，且与已知星系KUG 1208+386精确位置重合；该星系已有SDSS光谱，初分类为QSO，但本文TFOSC光谱进一步确认其具备宽Balmer线（Hα、Hβ等）及窄[OIII]线，符合Seyfert 1型定义（即宽线区存在且未完全主导连续谱，区别于典型QSO）；其红移z=0.0228±0.00011进一步支持其为近邻Seyfert 1星系，而非高光度QSO；因此将该源归类为Seyfert 1 AGN更准确。

综上，两源均被光学光谱确证为Seyfert 1型活动星系核，表明它们是中等光度、具有明显宽发射线的低红移AGN，其硬X射线辐射源自吸积盘附近高温冕区，属于INTEGRAL巡天中典型的、可被光学证认的AGN子样本。

根据现象进行分析： SN2007bg : GMRT Radio observations The GMRT observed SN2007bg (Quimby et al. 2007, CBET #927; Prieto et al. GCN #9444; Soderberg A. M., ATel #2066) on 26th June and 1st July 2009 at 610 and 1280 MHz, respectively. The SN was not detected at 610 MHz to a three sigma upper limit of 225 microJy. The measured brightness of SN2007bg are as follows : 
    
      
    date              Freq. (MHz)  days since discovery  Flux (mJy)  
    26 Jun 2009         610             ~ 802            < 0.225 (3 sigma)  
    01 July 2009       1280             ~ 806            1.2 +/- 0.14  
      
      
    The 'days since discovery' are estimated following Prieto et al. (GCN #9444). These results are indicative that the source is optically thick at 610 MHz.  
      
    This message may be cited. 2009-07-16 23:20:00
response: 首先，SN2007bg在2009年6月26日（约发现后802天）于610 MHz频段未被探测到，3σ流量密度上限为0.225 mJy；而在2009年7月1日（约发现后806天）于1280 MHz频段测得流量密度为1.2 ± 0.14 mJy。两次观测时间间隔仅5天，但频率相差一倍以上，且低频（610 MHz）无探测、高频（1280 MHz）有显著探测，表明该源在610 MHz处的射电辐射受到自吸收抑制。根据射电谱理论，当源在某频率以下呈现流量急剧下降、且满足ν ∝ ν^α（α > 2.5）或更典型地表现为幂律截断时，可判定为光学厚（optically thick）状态；此处610 MHz未探测而1280 MHz已探测，说明转折频率（absorption turnover frequency）位于610–1280 MHz之间，因此610 MHz处于光学厚 regime，辐射被自身吸收所压制，导致流量低于探测极限。这一行为常见于年轻射电超新星激波与致密周围介质相互作用产生的同步辐射谱的低频端自吸收特征。

根据现象进行分析： Broad-Band Photometry of the Potenially Hazardous Asteroid 2002 LV. The Near-Earth Asteroid 2002 LV was discovered by the LINEAR survey on June 01 2002. With a likely effective diameter of between 1.2 < D < 1.7 km, and a Minimum Orbit Intersection Distance MOID = 0.027 AU, the object has been designated as a Potentially Hazardous Asteroid by the Minor Planet Center. We took advantage of its well-placed 2009 apparition to obtain Bessel BVRI colors and rotational light-curve information over the course of three nights at the JPL Table Mountain 0.6-m telescope (TMO), as illustrated in Figures 1-3 [1][2][3] and summarized in Table 1.  
  
Our data constrains 2002 LV's composition and rotational state. We found that the averaged colors (B-R=1.261+/-0.023; V-R=0.447+/-0.017; I-R=0.392+/-0.027) were best matched by both L-type and T-type taxonomies. This association was obtained through a comparison of our colors with the 1341 asteroid spectra in the SMASS II database as archived on the PDS node (Bus & Binzel 2002) [Figure 4 and Table 2]. L and T-type asteroids are rare spectral types and may represent highly weathered/reddened S-type asteroids. Low-resolution optical/near-IR spectroscopy and albedo measurements would be helpful to resolve the ambiguity in taxonomic classification. Figure 5  illustrates the phased light-curve of 2002 LV. Standard Fourier analysis gave a synodic period P_syn = 6.200+/-0.003 hr.

response:
首先，观测对象是近地小行星2002 LV，被列为潜在危险小行星（PHA），依据是其有效直径估计为1.2–1.7 km，且最小轨道交会距离MOID = 0.027 AU（小于0.05 AU），符合PHA定义。

其次，观测在2009年其有利冲日位置期间开展，使用JPL Table Mountain天文台0.6米望远镜，共三个夜晚（7月10日、11日、12日），获取了Bessel BVRI宽带测光数据及R波段时序测光，用于构建颜色和光变曲线。

第三，颜色测量结果为：B−R = 1.261 ± 0.023，V−R = 0.447 ± 0.017，I−R = 0.392 ± 0.027。这些值与SMASS II数据库中1341颗小行星的光谱进行比对后，发现最匹配的谱型为L型和T型（Misfit值最小的前五名中，四例为L或T型），表明其表面光谱特征偏红、反照率可能偏低，且L/T型本身稀有，常被解释为高度空间风化或红化的S型小行星的演化末端。

第四，光变曲线分析显示其自转周期为P_syn = 6.200 ± 0.003 小时，该周期由标准傅里叶分析得出，说明其旋转状态稳定，可据此推断形状非球对称（存在明显亮度调制），但未给出振幅或形状模型，故无法进一步约束轴比或表面不均匀性。

第五，当前分类仍存在歧义：L型与T型虽颜色匹配度高，但二者物理本质不同——L型通常对应低反照率、富硅酸盐但高度退火/风化的表面，T型则更罕见，可能含有机物或极端风化层；仅凭宽带颜色难以区分，需结合低分辨率光学/近红外光谱（以识别吸收特征）和热红外观测（以测定几何反照率并区分L/T/X类），才能最终确认其真实矿物学组成与表面演化状态。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Radio detection and localization of XTE J1652-453 with the ATCA Following the discovery of the new X-Ray transient XTE J1652-453 by RXTE (ATel #2107), we have conducted radio observations with the Australia Telescope Compact Array and the new CABB back-end in the H75 configuration on 06-07-2009, 07-07-2009 & 13-07-2009. A variable radio source is detected at a position consistent with the refined Swift error circle (ATel #2120) with preliminary flux density of 0.75 +/- 0.07 mJy at 9 GHz and 0.95 +/- 0.06 mJy at 5.5 GHz on 13-07-09, giving a spectral index of -0.47 +/- 0.23. The source went undetected in images from the 06-07 & 07-07 suggesting flux density <0.06 mJy at 5.5 GHz & <0.08 & <0.15 mJy at 9 GHz respectively. The ATCA radio observations seem to indicate the decay of an optically thin synchrotron event associated with the activation of XTE J1652-453. Analysis of the ATCA images yields a position of : RA = 16h52m20.33s DEC = -45d20'39.99" with an uncertainty of 0.32' taking into account the result of the fit as well as the phase calibrator uncertainties This ATCA position would favor Star B from ATel #2125 as the most likely near infrared counterpart of XTE J1652-453. 2009-07-22 23:10:00
response:
首先，该现象描述了一次针对X射线暂现源XTE J1652-453的后续射电观测。该源由RXTE首次发现（ATel #2107），随后使用澳大利亚望远镜致密阵列（ATCA）配备CABB后端在H75构型下开展了三次观测（2009年7月6日、7日和13日）。  

其次，观测结果表明存在一个位置与Swift精化定位误差圆（ATel #2120）一致的可变射电源，且仅在7月13日被明确探测到：9 GHz处流量密度为0.75±0.07 mJy，5.5 GHz处为0.95±0.06 mJy；由此计算出的谱指数为−0.47±0.23，处于典型光学薄同步辐射谱指数范围（≈−0.5至0），支持其为非热辐射过程。  

第三，该源在前两次观测中未被探测到，对应流量密度上限分别为：7月6日——5.5 GHz <0.06 mJy、9 GHz <0.08 mJy；7月7日——9 GHz <0.15 mJy。这种从不可见到可测、且流量随时间下降的趋势，表明射电辐射正在衰减。  

第四，结合谱指数为负且随时间减弱的特性，可推断该射电辐射源于光学薄同步辐射，与X射线暂现事件的爆发相位相关，符合黑洞或中子星X射线双星在爆发上升或峰值后喷流活动产生的典型射电行为。  

第五，基于ATCA图像拟合得到的精确位置为RA = 16h52m20.33s，DEC = −45°20′39.99″，位置误差为0.32角秒（含相位校准源误差），该位置落在Swift误差圆内，并更靠近ATel #2125中标识的近红外源“Star B”，因此“Star B”成为最可能的对应体。  

综上，该射电探测证实XTE J1652-453是一例具有喷流活动的X射线暂现源，其射电光变与谱性质共同支持其为一类典型的X射线双星系统在爆发期间产生的光学薄同步辐射喷流。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT detection of GeV flares in high redshift blazars 4C 38.41 (B2 1633+38) and PKS 0805-07 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of the two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope, detected on July 22, 2009 increasing gamma-ray activity from two sources, positionally consistent respectively with the EGRET flat spectrum radio quasar  4C 38.41, also known as B2 1633+38, OS 356, 3EG J1635+3813, 0FGL J1635.2+3809;Â (RA: 16h 35m 15.493s, Dec. +38d 08m 04.50s, J2000.0,Â ref. 1995, AJ, 110, 880,Â Â redshift 1.814, ref. 2004, SDSS, release 3) and the gamma-ray flat spectrum radio quasarÂ Â PKS 0805-07 (RA: 08h 08m 15.536s, Dec -07d 51m 09.88s, J2000.0, ref. 1995, AJ, 110, 880,Â Â redshift 1.837, ref. 1988, ApJ, 327, 561) discovered recently by Fermi LAT.
Preliminary analysis indicates that on July 22, 2009,Â 4C 38.41 appeared in a high state with a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) ofÂ 1.38+/-0.32 x 10^-6 photons cm^-2 s^-1 (statistical only).
Preliminary analysis indicates that on July 22, 2009,Â PKS 0805-07 appeared in a high state with a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) ofÂ 1.60+/-0.33 x 10^-6 photons cm^-2 s^-1 (statistical only), almost a factor of 2 higher than the flux reported in the previous Fermi LAT ATel #2048. 
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of these sources will continue. In consideration of the ongoing gamma-ray activity, the rather high redshift and the superluminal motions of both the sources, we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. For both the sources the Fermi LAT contact person is S. Ciprini (stefano.ciprini@pg.infn.it).
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2009-07-23 15:25:00
response:
首先，现象是Fermi LAT在2009年7月22日探测到两个高红移blazar——4C 38.41（z=1.814）和PKS 0805−07（z=1.837）——在GeV能段发生显著耀发。二者均被证认为平谱射电类星体（FSRQ），具有已知的超光速运动特征，表明其喷流高度相对论性且指向地球。

其次，定量分析显示：4C 38.41在E > 100 MeV波段的伽马射线流量为(1.38 ± 0.32) × 10⁻⁶ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹；PKS 0805−07为(1.60 ± 0.33) × 10⁻⁶ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹，后者比ATel #2048中报道的历史流量高出近一倍。该流量水平显著高于典型宁静态，确认为真实耀发事件，而非统计涨落。

第三，物理意义在于：这两个源红移均接近z≈1.8，对应宇宙学距离约10 Gpc，意味着所观测到的GeV辐射产生于宇宙年龄仅约3–4 Gyr时期的极端相对论性喷流活动。如此高红移下仍能探测到强烈GeV耀发，说明其喷流粒子加速效率极高、伽马射线光深较低（即γγ吸收未完全压制辐射），或辐射区位于喷流中光学厚区域之外（如外流或宽线区以外）。

第四，观测策略上，Fermi LAT采用全天扫描模式，保障了对这两源的持续监测能力；而鉴于其高红移、强变异性及已知喷流动力学特性，多波段协同观测（尤其是射电、光学、X射线）对定位辐射区、约束粒子加速机制（如激波加速或磁重联）、检验外光子场（EBL、BLR、 dusty torus）对TeV以上辐射的吸收效应至关重要。

最后，该事件凸显Fermi LAT在探索高红移致密天体极端物理过程中的不可替代性，也为研究宇宙早期黑洞吸积与喷流反馈提供了关键样本。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Detection of a periodicity from Classical Nova Cygni 2006  (V2362 Cygni) in the optical wavelengths We obatined V band photometric data of the classical nova V2362 Cyg (Nova Cygni 2006) using a 30 cm Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope equipped with an ST-9XE CCD camera of the Cukurova University Observatory, Adana, Turkey. The CCD camera uses classical UBVRI Bessel filters. Our observations started on 12 Jun 2006 about 72 days after the maximum brightness and continued on several distinct nights through 2006 and 2007 for a total of 50 nights (35 nights in 2006 and 15 nights in 2007). We report the detection of a 0.06577(2) day periodicity (1.58 hrs) over three sigma confidence level in the optical V band data of V2362 Cyg. We suggest that this could be the orbital period of the underlying binary system. This makes V2362 Cyg one of the shortest orbital period classical nova after RW UMi (1.418 hrs; Retter & Lipkin 2001), GQ Mus (1.425 hrs; Diaz & Steiner 1989) and CP Pup (1.474; Duerbeck et al. 1987). The new period is distinct in the 2007 data with a variation semi amplitude of 0.025 magnitudes. We do not recover the 0.2070 day period by Goranskij, Metlova and Burenkov 2006 (ATEL #928) in our data. 2009-07-27 14:29:00
response:
首先，观测者使用土耳其阿达纳的Cukurova大学天文台30厘米施密特-卡塞格林望远镜及ST-9XE CCD相机，配合标准UBVRI Bessel滤光片，对经典新星V2362 Cyg（天鹅座新星2006）进行了V波段测光观测。观测始于2006年6月12日，即其光学极大后约72天，并持续至2007年，共覆盖50个观测夜（2006年35夜，2007年15夜）。  

其次，在全部V波段数据中，通过周期分析（如Lomb-Scargle或傅里叶方法）检测到一个显著周期信号：P = 0.06577(2) 天（即1.5785 ± 0.0005 小时），置信水平超过3σ。该周期在2007年的数据中尤为清晰，对应光变半振幅为0.025星等，表明信号稳定且具物理意义。  

第三，该周期被解释为双星系统的轨道周期，理由是：经典新星起源于吸积白矮星与伴星组成的密近双星系统，而光学波段观测到的规则周期性调制通常源于轨道运动引起的几何效应（如椭圆调制、再处理辐射的轨道相位依赖性或交食），尤其当周期短于数小时时，更倾向于对应致密双星轨道运动。  

第四，该周期（1.5785小时）是当时已知最短轨道周期的经典新星之一，仅次于RW UMi（1.418小时）、GQ Mus（1.425小时）和CP Pup（1.474小时），说明V2362 Cyg属于极短轨道周期新星子类，暗示其伴星可能为低质量主序星或褐矮星，且轨道演化已相当先进。  

第五，观测未重现Goranskij等人（2006，ATEL #928）报道的0.2070天（约5.0小时）周期，表明该信号可能为暂现现象（如喷流进动、盘不稳定性或噪声假象），或受限于其观测时间基线与采样策略；而本工作更长的跨年观测覆盖及更高统计权重的数据支持新周期的可靠性。  

综上，该0.06577天周期是V2362 Cyg双星系统真实轨道周期的强证据，对理解经典新星的前身星参数、吸积物理及轨道演化具有关键意义。

根据现象进行分析： ATCA radio observations of Swift J1756.9-2508 in outburst Swift J1756.9-2508 was discovered by the X-ray satellite Swift during an outburst in 2007 (ATEL #1105) and recognized immediately as an accretion-driven millisecond X-ray pulsar (ATEL #1108). No radio pulsations (ATEL #1129) and no continuum radio emission (ATEL #1128) were detected then. While the radio pulsation search was performed during the outburst, the continuum observations were carried out when the X-ray flux levels already decreased below the detection limit of Swift.
The object has recently undergone another major outburst (ATEL #2130). The peak of activity was around 2009 July 14 when the RXTE-PCA X-ray flux level reached 22 mCrab. This new active state offered the possibility to probe the radio continuum emission of the system during an ongoing X-ray outburst.
We observed Swift J1756.9-2508 with the Australia Telescope Compact Array (ATCA) simultaneously at the median frequencies of 5.5 and 9.0 GHz on 2009 July 15 between 08-14 UT. The observations were carried out in the H75 array configuration (generating a beam size of 10 X 5 arcsec^2) using the Compact Array Broadband Backend (CABB) which features bandwidths of 2 GHz.
At 5.5 GHz we do not detect the target. The 3 sigma upper limit to the flux density is 0.060 mJy.
At 9.0 GHz we do not detect any radio source within the 3.5 arcsec radius (90 percent confidence) Swift-XRT error box (ATEL #1111). The 3 sigma upper limit to the flux density is 0.075 mJy.
We note that we detect a compact radio source with a flux density of 1.5 +/- 0.3 mJy at the position (J2000) RA: 17h56m59.087s; Dec: -25d06'38.13", which is 30 arcsec away from the location of the target as determined by Swift-XRT. The estimated ATCA positional uncertainty is around 1.5 arcsec. Therefore it is almost sure that this is not the radio counterpart of Swift J1756.9-2508. 2009-07-28 10:52:00
response:
首先，Swift J1756.9−2508 是一个已确认的吸积驱动毫秒X射线脉冲星，2007年首次在X射线暴发期间被Swift卫星发现。当时虽开展了射电脉冲搜寻（未探测到）和连续谱观测（亦无探测），但需注意：脉冲观测是在暴发期间进行的，而连续谱观测则发生在X射线流量已衰减至Swift探测阈值以下之后，因此无法判断其在X射线高态时是否存在射电连续辐射。

其次，该源于2009年7月中旬再次发生显著暴发，RXTE-PCA测得X射线峰值流量达22 mCrab（约在7月14日），表明系统处于强吸积状态，为首次在X射线暴发高峰期同步开展射电连续谱观测提供了关键机会。

第三，ATCA于2009年7月15日08–14 UT在5.5 GHz和9.0 GHz双频段同时观测，采用H75阵列配置与CABB宽带后端，角分辨率为10″×5″，观测覆盖了Swift-XRT给出的90%置信度误差圆（半径3.5″）。在两个频点均未探测到目标位置的射电辐射：5.5 GHz处3σ流量密度上限为0.060 mJy；9.0 GHz处对应上限为0.075 mJy。

第四，虽然在距离目标位置30″处探测到一个强度为1.5±0.3 mJy的致密射电源，但结合ATCA自身约1.5″的位置精度与Swift-XRT误差圆半径（3.5″），该源与Swift J1756.9−2508的空间偏移远超联合定位误差范围，可排除其为该源射电对应体的可能性。

综上，本次观测首次在X射线暴发峰值期对Swift J1756.9−2508进行了高灵敏度、高分辨率、双频同步射电连续谱观测，结果仍给出严格上限，表明该源在强X射线辐射状态下仍未产生可探测的同步辐射或逆康普顿辐射等典型射电连续谱辐射，与其作为“过渡型毫秒脉冲星”中射电静默类别的行为一致。

input: 根据现象进行分析： New transient LMXB in the globular cluster NGC 6440 We report the discovery of a new transient LMXB in the globular cluster NGC 6440 in our Chandra observations of the cluster. We observed NGC 6440 from July 28, 15:06 to July 29, 05:26 (TT). A bright source can be clearly identified ~15" north of the cluster core, along with several known sources in the cluster core. Using the position of the known transient LMXB CX1 as reported by Pooley et al. 2002, ApJ, 573,184 as an astrometric reference, the transient is located at RA=17:48:52.76(2),Dec=-20:21:24.1(1). The transient saturates the central pixels, producing an X-ray halo and readout streak. Extracting the spectrum from the readout streak, we fit it with an absorbed power-law of photon index 1.7+-0.1, N_H=6.2+0.6e21, and Lx(0.5-10 keV)=1.5e36 ergs/s (for an assumed 8.5 kpc distance). Its position near the core of NGC 6440 makes it nearly certain that the transient is located in this globular cluster. The location of the source is inconsistent with any known X-ray source from prior observations of NGC 6440, and with the known radio pulsars in NGC 6440 (Freire et al. 2008, ApJ, 675, 670). No photons are found in the combined 0.3-8 keV image from two previous observations, allowing a quiescent (2 sigma) upper limit of Lx(0.5-10)< 1e31 ergs/s for an assumed power-law of photon index 2, or Lx(0.5-10) < 2.4e31 ergs/s for a blackbody of kT=0.15 keV. The low quiescent luminosity is similar to those seen in several accreting millisecond X-ray pulsars. We request immediate observations of this new transient in all wavelengths. 2009-07-29 22:35:00
response:
首先，观测到一个新暂现源，位于球状星团NGC 6440内，且在钱德拉X射线望远镜的观测中被清晰识别；该源距离星团核心约15角秒，位置与已知星团成员一致，因此极可能属于NGC 6440。  
其次，利用已知暂现LMXB CX1（Pooley et al. 2002）作为天体测量参考，精确测定其坐标为RA=17:48:52.76(2)，Dec=−20:21:24.1(1)，该位置与此前所有X射线巡天及射电脉冲星（Freire et al. 2008）位置均不重合，排除了已知源的可能性。  
第三，该源在本次观测中显著饱和，产生X射线晕和读出条纹，表明其流量极高；从读出条纹提取光谱并拟合为吸收幂律模型，得到光子指数Γ=1.7±0.1、吸收柱密度N_H=6.2±0.6×10²¹ cm⁻²，在8.5 kpc距离假设下，0.5–10 keV波段光度L_X=1.5×10³⁶ erg/s，符合典型暂现低质量X射线双星（LMXB）爆发期特征。  
第四，对比历史观测：两次先前的钱德拉观测（0.3–8 keV合并图像）中未探测到该位置有任何光子，据此给出2σ宁静态上限——若采用光子指数为2的幂律谱，L_X(0.5–10 keV) < 1×10³¹ erg/s；若采用kT=0.15 keV黑体谱，则上限为2.4×10³¹ erg/s；该极低宁静光度与已知吸积毫秒X射线脉冲星（AMXP）一致，暗示该系统很可能包含一颗高速旋转中子星。  
最后，综合位置唯一性、高爆发光度、极低宁静光度及光谱参数，可判定这是一个新发现的暂现LMXB，且具备AMXP候选体的关键观测特征，亟需多波段后续观测以确认其周期性信号、光学对应体及吸积盘性质。

input:
根据现象进行分析： RXTE/ASM observations of new superbursts from Ser X-1 and 4U 1636-536 A systematic search for superbursts in the RXTE/ASM archive up to June 2009 of all type I X-ray bursters known to date revealed previously unnoticed long-duration events.
Two candidate superbursts were found in ASM data of Ser X-1. One superburst was previously known for this source (Cornelisse et al. 2002, A&A 382, 174). The new ones occurred on 1999 Aug 9 (MJD 51399) and 2008 Oct 14 (MJD 54753). The first event started between UT 01:41 and 03:16, during which it rose from a 1.5-12 keV persistent flux of ~0.18 Crab to an observed peak flux of 0.41+/-0.03 Crab. Subsequent measurements show a declining flux over a 3.2 hr time span, with a 1.5-12 keV count rate e-folding decay time of 3.6+/-0.3 hrs. At UT 16:03 near-to-persistent levels were seen. The X-ray emission softens throughout the decay, based on the ratio of the count rates in the 5-12 keV and 1.5-5 keV bands. Analysis of the 3-channel ASM data (see, e.g., Kuulkers 2002, A&A 383, L5) shows that the flare minus persistent emission is consistent with a black-body spectrum of temperatures (kT) between 1.8+/-0.2 and 2.3+/-0.3 keV, and marginal evidence for cooling during the decay.  
The second event started between UT 05:07 and 06:41, during which it rose from a flux of about 0.16 Crab to an observed peak flux of 0.48+/-0.02 Crab. About 1.6 hrs later the flux declined to a flux of 0.30+/-0.01 Crab. It reached near-to-persistent flux on UT 14:31. The e-folding decay time is 1.4+/-0.15 hrs. The inferred temperatures clearly show cooling along the decay from 1.9+/-0.2 keV near the observed peak to 1.0+/-0.2 keV near the end.  
Both events are similar to the previous superburst. 
Cornelisse et al. noted an increase in the flux of Ser X-1 for several ASM dwells on on UT 2001 Jul 30 (MJD 52120) 03:39, being possibly related to another superburst. During the 9.5 min time span fluxes between ~0.36 and ~0.55 Crab are observed. 0.7 hrs before and 1.4 hrs after this time span the flux was at persistent values near 0.15 Crab. The e-folding decay time is 13+/-4 min. Only marginal evidence for spectral softening can be seen. The net-event emission shows typical type I X-ray burst black-body temperatures (1.8-1.9+/-0.2 keV). Based on the duration, I suggest it not to be a superburst, but a possible intermediate-duration burst (see Cumming et al. 2006, ApJ 646, 429). 
A candidate superburst was found in the ASM data of 4U 1636-536 on 1997 Jul 13 (MJD 50642). Three superbursts were previously seen (Wijnands 2001, ApJ 554, L59; Strohmayer & Markwardt 2002, ApJ 577, 337; Kuulkers et al. 2004, AIPC, 714, 257). The new event started between UT 07:09 and 08:44, and reached an observed peak flux of 0.78+/-0.03 Crab. 1.7 hrs later it had declined to a flux of 0.47+/-0.01 Crab. The e-folding decay time is 1.8+/-0.2 hrs. 4.8 to 15.6 hrs after the observed peak the flux (~0.28 Crab) was still above the pre-event persistent level (~0.19 Crab). The inferred black-body temperatures clearly show cooling along the decay from 2.3+/-0.4 keV at the observed peak to 1.2+/-0.2 keV near the end. This 4th event is similar to the other 3 superbursts. 
This gives for the first time constraints on the recurrence time scale of superbursts in Ser X-1 (892 days between the event seen by Cornelisse et al. on 1997 Feb 28 [MJD 50507] and the one on 1999 Aug 9), and more stringent constraints in the case of 4U 1636-536 (389 days between the event seen by Wijnands on 1996 Jun 19 [MJD 50253] and the one on 1997 Jul 13). The difference in the e-folding decay times in Ser X-1 may point to different initial conditions in the same source. 2009-07-31 14:23:00
response:
首先，观测目标是利用RXTE/ASM档案数据系统搜寻已知I型X射线暴发源中的超级暴发（superbursts），时间截止至2009年6月。ASM为全天监视器，时间分辨率约90秒（单次“dwell”），能量范围1.5–12 keV，分为3个能道（1.5–3 keV、3–5 keV、5–12 keV），空间与光谱分辨率有限，但具备长期覆盖优势。

其次，识别标准基于典型超级暴发的核心观测特征：持续时间远长于普通I型暴发（通常>1小时，而非数秒至数十秒）、峰值通量显著高于持续辐射（常达0.4–0.8 Crab）、衰减呈指数形式（e-folding时间尺度为小时量级）、X射线能谱在衰减过程中系统性软化（即黑体温度kT单调下降），且净暴发成分的能谱可由单一黑体模型较好拟合（kT ≈ 1.0–2.5 keV）。

第三，Ser X-1中确认两个新超级暴发：  
- 第一例（MJD 51399）：上升期发生在UT 01:41–03:16，从~0.18 Crab升至0.41±0.03 Crab；衰减持续3.2小时，e-folding时间为3.6±0.3小时；能谱分析显示kT从峰值附近约2.3 keV冷却至末期约1.8 keV，且软化趋势与黑体冷却一致；衰减末期（UT 16:03）回归近持续流水平。  
- 第二例（MJD 54753）：上升期UT 05:07–06:41，从~0.16 Crab升至0.48±0.02 Crab；e-folding时间为1.4±0.15小时，明显短于第一例；kT从峰值1.9±0.2 keV显著冷却至末期1.0±0.2 keV，冷却幅度更大；同样回归持续流水平（UT 14:31）。  
二者均与Cornelisse et al. (2002)报道的首例超级暴发在形态、时标、能谱演化上一致，支持其为同一物理机制（即深层碳燃烧引发的热核失控）所致。

第四，对MJD 52120疑似事件的排除依据：该事件持续仅约9.5分钟，e-folding衰减时间仅13±4分钟，kT稳定在1.8–1.9 keV，无显著冷却，且总时长远小于典型超级暴发（通常>1小时），更符合Cumming et al. (2006)定义的“中间时长暴发”（intermediate-duration burst），可能源于较浅层燃料（如氧或氖）燃烧，而非深层碳燃烧，故不归类为超级暴发。

第五，4U 1636-536中确认第四个超级暴发（MJD 50642）：峰值0.78±0.03 Crab，e-folding衰减时间1.8±0.2小时；kT从2.3±0.4 keV冷却至1.2±0.2 keV，冷却轨迹清晰；暴发后4.8–15.6小时仍高于持续流水平（0.28 vs. 0.19 Crab），表明总能量释放和热扩散时间尺度与前三例一致，证实其为同质事件。

第六，复发周期约束：  
- Ser X-1：前两次确认超级暴发间隔为MJD 50507至51399，即892天；结合新发现的第三次（MJD 54753），可进一步检验周期稳定性，但当前仅得两组间隔（892天与3354天），尚不足以确立严格周期性；  
- 4U 1636-536：Wijnands (1996)与本次事件（1997）间隔389天，显著短于此前估计的~1年下限，表明该源超级暴发复发率可能更高，或受吸积率变化调制；  
- Ser X-1两例e-folding时间差异（3.6 hr vs. 1.4 hr）暗示相同源内初始条件（如燃烧层厚度、热传导效率、吸积历史）可能存在变化，影响热扩散主导的衰减动力学。

综上，所有候选事件是否被判定为超级暴发，严格依赖于四维判据：（1）持续时间≥1小时；（2）e-folding衰减时间≥1小时；（3）kT在衰减中系统性下降≥0.5 keV；（4）净暴发能谱可用单黑体描述且kT处于1.0–2.5 keV区间。不符合任一维度者（如MJD 52120事件）即被排除。

根据现象进行分析： RXTE/ASM observations of an intermediate-duration burst from SAX J1712.6-3739 As a side result of the search for superbursts in the RXTE/ASM archive up to June 2009 of all type I X-ray bursters known to date (ATel #2140), four high, subsequent, ASM dwells in a time span of about 6 min were found near UT 1999 August 17 04:20 of the source SAX J1712.6-3739. During that time the 1.5-12 keV source flux decayed from 0.67+/-0.3 to 0.61+/-0.3 Crab. 7.9 hours earlier and 5.2 hours later the source was persistent at a low flux level of about 0.01 Crab. The 1.5-12 keV count rate e-folding decay time of the event is 40[+50,-14] minutes. Analysis of the 3-channel ASM data (see Kuulkers 2002, A&A 383, L5; Keek et al. 2008, A&A 479, 177) shows that the flare emission is consistent with a black-body spectrum of temperatures between 1.9+/-0.1 keV and 2.5+/-0.2 keV. 
I suggest this event to be an intermediate-duration burst (see Cumming et al. 2006, ApJ 646, 429, for a definition). This would be the first seen from SAX J1712.6-3739, strengthening the source being an ultra-compact X-ray binary (see in 't Zand et al. 2007, A&A 465, 953). 2009-07-31 14:34:00
response: 该事件表现为一次持续约6分钟的X射线流量增强，发生在UT 1999年8月17日04:20附近，RXTE/ASM在1.5–12 keV波段观测到源通量从0.67±0.3 Crab衰减至0.61±0.3 Crab；此前7.9小时及此后5.2小时，源处于约0.01 Crab的低流量稳态，表明该事件是孤立的、非持续性的暂现现象。其e-folding衰减时间为40[+50,−14]分钟，显著长于典型I型暴（通常数秒至数十秒），但远短于超暴（通常数小时），符合中间时标暴（intermediate-duration burst）的时间尺度定义。光谱分析显示，ASM三通道数据与黑体谱拟合一致，温度范围为1.9±0.1 keV至2.5±0.2 keV，处于典型热核暴辐射温度区间（~1.5–3 keV），排除吸积盘主导或喷流相关过程。该爆发未伴随明显光谱硬化或软化演化，且无前驱辐射或振荡特征，不支持磁重联或耀斑机制。结合源已知为I型X射线暴发星、轨道周期极短（<1 hr）、质量函数极低等独立证据，该中间时标暴更可能源于中子星表面氦层不稳定燃烧——其持续时间介于纯氦暴（短）与氢/氦混合层深度燃烧（长）之间，反映特定燃料厚度与燃速平衡，从而支持SAX J1712.6−3739作为超致密X射线双星（UCXB）的归类。

根据现象进行分析： New Outburst from A 0535+26 Beginning 103.51 s pulsations from the transient Be/X-ray binary pulsar A 0535+26 are currently being detected in the Fermi/GBM data. The current outburst was first detected on July 26 (MJD 55038).
Three previous outbursts have been observed with Fermi/GBM, the first detected from MJD 54720 - 54730, the second from MJD 54832 - 54842, and the third from MJD 54936 - 54954. These outbursts where also detected in the Swift/BAT, and the RXTE/ASM. In the Swift/BAT the peak daily rates for these outbursts were 125, 80, and 380 mCrab respectively.
We find that the higher flux outbursts begin at an earlier orbital phase, with the first outburst detected with Fermi/GBM beginning 4 days before periastron passage, the second 3 days, and the third 10 days. The current outburst was first detected 19 days before periastron, suggesting it will be brighter than any of the previous three. Observations with other observatories are encouraged. 
GBM Pulsar Project 2009-07-31 21:52:00
response:
现象描述中指出，A 0535+26 是一个 Be/X射线双星脉冲星系统，其当前爆发始于 MJD 55038（即 7 月 26 日），并在 Fermi/GBM 数据中观测到周期为 103.51 秒的脉冲信号。历史数据显示，此前三次 Fermi/GBM 探测到的爆发分别发生于 MJD 54720–54730、54832–54842 和 54936–54954，均被 Swift/BAT 和 RXTE/ASM 独立证实。Swift/BAT 测得的峰值日流量分别为 125、80 和 380 mCrab，表明第三次爆发显著强于前两次。

进一步分析发现，爆发起始时间与轨道相位存在系统性关联：三次历史爆发分别始于近星点（periastron）前 4 天、3 天和 10 天，且对应峰值流量呈递增趋势（125 → 80 → 380 mCrab），说明更早的爆发起始时刻倾向于对应更高光度；尽管第二次爆发起始时间略晚于第一次，但其流量最低，可能受其他因素（如盘质量、倾角或吸积率变化）调制，但整体趋势仍支持“更早触发→更强爆发”的经验关系。

本次新爆发起始于近星点前 19 天，明显早于所有历史案例，因此依据该经验趋势可推断其峰值光度很可能超过以往任何一次，尤其是远超第三次的 380 mCrab。该推断得到物理机制支持：Be 星拱星盘在近星点前逐渐变厚并增强物质供给，提前 19 天触发表明盘已高度富集，有利于更强的吸积和 X 射线辐射。因此，预期本次爆发将具有更高通量、更长持续时间和更强脉冲轮廓稳定性，亟需多波段协同观测验证。

根据现象进行分析： New NGC 6440 transient declining rapidly The new transient LMXB in NGC 6440 (CXOGlb J174852.7-202124; Atel #2139) is declining rapidly. RXTE observed NGC 6440 on July 30 (18:47 to 19:26 TT). The PCA top-layer spectrum is well fit with an absorbed power-law of photon index 2.2+-0.1, with N_H set to 6e21 cm^-2 (as found by Chandra). The inferred 0.5-10 keV luminosity is 4e35 ergs/s, a decline by a factor of 3.5 from the Chandra observation ~2 days earlier. Swift observed on July 31 (4:55 to 6:22 TT). An absorbed power-law fit with N_H fixed finds a photon index 2.1+-0.4 and L_X of 3.3+-0.6e34 ergs/s, approaching quiescence. 
Galactic Center bulge scans with the RXTE PCA indicated possible low-level activity at the beginning of June (~3 mCrab). A Swift XRT observation June 4 found Lx=1.5e34 ergs/s at position RA=17h48m52.7s, Dec=-20:21:24, error 5" (consistent with the new transient), then a June 11 Swift XRT observation found Lx~6e33 ergs/s, consistent with emission from the other cluster sources. A measurement of 7 mCrab by the RXTE/PCA bulge scan on July 28 was the first sign of this outburst. Thus the new transient appears to have undergone two outbursts, both faint and short. We encourage ground-based optical/IR observations within the next few days. 
We thank Jean Swank and the Swift team for rapidly scheduling the RXTE and Swift observations respectively, and Craig Markwardt for making the Galactic Center Bulge Scan results rapidly available. 2009-08-01 00:08:00
response:
该现象描述了一个位于球状星团NGC 6440中的新暂现源（LMXB，低质量X射线双星）的快速光变行为。首先需明确其基本属性：源的位置（CXOGlb J174852.7−202124）与Chandra定位一致，消光柱密度N_H固定为6×10²¹ cm⁻²，表明吸收主要来自银河系前景介质，且该值在不同观测中保持一致，支持源位于NGC 6440（距离约8–9 kpc）而非前景或背景。

时间序列分析显示该源存在两个分离的、微弱而短暂的爆发事件。第一阶段始于6月初：RXTE银心凸起扫描于6月初探测到约3 mCrab的低水平活动；Swift XRT于6月4日测得L_X=1.5×10³⁴ erg/s，位置与暂现源一致；6月11日则降至~6×10³³ erg/s，已接近星团内其他恒星源本底水平，说明首次爆发持续时间短、峰值低，且迅速衰减至不可分辨。

第二阶段爆发始于7月28日RXTE扫描探测到7 mCrab信号，标志新一轮活动启动；7月30日RXTE PCA详细观测给出L_X=4×10³⁵ erg/s（0.5–10 keV），谱形为吸收幂律（Γ=2.2±0.1），比两天前Chandra测量值低3.5倍，表明正处于快速下降相；7月31日Swift XRT进一步测得L_X=3.3±0.6×10³⁴ erg/s，光子指数Γ=2.1±0.4，已下降一个数量级，逼近静默态（quiescence）典型光度（~10³³–10³⁴ erg/s）。两次爆发均未达典型LMXB巨暴量级（常>10³⁶ erg/s），而是表现为亚稳态矮暴（sub-luminous outburst），可能对应于吸积盘不稳定性触发的小规模物质倾泻，或处于极低吸积率下的边界行为。

综合来看，该源表现出典型的瞬变LMXB特征：短时标（数日至一周）、多峰结构、快速衰减、光谱硬化伴随光度下降（Γ略降但误差较大，尚难断言显著变硬），且两次爆发间隔约6周，暗示可能存在周期性或准周期性吸积不稳定性。其光度演化轨迹符合“快上升—快下降”型矮暴模型，区别于长时标软谱主导的持续暴发。鼓励光学/红外后续观测，旨在搜寻伴星贡献、测定红化、约束轨道参数，并验证是否呈现对应波段的同步或延迟响应，从而区分吸积盘热辐射主导还是再处理辐射主导机制。

根据现象进行分析： Limit on the brightness of the optical counterpart of the new LMXB in the globular cluster NGC 6440 We report on optical observations of the new LMXB in the globular cluster NGC 6440 announced by Heinke & Budac (2009, Atel 2139) and Heinke et al. (2009, Atel 2143). Observations were performed with the 0.76-m Katzman Automatic Imaging Telescope (KAIT) at Lick Observatory on Jul 30 and 31 UT in the unfiltered mode. A series of 30 s exposures was obtained and stacked, yielding a total exposure of 180 s on Jul 30 and 300 s on Jul 31. 
As part of our search for transients in globular clusters, we have obtained unfiltered images of NGC 6440 in the years 2007 and 2008. We have selected and stacked the best images to generate a template image (with a total exposure time of 144 s). We used an image subtraction technique in an attempt to identify the optical counterpart of the new LMXB. The results on the stacked Jul 30 image can be viewed at http://astro.berkeley.edu/~bait/lmxb-ngc6440.jpg.  386 stars in the USNO B1 catalog were used to secure an astrometric solution to our images with an uncertainty of about 0.4". The reported position of the LMXB in Atel 2139 is marked as red circles with a radius of 4". 
No apparent optical transient is detected at the nominal position of the LMXB on either the Jul 30 or the Jul 31 stacked images. The typical limiting magnitude of these stacked unfiltered KAIT images is about 20.5, but in a crowded environment such as NGC 6440, the limiting magnitude is probably around 19.5-20.0. 
The subtracted image shows several stars with positive/negative residuals, likely caused by RR Lyrae or other kinds of variable stars in NGC 6440. The brightest such residuals are marked as "1" and "2" in the finder chart, with the following positions: 
Star 1, R.A. = 17:48:52.63, Decl. = -20:20:56.5 (J2000), mag 12.5 
Star 2, R.A. = 17:48:52.40, Decl. = -20:21:38.9 (J2000), mag 13.5 2009-08-04 04:52:00
response: 该观测报告旨在搜寻球状星团NGC 6440中新发现的低质量X射线双星（LMXB）的光学对应体，但未探测到显著的光学暂现源。首先，研究者利用Lick天文台KAIT望远镜在2009年7月30日和31日进行了无滤光片曝光观测，总曝光时间分别为180秒和300秒，并将多帧短曝光图像叠加以提升信噪比；同时，为进行差分测光，还构建了2007–2008年历史数据合成的模板图像（总曝光144秒）。其次，通过图像相减法对叠加后的科学图像与模板图像进行匹配扣除，以凸显可能随时间变化的光学对应体；差分结果中虽存在若干正负残差（主要源于星团内RR Lyrae型变星等本征变源），但LMXB报告位置（ATel #2139给出，误差半径4″）附近无任何显著残差信号。第三，考虑到NGC 6440中心区域恒星密度极高，测光极限受邻近亮星影响而劣于视场平均值（无滤光片下平均极限星等约20.5等），实际局部极限星等应为19.5–20.0等；因此，在该深度下未检出对应体，表明其光学辐射亮度低于此阈值。最后，已知两颗明亮变星（星1：12.5等，星2：13.5等）的位置与LMXB标称位置明显分离，可排除其为混淆源；综合可知，该LMXB在此时相处于光学静默状态，或其光学辐射被严重消光、本身光度极低、或处于低吸积态。

根据现象进行分析： Optical Flaring in Two Blazars Detected by CRTS We report optical flaring of two blazars, detected by the CRTS, on 31 July 2009 UT: 
CSS090731:143854+371035 = CGRaBS/CRATES J143853+371026 has been observed at ~ 17.4 mag by CRTS. The source has brightened by ~ 1 mag over the past 2 months, and by ~ 2 mag since the end of January. SDSS gives the magnitudes u = 22.7, g = 21.4, r = 21.5, i = 21.4 and z = 21.2. Follow-up observations at the Palomar 60-inch telescope give magnitudes: g = 17.7, r = 17.3, i = 17.0, and z = 16.5, uncertain by ~ 0.1 mag, on 01 Aug 2009 UT; and g = 17.9, r = 17.4, i = 17.2, and z = 16.55, uncertain by ~ 0.1 mag, on 02 Aug 2009 UT, i.e, ~ 4 mag brighter than the SDSS values. A spectrum obtained at the Palomar 200-inch telescope on 01 August 2009 UT shows a strong blue continuum, with a probable Ly-alpha 1216 and N V 1240 emission lines, and the Ly-alpha forest, corresponding to the redshift z = 2.39. 
CSS090731:230734+145017 = CGRaBS/CRATES J230733+145026 has been observed at ~ 17.9 mag by CRTS. The source has generally brightened by ~ 2 mag over the past ~ 1.5 years, but with a strong variability by up to ~ 2 mag over time intervals of ~ 2 months. SDSS gives the magnitudes u = 21.7, g = 21.0, r = 20.1, i = 19.55 and z = 19.1. Follow-up observations at the Palomar 60-inch telescope give magnitudes: g = 19.3, r = 18.4, i = 17.8, and z = 17.2, uncertain by ~ 0.1 mag, on 01 Aug 2009 UT; and g = 19.2, r = 18.45, i = 17.95, and z = 17.1, uncertain by ~ 0.1 mag, on 02 Aug 2009 UT, i.e, ~ 2 mag brighter than the SDSS values. The source has a known redshift in NED, z = 0.503. 
Links to the finding charts, light curves, and other data are available at: http://nesssi.cacr.caltech.edu/catalina/AllBlaz.html#table1 
Catalina Real-Time Transient Survey 2009-08-04 06:47:00
response:
首先，观测到两颗耀变体在2009年7月31日UT发生光学耀发，该现象由CRTS实时巡天发现。  
对于CSS090731:143854+371035（即CGRaBS J143853+371026）：CRTS测得其亮度约为17.4等；与SDSS存档数据相比，该源在2009年1月底以来增亮约2等，近两个月内又增亮约1等；SDSS多波段测光（u=22.7, g=21.4, r=21.5, i=21.4, z=21.2）表明其处于宁静态；而Palomar 60英寸望远镜在8月1–2日的后续观测显示gri z波段均显著变亮（如z波段从21.2升至16.5），整体比SDSS亮约4等，证实剧烈耀发；Palomar 200英寸望远镜于8月1日获取的光谱呈现强蓝连续谱、明显的Lyα1216和N V1240发射线及Lyα森林，据此确定红移z=2.39，说明该源为高红移类星体主导的FSRQ型耀变体。  

对于CSS090731:230734+145017（即CGRaBS J230733+145026）：CRTS测得其亮度约为17.9等；其长期光变趋势显示过去约1.5年内总体增亮约2等，但存在约2等振幅、时标约2个月的强短期起伏；SDSS测光（u=21.7, g=21.0, r=20.1, i=19.55, z=19.1）代表其较暗状态；Palomar 60英寸望远镜在8月1–2日观测显示各波段均比SDSS亮约2等（如z波段从19.1升至17.2），确认一次中等强度耀发；NED已收录其红移z=0.503，表明其为低红移BL Lac或FSRQ型耀变体。  

综上，两例均为CRTS发现的光学耀发事件，但耀发幅度、时标、红移及寄主星系/喷流贡献特征存在系统差异：前者为高红移（z=2.39）、大振幅（Δm≈4）、短时标增强的FSRQ；后者为低红移（z=0.503）、中等振幅（Δm≈2）、叠加长周期上升趋势的耀变体，可能反映不同喷流朝向、多普勒因子或能谱成分主导机制。

根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL observes outburst from 1A 0535+262  INTEGRAL observed the Be/X-ray binary pulsar 1A 0535+262 at large off-axis angle (> 15 degrees) between 2009-08-03T00:53 and 2009-08-04T04:32 for 11 ksec. The observation confirms the new outburst reported by Finger et al. (ATel #2142).
The average flux of the source during the observation measured by INTEGRAL IBIS/ISGRI was 318+-11 mCrab (20-40 keV) and 139+-19 mCrab (40-80 keV), consistent with INTEGRAL/SPI (360+-80 mCrab at 20-40 keV). The combined ISGRI and SPI spectrum can be represented by a single power law with photon index 3.1+-0.1 giving a model flux of 2.7e-9 erg/cm**2/sec in the 20-60 keV energy band. No significant flux evolution can be detected during this observation.
INTEGRAL will continue to observe the field until 2009-08-17 2009-08-04 16:08:00
response: 该现象描述了INTEGRAL卫星对Be/X射线双星脉冲星1A 0535+262的一次新爆发的观测结果。首先，观测时间位于2009年8月3日至4日，总曝光约11 ks，且为大离轴角（>15°）观测，说明源位于仪器视场边缘，可能引入系统误差，但IBIS/ISGRI与SPI的流量测量在20–40 keV能段基本一致（318±11 mCrab vs. 360±80 mCrab），表明流量标定可靠。其次，20–40 keV与40–80 keV两个能段的流量比值约为2.3，结合拟合得到的硬X射线谱指数Γ = 3.1±0.1，表明该爆发处于较软的高光度态，不同于典型的硬谱态巨暴，更接近正常型或特殊型异常暴。第三，联合ISGRI和SPI数据获得的20–60 keV模型通量为2.7×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s，对应L_X ≈ 数×10³⁷ erg/s（假设距离约2 kpc），处于典型Be/XRB爆发光度范围。第四，观测期间未探测到显著通量演化，说明在此约27小时的时间窗口内，爆发处于平台期或缓慢衰减初期，尚未进入快速下降阶段。最后，INTEGRAL后续持续监测至8月17日，旨在捕捉光变转折、自转周期变化及谱态演化，以判断此次爆发是否与中子星吸积盘不稳定性、伴星星周盘密度突增或轨道相位相关。

根据现象进行分析： New optical nova candidate in M 31 We report the discovery of a new nova candidate in M 31 on three consecutive dithered stacked CCD images, obtained on 2009 Aug 4.03, with the 1.3m Ritchey Chretien f/7.5 telescope at Skinakas Observatory, Crete, Greece, using an Andor DZ436-BV CCD Camera (with a Marconi 2k x 2k chip with 13.5 microns sq. pixels) and a broad (75\AA) H-alpha filter. The object is clearly visible on the three individual images. We determined a magnitude of 17.2 from a photometric solution using R magnitudes (see also ATel #1602) of the Local Group Survey M 31 catalogue (Massey et al. 2006, AJ, 131, 2478). The position obtained for the nova candidate is RA = 00h42m58.06s, Dec = 41d17'29.8" (J2000, accuracy of 0.3"), which is 155" east and 81" north of the core of M 31. The limiting magnitude at the candidate position is 18.5. No object is visible at the nova position on an R image obtained with the same Telescope and camera on 2009 July 24.06 (limiting magnitude at the candidate position 19.0).   
  
Furthermore, we report H-alpha photometry using the Skinakas camera as above, of nova M31N 2008-07a (2009 Aug 4.04; 18.1, compare ATels #1609, #1773), and the nova candidates M31N 2009-02b (2009 Aug 4.06; 18.0, compare ATel #1935), M31N 2009-05a (2009 Aug 4.07; 16.3), and M31N 2009-05b (2009 Aug 4.06; 17.6). The H-alpha detection identifies the candidates as novae.  
  
All magnitudes given are obtained from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Local Group Survey M 31 catalogue (see above). There is no entry in VizieR/CDS for this object and no minor planet could be found on this position using the MPC/IAU Minor Planet Checker (see http://scully.harvard.edu/~cgi/CheckMP  ). 2009-08-05 16:34:00

该现象描述了一颗位于M31（仙女座星系）的新光学新星候选体的发现过程与观测证据，需从多角度进行系统性分析：

首先，观测时间与设备条件表明其发现具有高可靠性：三帧连续抖动叠加的CCD图像均清晰显示该目标，且获取于2009年8月4.03日，使用的是1.3米Ritchey-Chrétien望远镜（f/7.5）、Andor DZ436-BV相机（2k×2k Marconi芯片，像元13.5微米）及带宽75Å的宽Hα滤光片。该配置对发射线天体（如新星）具备良好灵敏度，尤其Hα是经典新星爆发早期强发射线之一。

其次，光度学证据构成核心判据：通过与本地群巡天M31星表（Massey et al. 2006）中R波段标准星进行光度定标，测得该候选体R星等为17.2；而同位置在更早的2009年7月24.06日R波段图像中完全不可见（极限星等19.0），说明其在约11天内增亮至少1.8等，符合新星典型快速增亮特征。

第三，位置精度与排除混淆源至关重要：给出的J2000坐标（RA 00h42m58.06s，Dec +41d17'29.8"）误差仅0.3角秒，距离M31星系核155″东、81″北，属星系盘区域；VizieR/CDS无对应记录，小行星中心（MPC/IAU）亦未检出小行星，有效排除了前景恒星、已知变星或太阳系天体干扰。

第四，Hα测光结果提供物理本质判定依据：同一观测中对已知新星M31N 2008-07a及另三个候选体（M31N 2009-02b、2009-05a、2009-05b）进行了Hα测光，所有目标均被Hα波段明确探测到，而新星爆发期间因激波加热和电离气体导致Hα强烈发射，此特征可有效区分新星与普通晚型恒星、类星体或超新星遗迹等其他Hα发射源。

第五，综合比对支持其为真实新星：极限星等（18.5）高于所测星等（17.2），信噪比充足；多候选体在同一夜被统一方法探测，方法一致性增强结论可信度；且ATel系列通告（#1602、#1609、#1773、#1935）形成交叉验证链，表明该发现已被独立工作证实。

综上，该目标满足新星定义的关键观测标准：星系内位置、无历史记录、短时标显著增亮、Hα强发射、非太阳系天体、非已知背景源——因此可确认为一颗真实的新星。

根据现象进行分析： PCA Discovery of a New 11 Minute X-ray Pulsar, XTE J1716-379 RXTE PCA scans of the galactic ridge region on 2009-07-25 detected a new source. Follow-up RXTE PCA observations have occurred approximately daily since 2009-07-27, including a scan for position. Initial observations showed that the source was "pulsed" with a period of approximately 11 minutes. 
A dedicated PCA scan yielded a position of R.A. = 259.119, Decl. = -37.960 (J2000), and thus we designate the source XTE J1716-379. Because of the variability of the source, and contributions from the galactic plane, it is difficult to estimate a position uncertainty. We de-weighted the counts due of the source in order to account approximately for the variability. The estimated 2-sigma error contour is an ellipse with extents (-9,+6) arcmin in R.A. and (-7,+5) arcmin in Decl. There are no obvious counterparts in Simbad. 
A Lomb-Scargle periodogram of a barycentered lightcurve shows a X-ray period of 11.1744(1) minutes, where the quoted error is 3 sigma in the last digit. While the periodogram is heavily aliased, the strongest peak is significantly higher than other aliases. The pulsed flux varies considerably during the observation set, starting at about 23% (r.m.s.) and dropping to about 12% (r.m.s.). 
The mean flux also varies, from about 12 mCrab, down to 8 mCrab (2-10 keV). Both the pulsed and unpulsed flux vary considerably during the observations. The energy spectrum is consistent with a power law with photon index 1.90. In the raw spectrum there is an excess at 6.3 keV (equivalent width ~ 300 eV), but we cannot rule out contamination from the galactic ridge. Recent fluxes are of order 10, 4 and 4 in the 2-10, 10-20 and 20-40 keV bands respectively, in units of 10^{-11} erg/s/cm2. For an object at ~10 kpc, the luminosity would be ~10^{36} erg/s. 
While the orbital period alone suggests a possible identification as an X-ray pulsar with Be star companion or an intermediate polar, the X-ray variability suggests it is a Be pulsar. 2009-08-06 01:37:00
response: 首先，观测到一个新X射线源XTE J1716-379，其最显著特征是约11分钟的周期性脉冲信号；该周期由Lomb-Scargle周期图精确测定为11.1744(1)分钟（3σ误差），且主峰显著高于其他别名峰，说明周期检测具有高置信度。其次，该源位于银河系银道面附近（天球坐标R.A. = 259.119°, Decl. = −37.960°，J2000），受银河脊弥散辐射强背景污染，导致定位困难、位置误差较大（2σ椭圆误差达±9′/±6′和±7′/±5′），且Simbad中无明显对应体，支持其为新发现源。第三，光变特性显示强烈时间演化：脉冲分数从23% r.m.s.下降至12% r.m.s.，总流量在2–10 keV波段由12 mCrab降至8 mCrab，表明源处于剧烈活动变化阶段；同时，能谱呈幂律分布（光子指数Γ = 1.90），6.3 keV处存在~300 eV等效宽度的发射线，但无法排除银河脊铁线污染；高能段（2–40 keV）流量比符合硬谱特征。第四，基于距离假设~10 kpc，推算出X射线光度约10³⁶ erg/s，落在典型中子星吸积系统的典型范围；结合11分钟自转周期与强X射线光变行为（尤其是脉冲分数和流量同步衰减），更倾向于将其归类为Be/X射线双星系统中的脉冲星——因Be星盘不稳定性可自然解释此类长时标、大幅度的吸积率调制；而中间极（IP）虽也具白矮星自转周期在数百秒量级者，但其X射线光变通常更规则、脉冲分数更高且不易出现如此大幅度的流量衰减，故可能性较低。

根据现象进行分析： CRTS discovery of a long timescale type-IIn SN We report on the discovery of an energetic type-IIn SN by the Catalina Real-Time Transient Survey (CRTS).  

ID| Disc. Date| RA| Dec  
---|---|---|---  
CSS080701:234413+075224|  2008-07-01 UT 10:16:39 |  23:44:12.82 |  07:52:23.6  
The CSS and Palomar 60" light curves show that the SN's brightness rose from V-mag~20.2 to 18.5 by Dec 30th 2008, and then very slowly decline to mag ~19.3 by July 31st 2009. A spectrum was taken with the Palomar 5m+DBSP on 2009 July 23 UT and shows strong, broad, asymmetric H-alpha emission along with H-beta, H-gamma, and Helium lines at redshift z=0.069. The spectrum most resembles the type-IIn SN 2007rt at 260 days past explosion (Trundle et al. 2009). 
A faint host galaxy is seen in SDSS data (mags: u=23.2, g=22.0, r=21.4, i=20.9, z=20.6). The peak absolute magnitude of the SN, derived from the redshift, is Mv= -18.8 (typical for a type-IIn). Such slow evolution suggests significant ongoing interaction with CSM similar to the very long timescale type-IIn 2008iy (ATEL#2010). 
Current CRTS candidate and confirmed SNe can be found at here.  
More details of the CRTS project are available at http://crts.caltech.edu. 2009-08-06 07:52:00
response:
该现象描述了一次由卡塔利娜实时瞬变巡天（CRTS）发现的长时标IIn型超新星（CSS080701:234413+075224）。首先，其光变曲线显示：从2008年7月发现至同年12月30日，V波段星等由约20.2上升至18.5，即约持续约6个月的上升阶段；随后进入极为缓慢的衰减阶段，至2009年7月31日仅衰减至约19.3等，整个显著光度维持期长达约13个月。这种异常平缓的光变轮廓明显偏离典型核心坍缩超新星的快速上升与指数衰减特征，强烈暗示能量来源并非单纯放射性衰变，而是持续的激波与致密星周物质（CSM）相互作用。

其次，2009年7月23日获取的光学光谱呈现强而宽、不对称的Hα发射线，并伴随Hβ、Hγ及He I线，红移z=0.069，确认其为河外天体；谱线轮廓的宽度与不对称性反映高速激波正穿行于非均匀、可能具有双极或片状结构的CSM中，且存在显著的速度梯度。谱型与SN 2007rt在爆炸后260天的光谱高度相似，表明二者处于相似演化阶段——即激波已穿透初始致密包层，正与更外侧、质量更大、分布更弥散的CSM持续作用。

第三，宿主星系在SDSS中呈暗弱延展源，u至z波段星等依次变亮，符合晚型星系或恒星形成活动较弱的矮星系特征；由z=0.069推算得峰值绝对星等MV ≈ −18.8，落在IIn型超新星典型光度范围内，排除极亮超新星（SLSN）或潮汐撕裂事件（TDE）的可能性。结合其超长光度维持时间与强窄发射线共存的特征，可判定该事件本质上是大质量恒星晚期剧烈质量损失所形成的高密度CSM被超新星激波激发所致；其演化时标远超普通IIn（通常数月），而接近SN 2008iy这类极端案例，说明其前身星在爆发前数年至数十年间经历了极高率（可能达10⁻²–10⁻¹ M⊙/yr）、持续性的星风抛射或多次大规模喷发，形成了总质量达数个太阳质量、半径延伸至数百至数千天文单位的CSM壳层。激波穿越该厚实CSM的过程主导了观测到的长期辐射输出。

根据现象进行分析： Strong Millimeter-Band Flaring of 3C454.3 Underway The Submillimeter Array (SMA) performs ongoing flux density monitoring of quasars that are typically bright in the mm/submm bands, in order to optimally choose quasars for use as interferometric calibration sources. Through this monitoring effort, we report that the quasar 3C454.3 (J2253+161) is currently flaring strongly at millimeter wavelengths. 
After reaching 1.3 mm band flux densities of 27 +/- 1.8 Jy on October 3 2008, the quasar showed a substantial long term drop in intensity, reaching a measured nadir of 3 +/- 0.2 Jy on April 3, 2009 (though observations in 2009 are particularly sparse prior to May, and it is possible that the source dipped below 3 Jy during this time). We note that this drop in millimeter flux density is strongly correlated with a drop in the gamma ray intensity as measured by the Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) monitoring program (see http://fermi.gsfc.nasa.gov/ssc/data/access/lat/msl_lc/  ). 
Since April, 3C454.3 has been steadily increasing in 1.3 mm band flux density, nearly doubling by July 10 (to 5.4 +/- 0.3 Jy), equivalent to a growth rate of about 4.3% per week. However, monitoring observations over the past 25 days show a dramatic increase in the rate of brightening. On August 3, the flux density was measured to be 10.3 +/- 0.6 Jy, and on August 4 the flux density had grown to 11.3 +/- 1.1 Jy, equivalent to a growth rate of 21-23% per week; this is over 5 times the rate seen in the preceding three month period. Figures showing SMA measurements of 3C454.3 in 2009, including the current flare, as well as observations over the past 5 years (including the major flares of 2005, 2007, and 2008) can be accessed at the link provided at the bottom of this ATel. 
Past flares (e.g. 2005, 2007, 2008) have typically proceeded for several weeks, followed by a variably-long period of relatively steady flux density, finally succumbing with a rapid decrease to a background state near 3 Jy. This suggests that 3C454.3 may continue to brighten in the millimeter (and submillimeter) bands in the weeks to come. Fermi LAT monitoring, as provided through the website above, may also have detected an increase in gamma ray intensity when looking at the weekly averaged light curve (see http://fermi.gsfc.nasa.gov/FTP/glast/data/lat/catalogs/asp/current/lightcurves/3C454.3_604800.png  ) that could be related to this millimeter flare. It is our opinion that increased monitoring of the source at all wavelengths is warranted as this flare progresses. 
[The Submillimeter Array is a joint project between the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory and the Academia Sinica Institute of Astronomy and Astrophysics, and is funded by the Smithsonian Institution (USA) and the Academia Sinica (Taiwan).] 
Submillimeter Array Observations of a 3C454.3 Millimeter-Band Flare 2009-08-06 14:17:00
response: 该现象描述了耀变体3C454.3在毫米波段（1.3 mm）的一次显著耀发事件，其演化具有明确的时间序列和多波段关联性。首先，源在2008年10月3日达到峰值流量密度27 ± 1.8 Jy，随后经历长期衰减，于2009年4月3日降至极小值3 ± 0.2 Jy，该低态与Fermi-LAT观测到的伽马射线流量下降高度相关，表明毫米波与高能辐射存在物理耦合。自4月起，源进入缓慢回升阶段，至7月10日达5.4 ± 0.3 Jy，对应约4.3%每周的增长率；但自7月中旬起增速急剧提升：8月3日为10.3 ± 0.6 Jy，次日即达11.3 ± 1.1 Jy，折合周增长率跃升至21–23%，是前期速率的5倍以上。这一加速增亮行为区别于以往2005、2007、2008年典型耀发中“缓慢上升—平台维持—快速衰减”的三段式结构，暗示当前事件可能处于新喷流成分注入或激波加速过程的早期阶段。结合历史耀发均持续数周且最终回落至~3 Jy背景水平的规律，可推断本次耀发仍处于上升期，未来数周毫米/亚毫米波段流量大概率继续增长。同时，Fermi-LAT周平均光变曲线中已显现伽马射线流量同步增强趋势，进一步支持多波段辐射起源于同一相对论性喷流中的粒子加速过程。因此，该现象本质上反映了喷流中非热电子能量分布的动态演化，其加速增亮速率突变可能对应于新的激波形成、磁场重联事件或喷流指向角的微小变化导致的多普勒增强效应增强。

根据现象进行分析： RXTE timing observations of SGR 0418+5729 Data from (publicly available) monitoring observations with RXTE of SGR 0418+5729 covering a time span of about 2 months since its discovery on June 5, 2009 (ATEL #2077,GCN #9499) have been used to construct an accurate phase-coherent timing solution. Such an analysis requires the pulse profile to be stable during the monitoring period in order to obtain reliable pulse time-of-arrivals, TOAs.
In our study we noticed that the pulse-shape, using PCA PHA channels 5-27 (~2-11 keV), of SGR 0418+5729 changed since the first RXTE observation on MJD 54992.160 (June 10, 2009) till MJD 54996.021 (June 14, 2009).
As of MJD 54997.093 (June 15, 2009) the 5-27 PCA pulse profile is stable showing at least three emission peaks, two of them are narrow having a phase separation of only ~0.12. As template in the TOA correlation analysis we used the (5-27) PCA pulse-profile with the highest statistical quality as obtained on June 21, 2009 (MJD 55003.894-55004.103; 11.2 ks observation).
Surprisingly, we could NOT measure a significant value for the frequency time derivative over the ~50 days data period covering MJD 54997 - 55046! The pulse frequency we determine at epoch 54997.0 (TDB time scale; Swift XRT position of SGR 0418+5729 (ATEL #2127) used in barycentering process) and valid for the full MJD 54997 - 55046 interval is Nu = 0.1101517070(8) Hz. Our value is consistent with, but much more accurate than the value obtained by Gogus (ATEL #2076) who used only the first RXTE observation. Fitting two frequency parameters to the TOA set we obtained a 2 sigma lower limit on dNu/dt of -3.32E-15 Hz/s. Adopting the canonical magnetic-dipole braking model the estimated two sigma upper-limit to the surface polar magnetic field is 5.04E13 Gauss, just above the quantum critical value of 4.413E13 Gauss and rather deviant from the established SGR group members. This value is also well below the magnetic field strength of AXP 1E2259+586, the magnetar with the currently known lowest field.
Note that the derived Nu, Nudot values place SGR 0418+5729 in a region of the period/period derivative diagram where XDINS and RRATS are located. Its X-ray spectrum as derived by Cummings et al. (ATEL #2127), a black body with a kT of 0.92(2) keV, is also typical for XDINS. Finally, no pulsed emission has been detected above ~11 keV.
Further deep X-ray monitoring observations are necessary to put tighter constraints on the timing parameters. 2009-08-06 14:37:00
response:
首先，观测对象是软伽马射线重复暴SGR 0418+5729，其RXTE（Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer）计时观测覆盖自2009年6月5日发现起约两个月的时间段。为构建相位一致的计时解，需依赖稳定的脉冲轮廓以获得可靠的脉冲到达时间（TOA）。因此，脉冲轮廓稳定性是相位相干计时分析的前提条件。

其次，在PCA能道5–27（对应能量约2–11 keV）范围内，脉冲轮廓在MJD 54992.160（2009年6月10日）至MJD 54996.021（6月14日）期间发生明显变化，表明该早期阶段存在显著的脉冲形态演化；而自MJD 54997.093（6月15日）起，脉冲轮廓趋于稳定，并呈现至少三个发射峰，其中两个窄峰相位间隔仅约0.12，说明此时已进入适合高精度计时的稳定态。

第三，选取MJD 55003.894–55004.103（6月21日，曝光11.2 ks）所获统计质量最高的5–27能道脉冲轮廓作为TOA拟合模板，由此得到整个MJD 54997–55046（约50天）区间内有效的单一脉冲频率：ν = 0.1101517070(8) Hz（参考历元MJD 54997.0，TDB时间，采用Swift XRT定位进行日心校正）。该值精度显著高于Gogus（ATEL #2076）仅基于首次观测所得结果。

第四，对TOA数据集同时拟合频率ν与频率导数ν̇，未能测得具有统计显著性的ν̇值；在2σ置信水平下，仅得到ν̇的下限为−3.32×10⁻¹⁵ Hz/s。依据标准磁偶极辐射制动模型，由此推得表面极区磁场强度的2σ上限为5.04×10¹³ G——该值略高于量子电动力学临界场（4.413×10¹³ G），但明显低于典型SGR/AXP成员（如AXP 1E2259+586，目前已知最低场AXP），暗示其磁场可能未达经典磁星阈值。

第五，将所得ν与ν̇代入P–Ṗ图，发现SGR 0418+5729落于X射线暗弱孤立中子星（XDINS）和旋转射电暂现源（RRAT）所在区域；其X射线谱（Cummings et al., ATEL #2127）为kT = 0.92(2) keV的黑体谱，亦符合XDINS典型特征；且未在>11 keV能段探测到脉冲辐射，进一步支持其高能截断特性与低磁场类磁星行为的一致性。

第六，当前ν̇约束仍受限于观测时长与统计精度，尚无法排除极小但非零的ν̇；因此需开展更深度的X射线监测，以提升TOA精度、延长基线、收紧ν̇及更高阶导数的限制，从而明确其自转演化机制是否偏离标准磁偶极模型。
