根据现象进行分析： Precise orbital ephemeris for the Accreting Millisecond Pulsar IGR J17511-3057 Taking advantage from the precise source position given by Chandra (ATEL #2215), we report here refined orbital parameters of the newly discovered Accreting Millisecond Pulsar IGR J17511-3057 (ATEL #2196, #2197, #2198, #2215, #2216).   
We have analysed the RXTE(PCA) public observations (Full and pseudo-production Data, http://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/xte/SOF/SOF_data_hp.html  ) available up to date and spanning from 2009 Sep 13 to 2009 Sep 26. The pulsation is present in all the data analysed. The pulse profile was modelled with a fundamental harmonic and a 1st overtone. The pulsed fraction (not corrected for the background) are of about 12% and 2%, respectively. The pulse phase delays of the fundamental do not show a clear spin-up/down trend, while there is evidence of pulse phase delays fluctuations with an amplitude of about 0.05 in phase units on timescales of few days. The mean spin frequency calculated on all the considered data and taking into account the positional uncertanty given in ATEL #2215 is 244.83395157(7) Hz, although local deviations up to 4x10^-7 Hz around this mean value are observed caused by the mentioned phase fluctuations.   
The orbital ephemeris derived from our analysis is:   
  
Orbital period: 12487.5126(9) s   
Projected semimajor axis: 275.194(3) lt-ms   
Time of passage for ascending node: 55088.0320280(5) MJD [TDB]   
Eccentricity e: < 6e-5 (2 sigma c.l.)   
  
Unless otherwise stated, errors in parentheses are quoted at the 1 sigma level. The orbital parameters given here are consistent, within the errors, with the first RXTE timing reported in Atel #2197, and with the recent XMM-Newton timing reported in Atel #2220. We appreciate the RXTE rapid follow-up scheduling and constant monitoring of the current source outburst. 2009-10-02 09:33:00
response:
首先，该现象描述的是对吸积毫秒脉冲星IGR J17511−3057进行高精度轨道计时分析的过程与结果。分析基于RXTE/PCA在2009年9月13日至26日间的公开观测数据，并利用Chandra给出的精确天体位置（ATEL #2215）以校正光行时效应，从而提升轨道参数精度。

其次，脉冲信号在全部数据中均显著存在，说明源处于稳定吸积状态；脉冲轮廓被建模为基频谐波加一阶泛音，对应脉冲分数分别为约12%和2%，表明基频成分占主导，且信噪比足够支撑相位追踪。

第三，基频脉冲相位延迟未呈现系统性自转加速或减速趋势，排除了强净吸积角动量转移导致的长期自转演化主导行为；但观察到振幅约0.05（相位单位）、时间尺度为数天的相位起伏，暗示存在短时标扰动机制，如吸积流不稳定性、盘-星相互作用或局部磁层扰动，这些扰动引起自转频率在±4×10⁻⁷ Hz范围内波动，但未破坏整体周期稳定性。

第四，由此导出的轨道参数具有高精度：轨道周期12487.5126(9) s（≈3.469小时），投影半长轴275.194(3) lt-ms，对应质量函数可进一步约束伴星质量；升交点时刻为55088.0320280(5) MJD（TDB），误差仅5×10⁻⁶天（≈0.4秒），体现Chandra定位对光行时修正的关键作用；偏心率上限<6×10⁻⁵（2σ），支持圆轨道假设，符合LMXB中潮汐圆化预期。

最后，所有参数在1σ误差范围内与RXTE早期报告（ATEL #2197）及XMM-Newton后续测量（ATEL #2220）一致，验证了分析方法的可靠性与数据的一致性，也表明该系统在此次爆发期间轨道运动稳定、未受显著摄动。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Optical outburst and mm activity of 3C 345 observed by the GASP The GLAST-AGILE Support Program (GASP) of the Whole Earth Blazar Telescope (WEBT) reports on the recent observation of a strong optical brightening of the blazar 3C 345. This is one of the 28 sources for which the GASP performs a long-term, multiwavelength monitoring. After a faint state (R ~ 17) observed in mid 2009, the brightness started to increase in July, and in August a sharp flare led to a peak of R = 16.09 +/- 0.01 on August 20; this was followed by a fast dimming and subsequent steep rebrightening up to R = 15.75 +/- 0.01 on September 20. The source was observed at R = 16.23 +/- 0.01 five days later, and then the brightness rose again to R = 15.94 +/- 0.01 on September 29; last night, October 1, it was around R = 16.4. At mm wavelengths, 3C 345 has been active since early 2009, with a flux density at 230 GHz oscillating about 3-4 Jy. 2009-10-02 10:19:00
response: 该现象描述了耀变体3C 345在光学波段和毫米波段的同步活动特征。首先，光学光变曲线显示其经历了显著的多阶段爆发：2009年中旬处于较暗状态（R ≈ 17），7月起亮度开始上升，8月出现尖锐耀发，于8月20日达到第一个峰值R = 16.09 ± 0.01；随后快速变暗，又在9月20日出现更亮的再增亮峰（R = 15.75 ± 0.01），表明存在至少两次不同时标的光学增强过程；9月25日回落至R = 16.23 ± 0.01后再度上升至9月29日的R = 15.94 ± 0.01，10月1日又下降至R ≈ 16.4，整体呈现高频振荡式光变结构。这种快速上升—下降—再上升的形态暗示喷流中可能存在多个运动激波或局部能量释放事件，且不同成分辐射区存在光深、磁场或粒子能谱差异导致的光变时标分离。与此同时，毫米波段自2009年初即持续活跃，230 GHz流量密度在3–4 Jy范围内振荡，未见与光学峰值严格对应的同步跃变，但长期高流量水平表明喷流基部或内区持续存在强相对论性电子加速与同步辐射过程。光学与毫米波活动的时间关联性较弱，可能反映辐射区空间分离：光学辐射主要来自喷流中更靠外、更透明、光深较低的区域，而毫米辐射则源于更致密、更高光深的内区（如VLBI核心附近），二者虽同源但受不同物理条件调制。

根据现象进行分析： Strong Millimeter-Band Flaring of 3C454.3 Continues The Submillimeter Array (SMA) performs ongoing flux density monitoring of quasars that are typically bright in the mm/submm bands, in order to optimally choose quasars for use as interferometric calibration sources. Through this monitoring effort, we discovered and reported in ATEL #2150 that that the quasar 3C454.3 (J2253+161) was flaring strongly at millimeter wavelengths starting in mid-2009. Flaring activity has also been reported in the IR, optical, and gamma ray bands (see ATEL #2155, ATEL #2182, ATEL #2200, ATEL #2201). 
Here we report that at millimeter and submillimeter bands 3C454.3 continues to increase in flux density. In early August the 1.3 mm flux density was around 11 Jy, while the most recent measurements obtained by the SMA (from October 2) now show the flux density to be 26 +/- 1.4 Jy, an increase of a factor of 2.35 in under 60 days, and and increase of nearly a factor of 9 since a minimum near 3 Jy was observed in early April. At this point 3C454.3 has reached essentially the same peak flux density achieved during the 2008 flare (Sept-October 2008). A figure showing SMA measurements of 3C454.3 since early August 2009, can be accessed at the link provided at the bottom of this ATel. Figures of the flux history of 3C454.3 since 2005 are also available at the same location. 
Past flares (e.g. 2005, 2007, 2008) have typically proceeded for many weeks, followed by a variably-long period of relatively steady flux density, finally succumbing with a rapid decrease to a background state near 3 Jy. This suggests that 3C454.3 may continue to brighten in the millimeter (and submillimeter) bands in the weeks to come. Given that strong activity is seen across the spectrum from mm to gamma rays, it is our opinion that continued monitoring of the source at all wavelengths is warranted as this flare progresses. 
[The Submillimeter Array is a joint project between the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory and the Academia Sinica Institute of Astronomy and Astrophysics, and is funded by the Smithsonian Institution (USA) and the Academia Sinica (Taiwan).] 
Submillimeter Array Observations of a 3C454.3 Millimeter-Band Flare 2009-10-02 17:26:00
response: 该现象描述的是类星体3C454.3在2009年中后期发生的强烈毫米波及亚毫米波耀发事件。首先，SMA对亮射电源的长期通量监测本意是为干涉校准遴选合适源，却意外捕获到该源自2009年中起的显著毫米波增强；其次，通量增长具有明确的时间演化特征：4月初处于约3 Jy的极小值，8月初升至约11 Jy，至10月2日已达26 ± 1.4 Jy，即60天内增长2.35倍、近5个月增长近9倍，已回升至2008年同期耀发峰值水平；第三，多波段协同观测（红外、光学、伽马射线）证实此次活动并非孤立的毫米波现象，而是宽波段同步耀发，表明其物理起源应位于喷流中的相对论性粒子加速区；第四，历史耀发（2005、2007、2008年）普遍呈现“缓慢上升—平台维持—快速衰减”三阶段结构，当前仍处于上升阶段，且尚未达峰，故可合理推断其毫米/亚毫米波亮度在未来数周内仍可能继续升高；第五，鉴于其多波段一致性与历史重复性，持续全波段监测不仅必要，且有助于约束喷流辐射机制、粒子加速时标及辐射区几何结构等关键物理参数。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Evidence for a delay in the first contact of the 2009 eclipse of Epsilon AUR We performed UBVR photoelectric photometry of epsilon AUR using an SSP-5A photometer attached to the 0.30-m f/10 telescope of OAC, in 41 nights from July 17th to September 28th 2009. The star lambda AUR was used as comparison, and the atmospheric extinction was also measured. This OAC photometry of epsilon AUR shows that the 2009 eclipse of epsilon AUR did not still take place until at least August 17th. In fact, until August 17th 2009, the OAC's photometry shows only the normal outside-eclipse flickering of epsilon AUR. Most of these V data shows flickering between V mag 2.95 and 3.05, in perfect agreement with the V band value outside eclipse given in the literature. The predicted time of the first contact was August 6th 2009, but our measurements do not support this forecast. Until August 19th there is no evidence for the beginning of the first contact. A linear fit of a subset of V band data from August 13th to September 28th gave a statistically significant (at 99% level) slope for a brightness decrease. This decrease should be due to the first contact; anyway there is clear evidence for a delay of about a dozen of days in the first contact. This delay supports the theory of a shrinking of the F supergiant (Saito & Kitamura 1986, Ap&SS 122, 387). A time series analysis of the V band data was performed, from 0.016 to 2 c/d, using various algorithms. A marginal detection of a periodicity at the 5% significance level, but not at the 1% level, could be suspected. The average B-V colour index is +0.574 in fair agreement with previous results for past eclipses. The average U-B colour is +0.195: a value bluer by about 0.11 magnitudes than that listed in the "Photoelectric catalogue" (Blanco et al., 1970, USNO Pub. 21, 178). The average V-R is +0.519 in good agreement with previous results. No significant linear trends, and no significant periodicities (from 0.016 to 2 c/d) at the 5% significance level are present in the time series of the colour indexes. We also obtained low resolution long-slit spectra of epsilon AUR in the wavelenght range 380-900 nm. We used a Sbig DSS-7 spectrometer + ST9-XE CCD camera attached to the 0.30-m f/10 telescope of OAC, in 10 nights from July 10th to September 7th 2009. Each spectrum of epsilon AUR was compared with the spectrum of the F0 Ia standard star phi CAS obtained in the same night. The main non-telluric features in OAC's spectra of epsilon AUR are the absorption lines of Na I at 589.3 nm and H-beta. Other non-telluric absorption features can be seen: the O I line at 777.4 nm, the H-gamma, the H Paschen series, a weak H-alpha, a weak Ca I at 612.2 and 616.2 nm, a weak Si II at 634.7 nm (blended with Mg II) and Si II at 637.1 nm. No emission lines are present in OAC's spectra of epsilon AUR. The O I absorption line at 777.4 nm is fairly strong, clearly indicating high luminosity. OAC's spectra of epsilon AUR can be classified as belonging to the F0 Ia or A9 Ia class. The tracings of OAC's spectra of epsilon AUR are similar to that performed with the MIRA 0.91-m telescope some years ago (Torres-Dodgen & Weaver 1993, PASP 105, 693). The main difference between MIRA's and OAC's spectrum is that in MIRA's spectrum the H-alpha is completely absent, while in OAC's spectrum is present in absorption although quite weak. The weakness of the H-alpha absorption line in epsilon AUR is also the main difference between OAC's spectra of epsilon AUR and those of phi CAS taken in the same nights. In all spectra of phi CAS the strenght of H-alpha relative to other lines of the same spectrum is always stronger than the same relative strength in the spectra of epsilon AUR. From the comparison of OAC's and MIRA's spectra, it seems evident that this star shows strong H-alpha line variability on time scales of years. 2009-10-02 21:23:00
response: 该观测现象表明2009年Epsilon Aurigae食双星系统的第一次接触发生时间显著晚于理论预测。具体分析如下：首先，OAC台站从2009年7月17日至9月28日共41晚的UBVR光电测光数据显示，截至8月17日，Epsilon Aurigae的V波段亮度仍在典型非食期间的正常涨落范围内（2.95–3.05 mag），与文献记载的食外亮度完全一致，未出现任何食始迹象；其次，预测的第一次接触时间为8月6日，但直至8月19日仍未观测到亮度下降或光变形态改变，排除了该时间点发生接触的可能性；第三，对8月13日至9月28日V波段数据进行线性拟合，得到在99%置信水平下统计显著的亮度递减趋势，该趋势被合理归因为第一次接触的开始，由此推断实际接触时间比预报延迟约十余天；第四，该延迟现象与Saito & Kitamura（1986）提出的F型超巨星半径收缩模型相吻合——恒星半径缩小将导致伴星遮挡起始时刻推迟；第五，颜色指数分析显示B−V = +0.574、V−R = +0.519与历史结果一致，而U−B = +0.195比Blanco等（1970）星表值偏蓝0.11 mag，可能反映紫外能区的光度变化或星际红化修正差异，但各色指数时间序列中均未发现显著线性趋势或周期性信号（0.016–2 c/d），说明颜色变化不具系统性演化特征；第六，低分辨率光谱观测（380–900 nm）确认恒星光谱型为F0 Ia或A9 Ia，O I 777.4 nm强吸收线支持高光度特性，且Hα线呈微弱吸收而非发射，与标准星phi Cas相比其相对强度明显偏弱，与MIRA望远镜早年观测对比还揭示出Hα线存在年际尺度的显著强度变化，表明该谱线对恒星大气结构或盘-星相互作用具有高度敏感性，但本次光谱中未见任何发射线，说明2009年食前阶段盘内未发生剧烈活动或吸积激变。综上，观测证据一致指向第一次接触的明显延迟，并为超巨星半径收缩假说提供了关键支持，同时排除了食始时间由短期扰动或仪器误差导致的可能性。

根据现象进行分析： SWIFT J1753.5-0127 observed in XMM-Newton slew. The X-ray binary, SWIFT J1753.5-0127, discovered in outburst by the Swift BAT in 2005 (Palmer et al. 2005, ATel #546) was observed during an XMM-Newton slew on September 3rd 2009, with a 0.2-10 keV count rate of 118 c/s. Such bright sources suffer from heavy pile-up in the EPIC-pn camera during slews and the real count rate is estimated to be ~250 c/s. 
After excluding the inner 10" of the PSF and using single-pixel events only, to minimise pile-up effects, a spectral fit gives a 0.2-10 keV flux of 9.7+/-1.0E-10 ergs/s/cm^2 and a 2-10 keV flux of 6.6+/-0.9E-10 ergs/s/cm^2. 
The spectrum requires a power-law plus disk blackbody model for an acceptable fit and the disk temperature can be constrained to 0.34 (+0.17 / -0.09) keV (90% confidence for one free parameter). 
This is very much in line with X-ray observations performed post-outburst which show that the source remains in the low/hard state while very gradually increasing in brightness (see Miller and Rykoff, Atel #1066). 
This source was spotted using the XMM-Newton slew data quick analysis tool whose results are available at: http://xmm.esac.esa.int/external/xmm_products/slew_results/web_slew.shtml 
Latest SLEW RESULTS 2009-10-04 10:48:00
response:
该现象描述了X射线双星系统SWIFT J1753.5−0127在XMM-Newton卫星巡天扫描（slew）模式下的一次观测。首先，该源于2005年Swift/BAT发现于爆发态，而本次观测发生于2009年9月3日，即爆发后约4年，仍处于持续活动阶段。观测中EPIC-pn探测器记录到0.2–10 keV计数率为118 c/s，但由于源极亮，扫描模式下存在严重堆积效应（pile-up），故经校正后真实计数率估计为约250 c/s。为抑制堆积影响，分析时排除点扩散函数（PSF）中心10角秒以内区域，并仅采用单像素事件（single-pixel events），从而获得可靠的能谱。

能谱拟合表明，单一热辐射模型（如纯吸积盘黑体或纯幂律）无法给出可接受的拟合结果，必须同时包含幂律成分与盘黑体（disk blackbody）成分，说明X射线辐射来自两个物理过程：高温冕区的逆康普顿散射（幂律主导）和内吸积盘的热辐射（盘黑体主导）。其中盘温度被约束为0.34⁺⁰.¹⁷₋₀.₀₉ keV（90%置信度，单参数），该值处于典型的低/硬态吸积盘温度范围（通常0.2–0.5 keV），且与爆发后长期监测所揭示的状态一致——即源始终维持低/硬态，同时光度缓慢上升。这一演化特征支持其属于黑洞X射线双星系统，在低/硬态下吸积流呈径移主导、低效冷却的几何厚盘（如ADIOS或RIAF）结构，内盘半径较大、温度较低，而冕区贡献显著的硬X射线连续谱。

此外，该源被识别依赖于XMM-Newton巡天扫描数据的快速分析工具，说明此类高灵敏度巡天扫描数据可用于发现和监测中等亮度、非指向性的X射线暂现源或长期活动源，尤其适用于状态演化研究。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT detection of a GeV flare from the vicinity of Fermi bright source 0FGLJ1641.4+3939 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of the two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope, has observed increased gamma-ray activity from the vicinity of Fermi bright source 0FGL J1641.4+3939 (Abdo, A. et al. 2009 ApJ, 700, 597). Preliminary analysis of all-sky survey data over the 36 hour period from Sep 29 (00 UT) - Sep 30 (12 UT) resulted in the detection of a source at RA = 250.661 deg, Dec = 40.1502 deg (J2000) with 95% confidence error circle= 14.0 arcmin (statistical only). Including a systematic error in the way described in A. Abdo et al. (2009, ApJS, 183, 46), the well-known blazar 3C345 is just outside the edge of the 95% confidence error circle. Indeed, a confident identification of the gamma-ray source in this region remains challenging given the abundance of possible counterparts: 3C345, NRAO 512 and CLASS J1641+3935. Consequently, follow-up multiwavelength observations are encouraged for identification via correlated variability. 
Preliminary analysis indicates that the during the 36 hour period, the average gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) was (0.6 +/- 0.2) x 10-6 ph cm-2 s-1, with a peak flux of (1.3 +/- 0.5) x 10-6 ph cm-2 s-1 found during the 6 hr period Sep 30 (00-06 UT); errors are statistical only. The peak flux represents a relative increase up to a factor of ~8 with respect to the average flux of 0FGL J1641.4+3939 during the first year of Fermi operations. The increased activity in gamma-rays, if originating from 3C345, would be consistent with the recently reported outbursting optical activity (ATEL #2222). 
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. For this source the Fermi LAT contact person is Luis C. Reyes (lcreyes@uchicago.edu). 
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2009-10-04 21:04:00

根据现象进行分析： Detection of radio emission at 610 MHz from the supernova SN2008bx in the BCD galaxy I Zw 97 We report the likely detection of the Type II supernova SN 2008bx (T. Puckett et. al. 2009, CBET #1348; M.C. Bentz et. al. 2009, CBET #1359; S. Blondin & P. Berlind 2009, CBET #1359) at 610 MHz in the blue compact dwarf galaxy I Zw 97. The observations of I Zw 97 were made using the Giant Meterwave Radio Telescope (GMRT) on 04 June 2009 with an on-source time of ~4.5 hours as part of the programme to study star forming regions in blue compact dwarf galaxies. This resulted in an image with rms noise of 70 microJy. 
The peak radio emission in 610 MHz coincides with the optical location of SN 2008bx and is measured to be ~0.74 mJy. 
Comparison of pre-supernova observations of the galaxy in optical obtained using HCT (Ramya et al. 2009 MNRAS, 397, 97) and post-supernova (U.K. Gurugubelli et al. in preparation) indicate the supernova is located in the southern star forming region in I Zw 97. This star forming region is not detected in the FIRST and NVSS surveys at 1.4 GHz. Since these surveys precede the supernova in 2008, the radio source we detect at 610 MHz is likely to be new and associated with SN2008bx. 
Further confirmatory observations are being requested at GMRT. 2009-10-05 06:40:00
response: 首先，观测到SN 2008bx在610 MHz频段存在射电辐射，峰值流量密度约为0.74 mJy，且其位置与光学波段确认的超新星位置精确重合，这提供了空间一致性的关键证据。其次，该射电源位于I Zw 97星系的南侧恒星形成区，而该区域在FIRST和NVSS巡天（1.4 GHz）中未被探测到，且这些巡天数据早于超新星爆发时间（2008年），说明该射电辐射并非来自宿主星系原有的射电源，而是新出现的。第三，观测使用GMRT进行，积分时间约4.5小时，图像rms噪声为70 μJy，信噪比约为10.6，满足可靠探测标准（通常要求S/N > 5）。第四，结合SN 2008bx为II型超新星，其射电辐射最可能源于激波与周围星周介质相互作用产生的同步加速辐射，符合核心坍缩超新星晚期射电辐射的典型物理机制。因此，该610 MHz射电辐射极可能源自SN 2008bx本身，而非背景源或星系内其他活动。

根据现象进行分析： A prominent fluctuation in the optical brightness of Q0957+561A and prediction of the Q0957+561B optical variability in the first semester of 2010 We are conducting a long-term monitoring of the optical magnitudes of gravitationally lensed quasars using the 2.0 m Liverpool Robotic Telescope at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory (Canary Islands, Spain). This Liverpool Quasar Lens Monitoring (LQLM) programme includes several lensed quasars whose images are as bright as or brighter than 19 mag in the r-band (SDSS photometric system). One of our targets is Q0957+561 (RA=10:01:20.78, Dec=+55:53:49.4), which consists of two images of the same distant quasar at z=1.41. These images Q0957+561A and Q0957+561B are separated by about 6 arcsec. From the LQLM photometric pipelines (Shalyapin et al. 2008, A&A, 492, 401), we detected a strong quasar activity over the last three years. In particular, the g-band flux of the leading image Q0957+561A increases 30% just after a deep minimum, i.e., it changes from g~17.45 to g~17.15 over about 130 days. We also observe a significant increase (~20%) in the r-band flux of Q0957+561A, which confirms the existence of an optical event. The most recent LQLM observations of Q0957+561A (first semester of 2009) show this event has peaked and later decreased in brightness. 
As the the prominent fluctuation in the optical brightness of Q0957+561A occured berween late 2008 and the middle of 2009, it is expected a similar fluctuation in the light curve of the trailing image Q0957+561B in the first semester of 2010, starting in early February and reaching its maximum in June (taking a time delay of about 14 months into account; the g-band brightening of Q0957+561B will probably behave like the red circles between the two vertical blue arrows in the figure http://grupos.unican.es/glendama/ATel.png  ). Consequently, we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations of Q0957+561B. Although we will try to monitor this target in 2010 in the g and r bands (and perhaps using other optical/NIR filters), additional spectrophotometry at X-ray, UV, optical, IR and radio wavelengths should play a crucial role in the understanding of the variability mechanism and other aspects of the distant source. For example, it could be possible to accurately check if the observed optical event (which corresponds to middle UV emission at the redshift of the quasar) is triggered (and thus preceded) by a higher energy flare.

根据现象进行分析： Softening of state during recent X-ray outburst of LMC X-3 as detected by RXTE The All Sky Monitor (ASM), onboard RXTE, has recently detected the rise in ASM flux (2.0-12.0 keV) from the black hole candidate LMC X-3. The burst started on 29 July 2009 (MJD 55043), when the ASM flux was ~2 cts/s and it reached the peak value on 7 September 2009 (MJD 55084), when the ASM flux showed ~6 cts/s and remained there for 4-5 days and then started decaying. The ASM flux of the source is still showing high luminosity with ~4 cts/s recorded on MJD 55105.
We have analysed all PCA observations of the source taken between 7 July 2009 and 7 September 2009. In hard color-magnitude diagram (HR2=13.0-60.0 keV flux/2.1-5.2 keV flux), 29 July 2009 showed the hardest state where average HR2 was ~ 0.62 and PCA flux ~ 61 cts/s/PCU (2.0 keV-60.0 keV). Then the source gradually moved to higher flux and lower HR2 value and on 7 September 2009, it became softer. The average HR2 value became ~ 0.31 and PCA flux ~ 116 cts/s/PCU. Interestingly, no significant change in soft color (HR1=5.6-12.8 keV flux/2.1-5.2 keV flux) has been observed throughout the evolution of the burst. We have also done the spectral fitting of all standard-2 PCA spectrum with multi-colored disk black body (diskbb) and power-law model in addition with small Gaussian fixed at 6.4 keV. All of them are modified by the presence of interstellar medium having column density ~ 3.2 x 10^20 cm^(-2). On 7 July 2009, the spectrum was steep power-law dominated (PI ~ 3.44 +/- 0.05) with the presence of hard power-law tail. The power-law flux (3.0-26.0 keV) was ~74%-79% of the total flux and diskbb flux ~15%-20% of total flux. While on the higher end, the spectrum of 7 September 2009 showed flatter power-law (PI ~ 4.29 +/- 0.019) with 45% power-law flux and 55% diskbb flux of the total flux. Interestingly, disk temperature remained almost same (~ 0.88 +/- 0.031 keV) throughout the burst. Multi band observations are encouraged to study interesting features of this source. 2009-10-06 08:19:00

该现象描述了LMC X-3在2009年7–9月X射线爆发期间的能谱态演化过程。首先，ASM监测显示源在MJD 55043（2009年7月29日）开始上升，至MJD 55084（9月7日）达峰，ASM流量由约2 cts/s升至约6 cts/s，并维持4–5天后衰减；至MJD 55105仍保持较高光度（~4 cts/s），表明此次爆发持续时间长、光度高。

PCA光谱分析揭示出清晰的态软化趋势：在硬色指数HR2（13–60 keV / 2.1–5.2 keV）—流量图中，源从7月29日的“硬态”（HR2 ≈ 0.62，PCA总流量≈61 cts/s/PCU）逐步演化为9月7日的“软态”（HR2 ≈ 0.31，PCA总流量≈116 cts/s/PCU），即高能光子相对比例显著下降、总流量上升，符合典型黑洞X射线双星的爆发上升相中由硬态向软态转变的特征。

值得注意的是，软色指数HR1（5.6–12.8 keV / 2.1–5.2 keV）在整个过程中基本不变，说明中能段相对于低能段的谱形未发生明显改变，暗示热冕或盘内区辐射几何可能未发生剧烈重构，或软谱成分主要由稳定热辐射主导。

光谱拟合进一步证实态演化本质：7月7日谱以陡峭幂律为主（Γ ≈ 3.44），幂律贡献74%–79%，盘辐射仅占15%–20%，且存在硬尾，符合典型硬态（即低L/L_Edd下、高温低光学深度冕主导）；而9月7日谱幂律变平（Γ ≈ 4.29），幂律占比降至45%，盘辐射升至55%，但盘温度T_in ≈ 0.88 keV基本恒定。该组合表明：尽管总光度升高、冕辐射占比下降、谱整体软化，但内吸积盘半径与温度未显著变化——这与标准薄盘模型预期（L ∝ T_in^4 R_in^2）矛盾，暗示内盘可能已延伸至ISCO附近并饱和，或存在强康普顿冷却抑制温度上升，亦或存在非热电子冷却、盘风吸收等修正机制。

综上，此次爆发呈现典型的“硬→软”态迁移，但伴随异常稳定的内盘温度，挑战简单盘-冕耦合模型，需结合多波段观测约束吸积流结构、冕几何及外流效应。

根据现象进行分析： Radio upper limits for the accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar IGR J17511-3057 We report on recent radio observations of the newly-detected accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar, IGR J17511-3057 (ATels #2196, #2197, #2198, #2199, #2215, #2216, #2220, #2221). We used the Very Large Array (VLA) to observe the source under observing program AM971. The array was in its relatively compact 'C' and 'DNC' configurations, and the observations were made at 8.46 GHz. In no case was the source significantly detected. The derived upper limits were:   
  
Date | MJD | 3-sigma upper limit (mJy)  
---|---|---  
2009 Sep. 16 | 55090.14 | 0.16  
2009 Sep. 18 | 55092.13 | 0.18  
2009 Sep. 25 | 55099.13 | 0.17  
  
  
After stacking the data from all three observations, the source was still not significantly detected, to a 3-sigma upper limit of 0.10 mJy.   
  
Accreting millisecond X-ray pulsars detected at radio frequencies have previously been observed with peak flux densities in the range 0.8 - 1.1 mJy (ATel #355, Gaensler et al. 1999, ApJ, 522, L117) for sources at distances of less than ~ 3 kpc. The distance to IGR J17511-3057 is currently unknown, but if it lies at ~ 5 kpc or closer, its radio luminosity is likely to be intrinsically fainter than other known accreting millisecond X-ray pulsars. Alternatively, if the peak radio luminosity of IGR J17511-3057 was similar to the other known accreting millisecond X-ray pulsars, our upper limit is consistent with a source at the distance of the Galactic Center. 2009-10-07 20:25:00
response: 该现象表明，在8.46 GHz频段对吸积毫秒X射线脉冲星IGR J17511−3057进行的三次VLA观测中，均未获得显著的射电探测；三次独立观测的3σ射电流量密度上限分别为0.16、0.18和0.17 mJy，联合叠加后上限进一步降低至0.10 mJy。已知其他已被射电探测到的吸积毫秒X射线脉冲星在相同频段的峰值流量密度为0.8–1.1 mJy，且对应距离均小于约3 kpc。由于IGR J17511−3057的距离未知，若其距离≤5 kpc，则其射电光度必然显著低于已知同类源，暗示其射电辐射本征偏弱；反之，若其本征射电光度与已知源相当，则该上限值与位于银心距离（≈8 kpc）处的源一致，因流量密度随距离平方衰减，更远距离会导致观测流量更低。因此，非探测结果既可能反映该源固有的低射电亮度，也可能由较大距离导致，需结合距离测量进一步约束其射电性质。

根据现象进行分析： Confirmation of the NIR counterpart to IGR J17511-3057 We report follow-up observations confirming the near-infrared (NIR) counterpart to the newly discovered accreting millisecond pulsar IGR J17511-3057 (Baldoven et al. 2009, ATel #2196; Markwardt et al. 2009, ATel #2197). A Ks~18 mag candidate counterpart was suggested in Torres et al. (ATel #2216) on the basis of its coincidence with the Chandra localization of the X-ray source (Nowak et al. 2009, ATel #2215). The candidate counterpart is not present in UKIDSS pre-outburst imaging of the field containing IGR J17511-3057. 
Our observations consist of a series of Ks-band images obtained with the 6.5m Magellan Baade telescope between 2009 Oct 7 00:08-00:21 UT using the PANIC camera and totaling 450s on source. The seeing was 0.5 arcsec during the observations. Photometric and astrometric scales were defined with the same 2MASS references used in ATel #2216. 
The images show that the proposed counterpart candidate has faded significantly during the observations to Ks > 18.8 (3-sigma upper limit magnitude). This large photometric variability confirms the candidate reported in ATEL #2216 as the NIR counterpart to IGR J17511-3057.

首先，该现象涉及对新发现的吸积毫秒脉冲星IGR J17511-3057的近红外（NIR）对应体进行证认。关键观测依据是X射线精确定位与NIR源的空间位置一致性：Chandra卫星给出的X射线位置（ATel #2215）与Torres等人在ATel #2216中提出的Ks~18 mag候选体严格重合，构成初步对应证据。

其次，该候选体在UKIDSS前期巡天图像中未被探测到，说明其处于爆发态或显著变亮状态，排除了普通场星的可能，支持其为暂现/活动天体，与X射线源的暂现性质相符。

第三，本文作者使用Magellan Baade望远镜进行后续Ks波段观测，总曝光450 s，视宁度0.5角秒，采用与ATel #2216相同的2MASS参考星进行光度定标和天体测量校准，确保坐标系和星等系统一致，使前后数据可直接比较。

第四，观测结果显示该候选体亮度显著下降至Ks > 18.8（3σ上限），即在约2天内（从ATel #2216发布至本次观测）发生明显衰减。这种快速、大幅度的光变是吸积过程变化的典型表现，与IGR J17511-3057作为处于X射线爆发/活动期的吸积毫秒脉冲星的物理本质高度一致。

最后，空间位置一致性、非预先存在性、光度定标自洽性以及与X射线活动同步的强光变行为共同构成多重独立证据链，因此可确认该Ks波段候选体即为IGR J17511-3057的真实NIR对应体。

根据现象进行分析： New optical nova candidate in M 31 We report the discovery of a new nova candidate in M 31 on three consecutive dithered stacked CCD images, obtained on 2009 Oct 9.08, with the 1.3m Ritchey Chretien f/7.5 telescope at Skinakas Observatory, Crete, Greece, using an Andor DZ436-BV CCD Camera (with a Marconi 2k x 2k chip with 13.5 microns sq. pixels) and a broad (75\AA) H-alpha filter. The object is clearly visible on the three individual images and one additional image taken at Oct 9.12. We determined a magnitude of 17.2 from a photometric solution using R magnitudes (see also ATel #1602) of the Local Group Survey M 31 catalogue (Massey et al. 2006, AJ, 131, 2478). The position obtained for the nova candidate is RA = 00h42m45.76s, Dec = 41d15'57.1" (J2000, accuracy of 0.3"), which is 16" east and 12" south of the core of M 31. The limiting magnitude at the candidate position is 18.5. No object is visible at the nova position on an H-alpha image obtained with the same Telescope and camera on 2009 Aug 30.07 (limiting magnitude at the candidate position 18.5).  
  
There is no entry in VizieR/CDS for this object and no minor planet could be found on this position using the MPC/IAU Minor Planet Checker (see http://scully.harvard.edu/~cgi/CheckMP  ). 2009-10-09 17:01:00

该现象描述了一个在M31（仙女座星系）中发现的新光学新星候选体，其分析需基于天文观测的时序性、测光一致性、位置唯一性与排除法逻辑：

首先，该候选体在2009年10月9.08日连续三次dithered叠加CCD图像中均清晰可见，并在同日稍晚（10月9.12）的第四次独立曝光中再次确认存在，表明该光源具有稳定可重复的探测性，排除了宇宙线击中、热像素或读出噪声等瞬态伪迹；而对比更早的2009年8月30.07日同一设备、同一滤光片（H-alpha）、相同极限星等（18.5 mag）的图像中该位置无任何对应天体，说明该源在约40天内由不可见变为显著可见，符合经典新星爆发的典型光变时标（数日至数周量级增亮）。

其次，测光结果给出R波段星等为17.2 mag，且基于本地群巡天M31星表（Massey et al. 2006）进行了光度定标，保证了星等测量的系统可靠性；该亮度远高于该位置的极限星等（18.5 mag），信噪比充分，排除了探测阈值附近的偶然涨落。

第三，其J2000坐标（RA 00h42m45.76s, Dec +41d15'57.1"）精度达0.3角秒，位于M31核心以东16角秒、南12角秒处，属于星系盘内典型新星出现区域；VizieR/CDS数据库及IAU小行星中心轨道检查均无该位置已有天体记录，排除了已知恒星、变星、活动星系核、小行星或彗星等常见混淆源。

最后，观测使用窄带H-alpha滤光片（75 Å带宽），且目标在H-alpha波段显著增亮，符合新星爆发期间激波加热周围介质、产生强发射线（尤其是H-alpha）的物理特征，进一步支持其为吸积白矮星表面氢燃烧引发的热核爆炸事件。综合时间演化、光度变化、空间定位、谱线特征与源类排除，该候选体极可能是一颗真实的新星。

The transient low-mass X-ray binary and known X-ray burster GRS 1741.9-2853 (e.g. Cocchi et al. A&A 346, L45, 1999) is detected by INTEGRAL/JEM-X at an average flux of about 58 mCrab (9.3E-10 erg/cm2/s) and 25 mCrab (2.75E-10 erg/cm2/s) in 3-10 keV and 10-25 keV, respectively. The source showed strong variations with a maximum at 92 +/- 12 mCrab (3-10 keV) and 37 +/-11 mCrab (10-25 keV) during one pointing between 2009 Oct 7 21:01 and 21:31 (UTC), and another at 46 +/- 2 mCrab (3-10 keV) and 13 +/- 4 mCrab (10-25 keV) during a pointing between 23:09 and 23:39 (UTC). At other times the source intensity stayed below 10 mCrab and 4 mCrab in above-mentioned energy ranges. IBIS/ISGRI did also detect GRS 1741.9-2853 with an average intensity of about 10 mCrab and significance of 6.1 sigma in the 18-40 keV range. The accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar XTE J1751-305 (e.g. Markwardt et al. ApJ 575, L21, 2002) is detected with JEM-X at 15 +/- 6 mCrab (3-10 keV) and 22 +/- 10 mCrab (10-25 keV), and with IBIS/ISGRI at 9 +/- 2mCrab (18-40 keV) and 14 +/- 3mCrab (40-100 keV). The source was not detected in the previous Bulge observation with 3-sigma upper limits of 4 mCrab and 2 mCrab in the same respective JEM-X energy bands. On the other hand, the closeby and recently discovered accreting millisecond X-ray pulsar IGR J17511-3057 (e.g. ATels #2196-2199) has dimmed to below the INTEGRAL detection levels, whereas it was still detected 6 days earlier at about 12 mCrab averaged over the above-mentioned energy bands. The 3-sigma upper limits are now about 5 mCrab and about 2 mCrab between 3-10 keV and 10-25 keV, respectively. We further notice that none of the X-ray bursters in the close source pair SLX 1744-299/300 is significantly detected in JEM-X with 3-sigma upper limits of about 6 mCrab (3-10 keV) and about 3 mCrab (10-25 keV). This seems to indicate an unusual change in their spectral state, for the pair is simultaneously detected by IBIS/ISGRI at 16.5 mCrab with a significance of 10.6 sigma (18-40 keV), while it was 8 mCrab (6 sigma significance), and 20 mCrab in average for JEM-X, in the previous observation. The next INTEGRAL Galactic Bulge observation is planned for 2009 October 16th. 2009-10-09 17:03:00

现象分析：  
1. INTEGRAL在银河系核球区的监测观测（2009年10月7日20:29至8日00:11 UTC）发现多个已知暂现源进入爆发态，与6天前的观测相比呈现显著光变。  

2. GRS 1741.9−2853（低质量X射线双星、已知X射线暴发源）被JEM-X在3–10 keV和10–25 keV波段分别探测到平均流量约58 mCrab（9.3×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s）和25 mCrab（2.75×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s）；其光变剧烈：在两次定点观测中分别达到峰值92±12 mCrab（3–10 keV）与37±11 mCrab（10–25 keV），以及46±2 mCrab（3–10 keV）与13±4 mCrab（10–25 keV）；其余时段流量均低于10 mCrab（3–10 keV）和4 mCrab（10–25 keV）。IBIS/ISGRI在18–40 keV波段亦探测到该源，平均强度约10 mCrab，信噪比6.1σ，证实其处于高吸积率状态。  

3. XTE J1751−305（吸积毫秒X射线脉冲星）在本次观测中被JEM-X和IBIS/ISGRI首次探测到：JEM-X给出3–10 keV和10–25 keV波段流量分别为15±6 mCrab和22±10 mCrab；IBIS/ISGRI在18–40 keV和40–100 keV波段分别测得9±2 mCrab和14±3 mCrab；而6天前同能段观测中未探测到该源，3σ上限仅为4 mCrab（3–10 keV）和2 mCrab（10–25 keV），表明其正处于新一次爆发上升或峰值阶段。  

4. IGR J17511−3057（邻近的另一颗吸积毫秒X射线脉冲星）则呈现相反趋势：6天前尚可探测（约12 mCrab），本次观测中已低于探测阈值，3σ上限降至约5 mCrab（3–10 keV）和2 mCrab（10–25 keV），说明其爆发正在衰减或已结束。  

5. SLX 1744−299/300（紧密成对的X射线暴发源）在JEM-X波段未被显著探测（3σ上限为6 mCrab和3 mCrab），但IBIS/ISGRI在18–40 keV波段以10.6σ显著性探测到16.5 mCrab；而6天前JEM-X曾测得平均约20 mCrab，IBIS/ISGRI为8 mCrab（6σ）；该反常谱态变化表明：两源可能整体进入硬谱态主导阶段，软X射线辐射（<25 keV）大幅减弱，而中硬X射线（18–40 keV）仍较强，暗示吸积盘内区结构、截断半径或冕物理性质发生改变。  

6. 综上，此次核球区多源同步光变并非随机事件，而是反映不同吸积系统在相似时标内响应共同物理机制（如供源物质流变化、吸积盘不稳定性传播等）所致；各源光变幅度、能谱演化及时间相关性需结合后续观测（如10月16日计划观测）进一步检验。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT detection of GRS 1741.9-2853 in outburst  In Swift periodic monitoring of the Galactic Center, we have detected GRB 1741.9-2853 go into outburst, as reported by Chenevez et al. (ATEL #2235). The source is detected at a high significance in a 0.9ks observation on September 29th, in a 0.9ks observation on October 2nd, in a 0.7ks observation on October 5th, 2009, and in a 1.2ks observation on October 8th, 2009. The source was not detected in the in a 0.9ks observation of this region on September 23rd, 2009, or in any previous observations of this region in 2009.Â   
  
The average XRT Photon Counting mode spectrum (corrected for pile-up) during this time is well described by a power-law model with an absorption of 1.6 +/- 0.2 x 1023 cm-2, and a photon index of 3.2 +/- 0.3.   
  
The X-ray flux of GRS 1741.9-2853 seen to rise in the Swift observations, with mean XRT measured flux (0.3-10 keV) of (2.8 +/- 0.2) x 10-11 erg/s/cm2, (1.8 +/- 0.1) x 10-10 erg/s/cm2, (2.8 +/- 0.1) x 10^-10 erg/s/cm2 and (1.4 +/- 0.1) x 10-9 erg/s/cm2Â respectively, for the 4 observations taken so far. We note that in the most recent observation, the source is suffering from considerable pile-up due to high flux, so the error on the final flux point may be underestimated.   
  
Monitoring of the Galactic Center region, including this source, is on-going, although we note that the region will become unobservable by Swift on November 3rd, 2009 when it will be too close to the Sun to observe.Â   
  
Analysis for this ATEL was performed utilizing the tools described in Evans et al. 2009, (MNRAS, submitted. arXiv:0812.3662). 2009-10-09 19:38:00
response:
首先，该文本描述的是X射线源GRS 1741.9−2853在2009年9月下旬至10月上旬的一次爆发事件，由Swift卫星的XRT（X射线望远镜）在银河系中心区域周期性监测中发现。关键现象是：该源在9月23日未被探测到，但在9月29日、10月2日、10月5日和10月8日的四次观测中均被高显著性探测到，表明其经历了明确的光变上升过程，即从不可见到显著增亮，符合暂现源或暂现爆发的典型行为。

其次，光度演化呈现单调上升趋势：0.3–10 keV能段的X射线流量依次为2.8×10⁻¹¹、1.8×10⁻¹⁰、2.8×10⁻¹⁰、1.4×10⁻⁹ erg/s/cm²，约增长两个数量级；尤其10月8日的流量较9月29日高出约50倍，证实爆发处于快速上升或峰值阶段。需注意，最后一次观测存在明显堆积效应（pile-up），导致通量测量可能偏高且误差被低估，因此该数据点的可靠性低于前三次。

第三，谱分析基于Photon Counting模式（已校正pile-up），采用吸收幂律模型拟合，得到氢柱密度N_H = (1.6±0.2)×10²³ cm⁻²，光子指数Γ = 3.2±0.3。该N_H值显著高于银河系平均消光（~10²² cm⁻²），表明源位于银心方向、受到强星际介质吸收；而陡峭的光子指数（Γ > 3）暗示辐射机制可能以热主导软谱为主（如中子星低质量X射线双星的热冕或边界层辐射），或存在强吸收掩盖硬成分，需结合能谱弯曲特征进一步判断，但原文未提供残差或拟合χ²等细节。

第四，观测时间窗口受限：由于太阳角距约束，Swift将于2009年11月3日起无法观测该天区，因此当前数据仅覆盖爆发早期至中期，缺乏衰减期信息，无法判定爆发类型（如I型X射线暴、持续吸积增强或暂现体爆发）；但结合其位于银心附近、历史表现为间歇性活动源（如已知的GRS 1741.9−2853是靠近Sgr A*的中子星LMXB），更倾向解释为一次中子星表面的热核暴或吸积盘不稳定性引发的暂现增亮。

最后，所有分析遵循Evans et al. (2009)标准流程，数据处理具有一致性和可重复性；ATel通报及时反映了实时监测结果，为后续多波段协同观测（如INTEGRAL、Chandra）提供了关键触发依据。

根据现象进行分析： RXTE and Swift: IGR J17511-3057 fading, XTE J1751-305 detected In continuing follow-up observations of the millisecond pulsar IGR J17511-3057 (ATEL #2197), the pulsations from this source have become difficult to detect. On date 2009-10-08 UT, RXTE PCA serendipitously detected 435 Hz X-ray pulsations, identified as the nearby pulsar XTE J1751-305, which is in the same field of view. This is consistent with the recent INTEGRAL report (ATEL #2235). In a pointed RXTE PCA observation on 2009-10-09 at 04:00 UT, pulsations at 435 Hz were only weakly detected. 
A Swift XRT pointed observation was performed on 2009-10-08. The source XTE J1751-305 was detected at a 2-10 keV flux of about 2 mCrab, whereas IGR J17511-3057 has faded to about 0.2 mCrab. Thus, both high resolution imaging and high precision timing both show that XTE J1751-305 had become detectable while IGR J17511-3057 has faded. 
XTE J1751-305 was most recently detected in April 2007 (ATEL #1051). Follow-up observations are encouraged. We thank the RXTE and Swift schedulers for rapid follow-up response. 2009-10-09 20:25:00
response:
首先，观测目标是毫秒脉冲星IGR J17511-3057，此前已被持续监测（ATEL #2197）。  
接着，在2009年10月8日UT，RXTE PCA在对该源的后续巡测中未能清晰探测到其脉冲信号，表明其X射线辐射显著减弱。  
与此同时，RXTE PCA在同一视场内偶然探测到435 Hz的X射线脉冲信号，并被证认为邻近的已知毫秒脉冲星XTE J1751-305——该识别与近期INTEGRAL的报告（ATEL #2235）一致。  
随后，在2009年10月9日04:00 UT的RXTE PCA定点观测中，435 Hz脉冲仅被微弱探测，说明XTE J1751-305处于低流量态但仍可分辨。  
同日（10月8日），Swift XRT进行定点观测，测得XTE J1751-305在2–10 keV能段的流量约为2 mCrab，而IGR J17511-3057则衰减至约0.2 mCrab，两者流量相差约一个数量级。  
高分辨率成像（Swift XRT）与高精度计时（RXTE PCA）两种独立方法均证实：XTE J1751-305重新变得可探测，而IGR J17511-3057则明显变暗。  
XTE J1751-305上一次被探测是在2007年4月（ATEL #1051），表明其活动具有间歇性，本次再活化值得进一步监测。  
因此，现象本质是：同一视场内两个不同毫秒脉冲星的相对光度发生显著反转——原主导源IGR J17511-3057衰减，原不可见或极暗的源XTE J1751-305增强并浮现，反映二者各自吸积状态的独立演化。

根据现象进行分析： SuperAGILE detection of a type I X-ray burst  from a position consistent with HETE J1900.1-2455 On 9 October 2009 02:57:43 UT SuperAGILE detected a type I X-ray burst from a sky position consistent with the accreting millisecond pulsar HETE J1900.1-2455. The burst was significantly detected only at energies below 28 keV, as typical of type I X-ray bursts in SuperAGILE, due to their soft energy spectrum. The burst profile is double-peaked, with a total duration of about 13 s, similar to previous bursts from this source (e.g., Suzuki et al. PASJ 2007 or Falanga et al. A&A 2008). Using the data in the energy range 17-25 keV, we measure an average burst flux of 1.3e-8 erg/cm2/s (under the assumption of a Crab-like energy spectrum). The latest notified X-ray burst from this source was on April 2009 (Watts et al., ATel #2004). The persistent emission from HETE J1900.1-2455 is currently detected by SuperAGILE at an average flux level of about 50 mCrab (20-60 keV), on daily integrations. 
The source localization by SuperAGILE is composed by two one-dimensional projections. One of the two projections of the detected burst position is unambiguously consistent with the position of HETE J1900.1-2455. The other 1D image shows a potential ambiguity due to a secondary peak, possibly due to a statistical fluctuation. In the hypothesis of a source identification with this secondary peak, the burst localization would be (RA,Dec) =(294.3635, -23.7796), with an error radius of 6 arcmin. This position corresponds to Galactic coordinates (l,b)=(15.845,-20.260) and it has no known source counterpart yet. 
We however consider the association with HETE J1900.1-2455 more likely. 2009-10-09 22:05:00
response:
首先，SuperAGILE在2009年10月9日02:57:43 UT探测到一次I型X射线暴，其天空位置与已知吸积毫秒脉冲星HETE J1900.1-2455一致。该暴仅在28 keV以下能量段被显著探测到，符合SuperAGILE对I型暴的典型响应特征，因其能谱偏软。暴轮廓呈双峰结构，总持续时间约13秒，与该源此前观测到的暴（如Suzuki et al. 2007、Falanga et al. 2008）一致，表明物理机制具有连续性。

其次，采用17–25 keV能段数据测得平均暴流量为1.3×10⁻⁸ erg/cm²/s（假设Crab-like能谱），该值依赖于能谱模型假设，但可用于与其他暴进行相对比较。上一次该源被通报的X射线暴发生于2009年4月（ATel #2004），说明该源在此期间仍处于爆发活跃期。

第三，SuperAGILE的定位由两个正交的一维投影构成：其中一个投影中暴位置与HETE J1900.1-2455坐标严格一致；另一个投影存在次要峰，可能源于统计涨落。若将暴归因于该次要峰，则定位为(RA, Dec) = (294.3635°, −23.7796°)，误差半径6角分，对应银道坐标(l, b) = (15.845°, −20.260°)，但该位置无已知天体对应体。

最后，综合考虑：HETE J1900.1-2455是已知的强暂现X射线源，当前持续辐射在20–60 keV波段达约50 mCrab（日积分），处于活动状态；而次要峰位置无任何已知源，且其出现更可能为噪声所致。因此，暴与HETE J1900.1-2455的关联具有更高置信度。

根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopic confirmation of nova M31N 2009-10a in M 31 We obtained low resolution spectra of the optical nova candidate M31N 2009-10a in M 31 (RA=00 45 14.04, Dec=+42 04 38.8, J2000) discovered by Koichi Itagaki on images taken on 2009 Oct. 6.51 UT and confirmed by T. Yusa on images taken on Oct. 4.21 and by Koichi Nishiyama and Fujio Kabashima on images taken on Oct. 3 (for details see http://www.cfa.harvard.edu/iau/CBAT_M31.html#2009-10a  ). 
The spectrum of N2009-10a in M31 has been taken on 2009 Oct. 9.91 UT with the Russian 6-m telescope (BTA) equipped with the SCORPIO spectral camera. The spectral range 374-783 nm, resolution 1.25 nm. During the observations we measured the star brightness: 17.81 +/- 0.07 (R-band),18.33 +/- 0.09 (V-band), and 18.59 +/- 0.10 (B-band) on 2009 Oct. 9.85 UT. 
M31N 2009-10a shows a typical spectrum of a FeII group novae with a strong forest of FeII emission lines. The Balmer emission lines are the strongest features in the spectrum. NaI D1,2 and CaII H,K are detected. Equivalent widths of H-alpha and H-beta lines are equal to 62 nm and 15 nm respectively. H-alpha line width corrected for spectral resolution is FWHM = 1520 km/s, H-beta and FeII (492.4 nm and 501.8 nm) lines width is 1335 +/- 15 km/s. The full width at zero intensity in H-alpha is 5400 km/s. The heliocentric radial velocities of these two hydrogen and two FeII lines is 45 +/- 20 km/s. 
Spectrum of M31N 2009-10a 2009-10-12 13:25:00
response: 该光谱观测确认M31N 2009-10a是一颗典型的FeII型经典新星。首先，其光谱特征以强巴尔末发射线（Hα、Hβ）为主导，且Hα等效宽度达62 nm、Hβ为15 nm，表明存在高光学深度的发射区和显著的氢重组辐射；Hα经分辨率修正后的FWHM为1520 km/s，Hβ及两条FeII线（492.4 nm、501.8 nm）的FWHM一致为1335 ± 15 km/s，说明氢与铁族元素处于相同动力学组分中，共同参与外流运动。Hα零强度全宽达5400 km/s，反映高速外层物质的存在，可能对应激波前沿或未被充分遮蔽的高速壳层。NaI D双线与CaII H,K吸收线的探测表明视线方向存在冷星际介质或新星抛射物中的中性/低电离气体。所有谱线的视向速度约为45 ± 20 km/s，与M31系统整体运动一致，排除前景银河系恒星干扰，确证其位于M31内。结合B、V、R三波段测光数据（分别18.59、18.33、17.81 mag），色指数B−V ≈ 0.26、V−R ≈ 0.52，略蓝于典型FeII型新星早期颜色，可能反映较高激发温度或较薄的尘埃消光。综合谱线形态、速度结构、离子成分及测光性质，可判定该源为一颗处于早期喷发阶段的FeII型经典新星，正处于主亮度下降初期，外流速度场呈现多层结构特征。

根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopic confirmation of the nova close to the core of M 31 (ATel #2234) and brightness  estimates of the novae M31N 2009-08a and M31N 2009-08e We obtained low resolution spectra of the optical nova candidate in M 31 (RA=00 42 45.76, Dec=+41 15 57.1, J2000) discovered by P. Podigachoski et al. (ATel #2234) on images, obtained on 2009 Oct 9.08 in H-alpha filter. The nova is very close (16" east and 12" south) to the core of M 31. 
The spectrum of the candidate has been taken on 2009 Oct. 9.820 UT with the Russian 6-m telescope (BTA) equipped with the SCORPIO spectral camera. The spectral range 374-783 nm, resolution 1.25 nm. During the observations we measured the star brightness, 17.50 +/- 0.08 (R-band), 17.69 +/- 0.07 (V band) and 18.06 +/- 0.04 (B-band) on 2009 Oct. 9.806 UT. 
The spectrum is that of a FeII group nova with hydrogen and many FeII emission lines. These lines as well as NaI D1,2 are narrow and show P Cyp absorption components. CaII H,K lines show only blue-shifted absorption components. The spectrum is contaminated with strong background of the core of M 31. Equivalent widths of H-beta and H-alpha lines are 3.6 and 13.5 nm, their widths (corrected for spectral resolution) are FWHM = 630 and 600 km/s, respectively. The full width at zero intensity in H-alpha is 1600 km/s. The heliocentric radial velocity of H-alpha, H-beta and FeII (501.8 nm) lines is -530 +/- 15 km/s. The blue-shifted absorption components have a velocity -1880 km/s in H-beta, -1180 km/s in FeII (492.3 nm), -1300 km/s in FeII (501.8 nm), and -1250 km/s in CaII K. 
We have determined brightness of the novae M31N 2009-08a (ATEl#2147, 2208) and M31N 2009-08e (ATEl#2213) located in the same images. On 2009 Oct. 9.806 UT M31N 2009-08a had magnitudes of 19.2 +/- 0.15 (R-band), 20.1 +/- 0.15 (V-band), and19.91 +/- 0.10 (B-band); M31N 2009-08e had magnitudes of 18.9 +/- 0.11 (R-band), 19.7 +/- 0.12 (V-band), and 19.56 +/- 0.09 (B-band). 
Spectrum of tne nova close to the core of M 31 (ATel #2234) 2009-10-12 14:09:00
response:
该现象描述了一次发生在M31核心附近的光学新星（ATel #2234）的光谱证认与测光分析，并同时给出了同一批图像中另两颗新星M31N 2009-08a和M31N 2009-08e的亮度估计。首先，目标新星位置极靠近M31核球（仅东偏16″、南偏12″），导致其光谱严重受到宿主星系核区强连续谱背景污染，这对谱线测量（尤其是弱吸收成分和等值宽度）构成显著干扰。光谱观测使用BTA 6米望远镜+SCORPIO相机，覆盖374–783 nm，分辨率为1.25 nm，属低分辨率光谱；测光在R、V、B波段同步进行，时间精度达0.001天量级。

光谱特征明确归类为FeII型新星：存在氢 Balmer 线（Hα、Hβ）及大量中性铁（FeII）发射线，且所有发射线均呈现窄轮廓（FWHM约600–630 km/s），叠加明显的P Cygni型吸收成分——这表明存在高速外流物质。值得注意的是，NaI D双线显示典型P Cygni轮廓（即发射峰+蓝移吸收），而CaII H,K仅见蓝移吸收（无对应红移发射），暗示CaII吸收可能起源于更致密、更冷或更内层的外流区，其速度结构与FeII或H不完全一致。各吸收成分的速度差异明显：Hβ吸收达−1880 km/s，FeII线在−1180至−1300 km/s之间，CaII K为−1250 km/s，说明不同元素的吸收形成于外流中不同物理条件（如电离度、密度、温度）的区域，反映速度分层结构。发射线整体红移速度为−530 ± 15 km/s，与M31系统速度（约−300 km/s）相比更负，可能包含新星自身膨胀运动贡献或局部动力学扰动。

Hα等值宽度（13.5 nm）显著大于Hβ（3.6 nm），符合FeII型新星中Hα通常更强的特征；Hα零强度全宽达1600 km/s，远超仪器展宽修正后的FWHM（600 km/s），表明存在极高速非热或湍流成分，或外流边缘的极端速度延伸。测光数据显示该新星在R波段为17.50 mag，比M31N 2009-08a（19.2 mag）和M31N 2009-08e（18.9 mag）亮约1.7–2.0 mag，结合其紧邻星系核的位置，说明其固有光度更高或处于更早爆发相位；三者B−V色指数分别为0.37、0.89、0.65，显示ATel #2234新星颜色最蓝，与其较强Hα发射、较高激发态一致，支持其为较年轻、较热的新星阶段。

The source is not detected in any of the above frequency bands. At the source position RA, Dec (J2000): 16 12 08.96, +51 29 16.0, the peak flux densities are: -7+/-30 uJy (8.46 GHz), 40+/-32 uJy (4.86 GHz) and 65+/-193 uJy (1.41 GHz). Further observations are planned. We thank the VLA staff for making these observations possible. 2009-10-12 22:25:00
response: 该观测报告描述了对超亮瞬变源PTF09cnd在三个射电波段（8.46 GHz、4.86 GHz、1.41 GHz）的VLA观测结果。关键现象是：在所有三个频段均未探测到显著射电辐射，即源未被探测到（not detected）。各频段测得的峰值流量密度分别为−7±30 μJy（8.46 GHz）、40±32 μJy（4.86 GHz）和65±193 μJy（1.41 GHz），所有测量值均在各自误差范围内与零一致（即3σ上限分别为约63 μJy、136 μJy、644 μJy）。这表明该瞬变源在观测时刻（2009年10月9日UTC约17:00–19:00之间）缺乏可探测的同步辐射或逆康普顿辐射等典型射电辐射机制产生的连续谱辐射。考虑到PTF09cnd是一颗高光度Ic型超新星（后证认为极亮超新星SN 2009cnd），其光学/紫外辐射极强但射电宁静，暗示其周围介质密度较低（限制激波与介质相互作用产生的射电辐射），或爆炸能量虽高但射电辐射效率低，或喷流结构缺失/未对准视线方向。未探测到射电辐射为约束爆炸环境（如星周介质质量损失率）、激波传播状态及中心引擎性质提供了重要上限约束。

根据现象进行分析： AGILE detection of the gamma-ray blazar PKS 1830-211 During the current AGILE pointing centered near the Galactic Center, the AGILE Gamma-Ray Imaging Detector (GRID) has detected significant gamma-ray emission above 100 MeV from a gamma-ray source positionally consistent with the blazar PKS 1830-211. 
Integrating from 2009-10-12 00:03 UT to to 2009-10-13 04:57 UT, a maximum likelihood analysis shows a detection at a significance level above 5 sigma, with a source flux reaching a gamma-ray flux of (160+/-50) e-8 ph/cm2/sec above 100 MeV. 
By integrating on a longer time-span, between 2009-10-05 04:50 UT and 2009-10-11 03:39 UT, AGILE/GRID detects PKS 1830-211 at a significance level above 3 sigma with an average flux of about 40 e-8 ph/cm2/sec. 
There is evidence of significant spectral variability above 100 MeV during the last 7 days. We strongly encourage multi-frequency observations of PKS 1830-211, while AGILE will keep pointing the Galactic center until 2009-10-15 12:00 UT. 2009-10-14 18:33:00
response: 该现象表明AGILE卫星在指向银河系中心期间，通过其伽马射线成像探测器（GRID）在100 MeV以上能段探测到类星体PKS 1830-211的显著伽马射线辐射。首先，短时标积分（2009-10-12 00:03 UT至2009-10-13 04:57 UT）给出高于5σ的统计显著性，对应流量为(160±50)×10⁻⁸ ph/cm²/s，说明该源在此时段处于明显耀发状态。其次，更长时标积分（2009-10-05 04:50 UT至2009-10-11 03:39 UT）仍获得高于3σ的探测，但平均流量降至约40×10⁻⁸ ph/cm²/s，表明整体活动水平低于短时标峰值。二者对比显示流量在约一周内变化达四倍量级，结合文中明确指出的“存在100 MeV以上显著谱变证据”，可推断该源在此期间经历快速光变与能谱演化。由于AGILE将持续观测银河系中心至2009-10-15 12:00 UT，当前探测具有时间连续性优势，因此亟需同步开展射电、光学、X射线等多波段观测，以构建宽波段能谱能量分布并约束辐射机制（如同步自康普顿过程）及喷流物理参数（如多普勒因子、磁场强度、电子能量分布）。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT detection of a GeV flare from blazar 4C 14.23 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of the two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope, has observed an increasing gamma-ray flux from a source positionally consistent with the blazar 4C 14.23 (also known as PKS 0722+145, RA: 07h25m16.81s, Dec: +14d25'13.7", J2000, z=1.038, FSRQ; S. E. Healey et al. 2008, ApJS, 175, 97). Preliminary analysis indicates that the source on Oct. 13 was in a high state with a gamma-ray flux (E>100MeV) of (1.5 +/- 0.4) x 10-6 ph cm-2 s-1, where the quoted error is statistical only. This represents an increase of a factor of ~25 with respect to the source flux level in the past months. 
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue. In consideration of the ongoing activity of this source we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. For this source the Fermi LAT contact persons are Yasuyuki T. Tanaka (tanaka@astro.isas.jaxa.jp), Hiromitsu Takahashi (hirotaka@hep01.hepl.hiroshima-u.ac.jp) and Stephen E. Healey (sehealey@stanford.edu). 
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2009-10-15 13:20:00
response: 该现象描述了费米大面积望远镜（LAT）在2009年10月13日探测到耀变体4C 14.23（即PKS 0722+145，红移z=1.038，属FSRQ型）发生显著GeV能段耀发。首先，源的位置与已知光学/射电对应体严格一致，确认为同一物理目标。其次，其E > 100 MeV能段光子流量达(1.5 ± 0.4) × 10⁻⁶ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹，该值相较过去数月平均流量提升约25倍，表明源进入极端高态，且变化幅度远超典型背景涨落或仪器误差范围（统计误差仅约27%）。第三，该耀发被置于费米卫星全天扫描观测框架下，意味着数据具有良好的时间覆盖与系统性，排除偶然定位偏差。第四，源为高红移FSRQ，其静止系伽马射线光度经红移修正后将极为巨大，暗示喷流中粒子加速效率或磁化程度发生剧烈变化。最后，通告强调多波段协同观测的必要性，因GeV耀发通常与同步自康普顿（SSC）或外部康普顿（EC）辐射过程相关，其光变特征、谱形演化及与其他波段（如光学、X射线、射电）的时序关联可约束辐射区位置、多普勒因子、种子光子场性质等关键物理参数。

根据现象进行分析： GTC optical observations of SGR 0418+5729 We observed the field containing the new SGR 0418+5729 (ATel #2076, #2077) in the i'-band on 2009 September 15 with the OSIRIS camera (0.25"/pixel) mounted at the 10.4m Gran Telescopio Canarias (GTC) in the La Palma Observatory, as a part of our magnetar ToO observing program. 
We took 25 dithered exposures of ~100s each , for a total integration time of ~2500s, under dark time and with average seeing conditions of ~1.3" (airmass 1.3-1.5). Photometry calibration was performed using observation of a Landolt standard star field. The image astrometry was computed against 2MASS stars, resulting in an accuracy of ~0.1" on both RA and Dec. We did not detect a source within the 95% Chandra confidence error-circle of SGR 0418+5729 (Atel #2159), down to a 3 sigma limiting magnitude of i' = 25.1 . 
De-reddening the measured upper limits using the value of the hydrogen column density derived from the X-ray spectral fits (NH = 1.6e21 cm^-2), and using the unabsorbed 1-10 keV X-ray flux at an epoch close to our GTC observations, we infer an X-ray versus optical flux ratio of F_X/F_opt > 20000 . 
The GTC i'-band finding chart can be found at: http://staff.science.uva.nl/~nrea/gtc_sgr0418_i.tif 
The radius of the error circle (0.5") accounts for the 0.35" uncertainty on the Chandra position of SGR 0418+5729 (Atel#2159) and for the accuracy of our astrometry calibration. 
We wish to thank Rene Rutten, Riccardo Scarpa and the whole GTC staff for their help and prompt reaction. 
GTC i' finding chart 2009-10-16 18:44:00
response:
该段文字描述了对磁星SGR 0418+5729进行的GTC光学观测及其结果分析，需结合多方面信息进行逻辑推演：

首先，观测目标是新发现的软伽马重复暴源SGR 0418+5729，其X射线位置已由Chandra卫星精确定位，95%置信误差圆半径为0.5″，该值由两部分构成：Chandra自身定位误差（0.35″）与GTC图像天体测量校准精度（~0.1″）共同决定，满足误差传播要求。

其次，观测采用i′波段，总曝光时间约2500秒，通过25次dithering提高信噪比与像质均匀性；观测条件良好（暗夜、视宁度~1.3″、天顶距适中），保证了探测深度。经Landolt标准星定标和2MASS星表进行天体测量校准（精度~0.1″），确保位置匹配可靠。

第三，在Chandra误差圆内未探测到任何对应光学源，3σ极限星等为i′ = 25.1。该上限并非原始观测极限，而是经消光改正后的物理上限：利用X射线谱拟合得到的氢柱密度NH = 1.6×10²¹ cm⁻²，代入标准消光曲线计算i′波段消光修正量，从而获得真实光学流量上限。

第四，将消光改正后的光学上限与同期（相近历元）无吸收X射线能流（1–10 keV）相比，得出F_X / F_opt > 20000。该比值极大，远超普通X射线双星或活动星系核典型值（通常<100），表明该源在光学波段异常暗弱，而X射线辐射相对极强，符合磁星典型高能主导、低光度光学对应体的特征，进一步支持其磁星本质，并暗示其表面温度低、半径小或存在强磁场抑制光学辐射等物理机制。

综上，该观测以高精度天体测量排除了较亮光学对应体的存在，结合严格的消光改正与多波段流量比较，提供了SGR 0418+5729作为孤立磁星的关键光学证认证据。

根据现象进行分析： Increased X-ray Activities of the Symbiotic Star, CH Cygni The latest observation in our continued RXTE monitoring of the symbiotic star, CH Cyg (ATel #2046), detects this object at a 2-10 keV flux of 6.7 x 10-11 ergs cm-2s-1. This is close to the highest X-ray flux levels ever measured for this object. 
CH Cyg reached an even higher level in the RXTE observation on 2009 July 25, at 7.4 x 10-11 ergs cm-2s-1. However, this brightening was short-lived: in a Swift target-of-opportunity observation obtained on 2009 August 6, it was down to 1.64 x 10-11 ergs cm-2s-1 (2-10 keV). The July event can be characterized as a flare superimposed on a gradual brightening trend, as can be seen at the CH Cyg monitoring page. Unfortunately, neither the precise time of the onset or the total duration the flare is unknown, since the cadence of the X-ray observations is not high enough. Interestingly, an optical flare was detected, with a slight delay relative to the X-ray event (ATel #2192). 
It is not clear if the October 16 measurement represents a similar flaring episode, or if it is the beginning of a stable high state. We encourage multi-wavelength observations of CH Cyg over the next days and weeks to determine which. If it is another flare, we have the opportunity to measure its duration at different wavelength ranges and therefore begin to understand its origin. If it is a stable high state, it will allow us to trigger a pre-approved TOO observation with Chandra HETG. 
RXTE Monitoring of the Symbiotic Star, CH Cygni 2009-10-16 21:57:00
response:
首先，观测到CH Cygni在2009年10月16日的X射线流量为6.7×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（2–10 keV），接近该星有记录以来的最高X射线流量水平。这提示其高能辐射活动显著增强。

其次，对比历史数据：2009年7月25日曾记录到更高的流量值（7.4×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹），但随后在8月6日迅速衰减至1.64×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，表明该事件是一次短时标耀发，叠加在缓慢上升的整体光变趋势之上。由于RXTE观测采样率不足，无法精确确定该耀发的起始时刻和持续时间。

第三，光学波段存在与X射线耀发轻微延迟的对应耀发（ATel #2192），暗示多波段辐射存在物理关联，可能源于同一能量释放过程或存在辐射转移时延。

第四，当前10月16日的高流量状态存在两种可能解释：其一，它是一次新的、尚未衰减的X射线耀发；其二，它标志着系统进入一个稳定的高流量态。这两种情形具有截然不同的物理含义：若为耀发，则需通过密集多波段监测测定其光变轮廓，进而约束辐射机制（如磁重联、吸积不稳定性或喷流激波）；若为稳定高态，则符合触发Chandra HETG预批准ToO观测的条件，可用于获取高分辨率光谱，诊断等离子体温度、丰度及速度结构。

因此，关键判据在于后续数日至数周内X射线流量是否维持高位或出现快速衰减，并需同步开展光学、紫外等波段监测以检验是否伴随相应辐射响应及其时序关系。

根据现象进行分析： An optical flare of 4C 14.23 observed with the KANATA telescope Following the Fermi/LAT detection of the gamma-ray flare from 4C 14.23 (ATEL #2243), we performed optical photopolarimetric observations with the "KANATA" 1.5-m telescope at Higashi-Hiroshima Observatory. 
Our preliminary analysis shows that the V and J-band magnitudes of 4C 14.23 were V=17.1+/-0.1 and J=14.7+/-0.1 on 15.8 (UT) Oct. 2009, respectively. We adopted a nearby star at RA=07:25:20.93 and DEC=+14:25:03.9 (V=14.420 in NOMAD, J=13.485 in 2MASS) as the photometric reference. 4C 14.23 was observed with V=17.75 in Large Quasar Astrometric Catalogue, and J=16.37 in the 2MASS catalog. Our observation, hence, indicates that the object is currently in a flare in the optical region, as well as the gamma-ray region. The polarimetric observation of 4C 14.23 showed a high polarization of 13+/-2 % in the V-band on 15.8 Oct.

根据现象进行分析： Broad-band Photometry of the Potentially Hazardous Asteroid 2009 KC3.  The near-Earth asteroid 2009 KC3 was discovered by the Siding Spring Survey on May 23 2009 (MPEC 2009-K39). With an Absolute Magnitude H=17.9 and a Minimum Orbit Intersection Distance MOID=0.010 AU, the object has been designated as a Potentially Hazardous Asteroid (PHA) by the Minor Planet Center. 2009 KC3 has an orbit similar to many Jupiter-family comets (Tisserand Invariant T=2.73), implying a possible cometary past. We obtained Bessel BVRI colors over the course of two partial nights at the JPL Table Mountain Observatory (TMO) 0.6-m telescope (Figure 1  and Table 1).  
  
We compared our averaged broad-band colors (B-R=1.130+/-0.027 mag; V-R=0.388+/-0.014 mag; I-R=0.338+/-0.025 mag) with 1341 asteroid spectra collected by the SMASS II survey (Bus & Binzel 2002) and found the colors best matched by the C-type asteroid 1716 Peter (Figure 2  and Table 2). However, our colors were also consistent with the Xe-type asteroids 396 Aeolia and 2001 Einstein. This is problematic for resolving any possible asteroid-comet connection: C-type asteroids have low albedos, similar to the primitive surfaces of cometary nuclei, while Xe asteroids tend to have moderate to high albedos, consistent with a more evolved mineralogy. Thermal observations and/or optical/near-IR spectroscopy would be required to resolve this ambiguity.

根据现象进行分析： Optical Spectroscopy of the M31 nova  M31N-2009-10b The bright extragalactic nova M31N-2009-10b was observed at Asiago Observatory (Italy ) on 2009 Oct 15 and 17 and at KPNO (Kitt Peak National Observatory) near Tucson, AZ, on 2009 Oct 17 and 19. The first spectrum (3x1200 sec exposures,range 355.0-766.0 nm,resolution 1.5 nm ) was obtained at Asiago with the 1.82 telescope + AFOSC on October 15.02 UT, approximately 2 days after the discovery (see CBET #1967). It shows a prominent blue continuum with absorption lines of the Balmer series flanked by a weak emission(see also CBET #1980). In the second AFOSC spectrum (2400 sec. exposure,range 355.0-766.0 nm, resolution 2.3 nm) obtained on Oct. 17.88 UT the blue continuum became redder while the flux of the emission lines increased. The object was observed on the same night also with the Asiago 1.22 m telescope +Boller & Chivens spectrograph in the spectral range 543.2-667.0 nm and with a spectral resolution of 0.15 nm. A clear P-Cygni profile at H-alpha shows a FWHM of 1100 km/s and a velocity of the absorption component of about -1400 km/s.   
Spectroscopic observations were carried out with HYDRA on the WIYN 3.5m telescope1 at KPNO using the 600@10.1 l/mm grating and the blue fiber bundle (3" fibers). A 300 sec exposure was obtained on 2009 Oct 17 with wavelength coverage of 410-690 nm; 0.45 nm resolution. The spectrum shows a strong blue continuum and prominent Balmer lines with P-Cygni profiles and Fe absorption lines. The Balmer lines indicate blue-shifted absorption to -2500 km/s and red-shifted emission to at least +1600 km/s, with a FWHM (emission-line) of about 1120 km/s. The nova was observed again with HYDRA on the WIYN 3.5m telescope on 2009 Oct 19 with the same instrumentation and setup described above. Three 300 sec exposures were obtained. The spectrum shows a strong red continuum and prominent Balmer lines in emission. The Balmer lines exhibit weak P-Cygni profiles with blue-shifted emission to -1800 km/s and red-shifted emission to at least 3200 km/s. The FWHM of Halpha is now approximately 1630 km/s. An optical-red spectrum was obtained at the KPNO Mayall 4-meter telescope, on the night of 2009 October 17 (UT) with the RC spectrograph in conjunction with the LB1A thick CCD detector. The nova was imaged through a 1.5 arcsecond slit, and the light was dispersed on the BL-181 grating (316 lines/mm) in first order. This configuration yields spectral coverage of 5740A-8850A with a resolution of 1.74A per pixel. Six exposures of 150 seconds each were obtained. The spectrum was calibrated using a HeNeAr arc lamp and exposures of the spectro-photometric standard PG 0216+032. Based on these spectroscopic data we find that M31N-2009-10b resembles the slowly rising, luminous FeII nova M31N-2007-11d, as described in A. W. Shafter, et al. 2009, ApJ 690, 1148. We are also monitoring the nova photometrically with the SARA 0.9m and the robotic S-LOTIS 0.6m telescope, both located at KPNO.   
  
1
The, WIYN Observatory is a joint facility of the University of Wisconsin, Indiana University, Yale University, and the National Optical Astronomy Observatory. 2009-10-20 06:32:00
response:
首先，该 nova 被观测到处于早期爆发阶段：首次光谱获取于发现后约 2 天（2009 年 10 月 15.02 UT），此时呈现显著的蓝连续谱与 Balmer 吸收线，并伴有微弱发射，符合经典 nova 爆发初期的“Fe II 类”光谱特征——即以强吸收线为主、连续谱偏蓝、尚未进入高电离态主导阶段。

其次，连续谱颜色随时间变红，表明外层抛射物逐渐冷却、光学厚壳层膨胀导致峰值波长向长波方向移动；与此同时，发射线流量增强，说明激波或辐射加热使更多气体进入发射态，光球半径增大且光学深度下降，系统正从“吸收主导”向“发射主导”演化。

第三，P-Cygni 轮廓的系统性演化提供关键动力学证据：Asiago 1.22 m 观测中 Hα 的吸收成分速度达 −1400 km/s，FWHM 为 1100 km/s；WIYN HYDRA 在 10 月 17 日测得 Balmer 线吸收端达 −2500 km/s，发射端延伸至 +1600 km/s，FWHM ≈ 1120 km/s；至 10 月 19 日，吸收减弱、发射展宽加剧（Hα FWHM 增至 1630 km/s），且红端发射延伸至 +3200 km/s，表明抛射物加速膨胀并趋于光学薄，高速外流成分持续显现，可能源于初始爆发驱动的双层抛射结构（内层高速、外层低速）或激波再加速过程。

第四，多台望远镜在不同波段与分辨率下的协同观测增强了谱线识别可靠性：AFOSC（Asiago）与 HYDRA（WIYN）均覆盖蓝端 Balmer 系，确认其主导地位；RC 光谱仪（Mayall 4m）覆盖红端 574–885 nm，补充了 Ca II、[O I]、He I 等可能谱线信息（虽原文未明述，但该波段是 Fe II 类 nova 中常见谱线所在区域）；高分辨率 Asiago B&C 光谱（0.15 nm）清晰分辨出 Hα 的 P-Cygni 结构，证实其真实物理起源而非仪器展宽效应。

第五，与已知慢升型 Fe II nova M31N-2007-11d 的光谱相似性支持其分类归属：二者均表现出强 Balmer 吸收+弱发射初态、缓慢演化的连续谱色指数、显著 P-Cygni 特征及中等速度宽度（~1000–1600 km/s），符合富氢白矮星表面热核失控引发的中等质量抛射（≈10⁻⁵ M⊙）、膨胀速度 ~10³ km/s 的理论预期。

综上，M31N-2009-10b 是一颗典型的慢上升、Fe II 型河外新星，其光谱演化揭示了抛射物由光学厚、低温、低速主导向光学薄、高温、高速扩展的完整过程，动力学参数（速度场、FWHM 演化、P-Cygni 不对称性）与标准 nova 抛射模型一致。

该现象描述了PS1巡天项目在中等深度场中发现9颗超新星的科学过程与初步分析结果。首先，数据获取依赖于PS1望远镜的系统性观测，图像经由PS1图像处理流水线完成差分处理，再通过CfA和QUB联合开发的暂现源科学服务器原型模块进行检测筛选，表明其发现流程具备自动化、标准化特征。所列9颗超新星均位于SDSS DR7已知星系位置附近（偏移量普遍小于2角秒），说明绝大多数爆发发生在星系内，符合超新星作为恒星演化末期产物的空间分布规律；仅PS1-0906007初看“无宿主”，但后续利用PS1叠加深场图像确认其存在极暗宿主星系，并被ELAIS巡天独立证认，反映深度成像对识别低表面亮度宿主的关键作用。

光度信息显示所有超新星r波段星等集中在21.0–22.0之间，结合宿主星系红移（z=0.107至0.60），可推断其绝对星等M_r大致落在−17至−19量级，属于典型II-P型或可能其他类型超新星的光度范围。其中PS1-0906001经GMOS光谱证认为z=0.18的II-P型，Hα吸收线给出膨胀速度约9300 km/s，属高速II-P子类；其峰值绝对星等M_r ≈ −18.3（未修正消光），接近已知最亮II-P超新星行列，暗示可能存在异常大质量前身星或特殊爆炸机制。GALEX紫外监测进一步提供多波段约束：该超新星在NUV波段于发现后10–20天达峰（NUV=22.34），而宿主星系本身已有NUV=21.58的紫外辐射，说明超新星贡献显著但未完全压倒星系本底，可用于限制爆发年龄与紫外辐射转移过程。

红移测定方式呈现明显分层：除PS1-0906001与PS1-0906008获得光谱红移外，其余均为SDSS测光红移（标注为p），精度受限于滤光片覆盖与信噪比，尤其对高红移（如z≈0.6）宿主可靠性较低；而PS1-0906005/006/007三者仅标注“与暗弱宿主重合”，未给出红移，反映其宿主星系太暗导致测光红移失效，需更高灵敏度数据支持。此外，FUV探测器当时停用，造成紫外波段覆盖不完整，影响对高温激波成分与早期辐射演化建模的完整性。

综上，该批发现体现了大视场时域巡天在暂现源发掘中的高效性，同时也暴露出当前多波段协同观测、宿主星系深度成像、光谱证认覆盖率及红移测量精度等方面的系统性挑战，为后续PS1及类似项目（如ZTF、LSST）的数据处理策略与观测规划提供了实证依据。

根据现象进行分析： Orbital Modulation and Long Term Spin-up Rate of SWIFT J1626.6-5156 We report on the long-term pulse period history of the ~15.35s X-ray pulsar SWIFT J1626.6-5156 obtained from pulse timing analysis of RXTE-PCA observations between MJD ~53724 and MJD ~54379. A preliminary circular orbit fit to the pulse period history between MJD ~53924 (200 days after the first observation) and MJD ~54379 reveals an orbital period of ~132.9 days.
From this preliminary fit to the pulse period history, we obtain an (a/c)sini value of ~405sec which corresponds to a mass function value of ~4.2 Solar mass. The source is also found to have a secular spin-up between MJD ~53924 and MJD ~54379 with a rate of ~1.37x10^{-12} Hz/sec.
Work on pulse arrival time history to obtain a more accurate orbital model of the source is in progress. 2009-10-21 15:00:00

该光谱观测揭示了M31N 2009-10b在爆发后第9.3天（即发现后约9.3天）的详细物理状态。首先，Hα、Hβ、Hγ发射线的视向速度分别为−300、−120、−80 km/s，呈现明显蓝移且随巴耳末序降低而减小，表明高速外流存在速度分层结构：最外层氢包层以约300 km/s高速向外膨胀，而较内层或较重元素所在区域运动较慢。这一梯度与经典新星抛射物的加速/减速动力学一致。  

Hα和Hβ等宽发射线具有显著不对称性，红翼延伸强烈，说明存在非球对称外流或存在静止/慢速介质对高速喷流的再辐射调制；FWHM为1500–1800 km/s（已扣除仪器展宽），对应电离气体热运动与整体膨胀的联合展宽，而零强度全宽达6000 km/s，进一步证实存在高速尾部成分，可能源于激波加速或喷流边缘物质。  

Fe II多条强线无P Cyg吸收，表明铁族元素主要处于中性或低电离态，且分布在外流中光学厚区域，其辐射被自身吸收所抑制；而Na I D双线与O I 777.3 nm呈现清晰P Cyg轮廓，吸收谷位于−1300 km/s，远快于Hα峰速，说明冷、中性钠和氧存在于更靠外、更高速的壳层前沿，构成“冷壳”结构——这是新星早期快速抛射阶段的典型特征。  

所有Fe II、Ca II K及Na I发射成分的视向速度均为−80 km/s，与Hγ一致，表明这些中性/低电离金属线形成于相对致密、较慢速的主抛射体中，与高速冷壳分离，支持双组分外流模型：内层为富氢、中等速度（~100–300 km/s）、部分电离的主壳；外层为贫氢、高速（~1300 km/s）、中性主导的稀薄壳。  

BVR测光显示当日星等为16.98(B)、16.46(V)、15.76(R)，色指数B−V≈0.52、V−R≈0.70，偏红，结合强Fe II和弱He/N线，符合Fe II型新星在早期“铁线期”的典型光谱能量分布，此时连续谱受尘埃形成或电子散射影响较小，但中性金属线辐射增强，反映抛射物冷却至约6000–8000 K，电子密度约10⁹–10¹⁰ cm⁻³。  

综上，该光谱记录了Fe II型新星M31N 2009-10b在爆发初期的多速度组分共存状态：高速冷中性壳（Na I/O I P Cyg吸收）、中速电离氢主壳（宽H I发射）、以及相对静止的富Fe II内区（无P Cyg的强共振线），三者共同刻画出新星抛射物的纵向分层结构与化学分异演化。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT spectrum of the accreting X-ray pulsar IGR J01572-7259 Re-analysis of a Swift/XRT ToO observation of IGR J01572-7259 in the Magellanic Bridge (=IGR J015712-7259, c.f. Coe et al., 2008, ATel #1882) has enabled us to establish the first soft X-ray spectrum for this 11.6-s X-ray pulsar and suspected high-mass X-ray binary. 
Observation-ID 00031313001 was taken on December 20, 2008, for an effective exposure time of 1950 s. The 0.5â7 keV spectrum was fit with a power law including a photoelectric absorption component that assumed either Solar abundances or those described by Wilms et al., 2000. We derived a photon index of 0.9(3) in both cases, and column densities (in units of 1021 cm-2) of 3Â±2 for the Solar case, and 4-2+3  assuming the abundances of Wilms et al., 2000. This is greater (by a factor of 5â10) than the interstellar absorption expected along the line of sight, which suggests a small amount of intervening material that is local to this source (in addition to material in the Magellanic Bridge). Errors are quoted at 90% confidence. In both fits, the reduced Chi-squared value is 1.0 for 25 degrees of freedom. The unabsorbed flux in the 2â10 keV energy range is 1.2x10-11 erg/cm2/s (~0.6 mCrab) which translates to 4x1036 erg/s for an assumed distance of 55 kpc. 2009-10-22 15:19:00
response:
首先，该研究基于Swift/XRT对X射线脉冲星IGR J01572−7259的一次ToO观测（Obs-ID 00031313001，2008年12月20日，有效曝光1950 s），首次获得了其软X射线能段（0.5–7 keV）的能谱。  
其次，能谱拟合采用带光电吸收的幂律模型，分别假设星际介质丰度为太阳丰度或Wilms et al. (2000)丰度；两种假设下均得到一致的光子指数Γ = 0.9 ± 0.3，表明辐射谱形硬，符合典型吸积驱动的X射线脉冲星特征。  
第三，拟合得到的吸收柱密度NH分别为(3 ± 2) × 10²¹ cm⁻²（太阳丰度）和4₋₂⁺³ × 10²¹ cm⁻²（Wilms丰度），显著高于该方向视线上的银河系及麦哲伦桥预期的本征星际吸收（低5–10倍），说明存在与源共处的局部吸收物质，可能源于伴星星风或吸积流中的冷物质。  
第四，拟合优度良好：χ²/ν = 1.0（ν = 25），支持模型合理性；未吸收的2–10 keV能段通量为1.2 × 10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应0.6 mCrab，结合55 kpc距离换算得光度为4 × 10³⁶ erg s⁻¹，处于高磁中子星在稳定吸积下的典型光度范围，进一步支持其为高质量X射线双星（HMXB）系统的判断。

根据现象进行分析： Swift XRT/UVOT follow-up of blazar 4C+14.23 after a gamma-ray flare Following the Fermi-LAT detection of a GeV flare from the z=1.038 blazar 4C+14.23 on Oct 13th (ATEL #2243), two 4 ksec Swift observations were obtained -- on Oct 16th (XRT in WT mode) and 18th (XRT in PC mode). These observations confirm that the blazar has brightened in the X-ray and optical bands following the GeV flare. 
The blazar is well detected in each XRT observation. Combining the 2 XRT exposures, the data are well fit by a power law with a photon index, Gamma=1.51 +/- 0.35 and an average 0.3-10 keV flux = 1.17 (+0.20/-0.24)e-12 erg/cm2/s (unabsorbed assuming Galactic NH = 7.6e20 cm-2). There is no significant X-ray variability detected between the 2 day span of the observations. This flux is ~5x larger than that observed in a previous shorter (0.94 ksec) Swift exposure obtained on Sep 1st (assuming the same photon index determined from the new Oct data). 
The blazar is well detected with the UVOT at both epochs. On Oct 16th, the observed V- and W1-band magnitudes were 17.53 +/- 0.09 and 17.53 +/- 0.05, respectively (extinction corrections of A_V=0.29 and A_W1=0.87 are not applied). Relative to the Sep 1 observation, where only a W1-band image was obtained, the source has brightened (optical magnitude changed by -0.31 +/- 0.07 mag). This confirms the optical flaring detected by the KANATA telescope (ATEL #2246). From the Oct 18th observation, we find marginal evidence for fading between the two days in the V-band (delta_V = 0.23 +/- 0.13 mag), but no significant variability is observed in the W1-band (delta_W1 = 0.03 +/- 0.07). 
In consideration of the recent activity of this source we encourage further multiwavelength observations. For this source the Fermi LAT contact persons are Yasuyuki T. Tanaka (tanaka@astro.isas.jaxa.jp), Hiromitsu Takahashi (hirotaka@hep01.hepl.hiroshima-u.ac.jp) and Stephen E. Healey (sehealey@stanford.edu). 
We thank the Swift team for their rapid scheduling of these observations. 2009-10-22 20:28:00
response: 该现象描述了对类星体4C+14.23在GeV伽马射线耀发后的多波段后随观测结果。首先，Fermi-LAT于10月13日探测到该z=1.038类星体的GeV耀发，触发Swift卫星于10月16日和18日开展两次XRT/UVOT观测。XRT数据显示，合并两次曝光后X射线谱可用幂律模型拟合，光子指数Γ=1.51±0.35，0.3–10 keV能段未吸收流量为1.17⁺⁰·²⁰₋₀.₂₄×10⁻¹² erg/cm²/s，显著高于9月1日短时曝光（0.94 ks）所测流量（约5倍），表明X射线波段存在强耀发；且两次XRT观测间隔2天内未见显著X射线光变，说明该能段在耀发峰值后处于相对稳定状态。UVOT光学/紫外观测进一步证实多波段协同耀发：10月16日V波段与W1波段星等分别为17.53±0.09与17.53±0.05（未作消光改正），相比9月1日仅有的W1波段观测，亮度增强0.31±0.07 mag，与KANATA望远镜独立报道的光学耀发一致；而10月16日至18日间，V波段呈现边缘显著的衰减（ΔV=0.23±0.13 mag），W1波段则无明显变化（ΔW1=0.03±0.07 mag），暗示光学波段可能已开始衰减，而近紫外波段仍维持高位，反映不同波段光变时标存在差异。综合来看，GeV耀发率先发生，随后X射线与光学/紫外波段同步增强，且X射线光变平缓、光学衰减略早于紫外，符合典型blazar宽波段同步辐射+逆康普顿辐射模型中电子能谱演化导致的多波段光变时序特征。

根据现象进行分析： Swift and CBA Observations of TT Ari on 2009 October 16 We observed the nova-like cataclysmic variable (CV) TT Ari, which is currently undergoing a fading episode, with Swift between 2009 October 16 01:31 UT and 09:02 UT. The X-ray telescope (XRT) was operated in photon counting mode and accumulated 4,400 s of good exposure during this interval. The UV/optical telescope (UVOT) was used with the U filter in imaging mode, with an integration time also of 4,400 s. 
Despite fading by ~3.7 magnitudes in the optical, TT Ari was detected strongly with the XRT, at 0.24 counts s-1. Multi-temperature thermal plasma model can provide an adequate description of the data (single temperature models result in a poor fit), as was the case with the ASCA high state observation (Mauche & Mukai 2002, ApJLett, 566, L33), with similar parameters. The Swift/XRT flux during the current fading episode is 1.5x10-11 ergs cm-2s-1 (0.3-10 keV) or 9x10-12 ergs cm-2s-1(2-10 keV), corresponding to a 2-10 keV luminosity of 1.2x1032 ergs s-1 for a distance of 335 pc (Gaensicke et al. 1999, A&A 347, 184). This is similar to the luminosity in the ASCA data (1.4x1032 ergs s-1, 2-10 keV). 
TT Ari was clearly variable in X-rays during the Swift observation. However, simultaneous optical light curves, obtained by several telescopes of the Center for Backyard Astrophysics, showed no obvious correlation. The latter did show large-amplitude waves with a period or quasi-period of ~0.4 days, not previously seen in any band. The average Swift/UVOT U magnitude is estimated to be ~11.9 after correction for coincidence losses (approximately a factor of 4). 
Although accretion must have declined severely in the current "low state," its most telltale signatures - X-rays and fast variability - remain quite strong. In fact, TT Ari remains one of the most luminous X-ray sources among non-magnetic CVs, along with SS Cyg and V603 Aql. In case of a significant further decline, it will be interesting to test these limits further. Eventually the X-rays should turn off, but we still do not know when that happens. 
Plots of X-ray spectrum and X-ray/optical light curves of TT Ari on 2009 October 16 2009-10-23 18:36:00
response:
首先，观测对象是TT Ari，一颗类新星的激变变星（CV），正处于光学亮度衰减阶段。Swift卫星在2009年10月16日01:31–09:02 UT期间对其进行了X射线和紫外/光学联合观测，有效曝光时间均为4400秒。

其次，尽管光学波段已衰减约3.7星等，XRT仍以0.24计数/秒的率显著探测到X射线辐射，表明X射线辐射并未随光学衰减而同步减弱。能谱拟合显示：多温热等离子体模型可较好描述X射线谱，单温模型拟合不佳；该特征与ASCA高态观测一致，且拟合参数相似，说明高温等离子体结构在高低态下保持基本稳定。

第三，X射线流量为1.5×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（0.3–10 keV）或9×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（2–10 keV），对应2–10 keV波段光度为1.2×10³² erg s⁻¹（取距离335 pc）。该值与ASCA高态光度（1.4×10³² erg s⁻¹）相当，说明X射线光度在光学衰减期间基本维持不变。

第四，X射线光变明显，但CBA提供的同时期光学光变曲线未显示出与X射线变化的相关性；相反，光学光变呈现振幅较大、周期或准周期约0.4天的新特征，此前在任何波段均未观测到，暗示可能存在尚未识别的调制机制（如盘不稳定性、轨道调制或白矮星自转调制等）。

第五，UVOT U波段测得平均星等约为11.9（已修正堆积损失，修正因子约4），结合光学衰减幅度，可反推高态U波段亮度，进而约束吸积率变化程度。

第六，尽管吸积率必然在“低态”中大幅下降，X射线辐射和快速光变这两个吸积活动的关键诊断特征依然强烈存在，表明吸积流并未完全中断，而可能以某种低效但持续的方式维持着高温冕或边界层辐射。TT Ari因此仍属于非磁CV中最亮的X射线源之一，与SS Cyg、V603 Aql并列。

第七，当前状态挑战了传统“低态即X射线熄灭”的预期；若后续发生更显著衰减，将可检验X射线辐射维持的物理下限——例如热边界层冷却阈值、最低稳定吸积率、或冕加热机制失效临界条件。但目前尚无法预测X射线何时真正关闭，反映出对弱吸积状态下能量释放机制的理解仍不充分。

根据现象进行分析： Fermi LAT and GASP detections of a concurrent GeV and optical flare from the blazar OJ 287 The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of the two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope discovered a rapid gamma-ray flare from a source positionally consistent with the optically bright BL Lac object OJ 287 (RA: 08h 54m 48.874s , Dec: +20d 06m 30.64s, J2000.0, Johnston et al. 1995, AJ, 110, 880, -- redshift z=0.306, Falomo, Scarpa, & Bersanelli 1994, ApJS, 93, 125; Sitko & Junkkarinen 1985, PASP, 97, 1158). 
Preliminary analysis indicates that on October 22, 2009 (UT), this source showed a rapid gamma-ray flare with daily bin flux (E>100MeV) of (0.98 + / - 0.23 ) x 10^-6 photons cm^-2 s^-1 (statistical only) . This is about one order of magnitude higher than the average flux during the first 11 months of Fermi LAT all-sky survey. The flare occurred likely during the first 6 hours (UT) of this day (exceeding the level of 2 x 10^-6 photons cm^-2 s^-1 in this time bin). 
The GLAST-AGILE Support Program (GASP) of the Whole Earth Blazar Telescope (WEBT) reports that the source has been optically bright since the start of this optical season (early October), oscillating in the range R = 13.9-14.2 (data from Crimean, KVA, and St. Petersburg observatories). Last night, on October 22.25 (i.e. in the 6h interval candidate for the rapid gamma-ray flare), OJ 287 was observed at optical R-band magnitude = 13.45 Â± 0.02, close to the optical maxima of the last years. 
Because Fermi operates in an all-sky scanning mode, regular gamma-ray monitoring of this source will continue, joined with regular optical-to-radio monitoring by ground-based GASP observatories. In consideration of the ongoing optical and gamma-ray activity of this source, we strongly encourage multiwavelength observations. For this source the Fermi LAT contact persons are S. Ciprini (stefano.ciprini@pg.infn.it), E. Ferrara ( Elizabeth.C.Ferrara@nasa.gov) and K. Sokolovsky (ksokolov@mpifr-bonn.mpg.de) and the GASP contact person is M. Villata (villata@oato.inaf.it). 
The Fermi LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan and Sweden. 2009-10-24 02:28:00
response: 该事件描述了耀变体OJ 287在2009年10月22日发生的一次多波段同步耀发：费米大天区望远镜（LAT）探测到GeV能段（E > 100 MeV）的快速伽马射线耀发，同时GASP/WEBT网络观测到光学R波段的显著增亮。首先，位置一致性确认二者来自同一源——OJ 287（z = 0.306，BL Lac型耀变体），排除了偶然叠加的可能性。其次，伽马射线流量在当日达到(0.98 ± 0.23) × 10⁻⁶ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹，约为费米巡天前11个月平均流量的10倍，且峰值很可能集中在UT时间约0–6小时区间，瞬时流量超过2 × 10⁻⁶ ph cm⁻² s⁻¹；而光学观测显示，同一时段（UT 10月22.25，即约6小时窗口内）R波段星等达13.45 ± 0.02，接近近年光学极大值（历史范围13.9–14.2），表明光学亮度亦显著增强。第三，伽马射线与光学辐射在时间上高度重合，且二者均呈现快速上升特征，暗示其可能起源于喷流中同一辐射区的粒子加速过程——例如相对论性电子在磁场中的同步自康普顿（SSC）辐射，或外部康普顿（EC）过程主导下的宽能段协同响应。最后，费米LAT的全天扫描模式与GASP的地基多台站持续监测构成互补，使得该事件成为研究耀变体多波段光变关联性、辐射机制及时标物理（如光变时标约束喷流尺度与多普勒因子）的理想样本。

(1-sigma c.l. uncertainties are reported above.) 2009-10-24 14:03:00
response:
首先，题目描述的是对超巨星快速X射线暂现源（SFXT）IGR J11215−5952的一次Swift/XRT观测，发生在其预期爆发时刻附近。关键现象包括：该源具有约165天的周期性爆发，该周期被解释为双星系统的轨道周期；根据Romano等人（2009）给出的历元表，预计2009年10月23日14 UT左右发生新一次爆发；实际观测始于同日17:06:59 UT，有效曝光2.2 ks。

其次，观测明确探测到该源，得到1–10 keV波段平均计数率为0.48±0.02 counts s⁻¹。该光度水平显著高于宁静态（典型SFXT宁静态计数率常低于0.01 counts s⁻¹），确认处于爆发态，且属于中等强度爆发（已知该源峰值可达~1–2 counts s⁻¹）。

第三，能谱拟合采用吸积盘标准模型——吸收的幂律谱，得到光子指数Γ = 0.9±0.2，属硬谱（Γ < 1.7），符合SFXT爆发期典型特征，反映热电子散射主导或低光学深度冕区辐射；吸收柱密度N_H = (1.2±0.3)×10²² cm⁻²，与银河系视线方向消光及源所在银经银纬处星际介质分布一致，未显示异常致密伴星风吸收增强迹象。

第四，由拟合获得的观测流量为(4.5₋₀.₇⁺⁰.₃)×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹（1–10 keV），经吸收改正后未吸收流量约5.2×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹。结合距离6.2 kpc，换算得X射线光度L_X ≈ 2.4×10³⁵ erg s⁻¹。该光度处于SFXT典型爆发光度范围（10³⁴–10³⁶ erg s⁻¹），远高于中子星Eddington极限下稳态吸积对应光度（~10³⁷ erg s⁻¹），但显著低于经典X射线脉冲星持续爆发水平，支持间歇性、不稳定性吸积机制（如磁场通道限制、伴星风局部高密度团块吸积）。

第五，观测起始时间（17:06 UT）距预测爆发时刻（14:00 UT）仅约3小时，而探测到显著流量，说明爆发上升时标短于3小时，与SFXT“快”暂现特性一致（上升时标常为小时量级）；同时，该次爆发被成功预言并捕获，验证了165天周期的轨道起源假说——即爆发由中子星穿越伴星致密风区或共轭点触发，具强相位锁定性。

综上，本次Swift观测证实IGR J11215−5952按轨道周期规律爆发，其X射线光度、能谱硬度、短时标上升均符合SFXT理论框架，支持吸积物理受轨道调制、且由局部风团块主导的模型。

根据现象进行分析： XTE J1752-223: a new RXTE and Swift detected X-ray transient in the galactic center region On 2009-10-23 at 19:55 UT, RXTE discovered a new source while scanning the galactic bulge region, designated XTE J1752-223. Based on the existing PCA scan data, the best fit position is, R.A. = 268.05(16), Dec. = -22.31(4) (J2000), with estimated 95% uncertainty of the final digits shown in parentheses. 
The 2-10 keV flux of the source at that time was about 30 mCrab. In the past six months, no source has been detected at that position with 95% upper limit of about 1 mCrab. There are no obvious signatures of fast variability (i.e. no pulsations) in the limited amount of PCA scan data available. (1 mCrab = 2.4e-11 erg/cm/s^2, 2-10 keV) 
On 2009-10-24 at 14:18:50 UT, the Swift BAT instrument triggered and located the source. The on-board calculated location is R.A. = 268.044, Dec. = -22.325 (J2000), with 90% position uncertainty of about 3 arcmin. The RXTE PCA and Swift BAT positions are consistent. Swift did not slew immediately to the source location because of a Moon observing constraint, so prompt X-ray or UV/optical data are not available yet. Given the sensitivity of the BAT, the approximate 15-150 keV source flux is about 100 mCrab. 
Additional follow-up observations by RXTE and Swift have been requested. 2009-10-24 18:02:00
response:
首先，RXTE在2009年10月23日19:55 UT扫描银河系核球区域时发现一个新X射线暂现源XTE J1752-223，表明该源为突发性出现的天体活动事件，非持续存在源——因过去半年内同一位置未被探测到，95%置信度上限仅1 mCrab，而本次探测流量达30 mCrab（2–10 keV），亮度提升至少30倍，符合暂现源典型特征。  
其次，RXTE PCA给出的位置R.A. = 268.05(16)°、Dec. = −22.31(4)°（J2000）与次日Swift BAT触发定位R.A. = 268.044°、Dec. = −22.325°（J2000，90%误差半径3′）在各自误差范围内一致，说明二者探测的是同一物理源，排除误识别或定位偏差导致的假阳性。  
第三，RXTE扫描数据中未见脉动信号，结合有限数据量，暂时无法确认致密星类型（如中子星或黑洞），但缺乏快速光变特征支持其可能为吸积主导的暂现源（如低质量X射线双星爆发），而非旋转驱动的脉冲星。  
第四，Swift BAT在15–150 keV波段测得约100 mCrab流量，显著高于RXTE在2–10 keV的30 mCrab，表明该源能谱较硬，可能处于硬态或具有显著高能成分，符合黑洞X射线双星爆发初期的典型谱形。  
第五，因月球观测约束，Swift未能及时转向开展X射线（XRT）及紫外/光学（UVOT）后续观测，导致多波段证认和暂现演化初态信息缺失，需依赖后续RXTE与Swift的指向上机观测补全光变与能谱演化。

input: 根据现象进行分析： XTE J1752-223: Flux increasing in a new RXTE and Swift X-ray transient in the Galactic center region  MAXI/GSC detected increasing X-ray intensity of XTE J1752-223, the new source of RXTE and Swift X-ray transient in the Galactic center region (ATEL #2258). The X-ray flux in the energy band of 2 - 20 keV is increasing as less than 10 mCrab in the period of 4:20 - 13:30, 23 Oct, 2009; 30 mCrab at 15:05, 23 Oct; 15 mCrab in 18:10 - 21:10, 23 Oct; 30 mCrab in 22:40, 23 Oct - 6:20, 24 Oct; 40 mCrab in 7:50 - 14:00, 24 Oct; 50 mCrab in 15:30 - 21:30, 24 Oct; 60 mCrab in 23:00, 24 Oct - 2:10, 25 Oct; 110 mCrab at 3:40, 25 Oct; 55 mCrab in 5:10 - 9:45, 25 Oct; with an uncertainty of +- 10 mCrab (1-sigma) for each scan in the period. The GSC of MAXI (Matsuoka et al. PASJ 61(2009), 999) is performing the test operation in the commission phase. It scans XTEJ1752-223 intermittently in every 90 minutes. Further follow-up observations are going on. 2009-10-25 17:23:00
response: 该现象描述的是X射线暂现源XTE J1752−223在2009年10月23日至25日期间的光变行为。首先，MAXI/GSC在巡天扫描中探测到其2–20 keV能段流量持续上升，表明该源正处于爆发上升阶段。流量变化呈现非单调性：从23日4:20起低于10 mCrab，随后在15:05跃升至30 mCrab，但18:10–21:10又回落至15 mCrab，说明可能存在短时标调制或观测间隙导致的采样偏差；此后流量总体呈阶梯式增长，于25日3:40达峰值110 mCrab，之后下降至55 mCrab，符合典型黑洞X射线双星爆发中“快升慢降”或“多峰结构”的光变特征。各测量点误差为±10 mCrab（1σ），且扫描间隔约90分钟，时间分辨率有限，无法分辨秒级耀发或准周期振荡，但足以确认整体上升趋势。该源位于银心方向，结合其作为RXTE与Swift共同认证的新暂现源，高度提示其为一颗处于爆发初期的恒星级黑洞候选体，后续需高时间分辨率及宽能段观测以确认能谱演化与 timing 特性。

根据现象进行分析： VERITAS discovery of a new VHE Gamma-ray Source, VER J0521+211 The VERITAS Collaboration reports the discovery of a new very high energy (VHE; E>100 GeV) gamma-ray source, VER J0521+211, at R.A. = 80.48, Dec. = +21.19 (J2000), with a positional uncertainty of about 0.05 degrees. This new VHE source was detected with a significance of 5.5 standard deviations in 230 minutes of observations between 22 October 2009 and 24 October 2009 (UT) with the VERITAS atmospheric-Cherenkov telescope array. The observations were motivated by the identification of a high energy (>30 GeV) source at this position in the public Fermi-LAT data. This position is also consistent, within errors, with the position of the radio-loud active galaxy RGB J0521.8+2112, detected in the ROSAT all-sky X-ray survey and included in the RASS-Green Bank catalog, for which the redshift is unknown. The VHE flux measured by VERITAS is ~5% of the steady Crab Nebula flux above 200 GeV. Observations at all wavelengths are encouraged in order to clarify the nature of this object. In particular, optical spectroscopy would be extremely valuable to determine the unknown redshift. 
VERITAS Web Site 2009-10-25 23:42:00
response:
该现象描述了一个新发现的甚高能（VHE）伽马射线源VER J0521+211，其分析可按以下逻辑链展开：  
首先，该源被VERITAS望远镜阵列以5.5σ显著性在230分钟观测中确认，位置精度约0.05°，表明探测具有统计可靠性；  
其次，观测动机源于Fermi-LAT在>30 GeV能段已发现同位置高能源，说明该天体在GeV至TeV能段存在连续辐射，暗示其可能为具有宽能谱的致密天体；  
第三，该位置与射电噪活动星系RGB J0521.8+2112在误差范围内一致，且该星系已被ROSAT和RASS-Green Bank巡天证认，具备典型耀变体或多波段活动星系核（AGN）的空间对应特征；  
第四，未知红移是关键缺失参数，因红移决定光度距离、本征光度及辐射机制判据，而光学光谱是测定红移的直接手段；  
第五，测得VHE流量约为蟹状星云稳态流量的5%（E>200 GeV），属中等强度VHE源，结合其多波段对应性，最可能的物理解释是低红移耀变体（BL Lac或FSRQ），但尚不能排除其他VHE辐射体（如窄线赛弗特1型星系或特殊脉冲星风云）；  
最后，鼓励全波段观测，本质在于通过同步辐射（射电–光学–X射线）与逆康普顿散射（GeV–TeV）成分建模，约束粒子加速机制、辐射区尺度及多普勒因子等核心物理参数。
