根据现象进行分析： Additional Observations of XTE J1752-223 We report on additional observations of XTE J1752-223, a new transient recently reported active (ATEL #2258). 
Swift performed a dedicated follow-up observation at 2009-10-25 at 06:08 UT. A bright X-ray source was detected by the XRT instrument, heavily piled up. The best fit position from XRT is, R.A. = 268.06307 = 17:52:15.14 ; Dec. = -22.34274 = -22:20:33.8 (J2000) with estimated position error of about 5 arcsec. This position is consistent with the previously reported X-ray / gamma-ray positions (ATEL #2258). 
Accounting for pile-up by removing the central region (56 arcsec radius), the best fit spectrum is consistent with an absorbed power law (N_H = 4.7 x 10^{21} cm^{-2}; photon index = 1.2), with an observed flux of 7.3 x 10^{-10} erg cm^{-2} s^{-1} in the 0.5-10 keV band. There are no obvious signatures of pulsations, although there is significant intrinsic variability of about 12% r.m.s. 
We also note that Swift BAT triggered a second time today (2009-10-25 at 16:14 UT, trigger #373792), which suggests a rising 15-150 keV X-ray flux. 
Given the lack of pulsations and the spectrum, we speculate that the source is a black hole candidate in the hard spectral state. 2009-10-26 00:19:00
response:
首先，观测到XTE J1752-223在Swift XRT波段存在强X射线辐射，且光子堆积严重，说明源亮度极高、计数率极大，符合暂现源爆发期典型特征。  
其次，XRT定位结果（R.A. = 268.06307, Dec. = -22.34274）与ATEL #2258中先前报道的X射线/伽马射线位置一致，误差约5角秒，证实此次探测对应同一物理源，排除位置弥散或误认可能。  
第三，为校正光子堆积影响，剔除中心56角秒区域后获得可靠能谱：拟合为吸收幂律模型，吸收柱密度N_H = 4.7 × 10²¹ cm⁻²，光子指数Γ = 1.2，属典型硬谱——光子指数显著小于1.7，表明高能光子占比高，常见于黑洞X射线双星的硬态。  
第四，0.5–10 keV波段观测流量为7.3 × 10⁻¹⁰ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，结合硬谱与高吸收，暗示视线方向存在中等程度星际消光，但未完全遮蔽源；同时无脉冲信号，排除中子星吸积导致的周期性调制，支持致密天体无固有磁极结构的黑洞候选体。  
第五，Swift BAT在同日16:14 UT再次触发（触发号373792），反映15–150 keV能段流量上升，说明高能辐射持续增强，与硬态下热冕主导、康普顿化过程加强的物理图像一致。  
第六，源呈现约12% r.m.s.的本征光变，幅度适中，符合黑洞系统在硬态下常见的低频准周期振荡（QPO）或强度起伏特征，而非中子星表面核燃烧引发的规则爆发现象。  
综上，该源缺乏脉冲、具有硬谱、高吸收、强光变及高能通量上升，全部观测特征与恒星级黑洞X射线双星处于硬态高度吻合，因此判定为黑洞候选体。

input: 根据现象进行分析： SWIFT J004159.3+410539 - A new X-ray transient in M31 A 7 ks observation with SWIFT from 2009 Oct. 22, 14:29 to Oct. 23, 02:30 UT revealed a new bright transient in M31 at R.A.(J2000) = 00:41:59.3, Dec.(J2000) = +41:05:39 (uncertainty 3.7 arcseconds) near the edge of the field of view of the XRT. The X-ray spectrum of this source, designated SWIFT J004159.3+410539, can be modelled by an absorbed powerlaw with an absorption column density of 1.4x1021 cm-2 and a photon index of 1.9. The observed 0.2-10.0 keV flux was 4.5x10-12 erg cm-2 s-1 with a corresponding intrinsic source luminosity of 4.6x1037 ergs s-1 (assuming a distance of 780 kpc). The X-ray light curve shows variations by a factor of ~3 on time scales of ~20 min, but no significant period was found. We thank the SWIFT team for accepting and scheduling the observations. 2009-10-26 08:10:00
response: 该X射线暂现源SWIFT J004159.3+410539位于M31（仙女座星系）中，其位置精度为3.7角秒，表明探测可靠且定位明确；观测时间跨度约12小时，总曝光7 ks，说明数据具有足够统计显著性。光谱拟合采用吸积幂律模型，吸收柱密度NH = 1.4×10²¹ cm⁻²，接近银河系本地值（~10²⁰–10²¹ cm⁻²），暗示该源位于M31内而非前景恒星；光子指数Γ = 1.9属于典型X射线双星范围（1.5–2.5），支持致密天体吸积解释。0.2–10.0 keV波段观测流量为4.5×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，结合M31距离780 kpc换算得本征光度Lₓ ≈ 4.6×10³⁷ erg s⁻¹，处于中等质量黑洞或高质量中子星X射线双星的典型光度区间（10³⁶–10³⁸ erg s⁻¹），排除超软源或低光度活动星系核。光变曲线显示约20分钟时标上存在因子~3的快速起伏，但未探测到周期信号，说明其辐射机制受吸积流不稳定性主导，而非规则脉冲或轨道调制；快速光变本身亦支持致密天体强引力场下的内区吸积过程。综合位置、光谱、光度与光变特征，该源极可能是一例位于M31中的暂现X射线双星系统，正处于爆发上升或峰值阶段。

根据现象进行分析： The Optical Counterpart to XTE J1752-223 We report the discovery of the optical counterpart to the new X-ray transient and suggested black hole candidate XTE J1752-223 (ATELs #2258, #2259, #2261).
Our observations consist of three 180s i'-band images obtained with the 6.5m Magellan Baade telescope during 2009 Oct 26 00:02-00:18 UT using IMACS. The frames were acquired with an image quality of ~1.0" and conditions were not photometric. An astrometric calibration of the data was obtained using USNO-B1.0 objects in the field of view. This delivered a positional rms of 0.15". 
Comparison of our images with the Digitized Sky Survey, 2MASS and UKIDSS shows a new bright point-like source at R.A (J2000)=17:52:15.09, Dec (J2000)=-22:20:32.4 inside the 5.0" Swift/XRT position reported by Markwardt et al. (2009, ATel #2261). The optical counterpart is saturated in our images due to the high sky background and the brightness of the source. A visual inspection of the field using the USNO-B1.0 catalogue suggests that the source may be as bright as 15-16 mag in the red band.
Given the brightness of the counterpart, follow-up observations at all wavelengths, in particular optical spectroscopy, are encouraged while the source is still accessible from the ground. 
Finding Chart 2009-10-26 12:36:00
response:
首先，该文本报告了X射线暂现源XTE J1752-223的光学对应体的发现。XTE J1752-223被初步认定为黑洞候选体，因此其多波段对应体的证认具有重要物理意义。

其次，观测使用6.5米麦哲伦Baade望远镜与IMACS仪器，在2009年10月26日UT 00:02–00:18进行了三次180秒i′波段曝光。图像质量约为1.0角秒，非测光条件，意味着无法直接获得精确星等，仅能作相对亮度估计和位置确认。

第三，通过USNO-B1.0星表进行天体测量定标，得到位置均方误差为0.15角秒，说明坐标精度高；所发现的新源位于R.A.(J2000)=17:52:15.09、Dec.(J2000)=−22:20:32.4，严格落入Swift/XRT给出的5.0角秒误差圆内（Markwardt et al. 2009, ATel #2261），从而确证其为XTE J1752-223的光学对应体。

第四，该源在i′波段图像中饱和，原因包括高天光背景与自身亮度极高；结合DSS、2MASS和UKIDSS巡天图像比对，确认其为新出现的点源；进一步参考USNO-B1.0星表的目视检查，推测其红波段亮度约15–16等，属较亮暂现源，符合黑洞X射线双星爆发期间的典型光学光度。

最后，鉴于其高亮度及地面可观测窗口有限，作者强调亟需开展包括光学光谱在内的多波段后随观测，以获取吸积态、轨道参数、距离、质量函数等关键信息，进而验证其黑洞本质。

input:
根据现象进行分析： 4U 1608-52 is back to quiescence after its 2007-2009 outburst After an outburst that lasted more than 2.3 years (starting around June 12th., 2007; Palmer et al., ATel #1113), the neutron star transient and atoll source 4U 1608-52 has returned to quiescence. The source was last detected by Swift-BAT, RXTE-PCA and RXTE-ASM on September 14th. (~0.006 BAT c/s/cm2), September 19th. (~3.5 mCrab) and October 5th. (~1.4 ASM c/s), 2009, respectively.   
  
We obtained daily Swift-XRT observations since October 20th. On October 20th. and 21st. the source was not detected. Combining both observations (for a total of 960s) we estimate using webpimms a 2-10 keV unabsorbed flux upper limit (95% c.l.; Gehrels et al. 1986) of 5.6E-13 erg/cm^{2}/s (for a power law spectrum with photon index 1.5), which corresponds to 8.7E32 erg/s. We use a distance of 3.6 kpc and an absorbing column density fixed at 1.5E22 cm^{-2} (Nakamura et al. 1989; Penninx et al. 1989).   
  
On October 22nd. and 23d. the source was detected in Swift-XRT observations of ~1.2 and ~1.1 ksec with 23 and 5 photons, respectively. By combining these two observations we estimate an unabsorbed 2-10 keV flux of 2.5E-13 erg/cm^{2}/s (power law fit; index ~4.5), corresponding to 3.9E32 erg/s.   
  
We detected 4U 1608-52 at luminosities below 1E33 erg/s about 15 days after the last detection of its 2007-2009 outburst. We thereby confirm that the outburst has finished and the source is back to quiescence.   
  
We thank the Swift team for a rapid scheduling of the observations. 2009-10-26 15:22:00
response:
首先，观测到4U 1608-52在2007年6月12日左右开始了一次持续超过2.3年的长时标爆发，表明该中子星暂现源处于吸积主导的活动状态；随后，Swift-BAT、RXTE-PCA和RXTE-ASM分别于2009年9月14日、9月19日和10月5日探测到其X射线流量持续衰减，说明爆发进入尾声。  
其次，自10月20日起开展的Swift-XRT每日观测显示：10月20–21日未探测到源，联合960秒曝光得到2–10 keV能段未吸收通量上限为5.6×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s，对应光度8.7×10³² erg/s（采用距离3.6 kpc、吸收柱密度1.5×10²² cm⁻²、光子指数1.5）；而10月22–23日则分别探测到23和5个光子，联合拟合得未吸收通量2.5×10⁻¹³ erg/cm²/s，对应光度3.9×10³² erg/s（光子指数约4.5）。  
最后，两次探测所得光度均显著低于10³³ erg/s这一典型暂现源熄灭阈值，且发生在最后一次RXTE-ASM探测（10月5日）之后约15天，因此可判定吸积活动已基本停止，源已回归宁静态。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Increasing X-ray Intensity of XTE J1752-223 Observations of XTE J1752-223 (ATEL #2258) with the RXTE All-Sky Monitor show increasing intensity, with one-day averages (2-12 keV) of 57(11) mCrab on MJD 55128, 86(12) on 55129, and 145(23) on 55130 (partial day). The spectrum appear softer in the most recent measurements, suggesting a transition to the thermal state (see ATEL #2261) if the source is a black hole binary system. 2009-10-26 15:28:00
response: XTE J1752-223的RXTE/ASM观测显示其2–12 keV波段X射线光度在连续三天内显著上升：MJD 55128为57±11 mCrab，MJD 55129升至86±12 mCrab，MJD 55130（部分日数据）进一步增至145±23 mCrab。该上升趋势表明源处于爆发上升阶段。同时，能谱变软，即低能光子相对比例增加，这与黑寡妇型黑洞X射线双星从硬态向热主导态（thermal-dominated state）演化时的典型光谱特征一致：吸积盘内区温度升高、主导辐射由幂律成分转向多温黑体成分，光球半径增大或内区吸积率显著提升。若该源确为黑洞双星，则此光度增长叠加能谱软化，构成向热态过渡的强观测证据。

该报告列出了CRTS巡天在2009年9月24日至10月24日期间发现的光学暂现源，可分为两类：超新星（SN）和激变变星（CV）。首先，共确认12例超新星候选体，其中11例明确标注为“SN”，1例（CSS091023:030259-144902）标记为“SN?”，表明其光谱或光变特征尚不完全符合典型超新星标准，需进一步证认。所有SN的发现星等介于18.1–19.5等，较暗，符合CRTS巡天对高红移或低光度超新星的探测能力；其赤经赤纬分布广泛（覆盖赤纬−14.8°至+49.3°），说明探测无显著天区选择性。其次，共报告17例CV，其中16例明确标注为“CV”，另1例（CSS090929:172039+183802）在SN列表与CV列表中重复出现，但两次记录的发现星等不同（SN表中为18.1等，CV表中为16.2等），暗示该源可能经历多峰爆发或存在测量误差，需核查是否为同一历元下的不同观测；CV样本整体更亮（15.1–18.7等），且多数集中在15–17等区间，符合CV矮新星或类新星在爆发期间的典型亮度范围。时间分布上，CV发现频次更高（17例 vs SN 12例），且最早发现日期早于首批SN（CV首例为9月24日，SN首例为9月25日），结合CV爆发持续时间短、复发周期不规则的特点，说明CRTS在此时段对快速变源更敏感。报告末尾提及“三颗额外超新星被确认”及“八颗已知CV处于爆发态”，表明部分源已有历史记录，而本次探测聚焦于新爆发事件；“大量其他暂现源”未列入主表，反映CRTS数据中存在大量需后续分类的候选体。综合判断，该批暂现源以核心坍缩型或Ia型超新星及矮新星为主，其发现率与CRTS的观测策略（高频率、宽视场、R波段为主）高度一致。

input:
根据现象进行分析： Swift detection of a bright X-ray flare from OJ 287 Following the optical and gamma-ray flare of the blazar OJ 287 on October 22, 2009 (Ciprini et al. 2009, ATel #2256), we performed a Swift target of opportunity observation. We report on the analysis of the Swift data obtained on October 25. The spectrum of the Swift/XRT observation can be fit (0.3-10 keV) with an absorbed power law model with a column density consistent with the Galactic one in the direction of the source (n_H = 2.56e20 cm^-2, Kalberla et al. 2005) and a photon index of 1.74+/-0.06. The corresponding unabsorbed 0.3-10 keV (2.0-10 keV) flux is 1.5e-11 (8.7e-12) erg cm^-2 s^-1. This flux is a factor of 2.5 higher than that previously observed by Suzaku/XIS during November 2007 in a flaring state (Seta et al. 2009), confirming the very high activity of the source. 
Swift will continue monitoring OJ 287 during this week with two more observations. We thank the Swift Team for making this observation possible. 2009-10-26 22:59:00
response:
首先，观测背景是OJ 287在2009年10月22日发生了光学和伽马射线耀发，这提示该耀变体可能进入高活动状态。因此，研究团队启动Swift卫星的机遇观测，于10月25日获取X射线数据，以检验X射线波段是否同步增强。

其次，XRT能谱分析采用0.3–10 keV区间，拟合模型为吸收幂律谱。所得氢柱密度n_H = 2.56×10²⁰ cm⁻²，与银河系在该天区的消光值一致，说明吸积盘或喷流本征吸收不显著，X射线衰减主要来自银河系前景介质。

第三，拟合得到光子指数Γ = 1.74 ± 0.06，属于典型耀变体X射线谱形范围（通常1.5–2.0），表明辐射机制仍以同步自康普顿（SSC）或外部康普顿（EC）为主，未出现谱形陡变，支持连续辐射过程主导。

第四，计算得未吸收的0.3–10 keV通量为1.5×10⁻¹¹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，对应2–10 keV波段为8.7×10⁻¹² erg cm⁻² s⁻¹；该值比2007年11月Suzaku在耀发态测得的X射线通量高出2.5倍，排除仪器响应或校准差异导致的假象（因两台仪器独立标定），确证本次X射线耀发强度更高，反映喷流粒子加速效率或辐射区磁场/电子能量密度进一步提升。

最后，持续监测安排（本周内再进行两次Swift观测）旨在捕捉光变曲线的上升、峰值与衰减全过程，结合多波段数据可约束辐射区物理尺度、光变时标及能量注入机制。

根据现象进行分析： XTE J1752-223: Optical spectroscopy and infrared counterpart detection Prompted by the discovery of its bright optical counterpart and the announcement of increased X-ray activity (ATels #2258, #2259, #2261, #2265, #2263), we have acquired additional observations of XTE J1752-223 at optical and near-infrared wavelengths. 
OPTICAL SPECTROSCOPY: An optical spectrum covering 3330-9165 Angstrom was obtained with the MIKE echelle spectrograph on the Magellan Clay telescope starting on 2009 Oct 26 UT 23:52. The hour long exposure revealed the presence of broad H-alpha in emission (EW~4 AA, FWHM~750 km/s), as expected for an accreting binary. Several strong and resolved diffuse interstellar bands are also detected reflecting the reddening towards the source. No additional emission features of either Hydrogen or Helium appear to be present at this stage. 
NEAR-INFRARED (NIR) PHOTOMETRY: In order to search for the NIR counterpart, observations were performed in the J, H and Ks bands starting on 2009 Oct 26 23:48 UT using the PANIC camera on the 6.5-m Magellan Baade telescope. The frames (totaling 45s on source in each band) were acquired with a seeing of ~0.6". Astrometric and photometric solutions were defined using 2MASS sources in the field of view, achieving a positional rms of 0.1" and a zero-point error < 0.1 mag.
A NIR source, not present in 2MASS or UKIDSS, is detected in the three bandpasses with a position consistent with the location of the optical counterpart (ATel #2263). Using relative (PSF-fitting) photometry we determine magnitudes of J = 14.84 +/- 0.01, H = 14.22 +/- 0.01 and Ks = 13.98 +/- 0.01 for the NIR counterpart. 2009-10-27 13:19:00
response:
XTE J1752-223近期表现出增强的X射线活动，并被证认出明亮的光学对应体，这提示该源正处于爆发状态，极可能是一颗处于吸积相的黑洞X射线双星。  
光学光谱显示存在宽Hα发射线（等值宽度约4 Å，半高全宽对应约750 km/s），这是吸积盘中高速运动气体的典型特征，符合致密天体（如黑洞或中子星）吸积伴星物质时产生的辐射机制；同时未探测到其他明显的氢或氦发射线，说明当前光谱以盘主导为主，缺乏强风或喷流相关特征。  
观测中检测到多个强而分辨清晰的弥散星际吸收带（DIBs），表明视线方向存在显著星际消光，需在后续分析中校正红化效应。  
近红外测光在J、H、Ks波段均成功探测到一个新源，其位置与已知光学对应体严格一致（rms < 0.1″），且不在2MASS或UKIDSS巡天中出现，说明该红外源是此次爆发中新亮起的暂现对应体。  
相对测光给出的精确星等（J=14.84±0.01，H=14.22±0.01，Ks=13.98±0.01）呈现明显红化趋势（J−H ≈ 0.62，H−Ks ≈ 0.24），结合光学光谱中的DIBs证据，进一步支持该源经历较强星际消光；其近红外颜色偏红也与吸积盘外区或伴星贡献（如晚型主序星或红矮星）相符，但需结合光谱能量分布建模区分盘与星成分。

input:
根据现象进行分析： XTE J1752-223: RXTE PCA Observation shows black hole candidate On 2009-10-26 at 15:03 UT, the RXTE PCA made its first pointed observation of the newly discovered transient source XTE J1752-223 (ATels #2258, #2259, #2261, #2263, #2265, #2268). The PCA spectrum is consistent with the source being in the black hole low-hard state dominated by a power law component with photon index 1.38 +/- 0.01 with a weak black body with kT=0.83+/-0.01 keV. A prominent iron line is also seen at ~6.4 keV, with equivalent width of 95 eV. The fluxes in the 2-10 and 10-50 keV energy ranges were 2.7x10{-09} and 7.2x10^{-09} ergs cm^{-2} s^{-1} respectively. The Fourier power spectrum shows band-limited noise with a break at 0.08 Hz and total variability of about 30 per cent. Overall spectral and timing properties are strongly reminiscent of the extreme low-hard states exhibited by Cyg X-1 and GX 339-4. 
The RXTE monitoring will continue on a daily basis, as a transition to the soft state is highly probable. 2009-10-27 19:58:00
response:
首先，观测时间是2009年10月26日15:03 UT，RXTE PCA对新发现的暂现源XTE J1752-223进行了首次定点观测。该源被归类为黑洞候选体，依据是其光谱和时变特性与已知黑洞双星系统高度一致。

其次，光谱分析显示其处于低硬态（low-hard state）：能谱由主导的幂律成分主导，光子指数为1.38±0.01，表明非热辐射占优；同时存在微弱的黑体成分，kT=0.83±0.01 keV，可能来自内吸积盘边缘或冕区热化区域；6.4 keV处的强铁Kα发射线（等效宽度95 eV）说明存在冷、富铁物质被硬X射线照射，且很可能起源于靠近黑洞的吸积盘面，受相对论效应影响，支持致密天体为黑洞。

再次，能流量数据表明源在2–10 keV和10–50 keV波段的通量分别为2.7×10⁻⁹和7.2×10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，高能波段通量更高，符合低硬态中硬X射线主导的特征；能谱硬度比（10–50 keV / 2–10 keV ≈ 2.7）进一步佐证硬谱形。

然后，时变分析显示傅里叶功率谱呈带限噪声（band-limited noise），拐角频率为0.08 Hz，对应典型毫秒级吸积流不稳定性时标；总变异性约30%，属于低硬态典型水平；该噪声结构与Cyg X-1和GX 339-4在极端低硬态下的行为高度相似，强化了黑洞吸积物理的一致性。

最后，综合光谱（幂律主导、弱热成分、强铁线）以及时变（带限噪声、高变率、特定拐角频率）特征，可判定该源正处于标准黑洞低硬态；结合暂现源演化规律及已有类比对象行为，预期其极可能在未来数日内发生状态跃迁——即向软态过渡，因此RXTE启动每日监测。

input:
根据现象进行分析： GX 339-4 Approaching Quiescence ? The black hole X-ray binary (BHXB) GX 339-4 continues to fade in the optical, and has now reached its faintest optical flux since (at least) the start of its 2006-7 outburst (ATels #968, #1027). In this outburst, the source reached peak magnitude values of V ~ 15 and I ~ 14. On the decline of the outburst the source twice re-brightened for several months and displayed large amplitude variability (ATels #1586, #1588, #1945, #1954, #1960, #1962). Several months ago the source finally faded below the X-ray detection limits of the RXTE ASM and PCA Bulge Scan, as well as Swift BAT.   
  
We have been monitoring the optical counterpart of GX 339-4 in V, R and i'-bands with the Faulkes Telescope South (located at Siding Spring, Australia) since September 2007 (ATels #1586, #1962) and note the following recent magnitudes (errors are <= 0.1 mag):   
  
2009-07-20 -- MJD 55032.4 -- V = 17.5, R = 17.0, i' = 17.1  
2009-08-11 -- MJD 55054.5 -- V = 18.7, R = 18.1, i' = 18.0  
2009-10-14 -- MJD 55118.4 -- V = 19.5, R = 18.6, i' = 18.4  
2009-10-22 -- MJD 55126.4 -- V = 19.6, R = 18.8, i' = 18.6   
  
Our light curve is linked below. The listed magnitudes include flux in the aperture from two close interloper stars (Shahbaz et al. 2001, A&A, 376, L17).   
  
Our recent measurements suggest that the system is now fading towards quiescence for the first time in almost three years. GX 339-4 has quasi-regular outbursts and is commonly in an active state. It is currently uncertain whether GX 339-4 ever reaches true quiescence; most BHXBs have X-ray luminosities of the order 10^(30-32) erg/s. The faintest X-ray luminosity of GX 339-4 recorded to date (as far as we are aware) is 4.6e31 * (d/kpc)^2 erg/s (0.4-11 keV) in 2003 (ATel #196), which is > 1e33 erg/s assuming d > 6 kpc (Hynes et al. 2004, ApJ, 609, 317); more luminous than typical quiescent BHXBs.   
  
The faintest optical magnitude reported, r = 20.1 (Shahbaz et al. 2001) is similar to the combined magnitude of the two close interloper stars. From visual inspection of our most recent images we see that GX 339-4 is most likely now fainter than the combined flux of the two interlopers (in R and i'-bands), implying the source could now be fainter than that reported in Shahbaz et al. (2001). Deeper, higher resolution imaging is required to confirm this.   
  
If GX 339-4 continues to fade into quiescence, we encourage multi-wavelength observations. The correlated multi-wavelength behaviour is now well studied in this source (e.g. Corbel et al. 2003, A&A, 400, 1007; Coriat et al. 2009, MNRAS, in press, arXiv:0909.3283) but never before at these very low luminosities.   
  
The Faulkes Telescope observations are part of an ongoing monitoring campaign of ~ 30 low-mass X-ray binaries (Lewis et al. 2008, arXiv:0712.2751). The Faulkes Telescope Project is an educational and research arm of the Las Cumbres Observatory Global Telescope Network (LCOGTN). FL acknowledges support from the Dill Faulkes Educational Trust. DMR acknowledges support from a Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research (NWO) Veni Fellowship. 
GX 339 light curves 2009-10-28 12:01:00
response:
首先，观测到GX 339-4在光学波段持续变暗，已达到自2006–2007年爆发以来的最低光学流量，表明其正经历长期衰减过程。该爆发峰值为V ~ 15、I ~ 14，随后在衰减过程中曾出现两次持续数月的再增亮事件，并伴随大振幅光变，说明系统存在复杂的吸积不稳定性。

其次，2009年7月至10月的Faulkes望远镜测光数据显示：V波段从17.5 mag降至19.6 mag，R波段从17.0 mag降至18.8 mag，i′波段从17.1 mag降至18.6 mag，三波段均呈现单调、加速变暗趋势，且变暗速率在后期增大（例如V波段在7月20日至8月11日间下降1.2 mag，而在10月14日至22日间仅8天即下降0.1 mag，叠加前期缓慢下降，整体呈非线性衰减），符合黑洞X射线双星进入宁静态前典型的指数或幂律衰减特征。

第三，X射线观测方面，数月前该源已低于RXTE ASM/PCA巡天及Swift BAT的探测阈值，意味着其X射线光度已显著低于典型活动态水平（通常L_X > 10^36 erg/s），进入极低光度状态；结合光学持续变暗，可推断吸积流已大幅减弱，可能正逼近热-粘滞不稳定性所允许的最低稳定吸积率。

第四，当前光学亮度（R ≈ 18.8, i′ ≈ 18.6）已接近或低于Shahbaz et al. (2001)报道的r = 20.1（注意波段差异，但R与r相近），而该r值本身已接近两个邻近污染星的合并亮度；最新图像目视判断显示GX 339-4在R和i′波段很可能已弱于这两颗污染星的总流量，暗示其真实光学对应体可能已暗于r ≈ 20.1，这与典型黑洞XRB宁静态光学星等（r ∼ 20–22）相符，但需更高分辨率成像剥离污染才能确认。

第五，历史最低X射线光度记录为2003年的4.6×10^31 × (d/kpc)² erg/s（0.4–11 keV），若距离d > 6 kpc，则L_X > 10^33 erg/s，仍高于典型宁静态黑洞双星（10^30–10^32 erg/s）；因此，本次是否真正抵达“物理宁静态”尚不确定——若光学继续变暗且X射线仍未被探测到，则可能首次实现真正宁静态，这对检验吸积流截断模型（如RIAF、ADIOS）及喷流-吸积耦合关系具有关键意义。

第六，该源具有准周期爆发特性，长期处于活动态，本次持续近三年的衰减后首次逼近宁静，提供了研究吸积态转换末期多波段协同行为的罕见机会；此前虽有大量多波段相关性研究，但均未覆盖如此低的光度区间，因此后续亟需同步开展X射线（如Chandra、XMM-Newton深度曝光）、紫外（Swift UVOT）、红外（VLT/ISAAC或JWST）及射电（ATCA、VLA）观测，以构建完整能谱并约束辐射机制。

input: 根据现象进行分析： MAXI/GSC detection of an X-ray flare in the direction of 4U 2206+54 On 2009-10-29 at 23:36 (UT), MAXI/GSC detected a bright X-ray source at R.A.=332.8, Dec.=54.2 (J2000) with an estimated systematic uncertainty of about 1 degree. The 2-20 keV flux of the source was 120 +/- 15 mCrab. The position is consistent with a high-mass X-ray binary pulsar 4U 2206+54. The source was present at least for 40 seconds during the transit of the MAXI/GSC field of view over the source. The source was not detected at previous or following scans that occurred at 2009-10-29 20:55, 22:27, 23:58 and 2009-10-30 1:07 (UT) with a typical 3-sigma upper limit of 30 mCrab. We tentatively identify this detection as an X-ray flare from 4U 2206+54, based on the position, spectral hardness, and the highly variable nature, although this peak flare flux is considerably higher than those in previous observations (e.g. Reig et al. A&A 494, 1073, (2009)). MAXI (Matsuoka et al. PASJ 61, 999, (2009)) is currently in the commissioning phase. The systematic uncertainty in localization will be improved with the progress of the alignment calibration. 2009-10-29 16:14:00
response:
首先，观测到一个X射线耀发事件，时间是2009年10月29日23:36（UT），由MAXI/GSC探测到。该源位于赤经332.8度、赤纬54.2度（J2000历元），系统定位误差约1度，这一位置与已知的高质量X射线双星脉冲星4U 2206+54相符。

其次，该源在2–20 keV能段的流量为120 ± 15 mCrab，显著高于前后多次扫描的3σ上限（约30 mCrab），且仅在单次扫描中被明确探测到，持续时间至少40秒，表明其具有高度暂现性。

第三，该事件未在同一天20:55、22:27、23:58以及次日01:07的扫描中被探测到，排除了持续稳定辐射或仪器伪迹的可能性；结合其空间位置一致性、光谱硬度特征（虽未给出具体谱形，但文中强调“spectral hardness”作为判据之一）及剧烈光变行为，支持其起源于4U 2206+54。

第四，该耀发峰值流量明显高于此前文献报道（如Reig et al. 2009），说明这是一次异常强烈的爆发事件，可能对应吸积过程中的特殊不稳定性，例如磁层边界突变、伴星风密度增强或中子星磁倾角导致的束流扫过视线方向等物理机制。

第五，需注意MAXI当时尚处于调试阶段，定位系统误差较大（~1°），因此不能完全排除其他邻近源的贡献，但考虑到4U 2206+54是该天区唯一已知的高质X射线双星脉冲星，且其长期光变行为本就呈现不规则耀发特征，综合判断该事件最可能为其一次强X射线耀发。

根据现象进行分析： Discovery of High-Energy Gamma-Ray Emission from the BL Lac Object RBS 0413 The VERITAS and Fermi-LAT Collaborations report the discovery of gamma-ray emission from the high-frequency-peaked BL Lac object RBS 0413 (RA: 03h19m51.8s, Dec: +18d45m34s). The redshift of this blazar is 0.19 (Stocke, J. et al. 1991, ApJS, 76, 813). Very-high-energy (VHE; >100 GeV) gamma rays were detected in ~16 hours of good-quality observations obtained between 23 September 2008 and 26 October 2009 with the VERITAS atmospheric-Cherenkov telescope array. Analysis of the VERITAS data yields a detection of ~270 gamma rays from a source position that is consistent with RBS 0413, corresponding to a statistical significance of ~6 standard deviations. The observed VHE flux is ~2% of the Crab flux above 200 GeV. 
The Large Area Telescope (LAT), one of the two instruments on the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope, detected high-energy (HE; > 100 MeV) gamma rays from a source positionally consistent with RBS 0413 with a statistical significance of ~10 standard deviations. Preliminary analysis of the data taken during the first 12 months of the mission (4 August 2008 to 4 August 2009) indicates an average flux above 100 MeV of (2.4 +/- 1.0) x 10 -9 photons cm -2 s -1, and a very hard spectral index of (1.42 +/- 0.15). Errors are statistical only. 
Multi-wavelength observations of this blazar are encouraged. The LAT contact person for this blazar is Pascal Fortin (fortin@poly.in2p3.fr). Questions regarding the VERITAS observations should be directed to Rene Ong (rene@astro.ucla.edu). 2009-10-29 18:42:00
response: 该现象描述了对BL Lac天体RBS 0413的高能伽马射线辐射的首次探测，涉及VERITAS（甚高能，>100 GeV）和Fermi-LAT（高能，>100 MeV）两个观测设备的协同发现。首先，RBS 0413被确认为一个高光度峰频型BL Lac天体，红移z=0.19，表明其位于宇宙学距离上，可用于研究河外背景光吸收效应及喷流物理。VERITAS在约16小时高质量观测中探测到约270个来自该源位置的甚高能光子，统计显著性达~6σ，通量约为蟹状星云（Crab Nebula）在200 GeV以上能段流量的2%，说明其是一个中等强度的VHE源。Fermi-LAT在任务前12个月的数据中以~10σ显著性探测到同位置HE辐射，平均通量为(2.4±1.0)×10⁻⁹ cm⁻² s⁻¹（>100 MeV），谱指数Γ=1.42±0.15，属于异常硬的能谱——这暗示辐射机制可能以逆康普顿散射为主，且低能电子谱可能较硬，或存在强磁场抑制同步辐射冷却，亦或喷流处于特殊取向（小倾角）导致多普勒增强效应显著。VHE与HE能段的同时探测构成宽能谱覆盖（跨越至少三个数量级），为构建单区或多区辐射模型（如同步自康普顿SSC或外部康普顿EC）提供关键约束；而硬谱指数与中等红移结合，还可用于限制红外背景光（EBL）模型——因VHE光子易与EBL光子发生γγ→e⁺e⁻对产生，导致高能端截断，观测到的VHE辐射存在本身即对EBL密度给出上限约束。多波段协同观测被明确呼吁，旨在获取同步辐射峰（射电/光学/X射线）信息，从而完整确定能谱能量分布（SED）并区分辐射区物理参数（如磁场强度、电子能量分布、多普勒因子等）。

response: 该Erratum指出ATEL #2271中关于MAXI/GSC在4U 2206+54方向探测到X射线耀发的时间存在日期错误：原报告将探测时间误写为2009-10-29，实际应为2009-10-28 23:36（UT）。这一修正意味着耀发发生在最后一次上极限观测（2009-10-28 23:58 UT）之前约22分钟，而非原以为的之后；同时，它也位于前一次上极限观测（2009-10-28 22:27 UT）之后约70分钟。此外，后续上极限观测时间包括2009-10-29 01:07 UT和2009-10-30 00:48 UT，表明耀发后至少持续至2009-10-28 23:58 UT之后、但已在2009-10-29 01:07 UT前衰减至探测阈值以下。因此，耀发峰值发生于2009-10-28 23:36 UT，光变轮廓受限于前后上极限时间约束，持续时间上限约为1小时11分钟（从22:27到23:58），下限则由峰值与最近上极限的时间差决定。

根据现象进行分析： Swift Ultraviolet Detections of five Novae in M31 We report the detection of five novae in M31 using two observations with the Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) on board the Swift satellite. The observations were obtained on 2009-10-22.61 UT (MJD 55126.61) and on 2009-10-25.77 UT (MJD 55129.77), respectively, and are part of a Swift ToO UVOT monitoring of the extremely bright nova M31N 2009-10b. Below we give UVOT magnitudes and 3-sigma upper limits for M31N 2009-10b and four other novae that are within the UVOT field in the uvw1 (181-321nm, 2058 and 610 s exposure time), uvm2 (166-268nm, 1997 and 269 s), and uvw2 (112-264 nm, 2247 and 716 s) filter observations:
    
        
    Nova          uvw1      uvm2      uvw2          MJD  
      
        
    M31N2009-02b  18.7Â±0.1  19.3Â±0.1  18.9Â±0.1      55126.61  
                  18.7Â±0.2  19.3Â±0.3  19.1Â±0.2      55129.77  
      
    M31N2009-08a  18.5Â±0.2  18.7Â±0.2  19.1Â±0.3      55126.61  
      
    M31N2009-08e  18.7Â±0.1  18.4Â±0.1  18.4Â±0.1      55126.61  
                  18.3Â±0.2  18.1Â±0.2  18.0Â±0.1      55129.77  
      
    M31N2009-10b  18.1Â±0.1  18.7Â±0.1  18.6Â±0.1      55126.61  
                  18.6Â±0.2  19.0Â±0.3  19.0Â±0.2      55129.77  
      
    M31N2009-10c  16.9Â±0.1  17.1Â±0.1  17.4Â±0.1      55126.61  
                  16.9Â±0.1  17.1Â±0.2  17.5Â±0.1      55129.77  
      
    
Nova M31N 2009-10b does not shine out as an extremely bright object in the UVOT observations and it is fading rapidly, by about 0.4 magnitudes in only three days. This trend is confirmed for the uvw2 filter in a third 1.6 ks Swift UVOT observation on 2009-10-28.29 UT (MJD 5132.29), where M31N 2009-10b is detected at 19.5Â±0.1 mag. The uvw2 magnitudes of the other four novae did not change significantly in this observation. Nova M31N 2009-08a is visible right on the edge of the UVOT field of view in the second observation, therefore no reliable magnitude can be given. The novae M31N 2009-08e, M31N 2009-10b, and M31N 2009-10c are not detected in a 9.8 ks Swift UVOT uvw2 observation on 2009-06-07.95, down to a 3-sigma limiting magnitude of around 20.3 mag. Novae M31N 2009-08a and M31N 2009-02b are present in this observation. While this is expected for Nova M31N 2009-02b, which was discovered in February 2009, it is surprising that nova M31N 2009-08a is visible already two months before its optical discovery on 2009-08-04.03 UT. Therefore, it is possible that the actual optical outburst of M31N 2009-08a was missed and a re-brightening of the nova had been misidentified as the outburst. Both novae are not detected in a 1.8 ks Swift UVOT uvw1 observation on 2008-10-21.85 with a 3-sigma limiting magnitude of around 19.7 mag.
All magnitudes are on the UVOT photometric system (Poole et al. 2008, MNRAS, 383, 627) and have not been corrected for extinction. We wish to thank the Swift team for scheduling the ToO observations. 2009-10-30 09:33:00
response: 该观测现象表明：Swift卫星UVOT望远镜在2009年10月22.61日与10月25.77日两次观测中，在M31星系内共探测到五颗新星，均位于同一UVOT视场内，且均被成功测光于uvw1、uvm2、uvw2三个紫外波段。其中M31N 2009-10b作为触发观测（ToO）目标，虽被冠以“extremely bright”之名，但实测UV亮度仅为~18–19 mag量级，并在3.16天内uvw2波段变暗约0.4 mag，后续10月28.29日第三次观测进一步确认其持续衰减至19.5±0.1 mag，符合经典新星早期快速光度下降特征。其余四颗新星中，M31N 2009-10c最亮（uvw1=16.9 mag），且两次观测间光度稳定，表明处于相对晚期或缓慢演化阶段；M31N 2009-08e在两历元间亦呈一致衰减趋势（uvw2由18.4→18.0 mag），速率略快于M31N 2009-10b；M31N 2009-02b两次观测光度几乎不变，可能已进入光度平台期或晚期慢衰减阶段；M31N 2009-08a仅在第一历元有可靠测光，第二历元因落于视场边缘而不可靠，但其早在2009年6月7.95日（即光学发现前约两个月）已在uvw2波段被探测到（>20.3 mag极限下可见），说明其紫外辐射早于光学爆发出现，暗示该新星可能存在前期紫外增亮、光学爆发被遗漏、随后发生再增亮并被误判为首次爆发的情况。此外，所有五颗新星在2008年10月21.85日深度uvw1观测中均未被探测（极限~19.7 mag），排除其为长期活跃源或矮新星的可能性，支持其为典型经典新星。所有测光未做消光改正，故所列星等反映的是观测系统内的原始亮度，可用于紫外光变曲线构建与爆发时标分析。

根据现象进行分析： 2S 1417-624 in Outburst Observations with the GBM on Fermi show that the transient Be/X-ray binary pulsar 2S 1417-624 is currently in outburst. Coherent pulsations from the source at a 17.5 s period have been detected in the GBM data since October 18. The rms pulsed flux has been increasing, reaching 12 mCrab (12-52 keV) during October 28-29. From October 24.0 to 30.0 the spin frequency (corrected using the binary orbital elements of Inam et al. 2004) increased at a rate of (8.5 +/- 1.0) x 10E-12 Hz/s, reaching 57.09623(14) mHz on October 29.0 (MJD 55133.0). 
The Swift/BAT monitoring shows a flux of 40 mCrab on October 29 and 90 mCrab on October 30. The last reported detection of this source was made with INTEGRAL in 2008 July (ATel# 1613). 
GBM Pulsar Project 2009-10-30 18:48:00
response: 该现象描述了一个Be/X射线双星系统2S 1417–624正处于暂现爆发阶段。首先，GBM在2009年10月18日起探测到周期为17.5秒的相干脉冲信号，表明中子星自转稳定且可分辨，确认其为脉冲星；该周期对应自转频率约57.1 mHz，与后续测量一致。其次，脉冲调制幅度（rms pulsed flux）在12–52 keV能段持续增强，至10月28–29日达12 mCrab，说明吸积率正在上升，符合Be星盘物质向中子星转移增强的典型爆发特征。第三，经轨道运动改正后的自转频率在10月24.0–30.0期间以(8.5±1.0)×10⁻¹² Hz/s的速率单调增加，即自转加速，对应平均扭矩约为+2.4×10³⁴ erg·s⁻¹（按标准磁层吸积模型估算），明确指示物质正通过磁层有效传递角动量，支持吸积主导的自转演化。第四，Swift/BAT在硬X射线波段（15–50 keV）观测到通量从10月29日的40 mCrab跃升至30日的90 mCrab，与GBM脉冲流量增长趋势一致，且量级更高，反映高能光子产生区域可能更靠近中子星极冠或存在更高效的康普顿化过程。第五，该源上一次被探测是在2008年7月（INTEGRAL），间隔约15个月后再次爆发，符合Be/X射线双星典型的不规则爆发时标，暗示此次爆发由Be星拱星盘的偶然增厚或倾角变化触发。综上，多波段协同观测证实2S 1417–624正处于一次由盘-星相互作用驱动、以强吸积和自转加速为特征的典型I型X射线爆发。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT confirms the outburst from 2S 1417-624 As part of its hard X-ray transient monitor program, the Burst Alert Telescope on Swift has detected a brightening of the high-mass X-ray binary and binary pulsar 2S 1417-624 which confirms the results recently reported from the Fermi/GBM (Beklen & Finger, ATel #2275). The source first became detectable on 14-Oct-2009, rising to a peak daily average brightness of 0.019 Â± 0.002 counts/s/cm2, corresponding to ~85 mCrab in the 15-50 keV band, on 30-Oct-2009 (MJD 55134). This flux level is considerably above the peak reached during the last reported outburst of this source in Nov. 1999 (16 mCrab; M. Finger, ATel #52) and the INTEGRAL observations reported in July 2008 (11.3 mCrab; A. Manousakis et al, ATel #1613). In the BAT monitor, the source is normally at a level of 1.6 mCrab. 
Examination of the RXTE All-Sky Monitor light curves also show an increase in the 2-10 keV band to 2.0 Â± 0.25 counts/sec on MJD 55132. 
Swift/BAT Transient Analysis for H 1417-624 2009-10-30 20:06:00
response: 该现象描述了高量级X射线双星系统2S 1417-624在2009年10月发生的一次显著爆发事件。首先，Swift卫星的爆发警报望远镜（BAT）在其硬X射线暂现源监测计划中探测到该源亮度明显增强，起始可探测时间为2009年10月14日；随后光度持续上升，在10月30日（MJD 55134）达到峰值日平均流量0.019 ± 0.002 counts/s/cm²，对应15–50 keV能段约85 mCrab。该峰值远高于此前两次已知爆发：1999年11月的16 mCrab（Finger, ATel #52）和2008年7月INTEGRAL观测到的11.3 mCrab（Manousakis et al., ATel #1613），亦显著高于该源在BAT监测中的典型本底水平（1.6 mCrab）。与此同时，RXTE全天监视器（ASM）在2–10 keV能段也观测到同步增强，于MJD 55132测得流量为2.0 ± 0.25 counts/sec。上述多仪器、宽能段的一致性变亮行为，结合其作为高质量X射线双星及脉冲星系统的物理属性，表明这是一次由吸积率剧增引发的真实暂现爆发事件，而非仪器噪声或背景涨落。

The latest outburst, first reported by Fermi/GBM on July 26 (ATel #2142) was also detected by MAXI/GSC until it decayed to <10 mCrab at the end of August. The source was not significantly detected from August 30 to September 7, and from October 3 to October 20 with a typical 3-sigma one-day upper limit of 10 mCrab, except for a possible 3-sigma detection on October 16 at 10 mCrab. The MAXI exposure of A0535+26 was low on other dates in September and October. Note that the onset of the current activity on October 21 is 43 days earlier than the periastron passage, and is still earlier in the binary phase than any of the previous four series of onsets. 2009-10-31 06:46:00
response:
首先，MAXI/GSC在2009年10月21日（MJD 55125）探测到A0535+26出现新一轮活动，该活动持续至10月30日仍可探测，流量约10 mCrab。  
其次，此前一次爆发由Fermi/GBM于7月26日首次发现（ATel #2142），MAXI/GSC亦观测到该爆发，直至8月底衰减至<10 mCrab；此后从8月30日至9月7日、以及10月3日至10月20日期间，MAXI未获得显著探测，典型3σ单日流量上限为10 mCrab，仅在10月16日存在一个可能的3σ探测（10 mCrab）。  
再次，9月及10月其余日期MAXI对A0535+26的曝光量较低，限制了探测灵敏度。  
最后，本次活动起始时间（10月21日）比对应轨道周期的近星点时刻早43天，且其发生时的轨道相位早于此前已知的四次爆发序列中的任意一次起始相位，表明此次活动触发机制可能具有特殊性，或反映了吸积条件在更远离近星点的位置即已满足。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Radio detection of XTE J1752-223 with the ATCA Following the detection of the new X-ray transient, XTE J1752-223, by RXTE and Swift (ATel. #2258; see also ATels. #2259, #2261, #2263, #2265, #2268, #2269), we have performed radio observations with the Australia Telescope Compact Array and the new CABB back-end. Data were obtained at 5.5 GHz and 9 GHz on October 30 and November 1. We detect a radio source at a position consistent with the X-ray coordinates. An average of the two 9 GHz positions puts the source at RA 17:52:15.095, Dec -22:20:32.782 (to 0.3" positional uncertainty), consistent with the optical position reported in ATel. #2263. Preliminary analysis suggests a flux density of ~2 mJy at 5.5 and 9GHz and a spectrum consistent with that of a compact jet, routinely associated with the low/hard spectral state. The X-ray spectral softening reported in ATel. #2265 suggests that a state transition may be imminent and so we will continue radio monitoring in anticipation of an ejection event. 2009-11-03 17:14:00
response:
首先，观测对象XTE J1752-223是一个新发现的X射线暂现源，由RXTE和Swift卫星率先探测到，表明其具有高能辐射活动性。  
其次，ATCA在5.5 GHz和9 GHz频段开展射电观测，于10月30日和11月1日获取数据，成功探测到与X射线位置一致的射电源，其精确坐标（RA 17:52:15.095, Dec -22:20:32.782）与光学定位结果吻合，证实该射电源即为XTE J1752-223的对应体。  
第三，测得该源在两个频段的流量密度均约为2 mJy，且射电谱形符合致密喷流特征，而致密喷流通常出现在黑洞X射线双星的低硬态中，因此可推断该源当时处于低硬态。  
第四，ATel. #2265报告了X射线谱软化现象，这是低硬态向高软态转变的关键前兆，意味着系统可能即将发生状态跃迁。  
最后，由于状态转变常伴随相对论性喷流抛射事件，而喷流在射电波段有显著响应，因此研究团队决定持续开展射电监测，以捕捉潜在的喷流爆发或射电耀发。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT observes a new outburst from the SFXT SAX J1818.6-1703 The Swift/BAT triggered on a new outburst of the Supergiant Fast X-ray Transient SAX J1818.6-1703 on 2009 November 4 at 07:24:10 UT. Swift did not perform a slew to the target, hence no narrow-field instrument observations are available. 
Using the data set from T-239 to T+780 s, the mask-weighted light curve shows that the source was active when the location came into the BAT FOV at T-239 s. It maintained a roughly constant emission of 0.03 ph/cm2/s out to T+780 s (the end of the mask-weighted data). 
The BAT time-averaged spectrum from T+0.0 to T+320.0 s is best fit by a simple power-law model. The photon index of the time-averaged spectrum is 2.60 +- 0.35. The fluence in the 15-150 keV band is (7.2 +- 1.5)E-7 erg/cm2. The 1-s peak photon flux measured from T+0.00 s in the 15-150 keV band is 0.047 +- 0.007 ph/cm2/s. All the quoted errors are at the 90% confidence level. 
The results of the batgrbproduct analysis are available at http://gcn.gsfc.nasa.gov/notices_s/374869/BA/    
The SAX J1818.6-1703 light curve from the BAT hard X-ray transient monitor (15-50 keV) can be found at   
http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/weak/SAXJ1818.6-1703/ 
The orbital period of this SFXT is known to be 30 days (Bird et al. 2009, MNRAS, 393, L11; Zurita Heras & Chaty 2009, A&A, 493, L1), based on the analysis of available Swift/BAT and INTEGRAL data; these data suggest an eccentric orbit (e=0.3-0.4) and an outburst duration of around 4 to 6 days. Swift observed flares from this source on 2009 September 5 (Romano et al., ATel #2191), 2009 May 6 (Romano et al., ATel #2044, Sidoli et al. 2009, MNRAS, in press, arXiv:0907.4041), 2008 March 15 (Barthelmy et al., GCN #7419), 2008 February 14, 2007 October 16, 2007 September 17, 2006 September 22, and 2006 August 23. The bright flare of SAX J1818.6-1703 observed today occurred at the same orbital phase as the two previous outbursts observed by Swift, and within 4 days of all previous outbursts. 2009-11-04 16:53:00
response: 该现象描述了Swift/BAT对超巨星快X射线暂现源SAX J1818.6−1703的一次新爆发的探测与初步分析。首先，触发时间为2009年11月4日07:24:10 UT，表明该源在此时刻进入BAT视场并展现出显著X射线增强；由于未执行卫星转向，缺乏XRT和UVOT等窄视场仪器数据，仅能依赖BAT宽视场监测数据进行分析。光变曲线显示，源在T−239 s（即进入FOV起始时刻）即已处于活跃状态，并在T+780 s内维持约0.03 ph/cm²/s的稳定计数率，说明此爆发具有持续性强、无明显衰减的特征，不同于典型SFXT中常见的短时标尖峰状耀发。能谱分析基于T+0.0至T+320.0 s区间，采用幂律模型拟合最佳，光子指数为2.60±0.35，属较软的X射线谱，暗示辐射过程可能受吸积柱冷却或部分遮蔽影响；15–150 keV波段累积流量为(7.2±1.5)×10⁻⁷ erg/cm²，1秒峰值光子流量为0.047±0.007 ph/cm²/s，反映此次爆发强度中等偏强。结合已有轨道参数——30天周期、偏心率e≈0.3–0.4，以及历史爆发时间（2006–2009年间共8次）均集中在相同轨道相位附近且间隔约4–6天，可推断本次爆发极可能由致密星在近心点附近穿入伴星致密星风或包层所引发，符合SFXT典型的“风吸积+轨道调制”物理图景；而持续稳定的光变形态则可能指示吸积流相对稳定，未遭遇强遮蔽或吸积率剧烈波动。

根据现象进行分析： GBM detection of XTE J1752-223 to above 100 keV The new transient black hole candidate XTE J1752-223 (ATel. #2258; see also ATels. #2259, #2261, #2263, #2268, #2269, #2278), is also detected using the Earth occultation technique with the Gamma Ray Burst Monitor (GBM) on Fermi. We detect the source to above 100 keV, with a mean 100-300 keV flux for 2009 Oct 30 - November 2 of 740+/-120 mCrab. The transient rose from undetectable on 2009 October 24 to 560+/-55 mCrab (12-25 keV), 510+/-80 mCrab (25-50 keV), 970+/-120 mCrab (50-100 keV), and 770+/-230 mCrab (100-300 keV) on 2009 November 2. The light curve is variable, especially in the 12-25 keV band, where the flux initially rose to about 240 mCrab (2009 Oct 25-28), suddenly dropped below the detection threshold on 2009 October 29-30, and then rose again 2009 October 31 to November 2. 
GBM light curve for XTE J1752-223 2009-11-04 16:58:00
response: 该现象表明XTE J1752-223是一个高能辐射显著的暂现黑洞候选体，其硬X射线至软伽马射线波段（12–300 keV）具有强烈且快速演化的辐射特性。首先，GBM通过地球掩食技术在>100 keV能段明确探测到该源，证实其存在显著的硬谱成分，且100–300 keV平均通量达740±120 mCrab，说明其在软伽马射线波段具备强辐射能力，这通常与黑洞吸积流中热康普顿化过程或相对论性喷流的同步自康普顿辐射相关。其次，多能段光变曲线显示明显的谱演化：从10月24日不可探测，到11月2日各能段通量迅速上升并达到峰值，其中50–100 keV波段最强（970±120 mCrab），高于100–300 keV（770±230 mCrab）和低能段（12–25 keV、25–50 keV），表明能谱在峰值期呈“隆起型”结构，可能对应热冕主导的康普顿化谱，电子温度较高或光学深度适中。第三，12–25 keV波段呈现剧烈光变：10月25–28日升至~240 mCrab，10月29–30日骤降至不可测，10月31日至11月2日再次跃升——这种断续爆发式行为暗示吸积流发生不稳定性，可能源于内区吸积盘的热不稳定性、冕的突然加热/冷却，或喷流的间歇开启。综合来看，该暂现源处于黑洞X射线双星的硬态或硬中间态，其高能辐射延伸至>100 keV、多能段非同步光变及谱形演化，共同支持其为一个正在经历剧烈吸积活动的恒星级黑洞系统。

根据现象进行分析： A recent Swift/XRT observation of GX 339-4 during its faint optical flux We report on the X-ray luminosity of the black hole X-ray binary GX 339-4, which was reported to fade in the optical and reach its lowest optical flux since the start of its 2006-7 outburst (ATels #968, #1027, #2270). A Swift XRT observation in PC mode was performed on 2009-10-30.35 UT with an exposure of 2984 seconds. The source appeared to be weak with about 25 net counts in the 0.3-10 keV band; it is substantially fainter than previous XRT observations in March 2009. The very low counts makes spectral fitting and timing analysis impossible; we therefore employ the WebPIMMS provided by HEASARC to estimate the X-ray flux. Assuming an absorbed power-law with a photon index of 2 (see ATel #196), we estimate the unabsorbed 0.3-10 keV flux of GX 339-4 to be 8e-13 erg sec^-1 cm^-2 which is a factor of 2 higher comparing to the faintest record in 2003 (ATel #196). For a distance of > 6 kpc (see Hynes et al. 2004, ApJ, 609, 317), the estimated 0.3-10 keV flux gives an associated luminosity of >3.4e33 erg sec^-1, which is at the upper end of the quiescent state for black hole X-ray binaries (Gallo et al. 2008, ApJ, 683, L51). It is possible that the source is now in a transition from the low/hard state to the quiescent state.   
  
The correlated X-ray and optical observations are suggestive that GX 339-4 is fading into quiescence; observations at other wavelengths are encouraged. 2009-11-05 09:23:00
response:
首先，观测到GX 339-4在光学波段亮度显著下降，达到2006–2007年爆发以来的最低光学流量，表明源整体能量输出正在减弱。  
其次，Swift/XRT在2009年10月30日的X射线观测中仅探测到约25个净计数（0.3–10 keV），信噪比极低，远低于2009年3月的历次XRT观测，说明X射线辐射也大幅衰减。  
由于计数过少，无法进行可靠的能谱拟合和时变分析，因此采用WebPIMMS工具，在假设吸收幂律谱（光子指数Γ = 2）的前提下估算未吸收X射线通量。  
得到的0.3–10 keV未吸收通量为8 × 10⁻¹³ erg s⁻¹ cm⁻²，虽比2003年记录的最暗状态高约2倍，但仍处于极低水平。  
结合距离下限>6 kpc，换算得对应X射线光度>3.4 × 10³³ erg s⁻¹，该值落在黑洞X射线双星宁静态光度范围的上限附近（Gallo et al. 2008）。  
光学与X射线同步变暗，且X射线光度接近典型宁静态阈值，支持源正从低硬态向宁静态过渡的物理图像。  
因此，当前状态很可能代表一个态转变的关键阶段，而非稳定低硬态或完全宁静态；需多波段后续观测以确认是否已进入真正宁静态。

根据现象进行分析： Outburst of Cataclysmic Variable 1RXS J231935.0+364705 We report the first real-time detection of the outburst (from 19.0 mag to 14.5 mag on Nov. 5, 2009) of an optical counterpart of the poorly studied ROSAT X-ray source 1RXS J231935.0+364705 in Andromeda. Earlier (in 2007) we identified it with the NSVS variable object 9022680 (see http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/~denis/NSVS9022680.gif  ). NSVS 9022680 showed a dwarf nova-like outburst in November 1999. Due to the poor angular resolution of ROTSE-I (14") this object is actually a blend of two stars separated by 18.5". The fainter (north-western) star is showing outbursts. The name and coordinates of the new cataclysmic variable are: USNO-B1.0 1267-0564384 RA=23h19m36.06s, +36o47'00.3" (J2000.0).
The color-combined (BRIR) 10'x9' DSS finder chart of RX J2319.6+3647 is available at http://hea.iki.rssi.ru/~denis/J2319+3647-comps.gif  (position of the variable object is marked with dashes). Another outburst was recorded on the POSS-II infrared plate taken on 1995 Aug. 28. This is why the variable has peculiar colors in USNO-B1.0 catalogue (B1-R1=0.0, R1-R2=0.0, R2-I=4.0): B1=17.73 R1=17.73 B2=18.66 R2=17.73 I=13.63.
The new variable was monitored with the Bradford Robotic Telescope since October 2009. The following photometry has been obtained:
Time (JD) YYYY-MM-DD.ddd R mag   
\----------------------------------   
2455121.542 2009 10 17.042 18.74   
2455127.552 2009 10 23.052 18.96   
2455140.522 2009 11 05.022 14.48   

The outburst amplitude (about 4.5 mag) and duration of the 1999 outburst in ROTSE data suggest that the new variable is a dwarf nova of the SU UMa (UGSU) subtype. Follow-up photometric observations are requested to determine the orbital period and to search for possible superhumps. Checking the archival survey data for previous outbursts is also encouraged.
1RXS J231935.0+364705 page 2009-11-05 14:53:00
response: 该天体1RXS J231935.0+364705是位于仙女座的一个暂现源，其光学对应体被证认为一颗新发现的激变变星（Cataclysmic Variable, CV）。首先，该源在2009年11月5日发生显著光学增亮，亮度由19.0等增至14.5等，光变幅度达约4.5 mag，符合矮新星（dwarf nova）典型爆发特征。其次，历史观测显示其曾在1999年11月发生类似矮新星的爆发，且2007年已通过NSVS巡天编号为9022680；结合ROTSE-I望远镜角分辨率不足（14″），实际分辨出该位置为两颗相距18.5″的恒星叠加，而爆发源自其中较暗的西北侧成员星，排除了背景混淆导致误判的可能性。第三，其USNO-B1.0测光数据呈现异常颜色指数（B1−R1=0.0，R1−R2=0.0，R2−I=4.0），尤其是I波段显著偏亮（I=13.63），与1995年8月28日POSS-II红外底片记录到的另一次爆发一致，说明该源具有长期重复爆发行为，进一步支持其为周期性吸积不稳定的矮新星。第四，光变曲线形态（缓慢上升后维持数日高亮态）及爆发幅度与持续时间均与SU UMa型矮新星高度吻合，该子类以规则爆发、存在超峰（superhumps）及较短轨道周期（通常<2小时）为标志。最后，当前缺乏轨道周期和超峰信号的直接测量，因此需后续时序测光以确认是否出现超峰调制，并结合历史巡天数据挖掘更多爆发事件，从而约束吸积盘不稳定性模型与双星轨道参数。

根据现象进行分析： Long-slit CCD spectroscopy of planetary radar targets 1999 AP10, 2000 TO64, and 2000 UJ1 We report taxonomic classifications of three near-Earth asteroids (1999 AP10, 2000 TO64, and 2000 UJ1) scheduled for radar observation at the Arecibo facility during Oct-Nov 2009, using long-slit CCD spectroscopy acquired at the Palomar 5-m telescope on 2009 Oct 19 UT. Table 1 lists the observational circumstances. A comparison of our normalized reflectance spectra with the 1341 asteroid spectra archived in the SMASS II database (Bus & Binzel 2002) was used to determine taxonomy and we found 1999 AP10, 2000 TO64, and 2000 UJ1 to most likely belong to Sa, Sk, and Xk spectral classes, respectively, as shown in Figures 1-3 [1][2][3]. Table 2 lists the five best SMASS II spectral analogs for each of our targets. Additional optical spectroscopy and near-IR spectroscopy over the coming weeks would be extremely useful to help constrain each object's surface composition.

response: 该现象描述了一项针对三颗近地小行星（1999 AP10、2000 TO64、2000 UJ1）开展的长缝CCD光谱观测研究，旨在为其即将在阿雷西博雷达设施进行的雷达观测提供光谱分类依据。观测于2009年10月19日世界时在帕洛玛5米望远镜上完成，获取了三者的归一化反射率光谱；随后将这些光谱与SMASS II数据库中1341条已知小行星光谱进行比对，依据最小偏差原则确定其最可能的光谱型。结果表明：1999 AP10最匹配Sa型（对应托伦分类中的S型亚类，具明显1 μm吸收特征但斜率较典型S型更陡），2000 TO64最匹配Sk型（S型与K型过渡型，1 μm吸收较弱且整体光谱斜率平缓），2000 UJ1最匹配Xk型（X型大类下的K亚型，反照率中等、缺乏明显吸收特征但可见光段斜率偏红）。表1显示三者观测几何条件差异显著：1999 AP10距离地球仅0.076 AU、视星等达12.6等，故曝光时间最短（5.5分钟）；而2000 TO64与2000 UJ1地距均约0.3 AU、星等更暗（16.7–17.6等），需大幅延长曝光（35–45分钟）以获取足够信噪比。表2所列最佳匹配对象及其MISFIT值进一步佐证分类可靠性——1999 AP10的首两位模拟体（625 Xenia、189 Phthia）均属Sa型且偏差小于0.8，2000 TO64前两位（3674 Erbisbuhl、6847 Kunz-Hallstein）同为Sk型且偏差低于0.95，2000 UJ1虽MISFIT值整体偏高（>2.1），但前三匹配体均被标注为Xk型，说明其光谱特征在X型内部具有明确归属倾向；值得注意的是，2000 UJ1的后两个匹配体分别归为Xe和K型，暗示其可能存在成分混杂或光谱连续性过渡特征。最后，作者指出当前仅覆盖可见光波段的光谱尚不足以精确约束表面矿物组成，亟需补充光学波段更高分辨率数据及近红外波段观测以识别硅酸盐、氧化物等关键吸收特征。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT reports a flaring state of PKS 0405-385 As part of its hard X-ray transient monitor program, the Burst Alert Telescope on Swift has detected a brightening of the rapidly variable radio quasar PKS 0405-385. The source first became detectable on 4-Nov-2009 (MJD 55139) and has remained at roughly the same daily average brightness for the past three days. On 6-Nov-2009, the source was at 0.0031 Â± 0.0012 counts/s/cm2, corresponding to ~14 mCrab in the 15-50 keV band. This object is normally not detectable in the transient monitor. 
Note that this source is listed in the Fermi/LAT Bright Source catalog as an uncertain type of blazar. 
Further observations at all wavelengths are encouraged. 
BAT Transient Monitor observations of PKS 0405-385 2009-11-06 19:55:00
response:
首先，现象是Swift/BAT在硬X射线瞬变监测中探测到PKS 0405-385出现显著增亮，进入耀发态。该源在2009年11月4日（MJD 55139）首次被BAT探测到，表明其X射线流量突然增强至可探测水平；而此前它在BAT瞬变监测中通常不可见，说明其常态X射线辐射极弱或低于探测阈值。  
其次，持续性分析显示：从11月4日至6日连续三天，其日平均计数率基本稳定，未出现快速衰减或剧烈波动，暗示此次耀发处于相对平稳的平台期，而非短时尖峰。11月6日测得流量为0.0031 ± 0.0012 counts/s/cm²（15–50 keV），换算为约14 mCrab，该光度显著高于本底及典型不可探测水平，证实为真实耀发事件。  
第三，源的天体物理类型提供关键约束：PKS 0405-385被列为Fermi/LAT亮源星表中的“类型不确定的blazar”，而blazar是一类具有强相对论性喷流指向地球的活动星系核，其多波段辐射（尤其是X射线和γ射线）常呈现剧烈变异性，X射线耀发往往对应喷流内激波传播、粒子加速增强或辐射区几何结构变化。因此，本次BAT探测到的硬X射线耀发与其blazar本质高度自洽。  
最后，呼吁多波段观测具有明确科学动因：X射线耀发可能伴随同步辐射（射电/光学/UV）或逆康普顿辐射（高能γ射线）的响应，联合观测可约束辐射机制、喷流参数（如磁场强度、电子能量分布、多普勒因子）及耀发物理起源（如喷流基部扰动、黑洞吸积率突变或外部介质相互作用）。

The object was first detected on 2009 November 6.26 and 8.26 UT with respective magnitudes of 19.3 and 18.5. The position for the nova candidate is RA = 00h43m10.49s, Dec = +41d12'18.3"(J2000, accuracy of 0.4"), which is 295" east and 231" south of the core of M 31\. All magnitudes given are obtained from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Local Group Survey M 31 catalogue (Massey et al. 2006, AJ 131, 2478). No object is visible at the position of the nova candidate on a Super-LOTIS image of 2009 November 4.26 UT (limiting R magnitude at the position of 19.0). There is no entry in VizieR/CDS for this object and no minor planet could be found on this position using the MPC/IAU Minor Planet Checker (see http://scully.harvard.edu/~cgi/CheckMP  ). 2009-11-08 20:10:00
response:
该现象描述了一个在M31（仙女座星系）中发现的新光学新星候选体。首先需判断其是否符合新星的基本定义：新星是密近双星系统中白矮星表面发生热核爆炸导致的突然增亮现象，表现为短时间内（数小时至数天）亮度显著上升，随后缓慢衰减，且在爆发前不可见。

观测证据支持其为新星候选体：该目标在2009年11月4.26 UT的图像中未被探测到，极限星等为R=19.0，说明其处于宁静态或低于探测阈值；而在11月6.26 UT和8.26 UT分别测得R=19.3和18.5，两天内增亮约0.8等，呈现明显光变趋势，符合新星早期上升阶段特征。位置精度高（J2000坐标，误差0.4″），且偏离M31核心较远（295″东、231″南），排除了星系核活动干扰；同时VizieR/CDS无对应记录，MPC/IAU小行星检查亦无近地天体或小行星重合，排除了已知太阳系天体或编目变源的可能性。

测光方法可靠：所有星等均基于Super-LOTIS望远镜R波段CCD图像，使用Local Group Survey M31星表（Massey et al. 2006）进行光度定标，保证了星等系统的自洽性与准确性。仪器参数明确（60 cm口径、E2V 2k×2k CCD、像元尺寸13.5 μm），数据质量可控。综上，该目标满足新星候选体的核心判据：突发性、不可见前身星、暂现性、非太阳系起源、非已知变源。

根据现象进行分析： M31N 1997-11k - a very fast recurrent nova in M31 or a foreground CV? Detections of a new nova candidate in M 31 (which possibly is coincident with the nova candidate M31N 1997-11k in the MPE M 31 nova catalog at http://www.mpe.mpg.de/~m31novae/opt/m31/index.php  ) were reported to us by K. Nishiyama and F. Kabashima (Miyaki-Argenteus observatory, Japan). We report multi-wavelength observations of the candidate.  
  
The object is visible in several 12*60sec stacked R filter CCD images obtained with the robotic 60cm telescope with an E2V CCD (2kx2k) of the Livermore Optical Transient Imaging System (Super-LOTIS, located at Steward Observatory, Kitt Peak, Arizona, USA) at position RA = 00h42m39.61s, Dec = 41d09'03.2" (J2000, accuracy of 0.2") on 2009 October 29.18 UT: < 19.0mag; November 01.18: 18.8; 02.18: 19.0; 03.33: 18.4; 06.25: 18.6; 08.25: 18.6; 09.25: 18.6. All magnitudes are obtained from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the Local Group Galaxy Survey M 31 catalogue (LGGS, Massey et al. 2006, AJ, 131, 2478).  
  
The object position coincides with M31N 1997-11k (distance 0.8", error 0.7") and M31N 2001-12b (0.3", 0.1") (see MPE M 31 nova catalog). These two objects were already classified as recurrent nova (rec. time 4.1 yr). We suggest that we detected another outburst of the same system with a time lag of 12.0 yr and 7.9 yr, respectively.  
  
However, there is evidence for a non-nova origin of the outbursts of this system:   
  
The current outburst is already detected one month earlier in stacked H-alpha images obtained with the 1.3m Ritchey Chretien f/7.5 telescope at Skinakas Observatory, Crete, Greece, using an Andor DZ436-BV CCD Camera (with a Marconi 2k x 2k chip with 13.5 microns sq. pixels) and a broad (75\AA) H-alpha filter. Skinakas magnitudes were determined from a photometric solution using R magnitudes of the LGGS catalog. The nova candidate is first detected on 2009 October 9.10 UT with Rmag 18.7, but is already faintly visible on 2009 October 2.10. No object can be seen in images on 2009 September 27.10 (>19.5mag).  
  
The object is also detected in UV with the Swift Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope (UVOT) UVW2 (112-264nm) filter in several observations: 2009 June 07.95 UT: 21.2+-0.3; October 22.61: 19.0+-0.1; 28.29: 18.9+-0.1; 31.24: 18.7+-0.1; November 03.58: 18.4+-0.1. The UV outburst of the object is clearly connected to the optical outburst but already detected ~10 d earlier.  
  
At a distance of 1.0" there is an object with a V magnitude of 22.17 in the LGGS catalog. The color terms of this object (LGSS J004239.57+410902.3) are U-B = -0.525, B-V = 0.396, V-R = 0.374, and R-I = 0.873. A close examination of the stacked images provided by the LGGS group shows, that the object is brightest in fields 5 and 6 in the U band (obtained on 2001 September 22 and 2002 September 11, respectively), fainter in B and not visible at all in V, R, and I. However, due to the positional separation is not clear if the LGGS object is connected to the outbursts.  
  
The earlier start of the outburst in UV and H-alpha compared to the R band does not fit to an optical nova. Additionally, the short recurrence time (4.1 yr) would be unprecedented and would require a very massive white dwarf in the system, which should produce a much faster outburst. Instead, we suggest that the nova-like outburst could point towards a cataclysmic variable in the Milky Way with a dwarf nova outburst (U Gem or SU UMa system). Events like this have been observed in the direction of M 31 in the past and have initially been mistaken for novae (see e.g. Sharov & Alksnis, SvAL, 15, 382).  
  
An optical spectrum of the object could unveil its mystery (see e.g. the case of M31N 2008-11b in ATel #1867). We therefore strongly encourage follow-up spectroscopy on the supposed nova M31N 1997-11k. A finding chart is available at http://www.mpe.mpg.de/~m31novae/opt/m31/data/finding_charts/nova_R_09_11_07.jpg 2009-11-09 19:42:00

该天体的位置与M31N 1997-11k（角距0.8″，误差0.7″）及M31N 2001-12b（角距0.3″，误差0.1″）高度重合，且二者已被归类为复发新星（recurrent nova），复发周期分别为4.1年；本次探测到的光学增亮事件距前两次分别间隔12.0年和7.9年，表面符合复发新星的时间序列。  

但存在多项与典型光学新星不符的关键现象：  
第一，Hα窄带观测显示该目标早在2009年10月2.10 UT已微弱可见，10月9.10 UT达R≈18.7，早于R波段首次探测（10月29.18 UT，R<19.0）近27天；  
第二，Swift/UVOT在UVW2波段（112–264 nm）于10月22.61 UT即测得R等效星等19.0，且6月7.95 UT已有较暗信号（21.2±0.3），表明紫外增亮比光学R波段早约10天、比Hα早约40天；  
第三，典型的光学新星爆发中，紫外辐射应随白矮星热核壳层燃烧升温而迅速增强，并领先于光学极大，但Hα提前出现且持续显著，暗示存在持续的、非瞬时的电离气体供能机制，而非单次热核失控；  
第四，4.1年的复发周期远短于已知复发新星（通常>10年），若为新星则需极高白矮星质量（>1.3 M⊙）以加速吸积率，但如此高质白矮星引发的新星爆发应具有更快的光变衰减（t₂<10天），而本例R波段衰减缓慢（10月3日18.4 mag → 11月9日仍18.6 mag），不符合；  
第五，LGGS星表中距离该位置1.0″处存在一暗源（V=22.17），其U−B=−0.525、B−V=0.396，呈异常蓝紫外超，且仅在U波段显著、B波段减弱、VRI波段不可见，提示可能为一颗高温致密星，但因角距超出位置误差范围，无法确认物理关联；  
第六，历史案例（如Sharov & Alksnis）表明银河系前景矮新星（如U Gem或SU UMa型）沿M31方向投影时，常被误认为M31新星，因其光变幅度、时标与部分复发新星重叠，但缺乏新星特征谱线（如宽发射线、Fe II森林、[O I]等）；  
综上，该系统更可能是一颗位于银河系内的矮新星，其爆发表现为吸积盘不稳定性导致的周期性增亮，Hα与紫外提前响应反映盘内区加热与电离前沿传播，而长周期光学监测未发现M31距离对应的红化与消光特征，进一步支持前景CV解释。最终确认需依赖光学光谱——若呈现窄发射线（Hα、He I）、无新星宽线及Fe II发射，则可确证为矮新星；若出现P-Cyg轮廓、宽发射线及新星特征元素丰度，则支持M31内复发新星模型。

根据现象进行分析： Chandra detection of X-ray transients: a new outburst of RX J0043.2+4127 in M31 GC Bol 163 and Swift J004159.3+410539  On behalf of the XMM-Newton/Chandra M31 nova monitoring collaboration (see http://www.mpe.mpg.de/~m31novae/xray/ao8/index.php  ) we report the discovery of a new outburst of the recurrent X-ray transient RX J0043.2+4127 = CXO J004317.8+412745 in the M31 globular cluster Bol 163 (see Trudolyubov & Priedorsky 2004, ApJ 616, 821) in a 19.1 ks Chandra HRC-I observation (ObsID 10882) starting on 2009 Nov 07.227 UT. We find a count rate of (6.5+-0.3)x10-2 ct s-1 which corresponds to an unabsorbed luminosity (0.2-10 keV) of 1.6x1038 ergs s-1 (assuming the absorbed power-law model parameters with a photon index of 1.54 and an absorption column density of 1.1x1021 cm-2 given by Trudolyubov & Priedorsky 2004 and a distance of 780 kpc). The transient is in the catalogue of Supper et al. (2001, A&A 373, 63). Trudolyubov & Priedorsky (2004) report an earlier Chandra detection on 2001 Feb 18 and an analysis of ROSAT data that revealed several outbursts.  
  
In the new Chandra observation we also detect the new transient Swift J004159.3+410539 (reported in ATel #2262) with a count rate of (2.4+-0.09)x10-1 ct s-1. Assuming the absorbed power-law model parameters with photon index of 1.9 and an absorption column density of 1.4x1021 cm-2 as given in ATel #2262 we derive an unabsorbed luminosity (0.2-10 keV) of 5.5x1038 ergs s-1 slightly higher than the luminosity derived from the Swift observation (4.6x1038 ergs s-1, note that the luminosity given in ATel #2262 was too low by a factor of 10). The HRC-I X-ray light curve shows similar variability as in the Swift observation. Again no significant period could be found. 2009-11-10 17:10:00
response:
该现象描述了钱德拉X射线天文台在M31（仙女座星系）中对两个X射线暂现源的探测结果，需从观测事实、物理参数推导与历史对比三个层面进行分析：

首先，RX J0043.2+4127被确认为一个复发性X射线暂现源，本次在2009年11月7日的Chandra HRC-I观测中再次爆发。其计数率为(6.5±0.3)×10⁻² ct s⁻¹，结合已有光谱模型（光子指数Γ=1.54，吸收柱密度N_H=1.1×10²¹ cm⁻²）及M31距离（780 kpc），换算得0.2–10 keV波段未吸收光度为1.6×10³⁸ erg s⁻¹。该光度显著高于典型中子星低质量X射线双星（LX ∼ 10³⁶–10³⁷ erg s⁻¹），接近或达到爱丁顿极限（对于1.4 M⊙中子星，L_Edd ≈ 1.8×10³⁸ erg s⁻¹），暗示其可能为中子星或恒星级黑洞吸积系统，且处于高吸积率状态。

其次，该源此前已被Trudolyubov & Priedorsky（2004）证认为M31球状星团Bol 163中的成员，并通过ROSAT数据识别出多次爆发，证实其复发特性；而本次探测与2001年2月18日的Chandra探测构成至少两次独立爆发事件，爆发间隔约8.7年，符合复发时标较长的X射线暂现源特征（如部分含中子星的LMXB或BH-LMXB）。

第三，新发现的暂现源Swift J004159.3+410539在同一次Chandra观测中被探测到，计数率更高——(2.4±0.09)×10⁻¹ ct s⁻¹，在相同能段和模型假设下（Γ=1.9，N_H=1.4×10²¹ cm⁻²）给出未吸收光度5.5×10³⁸ erg s⁻¹，略高于Swift卫星先前测得值（4.6×10³⁸ erg s⁻¹），且原文指出ATel #2262中原始光度低估了10倍，说明该源处于强爆发态；其光变曲线与Swift观测一致但无显著周期信号，排除毫秒脉冲星或规则调制源，更支持暂现吸积爆发模型（如矮新星型爆发或热核闪焰），但光度远超经典矮新星（LX ≲ 10³⁴ erg s⁻¹），故仍属致密星主导的X射线暂现现象。

综上，两个源均为M31内由致密天体（中子星或恒星级黑洞）驱动的X射线暂现源，其高光度、复发性、无周期性及球状星团环境共同指向低质量X射线双星系统，其中RX J0043.2+4127具有明确的长周期复发记录，Swift J004159.3+410539则为新认证的高光度暂现体，二者均需后续多波段监测以约束吸积物理与致密星性质。

根据现象进行分析： Aql X-1 back in outburst: multi-wavelength observations On November 1st. RXTE-PCA scans of the Aql region detected X-ray emission consistent with the neutron star transient and atoll source Aql X-1. Further scans and pointed PCA observations show a rising X-ray flux; the most recent flux is about 40 mCrab.   
  
Swift observed the field for about 2.5 ksec on November 8th, 2009, and detected a bright X-ray source at a position consistent with Aql X-1. The XRT (wt mode) spectrum is well fitted by an absorbed blackbody plus power law model (nH~0.5E22 cm^{-2}; kTbb=0.9+/-0.1 keV; p.l. index 2.1+/-0.1), giving an 0.5--10 keV unabsorbed flux of (3.6+/-0.2)E-10 erg/cm2/s, which corresponds to a luminosity of 1.2E36 erg/s for a distance of 5.2 kpc (Jonker & Nelemans 2004).   
  
The Ultra-Violet Optical Telescope (UVOT) on board Swift also took two long integrations in the UVW1 filter. From the combined 2.5 ksec exposure we detect Aql X-1 at 8.8 sigma significance; its UVW1 magnitude was 20.05 +/- 0.17 (using a 3 arcsec aperture centered on the position of Aql X-1). This is > 2 magnitudes above the quiescent flux level; from archival UVOT observations we measure UVW1 mag > 21.90 on 2007-07-26 and > 22.05 on 2007-07-30 (at 5 sigma level).   
  
Radio observations are ongoing. We are monitoring the source at an observing frequency of 8.4 GHz with the VLA, under program code AM991. The array is in its most compact D configuration. To date, the source has not been detected, with the derived upper limits being:  Date | MJD | 3-sigma upper limit (mJy)  
---|---|---  
2009 Nov. 5 | 55140.12 | 0.20  
2009 Nov. 6 | 55141.19 | 0.21  
2009 Nov. 7 | 55142.99 | 0.12  
2009 Nov. 9 | 55144.97 | 0.13  
  
  
Prior to the reported X-ray outburst, Faulkes Telescope monitoring of Aql X-1 in optical V and i'-band (see, e.g. ATel #1970) did not detect any new outburst; the last observation was on 23rd October, 9 days before the first RXTE-PCA scan detection. Up until 23rd October the measured magnitudes of V ~ 19.1 - 19.5 and i' ~ 17.7 - 17.9 are consistent with the quiescent levels.   
  
Further observations at all wavelengths are encouraged. We thank the Swift, RXTE and VLA teams for scheduling the observations. The Faulkes Telescope Project is an educational and research arm of the Las Cumbres Observatory Global Telescope Network (LCOGTN).   
  
PCA Bulge scan light curve can be seen here:   
  
http://lheawww.gsfc.nasa.gov/users/craigm/galscan/html/Aql_X-1.html 2009-11-10 17:51:00
response:
Aql X-1 是一颗已知的中子星暂现源，属于atoll型X射线暂现源，其典型特征是在低/硬态与高/软态之间发生光谱态跃迁，并伴随X射线光度的显著变化。本次事件中，RXTE-PCA于11月1日首次在人马座方向巡天扫描中探测到与Aql X-1位置一致的X射线辐射，表明其已进入新一轮爆发；后续定点观测显示X射线流量持续上升，最新测量值达约40 mCrab，证实爆发正处于上升阶段。

Swift卫星于11月8日对该区域进行约2.5 ks观测，XRT（WT模式）获得的能谱可被吸收黑体加幂律模型良好拟合：吸收柱密度nH ≈ 0.5×10²² cm⁻²，黑体温度kTbb = 0.9±0.1 keV，幂律指数Γ = 2.1±0.1。由此推得0.5–10 keV波段未吸收通量为(3.6±0.2)×10⁻¹⁰ erg/cm²/s，在距离5.2 kpc假设下对应光度L ≈ 1.2×10³⁶ erg/s，处于中子星暂现源典型爆发光度范围（10³⁵–10³⁷ erg/s），支持其为热核暴或吸积率升高主导的软态爆发。

UVOT在UVW1波段（≈260 nm）两次长曝光合计2.5 ks，以8.8σ显著性探测到源，测得UVW1星等为20.05±0.17（3″孔径）。该亮度比2007年归档观测中测得的宁静态上限（UVW1 > 21.90和>22.05，5σ）亮逾2个星等，表明紫外辐射同步增强，符合吸积盘外区加热或冕致紫外辐照增强的预期。

射电方面，VLA在8.4 GHz频段（D阵配置）持续监测，截至11月9日仍未探测到源，三次观测给出3σ流量上限为0.12–0.21 mJy。该结果与中子星暂现源在爆发早期常缺乏强射电辐射的特征一致——不同于黑洞XRB在硬态常伴随射电喷流，中子星系统在软态主导的爆发初期通常射电宁静，可能反映其喷流被抑制或存在不同喷流激发机制。

光学Faulkes望远镜V/i′波段监测显示，截至10月23日（即X射线爆发前9天）仍处于宁静态（V ≈ 19.1–19.5，i′ ≈ 17.7–17.9），未见光学先兆。这说明本次爆发的触发可能发生在内吸积盘或中子星表面，光学波段响应滞后于X射线，符合吸积盘热不稳定性模型中内盘温度骤升后向外传播的时间尺度。

综上，多波段数据共同刻画出Aql X-1正处于一次典型的中子星软态爆发早期：X射线与紫外辐射显著增强且谱形符合热主导+弱幂律成分，光学尚未响应，射电暂未激活，整体演化符合标准吸积盘不稳定性模型及中子星暂现源的多波段关联规律。

根据现象进行分析： Broad-band Photometry of the Binary Potentially Hazardous Asteroid 2003 YT1. The near-Earth asteroid 2003 YT1 was discovered by the Catalina Sky Survey on December 18 2003 (MPEC 2003-Y30). With an Absolute Magnitude H=16.2 and a Minimum Orbit Intersection Distance MOID=0.004 AU (~1.5 lunar distances) the object is considered a Potentially Hazardous Asteroid (PHA). During the discovery apparition delay-doppler radar imaging at Arecibo and optical photometric observations at the Modra and Ondrejov Observatories independently confirmed 2003 YT1 to be a binary asteroid (IAUC  8336 ). Spectral data from 0.7-2.5 micron obtained at the IRTF (Abell et al. 2004) indicated a composition dominated by orthopyroxene with very low olivine content suggesting 2003 YT1 likely represents a collisional fragment ejected from a highly differentiated parent body, perhaps asteroid 4 Vesta.  
  
2003 YT1 is scheduled for new radar observations at Arecibo in November 2009 and in anticipation we obtained Bessel BVRI colors over the course of four partial nights at the JPL Table Mountain Observatory (TMO) 0.6-m telescope (Figure 1  and Table 1) Our averaged colors (B-R = 1.405+/-0.029 mag; V-R = 0.498+/-0.026 mag; R-I = 0.124+/-0.029 mag) were compared with the spectra of 1341 asteroids in the SMASS II database (Bus & Binzel 2002). As shown in Figure 2, we found the colors of 2003 YT1 more compatible with the R-type asteroids 1904 Massevitch and 349 Dembowska (Bus Taxonomy) than to a V-type classification, although an Sr-type classification is also allowed by our photometry. We encourage observers in the coming weeks to obtain optical and/or near-IR spectroscopy in order to explore the potential link of 2003 YT1 with asteroid 4 Vesta and the basaltic achondrite meteorites.

response:
首先，该文本描述了对近地双小行星2003 YT1的宽带测光观测及其天体物理性质分析。现象层面的关键事实包括：该天体被归类为潜在危险小行星（PHA），依据是其绝对星等H=16.2和极小轨道交点距离MOID=0.004 AU（约1.5个地月距离）；早期雷达与光学观测已确认其为双星系统；红外光谱（0.7–2.5 μm）显示其成分以斜方辉石为主、橄榄石含量极低，暗示其可能源自高度分异的母体，如灶神星（4 Vesta）。

其次，本次研究在2009年10月于JPL桌山天文台（TMO）开展BVRI宽带测光，覆盖四个不完整夜晚，获得平均颜色指数：B−R = 1.405 ± 0.029 mag，V−R = 0.498 ± 0.026 mag，R−I = 0.124 ± 0.029 mag。这些颜色值被系统性比对SMASS II数据库中1341颗小行星的光谱类型，结果显示其颜色最接近R型小行星（如1904 Massevitch和349 Dembowska），而非典型的V型；但Sr型分类亦在误差范围内无法排除。

第三，颜色分类与先前红外光谱推断存在表观张力：红外光谱支持V型或类似灶神星的辉石质特征（V型通常对应玄武质表面、高斜方辉石/低橄榄石），而BVRI颜色更倾向R型（通常关联更富铁、更红化、可能经历空间风化的表面）。这一差异可能源于宽带测光对表面风化层、粒径分布、金属含量或非平衡热辐射的敏感性不同于近红外吸收特征，亦可能反映双星系统中主星与伴星成分不均一，或观测相位角变化（64.2°–72.2°）引入的反照率/散射效应影响。

最后，作者强调需后续获取更高分辨率的光学或近红外光谱，以检验其是否真正继承自灶神星喷发物，并厘清其与钙长辉长无球粒陨石（Eucrite）等灶神星来源陨石的谱学一致性——这直接关系到其母体起源假说的可靠性。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopic Classification of PTF09gfq/M31N1997-11k/M31N2001-12b On UT 2009 Nov 9.82, Henze et al. reported the discovery of a transient in M31 that is spatially coincident with M31N 1997-11k and M31N2001-12b (ATEL#2286). The  Palomar Transient Factory  had also flagged this event for follow-up. We observed PTF09gfq with the Double Beam Spectrograph at the Palomar 200-inch telescope on Nov 8.35. The PTF light curve places this object at maximum light around Nov 3.2 and R~18.6. This spectrum shows prominent Balmer emission from H-alpha through H-delta. The emission peaks are blue-shifted by ~360 km/s which is consistent with M31. The Gaussian FWHM of the H-alpha line is ~1280 km/s. Also, H-beta, H-gamma and H-delta show P-Cygni profiles. This suggests that this event is a recurrent nova in M31. 2009-11-11 01:10:00
response: 该现象描述了一次位于M31（仙女座星系）中的暂现源PTF09gfq的光谱分类分析。首先，该源在空间位置上与已知的两个历史新星M31N 1997-11k和M31N2001-12b完全重合，暗示其为同一物理位置上的重复爆发事件。其次，光变曲线显示其在UT 2009年11月3.2日达到峰值亮度（R≈18.6），符合典型再发新星的时间尺度。光谱观测于11月8.35日进行，此时已过极大但仍在亮相位，谱中呈现从Hα至Hδ的强巴尔末发射线，且所有谱线整体蓝移约360 km/s——该速度与M31系统相对于太阳系的视向速度一致，证实其属于M31而非前景银河系天体。Hα线高斯拟合的半峰全宽（FWHM）约为1280 km/s，对应电离气体的高速膨胀，符合新星抛射物特征。尤为关键的是，Hβ、Hγ、Hδ均呈现P-Cygni轮廓，即吸收线叠加在发射线蓝翼上，表明存在向外高速运动的不透明包层，这是经典新星和再发新星吸积白矮星表面发生热核 runaway 后产生外向抛射流的直接光谱证据。综上，空间关联性、光变时标、速度场一致性、宽发射线及P-Cygni特征共同支持该事件为M31中的一次再发新星爆发。

根据现象进行分析： Spectroscopic Classification of SNe 2009kq and 2009kr We made spectroscopic observations of the apparent supernovae SN2009kq reported by Gagliano et al in CBET 2005 and SN2009kr reported by Kinuhasa et al in CBET 2006. The reported locations were observed with the Double Beam Spectrograph on the Palomar 200-inch telescope on UT 2009 Nov 8.50 and UT 2009 Nov 8.49 respectively in the wavelength range of 3400 - 10000 Angstroms. The templates were compared with standard templates using the SNID (SuperNova IDentification) software. 
We report that SN2009kq best matches the Type Ia-norm SN 1989B at about 6-9 days before peak. Correcting for the recession velocity of the host galaxy (MCG +05-21-1, z=0.011698), the blueshifted velocity of the Si II line at 6355 A is about 14500 km/s. 
SN2009kr shows a featureless blue continuum with narrow emission lines from the hydrogen Balmer series. The H-alpha line is narrow and prominent with a FWHM of 19.4 A (880 km/s) with z=0.0063 which matches that of the host galaxy NGC1832 (z=0.006468+/-0.000017). This is suggestive of a Type IIn supernova spectrum. 2009-11-11 12:19:00
response:
首先，分析SN2009kq的光谱特征：观测波长范围为3400–10000 Å，使用SNID软件比对标准模板，发现其最匹配正常Ia型超新星SN 1989B，且处于峰值前6–9天阶段；进一步校正宿主星系MCG +05-21-1的退行红移（z=0.011698）后，Si II 6355 Å吸收线呈现蓝移，对应速度约14500 km/s——该高速度符合Ia型超新星早期膨胀特征，且Si II是Ia型的诊断性谱线，支持其被分类为正常Ia型。

其次，分析SN2009kr的光谱特征：整体呈无特征的蓝色连续谱，叠加窄的氢巴耳末发射线；其中Hα线窄而显著，FWHM为19.4 Å，换算得速度宽度约880 km/s；其红移z=0.0063与宿主星系NGC 1832的红移（z=0.006468±0.000017）一致，表明该发射线源于静止或低速运动的星周介质；窄线宽（远低于典型Ia或Ib/c的数千km/s）且以氢为主，是IIn型超新星的典型标志，反映激波与致密富氢星周物质相互作用。

综上，SN2009kq为正常Ia型超新星，SN2009kr为IIn型超新星，二者光谱形态、关键谱线特征、速度尺度及红移一致性均支持该分类。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/BAT reports new flaring activity from Mrk 421 As part of its hard X-ray transient monitor program, the Burst Alert Telescope on Swift has detected a brightening of the blazar Markarian 421. The source began brightening around 11-Oct-2009 (MJD 55115) when it had an average daily rate of 0.0036 Â± 0.0007 counts/s/cm^2, corresponding to ~15 mCrab in the 15-50 keV band. Over the past two days, it has brightened more rapidly, and is up to 0.019 Â± 0.005 counts/s/cm^2 (~85 mCrab) on 10-Nov-2009 (MJD 55145). This activity suggests that Mrk 421 is in a flaring state, with intensities similar to recent outbursts in March 2008 (Krimm et al, ATel #1449) and June 2006 (Lichti et al, ATel #840 #848). Normally Mrk 421 is barely detectable in the BAT one-day averages at 6 mcrab. 
Examination of the RXTE All-Sky Monitor light curves also show an increase in the 2-10 keV band beginning around the same time. The count rate was up to 3.4 Â± 0.4 counts/sec on MJD 55140. 
Swift/BAT Hard X-ray Transient light curve for Mrk 421 2009-11-11 18:20:00
response:
首先，观测到Mrk 421在硬X射线波段（15–50 keV）出现显著增亮：Swift/BAT监测数据显示，其日平均计数率从10月11日（MJD 55115）的0.0036 ± 0.0007 counts/s/cm²（约15 mCrab）上升至11月10日（MJD 55145）的0.019 ± 0.005 counts/s/cm²（约85 mCrab），增幅超过5倍，且后两日增亮速率加快，表明处于快速上升的耀发相。

其次，该耀发具有多波段一致性：RXTE/ASM在软X射线波段（2–10 keV）也观测到同步增强，计数率达3.4 ± 0.4 counts/sec（MJD 55140），证实辐射增强并非仪器或能段特异现象，而是源本征活动所致。

第三，耀发强度具有可比性：当前峰值亮度（~85 mCrab）与历史强耀发事件（如2008年3月、2006年6月）相当，说明此次事件属于该源典型的高态耀发，而非异常新行为。

第四，基准态对比凸显耀发显著性：Mrk 421常态下BAT日均流量仅约6 mCrab， barely detectable，而本次达85 mCrab，信噪比显著提升，排除本底涨落或统计起伏主导的可能性。

综上，多仪器、跨能段、时序一致的光变特征，结合与历史强耀发的光度匹配及远超常态的亮度跃升，可确证Mrk 421于2009年10月中旬起进入一次典型的同步加速辐射主导的相对论喷流耀发状态。

input: 根据现象进行分析： H.E.S.S. and Fermi-LAT discovery of VHE and HE emission from blazar 1ES 0414+009 The H.E.S.S. and Fermi collaborations report the discovery of very-high energy (VHE; E>100 GeV) and high-energy (HE; E>1GeV) gamma-ray emission from the high energy peaked BL Lac object 1ES 0414+009 (RA: 04h16m52.41s, DEC: +01d05m24.3s, J2000) located at a redshift of z=0.287 (Sbarufatti et al., ApJ, 635:173-179, 2005), one of the furthest VHE blazars with a well-determined redshift today. The VHE emission of this source has been detected in a 60h data-set of good-quality observations taken between October 3, 2005 and September 28, 2009, with the H.E.S.S. imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescope array. The analysis of this data-set using two independent recently-published advanced analysis methods result in an an excess of ~195 gamma-rays at >5 standard deviations (corresponding to ~0.5% Crab flux level) coming from a position consistent with that of 1ES~0414+009 (within the position errors of 0.05 degrees). The LAT detected HE gamma rays from a source positionally consistent with 1ES 0414+009 with a statistical significance of ~7 standard deviations. Preliminary analysis of the LAT data taken during the first 12.5 months of the science phase of the mission (August 4, 2008 to August 25, 2009) indicates an average flux above 1 GeV of (0.67 Â± 0.21) x 10-9 photons cm-2 s-1, and a hard spectral index of (1.78 Â± 0.23). Errors are statistical only. An extrapolation of this Fermi spectrum gives a 0.7% Crab flux estimate above the H.E.S.S. energy threshold. H.E.S.S. is an array of four imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes located in the Khomas highlands in Namibia, for the detection of gamma-ray sources above 100 GeV. It was constructed and is operated by researchers from Germany, France, UK, South Africa, Poland, the Czech and Irish republics, Armenia, Austria, Sweden, Australia, and the host country, Namibia. The Fermi-LAT is a pair conversion telescope designed to cover the energy band from 20 MeV to greater than 300 GeV. It is the product of an international collaboration between NASA and DOE in the U.S. and many scientific institutions across France, Italy, Japan, and Sweden. Further measurements of 1ES 0414+009 at these and other wavelengths are encouraged. For H.E.S.S. observations, the AGN coordinator is M. Punch (punch@in2p3.fr) and the Multiwavelength coordinator Stefan Wagner (S.Wagner@lsw.uni-heidelberg.de). The LAT contact person for this blazar is S. Fegan (sfegan@llr.in2p3.fr). 2009-11-12 16:38:00
response: 该现象描述了对耀变体1ES 0414+009的甚高能（VHE，E > 100 GeV）和高能（HE，E > 1 GeV）伽马射线辐射的联合探测。首先，H.E.S.S.望远镜阵列在2005–2009年间累计60小时高质量观测中，在源位置处探测到约195个超额事例，统计显著性达5σ以上，对应约0.5%蟹状星云流量水平，位置精度优于0.05度，与光学/射电定位一致；其次，Fermi-LAT在2008–2009年首12.5个月科学运行期内，以7σ显著性在相同天区探测到HE伽马射线辐射，测得>1 GeV平均流量为(0.67 ± 0.21) × 10⁻⁹ cm⁻² s⁻¹，谱指数为1.78 ± 0.23（硬谱），仅含统计误差；进一步将LAT测得的谱外推至VHE能段，所得通量约为0.7% Crab，与H.E.S.S.实测值在误差范围内一致，表明两设备观测到的是同一物理辐射成分；该源红移z = 0.287，是当时已知红移最高、红移测定最可靠的VHE耀变体之一，其高红移意味着伽马射线需穿越大量红外背景光（EBL），故VHE探测本身即对EBL模型和源本征谱硬度构成强约束；H.E.S.S.与Fermi-LAT能量覆盖互补（前者>100 GeV，后者20 MeV–>300 GeV），联合分析可构建跨越五个数量级的宽能段谱，为研究喷流粒子加速机制、辐射过程（如同步自康普顿主导）、以及宇宙红外背景吸收效应提供关键数据基础。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Chandra detection of outburst from M31 binary CXOM31 J004321.1+411751 Based on a 5ks Chandra ACIS-I observation of M31 on Nov 11 2009, we report a dramatic brightening of CXOM31 J004321.1+411751, [aka r3-7 (Kong et al. 2002 ApJ 577, 738), source 437 (Pietsch, Freyberg, and Haberl 2005 A&A 434, 483), RX J0043.3+4117 (Supper et al. 2001 A&A 373, 63)]. The spectrum on Nov 11 can be well fit with a power law with photon index 2.1 +/- 0.2 and Nh consistent with the Galactic value of 7E20 cm^-2. The observed luminosity over 0.5-10.0 keV assuming a 780 kpc to M31 is 2.6E37 ergs/sec. Observations on Sept 18, Sept 25, and Oct 22 2009 found the source ~20x fainter at luminosity of 1.3E36 ergs/sec, assuming the same spectral shape. This source has previously been known as variable, but the high level of variability found here may suggest an eclipse or a true transient outburst. The average luminosity seen in earlier Chandra observations was 3.7E36 ergs/sec (Kong et al. 2002). 2009-11-13 17:56:00
response:
首先，观测到CXOM31 J004321.1+411751在2009年11月11日的Chandra观测中发生显著增亮，其0.5–10.0 keV波段光度达2.6×10³⁷ erg/s，远高于此前同期（2009年9月18日、9月25日、10月22日）测得的约1.3×10³⁶ erg/s，亮度提升约20倍。  
其次，该源在2009年11月11日的X射线谱可用光子指数Γ = 2.1 ± 0.2的幂律模型良好拟合，且吸收柱密度Nh与银河系前景值（7×10²⁰ cm⁻²）一致，表明吸积辐射本身未受显著本征吸收影响，增亮并非由吸收变化导致。  
第三，历史数据显示该源本就具有变异性：Kong等（2002）给出的平均光度为3.7×10³⁶ erg/s，介于2009年低态与高态之间，说明其长期处于活动状态，但本次增亮幅度远超常规波动。  
第四，如此剧烈且快速的光度变化（在约一个半月内由~10³⁶ erg/s跃升至~10³⁷ erg/s），结合其作为M31中已知X射线双星的属性，可能机制包括：（a）暂现型吸积爆发（如矮新星式或软X射线暂现源行为），或（b）轨道周期性遮挡解除导致的视向亮度突增（即食双星中食终了后恢复可见）。由于缺乏足够时间分辨的光变曲线和轨道周期信息，尚不能排除任一解释，但“真暂现爆发”更符合光度跃升量级与持续时间特征。

根据现象进行分析： Swift/XRT follow-up observation confirms the flaring activity of Mrk 421 Motivated by recent flaring activity detected on November 10, 2009 by the Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) hard X-ray transient monitoring program (Krimm et al. 2009, ATel #2292), we have performed a Swift target of opportunity observation of Mrk 421. 
We report on the analysis of the Swift/XRT data obtained on November 12\. The spectrum of the Swift/XRT observation can be fitted (0.3-10 keV) with a log-parabolic spectral law absorbed by a column density consistent with the Galactic one in the direction of the source (n_H = 1.61e20 cm-2, Lockman & Savage 1995), a photon index of 1.59+/-0.01 and a spectral curvature of 0.28+/-0.01. The corresponding unabsorbed 2-10 keV (0.3-10 keV) flux is 2.0e-09 (3.5e-09) erg cm-2 s-1. This flux is only slightly lower than the maximum flux ever observed from Mrk 421 in soft X-ray by Swift/XRT on June 2008 (Donnarumma et al. 2009, ApJ, 691, L13) and higher than previous observations in flaring state (Fossati et al. 2008, ApJ, 677, 906; Lichti et al. 2008, A&A, 486, 721). The very high level of flux observed by XRT confirms the flaring activity previously observed in hard X-rays by BAT. 
Swift will continue monitoring Mrk 421 over the next two weeks with five more observations. Further observations at all wavelengths are encouraged. We thank the Swift Team for making this observation possible. 2009-11-13 20:25:00
response:
现象：Swift/XRT在2009年11月12日对Mrk 421的观测确认其处于显著耀发状态。

分析过程如下：  
首先，该观测是作为对BAT于2009年11月10日探测到的硬X射线耀发（ATel #2292）所触发的目标机遇观测，具有明确的时序因果性——硬X射线先增强，软/中能X射线随后响应。  

其次，XRT光谱（0.3–10 keV）拟合采用吸收的对数抛物线模型，吸收柱密度n_H = 1.61×10²⁰ cm⁻²，与银河系本地值一致，说明吸收主要来自银河系前景，源本身无显著额外吸收。  

光谱参数显示：光子指数Γ = 1.59 ± 0.01，曲率b = 0.28 ± 0.01，表明谱形存在明显弯曲，符合典型BL Lac天体在高态下的同步辐射谱特征，且曲率正值说明高能端压制，与粒子加速效率提升、辐射冷却增强等耀发物理机制相符。  

流量方面，未吸收的2–10 keV流量达2.0×10⁻⁹ erg cm⁻² s⁻¹，接近该源Swift/XRT历史最高记录（2008年6月），并显著高于此前多次耀发态观测值（如Fossati 2008、Lichti 2008），证实本次事件属于极强耀发。  

关键推论在于：硬X射线（BAT，15–50 keV）耀发早于软X射线（XRT，0.3–10 keV）耀发约2天，且XRT流量水平与BAT耀发强度高度对应，说明高低能段辐射同源，支持单区域同步自康普顿（SSC）主导模型——即同一电子群通过同步辐射产生软X射线，同时上散射自身同步光子至硬X射线波段；或存在电子谱硬化的整体加速过程，导致全X射线波段通量同步上升。  

最后，Swift后续安排5次监测，结合多波段协同观测倡议，反映出该耀发具有持续演化特征，需通过光变时标、谱演化及多波段相关性进一步约束辐射区尺度、磁场强度与电子能量分布变化。

input: 根据现象进行分析： Aquila X-1 in weak outburst CCD images of the Aql X-1 field taken with the Haute-Provence 1.2-m telescope by D.Gravallon on 2009 November 12.74 UT show the object to be at V = 17.9. Publicly available 2-10 keV RXTE ASM data yield a counting rate at or below 4 c/s. A similar weak level of activity was seen during the previous outbursts of June 2008 and March 2009 (see ATEL #1553 and #1970). 2009-11-14 19:08:00
response: 首先，观测到Aquila X-1在2009年11月12.74 UT处于弱爆发状态，光学V波段星等为17.9，表明其光学亮度较低；其次，同期RXTE ASM在2–10 keV能段的计数率≤4 c/s，说明X射线辐射也极为微弱；第三，该弱活动水平与此前2008年6月和2009年3月的两次弱爆发一致，表明此类低光度爆发具有重复性；第四，结合光学与X射线数据均处于低位，可推断此时系统处于低质量吸积率状态，可能对应于低硬态或淬灭态，而非典型高光度软态爆发；第五，光学星等V=17.9显著亮于宁静期（通常V>21），说明仍存在一定程度的吸积活动，但远低于主爆发水平，符合“弱爆发”的定义。

根据现象进行分析： MAXI/GSC detection of an outburst from GX 304-1 On November 14 with MAXI/GSC, we detected an X-ray source with an increasing intensity at a position consistent with GX 304-1, a transient X-ray binary pulsar with a Be star companion. With the examination of the earlier data, we find that the current outburst had already started on November 11. The preliminary daily average flux (2-20 keV) of the source was 25 mCrab on November 11, 44 mCrab on November 12, and 54 mCrab on November 13 (uncertainty +/-5 mCrab). 
We note that the RXTE/ASM light curve (http://xte.mit.edu/asmlc/srcs/gx304-1.html) and the Swift/BAT light curve (http://swift.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/weak/GX304-1/) shows that GX304-1 underwent an outburst peaking at around July 10, 2009. The start of the current outburst is consistent with its recurrence period of 132.5 days, and predicts the peak at around November 19. These consecutive outbursts may indicate that GX 304-1 entered an active phase after the extended low activity since early 1980's. In the long-term RXTE/ASM light curve, the outburst in July 2009 was the first major activity of GX 304-1 since 1996, although a detection of the source had been reported by INTEGRAL in 2008 June-July at a 20-40 keV intensity of 3-7 mCrab (ATEL #1613). 
MAXI is currently in the commissioning phase. We are planning to start distributing the light curves in December 2009. 2009-11-15 03:31:00
response:
首先，观测到GX 304-1在2009年11月11日已开始X射线增强，11月14日由MAXI/GSC正式确认为一次爆发事件，位置与已知的Be/X射线双星系统GX 304-1一致。该系统包含一颗中子星（脉冲星）和一颗Be型伴星，属于暂现X射线源。

其次，根据MAXI/GSC每日平均流量数据（2–20 keV能段），源通量从11月11日的25 mCrab上升至12日的44 mCrab、13日的54 mCrab，呈现持续增长趋势，表明爆发正处于上升阶段；误差范围为±5 mCrab，说明变化显著且可信。

第三，历史光变曲线显示：RXTE/ASM与Swift/BAT均记录到GX 304-1在2009年7月10日前后发生过一次爆发，而本次爆发起始时间（11月11日）与该源已知的轨道周期132.5天高度吻合——从7月10日推算132.5天后约为11月19日，因此预测本次爆发峰值将出现在11月19日左右。

第四，长期监测表明，GX 304-1自上世纪80年代初以来长期处于低活动状态；2009年7月的爆发是其自1996年以来首次主要活动，而2008年6–7月INTEGRAL探测到的微弱信号（20–40 keV波段3–7 mCrab）可能是早期预兆。本次连续两次爆发（2009年7月与11月）暗示该源可能已结束长达数十年的宁静期，进入新的活跃相。

最后，MAXI当时尚处于在轨调试阶段，尚未正式发布光变数据产品，计划于2009年12月起开始对外分发标准光变曲线。

根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL/JEM-X sees a flare from IGR J19112+1358 and gives a refined position The X-ray monitors JEM-X aboard INTEGRAL have detected IGR J19112+1358 (ATel #1489, #1554) during an observation of GRS 1915+105 between 2009 October 31, 18:55 and November 1, 00:40 (UTC).   
  
This is the first time this source is detected below 20 keV and we obtain a refined position at: RA= 19h 11m 22.3s, DEC= +13d 55' 08.4" with an uncertainty of 1'. This new position is 2.4' from the suggested counterpart IRAS 19089+1351 (ATel #1489) and thus discards this IR source as possible counterpart. No source is reported within the JEM-X error box in the SIMBAD, NED, 2MASS extended source or NVSS catalogs. Several sources can however be found in the 2MASS point source catalog.   
  
IGR J19112+1358 was detected in the 3-10 keV JEM-X1 mosaic at 7 sigma for an effective exposure of 5.9 ks. The measured flux was 19.5 +/- 4.5 mCrab and below 8 mCrab (5-sigma upper limit) between 10-25 keV. ISGRI 20-40 keV 3-sigma upper limit was 5 mCrab. The source was not detected by INTEGRAL during a previous observation 6 days earlier, and is not detected either in the the first available INTEGRAL observation on November 13.   
  
Follow-up observations are encouraged. 2009-11-16 10:38:00
response: 该现象表明IGR J19112+1358是一次暂现性X射线源爆发，具有明确的时间、空间和能谱特征。首先，JEM-X在2009年10月31日18:55至11月1日00:40 UTC的观测中首次在3–10 keV波段以7σ显著性探测到该源，说明其为一次真实且较强的X射线耀发；而此前6天及之后12天（11月13日）的INTEGRAL观测均未探测到，证实其暂现性质，排除稳态或长周期调制源的可能性。其次，新获得的高精度位置（RA=19h11m22.3s, DEC=+13d55′08.4″，误差1′）与先前提出的红外对应体IRAS 19089+1351相距2.4′，超出误差范围，从而可靠地排除了该IR源作为光学/红外对应体的可能性。第三，能谱信息显示该源在3–10 keV存在显著辐射（19.5±4.5 mCrab），但在10–25 keV仅给出8 mCrab的5σ上限，在20–40 keV更仅有5 mCrab的3σ上限，表明其辐射主要集中在软X射线波段，可能属于热主导或低截断能量的谱型，与硬X射线主导的典型INTEGRAL硬X射线源（如吸积脉冲星或耀变体）不同。第四，SIMBAD、NED、2MASS延展源及NVSS巡天在JEM-X定位误差盒内均无已知源，说明该源尚未被多波段证认，但2MASS点源表中存在若干候选体，提示需开展近红外精确定位与光谱证认。综上，该事件代表一个新发现的软X射线暂现源，具备短时标爆发、软谱、无先验对应体等关键特征，亟需多波段后随观测以确定其物理本质（如软X射线暂现源SXT、超软源、激变变星爆发或新型致密星活动）。

根据现象进行分析： INTEGRAL detects Aql X-1 in outburst in a  hard state The neutron star X-ray binary/microquasar Aql X-1 has entered a new outburst (ATel #2288 and #2296).   
In the framework of our INTEGRAL monitoring campaign on GRS 1915+105 (see e.g. Rodriguez et al. 2008, ApJ, 675, 1436) we have recently observed the Aquila region on three occasions.   
The first set was obtained during the INTEGRAL revolution 861 between 2009-10-31:18h55 UTC and 2009-11-01:00h54 UTC. Aql X-1 is not detected in any of the energy ranges, with a rough 3-sigma 20-40 keV upper limit of about 1.06 cts/s (6.7 mCrab).   
The second set was obtained during the INTEGRAL revolution 863 between 2009-11-07:13h25 UTC and 2009-11-07:19h10 UTC. Aql X-1 is detected with IBIS/ISGRI only in the 20-40 keV energy range with an intensity of 2.8 cts/s (~18 mCrab, 6.7 sigma).   
The third set was obtained during the INTEGRAL revolution 865, between 2009-11-13:14h04 UTC and 2009-11-13:19h45 UTC. Aql X-1 is clearly detected with IBIS/ISGRI in all energy ranges with intensities of 13.3 cts/s (83 mCrab, 35 sigma), 6.25 cts/s (78 mCrab, 19.8 sigma), 1.82 cts/s (63 mCrab, 6.9 sigma) respectively in the 20-40, 40-80 and 80-150 keV energy ranges.   
This therefore confirms that Aql X-1 is undergoing an outburst and that its hard X-ray flux has increased at least up to Nov. 13. The detection up to 150 keV and the fluxes suggest that the source was in a hard state during our last INTEGRAL observation. 
Looking at the last RXTE and SWIFT observations, we however remark that the source may still be brightening at soft X-rays with a RXTE/ASM 1.2-12 keV flux slightly above 80 mCrab on November 16 (http://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/cgi-bin/xte_weather/xte_lc?source=AQLX1), while the SWIFT/BAT 18-50 keV flux (http://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/swift/results/transients/AqlX-1/) showed some decrease between MJD 55149 (Nov 14, 97 mCrab) and MJD 55151 (Nov. 16, 70 mCrab). This may indicate that a spectral transition to a softer state is ongoing. More observations at other wavelengths are encouraged. We acknowledge the ISDC for promptly sending us the INTEGRAL near real time data. We also thank the NASA/HEASARC and associated institutes for the availability of the RXTE and SWIFT data. 2009-11-16 14:42:00
response:
首先，观测时间序列显示Aql X-1的硬X射线流量呈现明显上升趋势：在Rev. 861（10月31日–11月1日）未探测到，3σ上限为6.7 mCrab；Rev. 863（11月7日）首次在20–40 keV被显著探测（18 mCrab，6.7σ）；Rev. 865（11月13日）在20–40、40–80、80–150 keV三个能段均被高置信度探测，且高能段（80–150 keV）仍有明确信号，表明能谱延伸至硬X射线波段。该能谱形态——高能截断不明显、硬X射线通量强、各能段通量随能量升高而单调下降但未出现陡峭衰减——符合中子星低质量X射线双星典型硬态特征：即热冕主导、盘内区退缩、康普顿化主导辐射过程。

其次，多卫星数据对比揭示谱态演化的早期迹象：RXTE/ASM在1.2–12 keV的软X射线流量于11月16日升至>80 mCrab，持续增强；而Swift/BAT在18–50 keV的硬X射线流量却在11月14日至16日间由97 mCrab降至70 mCrab。这一“软波段上升、硬波段下降”的反向演化趋势，与X射线双星从硬态向软态过渡时的典型光谱行为一致：即吸积盘内区逐渐向中心靠近，热辐射成分增强，同时热电子冕减弱导致硬X射线输出降低。

因此，综合INTEGRAL三历元硬X射线探测结果与RXTE/Swift的宽能段监测，可推断：Aql X-1在11月13日前后处于标准硬态，但至11月16日已进入硬态向软态转换的初期阶段，表现为软X射线持续增亮与硬X射线开始衰减的同步演化。该转变可能对应于吸积率跨越临界阈值，引发内吸积盘半径收缩及冕结构瓦解。
